en: PARIS – As the economic crisis deepens and widens, the world has been searching for historical analogies to help us understand what has been happening.
zh: 巴黎-隨著經濟危機不斷加深和蔓延，整個世界一直在尋找歷史上的類似事件希望有助於我們瞭解目前正在發生的情況。

en: At the start of the crisis, many people likened it to 1982 or 1973, which was reassuring, because both dates refer to classical cyclical downturns.
zh: 一開始，很多人把這次危機比作1982年或1973年所發生的情況，這樣得類比是令人寬心的，因為這兩段時期意味著典型的週期性衰退。

en: Today, the mood is much grimmer, with references to 1929 and 1931 beginning to abound, even if some governments continue to behave as if the crisis was more classical than exceptional.
zh: 如今人們的心情卻是沉重多了，許多人開始把這次危機與1929年和1931年相比，即使一些國家政府的表現仍然似乎把視目前的情況為是典型的而看見的衰退。

en: The tendency is either excessive restraint (Europe) or a diffusion of the effort (the United States).
zh: 目前的趨勢是，要麼是過度的剋制（歐洲 ） ， 要麼是努力的擴充套件（美國 ） 。

en: Europe is being cautious in the name of avoiding debt and defending the euro, whereas the US has moved on many fronts in order not to waste an ideal opportunity to implement badly needed structural reforms.
zh: 歐洲在避免債務和捍衛歐元的名義下正變得謹慎，而美國已經在許多方面行動起來，以利用這一理想的時機來實行急需的結構性改革。

en: For geo-strategists, however, the year that naturally comes to mind, in both politics and economics, is 1989.
zh: 然而，作為地域戰略學家，無論是從政治意義還是從經濟意義上，讓我自然想到的年份是1989年。

en: Of course, the fall of the house of Lehman Brothers has nothing to do with the fall of the Berlin Wall.
zh: 當然，雷曼兄弟公司的倒閉和柏林牆的倒塌沒有任何關係。

en: Indeed, on the surface it seems to be its perfect antithesis: the collapse of a wall symbolizing oppression and artificial divisions versus the collapse of a seemingly indestructible and reassuring institution of financial capitalism.
zh: 事實上，從表面上看，兩者似乎是完全是相反的：一個是象徵著壓抑和人為分裂的柏林牆的倒塌，而另一個是看似堅不可摧的並令人安心的金融資本主義機構的倒塌。

en: Yet 2008-2009, like 1989, may very well correspond to an epochal change, whose unfolding consequences will be felt for decades.
zh: 然而，和1989年一樣，2008-2009年很可能也能被視為一個劃時代的改變，其帶來的發人深省的後果將在幾十年後仍能讓我們感受得到。

en: The end of the East-West ideological divide and the end of absolute faith in markets are historical turning points.
zh: 東西方意識形態鴻溝的結束，以及對市場絕對信心的後果，都是歷史的轉折點。

en: And what happens in 2009 may jeopardize some of the positive results of 1989, including the peaceful reunification of Europe and the triumph of democratic principles over nationalist, if not xenophobic, tendencies.
zh: 而2009年所發生的事情可能會威脅1989年革命所帶來的積極成果，包括歐洲的和平統一和民主制度戰勝了民族主義傾向，如果不是恐外傾向的話。

en: In 1989, liberal democracy triumphed over the socialist ideology incarnated and promoted by the Soviet Bloc.
zh: 1989年，自由民主戰勝了由蘇聯集團具體化並推崇的社會主義意識形態。

en: For many of his supporters, it was President Ronald Reagan who, with his deliberate escalation of the arms race, pushed the Soviet economy to the brink, thereby fully demonstrating the superiority of liberal societies and free markets.
zh: 對於里根總統的許多的支持者來說，就是他精心策劃的軍備競賽的升級，把蘇聯經濟推向了崩潰的邊緣，從而充分顯示了自由社會和自由市場的優越性。

en: Of course, there are obvious differences between 1989 and now.
zh: 當然，現在的情況和1989年的情況明顯不同了。

en: First, and perhaps above all, the revolutions of 1989 and the subsequent collapse of the Soviet Union put an end to global bipolarity.
zh: 首先，也許是最重要的，1989年的革命和隨後的蘇聯解體結束了全球的兩極化。

en: By contrast, 2009 is likely to pave the way to a new form of bipolarity, but with China substituting for the Soviet Union.
zh: 與此相反，2009年很可能會為一種新的兩極化形式鋪平道路，只是中國取代了蘇聯。

en: Second, whereas democracy and market capitalism appeared as clear – if more fragile than expected – winners in 1989, it is difficult in 2009, with the spread of the global crisis, to distinguish winners from losers.
zh: 其二，民主制度和市場資本主義，或許要比預期的要脆弱些，看來確實是當時的贏家。

en: Everyone seems to be a loser, even if some are more affected than others.
zh: 而在2009年，隨著全球危機的蔓延，卻很難區分贏家和輸家；每個人似乎都是輸家，即使有些國家比其它國家受到的影響更大。

en: Yet, history is unfair, and the US, despite its greater responsibility for today’s global crisis, may emerge in better shape than most countries from the morass.
zh: 而歷史是不公平的。 儘管美國要為當今的全球危機負更大的責任，但美國可能會比大多數國家以更良好的勢態走出困境。

en: In better shape, but not alone.
zh: 美國會恢復得更好，但並不是唯一能恢復的國家。

en: As a visiting professor at Harvard and MIT, I am getting a good preview of what the world could look like when the crisis finally passes.
zh: 作為哈佛大學和麻省理工學院的訪問教授，我能看到危機過後的世界是什麼樣子的。

en: One senses something like the making of an American-Asian dominated universe.
zh: 我們能感受到一個美國和亞洲占主導地位的世界正在形成。

en: From the incredible media lab at MIT to the mathematics and economics departments at Harvard, Asians – Chinese and Indians, in particular – are everywhere, like the Romans in Athens in the first century BC: full of admiration for those from whom they were learning so much, and whom they would overcome in the coming decades.
zh: 從一流的麻省理工學院的媒體實驗室到哈佛大學的數學和經濟系，亞洲人-尤其是中國和印度人-到處都是，猶如公元前一世紀在雅典的羅馬人一樣：他們對那裡學到太多東西的人們充滿了敬佩，而他們將在今後幾十年打敗他們學習的物件。

en: But before this new order appears, the world may be faced with spreading disorder, if not outright chaos.
zh: 但是，在這一新秩序的出現之前，世界可能會面臨更廣泛的混沌，如果不是徹底的混亂的話。

en: What, for example, will happen to a country as central and vulnerable as Egypt when hundred of thousands of Egyptians working in the Gulf are forced to return to their homeland as a result of the crisis in the oil-producing countries?
zh: 例如，對埃及這樣一個重要而又脆弱的國家，有數十萬的埃及人曾在海灣工作但現在因石油生產國出現的危機而被迫返回了自己的家園，那埃及會發生什麼情況呢？

en: When the rich get less rich, the poor get poorer.
zh: 當富人不再那麼富了，窮人就會更窮。

en: And what about the foreign workers who have reached for the “European dream” and are now faced with potential explosions of xenophobia in Europe’s supposedly open countries?
zh: 還有，對於那些追求“歐洲夢”的外來工人，現在他們面臨著理應是開放的歐洲國家的仇外心態可能的爆發，他們會有怎樣的遭遇？

en: The consequences of 1989 ended up being less enduring than many observers, including me, would have assumed.
zh: 1989年革命所帶來的成果，最後沒有包括我在內許多觀察家所想象的那麼持久。

en: We can only hope that, in the end, the consequences of 2009 similarly prove to be far less dramatic than we now – intuitively and in our historical reflexes – feel them to be.
zh: 我們只能希望2009年的危機同樣地最後被證明是遠遠低於我們現在以直覺和歷史回顧的方式��感覺到的那麼劇烈。

en: One Hundred Years of Ineptitude
zh: 百年愚頑

en: BERLIN – The global financial and economic crisis that began in 2008 was the greatest economic stress-test since the Great Depression, and the greatest challenge to social and political systems since World War II.
zh: 柏林 — — 2008年爆發的全球金融和經濟危機是自大蕭條以來最嚴峻的一次經濟壓力測試，也是自二戰以來社會和政治制度所面臨的最嚴重挑戰。

en: It not only put financial markets and currencies at risk; it also exposed serious regulatory and governance shortcomings that have yet to be fully addressed.
zh: 它不僅對金融市場和貨幣構成威脅；而且還暴露了迄今為止都無法完全解決的嚴重的監管和治理缺陷。

en: In fact, the 2008 crisis will most likely be remembered as a watershed moment, but not because it led to reforms that strengthened economic resilience and removed vulnerabilities.
zh: 事實上，2008年危機極有可能被視為一座分水嶺，但卻並非因為它導致了強化經濟彈性和消除經濟弱點的改革而永久留在人們的記憶當中。

en: On the contrary, leaders’ failure to discern, much less act on, the lessons of the Great Recession may open the way for a series of fresh crises, economic and otherwise, in the coming decades.
zh: 相反，領導人未能汲取大蕭條的教訓，更不用說為此採取相應的預防對策可能引發未來幾十年一系列新的經濟和其他危機。

en: However serious those crises turn out to be, historians a century from now will likely despair at our shortsightedness.
zh: 無論這些危機有多嚴重，一個世紀後的歷史學家都極有可能絕望於我們的短視。

en: They will note that analysts and regulators were narrowly focused on fixing the financial system by strengthening national oversight regimes.
zh: 他們將會看到，分析人士和監管機構透過強化國家監管機制，僅僅是狹隘地專注於修復金融體系。

en: While this was a worthy goal, historians will point out, it was far from the only imperative.
zh: 儘管這一目標並非全無價值，但就像歷史學家們所指出的那樣，這絕不是唯一一件必須要做的事。

en: To prepare the world to confront the challenges posed by globalization and technological development in a way that supports sustainable and equitable growth, governance institutions and regulations at both the national and international levels must be drastically improved.
zh: 為使世界能夠以確保可持續及平衡增長的方式來應對全球化和技術進步所帶來的挑戰，就必須對國內和國際兩級治理機構和制度進行大規模升級。

en: Yet not nearly enough has been invested in this effort.
zh: 但目前這方面的投入還遠遠不夠。

en: Beyond regional bodies like the European Union, international financial governance has remained largely untouched.
zh: 除歐盟等地區機構外，國際金融治理機構基本仍未受到波及。

en: Worse, because the partial fixes to the financial system will enable even more globalization, they will end up making matters worse, as strain on already-inadequate governance and regulatory frameworks increases, not only in finance, but also in other economic and technological fields.
zh: 更糟的是，因為部分修復金融體系將會帶來進一步全球化，這些舉措最終會惡化現有問題，因為此舉不僅在金融、而且在其他經濟和技術領域增加了對本已欠缺的治理和監管框架的壓力。

en: Meanwhile, enormous financial investments focused on securing a higher rate of return are likely to fuel technological innovation, further stressing regulatory systems in finance and beyond.
zh: 此外，專注於提高回報率的鉅額金融投資很有可能會推動技術創新，並由此進一步加大對金融和其他監管體系所造成的壓力。

en: Major technological advances fueled by cheap money can cause markets to change so fast that policy and institutional change cannot keep up.
zh: 廉價資金推動的重大技術創新可以令市場變化速度快到政策和機構變化均無法適應。

en: And new markets can emerge that offer huge payoffs for early adopters or investors, who benefit from remaining several steps ahead of national and international regulators.
zh: 同時新市場的出現可以為早期進入者或投資者帶來巨大的回報，並使他們可以持續受益於相對國內及國際監管機構的領先。

en: This is what happened in the run-up to the 2008 crisis.
zh: 這恰恰符合2008年危機爆發之前的情況。

en: New technology-enabled financial instruments created opportunities for some to make huge amounts of money.
zh: 新技術支援的金融工具為某些人賺取鉅額利潤創造了機遇。

en: But regulators were unable to keep up with the innovations, which ended up generating risks that affected the entire economy.
zh: 但監管機構卻無法跟上創新的步伐，並最終釀成了影響整體經濟的風險。

en: This points to a fundamental difference between global crises of the twenty-first century and, say, the Great Depression in the 1930s or, indeed, any past stock-market crashes.
zh: 這體現出21世紀的全球危機與20世紀30年代大蕭條或過去任何一次股市崩盤之間的根本區別。

en: Because of the financial sector’s growth, more actors benefit from under-regulation and weak governance in the short term, making today’s crises more difficult to prevent.
zh: 金融行業持續增長導致更多參與主體從短期監管不足和治理薄弱中獲益，從而使人們更加難以預防現在的危機。

en: Complicating matters further, the systems affected by today’s crises extend well beyond any one regulatory body’s jurisdiction.
zh: 令問題更加複雜的是，受當前危機影響的系統遠遠超過任何一個監管機構的監管範圍。

en: That makes crises far unrulier, and their consequences – including their long-term influence on societies and politics – more difficult to predict.
zh: 這導致危機變得更加兇險，並導致人們更加難以對危機所產生後果 — — 包括社會和政治領域的長期後果 — — 進行預判。

en: The next crises – made more likely by rising nationalism and a growing disregard for science and fact-based policymaking – may be financial, but they could also implicate realms as varied as migration, trade, cyberspace, pollution, and climate change.
zh: 下一次危機 — — 因為民族主義情緒抬頭和人們越來越無視基於科學和事實的決策而變得可能性愈來愈大 — — 可能涉及金融，但也可能涉及移民、貿易、網路空間、汙染和氣候變化等諸多領域。

en: In all of these areas, national and international governance institutions are weak or incomplete, and there are few independent actors, such as watchdog groups, demanding transparency and accountability.
zh: 在上述所有領域，國內和國際治理機構都力量薄弱或覆蓋不完善，而且嚴重缺乏要求透明度和問責制的監督組織等獨立行動主體。

en: This makes it harder not only to prevent crises – not least because it creates opportunities for actors to game the system and shirk responsibility – but also to respond to them.
zh: 這不僅加大了預防危機的難度 — — 尤其因為它為參與者提供了鑽空子和逃避責任的機會 — — 還使得人們越來越難以採取措施來應對危機。

en: The 2008 crisis cast a harsh spotlight on just how bad we are at responding quickly to disasters, especially those fueled by fragmented governance.
zh: 2008年危機暴露出我們在面對災難時的快速反應有多麼薄弱，尤其當造成災難的主要原因是分散治理。

en: To be sure, as the Hertie School’s 2018 Governance Report shows, there have been some improvements in preparing for and managing crises.
zh: 可以肯定，就像2018年赫蒂學院治理報告所表明的那樣，人類在準備應對和管理危機方面取得了一定的進展。

en: But we must become more alert to how developments in a wide range of fields – from finance to digital technologies and climate change – can elude the governance capacities of national and international institutions.
zh: 但我們必須警惕更廣泛領域的發展 — — 從金融到數字技術再到氣候變化 — — 是以何種方式來規避國內和國際機構的治理監管。

en: We should be running crisis scenarios and preparing emergency plans for upheaval in all of these fields, and taking stronger steps to mitigate risks, including by managing debt levels, which today remain much higher in the advanced economies than they were before the 2008 crisis.
zh: 我們應當在上述所有領域進行危機情景預演並制定危機爆發之際的緊急計劃，同時採取包括管理債務水平等更強有力的措施來降低風險，今天發達經濟體的債務水平均遠高於2008年危機爆發之前。

en: Moreover, we should ensure that we provide international institutions with the needed resources and responsibilities.
zh: 此外，我們應當確保賦予國際機構必要的監管責任和資源。

en: And by punishing those who exacerbate risks for the sake of their own interests, we would strengthen the legitimacy of global governance and the institutions that are meant to conduct it.
zh: 透過對那些因為自身利益而加劇風險的人進行懲戒，我們可以強化全球治理及其責任落實機構的合法地位。

en: As it stands, inadequate cross-border coordination and enforcement of international agreements is a major impediment to crisis prevention and management.
zh: 目前，跨境協調和國際協定落實不充分是危機預防和管理的主要障礙。

en: Yet, far from addressing this weakness, the world is reviving an outdated model of national sovereignty that makes crises of various kinds more likely.
zh: 但世界各國正在重新興起過時的國家主權模式不但沒有解決這個問題，而且增大了各種危機的爆發風險。

en: Unless we change course soon, the world of 2118 will have much reason to regard us with scorn.
zh: 除非我們儘快改變方向，否則2118年的世界將有足夠的理由來鄙視我們。

en: What Failed in 2008?
zh: 2008年敗在何處？

en: BERKELEY – To solve a problem, it is not enough to know what to do.
zh: 伯克利—要解決問題，光知道做什麼是不夠的。

en: You actually have to implement the solution – and be willing to change course if it turns out that you did not know quite as much as you thought.
zh: 你實際上必須實施解決辦法 — — 並且在事實證明你知道的並不如你認為的那樣多時，你得願意改變辦法。

en: That is the message of two recent books that, together, tell you everything you need to know about the 2008 financial crisis: what caused it, what can be done to prevent it from recurring, and why those things have yet to be done.
zh: 這就是兩本新書一起告訴你的資訊。 這兩本新書講述了你需要知道的關於2008年金融危機的一切：什麼引起了金融危機，可以做什麼防止它再次發生，以及為何這些事情還沒有人去做。

en: The first book is The Shifts and the Shocks, by the conservative British journalist Martin Wolf, who begins by cataloguing the major shifts that set the stage for the economic disaster that continues to shape the world today.
zh: 第一本書是《變化和衝擊 》 （ The Shifts and the Shocks ） ， 作者是保守派英國記者馬丁·沃爾夫（Martin Wolf ） 。 在書的開頭，他對醞釀了至今仍在影響世界的這場經濟災難的重要變化做了歸納編目。

en: His starting point is the huge rise in wealth among the world’s richest 0.1% and 0.01% and the consequent pressure for people, governments, and companies to take on increasingly unsustainable levels of debt.
zh: 首先，他指出世界最富有的0.1%和0.01%人群財富劇增，這給人民、政府和公司造成了日益不可持續的高負債的壓力。

en: Meanwhile, policymakers were lulled into complacency by the widespread acceptance of economic theories such as the “efficient-market hypothesis,” which assumes that investors act rationally and use all available information when making their decisions.
zh: 與此同時，決策者因為“有效市場假說”等經濟理論的廣泛接受而志得意滿，有效市場假說認為投資者的行為是理性的，在作出決策時會利用一切可獲得的信心。

en: As a result, markets were deregulated, making it easier to trade assets that were perceived to be safe, but were in fact not.
zh: 結果，市場監管被放鬆，交易被認為安全但實際並不安全的資產變得更加容易。

en: As a result, systemic risk proliferated beyond central bankers’ wildest imagination.
zh: 結果，系統性風險悄然醞釀，並且超過了央行官員最大膽的想象。

en: Untested – and ultimately incorrect – assumptions created a policymaking environment defined by what can only be called hubris.
zh: 未受檢驗並且最終錯誤的假設形成了一個只能用狂妄自大形容的決策環境。

en: Officials underestimated tail risks.
zh: 官員低估了尾部風險。

en: They set inflation targets at around 2% – leaving little room for maneuver when the water got choppy.
zh: 它們將通脹目標設定在2%左右 — — 這意味著當波濤洶湧時他們根本沒有多少施展空間。

en: And, most audaciously of all, the European Union introduced the euro as a common currency.
zh: 此外，最大膽的動作要數歐盟引入歐元作為共同貨幣。

en: Indeed, wrongheaded policymaking continued long after the crisis began.
zh: 事實上，方向錯誤的決策在危機開始後仍然能維持了很長時間。

en: Politicians responded to worsening economic conditions by hewing as closely as possible to failed prescriptions, making sure to do no more than absolutely necessary to address the biggest economic disaster since the Great Depression.
zh: 政客對惡化的經濟條件的反應是堅定實施錯誤的藥方，對於這場大蕭條以來最嚴重的經濟災難，他們除了絕對需要做的事情意外什麼都不做。

en: Wolf’s prescription for countering the crisis is simple, smart, and unassailable.
zh: 沃爾夫給抵禦這場危機開出的藥方簡單、明智並且無懈可擊。

en: In the short term, he suggests that countries with reserve currencies spend more (especially to finance public-sector investments) and issue more debt.
zh: 在短期，他建議擁有儲備貨幣的國家增加支出（特別是公共部門投資融資 ） 、 發行更多債務。

en: Their central banks, he argues, should raise inflation targets to 3% or even 4% per year.
zh: 他指出，這些國家的央行應該將通脹目標提高到每年3%甚至4 % 。

en: Over the medium term, according to Wolf, countries need to put in place regulatory measures that lower debt levels and discourage overleveraging.
zh: 在中期，沃爾夫認為各國需要實施監管措施降低債務水平、阻止過度舉債。

en: The eurozone, too, must resolve its internal contradictions, either by disbanding or by introducing “a minimum set of institutions and policies” that allow the monetary union to function properly.
zh: 歐元區也必須解決其內部矛盾，要麼透過解散歐元區實現，要麼透過引入能令貨幣聯盟正常執行的“最小限度的機構和政策組合”實現。

en: Wolf’s long-term solutions include tackling inequality, “more global regulation,” a greater degree of “freedom for individual countries to craft their own responses,” and economic analysis that is less in thrall to the free-market ideologues that led us into the crisis in the first place.
zh: 沃爾夫的長期解決方案包括遏制不平等 、 “ 更加全球化的監管 ” 、 更大程度的“個體國家自己決定反應方式的自由”以及更少受到自由市場思想束縛的經濟分析。 一開始正是自由市場思想讓我們陷入了危機。

en: And yet, as recommendable as Wolf’s proposals may be, little has been done to implement them.
zh: 但是，儘管沃爾夫的方案值得推薦，但幾乎沒有任何實施。

en: The reasons why are found in the second book: Hall of Mirrors, by my friend, teacher, and patron, Barry Eichengreen.
zh: 原因可以從第二本書中找到：由我的朋友、老師和“老闆”巴里·艾肯格林（Barry Eichengreen）所著的《鏡廳 》 （ Hall of Mirrors ） 。

en: Eichengreen traces our tepid response to the crisis to the triumph of monetarist economists, the disciples of Milton Friedman, over their Keynesian and Minskyite peers – at least when it comes to interpretations of the causes and consequences of the Great Depression.
zh: 艾肯格林認為，我們對這場危機反應不溫不火，原因要追溯到作為弗裡德曼（MiltonFriedman）門徒的���幣經濟學家對凱恩斯主義和明斯基（MInskyite）主義同行的勝利 — — 至少在解釋大蕭條的原因和後果方面是如此。

en: When the 2008 financial crisis erupted, policymakers tried to apply Friedman’s proposed solutions to the Great Depression.
zh: 2008年金融危機爆發時，決策者試圖使用弗裡德曼提出的大蕭條方案。

en: Unfortunately, this turned out to be the wrong thing to do, as the monetarist interpretation of the Great Depression was, to put it bluntly, wrong in significant respects and radically incomplete.
zh: 不幸的是，事實證明這是錯的，直言不諱地說，貨幣主義者對大蕭條的解釋在眾多方面都是錯誤的，並且非常不完整。

en: The resulting policies were enough to prevent the post-2008 recession from developing into a full-blown depression; but that partial success turned out to be a Pyrrhic victory, for it allowed politicians to declare that the crisis had been overcome, and that it was time to embrace austerity and focus on structural reform.
zh: 由此產生的政策足以阻止2008年後的衰退演變為完全的蕭條；但這一區域性成功的代價也是巨大的，它讓政客宣佈危機已經被克服，應該採取緊縮並專注於結構改革。

en: The result is today’s stagnant economy, marked by anemic growth that threatens to become the new normal.
zh: 結果就是現在的經濟停滯，其特徵是增長無力並且隨時可能成為新常態。

en: The United States and Europe are on track to have thrown away 10% of their potential wealth, while the failure to strengthen financial-sector regulation has left the world economy exposed to the risk of another major crisis.
zh: 美國和歐洲損失了10%的潛在財富，而沒有強化金融部門監管讓世界經濟隨時可能迎來新一場大危機。

en: Wolf and Eichengreen would agree that the main shortcomings that led to the 2008 financial crisis – and that continue to underpin our inadequate response to it – are intellectual.
zh: 沃爾夫和艾肯格林會認為，導致2008年金融危機的主要缺陷 — — 以及繼續破壞我們對危機的不充分反應的主要缺陷 — — 是知識缺陷。

en: Indeed, the only true lesson of the crisis so far seems to be that its lessons will never truly be learned.
zh: 事實上，到目前為止，危機的唯一真正教訓是它的教訓從未被真正汲取。

en: A Comeback Strategy for Europe
zh: 歐洲的重振戰略

en: STOCKHOLM/MADRID – When Pope Francis addressed the European Parliament last November, he compared the European Union to a grandmother – pleasant and rich with experience, but lacking the vitality and energy of the past.
zh: 斯托克霍姆/馬德里—去年11月，教皇方濟各在其歐洲議會演講中將歐盟比作祖母 — — 和藹而富於經驗，但已不再有過去的活力和能量。

en: It is high time, Francis argued, that EU leaders shed their dozy image, recognize the strategic challenges that Europe faces, and forge a clear policy for tackling them.
zh: 方濟各說，現在是一個關鍵時刻，歐盟領導人必須擺脫懈怠形象，承認歐洲所面臨的戰略挑戰，並構建應對挑戰的明確政策。

en: Admittedly, the pope’s characterization was alarmingly accurate in some respects.
zh: 誠然，教皇的描述在某些角度講非常準確。

en: But, despite its seeming lassitude, Europe retains significant strengths.
zh: 但是，儘管歐洲看起來疲態盡露，但仍擁有巨大優勢。

en: It is a hub of high-level thought and innovation; it is home to some of the world’s most competitive regions and industries; and, perhaps most impressive, it has built a community and market encompassing a half-billion people.
zh: 歐洲是高水平思想和創新的樞紐；是世界最有競爭力地區和產業的所在地；最重要的是，它還構建了一個由五億人組成的社會和市場。

en: But the world is changing: the Asia-Pacific region is increasingly influencing global developments, economic and otherwise.
zh: 但世界正在變化：亞太地區正在日益影響全球經濟和其他發展趨勢。

en: The Trans-Pacific Partnership – by which the United States and 11 other countries would create a mega-regional free-trade zone – would most likely accelerate this shift (all the more so if China eventually joins).
zh: 跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（Trans-Pacific Partnership，TPP，由美國和其他11國建立的巨型地區自由貿易區）很有可能加速這一變革（如果中國最終也能加入就更加如此了 ） 。

en: Though the TPP faces no shortage of hurdles to clear before an agreement is finalized, its potential to augment Asia’s economic power cannot be underestimated.
zh: 儘管TPP距離最終完成協議還有很多障礙需要跨越，但其擴大亞洲經濟實力的潛力絕不容���覷。

en: Europe must work to secure its position in the new world order – beginning by enhancing its own trade and investment ties with the US.
zh: 歐洲必須致力於確保其在新世界秩序中的地位 — — 首先要強化其自身與美國的貿易和投資聯絡。

en: The problem is that, as the TPP negotiations progress, talks on the EU-US Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) have become so deeply mired in domestic controversies that the entire project may well be scuttled.
zh: 在TPP談判不斷推進的同時，歐盟-美國跨大西洋貿易和投資夥伴關係（Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership，TTIP）談判卻深陷國內矛盾的掣肘，整個工程都有可能夭折。

en: Business leaders on both sides of the Atlantic are convinced that a successful TTIP agreement would bring substantial economic benefits – a perception that many studies reinforce.
zh: 大西洋兩岸的商業領袖相信，成功的TTIP協議將帶來巨大的經濟收益 — — 許多研究都強化了這一感覺。

en: Yet trivial issues – for example, the use of chlorinated chicken and settlements of investor disputes – continue to dominate the debate.
zh: 但一些微妙的問題 — — 比如“氯化雞 ” （ 歐洲懷疑美國雞肉進入市場前都用氯消毒）和投資者糾紛和解等問題 — — 仍主導著爭論。

en: The TTIP’s goal is to unleash the power of the transatlantic economy, which remains by far the world’s largest and wealthiest market, accounting for three-quarters of global financial activity and more than half of world trade.
zh: TTIP的目標是釋放跨大西洋經濟的力量 — — 目前大西洋兩岸仍是世界最大最富有的市場，佔全球金融活動的四分之三和世界貿易量的一大半。

en: (If the TTIP was opened to other economies – such as Turkey, Mexico, and Canada – the benefits would be even greater.)
zh: （如果TTIP向其他經濟體開放 — — 比如土耳其、墨西哥和加拿大 — — 則收益還將更大。 ）

en: Even more compelling than the benefits of achieving an agreement, though, are the potentially catastrophic consequences of failure.
zh: 但是，比達成協議的好處更加讓人感到必須成功的是談判失敗可能帶來的災難性結果。

en: For starters, a breakdown of TTIP talks would give considerable ammunition to those in the United Kingdom who advocate withdrawal from the EU; conversely, if the TTIP were implemented, the UK would be unwise – and thus unlikely – to leave.
zh: 首先，TTIP談判的破裂將極大地加強英國鼓吹離開歐盟陣營的力量；反之，如果TTIP獲得實施，英國離開歐盟將是不明智之舉，因此也不會發生。

en: Moreover, the perception that the EU’s internal squabbles had led it to squander a strategic opportunity would probably drive the US to accelerate its disengagement from the continent.
zh: 此外，歐洲的內訌導致其白白浪費了一個戰略機會，這一感覺可能促使美國加速遠離歐洲。

en: And Russian President Vladimir Putin would invariably regard the EU’s failure as a major opportunity to exert more influence over parts of Europe.
zh: 而俄羅斯總統普京也必然會將歐洲的失敗視為影響歐洲更多地區的良機。

en: All of this contributes to a starkly fundamental strategic risk: If the TTIP stalls or collapses, while the TPP moves forward and succeeds, the global balance will tip strongly in Asia’s favor – and Europe will have few options, if any, for regaining its economic and geopolitical influence.
zh: 所有這些凸顯出一個根本新戰略風險：如果TTIP無法取得進展或失敗，而TPP取得進展併成功，則全球平衡將朝著極有利於亞洲的方向發展 — — 歐洲極有可能無法重振其經濟和地緣政治影響力。

en: When the TTIP was first proposed, Europe seemed to recognize its value.
zh: TTIP首次提出時，歐洲似乎能夠認識到其價值。

en: Indeed, it was the EU that pushed the US, which initially doubted Europe’s commitment, to launch the negotiation process in June 2013.
zh: 事實上，是歐洲推動一開始對歐洲的承諾有所懷疑的美國在2013年6月啟動了談判程式。

en: The ambition was to complete the negotiations on “one tank of gas.”
zh: 當時人們雄心萬丈，意圖“一鼓作氣”完成談判。

en: No one wanted to endure protracted talks – or the associated political pain.
zh: 沒人想讓談判長久拖延 — — 或忍受因此帶來的政治痛苦。

en: But EU leaders essentially abandoned the project, seemingly confirming American fears.
zh: 但歐盟領導人在事實上拋棄了這一工程，而這也印證了美國的擔心。

en: Trade negotiators struggled to make headway, while anti-globalization groups seized control of the public discourse, presenting the TTIP as a threat to everything from Europe’s democracy to its health.
zh: 貿易談判在掙扎中前行，而反全球化組織掌握了公共觀點的控制權，將TTIP描述為對一切事物的威脅 — — 從歐洲的民主到歐洲的健康莫不如此。

en: This is dangerously inaccurate talk, and EU leaders must prevent it from gaining any more traction by making the strategic case for the agreement.
zh: 這是非常危險的錯誤言論，歐盟領導人必須拿出推進TTIP的戰略性理由，從而阻止這一言論獲得更大的市場。

en: And they must revive their commitment to conclude the talks successfully in 2015.
zh: 他們還必須重振2015年成功完成談判的承諾。

en: This is not to say that resolving the remaining issues in the TTIP negotiations will be simple.
zh: 這並不是說解決TTIP談判中仍然存在的問題輕而易舉。

en: But establishing a trade agreement, especially one that entails so many regulatory issues, is always difficult, as it must account for the complexity and changeability of modern economies.
zh: 但簽訂貿易協議，特別是包含如此多監管問題的貿易協議，永遠不是件容易事，因為它必須考慮到現代經濟的複雜性和易變性。

en: The fact is that the challenges inherent in completing the TTIP are no more intractable than those that EU leaders have faced in the last few years of crisis.
zh: 事實上，完成TTIP所包含的挑戰並不比歐盟領導人在過去幾年的危機中所遇到的挑戰更棘手。

en: When the TTIP negotiations resume next month, EU leaders must push for genuine progress, with the goal of completing a deal by the end of the year.
zh: TTIP談判將在下個月重啟，屆時歐盟領導人必須推動真正的進展，並以在年底完成協議為目標。

en: The good news is that the recent midterm elections in the US might have improved their chances.
zh: 好訊息是最近的美國中期選舉有可能增加他們成功的機會。

en: President Barack Obama now might get so-called fast-track negotiating authority from Congress.
zh: 現在，美國總統奧巴馬可能將從國會獲得所謂的快速談判授權。

en: If he does, Congress would simply approve or reject any negotiated agreement, rather than picking it apart.
zh: 果真如此的話，美國國會將對談成的協議予以批准或否決，而不能束之高閣。

en: The US presidential election season is starting, and other issues in the new year could easily take over the EU agenda.
zh: 美國總統競選季即將來開帷幕，在新的一年裡，其他問題可能輕而易舉地取代歐盟日程。

en: That is why Europe’s leaders have no time to waste.
zh: 正因如此，歐洲領導人已無時間可以浪費。

en: They must seize economic opportunity – and avert strategic disaster.
zh: 他們必須抓住經濟機會 — — 並避免戰略災難。

en: The Year That Ended an Epoch?
zh: 標誌著時代終結的一年？

en: MADRID – As 2016 comes to an end, the outlook for 2017 is shrouded in uncertainty.
zh: 馬德里 — — 隨著2016年的結束，2017年的前景被不確定性所籠罩。

en: Tensions in the Middle East are rising, and populist movements have appeared in Europe and the United States.
zh: 中東緊張局勢正在加劇，歐洲和美國出現了民粹主義運動。

en: In the Middle East, the tragic conflict in Syria continues, despite several fruitless attempts at rapprochement, which were marred by the fundamental disagreement about Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s future role in any peace process or political transition.
zh: 因為對敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德未來在和平程序或政治過渡中所起的作用存在根本性的分歧，在幾次修復關係的努力無果而終後，中東的敘利亞悲劇性衝突仍將繼續下去。

en: Meanwhile, over the past week, Syrian government troops, backed by Russia and Iran, have retaken almost all of Aleppo – once Syria’s largest city, now utterly devastated by the war.
zh: 此外，過去一週，敘利亞政府軍在俄羅斯和伊朗的支援下，已經奪回了幾乎整個阿勒頗 — — 阿勒頗曾是敘利亞最大的城市，現在已經徹底毀滅在戰火之中。

en: The world’s priority for the coming year must be to achieve peace in Syria, which will require close regional and international cooperation.
zh: 世界各國來年的首要任務必須是透過密切的地區和國際合作來實現敘利亞和平。

en: On December 27, Iran, Russia, and Turkey will hold a tripartite meeting in Moscow to discuss a political solution for the Syria conflict.
zh: 12月27日，伊朗、俄羅斯和土耳其將在莫斯科舉行三方會議，探討政治解決敘利亞衝突。

en: That meeting, if it takes place, is likely to be overshadowed by the fallout from the assassination of Russia’s ambassador to Turkey.
zh: 如果那次會議真的召開，也有可能籠罩在俄羅斯駐土耳其大使被殺的陰影當中。

en: But it is nothing if not surprising that these parties, and not the US and the European Union, would be negotiating such an agreement.
zh: 最出人意料的是居然是俄、伊、土三方，而非美國和歐盟，參與談判這樣的協定。

en: One positive development this year came in March, when the EU and Turkey signed an agreement to address the refugee crisis.
zh: 今年的積極進展出現在3月份，當時歐盟和土耳其就解決難民危機的協議達成。

en: Turkey has now taken in some three million Syrian refugees since the beginning of the conflict.
zh: 從這次衝突開始到現在，土耳其已經接收了約300萬敘利亞難民。

en: Although EU-Turkey relations are currently not at their best, the dialogue between the two sides must continue in 2017, not least because of their common interests, which are based not only on economic interdependence, but also on the refugee crisis and the collective fight against terrorism.
zh: 儘管歐盟土耳其關係現在並不在歷史高點，但雙方必須在2017年繼續對話，尤其因為雙方擁有基於經濟相互依存、難民危機及反恐集體鬥爭等諸多共同利益。

en: European politics next year, meanwhile, will be consumed by the Brexit negotiations.
zh: 此外，英國退歐談判將影響明年的歐洲政治。

en: In March, the United Kingdom will likely invoke Article 50 of the Treaty of Lisbon, triggering the formal procedure for withdrawal from the EU.
zh: 英國或將於3月啟動《里斯本條約》第五十條，從而觸發退出歐盟的正式程式。

en: The challenge will be to reach an agreement that guarantees the wellbeing of future EU-UK relations.
zh: 難點在於就確保未來歐盟-英國關係健康發展達成一致。

en: This will not be easy, and EU negotiators have already set a timeline of only 18 months.
zh: 做到這一點絕非易事。 歐盟談判人員已經制訂了僅有18個月的時間表。

en: While much remains uncertain, what is clear is that if the UK wants to retain access to the European single market, it will have to accept the EU’s four freedoms, including the free movement of workers.
zh: 雖然不確定因素仍然很多，但有一點十分明確，即如果英國想要保留單一市場準入權，就必須接受包括勞動力自由流動在內的歐盟四項自由政策。

en: In 2017, several European countries will hold general elections, and there is a risk that isolationist, anti-European populist movements will make a strong showing.
zh: 有幾個歐洲國家將在2017年舉行大選，孤立主義者、反歐洲民粹運動或將在此期間表現強勢。

en: For the EU to lose a country as militarily and economically important as the UK is bad enough; but to lose a founding EU member state, such as France, would be tragic.
zh: 對歐盟而言，失去像英國這樣在軍事和經濟上都很重要的國家無疑是一種打擊；但失去法國這樣的創始成員國或將釀成悲劇性的後果。

en: Fortunately, many Europeans’ views toward the EU actually improved in the aftermath of the Brexit referendum.
zh: 幸運的是，許多歐洲人對歐盟的看法事實上在英國退歐公投後有改善的跡象。

en: But this will not lessen the challenge for EU governments in the year ahead.
zh: 但這並不意味著歐盟政府在今後一年所面臨的挑戰減輕。

en: They must unite societies divided by powerful global forces, such as globalization and rapid technological innovation.
zh: 他們必須重新團結被全球化和快速技術創新等強勁全球勢力切割得四分五裂的社會。

en: The Brexit referendum, followed by Donald Trump’s victory in the US presidential election, signaled the rise of populism in the West.
zh: 英國退歐公投、而後是唐納德·特朗普在美國總統大選中的獲勝標誌著西方民粹主義勢力抬頭。

en: But now that Trump is filling his cabinet with oligarchs and former military men, we have reason to doubt that he will keep his promise to govern without the Washington “establishment.”
zh: 但現在，特朗普正在徵召寡頭和前軍人進入其內閣，我們有理由質疑他是否會履行自己擺脫華盛頓“建制派”進行治理的承諾。

en: Trump’s incoming administration is full of unknowns, but there can be no doubt that his rejection of multilateral institutions will endanger international efforts to cooperate on solutions to the world’s biggest problems.
zh: 特朗普即將執政的新內閣充滿了未知數，但毫無疑問他對多邊機構的抗拒會危及合作解決全球最嚴重問題的工作。

en: This holds peril for US-EU relations.
zh: 這必將對美國-歐盟關係構成威脅。

en: In previous years, the Paris climate agreement and the nuclear agreement with Iran were rays of light in a world closing itself off to multilateralism.
zh: 過去幾年，巴黎氣候協議及伊朗核協議曾為這個遠離多邊主義的世界帶來一線曙光。

en: In the coming years, such rays may become scarcer still.
zh: 而在未來幾年，這樣的曙光會變得越來越稀有。

en: Now more than ever, we need the kind of dialogue that builds strategic trust between great powers.
zh: 現在比以往任何時候都更需要在大國間建立戰略互信的對話。

en: And yet, Trump’s statements casting doubt on continued US adherence to a “One China” policy vis-à-vis Taiwan could severely damage relations between the world’s two largest economies.
zh: 而特朗普質疑美國是否將繼續堅持“一箇中國”政策的宣告極有可能嚴重損害世界兩大經濟體之間的關係。

en: Similarly, notwithstanding the pro-Russian leanings of some among Trump’s team, the US-Russian relationship also lacks strategic trust, owing to Russia’s military intervention in Syria, its invasion of eastern Ukraine, and its alleged interference in the US election.
zh: 同樣，儘管特朗普團隊不乏一定程度的親俄傾向，但因為俄羅斯軍事入侵敘利亞、東烏克蘭以及干涉美國大選的指控，美俄關係同樣缺乏戰略互信。

en: The coming year will be particularly important for Europe.
zh: 來年對歐洲而言尤其重要。

en: Relations between the EU and the US must remain strong, rooted in mutual respect for democracy, freedom, and human rights.
zh: 植根於對民主、自由和人權的共同尊重，歐盟和美國之間的關係必須保持穩固。

en: After a turbulent 2016, and with little positive news in international politics, 2017 is shaping up to be a year of challenges and uncertainty.
zh: 在充滿動盪的2016年後，因為國際政治中幾乎鮮有積極訊息，2017年註定充滿挑戰和不確定性。

en: But the biggest uncertainty of all is whether this is simply the end of another year, or the end of a geopolitical epoch.
zh: 但最大的不確定性卻是2016年僅僅是又一年的結束，還是整個地緣政治時代的終結。

en: Another Slow Year for the Global Economy
zh: 全球經濟緩慢增長又一年

en: WASHINGTON, DC – Last April, the International Monetary Fund projected that the world economy would grow by 3.5% in 2015.
zh: 華盛頓—去年4月，國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）預測2015年世界經濟將增長3.5 % 。

en: In the ensuing months, that forecast was steadily whittled down, reaching 3.1% in October.
zh: 在隨後的幾個月中，這一預測被逐步調低，10月份時下降到3.1 % 。

en: But the IMF continues to insist – as it has, with almost banal predictability, for the last seven years – that next year will be better.
zh: 但IMF仍然堅持 — — 在過去七年中它一貫如此，幾乎沒有什麼預見性可言 — — 明年會更好。

en: But it is almost certainly wrong yet again.
zh: 但幾乎可以肯定，IMF又錯了。

en: For starters, world trade is growing at an anemic annual rate of 2%, compared to 8% from 2003 to 2007.
zh: 首先，世界貿易年增長率只有區區2 % ， 而2003—2007年間高達8 % 。

en: Whereas trade growth during those heady years far exceeded that of world GDP, which averaged 4.5%, lately, trade and GDP growth rates have been about the same.
zh: 這幾年中，貿易增長遠遠高於世界GDP（平均增長率為4.5 % ） ，但最近貿易和GDP增長大致相當。

en: Even if GDP growth outstrips growth in trade this year, it will likely amount to no more than 2.7%.
zh: 即使今年GDP增長超過貿易增長，也可能無法超過2.7 % 。

en: The question is why.
zh: 問題在於為什麼。

en: According to Christina and David Romer of the University of California, Berkeley, the aftershocks of modern financial crises – that is, since World War II – fade after 2-3 years.
zh: 據加州大學伯克利分校的克里斯蒂娜和大衛·羅默（Christina and David Romer ） ， 現代金融危機（二戰後）的餘波會持續2—3年時間才會消失。

en: The Harvard economists Carmen Reinhart and Kenneth Rogoff say that it takes five years for a country to dig itself out of a financial crisis.
zh: 哈佛大學經濟學家卡門·萊因哈特（Carmen Reinhart）和肯尼斯·羅格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）說，一國需要五年時間才能從金融危機中走出。

en: And, indeed, the financial dislocations of 2007-2008 have largely receded.
zh: 而事實上，2007—2008年的金融動盪已經基本消失。

en: So what accounts for the sluggish economic recovery?
zh: 因此，是什麼導致了經濟復甦滯後？

en: One popular explanation lies in the fuzzy notion of “secular stagnation”: long-term depressed demand for goods and services is undermining incentives to invest and hire.
zh: 一個流行的解釋是一個叫作“長期停滯”的模糊概念 — — 長期受到抑制的商品和服務需求破壞了投資和招聘激勵。

en: But demand would remain weak only if people lacked confidence in the future.
zh: 但需求只有在人們對未來信心不足時才會持續低迷。

en: The only logical explanation for this enduring lack of confidence, as Northwestern University’s Robert Gordon has painstakingly documented and argued, is slow productivity growth.
zh: 這一信心持續缺失的唯一符合邏輯的解釋，正如西北大學的羅伯特·戈登（Robert Gordon）費煞苦心地記錄和論證的，是生產率增長緩慢。

en: Before the crisis – and especially from 2003 to 2007 – slow productivity growth was being obscured by an illusory sense of prosperity in much of the world.
zh: 危機前，特別是2003—2007年，生產率增長緩慢被一種世界大部分國家都在欣欣向榮的幻覺所矇蔽。

en: In some countries – notably, the United States, Spain, and Ireland – rising real-estate prices, speculative construction, and financial risk-taking were mutually reinforcing.
zh: 在一些國家 — — 特別是美國、西班牙和愛爾蘭 — — 高升的放假、投機性建設和金融冒險互相強化。

en: At the same time, countries were amplifying one another’s growth through trade.
zh: 與此同時，各國透過貿易放大彼此的增長。

en: Central to the global boom was China, the rising giant that flooded the world with cheap exports, putting a lid on global inflation.
zh: 這場全球繁榮的核心是中國，這個崛起的巨無霸向全世界輸出廉價出口品，遏制了全球通脹。

en: Equally important, China imported a huge volume of commodities, thereby bolstering many African and Latin American economies, and purchased German cars and machines, enabling Europe’s largest economy to keep its regional supply chains humming.
zh: 同樣重要的是，中國進口了巨量大宗商品，從而提振了許多非洲和拉丁美洲經濟體；還購買了大量德國汽車和機器，讓歐洲最大經濟體保持其地區供應鏈滿負荷執行。

en: This dynamic reversed around March 2008, when the US rescued its fifth-largest investment bank, Bear Sterns, from collapse.
zh: 這一動態在2008年3月左右發生了逆轉。 當時，美國拯救了其第五大投資銀行貝爾斯登，使其免於破產。

en: With the eurozone banks also deeply implicated in the subprime mortgage mess and desperately short of US dollars, America and much of Europe began a remorseless slide into recession.
zh: 歐元區銀行業深陷次貸亂局，急缺美元，因此美國和歐洲的大部開始滑向衰退。

en: Whereas in the boom years, world trade had spread the bounty, it was now spreading the malaise.
zh: 在繁榮年份，世界貿易傳播著財富，而如今，世界貿易傳播著經濟萎靡。

en: As each country’s GDP growth slowed, so did its imports, causing its trading partners’ growth to slow as well.
zh: 隨著各國GDP增長的放緩，進口也開始放緩，貿易伙伴的增長也隨之放緩。

en: The US economy began to emerge from its recession in the second half of 2009, thanks largely to aggressive monetary policy and steps to stabilize the financial system.
zh: 美國經濟從2009年下半年開始走出衰退，這主要是為穩定金融體系而採取的激進貨幣政策和措施的功勞。

en: Eurozone policymakers, by contrast, rejected monetary stimulus and implemented fiscal austerity measures, while ignoring the deepening distress of their banks.
zh: 相反，歐洲決策者拒絕採取貨幣刺激而實施了財政緊縮，無視其銀行壓力的加劇。

en: The eurozone thus pushed the world into a second global recession.
zh: 於是，歐元區將世界拖入了第二場全球衰退。

en: Just when that recession seemed to have run its course, emerging economies began to unravel.
zh: 而正當這場衰退眼看就要痊癒時，新興經濟體開始崩潰。

en: For years, observers had been touting the governance and growth-enhancing reforms that these countries’ leaders had supposedly introduced.
zh: 多年來，觀察家們一直在鼓吹這些國家領導人如何如何實施治理和刺激增長的改革。

en: In October 2012, the IMF celebrated emerging economies’ “resilience.”
zh: 2012年10月，IMF大大讚揚了新興經濟體的“恢復力 ” 。

en: As if on cue, that facade began to crumble, revealing an inconvenient truth: factors like high commodity prices and massive capital inflows had been concealing serious economic weaknesses, while legitimizing a culture of garish inequality and rampant corruption.
zh: 恰逢此時，門面撐不住了，暴露出一個令人不快的事實：大宗商品價格高企和大規模資本流入等因素掩蓋了嚴重的經濟弱點，也讓劇烈的不平等性和無孔不入的腐敗成為合法的文化。

en: These problems are now being compounded by the growth slowdown in China, the fulcrum of global trade.
zh: 如今，這些問題因為全球貿易的支柱 — — 中國增長放緩而雪上加霜。

en: And the worst is yet to come.
zh: 而最壞的時刻還沒有到來。

en: China’s huge industrial overcapacity and property glut needs to be wound down; the hubris driving its global acquisitions must be reined in; and its corruption networks have to be dismantled.
zh: 中國巨大的工業過剩產能和房地產過剩還沒有消化；推動其全球兼併的傲慢必須得到遏制；其腐敗網路也必須打破。

en: In short, the factors that dragged down the global economy in 2015 will persist – and in some cases even intensify – in the new year.
zh: 簡言之，2015年拖累全球經濟的因素在新的一年裡還會持續 — — 有的甚至還會加劇。

en: Emerging economies will remain weak.
zh: 新興經濟體將繼續疲軟。

en: The eurozone, having enjoyed a temporary reprieve from austerity, will be constrained by listless global trade.
zh: 暫時擺脫了緊縮的歐元區將受到全球貿易萎靡的束縛。

en: Rising interest rates on corporate bonds portend slower growth in the US.
zh: 公司債券利率的提高預示美國增長減速。

en: China’s collapsing asset values could trigger financial turbulence.
zh: 中國資產價值崩盤可能引發金融動盪。

en: And policymakers are adrift, with little political leverage to stem these trends.
zh: 而決策者就像是無根之木，沒有政治手段來遏制這些趨勢。

en: The IMF should stop forecasting renewed growth and issue a warning that the global economy will remain weak and vulnerable unless world leaders act energetically to spur innovation and growth.
zh: IMF應該停止更新增長預測，而是釋出警告：全球經濟將繼續保持萎靡和脆弱，除非世界領導人著力刺激創新和增長。

en: Such an effort is long overdue.
zh: 這樣的措施早就應該實行了。

en: Trumpian Uncertainty
zh: 特朗普的不確定性

en: NEW YORK – Every January, I try to craft a forecast for the coming year.
zh: 發自紐約 — — 每年一月，我都會嘗試對未來一年作出預測。

en: Economic forecasting is notoriously difficult; but, notwithstanding the truth expressed in Harry Truman’s request for a one-armed economist (who wouldn’t be able to say “on the other hand”), my record has been credible.
zh: 經濟預測是件極為困難的事情；以至於哈里·杜魯門總統（Harry Truman）曾要求手下給他找一位獨臂經濟學家 — — 這樣此人就無法模稜兩可地說“另一方面（on the other hand ） ” 了 — — 但一直以來我的預測還是靠譜的。

en: In recent years, I correctly foresaw that, in the absence of stronger fiscal stimulus (which was not forthcoming in either Europe or the United States), recovery from the Great Recession of 2008 would be slow.
zh: 這幾年來我正確地預見到，在缺乏更強有力財政刺激政策（在歐洲或美國都一樣）的情況下，2008年大衰退的復甦程序將較為緩慢。

en: In making these forecasts, I have relied more on analysis of underlying economic forces than on complex econometric models.
zh: 同時我的預測更多地依賴於對基本經濟力量的分析，而非複雜的經濟計量模型。

en: For example, at the beginning of 2016, it seemed clear that the deficiencies of global aggregate demand that have been manifest for the last several years were unlikely to change dramatically.
zh: 例如在2016年初，很顯然在過去幾年中呈現的全球總需求不足將不大可能出現巨大改變。

en: Thus, I thought that forecasters of a stronger recovery were looking at the world through rose-tinted glasses. Economic developments unfolded much as I anticipated.
zh: 因此我認為那些相信會實現強勁復甦的預測者是過於樂觀了，最終實際的經濟發展也與我的預測一致。

en: Not so the political events of 2016.
zh: 2016年的政治事件也是如此。

en: I had been writing for years that unless growing inequality – especially in the US, but also in many countries throughout the world – was addressed, there would be political consequences.
zh: 多年來我一直指出，除非在全球許多國家（尤其是美國）日益嚴重的不平等問題得到解決，否則必將產生某些政治後果。

en: But inequality continued to worsen – with striking data showing that average life expectancy in the US was on the decline.
zh: 但不平等狀況依然持續惡化 — — 令人震驚的資料顯示，美國的預期平均壽命正在下降。

en: These results were foreshadowed by a study last year, by Anne Case and Angus Deaton, which showed that life expectancy was on the decline for large segments of the population – including America’s so-called angry men of the Rust Belt.
zh: 正如安娜·凱斯（Anne Case）和安格斯·迪頓（Angus Deaton）的一項研究表明：美國大部分人口的預期壽命都在下降，包括所謂北部老工業區的憤怒居民們。

en: But, with the incomes of the bottom 90% having stagnated for close to a third of a century (and declining for a significant proportion), the health data simply confirmed that things were not going well for very large swaths of the country.
zh: 而由於90％的底層人士收入增長已經停滯了將近1/3個世紀（且其中很大比例都出現了下滑 ） ， 醫療資料清晰明白地證實了美國大部分地區處境不妙。

en: And while America might be at the extreme of this trend, things were little better elsewhere.
zh: 但美國可能處於這種趨勢的極端，其他地方的情況會好一點。

en: But, if it seemed clear that there would be political consequences, their form and timing were far less obvious.
zh: 但如果這似乎必然預示著某些政治後果，那麼其形式和時間就不那麼明顯了。

en: Why did the backlash in the US come just when the economy seemed to be on the mend, rather than earlier?
zh: 為什麼美國的下行會在經濟恢復期出現，而不是更為提前？

en: And why did it manifest itself in a lurch to the right?
zh: 為何這會表現為政治右傾？

en: After all, it was the Republicans who had blocked assistance to those losing their jobs as a result of the globalization they pushed assiduously. It was the Republicans who, in 26 states, refused to allow the expansion of Medicaid, thereby denying health insurance to those at the bottom.
zh: 畢竟正是共和黨人拒絕援助那些因他們全力推動全球化而失業的人們，是共和黨人否決在26個州擴大醫療補助，從而拒絕為底層的人提供醫療保險。

en: And why was the victor somebody who made his living from taking advantage of others, openly admitted not paying his fair share of taxes, and made tax avoidance a point of pride?
zh: 為什麼一個依靠佔他人便宜來謀生，公開承認並未支付合理份額稅收，並以避稅為榮的人會成為大選最終贏家？

en: Donald Trump grasped the spirit of the time: things weren’t going well, and many voters wanted change.
zh: 唐納德·特朗普（Donald Trump）抓住了時代精神：境況不佳，許多選民都想來點改變。

en: Now they will get it: there will be no business as usual. But seldom has there been more uncertainty.
zh: 但如今他們會意識到真相：再也沒有什麼常態可言，但也不會存在更多的不確定性。

en: Which policies Trump will pursue remains unknown, to say nothing of which will succeed or what the consequences will be.
zh: 特朗普將實施何種政策仍然是未知之數，更遑論哪些政策將會成功或者後果將是什麼了。

en: Trump seems hell-bent on having a trade war.
zh: 特朗普似乎拼命想發起一場貿易戰。

en: But how will China and Mexico respond?
zh: 那麼中國和墨西哥將如何應對？

en: Trump may well understand that what he proposes will violate World Trade Organization rules, but he may also know that it will take a long time for the WTO to rule against him.
zh: 特朗普清楚知道他的提議會違反世貿規則，但他估計也明白世貿組織需要很長時間來推翻這一做法。

en: And by then, America’s trade account may have been rebalanced.
zh: 到那時候美國的貿易賬戶可能早就實現重新平衡了。

en: But two can play that game: China can take similar actions, though its response is likely to be more subtle.
zh: 但這個博弈可是雙方面的：中國也可以採取類似但更為隱秘微妙的行動。

en: If a trade war were to break out, what would happen?
zh: 那麼如果真爆發一場貿易戰的話，將會出現何種狀況？

en: Trump may have reason to think he could win; after all, China is more dependent on exports to the US than the US is on exports to China, which gives the US an advantage.
zh: 特朗普可能覺得自己有把握能贏；畢竟中國對向美國出口的依賴要強於美國對中國出口，這是美國的優勢。

en: But a trade war is not a zero-sum game. The US stands to lose as well.
zh: 但貿易戰可不是一場此消彼長的零和遊戲，美國也會輸。

en: China may be more effective in targeting its retaliation to cause acute political pain.
zh: 中國的報復可能更具針對性，足以對美國造成嚴重的政治壓力。

en: And the Chinese may be in a better position to respond to US attempts to inflict pain on them than the US is to respond to the pain that China might inflict on Americans.
zh: 而中國人可能比美國人處於更有利的地位來應對對方施加的危機。

en: It’s anybody’s guess who can stand the pain better.
zh: 大家都在猜測誰的承受能力更強：是普通民眾在泥潭裡長期掙扎的美國？

en: Will it be the US, where ordinary citizens have already suffered for so long, or China, which, despite troubled times, has managed to generate growth in excess of 6%?
zh: 還是即便在困難時期也得以實現超過6％增長的中國？

en: More broadly, the Republican/Trump agenda, with its tax cuts even more weighted toward the rich than the standard GOP recipe would imply, is based on the idea of trickle-down prosperity – a continuation of the Reagan era’s supply-side economics, which never actually worked.
zh: 更宏觀地看來，共和黨/特朗普的議程 — — 其稅收削減甚至比標準的共和黨方案更為偏袒富人 — — 意味著這些政策都是基於涓滴繁榮（富人多賺錢消費從而窮人有工作）的理念，也是里根時代供給側經濟學政策的延續 — — 但這一政策從未奏效過。

en: Fire-breathing rhetoric, or raving three a.m. tweets, may assuage the anger of those left behind by the Reagan revolution, at least for a while.
zh: 惹火的言論或者半夜三點在推特上發表的胡言亂語至少能在一段時間內安撫那些被裡根革命所拋棄的憤世者。

en: But for how long?
zh: 但這能維持要多久呢？

en: And what happens then?
zh: 隨後又會是何種狀況？

en: Trump might like to repeal the ordinary laws of economics, as he goes about his version of voodoo economics. But he can’t.
zh: 特朗普可能喜歡顛覆常規的經濟學法則，因為他樂於奉行自己那一套巫術經濟學，但這是行不通的。

en: Still, as the world’s largest economy leads the way into uncharted political waters in 2017 and beyond, it would be foolhardy for a mere mortal to attempt a forecast, other than to state the obvious: the waters will almost certainly be choppy, and many – if not most – pundit ships will sink along the way.
zh: 而隨著美國這個全球最大經濟體在2017年及以後的年月進入一片未知的政治水域，除了指出一些顯而易見的事實之外，任何人類的預測都是不智的：這片水域幾乎肯定會激起風浪，而許多 — — 如果不是大多數 — — 預測專家的航船也將隨之傾覆沉沒。

en: 9/11 and the New Authoritarianism
zh: 9/11和新獨裁專制主義

en: Five years after the attacks on the Twin Towers in New York and the Pentagon in Washington, “9/11” is no longer a mere date.
zh: 襲擊紐約雙子塔和華盛頓五角大樓五年後 ， “ 9/11”已經不再僅僅是一個日期了。

en: It has entered the history books as the beginning of something new, a new era perhaps, but in any case a time of change.
zh: 它已經作為一個變革時代的某種開端或者是一個新的時代的開始而載入史冊。

en: The terrorist bombings in Madrid and London and elsewhere will also be remembered; but it is “9/11” that has become the catchphrase, almost like “August 1914.”
zh: 恐怖分子在馬德里和倫敦以及其他地方製造的爆炸事件也將被人銘記；但是，只有“9/11”幾乎像“1914年8月”那樣成為了流行語。

en: But was it really a war that started on September 11, 2001?
zh: 但是，那果真是一場開於2001年9月11日的戰爭嗎？

en: Not all are happy about this American notion.
zh: 並不是所有人都贊同這一美國式的觀點。

en: During the heyday of Irish terrorism in the UK, successive British governments went out of their way not to concede to the IRA the notion that a war was being waged.
zh: 當愛爾蘭恐怖主義在英國猖獗之際，各屆英國政府都竭力不屈從於愛爾蘭共和軍的觀點，即正在進行一場戰爭。

en: “War” would have meant acceptance of the terrorists as legitimate enemies, in a sense as equals in a bloody contest for which there are accepted rules of engagement.
zh: “戰爭”將會意味著把恐怖分子接受為合法的敵人，其含義與具有認同的交戰規則的一場血腥戰爭的對等體相同。

en: This is neither a correct description nor a useful terminology for terrorist acts, which are more correctly described as criminal.
zh: 這既非對恐怖主義行為的正確描述，也不是有用的詞彙。 恐怖分子應該更為準確地被稱為罪犯。

en: By calling them war – and naming an opponent, usually al-Qaeda and its leader, Osama bin Laden – the United States government has justified domestic changes that, before the 9/11 attacks, would have been unacceptable in any free country.
zh: 但是透過稱之為戰爭、並把基地組織及其領導人本拉登點名為對手，美國政府給某些國內變化提供了理由。 這些國內變化在9/11襲擊之前是不會被任何自由國家所接受的。

en: Most of these changes were embodied in the so-called “USA Patriot Act.”
zh: 這些變化的大多數都體現在所謂的“美國愛國者法案”上。

en: Though some of the changes simply involved administrative regulations, the Patriot Act’s overall effect was to erode the great pillars of liberty, such as habeas corpus , the right to recourse to an independent court whenever the state deprives an individual of his freedom.
zh: 儘管某些變化僅僅涉及到行政規定，但是，愛國者法案的整體效果卻是侵蝕自由的支柱，例如人身保護，也就是無論何時國家剝奪個人自由，均有向獨立法院尋求救助的權利。

en: From an early date, the prison camp at Guantánamo Bay in Cuba became the symbol of something unheard of: the arrest without trial of “illegal combatants” who are deprived of all human rights.
zh: 很久以來，古巴關塔那摩灣的戰俘營成為了聞所未聞的象徵，也就是不經審判逮捕被剝奪所有人權的“非法戰鬥人員 ” 。

en: The world now wonders how many more of these non-human humans are there in how many places.
zh: 如今，世界並不知道在多少地方還有多少更多的遭受非人待遇的人。

en: For everyone else, a kind of state of emergency was proclaimed that has allowed state interference in essential civil rights.
zh: 對於其他所有人而言，好像是宣佈了某種緊急狀態，允許國家干涉基本民權。

en: Controls at borders have become an ordeal for many, and police persecution now burdens quite a few.
zh: 邊境檢查已經成為許多人的煎熬，警察起訴給很多人帶來了負擔。

en: A climate of fear has made life hard for anyone who looks suspicious or acts suspiciously, notably for Muslims.
zh: 一種恐懼的氣候讓任何看似可疑或者行為可疑的人、特別是穆斯林生活困難。

en: Such restrictions on freedom did not meet with much public opposition when they were adopted.
zh: 當採取這些限制自由的措施的時候並沒有遇到很多公眾的反對。

en: On the contrary, by and large it was the critics, not the supporters, of these measures who found themselves in trouble.
zh: 相反，總體而言，那些措施的批評者，而非支持者發現遇到了麻煩。

en: In Britain, where Prime Minister Tony Blair supported the US attitude entirely, the government introduced similar measures and even offered a new theory.
zh: 在英國，布萊爾首相全力支援美國的態度，政府引入了類似的措施，甚至提出了一個新的理論。

en: Blair was the first to argue that security is the first freedom.
zh: 布萊爾第一個主張安全是第一自由。

en: In other words, liberty is not the right of individuals to define their own lives, but the right of the state to restrict individual freedom in the name of a security that only the state can define.
zh: 換言之，自由並非是個人確定自身生活的權利，而是國家以安全的名義限制個人自由的權利。 只有國家才能確定安全的含義。

en: This is the beginning of a new authoritarianism.
zh: 這就是一個新的獨裁主義的開始。

en: The problem exists in all countries affected by the threat of terrorism, though in many it has not become quite as specific.
zh: 這一問題存在於所有受到恐怖主義威脅的國家，儘管在許多國家中這已經變得非常具體。

en: In most countries of continental Europe, “9/11” has remained an American date.
zh: 在大多數歐洲大陸國家 ， ” 9/11“已經成為一個美國人的日子。

en: There is even a debate – and indeed some evidence – concerning the question of whether involvement in the “war against terrorism” has actually increased the threat of terrorist acts.
zh: 甚至還有人辯論，而且確實還有證據表明，參與到“反恐戰爭”之中是否實際上增加了恐怖主義行動的威脅。

en: Germans certainly use this argument to stay out of the action wherever possible.
zh: 德國人當然在可能的情況下利用這一論點置身度外。

en: This stance, however, has not prevented the spread of something for which a German word is used in other languages, too: Angst .
zh: 但是，這一立場並沒有防止德語中所說的憂慮的擴散。

en: A diffuse anxiety is gaining ground.
zh: 一種彌散性的焦慮正在擴大。

en: People feel uneasy and worried, especially when traveling.
zh: 人們感到不安，特別是在旅行的時候。

en: Any train accident or airplane crash is now at first suspected of being an act of terrorism.
zh: 任何一個火車事故或者飛機墜毀現在都首先被懷疑是恐怖主義行為。

en: Thus, 9/11 has meant, directly or indirectly, a great shock, both psychologically and to our political systems.
zh: 這樣，9/11已經直接或間接地意味著一個巨大的震驚事件，在心理上以及對於政治體系而言都是如此。

en: While terrorism is fought in the name of democracy, the fight has in fact led to a distinct weakening of democracy, owing to official legislation and popular angst.
zh: 儘管以民主的名義與恐怖主義作戰，實際上這一斗爭由於官方的立法以及民眾的憂慮而已經導致對民主明顯的削弱。

en: One of the worrying features of the 9/11 attacks is that it is hard to see their purpose beyond the perpetrators’ resentment of the West and its ways.
zh: 9/11攻擊的令人擔憂的特性之一就是除了罪犯們仇恨西方及其生活方式之外，很難看到他們的目的。

en: But the West’s key features, democracy and the rule of law, have taken a far more severe battering at the hands of their defenders than by their attackers.
zh: 但是西方社會的主要特徵，即民主和法治卻已經在捍衛者手中遭到了嚴重的損害，其程度超過遠遠超過其攻擊者。

en: Two steps, above all, are needed to restore confidence in liberty within the democracies affected by the legacy of 9/11.
zh: 最重要的是，需要採取兩個步驟來在受到9/11後果影響的��主國家恢復對自由的信心。

en: First, we must make certain that the relevant legislation to meet the challenge of terrorism is strictly temporary.
zh: 首先，我們必須確保應對恐怖主義挑戰的相關立法是嚴格具有時限的。

en: Some of today’s restrictions on habeas corpus and civil liberties have sunset clauses restricting their validity; all such rules should be re-examined by parliaments regularly.
zh: 當今的某些對人身自由以及民權的限制含有限制其時效的廢止條款。 所有這些法規都應當定期接受議會的重新審查。

en: Second, and more importantly, our leaders must seek to calm, rather than exploit, public anxiety.
zh: 第二，也是更為重要的是，我們的領導人應當力求平息、而不是利用公眾的焦慮。

en: The terrorists with whom we are currently at “war” cannot win, because their dark vision will never gain broad popular legitimacy.
zh: 我們目前“交戰”的恐怖分子無法獲勝，因為他們的黑暗的觀點永遠不會贏得廣泛的公眾合法認可。

en: That is all the more reason for democrats to stand tall in defending our values – first and foremost by acting in accordance with them.
zh: 這也就是民主派人士應當身先士卒、首要地以遵循我們的價值觀的方式來捍衛它們的原因。

en: 9/11 in Perspective
zh: 9·11：十年後的盤點

en: NEW YORK – It was a decade ago that 19 terrorists took control of four planes, flew two into the twin towers of the World Trade Center, hit the Pentagon with a third, and crashed the fourth in a field in Pennsylvania after passengers resisted and made it impossible for the terrorists to complete their malevolent mission.
zh: 紐約 — — 十年前，19名恐怖分子劫持了四架民航客機，其中兩架撞上世貿中心雙子塔，第三架撞擊了五角大樓，第四架在乘客的反抗下無法完成襲擊，墜毀於賓夕法尼亞曠野。

en: In a matter of hours, more than 3,000 innocent people, mostly Americans, but also people from 115 other countries, had their lives suddenly and violently taken from them.
zh: 只不過幾個小時，3000多無辜平民被突如其來的暴行奪去了生命，其中大多是美國人，但也有來自其他115個國家的人。

en: September 11, 2001, was a terrible tragedy by any measure, but it was not a historical turning point.
zh: 2001年9月11日，以任何標準看都是一個可怕的慘劇，但它並非一個歷史轉折點。

en: It did not herald a new era of international relations in which terrorists with a global agenda prevailed, or in which such spectacular terrorist attacks became commonplace. On the contrary, 9/11 has not been replicated.
zh: 它並未開啟一個由全球恐怖主義主導國際關係的新時代，類似的大規模恐怖襲擊也沒有變成家常便飯。

en: Despite the attention devoted to the “Global War on Terrorism,” the most important developments of the last ten years have been the introduction and spread of innovative information technologies, globalization, the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, and the political upheavals in the Middle East.
zh: 雖然人們在“全球反恐戰爭”上投注了大量精力，但是過去10年最重要的進展是資訊科技的創新與傳播、全球化、伊拉克與阿富汗戰爭以及中東的政治動盪。

en: As for the future, it is much more likely to be defined by the United States’ need to put its economic house in order; China’s trajectory within and beyond its borders; and the ability of the world’s governments to cooperate on restoring economic growth, stemming the spread of nuclear weapons, and meeting energy and environmental challenges.
zh: 未來一個階段的關鍵，則是美國整修其經濟大廈的努力，中國在國內國際事務中的走向，各國政府在重振經濟增長、控制核擴散以及應對能源與環境挑戰方面的合作能力。

en: It is and would be wrong to make opposition to terrorism the centerpiece of what responsible governments do in the world.
zh: 如果把反對恐怖主義當成負責任的政府在世界上的核心要務，這是錯誤的。

en: Terrorists continue to be outliers with limited appeal at best.
zh: 恐怖主義仍是邊緣角色，它們的吸引力終歸是有限的。

en: They can destroy but not create.
zh: 它們只破壞，不建設。

en: It is worth noting that the people who went into the streets of Cairo and Damascus calling for change were not shouting the slogans of Al Qaeda or supporting its agenda.
zh: 值得注意的是，人們走上開羅和大馬士革街頭，呼喊的並不是基地組織的口號，也沒有對它的綱領表示支援。

en: Moreover, measures have been implemented to push back, successfully, against terrorists.
zh: 此外，種種措施已經成功地令恐怖分子退入守勢。

en: Intelligence assets have been redirected. Borders have been made more secure and societies more resilient.
zh: 情報資源已重新配置，國境線已變得更安全，社會已變得更有彈性。

en: International cooperation has increased markedly, in part because governments that cannot agree on many things can agree on the need to cooperate in this area.
zh: 反恐國際合作顯著增強，部分是因為，各國政府都覺得需要在這一領域加強合作，儘管它們在其他領域頗有分歧。

en: Military force has played a role as well.
zh: 軍事力量也扮演著某種角色。

en: Al Qaeda lost its base in Afghanistan when the Taliban government that had provided it sanctuary was ousted from power.
zh: 基地組織喪失了位於阿富汗的巢穴，正式因為向它提供庇護的塔利班政府被推翻。

en: Osama bin-Laden was finally found and killed by US Special Forces in the suburbs of Islamabad.
zh: 奧薩馬·本·拉登最終被美國特種部隊找到並擊斃。

en: Drones – unmanned aircraft that are remotely steered – have proven to be effective in killing a significant number of terrorists, including many of the most important leaders.
zh: 軍事無人機在擊斃恐怖組織頭目的行動中作用非凡。

en: Weak governments can be made stronger; governments that tolerate or support terrorism must be held accountable.
zh: 軟弱的政府可以得到加強，縱容乃至支援恐怖主義的政府則必須為此負責。

en: But progress is not to be confused with victory.
zh: 但進展不應被稱作勝利。

en: Terrorists and terrorism cannot be eliminated any more than we can rid the world of disease.
zh: 恐怖分子和恐怖主義不可能根除，就像我們不可能從地球上消滅疾病一樣。

en: There will always be those who will resort to force against innocent men, women, and children in pursuit of political goals.
zh: 總會有人試圖對無辜者動用武力以追求其政治目標，不論是對男人、婦女還是兒童。

en: Indeed, terrorists are advancing in some areas.
zh: 事實上，恐怖分子在某些領域走在了前頭。

en: Pakistan remains a sanctuary for Al Qaeda and some of the world’s other most dangerous terrorists.
zh: 巴基斯坦仍在為基地組織和世界上其他一些最危險的恐怖分子提供庇護所。

en: A mixture of instability, government weakness, and ideology in countries such as Yemen, Libya, Somalia, and Nigeria are providing fertile territory for terrorists to organize, train, and mount operations – much as they did in Afghanistan did a decade ago.
zh: 由於局勢動盪、政府軟弱和意識形態等等原因，葉門、利比亞、索馬利亞和奈及利亞也在淪為恐怖主義滋生的沃土，它們在那些地方組織、訓練、實施行動，就像在十年前的阿富汗一樣。

en: New groups constantly emerge from the ruins of old ones.
zh: 舊的組織剛被摧毀，新的組織就冒出頭來。

en: There is also a growing danger of homegrown terrorism.
zh: 本土恐怖主義的危險也在增長。

en: We have seen it in Great Britain and the US.
zh: 我們在英國和美國都看到了這種跡象。

en: The Internet, one of the great inventions of the modern Western world, has shown itself to be a weapon that can be used to incite and train those who wish to cause harm to that world.
zh: 網際網路，這一現代西方世界的偉大發明，也被當成武器，激勵並訓練那些試圖危害這個世界的人。

en: The question raised in October 2003 by then US Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld is no less relevant today: “Are we capturing, killing, or deterring and dissuading more terrorists every day than the madrassas and the radical clerics are recruiting, training, and deploying against us?”
zh: 2003年10月，時任美國國防部長拉姆斯菲爾德曾提出一個問題，至今仍很中肯 ： “ 我們每天俘虜、擊斃、關押和改造過來的恐怖分子，能比伊斯蘭學校和激進宗教人士每天招募、訓練和派遣出來反對我們的人數多嗎？

en: All things being equal, we probably are.
zh: ”如果將一切等量齊觀，那我們也許已經做到了。

en: But even small terrorist successes are costly in terms of lives, money, and making open societies less so.
zh: 但恐怖分子的任何一點微小成功，對開放社會都意味著高昂的生命和金錢成本，從這個意義上說，我��得不償失。

en: What is to be done?
zh: 那我們該怎麼辦？

en: Alas, there is no single or silver bullet.
zh: 可惜沒有一蹴而就的辦法。

en: The establishment of a Palestinian state will not be enough for those terrorists who want to see the elimination of the Jewish state, any more than reaching a compromise over Kashmir will satisfy those Pakistan-based terrorists with bigger agendas vis-à-vis India.
zh: 巴勒斯坦建國還是不夠，因為恐怖分子想要消滅猶太人的國家；在克什米爾問題上達成妥協，也無法滿足巴基斯坦恐怖分子對印度更大的領土要求。

en: Reducing unemployment is desirable, of course, but many terrorists do not come from poverty.
zh: 減少失業當然是件好事，但許多恐怖分子並非窮人出身。

en: Helping to make societies in the Middle East and elsewhere more democratic might reduce the alienation that can lead to radicalism and worse, but this is easier said than done.
zh: 幫助中東和其他地方的社會變得更民主有助於緩解邊緣化作用，遏制極端主義，但這說起來比做起來容易。

en: Of course, we want to continue to find ways to make ourselves less vulnerable and terrorists more so.
zh: 當然，我們需要繼續想辦法，讓我們變強，讓恐怖分子變弱。

en: But what may be most important, particularly in the Arab and Islamic communities, is to end any acceptance of terrorism.
zh: 但最重要的是阻止恐怖主義以任何方式進行傳播，尤其是在阿拉伯和伊斯蘭社會。

en: The Nigerian father who warned the US embassy in Lagos that he feared what his own son might do – before that same young man attempted to detonate a bomb aboard a flight to Detroit on Christmas Day 2009 – is an example of just this.
zh: 2009年聖誕節，奈及利亞的一位父親向美國駐拉各斯大使館警告說，他擔心他的兒子會做出可怕的事情來，從而阻止了後者在飛往底特律的航班上引爆一枚炸彈，這就是一個很好的例子。

en: Only when more parents, teachers, and community leaders behave likewise will recruitment of terrorists dry up and law-enforcement authorities receive full cooperation from the populations they police.
zh: 只有當更多的父母、教師和社會領袖以這樣的方式行動起來，才能令恐怖分子的來源枯竭，執法部門才能獲得民眾的全力配合。

en: Terrorism must lose its legitimacy among those who have historically supported or tolerated it before it will lose its potency.
zh: 在那些傳統上支援或縱容恐怖主義的地方，恐怖主義必須先喪失其合法性，才會進一步喪失能量。

en: Transatlantic Trade for All
zh: 所有人的跨大西洋貿易

en: WASHINGTON, DC – The negotiations to create a Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership between the European Union and the United States are being widely welcomed.
zh: 華盛頓—歐盟和美國之間關於成立跨大西洋貿易和投資合作伙伴（TTIP）的談判受到了廣泛的歡迎。

en: British Prime Minister David Cameron has called the TTIP a “once-in-a-generation prize,” citing potential gains of £80 billion ($125.5 billion) each for the EU and the US and £85 billion for the rest of the world.
zh: 英國首相卡梅倫將TTIP稱為“一代人只有一次的機會 ” ， 認為它將給歐盟和美國各帶來800億英鎊的潛在收益，給世界其他地區帶來850億英鎊的潛在收益。

en: For a world weary of waiting for the World Trade Organization’s interminable Doha trade round to conclude, even a bilateral trade initiative may seem like a boon, especially when, as a recent Financial Times editorial pointed out, “bilateral” covers half of the world’s economy.
zh: 對於一個等待世貿組織冗長的多哈回合最後結果已經不耐煩的世界來說，即使是雙邊計劃也像是天降恩惠，特別是在《金融時報》最近所指出的“雙邊”關係包括了世界經濟半壁江山的當下。

en: But there is a serious downside: The deal could hurt developing-country exporters, unless the EU and the US make a concerted effort to protect these actors’ interests.
zh: 但風險也是巨大的：TTIP協議可能傷害發展中國家的出口，除非歐盟和美國攜手保護這些行動方的利益。

en: The feature of the proposed pact that elicits the most excitement – its focus on regulatory barriers like mandatory product standards – should actually incite the greatest concern.
zh: 計劃中的契約引起最多興奮情緒的部分 — — 其對強制性產品標準等監管壁壘的強調 — — 實際上最應該引起關注。

en: Given low tariffs in the EU and the US – less than 5%, on average – further preferential reductions will not seriously handicap outsiders.
zh: 歐盟和美國關稅很低 — — 平均不到5 % — —因此進一步的優惠降稅並不會嚴重影響其他國家。

en: But, when it comes to standards – such as those governing safety, health, and the environment – the market-access requirements are brutal and binary: either you meet the established standard or you do not sell.
zh: 但是，在標準問題上 — — 比如涉及安全、健康和環境的標準 — — 市場準入標準是嚴酷且二分的：要麼滿足規定的標準，要麼別來這裡賣東西。

en: As a result, third-country firms’ options will depend on how TTIP standards are established: through harmonization (adoption of a common standard) or mutual recognition (acceptance of goods that meet one another’s established standards).
zh: 其結果是第三國企業的選擇將取決於TTIP標準如何設定：透過協調（採取共同標準）還是透過互相承認（接受滿足彼此規定標準的商品和服務 ） 。

en: The first option would enable producers everywhere to take advantage of economies of scale.
zh: 第一種選擇將讓世界各地的生產者都能夠利用規模經濟的優勢。

en: But, in some cases, the harmonized standard could be more stringent than some countries’ original standards.
zh: 但是，在一些場合，協調後的標準���能比某些國家原先的標準更加苛刻。

en: Even though new standards would apply to suppliers from all exporting countries, compliance costs usually vary, meaning that those less equipped to meet higher standards could suffer.
zh: 儘管新標準將適用於所有出口國供應商，但合規成本通常各不相同，這意味著更難以滿足高標準的企業會遭受損失。

en: In the late 1990’s, when the EU decided to harmonize standards for aflatoxins (a group of toxic compounds produced by certain molds), eight member states – including Italy, the Netherlands, and Spain – raised their national standards substantially, which is likely to have caused African exports of cereals, dried fruits, and nuts to Europe to decline by as much as $670 million.
zh: 20世紀90年代末，歐盟決定協調黃麴黴素標準（黃麴黴素是某些黴菌產生的有毒成分族 ） ， 八個成員國 — — 包括義大利、荷蘭和西班牙 — — 大幅度提高了國家標準，這或許就是非洲國家隊歐洲的穀物、水果乾和堅果對歐出口下降6.7億美元的原因。

en: With mutual recognition, the EU and the US would accept each other’s standards or conformity-assessment procedures, allowing firms to adhere to the less stringent requirements in each area.
zh: 若採取互相承認，那麼歐盟和美國將承認彼此的標準或合規評估程式，企業會在各種標準中選擇不太苛刻的那種。

en: If the policy were extended to third-country firms, it would have a powerful liberalizing impact.
zh: 如果該政策擴充套件到第三國企業，就會產生極大的自由化作用。

en: For example, Malaysian television producers could choose to comply with, say, America’s easier-to-meet safety standards, then sell the same product in both markets, reaping the benefits of economies of scale while lowering compliance costs.
zh: 比如，馬來西亞電視生產商可能選擇符合（比如）美國較易符合的安全標準，然後在歐美兩地銷售同樣的產品，既享受了規模經濟的好處，又降低了合規成本。

en: If, however, the TTIP excluded third-country firms from the mutual recognition policy, their competitiveness vis-à-vis European and American companies would diminish substantially.
zh: 但是，如果TTIP將第三國企業排除在互相承認政策之外，那麼它們相對歐洲和美股公司的競爭力將受到極大的削弱。

en: Indeed, our research shows that when mutual-recognition agreements include restrictive rules of origin, intra-regional trade increases – at the expense of trade with other countries – and that developing countries tend to suffer most.
zh: 事實上，我們的研究表明，若互相承諾協議包括嚴格的來源國限制，則地區內貿易將增加，與其他國家的貿易會削弱，發展中國家損失最大。

en: In fact, excessively constraining rules of origin have proved problematic for some of the EU’s previous recognition agreements, such as those governing professional-services standards.
zh: 事實上，歐盟此前的不少承認協議（比如在專業服務標準方面）表明，過度約束的來源地規則很有問題大有問題。

en: While a Brazilian orange admitted for sale in Portugal can be sold throughout the EU, a Brazilian engineer or accountant licensed in Portugal must fulfill separate licensing requirements to work elsewhere in the EU, hampering much-needed labor mobility by forcing non-European workers to endure costly and inefficient bureaucratic procedures.
zh: 儘管獲准在葡萄牙出售的巴西橙可以在整個歐盟出售，但獲得葡萄牙執照的巴西工程師和會計師仍必須滿足歐盟其他地區各自的執業要求，這迫使非歐洲工人忍受費時費力的官僚主義流程，不利於急需的勞動力流動。

en: Furthermore, when it comes to tariffs and standards, WTO rules are not created equal.
zh: 此外，在關稅和標準方面，世貿組織規則並不平等。

en: While they protect countries excluded from bilateral or regional tariff agreements, thereby ensuring that integrated markets do not receive additional advantages, few safeguards exist to shield third countries from the fallout of agreements on mandatory standards.
zh: 儘管世貿組織規則保護著被雙邊和地區關稅協定排除在外的國家，從而確保一體化市場不會獲得其他附加的優勢，但保護第三國免受強制性標準協議影響的保護措施幾乎不存在。

en: Even in the absence of international rules, the EU and the US could take two actions to ensure that the TTIP does not have adverse consequences for developing economies.
zh: 即使沒有國際法，歐盟和美國也可以採取兩個動作確保TTIP不會損害發展中經濟體。

en: First, they could allow all countries to reap the benefits of a bilateral mutual-recognition deal by agreeing not to impose restrictive rules of origin.
zh: 首先，它們可以同意不實施嚴格的來源地規則，這將使所有國家都能享受到雙邊互相承認協議的好處。

en: Second, where they do consider harmonization, they could favor the less stringent of the original standards, unless there is credible evidence that it would not support the relevant regulatory objective.
zh: 其次，在考慮協調的領域，它們可以傾向於原始標準中較不苛刻的一個，除非有充分的證據表明這樣做不利於相關監管目標。

en: This is akin to a WTO test for departures from established international standards.
zh: 這類似於世貿組織的脫離現行國際標準測試。

en: If the EU and the US made these two commitments, the rest of the world could follow the TTIP negotiations with hope, rather than trepidation.
zh: 如果歐盟和美國實施了這兩點，世界其他國家將可以帶著希望而不是恐懼追蹤TTIP。

en: A Balanced Look at Sino-American Imbalances
zh: 中美貿易不平衡的平衡觀

en: BEIJING – Before July 2007, most economists agreed that global imbalances were the most important threat to global growth.
zh: 發自北京 — — 在2007年7月以前，大多數經濟學家都認為全球增長的最重大威脅來自於全球貿易不平衡。

en: It was argued that the United States’ rising net foreign debt-to-GDP ratio – the result of chronic current-account deficits – would put a sharp brake on capital inflows, in turn weakening the dollar, driving up interest rates, and plunging the US economy into crisis.
zh: 他們覺得美國淨外債與GDP比率的不斷上升 — — 這是長期經常賬戶赤字所引發的後果 — — 將導致資金流入急劇減少，隨之削弱美元，而後利率上漲，並最終令美國經濟陷入危機當中。

en: But this scenario failed to materialize. Instead, the crisis stemmed from the US sub-prime debacle, which quickly dragged the global economy into its deepest recession since the 1930’s.
zh: 但這一設想卻未能成為現實，事實上本次危機源自於美國次級貸款的崩盤，並當即將全球經濟拖入了一場自1930年代以來最為嚴重的衰退當中。

en: Most economists failed to foresee the economic dynamics that actually led to the crisis, because they failed to pay enough attention to the rapid increase in US total debt.
zh: 而大多數經濟學家之所以無法預見到危機背後的真正經濟驅動力，是因為他們對美國總債務的快速增長缺乏足夠的關注。

en: Instead, they focused exclusively on US foreign debt, ignoring household debt (mortgage and consumer debt), public debt, business debt, and financial debt.
zh: 實際上他們把注意力都放在了美國的外債上，卻忽視了家庭負債（抵押貸款和消費者債務 ） 、 公共負債，商業債務和金融債務等方面的問題。

en: In particular, they should have paid greater attention to the sustainability of US mortgage and consumer debt.
zh: 他們尤其應當對美國抵押貸款和消費者債務的可持續性給予更多的關注。

en: In 2007, the mortgage and consumer debt-to-GDP ratio was more than 90%, compared to 24% for net foreign debt.
zh: 在2007年，上述兩項負債與GDP的比率已經上升到90%以上，而與此同時淨外債的相關比率只有24 % 。

en: Of course, the various components of debt differ considerably in their character and sources of financing – and thus in their sustainability.
zh: 當然，債務的不同組成部分也因各自的特性和資金來源而大不相同 — — 而其可持續性也是如此。

en: But all parts of a country’s total debt and how it is financed are interconnected.
zh: 但一國總債務的各個組成部分及其資助方式之間顯然是有所關聯的。

en: This means two things. First, funds from different sources of finance are interchangeable to a certain degree: deficiency of funds for one component of total debt can be supplemented by surplus funds originally aimed at financing other components.
zh: 這意味著兩點，首先：來自不同融資來源的資金在某種程度上是可互換的：總債務中某項資金出現的赤字可以用原本提供給其他用途的多餘資金來填補。

en: Second, troubles in any single component of total debt will have an impact on all the other components.
zh: 其二，總債務中某一部分所導致的問題將對其他部分造成影響。

en: After the subprime crisis erupted, mortgage and consumer debt was paid down by households either with their savings or by default.
zh: 在次貸危機爆發之後，美國家庭只能用儲蓄來支付抵押貸款和消費者債務，或者被迫放棄償還。

en: The fall in US total debt, and the narrowing of the financing gap between total debt and domestic funds, led to a significant improvement in the US current-account deficit in 2008-2009, disproving US Federal Reserve Board Chairman Ben Bernanke’s claim that the deficit was caused by a global “saving glut.”
zh: 美國總債務的下降，以及總債務和國內資金之間財政缺口的縮窄，都使得美國經常賬戶赤字狀況在2008-2009財年大大改善，也證明美聯儲主席伯南克宣稱該赤字是由全球“儲蓄偏好”所引發的觀點是錯誤的。

en: Indeed, America’s current-account position strengthened despite the dollar’s appreciation in the face of safe-haven demand.
zh: 事實上儘管美元在避險需求下升值，美國經常賬戶狀況卻得到了鞏固。

en: Unfortunately, as a result of the private-sector deleveraging and an increase in household savings, the US economy, driven by debt and consumption, slid into recession.
zh: 但不幸的是，隨著私人部門去槓桿化以及家庭儲蓄的增加，由負債和消費驅動的美國經濟陷入了衰退。

en: To offset the negative impact of private-sector deleveraging on growth, the US government has maintained expansionary fiscal and monetary policies.
zh: 為了減少私人部門去槓桿化對經濟增長的負面影響，美國政府採取了一系列擴張性的貨幣和財政政策。

en: Now, with household debt sustained on a knife-edge after feverish government intervention, the fiscal position has deteriorated dramatically and the current-account balance has worsened again.
zh: 如今政府大力干預後的家庭負債狀況依然處於危險邊緣，同時財政狀況急劇惡化，經常賬戶平衡狀況也再度變差。

en: Sustainability of public debt has replaced sustainability of private debt as the biggest threat to financial stability, and the focus of debate about the US current account has shifted from the sustainability of foreign debt to the impact of reducing the external deficit on growth and employment.
zh: 公共債務的可持續性已經取代私人債務成為美國金融穩定的最大問題，而針對美國經常賬戶狀況的爭論焦點也從外債的可持續性轉移到外部赤字降低對增長和就業的影響。

en: The dilemma facing US policymakers is how to stimulate growth while lowering the level of total debt.
zh: 對此美國的政策制定者目前陷入了困境：一方面要促進增長，另一方面又得降低總債務水平。

en: The most important way to achieve both objectives is to increase exports by strengthening US competitiveness.
zh: 而實現這兩大目標的最重要方式就是透過提升美國國家競爭力的方式來增加出口。

en: But where will increased competitiveness come from?
zh: 但這些競爭力的提升又從何而來？ ，

en: Devaluation of the dollar could improve US competitiveness in the short run, but it is not a solution.
zh: 將美元貶值的做法能在短期內提升美國的競爭力，但卻非長久之策。

en: Because rapid fiscal deterioration now has investors worrying about capital losses on US government securities, devaluation would make foreigners more hesitant to finance America’s budget deficit.
zh: 因為財政狀況的迅速惡化已經令投資者們對自己美國政府債券上的資本損失憂慮不已，此外貶值也將使外國人更不願意資助美國的預算赤字。

en: If foreign financing is not forthcoming, yields on US government debt will rise and the US economy will fall back into recession.
zh: 如果得不到外國資金，美國政府債務的收益率將被迫提升而美國經濟也將重新陷入衰退。

en: In the long run, America’s growth pattern must undergo a structural shift from reliance on debt and consumption one based on Americans vaunted capacity for creativity and innovation.
zh: 長期來說，美國的發展模式必須由原本對負債和消費的依賴轉向美國人引以為榮的創新能力。

en: Only then will America improve its competitiveness enough to allow the government to reduce both private and public debt to sustainable levels while maintaining a respectable growth rate.
zh: 只有這樣美國才能真正提升其競爭力，並使政府可以在保持合理增長率的同時將私人和公共債務都降低到一個可持續的水平上。

en: But neither improved competitiveness, nor reduction of total debt, can be achieved overnight.
zh: 但提升競爭力和減少總債務這兩個目標都不可能一蹴而就。

en: In the short run, the US current-account deficit will remain, regardless of which country runs bilateral surpluses.
zh: 無論對其擁有雙邊貿易順差的是哪一個國家，美國的經常賬戶赤字將在短期內繼續存在。

en: Thus, China’s continued reinvestment of its current-account surplus in US government securities is of utmost important for US growth and financial stability.
zh: 因此中國將其貿易盈餘持續投資在美國政府債券上的行為對美國的經濟增長和金融穩定都是極為重要的。

en: Given that America benefits mightily from China’s purchases of US government securities, it is difficult to understand why the US government and Congress have been complaining so much about the bilateral current-account deficit.
zh: 考慮到美國在中國購買美國國債方面獲取的重大利益，我們很難理解美國政府和國會為何總是對中美雙邊經常賬戶赤字大肆抱怨。

en: It is also difficult to grasp why China is so reluctant to reduce its bilateral surplus, given meager returns on its massive holdings of US government securities and a sustained risk of large capital losses in the future.
zh: 而於此同時，我們也難以解釋中國為何不願減少其雙邊貿易盈餘，因為大規模持有美國政府債券回報極低，而且還存在著鉅額資本流失風險。

en: The good news is that, following President Hu Jintao’s recent visit to Washington, both America and China have been taking positive steps to resolve their differences over the bilateral current-account balance.
zh: 但好訊息是，在中國國家主席胡錦濤最近的訪美之行中，中美兩國都在解決雙邊貿易不平衡方面做出了積極的舉措。

en: That augurs well for a more rational and constructive Sino-American dialogue on global imbalances, which would certainly benefit the global economy.
zh: 這預示著一個更加理性也更富建設性的中美全球貿易不平衡對話，而這也將對全球經濟有所裨益。

en: A Banking Union Baby Step
zh: 銀行聯盟第一步

en: BRUSSELS – At the beginning of the financial crisis, it was said that banks were, in Charles Goodhart’s crisp phrase, “international in life, but national in death.”
zh: 布魯塞爾—金融危機開始時，人們用查爾斯·古德哈特（Charles Goodhart）的名言來描述銀行 ： “ 生而國際，死而民族。

en: At the time (2008-2009), large international banks had to be rescued by their home countries’ governments when they ran into trouble.
zh: ”當是時（2008—2009年 ） ， 國際大銀行在深陷困境時不得不由母國政府出手相救。

en: But the problem now in Europe is the opposite: banks are “national in life, but European in death.”
zh: 但如今，歐洲的問題與此正好相反，銀行“生而民族，死而歐洲 ” 。

en: In Spain, for example, local savings banks (cajas) financed an outsize real-estate boom.
zh: 比如，在西班牙，地方儲蓄銀行是超級地產繁榮的融資提供者。

en: As the boom turned to bust, the losses threatened to overwhelm the capacity of the Spanish state, and the problem became European, because it threatened the very survival of the euro.
zh: 隨著繁榮變為蕭條，由此產生的損失已快要超過了西班牙整個國家的能力，這一問題變成了歐洲問題，因為事關歐元存亡。

en: The Spanish case is symptomatic of a larger problem.
zh: 西班牙的狀況是一個更大問題的症狀。

en: National supervisors always tend to minimize problems at home.
zh: 國家層面的監管者總是試圖最小化國內問題。

en: Their instinct (and their bureaucratic interest) is to defend their countries’ “national champion” bank(s) abroad.
zh: 他們的本能（也是他們官僚主義利益之所在）是捍衛“國寶 ” （ national champion）銀行在國外的表現。

en: But their resistance to recognizing problems at home runs even deeper.
zh: 但他們對辨認國內問題的牴觸更加嚴重。

en: Until recently, the Spanish authorities maintained that the problems in their country’s real-estate sector were temporary.
zh: 直到最近，西班牙當局才不再堅持該國房地產部門問題不是暫時性的。

en: To acknowledge the truth would have meant admitting that for years they had overlooked the build-up of an unsustainable construction boom that now threatens to bankrupt the entire country.
zh: 承認真相意味著多年來他們忽略了不可持續建設繁榮的風險，以至於如今整個國家都陷入了破產危險。

en: In the case of Ireland, the situation was initially not much different.
zh: 在愛爾蘭，最初的情況與西班牙並沒有太大不同。

en: When problems started to surface, the finance minister at the time initially claimed that the country would carry out “the cheapest bank rescue ever.”
zh: 當問題開始浮現時，時任財政部長宣稱愛爾蘭將實行“史上成本最小的銀行救援 ” 。

en: Given national supervisors’ predictable tendency not to recognize problems at home, it seemed natural that the cost of cleaning up insolvent banks should also be borne at the national level.
zh: 不難預料，國家級監管者總是傾向於對國內問題視而不見，因此，清算資不抵債銀行的成本應該由各國自行承擔似乎是自然而然的事情。

en: It thus seemed to make sense that even in the eurozone, banking supervision remained largely national.
zh: 於是，即使是在歐元區，銀行監管大體上仍維持各國各自為政的局面似乎也不無道理。

en: The recently created European Banking Authority has only limited powers over national supervisors, whose daily work is guided mainly by national considerations.
zh: 新近成立的歐洲銀行局所有用的許可權比日常工作主要根據國內情況進行的國家級監管者大不了多少。

en: But reality has shown that this approach is not tenable.
zh: 但現實已經證明，這條道路走不通。

en: Problems might originate at the national level, but, owing to monetary union, they quickly threaten the stability of the entire eurozone banking system.
zh: 問題也許肇始於國家層面，但是，由於貨幣聯盟的存在，它們很快會威脅到整個歐元區銀行系統的穩定性。

en: At their June summit, Europe’s leaders finally recognized the need to rectify this situation, transferring responsibility for banking supervision in the eurozone to the European Central Bank.
zh: 在6月峰會上，歐洲領導人最終意識到修正這一情況、將歐元區銀行監管職能移交給歐洲央行的重要性。

en: Given that financial integration is particularly strong within the monetary union, putting the ECB in charge was an obvious choice.
zh: 作為貨幣聯盟，金融一體化在歐元區非常牢固，這使得歐洲央行成了不二之選。
