en: A Centerless Euro Cannot Hold
zh: 缺少集中的歐元無法生存

en: CAMBRIDGE – With youth unemployment touching 50% in eurozone countries such as Spain and Greece, is a generation being sacrificed for the sake of a single currency that encompasses too diverse a group of countries to be sustainable?
zh: 美國劍橋—在西班牙和希臘等歐元區國家，年輕人失業率達到了50 % ， 這可以說是為了在覆蓋彼此差異太大而根本不可能持續的多國實行單一貨幣而犧牲了一代人嗎？

en: If so, does enlarging the euro’s membership really serve Europe’s apparent goal of maximizing economic integration without necessarily achieving full political union?
zh: 如果答案是肯定的，擴大歐元區成員國範圍真的有助於歐洲達到最大化經濟一體化而又不必形成政治上的完全統一這一眾人皆知的目標嗎？

en: The good news is that economic research does have a few things to say about whether Europe should have a single currency.
zh: 好訊息是，經濟研究確實對歐洲是否應該使用單一貨幣這一問題形成了一些成果。

en: The bad news is that it has become increasingly clear that, at least for large countries, currency areas will be highly unstable unless they follow national borders.
zh: 壞訊息是，越來越明顯的是，至少對於大國，貨幣區是非常不穩定的，除非其邊界和國境線相同。

en: At a minimum, currency unions require a confederation with far more centralized power over taxation and other policies than European leaders envision for the eurozone.
zh: 不管怎樣，貨幣聯盟至少需要是一個邦聯，擁有比歐洲領導人的歐元區願景遠為集中的稅收和其他政策權力。

en: What of Nobel Prize winner Robert Mundell’s famous 1961 conjecture that national and currency borders need not significantly overlap?
zh: 那麼，如何看待諾貝爾獎獲得者蒙代爾1961年的著名預言呢？ 蒙代爾說，國境線和貨幣邊界並不需要大致重合。

en: In his provocative American Economic Review paper “A Theory of Optimum Currency Areas,” Mundell argued that as long as workers could move within a currency region to where the jobs were, the region could afford to forgo the equilibrating mechanism of exchange-rate adjustment.
zh: 在他發表於《美國經濟評論 》 （ American Economic Review）的雄文《最優貨幣區理論 》 （ A Theory of Optimum Currency Areas）中，蒙代爾指出，只要工人能在貨幣區內自由流動追逐工作，該貨幣區就可以形成一個匯率調整的均衡機制。

en: He credited another (future) Nobel Prize winner, James Meade, for having recognized the importance of labor mobility in earlier work, but criticized Meade for interpreting the idea too stringently, especially in the context of Europe’s nascent integration.
zh: 蒙代爾將對勞動流動性的重要性的認識歸功於另一位（未來）諾貝爾獎獲得者米德，但也指出，米德對這一觀點的解釋太過嚴格，特別是在歐洲一體化剛剛出現萌芽的時候。

en: Mundell did not emphasize financial crises, but presumably labor mobility is more important today than ever.
zh: 蒙代爾並未強調金融危機，但他推測勞動流動性在今日要比過去更重要。

en: Not surprisingly, workers are leaving the eurozone’s crisis countries, but not necessarily for its stronger northern region.
zh: 毫不奇怪，工人們正在離開歐元區危機國，但遷移目標並非一定是更堅挺的北歐地區。

en: Instead, Portuguese workers are fleeing to booming former colonies such as Brazil and Macau.
zh: 事實上，葡萄牙工人正在逃向繁榮的昔日殖民地，比如巴西和澳門。

en: Irish workers are leaving in droves to Canada, Australia, and the United States.
zh: 愛爾蘭工人正在遷往加拿大、澳大利亞和美國。

en: Spanish workers are streaming into Romania, which until recently had been a major source of agricultural labor in Spain.
zh: 西班牙工人正在湧向羅馬尼亞，而後者以前一直是西班牙農業勞動力的主要來源。

en: Still, if intra-eurozone mobility were anything like Mundell’s ideal, today we would not be seeing 25% unemployment in Spain while Germany’s unemployment rate is below 7%.
zh: 儘管如此，如果歐元區內部流動效能夠與蒙代爾的理想狀況略有相似，那麼如今我們就不會看到西班牙失業率高達25%而德國失業率低至不到7%的情況。

en: Later writers came to recognize that there are other essential criteria for a successful currency union, which are difficult to achieve without deep political integration.
zh: 後來的研究者開始認識到成功的貨幣聯盟還���要其他關鍵要素，而這些要素在沒有深度政治一體化的情況下很難實現。

en: Peter Kenen argued in the late 1960’s that without exchange-rate movements as a shock absorber, a currency union requires fiscal transfers as a way to share risk.
zh: 柯南（Peter Kenen）在20世紀60年代末指出，如果沒有匯率變動作為衝擊吸收器，貨幣聯盟就需要財政轉移來作為分擔風險的辦法。

en: For a normal country, the national income-tax system constitutes a huge automatic stabilizer across regions.
zh: 在平常國家，國民所得稅嫡系便是一個巨型地區級自動穩定器。

en: In the US, when oil prices go up, incomes in Texas and Montana rise, which means that these states then contribute more tax revenue to the federal budget, thereby helping out the rest of the country.
zh: 在美國，當油價上漲時，德克薩斯州和蒙大拿州的收入會上升，這意味著該兩州將向聯邦預算貢獻更多的稅收收入，從而幫助美國的其餘地區走出困境。

en: Europe, of course, has no significant centralized tax authority, so this key automatic stabilizer is essentially absent.
zh: 當然，歐洲不存在大型中央稅收當局，因此這一重要自動穩定器也就不存在了。

en: Some European academics tried to argue that there was no need for US-like fiscal transfers, because any desired degree of risk sharing can, in theory, be achieved through financial markets.
zh: 一些歐洲學者試圖論證像美國那樣的財政轉移並不是必須的，因為從理論上說，不管你想要多大程度的風險共擔，都可以透過金融市場達到。

en: This claim was hugely misguided.
zh: 這一論斷大錯特錯。

en: Financial markets can be fragile, and they provide little capacity for sharing risk related to labor income, which constitutes the largest part of income in any advanced economy.
zh: 金融市場可能非常脆弱，所提供的分擔勞動收入相關風險能力幾乎為零，而勞動收入是發達國家收入的最大來源。

en: Kenen was mainly concerned with short-term transfers to smooth out cyclical bumpiness.
zh: 柯南主要關心的是短期轉移可以平滑週期性起伏。

en: But, in a currency union with huge differences in income and development levels, the short term can stretch out for a very long time.
zh: 但是，在一個收入和發展水平差異巨大的貨幣聯盟中 ， “ 短期”所經歷的時間可能非常長。

en: Many Germans today rightly feel that any system of fiscal transfers will morph into a permanent feeding tube, much the way that northern Italy has been propping up southern Italy for the last century.
zh: 許多德國人如今正確地感受到，任何財政轉移系統都有可能兌變為持久的飼管，正如上個世紀義大利北部對義大利南部的不斷輸血。

en: Indeed, more than 20 years on, Western Germans still see no end in sight for the bills from German unification.
zh: 事實上，德國統一20多年來，西德仍然看不到統一的成本什麼時候才是個頭。

en: Later, Maurice Obstfeld pointed out that, in addition to fiscal transfers, a currency union needs clearly defined rules for the lender of last resort.
zh: 再後來，奧布斯菲爾德（Maurice Obstfeld）指出，除了財政轉移，貨幣聯盟還需要有明確定義的最後貸款人規則。

en: Otherwise, bank runs and debt panics will be rampant.
zh: 否則的話，銀行擠兌和債務恐慌將會氾濫。

en: Obstfeld had in mind a bailout mechanism for banks, but it is now abundantly clear that one also needs a lender of last resort and a bankruptcy mechanism for states and municipalities.
zh: 奧布斯菲爾德構想了一個銀行救助機制，但現在，顯而易見的是，國家和自治地區也需要最後貸款人和破產機制。

en: A logical corollary of the criteria set forth by Kenen and Obstfeld, and even of Mundell’s labor-mobility criterion, is that currency unions cannot survive without political legitimacy, most likely involving region-wide popular elections.
zh: 從柯南和奧布斯菲爾德所提出的前提出發，甚至即使從蒙代爾的勞動流動性前提看，一個符合邏輯的推論是，貨幣聯盟不可能在沒有政治合法性 — — 最有可能的形式是地區級的大選 — — 的前提下生存。

en: Europe’s leaders cannot carry out large transfers across countries indefinitely without a coherent European political framework.
zh: 沒有凝聚性的歐洲政治框架，歐洲領導人就不可能無限度地在各國間實現大規模轉移。

en: European policymakers today often complain that, were it not for the US financial crisis, the eurozone would be doing just fine.
zh: 如今，歐洲決策者經常抱怨說，要不是美國金融危機，歐元區根本不會遭殃。

en: Perhaps they are right.
zh: 也許這麼說並不錯。

en: But any financial system must be able to withstand shocks, including big ones.
zh: 但金融體系必須能夠抵禦衝擊，即使是劇烈衝擊。

en: Europe may never be an “optimum” currency area by any standard.
zh: 歐洲也許從來都不是一個“最優”貨幣區，不管從什麼角度看都是如此。

en: But, without further profound political and economic integration – which may not end up including all current eurozone members – the euro may not make it even to the end of this decade.
zh: 但是，如果沒有更加深遠的政治和經濟一體化 — — 也許最終無法將所有當前歐元區成員國納入進來 — — 可能連這個十年都撐不過。

en: Achieving a “Europe of Results”
zh: 建設“以成果為導向的歐洲”

en: BRUSSELS – The tsunami that has swept across financial markets is a global catastrophe.
zh: 發自布魯塞爾 — — 席捲全球的金融海嘯無疑是場巨大的災難。

en: If handled correctly, however, the crisis may yet raise the esteem of the European Union and its institutions.
zh: 但如果處理得當的話，這場危機反而能為歐盟及其下屬機構贏來人們的重視與敬重。

en: The EU’s legitimacy problem has two different aspects: apathy, leading to a low turnout in the European parliamentary elections, and outright euro-skepticism.
zh: 毫無疑問，歐盟一直被其和合法性問題困擾著，而此問題則來自兩方面：首先是人們的漠視，這導致了歐洲議會選舉低下的投票率，還有就是那些徹底反對歐盟和歐元的懷疑論調。

en: The voter-turnout problem partly reflects frustration about the present state of the EU, and also people’s impression that they can exert little influence by voting one way or the other.
zh: 低投票率在某個側面體現了民眾對歐盟目前狀況的挫折感，在他們看來無論選誰，自己這一票都微不足道。

en: Euro-skepticism, on the other hand, and the looming threat of anti-European populism, is directly linked to the idea that the EU is not merely incapable of offering a solution to the crisis, but in fact is part of the problem.
zh: 而在另一方面，歐盟懷疑論以及反歐盟民粹主義的興起，則直接與另一種想法有關：那就是歐盟非但不能為危機提供解決方案，連其本身都是問題的始作俑者。

en: So, although the EU represents our best hope of ensuring that Europe is internationally competitive in today’s increasingly difficult environment, it is actually being blamed for globalization.
zh: 因此即便歐盟體現了我們為確保歐洲在日漸艱難的時勢中保持競爭力的良好願望，它依然受到“為危機全球化推波助瀾”的指責。

en: Many people confuse these two aspects of the EU’s legitimacy problem, and believe that somehow turnout in European elections can be increased by pointing out to people how good and important the EU is.
zh: 許多人混淆了歐盟合法性的這兩方面問題，並堅信只要能勸服民眾說歐盟有多好、有多重要，就能讓歐洲議會選舉投票率有所提升。

en: But in most cases, this is not possible.
zh: 但在絕大多數情況下，這條路根本沒行不通。

en: At first sight, the easiest answer to the problem of low voter turnout is to give more power to the European Parliament.
zh: 照“拍腦袋”簡單一想的方法，提高投票率的最簡單方法就是賦予歐洲議會更多的權力。

en: But if this was the solution, then we would not have had steadily declining turnouts since the high point of 63%, at the first elections to the European Parliament in 1979. After all, since then the EP’s influence and powers of joint decision-making have grown constantly.
zh: 但如果這也算解決方案的話，那就難以解釋為什麼歐洲議會的影響力和聯合決策權在1979年第一次選舉之後不斷擴大，但投票率卻在那次選舉的63%高點上逐步下降的矛盾現實了。

en: The trouble is that, EP elections must be “about” something if voters are to be interested, which means they must involve a real choice.
zh: 問題在於，歐洲議會選舉如果要吸引選民的話，那麼它必須“言之有物 ” ， 讓選民意識到自己確實在作出一個“實打實”的選擇。

en: And a real choice requires Europe-wide election campaigns by all parties. This would also involve making the choice of the European Commission’s president dependent on the outcome of the EP elections.
zh: 而這樣一個“實打實”的選擇要求有全歐洲所有黨派的競選活動來共同組成，其中還包括讓選民透過決定歐洲議會選舉的結果來選定誰是歐盟委員會主席。

en: But, in fact, both of these conditions have already been met; in 2004, Portuguese Prime Minister José Manuel Durão Barroso was appointed President of the Commission because he came from the political organization with the strongest election result, the European People’s Party.
zh: 但其實上述這些條件其實早就達到了：在2004年，葡萄牙首相何塞·曼努埃爾·杜朗·巴羅佐就因其背後的政治組織“歐洲人民黨團”在歐洲議會競選中風頭最勁而被任命為歐盟委員會主席。

en: And this year’s elections saw a more intensive presence of party organizations at European level than ever before.
zh: 而今年歐洲議會選舉中此類歐洲層面上的黨團勢力也比以往更加集中地出現在人們眼前。

en: Instead, I believe that the most important way to reawaken voters’ interest in European elections will be to open up the election of the Commission’s President to them, and create a genuinely Europe-wide political debate during the next election campaign.
zh: 因此我相信，要喚起選民熱情，最重要手段就是讓他們直接選舉歐盟委員會主席，還必須在下次歐洲議會競選活動中，真正掀起一場覆蓋全歐洲的政治大辯論。

en: The Euro-skepticism problem can be tackled only if the Union itself starts to perform better, and is seen to be doing so.
zh: 而歐洲懷疑論的冰釋，只能在歐盟開始表現得更好，並似乎能一直保持努力進步之後才能達到。

en: That is why in the aftermath of the failed referenda four years ago in France and the Netherlands on the Constitutional treaty, the Commission tried to emphasize the idea of a “Europe of Results” that would seek to convince citizens of its worth through concrete achievements.
zh: 這也是為什麼在對4年前歐盟憲法公投在法國和荷蘭慘遭滑鐵盧的事實進行了檢討之後，歐盟委員會就開始強調“以成果為導向的歐洲”這一理念，並試圖用看得見摸得著的政績去讓人們明白歐盟的價值。

en: Given the gravity of the economic crisis, the time has come for the EU to demonstrate its strengths whenever possible.
zh: 考慮到經濟危機的巨大影響力，是時候讓歐盟儘可能地展現自己的力量了。

en: The aim must be not only to win back the hearts of Europeans who have become skeptical, but also to convince them that the Union is indispensable to meeting the challenges Europeans face.
zh: 而這些努力的目標不僅是贏回那些滿腹狐疑的歐洲人的心，更要讓他們確信：歐盟這個組織在應對當前挑戰方面是不可或缺的。

en: Europe’s citizens understand that the relatively small nation-states that make up the EU are no longer able to face these enormous challenges on their own.
zh: 歐洲的公民們已經意識到，歐盟內部那些相對較小的國家早已無力獨自應對這些巨大挑戰。

en: In Ireland, last autumn’s financial crisis provoked a turnaround in public opinion about the EU, and even in Iceland, although it lies on the periphery of our continent, membership of the EU and the euro have become a priority.
zh: 在愛爾蘭，去年夏天的金融危機讓人們對歐盟的態度發生了180度的轉向，甚至連一向遊離於歐洲大陸之外的冰島，歐盟成員國資格和歐元也被放在了首位。

en: European countries have become so interconnected that isolated national measures on issues like financial-market regulation are hopeless.
zh: 歐洲國家的利益是如此盤根錯節地交織在一起，以至於那些試圖用孤立的國家政策來應對金融市場規管問題的手段都變得一無是處。

en: A changing world in which new powers like China and India play an increasingly important role will not wait for Europe to make up its mind.
zh: 世界正在變化，中國和印度這類新興強權正日漸扮演更重要的角色，它們可等不及歐洲去打自己的小算盤。

en: The EU must instead show leadership through its efforts to solve the world’s current problems.
zh: 因此歐盟必須透過解決當今世界問題的一系列努力來顯示其領導地位。

en: As for the European People’s Party, for us the economy is not an end in itself but should serve the people.
zh: 而對於我所屬的歐洲人民黨團來說，經濟體系的存在目的不是為自身謀利，而是服務大眾。

en: The economic crisis was caused by shortsightedness and a lack of control in the global financial system. Now we must redefine the role of regulators in financial markets and in the wider economy, for we cannot let the financial sector walk off with the profits and leave taxpayers bearing the losses.
zh: 目前這場經濟危機源自於目光短淺的行為以及全球金融系統的管制不力，因此我們必須重新定義在金融市場和更宏觀經濟中規管者所需扮演的角色，因為我們不能讓金融部門一面把利潤塞滿自己的口袋，另一面卻叫納稅人來承擔損失。

en: That doesn’t mean that we are advocating a move to socialism; we want better and smarter regulation, not regulation for its own sake.
zh: 這並不意味著我們鼓吹社會主義；監管必須更好和更明智，而不是為監管而監管。

en: We see five keys to recovery:
zh: 而下面五點則是經濟復原的關鍵：

en: A “Europe of Results” is achievable.
zh: 一個“以成果為導向的歐洲”是可以實現的。

en: It can strengthen the EU’s legitimacy, though, only if policy recommendations such as these, and the successes that result from implementing them, are communicated clearly and effectively to the general public.
zh: 只要我們能向公眾清晰有效地說明上述政策建議，並在實際執行中取得成功，那麼歐盟合法性的增強，就必然會得以實現。

en: The Education Roadmap to 2030
zh: 2030年教育路線圖

en: LONDON – When I visited the Zaatari refugee camp in Jordan earlier this year, I met with children who told me what education means to them.
zh: 倫敦—今年早些時候，我訪問了位於約旦的扎塔裡（Zaatari）難民營。 我遇見了一些兒童，他們告訴我教育對他們意味著什麼。

en: For Syrian youths who have been forced from their homes and have lost everything, education is about more than qualifications or test scores; it embodies their hope for the future.
zh: 對被迫離開家園、失去一切的敘利亞年輕人來說，教育的意義遠不止合格或分數；而是寄託著對未來的希望。

en: Children like those in Zaatari, and millions of others around the world, are central to the work of the International Commission on Financing Global Education Opportunity, which I joined last September.
zh: 扎塔裡難民營以及全世界的數百萬兒童是全球教育機會融資國際委員會（International Commission on Financing Global Education Opportunity）工作的核心。

en: This commission is committed to the fourth United Nations Sustainable Development Goal, which aims, by 2030, to “ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all.”
zh: 我在去年9月加入了該委員會，它致力於聯合國可持續發展目標中的第四項，即到2030年“確保包容和平等的高質量教育並推動全人類的終身學習機會。 ”

en: This goal is still a distant prospect for far too many children.
zh: 對於太多的兒童而言，這個目標仍然遙不可及。

en: With so many development issues demanding our attention, policymakers should bear in mind that education is not just a good in itself; it is also a catalyst for many other development gains.
zh: 有如此多的發展問題需要我們關注，決策者應該時刻銘記，教育不但本身是一種好東西（good ） ； 而且也是其他眾多發展收益的催化劑。

en: As the old African proverb goes, if you educate a girl, you educate an entire nation.
zh: 非洲古諺有云，教育女孩等於教育整個國家。

en: Ensuring access to quality education for children, especially girls, will lead to fewer child marriages and less child labor and exploitation.
zh: 確保兒童特別是女孩獲得高質量教育能減少童婚、童工和剝削。

en: And education has long-term societal benefits: aside from increased political engagement, educated children contribute intellectual capital and pursue entrepreneurial opportunities when they grow up, boosting economic growth.
zh: 教育也具有長期收益：除了增加政治參與，受過教育的兒童能帶來智力資本並能在長大後追求創業機會，從而提振經濟增長。

en: Tackling the education challenge needs to start from two principles embedded in the goal.
zh: 克服教育挑戰必須從聯合國可持續發展目標的兩大原則開始。

en: First, “for all” means that we must focus on the children who have been left behind.
zh: 首先 ， “ 全人類”意味著我們必須關注落後的兒童。

en: Millions of children are out of school or are receiving a substandard education because of who they are or where they live.
zh: 數百萬兒童因為出身家庭或地區而輟學或只能得到劣等教育。

en: According to the UN High Commissioner for Refugees, refugee children are five times more likely to be out of school than other children in the countries to which they’ve been displaced.
zh: 據聯合國難民高階委員，難民兒童輟學的可能性比收留國兒童高五倍。

en: And in all but two African countries, girls remain less likely than boys to complete a primary education.
zh: 只有兩個非洲國家，女孩完成小學教育的可能性不低於男孩。

en: Getting these children into school will require new approaches that directly address their exclusion and make schooling genuinely accessible and relevant.
zh: 讓這些兒童上學需要直指他們被排斥的問題、讓學校真正得到開放和重要的新方針。

en: Second, “quality”: Education must be effective, so that children actually learn.
zh: 其次是“高質量 ” ： 教育必須是有效的，從而讓兒童真正得到學習。

en: For the 61 million children who are out of primary school, formal education is beyond reach.
zh: 對6,100萬無法上小學的兒童來說，正規教育遙不可及。

en: But, just as urgently, more than one-third of children of primary-school age – 250 million – are not learning the basics, according to the UNESCO Education for All Global Monitoring Report.
zh: 但是，同樣緊迫的是，據聯合國教科文組織全民教育全球檢測報告，有超過三分之一的小學適齡兒童 — — 2.5億人 — — 沒有學到基礎知識。

en: Half of these children have been in school for at least four years.
zh: 這些兒童中有一半已經上了至少四年學。

en: We must address the barriers to learning, both in the classroom and at home, by improving the quality of teaching and classroom conditions and teaching parents how they can support their children’s education.
zh: 我們必須改善教學質量和教室條件、教會家長如何支援孩子的教育，以此消除教室和家中的學習壁壘。

en: Upholding these two principles will require increased investment.
zh: 堅守這兩大原則需要增加投入。

en: Last year, UNESCO calculated that governments must double education spending as a share of national income to achieve the 2030 goals.
zh: 去年，聯合國教科文組織估算政府必須將教育支出佔國民收入的比重提高一倍才能完成2030年目標。

en: This will require increased revenue from taxation and stronger efforts to collect what’s owed.
zh: 這需要增加來自稅收的收入、加強查漏補缺。

en: Donors also need to live up to their aid commitments and target aid more effectively.
zh: 出資國也需要兌現援助承諾，加強援助的定向性。

en: For example, less than one-third of education aid goes to Africa, even though the region accounts for almost two-thirds of out-of-school children.
zh: 比如，只有不到三分之一的教育援助流向了非洲，而那裡的輟學兒童數量佔全球的近三分之二。

en: Moreover, at the moment, education budgets are often regressive, with almost half of spending in the poorest countries allocated to the most educated 10% of the population.
zh: 此外，目前教育預算常常呈現出累退特徵，最貧窮國家的近一半支出流向了受教育程度最高的10%人口。

en: Fixing education investment requires action in two key areas.
zh: 增加教育投入需要在兩大關鍵領域採取行動。

en: First, we need equitable financing, with more investment in early childhood care and development, where there is the biggest potential for returns.
zh: 首先，我們需要公平的融資，更多地投入早期看護和發展，這是回報潛力最大的領域。

en: Budgets must be focused on the most excluded children, and primary education must be free at the point of use, so that every child can learn.
zh: 預算必須著重關注最受排斥的兒童，小學教育必須免費，以使人人都能上學。

en: We also urgently need more transparency and accountability, so that budgets are visible and communities have a say in school governance.
zh: 我們急需更多的透明度和問責，以使預算可見、社會能對學校治理問題發出聲音。

en: Second, we need to strengthen domestic education systems so that governments see themselves as the guarantor of accessible, quality schools for their citizens, rather than abdicating that role to outside development agencies.
zh: 其次，我們需要強化國內教育體系，以使政府自視為為公民提供開放的高質量學校的保證者，而不是自甘墮落為外部發展機構。

en: In particular, we should push for partnerships between government and business to boost domestic resources for education, and eliminate illicit capital flows that deprive governments of the means to fund it, such as tax evasion and money laundering across national borders.
zh: 特別是，我們應該推動政府和企業的合作以提振國內教育資源，清除阻礙政府融資途徑的非法資本流，如逃稅和跨境洗錢。

en: With these priorities in mind, the education commission will deliver its recommendations at the UN General Assembly on September 18, when the Secretary-General will receive and act on them.
zh: 帶著這些重點，教育委員會將在9月18日的聯合國大會上釋出它的建議，聯合國秘書長將得到這些建議並據此行動。

en: The Education Commission will have succeeded if we are able to leverage the funding and political will to ensure that every child learns, regardless of their income, location, or social status.
zh: 如果我們能夠利用資金和政治意願保證每個兒童，不論其收入、所在地或社會地位，都能學習，教育委員會就取得了成功。

en: Our work will not be complete until that happens.
zh: 到了這一步，我們的工作才能宣告完成。

en: Sustaining Progress in Transition Countries
zh: 保持轉型國家的進步

en: NEW YORK – In the World Bank’s most recent “Doing Business” report, half of the Eastern European and Central Asian countries included in the global ranking were among the top 50.
zh: 紐約—在世界銀行最新的《營商 》 （ Doing Business）報告中，有一半參與全球排名的東歐和中亞國家位列前50名。

en: As a measure of economic maturity, the report confirms what many in the international development community have long known: the region is ascendant.
zh: 作為經濟成熟度的指標 ， 《 營商報告》確認了許多國際發展界早已熟知的事情：該地區正在崛起。

en: Over the last decade, the economies of Eastern Europe and Central Asia have recorded spectacular gains, buttressed by ambitious market and public-sector reforms.
zh: 在過去十年中，東歐和中亞國家進步搶眼，它們依靠的雄心勃勃的市場和公共部門改革。

en: The question now is how to ensure that this progress – which has tripled the size of the middle class – is sustained.
zh: 現在的問題是如何確保這一進步 — — 它讓中產階級規模擴大了兩倍 — — 得到保持。

en: Signs of the region’s social and economic prosperity are everywhere.
zh: 該地區社會和經濟繁榮的跡象隨處可見。

en: In Azerbaijan, incomes have increased dramatically in recent decades, and only 5% of the population now lives below the poverty line – down from nearly 50% in 2002.
zh: 在亞塞拜然，最近幾十年來收入大幅上升，目前只有5%的人口生活在貧困線以下 — — 而2002年這一比例接近50 % 。

en: Elsewhere, Estonia is the third country in Europe in startups per person and has one of the fastest Internet speeds anywhere.
zh: 在其他國家，愛沙尼亞的人均初創企業數量位列歐洲第三，也是全世界網際網路網速最快的國家之一。

en: And from Albania to Kyrgyzstan, e-government systems are allowing more people to connect with critical services through online and electronic portals.
zh: 而從阿爾巴尼亞到吉爾吉斯斯坦，電子政務系統讓更多的人能夠透過線上和電子門戶連線到關鍵服務。

en: But while it is tempting to assume that the region is destined for prosperity, structural bottlenecks continue to slow progress, especially in the Western Balkans, the southern Caucasus, and parts of Central Asia.
zh: 但在我們認為該地區必將走向繁榮時，結構性瓶頸仍在拖累進步，特別是在西巴爾幹、南高加索和中亞的部分地區。

en: To maintain momentum in meeting the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by 2030, leaders must address three key issues.
zh: 要保持勢頭、實現聯合國2030年可持續發展目標（SDG ） ， 領導人必須解決三個重要問題。

en: First, the region’s economies need to be strengthened to incentivize smarter, more sustainable growth.
zh: 首先，該地區經濟體需要變得更加強大以激勵更智慧、更可持續的增長。

en: For example, fossil-fuel subsidies should be reconsidered, because they discourage investment in energy-efficiency projects, and impede the development of renewable technologies.
zh: 比如，化石燃料補貼應該重新考慮，因為它們阻礙了能源效率專案的投資，也阻礙了可再生科技的發展。

en: Similarly, while public financing of pensions and welfare programs is dependent on taxing labor, much of the region currently suffers from high rates of unemployment; in the Western Balkans, there are nearly no jobs, or none at all.
zh: 類似地，退休金和福利計劃的公共融資需要向勞動力征稅，而該地區大部分地區卻飽受失業率高企之苦；西巴爾幹地區幾乎沒有工作崗位可用。

en: Job creation is an urgent challenge for every state in the region.
zh: 就業創造對域內所有國家來說都是一項緊迫挑戰。

en: Second, in many countries, the space for civil society is becoming narrower, posing a threat to pluralism and accountability.
zh: 其次，在許多國家，公民社會的生存空間越來越狹窄，這成為多元化和問責的威脅。

en: To prevent conflict and give voice to the region’s marginalized groups, tolerance and respect for human rights must be made essential ingredients of governance.
zh: 為了防止衝突、為域內邊緣化群體提供發出聲音的機會，寬容和尊重人權必須成為治理的核心要素。

en: Finally, the region must coordinate on strategies to address the changes that automation and artificial intelligence will bring to the labor market.
zh: 最後，該地區必須制定協調戰略克服自動化和人工智慧給勞動力市場帶來的變化。

en: Leaders in some countries, particularly Belarus, are shifting economic output from heavy manufacturing to technology startups.
zh: 一些國家特別是白俄羅斯的領導人正在設法讓經濟產出從重型製造業向科技初創企業轉移。

en: But authorities everywhere can do more to increase the resilience of their workforces.
zh: 但各國當局都可以在提高勞動力適應力方面做更多事情。

en: Fortunately, governments, technology companies, civil-society groups, and journalists recognize the salience of these issues and are working together to build more transparent and accountable institutions.
zh: 幸運的是，政府、科技公司、公民社會團體以及記者認識到這些問題的突出性，並在合作構建更透明、問責性更好的機構。

en: In many countries, heads of government are using the SDGs to guide their national planning and efforts to legislate reforms.
zh: 在許多國家，政府首腦正在用SDG指引國家規劃和立法改革。

en: The parliaments of several Central Asian countries have even endorsed the SDGs as a development roadmap.
zh: 一些中亞國家的議會甚至將SDG寫入了發展路線圖。

en: Changes like these are helping to translate development ambition into action.
zh: 諸如此類的變化有助於將發展雄心轉化為行動。

en: In Armenia, the government recently created the world’s first national SDG innovation laboratory, a collaborative effort designed to “accelerate” SDG implementation.
zh: 在亞美尼亞，政府最近新成立了世界首個國家SDG創新實驗室，這是一個為“加快”SDG實施而進行的合作專案。

en: Initial research efforts will focus on increasing the country’s tax collection, improving its education system, and boosting its renewable-energy sector.
zh: 初始研究計劃將聚焦於提高國家稅收、改善教育制度以及提振可再生能源業。

en: Meanwhile, planning officials in Moldova have used crowdfunding to raise millions of dollars from the diaspora to fund sustainable development projects at home.
zh: 與此同時，摩爾多瓦的規劃館員利用眾籌從僑民手中籌集數百萬美元用於國內可持續發展專案。

en: Revitalization efforts have included the reconstruction of a public plaza in the capital, Chișinău, and the expansion of infrastructure in rural areas.
zh: 復興計劃包括重建首都基希訥烏的一個公共廣場和擴張農村基礎設施等。

en: The region’s private sector is also participating actively in sustainable development efforts.
zh: 該地區的私人部門也在積極參與可持續發展措施。

en: From Siemens’ green heating and air conditioning systems to Unilever’s “equal pay for equal work” policy, multinational firms operating in Eastern Europe and Central Asia are embracing sustainability and equality as viable business models.
zh: 從西門子的綠色採暖和空調系統到聯合利華的“同工同酬”政策，在東歐和中亞經營的跨國企業都將可持續性和平等性視為可行的商業模式。

en: In only a few decades, the people of Eastern Europe and Central Asia have witnessed profound political and economic changes.
zh: 在短短幾十年裡，東歐和中亞人民經歷了深刻的政治和經濟變化。

en: To capitalize on the development progress already made, countries and organizations must learn from one another, adapting solutions to local conditions.
zh: 要利用已經取得的發展成就，各國和組織必須彼此學習，根據本地條件採用方案。

en: That will be the main topic at the Istanbul Development Dialogues, an annual global gathering organized by the UN Development Programme, this week.
zh: 這也是本週舉行的伊斯坦布林發展對話（Istanbul Development Dialogues，聯合國開發規劃署組織的年度全球會議）的主要議題。

en: As the new UNDP Strategic Plan for 2018-2021 argues, collaboration is a critical component to any sustainable-development strategy.
zh: 聯合國開發規劃署2018—2021年戰略計劃指出，合作是可持續發展戰略的關鍵要素。

en: If the measure of a country can be calculated by how easily business is conducted within its borders, the states of Eastern Europe and Central Asia have a bright future.
zh: 如果一國的衡量指標可以透過在其境內營商的容易程度來計算，那麼東歐和中亞國家有著光明的未來。

en: With strong leadership that transforms the region’s economies and modernizes its institutions, the region’s recent gains will not be fleeting.
zh: 擁有改變地區經濟、現代化地區機構的強力領導層，該地區最近的進步不會飛逝。

en: The Achilles’ Heel of Trumponomics
zh: 特朗普經濟學的阿克琉斯之踵

en: NEW HAVEN – Donald Trump’s economic strategy is severely flawed.
zh: 紐黑文—唐納德·特朗普的經濟戰略存在嚴重缺陷。

en: The US president-elect wants to restore growth via deficit spending in a country with a chronic shortfall of saving.
zh: 這位當選總統想要透過赤字支出在長期儲蓄不足的美國重塑增長。

en: This points to a further compression in national saving, making a widening of an already outsize trade gap all but inevitable.
zh: 這將進一步擠壓國民儲蓄，導致已然十分巨大的貿易缺口不可避免地繼續擴大。

en: That dynamic unmasks the Achilles’ heel of Trumponomics: a blatant protectionist bias that collides head-on with America’s inescapable reliance on foreign saving and trade deficits to sustain economic growth.
zh: 這一動態暴露了特朗普經濟學的阿克琉斯之踵：公然倒向保護主義，而保護主義與保持美國經濟增長無法擺脫的外部儲蓄和貿易赤字依賴格格不入。

en: The Trump administration will not inherit a strong and sound US economy.
zh: 特朗普政策無法從前任手中獲得一個強大而可靠的經濟。

en: The pace of recovery since the Great Recession has been running at half that of normal cyclical rebounds – all the more disturbing given the massive size of the contraction in 2008-09.
zh: 自大衰退以來，復甦速度只有常規週期性反彈的一半 — — 考慮到2008—09年間的巨大萎縮程度，復甦速度的萎靡尤其令人不安。

en: And savings, the seed corn of future prosperity, remain in woefully short supply.
zh: 而身為未來繁榮種子的儲蓄仍然處於嚴重短缺狀態。

en: The so-called net national saving rate – the depreciation-adjusted sum of business, household, and government saving – stood at just 2.4% of national income in mid-2016.
zh: 2006年年中，所謂的淨國民儲蓄率 — — 經摺舊調整的企業、家庭和政府儲蓄總和 — — 僅為國民收入的2.4 % 。

en: While that’s an improvement from the unprecedented negative saving position in 2008-2011, it remains far short of the 6.3% average that prevailed over the final three decades of the twentieth century.
zh: 儘管相對2008—2011年間前所未有的負儲蓄頭寸而言這已經算得上是改善，但與二十世紀最後三十年6.3%的平均水平相比仍然相去甚遠。

en: This is important because it explains the pernicious trade deficits that Trump continues to rail against.
zh: 這個問題很重要，因為它解釋了特朗普一直大加鞭撻的罪惡的貿易赤字。

en: Lacking in saving and wanting to grow, the United States must import surplus saving from abroad.
zh: 美國一方面缺少儲蓄，一方面又渴望增長，因此必須從國外進口儲蓄盈餘。

en: And the only way to attract that foreign capital is by running massive current-account and trade deficits.
zh: 而吸引這一外國資本的唯一辦法是透過大規模經常專案和貿易赤字。

en: The numbers bear this out: since 2000, when national saving fell well below trend, the current-account deficit has widened to an average of 3.8% of GDP – nearly four times the 1% gap from 1970 to 1999.
zh: 數字說明一切：自2000年國民儲蓄大幅低於趨勢水平以來，經常專案赤字平均值擴大到GDP的3.8 % — —是1970—1999年間1%的缺口水平的近四倍。

en: Similarly, the net export deficit – the broadest measure of a country’s trade imbalance – has been 4% of GDP since 2000, versus an average of 1.1% over the final three decades of the twentieth century.
zh: 類似地，淨出口赤字 — — 一國貿易失衡程度最廣泛的指標 — — 自2000年以來為GDP的4 % ， 而二十世紀最後三十年間的平均水平為1.1 % 。

en: Trumponomics has the cause and effect behind this development backwards.
zh: 特朗普經濟學具備了這一趨勢倒轉的因果關係。

en: It fixates on country-specific sources of the trade deficit, like China and Mexico, but misses the fundamental point that these bilateral deficits are symptoms of America’s far deeper saving problem.
zh: 特朗普經濟學關注貿易赤字的具體國家來源（如中國和墨西哥 ） ， 但忽視了這些雙邊赤字只是更深層次的美國儲蓄問題的症候這一基本點。

en: Presume for the moment that the US closes down trade with China and Mexico – the first and fourth largest components of the overall trade deficit – through a combination of tariffs and other protectionist measures (including the proposed renegotiation of NAFTA and a Mexican-funded border wall).
zh: 假設有朝一日美國透過關稅和其他保護主義措施（包括特朗普所提出的重新談判NAFTA和由墨西哥出錢修建邊境牆）關閉與中國和墨西哥的貿易 — — 它們分別是貿易赤字第一大和第四大來源。

en: Without addressing America’s chronic saving shortage, the Chinese and Mexican components of the trade deficit would simply be redistributed to other countries – most likely to higher-cost producers.
zh: 這無法解決美國由來已久的儲蓄短缺，來自中國和墨西哥的貿易赤字將重新分配給其他國家 — — 很有可能是成本更高的生產國。

en: The result would be the functional equivalent of a tax hike on beleaguered middle-class US families.
zh: 結果在效果上等價於對飽受擠壓的美國中產階級家庭增稅。

en: In short, there is no bilateral fix for a multilateral problem.
zh: 簡言之，多邊問題無法透過雙邊方法解決。

en: The US had trade deficits with 101 countries in 2015 – a multilateral problem stemming from a saving shortfall that cannot be effectively addressed through country-specific “remedies.”
zh: 2015年，美國對101個國家存在貿易赤字 — — 這是一個源自儲蓄短缺的多邊問題，它無法透過針對具體國家的“療法”解決。

en: That’s not to say that America’s trading partners should be let off the hook for unfair practices.
zh: 這並不是說美國的貿易伙伴可以擺脫不公平行為的干係。

en: But it does mean that there is limited hope for resolving seemingly chronic trade deficits – and the related erosion of domestic hiring traceable to these imbalances – if the US doesn’t start saving again.
zh: 但這確實意味著，如果美國不重新開始儲蓄，解決似乎存在已久的貿易赤字問題 — — 以及可歸因於這些失衡的相關的國內就業損失問題 — — 的希望十分有限。

en: Alas, this plot is about to thicken.
zh: 可惜，情況將變得越發複雜。

en: Trumponomics seems likely to exacerbate America’s saving shortfall in the years ahead.
zh: 未來幾年，特朗普經濟學可能惡化美國的儲蓄短缺。

en: Analyses by the Tax Policy Center, the Tax Foundation, and Moody’s Analytics all indicate that federal budget deficits under Trump’s economic plan are headed back toward at least 7% of GDP over the next ten years.
zh: 稅收政策中心（Tax Policy Center ） 、 稅收基金會（Tax Foundation）和穆迪分析公司（Moody’s Analytics）的分析都表明，按照特朗普經濟計劃計算，聯邦預算赤字在未來十年將至少回升至GDP的7 % 。

en: Trump’s senior economic-policy advisers, Peter Navarro and Wilbur Ross (Trump's pick for commerce secretary), argued in a position paper in September that these estimates are flawed, because they don’t take into account “growth-inducing windfalls” from regulatory and energy reforms, or the added bonanza that should arise from a sharp narrowing of America’s trade deficit.
zh: 特朗普的高階經濟政策顧問彼得·納瓦羅（Peter Navarro）和威爾布林·羅斯（Wilbur Ross）在9月份的立場報告中指出，這些估算存在缺陷，因為它們沒有考慮來自監管和能源改革的“促進增長的意外之喜”以及美國貿易赤字急劇收縮所帶來額外收益。

en: Indeed, the Navarro-Ross analysis attributes fully 73% of the growth-inducing revenue windfall of Trumponomics to a massive improvement in the overall trade balance over the next decade.
zh: 事實上，納瓦羅-羅斯的分析認為，將特朗普經濟學所帶來的促進增長的收入意外之喜的整整73%歸因於未來十年間總體貿易平衡的大幅改善。

en: Yet, as stressed above, barring a miraculous surge in national saving, this is highly dubious.
zh: 但是，如上文所強調的，如果國民儲蓄不出現巨大增長，這一前景非常可疑。

en: Creative accounting, long a staple of supply-side economics, has never been more imaginative.
zh: 創造性會計 — — 供給側經濟學的長期招牌性行為 — — 也不敢這麼想。

en: Therein lies one of the most glaring disconnects of Trumponomics.
zh: 這就引出了特朗普經濟學最刺眼的邏輯混亂。

en: Getting tough on trade at a time when national saving is about to come under ever-greater pressure simply doesn’t add up.
zh: 在國民儲蓄即將承受前所未有的壓力的檔口收緊貿易絕對是無濟於事的。

en: Even the most conservative estimates of the federal budget deficit suggest that the already-depressed net national saving rate could re-enter negative territory at some point in the 2018-2019 period.
zh: 即使是最保守的聯邦預算赤字估計也認為，已經飽受抑制的淨國民儲蓄率可能在2018—2019年間的某個時點重新滑入負區間。

en: That would put renewed pressure on the current-account and trade deficits, making it extremely difficult to reverse the loss of jobs and income that politicians are quick to blame on America’s trading partners.
zh: 這將給經常專案和貿易赤字造成新的壓力，使扭轉就業和收入損失 — — 政客馬上就會將它歸咎於美國的貿易伙伴 — — 變得極其困難。

en: Ironically, in the coming era of negative saving, the US will find itself increasingly dependent on surplus saving from abroad.
zh: 諷刺的是，在即將到來的負儲蓄時代，美國將越來越依賴來自海外的盈餘儲蓄。

en: If the Trump administration takes aim at major foreign lenders – namely, China – its strategy could quickly backfire.
zh: 如果特朗普政府將目標對準主要外國貸款人 — — 即中國 — — 其戰略可能很快會適得其反。

en: At a minimum, there could be an adverse impact on the terms by which America borrows from abroad; that could mean higher interest rates – hints of which are already evident – and ultimately downward pressure on the dollar.
zh: 至少美國海外借貸條件將受到消極影響；這可能意味著利率升高 — — 其跡象已經十分明顯 — — 最終則會令美元承受貶值壓力。

en: And, of course, there is the worst-case scenario of an escalating global trade war.
zh: 當然，最壞情形是全球貿易戰升級。

en: Protectionism, anemic saving, and deficit spending make for an especially toxic cocktail.
zh: 保護主義、儲蓄不足和赤字支出形成了一個極其有害的組合。

en: Under Trumponomics, it will be exceedingly difficult to make America great again.
zh: 在特朗普經濟學統治下，讓美國重新偉大將難於上青天。

en: A Clarion Call for Emerging Markets
zh: 新興市場的號角

en: ITHACA – With 2012 underway, it is worth reflecting on how a decade of strong economic growth in emerging markets led to last year’s resounding political transformations.
zh: 伊薩卡—步入2012年之際，我們值得思考一下新興市場的十年強勁經濟增長是如何引發去年波濤洶湧的政治轉型的。

en: From the dramatic events in the Middle East, to the groundswell of support for the anti-corruption crusader Anna Hazare in India, leaders in emerging markets are getting a clear message from the streets that growth is not everything.
zh: 從中東的戲劇性事件，到印度人民對安納·哈扎爾（Anna Hazare）反腐行動山呼海嘯的支援，街頭運動站在向新興市場的領導人傳遞一個清晰的訊號，光有增長是不夠的。

en: They ignore this message at their peril.
zh: 忽視這個訊號必將付出代價。

en: Emerging-market economies delivered solid growth during the 2000’s, and even survived the global financial crisis without a growth collapse.
zh: 21世紀的第一個十年，新興市場經濟體穩步增長，甚至連全球金融危機都沒有阻止它們。

en: But the specter of rising corruption is compromising the legitimacy of their economic gains and eroding support for further reforms needed to sustain their growth momentum.
zh: 但伴隨著經濟利益一同出現的是腐敗橫行，而腐敗橫行動搖著人們對維持增長勢頭所必須的深入改革的支援。

en: Corruption takes many forms, but, in emerging markets, a combination of factors has turned it into a cancer that ultimately topples regimes.
zh: 腐敗有多種形式，但是，在新興市場，多種因素的合力正在形成最終顛覆現有體制的癌症。

en: Relentless low-level corruption is a major irritant for poor people in many of these countries; indeed, it limits their access to the social services and basic government functions that they often depend upon for their very survival.
zh: 在這些國家中，肆無忌憚的低層次腐敗激怒著貧困人口；事實上，低層次腐敗讓貧困人口無法獲得他們賴以生存的社會服務和基本政府功能。

en: Another type of corruption involves siphoning enormous sums of money from large-scale projects.
zh: 另一種腐敗是從大規模專案中撈取鉅額回扣。

en: In India, for example, the government lost as much as $30-40 billion of much-needed revenue when coveted band spectrum was sold through a rigged auction.
zh: 比如，在印度，供不應求的頻譜透過拍賣發售，而拍賣是被操縱的，政府因此要損失高達300—400億美元的收入。

en: For ordinary people, large-scale corruption is less visible, because, while the sums involved are mind-boggling, the costs are not as directly felt as they are in the case of lower-level graft.
zh: 對普通民眾來說，大規模腐敗不一定看得見，因為，儘管涉案數量大到令人咋舌，但其成本並不像低層次腐敗那樣能讓他們直接感受到。

en: But the perception of this type of mega-corruption has changed as rapid growth has increased inequality.
zh: 但隨著快速增長加劇了不平等性，人們對這類大規模腐敗的感知也發生了變化。

en: In countries like China and India, rapid economic growth has lifted a huge number of people out of poverty.
zh: 在中國和印度等國家，快速的經濟增長讓大量人民擺脫了貧困。

en: But the fruits of globalization and rapid growth have not been evenly shared – the rich become super-rich, even as a large fraction of the population remains destitute.
zh: 但全球化和快速增長帶來的好處並不是均勻分佈的，富人變得愈加富有了，而大部分人民仍在貧困狀態中掙扎。

en: Rising income inequality is hardly limited to emerging markets, but their combination of open corruption and pervasive inequities creates a toxic brew that is undermining support for reforms that would strengthen and consolidate their economic gains.
zh: 收入不平等惡化的問題絕不僅限於新興市場，但公開腐敗和普遍的不公相結合就造成了一股暗流，破壞了人們對增進和鞏固經濟利益所需要的改革的支援。

en: In many emerging markets, a lack of political freedom adds to the combustible mix.
zh: 在許多新興市場國家，缺乏政治自由在給問題火上澆油。

en: The combination of corruption, inequality, and political repression builds up enormous pressure, and there are no institutional channels through which to release it.
zh: 腐敗、不公加上政治壓迫造成了巨大的壓力，而且沒有發洩這種壓力的制度性渠道。

en: But freer political regimes are not a panacea.
zh: 但政治自由也不是萬靈丹。

en: In a democracy like India’s, the politically well-connected benefit from skewed growth, thus increasing the resentment of those left behind.
zh: 在印度這樣的民主國家，在政治上有關係者從有缺陷的增長中撈到了巨大的好處，而沒有撈到好處者怨聲載道。

en: The opportunity to “throw the rascals out” in each election cycle helps to let off some steam, but it does not resolve the problems that are generating it.
zh: 在每個選舉週期中，人民都有一次“讓混蛋滾蛋”的機會，這在一定程度上減輕了壓力，但並沒有根除造成這一現象的問題。

en: It is difficult to predict what triggers popular protest, but economic factors are key.
zh: 很難預測什麼會觸發群眾遊行，但經濟因素是關鍵的。

en: For example, rising food prices tend to hurt the poor, especially the urban poor, who spend a large share of their income on food; unlike agricultural workers, they receive none of the benefits of higher food prices.
zh: 比如，食品價格上漲會傷害貧民，特別是城市貧民，他們收入中的一大塊都花在了影片上；而與農村勞動力不同，他們不能從食品價格上漲中獲益。

en: With swelling urban populations, it will become increasingly difficult to keep a lid on these pressures.
zh: 隨著城市人口的膨脹，減輕他們的壓力將變得越來越困難。

en: Some governments have reacted to recent events with political repression, information blackouts, or a combination of authoritarian measures.
zh: 有的國家對最近發生的事件的反應是政治壓迫、資訊封鎖或多種威權措施的綜合。

en: China, for example, blocked media coverage of the Egyptian protests.
zh: 比如，中國就遮蔽了關於埃及示威的媒體報道。

en: The Arab Spring, however, reveals the fragility of repressive political regimes that try to maintain their legitimacy by limiting information flows.
zh: 但是，阿拉伯之春顯示了高壓政治體制的脆弱，透過限制資訊流動維持統治的合法性是行不通的。

en: The main lesson for dynamic emerging-market countries is that an exclusive focus on GDP growth may ultimately not be good for economic and political stability.
zh: 充滿活力的新興市場國家給我們的主要教訓是，只關注GDP增長最終可能不利於經濟和政治穩定。

en: Even with rapid increases in national income, if these countries’ leaders do not distribute the benefits fairly, they will become vulnerable to popular discontent.
zh: 儘管國民收入有了快速增加，但如果領導人不能公平地分配經濟增長到來的好處，他們就很容易受到群眾的反對。

en: Tackling corruption is critical to improving long-term growth and maintaining social stability.
zh: 處理腐敗是改善長期增長、維持社會穩定的關鍵。

en: These economies need measures that help to keep the poor out of poverty traps, and that give them realistic opportunities to improve their economic well-being.
zh: 這些國家需要採取措施助貧民擺脫貧困陷阱，給他們現實的機會改善其經濟福利。

en: Such steps include broadening financial markets to give more people access to credit and investment, strengthening social safety nets to protect the economically vulnerable, and improving educational access and quality.
zh: 這些措施包括擴大金融市場，讓更多的人能夠獲得信用和投資；增強社會安全網以保護經濟弱勢群體；以及增加教育的可獲得性和平等性。

en: These lessons apply equally to advanced economies, which also suffer from rising inequality and subtle forms of corruption.
zh: 這些教訓對發達經濟體同樣有效，因為發達經濟體也在遭受不平等性惡化和腐敗潛規則的問題。

en: But, for those wealthy economies, restoring decent growth is now the major priority.
zh: 但是，對富國來說，重建漂亮的經濟增長才是當務之急。

en: Emerging markets have a golden opportunity to build on their economic gains and lock in growth and stability by tackling deep-seated problems like corruption.
zh: 新興市場正面臨著黃金機會，可以透過解決腐敗等深層次問題來最大程度地汲取經濟利益、鎖定增長和穩定。

en: As the past year’s events have shown, the costs of inaction could be calamitous.
zh: 去年發生的一系列事件表明，不作為的代價是沉重的。

en: A Climate Deal is Not Enough
zh: 僅一個氣候協議還不足夠

en: AMSTERDAM – During the COP15 climate summit in Copenhagen, world leaders have been negotiating the future of our planet. All the signs suggest that they are unlikely to sign a global climate treaty.
zh: 阿姆斯特丹 — —

en: The politicians, civil servants, and other participants at the Copenhagen summit have mainly been bombarding each other with numbers.
zh: 在本次哥本哈根氣候大會上，世界各國的領導人們正在討論我們未來的命運。

en: Figures on how much various countries should reduce CO2 emissions, the amount of money they should put up in coming years, the exact nature of their responsibilities, how much temperature increase Earth will be able to endure, and how long we can continue to wait.
zh: 所有跡象都顯示，他們不可能簽署一個全球性的氣候條約。 不同的觀點，不同的工業化程序，不同的政治聯盟，各國之間彼此有太多的分歧。

en: These are all very important issues.
zh: 會議期間，政客，公務員和其他參會者各自引用不同的數字相互攻擊。

en: But the mere figures are simply not enough. A different approach to the problem of climate change is needed.
zh: 這些數字包括：不同減排的標準，應該投入的資金，目前各國準確的排放量，地球所能承受的溫度升幅，以及我們還能等待多久。

en: The climate issue can only be solved on the basis of shared, deeply felt ethical principles.
zh: 這些都是重要的話題，但光有數字還不足夠。

en: Humanity has reached a critical moment in Earth’s history, at which peoples and nations will have to recognize their solidarity – with each other and with the Earth – and start acting upon it.
zh: 我們應該另闢蹊徑，找到解決氣候問題的新方法。

en: Similar to the way world leaders adopted the United Nations Millennium Declaration in September 2000, and embraced the resulting Millennium Development Goals, today’s climate negotiators will have to commit themselves to creating a basis of shared fundamental ethical principles.
zh: 只有大家深深感到，對社會責任擁有共同承擔的義務，氣候問題才能解決。 人類已經走到了一個歷史關鍵時刻，所有的國家和民眾必須團結起來 — — 一起為我們的地球做些什麼。

en: Such a basis is not hard to find.
zh: 首先，我們應該接受2000年9月的聯合國千年宣言，實現當時制定的共同發展目標。 這些的共同點並不難找。

en: Its inspiration can be the Earth Charter, which, launched in 2000, was initiated by, among others, former USSR President Mikhail Gorbachev and Wangari Mathaai, who received the 2004 Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts in the Green Belt Movement, a pan-African tree-planting initiative.
zh: 由前蘇聯總統戈爾巴喬夫和旺加里‧馬塔伊教授等發起的地球憲章就是很好的例子。 旺加里‧馬塔伊積極發起了名為“綠帶運動”的非洲植樹活動，2004年因此獲得諾貝爾和平獎。

en: The climate problem does not stop at borders.
zh: 氣候問題不分國界。

en: In the next few decades, a low-lying country like the Netherlands will need to invest billions of euros to intensify its age-old struggle against rising water.
zh: 在今後的幾十年裡，一些低海拔的國家，例如荷蘭，將投資數十億美元，用於應對多年以來不斷上漲的海平面。

en: But in many other countries, the water is already flooding over the dikes, both literally and figuratively.
zh: 而對其他一些國家而言，洪水實際行已經淹沒了堤壩。 對於那些缺乏資金自救的國家尤其甚之。

en: Climate change affects particularly those countries that lack the money needed to take adequate measures against rising sea levels, persistent droughts, or devastating storms, even though they had nothing to do with the primary cause of these problems – industrialization in the developed countries.
zh: 它們無法應對不斷上漲的海平面，持續的乾旱和災難性的風暴。 而這些國家往往不是工業化國家，無端成了氣候問題的無辜受害者。

en: Apart from the necessary, often infrastructural adaptations to survive the effects of climate change, enormous efforts to prevent even worse things from happening are required.
zh: 除此之外，基礎設施的改進等其他重大的舉措也都十分必要。

en: Large investments in forestation, agriculture, and energy supply are called for.
zh: 我們必須在農林業和能源開發上投入鉅額資金。

en: In devising solutions, the role of women should be the main focus.
zh: 婦女應該在其中擔當重要角色。

en: Women are often the first people who have to address the problem of gaining access to natural resources, and they are capable of playing a major role as pioneers in finding solutions to climate change and the way humankind should adapt to it.
zh: 女性通常首先發現這些自然界問題，她們有能力承擔起領導角色，找到解決人類生存問題的良方。

en: In the short term, the world should become a sustainable global society of low CO2 emitters.
zh: 簡而言之，未來的世界應該是低碳可持續發展的社會。

en: This is a mission for all humankind, in which patriotic feelings and thinking in terms of power blocs have no place.
zh: 這是我們全人類的任務，狹隘的愛國主義和國家聯盟的思維在這裡沒有市場。

en: The pursuit of a sustainable global society of low CO2 emitters requires a tremendous effort.
zh: 要想達到低碳可持續發展的社會，我們還需��做出巨大的努力。

en: Precisely for this reason, it also requires a broadly shared ethical basis.
zh: 這就要求我們有著共同的道德基礎。

en: This would guide the negotiating parties in such a way that they look not only for solutions to a part of the problem, but first and foremost at a comprehensive solution to the entire problem.
zh: 這樣才能避免片面的理解，找到一個對所有問題的全面性的解決方法。

en: The climate change issue is too important to be left in the care of politicians.
zh: 氣候問題已不僅僅是政治領袖的事情。

en: In Copenhagen, it is therefore imperative that not only nation states, but the business community and citizens combine their efforts to save our planet’s climate. That is not only a scientific necessity; it is an ethical imperative.
zh: 在哥本哈根，不僅在國家層面，商界和市民社會也應該一起都行動起來，共同拯救我們的地球，這不僅僅是學術討論，而是關乎道德層面的問題。

en: A Communist Party without Communism
zh: 沒有共產主義的共產黨

en: PRINCETON – Russian President Vladimir Putin’s anointment of Alexander Medvedev to succeed him in what is supposed to be a democratic presidential election next March shows that Russia’s leaders have not changed a whit.
zh: 普林斯頓 - - 俄國總統普京欽點梅德韋捷夫在明年三月本應民主的總統選舉後繼承總統職位，這標明俄國領導人並未做出任何改變。

en: It looks increasingly likely that, as under Leonid Brezhnev, we will see the same names in the news for decades to come.
zh: 現在看來越發可能我們將會在今後幾十年中見到同樣的名字，正如在伯列日涅夫統治時期一樣。

en: According to Gleb Pavlovsky, the Putin regime’s leading ideologist, the current Russian system is perfect in all respects but one: it doesn’t know its enemies.
zh: 普京政權的首席意識形態官員巴普洛夫斯基說，俄國目前的體制除了不知道其敵人是誰意外在各方面都完美無缺。

en: Indeed, it seems as if everyone in the Kremlin is reading Carl Schmitt, the Nazi legal theorist who taught that naming your enemy is the central mission of politics.
zh: 確實，看起來克里姆林宮的每個人都在閱讀納粹法學家施密特的著作。 施密特教誨說，指出你的敵人是政治的中心使命。

en: In the spirit of Schmitt, Putin’s men designated a liberal party, the Union of Right Forces, as their ur-enemy.
zh: 根據施密特的精神，普京的人馬設計了一個自由派政黨即右翼力量聯盟作為他們的敵人。

en: Its public meetings were broken up by armed police; its leaders arrested and beaten; Putin called its supporters “coyotes.”
zh: 該黨的公開集會被武裝警察驅散；其領導人被捕和遭到毆打；普京把它的支持者們稱為“小狼 ” 。

en: What is surprising is that this aggressive behavior occurred in response to no visible danger.
zh: 令人驚訝的是，這一咄咄逼人的舉動是在沒有可以見到的危險的情況下發生的。

en: Oil prices are soaring, as are Putin’s approval ratings.
zh: 普京的支援率就像石油價格一樣在上漲。

en: His appointees control everything that matters, from Gazprom to the Central Electoral Committee.
zh: 他所任命的官員控制所有重要部門，從俄國天然氣石油公司到中央選舉委員會。

en: Since the pacification of Chechnya with violence and subsidies, the incarceration or emigration of a few financially viable opponents, and the massive “social investments” of recent years, which, under Medvedev’s personal supervision, have bribed the population, no credible force can seriously challenge Putin’s men.
zh: 近年來用暴力和補貼平息車臣叛亂，拘捕和驅逐幾個資金不菲的反對者並且最近幾年在巴普洛夫斯基親自監督下進行大幅度“社會投資 ” 。 這一投資收買了俄國人民，沒有令人信服的力量可以嚴重挑戰普京的人馬。

en: Yet their regime is in crisis, and they know it.
zh: 但是他們的政權處於危機之中，而且他們也知道這一點。

en: Russia’s economy is more dependent on gas and oil than ever before.
zh: 俄國經濟現在比以往更為依賴於天然氣和石油。

en: Military reform has been reversed.
zh: 軍事改革已經逆轉。

en: Despite increasing incomes, Russians are less educated and less healthy than they were when Putin came to power; they still die at a shockingly young age.
zh: 儘管收入增加，俄國人的教育和健康都不如普京剛剛掌權之時；他們依舊過早去世。

en: Russian involvement in world affairs is tainted by poison and corruption.
zh: 俄國參與世界事務也是充斥著敵視和腐敗。

en: State monopolies undo what private businesses created.
zh: 國家壟斷把私有經濟創造的東西化為烏有。

en: With more money, ill-educated bureaucrats hire more ill-educated bureaucrats; as a result, the regime fails to rule the country.
zh: 教育水平低下的官僚們有了更多的錢就任用更多的沒文化的官僚。 結果，這一政權無法治理國家。

en: The country is unruly, and its rulers know it.
zh: 俄國混亂不堪，而其統治者們知道這一點。

en: So they panic.
zh: 所以他們就緊張不安。

en: Putin’s aim was to subject all power to the control of Russia’s security forces.
zh: 普京的目標是把所有的權力都歸於俄國安全力量的控制之下。

en: His generation of KGB officers watched the collapse of the Communist Party and all the governmental bodies that it “directed and controlled,” including the KGB.
zh: 他的時代的克格勃官員目睹了共產黨和及其“指導和控制”的所有政府機關的崩潰，包括克格勃在內。

en: Under Putin, the security service has had its revenge.
zh: 在普京統治下，安全力量進行報復。

en: Its people have become powerful, arrogant, and enormously rich.
zh: 它們的人馬變得權力龐大、自負以及鉅富。

en: They have also become disobedient.
zh: 他們也變得不停從調遣。

en: In 2004, General Viktor Cherkesov, then Putin’s representative in northwest Russia, published an essay that glorified the KGB as the only unspoiled authority in a corrupted country.
zh: 在2004年，當時擔任普京駐俄國西北方代表的切爾克索夫將軍發表文章，把克格勃美化成為腐敗國家中唯一清廉的權力部門。

en: This essay, more than anything else, defined Putin’s second term.
zh: 這一文章要比任何東西都要確定普京的第二任期的性質。

en: In October 2007, Cherkesov (now chief of one of the most obscure and powerful services, the Federal Anti-Drug Administration) published another essay in which he lamented his colleagues’ degradation: warriors had turned into traders, he complained.
zh: 2007年10月，切爾克索夫(現在是最為不為人所知以及權力強大的部門聯邦反毒品局局長)發表了另一篇文章，痛斥其同僚的墮落。 他抱怨說，武士變成了商人。

en: Earlier, generals from a competing service, the FSB, had arrested Cherkesov’s deputy for “illegal bugging.”
zh: 早先，與其爭鬥的聯邦安全域性的將軍們因“非法竊聽”逮捕了切爾克索夫的副手。

en: In a public gesture of despair, Cherkesov admitted the failure of Putin’s project to reanimate Russian governance by subordinating it to the security services.
zh: 切爾克索夫公開表示絕望，承認普京透過把俄國政府置於安全部門控制之下來創新振作政府是失敗的。

en: Cherkesov’s deputy remains in prison.
zh: 切爾克索夫的副手還呆在牢裡。

en: Most believe that Putin is unable to intervene in his defense.
zh: 大多數人相信普京無力干預為其辯護。

en: In the absence of Communist Party control, these security officers betrayed their corporate ethic and engaged in horse-trading, applying force when a trade did not go well.
zh: 在沒有共產黨控制的情況下，這些安全官員背叛了他們的企業倫理，參與交易，並且在交易不順利的時候施加力量。

en: That this happens to ordinary Russians is clear; what Cherkesov revealed was that Putin’s circle also confronts this situation.
zh: 這發生在普通俄國人身上是明顯的；切爾克索夫揭露的是普京圈子裡的人也對抗這一局面。

en: What is to be done when ex-KGB warriors turn their swords and bugs against one another?
zh: 當以前的克格勃人馬自相殘殺的時候該怎麼辦呢？

en: Cherkesov’s case exemplifies Putin’s nightmare.
zh: 切爾克索夫的情況就是普京惡夢的例子。

en: But if your instincts betray you, you go back to even deeper ones.
zh: 但是如果你的本能背叛你，你就會進入更深的本能。

en: Now that Putin’s people have left their predecessors’ neo-liberal ideas behind and feel disenchanted with the ex-KGB clique, the task is to recreate an omnipresent political party that controls the security services, the administration, business, and much else.
zh: 現在，普京的人馬已經拋棄了其前任新自由派觀點，並且對前克格勃的結黨營私感到不滿。 現在的任務就是創新組織一個控制安全部門、政府、商界以及更多其他東西的無處不在的政黨。

en: This party will be centralized under personal leadership and will reduce the state to a legal fiction.
zh: 這一政黨將是個人領導下的集權體系，並且把國家削弱為一個法律虛構而已。

en: Preaching nationalism, its managers will believe in their universal competence, as opposed to KGB-style professionalism and corporatism.
zh: 其主管們灌輸民族主義，相信其無所不能，而不是克格勃風格的專業精神和社團主義。

en: Boris Yeltsin forbade party cells in state-controlled institutions by decree.
zh: 葉利欽透過命令禁止政黨存在於國家控制機構之中。

en: Putin’s lawyers will reverse that decision; the party will have cells or committees in every factory, corporation, military unit, university department, etc.
zh: 普京的律師們將會推翻這一決定。 政黨可以在任何工廠、公司、軍事單位、大學院系等等擁有組織或者委員會。

en: Integrated by the leader’s charisma and party discipline, party members will direct and unify the desolated country.
zh: 黨員將在領導人魅力和黨紀的融合下指導和團結這一荒涼的國家。

en: This is Putin’s plan.
zh: 這就是普京的計劃。

en: Like former Soviet leader Yuri Andropov, the only other KGB man to rule Russia, Putin will become the party’s general secretary.
zh: 唯一的另一個統治俄國的克格勃是安德羅波夫。 普京像���一樣將成為該黨的總書記。

en: As in the Soviet era, state and governmental officials will be reduced to party ciphers – the role that President Medvedev will play under General Secretary Putin.
zh: 就像在蘇聯時期一樣，國家和政府官員將會被變成黨的暗號，這就是梅德韋捷夫總統在普京總書記領導下所扮演的角色。

en: And, of course, being General Secretary carries no constitutional term limit.
zh: 而且當然，總書記沒有任期限制。

en: In the end, Putin has what history left him: not ideas, just a faction yearning to consolidate its grip on power.
zh: 最後，普京有的只是歷史留給他的東西。 沒有觀念，只有渴望鞏固權勢的派系。

en: Lenin and Trotsky needed a party to make their ideology a reality; Putin and Medvedev are devising an ideology to solidify their party.
zh: 列寧和托洛斯基需要一個政黨來把他們的意識形態變成現實；普京和梅德韋捷夫則正在設計一個意識形態來鞏固其政黨。

en: It is a bizarre ideology.
zh: 這是一個奇怪的意識形態。

en: Accusing warriors of being traders and traders of being thieves, it shuns its Marxist origins.
zh: 把武士指責為商人，把商人指責為賊，它拋棄了共產主義本源。

en: It will subordinate all who really do work – traders, warriors, journalists, and others – to party ideologues whose sole job is to search for enemies.
zh: 它將把所有作實際工作的人，也就是商人、武士、記者以及其他人統統置於政黨理論家之下，而這些理論家唯一的工作就是尋找敵人。

en: A Confederal Solution for Palestine
zh: 巴勒斯坦問題的聯邦制解決方案

en: LONDON – Last month, while in New York City, I happened to be staying in the same hotel as Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu.
zh: 倫敦 — — 上個月在紐約時，我碰巧與以色列總理本雅明·內塔尼亞胡同住在一家酒店。

en: To accommodate his security needs, the hotel had been converted into a fortress, much like Israel itself.
zh: 為照顧內塔尼亞胡的安全需要，這家酒店幾乎被武裝成一座堡壘，這與以色列本身頗有幾份相似之處。

en: Netanyahu was in the United States for yet another round of Middle East peace talks.
zh: 內塔尼亞胡要在美國參加另一輪中東和平談判。

en: The US offered various sweeteners to induce Israel to freeze its West Bank settlement construction for another 90 days.
zh: 美國開出種種優惠條件，目的是誘使以色列再凍結西岸定居點的建設九十天。

en: The Israelis refused; another impasse was reached.
zh: 以色列拒絕合作，談判再度陷入僵持局面。

en: What, then, might be the prospects of a negotiated peace between two peoples with claims to the same land?
zh: 那麼，對同一塊土地提出領土要求的兩群人究竟有著怎樣的談判前景？

en: The answer is: very poor.
zh: 答案只有一個： 談判前景極其黯淡。

en: All peace efforts since the Oslo accords of 1993 have been based on the “two-state solution,” according to which Israel is supposed to turn over the occupied territories to a Palestinian state, the Palestinians are supposed to renounce any claims on the Jewish state, and everyone is supposed to live happily ever after.
zh: 1993年《奧斯陸協議》後所有的和平努力都以“兩國制”為前提，在這樣的前提下，以色列應該向巴勒斯坦國歸還被佔領土，而巴勒斯坦國則應承認猶太國家的主權，而後雙方應該從此過上幸福的生活。

en: A negotiated “land for peace” solution still remains official Western doctrine.
zh: 透過談判達成“以土地換和平”協議迄今仍是西方的主流理論。

en: As US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton put it in a recent speech, “a just, lasting, and comprehensive peace” has to be based on “two states for two peoples.”
zh: 正如美國國務卿希拉里·克林頓在最近一次講話中提到的那樣 ， “ 為兩國人民分別建國”是實現“公正、持久、全面和平”的基礎。

en: Meanwhile, the two main parties to the dispute, Palestine and Israel, are searching for unilateral alternatives to the stymied “peace process.”
zh: 與此同時，中東衝突的兩大主體巴勒斯坦和以色列都在不停尋找阻礙“和平程序”的單方解決方案。

en: The Palestinians are pushing for international recognition of their statehood, while the Israelis are using their settlement policy to preempt a Palestinian state.
zh: 巴勒斯坦人不斷要求國際社會承認其獨立國家地位，而以色列則意圖藉助定居點政策搶先佔領巴勒斯坦。

en: Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas has said that, if the latest peace talks collapse, he will press for UN recognition of a Palestinian state based on the 1967 borders.
zh: 巴勒斯坦總統馬哈茂德·阿巴斯已經表示，如果最近一次和談失敗，他將敦促聯合國以1967年邊界為基礎承認巴勒斯坦國。

en: This month, Brazil and Argentina recognized “Palestine,” and a cascade of Latin American countries is expected to follow.
zh: 巴西和阿根廷這個月承認了“巴勒斯坦 ” ， 預計將引發一連串拉美國家的紛紛仿效。

en: Abbas is now setting his sights on Europe, and would ask Turkey to serve as a go-between.
zh: 阿巴斯現在將目光釘住歐洲，並將要求土耳其扮演中間人的角色。

en: The game is to use international recognition of an independent Palestinian state to pressure the US to retreat from its almost unconditional support for Israeli policy.
zh: 其目的是利用國際輿論對獨立巴勒斯坦國的承認向美國施壓，迫使其改變幾乎無條件支援以色列的政策。

en: Israel’s main concern continues to be security.
zh: 安全問題仍是以色列主要的關注目標。

en: The official Western doctrine is that Israel’s long-term security depends on the success of the “peace process.”
zh: 主流的西方理論仍然是以色列的長期安全取決於“和平程序”能否成功。

en: In practice, Israel has been taking other measures to secure its future.
zh: 事實上，以色列已經為保證未來安全採取了很多其他舉措。

en: Media attention has been focused on the “security wall,” which has certainly succeeded in reducing the level of violence.
zh: 其中最受媒體關注的非“安全牆”莫屬，這種方法確實有效減輕了暴力活動。

en: But, to the hawks who now control Israeli politics, the key to Israel’s security depends on depth of defense, for which expansion of the settlements is indispensable.
zh: 但在目前把持以色列政局的鷹派人物看來，以色列安全與否直接取決於防禦深度，因此擴建定居點成為必不可少的一步。

en: The hawks’ recipe for survival is threefold: continued military and economic support from the US, defensible frontiers through a strategic settlement program, and the carve-up of the Palestinian West Bank into disconnected bantustans, or subordinate authorities, incapable of concerted opposition to Israeli policy.
zh: 鷹派提出了層層推進的三重生存計劃： 繼續爭取美國的軍事和經濟支援、藉助戰略定居點計劃修建可防禦邊界、以及將巴勒斯坦西岸地區割裂成互不相連的班圖斯坦，或者是無力聯合反對以色列政策的孤立政權。

en: Thus, while Abbas seeks to create a new “fact on the ground” by drumming up international support for a Palestinian state, Israel aims to trump him by making such a state unviable.
zh: 於是，在阿巴斯爭取對巴勒斯坦國的國際支援，力求製造“既成事實”的同時，以色列的克敵之道則是釜底抽薪，讓建立巴勒斯坦國的願望不可能實現。

en: The ideal alternative to both strategies is a peace process that aims not to create two states, but rather to establish the political and economic basis for a single confederal state.
zh: 不追求兩個國家、而建立擁有統一政治經濟制度的聯邦制國家才是上述兩種戰略的理想替代方案。

en: Indeed, the two-state solution was always an illusion.
zh: 事實上，分別建國的解決辦法從來都無法實現。

en: There was never enough land to satisfy the passionate possessiveness of all those with claims to it.
zh: 有限的土地資源從來無法滿足各方強烈的佔有��願。

en: And, over time, Israeli settler disengagement from the West Bank and East Jerusalem has become just as impossible as any attempt by Israel to expel its remaining Arabs.
zh: 而且，隨著時間一點一滴的流逝，讓以色列定居者從西岸和東耶路撒冷地區撤離和從該地區驅逐剩餘阿拉伯人的企圖都已經無法實現。

en: Israeli Jews are bound to stay in the West Bank and East Jerusalem, and Israeli Arabs are bound to stay in Israel proper.
zh: 以色列猶太人註定要待在西岸和東耶路撒冷，而以色列阿拉伯人也註定要在以色列的本土上繁衍。

en: These are the “facts on the ground” that doom Palestinian hopes for a sovereign Palestinian state no less than Israeli hopes for a wholly Jewish state.
zh: 這就是“不得不面對的現實 ” ， 它打破了巴勒斯坦人獨立建國的希望，而以色列人建立純粹猶太國家的夢想也同樣因此而破滅。

en: Moreover, land for peace never made sense from an economic point of view.
zh: 此外，從經濟的角度講，以土地換和平從來就是行不通的解決方案。

en: If compensation for wrongs to the Palestinians was to be the guiding principle, there were always better ways of going about it than to found a rickety, poverty-ridden new country dependent on foreign aid.
zh: 如果真的以補償巴勒斯坦人所受的損失為解決問題的基本原則，那麼總有比成立仰仗外國援助的貧困國家更好的辦法來解決這場巴以衝突。

en: Most people have forgotten that the Paris Protocols of April 1994 established a customs union between Israel and the occupied territories, with a joint Economic Council to adjudicate trade disputes.
zh: 絕大多數人已經忘記1994年4月簽訂的《巴黎協議》建立了以色列和被佔領土關稅同盟，並規定由聯合經濟委員會負責對貿易糾紛做出裁決。

en: The free movement of goods, labor, and capital between the two parts could have given a tremendous economic boost to Palestinian GDP.
zh: 貨物、勞工和資金的自由流動可以在很大程度上推動巴勒斯坦國內生產總值的發展。

en: It could also have been the basis of a confederal state, whose Palestinian part would have benefited from the West Bank settlers’ productivity and taxes.
zh: 這也可以成為建立聯邦制國家的基礎，西岸定居者的生產和納稅會幫助聯邦制度下的巴勒斯坦方面。

en: But this benign prospect was undermined by the violence needed to maintain the Jewish state and enable the emergence of a Palestinian one.
zh: 但如此美好的前景卻遭到以保護猶太國、成立巴勒斯坦國為目的的暴力的無情破壞。

en: The official view remains that only an internationally guaranteed two-state settlement will bring about the security needed for the economic revival of the Palestinian territories.
zh: 主流觀點仍然堅持只有國際社會擔保的兩國解決方案才能確保巴勒斯坦地區經濟復甦所必不可少的安全。

en: But it is just possible that unilateral Israeli policy, implicitly backed by the US, will create interim conditions of peace that are sufficient for economic growth to cool Palestinian nationalism.
zh: 但我們必須承認這種可能性，即受到美國暗中支援的以色列單邊政策可以創造和平發展經濟的臨時條件，而經濟的發展則能夠熄滅巴勒斯坦民族主義的火焰。

en: The Palestinian cause is not the overriding preoccupation of even the Arab states, so Netanyahu’s strategy of defense in depth stands a better chance of success than Abbas’s pursuit of statehood through international recognition.
zh: 巴勒斯坦解放事業甚至談不上阿拉伯國家壓倒一切的當務之急，因此內塔尼亞胡的深度防禦策略比阿巴斯博取國際承認的建國策略取得成功的機會更大。

en: Netanyahu’s project is not moral.
zh: 內塔尼亞胡的計劃不合乎道德原則。

en: But that doesn’t mean that it won’t work, at least for a time.
zh: 但這並不意味著這項計劃不會取得至少某種短期效果。

en: A Confederation for Kosovo
zh: 為科索沃建立邦聯

en: Time is running out in Kosovo.
zh: 留給科索沃的時間已經越來越少了。

en: If a United Nations-backed settlement is not reached by early December, the province’s majority Albanian population is likely to declare independence unilaterally – a move that the United States has announced it may support.
zh: 如果一項由聯合國支援的解決方案在十二月初不能出臺，那麼在這個省佔多數的阿爾巴尼亞族很可能會單方面宣佈獨立。 美國曾表示會支援這一舉動。

en: That would be a disastrous step.
zh: 那將是一個災難性的舉動。

en: Russia would be furious, because it fears that Kosovo’s secession – whether or not it is internationally recognized – might fuel separatist movements in the former Soviet empire.
zh: 俄羅斯會震怒，因為它擔心科索沃一旦分離，不管是否為國際所承認，都會進一步引發前蘇聯帝國內部主張獨立的運動。

en: Serbia is even more strongly opposed.
zh: 塞爾維亞甚至會更激烈地表示反對。

en: Dusan Prorokovic, Serbia’s state secretary for Kosovo, has said that his country might use force to maintain its sovereignty.
zh: 塞爾維亞負責科索沃問題的國務秘書普羅洛科維奇曾表示他的國家可能會動用武力來維護他的主權。

en: Even if the government hesitates, ultranationalist groups might push Prime Minister Vojislav Kostunica to send in troops: the current UN presence in Kosovo is very thin (only 40 “military observers” and 2,116 policemen) but the stationing of 15,000 NATO troops could make any armed clash very dangerous.
zh: 即便政府會在這個問題上猶豫不決，極端民族主義團體也可能會迫使總理科什圖尼察派出軍隊。 聯合國目前在科索沃的軍事力量非常薄弱（只有40個“軍事觀察員”和2116名警察 ） ， 但是在那裡駐紮15000名北約軍隊也許會使任何的武裝衝突變得非常危險。

en: After eight years of international administration, Kosovo’s Albanian majority has tasted freedom and is eager for full independence.
zh: 在經過八年的國際管制後，科索沃佔據多數的阿爾巴尼亞族已經嚐到了自由的味道，並且渴望完全獨立。

en: But Serbia claims that the province remains an essential part of its historical and cultural tradition.
zh: 但是塞爾維亞宣稱，這個省從歷史和文化傳統上都是它的一個重要部分。

en: Moreover, independence would not be accepted by the Serbian public, which has already watched in dismay as “Great Serbia” has been gradually whittled away, most recently with the secession of Montenegro.
zh: 此外，獨立也不能為塞爾維亞的公眾所接受，他們已經眼睜睜地看著“大塞爾維亞”一點點地在縮小，而最近是黑山共和國分離。

en: Serbia is prepared to concede only “enhanced autonomy” to Kosovo, and some capacity to enter into international agreements.
zh: 塞爾維亞已經準備給予科索沃只會“得到增強的自治權 ” ， 以及部分簽定國際協約的地位。

en: Yet, while the two parties now seem irreconcilable, it is not too late for compromise.
zh: 然而，儘管這兩方看上去似乎無法調和，要取得妥協現在還為時不晚。

en: But this is possible only by resuscitating – and updating – an old institution of the international community: a confederation of states.
zh: 但是這隻有透過復甦以及更新一個國際社會的舊的機制，也就是多國邦聯才有可能實現。

en: By means of a binding UN Security Council resolution, Kosovo could be granted full and exclusive authority over its citizens and territory, as well as limited capacity for action on the international scene.
zh: 透過有約束力的聯合國安理會決議，科索沃可以被授予對其公民和領土全面和唯一的管轄權，以及在國際層面採取行動的有限權力。

en: It could be authorized to enter into trade agreements as well as agreements concerning individuals (for example, admission and circulation of foreigners, or extradition), plus the right to seek admission to the UN (which does not require full sovereignty and independence).
zh: 可以允許其簽署貿易協議以及與個人相關的協議（比如，允許外國人入境及在其境內活動，或者引渡 ） ， 以及尋求加入聯合國的權利（聯合國並不要求完全的主權和獨立 ） 。

en: Kosovo would thus gain some essential trappings of statehood.
zh: 科索沃將因此獲得某些表明國家地位的重要外部標誌。

en: However, a decision-making body consisting of delegates from Kosovo, Serbia, and the European Union would be given full authority over major foreign policy issues (for example, alliances and relations with international economic institutions), defence, borders (in case Kosovo wished to join with Albania), and the treatment of Kosovo’s Serbian minority.
zh: 然而，一個由科索沃、塞爾維亞和歐盟代表組成的決策機構將全權處理重大的外交政策事宜（比如，與國際經濟組織的結盟及關係 ） 、 防務、邊界（如果科索沃想加入阿爾巴尼亞的話）以及處理科索沃境內塞爾維亞少數民族的問題。

en: As a result, Kosovo and Serbia would constitute two distinct international subjects, bound by a confederation hinging on a common decision-making body.
zh: 其結果是，科索沃和塞爾維亞將組成兩個不同的國際主體，捆綁在由一個共同決策機構將其連線起來的邦聯體下。

en: Of course, this confederation would be asymmetrical, because the Serbian government’s sovereignty over the rest of Serbia would remain intact and unlimited, whereas the Kosovar government’s “sovereignty” over Kosovo would be restrained.
zh: 當然，這個同盟體是不對稱的，因為塞爾維亞政府對塞爾維亞其他部分的主權不會受到影響和限制，而科索沃政府對科索沃的“主權”會受到約束。

en: To avoid one of the two parties getting the upper hand and imposing arbitrary decisions, the common decision-making body should consist of four Serbian delegates, two Kosovar delegates, and three representatives of the EU, thus requiring both sides to gain the support of the European delegates.
zh: 為避免兩方的任何一方佔據上風而強行透過專橫的決定，這個共同決策機構將由四名來自塞爾維亞的代表、兩名來自科索沃的代表和三名來自歐盟的代表組成，這樣就需要兩方都要獲得歐盟代表的支援。

en: In addition, the EU should create a small but effective military force (say, 5,000 troops) to back up the common body’s decisions.
zh: 此外，歐盟應該建立一支小但卻有效的軍事力量（比如說，5000人的部隊）來支援共同決策機構所做出的決定。

en: As with any compromise, the contending parties would both gain and lose from this arrangement.
zh: 像任何妥協一樣，參與的各方在這一安排中都會有所得也有所失。

en: Serbia would save face, and would continue to have a say on crucial matters concerning Kosovo, including the treatment of the Serbian minority.
zh: 塞爾維亞會保全臉面，並且將繼續對有關科索沃的重大問題、包括科索沃的塞爾維亞少數民族的問題擁有話語權。

en: Kosovo would acquire limited independence, with its status rising from a province of a sovereign state to an international subject capable of entering into certain agreements with other states and even joining the UN.
zh: 科索沃會獲得有限的獨立，它的地位將從一個主權國家的省上升到一個能夠與其他國家簽署某種協定、甚至加入聯合國的國際主體。

en: The EU would benefit as well, by contributing to the stabilization of a highly volatile area.
zh: 透過給一個高度動盪的地區注入穩定，歐盟也會同樣從中受益。

en: Subsequently, the EU would monitor Kosovo and prevent any dispute that might turn violent.
zh: 其結果是，歐盟將會監管科索沃，並且防止任何可能會引發暴亂的爭端發生。

en: A final advantage of this solution is that it would be temporary.
zh: 這一解決方案的最後一點好處是它會是臨時性的。

en: Historically, confederations sooner or later either become federations (as occurred in the US, Germany, and Switzerland) or, pushed by centrifugal forces, split up (as with the United Arab Republic, established in 1958, which split three years later into Egypt and Syria).
zh: 在歷史上，邦聯早晚都會變成聯邦（就像在美國、德國和瑞士發生的那樣 ） ， 或者在離心力的推動下，分裂開（就像1958年建立的阿拉伯聯合共和國，它在三年後分裂成了埃及和敘利亞 ） 。

en: The confederation I advocate would thus constitute an intermediate stage (lasting five or ten years), at the end of which Kosovo is likely to become fully independent.
zh: 我所提倡的這個邦聯因此將是一箇中間步驟（延續5到10年時間 ） ， 在這一階段最後科索沃可能會完全獨立。

en: Delaying a final solution in this way would provide time to verify Kosovo’s prospects of joining the EU and thus eventually sharing “sovereign authority” with other independent states, which could deflate Kosovars’ dangerously robust nationalistic demands.
zh: 以這種方式延後一個最終的解決方案可以為驗證科索沃加入歐盟的前景從而最終享有與其他獨立國家同等的“主權權力”提供時間，也可以給科索沃危險的高漲的建立國家的要求降降溫。

en: A Cool Calculus of Global Warming
zh: 全球變暖的成本計算

en: The British government recently issued the most comprehensive study to date of the economic costs and risks of global warming, and of measures that might reduce greenhouse gas emissions, in the hope of averting some of the direst consequences.
zh: 英國政府最近釋出了迄今為止關於全球變暖的經濟成本和風險最為全面的研究報告，並提出了可能減少溫室氣體排放的措施，希望藉此避免一些最可怕的後果。

en: Written under the leadership of Sir Nicholas Stern of the London School of Economics, who succeeded me as Chief Economist of the World Bank, the report makes clear that the question is no longer whether we can afford to do anything about global warming, but whether we can afford not to.
zh: 這份報告在繼任世界銀行首席經濟學家的，倫敦經濟學院尼古拉斯▪斯特恩爵士的主持下完成。 它明確指出問題的關鍵不在於我們是否能夠負擔得起應對全球變暖的措施，而在於我們是否能夠承受無所作為的後果。

en: The report proposes an agenda whose cost would be equivalent to just 1% of annual consumption, but would save the world risk equivalent costs that are five times greater.
zh: 該報告提出的計劃其成本只等於年消費的1 % ， 但卻能為世界節省5倍的風險等價成本。

en: The reported costs of global warming are higher than in earlier studies because it takes into account the mounting evidence that the process of global warming is highly complex and non-linear, with a non-negligible chance that it may proceed much faster than had previously been thought and that the extent of warming may be much greater than had previously been thought.
zh: 所報告的全球變暖成本比早先的研究中提出的要高，那是因為它將越來越多的新證據考慮在內，比如全球變暖是一個高度複雜且非線性的過程。 一種不可忽視的可能性是它發生的速度比我們先前想象的要快，而且變暖的程度也比我們先前想象的要高。

en: Indeed, the study may actually significantly underestimate the costs: for instance, climate change may lead to more weather variability, a possible disappearance or major shift of the Gulf Stream – of particular concern to Europe – and a flourishing of disease.
zh: 的確，這項研究實際上很可能還大大低估了相關成本：例如，氣候變化會引起天氣的更大可變性，可能造成墨西哥灣暖流的變化消失—歐洲特別擔心的問題—並引發大量的疾病。

en: When I served in 1995 on the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, the scientific group that periodically assesses the science of global warming, there was overwhelming evidence that the concentration of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere had increased markedly since the beginning of the industrial revolution, that human activity had contributed significantly to those increases, and that they would have profound effects on climate and sea levels.
zh: 當我在1995年任職於“政府間氣候變化專門委員會 ” （ Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change ） ， 這個定期對全球變暖的科學研究進行評估的科學機構時，有令人震驚的證據表明溫室氣體在大氣中的集中程度自工業革命開始已經顯著增加。 還有證據表明人類活動在很大程度上造成了這種集中。

en: But few saw, for instance, the Artic ice cap melting as rapidly as now seems to be the case.
zh: 溫室氣體集中度的增加會對氣候和海平面產生強烈的影響。 但幾乎沒有人認識到北極冰蓋以現在的速度融化也與此有關。

en: Still, some suggest that because we are not certain about how bad global warming will be, we should do little or nothing.
zh: 可仍然有人建議說由於還不清楚全球變暖的情況究竟有多嚴重，我們應該靜觀其變甚至無所作為。

en: To me, uncertainty should make us act more resolutely today, not less.
zh: 在我看來，不確定性應該使我們今天更堅定地採取行動。

en: As one scientist friend puts it: if you are driving on a mountain road, approaching a cliff, in a car whose brakes may fail, and a fog bank rolls in, should you drive more or less cautiously?
zh: 正如我的一個科學家朋友所說：如果你在一條山路上開車，駛向一處懸崖，而汽車的制動系統可能有問題，又正逢山霧瀰漫，你應該開得更謹慎還是更隨意呢？

en: Global warming is one of those rare instances where the scientific community is more fearful of what may be happening than the population at large.
zh: 全球變暖是少數幾個令科學界比令大眾更擔心的問題。

en: Scientists have glimpsed what the future may portend.
zh: 科學家們已經窺見了未來。

en: As the Stern report points out, as usual, the poor are the most vulnerable.
zh: 正如斯特恩的報告中所指出，和很多情況下一樣窮國是最脆弱的。

en: A third of Bangladesh will be underwater by the end of this century.
zh: 到本世紀末孟加拉國三分之一的國土會被海水淹沒。

en: The Maldives and a host of Pacific Island states will disappear: our twenty-first-century Atlantis.
zh: 馬爾地夫和一些太平洋島國會消失：成為我們二十一世紀的亞特蘭蒂斯。

en: To an economist, the problem is obvious: polluters are not paying the full costs of the damage they cause.
zh: 對於一位經濟學家而言，問題是明顯的：汙染的製造者們沒有為自己造成的破壞完全買單。

en: Pollution is a global externality of enormous proportions.
zh: 汙染是一項比例巨大的全球性外部因素。

en: The advanced countries might mean Bangladesh and the disappearing island states no harm, but no war could be more devastating.
zh: 發達國家可能並非有意危害孟加拉國和那些正在消失的島國，但即便是戰爭也沒有這樣的破壞力。

en: A global externality can best be dealt with by a globally agreed tax rate.
zh: 應對一項全球性外部因素的最佳方式是透過一個全球認同的稅率。

en: This does not mean an increase in overall taxation, but simply a substitution in each country of a pollution (carbon) tax for some current taxes.
zh: 這並不是意味著總體稅收的增加，而僅僅是在每一個國家以一項汙染（碳）稅取代現有的某些稅種。

en: It makes much more sense to tax things that are bad, like pollution, than things that are good, like savings and work.
zh: 對汙染這樣的不良現象徵稅比對儲蓄和工作等良好的事物徵稅更有道理。

en: Although President George W. Bush says he believes in markets, in this case he has called for voluntary action.
zh: 雖然布什總統聲稱他相信市場的作用，但在這一問題上他還是呼籲自發的行動。

en: But it makes far more sense to use the force of markets – the power of incentives – than to rely on goodwill, especially when it comes to oil companies that regard their sole objective as maximizing profits, regardless of the cost to others.
zh: 但更為明智的做法的利用市場的力量—激勵機制的力量—而不是依靠善意，特別是當情況涉及那些將利益最大化作為唯一目標而不顧其行為對他人的影響的石油公司。

en: Exxon has reportedly been funding so-called think tanks to undermine confidence in the science of global warming, just as the tobacco industry funded “research” to question the validity of statistical findings showing the link between smoking and cancer.
zh: 據報道埃克森公司對一些所謂的“智庫”提供支援以削弱公眾對全球變暖的科學的信心，正如菸草工業資助質疑吸菸與癌症之間的聯絡的“研究”一樣。

en: Some companies even seem to celebrate the melting of the polar ice cap, because it will reduce the cost of extracting the oil that lies beneath the Arctic Ocean.
zh: 有些公司甚至似乎在慶祝極地冰蓋的融化，因為這會降低它們在北冰洋開採石油的成本��

en: The good news is that there are many ways by which improved incentives could reduce emissions – partly by eliminating the myriad of subsidies for inefficient usages.
zh: 好訊息是我們有很多辦法可以透過改善後的激勵機制減少（溫室氣體的）排放—其中一個辦法是取消對低效使用能源的種種補貼。

en: The US subsidizes corn-based ethanol, and imposes tariffs on sugar-based ethanol; hidden in the tax code are billions of dollars of subsidies to the oil and gas industries.
zh: 美國對用玉米為原料製備的乙醇提供補貼，而卻對以糖為原料的乙醇徵收關稅，被這一稅則掩蓋的是對石油和天然氣工業的鉅額補貼。

en: Most importantly, price signals that show the true social costs of energy derived from fossil fuels will encourage innovation and conservation.
zh: 最為重要的是，顯示來自化石燃料的能源所造成的真實成本的價格訊號會鼓勵創新和節能。

en: Small changes in practices, when replicated by hundreds of millions of people, can make an enormous difference.
zh: 日常行為的小小改變如果被成千上萬的人實踐就能扭轉局面。

en: For example, simply changing the color of roofs in warm climates to reflect sunlight or planting trees around houses can lead to great savings on energy used for air conditioning.
zh: 例如，僅僅改變氣候溫暖的地區的房屋頂部顏色以反射陽光，或在房屋周圍植樹就能實現空調耗能的大量節省。

en: We have but one planet, and should treasure it.
zh: 我們只有一個地球，我們應該珍愛它。

en: Global warming is a risk that we simply cannot afford to ignore anymore.
zh: 全球變暖是一個我們無論如何都不能再忽視的風險。

en: A Cool Head for the Hottest Issues
zh: 每臨大事有靜氣

en: LONDON – Reading Barack Obama’s Dreams from My Father, the US president’s beautifully written reflections on his early life and identity, most people are struck by his cool and intellectual approach.
zh: 發自倫敦 — — 當讀到《我父親的夢想》這本美國總統奧巴馬用優美的文筆敘述自己早年生活以及個人身份定位的自傳時，許多人都會驚訝於他那種冷靜而理智的做事方式。

en: This is not to say that he is unemotional.
zh: 但這並不是說奧巴馬就是個毫無感情的人。

en: Obama can rage and weep.
zh: 他這個人可以表現得狂野暴躁，有時也會軟弱無力。

en: But he rarely seems to act on the basis of raw sentiment or instinctive prejudice.
zh: 但奧巴馬似乎很少由著自己不加掩飾的情感或者本能的偏見行事。

en: Pragmatic and highly intelligent, sooner or later every issue receives the full attention of his forensic curiosity.
zh: 得益於他的務實和睿智，所有事物遲早都會被奧巴馬仔細研究和審視。

en: Recalling Hillary Clinton’s famous Democratic primary television advertisement, Obama, it turns out, is exactly the sort of president that most of us would want to have in the post for that 3 a.m. phone call about an international crisis.
zh: 再回想到希拉里·克林頓在民主黨總統初選時釋出的著名電視廣告，每個人都會毫不猶豫地認為奧巴馬就是他們所期望的那個能在凌晨3點鐘拿起電話處理國際危機的總統。

en: He would not be afraid to act, but he would be prepared to think first.
zh: 在行動面前他從不縮手縮腳，但在此之前，他必會三思。

en: I do not think, therefore, that Obama will be too vexed by some of the criticism he faces at the end of his first year in office, though he will undoubtedly grimace at the defeat of the Democratic candidate in the special election in Massachusetts to fill Ted Kennedy’s old seat.
zh: 因此我覺得奧巴馬大概也不會被自己第一任任期即將結束時所面臨的種種批評所困擾，雖然他肯定會對馬薩諸塞州因泰德·肯尼迪參議員過世而舉行的特別選舉中民主黨候選人的落馬而感到有點惱火。

en: Obama was praised extravagantly a year ago; 12 months on, the criticism is over the top, too.
zh: 一年之前，這位總統承受了過度的讚譽；如今12個月過去了，他所揹負的批評自然也會登峰造極。

en: Obama inherited a terrible legacy – recession, financial meltdown, Iraq, Afghanistan. He has not solved all of these problems.
zh: 奧巴馬繼承的是一筆非常糟糕的遺產 — — 經濟衰退，財政崩潰，伊拉克，還有阿富汗。

en: But it is difficult to see any really bad mistakes, except perhaps allowing himself to be pushed around by Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and giving China the impression that he was prepared for a bilateral relationship entirely on China’s terms.
zh: 他還未能解決上述所有問題，然而除了允許自己任由以色列總理內塔尼亞胡擺佈，以及令中國人相信他正在照中國的意思構建一個新的中美雙邊關係之外，似乎也沒有出什麼大的紕漏。

en: That seems to be changing now.
zh: 但事情如今也有了轉機。

en: Obama may have come to understand that when you are the leader of the world’s only superpower, you need to be feared just a little if you are to be respected.
zh: 奧巴馬可能會意識到，當自己是世界唯一超級大國的領袖時，如果想得到人們的尊敬，就得至少要讓別人有點害怕你。

en: The left in America criticizes Obama for not turning the economy around already.
zh: 美國左派批評奧巴馬至今沒有令經濟完全復甦。

en: The right angrily denounces him as a crypto-communist because he wants every American to have health care.
zh: 右派則憤怒地宣稱他是個共黨地下黨員，因為他試圖令每個美國人都享受醫療保險。

en: With a dispassionate eye on the long game, what will the president himself be thinking?
zh: 但不知道這位用平和的心態去看待這個漫長過程的總統，自己又在琢磨些什麼呢？

en: One issue that Obama is certain to have in his sights is a problem that shadowed the world for years.
zh: 對此，奧巴馬肯定會考慮的一個問題就是那個籠罩了世界多年的陰影。

en: When I was growing up in the 1950’s and 1960’s, world peace was based on the nuclear standoff between the US and the Soviet Union.
zh: 在我成長的那個1950~1960年代，世界和平是構築在美蘇之間核力量的均衡之上的。
