en: The main strategic assessment on both sides of the Berlin Wall was that if either side made a wrong move, all of us might end up consumed in the flames of a nuclear holocaust.
zh: 柏林牆對面雙方的主要戰略形勢評估就是如果任何一方走錯了一步，那麼我們所有人都會在一場核浩劫中化為灰燼。

en: This was called, in the geostrategic jargon of the day, “mutually assured destruction,” or MAD. The acronym was entirely appropriate.
zh: 在當時乾地緣政治這行的人口中，這叫“保證互相毀滅 ” （ Mutually Assured Destruction，亦稱“共同毀滅原則 ” ） ， “ MAD(癲狂 ) ” 這個縮寫堪稱神來之筆。

en: We have forgotten those days.
zh: 如今人們已經淡忘了那些年月。

en: Yet there are still 23,000 nuclear warheads on our planet, with the explosive power of 150,000 Hiroshima bombs.
zh: 但這個星球上依然有2萬3千枚核彈頭，破壞力相當於15萬枚廣島原子彈。

en: Terrorist groups would undoubtedly like to get their hands on one.
zh: 而那些恐怖組織也肯定很想搞到其中的一兩枚。

en: In all, there are eight nuclear-weapon states – the US, Russia, Britain, France, China, Israel, India, and Pakistan.
zh: 世界上總共有8個核武國家 — — 美、俄、英、法、中，還有印巴兩國以及以色列。

en: North Korea may also have a few bombs. Iran is believed by many to be trying to develop one.
zh: 朝鮮可能也有幾枚原子彈，很多人也相信伊朗正在努力發展核武器。

en: Other states, which have their own civil nuclear capacity, have the potential to develop a weapon. The number of countries in this category is bound to increase as the number of nuclear power reactors doubles over the next 20 years.
zh: 其它擁有民用核技術的國家也有製造原子彈的潛力，而這些國家正計劃在未來20年內將核反應堆的數量增加一倍。

en: The Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) has contained the number of nuclear states.
zh: 《核不擴散條約》文字中列明的核國家數目已經過時。

en: A conference is to be held in May to renew and review it.
zh: 因此將在今年五月召開一個會議對條約重新進行審議和修訂。

en: Obama clearly recognizes that the NPT needs to be strengthened in order to prevent countries from turning their civil nuclear-power capacity into weapons.
zh: 奧巴馬清楚地明白到必須加強這一條約，否則就難以阻止那些擁有民用核技術的國家將自己的科技轉化為殺人武器。

en: But Obama also knows that if the existing nuclear states want others to accept tougher restrictions, they will have to cut back their nuclear arsenals.
zh: 但奧巴馬也同時意識到，如果現有的核武國家希望其他國家接受更嚴格的管制，他們就必須削減自己的核武器數量。

en: This is principally an issue for the US and Russia, which possess 95% of the world’s nuclear weapons.
zh: 而這主要是美俄兩家的事情，因為兩國手中握有佔全世界總量95%的核彈頭。

en: In addition, it would help if the US could take a strong lead by ratifying the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty.
zh: 此外，如果美國能批��《全面禁止核試驗條約》的話，那麼將起到一個強有力的示範作用。

en: The nuclear issue is one of the biggest items on the Obama agenda. How it is handled will help to define his presidency.
zh: 核問題是奧巴馬眾多議程中的其中一個重中之重。

en: Even before the talking gets serious in May, there will be the question of Iran to sort out.
zh: 而如何處理這個問題甚至將決定人們對他總統任期的評價。

en: Iran says that it seeks no more than its own ability to produce nuclear power.
zh: 即便在五月進行正式談判之前，伊朗的問題也亟待解決。

en: Disbelief grows with every revelation of secret Iranian facilities and plans, and with every refusal by Iran to negotiate safeguards that would allow for civil use while preventing weaponization.
zh: 隨著伊朗秘密核設施和反應堆的不斷曝光，以及德黑蘭當局不斷拒絕旨在保證核設施民用而非武器化的國際監察，不信任的情緒正與日俱增.

en: The US, the European Union, and Russia have tried to engage Iran on this issue, so far without success.
zh: 在這個問題上，美國，歐盟和俄羅斯都在努力和伊朗接觸，但至今都無功而返。

en: China seems likely to block effective sanctions on Iran because of its close energy relationship with the country.
zh: 中國似乎出於兩國之間緊密的能源關係考慮，希望阻止對伊朗進行有效制裁。

en: How China eventually handles this will profoundly affect its standing in the US and Europe.
zh: 而中國最終如何處理這個問題將深遠地影響其在美國和歐洲心目中的形象。

en: These are going to be some of the major questions for Obama over the next year and more.
zh: 而上述就幾個是奧巴馬在今後幾年中所需要面對的主要問題。

en: If he gets them right, he can forget about his short-term critics.
zh: 如果處理得漂亮，他就能把這些短期內的批評置諸腦後。

en: Fortunately, he is smart enough to know this.
zh: 幸運的是，他足夠聰明，肯定會意識到這一點。

en: A Crisis in Full Flight
zh: 大逃亡危機

en: MUNICH – For a while, it looked as if the European Central Bank’s €1 trillion credit program to pump liquidity into Europe’s banking system had calmed global financial markets.
zh: 慕尼黑—曾經有那麼一段時間，看上去歐洲央行向歐洲銀行系統注資1萬億歐元信用以提振流動性的計劃已讓金融市場平靜下來。

en: But now interest rates for Italian and Spanish government bonds are on the rise again, closing in on about 6%.
zh: 但眼下，義大利和西班牙國債利率再次開始上升，正在向6%靠近。

en: Of course, this may not be the breaking point beyond which the debt burden becomes unsustainable.
zh: 當然，這或許並不是債務負擔變得不可持續的臨界點。

en: After all, interest rates in Southern Europe were well above 10% in the decade before the euro was introduced.
zh: 畢竟，南歐國家的利率在歐元引入前要大大高於10 % 。

en: Even Germany at that time had to pay bondholders more than 6%.
zh: 即使是德國，當時也必須向債權人支付6%的利息。

en: Nevertheless, the markets are clearly signaling growing doubt about whether Spain and Italy will be willing to bear their debt burden.
zh: 儘管如此，市場清楚地標明，對西班牙和義大利是否願意承擔債務負擔的疑慮正在與日俱增。

en: The main problem is Spain, where private and public-sector foreign debt is larger than that of Greece, Portugal, Ireland, and Italy combined, and, as in Greece, is in the neighborhood of 100% of GDP (93% to be precise).
zh: 主要的問題是西班牙，它的公私債務比希臘、葡萄牙、愛爾蘭和義大利加起來還要多，已經達到了GDP的近100 % （ 確切地說，是93 % ） ，與希臘相彷彿。

en: A quarter of the labor force and half of Spain’s youth are unemployed, reflecting the country’s loss of competitiveness in the wake of the real-estate bubble inflated by cheap euro credit in the pre-crisis period.
zh: 四分之一的西班牙人口和一半年輕人沒有工作，這表明危機之前由便宜的歐元信用引起的地產泡沫導致該國競爭力的流失。

en: The current-account deficit remains at 3.5% of GDP, despite the recession-induced decline in imports, while economic contraction will cause Spain to miss its budget-deficit target again.
zh: 經常專案赤字相當於GDP的3 % ， 這還是衰退導致進口大幅下降情況下的數字；而經濟收縮將使西班牙再次脫離預算赤字目標。

en: Moreover, Spain’s debt with the ECB’s TARGET settlement system rose by €55 billion ($72 billion) between February and March, because capital outflows of that amount had to be compensated.
zh: 此外，今年2月—3月，西班牙在歐洲央行“目標 ” （ TARGET）清算系統中的債務增加了550億歐元（相對於720億美元 ） ， 這是因為大規模資本外流需要獲得補償。

en: Since July 2011, Spain’s TARGET debt has grown by €199 billion.
zh: 2011年7月以來，西班牙的“目標”系統債務增加了1990億歐元。

en: Capital is in full flight, more than offsetting the inflows from 2008-2010.
zh: 資本蜂擁而出，比2008—2010年的流入量還要多。

en: The cumulative total since the beginning of the first crisis year (2008) means that Spain has financed its entire current-account deficit via the printing press.
zh: 從危機爆發首年（2008）以來的累計總量看，西班牙的全部經常專案赤字都是透過印鈔來融資的。

en: The picture is little better in Italy, where the current-account balance has swung from a surplus of around 2% of GDP to a 3%-of-GDP deficit over the last ten years.
zh: 義大利的情況要好一些，過去十年來經常專案收支在2%GDP盈餘和3%GDP赤字之間波動。

en: The country’s TARGET debt grew by €76 billion from February to March, with the total since July 2011 reaching €276 billion.
zh: 今年2月—3月，義大利“目標”系統債務增加了760億歐元，2011年7月以來的總額為2760億歐元。

en: Italy, too, is being drained of capital; in fact, the flight of investors accelerated after the ECB’s liquidity injection.
zh: 義大利也面臨著資本枯竭的問題；事實上，投資者的外逃加速了歐洲央行的流動性注入。

en: It is now clear that the ECB itself has caused a large part of the capital flight from countries like Spain and Italy, because the cheap credit that it offered drove away private capital.
zh: 現在看來，顯然歐洲央行自身壓實資本從西班牙和義大利等國大量外逃的一大原因，因為它所提供的廉價信用驅走了私人資本。

en: The purpose of the ECB’s measures was to re-establish confidence and bring about a recovery of the inter-bank market.
zh: 歐洲央行行動的初衷是重塑信心並讓銀行間市場復甦。

en: In this, too, it has not really been successful, despite the huge amount of money that it put on the table.
zh: 但這個目的同樣沒有達到，儘管它丟擲了鉅額資金。

en: Indeed, now the French are looking wobbly.
zh: 事實上，現在法國看上去也開始動搖了。

en: As capital fled the country between July 2011 and January 2012, France’s TARGET debt increased by €95 billion.
zh: 2011年7月至2012年1月，資本從法國逃出，該國“目標”系統債務增加了950億歐元。

en: France, too, has become uncompetitive, owing to the cheap credit brought by the euro in its initial years.
zh: 使用歐元最初幾年的便宜信用同樣拖累了法國的競爭力。

en: According to a recent study by Goldman Sachs, the country’s price level must drop by an estimated 20% vis-à-vis the euro average – that is, depreciate in real terms – if the economy is to regain competitiveness within the eurozone.
zh: 高盛公司最新研究稱，據估算，法國價格水平必須較歐元平均水平下跌20 % — —即實際貶值 — — 才能讓法國重新獲得歐元區內的競爭力。

en: Italy will have to depreciate by 10-15%, and Spain by roughly 20%.
zh: 義大利必須貶值10 % — 15 % ， 西班牙必須貶值約20 % 。

en: While Greece and Portugal face the need for deflation totaling 30% and 35%, respectively, the figures for Spain and Italy are high enough to justify fears about the future development of the eurozone.
zh: 希臘和葡萄牙所需貶值幅度分別為30%和35 % ， 但西班牙和義大利的數字之高已足以引起人們對歐元區未來的擔憂。

en: These imbalances can be redressed only with great effort, if at all, and only if one accepts a decade of stagnation.
zh: 這些失衡唯有透過付出巨大努力才能消除，而且必須接受長達十年的停滯。

en: For Greece and Portugal, staying in the eurozone will be a tight squeeze.
zh: 對希臘和葡萄牙來說，留在歐元區內將是活受罪。

en: There are many who would solve the problem by routing more and more cheap credit through public channels – bailout funds, eurobonds, or the ECB – from the eurozone’s healthy core to the troubled South.
zh: 對許多人來說，解決問題之道就是透過公共渠道（援助基金、歐元債券或歐洲央行）由歐元區堅挺核心國向疲軟南歐國提供更多更便宜的信用。

en: But this would unfairly force savers and taxpayers in the core countries to provide capital to the South on terms to which they would never voluntarily agree.
zh: 但這對核��國的儲蓄者和納稅人是不公平的，他們向南歐提供資本，所能獲得的回報太低，他們不會自願接受。

en: Already German, Dutch, and Finish savings amounting to €15,000, €17,000, and €21,000, respectively, per working person have been converted from marketable investments into mere equalization claims against the ECB.
zh: 德國、荷蘭和芬蘭的工作者人均分別有15000、17000和21000歐元儲蓄由可交易投資變成了一視同仁的歐洲央行債權。

en: No one knows what these claims will be worth in the event of a eurozone breakup.
zh: 如果歐元區崩潰，沒人知道這筆債權能有多大價值。

en: Above all, however, the permanent public provision of cheap credit would ultimately lead to a lingering infirmity, if not to Europe’s economic collapse, because the eurozone would become a central management system with state control over investment.
zh: 不過，最大的問題是，廉價信用的持續注入最終會導致曠日持久的虛弱（如果歐洲經濟部崩盤的話 ） ， 因為歐元區將淪為一箇中央管理系統，而投資掌控權則在國家手裡。

en: Such systems cannot work, because they eliminate the capital market as the economic system’s main steering mechanism.
zh: 這樣一個系統是無法運作的，因為它剝奪了資本市場作為經濟系統主要導航機制的地位。

en: One cannot help but wonder how thoughtlessly Europe’s politicians have started down this slippery slope.
zh: 留給人們的只能是無盡的迷惑：無腦的歐洲政客為什麼會選擇走這樣一條黑路。

en: A Crisis in Two Narratives
zh: 一個危機，兩種解讀

en: CHICAGO – With the world’s industrial democracies in crisis, two competing narratives of its sources – and appropriate remedies – are emerging.
zh: 芝加哥—世界發達民主國家陷入了危機，關於什麼是危機的源頭以及如何補救，出現了兩種相互對立的聲音。

en: The first, better-known diagnosis is that demand has collapsed because of high debt accumulated prior to the crisis.
zh: 第一種為人所熟知的診斷是需求因為危機前積累的高債務而崩潰。

en: Households (and countries) that were most prone to spend cannot borrow any more.
zh: 最具支出傾向的家庭（以及國家）再也無法借到錢了。

en: To revive growth, others must be encouraged to spend – governments that can still borrow should run larger deficits, and rock-bottom interest rates should discourage thrifty households from saving.
zh: 為了重振增長，必須鼓勵其他家庭和國家來支出 — — 仍然能夠借錢的政府應該擴大赤字，同時極低的利率應該阻止節約的家庭繼續儲蓄。

en: Under these circumstances, budgetary recklessness is a virtue, at least in the short term.
zh: 這種觀點認為，粗獷的預算是一種美德，至少在短期看是如此。

en: In the medium term, once growth revives, debt can be paid down and the financial sector curbed so that it does not inflict another crisis on the world.
zh: 從中期看，只要增長能夠得到提振，債務就能活得償付，而金融部門得到了抑制，因此不會在世界上掀起另一場危機。

en: This narrative – the standard Keynesian line, modified for a debt crisis – is the one to which most government officials, central bankers, and Wall Street economists have subscribed, and needs little elaboration.
zh: 這種觀點是標準的凱恩斯主義，只是根據債務危機做了些許修正。 該觀點受到了大部分政府官員、中央銀行和華爾街經濟學家的支援，已無需再贅述了。

en: Its virtue is that it gives policymakers something clear to do, with promised returns that match the political cycle.
zh: 其優點在於向決策者明確指出了行動方向，還給出了符合政治週期的預期回報。

en: Unfortunately, despite past stimulus, growth is still tepid, and it is increasingly difficult to find sensible new spending that can pay off in the short run.
zh: 不幸的是，儘管已經實施了刺激措施，但增長仍然疲軟，而且，從短期看，要找到給力的新支出之源越來越困難了。

en: Attention is therefore shifting to the second narrative, which suggests that the advanced economies’ fundamental capacity to grow by making useful things has been declining for decades, a trend that was masked by debt-fueled spending.
zh: 於是，人們的目光開始轉移到第二種觀點。 這種觀點認為，發達經濟體透過生產有用的東西獲得增長的基本能力下滑已經持續了數十年之久了，其特徵便是用債務來支撐支出。

en: More such spending will not return these countries to a sustainable growth path.
zh: 更多的同類支出無法給這些國家帶來可持續的增長。

en: Instead, they must improve the environment for growth.
zh: 相反，它們必須改善增長環境。

en: The second narrative starts with the 1950’s and 1960’s, an era of rapid growth in the West and Japan.
zh: 第二種觀點的著眼點始於20世紀五六十年代，當時正是西方和日本的高速增長期。

en: Several factors, including post-war reconstruction, the resurgence of trade after the protectionist 1930’s, the introduction of new technologies in power, transport, and communications across countries, and expansion of educational attainment, underpinned the long boom.
zh: 幾大因素 — — 包括戰後重建、20世紀30年代保護主義風潮過去之後的貿易復興、電力、運輸和跨國通訊方面的新技術，以及教育程度的改善 — — 推動了長期繁榮。

en: But, as Tyler Cowen has argued in his book The Great Stagnation, once these “low-hanging fruit” were plucked, it became much harder to propel growth from the 1970’s onward.
zh: 但是，泰勒·柯萬（Tyler Cowen）在其《大停滯 》 （ The Great Stagnation）一書中指出，這些“低處的果實”被摘取殆盡後，進入20世紀70年代以來，提振增長就變得日益困難了。

en: Meanwhile, as Wolfgang Streeck writes persuasively in New Left Review, democratic governments, facing what seemed, in the 1960’s, like an endless vista of innovation and growth, were quick to expand the welfare state.
zh: 與此同時，沃爾夫岡·斯特里克（Wolfgang Streeck）在《新左翼評論 》 （ New Left Review）中雄辯地寫道，民主政府在20世紀60年代面臨著看似永遠光明的創新和增長前景，因此大踏步地進入了福利國家的行列。

en: But, when growth faltered, this meant that government spending expanded, even as its resources shrank.
zh: 但是，當增長開始放緩時，這意味著政府支出的膨脹（儘管此時其創收資源出現了萎縮 ） 。

en: For a while, central banks accommodated that spending.
zh: 在一定的時間裡，央行承擔起了支出的重任。

en: The resulting high inflation created widespread discontent, especially because little growth resulted.
zh: 由此產生的高通脹引起了廣泛的不滿，特別是在增長不見提振的情況下。

en: Faith in Keynesian stimulus diminished, though high inflation did reduce public-debt levels.
zh: 人們對凱恩斯主義刺激的信任度下降了，儘管高通脹確實降低了公債水平。

en: Central banks then began to focus on low and stable inflation as their primary objective, and became more independent from their political masters.
zh: 此後，央行開始將穩定的低通脹作為其首要目標，並越來越獨立於行政。

en: But deficit spending by governments continued apace, and public debt as a share of GDP in industrial countries climbed steadily from the late 1970’s, this time without inflation to reduce its real value.
zh: 但政府的赤字支出並沒有放慢腳步，發達國家公債水平佔GDP的比例從20世紀70年代末開始穩步攀升，這一次不再有通脹來幫它們拉低債務的真實價值了。

en: Recognizing the need to find new sources of growth, towards the end of Jimmy Carter’s presidency, and then under Ronald Reagan, the United States deregulated industry and the financial sector, as did Margaret Thatcher in the United Kingdom.
zh: 美國從吉米·卡特任期後半段和羅納德·里根任期內開始認識到需要尋找新的增長源，並對產業和金融部門實施了去監管化，與此同時，撒切爾夫人在英國也採取了相似的動作。

en: Productivity growth increased substantially in these countries over time, which persuaded Continental Europe to adopt reforms of its own, often pushed by the European Commission.
zh: 多年來，這些國家的生產率有了顯著提高，受此影響，歐洲大陸國家也採取了改革（大多由歐洲委員會推動 ） 。

en: Yet even this growth was not enough, given previous governments’ generous promises of health care and pensions – promises made even less tenable by rising life expectancy and falling birth rates.
zh: 但由於此前政府承諾了過於慷慨的醫療和養老承諾，如此增長仍舊顯得力不從心，而預期壽命的增加和出生率的下降使得政府愈加不堪重負了。

en: Public debt continued to grow.
zh: 公債水平繼續增加。

en: And the incomes of the moderately educated middle class failed to benefit from deregulation-led growth (though it improved their lot as consumers).
zh: 而教育程度適中的中產階級在去監管化帶來的增長中並沒有獲得好處（儘管作為消費者，他們獲益良多 ） 。

en: The most recent phase of the advanced economies’ frenzied search for growth took different forms.
zh: 發達經濟體瘋狂尋找增長的最新階段，各國可謂八仙過海各顯神通。

en: In some countries, most notably the US, a private-sector credit boom created jobs in low-skilled industries like construction, and precipitated a consumption boom as people borrowed against overvalued houses.
zh: 在有的國家（以美國為甚 ） ， 私人部門的信貸繁榮為低技能行業（如建築業）帶來了大量工作崗位，而居民則透過以價值高估的房地產作抵押，借錢來維持消費繁榮。

en: In other countries, like Greece, as well as under regional administrations in Italy and Spain, a government-led hiring spree created secure jobs for the moderately educated.
zh: 在其他國家（如希臘以及西班牙和義大利的部分地區 ） ， 政府領導的招工潮為教育程度不高者提供了就業保障。

en: In this “fundamental” narrative, the advanced countries’ pre-crisis GDP was unsustainable, bolstered by borrowing and unproductive make-work jobs.
zh: 在這一“基本面”觀點看來，發達國家的危機前GDP增長是不可持續的，是用借貸和非生產性冗餘工作崗位堆出來的。

en: More borrowed growth – the Keynesian formula – may create the illusion of normalcy, and may be useful in the immediate aftermath of a deep crisis to calm a panic, but it is no solution to a fundamental growth problem.
zh: “借”來的繁榮 — — 即凱恩斯模式 — — 可以造成一種常態幻覺，在深度危機襲來後可以起到平息恐慌的作用，但絕非基本增長問題的解決辦法。

en: If this diagnosis is correct, advanced countries need to focus on reviving innovation and productivity growth over the medium term, and on realigning welfare promises with revenue capacity, while alleviating the pain of the truly destitute in the short run.
zh: 如果這一診斷正確，那麼發達國家就需要將注意力集中於重塑中期創新和生產率增長，同時根據收入能力重新定義福利承諾，在短期則致力於減輕真正赤貧者的痛苦。

en: For example, Southern Europe’s growth potential may consist in deregulating service sectors and reducing employment protection to spur creation of more private-sector jobs for retrenched government workers and unemployed youth.
zh: 比如，南歐國家的增長潛力或許在於放鬆服務部門的監管、減少就業保護以為丟掉工作的政府員工和失業青年創造更多的私人部門工作崗位。

en: In the US, the imperative is to improve the match between potential jobs and worker skills.
zh: 在美國，當務之急是改善潛在工作崗位和工人技能之間的匹配度。

en: People understand better than the government what they need and are acting accordingly.
zh: 個人要比政府更清楚知道他們需要什麼，並據此行動。

en: Many women, for example, are leaving low-paying jobs to acquire skills that will open doors to higher-paying positions.
zh: 比如，大量婦女正在脫離低收入崗位，以便獲得更好的技能叩開高收入職位之門。

en: Too little government attention has been focused on such issues, partly because payoffs occur beyond electoral horizons, and partly because the effectiveness of government programs has been mixed.
zh: 政府在這些方面的關注度遠遠不夠，部分是因為其好處要在在任者任期結束後才會顯現，也有部分是因為政府計劃的效率不夠高。

en: Tax reform, however, can provide spur retraining and maintain incentives to work, even while fixing gaping fiscal holes.
zh: 稅收改革可以刺激人們參與再培訓，也可以激勵人們繼續工作，且不耽誤填補財政窟窿。

en: Three powerful forces, one hopes, will help to create more productive jobs in the future: better use of information and communications technology (and new ways to make it pay), lower-cost energy as alternative sources are harnessed, and sharply rising demand in emerging markets for higher-value-added goods.
zh: 有三大力量有助於在未來創造更多的生產性崗位：對資訊和通訊技術的更好的使用（以及新的收費方式 ） 、 隨著替代資源的開發而實現的低成本能源，以及新興市場快速增長的對高附加值產品的需求。

en: The advanced countries have a choice.
zh: 發達國家有的選擇。

en: They can act as if all is well, except that their consumers are in a funk, and that “animal spirits” must be revived through stimulus.
zh: 它們可以若無其事（儘管消費者如同驚弓之鳥 ， “ 動物精神”也需要刺激來予以提振 ） 。

en: Or they can treat the crisis as a wake-up call to fix what debt has papered over in the last few decades.
zh: 它們也可以將此次危機視為修正過去數十年來產生債務的問題的契機。

en: For better or worse, the narrative that persuades these countries’ governments and publics will determine their future – and that of the global economy.
zh: 無論如何，政府和公眾選擇相信哪種觀點將決定它們的未來 — — 以及全球經濟的未來。

en: Financing the Next Development Agenda
zh: 為下一個發展日程融資

en: WASHINGTON, DC – As the 2015 target date for the Millennium Development Goals approaches, the United Nations is intensifying its efforts to foster debate about what comes next for promotion of development worldwide.
zh: 華盛頓—隨著千年發展目標2015年到期日的臨近，聯合國抓緊了關於下一輪促進全球發展措施的爭論。

en: The outcome of these discussions will shape policies and investment aimed at spurring GDP growth, strengthening human capital, and promoting more inclusive prosperity.
zh: 這些討論的結果將決定旨在刺激GDP增長、強化人力資本和促進更具包容性的繁榮的政策和投資。

en: With the global population expected to reach nine billion people by 2050 – a significant proportion of whom will reside in developing or underdeveloped countries – the international community must improve access to education, health care, and employment opportunities worldwide.
zh: 2050年，世界人口預計將達到90億 — — 其中很大一部分將居住在發展中或欠發達國家 — — 國際社會必須改善全球教育、衛生和就業機會的普及。

en: Meanwhile, the prospect of a rise in global temperature of more than 2°C (3.6°F) over pre-industrial levels by the end of this century (which would trigger global warming’s most damaging effects) calls for higher investment in sustainable urbanization, climate-smart agriculture, and social safety nets.
zh: 與此同時，全球氣溫預計將在本世紀末較工業化前水平升高2℃以上（這將觸發全球變暖最危險的效應）意味著需要增加可持續城市化、氣候智慧型農業和社會安全網的投資。

en: Both factors challenge us to define, in the longer term, more sustainable patterns of production and consumption.
zh: 兩大因素對我們構成了挑戰，從長期看，我們需要更加可持續的生產和消費模式。

en: Governments, civil society, and the private sector must rise to the challenge, cooperating to find and implement creative solutions.
zh: 政府、公民社會和私人部門必須應對這一挑戰，合作尋找並實施創造性解決方案。

en: But, first, they must anticipate the associated financing requirements, which will soon surpass the current capacities of governments and international donors, and take action now to activate new, reliable sources of financing.
zh: 但是，首先，我們必須預計相關融資要求 — — 融資要求很快就會超過政府和國際贊助者當前的能力；同時，我們還必須現在就採取行動啟用可靠地新融資源。

en: To start, governments should design targeted, evidence-based policies and support the development of sound institutions.
zh: 首先，政府應該設計基於證據的定向政策並支援可靠機構的發展。

en: This would make government services more effective, while helping to catalyze additional development aid from traditional donors and mobilize private-sector resources.
zh: 這將讓政府服務更加有效，同時有助於刺激傳統贊助者提高發展援助以及動員私人部門資金源。

en: In many countries, there is considerable scope for domestic resource mobilization.
zh: 在許多國家，國內資源動員空間相當大。

en: Broadening the tax base, improving tax administration, and closing gaps in the value-added tax could make a significant difference in lower-income countries, where tax revenues account for only about 10-14% of GDP, compared to 20-30% of GDP in high-income countries.
zh: 擴大稅基、改善稅制以及縮小增值稅差異能讓低收入國家發生翻天覆地的變化，在這類國家，稅收收入只佔GDP的10—14 % ， 而高收入國家佔GDP的20—30 % 。

en: More equitable taxation would have a positive impact on governance, another important tool for mobilizing domestic resources.
zh: 更平等的稅收能對治理產生積極效應，而治理是動員國內資源的又一重要工具。

en: With improved corporate and public governance and clear transfer-pricing policies, resource-rich countries could shore up their capacity to negotiate fair contracts with extractive industries, balance revenues and expenditures over time, and manage their natural endowments more transparently.
zh: 改善公司和公共治理、明確移定價政策能讓資源富裕國獲得與開採業談判公平合同的能力，逐漸平衡收入和支出，並更透明地管理其自然資源稟賦。

en: Progress in these areas would help governments to channel their spending more effectively toward those who would benefit the most.
zh: 這些方面的進步有助於政府有效地將錢花在受益最大的人群上。

en: For example, only 8% of the $409 billion spent on fossil-fuel subsidies in 2010 reached the poorest 20% of the population.
zh: 比如，2010年所發放的4090億美元化石燃料補助中只有8%送到了最貧困的20%人群手中。

en: A targeted support program could increase substantially the efficiency of spending, freeing up resources for education, health, and poverty eradication.
zh: 定向支援專案能極大地增加支出的效率，解放資源用於教育、衛生和減貧。

en: Furthermore, promoting financial deepening and inclusiveness could accelerate private-sector growth, creating more opportunities.
zh: 此外，促進金融深化和包容能加速私人部門增長，創造更多機會。

en: Indeed, broader access to financial services would help the estimated 400 million micro, small, and medium-size enterprises in developing countries to prosper, while enabling the 2.5 billion people worldwide who currently lack access to such services to build their assets.
zh: 事實上，金融服務的普及有助於發展中國家約4億家（估計值）微型、小型和中型企業繁榮，同時讓全世界25億目前無法獲得金融服務的人建立自己的資產。

en: A deeper and more efficient financial sector would also reduce transaction costs and facilitate risk management.
zh: 更深化、更高效的金融部門還能降低交易成本、有利於風險管理。

en: Local-currency bond markets could help to develop domestic investor bases and mobilize domestic savings to support long-term investments.
zh: 本幣債券市場有助於發展國內投資者基礎病動員國內儲蓄支援長期投資。

en: At the same time, the international community should work to improve the availability and effectiveness of official development assistance.
zh: 與此同時，國際社會應該致力於改善官方發展援助（ODA）的普及型和效率。

en: The ODA target of 0.7% of GDP – agreed in 2002 at the International Conference on Financing for Development in Monterrey, Mexico – should motivate countries to increase their contributions.
zh: 2002年墨西哥蒙特雷國際發展融資會議（International Conference on Financing for Development）為ODA設定了GDP的0.7%的目標值，這應該能夠刺激各國增加各自的貢獻力度。

en: They can also take steps to make ODA more predictable from year to year.
zh: 它們還可以採取措施逐年增加ODA的可預測性。

en: Donors should structure aid to ensure that it supports sound national development policies and programs, rather than their own narrow interests.
zh: 贊助者應該設計好援助結構，以保證支援優質國民發展政策和計劃，而不是滿足它們自身的狹隘利益。

en: This is particularly relevant as emerging development partners, especially the BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa), offer new kinds of aid packages that incorporate investment and non-financial assistance.
zh: 這一點隨著新興發展夥伴 — — 特別是金磚國家（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非 ） — —提供結合了投資和非金融援助的新形式的援助方案而顯得特別重要。

en: Private charities, which have been instrumental in promoting innovation in fields such as health care, the environment, and education, could provide valuable insight into channeling aid more effectively.
zh: 私人慈善機構 — — 它們一直是刺激衛生、環境和教育等領域創新的有力工具 — — 能提供關於如何更高效地使用援助的寶貴洞見。

en: More generally, improving coordination among donors would help to maximize the impact of aid on the ground.
zh: 更一般地，改善贊助者間的協調有助於援助專案影響的最大化。

en: While ODA remains an important source of financing for fragile and very-low-income countries, it represents only 7% of net financial flows to developing countries, where foreign direct investment, remittances, long-term debt, and portfolio investment have a larger impact.
zh: ODA仍是脆弱的極低收入國家重要的融資源，但它僅佔流向發展中國家的淨金融流的7 % ， 外國直接投資、僑匯、長期債務和資產組合投資佔比均高於ODA。

en: Donors should leverage aid to “grow the pie” and to diversify financing sources for the world’s poorest countries by providing risk guarantees, innovative investment vehicles, debt syndication, and co-financing arrangements.
zh: 贊助者應該利用援助“做大餡餅”並透過提供風險擔保、創新性投資載體、債務承銷團和共同融資安排實現世界最貧困國家融資源的多樣化。

en: Attracting even a fraction of the assets held by institutional investors, sovereign-wealth funds, and public pension funds could boost development finance substantially.
zh: 吸引哪怕一小部分機構投資者、主權財富基金和公共養老基金所持資產也能夠極大地提振發展融資。

en: Diaspora populations are another major potential source of development financing.
zh: 僑民是另一個發展融資的潛在主要來源。

en: Reducing transfer costs, which average an estimated 9% of the value of transactions, would put more money into the hands of those who need it most.
zh: 降低匯款成本 — — 據估計平均而言佔交易價值的9 % — —將使更多的錢流向最需要它們的人的手中。

en: Tailoring financial products for diaspora communities could attract resources for investment, while reinforcing migrants’ ties – economic and otherwise – to their home countries.
zh: 為僑民社群量身定做金融產品能吸引投資源，同時加強移民與其祖國的經濟和其他聯絡。

en: Finally, the international community bears a special responsibility for delivering global public goods.
zh: 最後，國際社會有實現全球公共品多樣化的特殊責任。

en: The responsibility to preserve the environment, stem the spread of communicable diseases, strengthen the international financial architecture, enhance developing-country participation in the global trading system, and facilitate the exchange of knowledge lies at the intersection of national development priorities and global interests.
zh: 保護環境、阻止傳染病傳播、強化國際金融結構、促進發展中國家參與全球貿易體系以及增進知識交換的責任是國民發展優先項和全球利益的交匯點。

en: Duty-free, quota-free access to OECD markets, complemented by simpler, more transparent rules of origin, would raise GDP by 1% in the least-developed countries, lifting millions out of poverty.
zh: 免責、無限額地進入經合組織市場，並輔之以更簡單、更透明的原產地規則能使最不發達國家GDP提高1 % ， 讓千百萬人擺脫平困。

en: Investment in statistical capacity would help governments and businesses worldwide to make better policy decisions, based on a more accurate accounting of the associated costs and benefits.
zh: 投資於統計能力有助於全球政府和企業更好地做出政策決策，讓計量相關成本和收益更加正確。

en: The challenge of the post-2015 development agenda lies in finding creative solutions to support prosperity, equality, and sustainability.
zh: 2015年後的發展日程的挑戰在於找出創造性解決方案支援繁榮、平等和可持續性。

en: Together, governments, civil society, international organizations, and the private sector can improve the availability and quality of finance for development, and shape a better future for all.
zh: 政府、公民社會、國際組織和私人部門齊心協力就能改善發展融資的普及和質量，為所有人帶來更美好的未來。

en: A Czech Moment
zh: 捷克風光時刻

en: PRAGUE – As I listened to what some Europeans were saying as my country prepared to take over the presidency of the European Union, I heard dim echoes of Neville Chamberlain’s infamous description of Czechoslovakia as “a faraway country of which we know little.”
zh: 布拉格 - - 當捷克準備接手成為歐盟輪值主席國的時候，有些歐洲人議論我國。 我聽到他們言論好像是張伯倫對捷克斯洛伐克聲名狼藉評論的迴音，那也就是，我們是“一個很少聽說的窮鄉僻壤國家 ” 。

en: I suppose that Donald Rumsfeld’s misguided bid a few years ago to incite a divide between “new and old” Europe contributed to the re-emergence of that disdainful attitude.
zh: 幾年前，拉姆斯菲爾德想要把歐洲分出“新歐洲”和“老歐洲”實為不智，但是他的這一言論確重新體現了這一令人厭惡態度。

en: The reality is that there is no such thing as “old and new” Europe, and there never was.
zh: 實際上，世上根本就沒有什麼“新歐洲”和“老歐洲 ” ， 歷史上從來就沒有這回事。

en: The break with communism and reunification of Europe is now almost two decades old.
zh: 歐洲重新統一併且與共產主義決裂目前已經將近二十年時間。

en: We Czechs are 100% European, and were even when the Iron Curtain cut us off from democratic Europe.
zh: 我們捷克人是100%的歐洲人，而且在鐵幕把我們從民主歐洲分裂的時代更為如此。

en: Indeed, our pro-EU sentiments may be all the stronger because our membership in the Union, like our freedom, is so comparatively new.
zh: 確實，隨著加入歐盟以及剛剛獲得自由，我們的親歐盟情感更為強烈。

en: So no one in Europe needs to fear that the Czech Republic has some nostalgic or idiosyncratic agenda that it wants to impose on the Union.
zh: 所以，歐洲沒有必要擔心捷克共和國有什麼懷舊或者怪異的議程來施加在歐盟頭上。

en: On the contrary, events have imposed an agenda on Europe that we cannot escape and for which solidarity – true union – will be needed.
zh: 相反，國際大事確給歐洲施加了我們所無法逃避的議程。 對此，我們需要真正的歐洲團結。

en: The primary, and most pressing, of the problems we face is the financial and economic crisis that is enveloping the EU.
zh: 我們面臨的主要、也是最為迫切的問題是正在席捲歐盟的金融和經濟危機。

en: Unfortunately, conditions across the Union will likely worsen before they begin to improve.
zh: 不幸的是，整個歐盟的形勢在轉好之前還要繼續變壞。

en: The type of social unrest recently witnessed in Greece may spread, because the downturn is likely to take a disproportionate toll on Europe’s young people, who are seeking jobs at a time when hard-pressed European businesses will be able to offer them very few.
zh: 最近在希臘發生的社會動亂可能蔓延，這是因為經濟衰退對歐洲年輕人的影響可能更加嚴重。 這些找工作的年輕人正好趕上不景氣的歐洲企業無法提供多少就業機會。

en: It will fall to the Union, once again, to help transform despair into hope.
zh: 這樣，歐盟就要再次幫助把絕望轉化為希望。

en: We Czechs know something about this, as the wrenching economic transition that we underwent in the 1990’s taught us much about how the right policies can break the grip of hopelessness.
zh: 我們捷克人對此有所瞭解，因為我們在九十年代經歷了艱苦的經濟轉型，告訴了我們許多道理，也就是正確的政策可以打破絕望鉗制。

en: To contain today’s financial and economic crisis, Europe will also need to continue the cooperation that it has shown up to this point.
zh: 歐洲為了遏制當今的金融和經濟危機就必須繼續進行迄今為止的合作。

en: The very existence of our Union, and particularly of the euro, has already helped to prevent the competitive devaluations and beggar-thy-neighbor policies that ravaged Europe during the 1930’s – the last time the continent faced so brutal an economic downturn.
zh: 二十世紀三十年代，歐洲大陸面臨同樣殘酷的經濟衰退。 如今，歐盟、特別是歐元的存在本身就已經防止了當時破壞歐洲的各國貨幣競相貶值以及讓鄰國貧困的政策。

en: But we cannot be complacent that the forces of national egoism will remain in check.
zh: 但是我們並不能自滿，認為各國民族自我觀念會受到限制。

en: For now, EU governments’ coordinated fiscal stimulus has deprived populists of their usual charge that the EU is indifferent to the fate of individuals.
zh: 目前，歐盟各國政府協調財政刺激政策，民粹主義者通常指責歐盟對單個個人的命運無動於衷也就不攻自破。

en: Even more policy coordination will be needed both to confront the crisis and to re-establish EU norms once the storm clouds begin to dissipate.
zh: 為了應對危機以及在暴風開始消失的時候重新建立歐盟規則，人們就需要更多的政策協調。

en: Although it is right that the Stability and Growth Pact has become more flexible in these extraordinary times, its rules did secure a successful first decade for the euro.
zh: 歐洲穩定和增長公約在這一特殊時期變得更為靈活，這是不假。 但是這一公約規則確保了歐元取得第一個十年的成功。

en: These rules must eventually be restored intact if Europe is to return to the path of sustainable growth, and a consensus will need to be forged now to make that happen.
zh: 歐洲要想回到可持續增長的道路上來，這些規則就必須最終得以恢復，而且人們必須就如何促成這一局面達成一致意見。

en: The second key challenge that we will face during our European presidency is that of Russia.
zh: 我們擔任歐盟輪值主席國期間將要面臨的第二個關鍵挑戰就是俄國。

en: A new Partnership and Cooperation Agreement (PCA) between the EU and the Russian Federation must be negotiated.
zh: 我們必須談判制定一項歐盟與俄羅斯聯邦之間新的夥伴關係和合作協議。

en: Those negotiations should have begun seriously last year, but the war in Georgia intervened to put them on hold.
zh: 談判原本應該在去年就認真開始，但是喬治亞戰事卻把這一工作陷於停頓。

en: Now those talks have resumed, but the background to the negotiations has changed dramatically.
zh: 現在這些談判已經恢復，但是談判的背景發生了劇烈的變化。

en: Russia’s economy is now in far worse shape than that of EU members.
zh: 俄國經濟現在比歐盟國家的要糟糕許多。

en: The collapse of world oil and gas prices has wounded Russia’s budget, and lack of investment in the country’s energy sector over the years is now causing the declining production that economists have long predicted.
zh: 國際石油和天然氣價格大跌損害了俄國的預算，而且俄國能源部門多年來投資不足正在造成經濟學家們長久以來就預言的產量下降。

en: Until now, Russia has cared less about a new PCA than the EU, because two-thirds of Russia’s exports to the Union comprise natural resources, which bring in cash even without the strong rules that a PCA provides.
zh: 目前為止，俄國對協議的關心並不像歐盟那樣強烈，因為俄國向歐盟出口的三分之二是自然資源。 因此，即使沒有協議規定的硬性條款也能夠帶來現金收入。

en: Given the stark changes in economic conditions, however, it is now in Russia’s national interest to reassure international markets that it is a reliable place to do business, for which a new PCA would serve as an ideal signal.
zh: 但是，由於經濟形勢發生了劇烈變化，現在俄國向國際市場重新保證其是個經商的可靠地方符合自身的利益，而新的協議就是一個理想的訊號。

en: Moreover, without a new PCA, individual European countries may feel it necessary to seek even more bilateral agreements with Russia.
zh: 而且，沒有新的協議，歐洲各國就會感到有必要與俄國簽訂更多的雙邊協議。

en: Indeed, many EU members have been in a race with each other to see who will be Russia’s closest friend in the Union.
zh: 確實，許多歐盟成員國已經開展競賽，看看誰成為歐盟中與俄國最為親近的朋友。

en: But the bilateral deals that have emerged from this race sometimes come at the expense of other Union members, and may unbalance relations within the Union as a whole.  Only a rules-based EU framework can provide a firm foundation for both bilateral and Union-wide relations with Russia.
zh: 但是這一競賽帶來的雙邊協議有時候會損害其他歐盟成員國，而且可能破壞整個歐盟的內部平衡。 只有建立在規則基礎上的歐盟框架才能夠為對各國和整個歐盟對俄關係提供堅實的基礎。

en: Europe’s main strength in foreign policy is not its commitment to a rules-based multilateralism, important as that undoubtedly is, but its unity.
zh: 儘管多邊主義毫無疑問非常重要，但是歐洲外交的主要力量並不是其專心致志建立規則基礎之上的多邊主義，而是團結。

en: When the Georgia crisis erupted, Europe united around a single position on Russia’s withdrawal.
zh: 喬治亞危機爆發之時，歐洲團結一致，要求俄國撤軍。

en: It is the Czech Republic’s task, and that of the Swedish EU presidency that will follow our own, to maintain this unity as the PCA negotiations move forward.
zh: 捷克共和國的任務，以及隨後擔任主席國的瑞典的任務就是在協議談判的時候維持團結。

en: During the 1990’s, the US and Europe erred in treating Russia with benign neglect.  It would be a mistake for Russia to respond in kind today by seeking to prolong the PCA negotiations in the hope that a possibly more amenable EU president may one day offer softer terms.
zh: 在九十年代，美國和歐洲善意忽略俄國犯下錯誤。 如今，如果俄國尋求拖延協議談判，從而希望更為屈從的歐盟主席國會有一天提出更為軟弱的條款，那就是錯誤。

en: We, like all EU presidencies, will be representing the wider Union interests when we negotiate.
zh: 我們和其他歐盟輪值主席一樣，將會在談判的時候推動廣泛的歐盟利益。

en: In Praise of Fragmentation
zh: 讚美碎片化

en: LONDON – Emerging markets are back in the spotlight.
zh: 發自倫敦 — — 新興市場再次成為了眾人的焦點。

en: Investors and banks are suddenly unwilling to finance current-account deficits with short-term debt.
zh: 投資者和銀行突然不願為為經常賬戶赤字提供短期貸款融資。

en: South Africa, for example, has had to increase interest rates, despite slow economic growth, to attract the funding it needs.
zh: 例如南非儘管經濟增長緩慢，但不得不提高利率來吸引資金。

en: Turkey’s rate increase has been dramatic.
zh: 土耳其的利率提升也非常引人注目。

en: For these and other emerging countries, 2014 may prove to be a turbulent year.
zh: 對它們以及其他新興國家來說，2014年可能會被證明是動盪的一年。

en: If volatility becomes extreme, some countries may consider imposing constraints on capital outflows, which the International Monetary Fund now agrees might be useful in specific circumstances.
zh: 如果波動變得極端，一些國家可能會考慮限制資本流出，國際貨幣基金組織目前認為這個做法在特定的情況下可能有用。

en: But the fundamental question is how to manage the impact of short-term capital inflows.
zh: 但根本問題在於如何應對短期資本流入所帶來的影響。

en: Until recently, economic orthodoxy considered that question invalid.
zh: 直到最近，正統經濟理論認為該問題是不成立的。

en: Financial liberalization was lauded because it enabled capital to flow to where it would be used most productively, increasing national and global growth.
zh: 人們讚美金融自由化就是因為它能使資本流向生產力最高的地方，從而促進國家和全球的增長。

en: But empirical support for the benefits of capital-account liberalization is weak.
zh: 但對資本賬戶自由化優點的實證支撐相當薄弱。

en: The most successful development stories in economic history – Japan and South Korea – featured significant domestic financial repression and capital controls, which accompanied several decades of rapid growth.
zh: 經濟史上最成功的發展故事 — — 日本和韓國 — — 就是靠著特色鮮明的國內金融管制和資本控制實現了數十年的高速發展。

en: Likewise, most cross-country studies have found no evidence that capital-account liberalization is good for growth.
zh: 同樣地，大多數跨國研究發現表明沒有證據證明資本賬戶自由化有利於經濟增長。

en: As the economist Jagdish Bhagwati pointed out 16 years ago in his article “The Capital Myth,” there are fundamental differences between trade in widgets and trade in dollars.
zh: 正如經濟學家賈格迪什·巴格沃蒂（Jagdish Bhagwati）16年前在他的文章《資本神話》中所指出的那樣，在商品貿易和美元貿易之間存在著根本差異。

en: The case for liberalizing trade in goods and services is strong; the case for complete capital-account liberalization is not.
zh: 商品和服務貿易自由化會促進經濟增長，而全面資本賬戶自由化則不會。

en: One reason is that many modern financial flows do not play the useful role in capital allocation that economic theory assumes.
zh: 一個原因是許多現代金融流動並非如經濟理論假設的那樣對資本分配發揮有益的作用。

en: Before World War I, capital flowed in one direction: from rich countries with excess savings, such as the United Kingdom, to countries like Australia or Argentina, whose investment needs exceeded domestic savings.
zh: 在第一次世界大戰前，資本只在一個方向流動：從英國這樣超額儲蓄的富裕國家，流向澳大利亞或阿根廷這樣投資需求超過國內儲蓄的國家。

en: But in today’s world, net capital flows are often from relatively poor countries to rich countries.
zh: 但是在當今世界，資本淨流動通常是從相對貧窮國家流向富裕國家。

en: Huge two-way gross capital flows are driven by transient changes in perception, with carry-trade opportunities (borrowing in low-yielding currencies to finance lending in high-yielding ones) replacing long-term capital investment.
zh: 巨大的雙向資本流動總額由對瞬間變化的感知來驅動，使得套利交易機會（借入低收益的貨幣去投資高收益的貨幣）取代了長期資本投資。

en: Moreover, capital inflows frequently finance consumption or unsustainable real-estate booms.
zh: 此外，資金流經常會促進消費或非持續性的房地產繁榮。

en: And yet, despite the growing evidence to the contrary, the assumption that all capital flows are beneficial has proved remarkably resilient.
zh: 然而儘管有越來越多的反面證據，但認為所有資本流動都有利的假說卻長盛不衰。

en: That reflects the power not only of vested interests but also of established ideas.
zh: 這反映了其力量不僅來自既得利益者，同時也來自已經建立的某些觀念。

en: Empirical falsification of a prevailing orthodoxy is disturbing.
zh: 須知一個流行的正統理論被實證推翻是件令人不安的事情。

en: Even economists who find no evidence that capital-account liberalization boosts growth often feel obliged to stress that “further analysis” might at last reveal the benefits that free-market theory suggests must exist.
zh: 甚至是那些認為沒有證據表明資本賬戶自由化能促進增長的經濟學家，也會常覺得有必要強調“進一步分析”最終可能證實自由市場理論所說的好處一定存在。

en: It is time to stop looking for these non-existent benefits, and to distinguish among different categories of capital flows.
zh: 是時候停止尋找這些子虛烏有的好處，並區分不同類別的資本流動。

en: Some are valuable, but some are potentially harmful.
zh: 有些是有價值的，有些則是有害的。

en: Foreign direct investment (FDI), for example, can aid growth, because it is long term, involves investment in the real economy, and is often accompanied by technology or skill transfers.
zh: 例如外國直接投資（FDI）可以刺激經濟增長，因為它是長期的，涉及到實體經濟中的投資，並往往伴隨著技術或技能轉移。

en: Equity portfolio investment may involve price volatility as ownership positions change, but at least it implies a permanent commitment of capital to a business enterprise.
zh: 股票投資組合可能涉及價格波動作為所有權的位置變化，但至少它意味著對商業企業一個永久的資本承諾。

en: Long-term debt finance of real capital investment can play a useful role as well.
zh: 實際資本投資的長期債務融資可以發揮有益的作用。

en: By contrast, short-term capital flows, particularly if provided by banks that are themselves relying on short-term funding, can create instability risks, while bringing few benefits.
zh: 相比之下，短期資本流動，尤其是如果由本身就依靠短期資金運作的銀行來提供的，會在帶來少許好處的同時產生不穩定的風險。

en: What is less clear is the best policy response.
zh: 而最好的政策回應就是留下一點模糊空間。

en: Capital controls are invariably porous, and we cannot gain the benefits of free trade and FDI without creating some opportunities for short-term investor positioning.
zh: 因為資本管制永遠有漏洞可鑽，我們無法只是獲得自由貿易和FDI的好處而不給短期投資者留下一些機會。

en: China has not liberalized its capital account, but short-term inflows are now driving stronger upward pressure on the renminbi (and larger offsetting reserve accumulation by the People’s Bank of China) than can be explained by the current-account surplus and FDI flows.
zh: 中國還沒有開放其資本賬戶，但短期流入現在對人民幣（以及中國人民銀行更龐大的累積對沖儲備）產生了超出經常賬戶順差和FDI流動所能解釋的更大升值壓力。

en: A case can thus be made for capital-account liberalization that is based on the impossibility of effective control, not on any supposed benefits.
zh: 這可以作為基於不可能有效控制 — — 而不是基於任何假設的優點 — — 的資本賬戶自由化的一個案例。

en: But while perfect policy is unattainable, partly effective controls can still play a useful role if targeted at the interface between short-term inflows and domestic credit cycles.
zh: 雖然完善的政策是不存在的，但如果針對短期流入和國內信貸週期的臨界點，部分有效的控制仍能發揮作用。

en: After all, capital inflows cause the greatest harm when they drive rapid increases in credit-financed consumption or real-estate speculation.
zh: 畢竟，當資本流入驅動信貸消費或者房地產投機快速增長時就會導致最大的破壞。

en: The required policy response should integrate domestic financial regulation with capital-account management.
zh: 所需的政策反應應該把國內金融監管與資本賬戶管理整合起來。

en: Tax instruments and reserve requirements that put sand in the wheels of short-term capital inflows should be combined with strong countercyclical measures, such as additional capital requirements, to slow domestic credit creation.
zh: 那些阻礙短期資本流入的稅收工具和準備金要求應與反週期措施緊密結合，例如提出額外的資本要求以遏制國內的信貸活動。

en: The effectiveness of such measures can be undermined if global banks operate in emerging countries in branch form, providing domestic credit financed by global funding pools.
zh: 如果全球銀行在新興國家以分行形式運作，並利用全球資金儲備提供國內信貸，那這些措施的效果將會受到破壞。

en: But this danger can be countered by requiring banks to operate as legally incorporated subsidiaries, with locally regulated capital and liquidity reserves, and strong regulatory limits on the maturity of their funding.
zh: 但這種危險可以透過要求銀行以合法註冊的子公司形式運作，區域性調整資本和流動性儲備，並對它們的資金期限進行強有力的監管來進行防範。

en: Such requirements would not prevent useful capital flows: global banking groups could invest equity in emerging markets and fund their subsidiaries’ balance sheets with long-term debt.
zh: 這樣的要求不會阻止有用的資本流動：全球銀行集團可以投資於新興市場股票，並將長期債務來為子公司的資產負債表提供資金。

en: In banking, as in other sectors, investment that combines long-term commitment with skill transfer can be highly beneficial, which implies that foreign banks should be free to compete on the same basis as domestic banks.
zh: 在銀行業，就像其他部門一樣，結合長期技術轉移承諾的投資是非常有益的，這意味著外資銀行應該被允許在相同的基礎上與國內銀行自由競爭。

en: Neither mandatory subsidiarization nor tax- or regulation-based capital controls will solve all of the problems.
zh: 無論是強制性的子公司化，還是基於稅收或法規的資本管制都不能解決所有的問題。

en: But, taken together, they can stem the volatility implied by short-term flows and help to smooth out domestic credit cycles.
zh: 但總的來說，它們可以遏止由於短期資本流動所引起的波動，並幫助緩和國內信貸週期。

en: Much of the financial industry resists such measures, as do the many economists who remain wedded to the old orthodoxy.
zh: 許多金融業堅持這些措施，就像許多經濟學家仍然執著於舊的正統理論一樣。

en: Renewed capital controls, they claim, would “fragment” the global financial market, undermining its ability to allocate capital efficiently.
zh: 他們聲稱，更新資本管制，將使得全球金融市場“碎片化 ” ， 削弱其有效配置資本的能力。

en: In the past, policymakers have been at pains to stress that no such fragmentation will be allowed.
zh: 過去，政策制定者一直在竭力強調，這樣的碎片化是不會被允許的。

en: But we need to be blunt: Free flows of short-term debt can result in capital misallocation and harmful instability.
zh: 但我們需要直言不諱：短期債務的自由流動會導致資本配置不當和有害的不穩定性。

en: When it comes to global capital markets, fragmentation can be a good thing.
zh: 當全球資本市場來臨，碎片化可能是一件好事。

en: The High-Tech, High-Touch Economy
zh: 高科技、高接觸經濟

en: LONDON – A recent report revealed that the five richest families in Britain are worth more than the country’s poorest 20% combined.
zh: 倫敦—最近的一份研究披露，英國最富的五個家庭的財富比最窮的20%英國人加起來還要多。

en: Some of the wealth comes from new business ventures; but two of the five are a duke and an earl whose ancestors owned the fields across which London expanded in the nineteenth century.
zh: 在他們的財富中，有一些來自新企業；但其中有兩個家庭是公爵和伯爵，他們的祖先擁有倫敦在十九世紀所擴張的土地。

en: Urban land wealth is not just a London phenomenon.
zh: 城市和財富並不只是倫敦才有的現象。

en: As Thomas Piketty’s recent book Capital in the Twenty-First Century shows, accumulated wealth has grown rapidly relative to income across the advanced economies over the last 40 years.
zh: 托馬斯·皮克提（Thomas Piketty）的新著《二十一世紀的資本主義 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）指出，在過去四十年中，發達經濟體的累積財富增長相對要快於收入。

en: In many countries, the majority of that wealth – and the lion’s share of the increase – is accounted for by housing and commercial real estate, and most of that wealth resides not in the value of the buildings, but in the value of the urban land on which it sits.
zh: 在許多國家，大部分財富 — — 以及財富增量中的大頭 — — 都由住房和商業地產貢獻，並且這些財富的大部分並不在於建築的價值，而在於建築所在城市土地的價值。

en: That might seem odd.
zh: 這或許有些奇怪。

en: Though we live in the hi-tech virtual world of the Internet, the value of the most physical thing – land – is rising relentlessly.
zh: 儘管我們生活在高科技網際網路虛擬世界，但最實實在在的東西 — — 土地仍在不停地上漲。

en: But there is no contradiction: The price of land is rising because of rapid technological progress.
zh: 但這其實並不矛盾：土地價格之所以上漲，正是因為快速的科技進步。

en: In an age of information and communication technology (ICT), it is inevitable that we value what an ICT-intensive economy cannot create.
zh: 在資訊和通訊技術（ICT）時代，我們難免會珍視ICT密集型經濟無法創造的東西。

en: ICT has already delivered remarkable new products and services; but, as MIT’s Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee argue persuasively in their recent book The Second Machine Age, the really dramatic changes are yet to come, with robots and software bound to automate out of existence a huge number of jobs.
zh: ICT帶給了我們令人矚目的新產品和服務；但是，正如麻省理工學院的埃裡克·布萊恩約弗森（Eric Brynjolfsonn）和安德魯·麥卡菲（Andrew McAfee）在他們的近著《第二次機器時代 》 （ The Second Machine Age）中所令人信服地指出的，真正戲劇性的變化還沒有到來，機器人和軟體必將把大量工作崗位“自動化掉 ” 。

en: One consequence is the striking phenomenon of huge wealth creation with very little labor input.
zh: 一個結果是一個令人驚奇的現象：極少數勞動力投入就可以創造巨大的財富。

en: Facebook has an equity valuation of $170 billion but employs only around 6,000 people.
zh: Facebook市值高達1,700億美元，但只有約6,000名僱員。

en: The investment that went into building the software that runs it entailed no more than around 5,000 software engineer man-years.
zh: 建設執行Facebook的軟體的投資不過5,000軟體工程師人年。

en: This remarkable technology has helped to deliver increasing average incomes and will continue to do so.
zh: 這一令人矚目的技術推動了平均收入的增加，並將一直如此。

en: But the distribution of that bounty has been very unequal.
zh: 但這筆財富的分配是非常不平等的。

en: The lion’s share of the growth has gone to the top half, the top 10%, or even the top 1% of the population.
zh: 增長的絕大部分都流向了頂層的一半人、10%的人甚至1%的人。

en: As the better off become richer, however, much of their rising income will not be spent on ICT-intensive goods and services.
zh: 但是，儘管受益者變富了，其收入增幅的大頭並沒有花在ICT密集型商品和服務上。

en: There is a limit to how many iPads and smart phones one can need, and their price continues to plummet.
zh: 一個人需要的iPad和智慧手機數量總歸有限，並且它們的價格也一直在下降。

en: Instead, an increasing share of consumer expenditure is devoted to buying goods and services that are rich in fashion, design, and subjective brand values, and to competing for ownership of location-specific real estate.
zh: 相反，越來越大的消費支出比重被用於購買富於時尚、設計和主管品牌價值的商品和服務以及攀比房產地段上。

en: But if the land on which the desired houses and apartments sit is in limited supply, the inevitable consequence is rising prices.
zh: 但如果高尚別墅和公寓的地段供給是有限的，那麼漲價便成為難以避免的結果。

en: Urban land is therefore rising in value – in London, New York, Shanghai, and many other cities – partly because of consumer demand.
zh: 因此，倫敦、紐約、上海和其他許多城市土地價值節節攀升 — — 部分是因為消費需求的推動。

en: But its rising value also makes it an attractive asset class for investors, because further price increases are expected.
zh: 但土地價值的上升讓它們成為令投資者垂涎不已的資產類別，因為可以預期未來價格還會上漲。

en: Moreover, returns on real estate have been swollen by the dramatic fall in interest rates over the last 25 years, a decline that was far advanced even before the 2008 financial crisis.
zh: 此外，房地產回報因為過去25年來利率的大幅下降（遠在2008年金融危機前便已開始）而節節升高。

en: The cause of those low interest rates is debated; but one probable factor is the reduced cost of business investment in hardware and software-based “machines.”
zh: 低利率的原因有待爭議；但一個可能因素是基於硬體和軟體的“機器”的商業投資的成本的下降。

en: If you can build a $170 billion company with just 5,000 software engineer man-years, you don’t need to borrow much money.
zh: 如果建立一個1,700億美元的公司只需要5,000軟體工程師人年的，那麼就無需大量借錢。

en: The fact that technology is so powerful not only makes physical land more valuable; it also means that future employment growth will be concentrated among the jobs that cannot be automated, particularly in services, which have to be delivered physically.
zh: 科技如此強大，這一事實不但讓實體土地變得更有價值；也意味著未來就業增長將圍繞無法自動化的崗位，特別是必須實在提供的服務崗位。

en: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics estimates that among the most rapidly growing occupational categories over the next ten years will be “healthcare support occupations” (nursing aides, orderlies, and attendants) and “food preparation and serving workers” – that is, overwhelmingly low-wage jobs.
zh: 美國勞動統計局估算，未來十年增長最快的職業分類將是“健康支援崗位 ” （ 護理、看護和侍從）以及“食品準備和服務工人 ” — —也就是說，絕大多數是底薪崗位。

en: In short, ICT creates an economy that is both “hi-tech” and “hi-touch” – a world of robots and apps, but also of fashion, design, land, and face-to-face services.
zh: 簡言之，ICT創造了一��“高科技”和“高接觸”的經濟 — — 一個機器人和應用與時尚、設計、土地和面對面服務並存的世界。

en: This economy is the result of our remarkable ability to solve the problem of production and automate away the need for continual labor.
zh: 這個經濟是我們解決生產問題能力高超以及連續勞動需要被自動化排除的結果。

en: But it is an economy that is likely to suffer two adverse side effects.
zh: 但這個經濟可能帶來兩大副作用。

en: First, it may be inherently unstable, because the more that wealth resides in real estate, the more the financial system will provide leverage to support real-estate speculation, which has been at the heart of all of the world’s worst financial crises.
zh: 首先，它可能具有內在不穩定性，因為聚集在房地產的財富越多，金融系統為支援房地產投資所提供的槓桿也就越大，而這正是最糟糕的世界金融危機的核心原因。

en: Major changes in financial and monetary policy, going far beyond those introduced in response to the 2008 crisis, are required to contain this danger.
zh: 這需要金融和貨幣政策的重大變化來遏制，變化程度將令2008年危機所導致的應對措施黯然失色。

en: Second, unless we deliberately design policies that encourage and sustain inclusive growth, a highly unequal society is virtually inevitable, with rising land values and wealth magnifying the effects of the unequal income distribution that ICT produces directly.
zh: 其次，除非有意設計鼓勵和維持包容性增長的政策，否則高度不平等的社會幾乎是不可避免的，土地價值和財富的增加將放大ICT直接帶來的不平等收入分配效應。

en: Indeed, the modern economy may resemble that of the eighteenth century, when the land owned by the Duke of Westminster and the Earl of Cadogan was still just fields to the west of London, more than the middle-class societies in which most developed countries’ citizens’ grew up.
zh: 事實上，現代經濟可能更類似於十九世紀（當時威斯敏斯特公爵和卡多根伯爵所擁有的土地只不過是西倫敦的荒地 ） ， 而不是大部分發達國家公民所成長起來的中產階級社會。

en: The Trade Delusion
zh: 貿易的迷思

en: LONDON – Since 2008, global trade has grown slightly more slowly than global GDP.
zh: 發自倫敦 — — 自2008年以來，全球貿易的增長幅度稍微落後於全球GDP的增長。

en: The Doha Round of World Trade Organization negotiations ended in failure.
zh: 世界貿易組織多哈回合談判以失敗告終。

en: Transatlantic and transpacific trade negotiations are progressing slowly, held back by the resistance of special interests.
zh: 在各特殊利益集團的阻撓之下，跨大西洋和跨太平洋的貿易談判也步履維艱。

en: But, though many experts fear that protectionism is undermining globalization, threatening to impede global economic growth, slower growth in global trade may be inevitable, and trade liberalization is decreasingly important.
zh: 儘管許多專家擔心保護主義會破壞全球化並威脅到全球經濟增長，但全球貿易增長放緩很可能是無法避免的，而貿易自由化的重要性也在不斷降低。

en: To be sure, for 65 years, rapid trade growth has played a vital role in economic development, with average advanced-economy industrial tariffs plummeting from more than 30% to below 5%.
zh: 可以肯定的是，過去65年以來，貿易的快速增長在經濟發展中扮演了至關重要的作用，使得發達經濟體的各行業平均關稅從超過30%暴跌到5%以下。

en: The creation of Europe’s single market facilitated increased intra-European trade.
zh: 歐洲單一市場的建立促進了歐盟內部貿易的增長。

en: Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan achieved rapid economic catch-up on the basis of export-led growth.
zh: 日本、韓國以及臺灣以出口主導型增長實現了經濟的快速趕超。

en: China has followed the same path over the last 30 years.
zh: 中國在過去30年中遵循了同樣的路徑。

en: Trade grew about twice as fast as global output from 1990 to 2008.
zh: 從1990年到2008年，貿易增速相當於全球產出增速的兩倍。

en: But there is no reason why trade should grow faster than GDP forever.
zh: 但是貿易不可能永遠比GDP增長得更快。

en: Indeed, even if there were no trade barriers at all, trade might grow significantly more slowly than GDP in some periods.
zh: 事實上，即使沒有貿易壁壘，貿易增長也可能會在某些時期明顯慢於GDP增長。

en: Several factors make it possible that we are entering such a period.
zh: 有幾方面因素使得我們正在進入這樣一個時期。

en: For starters, there is the changing pattern of consumption in the advanced economies.
zh: 首先，發達經濟體的消費模式發生了變化。

en: Richer people spend an increasing share of their income on services that are either impossible to trade (for example, restaurant meals) or difficult to trade (such as health services).
zh: 富人越來越多的把收入份額花費在服務上，這些服務要麼是不可能進行貿易（例如，外出用餐 ） ， 要麼是難以貿易（如衛生服務 ） 。

en: Non-tradable sectors tend to account for a growing share of employment and economic activity.
zh: 非貿易部門在就業和經濟活動中佔據的份額越來越大。

en: For several decades, that tendency has been offset by ever more intensive trading of tradable goods, often passing through many countries in complex supply chains.
zh: 幾十年來，這一趨勢一直被越發頻密的可貿易商品交易所抵消，這些交易往往透過複雜的供應鏈在許多國家之間流通。

en: In the future, however, the shift to non-tradable consumption may dominate.
zh: 然而在未來，非貿易消費可能轉而佔據主導地位。

en: Indeed, trade intensity may decline even for manufactured goods.
zh: 事實上，甚至製造業商品的貿易頻密度也可能會下降。

en: Trade is partly driven by differences in labor costs.
zh: 貿易在一定程度上是由勞動力成本差異所驅動的。

en: China’s dramatic manufacturing growth reflected low wages up to now.
zh: 目前為止，中國製造業的急劇增長反映了其低工資水平。

en: But as real wages in China and other emerging economies grow, incentives for trade will decline.
zh: 但隨著中國和其它新興經濟體實際工資的提高，貿易的激勵因素將下降。

en: The more that global incomes converge, the less trade there may be.
zh: 全球收入越是趨同，貿易的次數就越少。

en: In addition, as the economists Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee of MIT have argued in their book The Second Machine Age, rapid advances in information technology may enable increasingly extensive automation.
zh: 另外，正如麻省理工學院經濟學家埃裡克·布倫喬爾森（Erik Brynjolfsson）和安德魯·麥卡菲（Andrew McAfee）在《第二次機器時代 》 （ The Second Machine Age）一書中所說，飛速發展的資訊科技可以使自動化技術的應用日益廣泛。

en: Some manufacturing activities, though few jobs, may well return to developed countries, as the advantages of proximity to customers and lower transport costs outweigh decreasingly important differences in labor costs.
zh: 一些生產活動，儘管只能很少的就業，很可能會回到發達國家開展，因為接近客戶的優勢和更低的運輸成本更勝於重要性逐漸降低的勞動力成本差異。

en: Global trade as a share of GDP may therefore decline, but without adverse consequences for global economic growth.
zh: 全球貿易作為全球GDP的組成部分，其比例可能因此下降，但不會對全球經濟增長產生不利影響。

en: Rising productivity does not require relentlessly increasing trade intensity.
zh: 生產率的提高無需不斷增加貿易頻密度。

en: Earth, after all, does not trade with other planets, yet its economy still grows.
zh: 畢竟，雖然地球沒有跟其他星球進行貿易，其經濟卻仍然保持增長。

en: Optimal trade intensity depends on many factors – such as relative labor costs, transport costs, productivity levels, and economy-of-scale effects.
zh: 最優貿易頻密度取決於許多因素 — — 如相對勞動力成本，運輸成本，生產力水平，經濟規模效應。

en: Trends in these factors might make reduced trade intensity not only inevitable but desirable.
zh: 這些因素的變化趨勢會令貿易頻密度的降低變得不可避免，但卻是有利的。

en: Even if that is true, international trade will still play a vital role, and preventing any reversal of past trade liberalization is essential.
zh: 即使這是真的,國際貿易仍將發揮至關重要的作用，防止對過去貿易自由化程序的逆轉是至關重要的。

en: But further trade liberalization is bound to be of declining importance to economic growth.
zh: 但進一步的貿易自由化對經濟增長的重要性必然會下降。

en: With industrial tariffs already dramatically reduced most potential benefits of trade liberalization have already been grasped.
zh: 由於各行業關稅都已大大減少，大多數貿易自由化的潛在好處已經被開發。

en: Estimates of the benefits of further trade liberalization are often surprisingly low – no more than a few percentage points of global GDP.
zh: 估計進一步的貿易自由化的好處往往出奇地低 — — 不超過全球GDP的幾個百分點。

en: That is small compared to the cost of the 2008 financial crisis, which has left output in several advanced economies 10-15% below pre-crisis trend levels.
zh: 這相比2008年金融危機的影響來說極為微小，後者導致多個發達經濟體的經濟產出比危機前下跌了10~15 % 。

en: It is small, too, compared to the difference in economic performance between successful catch-up countries – such as China – and other countries that have enjoyed the same access to global markets but have performed less well for other reasons.
zh: 而這相對於那些成功實現經濟追趕的國家 — — 比如中國 — — 與那些同樣擁有通往全球市場渠道但因為其他原因未能充分發力的國家之間的經濟表現差異來說也相對較少。

en: The main reason for slow progress in trade negotiations is not increasing protectionism; it is the fact that further liberalization entails complex trade-offs no longer offset by very large potential benefits.
zh: 貿易談判進展緩慢的主要原因並不是貿易保護主義的日漸增加；而是因為進一步自由化導致的複雜權衡取捨無法再被非常龐大的潛在利益所抵消。

en: The Doha Round’s failure has been decried as a setback for developing countries. And some liberalization – say, of advanced economies’ cotton imports – would undoubtedly benefit some low-income economies.
zh: 多哈回合的失敗被認為是發展中國家所遭遇的挫折���同時一些自由化行動 — — 比如發達國家的棉花進口 — — 無疑會令一些低收入國家受益。

en: But full trade liberalization would have a complex impact on the least developed economies, some of which would benefit only if compensated for the loss of the preferential access to advanced-economy markets that they currently enjoy.
zh: 但全面的貿易自由化會對那些最不發達的國家產生複雜的影響，其中一些國家可能會失去現在享有的通往發達經濟體市場的優惠渠道，只有對此進行補償才能讓它們受益。

en: This implies that further progress in trade liberalization will be slow.
zh: 這意味著貿易自由化的進一步進展將會放緩。

en: But slow progress is a far less important challenge to growth prospects than the debt overhang in developed economies, or infrastructure and educational deficiencies in many developing economies.
zh: 但相對於發達國家所面對的債務，或者許多發展中經濟體的基礎設施和教育缺口來說，這一緩慢進展只能算是一個次要的發展障礙。

en: That reality often goes unacknowledged.
zh: 事實的真相往往會被忽視。

en: The importance of past trade liberalization has left the global policy establishment with a bias toward assuming that further liberalization would bring similar benefits.
zh: 過去的貿易自由化導致全球政策體制出現了一種偏見，以為進一步的自由化就能產生同樣的結果。

en: But while the potential global benefits of trade liberalization have declined, reduced trade intensity might still impede economic development in some countries.
zh: 但雖然貿易自由化所帶來的潛在全球利益在縮小，但貿易頻密度的降低將依然阻礙某些國家的經濟發展。

en: Only a handful of economies over the last 60 years have fully caught up to advanced-economy living standards, and all relied on export-led growth to drive productivity and job creation in manufacturing.
zh: 在過去60年中只有少數幾個國家完全趕上的發達國家的生活水平，而這些國家都是依靠出口導向型增長並透過製造業提高生產力和創造就業。

en: Relying solely on that model will be more difficult in the future.
zh: 在未來，單純依靠這一模式將變得更為艱難。

en: China is so big that it must develop domestic drivers of growth at an earlier stage of development than did Japan, Taiwan, or South Korea; as a result, its exports will inevitably decline (relative to GDP).
zh: 中國幅員遼闊，所以它必須比日本，臺灣和韓國提早一個階段去開發發展的國內驅動力；因此其出口將無可避免地（相對於GDP）下跌。

en: Meanwhile, for some low-income countries, increased manufacturing and service-sector automation of the sort described by Brynjolfsson and McAfee, whether within advanced economies or within China’s established industrial clusters, will make the path to middle- and high-income status more difficult to achieve.
zh: 與此同時，對某些低收入國家來說，布倫喬爾森和麥卡菲所提出的那種製造業和服務業自動化，無論是在發達經濟體還是中國已經成型的產業叢集之中，都將令它們邁向中等/高收入國家的路徑更加坎坷。

en: That poses important challenges for development policy, which further trade liberalization can alleviate only marginally.
zh: 這對發展政策的制定提出了嚴峻的挑戰，而進一步的貿易自由化只是杯水車薪而已。

en: Rethinking the Monetization Taboo
zh: 反思貨幣化戒條

en: LONDON – Now that the pace of the US Federal Reserve’s “tapering” of its asset-purchase program has been debated to death, attention will increasingly turn to prospects for interest-rate increases.
zh: 發自倫敦 — — 如今人們已經對美聯儲“縮減”資產收購計劃的步驟進行了充分的討論，而注意力也將逐漸轉向對利率上升的預期方面。

en: But another question looms: How will central banks achieve a final “exit” from unconventional monetary policy and return balance sheets swollen by unconventional monetary policy to “normal” levels?
zh: 但同時又出現了另一個問題：央行們將如何達到一個退出非常規貨幣政策的最終“出口 ” ， 並把在非常規貨幣政策下過度膨脹的資產負債表恢復到“正常”的水平？

en: To many, a larger issue needs to be addressed.
zh: 對許多人來說，一個更大的問題必須得到處理。

en: The Fed’s tapering merely slows the growth of its balance sheet.
zh: 美聯儲的縮減僅僅是減緩了其資產負債表的增速。

en: The authorities would still have to sell $3 trillion of bonds to return to the pre-crisis status quo.
zh: 如果想回到危機前水平的話，當局還要發行價值3萬億美元的債券。

en: The rarely admitted truth, however, is that there is no need for central banks’ balance sheets to shrink.
zh: 但一個很少被承認的真相就是各大央行其實無需去縮減自己的資產負債表規模。

en: They could stay permanently larger; and, for some countries, permanently bigger central-bank balance sheets will help reduce public-debt burdens.
zh: 它們可以長期保持更大的規模；而對一些國家來說，這種長期大規模狀況將有助於減輕公共債務負擔。

en: As a recent IMF paper by Carmen Reinhart and Kenneth Rogoff illustrates, advanced economies face debt burdens that cannot be reduced simply through a mix of austerity, forbearance, and growth.
zh: 正如卡門·萊因哈特與肯尼思·羅格夫最近發表的一篇國際貨幣基金組織論文所指出的那樣，那些發達經濟都面臨著一些無法僅僅藉助一系列緊縮，拖延和增長就能消除的債務負擔。

en: But if a central bank owns the debt of its own government, no net public liability exists.
zh: 但如果一家央行也持有本國債券的話，那就再也不存在什麼純粹的公共債務責任了。

en: The government owns the central bank, so the debt is to itself, and the interest expense comes back to the government as the central bank’s profit.
zh: 央行為政府所有，因此等於政府自己向自己借債， 而利息支出又以央行利息收入的形式返還給了政府。

en: If central bank holdings of government debt were converted into non-interest-bearing perpetual obligations, nothing substantive would change, but it would become obvious that some previously issued public debt did not need to be repaid.
zh: 即便央行持有的政府債券被轉化成無息長期債券，也不會有任何實質性的改變，但很顯然一些從前發行的公共債權都不再需要償還了。

en: This amounts to “helicopter money” after the fact.
zh: 這等同於債務出現之後投放的“直升飛機貨幣 ” 。

en: In 2003, then-Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke argued that Japan, facing deflation, should increase public expenditure or cut taxes, funding the operation by printing money rather than issuing bonds.
zh: 在2003年，時任美聯儲主席的本·伯南克認為面臨通縮的日本應當增加公共支出或者減稅，並透過印鈔而非發行債券的方式來為這些措施注入資金。

en: This, he argued, was bound to increase national income, because the direct stimulative effect would not be offset by concern about future debt burdens.
zh: 他認為這最終會增加國家收入，因為這種直接刺激的效應不會被對未來債務負擔的擔憂所抵消。

en: His advice was not followed; large Japanese deficits were in fact bond-financed.
zh: 但他的建議卻沒有被採納；大量的日本財政赤字其實是透過發債支撐的。

en: But the debts held by the Bank of Japan (BoJ) could still be written off.
zh: 但日本銀行所持有的債務卻依然是可以被登出的。

en: In Japan’s case, this would reduce government debt by an amount equal to more than 40% of GDP today, and around 60% if implemented after the bond purchases planned for 2014.
zh: 對日本來說，這將可以削減相當於當前GDP總額40%的政府債務，如果在2014年計劃的債權購買計劃後實施的話甚至可以達到60 % 。

en: Objections focus on two risks: central-bank losses and excessive inflation.
zh: 反對的焦點集中在兩大風險之上：央行的損失以及過度通脹。

en: But both of these outcomes can be avoided.
zh: 但這兩點後果其實都是可以避免的。

en: Central banks have bought government bonds with money on which they currently pay zero or very low interest rates.
zh: 央行們用自身以零利率或者超低利率融來的錢去購買政府債券。

en: So, as interest rates rise, central banks might face costs exceeding their income.
zh: 因此隨著利率上升，央行可能會面臨支出超過收入的狀況。

en: But central banks can choose to pay zero interest on a portion of the reserves that commercial banks hold with them, even when they increase the policy interest rate.
zh: 但即便央行提升了政策利率，它們依然可以選擇去向那一部分由商業銀行持有的儲蓄支付零利息。

en: And they can require commercial banks to hold zero-interest reserves at the central bank equal to a defined proportion of their loans, thus preventing inflationary growth of private credit and money.
zh: 它們也可以要求商業銀行在央行持有相當於其貸款特定比例的零利率儲蓄，並因此防止私人信貸和貨幣的通脹性增長。

en: Permanent monetization of government debts is undoubtedly technically possible.
zh: 長期的政府債務貨幣化無疑是技術上可行的。

en: Whether it is desirable depends on the outlook for inflation.
zh: 而這是否可取則取決於對通脹的預期。

en: Where inflation is returning to target levels, debt monetization could be unnecessarily and dangerously stimulative.
zh: 當通脹恢復到目標水平時，債務貨幣化就可能變成一種不必要且危險的刺激手段。

en: Central-bank bond sales, while certainly not inevitable, may be appropriate.
zh: 央行債務出售，雖然註定無法避免，但也可以是恰當的。

en: But if deflation is the danger, permanent monetization may be the best policy.
zh: 但如果通縮是真正威脅的話，長期的貨幣化可能是最佳的政策。

en: I predict that Japan will, in effect, permanently monetize some government debt.
zh: 我預測日本會在事實上將一些政府債務實施長期貨幣化。

en: After two decades of low growth and deflation, Japanese gross public debt is now above 240% of GDP (and above 140% of GDP on a net basis); and, with the fiscal deficit at 9.5% of GDP, the debt burden continues to increase.
zh: 在經歷了20年的低增長和通縮之後，日本的總公共債務已經超過了GDP的240 % （ 如果以淨債務計算的話則超過GDP的140 % ） ；同時在相當於GDP9.5%的財政赤字之下，債務負擔依然在不斷增長。

en: According to the IMF, to reduce its net public debt to 80% of GDP by 2030, Japan would have to turn today’s 8.6% primary budget deficit (the balance excluding interest payments) into a 6.7% primary surplus by 2020 and maintain such surpluses continuously until 2030.
zh: 據國際貨幣基金組織統計，如果要在2030年將淨公共債務總額降低到相當於GDP80%的話，日本必須在2020年將當前8.6%的基本預算赤字轉變為6.7%的基本盈餘，並維持這一狀況到2030年。

en: That will not happen, and any attempt to reach that target would drive Japan into a severe depression.
zh: 這種情況不會發生，而且任何試圖實現這一目標的舉措都將把日本帶入一場嚴重衰退之中。

en: But the government does not need to repay the ¥140 trillion ($1.4 trillion) of its debt that the BoJ already owns.
zh: 但日本政府不需要償還日本銀行已經持有的140萬億日元（摺合1.4萬億美元）債務。

en: The BoJ will continue to increase its balance sheet until it achieves its 2% inflation target.
zh: 日本銀行將繼續擴大其資產負債表直到達到2%的通脹目標。

en: Thereafter, its balance sheet may stabilize in absolute yen terms and fall slowly as a percentage of GDP, but its absolute size will probably never decrease – a likelihood that should cause no concern.
zh: 此後其資產負債表的日元淨值將趨向穩定並以GDP的一定比例穩步下降，但其絕對規模或許永遠不會減少 — — 這是一種不會引發任何憂慮的可能性。

en: It is precisely what happened to the Fed’s balance sheet after its wartime and postwar buying of US government bonds came to an end in 1951.
zh: 而這也正是美聯儲的資產負債表在1951年結束購買美國政府戰時和戰後債券後所發生的情況。

en: Even as permanent monetization occurs, however, the truth may be obfuscated.
zh: 即便長期貨幣化的情況出現，但真相或許會被掩飾掉。

en: If government bond repayments to the BoJ continued, but were always offset by new BoJ bond purchases, and if the BoJ kept the interest rate on reserves at zero, the net effect would be the same as a debt write-off, but the fiction of “normal” central-bank operations could be maintained.
zh: 如果日本政府債券對日本銀行的償付持續存在，但卻往往會被新的央行債券購買所抵消，同時倘若日本銀行將儲蓄利率保持為零，那產生的淨效應就等於登出了這些債務，但一個“正常”央行運作的虛構表象將得到維持。

en: Central banks can monetize debt while pretending not to.
zh: 央行可以在假裝沒有的情況下把債務貨幣化。

en: That pretense may reflect a useful taboo: if we overtly recognize that debt write-off/monetization is possible, politicians might want to do it all the time and in excess, not just in circumstances that make it appropriate.
zh: 這種假裝可能反映出一個有用的戒條：如果我們公開承認債務登出/貨幣化是可能的，政治家們就可能時刻想著怎樣去濫用它，而不是選擇適當的時機去實施。

en: The historical experience of Weimar Germany, or that of Zimbabwe today, illustrates the danger.
zh: 過去德國魏瑪政府，當今辛巴威的遭遇都反映了這種風險。

en: As a result, even when permanent monetization occurs – as it almost certainly will in Japan and possibly elsewhere – it may remain forever the policy that dare not speak its name.
zh: 因此，即便發生了長期貨幣化 — — 幾乎可以確定日本會實施而其他國家也有可能 — — 但可能政策永遠不會提到這一詞彙。

en: Such reticence may serve a useful purpose.
zh: 這種沉默或許將有利於實現一個有益的目的。

en: But it must not blind central banks and governments to the full range of policy tools available to address today’s severe debt overhangs.
zh: 但這也不應令央行和政府們忘記還有這類政策工具是可以用來應對當前的債務暴增問題的。

en: The Perils of Financial Freedom
zh: 金融自由的弊端

en: LONDON – Back in 2007, China’s then-prime minister, Wen Jiabao, famously described his country’s economy as “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable.”
zh: 發自倫敦 — — 2007年，時任中國國家總理的溫家寶指出“中國經濟存在著巨大問題，依然是不穩定、不平衡、不協調、不可持續的結構性的問題。

en: Today, the imbalance remains, with the economy too focused on investment and too dependent on credit.
zh: ”如今，不平衡狀態依然存在，而中國經濟則太過集中於投資領域並過度依賴於信貸。

en: China’s current leadership is committed to building a more balanced model, and believes that the market must play a “decisive role” in achieving that.
zh: 當前的中國領導層承諾要建立一個更為均衡的發展模式，並相信市場會在實現這一目標的過程中扮演“決定性的角色 ” 。

en: But, while stronger market discipline is needed in some areas, Chinese officials should be under no illusion that free markets are a panacea for the financial sector.
zh: 但當某些領域需要更強監管之時，中國官員們不應奢望自由市場會成為金融部門的一劑萬能藥。

en: Indeed, China’s current economic imbalances partly reflect the dangers created by competition in credit markets.
zh: 事實上，中國當前的經濟不平衡狀況在某種程度上正是反映出由信貸市場競爭所產生的危機。

en: Even before the 2008 global financial crisis, China’s annual investment/GDP ratio was running at an exceptionally high 40%, and economists were calling for a transition to more consumption-led growth.
zh: 即便是在2008年全球金融危機之前，中國的年均投資/GDP比率就達到極高的40%水平，而經濟學家們也在呼籲向更消費導向的增長形勢轉型。

en: But the huge credit stimulus introduced in 2009 drove the economy further in the opposite direction.
zh: 2012年上述比率上升到47 % ， 而工程建設已經佔到了全部產值的40 % 。

en: The investment ratio rose to 47% by 2012, and construction now accounts for 30% of all output. Total credit has risen from 130% of GDP to 200%, with both bank loans and “shadow bank” credit expanding rapidly.
zh: 總信貸量也從相當於GDP的130%飆升到200 % ， 無論是銀行貸款還是“影子銀行”信貸都急劇擴張。

en: Both China and the global economy benefited from that stimulus, which helped prop up overall demand in dangerously deflationary times.
zh: 中國和全球經濟都從這一刺激行動中受益，而這也在危險的通縮時期推高了總需求。

en: But it has led to significant wasted investment in heavy industry, real estate, and urban infrastructure, and leaves China facing the challenge of deleveraging and working out bad debts.
zh: 但這也導致了在重工業，房地產以及城市基礎設施建設方面的大量浪費，為中國留下了去槓桿化和壞賬的挑戰。

en: In many areas, improved market discipline does have an important role to play in addressing the structural causes of imbalance.
zh: 在許多領域，市場紀律的強化確實在應對失衡狀況的結構性原因方面發揮了重要作用。

en: Wasteful construction investment is encouraged by the under-pricing of rural land.
zh: 壓低價格的農村土地鼓勵了過度浪費的建設投資。

en: The lack of a normal ownership relationship between the central government and state-owned enterprises (SOEs) allows the latter to pay minimal dividends and over-invest in business expansion.
zh: 中央政府和國有企業之間正常所有權關係的缺失令後者可以只支付最低限度的紅利並在業務發展方面過度投資。

en: Caps on interest rates on bank deposits result in household savers supplying a large subsidy to corporate borrowers.
zh: 對銀行存款利率設定的上限導致家庭儲蓄者實際上是鉅額補貼了企業貸款者。

en: And SOEs have better access to credit from state-owned banks than private companies do.
zh: 國企也比私企更容易從國有銀行得到貸款。

en: But the belief that financial liberalization will provide an easy route to a balanced and stable economy is a delusion, as Japan’s experience in the 1980’s illustrates.
zh: 但日本在1980年代的經驗證明，那種認為金融自由化就能使經濟走向平衡穩定的想法是錯誤的。

en: As Joe Studwell argues persuasively in his book How Asia Works, neither Japan nor South Korea based its successful economic development on free markets in credit supply; instead, they relied on the deliberate direction of credit toward industrial development rather than real estate or consumption.
zh: 正如喬·斯蒂維爾（Joe Studwell）在其著作《亞洲是如何執行》中證明的那樣，無論是日本還是韓國都不是透過自由市場的信貸供應實現經濟奇蹟的，相反，它們是依靠有意將信貸匯入工業發展而非房地產或消費實現成功的。

en: When Japan relaxed constraints on its banking system in the 1980’s, the result was an enormous real-estate boom and subsequent bust, followed by two decades of slow growth and deflation.
zh: 當日本在1980年代放鬆對銀行系統的管制之後，藉著就是一場巨大的房地產泡沫以及隨後的經濟破滅，結果就是持續20年的低速增長和通縮。

en: China’s per capita income is still only about a quarter of Japan’s in 1990; it would be a tragedy if it suffered a similar setback before completing the path to developed-country living standards.
zh: 中國的人均收入在1990年僅相當於日本的1/4，如果中國在實現發達國家生活水平出現了類似的挫折，那必將是悲劇性的。

en: One striking feature of the Chinese economy, however, is that real estate and urban infrastructure development – high-rise housing, grand transport projects, convention centers, sports stadiums, and museums – already play a far more important role than they did in Japan and South Korea at comparable stages of economic development.
zh: 然而中國經濟其中一個引人注目的特點就是房地產和城市基礎設施建設 — — 高層住宅、大型交通樞紐、會議中心，體育館和博物館都比在同一經濟發展階段的日本和韓國要扮演更重要的角色。

en: This reflects the interaction of two distinctively Chinese factors and one inherent feature of all banking systems.
zh: 這反映出兩大中國特色因素和所有銀行系統的一個內在特點的互動結合。

en: The first Chinese factor is the authorities’ focus on “urbanization” as an end in itself, rather than as a byproduct of industrialization.
zh: 第一大特色是當局強調“城市化 ” ， 但這種城市化本身就是目的，而非工業化的副產品。

en: The second is China’s decentralized approach to economic development, with strong competition between regions and cities often focusing on prestige urban infrastructure projects.
zh: 其二是中國實現經濟發展的去中心化手段，區域之間不斷競爭，各城市都以宏大華麗的城市基礎設施專案為榮。

en: The universal feature in this mix is the fact that banks everywhere can create private credit, money, and purchasing power that did not previously exist, and they have a natural bias, if not constrained by public policy, to allocate it to fund real-estate developments, which drive rising land prices.
zh: 在這一混合體中的共有特點則是世界各地的銀行都可以創造出原本不存在的私人信貸，資金以及購買力，而如果不受公共政策限制的話，這些銀行都有一個天然的偏好，就是把上述��造物投入到房地產發展中去，並因此推高土地價格。

en: These factors will drive construction booms and busts even if obvious market distortions are removed and market discipline is tightened.
zh: 即便排除了明顯的市場扭曲並強化市場紀律，這些因素依然會導致房產建設泡沫並最終破裂。

en: The pre-crisis Irish and Spanish banking systems proved just as capable as Chinese state-owned banks at funding excessive real-estate construction.
zh: 危機前的愛爾蘭和西班牙銀行都和中國的國有銀行一樣擁有資助過度房地產建設的能力。

en: So, even as China introduces greater market discipline to a largely positive effect, it must plan to constrain credit creation with policy tools that were missing in the advanced economies before the 2008 crisis.
zh: 因此，即便中國引入了更多的市場管制來取得一個積極的成效，它必須計劃好用發達經濟體在2008年危機前缺失的政策工具去限制信貸創造。

en: Caps on loan-to-value or loan-to-income ratios on real-estate loans should be used aggressively.
zh: 應當大規模應用對貸款額/價值比和貸款額/收入比設定上限的方法。

en: Capital requirements for banks should reflect higher risk weights for real-estate lending than banks’ private assessments of credit risks suggest are appropriate.
zh: 同時對銀行資本金的要求應體現在對房地產貸款方面比銀行內部信貸風險評估更高的風險權重。

en: The People’s Bank of China should maintain reserve requirements for commercial banks to contain credit creation, rather than reject them as old-fashioned, as occurred in the advanced economies in the decades before 2008.
zh: 中國人民銀行應當維持商業銀行的資本儲備要求以限制信貸創造，而不是像2008年前的發達經濟體那樣將其視為過時的東西。

en: Credit provision by shadow banks needs to be tightly regulated.
zh: 影子銀行的信貸供應必須嚴加規管。

en: The credit cycle is too important to be left to free markets.
zh: 對信貸週期的控制能力至關重要，不可拱手讓給自由市場。

en: China thus faces a difficult challenge.
zh: 中國因此面對這一個嚴峻的挑戰。

en: It must undergo a transition not to the Western model that produced the 2008 crisis, but to an entirely new model that combines elements of market discipline with strong public-policy constraints.
zh: 它必須實施一個轉型，不是朝向導致了2008年危機的西方模式，而是實現一個將某些市場管制因素和強大公共政策限制相結合的全新模式。

en: How smoothly that transition occurs matters for the whole world.
zh: 這場轉型能否平穩進行對全世界來說都非常重要。

en: By the early 2020’s, China’s GDP will be $20 trillion.
zh: 到2020年代初期，中國的GDP將達20萬億。

en: If the credit/GDP ratio reaches 250% by then, total loans and debt securities would equal $50 trillion, which is more than three times the total of US mortgage debt in 2008.
zh: 如果信貸/GDP比率在那時達到250 % ， 就意味著總貸款和債務證券價值將達到50萬億，比美國2008年是的次級貸規模還大3倍。

en: Today, much of that debt represents claims within the state sector – owed, for instance, by SOEs to state-owned banks.
zh: 如今，大多數債務的償付都在國有部門以內，比如國有企業和國有銀行。

en: But, as the private sector develops, SOEs are subjected to hard budget constraints, and the external capital account is opened, this huge credit mountain will create increasing global financial vulnerability.
zh: 但隨著私人部門不斷發展，國企受到嚴格預算限制，外部資本賬戶被放開，這一龐大信貸數額將導致全球金融風險不斷增大。

en: One hopes that the Chinese authorities understand the dangers as well as the benefits of free financial markets better than advanced-economy policymakers did ahead of the 2008 crisis.
zh: 我們希望中國政府能比2008年危機前的發達經濟體政策制定者們更好地認識到自由市場的優點和風險。

en: If not, another crisis – far more severe than the last – may become inevitable.
zh: 如果不是的話，另一場危機 — — 而且比前一場更加劇烈 — — 將不可避免。

en: The Great Credit Mistake
zh: 信用之謬大矣

en: LONDON – Before the financial crisis erupted in 2008, private credit in most developed economies grew faster than GDP.
zh: 倫敦—2008年前，大部分發達經濟體的私人信用增長都快於GDP。

en: Then credit growth collapsed.
zh: 接著，私人信用增長崩了盤。

en: Whether that fall reflected low demand for credit or constrained supply may seem like a technical issue.
zh: 私人信用增長的崩盤反映了需求低迷還是供給受限或許是個技術性問題。

en: But the answer holds important implications for policymaking and prospects for economic growth.
zh: 但答案對決策和經濟增長前景具有重要影響。

en: And the official answer is probably wrong.
zh: 而官方答案可能是錯的。

en: The prevailing view has usually stressed supply constraints and the policies needed to fix them.
zh: 流行的觀點通常強調供給受限以及糾正這一問題的政策。

en: An impaired banking system, it is argued, starves businesses, particularly small and medium-size enterprises (SMEs), of the funds they need to expand.
zh: 該觀點認為，受損的銀行系統讓企業困於缺乏擴張所需要的資金，特別是中小企業。

en: In September 2008, US President George W. Bush wanted to “free up banks to resume the flow of credit to American families and businesses.”
zh: 2008年9月，美國總統小布什希望“解放銀行以使信用重新流向美國家庭和企業。 ”

en: The stress tests and recapitalizations of US banks in 2009 were subsequently hailed as crucial to the recovery of both the banking system and the economy.
zh: 2009年美國銀行的壓力測試和資本重組隨後被稱為是銀行系統和經濟復甦的關鍵。

en: By contrast, the European Central Bank’s inadequately tough stress tests in 2010 were widely panned for leaving eurozone banks too weak to provide adequate credit.
zh: 相反，2010年歐洲央行壓力測試不夠嚴厲被廣泛指為導致歐元區銀行太疲軟而無法提供重組信用的原因。

en: In the United Kingdom, banks have been criticized for not lending the reserves created by quantitative easing to the real economy, leading the Bank of England to introduce its “funding for lending” scheme in 2012.
zh: 在英國，人們批評銀行沒有將量化寬鬆所創造出來的準備金貸給實體經濟，導致英格蘭銀行在2012年引入“貸款專用資金 ” （ funding for lending）機制。
