en: Advocates of stronger action respond that low-carbon investments can generate much stronger, cleaner growth.
zh: 加強行動的支持者回應道，低碳投資可以帶來強勁得多、潔淨得多的增長。

en: They point to the savings available from energy efficiency, and to the market opportunities generated by clean-energy technologies as the processes of learning and discovery take hold.
zh: 他們指出，隨著學習和發現的進行，能源效率能帶來節約，而清潔能源技術能帶來市場機會。

en: They seek to demonstrate the benefits that a more sustainable pattern of development can bring to the world’s cities, to people’s health (from the reduction in air pollution), to energy security, and to the ability of the world’s poor to access energy.
zh: 他們試圖證明，更加可持續的發展模式給世界各大城市 、 （ 透過減少空氣汙染）給人民健康、給能源安全帶來諸多好處，也能讓窮人獲得更多的能源。

en: And they propose green bonds and public investment banks to finance new infrastructure and jobs at a time when world interest rates are low and demand is depressed in many countries.
zh: 他們建議發行綠色債券，敦促上市投資銀行利用世界利率較低、許多國家需求受抑制的時機為新基礎設施和就業提供資金支援。

en: These are serious economic debates, but too often they have become entangled in ideological disputes about the appropriate response to the economic crisis and the value of government intervention in markets.
zh: 這些都是很嚴肅的經濟學爭論，但它們往往演化為關於經濟危機的合理應對措施和政府幹預市場的價值的意識形態糾紛。

en: That is regrettable.
zh: 這實在令人遺憾。

en: Climate change is not a partisan issue, and climate policy is essentially market-based.
zh: 氣候變化並非派系之爭，氣候政策從根本上說也是基於市場的。

en: It is about correcting market failures so that markets and entrepreneurship can play their proper role of ensuring innovation and efficient resource allocation.
zh: 這是關於糾正市場失靈從而使市場和企業家精神能夠在保證創新和有效資源配置中扮演適當角色的問題。

en: In order to escape this impasse, we have helped to launch the Global Commission on the Economy and Climate.
zh: 為了跳出這一僵局，我們協助成立了全球經濟和氣候委員會（Global Commission on the Economy and Climate ） 。

en: The Commission’s New Climate Economy project brings together seven leading policy research institutes from six continents, overseen by a panel of former heads of government and finance ministers and prominent business leaders, and advised by a panel of leading economists from across the world.
zh: 委員會的新氣候經濟（New Climate Economy）專案集合了六大洲的七大領先政策研究機構，由前政府首腦、財政部長和註明商業領袖組成的專家委員會監督，由全球著名經濟學家組成的專家委員會擔任顧問。

en: Its purpose is to provide authoritative new evidence concerning how governments and businesses can achieve stronger economic growth while simultaneously addressing climate risks.
zh: 其目的是提供關於政府和企業如何在實現更強的經濟增長的同時糾正氣候風險的權威新證據。

en: Few governments or investors start from the standpoint of climate change.
zh: 很少有政府或投資者以氣候變化為出發點。

en: They want to promote investment and economic growth, create jobs, stabilize public finances, expand markets, turn profits, ensure reliable energy and food supplies, produce goods and services, reduce poverty, and build cities.
zh: 他們想促進投資和經濟增長、創造就業崗位、穩定公共財政、擴大市場、帶來利潤、保證可靠的能源和食品供給、生產商品和服務、減少貧困以及建設城市。

en: So the primary question that we need to ask is not whether we can reduce emissions, but how public policy can help to achieve these core goals while reducing emissions and building a more climate-resilient economy.
zh: 因此，我們需要問的主要問題不是能否減少排放，而是公共政策如何幫助在實現這些核心目標的同時減少排放、建設氣候恢復力強的經濟。

en: There is now a lot of experience around the world in this area.
zh: 在這方面，全世界範圍有許多經驗可以遵循。

en: When the Stern Review on the economics of climate change was published seven years ago, the subject was largely theoretical.
zh: 七年前關於氣候變化經濟學的《斯特恩報告 》 （ Stern Review）釋出時，這個主題基本上還停留在理論階段。

en: Now countries at all stages of development are pursuing new patterns of economic growth that take climate into account.
zh: 如今，處於各個發展階段的各國都在追求新的考慮氣候問題的經濟增長模式。

en: Germany, for example, is planning the world’s most ambitious low-carbon energy transition, based on energy conservation and renewables.
zh: 比如，德國正在規劃全世界最有雄心的低碳經濟轉型，該計劃以節能和可再生為基礎。

en: South Korea has made “green growth” a central economic goal.
zh: 韓國將“綠色增長”制定為核心經濟目標。

en: Mexico’s 2012 General Law on Climate Change has put it on course for a major increase in clean power.
zh: 墨西哥2012年氣候變化一般法（General Law on Climate Change）將大大提高畫質潔電力的用量。

en: China has placed the industrial development of green technologies at the top of its agenda.
zh: 中國將綠色技術產業開發作為其日程的最優先專案。

en: Ethiopia is seeking to move to lower-carbon farming.
zh: 衣索比亞正在尋求發展低碳農業。

en: Brazil has significantly reduced the rate of deforestation in the Amazon.
zh: 巴西極大地降低了亞馬孫森林的採伐速度。

en: Some major businesses are providing powerful examples of what is possible.
zh: 一些大企業提供了有力的例子，讓我們知道可以做到什麼程度。

en: Unilever has committed to the sustainable sourcing of agricultural and forest products.
zh: 聯合利華承諾使用可持續的農業和森林產品源。

en: Coca-Cola is phasing out all use of climate-polluting hydrofluorocarbons.
zh: 可口可樂正在徹底停用汙染氣候的氫氟碳化合物。

en: The retail giant Wal-Mart is driving emissions reduction throughout its supply chain.
zh: 零售巨頭沃爾瑪在其全供應鏈推動減排運動。

en: Meanwhile, the World Bank and the European Investment Bank have stopped lending to high-emission coal plants.
zh: 與此同時，世界銀行和歐洲投資銀行也不再向高排放煤電貸款。

en: Yet genuine questions remain about how fast economies should move on to a low-carbon path, and the most effective way to do so.
zh: 但真正的問題依然存在 — — 經濟可以以多快的速度邁向低碳之路，以及什麼透過什麼辦法實現最有效。

en: Some low-carbon policies have clearly been expensive, while other, apparently cost-effective options, have not been pursued at all.
zh: 一些低碳政策顯然代價十分高昂，而一些顯然成本很低的選擇則完全沒有人實施。

en: Any structural transformation involves costs, trade-offs, and uncertainties, and it is vital that we understand these properly.
zh: 任何結構性變化都包括成本、權衡和不確定性，合理地理解這些因素十分重要。

en: Powerful interests will, of course, oppose any low-carbon transition, dismissing and often drowning out those who stand to benefit.
zh: 當然，強大的既得利益會反對一切低碳轉型，打壓甚至擠出低碳轉型的受益者。

en: That makes it even more important to clarify the choices.
zh: 這意味著澄清選擇更加重要了。

en: As science makes clear how imperative the climate question is, it is time for economists and policymakers to explain how it can be answered.
zh: 科學已經清楚地證明了氣候問題的緊迫性，現在該輪到經濟學家和決策者來解釋如何應對這一緊迫性了。

en: The Mouse Click that Roared
zh: 咆哮的滑鼠

en: CAMBRIDGE – Until recently, cyber security has primarily interested computer geeks and cloak-and-dagger types.
zh: 美國劍橋—直到最近，關注網路安全的還大多是電腦極客和陰謀論者。

en: The Internet’s creators, part of a small, enclosed community, were very comfortable with an open system in which security was not a primary concern.
zh: 網際網路的創造者 — — 他們屬於一個封閉的小圈子 — — 對安全並非主要顧慮的開放系統感到十分滿意。

en: But, with some three billion or so users on the Web nowadays, that very openness has become a serious vulnerability; indeed, it is endangering the vast economic opportunities that the Internet has opened for the world.
zh: 但是，如今有三十億網路使用者，這一開放性成了嚴重的弱點；事實上，這個弱點正在威脅到網際網路為世界開啟的廣袤的經濟機會海洋。

en: A “cyber attack” can take any number of forms, including simple probes, defacement of Web sites, denial-of-service attacks, espionage, and destruction of data.
zh: “網路攻擊”可以以數不清的形式出現，包括簡單的侵入、塗鴉網站、拒絕服務攻擊、間諜活動和毀壞資料。

en: And the term “cyber war,” though best defined as any hostile action in cyberspace that amplifies or is equivalent to major physical violence, remains equally protean, reflecting definitions of “war” that range from armed conflict to any concerted effort to solve a problem (for example, “war on poverty”).
zh: “網路戰”一詞也是千變萬化 — — 儘管最好的定義是放大或等同於重大實體侵犯的網路空間上的敵對行動 — — 可以反映從武裝衝突到齊心協力解決問題（比如“減貧戰 ” ） 在內的一系列“戰”的定義。

en: Cyber war and cyber espionage are largely associated with states, while cyber crime and cyber terrorism are mostly associated with non-state actors.
zh: 網路戰和網路間諜大多與國家有關，與此同時，網路犯罪和網路恐怖主義往往由非國家行動者發出。

en: The highest costs currently stem from espionage and crime; but, over the next decade or so, cyber war and cyber terrorism may become greater threats than they are today.
zh: 目前，最大的成本來自間諜和犯罪；但是，在未來十年中，網路戰和網路恐怖主義有可能成為比今天更大的威脅。

en: Moreover, as alliances and tactics evolve, the categories may increasingly overlap.
zh: 此外，同盟和戰術的演化，分類也可能日漸重疊。

en: Terrorists might buy malware from criminals, and governments might find it useful to hide behind both.
zh: 恐怖主義可以從犯罪分子那裡買來惡意軟體，政府可能會在背後指使。

en: Some people argue that deterrence does not work in cyberspace, owing to the difficulties of attribution.
zh: 有人認為，威懾在網路空間中並不管用，因為其來源難以確定。

en: But that is facile: inadequate attribution affects inter-state deterrence as well, yet it still operates.
zh: 但這簡直是信口開河：不充分的來源確定同樣影響著國家間的威懾，但威懾仍然常常被使用。

en: Even when the source of an attack can be successfully disguised under a “false flag,” governments may find themselves sufficiently enmeshed in symmetrically interdependent relationships such that a major attack would be counterproductive.
zh: 即便攻擊源頭可以用“偽旗”成功掩蓋，政府仍可能陷入對稱依賴的關係，讓重大攻擊產生適得其反的效果。

en: China, for example, would lose from an attack that severely damaged the American economy, and vice versa.
zh: 比如，中國可能因為嚴重危害美國經濟的襲擊中受到損失，反之亦然。

en: An unknown attacker may also be deterred by cyber-security measures.
zh: 未知的攻擊者還能被網路安全措施威懾。

en: If firewalls are strong, or redundancy and resilience allow quick recovery, or the prospect of a self-enforcing response (“an electric fence”) seems possible, an attack becomes less attractive.
zh: 如果防火牆夠強，或冗餘性和恢復力足以讓其快速回復，或有可能產生自我強化反應 （ “ 電圍欄 ” ） ，實施攻擊就會變得不再具有吸引力。

en: While accurate attribution of the ultimate source of a cyber attack is sometimes difficult, the determination does not have to be airtight.
zh: 儘管準確地確定網路攻擊的最終來源有時十分困難，但也不是一籌莫展。

en: To the extent that false flags are imperfect and rumors of the source of an attack are widely deemed credible (though not legally probative), reputational damage to an attacker’s soft power may contribute to deterrence.
zh: 由於偽旗的不完善性以及關於攻擊來源的傳聞被廣泛認為是可靠的（儘管未經法律驗證 ） ， 對攻擊者軟實力的名譽傷害也能形成威懾。

en: Finally, a reputation for offensive capability and a declared policy that keeps open the means of retaliation can help to reinforce deterrence.
zh: 最後，攻擊能力的名聲和公開宣佈以牙還牙政策也有助於增強威懾。

en: Of course, non-state actors are harder to deter, so improved defenses such as pre-emption and human intelligence become important in such cases.
zh: 當然，非國家行動者更難偵測，因此改善防線 — — 比如先發制人和人力情報 — — 在這類案件中就變得十分重要。

en: But, among states, even nuclear deterrence was more complex than it first looked, and that is doubly true of deterrence in the cyber domain.
zh: 但是，在國家之間，即便是核威懾也比乍看上去更復雜，在網路空間中的威懾更是如此。

en: Given its global nature, the Internet requires a degree of international cooperation to be able to function.
zh: 出於其全球性，網際網路需要一定程度的國際合作才能執行。

en: Some people call for the cyber equivalent of formal arms-control treaties.
zh: 有人呼籲制定網際網路版的正式武器控制條約。

en: But differences in cultural norms and the difficulty of verification would make such treaties hard to negotiate or implement.
zh: 但文化規範差異和查證困難將使這類條約難以談判和實施。

en: At the same time, it is important to pursue international efforts to develop rules of the road that can limit conflict.
zh: 與此同時，追求制定防止衝突的國際規則十分重要。

en: The most promising areas for international cooperation today most likely concern problems posed for states by third parties such as criminals and terrorists.
zh: 如今，最有希望的國際合作領域是第三方給國家帶來的問題，比如犯罪和恐怖主義。

en: Russia and China have sought to establish a treaty establishing broad international oversight of the Internet and “information security,” which would prohibit deception and embedding malicious code or circuitry that could be activated in the event of war.
zh: 俄羅斯和中國尋求制定條約建立對網際網路和“資訊保安”的全面國際監督，該條約將禁止欺詐和嵌入在可以在戰爭事件發生時啟用的惡意程式碼和電路。

en: But the US has argued that arms-control measures banning offensive capabilities could weaken defenses against attacks and would be impossible to verify or enforce.
zh: 但美國認為限制攻擊能力的武器控制措施會削弱針對攻擊的防禦，並且難以論證和強制實施。

en: Likewise, in terms of political values, the US has resisted agreements that could legitimize authoritarian governments’ censorship of the Internet – for example, by the “great firewall of China.”
zh: 類似地，在政治價值方面，美國拒絕了可能讓獨裁政府審查網際網路合法化的協定 — — 比如“中國防火長城 ” 。

en: Moreover, cultural differences impede any broad agreements on regulating online content.
zh: 此外，文化差異阻止了任何監管線上內容的廣泛協定。

en: Nonetheless, it may be possible to identify behaviors like cyber crime that are illegal in many domestic jurisdictions.
zh: 儘管如此，在本國司法轄區內鑑別網路犯罪等非法行為仍是可能的。

en: Trying to limit all intrusions would be impossible, but one could start with cyber crime and cyber terrorism involving non-state parties.
zh: 阻止一切侵入或許不可行，但可以從網路犯罪和非國家行動方參與的網路恐怖主義著手。

en: Here, major states would have an interest in limiting damage by agreeing to cooperate on forensics and controls.
zh: 在這方面，透過同意在取證和控制方面達成一致來限制傷害符合大國的利益。

en: The transnational cyber domain poses new questions about the meaning of national security.
zh: 跨國網路空間給我們帶來了關於國家安全含義的新問題。

en: Some of the most important responses must be national and unilateral, focused on hygiene, redundancy, and resilience.
zh: 一些最重要的應對措施必須是國家層面的、單方面的，專注於清掃、冗餘性和恢復力。

en: It is likely, however, that major governments will soon discover that the insecurity created by non-state cyber actors will require closer cooperation among governments.
zh: 但是，很有可能大國政府很快就會發現，由非國家網路行動者造成的不完全將要求各國政府間進行緊密合作。

en: A Practical Agenda for Revolutionary Times
zh: 革命時代的務實日程

en: OXFORD – As the world’s financial leaders gather for the International Monetary Fund and World Bank spring meetings, many working people around the world are demanding radical change, because they sense that their voices are not being heard.
zh: 牛津—在世界金融領導人齊聚國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）和世界銀行春季會議之際，全世界許多工作人口正在要求徹底的變革，因為他們認為他們的聲音沒有得到聆聽。

en: Those who are supposed to represent them should not ignore this anger and frustration any longer.
zh: 他們的所謂代表們不應該繼續忽視這一憤怒和失望了。

en: According to the 2017 Edelman Trust Barometer, the public’s confidence in the status quo has collapsed worldwide, owing to widely held concerns about globalization, innovation, immigration, the erosion of social values, and corruption.
zh: 據2017年阿德爾曼信任報告（2017 Edelman Trust Barometer ） ， 全世界對現狀的公共信心都出現了暴跌，原因在於人們對全球化、創新、移民、社會價值觀的墮落和腐敗普遍感到擔憂。

en: At the same time, the response from elites who regard themselves as the guardians of economic growth has sometimes made matters worse.
zh: 與此同時，自視為經濟增長的守護神的精英的反應有時令情況雪上加霜。

en: If they think they can allay public concerns simply by explaining the benefits of the current global economic system and tweaking policies to compensate those left behind, they are in for a rude awakening.
zh: 如果他們認為他們可以僅憑解釋當前全球經濟體系的好處，以及調整政策補償落後群體就能平息公眾質疑的話，他們將遭到當頭棒喝。

en: Earlier this month, the IMF, World Bank, and World Trade Organization published a joint report extolling the benefits of trade as a driver of productivity growth, competition, and consumer choice.
zh: 本月早些時候，IMF、世界銀行和世界貿易組織釋出了一份聯合報告，報告稱讚貿易是生產率增長、競爭和消費選擇的推進器。

en: The report’s argument in favor of free trade is not new, nor is its recommendation that “active labor-market policies” be used to cushion the blow of lost jobs and livelihoods.
zh: 這一支援自由貿易的觀點並不新鮮，而報告中所提出的用“積極的勞動力市場政策”支援喪失工作和生計的群體的建議也是了無新意。

en: What is new is that repeating these claims, without also addressing people’s deeper concerns, can now do more harm than good.
zh: 新的情況是，反覆強調這些觀點，而不同時解決人們更深層次的擔憂，很有可能弊大於利。

en: Global public opinion has changed dramatically in recent years.
zh: 全球公共觀點在近幾年中發生了劇烈變化。

en: A majority of people worldwide – and up to 72% of people in France and Italy – now believe that the system has failed them.
zh: 大部分世界人口 — — 法國和義大利已經高達72 % — —現在相信體系辜負了他們。

en: Moreover, only 29% of people across 28 countries now trust government leaders, while three-quarters of those surveyed say they trust reformers who would upend the status quo.
zh: 此外，在28個國家中只有29%的群眾信任政府領導人，而四分之三的受訪者表示他們信任將顛覆現狀的改革家。

en: These findings suggest that those defending free trade have lost credibility with the people they hope to persuade.
zh: 這些發現表明，自由貿易的捍衛者已經失去了在他們希望說服的群眾中的信譽。

en: World leaders need to recognize that today’s populist revolts are being fueled by a sense of lost dignity – a sentiment that does not factor into most policymakers’ prescription for economic growth and compensatory payments.
zh: 世界領導人需要認識到，當今民粹主義反動正在受到一種失去尊嚴的感覺的推動 — — 而這種感覺並沒有在大部分決策者為經濟增長和補償性支付所開出的藥方中獲得考慮。

en: Working-class voters have lashed out because they feel not just economically abandoned, but also socially disdained and culturally marginalized.
zh: 工作階級選民群情激奮，因為他們不但覺得自己在經濟上遭到了拋棄，在社會上和文化上也遭到了鄙視和邊緣化。

en: Their vote is the only means they have left to hit back at the establishment.
zh: 他們的選票是他們眼中唯一可以反擊建制的手段。

en: To address the public’s concerns requires a three-part agenda.
zh: 解決公眾擔憂需要一套三部分的日程。

en: The first order of business should be to reach out to those who feel voiceless and unrepresented.
zh: 首要任務是向覺得沒人聆聽和代表自己的群體丟擲橄欖枝。

en: During the US presidential campaign, Donald Trump tapped into this sentiment when he vowed to punish any company that moves jobs to China or Mexico.
zh: 在美國總統選戰期間，特朗普就利用了這一情緒，承諾要懲罰所有將工作崗位遷往中國或墨西哥的公司。

en: As the filmmaker Michael Moore explained prior to the election, American working-class voters were desperate to hear someone promise to take on big business.
zh: 電影製片人邁克爾·摩爾（Michael Moore）在大選前解釋道，美國工作階級選民急切地想聽到有人承諾向大企業開刀。

en: The fact that it took a populist plutocrat to do it underscores the extent to which the American labor movement has been extinguished.
zh: 由一位民粹主義財閥來做這件事這一事實讓美國勞工運動的窮途末路表露無遺。

en: Political parties that originally emerged from the labor movement have long since shifted to the “center.”
zh: 最初從勞工運動發展而來的政黨早已轉向了“中間派 ” 。

en: They now accept political contributions from big business, and have accordingly adopting the language of common prosperity and “consensus politics,” leaving the many working people who do not share in that prosperity and consensus feeling disregarded and displaced.
zh: 如今，它們接受大企業的政治獻金，並據此舉起了共同繁榮和“共識政治”的大旗，讓許多未能從這一繁榮和共識中分得一杯羹的工作階級覺得受到了無視和迷茫。

en: Second, the quality of work, and the status that it confers, must be improved.
zh: 其次，工作的質量，以及工作所帶來的地位，必須改善。

en: In wealthy countries, precarious, poorly paid, and even dangerous forms of employment are becoming increasingly common.
zh: 在富裕國家，不穩定、低薪乃至危險的就業形式正變得日益普遍。

en: A recent Bloomberg Businessweek story describes how temporary workers at auto-parts factories in Alabama are paid just $7.25 per hour, and must work in hazardous conditions with no safety training.
zh: 新一期《彭博商業週刊》上的一篇報道描述了亞拉巴馬州汽車零件廠的臨時工每小時只能掙7.25美元，並且必須在高風險環境中工作，還得不到安全培訓。

en: In 2010, these workers suffered work injuries at a 50% higher rate than unionized auto-parts workers elsewhere.
zh: 2010年，這些工人的工傷率比其他地方的非工會成員汽車零件工人高50 % 。

en: As the OECD has shown, “non-standard” work is proliferating globally.
zh: 經合組織指出 ， “ 非標準”工作正在全球興起。

en: This trend is contributing to deteriorating working conditions, making workers feel increasingly helpless and vulnerable.
zh: 這一趨勢導致了工作環境的惡化，讓工人覺得越來越無助和脆弱。

en: Reversing it will require robust standards to ensure workplace safety, fair pay, and the right to enter into collective-bargaining arrangements.
zh: 扭轉這一狀況需要制定嚴格的標準保證工作場所安全、公平薪資和參與集體議價安排的權利。

en: Governments will have to intervene to set these standards, as they did during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries to improve abysmal conditions in factories.
zh: 政府需要干預制定這些標準，一如它們在十九和二十世紀干預改善惡劣的工廠環境。

en: Otherwise, businesses will not be able to behave decently, for fear of being undercut by unscrupulous competitors.
zh: 否則，企業將無法體面地執行，因為它們面臨著無良競爭者的惡性競爭。

en: Finally, more opportunities must be created for the next generation – and not just economic opportunities.
zh: 最後，必須為子孫後代創造更多機會 — — 不僅僅是經濟機會。

en: Since the 2008 financial crisis, many governments have reduced their investments in health, education, housing, and other forms of human capital.
zh: 2008年金融危機以來，許多政府縮減了它們在衛生、教育、住房和其他形式的人力資本上的投資。

en: Many have also cut support for the unemployed, homeless, or indebted.
zh: 許多政府還削減了對失業者、無家可歸者和負債者的支援。

en: As a result, those who have fallen behind are deprived not just of resources, but, more important, the chance to pursue their aspirations.
zh: 結果，落後群體不但被剝奪了資源，跟重要的是，也被剝奪了追求理想的機會。

en: As the IMF, World Bank, and WTO show in their report, free trade and globalization have certainly increased the size of the overall economic pie.
zh: IMF、世界銀行和世貿組織在它們的報告中指出，自由貿易和全球化毫無疑問擴大了經濟蛋糕的總規模。

en: In theory, this should have expanded governments’ capacity to compensate those left behind and create the conditions for them to get ahead.
zh: 理論上，這應該能提升政府補償落後群體、為他們創造迎頭趕上的條件的能力。

en: In fact, the opposite has happened, owing to government cutbacks since 2008.
zh: 事實上，情況正好相反，原因就在於2008年以來政府的緊縮政策。

en: The establishment’s agenda has been failing for too long.
zh: 建制派的日程早已失敗多時。

en: And as elites continue to proclaim the benefits of free trade and globalization, they are merely widening the chasm of popular mistrust.
zh: 而在精英們繼續鼓吹自由貿易和全球化的好處的時候，他們只能不斷地擴大公眾的信任裂痕。

en: Over the past year, that mistrust has boiled over in many countries, with voters in one election after another rejecting the status quo.
zh: 在過去的一年中，這一不信任在許多國家引爆，在一次又一次選舉中，選民們都拒絕了現狀。

en: Piecemeal curbs on globalization will not be enough to quell the revolt.
zh: 零敲碎打的全球化限制不足以平息這場反動。

en: Instead, world leaders must leave their echo chamber, take ordinary people’s concerns seriously, diversify their views, and think about why so many have lost faith in the system.
zh: 相反，世界領導人應該走出他們的迴音室，認真對待普羅大眾的擔憂，多樣化他們的觀點，思考為什麼如此多人失去了對體系的信念。

en: The Development Costs of Homophobia
zh: 同性戀的發展成本

en: LONDON – As a gay man living in Nigeria, my biggest challenge was choosing between my sexuality and my job.
zh: 倫敦—作為一個生活在奈及利亞的男同性戀，我最大的挑戰是在性取向和工作之間做出選擇。

en: In 2004, I was at the start of my acting career.
zh: 2004年，我開始了我的表演生涯。

en: I had just left university, and I was featured in “Roses and Thorns,” a prime-time soap opera on Galaxy Television, one of Nigeria’s most popular TV stations. I was playing the role of “Richard,” the only son of a rich family who was having an affair with the house maid.
zh: 當時我剛剛告別校園，在奈及利亞最受歡迎的電視臺銀河電視臺（Galaxy Television）的黃金檔肥皂劇《玫瑰與荊棘 》 （ Roses and Thorns）中扮演一個叫做“理查德 ” （ Richard）的角色，理查德是一個富裕家庭唯一的兒子，與女傭發生了一段羅曼史。

en: Whispers were making the rounds about my private life, and I decided it was time to come out.
zh: 關於我的私生活流言蜚語不斷，我決定是時候站出來了。

en: So I agreed to go on Nigeria’s most-watched television talk show to discuss my sexuality.
zh: 因此我同意參加奈及利亞收視率最高的電視脫口秀討論我的性取向。

en: Almost immediately, my character was eliminated.
zh: 我的角色幾乎馬上就被取消了。

en: And when my job disappeared, so did my financial security.
zh: 丟了飯碗的我也失去了財務保障。

en: Like many gay men and lesbians in Africa, my choice was between economic freedom and mental imprisonment.
zh: 與非洲的眾多男女同性戀一樣，我必須在經濟自由和精神禁錮之間做出選擇。

en: This year, Nigeria and Uganda put in place draconian anti-gay laws, sparking a worldwide debate about human rights.
zh: 今年，奈及利亞和烏干達都出臺了嚴厲的反同性戀法律，激起了關於人權的全球爭論。

en: This debate has also started at the World Bank, whose president, Jim Yong Kim, recently declared that “institutionalized discrimination is bad for people and for societies.”
zh: 這場爭論也在世界銀行展開，行長金墉最近宣佈“制度化歧視對人類和社會不利。 ”

en: Kim’s statement has invited criticism and controversy.
zh: 金墉的表態招來了批評和爭議。

en: Often, as in Uganda and Nigeria, we hear the claim that opposition to official discrimination against gay, lesbian, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) people is simply a way to impose “Western” values on Africa.
zh: 通常，與在烏干達和奈及利亞一樣，我們總是聽到這樣的聲音：反對針對男同性戀、女同性戀、雙性戀和變性人的正式歧視純屬將“西方”價值強加於非洲頭上。

en: But this assumes that homosexuality is “un-African.”
zh: 但這一論斷意味著同性戀是“不非洲”的。

en: And, despite the absence of evidence that any given country or continent does not have LGBT people (and ample evidence to the contrary), it is an assumption that an increasing number of African leaders have embraced.
zh: 而儘管沒有證據表明有任何一個國家或大洲不存在同性戀、雙性戀和變性人（相反的證據倒是汗牛充棟 ） ， 但越來越多的非洲領導人都採取了這一觀點。

en: In 2006, President Olusegun Obasanjo, then Nigeria’s president, was among the first to do so.
zh: 2006年，奈及利亞時任總統奧巴桑喬（Olusegun Obasanjo）是第一批接受這一觀點的領導人之一。

en: Uganda’s President Yoweri Museveni followed suit when signing the anti-gay bill into law in 2014.
zh: 烏干達總統穆塞維尼（Yoweri Museveni）緊隨其後，在2014年也簽署了反同性戀法案。

en: Other leaders, from Gambia’s President Yahya Jammeh to Zimbabwe’s Robert Mugabe, have spoken in the same vein.
zh: 其他領導人，如尚比亞總統賈梅（Yahya Jammeh）和辛巴威總統穆加貝（Robert Mugabe）也持有相同態度。

en: These official attitudes have caused significant suffering for Africa’s gays and lesbians.
zh: 這些官方態度導致非洲同性戀群體備受傷害。

en: Indeed, the price of homophobia for gay people in many African countries is painfully clear: legal penalties, social ostracism, and mob justice.
zh: 事實上，在許多非洲國家，同性戀厭惡給同性戀群體造成的代價是顯而易見的：法律傷害、社會排斥、暴民正義，等等。

en: But here is what Africa’s anti-gay leaders miss: legal protections are not only a human-rights issue, but also an economic issue.
zh: 但這方面正是非洲反同性戀領導人所忽略的：法律保護不僅是一個人權問題，也是一個經濟問題。

en: Kim is exactly right, and research has started measuring the economic costs of homophobia by exploring links between anti-gay sentiment and poverty in countries where laws and social attitudes proscribe same-sex relationships.
zh: 金墉的宣告是非常正確的，衡量同性戀厭惡的經濟成本的研究已經開始，探索法律和社會觀念排斥同性關係國家的反同性戀情緒與貧困的關係。

en: M.V. Lee Badgett, an economist at the University of Massachusetts-Amherst, presented the initial findings of a study of the economic implications of homophobia in India at a World Bank meeting in March 2014.
zh: 在2014年3月舉行的世界銀行會議上，麻州大學安姆赫司特（Amherst）分校經濟學家巴吉特（M.V. Lee Badgett）展示了關於印度同性戀厭惡的經濟影響的初步研究發現。

en: Badgett estimated that the Indian economy may have lost up to $23.1 billion in 2012 in direct health costs alone, owing to depression, suicide, and HIV treatment disparities caused by anti-gay stigma and discrimination.
zh: 巴吉特估計，由於反同性戀羞辱和歧視造成的抑鬱、自殺和艾滋病治療差距，2012年印度經濟光是直接健康損失成本就高達231億美元。

en: In addition to such concrete costs, being gay can bring violence, job loss, family rejection, harassment in schools, and pressure to marry.
zh: 除了這些實實在在的成本，成為同性戀可能帶來暴力、失去工作、被家庭排斥、在學校受到騷擾以及結婚壓力。

en: As a result, many gay people have less education, lower productivity, lower earnings, poorer health, and a shorter life expectancy.
zh: 結果，許多同性戀教育程度低、生產率差、收入少、健康不良、壽命預期也較短。

en: In Nigeria, I started the Independent Project for Equal Rights (TIERs) in 2005 to respond to the increasing number of people who were losing their jobs because of suspicions about their sexuality.
zh: 在奈及利亞，我在2005年建立了平等權利獨立計劃（Independent Project for Equal Rights，簡稱TIGERs ） ， 以應對日益增多的因為性取向受懷疑而丟失工作的人。

en: During our first year, we provided support for dozens of people.
zh: 在該計劃成立後的第一年裡，我們為幾十人提供了支援。

en: One young man, “Olumide,” was given temporary housing after his family kicked him out for being gay.
zh: 其中一位年輕人“奧魯邁德 ” （ Olumide）因為身為同性戀而被逐出家門，我們為他提供了暫時居所。

en: Another, “Uche,” was fired from his job as a chef after his sexuality was revealed.
zh: 另一位名叫“烏奇 ” （ Uche）的人因為性取向暴露而失去了廚師工作。

en: TIERs helped him with accommodation and capital to set up a catering business.
zh: TIERS幫他找到容身之所，並提供了做餐飲生意的資本。

en: Though almost 10 years have passed, it is still not safe to use their real names.
zh: 儘管時間已經過去了近10年，他們仍不能安全地使用真名。

en: Across Africa, the economic costs of discrimination are increasing, in line with growing pressure on employers, landlords, health-care providers, educational institutions, and others to exclude LGBT people.
zh: 在整個非洲，歧視的經濟成本正在增加，相應地，僱主、地主、醫療服務提供者、家哦哦與機構和其他群體也在排斥同性戀、雙性戀和變性人士。

en: Today, the World Bank and other development agencies are mapping out the global development priorities that will follow the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs), which officially end in 2015 and included specific targets for promoting gender equality and empowering women as a strategy for economic growth.
zh: 如今，世界銀行和其他發展機構正在為千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goals）之後的發展日程制定優先項。 千年發展目標將於2015年正式結束，其中包括了促進性別平等、將增加婦女權益作為經濟增長戰略等具體目標。

en: Looking ahead, the Bank should take the same approach to LGBT rights and make legal protections for sexual orientation and gender identity a condition for countries receiving loans.
zh: 放眼未來，世界銀行應該對同性戀、雙性戀和變性人群體權利採取同樣的態度，將對性取向和性別認同的法律保護作為各國獲得貸款的條件。

en: Building recognition of women’s rights into the MDGs did not corrupt African cultures by imposing “Western” values; in fact, it strengthened many African countries, which now lead the world in the representation of women in government.
zh: 將承認婦女權利作為千年發展目標之一並沒有因為強加“西方”價值而損害非洲文化；事實上，這讓許多非洲國家變得更加強大，如今，在女性佔政府官員的比重方面它們已經成為全球領先者。

en: By pursuing similar protections for LGBT people, international investment and aid can improve economic performance and strengthen respect for basic human rights.
zh: 國際投資和援助可以透過為同性戀、雙性戀和變性人群體爭取同樣的保護改善經濟表現、強化對基本人權的尊重。

en: The World Bank, always wary of entangling itself in “political” questions, emphasizes that it is not a global human-rights enforcer.
zh: 世界銀行總是擔心自己牽涉“政治”問題，強調它不是一個全球人權推廣機構。

en: But it also increasingly recognizes its own role as a facilitator in helping Bank members realize their human-rights obligations.
zh: 但它也日益承認其在幫助世行成員國認識到自身人權義務方面的促進作用。

en: LGBT rights should be a test case.
zh: 同性戀、雙性戀和變性人權利應該成為對世行的考驗。

en: Aid to governments that permit specific social groups to be ostracized can carry very real economic costs.
zh: 對允許排斥特定社會群體的政府的援助可能造成非常現實的經濟代價。

en: As new loans are considered, steps should be taken to ensure that the benefits are as inclusive as possible.
zh: 在考慮新貸款時，應該採取措施確保讓其收益儘可能具有包容性。

en: If the Bank – which currently lends Nigeria almost $5.5 billion and expects to commit an additional $2 billion in each of the next four years – moved in this direction, other funders might follow.
zh: 目前，世界銀行對奈及利亞貸款大約在55億美元，預計還將承諾在未來四年每年增加20億美元。 世界銀行正在朝這一方向前進，其他資金提供者可以跟進。

en: Africa’s LGBT people desperately need such powerful allies in their struggle for human and economic rights.
zh: 非洲的同性戀、雙性戀和變性人群體急切地需要在人權和經濟權利的鬥爭中獲得這些強大的盟軍。

en: A Democratic Burma?
zh: 民主緬甸？

en: TOKYO – Historic transformations often happen when least expected.
zh: 東京 — — 歷史轉型的發生總是出人意料的。

en: Mikhail Gorbachev’s liberalizing policies of glasnost and perestroika in the Soviet Union emerged at one of the Cold War’s darkest hours, with US President Ronald Reagan pushing for strategic missile defense and the two sides fighting proxy wars in Afghanistan and elsewhere.
zh: 在冷戰正酣的時候，戈爾巴喬夫在蘇聯推出了改革與新思維的自由化政策，而美國總統里根推出了戰略導彈防禦系統，並在阿富汗和其他地區的實施雙邊戰爭代理人戰爭。

en: Deng Xiaoping’s economic opening followed China’s bloody – and failed – invasion of Vietnam in 1978.
zh: 鄧小平的經濟開放政策是在1978年中國對越南的血腥入侵（以失敗告終）之後推行的。

en: And South Africa’s last apartheid leader, F. W. de Klerk, was initially perceived as just another apologist for the system – hardly the man to free Nelson Mandela and oversee the end of white minority rule.
zh: 而南非的末代種族隔離領導人德克拉克一開始被普遍認為只是舊體制的又一個捍衛者，幾乎無人想到他會釋放曼德拉並結束少數白人的統治。

en: Now the world is suddenly asking whether Burma (Myanmar), after six decades of military dictatorship, has embarked on a genuine political transition that could end the country’s pariah status.
zh: 現在，世界突然對緬甸產生了疑問，在60年的軍事獨裁之後，緬甸真的將開始走向終結該國賤民地位的實質性政治轉型了嗎？

en: Is Burma, like South Africa under de Klerk, truly poised to emerge from a half-century of self-imposed isolation?
zh: 緬甸會像德克拉克的南非一樣，真正從半個世紀的自我封閉中走出來嗎？

en: And can Aung San Suu Kyi, the heroic opposition leader, and Thein Sein, Burma’s new president, engineer a political transition as skillfully and peacefully as Mandela and de Klerk did for South Africa in the early 1990’s?
zh: 反對派的英雄領導人昂山素季和新任緬甸總統登盛能像20世紀90年代初曼德拉和德克拉克在南非那樣推行巧妙而和平的政治轉型嗎？

en: Despite her two decades of house arrest and isolation, Suu Kyi possesses two of the gifts that enabled Mandela to carry out his great task: a reassuring serenity and an utter lack of vindictiveness.
zh: 儘管昂山素季經歷了20年的軟禁和隔離，但仍具有讓曼德拉完成偉大成就的兩大素質：心止如水和悲天憫人。

en: As Burma’s authorities test reform, these gifts, together with her negotiating skills and, most of all, her vast moral authority, will be tested as never before.
zh: 隨著緬甸當局開始改革檢驗，這些素質和她的談判技能 — — 以及最重要的，她在道德上的居高臨下 — — 一起，將受到前所未有的考驗。

en: Moreover, unlike Mandela during his 27-year imprisonment, Suu Kyi has had her hopes raised – and dashed – before.
zh: 除此以外，與曼德拉的27年鐵窗生涯不同，昂山素季曾經有過燃起希望並幾乎成功的經歷。

en: In the mid-1990’s, and again in 2002-2003, reconciliation between Suu Kyi’s National League for Democracy (NLD) and the military junta seemed to be in the offing.
zh: 在20世紀90年代中期以及2002—2003年間，昂山素季的國家民主聯盟和軍政當局幾乎要形成妥協了。

en: On both occasions, however, the regime’s hardliners gained the upper hand, crushing prospects for reform.
zh: 但是，最終體制內的強硬派佔了上風，扼殺了改革希望。

en: Yet Suu Kyi, and much of the Burmese opposition, is beginning to admit that today’s political liberalization might be the real thing.
zh: 但昂山素季以及大部分緬甸反對派均開始承認，今天的政治自由化可能是來真的。

en: Because Burma’s generals say almost nothing in public, it is difficult to fathom why they allowed elections that elevated Thein Sein to power, or to explain their willingness to embrace dialogue with the long-suppressed opposition.
zh: 由於緬甸的將軍們在公開場合幾乎總是緘口不言，因此很難看出他們為何會容許把登盛推上權力寶座的選舉發生，也很難解釋為什麼他們願意與被長期鎮壓的反對派展開對話。

en: Recent events suggest one possible explanation: Burma’s rulers have grown wary of China’s almost smothering embrace – a result of the country’s international isolation.
zh: 最近的事件顯示了一種可能的解釋：緬甸的當權者開始擔心令人窒息的把持 — — 而這又是該國國際孤立的結果。

en: Indeed, public protests against China’s commercial exploitation of Burma’s natural resources became so widespread that the government called a halt to construction by Chinese investors on the huge and environmentally damaging Myitsone Dam on the Irrawaddy River.
zh: 事實上，緬甸公眾反對中國對緬甸自然資源的商業開發已成燎原之勢，以至於政府不得不叫停中國投資者可能造成嚴重環境破壞的瓦底江密松大壩專案。

en: Thein Sein’s decision to halt the project is clearly an important policy shift.
zh: 登盛叫停密松大壩專案的決定顯然是一個清晰的政策轉向訊號。

en: It is also a signal to the outside world that Burma’s new government may be much more willing than any of its predecessors to heed both public pressure and international opinion, both of which vehemently opposed the dam’s construction.
zh: 此外，這還向外界表明，緬甸新政府要比其所有前任都更加願意關心公眾壓力和國際輿論 — — 這兩樣均強烈反對大壩的建設。

en: Almost simultaneously, Thein Sein offered even stronger signals that his was a very different Burmese administration: he freed political prisoners and invited Suu Kyi for direct talks with him.
zh: 幾乎是在同時，登盛還給出了一個更加強烈的訊號，表明這一屆政府是一個完全不同的政府：他釋放了一批政治犯，並邀請昂山素季和他展開直接對話。

en: Indeed, Suu Kyi now enjoys far greater freedom of movement than she has at any time since she received the Nobel Peace Prize 20 years ago, and the NLD recently announced that it will field candidates in the forthcoming by-elections to the country’s newly established parliament.
zh: 事實上，如今昂山素季過著她20年前獲得諾貝爾和平獎以來最自由的生活，國家民主聯盟最近宣稱，該組織將推舉即將到來的新議會候補選舉候選人。

en: If Suu Kyi is permitted to campaign free of restraint, for both her own seat and to boost the electoral chances of her NLD colleagues, it will be clear that Thein Sein and his government are truly determined to bring their country in from the cold.
zh: 不管昂山素季還是她的國家民主聯盟同志，能夠自由參選無疑表明登盛及其政府真心實意地想讓緬甸走出鐵幕。

en: For both Suu Kyi and Thein Sein, every step from now on will be delicate, to be calibrated with the same care and deliberation that Mandela and de Klerk used in bridging their differences and leading their country out of isolation.
zh: 對昂山素季和登盛來說，從現在開始的每一步都將如履薄冰，人們將用曼德拉和德克拉克撥亂反正、將祖國帶出孤立狀態的自由化舉措來要求他們。

en: But the international community, too, must act with great care.
zh: 但國際社會也必須小心行事。

en: While Thein Sein would undoubtedly wish to see the myriad economic and political sanctions imposed on Burma quickly lifted, it is too soon for a general easing of such measures.
zh: 毫無疑問，登盛願意看見施加於緬甸的大量經濟和政治制裁迅速被取消，但現在就放鬆制裁還為時過早。

en: But the outside world should demonstrate that every clear move toward greater political openness will merit more international political and economic engagement.
zh: 不過，外部世界應該表明態度：任何朝增進政治開放方向的進步都會得到國際政治和經濟回報。

en: The Japan Investment Bank’s decision to invest in port development in Burma – essential if the economy, too, is to be opened – is one positive sign that the world will keep pace with Thein Sein step for step.
zh: 日本投資銀行決定投資緬甸的港口開發 — — 如果緬甸經濟也開放的話，這將是很重要的 — — 這是一個積極的訊號，表明世界對於登盛的每一次進步都會投桃報李。

en: And US President Barack Obama’s decision to send Secretary of State Hillary Clinton to Burma to meet Thein Sein is another clear sign that the world is ready to end the country’s isolation.
zh: 美國總統奧巴馬決定派國務卿希拉里·克林頓前往緬甸會晤登盛是另一個訊號，表明世界時刻準備著結束緬甸的孤立狀態。

en: Closer to home, ASEAN’s recent decision to give Burma a chance to chair the organization in 2014 underscores its neighbors’ desire for the country’s full participation in Asia’s growing prosperity.
zh: 在近鄰方面，東盟最近決定將2014年的主席國地位授予緬甸，這表明鄰國也渴望緬甸完全融入亞洲的日漸繁榮。

en: No one should rush to judgment yet, but Thein Sein’s decisions, at least so far, are beginning to resemble those of South Africa’s de Klerk when he initiated his country’s reform process.
zh: 現在就下判斷為時過早，但至少從目前來看，登盛的決定正走在德克拉克啟用南非改革程序的道路上。

en: Fortunately, Burma already has in Aung San Suu Kyi its very own Nelson Mandela.
zh: 幸運的是，緬甸已經找到了自己的曼德拉 — — 昂山素季。

en: A Devaluation Option for Southern Europe
zh: 解決南歐問題的方案 — — 貨幣貶值

en: CAMBRIDGE – This year is likely to mark a make-or-break ordeal for the euro.
zh: 劍橋 — — 對於歐洲而言，今年很可能是歐元生死存亡的考驗。

en: The eurozone’s survival demands a credible solution to its long-running sovereign-debt crisis, which in turn requires addressing the two macroeconomic imbalances – external and fiscal – which are at the heart of that crisis.
zh: 歐元區若要繼續存在，則需要提出一項可靠的方案，解決其長期存在的主權債務危機問題，而這反過來又需要解決外部失衡和財政失衡兩大問題，這兩種宏觀經濟失衡問題正是這一危機的核心。

en: The crisis has exposed the deep disparities in competitiveness that have developed within the eurozone.
zh: 此次危機暴露出歐元區內部成員國在經濟競爭力方面存在很大的差距。

en: From 1996 to 2010, unit labor costs in Germany increased by just 8%, and by 13% in France. Compare that to 24% in Portugal, 35% in Spain, 37% in Italy, and a whopping 59% in Greece.
zh: 從1996年到2010年，德國單位勞動力成本僅上升8 ％ ， 法國上升13 ％ ， 而葡萄牙上升24 % ， 西班牙上升35 ％ ， 義大利上升37 ％ ， 希臘上升則高達59 ％ 。

en: The result has been large trade imbalances between eurozone countries, a problem compounded by large fiscal deficits and high levels of public debt in southern Europe (and France) – much of it owed to foreign creditors.
zh: 這一問題導致歐元區內部國家貿易極度不平衡，而南歐和法國龐大財政赤字和公共債務龐大，使這一問題更為複雜，原因很大部分要歸咎於外國債權人。

en: Does addressing these imbalances require breaking up the eurozone?
zh: 難道必須要歐元區解體才能解決這些貿易不平衡問題嗎？

en: Suppose, for example, that Portugal were to leave and re-introduce the escudo. The ensuing exchange-rate devaluation would immediately lower the price of Portugal’s exports, raise its import prices, stimulate the economy, and bring about much-needed growth.
zh: 假如葡萄牙退出歐元區，重新引入埃斯庫多（葡萄牙貨幣單位 ） ， 那麼隨後而來的匯率貶值會使葡萄牙出口產品價格下跌，進口產品價格上漲，刺激葡萄牙經濟發展，帶來其急需的經濟增長。

en: But a euro exit would be a messy affair. The resulting turmoil could very well trump any short-term gains in competitiveness from devaluation.
zh: 但是，脫離歐元將是一件很棘手的事，因為它所帶來的金融風暴將勝過任何透過貨幣貶值來增強競爭力中獲得的短期收益。

en: There is a remarkably simple alternative that does not require southern Europe’s troubled economies to abandon the euro and devalue their exchange rates.
zh: 有這樣一種非常簡單的解決方案，南歐經濟困難國家不必放棄歐元，也不必貶低本國貨幣匯率。

en: It involves increasing the value-added tax while cutting payroll taxes.
zh: 這一方案包括提高增值稅，同時削減工資稅。

en: Our recent research demonstrates that such a “fiscal devaluation” has very similar effects on the economy in terms of its impact on GDP, consumption, employment, and inflation.
zh: 我們最近進行的研究表明，這樣的“財政貨幣貶值 ” ， 無論在國內生產總值，消費還是就業和通脹方面，對經濟產生的影響與貶低本國貨幣匯率產生的影響相當。

en: A currency devaluation works by making imports more costly and exports cheaper. A VAT/payroll-tax swap would do exactly the same thing.
zh: 貨幣貶值能行得通，因為這樣會使進口產品更加昂貴，出口產品更加便宜，而提高增值稅，削減工資稅也能發揮這樣的作用。

en: An increase in VAT raises the price of imported goods, as foreign firms face a higher tax.
zh: 提高增值稅會提高進口貨物的價格，外國企業面臨更高的關稅。

en: To ensure that domestic firms do not have an incentive to raise prices, an increase in VAT needs to be accompanied by a cut in payroll taxes.
zh: 為確保國內企業不會提高價格，在增加增值稅的同時，必須削減工資稅。

en: Moreover, since exports are exempt from VAT, the price of domestic exports will fall.
zh: 此外，由於出口產品免徵增值稅，國內出口產品價格也將下降。

en: The desired competitiveness effects of exchange-rate devaluation can thus be had while staying in the euro.
zh: 這樣以來，即使不脫離歐元區，不進行匯率貶值，也能增強經濟競爭力，收到同樣的預期效果。

en: This policy can also help on the fiscal front.
zh: 這項政策在財政方面也會有所幫助。

en: As is true of an exchange-rate devaluation, the positive impact on growth of an increase in competitiveness can strengthen the fiscal position by raising tax revenues.
zh: 匯率貶值確實能夠增強競爭力。 增強競爭力對經濟增長產生積極影響，透過提高稅收，可以改善財政狀況。

en: Moreover, an important advantage of fiscal devaluations is that they generate additional revenues in proportion to the country’s trade deficit.
zh: 此外，財政貨幣貶值的一項重要優勢體現在，其產生的額外收入與國家的貿易赤字比例相當。

en: For countries that are suffering from weak competitiveness and, as a consequence, running trade deficits, this typically means more revenues, especially in the short run.
zh: 對於正遭受因競爭力不強而因此產生貿易赤字的國家而言，此舉通常意味著能獲得更多的收入，在短期內尤為如此。

en: Like exchange-rate devaluations, fiscal devaluations create winners and losers.
zh: 財政貨幣貶值和匯率貶值一樣，在這一過程中既會有贏家也會有輸家。

en: Both act as a wealth levy: inflation means that bondholders suffer a real loss in proportion to their wealth and the size of the devaluation.
zh: 兩者都起著財富槓桿的作用：通脹意味著債券持有人會遭受實際損失，這一損失與他們的財富多少及貶值的幅度相稱。

en: If taxes on capital are not adjusted, holders of domestic stocks suffer a comparable loss.
zh: 如果不調整資本稅，國內股票持有人也會蒙受類似的損失。

en: By contrast, many transfers, such as unemployment benefits, health benefits, and public pensions, are indexed to inflation, and thus maintain their real value.
zh: 相比而言，許多資金轉移，如失業福利，衛生福利，公共養老金等，都與通貨膨脹掛鉤，從而維持了其實際價值。

en: The same is true of minimum wages.
zh: 最低工資也是如此。

en: These distributive effects play an important role in the politics of exchange-rate devaluations, and most of these effects appear in fiscal devaluations as well.
zh: 這些資金分配產生的影響在匯率貶值方面發揮了重要的政治作用，這些影響大部分也在財政貨幣貶值中得到體現。

en: Fiscal devaluations already have some advocates.
zh: 財政貨幣貶值的做法已經得到了一些人士的擁護。

en: Indeed, French President Nicolas Sarkozy’s government just announced one.
zh: 事實上，法國總統尼古拉·薩爾科齊政府就剛剛宣佈了一項財政貨幣貶值計劃。

en: And concerns that a fiscal devaluation will conflict with euro rules can be met by simply pointing out that Germany’s government carried one out in 2007, though by another name, when it raised VAT from 16% to 19% and cut employers’ contribution to social insurance, from 6.5% to 4.2%.
zh: 若有些人擔心財政貨幣貶值將會與歐元規則相互衝突，則可以援引德國舉例即可。 德國政府2007年實施了一項類似的計劃（沒有公開說明 ） ， 將增值稅從16％提高到19 ％ ， 將僱主對社會保險的貢獻率從6.5％削減至4.2 ％ 。

en: In short, there are simple fiscal alternatives to exchange-rate devaluation that can address southern Europe’s short-term competitiveness problems.
zh: 總之，除了推行匯率貶值以外，還存在其他解決南歐短期競爭力問題的簡單財政方案。

en: To be sure, feasible fiscal devaluations would be limited in size.
zh: 可以肯定的是，可行的財政貨幣貶值方案必須將規模控制在一定限度內。

en: But, together with debt restructuring, accommodative monetary policy, liquidity support from the European Central Bank, and much-required structural reforms, they can help to put these troubled economies on a sound footing without a euro breakup or a major austerity-induced recession.
zh: 但是，伴隨著債務重組，寬鬆的貨幣政策，歐洲央行的資金流動性支援及非常必要的結構性改革，這些可行的財政貨幣貶值方案，可以在歐元區不解體，並且不會導致緊縮引起的嚴重經濟衰退的前提下，幫助那些經濟困難的國家踏上正軌。

en: A Dissident in China
zh: 一位中國的異議人士

en: TOKYO – 2009 was a good year for China. The Chinese economy still roared ahead in the midst of a worldwide recession.
zh: 東京 — — 對於中國而言， 2009 年可是一個好年頭。

en: American President Barack Obama visited China, more in the spirit of a supplicant to an imperial court than the leader of the world’s greatest superpower. Even the Copenhagen summit on climate change ended just the way China wanted: failure in its attempt to commit China, or any other industrial nation, to making significant cuts in carbon emissions, with the United States getting the blame.
zh: 在全球一片衰退的景象之中，中國經濟卻獨領風騷、大步前進；美國總統貝拉克·奧巴馬在他的中國之行中，表現的更像是一位置身帝國宮廷內的有求之人，而非一名全球最強超級大國的元首；甚至連關於氣候變化問題的哥本哈根峰會，都以令中國稱心如意的方式落幕：它未能令中國或其他任何一個工業國承擔起重大的減排義務，而此罪責卻由美國承擔。

en: The Chinese government, under the Communist Party, has every reason to feel confident.
zh: 共產黨領導下的中國政府有充分的理由感到自信。

en: So why did a gentle former literature professor named Liu Xiaobo have to be sentenced to 11 years in prison, just because he publicly advocated freedom of expression and an end to one-party rule?
zh: 這樣，為何一位儒雅的原文學教授（劉曉波）卻僅僅因為公開倡導言論自由及一黨統治的終結，而要被判處十一年徒刑呢？

en: Liu was co-author in 2008 of a petition, Charter 08, signed by thousands of Chinese, calling for basic rights to be respected.
zh: 劉曉波是 2008 年的請願檔案 — — 《 08 憲章》的共同作者，這份呼籲尊重基本權利的檔案，業已徵得數千中國人的簽名。

en: Liu is not a violent rebel. His opinions, in articles published on the Internet, are entirely peaceful.
zh: 劉曉波並非是一名暴力叛亂分子，他在發表於網際網路的文章中所表達的觀點，完全不帶戾氣。

en: Yet he was jailed for “inciting subversion of state power.”
zh: 即便如此，他還是因“煽動顛覆國家政權罪”而被判入獄。

en: The notion that Liu might be capable of subverting the immense power of the Communist Party of China is patently absurd.
zh: 認為劉曉波或有能力顛覆中共巨大權力的觀點，顯然是一派胡言。

en: And yet the authorities clearly believe that they had to make an example of him, to prevent others from expressing similar views.
zh: 然而當局卻明顯相信：自己必須殺一儆百，以防他人發表類似觀點。

en: Why does a regime that appears to be so secure consider mere opinions, or even peaceful petitions, so dangerous?
zh: 為何對於一個看似穩固的政權來說，那些純粹的觀點、或者甚至是和平的請願活動，卻被認為是如此危險呢？

en: Perhaps because the regime does not feel as secure as it looks.
zh: 這或許是因為該政權並不像它看上去那般坦然無懼。

en: Without legitimacy, no government can rule with any sense of confidence. There are many ways to legitimize political arrangements.
zh: 若失去了合法性，任何政府都無法自信地施行統治。

en: Hereditary monarchy, often backed by divine authority, has worked in the past. And some modern autocrats, such as Robert Mugabe, have been bolstered by their credentials as national freedom fighters.
zh: 為政治制度賦予合法性的方式多種多樣：自由民主制只是近來的一種創新而已；通常由君權神授為依託的世襲君主制，曾在歷史上大行其道；而某些現代的獨裁者（如羅伯特·穆加貝 ） ， 則是以民族解放鬥士這一資歷作為其統治的依據。

en: China has changed a great deal in the last century, but it has remained the same in one respect: it is still ruled by a religious concept of politics.
zh: 中國在過去的一個世紀內發生了巨大的變化，但在某一個方面，它卻依然如故：宗教式的政治觀念仍在統御著這個國家。

en: Legitimacy is not based on the give and take, the necessary compromises, and the wheeling and dealing that form the basis of an economic concept of politics such as that which underpins liberal democracy.
zh: 這種觀念的合法性並非基於互諒互讓、討價還價以及做出必要的妥協；而這些行為構成了經濟式政治觀念的基礎，其中，自由民主制度的支柱便是一例。

en: Instead, the foundation of religious politics is a shared belief, imposed from above, in ideological orthodoxy.
zh: 相反，宗教式政治的基石是一種以意識形態正統性為體現的、由上而下強加於民的共有信念。

en: In imperial China, this meant Confucian orthodoxy.
zh: 在帝制中國，這便意味著儒家的正統觀念。

en: The ideal of the Confucian state is “harmony.”
zh: 儒家邦國的理想狀態即為“和諧 ” 。

en: If all people conform to a particular set of beliefs, including moral codes of behavior, conflicts will disappear.
zh: 如果所有人都能遵從一套包括行為道德準則在內的特定信念的話，衝突就將消失。

en: The ruled, in this ideal system, will naturally obey their rulers, just as sons obey their fathers.
zh: 在這種理想體系之中，被統治者正如子女遵從父親一般、自然而然地聽命於統治者。

en: After the various revolutions in the early decades of the twentieth century, Confucianism was replaced by a Chinese version of Communism.
zh: 在二十世紀前期數十年的種種革命之後，儒家思想被中國式的共產主義所取代。

en: Marxism appealed to Chinese intellectuals, because it was bookish, introduced a modern moral orthodoxy, and was based, like Confucianism, on a promise of perfect harmony. Ultimately, in the Communist utopia, conflicts of interests would melt away.
zh: 對於中國的知識分子而言，馬克思主義頗具吸引力，這一方面是因為它帶著書卷的氣息，引入了一套現代道德正統觀念；另一方面則是因為馬克思主義與儒家學說一樣，都建立在一種關於完美和諧的諾言基礎之上：在共產主義烏托邦內，最終將再無利益的衝突。

en: Chairman Mao’s rule combined elements of the Chinese imperial system with Communist totalitarianism.
zh: 毛澤東主席的統治，便是對中國帝制體系與共產主義極權制度諸元素的結合。

en: This orthodoxy, however, was also destined to fade away.
zh: 然而，這種正統思想註定也將消亡。

en: Few Chinese, even in the top ranks of the Communist Party, are convinced Marxists anymore.
zh: 很少有中國人仍舊是馬克思主義的忠實信徒，甚至在共產黨高層內部，情況也是如此。

en: This left an ideological vacuum, swiftly filled in the 1980’s by greed, cynicism, and corruption.
zh: 這種狀況留下了一個意識形態真空，它在上世紀八十年代被貪婪、腐化以及玩世不恭所快速佔據。

en: Out of this crisis came the demonstrations all over China, collectively known as “Tiananmen.”
zh: 這場危機催生了遍及中國全境的示威活動，它們被籠而統之地冠以“天安門事件”之名。

en: Liu Xiaobo was an active spokesman in 1989 for the student protests against official corruption and in favor of greater freedom.
zh: 劉曉波在 1989 年，便身為學生針對官員腐化、並要求獲得更大自由的抗議活動之積極代言人。

en: Soon after the bloody crackdown on Tiananmen, a new orthodoxy replaced Chinese Marxism: Chinese nationalism.
zh: 在天安門的血腥鎮壓行動後不久，一種新的正統思想取代了中國式馬克思主義的地位，這便是中國的民族主義。

en: Only one-party rule would guarantee the continuing rise of China and put an end to centuries of national humiliation.
zh: 只有一黨統治，方可確保中國能繼續崛起，併為數百年的民族屈辱史畫上句號；共產黨代表著中國的大國宿命。

en: The Communist Party represented China’s destiny as a great power. To doubt this was not just mistaken, but unpatriotic, even “anti-Chinese.”
zh: 對���觀點心存疑慮已不單是一種錯誤，還是一種不愛國、甚至“反華”的表現。

en: From this perspective, Liu Xiaobo’s critical views were indeed subversive.
zh: 以此看來，劉曉波的批判觀點的確是顛覆性的。

en: They cast doubt on the official orthodoxy, and thus on the legitimacy of the state.
zh: 這些觀點為官方正統思想打上了問號，也由此對國家政權的合法性提出了質疑。

en: To wonder, as many have, why the Chinese regime refused to negotiate with the students in 1989 – or to find some accommodation with its critics today – is to misunderstand the nature of religious politics.
zh: 許多人對於中國政府為何拒絕在 1989 年與學生進行談判、或對如今的批判者做出一些遷就而感到驚訝，這恰恰是誤解了宗教式政治的本質。

en: Negotiation, compromise, and accommodation are the marks of economic politics, where every deal has its price. By contrast, those who rule according to a shared belief cannot afford to negotiate, for that would undermine the belief itself.
zh: 談判、妥協與遷就皆為經濟式政治的特徵， 這種政治模式可以就事論事； 與之形成鮮明對比的是，那些根據共有信念施行統治的人，是無力承擔談判之代價的，因為談判行為將會對信念本身造成傷害。

en: This is not to say that the economic concept of politics is utterly strange to the Chinese – or, for that matter, that the religious notion of politics is unknown in the democratic West.
zh: 這並非意味著經濟式政治觀念對於中國人來說，是一種完全陌生的模式；就此而言，這也不是指奉行民主制度的西方就不知宗教式政治觀念為何物。

en: But the insistence on orthodoxy is still sufficiently strong in China to remain the default defense against political critics.
zh: 然而在中國，人們對於正統觀念的堅持，依舊強大到使其足可繼續作為對政治批評者的預設防範方式之地步。

en: These things can change.
zh: 這些情況可以發生轉變。

en: Other Confucian societies, such as South Korea, Taiwan, and Japan, now have thriving liberal democracies, and there is no reason to believe that such a transition is impossible in China.
zh: 諸如韓國、臺灣以及日本等其他的儒家社會，如今都已擁有繁榮的自由民主制度，人們沒有理由相信：中國不可能經歷這種轉型。

en: But external pressure is unlikely to bring it about.
zh: 但外部壓力不太可能帶來這種變革。

en: Many non-Chinese, including me, have signed a letter of protest against the jailing of Liu Xiaobo.
zh: 包括我在內的許多外國人士，都已在針對劉曉波被判入獄一事的抗議信上簽字。

en: One hopes that this will lend comfort to him, and give a moral boost to Chinese who share his views. But it is unlikely to impress those who believe in the current orthodoxy of Chinese nationalism.
zh: 人們只是希望此舉能聊表慰藉，並給予那些與劉曉波志同道合的中國人以道義上的鼓舞；但對於那些篤信當前中國民族主義正統思想的人士而言，此舉不太可能令其受到震動。

en: Until China is released from the grip of religious politics, Liu’s ideals are unlikely to take root.
zh: 在中國從宗教式政治的控制下獲得解放之前，劉曉波的理念不太可能生根。

en: This does not bode well for China, or, indeed, for the rest of the world.
zh: 對於中國（實際上也對世界其他國家）而言，這可不是個好兆頭。

en: A Drug War on Auto-Pilot
zh: 不由分說的禁毒戰爭

en: THE HAGUE – The war in Afghanistan, now approaching its tenth year, may seem to many to have no end in sight, but Latin America has endured an even longer fight, one that has recently become much more bloody: the “war” against drug trafficking.
zh: 海牙 — — 阿富汗戰爭迄今為止已經打了十年，在很多人看來或許仍沒有結束的跡象，但拉丁美洲卻忍受了更為漫長的戰爭，而且近來血腥程度甚至愈演愈烈： 這就是打擊販毒的“戰爭 ” 。

en: So rote – and so violent – has that war become that many people in Latin America now wonder which side is suffering the more pathological addiction.
zh: 這場戰爭已經變得如此生硬 — — 如此暴力 — — 以致於拉美很多人現在感到驚訝，弄不清病理性成癮更為嚴重的究竟是哪一方。

en: The new strategy that US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton has been promoting to staunch the upward trend of narco-trafficking-related murders – which leaked Mexican government reports put at more than 22,000 since late 2006 – is to build “stronger, more resilient communities.”
zh: 建設“更強大，適應力更強的社會”是美國國務卿希拉里·克林頓宣傳能夠阻止與毒品販運有關謀殺上升趨勢的新戰略 — — 洩露出來的墨西哥政府報告統計2006年以來與販毒有關的謀殺已經超過 22,000起。

en: Ciudad Juárez, a sprawling Mexican border town that is now the homicide capital of the world, would have to be high on the list.
zh: 不斷擴張的墨西哥邊境小鎮華雷斯市現在已經成為全世界的殺人之都，肯定應該高居名單的榜首位置。

en: Four bridges and innumerable tunnels and drainage canals connect Ciudad Juárez and El Paso, Texas.
zh: 華雷斯市和得克薩斯州的艾爾帕索縣透過四座橋樑和難以數計的隧道和排水溝連線在一起。

en: Rival cartels sparring for control of a plaza, the name given to any trafficking route, butcher each other and the security forces.
zh: 具有競爭關係的卡特爾拼命為爭奪廣場的控制權互相殘殺並屠殺安全部隊，廣場是人們對任何販毒路線的稱謂。

en: There is apparently no shortage of young, unemployed men willing to join the carnage.
zh: 顯然願意加入這場屠殺的無業年輕男性大有人在。

en: Addressing the deep-seated social and economic problems of a city like Juárez, however, is a lot harder than flooding its streets with 8,000 soldiers carrying assault rifles.
zh: 不過解決像華雷斯這樣一座城市根深蒂固的社會和經濟問題比派8，000名手持突擊步槍計程車兵佔據這座小城的街道要困難得多。

en: Mexican President Felipe Calderón has, in this respect, remained faithful to the script written in previous theaters in the drug war, whether in Bolivia, Colombia, or Peru, where governments have used military force and extradition to placate the US and punish those with the least voice and influence.
zh: 在這方面，墨西哥總統費利佩·卡爾德龍繼續忠實於玻利維亞、哥倫比亞或秘魯等國禁毒戰爭此前寫好的電影指令碼，這些國家政府依靠武力和引渡來平息美國的怒氣，懲罰那些最沒有發言權和影響力的窮人。

en: But the language used by the Obama administration to describe the violence and state corruption that snakes from the Andes to the US border is starting to capture new thinking on narcotics.
zh: 但奧巴馬政府形容從安第斯山脈流向美國邊境的暴力和國家腐敗時所用的語言正開始抓住毒品問題的全新思維。

en: Three former Latin American presidents, Mexico’s second richest man, Ricardo Salinas, and the Supreme Court of Argentina, among others, have criticized the war on drugs as a manifest failure that has lowered street prices, fueled production, and undermined weak states.
zh: 值得一提的是三位前拉美總統，墨西哥排名第二的富翁裡卡多·薩利納斯以及阿根廷最高法院已經批評禁毒戰爭是一場顯而易見的失敗，它拉低了房地產價格、推升毒品產量，並對弱國造成了破壞。

en: More strikingly, both Bolivia and Ecuador are governed by presidents who suffered directly from the collateral insensitivities of the war on drugs.
zh: 更令人驚奇的是，玻利維亞和厄瓜多兩國總統都是禁毒戰爭所忽略問題的直接受害者。

en: Bolivia’s Evo Morales rose to prominence as leader of the country’s coca growers during a brutal campaign to wipe out their crops, the so-called Dignity Plan.
zh: 玻利維亞總統埃沃·莫拉萊斯在一場消滅古柯作物的殘酷運動中崛起為這個國家古柯種植者的領袖，這場運動就是所謂的尊嚴計劃。

en: Ecuadoran President Rafael Correa’s father was jailed for smuggling drugs to the US when the future leader was five years old.
zh: 而厄瓜多總統拉斐爾·科雷亞的父親在這位未來的領袖只有五歲時因走私毒品而被捕入獄。

en: These leaders’ profound ambivalence toward the goal of a world free of illegal drugs is shared by the European Union, where restrictions on narcotics consumption have slackened over the past decade.
zh: 與這些領袖一樣對無非法毒品世界目標抱有矛盾心理的還有歐盟，它過去幾十年來已經放鬆了對毒品消費的限制。

en: The past three US presidents, furthermore, have all admitted to consuming – to one extent or another – illegal psychoactive substances, while seven million Americans, according to the United Nations, are regular cocaine users.
zh: 此外，之前的三任美國總統都已經承認或多或少吸食過非法的精神刺激藥物，而據聯合國統計，有七百萬美國人都是常規的可卡因使用者。

en: But the inertia of a bureaucratic drug-enforcement superstructure (worth approximately $40 billion each in the US and the EU), sustained by a deep-seated fear of the “threat” posed by drugs and cartels, appears to push policy repeatedly towards the familiar option of repressive auto-pilot.
zh: 但禁毒執法上層建築的慣性（在美國和歐盟價值均達到400億美元）在對毒品和卡特爾所造成“威脅”根深蒂固的恐懼的推動下，似乎一而再、再而三地將政策推向不由分說鎮壓的一成不變的選擇。

en: For example, US support for Mexico’s campaign against the cartels looks set in stone, with Congress apparently ready to provide $300 million for another year of military and security upgrading.
zh: 比如，美國對墨西哥打擊卡特爾運動的支援似乎牢不可破，國會顯然已經做好準備為又一年的軍事和安全設施升級提供3億美元的經費。

en: In Colombia, seven new joint military installations are planned, and support for US private contractors who have cornered the market in crop fumigation presumably will not be interrupted.
zh: 人們計劃在哥倫比亞建設七座聯合軍事設施，並且對壟斷作物燻蒸市場的美國私人承包商的支援很可能也不會動搖。

en: Nevertheless, as the flaws in the four-decade-old edifice of counter-narcotics become more visible, it is increasingly difficult to regard the risks of drug use as being greater than the damage done by repression.
zh: 儘管如此，隨著歷經四十年的禁毒大廈缺點逐漸暴露，認定使用毒品的風險大於鎮壓所造成的破壞已經越來越難。

en: Prohibition hikes the mark-up on prices – an astounding 15,000% in the case of cocaine traveling to Europe from Andean processing facilities.
zh: 禁毒措施促成了毒品價格上漲，從安第斯加工廠運到歐洲的可卡因令人震驚的上漲15,000 % 。

en: While the war on drugs focuses on bringing down cartels and their kingpins, it perversely aids the health of their markets, which nestle within legitimate trade flows and respond to price incentives.
zh: 在禁毒戰爭關注摧毀卡特爾及其主要人物的同時，卻頑強地促進了在合法貿易流動的夾縫中生存並對價格激勵作出反應的毒品市場的健康。

en: Interviewed by the Mexican magazine Proceso this year, the second-in-command of the giant Sinaloa cartel, Ismael Zambada, made the point clearly: “The narco problem involves millions of people.
zh: 在年內接受墨西哥雜誌《Proceso》採訪時，規模龐大的錫那羅亞卡特爾的二號人物伊斯梅爾•尚巴達明確指出 ： “ 毒品問題涉及成百上千萬人口。

en: How do you control it?
zh: 這樣的問題怎麼控制？

en: The capos can be jailed, killed, or extradited, but their replacements are already wandering around.”
zh: 領頭的人可以被監禁、殺死或者引渡，但頂替者已經在周圍徘徊等候。 ”

en: The emergence of Latin America’s powerful drug mafias cannot be traced to the radical evil of certain individuals.
zh: 拉美強大販毒集團的出現究其原因並非是由於某些個人的極端邪惡。

en: These people emerged under conditions created in deeply inequitable societies by a misapplied, inconsistent, and bureaucratic war.
zh: 這些人是在一場由濫用權力、反覆無常和充滿官僚氣息戰爭造成的嚴重不公的社會條件下自然產生的。

en: Indeed, the furies of the Zetas in Mexico originate in the counter-insurgency training provided in the 1990’s to a select group of special-forces soldiers, who later deserted.
zh: 事實上，墨西哥的齊塔復仇女神最初接受過20世紀90年代向選定的特種部隊士兵提供的反暴動訓練，而後逃離了特種部隊。

en: The Zetas’ star recruits in recent years have come from the Guatemalan military’s special forces, whose infamous induction technique involved biting off the head of a live chicken.
zh: 近年來齊塔人招募的明星新銳大多具有瓜地馬拉軍隊的特種部隊背景，這支部隊一種臭名昭著的入門技術是咬掉一隻活雞的頭顱。

en: Meanwhile, in Jamaica and across the rural outposts of Central America, drug lords have become benefactors and heroes to the poor.
zh: 與此同時，在牙買加以及中美洲的農村前沿，毒梟正在扮演著窮苦人的救世主兼英雄的角色。

en: It is time for serious reconsideration of the status and regulation of illegal drugs, pointing to selective legalization, as well as reclassification of the market as a public-health, rather than a criminal, concern.
zh: 認真重新考察局勢和非法毒品管理狀況的時候到了，可以考慮實行有選擇的合法化，對這個市場重新進行公共健康而不是刑事方面的考量。

en: For now, policymakers across the Americas are tiptoeing towards the obvious.
zh: 現在，美洲各國的決策者正悄悄向顯而易見的解決方案靠攏。

en: A Global "New Deal"?
zh: 全球“新政 ” ？

en: ATHENS – The International Monetary Fund’s belated admission that it significantly underestimated the damage that austerity would do to European Union growth rates highlights the self-defeating character of “orthodox” recipes to address the causes of the debt crisis that followed the financial crash of 2008-2009.
zh: 雅典—IMF終於承認它嚴重低估了緊縮給歐盟增長率帶來的傷害，這表明糾正2008—2009年金融危機後發生的債務危機的根源的“正統”藥方起到了弄巧成拙的效果。

en: Conventional theory suggests that a single country (or group of countries) consolidating its finances can expect lower interest rates, a weaker currency, and an improved trade position.
zh: 傳統智慧認為，就個別國家（或一組國家）而言，整合其財政意味著降低利率、貨幣貶值和改善貿易處境。

en: But, because this cannot happen for all major economies simultaneously – one country’s (or group of countries’) austerity implies less demand for other countries’ products – such policies eventually lead to beggar-thy-neighbor situations.
zh: 但是，由於這無法同時在所有主要經濟體發生 — — 一個國家（或一組國家）的緊縮意味著其他國家產品需求下降 — — 這些政策最終會導致以鄰為壑局面。

en: Indeed, it was this dynamic – against which John Maynard Keynes fought – that made the Great Depression of the 1930’s so grim.
zh: 事實上，凱恩斯所反對的正是這一動態，正是它導致了20世紀30年代悲慘的大蕭條。

en: Today’s problems are compounded by a lack of sufficient private demand – particularly household consumption – in the advanced economies to compensate for demand losses stemming from austerity.
zh: 當今問題的一個組成部分是發達國家私人需求（特別是家庭消費）不振，不足以補償緊縮帶來的需求損失。

en: During the last two decades, consumption drove these countries’ economic growth, reaching historically high GDP shares.
zh: 在過去20年中，消費推動著這些國家的經濟增長，其佔GDP比重達到了歷史新高。

en: Moreover, major advanced economies, such as the United States, Germany, and Japan, face longer-term fiscal problems in the form of aging populations or oversize welfare states, limiting their capacity to contribute to demand management.
zh: 此外，美國、德國和日本等主要發達國家面臨老齡化、福利國家規模太大等長期財政問題，制約著它們的需求管理能力。

en: Recent moves to ease monetary policy have been a step in the right direction; but, so far, they have not proved to be a game changer.
zh: 當前的貨幣寬鬆政策方向是對的，但到目前為止並沒有起到扭轉局勢的作用。

en: For domestic demand to act as an engine of growth, policies should shift resources from investment to consumption.
zh: 由於內需成了增長引擎，因此政策應該將資源從投資引向消費。

en: While the magnitudes involved are huge, they must be attained if an extended period of low growth, high unemployment, and declining living standards among the world’s poorest is to be avoided.
zh: 儘管所涉規模巨大，但必須完成，否則就會導致低增長、高失業、全球最貧困人口生活之質量下降。

en: International economic policy coordination should be significantly strengthened in order to deal effectively with changes on such a scale.
zh: 應該著力強調國際經濟政策協調，以便有效地應對如此規模的變局。

en: Start with Europe.
zh: 從歐洲開始。

en: It is by now patently obvious that austerity and domestic reforms are not enough to pull the eurozone’s periphery out of deep recession.
zh: 如今，毫無疑問緊縮和國內改革不足以將歐元區外圍國拉出衰退。

en: Growing awareness of the failure of current policies is causing social discontent, civil disorder, and political instability, with the recently concluded Italian elections and the growing popular resistance to Greek reform efforts serving as a bellwether.
zh: 人們越來越意識到當前的政策是失敗的，這正在造成社會不滿、國內失序和政局動盪，最近結束的義大利選舉和希臘改革措施所受到的越來越大的阻力就是明證。

en: Returning the eurozone’s peripheral economies to the path of growth requires more than structural reforms and fiscal consolidation.
zh: 要讓歐元區外圍國迴歸增長之路，光有結構性改革和財政整合是不夠的。

en: It also requires a substantial reform of the monetary union’s system of economic governance, aimed at restoring financial stability and lowering borrowing costs, together with a boost in external demand in order to compensate for the effects of austerity.
zh: 歐元區經濟治理制度也必須有徹底的改革，其目標應是重塑金融穩定、降低借貸利率，同時提振外部需求以補償緊縮措施帶來的後果。

en: Reforming governance implies significant progress toward economic unification: centralizing European debt through Eurobonds, mobilizing sufficient rescue funds, allowing the European Central Bank to intervene in the primary bond markets, and establishing both a fiscal and a banking union.
zh: 改革治理意味著向經濟聯盟邁出一大步：透過歐元債券將歐洲債務集中化；動員足夠的救援資金；允許歐洲央行在債券一級市場實施干預；並建立財政和銀行聯盟。

en: This is a tall order, in view of the reluctance of most EU member states to cede competences to European institutions.
zh: 這似乎是個不可能的任務，因為大部分歐盟成員國都不願把權力割讓給歐洲機構。

en: But Europe should move more decisively in this direction.
zh: 但歐洲應該堅決地向這一方向邁進。

en: Otherwise, speculation on member states’ national debt will persist, keeping borrowing costs at levels that are inconsistent with the conditions required to sustain economic recovery.
zh: 否則的話，關於成員國國民債務問題的猜疑就不會停止，這會導致借貸成本維持在與維持經濟復甦不相容的水平。

en: Concerning external demand, intra-European help in the form of reflationary policies in stronger economies is unlikely to prove sufficient, owing primarily to the fiscal and political conditions prevailing in Germany.
zh: 在外部需求問題上，堅挺國實施再通脹政策的歐洲內部援助不可能充分，其主要原因在於德國國內的財政和政治條件。

en: Implementing a Marshall Plan-type initiative by mobilizing EU budget resources and additional lending by the European Investment Bank to finance investments in weaker countries could be an alternative, but it lacks political support.
zh: 透過動員歐盟預算資源並增加歐洲投資銀行向疲軟國金融投資專案的貸款等形式實施的歐洲內部版馬歇爾計劃可以成為替代方案，但缺少政治支援。

en: On a global scale, neither the US nor Japan is in a position to provide significant external stimulus.
zh: 在全球範圍內，美國和日本都沒有提供重大外部刺激的條件。

en: Only the emerging and developing economies of Asia could effectively contribute to lifting global demand through a coordinated effort aimed at boosting domestic consumption, which, in turn, would stimulate additional investment.
zh: 只有亞洲的新興和發展中國家能透過旨在提振國內消費 — — 這反過來能夠刺激更多的投資 — — 的政策協調有效地提振全球需求。

en: Recent IMF experience suggests that, through appropriate coordination, private funds could be mobilized for big private-public partnership projects linking demand expansion with infrastructure investment.
zh: IMF的最新經驗表明，透過適當的協調，私人資金可以動員起��參與大型公司合作專案，將需求擴張和基礎設施投資結合起來。

en: In other words, a global “New Deal” – combining policies designed to achieve an orderly realignment of consumption and investment worldwide – seems to be required.
zh: 換句話說，我們需要全球“新政 ” — —將旨在有序重列全球消費和投資的政策結合起來。

en: The advanced economies should promote productivity-enhancing structural reforms with renewed vigor.
zh: 發達國家應該打起精神推進增進生產率的結構性改革。

en: The eurozone should solidify its currency union.
zh: 歐元區應該鞏固其貨幣聯盟。

en: And the emerging and developing economies should support domestic sources of growth.
zh: 而新興和發展中國家應該支援內部增長源。

en: For such a deal to become possible, certain preconditions must be met.
zh: 為了讓這一新政成為可能，必須滿足一定的先決條件。

en: First, international policy coordination by the G-20 must be tightened by creating a permanent secretariat to make policy proposals and recommendations concerning macroeconomic and financial developments.
zh: 首先，G20必須加緊國際政策協調，這可以透過成立永久性秘書處負責考慮關於宏觀經濟和金融發展的政策方案和建議。

en: The secretariat should actively cooperate with the IMF to benefit from its analysis, notably regarding exchange rates.
zh: 這一秘書處應該積極地與IMF合作，利用後者的分析結果，特別是匯率問題上的分析結果。

en: Second, global financial reform must proceed at a faster pace.
zh: 其次，全球金融改革必須加快節奏。

en: The financial sector requires tougher regulation, strengthened supervision, and internationally consistent resolution mechanisms to address the problems posed by very large, global institutions that are considered too big (or too complex) to fail.
zh: 金融部門需要加強監管、強化監督，還需要國際一致的解決機制以糾正太大（或太複雜）而不能倒的大型全球性機構帶來的問題。

en: Such reform is essential if the international financial system is to mediate the sizeable resource transfers that will underpin the required changes in the structure of global demand.
zh: 這類改革至關重要的，如果想要國際金融體系成為大規模資源轉移媒介的話（而這又是全球需求結構必要變化的基礎 ） 。

en: Finally, a new trade pact – possibly, but not necessarily, within the Doha Round – is needed to ensure the major trading powers’ access to foreign markets.
zh: 最後，還需要新的貿易契約 — — 可能（但不一定）在多哈回合中形成 — — 以確保主要貿易大國能夠進入外國市場。

en: This is critically important for inspiring confidence in Asian countries, which might be persuaded to favor domestic, as opposed to external, sources of demand.
zh: 這對於激發亞洲國家信心具有關鍵重要性，說服它們開發內部而不是外部需求源。

en: Moreover, trade liberalization will also increase consumer confidence worldwide.
zh: 此外，貿易自由化也能增加全世界消費者的信心。

en: The time is right for a new global settlement that targets growth, addresses crisis conditions in certain parts of the world, and rebalances the global economy to set it back on a path of strong and steady growth.
zh: 新的全球協定正當時。 這一協定的目標應該是提振增長、消除世界某些地區的危機環境以及實現全球經濟的再平衡以使其回到強勁、穩健的增長道路上來。

en: The Other Financial Crisis
zh: 另一種金融危機

en: NEWPORT BEACH – Two variants of financial crisis continue to wreak havoc on Western economies, fueling joblessness and poverty: the one that we read about regularly in newspapers, involving governments around the world; and a less visible one at the level of small and medium-size businesses and households.
zh: 發自紐波特灘 — — 金融危機的兩個變體正繼續蹂躪著西方經濟，令失業和貧窮狀況進一步加劇：一個是我們經常在報紙上讀到的涉及各國政府的金融危機；另一個不那麼起眼的則是中小型企業和家庭層面上的危機。

en: Until both are addressed properly, the West will remain burdened by sluggish growth, persistently high unemployment, and excessive income and wealth inequality.
zh: 在這兩種危機得到恰當應對之前，西方世界將繼續揹負著增長滯緩、失業率長期居高及收入與財富差距過大的負擔。

en: The sovereign-debt crisis is well known.
zh: 主權債務危機是眾所周知的。

en: In order to avert a likely depression, governments around the world engaged in fiscal and monetary stimulus in the midst of the global financial crisis.
zh: 為了避免出現經濟蕭條，各國政府在全球金融危機期間都忙於實施財政及貨幣刺激政策。

en: They succeeded in offsetting nasty economic dislocations caused by private-sector deleveraging, but at the cost of encumbering their fiscal balances and their central banks’ balance sheets.
zh: 此舉成功抵消了因私營部門去槓桿化所導致的嚴重經濟紊亂，但卻是以破壞自身財政收支平衡以及擾亂央行資產負債表為代價的。

en: While sovereign credit quality has deteriorated virtually across the board, and will most probably continue to do so, the implications for individual countries vary.
zh: 雖然主權信貸的質量幾乎全面惡化 — — 並很可能繼續惡化下去 — — 但它對各國的影響卻有所不同。

en: Some Western countries – such as Greece – had fragile government accounts from the outset and tipped quickly into persistent crisis mode.
zh: 某些西方國家 — — 比如希臘 — — 起初其政府賬目就非常糟糕，所以很快就陷入了長期持續性的危機模式。

en: There they remain, still failing to provide citizens with a light at the end of what already has been a long tunnel.
zh: 這些國家將一直深陷危機，即便很長一段時期之後都依然無法為其公民帶來一絲希望。

en: Other countries had been fiscally responsible, but were overwhelmed by the liabilities that they had assumed from others (for example, Ireland’s irresponsible banks sank their budget).
zh: 其他國家過去在財政上一直盡職盡責，卻無力應對那些從別處承擔的債務（例如那些不可靠的愛爾蘭銀行就毀了本國的預算 ） 。

en: Still others, including the United States, faced no immediate threat but failed to make progress on longer-term issues. A few, like Germany, had built deep economic and financial resilience through years of fiscal discipline and structural reforms.
zh: 另外一些國家 — — 包括美國 — — 沒有受到直接的威脅，但無法在某些長期事務上取得進展。 而有幾個像德國這樣的國家則透過多年的財政紀律和體制改革擁有了深厚的經濟和金融復原能力。

en: It is not surprising that policy approaches have also varied.
zh: 各國的應對政策各不相同，這也並不奇怪。

en: Indeed, they have shared only one, albeit crucial (and disappointing) feature: the inability to rely on rapid growth as the “safest” way to deleverage an over-indebted economy.
zh: 但事實上，這些政策之間只擁有一個至關重要（也令人失望）的共同點：那就是無法依靠經濟快速增長這個“最安全”的方法來為其過度負債的經濟去槓桿化。

en: Greece essentially defaulted on some obligations.
zh: 希臘實際上已經在某些債務上出現了違約。

en: Ireland opted for austerity and reforms, as has the United Kingdom.
zh: 愛爾蘭和英國一樣選擇了緊縮政策和改革。

en: The US is gradually transferring resources from creditors to debtors through financial repression.
zh: 美國正逐步透過金融抑制手段把資源從債權人轉移到債務人手上。

en: And Germany is slowly acquiescing to a prudent relative expansion in domestic demand.
zh: 而德國正逐漸適應在國內需求方面的穩健相對擴張。

en: So much for the sovereign-debt crisis, which, given its national, regional, and global impact, has been particularly well covered.
zh: 關於主權債務危機我想說的就這麼多，因為考慮��其對國家、區域及全球的影響，對其的討論已經足夠豐富了。

en: After all, sovereigns are called that because they have the power to impose taxes, regulations, and, at the extreme, confiscation.
zh: 畢竟，它之所以被稱之為主權，就是因為它們擁有徵稅、監管，甚至極端點說，沒收的權力。

en: But the other credit crisis is equally consequential, and receives much less attention, even as it erodes societies’ integrity, productive capabilities, and ability to maintain living standards (particularly for the least fortunate).
zh: 另外一種信貸危機也同樣重要，但其受到的關注卻少得多，即使它損壞了社會的凝聚力、生產力以及人們維持自身生活水平的能力（尤其是對底層人群來說 ） 。

en: I know of very few Western countries where small and medium-size companies, as well as middle-income households and those of more limited means, have not experienced a significant decline in their access to credit – not just new financing, but also the ability to roll over old credit lines and loans.
zh: 據我所知，絕大部分西方國家的中小企業、中等收入以及收入拮据的家庭都經歷過信貸獲取渠道顯著下降 — — 不僅針對新的融資，還包括更新過往信貸額度和借款的能力。

en: The immediate causes are well known.
zh: 這種信貸危機產生的直接原因大家都知道。

en: They range from subdued bank lending to unusually high risk aversion, and from discredited credit vehicles to the withdrawal of some institutions from credit intermediation altogether.
zh: 其範圍涵蓋從銀行抑制貸款到異常的高風險規避行為、從信貸工具信譽崩潰再到某些機構完全撤出信用中介機構的舉措。

en: Such credit constraints are one reason why unemployment rates continue to rise in so many countries – often from already alarming levels, such as 25% in Greece and Spain (where youth unemployment is above 50%) – and why unemployment remains unusually high in countries like the US (albeit it at a much lower level).
zh: 這種信貸約束是許多國家失業率持續上升的一個原因 — — 通常這些國家的失業率原本已經處於令人擔憂的水平了，例如希臘和西班牙25%的失業率（這兩個國家的青年失業率已經超過了50 % ） — — 同時也是像美國這樣的國家失業率居高不下的原因（雖然相對而言美國的失業率並不高 ） 。

en: This is not just a matter of lost capabilities and rising poverty; persistently high unemployment also leads to social unrest, erosion of trust in political leaders and institutions, and the mounting risk of a lost generation.
zh: 這不僅僅是生產力流失和貧困加劇的問題；長期的高失業率還會導致社會動盪、對本國政治領導人的不信任以及產生失落一代的風險。

en: Indeed, unemployment data in many advanced countries are dominated by long-term joblessness (usually defined as six months or more).
zh: 確實，許多發達國家的失業資料主要由長期失業構成（通常定義為六個月或以上 ） 。

en: Skill erosion becomes a problem for those with prior work experience, while unsuccessful first-time entrants into the labor force are not just unemployed, but risk becoming unemployable.
zh: 技能的逐漸喪失對那些原本有工作經驗的人來說是個問題，而首次就業不成功則不僅意味著失業這麼簡單，還隱含著不會被僱傭的風險。

en: Governments are doing too little to address the private credit debacle.
zh: 政府們在處理私人信貸危機上做得太少了。

en: Arguably, they must first sort out the sovereign side of the crisis; but it is not clear that most officials even have a comprehensive plan.
zh: 雖然理論上它們必先解決危機中的主權債務方面；然而目前尚不清楚大部分官員是否制訂了一個全面計劃。

en: Policy asymmetry is greatest for the countries most acutely affected by the sovereign-debt crisis.
zh: 那些受到主權債務危機影響最劇烈的國家的政策非對稱性最為明顯。

en: There, the private sector has essentially been left to fend for itself; and most households and companies are struggling, thus fueling continued economic implosion.
zh: 在這些國家，政府基本上任由私營部門自生自滅；大部分家庭和企業都處在掙扎之中，因此加劇了長期的經濟崩潰。

en: Other countries appear to have adopted a “Field of Dreams” – also known as “build it and they will come” – approach to private credit markets, In the US, for example, artificially low interest rates for home mortgages, resulting from the Federal Reserve’s policy activism, are supposed to kick-start prudent financing.
zh: 其他國家則彷彿採取了一種“尋夢之地 ” — —也被稱之為“平臺建好了，人就來了 ” — —的方法來處理私人信貸市場，例如，在美國，由於美聯儲的政策措施，人為降低了對住房抵押貸款的利率，以期啟動審慎的融資。

en: The European Central Bank is taking a similarly indirect approach.
zh: 歐洲央行也正在採取這麼一個間接手段。

en: In both places, other policymaking entities, with much better tools at their disposal, appear either unwilling or unable to play their part.
zh: 但在這兩個地方，掌握有更有力工具的其他政策制定實體似乎既不願意也無力承擔自己的角色。

en: As such, action by central banks will repeatedly fail to gain sufficient traction.
zh: 在這種情況下，央行的行動將一直無法產生足夠的牽引力。

en: In fact, only the UK is visibly opting for a more coordinated and direct way to counter the persistent shortfalls stemming from the private part of the credit crisis.
zh: 事實上，只有英國明確選擇了更協調也更直接的方式來抵消由私人信貸危機引起的長期短缺。

en: There, the “Funding for Lending Scheme,” jointly designed by the Bank of England and the Treasury, seeks “to boost the incentive for banks and building societies to lend to UK households and non-financial companies,” while holding them accountable for proper behavior.
zh: 由英國格蘭銀行和財政部共同設計的“貸款資助方案”旨在“提高銀行和建房互助協會向英國家庭和非金融企業借貸的動力 ” ， 同時也要求前者為自身的行為負責。

en: The UK example is important; but, given the scope and scale of the challenges, the proposal is a relatively modest one.
zh: 英國的例子很重要；但是考慮到整個挑戰所涉及的範圍和規模 ，該提案還是相對保守的。

en: The program may stimulate some productive credit intermediation, but it will not make a significant dent in what will remain one of the major obstacles to robust economic recovery.
zh: 這一計劃也許能刺激一些有益的信用中介行為，但它依然無法對那些繼續阻礙強勁經濟復甦的因素產生重大影響。

en: Proper access to credit for productive segments is an integral part of a well-functioning economy.
zh: 生產部門能夠擁有適當的信貸獲取渠道對一個運轉良好的經濟體來說至關重要。

en: Without it, growth falters, job creation is insufficient, and widening income and wealth inequality undermines the social fabric.
zh: 否則經濟增長就將止步不前，也無法充分創造就業，不斷擴大的財富與收入差距將腐蝕整個社會結構。

en: That is why any comprehensive approach to restoring the advanced countries’ economic and financial vibrancy must target the proper revival of private credit flows.
zh: 這就是為什麼任何恢復發達國家經濟和金融活力的綜合性手段都必須著眼於適當復甦私人信貸流的原因。

en: Toxic Politics Versus Better Economics
zh: 有害的政治學和更好的經濟學

en: NEW YORK – The relationship between politics and economics is changing.
zh: 紐約—政治學和經濟學之間的關係在變化。

en: Advanced-country politicians are locked in bizarre, often toxic, conflicts, instead of acting on a growing economic consensus about how to escape a protracted period of low and unequal growth.
zh: 發達國家政客陷於古怪並且常常有害的衝突之中，而沒有在關於如何擺脫長期不平等低增長時期的問題上按照日益一致的經濟共識行事。

en: This trend must be reversed, before it structurally cripples the advanced world and sweeps up the emerging economies, too.
zh: 這一趨勢必須扭轉，否則它將破壞發達經濟的結構，並讓新興經濟體也陷入困境。

en: Obviously, political infighting is nothing new.
zh: 顯然，政治內鬥不是什麼新鮮事。

en: But, until recently, the expectation was that if professional economists achieved a technocratic consensus on a given policy approach, political leaders would listen.
zh: 但是，直到最近，人們一直認為，如果職業經濟學家能就給定的政策方針形成技術官僚一致，政治領導人是能夠聽進去的。

en: Even when more radical political parties attempted to push a different agenda, powerful forces – whether moral suasion from G7 governments, private capital markets, or the conditionality attached to International Monetary Fund and World Bank lending – would almost always ensure that the consensus approach eventually won the day.
zh: 即使有更多激進政黨試圖推行不同的日程，但強大的力量 — — 不管是來自G7政府的到的勸告、私人資本市場，還是國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）和世界銀行貸款的附加條件 — — 幾乎總能確保共識方針最終能夠勝出。

en: In the 1990s and 2000s, for example, the so-called Washington Consensus dominated policymaking in much of the world, with everyone from the United States to a multitude of emerging economies pursuing trade liberalization, privatization, greater use of price mechanisms, financial-sector deregulation, and fiscal and monetary reforms with a heavy supply-side emphasis.
zh: 比如，從20世紀90年代到21世紀初，所謂的華盛頓共識主導著世界大部的政策決定，從美國到諸多新興經濟體，所有人都在追求貿易自由化、私有化、擴大價格機制用途、金融業去監管，以及著重強調供給側的財政和貨幣改革。

en: The embrace of the Washington Consensus by multilateral institutions amplified its transmission, helping to drive forward the broader process of economic and financial globalization.
zh: 多邊機構採用華盛頓共識放大的這一傳導機制，推動了更廣大的經濟和金融全球化過程。

en: Incoming governments – particularly those led by non-traditional movements, which had risen to power on the back of domestic unease and frustration with mainstream parties – sometimes disagreed with the appropriateness and relevance of the Washington Consensus.
zh: 即將上任的新政府 — — 特別是那些由非傳統運動的政府，它們之所以能夠掌權，依靠的是國內的焦慮情緒和對主流政黨的失望 — — 有時華盛頓共識的適當性和重要性有不同意見。

en: But, as Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva demonstrated with his famous policy pivot in 2002, that consensus tended largely to prevail. And it continued to hold sway as recently as almost two years ago, when Greek Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras executed an equally notable U-turn.
zh: 但是，巴西總統盧拉以其著名的2002年政策重點證明，華盛頓共識最後往往還是能夠勝出，並且一直主導全域性直到兩年前希臘總理齊普拉斯採取了同樣令人矚目的一百八十度大轉彎。

en: But after years of unusually sluggish and strikingly non-inclusive growth, the consensus is breaking down.
zh: 但在經歷了多年反常的停滯和令人震驚的不包容增長後，華盛頓共識正在解體。

en: Advanced-country citizens are frustrated with an “establishment” – including economic “experts,” mainstream political leaders, and dominant multinational companies – which they increasingly blame for their economic travails.
zh: 發達國家公民對“建制 ” — —包括經濟“專家 ” 、 主流政治領導人、主要跨國公司 — — 感到失望，越來越多的人指責它們是經濟艱難的罪魁禍首。

en: Anti-establishment movements and figures have been quick to seize on this frustration, using inflammatory and even combative rhetoric to win support.
zh: 反建制運動和人物很快就抓住了這一不滿，利用煽動性乃至戰鬥性言辭贏得支援。

en: They do not even have to win elections to disrupt the transmission mechanism between economics and politics.
zh: 他們甚至不需要贏得選舉就能干擾經濟學和政治學之間的傳遞機制。

en: The United Kingdom proved that in June, with its Brexit vote – a decision that directly defied the broad economic consensus that remaining within the European Union was in Britain’s best interest.
zh: 6月份，英國以退歐投票證明了這一點 — — 這一決定直接否認了留在歐盟符合英國的最佳利益這一經濟共識。

en: The referendum happened for one reason: in 2013, then-Prime Minister David Cameron feared that he would be unable to secure sufficiently his Conservative Party base in the general election that year.
zh: 英國公投的發生原因是，2013年，時任首相卡梅倫擔心他在當年的大選中無法確保其保守黨基本盤。

en: So he pandered to Euroskeptic voters with the promise of a referendum.
zh: 因此他用承諾舉行公投誘惑疑歐派選民。

en: The source of Cameron’s fear?
zh: 卡梅倫為什麼要擔心？
