en: The political disruption caused by the UK Independence Party – an anti-establishment party that ended up winning only one seat in Parliament and subsequently found itself leaderless and in turmoil.
zh: 因為英國獨立黨（UK Independent Party）所造成的政治干擾。 反建制的英國獨立黨最後只在議會贏得了一個席位，隨後便陷入群龍無首的亂局。

en: Now, it seems, the floodgates have opened.
zh: 如今，防洪門似乎已經洞開。

en: At the recent Conservative Party annual conference, speeches by Prime Minister Theresa May and members of her cabinet revealed an intention to pursue a “hard Brexit,” thereby dismantling trading arrangements that have served the economy well.
zh: 在最近的保守黨年度大會上，首相梅及其內閣成員的講話表明他們準備追求“硬退歐 ” ， 取締給英國經濟帶來巨大好處的貿易安排。

en: They also included attacks on “international elites” and criticism of Bank of England policies that were instrumental in stabilizing the British economy in the referendum’s immediate aftermath – thus giving May’s new government time to formulate a coherent Brexit strategy.
zh: 他們還抨擊“國際精英 ” ， 批評英格蘭銀行的政策。 在公投剛剛結束的那段時間，英格蘭銀行的政策起到了穩定英國經濟的中流砥柱的作用，從而給梅的新政府贏得了制定一致的退歐戰略的時間。

en: Several other advanced economies are experiencing analogous political developments.
zh: 其他一些發達經濟體也正在經歷類似的政治發展趨勢。

en: In Germany, a surprisingly strong showing by the far-right Alternative für Deutschland in recent state elections already appears to be affecting the government’s behavior.
zh: 在德國，極右翼的德國另類黨（Alternative für Deutschland）在最近的州選舉中表現出人意料的強勢，它已經開始影響德國政府的行為。

en: In the US, even if Donald Trump’s presidential campaign fails to put a Republican back in the White House (as appears increasingly likely, given that, in the latest twist of this highly unusual campaign, many Republican leaders have now renounced their party’s nominee), his candidacy will likely leave a lasting impact on American politics.
zh: 在美國，即使唐納德·特朗普的競選不能讓共和黨重新問鼎白宮（這一可能性日益增加，因為這出相當反常的總統選戰最近又曝出新轉折，許多共和黨領導人宣佈不再支援本黨提名人 ） ， 他成為候選人這一事實也可能給美國政治帶來持續影響。

en: If not managed well, Italy’s constitutional referendum in December – a risky bid by Prime Minister Matteo Renzi to consolidate support – could backfire, just like Cameron’s referendum did, causing political disruption and undermining effective action to address the country’s economic challenges.
zh: 如果管理不當，12月的義大利憲政公投 — — 總理倫齊為鞏固其支援而兵行險招 — — 將適得其反，一如卡梅倫的公投方案，導致政治干擾，阻礙解決義大利經濟挑戰的有效行動。

en: Make no mistake: solid and credible policy options are available.
zh: 不要弄錯了，可靠可信的政策選項仍在可及範圍內。

en: After years of mediocre economic performance, there is widespread agreement that a shift away from excessive dependence on unconventional monetary policy is needed.
zh: 在經歷了多年的平庸經濟表現後，一個廣泛的一致是必須擺脫對非常規貨幣政策的過度依賴。

en: As IMF Managing Director Christine Lagarde put it, “central banks cannot be the only game in town.”
zh: IMF總裁拉加德指出 ， “ 中央銀行不可以成為唯一的博弈 ” 。

en: And yet they have been.
zh: 但它們正是。

en: As I argue in The Only Game in Town, published in January, countries need a more comprehensive policy approach, involving pro-growth structural reforms, more balanced demand management (including higher fiscal spending on infrastructure), and better cross-border policy coordination and architecture.
zh: 我在1月出版的《唯一的博弈 》 （ The Only Game in Town）中指出，各國需要更加全面的政策方針，包括促增長的結構性改革、更平衡的需求管理（包括增加基礎設施方面的財政支出）和更好的跨國政策協作和組織。

en: There is also a need, highlighted by the protracted Greek crisis, to address pockets of severe over-indebtedness, which can have crushing impact extending well beyond the directly affected.
zh: 此外還需要解決嚴重的過度負債問題 — — 沒完沒了的希臘危機突出了這一點 — — 該問題的破壞性影響遠遠不侷限於直接受害者。

en: The emergence of a new consensus on these points is good news.
zh: 在這些問題上形成新共識是好訊息。

en: But, in the current political environment, translating that consensus into action is likely to happen too slowly, at best.
zh: 但是，在當前政治環境下，將這一共識轉化為行動可能過於緩慢甚至無從實現。

en: The risk is that, as bad politics crowds out good economics, popular anger and frustration will rise, making politics even more toxic.
zh: 風險在於，隨著壞政治學擠出好經濟學，群眾憤怒和不滿將愈演愈烈，讓政治學變得更加有害。

en: One hopes that enlightened political leadership takes the reins in time to make the needed mid-course corrections voluntarily, before unambiguous signs of economic and financial crisis force policymakers to scramble to minimize the damage.
zh: 我們希望開明的政治領導層及時掌控全域性，自願採取中途糾錯，以免明確的經濟和金融危機訊號迫使決策者不得不將重點放在影響最小化上。

en: Another Lesson from Japan
zh: 日本的另一個教訓

en: NEW HAVEN – Yet another in a long string of negative inflation surprises is at hand.
zh: 發自紐黑文 — — 最近這段時間出人意料的通脹壞訊息真是一個接著一個。

en: In the United States, the so-called core CPI (consumer price index) – which excludes food and energy – has headed down just when it was supposed to be going up.
zh: 在美國，所謂的核心消費價格指數（core CPI ） — —不包括食品和能源 — — 在一片上行預期中調頭向下。

en: Over the three months ending in May, the core CPI was basically unchanged, holding, at just 1.7% above its year-earlier level.
zh: 截至五月份的三個月中，核心消費物價指數基本保持不變，維持在較去年同期高出1.7個百分點的水平。

en: For a US economy that is widely presumed to be nearing the hallowed ground of full employment, this comes as a rude awakening – particularly for the Federal Reserve, which has pulled out all the stops to get inflation back to its 2% target.
zh: 對於各界廣泛認為已經近乎實現充分就業神蹟的美國經濟來說，這簡直是當頭一盆冷水 — — 而最尷尬的莫過於已盡一切努力要使通脹水平迴歸2％目標值的美聯儲了。

en: Halfway around the world, a similar story continues to play out in Japan.
zh: 而在世界的另一側，類似的故事也在日本繼續上演。

en: But, for the deflation-prone Japanese economy, it’s a much tougher story.
zh: 但是對於極易出現通縮的日本經濟來說，故事的內容更讓人揪心。

en: Through April, Japan’s core CPI was basically flat relative to its year-earlier level, with a similar outcome evident in May for the Tokyo metropolitan area.
zh: 截至今年4月份，日本的核心消費物價指數較去年同期基本持平，而東京都市圈的經濟表現顯示5月也將如此。

en: For the Bank of Japan (BoJ), which committed an unprecedented arsenal of unconventional policy weapons to arrest a 19-year stretch of 16.5% deflation lasting from 1994 to 2013, this is more than just a rude awakening. It is an embarrassment bordering on defeat.
zh: 對於為遏制持續19年（1994~2013）累計達19.5％的通縮趨勢而動用了史無前例的非常規政策武器庫的日本銀行來說，這不僅僅是一個盆冷水，簡直就是一場近乎失敗的窘境。

en: This story is global in scope.
zh: 這個故事適用於全球範圍。

en: Yes, there are a few notable outliers – namely, the United Kingdom, where currency pressures and one-off holiday distortions are temporarily boosting core inflation to 2.4%, and Malaysia, where the removal of fuel subsidies has boosted headline inflation, yet left the core stable at around 2.5%.
zh: 當然也存在一些值得留意的異常例子 — — 比如英國，貨幣壓力和一次性假期扭曲暫時將核心通脹率提高至2.4 ％ ， 還有馬來西亞，燃料補貼的取消推動了總體通脹，但核心通脹率穩定在2.5％左右。

en: But they are exceptions in an otherwise inflationless world.
zh: 但它們都是這個無通脹世界中的例外。

en: The International Monetary Fund’s latest forecasts bear this out.
zh: 國際貨幣基金組織的最新預測表明了這一點。

en: Notwithstanding a modest firming of global economic growth, inflation in the advanced economies is expected to average slightly less than 2% in 2017-2018.
zh: 儘管全球經濟將實現溫和增長，但發達經濟體在2017~18年的通脹水平預計將略低於2 ％ 。

en: The first chapter of this tale was written many years ago, in Japan.
zh: 這個故事的第一章是多年前在日本寫就的。

en: From asset bubbles and excess leverage to currency suppression and productivity impairment, Japan’s experience – with lost decades now stretching to a quarter-century – is testament to all that can go wrong in large and wealthy economies.
zh: 從資產泡沫和槓桿過剩到匯率壓制和生產力下降，日本的經驗 — — 所謂“失去的十年”現在已經拉長到了二十五年 — — 展現了一個大型富裕的經濟體可能會犯下的所有錯誤。

en: But no lesson is more profound than that of a series of policy blunders made by the BoJ.
zh: 但沒什麼教訓能比日本央行犯下的一系列政策失誤更為深刻。

en: Not only did reckless monetary accommodation set the stage for Japan’s demise; the country’s central bank compounded the problem by taking policy rates to the zero bound (and even lower), embracing quantitative easing, and manipulating long-term interest rates in the hopes of reviving the economy.
zh: 不僅使用魯莽的貨幣寬鬆政策為日本的衰亡奠定了基礎；該國央行還將政策利率歸零（甚至更低 ） ， 實施量化寬鬆政策和操縱長期利率以期復興經濟，卻令問題變得更為複雜。

en: This has created an unhealthy dependency from which there is no easy exit.
zh: 這創造了一種不健康卻又極難擺脫的依賴狀態。

en: Though Japan’s experience since the early 1990s provides many lessons, the rest of the world has failed miserably at heeding them.
zh: 雖然日本自1990年代初以來的經驗提供了許多教訓，但世界其他地方對此卻令人沮喪地充耳不聞。

en: Volumes have been written, countless symposiums have been held, and famous promises have been made by the likes of former US Fed chairman Ben Bernanke never to repeat Japan’s mistakes.
zh: 研究論文寫了無數篇，研討會舉辦了無數次，還有諸如美國前美聯儲主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）等高人都承諾永不會重蹈日本覆轍。

en: Yet time and again, other major central banks – especially the Fed and the European Central Bank – have been quick to follow, with equally dire consequences.
zh: 不過一次又一次地其他主要中央銀行 — — 尤其是美聯儲和歐洲央行 — — 總是會緊接著掉進坑裡，併產生同樣可怕的後果。

en: The inflation surprise of 2017 offers three key insights.
zh: 2017年的通脹意外事件提供了三個關鍵的見解。

en: First, the relationship between inflation and economic slack – the so-called Phillips curve – has broken down.
zh: 首先，通貨膨脹與經濟蕭條程度之間的關係 — — 即所謂的菲利普斯曲線（Phillips curve ） — —已經瓦解了。

en: Courtesy of what the University of Geneva’s Richard Baldwin calls the “second unbundling” of globalization, the world is awash in the excess supply of increasingly fragmented global supply chains.
zh: 拜日內瓦大學教授理查德·鮑德溫（Richard Baldwin）所謂的全球化“第二次分割”所賜，世界上因此充斥著供應過剩且日益分散化的全球供應鏈。

en: Outsourcing via these supply chains dramatically expands the elasticity of the global supply curve, fundamentally altering the concept of slack in labor and product markets, as well as the pressure such slack might put on inflation.
zh: 而藉助這些供應鏈的外包大大擴大了全球供應曲線的彈性，並從根本上改變了勞動力和產品市場蕭條的概念，以及這類蕭條狀態對通脹的壓力。

en: Second, today’s globalization is inherently asymmetric.
zh: 其次，當今的全球化在本質上是不對稱的。

en: For a variety of reasons – hangovers from balance-sheet recessions in Japan and the US, fear-driven precautionary saving in China, and anemic consumption in productivity-constrained Europe – the demand side of most major economies remains severely impaired.
zh: 由於各種原因 — — 日本和美國資產負債表的持續衰退，恐懼驅動下的中國國內預防性儲蓄，以及歐洲生產力受限導致的消費疲軟 — — 大多數主要經濟體的需求側依然受損嚴重。

en: Juxtaposed against a backdrop of ever-expanding supply, the resulting imbalance is inherently deflationary.
zh: 再結合供應不斷擴大的背景，因此導致的不平衡狀態在本質上是通縮式的。

en: Third, central banks are all but powerless to cope with the moving target of what can be called a non-stationary liquidity trap.
zh: 第三，中央銀行在應對所謂的非平穩流動性陷阱的變動目標方面都是無能為力的。

en: First observed by John Maynard Keynes during the Great Depression of the 1930s, the liquidity trap describes a situation in which policy interest rates, having reached the zero bound, are unable to stimulate chronically deficient aggregate demand.
zh: 正如約翰·梅納德·凱恩斯（John Maynard Keynes）在1930年代大蕭條時首先觀察到的那樣，流動性陷阱描述了一個政策利率已達零點，卻依舊無法刺激長期缺乏的總需求的狀況。

en: Sound familiar?
zh: 這聽起來是不是有點耳熟？

en: The novel twist today is the ever-expanding global supply curve.
zh: 而如今使用的新花招則是不斷擴張的全球供應曲線。

en: That makes today’s central banks even more impotent than they were in the 1930s.
zh: 這使得今天的中行比1930年代更加束手無策。

en: This is not an incurable disease.
zh: 這可不是不治之症。

en: In a world of hyper-globalization – barring a protectionist relapse led by the America Firsters – treatment needs to be focused on the demand side of the equation.
zh: 在一個超全球化的世界 — — 除了由美國優先主義者領導的保護主義逆流之外 — — 應對方案應當集中在等式的需求一側。

en: The most important lesson from the 1930s, as well as from the modern-day Japanese experience, is that monetary policy provides no answer for a chronic deficiency of aggregate demand.
zh: 而1930年代以及從現代日本的經驗帶來的最重要教訓，就是貨幣政策對總需求的長期缺乏狀況無計可施。

en: Addressing it is a task primarily for fiscal authorities. The idea that central banks should consider making a new promise to raise their inflation targets is hardly credible.
zh: 解決這個問題主要得靠財政部門，中行應該考慮再度許諾提高其通脹目標的想法是不可靠的。

en: In the meantime, Fed Chair Janet Yellen is right (finally) to push the Fed to normalize policy, putting an end to a failed experiment that has long outlived its usefulness.
zh: 與此同時，美聯儲主席珍妮特·耶倫（Janet Yellen ） （ 最後終於）作出了正確的決定，推動美聯儲的政策正常化，終結了一個早該因一無是處而剎車的錯誤實驗。

en: The danger all along has been that open-ended unconventional monetary easing would fail to achieve traction in the real economy, and would inject excess liquidity into US and global financial markets that could lead to asset bubbles, reckless risk taking, and the next crisis.
zh: 一直以來的危險在於：不是何時才是盡頭的非常規貨幣寬鬆政策將無法對實體經濟構成牽引力，並將過多的流動性注入了美國和全球金融市場，從而導致資產泡沫，肆意金融冒險和下一次危機。

en: Moreover, because unconventional easing was a strategy designed for an emergency that no longer exists, it leaves the Fed with no ammunition to fight the inevitable next downturn and crisis.
zh: 此外，由於非常規寬鬆政策是為了一個不再存在的緊急狀態而制定的戰略，因此也使得美聯儲沒有彈藥來應對不可避免的下一輪衰退和危機。

en: We ignore history at great peril.
zh: 我們對歷史的忽視是存在極大危險的。

en: The latest disappointment for inflation-targeting central banks is really not a surprise after all. The same is true of the related drop in long-term interest rates.
zh: 以通脹為目標的各大央行最近的鎩羽而歸根本不是一個意外，相關的長期利率下跌也是如此。

en: There is much to be gained by studying carefully the lessons of Japan.
zh: 仔細學習日本的教訓，必定獲益良多。

en: A Rest Stop for Europe
zh: 歐洲：退一步海闊天空

en: PRINCETON – Last week, in a highly anticipated speech, German President Joachim Gauck cautioned against the blind pursuit of an “ever-closer” European Union, acknowledging that the growing inequality among member states is generating “a sense of unease, even unmistakable anger,” and increasing the risk of national humiliation.
zh: 普林斯頓—上週，在一次備受期待的演講中，德國總理高克對盲目追求“前所未有地緊密”的歐盟表達了擔憂，他承認成員國之間日漸增加的不平等性正在產生“不安的感覺，甚至錯誤的憤怒 ， ” 這增加了國家受辱的風險。

en: He pointed out that, in addition to the economic crisis, there is “a crisis of confidence in Europe as a political project.”
zh: 他指出，除了經濟危機，還有“一場對作為政治工程的歐洲的信心的危機 ” 。

en: While Gauck made clear that he remains decidedly pro-Europe, he highlighted the need for closer reflection about Europe’s future – and especially that of the eurozone.
zh: 儘管高克斷然表示他仍是堅決的歐洲支持者，但他也強調了深刻思考歐洲未來的需要，特別是歐元區的未來。

en: Standing on the verge of greater integration, Europeans are hesitant, “unsure whether we should really stride out on the onward journey.”
zh: 站在進一步一體化的邊上，歐洲人猶豫了 ， “ 不確定我們是否應該向前跨出新的步伐 ” 。

en: Addressing this hesitation, he declared, will require a thoughtful, nuanced understanding of what “more Europe” actually means.
zh: 他說，要打消這一猶豫，深入細緻地思考“更歐洲”的真正含義。

en: Gauck may not have gone far enough: At this point, an ever-closer union may be a political mirage.
zh: 或許高克走的還不夠遠：目前前所未有地緊密的聯盟可能是一場政治婚姻。

en: Any meaningful progress toward stabilizing the eurozone would require a significant – potentially open-ended – financial commitment, and the EU is not politically ready to cross that threshold.
zh: 任何有讓歐元區更穩定的有意義的進步都需要重大 — — 從根本上說是開放 — — 的財政承諾，而歐盟還沒有做好跨越之一門檻的政治準備。

en: Repeatedly pretending to move forward, then pulling back at the critical point, exacerbates political uncertainty and economic vulnerability.
zh: 一再地假裝前進，然後又在臨界點退縮，這增加了政治不確定性和經濟脆弱性。

en: Rather than indecisively pursuing more unity, this may be the moment to restore effective sovereignty to national authorities in eurozone countries.
zh: 現在或許並不是猶猶豫豫追求更統一的時機，而是重塑歐元區國家當局有效主權的時機。

en: Such a move would alleviate anxiety in the short term, thereby giving Europeans the opportunity to regroup in preparation for future steps toward a more integrated Europe and a more resilient euro.
zh: 這樣做能夠在短期緩和焦慮，從而使歐洲得到重組機會，為未來邁向更一體化的歐洲和更堅挺的歐元做好準備。

en: To this end, eurozone leaders must take three key steps.
zh: 在這方面，歐元區領導人必須實施三個基本措施。

en: The dysfunctional system of European fiscal governance should be dismantled; fiscal responsibility should be returned to member states; and, to minimize the risk of excessive future lending, private lenders should be required to bear the losses implied by unsustainable sovereign debt.
zh: 功能不全的歐洲財政治理制度應該取消；財政責任應該交還給成員國；同時，為了讓未來過度借貸最小化，應該要求私人債權人承擔不可持續的主權債務的損失。

en: The case against European fiscal governance is straightforward.
zh: 歐洲財政治理的問題是顯而易見的。

en: Before the crisis, the single-minded emphasis on reducing national budget deficits to less than 3% of GDP led to extensive abuse.
zh: 危機前一根筋地強調將預算赤字限制在GDP的3%之內導致了這一方針的濫用。

en: Either the target was openly flouted, as it was in leading economies like Germany and France, or the data were manipulated to obscure problems (a common practice throughout the eurozone, not just in Greece).
zh: 德國和法國等領先經濟體公開奚落這一目標，而有的國家則操縱數字掩蓋問題（這是歐元區普遍的現象，不光是希臘 ） 。

en: And the belief in economic growth as a fiscal panacea led to unrealistically optimistic GDP forecasts.
zh: 而把經濟增長當作財政萬靈丹的思想導致了不切實際的樂觀GDP預期。

en: When the crisis struck, the 3% deficit target became the focal point for unrelenting austerity – a form of what anthropologist Clifford Geertz described as “involution,” which occurs when a process intensifies rather than changes in response to external or internal pressure.
zh: 危機爆發後，3%赤字目標成了無情的緊縮政策的焦點 — — 人類學家格爾茨（Clifford Geertz）將這種形式稱為“內卷化 ” ， 當一個過程因外部或內部壓力而加劇而不是變化時就發生了內卷化。

en: In other words, EU leaders began to complicate fiscal governance, ultimately creating an inefficient, inescapable labyrinth of regulation and bureaucracy.
zh: 換句話說，歐盟領導人開始強化財政治理，最終形成了不可避免的低效監管和官僚主義難題。

en: As fiscal metrics become increasingly intricate, monitoring efforts will become ever easier to undermine.
zh: 隨著財政指標變得越來越複雜，監控財政行為越來越容易糊弄。

en: The case for returning fiscal responsibility to national authorities is also strong – and not only because centralized fiscal authority has proved to be so inefficient.
zh: 把財政責任交還給國家當局的問題也很大 — — 這不僅是因為集中財政當局已被證明極其低效。

en: With citizens of distressed countries bearing the fiscal burden of the crisis, the enduring presumption that they will not act responsibly is patronizing, at best.
zh: 受困國人民承擔了危機的財政負擔，如此仍認為它們不負責任的說法不可不謂傲慢。

en: And the current strategy of exchanging goodies for good behavior encourages game-playing and dilutes responsibility.
zh: 當前用甜頭換良政的策略鼓勵博弈而不利於責任。

en: While the risk that governments will succumb to fiscal temptation remains, citizens’ current suffering is likely to deter future excesses.
zh: 儘管政府受財政誘惑的風險仍然存在，但當下人民所受的苦難有可能會遏制未來的過度。

en: National fiscal sovereignty would facilitate the final crucial step: building a more mature relationship with private lenders.
zh: 國家財政主權能促進最後的關鍵措施：建立與私人債權人的更成熟的關係。

en: The eurozone was founded on the “no bailout” principle: if member states could not repay their debts, lenders would bear the losses.
zh: 歐元區是建立在“無援助”原則上的：如果成員國無法償還債務，債權人必須承受損失。

en: But lenders chose – correctly, as it turned out – to disregard that threat.
zh: 但債權人選擇無視這一威脅 — — 事實表明他們是正確的。

en: Instead of enforcing the no-bailout principle and establishing a precedent, debtor countries used official loans to repay private creditors.
zh: 債務國並沒有強推無援助原則為後來者建立榜樣，而是用官方貸款償付私人債權人。

en: As a result, these countries have condemned themselves to continued austerity, low growth, and high debt, while diminishing any future incentive for private lenders to impose fiscal discipline on sovereign borrowers.
zh: 結果，這些國家把自己推向了持續緊縮、低增長和高債務，同時又切斷了所有讓私人債權人對主權債務人施加財政紀律的未來激勵。

en: Only by shifting the burden of responsibility back onto private lenders can debtor countries escape this quagmire.
zh: 除非將這一負擔拋回給私人債權人，否則債務國就無法擺脫債務泥淖。

en: In the United States, each state is responsible for its fiscal management, without being forced to comply with a single, overarching template.
zh: 在美國，各州對其財政管理負責，不需遵守單一的總模式。

en: The states are not regulated by the federal government; they are disciplined by the knowledge that no one will repay their debts for them.
zh: 各州不受聯邦政府監管；它們受沒人會為它們的債務買單這一認識的約束。

en: And the system seems to work: entering the crisis, US states had significantly lower deficit and debt ratios than the eurozone’s vulnerable member states.
zh: 這一制度運轉良好：與歐元區的脆弱成員國相比，進入危機後，美國各州大幅降低了赤字和債務率。

en: So far, European integration has largely been a process of “falling forward,” with each stumble serving as a lesson from which a stronger union emerges.
zh: 目前，歐洲一體化大體上是一個“掉向前 ” （ falling forward）的過程，每一次跌倒都會成為形成更堅固的聯盟的教訓。

en: But, while this uncertain approach may suffice as a basis for declarations of good intentions, it does not inspire the confidence required for countries to make the profound financial commitment that is now needed.
zh: 但是，這一不確定方法或許足以成為宣稱善意的基礎，但並不能激發各國做出當下所急需的深刻財政承諾所需要的信心。

en: Europeans should have the chance to regain their footing.
zh: 歐洲人應該獲得站穩腳跟的機會。

en: Transferring fiscal responsibility back to national authorities would not only mean the end of counterproductive efforts to manage fiscal affairs centrally; it would also diminish the sense of frustration and lack of control that is fueling Euro-skepticism.
zh: 將財政責任交還給國家當局不僅意味著倒行逆施的集中管理財政事務的做法的終結，還能減輕沮喪感和無從掌握全域性感，後兩者正是歐元悲觀主義的溫床。

en: In short, taking a step back would provide an opportunity to reset, to reflect, and to plot the best course toward a more stable, more integrated Europe.
zh: 簡言之，退後一步將是重設、反思和策劃邁向更穩定、更一體化歐洲的最佳方案的機會。

en: For a fiscal union to function – however unlikely that outcome may be – a solid foundation is crucial.
zh: 對於一個能夠運轉的財政聯盟來說 — — 不管這一可能性多麼渺茫 — — 穩固的基礎是至關重要的。

en: As Gauck explained, Europeans “are pausing to… equip [themselves] both intellectually and emotionally for the next step, which will require [them] to enter uncharted territory.”
zh: 正如高克所解釋的，歐洲人“正在停下來 … … 從知識和情緒兩方面為下一步武裝（自己 ） ， 下一步要求（他們）踏入未知領域。 ”

en: Giving Europeans the time and space to choose more Europe would reinforce the core values upon which integration has rested for more than six decades.
zh: 給歐洲人時間和空間去選擇更歐洲有助於強化六十多年來作為歐洲一體化基石的核心價值。

en: Continuing to stumble forward, however, would inevitably lead to a debilitating, if not fatal, fall.
zh: 但是，繼續蹣跚向前不可避免地會導致孱弱甚至衰亡。

en: A European Cure for Balkan Depression
zh: 巴爾幹衰退的歐洲式療法

en: VIENNA – European politics is mostly shaped by events and anniversaries.
zh: 發自維也納－歐洲政治的絕大部分內容都是由某些重大事件和週年紀念構成的。

en: But while events are often unforeseeable, anniversaries are not.
zh: 而雖然重大事件往往有其不可預測性，但週年紀念卻還是有跡可循的。

en: Five years from now, Europe will be reflecting on the 100th anniversary of the outbreak of World War 1, which led to a loss of life almost without parallel and set in motion a chain of events that led to the creation of Europe as we now know it.
zh: 就在5年之後，歐洲將迎來第一次世界大戰爆發100週年的紀念活動，那場戰爭不但造成了其它事件所無法比擬的流血犧牲，更透過推動一系列事件，最終催生了今天我們眼中的歐洲。

en: World leaders may have already reserved some days in August 2014 to mark the occasion.
zh: 而世界各國的元首們說不定也早就預留了2014年8月的某些日子來操辦紀念儀式。

en: It is easy to predict that Sarajevo will be the place where they will meet to look back on Europe’s savage twentieth century.
zh: 不難想象，薩拉熱窩將成為他們齊聚一堂，共同回顧殘酷血腥的20世紀歐洲史的地方。

en: But how will Sarajevo look in five years?
zh: 但不知５年後的薩拉熱窩又將是何種風貌？

en: Will it still be the capital of a country whose citizens view the future bleakly and whose politicians have totally lost touch with the electorate?
zh: 它是否仍會是那個國民對未來徹底絕望，政治家與選民徹底絕緣的國家的首都？

en: Or is there a hope that European leaders will use the anniversary to announce the successful integration of the remaining Balkan countries into the European Union?
zh: 或者是否存在這樣的可能性，那就是歐洲各國的領導人將藉此週年紀念之機，宣佈巴爾幹半島上的其餘國家已經被成功整合進了歐盟？

en: A Balkan Monitor survey recently conducted by Gallup Europe gives suggests the state of public opinion in Serbia, Montenegro, Macedonia, Albania, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Kosovo 20 years on from the fall of the Berlin Wall and a decade after the end of the Kosovo war.
zh: 但就在最近，由蓋洛普歐洲完成的一份名為《巴爾幹觀察》的調查給出了自柏林牆倒塌20年以及科索沃戰爭爆發10年以來，塞爾維亞，黑山共和國，馬其頓，阿爾巴尼亞，克羅埃西亞，波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那以及科索沃各地的輿論狀況。

en: The findings seem to indicate that the next five years will be a make-or-break period for the region’s future development.
zh: 而調查結果似乎顯示，今後5年將是一個關鍵時期，決定該地區未來發展的成敗。

en: While the overwhelming majority of citizens are convinced that further armed conflict in the region is unlikely, the public’s mood – with the exception of Kosovars and Albanians – is pessimistic.
zh: 報告顯示，儘管絕大多數市民相信在本地區內爆發進一步的武裝衝突不太可能，但公眾的情緒 — — 除科索沃和阿爾巴尼亞以外 — — 卻都甚為悲觀。

en: The future promises peace without development.
zh: 未來唯一能帶給他們的只有和平，而發展卻遙遙無期。

en: Trust in political elites and in national and European institutions has been steadily declining.
zh: 人們對政治精英，國家機關及歐盟機構的信任度也都在不斷下降。

en: The majority of citizens have experienced a decline in living standards in the last year, and there remains a perception that people have more opportunities outside their own countries.
zh: 就在去年，絕大部分市民都遭遇了生活水平的下降，人們依然認為到了國外才有更多的機會。

en: Pessimism about employment is alarmingly high among young people, while corruption and government mismanagement are regarded as being widespread.
zh: 年輕人中對就業感到悲觀的比率高得驚人，而政府腐敗和管理不當也被認為是廣泛存在的現象。

en: All those who have made it their job to praise the stability in the region should look at these figures.
zh: 因此這些資料值得那些視稱頌該地區的穩定為己任的人去好好看看。

en: Indeed, it is striking that the majority of citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina believe that their leaders are not interested in their country joining the EU.
zh: 事實上令人感到震驚的是，波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那的大部分市民都認為他們的領導人對加入歐盟不感興趣。

en: An absolute majority of citizens in each of the surveyed countries are convinced that their country is heading in the wrong direction.
zh: 而各被調查國中的絕大部分市民都認為他們的國家已經誤入歧途。

en: Less than one in 10 Croats (whose country could be joining the EU in the near future) believes that their country is heading in the right direction.
zh: 只有不到1/10的克羅埃西亞人（該國將在不久後加入歐盟）認為自己的國家走上了正軌。

en: There are now two options for the region: one is a “shock integration” program that takes all of the Western Balkan states into the EU; the other is a journey into the unknown. The hope that these countries can muddle through on their own is a dangerous illusion.
zh: 事到如今，該地區面臨兩個選擇：一是選擇“休克式整合”計劃，即把巴爾幹半島西部的所有國家不管好壞一股腦全部納入歐盟；另一個選擇則是走著瞧，但期望這些國家能夠靠自身實力涉險過關顯然都是些極端危險的幻想。

en: Stability alone can no longer be the EU’s only objective in the region.
zh: 因此歐盟在本地區的目標可不應僅限於“維穩”兩字。

en: The EU’s continuing presence as a colonial power in places like Bosnia and Herzegovina and Kosovo could cause even more problems in the future, especially if benefits are not forthcoming.
zh: 而歐盟如果繼續以殖民強權式的面目不斷在波黑及科索沃等地進行活動的話，那麼就只能給未來造成更多的問題，尤其是當許諾的好處無法馬上兌現之時。

en: In particular, a delay in Serbia’s integration into the EU could bring Tito-inspired fantasies to the heart of the country’s foreign and security policy.
zh: 特別對於塞爾維亞來說，如果遲遲不能加入歐盟，那麼從前那種鐵托式的不結盟主義思想就將重新佔據該國外交和安全政策的核心。

en: Thus, demoralization of Balkan society creates a dynamic of its own when the best and the brightest see their future outside of their own countries and where “stability” is just another name for political and economic stagnation.
zh: 由此可見，當最優秀和最聰明的人都認為自己的未來在異國他鄉之時，當“穩定”只是政治和經濟停滯的代名詞時，巴爾幹社會的混亂就將催生一種自身的內在動力。

en: If European leaders do plan to meet in 2014 in Sarajevo, they should act now.
zh: 因此如果歐洲的領導人真的計劃在2014年在薩拉熱窩召開會議，那麼他們現在就得行動起來。

en: The ratification of the Lisbon Treaty allows for an element of visionary realism in European politics, as there are no longer any institutional obstacles to the future enlargement of the EU.
zh: 其實《里斯本條約》的透過已經為歐洲政治的組成元素增添了兼具長遠眼光的現實主義理念，而歐盟未來的擴張至此已不再存在任何制度上的障礙。

en: Today, unlike a year ago, we know how many states are in the Balkans, and the Balkan Monitor results show that all of them want to join the Union.
zh: 而今天與一年前不同的是，我們已經能弄清楚在巴爾幹半島���究竟有多少個國家，況且《巴爾幹觀察》的結果也顯示這些國家都想加入歐盟。

en: What the EU has learned from the results of the last parliamentary elections in Bulgaria is that, contrary to conventional wisdom, the leverage of Brussels over new member states increases rather than diminishes after they join.
zh: 此外歐盟應從最近一次保加利亞議會選舉中學到的東西則是，與傳統思維相反，在新成員加入之後，布魯塞爾對這些國家的影響力其實是有增無減。

en: The EU’s decision to liberalize its visa regime for Serbia, Montenegro, and Macedonia – and the fact that George Papandreou, the major architect of the EU’s Balkan integration strategy, is back in power in Greece – is another source of optimism.
zh: 歐盟放寬對塞爾維亞，黑山共和國和馬其頓的簽證限制的決定 — — 以及歐盟巴爾幹整合戰略的主要構建者喬治·帕潘德里奧在希臘重新掌權的事實 — — 都是令人感到樂觀的理由。

en: But it is now or never for the Balkans.
zh: 而對於巴爾幹人來說，要麼現在加入，要麼就永遠不加入。

en: Visa liberalization can be a strategic step in the direction of “shock integration,” but if it is not followed by bold political action from the EU, it could merely become a re-packaging of the status quo.
zh: 放寬簽證可以作為向“休克式整合”邁進的一個戰略步驟，但如果歐盟沒能緊接著給出清晰的政治行動，那這一切就僅僅是換湯不換藥而已。

en: In short, the moment has arrived for shaping events instead of simply marking anniversaries.
zh: 一句話，一戰100週年的時刻有的不僅是紀念，更是時機，一個決定重大事件的時機。

en: Closing Europe’s Strategy Gap
zh: 填補歐洲的戰略空白

en: MADRID – The ongoing crisis in Ukraine has been a hot topic of analysis for almost a year.
zh: 馬德里—持續發酵的烏克蘭危機已經成為近一年來的一個熱點分析話題。

en: But one question has largely escaped thorough examination: what Russia’s annexation of Crimea and invasion of eastern Ukraine indicates about the European Union’s foreign policy.
zh: 但有一個問題幾乎沒人研究：俄羅斯吞併克里米亞和入侵東烏克蘭對歐洲外交政策意味著什麼。

en: During the early stages of the crisis, Germany, which had bet heavily on Russia’s modernization, was averse to taking any consequential action.
zh: 在危機的早期階段，對俄羅斯現代化下了重注的德國反對採取任何可能帶來後果的行動。

en: But, as the crisis deepened, German Chancellor Angela Merkel worked to persuade her European counterparts to implement a broad and biting sanctions regime.
zh: 但是，隨著危機的深化，德國總理默克爾設法說服了歐洲同儕，實施了廣泛而嚴厲的制裁措施。

en: This certainly was a step in the right direction, but it did nothing to address the foreign-policy failings that helped spark the Ukrainian crisis and continue to undermine Europe’s response – namely, the EU’s misguided Neighborhood Policy (ENP) and its muddled approach to energy.
zh: 這毫無疑問是防線爭取的一步，但對於糾正引發烏克蘭危機、制約歐洲的反應的失敗外交政策 — — 即歐洲被誤導的鄰國政策（Neighborhood Policy，ENP）以及混亂的能源方針 — — 無濟於事。

en: On both of these fronts, the EU’s lack of strategic vision has created the impression that Europe is repeatedly being outmaneuvered by Russian President Vladimir Putin.
zh: 在這兩條陣線上，歐洲缺乏戰略眼光，以至於給人們造成了被俄羅斯總統普京玩弄於鼓掌之間的印象。

en: It increasingly appears that Ukraine is becoming locked in a “frozen conflict” – Russia’s foreign-policy specialty.
zh: 烏克蘭危機日益表現出陷入“凍結衝突”的跡象 — — 此乃俄羅斯外交政策的專長。

en: Indeed, the situation in Ukraine represents a tactical victory for Russia, with the fragile but enduring ceasefire – and accompanying legislation that grants Donetsk and Luhansk considerable political autonomy – allowing Russia to entrench the conflict near the EU’s border.
zh: 事實上，烏克蘭局勢表明俄羅斯取得了戰術性勝利，脆弱但一直得以維持的停火 — — 以及隨之發生的授予頓涅茨克和盧甘斯克巨大政治自治權的立法 — — 讓俄羅斯可以在歐盟眼皮底下根深蒂固地建立衝突。

en: Moreover, the delayed implementation of key elements of the EU’s association agreement with Ukraine is clear evidence that, at the moment, Russia dictates the terms of EU-Ukrainian engagement.
zh: 此外，歐盟與烏克蘭的入盟協定的關鍵要素遲遲得不到執行，這清楚地表明眼下俄羅斯主宰著歐盟-烏克蘭聯姻的條件。

en: In Europe, the Kremlin has been able to pursue a successful divide-and-rule strategy, particularly in view of Hungary’s decision to suspend gas flows to Ukraine.
zh: 在歐洲，克里姆林宮一直能夠追求成功的分而治之（divide-and-rule）戰略，匈牙利暫停向烏克蘭輸氣的決定就是顯著的例子。

en: Prime Minister Viktor Orbán’s government, whose behavior in recent years has been at odds with the EU’s criteria for democracy, now openly approves of authoritarian regimes – and Putin’s, in particular – with serious potential consequences for European unity.
zh: 匈牙利總理奧班政府近幾年來的行為與歐盟的民主標準格格不入，現在又公開支援給歐洲的統一帶來嚴重陰影的極權政權 — — 特別是普京政權。

en: Nonetheless, the timing of the current ceasefire, which coincides with the installation of a new EU Commission, is advantageous, as is Putin’s shortsighted emphasis on tactical victories.
zh: 儘管如此，當前停火的時機 — — 正逢歐盟委員會換屆 — — 非常有利，普京短視地強調戰術性勝利亦然。

en: EU leaders should take advantage of the break in the fighting to stop reacting and start anticipating.
zh: 歐盟領導人應該利用戰鬥間歇停止被動反應，開始主動預測。

en: With a long-term strategic vision, the EU could overwhelm and ultimately undermine Putin’s short-term successes.
zh: 歐盟可以著眼於長期戰略，克服並最終破壞普京的短期成功。

en: Such a vision must include a reconceptualization of the ENP.
zh: 如此算盤必須包括重新定義ENP。

en: The program’s mission – to help guide the political, social, and economic transitions of neighboring states – is not inherently problematic; the problem lies in the way that the mission has been interpreted and pursued.
zh: 該計劃的任務 — — 幫助引導鄰國的政治、社會和經濟轉型 — — 並無本質問題；問題在於該任務的解釋和執行方法。

en: For starters, the ENP assumes that all of the EU’s neighbors, both in the south and in the east, ultimately want to realize European values and structures in their own countries.
zh: 首先，ENP假設所有歐盟鄰國 — — 不管是南部鄰國還是東部鄰國 — — 說到底都希望在本國實現歐洲價值和結構。

en: In other words, the ENP does not account for the developmental, cultural, and aspirational differences among the EU’s partner countries.
zh: 換句話說，ENP沒有考慮歐盟夥伴國之間的發展、文化和志趣差異。

en: The ENP suffers operationally from its excessively technical approach and lack of strategic vision.
zh: 在實際操作中，ENP過度強調技術方針，缺少戰略眼光，因此大受影響。

en: For example, before the Ukraine crisis, the European Commission was so focused on negotiating the technical features of the association agreement that it did not consider adequately the potential fallout of the process – such as, say, a response from Russia.
zh: 比如，在烏克蘭危機前，歐盟委員會全部精力都集中在入盟協定的技術細節上，完全沒有充分考慮該程序潛在後果 — — 比如俄羅斯的反應。

en: To be sure, the EU recognized its need for a coherent strategy, and attempted to resolve it by establishing the European External Action Service and the position of High Representative for Foreign Affairs.
zh: 平心而論，歐盟認識到需要統一的戰略，也試圖透過設立歐洲對外行動署（European External Action Service，EEAS）和對外事務高階代表解決這一問題。

en: But the EEAS ended up in a turf war with the European Commission, and outgoing High Representative Catherine Ashton did little to ease the tension, owing to her unwillingness to involve herself in intra-EU disagreements.
zh: 但EEAS最終在與歐盟委員會的扯皮中無疾而終，而即將卸任的高階代表凱瑟琳·阿什頓（Catherine Ashton）也沒能緩和這一緊張局面，因為她自己也不願捲入歐盟內部的糾紛中。

en: It is telling that Ashton has made progress exclusively in areas defined by ample consensus, such as the negotiations on Iran’s nuclear program and the pact between Kosovo and Serbia.
zh: 很能說明問題的是阿什頓只在用充分共識的領域取得了進展，如伊朗核計劃談判和科索沃與塞爾維亞的契約。

en: Further eroding Europe’s effectiveness is its fragmented approach to securing energy supplies.
zh: 進一步制約歐洲效率的是其在確保能源供給方面的各自為政。

en: With every country largely controlling its own energy policy, Europe’s energy market has become inefficient and excessively dependent on Russian supplies.
zh: 各個國家大體上都控制著本國的能源政策，歐洲能源市場變得效率低下，過度依賴俄羅斯的供給。

en: To the extent that there has been an EU-wide energy strategy, it has related to renewables, rather than the intersection of geopolitics and energy security.
zh: 泛歐盟能源政策是存在的，但是關於可再生能源而非地緣政治和能源安全互動的。

en: But there is reason for hope.
zh: 但我們仍可抱有很大希望。

en: The new Commission, which its president, Jean Claude Juncker, has restructured significantly, could provide Europe with the strategic leadership it so badly needs.
zh: 新歐盟委員會主席讓·克勞德·容克（Jean Claude Juncker）對其進行了大刀闊斧的重組，將為歐洲提供急需的戰略領導。

en: In fact, Juncker has already expressed a desire to integrate incoming High Representative Federica Mogherini into the Commission’s policy program.
zh: 事實上，容克已經表達了讓即將赴任的高階代表費得利卡·莫格里尼（Federica Mogherini）參與歐盟委員會政策計劃的意思。

en: The new structure – which tasks Mogherini with guiding and coordinating the work of multiple commissioners, including those responsible for trade, the ENP, and climate and energy – should strengthen the coherence and direction of EU policies, particularly after Mogherini completes her European Council-mandated assessment of the global strategic landscape.
zh: 這一新結構 — — 莫格里尼將負擔指導和協調多名委員工作的任務，包括負責貿易、ENP和氣候與能源的委員 — — 應能強化歐盟政策的統一和防相，特別是在莫格里尼完成了她的歐洲理事會任命的全球戰略局勢評估後。

en: But a restructured Commission is not enough to ensure a reset of Europe’s foreign-policy strategy.
zh: 但重組後的歐盟委員會仍不足以確保歐洲外交政策戰略的重設。

en: For that to happen, Mogherini must assert herself as a leader, backed by Juncker and the new European Council president, Donald Tusk.
zh: 若要實現這一點，莫格里尼必須把自己當作受容克和歐洲理事會主席唐納德·塔斯克（Donald Tusk）支援的領導者。

en: And, most important, all EU member states must recommit themselves to cooperation.
zh: 最重要的是，所有歐盟成員國都必須承諾合作。

en: The Ukrainian people have demonstrated the power of Europe’s values.
zh: 烏克蘭人民已經證明了歐洲價值的力量。

en: Indeed, Europe has a large set of tools at its disposal; it just needs to figure out how to use them.
zh: 事實上，歐洲有的是可用手段；它只是需要明白如何使用。

en: If it can, it will be better able to respond not only to the Russian challenge, but also to many of the other challenges that characterize today’s rapidly shifting global environment.
zh: 如果可以，歐洲不但可更好地響應俄羅斯挑戰，對當今快速變化的全球環境的其他許多挑戰同樣如此。

en: A Europe of Women?
zh: 女性主導歐洲？

en: PARIS – Are women in Europe on the verge of becoming an engine for political change?
zh: 發自巴黎 — — 歐洲女性是否將搖身一變成為政治變革的原動力？

en: In economic-development circles, experience and common sense suggest that progress, accountability, and hard work start with and depend on women.
zh: 經驗和常識告訴我們，經濟發展週期中的進步，責任和勤奮都發端於女性並依靠她們走向成功。

en: Micro-credits, for example, are much more efficient when women receive and repay them.
zh: 以小額貸款為例，由女性獲取並償付的貸款一般都更有效率。

en: Perhaps because they bear children and must find the means to feed them, women are now perceived as the best and most determined “agents of change.”
zh: 或許因為女性往往負有養育兒女的責任，於是也就成了最優秀且最堅決的“變革代理人 ” 。

en: That seems to be as true now of European politics as it has been of economics in parts of Africa and Asia.
zh: 上述情況早就在亞非部分經濟體中有所體現，而當今歐洲政治似乎也在向其靠攏。

en: The results of Italy’s recent municipal elections could be a signal of an incipient electoral dynamic: it was women who voted Silvio Berlusconi’s party out of power in Milan, a city that he has long controlled (and the original seat of his power).
zh: 最近的義大利地方政府大選則堪稱這種新生選舉原動力所發出的一個訊號：正是女性選票在米蘭市長選舉中把西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼的政黨拉了下臺，要知道米蘭一直以來都由貝氏控制（也是其權力的根源所在 ） 。

en: No direct link exists between that result and the dramatic Dominique Strauss-Kahn scandal in New York, but in the immediate aftermath of DSK’s arrest, Italian women and young voters decisively mobilized to defeat Berlusconi’s party (led in Milan, ironically, by a woman).
zh: 貝盧斯科尼陣營的潰敗與國際貨幣基金組織前總裁斯特勞斯-卡恩在紐約的離奇性醜聞本無直接聯絡，但在後者被捕之後，義大利的女性和年輕選民當即動員起來反對貝盧斯科尼陣營（諷刺的是該陣營的米蘭市長恰好是位女性 ） 。

en: These voters could no longer stand the combination of machismo and vulgarity that had once served so well the man Italian humorists now call “Berlus-Kahn.”
zh: 她們再也無法忍受這種大男子主義和粗鄙言行的結合體，即便這些元素曾被如今義大利漫畫家稱為“貝盧斯-卡恩”的那個男人玩得出神入化。

en: When Berlusconi first came to power 17 years ago, he had the support of a majority of women.
zh: 當貝盧斯科尼在17年前首次當權的時候，他曾受到廣大女性的一致愛戴。

en: They were not discouraged by his ambivalent perception of them (by turns celebrating their traditional domesticity and glorifying their sexual objectification).
zh: 她們並未受到他對女性矛盾看法的影響（一邊讚美她們在傳統家庭生活中的角色，另一方面又將她們比作男人的性玩物 ） 。

en: But Italian society has changed: most women are now working, and they are no longer willing to accept Belusconi’s anachronistic and outrageous chauvinism.
zh: 但義大利的社會早已今非昔比：如今大部分女性都是職業女性，因此對貝盧斯科尼那套陳詞濫調及其胡作非為的大男子主義失去了興趣。

en: Italian men may pity the aging, isolated leader, who looks increasingly like his wax effigy at Madame Tussaud’s.
zh: 義大利男性可能會同情這位日漸衰老孤立的領導人，因為他越來越像自己在杜莎夫人蠟像館裡的蠟像了。

en: But Italian women (indeed, women everywhere, it seems) feel only anger and humiliation over a man so obsessed with himself, his various criminal trials, and his vulgar pleasures that he appears to them to have no purpose left except to remain in power as long as possible.
zh: 但對義大利的女性來說（事實上幾乎世界各地的女性都一樣 ） ， 她們對一個如此自戀，如此沉迷於各種犯罪指控和低階趣味的人感到無比憤怒和羞恥，在她們眼中貝盧斯科尼一無是處，只不過是個貪戀權位的政客而已。

en: Women, of course, are not alone in their opposition to Berlusconi, but they made the difference in Milan.
zh: 當然反對貝盧斯科尼的並不僅僅是女性，但她們在米蘭表現得特別搶眼。

en: They are the incarnation of modernity, animated by a yearning for simple dignity and respect.
zh: 她們成為了現代性的化身，在渴求基本尊嚴與尊重的驅使下挺身而出。

en: They are not alone in the vanguard of a new Europe of women.
zh: 在嶄新的女性主導的歐洲中，她們不是一個人在戰鬥。

en: As Iceland spiraled into bankruptcy, owing the irresponsible behavior of its mostly male political and financial elites, the people of Iceland decided that only a strong and responsible woman could redress the country’s problems.
zh: 隨著冰島逐漸破產的過程中 — — 這是由其主要由男性組成的政治和金融界精英階層的不負責任行為所導致的 — — 其國民一致認定，只有一個強勢和勇於擔當的女性才能解決國家當前所面臨的問題。

en: So they elected one as President.
zh: 於是他們選出了一位女總統。

en: The depth and gravity of the current economic and social crisis in countries like Greece, Portugal, and Spain present women with a new opportunity.
zh: 在希臘、葡萄牙和西班牙這樣的國家，國內經濟和社會危機的深刻和嚴重程度也為當地女性帶來一次新的機會。

en: Confronted with what many of them perceive as the equivalent of an “economic war,” women are playing an increasingly important role in maintaining their families’ financial security.
zh: 在面對被許多人所謂的“經濟戰爭”時，女性在維持家庭財政安全方面扮演了越來越重要的角色。

en: And the more widespread this becomes, the more women will seek a political role that reflects their economic clout.
zh: 隨著危機的擴散，女性會尋求獲取更多能夠體現其經濟影響力的政治地位。

en: Of course, women’s changing status may not translate immediately into growing political influence.
zh: 當然女性地位的變化不會立刻轉化為政治影響力。

en: And the rest of Europe might never follow the example of Scandinavia, where gender equality has advanced much further than anywhere else.
zh: 而歐洲其他國家可能永遠不會向斯堪的那維亞半島國家看齊 — — 在那裡的性別平等要比世界任何地方都發展得更快。

en: But such a dynamic does now seem to be in motion.
zh: 但這種動力確實不斷在推進之中。

en: Similarly, regardless of the outcome of DSK’s trial in New York, the case might represent a turning point in the treatment of women in Europe.
zh: 同樣，不管IMF前總裁的紐約審判結果如何，這個案子都將成為歐洲女性社會待遇的一個轉折點。

en: Public and private displays of atavistic machismo, one hopes, will no longer be considered acceptable.
zh: 在人們的意識中，那種對公開或私下的返祖式大男子主義行為的認同也將一去不返了。

en: In the Arab world, too, from Tunis to Cairo, young women have played an important role in the revolutionary process.
zh: 與此同時在從突尼西亞到開羅的阿拉伯世界裡，年輕女性在這場茉莉花革命中也扮演了重要角色。

en: Their appetite for change – understandable, given the treatment of women in traditional Muslim societies – appears to be one of the main causes underlying the force of the revolutionary impulse in Tunisia and Egypt.
zh: 她們對變革的渴望 — — 只要想一下她們在傳統穆斯林社會中的待遇，就不難理解這種渴望了 — — 成為了突尼西亞和埃及革命動力的主要來源之一。

en: None of this is to argue that “women” are a universal force for positive change in Europe and around the world.
zh: 但上述一切也並不能證明“女性”就是歐洲以及全世界改革的積極力量。

en: Consider, for example, Marine Le Pen, the new head of France’s National Front, Elena Ceaucescu, the sordid wife of the former Romanian dictator, or, more recently, Tunisian ex-President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali’s wife, Leila Trabelsi, who fled to Dubai with 1.5 tons of gold plundered from the central bank.
zh: 不要忘記這世界上還有諸如法國國民陣線的新女領袖馬琳·勒龐，惡行累累的前羅馬尼亞獨裁者之妻埃列娜·齊奧塞斯庫，以及最近曝光的萊拉·特拉貝爾西，這位突尼西亞前總統本阿里的妻子逃亡到了迪拜，還不忘帶上從突尼西亞中央銀行盜取的1.5噸黃金。

en: The point, simply, is that with so many people in so many countries demanding far-reaching change, the politics of gender is very much in play – in Europe and beyond.
zh: 簡而言之，在歐洲境內外的眾多國家之中有如此多人渴望實現意義深遠的革新，那麼性別政治也會在其中大顯身手。

en: The main question is whether the growing number of women in politics will deliver the different perspectives and modes of leadership that many voters (or protesters) now seem to crave.
zh: 但最主要的問題是，隨著女性政治參與度的不斷上升，她們又是否能創造出選民（或示威者們）渴望的嶄新前景和領導模式呢？

en: A Euro Sabbatical
zh: 休病假的歐元區受災國

en: MUNICH – Under substantial external pressure, the eurozone’s crisis-hit countries are, at long last, bringing themselves to make painful cuts in their government budgets.
zh: 發自慕尼黑 — — 在持續的外部壓力之下，那些遭到危機侵襲的歐元區國家終於放棄了長期以來的抵抗，開始忍痛削減財政預算。

en: Salaries are being slashed and public employees sacked to reduce new borrowing to a tolerable level.
zh: 一方面大幅下調工資水平，另一方面削減公務員職位，希望能令新增債務的規模維持在一個可忍受的水平上。

en: And yet, competitiveness in Greece and Portugal, in particular, is not improving.
zh: 但這些國家的競爭力 — — 尤其是希臘和葡萄牙 — — 卻並未得到改善。

en: The latest Eurostat figures on the evolution of the price index for self-produced goods (GDP deflator) show no tendency whatsoever in the crisis-stricken countries towards real devaluation. But real devaluation, achieved by lowering prices vis-à-vis their eurozone competitors, is the only way to re-establish these countries’ competitiveness.
zh: 最新的歐盟統計局數字顯示：無論哪個受災國家的自產商品價格指數（扣除GDP中的通貨膨脹因素後）都沒有出現向實質性貶值靠攏的趨勢，而如果要重新樹立競爭力優勢的話就只能透過壓低與其他歐元區國家競爭時的我方報價，也就是實質性貶值。

en: A reduction in unit labor costs can also increase competitiveness only to the extent that it actually results in price reductions.
zh: 也只有在真正實現價格下降的情況下，單位勞動力成本的降低才能轉化為競爭力的提升。

en: After all, it was price inflation in the crisis countries, fueled by massive inflows of cheap credit following the introduction of the euro, that resulted in their loss of competitiveness, ballooning current-account deficits, and accumulation of enormous foreign debt.
zh: 畢竟，正是在引入歐元后廉價信貸大量湧入，隨後引發價格通貨膨脹才最終導致了這些國家的競爭力下降，經常賬戶赤字膨脹和大量外債的積累。

en: Now that capital markets are no longer willing to finance these deficits, prices should be going into reverse, but this, obviously, is not happening.
zh: 如今資本市場已不願再去填補這些赤字缺口，因此價格應該逆向走低，但很顯然，預料中的這一切都沒有發生。

en: In 2010, inflation in some of the crisis countries lagged slightly behind that of their eurozone competitors.
zh: 在2010年，某些歐元區危機國的通脹水平僅比同區競爭者低一點點。

en: The latest Eurostat figures for the third quarter of 2011, however, are already showing a different picture: the price level in Portugal and Greece has remained practically unchanged over the course of the year, and in Italy and Spain it even rose slightly (by 0.4% and 0.3%, respectively).
zh: 但最新的2011年第三季度歐盟統計局數字則展示出一個截然不同的畫面：葡萄牙和希臘的價格水平在經歷了一整年的救災行動後依然維持原狀，義大利和西班牙的價格水平甚至還分別略微上升了0.4%和0.3 % 。

en: Only Ireland continued on a path of rapid deflation – as it has since the country’s real-estate bubble burst in 2006 – with a relative price decrease of 2.2%.
zh: 只有愛爾蘭繼續在迅速貶值 — — 從該國2006年地產泡沫爆破之後就是如此，至今相對價格已經下跌了2.2 % 。

en: On the whole, Ireland has become cheaper relative to its eurozone competitors by a total of 15% over the course of the past five years.
zh: 從整體上看，在經歷了五年調整後愛爾蘭相對於其他歐元區競爭者來說價格已經便宜了總共15 % 。

en: This internal devaluation is paying off: while Ireland was still running a current-account deficit of 5.6% of GDP in 2008, the European Commission expects the outturn for 2011 to have been a 0.7%-of-GDP current-account surplus.
zh: 這一內部貶值程序是有所回報的：愛爾蘭在2008年時的經常賬戶赤字相當於GDP的5.6 % ， 而歐盟委員會預計該國會在2011年實現相當於GDP0.7%的盈餘。

en: True, much of this is mere debt-service relief, given that Ireland was able to repay its foreign liabilities with self-printed money, for which it pays only 1% interest.
zh: 沒錯，考慮到愛爾蘭可以自己印刷貨幣來償還那些利率只有1%的外債，上述大部分成果都僅僅是緩解了債務償付問題。

en: However, Ireland’s big trade surplus did improve further.
zh: 但愛爾蘭的大宗貿易盈餘確實得到了進一步改善。

en: Ireland owes much of this turnaround to its efficient export sector, whose supporters were able to enforce a political U-turn.
zh: 愛爾蘭所實現的逆轉大部分都歸功於其高效的出口部門 — — 這些部門的支持者們有能力促成政治上的轉向。

en: Greece, on the other hand, is under the influence of a strong import lobby.
zh: 相反希臘國內進口部門的遊說力量卻極為強大。

en: As the Greek economics minister, Michalis Chrysochoidis, has said, this is attributable to European Union subsidies, which drove entrepreneurs to follow the easy money into the import sector.
zh: 正如希臘經濟部長米哈利斯·赫裡索希季斯（Michalis Chrysochoidis）所說，這都要怪歐盟實施的補貼政策，搞得企業家們都跑到進口部門去掙快錢了。

en: Now these importers form a powerful bulwark against any policy that causes deflation, even though lowering prices – and thereby redirecting Greek demand from foreign to domestic products and helping tourism – is the only way to put the Greek economy back on its feet.
zh: 如今這些進口商已經構築了一個強大的壁壘來抵制任何可能引發通貨緊縮的政策，即便降低價格 — — 並因此將希臘的需求從外部轉向內部產品同時扶助旅遊業發展 — — 才是讓希臘經濟重回正軌的唯一方法。

en: Since Greece’s current-account deficit as a share of GDP was three times higher than Ireland’s, Greek prices would have to fall by about half to achieve the same kind of success.
zh: 由於希臘經常賬戶赤字佔GDP的比例比愛爾蘭高三倍，希臘的價格水平也必須下跌一半才能取得愛爾蘭那樣的成就。

en: It is inconceivable that Greece could manage that within the eurozone without widespread social unrest, if not conditions approaching those of civil war.
zh: 但誰也不相信希臘能在避免大規模社會動亂 — — 說不定還會瀕臨內戰邊緣 — — 的情況下作為歐元區成員國實現這一點。

en: But it isn’t just importers who are blocking real devaluation. Unions, too, are resisting the necessary wage reductions, and public and private debtors fear the prospect of insolvency if their assets and revenues are assessed at a lower value, while their debts remain unchanged.
zh: 而且阻止實質性貶值的不僅僅是進口商，公會也在抵制必要的工資削減，雖然債務總額依然不變，但無論公私債務人都害怕國家破產預期會令自己的資產和收益估值降低。

en: The situation is intractable.
zh: 由此可見，情況相當棘手。

en: Many people regard debt relief and socialization of debts as the only way out.
zh: 許多人都認為債務緩解以及債務社會化才是唯一出路。

en: This help has been given.
zh: 但其實這類手段早就實施了。

en: The recent agreement gave Greece relief of €237 billion ($316 billion), about 30% more than Greece’s net national income of roughly €180 billion euros.But such help only entrenches the wrong prices – and thus the economy’s lack of competitiveness.
zh: 最近簽訂的協議減免了希臘2370億歐元（摺合3160億美元）的債務，比希臘約1800億歐元的淨國民收入還高出30 % 。 但這類援助僅僅是鞏固了那些錯誤的價格 — — 以及隨之產生的國家競爭力低下狀況。

en: The debts will re-emerge like a tumor, growing year by year, while undermining the creditworthiness of stable eurozone countries.
zh: 這些債務會像一個腫瘤一樣重新滋長起來，一天比一天更大，同時還會腐蝕那些穩健歐元區國家的資信可靠度。

en: If that happened, the euro would eventually collapse.
zh: 如果出現這個情況的話，歐元將最終走向崩潰。

en: Only a price reduction would create current-account surpluses and enable the crisis countries to pay off their foreign debts.
zh: 只有降低價格才能創造經常賬戶盈餘並令這些受災國家得以償還自身外債。

en: It is time for Europe to come to terms with this remorseless truth.
zh: 而歐洲如今也是時候面對這個殘酷的現實了。

en: Those crisis countries that do not want to take it upon themselves to lower their prices should be given the opportunity to leave the eurozone temporarily in order to devalue prices and debts.
zh: 那些不願意自己行動起來降低價格的受災國家應該獲得一個暫時脫離歐元區以削減價格和債務的機會。

en: In other words, they should take a kind of euro sabbatical – a proposal that has now also been taken up by American economist Kenneth Rogoff.
zh: 換句話說，他們應該放一個歐元意義上的離崗病假 — — 正如美國經濟學家肯尼思·羅格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）建議的那樣。

en: After the ensuing financial thunderstorm died down, the sun would come out again very quickly.
zh: 在在隨之而來的金融風暴逐漸散去之後，陽光將很快重新普照大地。

en: The creditor countries would have to shoulder big losses from write-downs, but they would still end up with more than they would have gotten had the crisis countries remained within the eurozone, because these countries’ new prosperity, gained by leaving, offers the only chance of recovering any assets at all.
zh: 那些債權國可能要承擔因債務減免而帶來的巨大損失，但相對於把那些受災國留在歐元區內的做法，前者最終獲得的好處會更多，因為這些受災國透過脫離而實現的繁榮才是重新追回所有資產的唯一機會。

en: A Fair Deal for Turkey
zh: 土耳其的公平待遇

en: Turkey has been given what looks like an ultimatum from the EU Commission: open your ports for ships from Cyprus within a month, or you may risk a halt to the EU accession talks now underway.
zh: 土耳其好像收到了歐盟委員會的最後通牒，那就是在一個月內向來自塞普勒斯的船隻開放港口，否則，就有暫停目前正在進行的入盟談判的危險。

en: At the same time, the Commission’s latest report on Turkey’s progress toward accession notes that political reforms have slowed down, further calling into question the country’s future EU membership.
zh: 與此同時，委員會有關土耳其入盟進展的最新報告說明，政治改革已經放慢，從而進一步質疑該國未來加入歐盟的可能性。

en: The Commission’s progress report will be dealt with by the European Council next month.
zh: 歐盟理事會將在下月研究歐盟委員會的進展報告。

en: At that meeting, European leaders should ask themselves the following questions: Has the EU given Turkey a fair deal in the case of Cyprus?
zh: 在這一會議中，歐洲領導人應當向他們自己提出下面的問題：在塞普勒斯問題上，歐盟是否公平對待土耳其？

en: Has the EU’s behavior been consistent in supporting political reform in Turkey?
zh: 歐盟是否一如既往地支援土耳其的政治改革？

en: What are the EU’s long-term interests vis-à-vis Turkey?
zh: 在土耳其的問題上，歐盟的長久利益是什麼？

en: If the answers to the first two questions are “no” – as I believe they are – the third question becomes vitally important.
zh: 如果前兩個問題的答案正如我所相信的那樣是否定的話，那麼，第三個問題就極為重要。

en: True, Turkey has closed its ports to ships from (Greek) Cyprus, and this is a violation of agreements.
zh: 確實，土耳其對(希臘)塞普勒斯關閉了其港口，這違反了協議。

en: But it is also true that the northern Turkish part of Cyprus is denied access to free trade and other benefits from EU-membership.
zh: 但是，拒絕給予塞普勒斯北部的土耳其部分歐盟成員的自由貿易待遇以及其他利益也是事實。

en: This is because Cyprus remains a divided island.
zh: 這是因為塞普勒斯依然還是一個分裂的島嶼。

en: It was assumed that Cyprus should be united when the country joined the EU in 2004.
zh: 當時認為，當塞普勒斯在2004年加入歐盟之時將會統一。

en: A United Nations plan for unification was accepted by the Turkish part.
zh: 土耳其方面接受了聯合國提出的統一方案。

en: But the Greek Cypriots voted against the plan because their leaders did not live up to the implicit deal with the EU to support it.
zh: 但是，希臘族塞普勒斯的領導人並沒有遵守與歐盟的默契來支援這一方案，因此，它投票否決了這一方案。

en: Nevertheless, Cyprus became an EU member – but only the Greek part.
zh: 但是，塞普勒斯成為了歐盟成員，但僅僅是希臘部分。

en: This was clearly a mistake, because it made the EU part of the conflict.
zh: 這明顯是一個錯誤，因為它使得歐盟成為衝突的一部分。

en: It gave Greek Cypriot leaders the possibility of blocking progress in negotiations between the EU and Turkey.
zh: 它給了塞普勒斯希臘族領導人阻礙歐盟與土耳其之間談判進展的可能性。

en: So how can Turkey under these conditions maintain confidence in the EU’s fairness?
zh: 那麼，在這種情況下，土耳其如何對歐盟的公平維持信心呢？

en: Political and legal reforms in Turkey in recent years have been remarkably far-reaching, for they have clearly been spurred by Turks’ wish to move closer to the EU.
zh: 近年來土耳其的政治和法治改革極為廣泛，因為土耳其人向歐盟靠攏的願望促進了這些改革。

en: But Turkish public support for EU membership has fallen dramatically as Turks have grown to feel that they are not being given a fair deal.
zh: 但是，土耳其人越發感覺到他們沒有得到公平待遇，因此土耳其公眾對於入盟的支援已經急劇下降。

en: This has given new strength to those who want Turkey to develop in another direction, towards a more Islamic society instead of a modern secular state.
zh: 這樣，就給那些想要讓土耳其向另一個方向發展的人增添了新的力量。 他們想要讓土耳其向更為伊斯蘭社會、而非現代世俗國家的方向發展。

en: Therefore, the recent lack of progress in Turkey’s reform process can to a large extent be explained by the EU’s behavior.
zh: 因此，歐盟的舉動就可以在很大程度上解釋最近土耳其的改革程序缺乏進展了。

en: This leaves us with the third question: what kind of Turkey does the EU want?
zh: 這樣就出現了第三個問題：歐盟想要一個什麼樣的土耳其？

en: There should be no doubt about the answer: it is clearly in the EU’s interest to see Turkey’s democracy and economy continue to strengthen.
zh: 對於這一問題應當沒有疑問，那就是，土耳其的民主和經濟繼續得到加強顯然符合歐盟的利益。

en: More than 40 years ago, it was promised that once Turkey lives up to the preconditions for membership, it will be welcome in the EU.
zh: 四十多年前，歐盟保證說一旦土耳其滿足了成員的先覺條件就將歡迎其入盟。

en: It is high time that European leaders take this promise seriously.
zh: 現在，歐盟領導人們應當認真履行這一保證了。

en: It is a sad fact that a large majority of voters in the EU are against Turkish membership.
zh: 歐盟內部的大多數選民反對土耳其入盟，這是一個悲哀的事實。

en: But they are reacting to the current situation.
zh: 但是，他們不過是對當前的局勢做出反應。

en: When they are asked if they would like a reformed Turkey as a partner – a Turkey that lives up fully to the conditions for membership described in the Copenhagen Criteria (democracy, rule of law, respect for human rights, and an effective market economy) – many more are inclined to say yes.
zh: 如果問他們，他們是否想要一個改革後的土耳其作為夥伴，有更多的人傾向於說是的。 所謂改革後的土耳其，就是完全符合哥本哈根標準指定的入盟條件，也就是民主、法治、尊重人權以及有效的市場經濟。

en: European leaders must therefore take up two challenges.
zh: 因此，歐洲領導人必須接受兩項挑戰。

en: First, they should say clearly to their own voters that the EU must live up to its promises to Turkey, and that this is in the larger interest of all Europeans.
zh: 首先，他們應當向自己的選民明確地說明，歐盟必須遵守對土耳其所做得保證，而且，這也符合所有歐洲人更大的利益。

en: Second, they should give Turkey a fair deal in the negotiations.
zh: 第二，他們必須在談判中公平對待土耳其。

en: The first litmus test on European leadership concerns the practical problem of access to harbors.
zh: 歐洲領導作用的第一塊試金石就是有關使用港口的現實問題。

en: Here the Finns, who chair the EU right now, have taken an initiative to implement a pragmatic solution that takes into consideration both sides in the conflict.
zh: 在這一問題上，歐盟輪值主席國芬蘭提議落實一項現實的、考慮衝突雙方的解決方案。

en: The Finnish initiative should be given strong support from all European leaders.
zh: 所有歐洲領導人都應該大力支援芬蘭的提議。

en: At the same time, a new effort should be made to bring life to the UN’s proposals regarding Cyprus.
zh: 同時，應當重新努力讓聯合國有關塞普勒斯的提議恢復生機。

en: If this means putting pressure on some actors within the EU’s own ranks, so be it.
zh: 如果這意味著對某些歐盟成員國施加壓力，那就應當如此。

en: A Farewell to (Glorious) War
zh: 永別了（榮耀的）戰爭

en: In recent days, Italy’s government fell after losing a parliamentary vote on the country’s troop deployment in Afghanistan, while Britain and Denmark announced that they are to begin withdrawing their troops from Iraq.
zh: 最近幾天，義大利政府在國會中未能透過向阿富汗部署軍隊的議案之後倒臺。 同時英國和丹麥也宣佈了它們將開始把部隊撤出伊拉克。

en: Whereas the Bush administration is deploying an additional 21,000 American soldiers in Iraq, and is pushing for more allied troops in Afghanistan, America’s allies are rejecting its Middle East policy.
zh: 而布什政府卻正向伊拉克增派21000名美國士兵，並敦促盟國增兵阿富汗。 美國的盟友們正抵制其中東政策。

en: They are increasingly convinced that “victory” will be elusive in any asymmetric conflict between states, however powerful, and religiously driven armed insurgents.
zh: 它們日益堅信在任何不對稱的國家間衝突中，不論武裝叛亂者有多強大、其宗教驅動力有多深厚 ， “ 勝利”都是不可捉摸的。

en: Donald Rumsfeld’s dogma of military “transformation” – the technological upgrading of an army’s capacity to enable decisive victory with fewer troops – failed resoundingly in Iraq.
zh: 唐納德·拉姆斯菲爾德的軍事“轉型”定論—以軍隊實力的技術升級來實現用更少的部隊取得決定性勝利—在伊拉克徹底失敗。

en: Nor could Israel, with its overwhelming technological advantage, defeat Hezbollah in Lebanon.
zh: 以色列即便擁有超強的技術優勢也未能打敗黎巴嫩真主黨。

en: More rockets and missiles fell on northern Israel in 33 days than hit Britain during all of World War II.
zh: 在33天時間裡落到以色列北部的火箭和導彈數量比二戰期間襲擊英國的還多。

en: So the Israelis now must reckon with an entirely new phenomenon: an asymmetric entity, Hezbollah, with nation-state firepower.
zh: 因此以色列人現在必須正視這一全新的現象：一個擁有國家級火力的不對稱實體，真主黨。

en: So the fierce debate over whether to increase the size of American ground forces in Iraq is beside the point.
zh: 所以關於是否應該擴大美軍駐伊拉克地面部隊規模的激烈爭論是毫無意義的。

en: Neither the Soviet experience in Afghanistan in the 1980’s nor NATO’s today vindicates the claim that troop numbers are what matter most on the modern battlefield.
zh: 前蘇聯1980年代在阿富汗的經驗和北約當今的情況都無法證明軍隊的數量是現代戰場上最為重要的因素這一命題。

en: When geo-strategic military front lines are non-existent, as in Kosovo, Afghanistan, and Iraq, mass no longer equals victory.
zh: 當地緣戰略軍事前沿不復存在，正如在科索沃、阿富汗和伊拉克那樣，人多勢眾就不再等同於勝利。

en: The great military thinker Carl von Clausewitz’s notion of “decisive battles” as the “center of gravity” of war is simply irrelevant to conflicts that have no visible “center of gravity.”
zh: 偉大的軍事思想家克勞斯·馮·克勞塞維茨關於將“決定性戰役”作為戰爭的“重心”的理念在全然沒有“重心”的衝突中也失去了用武之地。

en: Indeed, while wars from the time of Hannibal’s defeat of the Romans in 216 B.C. to the Gulf War of 1991 had this center of gravity, with a massive concentration of force capable of bringing an enemy to its knees, such industrial inter-state wars have now become an historical anachronism.
zh: 的確，儘管從公元前216年漢尼拔擊潰羅馬人到1991年的海灣戰爭都有一個這樣的重心（其表現是能對敵方施以毀滅性打擊的軍事力量的大規模集中 ） ， 而這種工業化的國家間戰爭現在已經成為歷史陳跡。

en: Most states nowadays lie within borders that are widely accepted as legitimate, and they increasingly abide by international norms of behavior in times of war.
zh: 現今大多數國家都有被廣泛認可的合法邊界，它們在戰爭時期也越來越遵守國際規範和行為準則。

en: In fact, the obligation of states to abide by humanitarian rules of conduct while their enemies are free to barbarize warfare is what makes asymmetric wars especially insoluble.
zh: 事實上，國家遵守人道主義行為規範的義務與其敵方肆意挑起野蠻戰事的矛盾使得不對稱的戰爭特別難以調解。

en: Moreover, in an era of global media and international war crimes courts, the criteria for states’ use of military force have become more complex than ever.
zh: 此外，在一個全球性媒體和國際戰爭罪行法庭的時代，國家使用武力的條件變得越來越複雜。

en: Inter-state combat may still occur where strategic front lines can be found, such as Israel’s border with Syria, India’s border with Pakistan, and the border dividing the two Koreas.
zh: 在戰略前沿存在的地方，如敘以邊界、印巴邊界和南北韓分界線，國家間的武裝衝突仍然可能發生。

en: In such cases, war, as the Egyptians showed in 1973, might still serve as an avenue to resolving a conflict.
zh: 在這種情況下，戰爭，正如埃及人在1973年所展示的那樣，仍可能成為解決衝突的一種途徑。

en: The Syrians might be tempted to launch an offensive against Israel with the objective of breaking the deadlock over the future of the Golan Heights.
zh: 敘利亞人可能會企圖對以色列發起進攻以達到打破戈蘭高地未來僵局的目的。

en: However, in the case of Kashmir, the asymmetric conflict currently fought by proxies and terrorist groups might not degenerate into all-out war precisely because India and Pakistan have mutual nuclear deterrence.Indeed, such asymmetric conflicts through proxies have become the new conventional way that states avoid the price of a general war.
zh: 然而，在克什米爾問題上，現在由代理人和恐怖分子集團參與的不對稱衝突可能不會退化為一場全面的戰爭，恰恰是由於印度和巴基斯坦都擁有相互的核威懾。 的確，這種透過代理人進行的不對稱衝突已成為各個國家避免付出全面戰爭代價的新的常規方式。

en: This changing nature of the battlefield essentially means that war as a conclusive event in an international conflict has become obsolete.
zh: 戰場不斷變化的特點從本質上意味著戰爭作為國際衝突的決定性事件的理念已經過時了。

en: The facile Clausewitzian wisdom that military action ultimately leads to a political solution is no longer convincing.
zh: 克勞塞維茨式的 認為軍事行動最終將導致政治解決的淺顯理論已不再讓人信服。

en: “Victory” cannot bring peace, simply because there will always be a war after the war.
zh: “勝利”不能帶來和平，就是因為戰爭還會接連不斷地發生。

en: Thus, for example, the conventional war in Kosovo lasted for two months, only to usher in a six-year asymmetric conflict.
zh: 因此，例如，科索沃的常規戰爭持續了兩個月，就開啟了長達六年的非對稱衝突的序幕。

en: Likewise, America’s three-week “shock and awe” campaign in Iraq in 2003 ended in “victory,” but opened the gates of hell for occupiers and ordinary Iraqis alike.
zh: 同樣，美國2003年在伊拉克發動的為期三週的“震懾行動”戰役以“勝利”告終，但卻為佔領者和普通的伊拉克人開啟了地獄之門。

en: And six months after the merciless pounding of southern Lebanon, Hezbollah is as strong as it was before.
zh: 在經歷了對黎巴嫩南部六個月的無情打擊之後，真主黨的實力並未被削弱。

en: Nor does the return of the Taliban in Afghanistan six years after their overthrow now seen too far-fetched.
zh: 被推翻的塔利班六年之後在阿富汗捲土重來似乎也不是空穴來風。

en: It is during the war after the war that the occupier’s inferiority is revealed, with constant reinforcements increasing the number of targets for the insurgents far more quickly than the occupier can adapt to the changing battlefield.
zh: 佔領者的劣勢在戰後的戰鬥中暴露出來。 持續的強化部署為叛亂分子增加了目標，而佔領軍根本來不及適應戰場形勢的變化。

en: The insurgents in Iraq, as the British admit, were able in just three years to cope with their enemies’ technological superiority in a way that the IRA in Northern Ireland was unable to do in 30 years.
zh: 伊拉克的叛亂分子，正如英國人所承認的，僅用了三年的時間就能應對它們敵方的技術優勢，而同樣的應對能力北愛的愛爾蘭共和軍花了30年都沒做到。

en: The Iraq war and Israel’s wars with Hamas and Hezbollah show the limits of what military power can achieve, as well as vindicate diplomacy and conflict resolution.
zh: 伊拉克戰爭和以色列與哈馬斯及真主黨的戰爭顯示了武力的侷限性，同時也證實了外交和衝突決議的作用。

en: When it comes to tackling complex political and cultural conflicts, forging international and regional alliances around a legitimate objective is more important than sheer military capacity.
zh: 在應對複雜的政治和文化衝突時，圍繞一個合法的目的建立國際和地區性聯盟比單靠武力更為重要。

en: That said, it would be dangerously naïve to believe that the exercise of power and the capacity to intimidate are unnecessary.
zh: 雖然如此，認為使用武力和威懾力並不必要的想法也是天真得危險。

en: But the objectives of the use of force need to be linked to the recognition that in today’s asymmetric conflicts, victory is no longer achieved on the battlefield.
zh: 但使用武力的目的需要與這樣一個認識聯絡起來，即：在當今的非對稱衝突中，勝利不再能夠從戰場上獲得。

en: Only better-informed foreign policies that can address the genuine anxieties of civilizations in crisis will yield more sustainable results.
zh: 只有能應對處於危機中的文明的真正焦慮的，更明智的外交政策才能產生更具可持續性的成果。

en: A Farewell to Nuclear Arms
zh: 向核武器說再見

en: MOSCOW – Twenty-five years ago this month, I sat across from Ronald Reagan in Reykjavik, Iceland to negotiate a deal that would have reduced, and could have ultimately eliminated by 2000, the fearsome arsenals of nuclear weapons held by the United States and the Soviet Union.
zh: 莫斯科 — — 25年前的10月，我和羅納德·里根在雷克雅未克面對面討論如何削減並在2000年前徹底銷燬蘇俄雙方恐怖核武庫的事宜。

en: For all our differences, Reagan and I shared the strong conviction that civilized countries should not make such barbaric weapons the linchpin of their security.
zh: 儘管我倆存在諸多分歧，但均強烈同意文明社會不應該把如此恐怖的武器作為安全基石。

en: Even though we failed to achieve our highest aspirations in Reykjavik, the summit was nonetheless, in the words of my former counterpart, “a major turning point in the quest for a safer and secure world.”
zh: 儘管在雷克雅未克我們並未達成最高願望，但用里根的話說，這次峰會是“探尋安全穩定世界的轉折點。 ”

en: The next few years may well determine if our shared dream of ridding the world of nuclear weapons will ever be realized.
zh: 未來幾年將決定我們讓核武器從地球上消失的夢想是否能夠實現。

en: Critics present nuclear disarmament as unrealistic at best, and a risky utopian dream at worst.
zh: 批評家指出，核裁軍往好了說是不現實，往差了說純屬危險的烏托邦之夢。

en: They point to the Cold War’s “long peace” as proof that nuclear deterrence is the only means of staving off a major war.
zh: 他們指出，冷戰的“長期和平”證明，核威懾是讓大規模戰爭含而不發的唯一途徑。

en: As someone who has commanded these weapons, I strongly disagree.
zh: 作為曾經彈指間就能動用核武器的人，我強烈反對這一觀點。

en: Nuclear deterrence has always been a hard and brittle guarantor of peace.
zh: 核威懾永遠只是外強中乾的和平保障。

en: By failing to propose a compelling plan for nuclear disarmament, the US, Russia, and the remaining nuclear powers are promoting through inaction a future in which nuclear weapons will inevitably be used.
zh: 由於未能拿出完整的核裁軍計劃，美國、俄羅斯和其他有核國家正在用不作為把全世界引入不得不使用核武器的未來。

en: That catastrophe must be forestalled.
zh: 我們必須先下手為強，阻止這一災難的發生。

en: As I, along with George P. Shultz, William J. Perry, Henry A. Kissinger, Sam Nunn, and others, pointed out five years ago, nuclear deterrence becomes less reliable and more risky as the number of nuclear-armed states increases.
zh: 正如我和喬治·舒爾茨（George P. Shultz ） 、 威廉·佩裡（William J. Perry ） 、 亨利·基辛格、山姆·那恩（Sam Nunn）等人五年前所指出的，隨著有核國家數量的增加，核威懾變得越來越不可靠、越來越危險。

en: Barring preemptive war (which has proven counterproductive) or effective sanctions (which have thus far proven insufficient), only sincere steps toward nuclear disarmament can furnish the mutual security needed to forge tough compromises on arms control and nonproliferation matters.
zh: 只有真心實意拿出核裁軍路線圖才能制止先發制人的戰爭（已被證明只能適得其反）和有效制裁（從目前來看和“有效”還相去甚遠 ） ， 帶來共同安全感，達成關於核武器控制和核不擴散事務的艱難妥協。

en: The trust and understanding built at Reykjavik paved the way for two historic treaties.
zh: 在雷克雅未克建立起來的信任和理解為兩大歷史性條約鋪平了道路。

en: The 1987 Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces (INF) Treaty destroyed the feared quick-strike missiles then threatening Europe’s peace.
zh: 1987年的《中程核力量條約 》 （ INF）讓歐洲不再擔心快速打擊導彈。

en: And, in 1991, the first Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty (START I) cut the bloated US and Soviet nuclear arsenals by 80% over a decade.
zh: 1991年簽訂的首個《戰略武器削減條約 》 （ START1）在10年時間裡讓美蘇的巨大核武庫縮水了80 % 。

en: But prospects for progress on arms control and nonproliferation are darkening in the absence of a credible push for nuclear disarmament.
zh: 但由於缺乏可信的核裁軍計劃，核武器控制和核不擴散的前景令人堪憂。

en: I learned during those two long days in Reykjavik that disarmament talks could be as constructive as they are arduous.
zh: 我在雷克雅未克的漫長兩天中了發現，核裁軍談判的成效固然甚大，但必須投入巨大的時間和精力。

en: By linking an array of interrelated matters, Reagan and I built the trust and understanding needed to moderate a nuclear-arms race of which we had lost control.
zh: 里根和我透過將一系列相關事件聯絡起來，成功建立了緩解大有失控之勢的核競賽所需要的信任和理解。

en: In retrospect, the Cold War’s end heralded the coming of a messier arrangement of global power and persuasion.
zh: 從歷史來看，冷戰的結束讓全球實力和影響力局面更加混亂了。

en: The nuclear powers should adhere to the requirements of the 1968 Non-Proliferation Treaty and resume “good faith” negotiations for disarmament.
zh: 有核國家必須遵守1968年《核不擴散條約》的要求，重新開始關於核裁軍的“誠意”談判。

en: This would augment the diplomatic and moral capital available to diplomats as they strive to restrain nuclear proliferation in a world where more countries than ever have the wherewithal to construct a nuclear bomb.
zh: 這樣做能夠增加外交談判所需要的外交和道德資本，有助於在當前有實力建造核彈的國家數量前所未有地增多的情況下限制核擴散。

en: Only a serious program of universal nuclear disarmament can provide the reassurance and the credibility needed to build a global consensus that nuclear deterrence is a dead doctrine.
zh: 唯有真正的全球核裁軍計劃能夠為“核威懾教條已死”的全球共識提供保障和信譽。

en: We can no longer afford, politically or financially, the discriminatory nature of the current system of nuclear “haves” and “have-nots.”
zh: 不管是政治上還是財政上，我們都不能讓當前“有核”和“無核”體系的區別對待特徵繼續下去了。

en: Reykjavik proved that boldness is rewarded.
zh: 雷克雅未克峰會證明，果斷能夠帶來回報。

en: Conditions were far from favorable for a disarmament deal in 1986.
zh: 就達成核裁軍協議這件事而言，1986年我和里根所處的環境於今天根本不可同日而語。

en: Before I became Soviet leader in 1985, relations between the Cold War superpowers had hit rock bottom.
zh: 我於1985年成為蘇聯領導人時，美蘇兩大冷戰超級大國之間的關係正處於歷史冰點。

en: Reagan and I were nonetheless able to create a reservoir of constructive spirit through constant outreach and face-to-face interaction.
zh: 但是，里根和我仍然能夠透過不斷擴大的面對面互動為建設性協議創造空間。

en: What seem to be lacking today are leaders with the boldness and vision to build the trust needed to reintroduce nuclear disarmament as the centerpiece of a peaceful global order.
zh: 今日世界所缺乏的是具有遠見卓識的果敢領導人，因此無法建立重新把核裁軍置於和平的全球秩序之核心所需要的信任。

en: Economic constraints and the Chernobyl disaster helped spur us to action.
zh: 經濟約束以及切爾諾貝利災難曾經成為更進一步的刺激因素。

en: Why has the Great Recession and the disastrous meltdown at Fukushima Daiichi in Japan not elicited a similar response today?
zh: 如今，大衰退和福島核電站事故為什麼就不能造成類似的結果？

en: A first step would be for the US finally to ratify the 1996 Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty (CTBT).
zh: 第一步是美國最終批准1996年《全面禁止核試驗條約 》 （ CTBT ） 。

en: President Barack Obama has endorsed this treaty as a vital instrument to discourage proliferation and avert nuclear war.
zh: 奧巴馬總統已表態支援這一對阻止核試驗、預防核戰爭來說至關重要的工具的條約。

en: It’s time for Obama to make good on commitments he made in Prague in 2009, take up Reagan’s mantle as Great Communicator, and persuade the US Senate to formalize America’s adherence to the CTBT.
zh: 奧巴馬是時候兌現2009年在布拉格許下的承諾了，繼承里根“偉大溝通者”的衣缽，說服美國參議院正式批准美國加入CTBT。

en: This would compel the remaining holdouts – China, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Iran, Israel, North Korea, and Pakistan – to reconsider the CTBT as well.
zh: 美國的入局能迫使其他拒絕加入CTBT的國家 — — 中國、埃及、印度、印尼、伊朗、以色列、朝鮮和巴基斯坦 — — 重新考慮自己的決定。

en: That would bring us closer to a global ban on nuclear tests in any environment – the atmosphere, undersea, in outer space, or underground.
zh: ���這又能讓我們在邁向全面禁止全球核試驗 — — 不管是地面、海底、外太空還是地下 — — 的道路上更進一步。

en: A second necessary step is for the US and Russia to follow up on the New START agreement and begin deeper weapons cuts, especially tactical and reserve weapons, which serve no purpose, waste funds, and threaten security.
zh: 第二大必須步驟是美俄簽署新的戰略核武器削減條約（New START ） ， 深入落實核武器的銷燬工作，特別是戰術核武器和儲備核武器，它們根本起不到什麼作用，只能浪費資金、威脅安全。

en: This step must be related to limits on missile defense, one of the key issues that undermined the Reykjavik summit.
zh: 這一步驟必須與導彈防禦限制 — — 雷克雅未克峰會就是敗在它手上 — — 聯絡起來。

en: A fissile material cut-off treaty (FMCT), long stalled in multilateral talks in Geneva, and a successful second Nuclear Security Summit next year in Seoul, will help secure dangerous nuclear materials.
zh: 簽訂一份禁止生產核裂變材料條約（FMCT，自日內瓦多邊談判以來一直停滯不前）以及明年首爾成功舉行和安全峰會將有助於叫停危險核原料的生產。

en: This will also require that the 2002 Global Partnership, dedicated to securing and eliminating all weapons of mass destruction – nuclear, chemical, and biological – is renewed and expanded when it convenes next year in the US.
zh: 這也要求明年在美國舉行的致力於叫停和銷燬所有大規模殺傷性武器（核武器、化學武器和生物武器）的2002年全球夥伴（Global Partnership）計劃重新啟動並擴大規模。

en: Our world remains too militarized.
zh: 世界仍然處在過度軍事化的狀態。

en: In today’s economic climate, nuclear weapons have become loathsome money pits.
zh: 在當今的經濟氣候中，核武器已成為令人厭惡的資金黑洞。

en: If, as seems likely, economic troubles continue, the US, Russia, and other nuclear powers should seize the moment to launch multilateral arms reductions through new or existing channels such as the UN Conference on Disarmament.
zh: 照目前來看，如果經濟困境繼續下去，美國、俄羅斯和其他有核國家應該抓住機會，透過聯合國核裁軍會議等已有或新啟渠道推出多邊核武器削減計劃。

en: These deliberations would yield greater security for less money.
zh: 這樣的動議能夠以更低的經濟代價帶來更大的安全。

en: But the buildup of conventional military forces – driven in large part by the enormous military might deployed globally by the US – must be addressed as well.
zh: 但常規軍事力量的建設 — — 大部分是因為美軍的全球部署所致 — — 也應該有所抑制。

en: As we engage in furthering our Conventional Forces in Europe (CFE) agreement, we should seriously consider reducing the burden of military budgets and forces globally.
zh: 既然我們都參與了深化歐洲常規力量（CFE）安排，我們就應該認真考慮削減全球軍事預算和軍事力量負擔。

en: US President John F. Kennedy once warned that “every man, woman, and child lives under a nuclear sword of Damocles, hanging by the slenderest of threads, capable of being cut at any moment.”
zh: 美國總統肯尼迪曾警告“每個人，不管男人、女人還是兒童，都生活在核達摩克利斯之劍之下，千鈞之重繫於一髮，隨時隨地都有可能發斷劍落。

en: For more than 50 years, humanity has warily eyed that lethal pendulum while statesmen debated how to mend its fraying cords.
zh: ”50多年來，人類時時刻刻都在戰戰兢兢地看著性命之所繫的髮絲，而政客卻在為如何修復髮絲的磨損而吵個不可開交。

en: The example of Reykjavik should remind us that palliative measures are not enough.
zh: 雷克雅未克的教訓表明，姑息遷就是解決不了問題的。

en: Our efforts 25 years ago can be vindicated only when the Bomb ends up beside the slave trader’s manacles and the Great War’s mustard gas in the museum of bygone savagery.
zh: 只有當核彈被鎖進陳列人類野蠻歷史的博物館，與奴隸貿易者的鐐銬和一戰的芥子氣為伍時，我們在25年前的努力才能夠被證明沒有白費。

en: Affirmative Action for Europe
zh: 平權歐洲

en: The violence in France, fueled by staggering unemployment and ruthless policing, reflects the utter failure of the French model of social integration.
zh: 高居不下的失業率和魯莽的警察執法為法國的暴力衝突火上澆油。 這反映了社會一體化法國模式的徹底失敗。

en: But violence elsewhere in Europe, such as the London bombings of July and the brutal murder of Dutch filmmaker Theo van Gogh on the streets of Amsterdam in November 2004, had already made Europe’s failure to integrate its minorities painfully clear.
zh: 然而，發生在歐洲其它地方的暴力，例如7月的倫敦爆炸和2004年11月荷蘭電影製作人在阿姆斯特丹街頭被殘忍地謀殺，已經用痛苦的明瞭方式見證了歐洲在少數族裔融合上的失敗。

en: As the riots in France fade, French politicians are agonizing about how to proceed.
zh: 隨著暴亂在法國的逐漸平息，法國的政治家們又開始為何去何從而苦惱。

en: Forty years ago, after legal segregation of blacks and whites formally ended in America, the United States was confronted by similar problems.
zh: 40年前，當對黑人和白人在法律上的隔離制度正式終結後，美國也面臨過類似的問題。

en: America’s response shows, however, that integration cannot be viewed as a one-way street.
zh: 然而，美國的應對錶明民族融合不能被看作是一條單行道。

en: In addition to imposing demands and constraints on minorities to join the mainstream, society must be willing to demand of itself that it make room for all its citizens.
zh: 除了對少數族裔加入主流社會實行法律上的保障外，社會也必須自願為其所有的公民騰出空間。

en: As a potential model to be followed, Europe should look at the so-called “affirmative action” policies that America enacted to provide opportunities to blacks.
zh: 作為一種可資效仿的模式，歐洲應該仔細考察美國為給黑人提供機會而實施的所謂“平權(affirmative action ) ” 政策。

en: Affirmative action, or “positive discrimination,” as some have called these policies, began with university admissions.
zh: 平權，或又被稱作“積極差別待遇（positive discrimination ） ” ，開始於大學錄取。

en: But, in the early 1970’s, President Richard M. Nixon expanded the scope of affirmative action.
zh: 但是，在1970年代早期，尼克松總統擴大了平權的範圍。

en: As a result, ethnicity began to be weighed as a positive factor not only in university admissions, but also in public procurement decisions, credit facilities for small enterprises, and government hiring.
zh: 其結果是種族劃分開始被接受成為一種積極的因素。 這不僅表現在大學錄取過程中，也被貫徹到了公共採購決策、對小型企業的信貸和政府僱用等方面。

en: The rational for affirmative action in those early years was the fact that, after a long history of systemic injustice, merely outlawing discrimination based on race or gender would not ensure equal opportunity for all.
zh: 早期平權背後的理由是：經過長期系統性的不公正，僅僅依靠將種族和性別歧視非法化還並不足以保證所有人的機會平等。

en: Such programs are often viewed as contradicting a basic American value, namely that admissions, lending, and hiring decisions should be based on the merits of the individual, not group distinctions.
zh: 這些政策經常被認為是有悖於基本的美國價值觀，即：錄取、放貸和僱用的決策應該基於個人的成績表現，而不是種族的劃分。

en: But they remain in existence three decades later.
zh: 但三十年後，這些政策仍然存在。

en: Indeed, leading American companies, like General Motors, General Electric, and Walmart, have created affirmative action programs for hiring and selecting suppliers at their own initiative.
zh: 的確，如通用汽車、通用電氣和沃爾瑪等領導性的美國公司都已創立了自身在人員僱用和供貨商選擇方面的平權政策。

en: Similarly, anchormen and anchorwomen from all ethnic backgrounds populate American television news programs.
zh: 同樣，美國的電視新聞節目中有很多來自各種族裔背景的男女主播。

en: In France, by contrast, the appointment of the black anchorwoman Audrey Pulvar was big news on its own, because most of her colleagues in France are white.
zh: 相比之下，在法國，黑人女主播奧黛麗•布林瓦的任命本身就是一條大新聞，因為她的大多數法國同事都是白人。

en: Affirmative action in the US has been effective in creating a large African-American middle class.
zh: 美國的平權在建立一個龐大的非洲裔美國人中產階級方面卓有成效。

en: The percentage of black households earning over $50,000 a year (adjusted for inflation) has more than tripled over the last four decades, from 9.1% in 1967 to 27.8% in 2001.
zh: 在過去的40年裡，年收入超過5萬美金（計入通脹因素）的黑人家庭的百分比增長了三倍多，從1967年的9.1%增加到2001年的27.8 % 。

en: Indeed, in the US, more people of color and women hold top jobs in the public and private sector than anywhere else in the world.
zh: 的確，在美國的公私領域身居高位的有色人種和女性數量超過了世界上任何其它地方。

en: The fact that a large black underclass remains – something the recent floods in New Orleans revealed in a horrifically dramatic way – is mainly the result of failing school systems.
zh: 而龐大的黑人下層階級仍然存在的事實—被最近的新奧爾良洪水以驚人的戲劇性方式暴露出來—主要是每況愈下的學校體系造成的。

en: Affirmative action programs, of course, have always been vulnerable to attack by those who can’t benefit from them.
zh: 當然，平權政策從來就是那些不能從中獲益的人的攻擊目標。

en: In 2003, a white student asked the US Supreme Court to declare that the use of race in the University of Michigan’s admission policies violated the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment of the US Constitution.
zh: 在2003年，一位白人學生要求美國最高法院宣佈密歇根大學在招生政策中使用種族標準違反了美國憲法第十四條修正案中的《平等保護條款 》 。

en: The Supreme Court, however, ruled that the program was constitutional, citing a “compelling state interest” in racial diversity.
zh: 但最高法院裁決認為該政策符合憲法精神，並引用了種族多樣性中的“強制性國家利益”為理由。

en: “Effective participation by members of all racial and ethnic groups in the civil life of our nation,” the court said, “is essential if the dream of one nation, indivisible, is to be realized.”
zh: 判決中說 ： “ 所有種族和民族集團的成員有效地參與我們國家的公民生活，對於一個國家不可分割的夢想的實現至關重要。 ”

en: In reaching its decision, the Supreme Court took into account a legal brief submitted by 60 major American businesses, led by General Motors, asking that affirmative action be upheld.
zh: 在達成該判決的過程中，最高法院還認真參考了一份由通用汽車為首的60家美國大公司呈交的法律綱要。 該檔案要求維持平權政策。

en: They argued that the skills needed in today’s global marketplace can only be developed through exposure to a wide diversity of people.
zh: 這些公司認為，當今全球市場所需的技能只有透過族裔多樣性的溝通才能獲得。

en: Retired military officers and commanders told the court that affirmative action was essential to maintaining an integrated officer corps.
zh: 退伍的軍官和指揮官告訴法院平權對於保持軍官隊伍的完整性���關重要。

en: What America’s affirmative action programs may not do is set quotas for minorities, as this prevents competition between different groups.
zh: 美國的平權政策不可能做的就是對少數族裔設定配額，因為這會妨礙不同族裔集團之間的競爭。

en: But, in comparing groups, it is permitted to use an individual’s status as member of an under-represented minority in his or her favor.
zh: 但在進行不同族群的比較時，該政策允許將個體的少數族群成員身份作為一項對個人有利的條件。

en: As a result, a university may select a black student with a satisfactory score on the admissions test, even if there is a white student with a better score.
zh: 其結果是，即使是另一個白人學生的成績更高，大學仍可能錄用一個在入學考試中成績合格的黑人學生。

en: From the current French viewpoint, however, laws and regulations based on ethnicity are regarded as an unwelcome encroachment on the Republican ideal.
zh: 然而，從目前的法國觀點來看，基於種族的法律和法規被認為是不受歡迎的，對共和理想的侵犯。

en: French President Jacques Chirac vehemently opposes quotas for immigrants, out of fear that such a policy would stigmatize groups.
zh: 法國總統希拉剋激烈反對移民配額，擔心這樣的政策會成為種族烙印。

en: And French businesses don’t see it as their role to solve the problems of the suburbs.
zh: 而法國的公司並不認為解決郊區的問題是他們的責任。

en: Moreover, French Interior Minister Nicolas Sarkozy hasn’t done much except hand out some special grants to the smartest immigrants from the suburbs.
zh: 另外，法國內政部長Nicolas Sarkozy除了給來自郊區的最聰明的移民頒發一些特殊津貼以外也無所建樹。

en: France does have affirmative action programs, but they address poverty, not ethnicity.
zh: 法國也有平權政策，但都是針對貧困問題，而不是族群問題。

en: If European politicians are serious about preventing a schism between population groups, affirmative action is essential – not only at the workplace, but also for small business loans, home loans, public procurement, and school admissions.
zh: 如果歐洲的政治家們認真地想要防止人口族群的分裂，那么平權政策就至關重要—這不僅要體現在職場，還要體現在小額商業貸款、房屋貸款、公共採購和學校招生等方面。
