en: Tony Blair, who in July was faced with the shortcomings of integration in the UK, should take advantage of the country’s current presidency of the European Union to make affirmative action programs the top priority at next month’s summit of European government leaders in Brussels.
zh: 在7月直面了英國民族融合中的缺陷的託尼•布萊爾，應該利用英國作為目前歐盟輪值主席國的機會，將平權政策作為下月將在布魯塞爾舉行的歐洲政府首腦峰會的首要議題。

en: Affordable Green Energy
zh: 我們所負擔得起的綠色能源

en: COPENHAGEN – Public skepticism about global warming may be growing, but the scientific consensus is as solid as ever: man-made climate change is real, and we ignore it at our peril.
zh: 發自哥本哈根 — — 雖然公眾對全球變暖的質疑之聲日益滋長，但科學界對於該現象也達成了空前一致的共識：人為造成的氣候變化時確實存在，而我們卻忽視了它所造成的風險。

en: But if that issue is settled (and it should be), there is an equally large and important question that remains wide open: what should we do about it?
zh: 但如果這個問題能得到（也應該得到）解決的話，那麼就有一個同樣宏大而且重要的問題亟待解答：究竟該用什麼方法解決？

en: One prescription that is bandied about with increasing frequency certainly sounds sensible: the world should drastically cut the amount of greenhouse gases that it pumps into the atmosphere each day.
zh: 對此有一種解決方案正日漸流行，而且聽上去似乎也合情合理，那就是全世界必須大幅削減每天的溫室氣體排放量。

en: Specifically, we are told, the goal should be a 50% reduction in global carbon-dioxide emissions by the middle of the century.
zh: 具體來說，目標就是在本世紀中期將全球二氧化碳排放量減少50 % 。

en: Even its backers concede that achieving this target won’t be easy – and they are right.
zh: 而即便是該方案的支持者也自知達到這個目標非常不易 — — 他們是對的。

en: In fact, they are so right that they are wrong.
zh: 事實上，正是他們的正確導致了自身的錯誤。

en: Allow me to explain.
zh: 且聽我細細道來：

en: Our dependency on carbon-emitting fuels is more than enormous. It is overwhelming.
zh: 如今，我們對那些排放二氧化碳的燃料的依賴何止是巨大，簡直是壓倒性的，太陽能，風能以及其他熱炒的綠色能源目前僅佔全球能源消費的0.6 % 。

en: For all the talk about solar, wind, and other hyped green-energy sources, they make up only 0.6% of global energy consumption. Renewable energy overwhelmingly comes from often-unsustainable burning of wood and biomass by people in the Third World.
zh: 絕大多數可再生能源都來自於第三世界人民燃燒木柴或者其他生物燃料，而且往往是不可持續地濫用。

en: Fossil fuels account for more than four-fifths of the world’s energy diet.
zh: 而化石燃料則佔據了全世界能源總消耗量的4/5強。

en: So, in order to cut global carbon emissions in half by the middle of the century, we would obviously have to start getting a lot more of our energy from sources that don’t emit carbon.
zh: 因此如果要實現在本世紀中期將全球碳排放量減半的話，很顯然，我們必須得從那些不排放碳的資源中獲取更多的能源。

en: Can we do this?
zh: 我們能做到這一點嗎？

en: According to the International Energy Agency, here’s what it would take to achieve the goal of cutting emissions by 50% between now and mid-century:
zh: 根據國際能源署的研究，要在2050年時達到50%的碳排放削減，我們必須做到以下幾點：

en: Now consider this: this list does not describe what we would have to build between now and 2050, but what we would have to build each and every year until then!
zh: 現在再考慮一下：上面所列的可不是我們需要在未來40年間總共所需的裝置，而是這40年間每年都需要建設的裝置數量！

en: One more thing: even if we managed to do all this (which we obviously cannot), the impact on global temperatures would be hardly noticeable by 2050.
zh: 還有一點：即便我們拼死拼活把這些東西都建起來了（很顯然，這是不可能的 ） ， 但到了2050年時，這一切努力對全球氣溫的影響幾乎微乎其微。

en: According to the best-known climate-economic model, this vast undertaking would likely wind up reducing global temperatures by just one-tenth of one degree centigrade (one-fifth of one degree Fahrenheit), while holding back sea-level rises by only one centimeter (less than half an inch).
zh: 照最著名的氣候-經濟模型推算，這場大規模建設最終將把全球氣溫降低0.1攝氏度（約為0.2華氏度 ） ， 而海平面升高的幅度也只會減少1釐米（不到半英寸 ） 。

en: That’s not a lot of bang for the buck.
zh: 這可不是一筆劃算的買賣。

en: Indeed, the projected costs of this approach – some $5 trillion annually by mid-century – are so much greater than its likely benefits that it makes no sense to call it a solution at all.
zh: 實際上，這一套方案的預計成本 — — 大概5萬億美元一年 — — 相比其取得的效果來說是如此龐大，將其稱之為“解決方案”簡直就有點荒謬了。

en: Fortunately, there is a better, smarter way to deal with global warming.
zh: 幸運的是，我們還有一種更好，更明智的方法來應對全球變暖問題。

en: What if, instead of spending trillions of dollars trying to build an impossible number of power plants – or, more likely, condemning billions of people around the world to continued poverty by trying to make carbon-emitting fuels too expensive to use – we devoted ourselves to making green energy cheaper?
zh: 與其花費數千億美元興建無數的發電站 — — 或者刻意提高碳排放燃料的費用，不惜令全球數十億人生活在貧困當中 — — 不如讓我們一起努力，令綠色能源變得更加廉價。

en: Right now, solar panels are so expensive – about 10 times more than fossil fuels in terms of cost per unit of energy output – that only well-heeled, well-meaning (and, usually, well-subsidized) Westerners can afford to install them.
zh: 目前，太陽能電池板非常昂貴 — — 其能源輸出成本相當於化石燃料的10倍之多 — — 只有那些富有而熱心（而且往往手握大把補貼）的西方人才能用得起。

en: But think where we’d be if we could improve the efficiency of solar cells by a factor of ten – in other words, if we could make them cheaper than fossil fuels.
zh: 但試想，如果我們能把太陽能電池的效率提高十倍 — — 換言之，如果我��能令其比化石燃料更便宜。

en: We wouldn’t have to force (or subsidize) anyone to stop burning coal and oil.
zh: 那時我們根本不需要強迫（或補貼）人們停用化石燃料。

en: Everyone, including the Chinese and the Indians, would shift to the cheaper and cleaner alternatives – and global emission targets would automatically be met.
zh: 世界上的每個人，包括中國和印度人民，會轉向這種更廉價且清潔的替代方案 — — 而全球減排目標也自動實現了。

en: Can we achieve this technological miracle over the next 20 to 40 years?
zh: 那麼我們究竟能不能在未來20至40年間實現這一科技奇蹟呢？

en: In a word, yes.
zh: 總而言之，可以！

en: The price of solar energy has been dropping steadily for 30 years – by about 50% every decade – and we could likely accelerate that decline further with sufficiently large investments in research and development.
zh: 太陽能的價格將在未來30年內穩步下降 — — 大概每10年下降50 % — —而如果有足夠大量的資金投入研究的話，我們可以進一步加快下降的速度。

en: How large?
zh: 那麼究竟要多“大量”的資金？

en: If we were willing to devote just 0.2% of global GDP (roughly $100 billion a year) to green-energy R&D, I believe that we could bring about game-changing breakthroughs not just for solar power, but also for a wide variety of other alternative-energy technologies.
zh: 只要投入全球年度GDP的0.2 % （ 大概1000億美元）投入到研究當中，相信就能取得開創性的突破，而且不僅限於太陽能領域，其他各類可替代能源技術都將從中受益。

en: This belief in the potential of technological progress strikes some climate activists as naïve or even delusional.
zh: 我這種對技術進步潛力的信心被某些氣候活動分子認為是痴心妄想。

en: But is it really?
zh: 這是真的嗎？

en: Consider one of the miracles of the modern age – the personal computer.
zh: 想想當今世界的其中一個奇蹟 — — 個人電腦。

en: These devices didn’t become household items because governments subsidized purchases or forced up the price of typewriters and slide rules.
zh: 由於政府補貼採購並強迫提高打字機和計算尺的價格，這些裝置起初根本無緣進入普通家庭。

en: No, what happened is that, largely as a result of the space race, the United States government poured lots of money into R&D for solid-state physics and electronics engineering. The resulting breakthroughs not only got Neil Armstrong to the moon in 1969, but also made it possible for Apple to introduce the first Mac in 1976 and IBM to debut the first PC five years later.
zh: 而事實上，由於太空競賽的緣故，美國政府投入巨資到固態物理和電子工程領域，結果不僅僅是尼爾·阿姆斯特朗1969年登月成功，同時還催生了蘋果公司於1976年推出的第一臺蘋果電腦，以及5年之後IBM個人電腦的誕生。

en: We can do the same for clean energy.
zh: 這是可供潔淨能源借鑑的成功先例。

en: Forget about subsidizing inefficient technologies or making fossil fuels too expensive to use. Instead, let’s fund the basic research that will make green energy too cheap and easy to resist.
zh: 不要再試圖補貼低效率的技術或者嘗試提高化石能源的價格，反過來，讓我們去資助那些有助於令綠色能源更廉價，更讓人難以抗拒的基礎研究吧！

en: Afghanistan Is Lost Without Better Governance
zh: 沒有更好的統治，阿富汗前途黯淡

en: NEW YORK – President Obama's recent trip to Afghanistan highlighted the growing American and international perception that without better governance Afghanistan will fail.
zh: 紐約 — —

en: As President Obama apparently made clear in his late night meeting with President Hamid Karzai, no matter what other progress is made, America and its allies cannot succeed in Afghanistan unless the Afghan government succeeds—and that government is moving in the wrong direction.
zh: 今年，在阿富汗問題上，美國阿富汗及北約盟友都取得不錯的進展。

en: Until this changes, all other efforts will ultimately be in vain and current levels of international engagement with Afghanistan will become unjustifiable.
zh: 正在進行的瑪利亞行動，逮捕了位於巴基斯坦的巴拉達爾和兩名塔利班“影子內閣部長 ” ； 近期持續打擊親塔利班的哈卡尼組織等行動，都是在正確的方向上取得的勝利。

en: The United States and its Afghan and NATO allies have demonstrated unmistakable progress in Afghanistan this year.
zh: 但不管在其他方面的進展如何，只有阿富汗政府有效運作，美國及其盟友才能談得上勝利 — — 但現在，阿富汗政府正在朝著錯誤的方向前行。

en: The ongoing Marja campaign, the arrest of Mullah Abdul Ghani Baradar and two Taliban "shadow governors" in Pakistan, and the recent drone strike hitting top leaders of the Al Qaeda-affiliated Haqqani network are all clear steps in the right direction.
zh: 只有改變方向性錯誤，不然所有一切的努力都是白費，國際社會的參與也就沒了合法性。

en: President Obama has defined America's goals in Afghanistan as denying Al Qaeda a safe haven, reversing the Taliban's momentum, and helping the country's security forces and government "take lead responsibility for Afghanistan’s future."
zh: 美國總統奧巴馬將美國在阿富汗的目標設定為：擊垮基地組織老巢，阻擊塔利班和幫助阿國建立安全部隊及有效政府，以 “擔負起阿富汗未來的領導責任。

en: To this end, Obama launched an 18-month military "surge" with the backing of other NATO member countries, to be followed by the beginning of withdrawal.
zh: ”為此，在北約盟友的協助下，奧巴馬展開了在正式撤軍之前為期 18 個月的軍事行動。

en: To achieve these goals in such a short time, NATO and its Afghan partners must overcome three enormous obstacles.
zh: 為了在短時間內達到上述目標，北約及其阿富汗盟友必須克服三大障礙。

en: First, they must fight far more successfully against the Taliban to create space for rebuilding and possible negotiation.
zh: 首先，他們必須在對塔利班的戰爭中取得巨大勝利，以創造重建國家及和談的可能。

en: Second, they must convince Pakistan to begin actively opposing the Afghan Taliban and denying them the safe haven and support they currently receive in Pakistan.
zh: 第二，他們必須說服巴基斯坦積極加入反對阿富汗塔利班的行動，消除塔利班在巴的老巢。

en: Third, they must support the emergence of a legitimate Afghan government that is not, unlike the current government, seen as corrupt and ineffectual by its citizens.
zh: 第三，他們必須支援成立阿富汗合法政府，而不是現任那個腐敗低效的政權。

en: Because the NATO strategy's success requires significant progress on each of these fronts, even the current preliminary signs of military progress and in Pakistan's relations with the Afghan Taliban will be for naught if Afghanistan's government cannot establish its legitimacy domestically.
zh: 北約戰略成功來自於全方面的成功。 如果阿富汗無法建立合法政府，那麼，現在的軍事勝利和巴基斯坦對阿塔利班的打擊都會毀於一旦。

en: Recent efforts by President Hamid Karzai’s administration to limit its public accountability demonstrate that the Afghan government in its current form lacks either the capacity or the willingness to do so.
zh: 近期對卡爾扎伊政府的不信任顯示出目前的政權缺乏能力和意願來管理國家。

en: For at least a year prior to the August 2009 elections, NATO officials recognized that ordinary Afghans' disgust with their government's massive corruption was among the Taliban's most effective recruitment tools.
zh: 早在 2009 年 8 月的大選之際，北約官員就發現，普通阿富汗民眾對政府大規模腐敗感到厭惡，這也是塔利班徵兵的一個最有效藉口。

en: At that time, these officials argued that the elections would give Afghanistan’s leaders a clear mandate for reform.
zh: 當時，他們原指望透過大選來幫助阿富汗領導人實施改革。

en: The deeply discredited elections put an end to those hopes.
zh: 隨後充滿舞弊的大選讓所有人都寒了心。

en: The original flaw of the 2009 elections was structural. There was no voter list, and so it was nearly impossible to prevent ballot-stuffing.
zh: 2009 年大選的失敗是全面的，沒有選民名單的選舉很難阻止舞弊發生。

en: The body empowered to conduct the vote, the Independent Election Commission, was run by commissioners all appointed by and partial to one candidate, Karzai.
zh: 作為選舉機構的獨立選舉委員會的委員，很大程度上都由卡爾扎伊任命。

en: One institution, the Electoral Complaints Commission—a hybrid Afghan-international oversight body with a majority vote controlled by United Nations-appointed commissioners—retained its credibility throughout the process.
zh: 由阿富汗和國際社會共同組成的選舉監督委員會中大部分委員由聯合國任命 — — 在選舉過程中保持一定的威信。

en: Only the presence of the ECC, particularly its international commissioners, and the hope that it would ensure at least some fairness into the process prevented the electoral controversy from erupting into open conflict.
zh: 選舉監督委員會的存在保證了選舉過程上某種程度的公平，阻止選民潛在的公開衝突。

en: As flawed as the elections were and as contentious as the outcome ultimately was, the situation would have been far worse without the ECC.
zh: 雖然整個選舉漏洞百出，但如果沒有監督委員會，情況會更加糟糕。

en: After the election, many hoped that Karzai would recognize the need to build a more accountable government to help secure both Afghanistan's future and the future of international military and financial support.
zh: 大選之後，許多人希望卡爾扎伊能建立一個值得信任政府，確保阿富汗的未來和後期維和部隊介入及國際援助的順利展開。

en: In a high-profile speech in London this past January, Karzai pledged to make progress in fighting corruption and promoting government accountability.
zh: 今年 1 月，卡爾扎伊在倫敦高調講演，承諾在反腐和推動政府誠信問題上作出努力。

en: Instead, the opposite appears to be happening.
zh: 但事實卻是恰恰相反。

en: Since his London speech, Karzai has actively opposed efforts to attack official corruption, sought to appoint warlords to his cabinet, failed to promote civil society, and weakened processes aimed at increasing the representation of women in parliament.
zh: 自從倫敦講話之後，卡爾扎伊積極反對反腐行動，把軍閥引入內閣中，無法推動公民社會的建設，反對增加婦女在議會中比例的活動。

en: To make matters worse, Karzai issued a decree on February 13 permitting him to appoint all of the ECC's members, a measure clearly designed to strengthen the patronage system and weaken opposition movements’ prospects in future elections and a strong demonstration that his administration is not serious about establishing greater government accountability.
zh: 更有甚者， 2 月 13 日，卡爾扎伊頒佈法令，讓自己任命所有選舉監督委員會成員。 這顯然是為了強化裙帶關係，以便在未來的選舉中打壓反對勢力，這清楚地表明他對提高政府誠信視為兒戲。

en: NATO and the international community must do everything possible to foster accountable government at all levels in Afghanistan.
zh: 北約和國際社會必須行動起來，竭力建立一個全方位的可信政府。

en: Although Afghanistan's government does not need to be fully centralized, Afghanistan cannot succeed if the central government fails.
zh: 雖然阿富汗政府不能完全集權，不過，如果中央政府失靈，人民也就不會幸福。

en: For this reason, unless the Karzai government changes course there is no justification for NATO member countries to risk the lives of their soldiers and commit other valuable resources to the struggle in Afghanistan if the Afghan government’s corruption and legitimacy deficit make current progress unsustainable and achievement of NATO’s goals impossible.
zh: 所以，除非卡爾扎伊作出改變，積極反腐，否則，北約盟國沒有必要讓自己計程車兵冒險和向阿提高寶貴的資源。

en: Karzai is free to lead his country as he pleases, but America and its allies cannot and should not maintain their current levels of commitment unless his government can establish itself as a viable partner.
zh: 卡爾扎伊可以按照自己的意願領導國家，不過，除非現任政府能成為有效的合作伙伴，否則美國及其盟友不能，也不應該保持自己的承諾。

en: The 18-month clock is ticking.
zh: 18 個月最後期限的倒計時已經開始。

en: No Exit from Afghanistan
zh: 阿富汗沒有出路

en: NEW DELHI – Despite frequent turmoil and repeated invasions, Afghanistan has remained virtually unchanged for centuries.
zh: 新德里—儘管動亂頻仍並一再被侵略，但幾百年來阿富汗幾乎沒有任何變化。

en: Nearly 120 years ago, Winston Churchill described the futility of warfare in the region: “Financially it is ruinous.
zh: 近120年前，溫斯頓·丘吉爾這樣描述在該地區發動戰爭的無用性 ： “ 財政上這是災難。

en: Morally it is wicked.
zh: 道德上這是邪惡。

en: Militarily it is an open question, and politically it is a blunder.”
zh: 軍事上這不確定。 政治上這是大錯。

en: Churchill’s assessment undoubtedly rings true for many United States and NATO officials today, as they attempt to coordinate an exit from America’s longest overseas combat commitment in history.
zh: ”毫無疑問，丘吉爾的評價對當今許多美國和北約官員來說是正確的警鐘 — — 他們正在組織從美國為時最長的海外戰鬥中聯合撤軍。

en: While the war in Afghanistan may have resulted in fewer American deaths and injuries than previous US wars, the human cost remains substantial – especially after factoring in Afghan deaths and injuries.
zh: 阿富汗戰爭造成美軍傷亡人數比前幾場戰爭都要少，但人力成本仍然非常巨大 — — 特別是在考慮到阿富汗方面的傷亡後。

en: Moreover, trillions of dollars have been wasted, with the few positive effects of the US-led military intervention already beginning to fade, and its many adverse consequences continuing to destabilize the region.
zh: 此外，數萬億美元被浪費，美國領導的軍事幹預所造成的少得可憐的積極效果已開始消失，副作用倒是在繼續動搖該地區。

en: US President Barack Obama is now trying to negotiate a new “status of forces” agreement with the Afghan government in order to establish how many US troops will remain in Afghanistan and the terms of their deployment.
zh: 如今，美國總統奧巴馬在試圖與阿富汗政府談判新的“駐軍地位”協議，以確定多少美軍將留駐阿富汗以及他們的部署問題。

en: But the reality is that the US is scuttling from a conflict that it has lost, just as it did in Vietnam almost 40 years ago, leaving the beleaguered population to its own devices.
zh: 但現實是美國從衝突中敗北遁走，一如近40年前的越南，任其走後被包圍的群眾自生自滅。

en: Rather than admit defeat, US officials are resorting to diversionary rhetoric.
zh: 美國官員不承認失敗，反而再次祭出了轉移注意力的把戲。

en: For example, speaking recently in New Delhi, Secretary of State John Kerry said that the key to stabilizing Afghanistan is to build a “new silk road” connecting it with central Asia – a cynical contrivance apparently aimed at cloaking America’s failure in illusions of future commerce.
zh: 比如，國務卿克里在其最近的新德里演講中表示，穩定阿富汗的關鍵是建設“新絲綢之路 ” ， 將它和中亞聯絡起來 — — 這個蹩腳的藉口顯然是在用未來商業幻覺掩蓋美國的失敗。

en: Kerry’s insistence that the US is not withdrawing, but “drawing down,” is a similarly transparent attempt at manipulation.
zh: 克里堅持說美國不是撤退，而是“縮編 ” ， 這也顯然是文字操縱伎倆。

en: To be sure, America’s presence in Afghanistan has spawned important regional linkages; unfortunately, they are not the kind that support economic renewal.
zh: 毫無疑問，美國在阿富汗的存在催生了重要的地區聯絡；不幸的是，這些聯絡並不能支援經濟復甦。

en: The last decade of war and lawlessness has facilitated the Taliban’s proliferation across Pakistan and Afghanistan, leading the Taliban to consider itself an indefatigable force – a belief that could lead its leaders to undercut any progress toward stability.
zh: 過去十年的戰爭和法律真空助長了塔利班在巴基斯坦和阿富汗的滋生，導致塔利班自視為不屈不撓的軍事力量 — — 這樣的信念可能導致其領導人破壞任何通往穩定的程序。

en: In fact, the Taliban’s confidence already drove them to disrupt plans for peace talks with the Afghan government.
zh: 事實上，塔利班的信心已然促使他們干擾與阿富汗政府的和平談判計劃。

en: After agreeing to establish an office in Qatar exclusively to host the talks, in June the Taliban opened a quasi-embassy of the “Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan.”
zh: 塔利班先是同意在卡達成立一個辦公室專門用來舉行談判，但在6月，他們又與“阿富汗伊斯蘭酋長國”建立了準大使級關係。

en: The Afghan government responded by suspending talks with the Taliban, as well as the status-of-forces negotiations with the US.
zh: 阿富汗政府的反應時中止了與塔利班的談判和與美國的軍隊地位談判。

en: Pakistan recommends seeking an alternate venue for the negotiations with the Taliban, rather than abandoning reconciliation efforts altogether.
zh: 巴基斯坦建議尋找其他地點與塔利班談判，而不要一股腦兒放棄協調努力。

en: This bodes well for the resumption of talks, given that Pakistan played a leading role in facilitating the Taliban’s emergence and is now home to the Afghan Taliban’s ruling council, including its leader, Mullah Omar, along with the Pakistani Taliban.
zh: 這對重啟談判來說是個福音，因為巴基斯坦在幫助塔利班崛起方面扮演了重要角色，也是阿富汗塔利班統治委員會（包括其領袖奧馬爾）和巴基斯坦塔利班的老巢。

en: India’s former ambassador to Afghanistan, Vivek Katju, is confident that Afghan President Hamid Karzai’s anger at the Taliban’s gambit in Qatar will not delay negotiations for long.
zh: 前印度駐阿富汗大使卡特居（Vivek Katju）信心滿滿地認為，阿富汗總統卡爾扎伊對塔利班卡達策略的憤怒將長期推遲談判。

en: (Indeed, Karzai has reportedly already met with Taliban representatives for secret talks aimed at restarting the stalled peace initiative.)
zh: （事實上，卡爾扎伊已多次會見塔利班代表進行秘密談判，目的是重啟陷入停頓的和平計劃。 ）

en: Katju attributes the talks’ inevitable resumption to America’s “strategic desperation,” which is so acute that the US would be unlikely even to follow through on Kerry’s pledge to call off the talks if any link to Al Qaeda were found.
zh: 卡特居認為談判必然重啟的原因是美國的“戰略絕望 ” ， 這種絕望極其強烈，以至於如果找到與基地組織的聯絡，美國甚至不可能兌現克里取消談判的承諾。

en: After all, the US has already accepted the Taliban’s unrealistic assurances that it will not use Afghanistan as a base from which to “foment trouble” – that is, execute terrorist attacks – elsewhere.
zh: 畢竟，美國已經接受了塔利班不現實的保證 — — 不會利用阿富汗作為在別的地區“挑起麻煩 ” （ 即進行恐怖襲擊）的基地。

en: Fortunately for the US, the Taliban is no longer a homogeneous group.
zh: 對美國來說，幸事是塔利班不再是鐵板一塊的組織。

en: A decade of running and hiding from unrelenting surveillance and targeted drone attacks has caused the movement to splinter.
zh: 十年來一刻不停地與監控和定向無人機攻擊捉迷藏已經造成了塔利班內部的裂痕。

en: Yet, as the security expert Sajjan M. Gohel has observed, “the displaced and disillusioned Taliban youth of today” have “found solace and purpose in an extremely radical interpretation of Islam.”
zh: 但是，正如安全專家高爾（Sajjan M. Gohel）所觀察的 ， “ 流離失所、幻想破滅的今日塔利班青年”已經“在對伊斯蘭教的極端激進的解釋中找到了慰藉和目標。

en: The Taliban may no longer be a unified force, but they clearly remain a dangerous one.
zh: ”塔利班可能不再是團結的軍事力量，但顯然仍是極其危險的。

en: All of these developments have put India in a difficult position.
zh: 所有這些發展趨勢讓印度的處境極其艱難。

en: In Afghanistan, America’s military was so tactically dependent on Pakistan that, on several occasions, the US encouraged India to curtail development projects, such as rebuilding Afghanistan’s infrastructure.
zh: 在阿富汗，戰術上美軍極其依賴巴基斯坦，在不少情形中，美國還鼓勵印度削減開發專案，如阿富汗基礎設施的重建。

en: Following America’s military withdrawal, Afghanistan will most likely revert to pre-war conditions; Pakistan will revive state-sponsored terrorism against India; and extremism will spill into the Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir.
zh: 美軍撤退後，阿富汗極有可能回到戰前狀態；巴基斯坦國家支援的針對印度的恐怖主義將復興；極端主義���溢位波及印度查默邦和克什米爾邦。

en: In order to make the best of a grim situation, India must be prepared to protect its own interests at all costs.
zh: 為了儘量減輕不利情形，印度必須做好不惜一切代價捍衛自身利益的準備。

en: After all, as the US extricates itself from its Afghan quagmire, its own national interests will continue to trump all other considerations.
zh: 畢竟，隨著美國從阿富汗泥沼中脫身而出，其自身國家利益將繼續壓倒其他一切考慮。

en: But China, Pakistan, and Iran also have their own important national-security interests in Afghanistan that each will now do their utmost to guarantee.
zh: 但中國、巴基斯坦和伊朗也有其重要國家安全利益在阿富汗，它們都會竭盡全力維護這一利益。

en: So, while US troops may be leaving Afghanistan, an end to the violence spawned by America’s war remains nothing more than a distant dream – especially for Afghanistan’s South Asian neighbors.
zh: 因此，早美國軍隊可能離開阿富汗的同時，而由這場美國戰爭而形成的暴力平息局面也將化為一場泡影 — — 特別是對阿富汗的南亞鄰國來說。

en: Afghanistan’s Customary Anguish
zh: 阿富汗陋習所帶來的痛苦

en: FARAH, AFGHANISTAN – When the problems riddling Afghan society are listed – violence, insecurity, corruption, religious fundamentalism – one dominating factor is usually left out: the influence of customary law.
zh: 阿富汗法拉赫 — — 在歷數暴力、危險、腐敗、原教旨主義等諸多困擾阿富汗的謎題時，人人往往遺漏了一個起決定作用的因素：那就是習慣法的影響。

en: In Afghanistan, there are three principal legal references:  constitutional law, the Koran, and the system of customary law known as Farhang, the most dominant and strictest version of which is called Pashtunwali (the way of the Pashtuns).
zh: 當前影響阿富汗的主要有三大法律體系：憲法、古蘭經和被稱為Farhang的習慣法。 而在習慣法中，最重要也最嚴格的版本當屬普什圖法（Pashtunwali ） 。

en: Originally an ancient honor code, Farhang ensures the dominance of the oldest male of any household, followed by married sons, unmarried sons, and grandsons, then wives (with the youngest at the bottom).
zh: Farhang起源於古老的榮譽守則，目的是確保家庭控制權掌握在最年長的男子手中。 接下來掌握決策權的依次是已婚兒子、未婚兒子、孫子和妻子（最年輕的排在最末 ） 。

en: Collective decisions are taken by patriarchs in councils called jirgas, where all have to be in agreement.
zh: 集體決策由jirgas委員會中的長老做出，所有人都必須服從他們的決策。

en: This agreement includes including collaborating or not with the Taliban, cooperating with the Coalition forces, accepting or refusing poppy eradication in a village.
zh: 決策內容包括是否與塔利班和聯盟武裝合作，還包括接受或拒絕在村子裡剷除罌粟。

en: Everything else is left to patriarchal discretion.  Here, no one will intervene except to reinforce the application of  the patriarch's rights – say, in stoning a supposedly wayward girl, or turning a blind eye to so-called “honor killings” of women.
zh: 所有事務的生殺大權均由族長們掌握。 除鞏固族長權利外任何人無權干涉 — — 比方說用石塊砸死一個任性胡為的女孩，或者對女性所謂的“榮譽殺戮”熟視無睹。

en: Every act of an Afghan male’s life is integrated in a form of reciprocity, in which nothing is free.
zh: 阿富汗男性生命中的一舉一動均包含某種形式的互換，沒有什麼東西是不付出代價就可以得到的。

en: Melmastia, the basic tenet of hospitality means “I will give you shelter if you ask me to, even if you are a fugitive murderer; but, in exchange, you fight my battles.”
zh: Melmastia（互惠互利）是人際交往的基本原則，它意味著“即使你是亡命天涯的殺人兇手，只要來求我幫助我也會為你提供棲身之所，但交換條件是，你必須為我戰鬥。

en: This sense of customary obligation is why so many of President Hamid Karzai’s cronies remain in place and Taliban leaders remain safe.
zh: ”這種約定俗成的責任意識就可以解釋為什麼哈米德·卡爾扎伊總統的那麼多親信依然在位，也可以解釋塔利班領導人為什麼仍然安全。

en: Women are excluded from collective decision-making, as they are mere objects.
zh: 女人被排斥在集體決策的過程之外，因為她們不過是沒有思想的物品。

en: Girls are literally sold upon marriage (the father is paid money for his daughter’s labor and reproductive capacity) and join their husband’s household.
zh: 女孩在結婚時基本上是待價而沽（父親能為自己女兒的勞動和生育能力而得到報酬 ） ， 並在婚後進入丈夫的家族。

en: The younger the girl, the higher the price.
zh: 越年輕的女孩售價就越高。

en: Marriage, especially in the provinces, is routinely consummated on pre-pubescent bodies.
zh: 尤其是在阿富汗所屬各省，結婚的通常都是尚在青春期的女孩。

en: Yet women are precious in their own way.
zh: 但女性也有女性的寶貴之處。

en: A family’s principal “cultural capital” is its honor, which is ensured by denying women any opportunity to highlight male failings and therefore tarnish clan respectability.
zh: 一個家族主要的“文化資本”是家族的榮耀，而保護家族榮耀必須確保不讓女性有任何機會指出男性所犯的錯誤、從而玷汙家族的名望。

en: As a result, women must be strictly secluded and made invisible when in public, for they are personally responsible for the desire that they could ignite in schools, hospitals, parks, or markets.
zh: 因此，必須讓女性徹底與世隔絕，不在公眾場合拋頭露面，因為女性出現在學校、醫院、公園或市場可能點燃的慾望都要由她們自己負責。

en: The all-covering burqa ensures sufficient anonymity to permit women a certain amount of freedom in public space.
zh: 把渾身上下包裹得嚴嚴實實的長袍可以很好地隱藏她們的身份，讓她們一定程度上能在公共場所自由活動。

en: Every female simultaneously carries her father’s and her husband’s honor, and will stoically submit to all forms of violence committed in its name.
zh: 每位女性同時肩負著父親和丈夫的榮耀，對於所有以上述名義強加的暴力都必須無條件的服從。

en: This may mean dying in childbirth rather than risking the “dishonor” of giving birth in a public place, a hospital, in front of strangers.
zh: 這或許意味著她們必須選擇寧願在生孩子的時候死去，也不能甘冒受辱的危險去醫院這樣的公共場所接受陌生人的幫助。

en: Going to court is practically unheard of, as it would mean renouncing family practices.
zh: 上法院更是幾乎聞所未聞，因為這意味著放棄家族決定權。

en: From the male point of view, resorting to outside police or judicial intervention would signify an inability to fight one’s own battles – an admission of defeat and a symbolic castration.
zh: 從男性的角度看，求助於外來的警察或司法力量意味著沒有能力獨立作戰 — — 這等同於承認失敗並接受象徵性的閹割。

en: This helps explain the intense corruption present in Afghan courts, where “honor” can be redeemed by bribing a judge to have a rapist or murderer released.
zh: 這有助於解釋阿富汗法院存在的嚴重腐敗現象，人們相信可以透過賄賂法官釋放強姦或殺人犯來贖回“榮耀 ” 。

en: As violence is strictly a private matter, relinquishing justice to state institutions could be an unacceptable humiliation.
zh: 因為暴力純屬於私人事務，將裁決權拱手讓給國家機構可以成為一種令人無法忍受的恥辱。

en: Customary law is not rigid in that it is made to fit round the demands of global economy.
zh: 習慣法在最初誕生時並不死板，因為它需要適應全球經濟發展的需求。

en: It has become more rigorous in it s applications due to the influence ofmilitant Islam, which seeks to use religious texts to legitimize escalating brutality, especially against women.
zh: 後來在執行上越來越僵化死板主要是受到伊斯蘭好戰主義的影響，好戰份子試圖藉助宗教教義來實現暴力升級、特別是使針對婦女的暴力合法化。

en: However, Farhang and privatized violence are precisely what Mohammad sought to ban through Koranic law, which went beyond the personal domain and instituted a code that gave some rights to women.
zh: 但是，Farhang和個人暴力正是默罕默德希望透過古蘭經法律禁止的行為，它已經超越了私人事務領域，制定了一部法規，並將某種形式的權利賦予了女性。

en: For example, while the Koran allows for a measure of female inheritance, tribal custom does not authorize it, which explains the popularity of tribal councils to resolve inheritance problems and cheat women out of their rights.
zh: 比方說，儘管古蘭經允許對女性的繼承權進行考量，但部族慣例對此卻並不認可，這也可以解釋為什麼靠欺騙婦女放棄繼承權來解決繼承問題在部族委員會如此盛行。

en: Similarly, whereas the Koran requires four eyewitnesses as proof of adultery, mere suspicion of some unregulated, potentially sexual conduct by a woman warrants stoning under customary law.
zh: 同樣，古蘭經規定必須有四名目擊證人才能證實通姦罪，但僅僅懷疑一名女性可能發生過違法性行為就足以按照習慣法的規則對其處以石刑。

en: Yet an awareness of alternatives is seeping in through the media, even in remote provinces.
zh: 但即使是在最邊遠的省份，對於替代性選擇的認識也正透過媒體逐漸地向人們滲透。

en: Iranian films and the much loved Indian TV serials, not to mention the occasional American film, influence peoples' expectations.
zh: 伊朗影片和備受喜愛的印度連續劇，更不要說偶爾上映的美國電影都在潛移默化地影響著人們的看法。

en: Add to that the experience of having lived abroad as refugees in Pakistan and Iran.
zh: 曾經在巴基斯坦和伊朗的難民生活經歷也起到同樣的作用。

en: Girls know that there are options to an unacceptable way of life: women are increasingly demanding more from life than what custom ordains.
zh: 女孩們知道除接受無法容忍的生活方式外還有其他選擇：在習俗規定的範圍外，女性對生活提出了越來越多的要求。

en: This is especially true for those who have lived in Iran, a totally Muslim environment that allows women the freedom to study and work as well as access to adequate healthcare and family planning.
zh: 那些曾經在伊朗生活的人尤其如此，那裡雖然是純而又純的穆斯林環境，但卻允許婦女自由地學習和工作，也可以享有充分的醫療和計劃生育保障。

en: Once back in rural Afghanistan, forced into brutal marriages, many desperate women – especially returnees from Iran – resort to self-immolation.
zh: 一旦返回到阿富汗農村，被迫接受野蠻的婚姻，許多絕望的女性 — — 特別是從伊朗回國的女性 — — 寧願選擇自我毀滅的道路。

en: Violence and murder of women are on the increase, perpetrated by men who feel that these alternatives pose a threat to their authority.
zh: 針對婦女的暴力和謀殺呈上升趨勢，因為犯罪的男性感到這些選擇對他們的權威構成了挑戰。

en: The West imagines that religion is the central issue in Afghanistan.
zh: 西方人普遍認為宗教是阿富汗問題的核心。

en: But the heart of the matter is the preservation of ancient patriarchal rights that go back to Biblical times, reformatted to fit the demands of globalized capitalism.
zh: 但問題的癥結所在是保留了可以追溯到《聖經》時代的古老的宗族權利，上述宗族權利只是進行了某些調整來適應全球化資本主義的要求。

en: Governments and international aid organizations have failed to take into consideration the role of Farhang, perhaps because the power of unwritten law remains largely inconceivable in the West.
zh: 政府和國際援助機構尚未將Farhang的作用納入考慮，也許因為多數西方人無法理解不成文法律的力量。

en: But Afghanistan cannot begin to solve its many problems until it criminalizes the privatized violence of this antiquated code.
zh: 但在懲罰這項古老規則引發的私人暴力之前，阿富汗的許多問題都無法得到解決。

en: Afghanistan’s Drug-Friendly Environment
zh: 阿富汗適宜毒品的環境

en: Afghanistan’s President Hamid Karzai has stepped up international fundraising efforts in recent weeks, seeking a fresh package of military and reconstruction aid from the United States, together with stronger strategic guarantees.
zh: 阿富汗總統哈米德·卡爾扎伊（Hamid Karzai）最近幾周加強了國際籌款活動，向美國尋求新的一系列武器和重建援助以及更強的戰術保障。

en: But Karzai’s relationship with his sponsors has begun to sour, in part owing to charges that his government has failed to stop the resurgence of Afghanistan’s huge opium trade.
zh: 但是卡爾扎伊與其資助人之間的關係已經開始惡化，一部分原因是由於他的政府未能阻止阿富汗大規模的鴉片貿易的興起。

en: Underlying the opium trade issue is a security threat of another kind, one overlooked since the US-led invasion toppled the Taliban regime in 2001, despite the grave risk it poses to Afghanistan’s long-term stability, and that of the region.
zh: 隱藏在鴉片貿易問題下面的是另外一種安全威脅，儘管這個問題對阿富汗以及該地區的長期穩定造成了嚴重威脅，但是自2001年美國為首發動入侵併顛覆塔利班政權以來，它從來沒有被重視過。

en: In countries like Afghanistan, where 80% of the population lives on what they grow and many communities live far from any water source, environmental damage can be both economically devastating and politically momentous.
zh: 阿富汗國內80%人口以種植業為生，許多村落居住在遠離水源之處，在這樣一個國家裡，環境的危害不僅會造成經濟惡化，也會給政治帶來嚴重影響。

en: That lesson should have been absorbed and understood, not least by American strategists, long before the Taliban’s fall.
zh: 在塔利班垮臺以前，人們就應該吸取並記住這個教訓，尤其是美國的戰略家。

en: After all, desertification and deforestation helped fuel the rise, two decades earlier, of the Maoist guerilla group Sendero Luminoso (Shining Path) in Peru.
zh: 畢竟，沙漠化和森林採伐促成了二十多年前秘魯的毛澤東主義游擊隊Sendero Luminoso（光輝道路）的崛起。

en: Sendero, which supplemented its income with drug production and timber smuggling, deliberately chose drought-weakened and deforested mountain villages as the stronghold of its insurgency.
zh: Sendero靠種植毒品和走私木材補充收入，刻意選擇那些久經乾旱、採伐過度的山地村莊作為他們叛亂的根據地。

en: Similarly, the Maoist insurgency in Nepal, which has claimed 10,000 lives, exploits the desperation of mountain villagers hit by flash floods – the result of deforestation higher up.
zh: 同樣，導致10,000多人喪生的尼泊爾毛澤東主義叛亂使得那些遭受驟發洪水襲擊的山地村民徹底絕望，驟發洪水正是高地森林採伐的結果。

en: No Maoist group could ever gain a toehold in Afghanistan’s parched Pashtun south (these were, after all, people who, bare-knuckled, smashed the Soviets).
zh: 沒有毛澤東主義團體可以在阿富汗南部普什圖族（Pashtun）乾裂的土地上獲得立足之地（畢竟這些人曾經赤手空拳擊潰蘇聯 ） 。

en: But the Taliban’s rapid rise in the 1990’s was inextricably linked to the failure of irrigation systems.
zh: 但是上世紀九十年代塔利班的迅速壯大與灌溉體系的失敗不無關係。

en: Villagers whose crops shriveled and whose livestock died in a prolonged drought saw joining the Taliban as an economic opportunity.
zh: 村民們的莊稼在一場持續乾旱中枯萎、牲口也大批死亡，他們把加入塔利班看作一個改善經濟的機會。

en: Had there been more irrigation, the Taliban’s gains might have been far less impressive.
zh: 如果有更多的灌溉的話，塔利班所佔有的也許就遠沒有那麼令人印象深刻。

en: The Taliban are now an increasingly spent force, but lack of water reinforced the logic of opium production across its former strongholds in the south.
zh: 如今，塔利班已是強弩之末，然而水源的缺乏更使它難以維繫它在前南方大本營的鴉片生產流程。

en: Irrigation has failed or is inadequate in Helmand, Uruzgan, and Kandahar – three of the top five opium-producing provinces – where indebted farmers are hooked by the economics: opium brings in eight times as much cash as wheat and uses less water.
zh: 在灌溉失敗或不足的赫爾曼德、Uruzgan和坎大哈 — — 五大鴉片生產大省中的三個 — — 負債累累的農民受到經濟利益的誘惑；鴉片帶來的收入是種植小麥的八倍，並且用水更少。

en: Without serious investment in irrigation, including construction of reservoirs to make use of the snowfall in the Hindu Kush, and in new cash crops such as saffron and rose oil, Afghanistan’s drift toward narco-statehood will continue, with all the instability that this implies.
zh: 如果缺乏對灌溉系統的大力投資，包括建造水庫以充分利用興都庫什（Hindu Kush）的降雪，並投資種植新的諸如藏紅花和玫瑰油等經濟作物，阿富汗將隨著由此引發的種種不穩定性，逐漸成為一個毒品之國。

en: Clear-cutting of old growth forests in the mountains bordering Pakistan may prove as problematic.
zh: 巴基斯坦山區邊界濫砍濫伐老熟森林的做法受到質疑。

en: Agriculture there has been damaged by the cutting of walnut, apricot, and mulberry trees for winter fuel, and by a failure to replant poplar, willow, and tamarisk – the trees that hold fragile meadows in place.
zh: 由於為獲取冬天的燃料而砍伐核桃樹、杏樹和桑樹，同時又未能重新種植那些能夠緊抓鬆弛地表土壤的白楊樹、柳樹和西河柳，當地的農業已經遭受重創。

en: These sorts of trees can be restored, given a concerted campaign and investment in nurseries to produce local varieties.
zh: 如果人們齊心協力，投資培育開發本地樹木品種，這些種類的樹木就能重新恢復。

en: Loss of the ancient cedar, pine, fir, and oak forests on the slopes above is another matter.
zh: 山坡上的古杉木、松樹、樅樹和橡樹林的消失是另外一個問題。

en: This year’s snowmelt caused landslides and flooding – a warning of more soil erosion and destruction of arable land to come; hundreds died and thousands lost their livelihoods.
zh: 今年的雪融水引發了山崩和洪水 — — 這是更多土壤遭受侵蝕以及耕地將被大量破壞的警告；數百人喪生於此，成千上萬的人失去了生計。

en: Forestry has always been a problem in Afghanistan.
zh: 阿富汗的森林一直是一個棘手問題。

en: In 1960, the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization spoke of wasteful logging practices, such as “head-skidding” (in which a log is rolled downhill, ripping up plants and soil).
zh: 1960年，聯合國食品和農業組織（FAO）談到了不經濟的伐木行為，例如“ 木頭滾滑法（head-skidding ） ” （即將木頭滾下山去，同時將樹木帶著土壤連根拔起 ） 。

en: Aerial photographers were called in, and a large budget was set aside.
zh: 航空攝影師被召來拍攝照片，結果預算被取消了。

en: But, in 1976, the FAO admitted in a new plan that forest and watershed management activities had “turned out to be quite limited.”
zh: 但是1976年FAO在一項新計劃中承認森林和水流域的管理行動“十分有限 ” 。

en: The 1976 plan called for sustainable logging and basic forest-fire control, but war intervened, costing Afghanistan half its forest cover.
zh: 1976年計劃呼籲可持續發展地伐木以及森林火災的基本控制，但是戰爭爆發使阿富汗失去了一半的森林土地。

en: Up to 60% of the old growth forest in Nangahar, the second largest opium-producing province, may have been cut during the war years.
zh: 第二大鴉片生產省楠阿哈省（Nangahar）有達60%的土地是老熟林，但它們在戰爭期間被砍伐一空。

en: Mujahedin factions and later the Taliban exported stands of fine-grained cedar by the truckload from Nangahar and surrounding provinces to Pakistan, often in return for arms.
zh: 聖戰組織的派系以及後來的塔利班用貨車從楠阿哈省及周邊地區向巴基斯坦出口品種優良的杉木，經常以此交換武器。

en: Illegal logging continues today, with only ineffectual efforts made to stop it.
zh: 直至今日，由於沒有有效措施，非法伐木仍在繼續。

en: At the current rate, Afghanistan’s old growth forest could vanish within a decade.
zh: 按照目前的速度，阿富汗的老熟林將在十年內消失盡貽。

en: The UN acknowledges the problem but is (rightly) unwilling to risk sending forestry experts into a tribal region where American and allied troops venture only in armored convoys.
zh: 聯合國認識到了這個問題，但是卻不願意冒風險將森林學專家派往一個連美國及其聯軍只有在武裝護衛的情況下才敢冒險涉足的偏遠部族地區。

en: Safety concerns and cost also limit intervention by international conservation organizations.
zh: 安全問題及成本問題限制了國際保護組織的介入。

en: A new initiative called the Green Corps includes 300 forest rangers charged with stopping illegal logging, and the ministry hopes to boost their numbers within a year. But the initiative is unlikely to have much effect.
zh: 一項新的稱之為綠色團體（Green Corps）的計劃包括了300名負責阻止非法伐木的森林巡邏員，並且政府希望在一年內增加巡邏員人數。

en: Illegal logging crews number 200 or more.
zh: 但是這個計劃看起來並不太可能有效。

en: They have chain saws and trucks. They are armed and work with the backing of drug and emerald smugglers – and often of local officials.
zh: 非法伐木隊共計200餘人，他們有鋸子和卡車，他們全副武裝，並在毒品和翡翠走私者（通常是當地官員）的支援下工作。

en: The price of plank cedar in Lahore is incentive enough to corrupt, or kill, any Green Corps men brave enough to stand in their way.
zh: 厚杉木在拉合爾（Lahore）的價格之高足以讓他們去賄賂或殺害任何一個綠色團體中敢擋他們路的人。

en: Environmental issues are of paramount importance in marginal countries because their impact on human survival is immediate and direct.
zh: 環境問題對邊緣國家十分重要，因為它對人類生存具有立竿見影的直接影響。

en: The inadequate response to pressing questions of natural resource management, whether of water or trees, merely strengthens the hands of opium dealers and malcontents in what is already the most disaffected and sensitive part of Afghanistan – the clear-cut mountain slopes where intelligence officers believe Osama bin Laden is most likely holed up.
zh: 若對緊迫的自然資源管理問題 — — 不管是水資源還是森林資源的管理問題反應措施不當，就只會在砍伐一空的山坡地帶 — — 阿富汗本已充斥不滿情緒和最敏感的地帶，加強鴉片商人和不滿分子的力量。 情報官員相信那裡是奧薩馬·本·拉登最有可能洗劫的地方。

en: Afghanistan’s Feminist Revolution
zh: 阿富汗的女權主義革命

en: On April 16, more than 300 Afghani women – many of them students – marched together in Kabul in protest of a new law passed by Parliament that would impose a series of Taliban-like restrictions on women.
zh: 4月16日，300多名阿富汗婦女 — — 其中有不少是學生 — — 在喀布林舉行聯合遊行，抗議議會透過一項新的法律，將一系列塔利班式的限制強加給女性。

en: The law would permit marital rape, limit women’s movements – say, for work or study – without male permission, and even make it illegal for a woman to refuse to dress as her husband wishes.
zh: 這項法律允許婚內強姦行為，限制在沒有得到男性許可前提下女性的行動 — — 比如工作或者學習，甚至將女人拒絕像丈夫希望的那樣穿衣打扮規定為非法。

en: The women, facing a crowd of furious men calling them “whores” and other epithets, marched two miles under a rain of abuse and delivered their petition against the law to legislators.
zh: 這些婦女面對著用“妓女”和其他侮辱性綽號辱罵她們的憤怒的男人，在一片謾罵聲中游行了兩英里，向議員們表達了她們對這部法律的不滿。

en: Both houses of Parliament had approved the law, and President Hamid Karzai signed it.
zh: 議會上下兩院都已經透過了這部法律，哈米德·卡爾扎伊總統也已經簽字批准。

en: The law now affects only the Shia minority, but threatens to affect pending legislation that could restrict the rights of non-Shia women as well.
zh: 這部法律目前隻影響到什葉派少數族裔，不過或許會影響到可能限制非什葉派婦女權利的即將表決的法案。

en: When Western media sought quotes from the women, they frequently heard a Western-style feminist refrain: “These laws would make women into a kind of property.”
zh: 當西方媒體採訪遊行婦女的時候，他們經常會聽到與西方式女權主義類似的觀點 ： “ 這部法律會把女人變成一種財產。

en: In the West, the counterpoint to the notion of woman as property has been a highly individualistic demand for personal autonomy – decision-making based primarily on a woman’s own wishes, rather than as wife, mother, community member, or worshipper.
zh: ”在西方，把女人當作財產的說法對應著高度個性化的個人自主權要求 — — 即按照婦女自身的願望做出決定，而不顧及她作為妻子、母親、社會成員或宗教信徒的社會角色。

en: But, while some Western feminist insights may be useful to Afghani women and other women in the developing world as they resist certain forms of male oppression, we should not assume – as Western feminists often have – that our job is to proselytize “our” feminism.
zh: 不過儘管某些西方女權主義觀點可能有助於阿富汗和其他發展中國家女性抗拒特定形式的男性壓迫，但我們不應當想當然地認定 — — 就像西方女權主義者常乾的那樣 — — 我們的任務是讓“我們的”女權主義者改變她們的觀點。

en: On the contrary, the feminism expressed by women such as these Afghani heroines should educate us in the West about our own shortcomings.
zh: 恰恰相反，阿富汗女主人公們表達的女權主義思想應當教育西方人認識到自身的弱點。

en: The core theory with which emerging feminists in more traditional and religious societies are working is far different from that of Western feminism – and in some ways far more profound and humane.
zh: 在傳統並信奉宗教的社會中新興的女權主義核心理論與西方的女權主義差別很大 — — 從某種角度來講前者的人性化和深刻程度遠遠超過了後者。

en: In India, for example, feminists articulated to me a vision of women’s equality that was family-centered rather than self-centered, and that valued service to community rather than personal gratification.
zh: 比如在印度，女權主義者們向我闡述的女性平等理念更偏重於以家庭而不是以自我為中心，她們更看重的是對社會的貢獻而不是個人的滿足感。

en: They did not see their struggle as a cultural or ideological clash between men and women, but rather as a very practical effort to live free from violence and sexual assault, forced child marriage and bride-burning, and legal exclusion from parity.
zh: 她們並沒有把自己的鬥爭看作是男女之間的文化或意識形態衝突，而恰恰看成是使自己避免暴力和性侵害、被迫早婚和焚妻、以及法律不平等的一項實際的工作。

en: The emerging consensus in India in support of greater rights and freedoms for women, while certainly causing some upheaval and adjustment (especially within the growing middle classes) has not yet – and might never – poison the basic trust and warmth between men and women.
zh: 剛剛在印度興起的支援擴大婦女自由和權利的共識儘管註定會帶來某些動盪和調整（特別是在日益壯大的中產階級內部這種變化無法避免 ） ， 但還沒有 — — 或許永遠也不會 — — 損害男女之間最基本的信任和溫暖。

en: Nor does it seem likely to emulate the splintered, individualized, solitary society – and the commodified sexual revolution – that Western, self-based feminism reflects.
zh: 它似乎也不會步分裂、個性化、孤獨社會 — — 以及西方自我中心的女權主義所反應的商業化性解放的後塵。

en: This version of feminism – the notion that women can claim equality and still have a valued role in the home, prize family above all, and view rights in the context of community and spirituality – seems like a much-needed corrective to some of Western feminism’s shortcomings.
zh: 此類女權主義版本 — — 女性有權要求平等但仍然在家庭中體現價值、把家庭利益放在首位、並以社會和精神為背景來看待權利的理念 — — 似乎是某些西方女權主義缺點迫切需要的修正手段。

en: Ideally, men’s drive for progress in the developing world would also evolve, uniting the idea of the autonomous self with support for family, community, and other ties, and Western men would learn from this as well.
zh: 理想情況下，發展中國家男性的進步動力也會不斷變化，將自主權和支援家庭、社會及其他關係的理念融合在一起，而且西方男性也會從中得到學習和提高。

en: Moreover, intellectually, these women remind us that Western feminism did not have to evolve the way it did, and can still change and grow to embrace a more satisfying and humane definition of equality.
zh: 此外，從理智的角度講，這些婦女提醒我們西方女權主義不一定非要按照既有的方向發展，我們仍然可以對其進行修改和完善，從而使之貼近更令人滿意、更具人情味的平等定義。

en: Simone de Beauvoir, whose seminal book The Second Sex laid the groundwork for post-war Western feminism, was an Existentialist who was neither a wife nor a mother nor a woman of faith.
zh: 西蒙·德·波伏娃的著作《第二性》奠定了戰後西方女權主義的基礎，是一種既非妻子又非母親亦非信徒的存在主義者形象。

en: So her work naturally posited female freedom in a secular, solitary, and individualistic context, in which “freedom” means pure autonomy rather than integration within a whole – comprising family, community, and even God – on equal terms.
zh: 因此她的著作自然而然地把女性自由置於一種世俗、孤立和個人主義的背景之下，其中的“自由”意味著純粹的自主而非在平等的前提下與家庭���團體甚至是上帝組成的統一體的融合。

en: The good news for all women, East and West, is that President Karzai, under intense international criticism – and not just Western criticism – changed the law less than one week after the march.
zh: 對東西方婦女的好訊息是卡爾扎伊總統在嚴厲的國際批評下 — — 這樣的批評言論不只來自於西方 — — 在遊行結束不到一週後就修改了這項法律。

en: This global uproar is a testament to how three decades of Western feminist challenges to leadership have changed the world for the better.
zh: 這次國際動盪證明了三十年來西方女權主義者對領導權的挑戰怎樣讓世界向好的方向發展。

en: But our (Western) moment of feminist leadership is over now – for good reasons.
zh: 但我們（西方）把持女權主義領導地位的時代已經結束了 — — 而且之所以這樣也有充分的理由。

en: We know by now what our problems are as women in the West, and we know the blueprint for solving them.
zh: 我們現在知道西方女性的問題在哪裡，而且也已經清楚解決之道。

en: What we lack now is not analysis, but the organizational and political will to do so.
zh: 我們現在缺乏的不是分析，而是切實執行的組織和政治意願。

en: So the leadership role is shifting to women in the developing world.
zh: 因此領導權已經轉移到發展中國家的婦女手中。

en: Their agenda is more pressing, and their problems, frankly, far more serious than ours, which makes it much more urgent for them to develop theories appropriate to the challenges they face.
zh: 她們的任務更加緊迫，而且坦率地講，她們的問題比我們嚴重得多，因此她們迫切需要發展與所面臨挑戰相適應的理論。

en: If one of those courageous Afghan women who marched in Kabul wrote – as I hope she or one of her sisters in the developing world is doing right now – the seminal text for the next 50 years on non-Western feminism, it would no doubt be equality-driven and practical.
zh: 如果某位參與喀布林遊行的勇敢的阿富汗婦女寫出 — — 就像我希望她或她在發展中國家的某位姐妹正在做的那樣 — — 今後50年非西方女權主義的根本性文字，那麼它毫無疑問將來自於平等的驅動並的確切實可行。

en: And perhaps, in its likely view of the world as being more than the sum of consuming, competing autonomies, or gender warfare, it would be a valuable challenge to truisms that we Western feminists – and the men who love us – have thought we had to take for granted.
zh: 而且也許，在她們把世界看作消耗、競爭自主權或性別戰爭的可能的見解中，它將成為對我們西方女權主義者 — — 以及熱愛我們的男人 — — 曾經認為我們必須看作理所當然的真理的一次有價值的挑戰。

en: Afghanistan’s Opium War
zh: 阿富汗的鴉片戰爭

en: When NATO leaders meet for their summit in Riga at the end of this month, there will be a ghost at the feast: Afghanistan’s opium.
zh: 北約領導人本月底在里加召開首腦會議之時，將有一個魔鬼在會議徘徊，那就是阿富汗的鴉片問題。

en: Afghanistan is in danger of falling back into the hands of terrorists, insurgents, and criminals, and the multi-billion-dollar opium trade is at the heart of the country’s malaise.
zh: 阿富汗正處於陷入恐怖份子、叛亂份子以及罪犯手中的危險，而幾十億美元的鴉片交易則是這個國家病症的核心所在。

en: Indeed, NATO’s top general, James Jones, has called drugs the “Achilles heel” of Afghanistan.
zh: 確實，北約總司令瓊斯把毒品稱為阿富汗的致命弱點。

en: This year’s record harvest of 6,100 tons of opium will generate more than $3 billion in illicit revenue – equivalent to almost half of Afghanistan’s GDP.
zh: 今年6100噸鴉片收成將會產生超過30億美元的非法收入，幾乎相對於阿富汗國民生產總值的一半。

en: Profits for drug traffickers downstream will be almost 20 times that amount.
zh: 下游毒販的利潤將幾乎是這個數目的20倍。

en: Opium money is corrupting Afghan society from top to bottom.
zh: 鴉片收入正在從上到下腐蝕阿富汗社會。

en: High-level collusion enables thousands of tons of chemical precursors, needed to produce heroin, to be trucked into the country.
zh: 高層勾結使得數以千噸用於製造海洛因的化學前體運入該國。

en: Armed convoys transport raw opium around the country unhindered.
zh: 武裝運輸隊在境內運輸鴉片如入無人之境。

en: Sometimes even army and police vehicles are involved.
zh: 有時，連軍隊和警察也捲入其中。

en: Guns and bribes ensure that the trucks are waved through checkpoints.
zh: 武器和賄賂確保卡車得以透過檢查站。

en: Opiates flow freely across borders into Iran, Pakistan, and other Central Asian countries.
zh: 鴉片劑大搖大擺地越境進入伊朗、巴基斯坦以及其他中亞國家。

en: The opium fields of wealthy landowners are untouched, because local officials are paid off.
zh: 由於買通了當地官員，富有地主們的鴉片種植地無人敢碰。

en: Major traffickers never come to trial because judges are bribed or intimidated.
zh: 法官們受賄或者受到恐嚇，因此毒販頭子們從來都是逍遙法外。

en: Senior government officials take their cut of opium revenues or bribes in return for keeping quiet.
zh: 政府高官抽取鴉片收入或者賄賂以保持緘默。

en: Perversely, some provincial governors and government officials are themselves major players in the drug trade.
zh: 某些省長以及政府官員竟然也是毒品貿易的主要經營者。

en: As a result, the Afghan state is at risk of takeover by a malign coalition of extremists, criminals, and opportunists.
zh: 結果，阿富汗國家處在被極端份子、罪犯以及投機主義份子等組成的邪惡聯盟接管的危險之中。

en: Opium is choking Afghan society.
zh: 鴉片正在令阿富汗社會窒息。

en: Within Afghanistan, drug addiction is rising.
zh: 在阿富汗境內，越來越多的人在吸毒。

en: Neighbors that used to be transit states for drugs are now major consumers, owing to similar dramatic increases in opium and heroin addiction.
zh: 由於鴉片和吸食海洛因，過去是毒品中轉地的地方現在成為了主要的消費地。

en: Intravenous drug use is spreading HIV/AIDS in Iran, Central Asia, and the former Soviet Union.
zh: 使用注射毒品正在伊朗、中亞以及前蘇聯傳播艾滋病。

en: In traditional Western European markets, health officials should brace for a rise in the number of deaths from drug overdoses, as this year’s bumper opium crop will lead to higher-purity doses of heroin.
zh: 在傳統的西歐市場，由於今年鴉片作物豐收將會導致更高純度劑量的海洛因，衛生官員將會遇到由於吸毒過量而造成的死亡數量的上升事件。

en: What can be done?
zh: 如何對付呢？

en: First, the veil of corruption in Afghanistan must be lifted.
zh: 首先，必須揭開阿富汗的腐敗面紗。 阿富汗人對於傲慢而又受到武裝保護的大亨們已經不耐煩了。

en: Afghans are fed up with arrogant and well-armed tycoons who live in mansions and drive top-of-the range Mercedes limousines – this in a country where barely 13% of the population have electricity and most people must survive on less than $200 a year.
zh: 他們身居豪宅，駕駛頂級的賓士豪華轎車。 而在這個國家中，只有13%不到的人口擁有電力，大多數人必須靠每年200美元不到的收入過活。

en: It is time for the Afghan government to name, shame, and sack corrupt officials, arrest major drug traffickers and opium landlords, and seize their assets.
zh: 現在，阿富汗政府應該點名、羞辱並且解僱那些貪官，逮捕主要的毒販和鴉片地主，並且沒收他們的資產。

en: Donors have trained police and prosecutors and built courts and detention centers.
zh: 捐助國家們已經培訓了警察、檢察官，並且建造了法院和拘留中心。

en: Now it is up to the government to use the judicial system to impose the rule of law.
zh: 現在，政府應當使用司法體系來實施法治。

en: It will be difficult, but not impossible, to re-establish confidence in the central government.
zh: 重新建立對中央政府的信心將會是困難的，但並非不可能。

en: Putting major drug traffickers behind bars at the new maximum-security prison at Pul-i-Charki, near Kabul, would be a good start.
zh: 把主要的毒品販子關進靠近喀布林的波爾-伊-查基的新的最高安全戒備的監獄將會是一個良好的開端。

en: Of course, Afghanistan does not bear sole responsibility for its plight.
zh: 當然，阿富汗人對其災難並不承擔所有的責任。

en: The heroin trade would not be booming if Western governments were serious about combating drug consumption.
zh: 如果西方國家政府嚴肅打擊毒品消費，那麼，海洛因交易就不會猖獗。

en: It is a bitter irony that the countries whose soldiers’ lives are on the line in Afghanistan are also the biggest markets for Afghan heroin.
zh: 具有令人心酸的諷刺意味的是，那些向阿富汗派遣隨時都有生命危險計程車兵的國家同時也是阿富汗海洛因最大的市場。

en: Furthermore, Afghanistan’s neighbors must do more to stop insurgents, weapons, money, and chemical precursors from flowing across their borders into the country.
zh: 而且，阿富汗的鄰國必須多做工作，以制止反叛人員、武器、金錢以及化學前體跨境進入該國。

en: Coalition forces should take a more robust approach to the drug problem.
zh: 聯合部隊應當對毒品問題採取更為強硬的手段。

en: Counter-insurgency and counter-narcotics are two sides of the same coin.
zh: 反叛亂和反毒品是一個問題的兩個方面。

en: Improving security and the rule of law must include destroying the opium trade.
zh: 改善安全以及法治必須包括摧毀鴉片交易。

en: Allowing opium traffickers to operate with impunity gives them a free hand to raise money to pay for the arms and fighters battling the Afghan army and NATO forces.
zh: 允許鴉片販子肆無忌憚就讓他們無所顧忌地籌款來支付軍火以及同阿富汗和北約軍隊作戰的份子。

en: The United Nations Security Council has authorized the International Security Assistance Force to take all necessary measures to fulfill its mandate.
zh: 聯合國安理會已經授權國際安全援助部隊採取所有必要的手段來實現其使命。

en: NATO troops should be given the green light to help the Afghan army fight opium – destroy the heroin labs, disband the opium bazaars, attack the opium convoys, and bring the big traders to justice.
zh: 應當授權北約部隊幫助阿富汗軍隊與鴉片作戰，即摧毀海洛因實驗室，解除鴉片集市，襲擊鴉片運輸隊，並且把大毒販繩之以法。

en: And they should be given the tools and manpower to do the job.
zh: 而且，應該給他們必要的裝備和人員來完成使命。

en: There is no point in trying to win the hearts and minds of major drug traffickers.
zh: 試圖贏得主要毒販的歡心是沒有用處的。

en: Farmers are a different story.
zh: 農民們則另當別論。

en: Forced eradication risks pushing farmers into the hands of extremists, and thus will not lead to the sustainable reduction of opium fields.
zh: 強制毀田有可能把農民們逼入極端份子手中，從而不會導致鴉片地可持續的減少。

en: Indeed, as we have seen in some Andean countries, it can be counter-productive.
zh: 實際上，正如我們在某些安達斯國家所見到的那樣，這樣做可能會適得其反。

en: Therefore, security and development must go hand in hand.
zh: 因此，安全和發展必須並舉。

en: To achieve this, Afghanistan needs more development assistance.
zh: 為了實現這一目標，阿富汗需要更多的國際援助。

en: International support so far has been generous, but it is still well below per capita equivalents for other post-conflict situations – and the need is much greater.
zh: 目前為止，國際支援是慷慨的，但是，還是遠遠低於其他戰後形勢的人均水平，而且，需求更大。

en: Farmers will be weaned off opium over the long term only if they have sustainable livelihoods.
zh: 農民們只有具備了可以持久的生計才能長久地脫離鴉���。

en: At the moment, Afghanistan’s drug lords are prospering, and rural communities are suffering.
zh: 目前，阿富汗的大毒梟們為所欲為，而農村社群則奄奄一息。

en: That situation needs to be reversed.
zh: 這一局面必須得到扭轉。

en: We must punish the traffickers and reward the farmers.
zh: 我們必須懲治毒販而獎勵農民。

en: We cannot afford to fail in Afghanistan.
zh: 我們無法在阿富汗失敗。

en: Recent history has given us graphic evidence of what would happen if we do.
zh: 最近的歷史生動地告訴我們失敗的結局是什麼。

en: But any solution in Afghanistan depends on eliminating its opium.
zh: 但是，任何阿富汗的解決之道都取決於消除其鴉片。

en: Afghanistan’s Terrorized Women
zh: 暴力威脅下的阿富汗婦女

en: KABUL – Recently, the Afghan Independent Human Rights Commission (AIHRC) office in Kudoz province reported the rescue of a young woman who had been imprisoned in her in-laws’ dungeon for seven months.
zh: 發自喀布林 — — 最近阿富汗獨立人權委員會（AIHRC）在庫都茲省（Kudoz）的辦事處報告了一起營救事件。

en: Fifteen-year-old Sahar Gul was forced to marry an older man who serves in the Afghan army. She was then kept in the dungeon by her husband’s family and brutally tortured for months, because she refused to work as a prostitute.
zh: 年僅15歲的莎哈爾·古爾（Sahar Gul）先是被迫嫁給一名年紀比她大的阿富汗軍人，隨後又被夫家人強迫賣淫，她不從，於是就被鎖在地牢裡殘酷虐待了整整七年，直至被營救出來。

en: Over the past ten years, the AIHRC has received more than 19,000 complaints related to violence against women.
zh: 在過去十年間，委員會收到了超過1.9萬件與虐待婦女有關的申訴。

en: Despite making some progress in investigating the complaints and referring them to the justice system, as well as in raising public awareness about the issue, the challenges remain huge.
zh: 儘管在調查這些申訴並移交司法機關的提升了公眾對該事務關注度方面取得了一些進展，但我們所面對的挑戰依然非常艱鉅。

en: Since 2002, many efforts have been made to improve women’s lives in Afghanistan.
zh: 自2002年以來，各界在改善阿富汗婦女待遇方面作出了許多努力。

en: The country has enacted several new laws and established a fairly advanced legal framework to end discrimination against women, including a new law that criminalizes any act that results in violence against women.
zh: 國家也頒佈了一系列新法並建立了一個相當先進的法律框架來結束對婦女的歧視，其中包括一部能將任何針對婦女的暴力行為定罪的法律。

en: But laws and policies alone are not sufficient to protect women from horrific domestic abuse.
zh: 但僅靠法律和政策並不足以保護婦女免遭殘酷的家族虐待行為。

en: Indeed, the Gul case is hardly the only well-publicized case.
zh: 事實上，上面那宗案件只不過是曝光率最高的一個。

en: There was also Gulnaz, a young woman who was jailed for adultery after being raped by a relative (she was recently released after a presidential pardon, but may be forced to marry her attacker).
zh: 還有一名叫古爾納茲（Gulnaz）的年輕婦女在遭到親戚強姦之後竟以通姦罪名入獄（雖然她最近得到總統特赦，但仍可能被迫要和強姦者結婚 ） 。

en: The husband of another young woman, Aisha, cut off her nose and ears when she ran away.
zh: 而另一位叫阿莎的婦女試圖從家裡逃走，卻被其夫捉回來殘忍地割掉了鼻子和雙耳。

en: Violence against women in Afghanistan persists for many reasons. First, the country has inherited a patriarchal tribal tradition that assumes women’s inferiority.
zh: 而針對婦女的暴力行為之所以在阿富汗屢禁不止，是由許多原因的：首先，該國繼承了一個男權部落傳統，認為女性就是低人一等，並因此剝奪了女性的基本權利和自由。

en: Second, there is a strong political incentive to deprive women of their rights.
zh: 其次，在政治上也存在強大的誘因去剝奪女性的權利。

en: Radical groups receive immense support from the large share of the population that opposes women’s rights.
zh: 有極大數量的民眾反對給於婦女權利，而這些人同時又為那些極端組織提供了強大的支援。

en: The Taliban, for example, have consistently used an anti-women policy to appeal to tribal and rural people.
zh: 例如塔利班組織就一直利用一套壓制婦女的政策來吸引部落和農村地區的民眾。

en: Third, family pride and honor are deemed more important than a woman’s individual well-being and safety.
zh: 第三，有些人把家族榮譽看得比婦女個人的幸福和安全更加重要。

en: For example, if family members beat or abuse a woman, she has few options.
zh: 如果其他家庭成員虐打了家族中的一名婦女，她有幾個選項。

en: Often, her only choice is to remain silent or risk disgracing the family.
zh: 一般情況下，她只能在忍氣吞聲和令家族蒙羞之間選擇。

en: If she does report the matter to the authorities, the case will almost certainly never be properly investigated, nor the perpetrators ever prosecuted.
zh: 如果該名婦女把情況報告給了當局，這個案件幾乎不會被認真調查，施暴者也不會被起訴。

en: Gul, for example, complained to the police about her abusive in-laws, but she was returned to the family when some of their influential contacts intervened.
zh: 比方說在古爾一案中，古爾將自己所遭受的暴行報告給了警察，誰知在夫家認識的某些權勢人物介入後，警察竟又把她送回了夫家。

en: Fourth, laws are often arbitrarily applied, and sharia (Islamic law) frequently takes precedence over civil legislation, resulting in widespread impunity for crimes of violence against women.
zh: 其四，法律往往無法得到徹底執行，伊斯蘭教法又經常凌駕於民法之上，使得那些針對婦女的暴力或罪行得以逍遙法外。

en: For example, in October 2010, the Afghan Supreme Court ruled that women who run away from home can be charged with prostitution, unless they go to the police or an immediate relative's home. It is this mindset that led to Gul’s victimization.
zh: 例如2010年10月阿富汗最高法院裁定：除非前往警察局或者直系親屬的家，否則逃離家庭的婦女將以賣淫罪論處。

en: Finally, while the Taliban lost power ten years ago, discrimination and violence against women has occurred in Afghan society for centuries.
zh: 最後，當塔利班政權在十年前倒臺之時，對婦女的歧視和暴力已經在阿富汗存在了幾個世紀之久。

en: Thus, despite some progress, public and official sensitivity to violence against women is only slowly emerging.
zh: 儘管目前取得了一些進步，公眾和官方對這些事件的敏感度也只是緩慢建立之中。

en: The Afghan government must take several steps to protect women fully.
zh: 因此阿富汗政府必須採取一系列步驟去徹底保護婦女權益。

en: Above all, perpetrators of violence against women should be prosecuted and tried under due process of law.
zh: 其中最重要的莫過於要將這些針對婦女的暴力行為予以起訴並在恰當的法律程式下進行審判。

en: This will require strengthening the rule of law and ending the prevailing culture of impunity.
zh: 這就要求強化法治並消滅當前這種有罪不糾的文化。

en: That, in turn, requires educating the public further about human rights and women’s rights through school textbooks, continuing education courses, and a vigorous media campaign.
zh: 這反過來要求透過教科書，繼續教育課程和大型媒體宣傳活動來進一步向公眾傳達關於人權和婦女權利的知識。

en: It also requires persuading representatives and policymakers to develop policies and allocate budget revenues to combat violence against women, and training police and judges to handle cases of violence against women without deferring to claims of family honor.
zh: 同時也需要說服民意代表和政策制定者們去制定相關政策並撥出預算來打擊暴力虐待婦女的行為，訓練警察和法官摒除所謂家族榮譽的影響，秉公處理相關案件。

en: Perhaps most importantly, non-constitutional justice systems, such as sharia, must be monitored and checked, if not prohibited altogether.
zh: 而或許更重要的是，要麼將類似伊斯蘭教法這樣的非憲政司法系統全面禁止，要麼對其進行檢討和修訂。

en: As for Sahar Gul, her case must be thoroughly investigated, and the police and judiciary must commit to bringing her torturers to justice.
zh: 對於莎哈爾·古爾來說，她的案件必須得到徹查，警察和法官必須盡全力將那些虐待她的人繩之於法。

en: Furthermore, Gul’s case, and others like it, should be studied in order to understand the roots of such crimes.
zh: 此外也必須對這些案件進行研究以辨清這類犯罪的根源。

en: Until Afghanistan’s leaders begin to address this problem seriously, our country will continue to bear the scar of violence against women on its face.
zh: 除非阿富汗領導人們開始認真處理這個問題，否則我們這個國家將繼續因虐待婦女的罪行而蒙羞。

en: A Flat World and a Round Ball
zh: 平面世界和圓的足球

en: With the final stage of the World Cup approaching, now is a good opportunity for a mid-tournament appraisal.
zh: 世界盃最後階段的比賽正在臨近，現在是作出賽中評論的好時機。

en: This year’s Cup, unlike the previous one in Japan and South Korea in 2002, didn’t witness any real upsets in the first round.
zh: 今年的世界盃與2002年上一屆韓日世界盃不同，並沒有在第一輪出現大冷門。

en: Switzerland and Australia surprisingly reached the elimination round, and the Asian and African teams disappointed somewhat, with only Ghana advancing.
zh: 瑞士和澳大利亞進入十六強令人驚訝，而亞洲和非洲球隊則多少令人失望，只有迦納隊晉級。

en: There have been just two ugly matches so far, full of fouls, nasty attacks, and unnecessary aggression, as well as numerous yellow and red cards: Italy vs. the US, and Portugal vs. the Netherlands.
zh: 目前為止，只有兩場比賽，也就是義大利對美國和葡萄牙對荷蘭醜陋不堪，充滿犯規、下流的攻擊、毫無必要的侵犯以及漫天飛舞的紅黃牌。

en: Otherwise, we’re experiencing a wonderful Cup in Germany, in terms of both sportsmanship and the overall atmosphere.
zh: 否則，我們正在體驗一屆無論是從體育角度還是整體氣氛都是美妙的德國世界盃。

en: As for Germany and the Germans, one hardly recognizes one’s own country and people.
zh: 至於德國和德國人，人們幾乎不認識自己的國家和同胞。

en: Even Mother Nature has played along.
zh: 即使是大自然母親也隨人意。

en: After a long winter and a non-existent spring, summer started promptly with the first kick-off – and virtually overnight, Germany has flaunted its sunniest and most delightful side.
zh: 經過了漫長的冬天和稍縱即逝的春天后，隨著首場比賽的開始，夏天即刻來臨，而且幾乎是一夜之間，德國呈現了最為陽光明媚和快樂的一面。

en: The weather is Mediterranean, and all of a sudden, so are the people.
zh: 天氣是地中海式的，而且連人也奔放。

en: The Cup’s organization has been exceptional (as was to be expected), with excellent police work giving hooligans hardly a chance.
zh: 本屆世界盃賽的組織工作是出類拔萃的（正如預料的一樣 ） ， 警方的出色工作讓足球流氓們無計可施。

en: The whole of Germany has been celebrating a never-ending party with guests from all over the world (which was not expected).
zh: 德國全國都在與來自五湖四海的賓客們一道慶賀這場不散的聚會（這是沒有預料到的 ） 。

en: And the German team has put on a wonderful display of heart warming and modern offensive soccer (which nobody could have expected!).
zh: 而德國隊則展現了令人暖人心的現代攻勢足球（這是沒有人預料到的！ ） 。

en: More importantly, not only in the German team, but also in the country as a whole, a young, cool, laid-back, and carefree Germany is raising its head – a Germany that is cosmopolitan, friendly, and good-humored.
zh: 更為重要的是，不僅僅是德國足球隊，而且是整個國家都在以一個年輕、帥氣、悠閒以及無憂無慮形象昂首闊步，也就是匯納百川、友善以及風趣幽默。

en: Years of bad news appear to have passed the Germans by without a trace.
zh: 多年來的壞訊息看起來已經過去，沒有給德國留下痕跡。

en: Doctors are on strike, taxes are on the rise, the parties in government are mauling each other, and Chancellor Angela Merkel herself proclaimed in a prominent speech that the country is in disastrous shape.
zh: 醫生正在罷工，納稅正在上升，聯合政府的各黨派在相互抨擊，德國總理默克爾本人則在一場重要演講中宣稱國家大事不好。

en: But the Germans, undaunted by it all, simply keep celebrating one great soccer party with their newfound friends from all over the world.
zh: 但是，德國民眾對此毫無興趣，只是繼續和來自五湖四海新結交的朋友們一道慶賀這一足球盛會。

en: The black, red, and gold German tricolor adorns the entire country as never before, but almost nowhere are there nationalist undertones.
zh: 德國國旗的三色黑、紅和金色從來沒有像現在這樣在全國到處飄揚，但是，沒有地方出現民族主義的意味。

en: In fact, the flags of many nations fly alongside German.
zh: 實際上，許多國家的旗幟與德國國旗一同飄揚。

en: In Berlin, as in other large German cities, taxis sport the flags of their drivers’ home countries – from Angola to Saudi Arabia.
zh: 在柏林以及其他德國大城市，可以看到計程車司機們展現祖國的國旗，從安哥拉一直到沙烏地阿拉伯。

en: Fans don not just their nations’ flags, but also fantastic costumes evocative of their home countries’ colors.
zh: 世界各地的球迷們不僅披上他們的國旗，也披上他們各自國家顏色鮮豔的服飾。

en: Flags are flown in hope of victory, but also serve to dry the tears of defeat.
zh: 揮舞國旗是為了報有勝利的希望，也是為了摸去國家隊被擊敗的淚水。

en: In short, Germany during the World Cup is reminiscent of a Shakespearean midsummer night’s dream, with a touch of Woodstock to boot.
zh: 總而言之，世界盃期間的德國讓人想起了莎士比亞的仲夏夜之夢，還有伍德斯托克音樂節的氣氛。

en: Outside the stadiums, public screenings of the games have become joyous mass “happenings.”
zh: 在足球場外，大螢幕的比賽轉播已經成為巨大的球迷歡樂“事件 ” 。

en: And how is the soccer?
zh: 那麼足球本身又如何呢？

en: This World Cup demonstrates three main developments that the sport has undergone.
zh: 本屆世界盃展現了足球運動所經歷的三種主要發展趨勢。

en: First, Europe and South America are more dominant than four years ago and remain the unchallenged great powers of international soccer.
zh: 第一，歐洲和南美球隊要比四年以前更為佔據優勢，而且保持為國際足球中無可挑戰的大國。

en: So we must hope that the World Cup in South Africa in 2010 will finally bring greater global parity.
zh: 所以，我們必須希望2010年的南非世界盃將最終帶來更大的全球性的強手林立。

en: Second, international soccer is witnessing the advent of a new generation.
zh: 第二，國際足球正在見證新的一代的來臨。

en: Spain, Argentina, and Germany, to name but a few countries, have put forward very young teams that have played an impressive game.
zh: 西班牙、阿根廷以及德國推出了非常年輕的球隊，令人印象深刻。 這些只是其中一些隊伍。

en: On the French, English, and Portuguese teams, too, it is the young players that have shone – despite the continuing presence of Zidane, Beckham, and Figo.
zh: 儘管齊達內、貝克漢姆以及菲哥仍在場上，法國、英國以及葡萄牙隊的年輕隊員也奪人耳目。

en: Even the Brazilian squad is looking more aggressive and likely to score with young players like Robinho and Juninho than with their aging champions from 2002.
zh: 巴西也看起來更加富有攻勢，羅比尼奧和儒尼奧爾也比2002年以來正在老邁的冠軍們更有可能進球。

en: This generational change is accelerated by a third development.
zh: 這一世代改變由於第三個進展而加快進行。

en: At the top international level, soccer has become faster and more athletic, and the top teams can shrink space on the field more effectively.
zh: 在國際水平的頂級，足球變得更快，更加要求運動性，頂級球隊更為有效地壓縮球場空間。

en: A team that is unable to keep going at full speed for the full 90 (or more) minutes, switch from defense to offense quickly with the whole team, and maintain control of the ball to restrict their opponents' movements won’t stand much of a chance.
zh: 一支球隊如果無法在90分鐘甚至更長的時間裡保持全速，迅速從防守轉向進攻，並且控球限制對手的運動，那麼就不會在頂級水平立足。

en: Here, soccer parallels today’s globalized markets, which make similar restructuring of national economies necessary.
zh: 在這裡，人們可以在足球和當今全球化的市場程序之間有相似的地方。 由於全球化的市場，各國經濟類似的重組十分必要。

en: Unlike economic globalization, however, it remains to be seen whether this new, fast-paced style of soccer will prevail (after all, the young blood of Spain lost to the Old Boys of France).
zh: 但是，與經濟全球化不同的是，這一新的、快節奏足球是否能夠獲勝還有待觀察（畢竟，血氣方剛的西班牙輸給了老邁的法國 ） 。

en: The sport and its fans will certainly profit if it does.
zh: 體育和球迷肯定都會獲益匪淺。

en: For now, we have a World Cup filled with soccer that is being shaped by a new, young generation both on and off the playing field – light-hearted, enthralling, and beautiful to watch.
zh: 現在，這是一屆由新的年輕一代在場上場下塑造的世界盃，這一代人輕鬆愉快、令人著迷而且美麗動人。

en: Let’s hope that when the last whistle blows at the final in Berlin on July 9, we Germans retain as much of this positive spirit as possible.
zh: 讓我們希望，當7月9日決賽哨音在柏林吹響的時候，我們德國人能夠保持儘可能多的這種精神。

en: Germany urgently needs this kind of optimism, because, unfortunately, two universal principles will continue to apply in the future: first, the winter will return, and, second, the ball is round and the next game is always the most difficult.
zh: 德國急需這種樂觀精神，因為，不幸的是，兩項原則在未來依然有效：第一，冬天將會回來；第二，足球是圓的，下一場比賽總是最艱鉅的。

en: A Free Lunch for America
zh: 美國的免費午餐

en: BERKELEY – Former US Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers had a good line at the International Monetary Fund meetings this year: governments, he said, are trying to treat a broken ankle when the patient is facing organ failure.
zh: 伯克利 — — 前美國財政部長薩默斯（Lawrence Summers）在今年的IMF會議上頗有想象力：他說，各國政府的做法，就好比是病人明明是臟器問題，卻在給他治腳踝。

en: Summers was criticizing Europe’s focus on the second-order issue of Greece while far graver imbalances – between the EU’s north and south, and between reckless banks’ creditors and governments that failed to regulate properly – worsen with each passing day.
zh: 薩默斯是在批評歐洲將注意力集中在希臘問題這樣的次要問題上，而更危險的失衡 — — 北歐和南歐之間的失衡、魯莽銀行債權人與監管不力的政府之間的失衡 — — 卻在一天比一天更嚴重。

en: But, on the other side of the Atlantic, Americans have no reason to feel smug.
zh: 但在大西洋的另一邊，美國人就找不到任何自命不凡的理由了。

en: Summers could have used the same metaphor to criticize the United States, where the continued focus on the long-run funding dilemmas of social insurance is sucking all of the oxygen out of efforts to deal with America’s macroeconomic and unemployment crisis.
zh: 薩默斯的比方同樣可以用來形容美國 — — 美國人一直把焦點放在社保的長期籌資困境上，而對美國宏觀經濟和失業危機視而不見。

en: The US government can currently borrow for 30 years at a real (inflation-adjusted) interest rate of 1% per year.
zh: 當前，美國政府的30年債務真實（經通脹調整的）利率為每年1 % 。

en: Suppose that the US government were to borrow an extra $500 billion over the next two years and spend it on infrastructure – even unproductively, on projects for which the social rate of return is a measly 25% per year.
zh: 假設未來兩年美國政府多借5000億美元，並將這筆錢用於基礎設施建設 — — 即使這些投資並非生產性的，其社會回報率只有每年25 % 。

en: Suppose that – as seems to be the case – the simple Keynesian government-expenditure multiplier on this spending is only two.
zh: 假設 — — 目前看來正是如此 — — 簡單凱恩斯政府支出乘數 為2。

en: In that case, the $500 billion of extra federal infrastructure spending over the next two years would produce $1 trillion of extra output of goods and services, generate approximately seven million person-years of extra employment, and push down the unemployment rate by two percentage points in each of those years.
zh: 這樣，未來兩年5000億美元的額外聯邦基礎設施支出將產生1萬億美元的額外商品和服務產出，創造大約700萬人年的額外就業機會，將每年的失業率降低2個百分點。

en: And, with tighter labor-force attachment on the part of those who have jobs, the unemployment rate thereafter would likely be about 0.1 percentage points lower in the indefinite future.
zh: 此外，隨著就業人口的勞動力附著效應收緊，失業率將在無窮期的未來中下降0.1個百分點。

en: The impressive gains don’t stop there.
zh: 可觀的好處還不僅於此。

en: Better infrastructure would mean an extra $20 billion a year of income and social welfare.
zh: 更好的基礎設施將意味著每年多產生200億美元的收入和社會財富。

en: A lower unemployment rate into the future would mean another $20 billion a year in higher production.
zh: 未來更低的失業率將意味著年產量提高200億美元。

en: And half of the extra $1 trillion of goods and services would show up as consumption goods and services for American households.
zh: 而額外產生的1萬億美元商品和服務中有一半會表現為美國家庭的消費品和服務。

en: In sum, on the benefits side of the equation: more jobs now, $500 billion of additional consumption of goods and services over the next two years, and then a $40 billion a year flow of higher incomes and production each year thereafter.
zh: 總結一下好處：提高現在的就業率、未來2年內產生5000億美元額外商品和服務消費、此後每年400億美元的額外收入流和產量增加。

en: So, what are the likely costs of an extra $500 billion in infrastructure spending over the next two years?
zh: 那麼，未來兩年內增加5000億美元基礎設施支出的潛在成本又是多少呢？

en: For starters, the $500 billion of extra government spending would likely be offset by $300 billion of increased tax collections from higher economic activity.
zh: 首先，5000億美元額外政府支出可以用稅收增加額抵消3000億，這筆稅收增量來自更高的經濟活躍度。

en: So the net result would be a $200 billion increase in the national debt.
zh: 因此淨結果是國民債務水平將上升2000億美元。

en: American taxpayers would then have to pay $2 billion a year in real interest on that extra national debt over the next 30 years, and then pay off or roll over the entire $200 billion.
zh: 美國納稅人因此必須在未來30年內為這筆增加的債務付出每年20億美元的真是利息，然後償付2000億美元本金或將債務展期。

en: The $40 billion a year of higher economic activity would, however, generate roughly $10 billion a year in additional tax revenue.
zh: 但是，經濟活動每年提高400億美元會產生大約100億美元的額外稅收收入。

en: Using some of it to pay the real interest on the debt and saving the rest would mean that when the bill comes due, the tax-financed reserves generated by the healthier economy would be more than enough to pay off the additional national debt.
zh: 用其中的一部分來支付債務的真是利息，並將剩餘部分儲蓄起來，這樣，在債務到期時，由更健康的經濟所產生的來自稅收的儲備將足以償清增加的國民債務。

en: In other words, taxpayers win, because the benefits from the healthier economy would more than compensate for the costs of servicing the higher national debt, enabling the government to provide more services without raising tax rates.
zh: 換句話說，納稅人將是贏家，因為更健康的經濟所帶來的好處將補償增加國民債務的利息成本而有餘，從而使政府有能力在不提高稅率的情況下提供更多的服務。

en: Households win, too, because they get to buy more and nicer things with their incomes.
zh: 企業也是贏家，因為商品和工人將能夠使用改善的基礎設施。

en: Companies win, because goods and workers get to use the improved infrastructure.
zh: 失業者也是贏家，因為不少人將得到工作。

en: The unemployed win, because some of them get jobs. And even bond investors win, because they get their money back, with the interest for which they contracted.
zh: 甚至債券投資者也是贏家，因為他們拿回了借出去的錢，而且還獲得合同中規定的利息。

en: So what is not to like?
zh: 有什麼不好的地方嗎？

en: Nothing.
zh: 沒有。

en: How, you might ask, can I say this?
zh: 你也許會問，我為什麼這樣說？

en: I am an economist – a professor of the Dismal Science, in which there are no free lunches, in which benefits are always balanced by costs, and in which stories that sound too good to be true almost inevitably are.
zh: 我可是個經濟學家，這個“沉悶科學”的教授，在經濟學看來，天下沒有免費的午餐，有好處就必有相應的成本，那些聽起來難以置信的好事幾乎無一例外真的不是好事。

en: But there are two things different about today.
zh: 但今天的情況有兩點不同。

en: First, the US labor market is failing so badly that expanded government spending carries no resource cost to society as a whole.
zh: 首先，美國勞動力市場出現了大失靈，以至於擴張的政府支出不會給作為一個整體的社會帶來資源成本。

en: Second, bond investors are being really stupid.
zh: 其次，債券投資者在現實中是很愚蠢的。

en: In a world in which the S&P 500 has a 7% annual earnings yield, nobody should be happy holding a US government 30-year inflation-adjusted bond that yields 1% per year.
zh: 如今，標普500指數可以產生7%的年收益，因此理應無人問津美國政府的30年經通脹調整的債券 — — 收益率只有每年1 % 。

en: That six-percentage-point difference in anticipated real yield is a measure of bond investors’ extraordinary and irrational panic.
zh: 這6個百分點的預期真實收益率差額便是債券投資者不同尋常的非理性恐慌的寫照。

en: They are willing to pay 6% per year for “safety.”
zh: 他們願意為“安全”付出每年6%的利息。

en: Right now, however, the US government can manufacture “safety” out of thin air merely by printing bonds.
zh: 不過，眼下��國政府可以僅憑印債券創造“安全 ” 。

en: The government, too, would then win by pocketing that 6% per year of value – though 30 years from now, bondholders who feel like winners now would most likely look at their portfolios’ extraordinarily poor performance of over 2011-2041 and rue their strategy.
zh: 於是，政府也是贏家，它可以在未來30年內將每年6%的價值收入囊中。 那些現在自視為贏家的債券持有者很可能會在2011—2041年期間看到自己的投資組合表現奇差無比，為現在的策略後悔不迭。

en: A French Presidential Primer
zh: 法國總統引言

en: The late British Prime Minister Harold Wilson used to quip that “a week is a long time in politics.”
zh: 前英國首相哈羅德·威爾遜曾經說過 ， “ 從政治角度講一個星期稱得上是漫長的時光 ” 。

en: So, in the 30 or so weeks between now and the next French presidential election, any prediction made today could be reversed, and reversed again, before the vote.
zh: 因此，從現在開始到下一次法國總統大選到來之前的30多個星期裡，今天所做的任何預測都有可能在投票前發生逆轉、再發生逆轉。

en: But two candidates have emerged as clear and constant favorites in opinion polls: Nicolas Sarkozy on the right and Ségolène Royal on the left.
zh: 但民意調查中有兩位候選人一直遙遙領先：他們是右翼候選人尼古拉·薩爾柯齊(Nicolas Sarkozy)和左翼人士賽格萊娜·羅亞爾（Ségolène Royal ） 。

en: In fact, they have more in common than meets the eye, for each speaks of a rupture with the past while incarnating a form of continuity.
zh: 實際上，他們除了引人注目之外還有其他共同之處，那就是兩個人都提出要與過去決裂，但同時要體現出某種形式的繼承。

en: For Sarkozy, “rupture” reflects both mundanely tactical and deeply personal choices.
zh: 對薩爾柯齊來講 ， “ 決裂”既反映了世俗的技巧，也是深層次的個人選擇。

en: The 12 years of Jacques Chirac‘s presidency, together with France’s tradition of alternation in power, suggests a victory for the left.
zh: 雅克·希拉剋（Jacques Chirac）12年執政，以及法國領導層變動的傳統，都表明勝利屬於左翼黨派。

en: Positioning himself as the candidate who represents a sharp break with today’s unpopular politics is the only means to escape that fate.
zh: 將自己定位成與今天不受歡迎的政治決裂的候選人是避免厄運的唯一出路。

en: This is reflected in Sarkozy’s openly pro-American stance – an act of political courage in a France where anti-Americanism is running high.
zh: 這在薩爾柯齊公開的親美立場中有所反映¾在今天反美主義甚囂塵上的法國，採取這樣的立場需要很大的政治勇氣。

en: Sarkozy’s message is that Chirac and Villepin were right in substance to oppose America’s military adventure in Iraq, but that their style was disastrously wrong.
zh: 薩爾柯齊的立場是希拉剋和維爾潘反對美國軍事入侵伊拉克在實質上並沒有錯，但在形式上卻錯得一塌糊塗。

en: Thus, his deep admiration for “American values,” while sincere, implies no embrace of President George W. Bush.
zh: 因此，他對“美國價值觀”的深層崇拜儘管是真心流露，但卻不意味著喬治·W·布什總統的所作所為能得到贊同。

en: It also reassures the French business community, which was shocked by Dominique de Villepin’s flamboyant opposition to the United States when he was Chirac’s foreign minister.
zh: 薩爾柯齊的立場還給法國企業界人士吃下了定心丸，這些企業家被多米尼克·德維爾潘擔任希拉剋外長時與美國的公然對抗嚇出一身冷汗。

en: At home, Sarkozy has aimed his message particularly at the young, issuing a patriotic call to the values of work and discipline, a counter-revolutionary revolution.
zh: 在內政方面，薩爾柯齊把重點放在了青年人身上，力求喚起他們的愛國熱情，建立勤於工作和遵紀守法的價值觀，這是一場反對革命的革命。

en: The revolution that must be overcome is that of May 1968, whose leaders and supporters, according to Sarkozy, may have lost politically to de Gaulle, but deeply weakened France over the succeeding decades with their emphasis on “false values.”
zh: 必須杜絕1968年5月革命那樣的災難，因為在薩爾柯齊看來，這場革命的領導者和支持者或許在政治上輸給了戴高樂，但他們所強調的“錯誤價值觀”卻在接下來的幾十年內大大削弱了法國的力量。

en: By contrast, rebelling against one’s parents’ generation and rediscovering traditional moral stances will save France – a message that is highly applicable to issues, such as education and immigration, that may dominate the electoral campaign.
zh: 與此形成鮮明對照的是，反對父母那一代的觀點，重新發掘傳統的道德準則能夠拯救法國¾這樣的觀點對教育和移民等問題都大有裨益，而上述問題在競選活動中佔據了主導地位。

en: In the case of Royal, the meaning of “rupture” is both more obvious and more visible.
zh: 在羅亞爾看來 ， “ 決裂”的含義更加明確和清晰。

en: She is seeking to become the first woman President of the French Republic.
zh: 她試圖成為法蘭西共和國歷史上首位女性總統。

en: To achieve her goal, she prefers to emphasize her “essence,” thereby countering Sarkozy’s stress on his record as a “doer.”
zh: 為了達到這一目的，她更願意強調自己的“本質 ” ， 並以此來對抗薩爾柯齊的所謂“實幹家”履歷。

en: Her appeal to voters is simple: “I am a woman, and you have never tried a woman, so be modern and try one now.”
zh: 她吸引選民的口號非常簡單 ： “ 我是個女人，你們從來沒選過女總統，現在就應該跟上潮流，試試女總統的執政能力。 ”

en: Hiding behind the originality (in French presidential politics) of her gender, Royal has avoided specifying a detailed program.
zh: 躲在其性別（在法國總統政治中）的原創性背後，羅亞爾一直閃爍其辭，不願說明詳細的施政計劃。

en: When challenged by inquisitive journalists demanding greater precision about her policy agenda, her highly effective line of defense (so far!) has been: “You would not dare to ask me such a question if I were not a woman!”
zh: 當喜愛刨根問底的記者對她的政治安排的細節提出質疑的時候，她最有效的防禦手段（至少到目前為止）是 ： “ 如果我不是位女性，你根本就不敢提出這樣的問題！ ”

en: Thus, Royal’s program is her popularity.
zh: 於是，人氣就成了羅亞爾的法寶。

en: In foreign policy, one can only guess what her priorities would be.
zh: 我們只能猜想她在外交上將做出何種安排。

en: As far as Europe is concerned, she seems as “agnostic” as Sarkozy, who, like her, incarnates a new generation of “post-European” leaders.
zh: 在歐洲問題上，她似乎和薩爾柯齊一樣諱莫如深，而後者和她一樣，是新一代“後歐洲”領袖人物的代表。

en: In terms of values, Royal, too, seems to represent a rupture with May 1968, with her emphasis on discipline and family.
zh: 在價值觀方面，羅亞爾似乎也提倡與1968年5月革命決裂，而她著重強調的是法紀和家庭。

en: According to public opinion polls, Royal is the clear favorite of the left and the only candidate able to defeat Sarkozy.
zh: 民意測驗的結果顯示，羅亞爾顯然受到左翼黨派的青睞，是唯一有可能擊敗薩爾柯齊的候選人。

en: Her support is particularly strong among women voters.
zh: 女性選民對她的支援尤為熱烈。

en: For the Socialist Party, which is eager to return to power but has not yet recovered from the humiliating defeat of Lionel Jospin in the first round of the presidential election in 2002, the question is whether it can afford to resist the wave of favorable public opinion behind Royal.
zh: 對於急於重新當選而又尚未從2002年利昂內爾·若斯潘（Lionel Jospin）首輪選舉即慘遭淘汰的屈辱經歷中恢復元氣的社會黨來說，真正的問題在於它是否敢於對抗羅亞爾身後民意支援的洪流。

en: In the opinion of Royal’s many opponents among Socialist leaders and militants, the dominance of the media in the political process is leading to mediocrity: the qualities required to be elected are becoming nearly incompatible with those needed to govern.
zh: 在社會黨和軍界中羅亞爾的許多反對者看來，政治過程中媒體的主導地位已經導致政治日漸平庸：當選所需要的品質幾乎與執政需要的品質格格不入。

en: According to Royal’s Socialist critics, the “Hollywoodization” of politics from which she benefits entails a new approach in which leaders follow and followers lead.
zh: 在羅亞爾的社會黨批評者看來，令她受益匪淺的政治“好萊塢化”帶來一種嶄新的局面：那就是領導人譁眾取寵，而普通公眾反倒成了主角。

en: But the same criticism can be directed at Sarkozy.
zh: 但同樣的批評也可以指向薩爾柯齊。

en: Moreover, both candidates embody continuity – with Chirac’s Gaullist side for Sarkozy and with François Mitterrand for Royal – as much as rupture.
zh: 不僅如此，兩位候選人都在與過去決裂的同時，體現了政策的延續性¾薩爾柯齊���承了希拉剋和戴高樂的政策，而羅亞爾則接過了弗朗索瓦·密特朗(François Mitterrand) 的社會主義衣缽。

en: Royal openly claims Mitterand’s legacy as she searches for legitimacy, while Sarkozy’s rejection of Chirac’s legacy has more to do with form than substance.
zh: 羅亞爾在確立合法地位時公開聲稱要繼承密特朗的事業，而薩爾柯齊對希拉剋證見的排斥形式要遠遠大於實質內容。

en: To a large extent, Sarkozy can be seen as Chirac with more, whereas Royal is clearly Mitterrand with less.
zh: 在很大程度上薩爾柯齊比希拉剋更有能力，而羅亞爾則顯然比密特朗遜色許多。

en: When the voters decide in the spring of 2007, their choice may depend more on negative than positive considerations, as it did in 2002, when Chirac faced the odious nationalist Jean-Marie Le Pen in the second round.
