zh: 選民們在2007年春做出最後決定的時候，決定因素也許更多地來自負面、而不是正面的印象，這一點與2002年第二回合選舉中希拉剋面對臭名昭著的民族主義分子勒龐（Jean Marie Le Pen）時如出一轍。

en: As in 2002, the winner next year will be whomever the electorate dislikes or fears less.
zh: 與2002年時一樣，明年獲勝的將是選民們不那麼憎惡和害怕的候選者。

en: But one way or the other, personalities will prevail over programs.
zh: 但無論是誰最終當選，有一點可以肯定，那就是個性因素將成為凌駕於政治見解之上的決定性力量。

en: A Fresh Start for China and Japan?
zh: 中日關係的新開始？

en: Edmonton – Chinese President Hu Jintao will make a high-profile visit to Japan from May 6-10, making him the second Chinese head of state ever to travel there.
zh: 埃德蒙頓 — — 中國主席胡錦濤將於5月6日至10日高調訪問日本，這次訪問令他成為有史以來第二位訪日的中國國家主席。

en: The trip is being carefully managed by both countries, and is being watched closely around the world, with good reason: Sino-Japanese relations over the past decade have been turbulent, to say the least.
zh: 中日兩國都小心謹慎地對待這次訪問，世界其他國家也一直在密切關注這次訪問的行程，其原因顯而易見：過去10年來的中日關係一直充滿了各種各樣的動盪，這恐怕還是最緩和的說法。

en: When Hu’s predecessor, Jiang Zemin, traveled to Japan ten years ago, bilateral relations were deteriorating: China was unhappy with the Japanese government’s refusal to extend the same apology offered to South Korea for past aggression; Japan was worried about a rising China and thus turning more confrontational.
zh: 當胡的前任江澤民10年前訪問日本時，雙邊關係正在迅速惡化：中國對日本政府拒絕對過去的侵略行為向中國和韓國同樣致歉深感不滿，而日本則對中國的崛起充滿了憂慮，也因此滋長了對立情緒。

en: The Japanese media’s coverage of the visit was overwhelmingly negative, and it was remembered as a public-relations disaster.
zh: 日本媒體對那次訪問進行了佔據壓倒優勢的負面報導，而那次訪問也被作為公共關係的一場災難載入了史冊。

en: Hu succeeded Jiang in 2002, almost as former Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi was coming to power in Japan, and encouraged “New Thinking” in China’s Japan policy, which would entail moving away from historical grievances and promoting better ties.
zh: 胡在2002年接替了江的位置，當時的前日本首相小泉純一郎也剛剛宣誓就職，胡鼓勵在中日關係中引入“全新思維 ” ， 這樣也許可以遠離歷史的不滿並促進更為健康的雙邊關係。

en: But, instead of accepting China’s olive branch, Koizumi implemented a more nationalistic agenda, including annual visits to the Yasukuni Shine, which is regarded as a symbol of Japanese militarism by Japan’s neighbors.
zh: 但小泉不僅沒有接過中國遞出的橄欖枝，相反卻實行了更傾向於民族主義的政治策略，包括每年一度參拜敬國神社，而該神社在日本的鄰國看來恰恰象徵著日本的軍國主義。

en: His hard-line approach isolated Japan and angered China, leading to an outburst of anti-Japanese demonstrations in China in 2005.
zh: 小泉的強硬路線在讓日本陷入孤立的同時激怒了中國，引發了2005年的一系列反日示威。

en: But both Japan and China recognize that further tension will serve neither country’s long-term interests.
zh: 但日本和中國都已意識到：雙邊關係進一步緊張化不符合任何一方的長期利益。

en: Koizumi’s successors, Prime Ministers Shinzo Abe and Yasuo Fukuda, have sought to engage China over the past two years, with summits in Beijing and a successful visit by Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao to Japan last year.
zh: 小泉的繼任者，安倍晉三和福田康夫首相，過去兩年來一直試圖改善與中國的關係，中日雙方召開了北京峰會，而且去年中國總理溫家寶的訪日取得了成功。

en: Hu’s trip is likely follow the example set by Wen.
zh: 胡的訪問很有可能將溫的成果延續下去。

en: He will emphasize common strategic interests, highlight mutual economic benefits, generate positive public opinion, and promote further exchanges.
zh: 他將強調雙方共同的戰略利益，強調雙邊經濟互惠，促進積極的公眾輿論，並推動兩國進一步的交流。

en: Japan is not only one of China’s largest trade and investment partners, it is also the most powerful neighbor with which China wants to be on good terms, partly to showcase that China’s rise is not a threat to Asia and the rest of the world.
zh: 日本不僅是中國最大的貿易和投資夥伴，也是中國希望與之維護友好關係的實力最強的鄰居，中國這樣做的部分目的是向亞洲和世界其他國家展示中國的崛起並不對任何人構成威脅。

en: Japan, whose economic recovery is attributable largely to its deepening ties with China in recent years, is also eager to demonstrate that it regards China not as a threat but as an opportunity, as least in economic terms.
zh: 而日本近年以來的經濟復甦應該在很大程度上歸功於與中國日益深入的關係，因此日本也急於表明，日本並沒有把中國看作是一種威脅，而是一種機遇，這樣的看法至少在經濟領域能夠成立。

en: It was 30 years ago that former Prime Minister Takeo Fukuda, the father of today’s prime minister, signed a Peace and Friendship Treaty with China.
zh: 就在30年前，現任日本首相的父親，前任日本首相福田赳夫，與中國簽訂了《和平友好條約 》 。

en: The two governments will certainly use Hu’s visit to celebrate the anniversary with new programs designed to enhance bilateral understanding and friendship.
zh: 中日兩國政府肯定會利用胡錦濤這次的訪日契機制定旨在促進雙邊瞭解和友誼的新計劃，來慶祝《條約》簽訂的三十週年紀念日。

en: But, unlike three decades ago, when the Japanese regarded China as one of their most favored countries, public opinion in both countries nowadays registers more negative feelings than positive ones.
zh: 但與30年前情況不同的是，當日本把中國看作最惠國之一的時候，日中兩國目前的公眾輿論所顯示出來的負面情感卻遠遠多於善意。

en: Behind the smiles, the polite interactions, and the cautiously worded diplomatic language, strong undercurrents of suspicion remain.
zh: 在微笑、禮貌的接觸以及措辭小心翼翼的外交語言背後，仍然存在著力量強大的懷疑的暗流。

en: One problem is the disputed waters of the East China Sea.
zh: 問題之一是中國東海的爭議水域。

en: Despite new joint projects in energy efficiency and environmental protection, areas in which China ranks Japan as the best performer among industrialized countries, the two sides remain in bitterly divided over these territorial waters, which contain huge potential oil, gas, and other mineral deposits. Even after many rounds of talks, no resolution is in sight, and Hu’s visit is not expected to produce any breakthroughs.
zh: 儘管在能源效率和環境保護領域開展了新的合作專案，而且中國在上述領域裡把日本列為工業化國家首選的合作伙伴，但中日雙方依然在地區性水域問題上存在著嚴重的對立，而在中日存在著嚴重爭議的水域，很有可能蘊藏著大量的石油、天然氣和其他礦產資源。

en: Then there are strategic suspicions.
zh: 其次是嚴重的戰略懷疑。

en: Fukuda has dropped Abe’s talk about an “arch of freedom” – an effort to forge a bloc with the United States, Australia, and India.
zh: 福田停止了安倍有關“自由圈”的談判 — — 放棄了與美國、澳大利亞和印度組成聯合集團的努力。

en: But Japan remains concerned about China’s rapidly modernizing military, while China worries about a potential US-Japan containment strategy for China, especially in the case of a crisis in the Taiwan Straits.
zh: 但日本依然對中國軍事領域的快速現代化表示憂慮，而中國則擔心美日可能聯手對中國採取遏制策略，特別是如果臺海地區發生危機。

en: So, although both sides endorse the idea of a “mutually beneficial strategic relationship,” and despite progress bilateral on military exchanges, mutual trust and confidence-building have a long way to go.
zh: 因此，儘管中日雙方都對“互惠互利的戰略關係”深表讚賞，而且在雙邊軍事交流方面也取得了不少進步，但是在重拾信心，建立互信等領域還有很多工作有待完成。

en: Moreover, today’s “warm politics, cool economics” trend is the reverse of the “cold politics, warm economics” pattern under Koizumi.
zh: 此外，當前“政治熱、經濟冷”的趨勢正在取代小泉治下的“政治冷、經濟熱”的模式。

en: Last year, Japan’s committed investment projects in China fell 24% from 2006, while actual investment volume decreased by 25%, partly owing to regulatory changes in China regarding foreign investment.
zh: 去年，日本在中國的專屬投資專案比2006年降低了24 % ， 而實際投資額則縮減了25 % ， 這一變化部分來源於中國在外資流入方面的監管變化。

en: Recent food safety issues, such as the “poisoned dumplings” cases, have clearly heightened the Japanese public’s sensitivity about Chinese exports.
zh: 不久前所發生的安全問題，比如“毒餃子”事件，已經提高了日本公眾對中國出口商品的警惕。

en: Finally, historical issues could still resurface to cause new problems.
zh: 最後，歷史事件可以重新浮出水面造成新的問題。

en: While Fukuda has made it clear that he will not visit the Yasukuni Shrine, 160 other parliamentarians paid homage at the site last month, an indication that conservative forces in Japan remain strong and that future prime ministers may not abstain from visiting Yasukuni.
zh: 儘管福田明確了他將不再參拜敬國神社，仍然有160名議會成員在上個月到場表示了敬意。 這一現象表明日本的保守派勢力仍然十分強大，因此未來的日本首相不一定會放棄參拜神社的權利。

en: And Japan has so far failed to live up to its treaty obligations to clean up between 700,000 and two million chemical weapons that were abandoned in China by the Japanese army at the end of World War II, another potential flash point if any of these weapons causes casualties in China.
zh: 而且日本到目前為止未能履行條約中所應承擔的義務，清理二次大戰末期日軍遺棄在中國的700，000到2百萬件化學武器。 如果這些武器在中國造成人員傷亡，可能提醒中國民眾再次回憶起那段痛苦的經歷。

en: A Fresh Start for Europe
zh: 歐洲的新起點

en: As Europe’s leaders gather in Portugal to put the finishing touches on the new, slimmed down, Reform Treaty, it might be helpful if they all pretended that the last 50 years of European integration had never taken place.
zh: 當歐洲的領導人們在葡萄牙匯聚一堂，對新的、經過精減的《改革公約》進行最後潤色的時候，如果他們能佯裝過去50年的歐洲一體化從未發生那就好了。

en: Let’s then imagine what Europe needs to do to confront its most pressing challenges, especially if it were able to do so without the political constraints of 50 years of EU deal-making and ramshackle institution-building.
zh: 就讓我們想象一下歐洲為了應對最迫在眉睫的挑戰需要怎麼做，特別是它如果能夠擺脫50年來歐盟討價還價和朝三暮四的制度建設的政治制約。

en: On top of that, let us make a major leap of imagination and suppose that even though this scenario of the EU at “Year Zero” means we would not have a half-century of intra-European cooperation to draw on, the nations that today make up the EU would nevertheless be keen to adopt far-reaching joint policies.
zh: 在此之前，讓我們再發揮一下跳躍式的想象，假設儘管歐盟“零年”的情形意味著我們沒有長達半個世紀的歐洲內部合作的基礎，但當今組成歐盟的各國仍然渴望實施長期的共同政策。

en: Let’s suspend our disbelief, then, and try to imagine what Europe could and should be doing to tackle some of the most far-reaching and obstinate policy challenges that will determine whether the next 50 years are as constructive as the last.
zh: 那麼，讓我們擱置懷疑，並想象一下歐洲可以並且應該怎麼做以應對那些最為長遠和困難的政策挑戰。 這些挑戰會決定未來五十年是否會和過去的五十年一樣具有建設性。

en: Or, to put it another way, let’s look at our problems in the light of the EU’s existing mechanisms and its potential for creating far-reaching new policies, and then let’s ask ourselves why the EU isn’t realizing its own potential and delivering the goods.
zh: 或者，換句話說，讓我們在現有機制下來看待這些問題及歐盟創造長期新政策的潛力，然後再讓我們捫心自問歐盟為何沒有發揮潛力、實現目標。

en: Broadly, we see three areas in which Europe’s policymakers at both the national and EU levels can do better: global challenges where Europe could show greater leadership, the creation and strengthening of human capital within the EU and worldwide, and improvement in the effectiveness of the EU’s own political machinery.
zh: 從大處講，歐洲的政策制定者們在國家和歐盟層面上的三個領域可以做得更好：在全球性挑戰方面歐洲可以發揮更大的領導作用；在歐盟和世界範圍內創造和強化人力資本；提升歐盟自身政治機器的效率。

en: Europe needs a clearer and more recognizable global agenda.
zh: 歐洲需要一份更清晰和更能被認可的全球議程。

en: It needs to build substantially on its leadership on climate change by adopting much tougher EU goals, and then use its international economic and trade clout to champion new global emissions standards that scientific opinion can accept as meaningful.
zh: 它需要透過實施更為嚴格的歐盟目標來大幅提升在氣候變化方面的領導力，然後運用其國際經濟與貿易的影響力來引領新的全球排放標準。 這些標準應該被科學界認定為有意義的。

en: On conflict and security issues, Europe should be advancing to a new phase in which it takes much clearer and unambiguous positions on issues ranging from nuclear proliferation to sanctions against Burma’s military regime.
zh: 在衝突和安全問題上，歐洲應該步入一個新階段，在從核擴散到制裁緬甸軍政府的問題上表明更清晰和堅定的立場。

en: The purpose must be to establish Europe as a forceful and fair-minded player on the world stage, rather than as a “broad church” in which different viewpoints co-exist.
zh: 這樣做的目的是為了讓歐洲在世界舞臺上扮演一個強既有力又公平的角色，而不是一個不同觀點共存的“大聖堂 ” 。

en: The aim should be that “soft power” instruments like EU development aid and economic partnerships would be linked with a growing sense of political and security outreach to ensure Europe is a global player to be reckoned with.
zh: 其目標是將如歐盟發展援助和經濟夥伴關係這樣的“軟實力”工具與日益增長的政治和安全保障感聯絡起來，從而確立歐洲的全球作用。

en: That means, of course, that the EU should seek to widen its transatlantic thinking so that the EU and the United States cooperate more closely on defining – and thus protecting – their common interests in a world where together they account for little more than 10% of the total population.
zh: 當然，這就意味著歐盟應該尋求擴充套件其跨大西洋的思維以便歐盟和美國在定義—進而保護—它們在世界上的共同利益方面更緊密地合作。 兩者的總人口只不過佔世界總人口的百分之十多一點。

en: These points are far from a blanket criticism of the EU’s efforts to create a common foreign and security policy.
zh: 這些觀點甚至不算是對歐盟建立共同外交與安全政策的努力的委婉批評。

en: But they are intended to underline what many people in Europe know very well, which is that the speed with which problems concerning international development and conflict are growing easily outpaces the EU’s policy responses so far.
zh: 但它們旨在強調一些歐洲的許多人都再明白不過的事實，即與國際發展和衝突相關的問題惡化的速度早已超過了歐盟的政策回應速度。

en: Building more human capital in Europe and worldwide is a crucially important element in future EU activities.
zh: 在歐洲和世界範圍內建立更多的人力資本是歐盟未來活動中至關重要的因素。

en: Education is by far the most profitable investment Europe can make, so it should be launching its most ambitious strategy ever to create a new knowledge dynamic and employment inside the EU while helping to expand greatly education in the world’s poorest countries.
zh: 教育是目前為止歐盟可以進行的回報最高的投資。 因此它應該啟動有史以來最為宏偉的計劃，在內部創造新的求知動力和就業機會，同時幫助世界上最窮困的國家大力發展教育事業。

en: Europe also must at last grasp the nettle of immigration policy – something that has persistently eluded generations of political leaders.
zh: 歐洲還終究必須解決移民政策的痼疾—這個讓好幾代領導人都避之不及的問題。

en: Agreed EU-wide immigration rules are needed to reconcile shrinking Europe’s hunger for imported labor with widespread fears of cultural tensions and social unrest.
zh: 我們需要一套經各方批准的全歐洲的移民法規來協調那種透過廣泛傳播的對文化壓力和社會不安定的恐懼來抑制歐洲對外來勞力的極大需求的做法。

en: It won’t be easy to create a fairer and more multi-cultural Europe, but failure to address this problem openly will carry an even heavier price.
zh: 建設一個更為公平和多文化的歐洲決非易事，但在這個問題上應對不力會讓我們付出更為沉重的代價。

en: By much the same token, Europe’s governments should be making a determined new effort to strengthen Europeans’ sense of a shared history and common values.
zh: 同理，歐洲各國的政府應該付出更為堅定的努力來強化歐洲人的共同歷史感和共同價值觀。

en: A stronger European identity is the soundest basis for creating the more multi-cultural society that demographers regard as inevitable.
zh: 一種更強烈的歐洲認同感是創造多文化社會的最堅實基礎。 這樣的社會在人口統計學家們看來是不可避免的。

en: Meanwhile, doubts still surround the political and institutional machinery the EU will need to realize these and other ambitious goals.
zh: 同時，在歐盟實現其宏偉目標所需要的政治與制度機器上仍然疑雲籠罩。

en: Sighs of relief greeted EU leaders’ mid-year agreement on a Reform Treaty aimed at overhauling the Union’s decision-making mechanisms, but it is still uncertain whether the new pact will survive the ratification process in 27 countries.
zh: 歐盟領導人們在全面檢視該組織的決策機制的《改革公約》上達成的年中協議令人可以舒一口氣，但這一新協定能否得到27個成員國的批准仍然是個未知數。

en: We believe, though, that the increased use of qualified majority voting by member governments embodied in the new treaty should also be applied to the ratification process itself.
zh: 但我們認為新公約所規定的、正被各成員國越來越多地使用的有效多數票（qualified majority voting）方式，也應該適用於公約的批准過程本身。

en: That way, if a small minority of EU governments prove unable to ratify the treaty, it would not be torpedoed the way that its predecessor, the Constitutional Treaty, was in 2005.
zh: 如此一來，即便歐盟少數的成員國政府不能批准該公約，那麼它也不會像其前身《憲法公約》在2005年時一樣前功盡棄。

en: How to Help the African Dust Bowl
zh: 如何幫助非洲塵暴區

en: SEATTLE – Picture a small farm under a blazing hot sky.
zh: 西雅圖 — — 想象一下炎熱的天空下有一家小農場。

en: An intense drought is afflicting the surrounding region, prospects for the next harvest are bleak, and the financial system lacks the capacity to provide the loans farmers need to get by.
zh: 嚴重的乾旱影響著周圍地區，下一次收成前景十分暗淡，而金融系統卻不具備為農民提供應急貸款的能力。

en: This scenario describes today’s southern Africa, which is in the grips of an epic drought.
zh: 這副景象描繪的是今天的南部非洲，這裡正在遭受一場歷史性乾旱的侵襲。

en: As it happens, it also describes eastern Nebraska in the “Dust Bowl” years of the early 1930s – a period through which my own family lived.
zh: 這碰巧也是內布拉斯加州東部二十世紀三十年代初“塵暴”天氣的寫照 — — 這是我和家人的親身經歷。

en: My father, Ralph Raikes, was the first in his family to graduate from college.
zh: 我的父親拉爾夫·萊克斯是家族大學畢業的第一人。

en: After working for Standard Oil in California, he stopped by his parents’ farm on his way to Cambridge, Massachusetts, where he planned to pursue graduate studies at MIT.
zh: 畢業後，他先在加利福尼亞標準石油公司就職，而後在他父母的農場中途停留，打算之後前往馬薩諸塞州劍橋市攻讀麻省理工學院的研究生學位。

en: He never made it.
zh: 他沒能實現這個願望。

en: He had to stay in Nebraska and help my grandfather save the family farm from the banks, which had already repossessed one-third of the land.
zh: 他被迫留在了內布拉斯加，幫助我的祖父挽救家庭農場免於被銀行收回，當時銀行已經收回了三分之一的土地。

en: The most important change my father made was in his mindset: he came to think of the farm not as a subsistence operation, but as a family business.
zh: 我父親最重要的改變在於心態：他沒有把農場視作維持生計的小本經營，而是視作家族生意。

en: He turned to the University of Nebraska, where he had received his undergraduate degree, and acquired hybrid corn and other improved seeds that the university was developing.
zh: 他求助於自己本科畢業的內布拉斯加大學，從那裡拿到了這所大學正在研發的雜交玉米和其他改良種子。

en: Then he tracked inputs and weather conditions, which was rarely done at that time.
zh: 而後他嚴密監控投入的生產資料及天氣條件，這在當時是非常罕見的。

en: My father realized that he couldn’t go it alone, and that he would need better access to financing.
zh: 我父親意識到他不能單打獨鬥，他需要好的渠道進行融資。

en: So he helped guide – first as a customer, and later as an adviser and director – Farm Credit, a national banking cooperative network, in its efforts to help local farmers weather the Dust Bowl years.
zh: 因此他協助建立了農業信貸協會 — — 最初是以客戶的身份，後來逐漸成為顧問和董事，這是一套國家銀行合作網路，其目的是幫助當地農民度過塵暴天氣。

en: He also helped found the Nebraska Farm Business Association, which aggregated the data that he and his peers collected, so that they could determine best practices.
zh: 他還協助建立了內布拉斯加州農場業協會，該協會對他和同行蒐集的資料進行彙總，以便確定最佳的行為慣例。

en: And he worked together with my mother, Alice, who ran the family poultry business.
zh: 他與我的母親愛麗絲一起工作，我母親負責經營家族的禽類企業。

en: Farm Credit and the University of Nebraska’s labs and greenhouses emerged out of United States government programs that had been created to improve the agriculture sector’s performance.
zh: 農業信貸協會和內布拉斯加大學實驗室及溫室源於美國政府計劃，目的是改善農業領域的業績。

en: That sector was under water in 1933; with one-quarter of the population living on farms at the time, more investment was needed.
zh: 1933年農業境況低迷；當時有1/4的人口以務農為生，迫切需要加大對這一領域的投資。

en: That year, Congress passed the first “farm bill,” the Agricultural Adjustment Act, which boosted investment in the rural economy and helped lift farm income by 50% within two years.
zh: 那一年，國會透過了首部“農業法案 ” — —即“農業調整法案 ” — —推動了對農村經濟的投資，成功地在兩年內將農民收入提高了50 % 。

en: Federal farm programs treated farming as a business enterprise, enabling businessmen like my father to prosper.
zh: 聯邦農業計劃將農場視為一種商業企業，從而使我父親這樣的商人能夠興旺發達。

en: Eighty years later, African farmers need to make the same switch, by treating their subsistence operations as family-owned enterprises.
zh: 八年後，非洲農民需要做出同樣的轉變，把維持生計的小本經營看成家族產業。

en: And, like my father during the Dust Bowl years, they have novel means at their disposal: a wide range of new seeds and other technologies have been developed for African family farms – those with 4-5 acres or less – to use in the field.
zh: 而且，就像當年塵暴期我的父親一樣，他們不乏新的手段可以支配：為非洲農場研發了各式各樣的新種子和其他技術 — — 那些擁有4-5英畝土地或者更少的農戶可以在自己的田裡利用新技術和種子。

en: In October, a group of scientists received the World Food Prize for producing and disseminating a sweet potato variety that adds vitamin A to Sub-Saharan Africans’ diets, and other new seed varieties are helping farmers survive the harvest-crushing drought.
zh: 10月，一群科學家因生產和傳播一種新品種甘薯而獲得世界糧食獎，這種新品種甘薯在撒哈拉以南非洲人的飲食中加入了維他命A，此外還有其他新型種子品種正在幫助農民度過影響農業收成的旱災。

en: But, as a recent report from the Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa (AGRA) makes clear, government investment must follow the science.
zh: 但非洲綠色革命聯盟（AGRA）最近的一份報告表明，政府投資必須遵循科學原則。

en: Agriculture comprises almost two-thirds of Sub-Saharan Africa’s workforce, and in 2003 the African Union called for countries to increase their investment in the sector to an ambitious 10% of all government spending.
zh: 農業幾乎佔到撒哈拉以南非洲勞動力的三分之二，2003年非洲聯盟雄心勃勃地呼籲各國將農業部門投資提升到所有政府開支的10 % 。

en: Only 13 countries answered that call, but their investments – in research and development, services that help farmers take advantage of new research findings, credit and financing initiatives, commodity exchanges, and other marketing efforts – have already paid dividends.
zh: 只有十三個國家響應了這一呼籲，但他們的投資 — — 在研發領域、幫助農民利用新研究成果的服務、信貸和融資計劃、商品交易所和其他營銷努力 — — 均已經產生了豐厚的紅利。

en: Those 13 countries have experienced marked improvements in agricultural production, per capita GDP, and nutrition.
zh: 這十三個國家的農業生產、人均國內總產值和營養狀況均得到顯著的改善。

en: Government investment paves the way for private-sector investment, and it could be a game-changer for African farmers, who have operated at subsistence levels for far too long.
zh: 政府投資為私營部門投資鋪平了道路，對長期以來停留在維持生計低水平上的非洲農民來說，這可能徹底改變遊戲規則。

en: Only about 6% of rural households in Sub-Saharan Africa receive loans from financial institutions.
zh: 只有6%的撒哈拉以南非洲農村家庭可以從金融機構那裡獲得貸款。

en: Moreover, almost two-thirds of African farmland soil is missing key nutrients, and many farmers lack the technical knowledge and resources to restore their land’s fertility, leaving them unable to take full advantage of new technologies.
zh: 不僅如此，近2/3的非洲農田土壤缺少關鍵營養元素，而且很多農民缺乏恢復土地肥力的資源和技術知識，導致他們無法充分利用新技術。

en: African farmers growing new crop varieties are increasing their yields by only 28%, compared to 88% for farmers in Asia.
zh: 非洲農民種植新作物品種單產僅增加28 % ， 而亞洲農民的增長比例則高達88%左右。

en: My parents made certain that all five of their children graduated from college.
zh: 我的父母確保他們的每一個子女都讀到大學畢業。

en: Like them, farmers everywhere want to ensure that their children lead healthy, prosperous lives; and they all recognize the importance of education.
zh: 像他們一樣，世界各地的農民都希望確保自己的孩子過上健康、富足的生活；而且他們都認識到教育的重要性。

en: The farmers I have met around the world often just want to sell enough extra produce to pay their health bills and put their children through school.
zh: 我在世界各地碰到的農民往往只希望出售足夠的多餘農產品來支付自己的醫療費用和送子女上學。

en: They take advantage of opportunities when they arise, and they position their children to reap larger profits in the future.
zh: 他們在機會出現時緊緊抓住，他們努力確保自己的孩子能在未來能夠獲取更大的利潤。

en: One hopes that an American story of economic progress, like that of my family, will soon be an African story, too.
zh: 我們希望像我家這樣的美國經濟進步故事將會很快發生在非洲。

en: With so many new innovations becoming available, Africa’s family farmers need their governments to invest in their future.
zh: 隨著諸多創新成果集中上市，非洲家庭農場主需要他們的政府為他們的未來投資。

en: If they do, that future will look much better than today’s dusty and desperate reality.
zh: 如果政府做到這一點，未來將比今天塵土飛揚的絕望現實要好得多。

en: Africa at Risk
zh: 身處危險中的非洲

en: ADDIS ABABA – Climate change will hit Africa – a continent that has contributed virtually nothing to bring it about – first and hardest.
zh: 亞的斯亞貝巴 — — 氣候變化最先、也最沉重地打擊了非洲這塊從未造成過氣候變化的大陸。

en: Aside from Antarctica, Africa is the only continent that has not industrialized.
zh: 除南極洲以外，非洲恐怕是唯一一塊尚未實現工業化的大陸。

en: Indeed, since 1980’s the industrialization that had taken place in Africa has by and large been reversed.
zh: 事實上，在20世紀80年代以後，非洲大陸的工業化程序就總體而言已經發生了逆轉。

en: Africa has thus contributed nothing to the historical accumulation of greenhouse gases through carbon-based industrialization.
zh: 非洲也因此沒有在以碳為基礎的工業化溫室氣體積累中扮演任何角色。

en: Moreover, its current contribution is also negligible, practically all of it coming from deforestation and degradation of forests and farmland.
zh: 此外，非洲目前的碳排放也微乎其微，非洲所有的碳排放幾乎全部來自森林砍伐以及森林和農田的逐步退化。

en: Yet climate change will hit Africa hardest, because it will cripple the continent’s vulnerable agricultural sector, on which 70% of the population depends.
zh: 但氣候變化對非洲的打擊卻最大，因為它嚴重影響到非洲大陸脆弱的農業部門，而農業部門養活了70%的非洲人口。

en: All estimates of the possible impact of global warming suggest that a large part of the continent will become drier, and that the continent as a whole will experience greater climatic variability.
zh: 對全球變暖可能影響的所有預測都表明非洲大部分地區將會更加乾旱，而從整體而言非洲大陸將出現更為劇烈的氣候變化。

en: We know what the impact of periodic droughts have been on the lives of tens of millions of Africans.
zh: 我們已經知道週期性乾旱對數千萬非洲民眾生活所造成的影響。

en: We can therefore imagine what the impact of a drier climate on agriculture is likely to be.
zh: 因此我們可以想見氣候變幹可能對農業造成的影響。

en: Conditions in this vital economic sector will become even more precarious than they currently are.
zh: 與現有狀況相比，這一生死攸關的經濟領域的穩定性將會進一步下降。

en: Africa will not only be hit hardest, but it will be hit first.
zh: 非洲遭受的打擊不但最重，而且也最早。

en: Indeed, the long dreaded impact of climate change is already upon us.
zh: 實際上，人們已經在遭受懼怕已久的氣候變化的影響。

en: The current drought covering much of East Africa – far more severe than past droughts – has been directly associated with climate change.
zh: 東非絕大部分地區都在發生旱災 — — 這場旱災與氣候變化有著直接的關係，而且也比以往更加嚴重。

en: The upcoming climate negotiations ought to address the specific problems of Africa and similarly vulnerable poor parts of the world.
zh: 即將開始的氣候談判應當針對非洲和同樣脆弱的世界貧困地區所出現的具體情況。

en: This requires, first and most importantly, reducing global warming to the apparently inevitable increase of two degrees Celsius, beyond which lies an environmental catastrophe that could be unmanageable for poor and vulnerable countries.
zh: 第一步，也是最重要的一步，是要將全球變暖控制在看似不可避免的兩攝氏度的範圍之內，如果超出這個幅度，它所帶來的環境災難就會使貧困和脆弱國家無法承受。

en: Second, adequate resources should be made available to poor and vulnerable regions and countries to enable them to adapt to climate change.
zh: 其次，應該為貧困和脆弱的國家和地區提供充足的資源，以便使它們能夠適應氣候的變化。

en: Climate change, which was largely brought about by the activities of developed countries, has made it difficult for poor and vulnerable countries to fight poverty.
zh: 總體而言由發達國家活動所造成的氣候變化已經加大了貧困和脆弱國家戰勝貧困的難度，導致發展環境進一步惡化。

en: It has created a more hostile environment for development. No amount of money will undo the damage done.
zh: 由此造成的損失無論花多少錢都無法彌補。

en: But adequate investment in mitigating the damage could partly resolve the problem.
zh: 但投入充足的資金減輕損失或許能夠部分解決問題。

en: Developed countries are thus morally obliged to pay partial compensation to poor and vulnerable countries and regions to cover part of the cost of the investments needed to adapt to climate change.
zh: 因此，發達國家也有義務向貧困脆弱國家及地區支付部分彌補氣候變化所需投資的相關賠償。

en: Various estimates have been made of the scale of investment required by those countries.
zh: 人們對上述國家所要求的投資規模做出了各種猜想。

en: One conservative estimate – which has a reasonable chance of being accepted precisely because it is conservative – calls for $50 billion per year as of 2015, increasing to $100 billion by 2020 and beyond.
zh: 一種保守的估計提出到2015年前每年投資500億美元，到2020年及以後則增加到1000億美元 — — 這一提案之所以有可能被採納也正是因為它比較保守。

en: A transitional financing arrangement would be put in place for the period 2010-2015.
zh: 2010－2015年間將實行過渡性融資計劃。

en: Some argue that developed countries cannot come up with such sums, particularly given their current economic challenges.
zh: 有人提出特別是在當前的經濟困境下，發達國家拿不出這麼大的數目。

en: But no one has so far argued that the cost of damage caused to the development prospects of poor countries and regions is less than the amount of compensation being offered to cover adjustment costs.
zh: 但迄今為止還沒有人提出貧困國家和地區發展前景所遭受的損失達不到支付調整費用的補償額。

en: The reason is obvious: the damage caused is many times higher than the compensation being requested.
zh: 原因非常明顯：所造成的損失數倍於所要求補償的數額。

en: Nonetheless, it is argued, whatever the real cost of the damage, developed countries currently cannot afford to provide that kind of money.
zh: 即便如此，仍有人提出無論損失的實際數額怎樣，發達國家目前都無法支付這筆金額。

en: But we all know that these countries and their national banks were able to spend trillions of dollars in a few months to bail out their bankers, who earned super-profits when the going was good.
zh: 可我們都知道這些國家和它們的央行有能力在數月之內耗費數萬億美元的巨資來救助它們在經濟執行平穩時賺取了超額利潤的銀行。

en: When the good times ended, taxpayers and governments were prepared to rescue them and to ensure that they continued to receive their extraordinary bonuses.
zh: 好日子結束時，納稅人和政府準備救援它們，確保它們繼續得到額外的津貼。

en: If the developed world is able to pay trillions of dollars to clean up its bankers’ mess, how is it possible that it cannot afford to pay billions of dollars to clean up a mess that it created, and that is threatening the survival of whole continents?
zh: 如果發達國家能拿出數萬億美元清理銀行的混亂局面，那麼它又怎麼可能拿不出區區數十億美元來為自己製造的威脅到世界民眾生存的混亂局面繕後？

en: Clearly this is not about the availability of resources. It is about the inappropriate priorities in how resources are allocated.
zh: 顯然問題的關鍵並不在於有沒有相關的資源，而在於資源分配的順序恰不恰當。

en: It is about moral values that make it appropriate to rescue bankers, who expect everyone but themselves to pay for the mess they created, and inappropriate to compensate the world’s poorest people, whose survival is threatened precisely because of the mess created by developed countries.
zh: 問題的關鍵是在某些人價值取向中認為應當救援銀行，哪怕銀行希望除自己之外的所有人為自己造成的混亂負責，也不應該補償世界最貧困的民眾，他們的生存已經在發達國家所造成的混亂中受到了威脅。

en: I cannot believe that people in developed counties, when informed about the issues, would support rescuing bankers and oppose partial compensation for poor countries and regions.
zh: 我無法相信發達國家的民眾在瞭解事實真相後，會支援援助銀行而反對對貧困國家地區給予部分的補償。

en: I cannot believe that they will let such an injustice occur.
zh: 我無法相信他們會放任這種不公平的現象。

en: If they are not expressing their outrage over the injustice of it all, it can only be because they are inadequately informed.
zh: 如果他們沒有表達對這種不公平現象的憤怒，那隻能是因為他們還不完全瞭解事實的真相。

en: Three Humanitarian Challenges for Africa in 2018
zh: 2018年非洲的三大人道主義挑戰

en: NAIROBI – In mid-2017, when a cholera outbreak in Somalia threatened to overwhelm local hospitals, health experts feared the worst.
zh: 內羅畢—2017年年中，索馬利亞爆發了一場禍亂，幾乎讓當地醫院完全癱瘓，衛生專家做好了最壞的打算。

en: With crippling drought, malnutrition, and poverty already endemic, an outbreak of deadly diarrhea seemed destined to paralyze the fragile state. But, despite the dire predictions, institutional paralysis was avoided.
zh: 目前，大旱、營養不良和貧困仍然頑固難除，爆發致命的腹瀉病、讓這個脆弱的國家陷入癱瘓的情景似乎難以避免。

en: Although hundreds died and many more became sick, the collective response managed by governments, NGOs, and local communities, including the national Red Crescent Societies supported by the Red Cross movement, contained the disease.
zh: 儘管有數百人喪生，更多人患病，但政府、非政府組織、當地社群 — — 包括紅十字會運動支援的國家紅十字會 — — 共同組織的集體響應還是遏制了疫情。

en: Somalia’s experience gives me great hope for Africa’s future.
zh: 索馬利亞的經驗讓我們的非洲的未來有了很大希望。

en: But it also serves as a reminder that local capacity is easily inundated during times of crisis.
zh: 但它也提醒我們，地方能力很容易被危機吞噬。

en: While some parts of Africa have become self-sufficient in terms of public health, others continue to lean heavily on global aid.
zh: 儘管一些非洲國家在公共衛生方面已能自給自足，但其他國家仍嚴重依賴國際援助。

en: For these areas, partnership is the best means of minimizing risks.
zh: 對於這些地區，合作是實現風險最小化的最好辦法。

en: In particular, three key challenges this year are likely to pose the severest tests of Africa’s ability to manage humanitarian crises.
zh: 特別是，今年有三項主要挑戰有可能對非洲管理人道主義危機的能力進行最嚴厲的檢驗。

en: The first challenge is violence in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
zh: 第一項挑戰是民主剛果的暴力。

en: Last year, conflict in the DRC’s central Kasai region displaced some 1.4 million people, bringing the total displaced population to 4.1 million – the largest concentration of internal refugees anywhere in Africa.
zh: 去年，民主剛果中部的開賽（Kasai）地區有140萬人流離失所，使得失去家園的總人口達到了410萬 — — 也是非洲規模最大的國內難民群體。

en: The violence has exacerbated food insecurity, with more than three million people severely undernourished.
zh: 暴力加劇了糧食安全問題，三百多萬人嚴重營養不良。

en: Unfortunately, the Kasai crisis is expected to worsen in 2018.
zh: 不幸的是，預計在2018年，開賽危機還將繼續惡化。

en: A recent assessment by the Red Cross Society of the DRC warns that the number of people displaced will continue to rise, and with a fast-spreading cholera outbreak threatening the region, a coordinated plan of action is urgently needed.
zh: 民主剛果紅十字會的一份 最新評估警告說，流離失所人數將繼續增加，且該地區還受到傳播迅速的霍亂疫情的威脅，急需協調行動計劃。

en: The second challenge this year is Somalia’s food insecurity, which, according to the Famine Early Warning Systems Network, is expected to intensify this year.
zh: 今年的第二項挑戰是索馬利亞糧食安全問題，據饑荒早期預警系統網路的資料，索馬利亞糧食安全問題在今年將加劇。

en: Below-average rainfall in 2017 stunted harvests, and most regions have not fully recovered.
zh: 2017年，低於平均水平的降水妨礙了收成，大部分地區尚未完全恢復。

en: As humanitarian aid is channeled to the country, efforts must be made to target long-term solutions, such as improving agricultural output, educational access, and economic opportunity.
zh: 在人道主義援助不斷流向索馬利亞之際，必須制定長期方案，如改善農業產出、普及教育和經濟機會。

en: Historically, most aid to the country has been earmarked for emergency relief; even the collective cholera response was narrowly focused on short-term health.
zh: 從歷史上看，流入索馬利亞的大部分援助用來進行緊急紓困；即使是集體霍亂響應措施，也狹窄地集中關注短期健康。

en: But Somalia desperately needs a more holistic, long-term development strategy.
zh: 但索馬利亞急需更加全域性性的長期發展戰略。

en: Finally, the very scourge that Somalia contained last year will continue to rear its head elsewhere in the region.
zh: 最後，去年被索馬利亞克服的災難，今年將在域內其他地方急需肆虐。

en: Yemen’s cholera outbreak is now the largest in history, having already surpassed one million confirmed cases, and, despite years of international assistance, the threat continues to stalk Africa.
zh: 葉門霍亂疫情已經達到歷史最大規模，確診病例已超過一百萬例，而儘管有多年來國際援助的支援，非洲也仍然飽受霍亂的威脅。

en: In the last four decades, African countries reported over three million suspected cholera cases to the World Health Organization and new cases are cropping up this year in Africa’s east-central and southern regions.
zh: 在過去四十年裡，非洲國家向世界衛生組織報告了三百萬例疑似病例，而在非洲中東部和南部地區，今年不斷有新病例湧現。

en: Fortunately, there is hope that Somalia’s containment success in 2017 can be replicated, provided that communities and individuals are well aware of the disease and related risks, and that local actors receive the needed resources.
zh: 幸運的是，索馬利亞在2017年所取得的遏制霍亂的成功有希望得到複製，只要社會和個人對霍亂及其相關風險有清醒的認識，並且本地行動方能夠獲得所需要的資源。

en: The Global Task Force on Cholera Control, which seeks to build local and international support for improved health care and sanitation, has published a global roadmap for ending cholera by 2030.
zh: 霍亂控制全球任務組（Global Task Force on Cholera Control）負責為醫療和衛生設施的改善尋找本地和國際支援，它已經發布了2030年消滅或亂全球路線圖。

en: Although that is an ambitious target, it is achievable if international organizations and local governments work together.
zh: 儘管這是一個宏大的目標，但只要國際組織和地方政府齊心協力，仍然是可以實現的。

en: Natural and manmade crises will continue to plague Africa, but organizations like mine are working hard to bring about a brighter future through improved capacity building.
zh: 自然和人為危機將繼續在非洲肆虐，但我所在的和其他組織正在努力透過改善能力構建為非洲打造更加光明的未來。

en: To succeed, however, local and international development partners must reorient their thinking; humanitarian aid alone will not solve Africa’s myriad challenges.
zh: 但要想獲得成功，本地和國際發展夥伴必須改變思維：光靠人道主義援助不足以解決非洲為數巨大的挑戰。

en: While money is clearly needed, it must be spent more strategically to improve structural weaknesses that perpetuate instability.
zh: 資金顯然是必要的，但花錢必須更有策略性，以改善造成持續動盪的結構性弱點。

en: For example, if more funding were devoted to community-level health care projects, local organizations would be better positioned to lead when outbreaks threaten.
zh: 比如，如果更多的資金能夠用於社群層面的醫療專案，本地組織就能在疫情爆發時更好地起到領導作用。

en: Put simply, the international development community must do more to invest in grassroots solutions, empowering Africans rather than treating them as subcontractors to their own suffering.
zh: 簡言之，國際發展社會必須加大對草根方案的投入，為非洲人民賦權，而不是將他們視為解決自身困難的轉包商。

en: Not only are local organizations better positioned to navigate complex cultural and linguistic landscapes; they also have more to lose if they fail.
zh: 本地組織更適合應付複雜的文化和語言環境；但如果它們失敗的話，代價也更大。

en: Last year was devastating for many Africans, as millions suffered from drought, hunger, and violence.
zh: 去年對於許多非洲人來說是災難性的一年，數百萬人蒙受了乾旱、飢餓和暴力。

en: But in Somalia, a coordinated response to a serious health threat offered new hope for a more secure future.
zh: 但在索馬利亞，面對嚴重衛生威脅的協調響應讓人們感到能夠構建更安全的未來的新希望。

en: When local ingenuity and international support align, the cycle of suffering can be broken. For many African countries, the ability to look confidently beyond the next crisis is the first step on the long road to self-reliance.
zh: 對許多非洲國家而言，充滿自信地將目光放在比下一場危機更遠的地方，是構建自我恢復力的漫長征程的第一步。

en: Africa, Climate Change, and the G-8 Summit
zh: 非洲、氣候變化和八國峰會

en: British Prime Minister Tony Blair has declared that the two issues at the center of the G-8 Summit this July will be African poverty and global climate change.
zh: 英國首相托尼·布萊爾已經宣佈，今年七月舉行的八國峰會的兩大主要議題將是非洲貧困與全球氣候變化。

en: These may seem to be distinct issues. In fact, they are linked.
zh: 這兩個話題也許看起來大相徑庭，但事實上，它們卻是相互關聯的。

en: A trip I took to a village in the Tigre region in northern Ethiopia shows why.
zh: 我去了衣索比亞北部的Tigre地區的一個村莊，這趟旅行能解釋其中緣由。

en: One morning, I was taken to a dry riverbed at the village’s edge.
zh: 一天早晨，我被帶到村莊邊緣一個乾涸的河床。

en: Farmers were digging a pit in the riverbed, down to the water table approximately two meters below ground level.
zh: 農民們正在河床中挖一個深坑，一直挖到地面以下兩米多的水管處。

en: They explained that until recently this was a perennial river – one that flows throughout the year – but now the river stops flowing during the dry season.
zh: 他們解釋說，這條河不久之前還是一條四季不枯竭、全年流淌不息的河，但是現在這條河一到旱季就斷流。

en: Only when the annual rains begin in the summer does water reappear in the river bed.
zh: 只有在每年夏天的降雨來臨之時，河床裡才會有河水。

en: Until then, water-starved communities dig for water, if they can find it and if they can afford to pump it out.
zh: 就是從那個時候開始，只要能夠找到水源並且有足夠的錢把水抽出來，缺水地區就會挖坑尋水。

en: In northern Ethiopia, as in much of Africa, the rain cycle has changed markedly in recent years.
zh: 和非洲其他諸多地區一樣，北衣索比亞最近幾年的雨迴圈已經發生顯著變化。

en: Ethiopian village life has long depended on two crops, one during a short rain in March and April, and the main crop during the long rain in the summer months.
zh: 衣索比亞內的村莊長期以來依賴於兩種農作物。 一種農作物生長於三月和四月的短雨季，而主要農作物則在夏天的長雨季中生長。

en: In recent years, the short rains have failed entirely, and long rains have been erratic.
zh: 最近幾年，短雨季已經完全消失，而長雨季也變得不再穩定。

en: Hunger is omnipresent.
zh: 饑荒正在蔓延。

en: Perhaps half of the children are severely underweight.
zh: 或許已有一半的兒童體重嚴重不足。

en: Much of arid sub-Saharan Africa, notably in the Sahel (the region just south of the Sahara desert), has experienced a pronounced drop in rainfall over the past quarter-century.
zh: 撒哈拉沙漠以南的大部分乾旱地區，尤其是Sahel（該地區就在撒哈拉沙漠南面 ） ， 過去25年的降雨量已經明顯下滑。

en: This decline coincided with a rise in the surface temperature of the neighboring Indian Ocean, a hint that the decline in rainfall is in fact part of the longer-term process of man-made global warming.
zh: 與此同時，離它不遠的印度洋卻水溫上升，這一現象暗示著，降雨量的減少實際是人類一手造成的長期全球性氣候變暖的一部分。

en: Failures of rainfall contribute not only to famines and chronic hunger, but also to the onset of violence when hungry people clash over scarce food and water.
zh: 降雨量的不足不僅導致了連年饑荒，還引發了暴力活動，飢餓的人們為爭奪稀少的食物和水源而衝突不斷。

en: When violence erupts in water-starved regions such as Darfur, Sudan, political leaders tend to view the problems in narrow political terms.
zh: 當缺水地區，諸如達爾富爾和蘇丹，爆發暴力活動時，政治領導人從狹隘的政治角度來看待問題。

en: If they act at all, they mobilize peacekeepers, international sanctions, and humanitarian aid.
zh: 一旦行動，他們就會動用和平維護者、國際制裁和人道主義援助。

en: But Darfur, like Tigre, needs a development strategy to fight hunger and drought even more than it needs peacekeepers. Soldiers cannot keep peace among desperately hungry people.
zh: 但是，與Tigre一樣，對達爾富爾來說，比起和平維護者來說，它更需要一個能夠抵抗饑荒和乾旱的發展策略。

en: One course of action must be to help impoverished African regions to “adapt” to climate change and to escape the poverty trap.
zh: 該行動必須要有一個能幫助貧瘠的非洲地區“適應”氣候變化並脫離貧窮陷阱的過程。

en: Water-stressed regions like Ethiopia and Sudan can adapt, at least in part, through improved technologies such as “drip irrigation,” rainwater harvesting, improved water storage facilities, deep wells, and agro-forestry techniques that make best use of scarce rainfall. Better land-management practices (the re-planting of degraded forests, for example) can recharge underground water aquifers.
zh: 透過技術改進，諸如能最有效利用不足降水的“滴灌 ” 、 人工彙集雨水、改良後的儲水裝置、深井以及農業林學技術，使衣索比亞和蘇丹這樣的缺水地區至少在一定程度上適應氣候變化。

en: Poor countries cannot afford these technologies on their own.
zh: 貧窮國家本身無力擔負這些技術的費用。

en: Nor should they have to.
zh: 這也不應該由他們來承擔。

en: Help for poor countries in Africa and elsewhere to adapt to climate change should not be described as charity or aid, but rather as compensation for damages being imposed on the poorest people on the planet.
zh: 對非洲或其他任何地方的貧窮國家提供使他們適應氣候變化的幫助不應當被視為是一種慈善或援助，而是對這個星球上最貧困的、強制性忍受各種毀壞的人們的一種補償。

en: Greater help for these countries to escape from extreme poverty has been promised for decades but has not been delivered.
zh: 數十年來，向這些國家提供更多使其脫離極度貧困的承諾一再出現，卻從未兌現。

en: In addition to adapting to climate change, the world must also reduce future risks to the planet by cutting back on emissions of greenhouse gases, which are the source of man-made climate change.
zh: 除了要適應氣候變化，全世界也必須減少溫室氣體的排放以降低這個星球未來所面臨的風險。 溫室氣體正是人為氣候改變的罪魁禍首。

en: While adaptation to climate change is necessary – because it is already occurring – this is not enough.
zh: 雖然對氣候變化的適應是必需的 — — 因為它已經發生了 — — 但這還不夠。

en: If the world fails to mitigate future climate change, the effects of rising temperatures, increasing droughts, more numerous and severe tropical storms, rising sea levels, and a spread of tropical diseases will pose huge threats to the entire planet.
zh: 如果全世界不能減緩未來氣候變化的趨勢，那麼上升的氣溫、愈發嚴重的旱情、愈加頻繁嚴重的熱帶��暴、不斷上漲的海平線以及熱帶疾病的擴散將會給全球帶來嚴峻考驗。

en: The famines in Ethiopia and the violence in Darfur suggest what can lie ahead.
zh: 衣索比亞的饑荒和達爾富爾的暴力活動已經預示著將會面臨的情況。

en: The best way to reduce long-term climate change is to reduce carbon emissions.
zh: 減緩長期氣候變化趨勢的最佳方法是減少碳化物的排放。 這至少有三個辦法： 改用非碳能源，諸如太陽能和核能。

en: There are at least three options: shift to non-carbon energy sources such as solar or nuclear energy; capture and dispose of the carbon dioxide emitted at carbon-based power plants; economize on energy use, for example by shifting to hybrid automobiles and trucks.
zh: 不允許以碳作能源的發電廠釋放二氧化碳氣體，對二氧化碳氣體作妥善處理。 節約使用能源，比如改用混合型汽車和卡車。

en: Most likely, all three of these methods will have to play a role.
zh: 很有可能，這三種方法都必須發揮作用。

en: The effort to reduce greenhouse gases will require decades of action, but, given the long lead times in overhauling the world’s energy systems, we must start now.
zh: 要減少溫室氣體還需要很多努力，但是，鑑於改革全球能源系統需要很長時間，我們必須現在就開始。

en: Rich countries need to lead the way.
zh: 富國應當擔當起領頭羊的任務。

en: It is ironic that the United States, which portrays itself as a friend of democracy and impoverished countries, gives the smallest share of its GNP in aid among the rich countries, and also refuses to participate in global efforts to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
zh: 頗為諷刺的是，向來自詡為民主和窮困國家之友的美國，與其他富國相比，提供的援助只佔其國民生產總值的最小份額，它還拒絕參加為減少溫室氣體排放的全球行動。

en: This is especially ironic because African countries like Ethiopia stand steadfastly and bravely with the US in the fight for freedom and against terrorism, even as they struggle with hunger, disease, and famine.
zh: 這點尤為諷刺，因為衣索比亞這樣的非洲國家即使在飢餓、疾病和饑荒中艱苦掙扎，他們還是堅定不移、勇往無懼地與美國一起站在爭取自由與反對恐怖主義的同一戰線上。

en: Moreover, countries like Ethiopia are making valiant, indeed remarkable, efforts to overcome their problems, despite the lack of adequate, and long-promised, help from the world’s richest countries.
zh: 此外，像衣索比亞這樣的國家正在採取堅定有效的措施來克服他們的問題，儘管沒有得到來自世界最富有國家承諾許久的任何適當幫助。

en: Africans suffering from hunger and drought, and indeed poor people everywhere, have a right to ask much more of the US and other rich countries.
zh: 正在遭受著饑荒和旱災的非洲人民，以及世界各地的貧困人們，都有權利來向美國和其他富國提出更多要求。

en: Tony Blair is right to call on his rich-country colleagues to follow through on their unfulfilled promises.
zh: 託尼·布萊爾號召他的富國同僚們來履行完他們未盡責的承諾，他做對了。

en: Capitalizing on Africa’s Demographic Dividend
zh: 利用非洲的人口紅利

en: LOMÉ – Africa is home to the world’s youngest and fastest-growing population.
zh: 洛美—非洲擁有全世界最年輕、增長最快的人口。

en: With as many as 20 million young people poised to join the workforce every year for the next three decades, the continent has an opportunity to shift the balance of local and global growth with a purpose: jobs.
zh: 未來三十年，每年都會有多達2,000萬年輕人加入勞動力，非洲面臨著改變本地和全球增長平衡的機會：就業。

en: But it is far from inevitable that it will do so.
zh: 但這絕非定局。

en: For African countries to capitalize on this demographic dividend, the future workforce must be educated, trained, and have adequate employment opportunities.
zh: 非洲國家要想利用這一人口紅利，未來勞動力就必須接受教育和訓練，並擁有充足的就業機會。

en: Putting all the pieces in place will not be easy.
zh: 同時滿足這些條件絕非易事。

en: These are uncertain times for the global economy.
zh: 現時代是全球經濟的不確定時代。

en: Trade tensions between the United States and China are threatening the integrity of global value chains, and Britain’s looming exit from the European Union has the potential to cause even more disruption.
zh: 美國與中國之間的貿易緊張威脅著全球價值鏈的完整性，即將發生的英國退歐有可能導致更大的破壞。

en: The International Monetary Fund’s October forecast warns that as historic economic drivers stall, global growth this year and next could fall to 3.7%, a decline of 0.2 percentage points from previous estimates.
zh: 國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）在其10月份的預測中警告說，隨著歷史性的經濟引擎的熄火，今年和明年全球增長可能下降至3.7 % ， 較此前的預測降低0.2個百分點。

en: But as this slowdown gets priced in by stock markets around the world, new drivers of growth will emerge.
zh: 但隨著這一減速體現在全世界股票市場中，新的增長引擎也將浮現。

en: Africa is well positioned to become one of them.
zh: 非洲非常有望成為新引擎之一。

en: According to the World Bank, six of the world’s ten fastest-growing economies are in Africa.
zh: 據世界銀行資料，全球增長最快的十個經濟體中有六個在非洲。

en: Intra-African trade might be the gateway to future local and global growth, with the continent’s burgeoning population forging new opportunities across borders.
zh: 非洲內部貿易可能成為未來本地和全球增長的門戶，其生機勃勃的人口將帶來眾多跨國機會。

en: Most significantly, Africa’s labor force is on the verge of a dramatic expansion.
zh: 最重要的是，非洲勞動力即將迎來大爆發。

en: Today, 60% of Africans are younger than 25, and 41% are under the age of 15.
zh: 今天，60%的非洲人不到25歲，41%不到15歲。

en: By 2050, Africa’s youth population is expected to reach 840 million.
zh: 到2050年，非洲青年人口預計將達到8.4億。

en: But this massive pool of potential talent is a double-edged sword.
zh: 但這一巨大的未來人才庫是一柄雙刃劍。

en: Despite strong GDP growth over the last ten years, the majority of young people in Africa could not capture economic opportunities.
zh: 儘管過去十年GDP增長強勁，但非洲大部分年輕人無法抓住經濟機會。

en: Furthermore, the African Union/OECD report Africa’s Development Dynamics 2018 highlights that if the underemployment trend continues, Africa’s young people will suffer the most.
zh: 此外，非盟/經合組織報告《非洲發展動態2018 》 （ Africa’s Development Dynamics 2018）強調，如果失業趨勢繼續，非洲年輕人將受到最大沖擊。

en: Failing to employ Africa’s young people fully could marginalize an entire generation and lead them down a path of disruption for which we may not be prepared.
zh: 不能充分僱用非洲年輕人可能會造成整整一代人被邊緣化，把他們推向他們未必準備好的破壞之路。

en: For countries to experience job-led long-term growth, the provision of quality opportunities in agriculture is vital.
zh: 對於意在透過就業刺激長期增長的國家，提供高質量農業機會至關重要。

en: If that does not happen, and quality jobs remain scarce, the economic expansion of which Africa is capable will not happen.
zh: 若非如此，如果高質量就業仍然稀缺，非洲本有能力實現的經濟擴張就不會發生。

en: In other words, African governments are facing a deadline to match job growth with skills training.
zh: 換句話說，非洲政府面臨匹配就業增長與技能訓練的最後期限。

en: Unfortunately, at the moment, few countries are addressing this challenge effectively.
zh: 不幸的是，目前很少有國家能夠有效地面對這一挑戰。

en: According to the African Development Bank, the unemployment rate for young people in Africa is already double the rate for adults.
zh: 據非洲開發銀行，非洲年輕人失業率已高達成年人的兩倍。

en: In fact, young people are being let down even before they start looking for work.
zh: 事實上，年輕人在開始找工作之前便已經被淘汰。

en: Too many primary schools suffer from crippling teacher shortages, for example, and gender discrimination prevents millions of girls from even attending high school.
zh: 比如，太多小學師資力量嚴重短缺，而性別歧視又讓數百萬女童根本無法上學。

en: To overcome these shortcomings will require significant investments of political and financial capital.
zh: 要克服這些缺陷，需要投入巨大的政治和金融資本。

en: Some leaders are moving in this direction.
zh: 一些領導人正在朝這一方向努力。

en: At the Paris Peace Forum (PPF), held earlier this month, African and global leaders gathered to discuss the powerful idea that international cooperation is the key to tackling global challenges and ensuring durable peace.
zh: 在本月早些時候舉行的巴黎和平論壇（PPF）上，非洲和全球領導人聚會討論了一個強大的概念：國際合作是解決全球挑戰、確保持續和平的關鍵。

en: On the sidelines of the PPF, the focus fell on African youth.
zh: PPF會場之外，焦點集中在了非洲年輕人身上。

en: The AU-EU Youth Cooperation Hub, one of 119 projects selected to participate in the Forum, attended the meeting to discuss the AU-EU Youth Agenda.
zh: 作為被選中參與PPF的119個專案之一，非盟-歐盟青年合作中心（AU-EU Youth Cooperation Hub）參會討論了非盟-歐盟青年日程。

en: Striving to involve young people across Africa and Europe in decisions that impact them, now and in the future, this initiative aims to showcase strategies for bringing Africa and Europe together to address challenges such as the demographic dividend.
zh: 該計劃致力於讓非洲和歐洲的年輕人參與到現在和未來影響他們的決策中，旨在呈現讓非洲和歐洲合作解決人口紅利等挑戰的策略。

en: One approach to capitalizing on Africa’s demographic boom is to expand the availability of training initiatives that pair employers’ needs with African talent.
zh: 利用非洲人口紅利的一個方法是擴大訓練專案普及度，讓僱主的需求與非洲人才相匹配。

en: As a former fellow with the Ibrahim Leadership program, I can attest to the transformative power of top-tier educational schemes and their value as incubators for job-related skills.
zh: 作為 易卜拉欣領導力（Ibrahim Leadership）專案前成員，我能夠證明優秀的教育計劃的轉變力，以及作為就業相關技能孵化器的價值。

en: Africa’s success relies on its ability to harness its demographic dividend by equipping its youth with technological and innovative skills, which will be a catalyst for economic growth.
zh: 非洲的成功取決於其用技術和創新技能武裝年輕人，成為經濟增長的催化劑，從而抓住人口紅利的能力。

en: This includes training and agriculture-focused programs to absorb skills along the value chains that connect raw materials to industries and markets across Africa.
zh: 這包括透過訓練專案和以農業為中心的計劃，沿著從整個非洲的原材料到產業和市場的價值鏈吸收技能。

en: By 2030, one in every five people on the planet will be African.
zh: 到2030年，全世界五分之一的人口都將生活在非洲。

en: Because of its size alone, Africa’s labor force will have the potential to drive global growth for decades.
zh: 光是這一人口規模就決定了非洲勞動力將有望成為全球幾十年增長的引擎。

en: But to do so, Africans must implement the necessary reforms today.
zh: 但要實現這一點，非洲人必須從現在開始進行不要的改革。

en: As our demographic dividend matures, governments, institutions, and organizations must help position young people for success.
zh: 隨著我們的人口紅利逐漸成熟，政府、機構和組織必須幫助年輕人做好成功的準備。

en: If African countries can meet this challenge, prolonged economic growth – at home and abroad – will be the reward.
zh: 如果非洲國家能夠戰勝這一挑戰，長期經濟增長可期 — — 不管是國內還是國外。

en: Africa’s Path from Poverty
zh: 非洲脫貧之路

en: BEIJING – All low-income countries have the potential for dynamic economic growth.
zh: 北京—所有低收入國家都有實現充滿活力的經濟增長的潛力。

en: We know this because we have seen it happen repeatedly: a poor, agrarian economy transforms itself into a middle- or even high-income urban economy in one or two generations.
zh: 我們知道這一點，因為過去曾經一再發生這一幕：貧窮的農村經濟在一兩代人的時間裡搖身一變成為中等收入甚至高收入城市經濟。

en: The key is to capture the window of opportunity for industrialization arising from the relocation of light manufacturing from higher-income countries.
zh: 關鍵是抓住高收入國家輕型製造業重新佈局帶來的工業化機會視窗。

en: That was true in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, and it remains true today.
zh: 在十九和二十世紀是如此，今天仍然是如此。

en: Japan seized its opportunity in the years following World War II, using labor-intensive industries, such as textiles and simple electronics, to drive its economy until rising labor costs eroded its comparative advantage in those sectors.
zh: 日本在二戰後抓住了這一機會，用勞動密集型行業（如防止和簡單電子）驅動經濟，直至勞動力成本遏制了這些行業的比較優勢。

en: That shift then allowed other low-income Asian economies – South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and to some extent Malaysia and Thailand – to follow in Japan's footsteps.
zh: 接著，這一轉變又讓低收入亞洲經濟體 — — 韓國、中國臺灣、中國香港、新加坡以及某種程度上的馬來西亞和泰國 — — 效仿了日本的榜樣。

en: China, of course, is the region's most recent traveler along this well-trodden path.
zh: 當然，中國是這條老路上的最新旅客。

en: After more than three decades of breakneck economic growth, it has transformed itself from one of the poorest countries on earth to the world's largest economy.
zh: 在經歷了三十多年的高速增長後，中國已經從世界最貧窮國家之一轉變為世界最大經濟體。

en: And now that China, too, is beginning to lose its comparative advantage in labor-intensive industries, other developing countries – especially in Africa – are set to take its place.
zh: 而如今，中國也開始失去其在勞動密集型行業的比較優勢，其他發展中國家 — — 特別是非洲國家 — — 即將取代中國的位置。

en: Indeed, ever since the Industrial Revolution, the rise of light manufacturing has driven a dramatic rise in national income.
zh: 事實上，自工業革命以來，輕型製造業的崛起驅動了國民收入的大幅上升。

en: The United Kingdom's economic transformation started with textiles.
zh: 英國經濟轉型從紡織業開始。

en: In Belgium, France, Sweden, Denmark, Italy, and Switzerland, light manufacturing led the way.
zh: 比利時、法國、瑞典、丹麥、義大利和瑞士都是輕型製造業領路。

en: Similarly, in the United States, cities like Boston, Baltimore, and Philadelphia became centers for producing textiles, garments, and shoes.
zh: 類似地，在美國，波士頓、巴爾的摩和費城等城市也都曾經是紡織品、服裝和鞋子的生產中心。

en: Until recently, few believed that Africa, too, could become a center for modern manufacturing.
zh: 知道最近，仍很少有人相信非洲也可以成為現代製造業的中心。

en: But, with the right policies, there is no reason why African countries could not follow a similar trajectory.
zh: 但是，有正確的政策，沒有理由認為非洲國家不可能走上同樣的軌跡。

en: Consider land-locked Ethiopia, which only ten years ago seemed to be an especially bad bet.
zh: 以內陸國家衣索比亞為例。 十年前，它看起來仍然毫無前途。

en: But then the country built an industrial park near Addis Ababa and invited the Chinese shoemaker Huajian to open a factory there.
zh: 但隨後它在亞的斯亞貝巴附近建設了一個工業園，邀請中國製鞋商華建國際前去設廠。

en: Huajian opened its doors in January 2012 with two production lines and some 600 workers.
zh: 華建國際在2012年開張，擁有兩條生產線和600名左右的工人。

en: By the end of the year, it had employed 2,000 Ethiopians and doubled the country's exports of leather shoes.
zh: 到當年年底，華建國際僱用了2,000名衣索比亞人，讓衣索比亞皮鞋出口翻了一番。

en: Today, the company has 3,500 workers in Ethiopia producing more than two million shoes a year.
zh: 如今，華建國際在衣索比亞有3,500名工人，每年生產超過兩百萬雙鞋。

en: In 2013, spurred by Huajian's success, the Ethiopian government created a new industrial park, with space for 22 factory units.
zh: 2013年，受華建國際成功的鼓舞，衣索比亞政府建造了一個可容納22個工廠單位的新工業園。

en: Within three months, all of them had been leased by export-oriented companies from Turkey, Korea, Taiwan, China, and elsewhere.
zh: 不出三個月，所有單位被來自土耳其、韓國、中國臺灣、中國和其他地區的出口導向型公司租賃一空。

en: The World Bank has provided $250 million to support the continued construction of these industrial parks.
zh: 世界銀行提供了2.5億美元支援工業園的繼續建設。

en: The Ethiopian success story is just the start.
zh: 衣索比亞的成功故事只是個開始。

en: As investors learn more about Africa, they will increasingly see what it has to offer.
zh: 隨著投資者對非洲瞭解的深入，他們將日益看到非洲的計劃。

en: Indeed, the cost of labor in Africa is competitive enough that Ethiopia could attract companies from countries as poor as Bangladesh.
zh: 事實上，非洲勞動力成本優勢非常大，衣索比亞甚至可以吸引孟加拉國等窮國的公司。

en: Africa has a surplus of agricultural labor and too few other jobs.
zh: 非洲農業勞動力過生，其他工作崗位又過少。

en: As foreign firms launch operations in the labor-intensive sectors in which Africa has a comparative advantage, they will train the local workforce.
zh: 只要外國企業在非洲擁有比較優勢的勞動密集型行業開展經營，就能訓練本地勞動力。

en: Some workers will become managers.
zh: 一些工人將變為管理者。

en: They will become familiar with the technology and learn how to maintain consistent quality in the production line.
zh: 他們將熟悉技術，學習如何維持生產線的質量。

en: They will establish contacts with international buyers and investors.
zh: 他們將與國際買家和投資者簽訂合同。

en: And, eventually, some of them will be able to raise capital and start firms of their own – export companies owned and operated by Africans.
zh: 最終，他們中的一些人將能夠籌集資本自己創業 — — 非洲人擁有和經營的出口公司。

en: Mauritius shows the path ahead.
zh: 模里西斯就是很好的例子。

en: In the 1970s, the government set up industrial parks to process textiles and garments for export.
zh: 20世紀70年代，模里西斯政府建設了工業園生產紡織品和服裝以供出口。

en: At the time, most of the owners were from Taiwan or Hong Kong; today, more than 70% of the island's industrial companies are locally owned.
zh: 當時，一些工廠的所有者來自中國臺灣和中國香港；如今，模里西斯70%以上的工業公司為本國所有。

en: A carefully focused export strategy is crucial.
zh: 謹慎而集中的出口戰略至關重要。

en: The international development community and many African governments want to work toward regional integration, linking the markets of 55 African countries.
zh: 國際發展機構和許多非洲國家政府希望朝地區一體化方向努力，將55個非洲國家的市場聯絡起來。

en: This might have its advantages, but it should not be a priority.
zh: 這也許會帶來優勢，但不適合作為當務之急。

en: Africa today accounts for just 1.9% of global GDP, compared to 21% for the United States and 23% for Europe.
zh: 如今，非洲只佔全球ＧＤＰ的１.９ ％ ， 而美國為21 % ， 歐洲為23 % 。

en: Developing countries must use their limited resources in the most effective way, and there is no question where the most attractive opportunities in Africa are to be found.
zh: 發展中國家必須將有限的資源用在效率最高的地方，毫無疑問，非洲最誘人的機會還有待發現。

en: For example, instead of investing heavily in the infrastructure needed for regional integration, a country like Ethiopia would be better off building industrial parks and linking them by road to ports in Djibouti.
zh: 比如，埃塞俄比��等國家不應該大量投資於地區一體化所需要的基礎設施，投資於建設工業園並用公路將它們與吉布提的港口連線起來效果更好。

en: With the right growth strategy, far-reaching change can come within a person's lifetime – sometimes more than once.
zh: 有了正確的增長戰略，我們在有生之年就可以看到深遠的變化 — — 甚至多次變化。

en: My native Taiwan is now a high-income economy.
zh: 我的出生地臺灣如今已是高收入經濟體。

en: But when I was born there, in 1952, the island was poorer than almost every country in Africa.
zh: 但在1952年我出生時，臺灣島比非洲幾乎所有國家都要窮。

en: Then it happened to me again.
zh: 後來我再一次經歷了這一轉變。

en: I moved to mainland China in 1979, when the country's per capita income was less than one-third of Sub-Saharan Africa's.
zh: 1979年我來到中國大陸，當時，中國大陸人均收入只有撒哈拉以南非洲的不到三分之一。

en: Today, China has become an upper-middle-income country, and it is on track to become a high-income country by 2020.
zh: 如今，中國已成為中高收入國家，並且極有可能在2020年步入高收入行列。

en: My hope is that I can witness a third economic transformation in my lifetime, this time in Ethiopia and other countries in Africa.
zh: 我希望能在我的有生之年看到第三次經濟轉型 — — 在衣索比亞和其他非洲國家。

en: If they stay on the tried and tested path of those who have gone before, there is every chance that I will.
zh: 如果它們能夠堅持其他國家已經嘗試並考驗過的道路，我的這一願望實現的可能性相當大。

en: The Promise of Digital Health
zh: 數字醫療的憧憬

en: BASEL – Africa has changed remarkably, and for the better, since I first worked as a young doctor in Angola some 20 years ago.
zh: 巴塞爾—自20年前年輕的我在安哥拉行醫以來，非洲已經發生了天翻地覆的變化 — — 越變越好。

en: But no change has been more obvious than the way the continent has adopted mobile technology.
zh: 但變化最顯著的地方還是非洲的移動技術。

en: People in Africa – and, indeed, throughout low- and middle-income countries – are seizing the opportunities that technology provides, using mobile phones for everything from making payments to issuing birth certificates, to gaining access to health care.
zh: 非洲人 — — 實際上，是所有中低收入國家的人 — — 正在抓住技術所提供的機會，將行動電話應用於從支付到頒發出生證和獲得醫療服務的方方面面。

en: The benefit of mobile technologies lies in access.
zh: 移動技術的優勢在於通道。

en: Barriers like geographical distance and low resources, which have long prevented billions of people from getting the care they need, are much easier to overcome in the digital age.
zh: 地理距離和資源匱乏等障礙長期阻礙數十億人獲得他們所需要的看護，而在數字時代，這些障礙可以輕易克服。

en: And, indeed, there are countless ways in which technology can be deployed to improve health-care access and delivery.
zh: 事實上，技術可以透過數不清的方式用於改善醫療普及和實現（access and delivery ） 。

en: Of course, this is not new information, and a growing number of technology-based health initiatives have taken shape in recent years.
zh: 當然，這並非什麼新訊息，並且近幾年來也取得了越來越多的基於技術的醫療創新。

en: But only a few have reached scale, and achieved long-term sustainability; the majority of projects have not made it past the pilot phase.
zh: 但只有少數創新形成了規模並實現了長期可持續性；大部分專案尚未渡過實驗階段。

en: The result is a highly fragmented landscape of digital solutions – one that, in some cases, can add extra strain to existing health systems.
zh: 結果是數字方案呈現出高度的碎片化特徵 — — 在某些例子中，這給現有醫療體系帶來了額外的約束。

en: The first step to addressing this problem is to identify which factors breed success – and which impede it.
zh: 解決這一問題的第一步是並別那些因素能帶來成功 — — 以及哪些因素阻礙成功。

en: Here, perhaps the most important observation relates to how the solution is linked to the reality on the ground.
zh: 在這方面，最重要的觀察與方案如何與現實聯絡起來有關。

en: After all, technology is an enabler for the innovation of health-care delivery, not an end in itself.
zh: 畢竟，技術只是醫療實現的創新的促成因素，其本身絕非終點。

en: Solutions that focus on end-users, whether health practitioners or patients, have the best chance of succeeding.
zh: 注重終端使用者 — — 不管是醫生還是患者 — — 的方案最有可能取得成功。

en: Fundamental to this approach is the recognition that what users need are not necessarily the most advanced technologies, but rather solutions that are easy to use and implement.
zh: 這一方法的關鍵是認識到使用者需要的東西未必是最先進的技術，而是便於使用和實施的方案。

en: In fact, seemingly outdated technologies like voice and text messages can be far more useful tools for the intended users than the latest apps or cutting-edge innovations in, say, nanotechnology.
zh: 事實上，看似過時的技術，如語音和文字簡訊，可以成為對預期使用者極為有用的工具，遠比最新APP或（比如）奈米技術的尖端創新更有用。

en: Consider the Community-based Hypertension Improvement Project in Ghana, run by the Novartis Foundation, which I lead, and FHI 360.
zh: 以迦納基於社群的高血壓改善計劃為例。 該計劃由我所領導的諾華基金會（Novartis Foundation）和FHI 360負責運營。

en: The project supports patients in self-managing their condition through regular mobile medication reminders, as well as advice on necessary lifestyle changes.
zh: 該計劃支援患者透過定期移動醫療提醒功能，根據必要的生活方式改變建議進行自我管理。

en: This approach is successful because it is patient-centered and leverages information and communication technology (ICT) tools that are readily available and commonly used.
zh: 這一方法取得成功的原因是它已患者為中心，並利用現成和常用的資訊和通訊技術（ICT）工具。

en: In a country where mobile penetration exceeds 80% but only a few people have smartphones, such simple solutions can have the greatest impact.
zh: 迦納的行動電話滲透率超過80 % ， 但只有少數人擁有智慧手機，但如此簡單的方案仍起到了最大的效果。

en: For health practitioners, digital solutions must be perceived as boosting efficiency, rather than adding to their already-heavy workload.
zh: 對醫療工作者而言，數字方案必須讓他們感到能夠增加效率，而不是徒增已經十分沉重的工作負擔。

en: Co-creating solutions with people experienced in delivering health care in low-resource settings can help to ensure that the solutions are adopted at scale.
zh: 與富有在低資源條件下實現醫療服務的經驗的人士合作制定方案有助於確保方案可以形成規模化實施。

en: For example, the telemedicine network that the Novartis Foundation and its partners rolled out with the Ghana Health Service was a direct response to the need, expressed by health-care practitioners on the ground, to expand the reach of medical expertise.
zh: 比如，諾華基金會及其合作伙伴與迦納衛生部共同開展的遠端醫療網路直接響應一線醫療工作者擴大醫療專家覆蓋範圍的要求。

en: The network connects frontline health workers with a simple phone call to consultation centers in referral hospitals several hours away, where doctors and specialists are available around-the-clock.
zh: 該網路讓一線衛生工作者一個電話就能接通數小時里程之外的轉診醫院諮詢中心，那裡的醫生和專家隨時候命。

en: From the outset, the project was a response to an expressed need to expand the reach of medical expertise, and was fully operated on the ground by Ghana Health Service staff, which made this model sustainable at scale.
zh: 從一���始，該專案就是為了響應擴大醫療專家覆蓋面的要求，並完全由迦納衛生部工作人員負責運營，這讓該模式實現上規模、可持續。

en: To realize the full potential of digital health, solutions need to be integrated into national health systems.
zh: 為了充分實現數字醫療的潛力，解決方案必須與國家衛生系統相結合。

en: Only then can digital technology accelerate progress toward universal health coverage and address countries’ priority health needs.
zh: 惟其如此，數字技術才能加快全民醫療覆蓋和解決國家緊迫醫療需求的程序。

en: Collaboration across the health and ICT sectors, both public and private, is essential.
zh: 醫療和ICT的合作 — — 包括私人和公共合作 — — 至關重要。

en: Multidisciplinary partnerships driven by the sustained leadership of senior government officials must guide progress, beginning at the planning stage.
zh: 必須透過高階政府官員的持續領導推動的多學科合作來指引程序，第一步是規劃階段。

en: Intra-governmental collaboration, dedicated financing for digital health solutions, and effective governance mechanisms will also be vital to successful strategies.
zh: 致力於為數字衛生解決方案提供融資的政府間合作以及有效的治理機制也是成功戰略的關鍵。

en: Digital technologies offer huge opportunities to improve the way health care is delivered.
zh: 數字技術為我們提供了改善醫療實現方式的巨大的機會。

en: If we are to seize them, we must learn from past experience.
zh: 要想把握這些機會，我們必須從過去的經驗中汲取教訓。

en: By remaining focused on the reality of end-users and on priority health needs, rather than being dazzled by the latest technology, we can fulfil the promise of digital health.
zh: 透過專注於終端使用者的現實和最重要的醫療需求，而不是迷失於最新技術，我們能夠實現數字醫療的憧憬

en: Confronting Africa’s Water Challenge
zh: 直面非洲的水資源挑戰

en: ABIDJAN – Water is essential for life, and yet it is scarce in many parts of the world.
zh: 阿比讓 — — 水對生命而言必不可少，但世界許多地區都面臨水資源稀缺。

en: Owing to the effects of climate change, Africa is experiencing its worst drought since 1945, especially in Southern Sudan, Somalia, Ethiopia, and Northern Nigeria.
zh: 由於氣候變化的影響，非洲正在經歷1945年來最嚴重的乾旱，尤其是在南蘇丹、索馬利亞、衣索比亞和北奈及利亞等地區。

en: These fragile areas now need the global community’s support.
zh: 上述脆弱地區現在需要國際社會的支援。

en: We need to build resilient systems to ensure access to potable water for all people, and to improve water-delivery and sanitation provisions in Africa’s rapidly growing urban areas.
zh: 我們需要建設能確保為所有人提供飲用水的彈性系統，並在非洲快速發展的城市區域改善供水和衛生設施。

en: We should begin by expanding Africans’ capacity to harness wastewater.
zh: 我們首先應當從提高非洲人利用廢水的能力開始。

en: With investment and proper management, wastewater can become a sustainable source of wealth for many Africans, with added benefits for human health, agricultural productivity, and environmental sustainability.
zh: 透過投資和恰當的管理，廢水可以為許多非洲人持續提供財富，並有益於提高人類健康、農業生產率和可持續的環境保護。

en: Over the past six years, the African Development Bank has invested $3.3 billion in projects to expand access to water and improve sanitation, with around $2.2 billion of that going to urban services that reach at least 17 million people.
zh: 過去六年來，非洲開發銀行已經投資33億美元用於拓展飲用水和衛生設施專案，其中約22億美元被用於至少惠及1，700萬人的城市服務。

en: The AfDB supports an integrated urban water-management model (IUWM) that, in keeping with United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 6, enables communities to derive a sustainable income from management of urban liquid and solid waste.
zh: 非洲開發銀行支援一種綜合性城市水資源管理模式（IUWM ） ， 這種模式貫徹聯合國可持續發展目標第六條的精神，確保民眾能夠從城市液體和固體廢物管理中獲得可持續收入。

en: IUWM efforts require a significant initial investment, and come with steep capital and operational costs.
zh: 綜合性城市水資源管理模式需要大量的初期投資，之後的資金和運營成本同樣是十分可觀的。

en: Only a few African cities collect and treat any more than 20% of the wastewater generated through centralized wastewater-management systems.
zh: 目前僅有少數幾個非洲城市透過集中廢水管理系統蒐集並處理超過20%的廢水。

en: The remaining 80% constitutes a huge untapped source of potentially valuable liquid and solid waste.
zh: 其餘80%具有潛在價值的大量液體和固體廢物完全沒有被加以利用。

en: With the right investment, foresight, and commitment, this underappreciated resource can create jobs and deliver sustainable growth.
zh: 如果有恰當的投資、遠見和承諾，上述被嚴重低估的資源可以創造就業並帶來可持續增長。

en: Wastewater management is thus a central feature of the AfDB’s strategic priorities, known as the High 5s, which aim to improve Africans’ quality of life, boost public health, achieve gender equality, create jobs, and increase communities’ resilience to the effects of climate change.
zh: 廢水管理也因此成為非洲開發銀行重點戰略的核心特徵。 這項被稱為High 5s的計劃旨在提高非洲人的生活質量、促進公共衛生、實現兩性平等、創造就業機會，並使社會更能從容應對氣候變化的影響。

en: Water will also play a key role in reaching the High 5s’ industrialization and sustainable-farming objectives.
zh: 同時，水資源還將在實現High 5s工業化和可持續農業目標方面發揮關鍵的作用。

en: In Yaoundé, Cameroon, the AfDB helped to protect some 300,000 people and their property by reducing the frequency of floods from 15 incidents per year to just three.
zh: 在喀麥隆首都雅溫得，非洲開發銀行透過將每年發生洪災的頻率從15次降低到僅僅3次來為 300,000民眾及其財產提供保護。

en: And with a $40 million sanitation project, the AfDB helped to lower the proportion of the city’s malaria-afflicted population from 16% to 12%.
zh: 而且非洲開發銀行投資的一項4，000萬美元的衛生專案協助將雅溫得市瘧疾感染的人口比例從16%降到12%左右。

en: In Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire, the $23 million AfDB-funded Gourou Basin Integrated Watershed Management Project significantly reduced flooding throughout the Gourou Basin, and improved 2.8 million inhabitants’ livelihoods.
zh: 在象牙海岸首都阿比讓，非洲開發銀行投資的價值2，300萬美元的古魯盆地綜合流域管理專案大大減少了古魯盆地的洪災次數，並顯著改善了280萬居民的生活。

en: In Zimbabwe, after 4,300 people died in the 2008-2009 cholera pandemic, the AfDB and other donors supported the $43.6 million Urgent Water Supply and Sanitation Rehabilitation Project, which made emergency repairs to wastewater systems in urban areas, helping 2.5 million people.
zh: 在辛巴威，在4，300人死於2008-2009年爆發的霍亂疫情後，非洲開發銀行和其他捐助者出資支援了4，360萬美元的緊急供水和衛生設施修復專案，該專案對城市地區廢水系統進行了緊急維修，惠及當地超過250萬人口。

en: All AfDB-supported wastewater-management systems follow sustainability strategies to ensure that they enhance economic gains, benefit local communities, and remain affordable.
zh: 所有非洲開發銀行支援的廢水管理系統都遵循可持續發展原則，以確保能提高經濟收益、惠及當地社會並讓當地民眾負擔得起相應的費用。

en: These projects also help countries to harness and use waste flows, by converting sewage to biogas and fertilizer.
zh: 這些專案還透過將汙水轉化為沼氣和化肥來幫助相關國家利用廢水和廢物。

en: Meanwhile, the AfDB’s African Water Facility (AWF) complements its project-finance work by attracting downstream investments in water infrastructure.
zh: 不僅如此，非洲開發銀行的非洲水利設施（AWF）專案還透過吸引下游資金投向水利基礎設施很好地補充了其專案融資工作。

en: In February, flooding and strong winds from Tropical Storm Dineo devastated the coast of Mozambique and had a severe impact on the local population.
zh: 今年2月，熱帶風暴迪尼奧造成的洪水和颶風摧毀了莫三比克海岸，嚴重影響了當地民眾的生產生活。

en: But just a few weeks later, the AWF launched a feasibility study to improve livelihoods and climate-change resilience throughout Mozambique’s Inhambane Province, where the storm struck.
zh: 但短短幾星期後，非洲水利設施計劃就啟動了一項可行性調查，目的是改善遭受風暴襲擊的莫三比克伊尼揚巴內省適應氣候變化的能力和民眾生活。

en: In collaboration with the Global Water Partnership, the AWF is implementing IUWM systems in five African cities, including Kinshasa in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Marondera in Zimbabwe.
zh: 非洲水利設施計劃與全球水體合作伙伴組織一道，正在包括剛果民主共和國的金沙薩和辛巴威馬龍德拉在內的非洲五大城市推行綜合性城市水資源管理專案。

en: In the DRC alone, IUWM systems can be expected to improve water delivery and sanitation for 17 million people by 2030.
zh: 截止2030年，僅在剛果民主共和國一地，綜合性城市水資源管理系統就可望幫助1，700萬人改善供水和衛生設施。

en: The Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation is also tapping into the AfDB’s expertise, by providing an $18 million grant to fund Phase II of the AfDB’s Urban Sanitation Program.
zh: 比爾和梅林達·蓋茨基金同樣在利用非洲開發銀行的專業知識，透過提供1，800萬美元的贈款來支援非洲開發銀行第二階段的城市衛生專案。

en: This effort will help to develop business innovations for affordable and sustainable sanitation services in Africa, which could reach two million urban dwellers directly and another six million people through subsidiary projects.
zh: 這項工作將有助於催生能為非洲提供廉價、可持續衛生服務的商業創新，該計劃可以令兩百萬城市居民直接受益，並透過附屬專案惠及另外600萬人。

en: Africa’s wastewater-management challenges are substantial and complex.
zh: 非洲面臨的廢水管理挑戰巨大而又複雜。

en: But the AfDB is determined to provide opportunities that pay dividends for African communities – in public health, improved sanitation, economic development, and environmental protection.
zh: 但非洲開發銀行決心為非洲民眾提供能夠帶來紅利的機會，無論涉及到公共保健、衛生改善、經濟發展還是環境保護。

en: Improving the quality of life for all Africans will require political commitment, public-private partnerships, and robust public involvement.
zh: 改善所有非洲人的生活質量需要政治決心、公私合作以及積極的公眾參與。

en: With the High 5s framework, the AfDB is working to bring these three ingredients together.
zh: 在High 5s框架下，非洲開發銀行正在努力將所有三項要素加以整合。

en: All stakeholders – in Africa and internationally – must redouble our efforts to ensure clean, affordable water for all, and to support African countries suffering through a historic drought.
zh: 非洲和全球所有利益相關方必須加倍努力，確保為所有人提供潔淨廉價的日常用水，並且為正在遭受著歷史性旱災的非洲國家提供援助。

en: We have a moral obligation to do so.
zh: 這樣做是我們的道義義務。

en: After all, water means life.
zh: 畢竟，水和生命是聯絡在一起的。

en: Is Africa Still Rising?
zh: 非洲仍在崛起嗎？

en: WASHINGTON, DC – Between 2000 and 2014, Africa grew at a strong clip, fueling belief in the narrative of an “Africa rising.”
zh: 華盛頓—從2000年到2014年，非洲實現了強勁增長，這帶來了一種“非洲崛起”的信念。

en: But, since 2015, growth across Sub-Saharan Africa has weakened, and the poor outlook for commodity prices has cast doubt on Africa’s economic promise, leading many to question the “Africa rising” narrative – and some to pronounce it dead.
zh: 但2015年後，整個撒哈拉以南非洲地區的增長有所放緩，而大宗商品價格的悲觀前景也讓人們開始質疑非洲的經濟前途，許多人開始懷疑“非洲崛起”敘事 — — 更有人宣佈非洲崛起的概念已死。

en: Such skepticism is, to some extent, understandable.
zh: 從某種程度上說，這樣的懷疑不難理解。

en: The 2014 oil-price shock hit several African economies especially hard, and played a role in pushing aggregate growth down from 5-6% in 2004-2014 to just 2.5% in 2015-2017 – a rate that barely keeps up with population growth.
zh: 2014年石油價格衝擊給一些非洲經濟體造成了非常嚴重的影響，也讓總體增長率從2004—2014年間的5—6%下降到2015—2017年的2.5 % — —這一增長率還趕不上人口增長率。

en: Moreover, the continent's three largest economies – Angola, Nigeria, and South Africa – have experienced major declines in performance.
zh: 此外，非洲的三個最大經濟體 — — 安哥拉、奈及利亞和南非，表現都出現了大幅下滑。

en: Last year, Angola and South Africa’s economies stagnated, while the Nigerian economy actually contracted for the first time since 1991.
zh: 去年，安哥拉和南非經濟出現停滯，而奈及利亞出現了1991年以來的首次實際萎縮。

en: The latest projections suggest that these economies will experience tepid recoveries in the coming years.
zh: 最新預測表明，這些經濟體未來幾年的復甦也將非常緩慢。

en: But Africa’s skeptics have overlooked a number of important factors.
zh: 但非洲懷疑派忽視了許多重要因素。

en: For starters, when one sets the three largest economies aside, Sub-Saharan Africa’s aggregate-growth rate for this year rises from 2.5% to almost 4%.
zh: 首先，如果你剔除掉三個最大的經濟體，那麼今年撒哈拉以南非洲總體增長率就能從2.5%增加到近4 % 。

en: That is faster than the 3.5% rate at which the global economy is currently growing.
zh: 這一數字高於當前全球經濟增長率3.5 % 。

en: In fact, five of the ten fastest-growing economies in the world are in Africa.
zh: 事實上，全世界十個增長最快的經濟體中，有五個來自非洲。

en: And over the next five years, around half of all Sub-Saharan economies will expand at an average rate similar to or higher than that which prevailed during the “Africa rising” heyday.
zh: 而在未來五年中，大約一半的撒哈拉以南經濟體將實現不亞於“非洲崛起”頂峰時期的平均增長率。

en: Furthermore, high commodity prices were just one factor in the region’s strong economic performance between 2000 and 2014.
zh: 此外，高企的大宗商品價格只是2000—2014年間該地區經濟表現強勁的一個因素。

en: Many African countries have made vast improvements to macroeconomic management, governance, and the business environment, and entrepreneurship is on the rise.
zh: 許多非洲國家在宏觀經濟管理、治理和營商環境方面取得了巨大進步，企業家精神也在蓬勃發展。

en: Even with lower commodity prices, these developments will continue to bolster many African economies.
zh: 即使大宗商品價格有所下跌，這些發展趨勢仍能夠支撐許多非洲經濟體。

en: Today’s skepticism may reflect lasting memories from a darker period, and fears that Africa’s progress has not been sufficiently consolidated.
zh: 今天的懷疑論也許體現了對黑暗時代的記憶，以及對非洲的進步沒有得到充分鞏固的擔憂。

en: From the 1970s to the mid-1990s, dictators ruled in many African countries, and the institutions necessary for sustaining strong economic growth were fragile at best.
zh: 從20世紀70年代到90年代中期，許多非洲國家由獨裁者統治，維持強勁經濟增長所需要的制度十分脆弱。

en: With civil wars constantly shredding the social fabric in many countries, the continent experienced decades of tepid economic growth.
zh: 內戰不斷地摧殘著許多國家的社會結構，幾十年來，整個非洲經濟增長十分緩慢。

en: By 2000, it had been reduced to what The Economist called “Hopeless Africa.”
zh: 到2000年，非洲已經淪為《經濟學人 》 （ The Economist）所謂的“沒有希望的非洲 ” 。

en: But those days are gone.
zh: 但這些都是老黃曆了。

en: Policymakers across the continent have sustained the 1990s-era reforms that set the stage for the subsequent period of high growth.
zh: 非洲決策者保持著20世紀90年代的改革，為後續高速增長打下了基礎。

en: Although there is still much work to be done, the economic and business environment in many African countries has continued to improve, and institutions and governance have grown stronger.
zh: 儘管還有很多工作有待完成，但許多非洲國家的經濟和營商環境持續改善，制度和治理也變得更加強大。

en: Owing to new information and communication technologies, Africans, particularly young Africans, are better informed, more engaged in civil and political discourse, and increasingly capable of holding their leaders accountable.
zh: 拜新資訊和通訊技術所賜，非洲人，特別是非洲年輕人，對資訊瞭解得更多，也更積極地參與民間和政治事務，越來越具備問責領導人的能力。

en: ICTs have also unleashed a wave of innovation and entrepreneurship across the continent.
zh: 資訊和通訊技術還在非洲釋放出一股創新和企業家精神的浪潮。

en: These positive trends are not likely to be reversed, and will continue to improve the economic conditions in Africa, even if commodity prices do not rebound.
zh: 這些積極的趨勢很難逆轉，將繼續改善非洲的經濟環境，即使大宗商品價格無法反彈。

en: After all, the region’s economic growth averaged 5.6% between 2000 and 2004, before commodity prices had begun their rapid ascent.
zh: 畢竟，2000—2004年間，大宗商品價格的迅速上漲尚未開始，非洲地區的平均增長率仍高達5.6 % 。

en: But that is not to say Africa will be spared from daunting challenges in the years ahead.
zh: 但這並不是說非洲能夠在未來多年裡不必面臨艱鉅挑戰。

en: Globally, the economic environment will become less favorable for African economies.
zh: 放眼全球，經濟環境對非洲經濟體更加不利了。

en: In the major advanced economies, interest rates will soon rise, and the political backlash against globalization may force governments to abandon their past commitments to development assistance.
zh: 在主要發達經濟體，利率很快就會上升，而針對全球化的政治反對力量可能迫使政府放棄過去許下的發展援助承諾。

en: In light of all this uncertainty, African policymakers should look inward, by focusing on policies to mobilize national resources and finance their economic agendas.
zh: 面臨所有這些不確定性，非洲決策者應該向內看，專注於動員國家資源和經濟日程融資政策。

en: Those agendas should include a number of key priorities.
zh: 這些日程應該包括一系列關鍵性重點。

en: African countries need to diversify their economies to withstand future shocks better, while also accelerating the pace of industrialization across the continent.
zh: 非洲國家需要實現經濟多樣化，以更好地抵禦未來衝擊，同時，整個非洲還需要加快工業化步伐。

en: Governments will have to find a way to create decent jobs for the 11 million people now entering the region’s labor force every year.
zh: 政府必須找到辦法為每年加入勞動力大軍的1,100萬非洲人創造體面的工作。

en: And they will need to enact policies to reduce poverty, and ensure that prosperity is shared across all cohorts of society.
zh: 它們還需要採取措施減少貧困，確保繁榮被全體社會所共享。

en: These are particularly important goals for Angola, Nigeria, and South Africa.
zh: 對安哥拉、奈及利亞和南非來說，這些目標尤其重要。

en: Angola and Nigeria need to become far less reliant on oil; and South Africa still needs to implement far-reaching reforms to address structural problems that have plagued it since the apartheid era.
zh: 安哥拉和奈及利亞需要大幅降低對石油的依賴；南非仍然需要實施重大改革措施以解決自種族隔離時代以來困擾它的結構性問題。

en: Seeing these projects through will require competent political leaders who are committed to the principles of good governance.
zh: 真心實意地推行這些工程需要有能力的領導人堅守好治理原則。

en: Failure could result in an extended period of low growth.
zh: 失敗可能導致長期低增長。

en: But even if Africa’s three largest economies do end up in the doldrums, it will not necessarily seal the fate of the “Africa rising” story.
zh: 但即使非洲最大的三個經濟體最終陷入蕭條 ， “ 非洲崛起”的故事也未必可以全盤否定。

en: After all, “Africa rising” need not mean “all” of Africa.
zh: 畢竟 ， “ 非洲崛起”不必是“全部”非洲的崛起。

en: From the 1960s to the 1990s, the “Asian Tigers” narrative referred only to Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea, and Taiwan, excluding other developing countries in Asia, such as China.
zh: 從20世紀60年代到90年代 ， “ 亞洲小龍”敘事也僅限於香港、新加坡、韓國和臺灣，中國在內的其他亞洲發展中經濟體都不在其列。

en: Similarly, African economies are increasingly differentiating themselves, and should thus be evaluated individually, on the merits of their respective economic policies.
zh: 類似地，非洲各經濟體本身之間的差異日益擴大，因此，應該根據各自的經濟政策的利弊，對它們進行單獨的評估。

en: Africa Still Rising
zh: 非洲仍在冉冉升起

en: JOHANNESBURG – Is the honeymoon over for African economies?
zh: 約翰內斯堡 — — 非洲經濟體的蜜月期是否已經結束？

en: Less than a decade ago, it seemed that the continent’s economic dreams were beginning to come true, with many countries experiencing impressive GDP growth and development.
zh: 不到十年前，隨著許多國家取得驚人的GDP增長和發展，非洲大陸的經濟之夢似乎正在變成現實。

en: Now, as the harsh reality of the continent’s vulnerability to challenging external conditions has set in, sustaining that growth has proved difficult.
zh: 現在，隨著非洲大陸在充滿挑戰的外部環境面前的脆弱性逐漸顯現，現有的增長速度已經很難保持。

en: Encumbered by slowing growth in China, a collapse in commodity prices, and adverse spillover from numerous security crises, Africa’s overall annual GDP growth averaged just 3.3% in 2010-2015, barely keeping up with population growth – and down sharply from the 4.9% recorded from 2000 to 2008.
zh: 在中國經濟增長放緩、大宗商品價格暴跌以及不止一次安全危機的拖累下，非洲的年度總體GDP增長在2010到2015年僅為3.3 % ， 這一速度僅能勉強跟上人口增長 — — 與2000到2008年4.9%的記錄相比速度大幅放緩。

en: But a deeper look suggests that things may not be as bad as they seem, for two key reasons.
zh: 但深層次觀察表明局勢也許不像看上去那樣嚴重，得出這樣的結論有兩個主要原因。

en: First, though average growth has declined, some African economies have thrived in recent years.
zh: 首先，雖然平均增速有所回落，但某些非洲國家在近年來實現了蓬勃發展。

en: Indeed, aggregate GDP has been dragged down since 2010 by faltering growth among oil exporters and security-related crises in the Sahel and North Africa; but in the rest of Africa, GDP growth has accelerated, from 4.1% in 2000-2010 to 4.4% in 2010-2015.
zh: 事實上，石油出口國經濟搖搖欲墜以及薩赫勒和北非地區爆發安全危機已經將2010年以來的GDP總量拉了下來；但在非洲其他地區，GDP發展呈加速之勢，從2000到2010年的4.1%增長到2010到2015年的4.4 % 。
