en: Second, Africa is undergoing a profound long-term transformation, characterized by rapid digitization, urbanization, and growth in the working-age population, which will outnumber the labor force of China and India by 2034.
zh: 其次，非洲正在經歷一次以快速數字化、城市化和勞動年齡人口增長為特色的深刻的長期轉型，非洲勞動人口截止2034年將在數量上超過中國和印度。

en: That demographic trend could unlock future growth by advancing economic diversification, spurring domestic consumption, and supporting industrialization.
zh: 這樣一種人口趨勢完全可能透過推進經濟多樣化、刺激國內消費和支援產業化來達到解鎖未來經濟增長的目的。

en: In fact, today’s high-growth countries – including Côte d’Ivoire, Ethiopia, Kenya, and Tanzania – have made substantial progress in reducing their dependence on commodity exports, in favor of trade, investment, and domestic consumption.
zh: 事實上，今天的高增長國家 — — 包括象牙海岸、衣索比亞、肯亞和坦尚尼亞 — — 都在減少依賴商品出口、發展貿易、投資和國內消費等方面取得了實質性的進展。

en: And many lower-growth countries could head down a similar path.
zh: 而且許多低增長國家也可以走上類似的道路。

en: New research by the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI) shows that spending by Africa’s consumers and businesses already totals $4 trillion.
zh: 麥肯錫全球研究院（MGI）最新研究成果 顯示非洲消費者和企業的支出總額已經達到4萬億美元。

en: By 2025, private spending could reach $5.6 trillion – $2.1 trillion by households, and $3.5 trillion by businesses.
zh: 截止2025年，私人開支可能達到5.6萬億美元 — — 其中2.1萬億美元來自家庭部門，而其餘3.5萬億美元則來自企業。

en: This represents a huge opportunity for Africa���s manufacturers.
zh: 這為非洲製造企業創造了巨大的機會。

en: We believe that Africa can almost double its manufacturing output, to nearly $1 trillion, by 2025, with about 75% of that growth tied to production for local markets.
zh: 我們認為截止2025年非洲幾乎可以實現製造業產出翻番，而相關增長中75%與當地市場生產密切相關。

en: The question is whether manufacturers will manage to exploit the growth potential that lies in front of them.
zh: 問題在於製造企業能否充分利用擺在他們面前的增長潛力。

en: African firms have not yet proved capable of meeting existing domestic demand.
zh: 非洲企業尚未用事實證明自己具備滿足現有國內需求的能力。

en: Africa still imports about one-third of the food, beverages, and similar processed goods it consumes, whereas the Association of Southeast Asian Nations imports about 20%, and South America’s Mercosur trade bloc imports just 10%.
zh: 非洲所需的食品、飲料和類似加工產品約1/3仍依靠進口，而東南亞國家協會的進口比重僅為約20 % ， 南美南方共同市場集團進口比重僅為約10 % 。

en: Africa even imports 15% of the cement it uses, despite having abundant raw materials to make it at home.
zh: 甚至連非洲所用水泥的15%都要依靠進口，儘管非洲擁有充足的原材料可以實現國內生產。

en: To be sure, African business has made great strides in recent years.
zh: 可以肯定，非洲企業在近年來取得了長足的進步。

en: Today, 400 African companies have annual revenue of more than $1 billion, and 700 have annual revenue of more than $500 million.
zh: 今天，四百家非洲企業實現年收入超過10億美元，另外還有七百家年收入超過5億。

en: On the whole, these large companies are growing faster – and generating higher profits – than their global peers.
zh: 總體而言，與世界其他國家的同行相比，這些大企業正在快速成長 — — 取得的利潤也越來越可觀。

en: But there is still a long way to go.
zh: 但距離實現目標還有很長的路要走。

en: Large African (excluding South African) firms’ average annual revenue of $2 billion is half that of large firms in Brazil, India, Mexico, and Russia.
zh: 大型非洲企業（除南非外）20億美元的平均年收入僅為巴西、印度、墨西哥和俄羅斯等國的一半。

en: And Africa only has about 60% of the large firms it needs to put it at the same level as the emerging economies.
zh: 而非洲還要增設40%的大型企業才能與其他新興經濟體等量齊觀。

en: One key factor limiting firms’ growth is the fragmented nature of the African market, which currently comprises mostly small economies with only limited economic and political linkages.
zh: 限制企業增長的一個關鍵因素是非洲市場四分五裂，現有的非洲市場主要由經濟和政治聯絡有限的小型經濟體構成。

en: There are eight partly overlapping regional trade zones, none of which includes more than half of Africa’s countries.
zh: 目前部分割槽域重疊的區域貿易區共有8個，卻沒有一個囊括了超過一半的非洲國家。

en: Only Egypt, Morocco, Nigeria, and South Africa rank in the top 100 of MGI’s Global Connectedness Index.
zh: 只有埃及、摩洛哥、奈及利亞和南非在麥肯錫全球研究院的全球聯通指數中躋身前100位。

en: Beyond excessive trade barriers, Africa suffers from inadequate transport links and limits on the free movement of people.
zh: 除貿易壁壘高企外，人員自由流動和交通聯絡匱乏同樣困擾著非洲。

en: Africans need visas to travel to more than half the countries on their own continent.
zh: 非洲人前往自己大陸的一半以上國家還需要簽證。

en: The recent launch of the African Union passport is a step in the right direction – but it is only one step.
zh: 近期推出的非洲聯盟護照是朝正確方向邁出的一步 — — 但也僅僅是一步而已。

en: A more integrated market would not only enable African companies to create the economies of scale they need to compete; it would also be far more appealing to institutional investors.
zh: 加強市場融合不僅將為非洲企業創造出競爭所需的規模經濟；還可以在很大程度上吸引機構投資者。

en: Building such a market must therefore be a top priority for African leaders, as they seek to unleash the continent’s economic potential.
zh: 建設這樣的市場因此必須成為非洲領導人的首要任務，這樣才能釋放非洲大陸的經濟潛能。

en: Equally important, Africa’s leaders must work to improve the business environment.
zh: 非洲領導人必須努力改善營商環境，這一點同樣重要。

en: Though some progress has been made on this front in the last two decades, non-tariff barriers remain high.
zh: 儘管過去二十年來這方面已經取得了一定進步，但非關稅壁壘依然很高。

en: Indeed, regulatory issues are still cited as a serious deterrent to investment.
zh: 事實上，監管問題依然嚴重製約著投資。

en: Many African businesses – nearly half of companies in Nigeria, and more than one-third in Angola and Egypt – highlight unreliable electricity supplies as a major challenge.
zh: 許多非洲企業 — — 奈及利亞企業的將近一半、安哥拉和埃及的超過1/3 — — 強調電力供應不可靠對他們構成嚴重挑戰。

en: And almost 40% of firms surveyed by the World Bank lament the constraints imposed by competition from informal firms.
zh: 接受世界銀行調查企業中近40%對非正規企業競爭帶來的限制深表遺憾 。

en: Some of these issues could be addressed relatively quickly.
zh: 其中某些問題解決起來速度較快。

en: Consider the strides Rwanda has made since 2007, when it established a development board to improve its business environment.
zh: 比如從2007年設立發展委員會改善營商環境以來盧安達已經取得了很大進展。

en: In less than a decade, that board has led the creation of a “one-stop center” to facilitate investment, has overseen streamlined issuance of construction permits, and has pressed successfully for a fixed fee for property registration, the extension of customs hours, and risk-based customs inspections.
zh: 在不到十年時間裡，該委員會已經領導創立了促進投資的“一站式中心 ” 、 一直負責監管建築許可證的快速發放，併成功促進在財產登記、海關延長營業時間和以經營風險為基礎的海關檢查領域收取固定費用。

en: As a result, Rwanda’s global ranking for the ease of doing business jumped from 143 in 2008 to 32 in 2014.
zh: 結果導致盧安達的全球營商環境排名從2008年的第143位躍升至2014年的第32位。

en: This success can surely be replicated elsewhere in Africa.
zh: 非洲其他國家無疑也可以複製這樣的成功。

en: Despite the challenges some African countries face, the continent’s economic potential remains massive, thanks to favorable demographic dynamics, fast-growing cities, burgeoning domestic markets, and a digital revolution.
zh: 儘管非洲國家面臨諸多挑戰，但多虧樂觀的人口趨勢、快速發展的城市、蓬勃發展的國內市場和數字革命，非洲大陸仍然擁有巨大的經濟發展潛能。

en: With the right policies, a relentless focus on execution, and a great deal of determination, Africa can still rise.
zh: 只要政策對路、執行到位、決心不動搖，非洲仍然有崛起的機會。

en: Africa’s Arrival
zh: 非洲發展的時刻到了

en: NEW YORK – The African Development Bank (AfDB) has just published its African Economic Outlook for 2018.
zh: 紐約 — — 非洲開發銀行剛剛釋出了其2018年非洲經濟展望報告。

en: This year’s revamped publication – shorter than usual, analytically well-structured, and written in lucid prose, without hyperbole – in some ways mirrors Africa’s own transformation, as it raises hopes that we may at last be witnessing the continent’s long-promised economic arrival.
zh: 今年經過修訂的版本 — — 比往年更簡短、分析結構更合理、文風條理清晰不誇張 — — 以某種方式反映了非洲自身的轉型，因為它或許讓我們最終看到了非洲大陸期待已久的經濟發展的希望。

en: Africa’s rise has been a long time coming.
zh: 人們一直在等待非洲的崛起。

en: In the 1960s, hopes were high.
zh: 世紀60年代，外界抱有很高的希望。

en: The remarkable leaders of the independence generation – such as Ghana’s Kwame Nkrumah and Kenya’s Jomo Kenyatta – received advice from the world’s top economists.
zh: 獨立一代的傑出領袖 — — 包括迦納的克瓦米·恩克魯瑪和肯亞的喬莫·肯雅塔 — — 得到了世界頂級經濟學家的顧問服務。

en: The Caribbean-born Nobel laureate Arthur Lewis became Nkrumah’s Chief Economic Adviser.
zh: 加勒比出生的諾貝爾獎得主阿瑟·劉易斯曾擔任恩克魯瑪的首席經濟顧問。

en: In India, we read about these leaders’ friendship with our own post-independence prime minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, and the hope for a new dawn for all emerging economies.
zh: 在印度，我們讀懂了這些領導人與我們自己的後獨立期總理尼赫魯的友誼，也看到了所有新興經濟體新的曙光。

en: And many emerging economies did indeed take off.
zh: 而許多新興經濟體也確實走上了騰飛之路。

en: In the late 1960s, some East Asian economies surged ahead.
zh: 20世紀60年代末，一些東亞國家快速發展。

en: Beginning in the early 1980s, China began its decades-long rise.
zh: 20世紀80年代初開始，中國也踏上了長達十年的崛起之路。

en: And, from the early 1990s, India’s economy also began to grow robustly, with annual rates reaching the 9% range by 2005.
zh: 而從20世紀90年代早期，印度經濟也開始強勁增長，2005年的年增長率高達9 % 。

en: But Africa remained stagnant, mired in poverty.
zh: 但非洲仍停滯不前，深陷於貧困當中。

en: Ironically, it was the continent’s resource wealth that hampered economic progress, as it fueled conflicts among governments and insurgents eager to control it.
zh: 頗具諷刺意味的是，這塊大陸的資源財富因為引發了政府和急於控制這些財富的武裝分子之間的衝突而阻礙了經濟進步。

en: The resulting political instability attracted outsiders keen to exploit governments’ weakness.
zh: 由此造成的政局動盪吸引了熱衷於利用政府弱點的外來者。

en: As the Indian poet and Nobel laureate Rabindranath Tagore put it in his 1936 poem “Ode to Africa,” which played on perceptions about who is “civilized,” the continent fell prey to “civilization’s barbaric greed,” as the colonists “arrived, manacles in hand/Claws sharper by far than any of your wolves.”
zh: 印度詩人兼諾貝爾獎得主拉賓德拉納特·泰戈爾1936年創作了“非洲頌歌 ” ， 他在這首詩中表達了對文明的看法，指出隨著手裡拿著手銬/爪牙比狼更鋒利的殖民者的到來，非洲大陸淪為了“文明世界野蠻貪婪”的獵物。

en: Finally, at the turn of the twenty-first century, things began to change for Africa.
zh: 最終，在21世紀之交，非洲的局面開始發生變化。

en: A few dynamic leaders, democratic stirrings, and emerging regional cooperation led to a decline in poverty and a pickup in growth.
zh: 一些有活力的領導人、活躍的民主事件和新興的地區合作導致貧困下降、經濟增長率上升。

en: Commodity exporters faced a setback around 2014, when prices plummeted.
zh: 大宗商品出口國在2014年前後因為價格大幅下挫而經歷了某些挫折。

en: But this turned out to be a blessing in disguise, because it forced countries to diversify their economies and increase production – factors that supported renewed growth.
zh: 但這卻逐漸演變成一件變相的好事，因為這迫使各國增加產量並實現經濟多元化 — — 而這些因素又支撐了新的增長。

en: According to the AfDB report, Africa’s 54 economies grew by 2.2% in 2016, on average, and 3.6% in 2017.
zh: 非洲開發銀行報告顯示，非洲54個經濟體2016年平均增長2.2 % ， 2017年則增長3.6 % 。

en: In 2018, the AfDB predicts, average growth will accelerate to 4.1%, while the World Bank expects Ghana to grow by 8.3%, Ethiopia by 8.2%, and Senegal by 6.9%, placing these countries among the world’s fastest-growing economies.
zh: 非洲開發銀行預測2018年平均增長率將提高到4.1 % ， 而世界銀行預期迦納將增長8.3 % ， 衣索比亞8.2 % 、 塞內加爾6.9 % ， 躋身全世界增長最快經濟體之列。

en: And these figures are not wishful thinking: in 2016, Ethiopia’s GDP grew by 7.6%.
zh: 這些數字並不是一廂情願的痴心妄想：2016年，衣索比亞的GDP增長7.6 % 。

en: Of course, serious challenges remain.
zh: 當然，非洲仍然面臨嚴峻的挑戰。

en: South Africa, the continent’s strongest economy, is now facing the difficult task of tackling its deep-rooted corruption.
zh: 這塊大陸最強勁的經濟體南非現在正面臨著解決根深蒂固的腐敗的艱鉅任務。

en: Yet, with the African National Congress now apparently determined to replace President Jacob Zuma’s scandal-ridden administration with one led by the party’s new leader, Cyril Ramaphosa, there is reason for hope.
zh: 但因為非國大目前顯然決心用該黨新領袖西里爾·拉馬福薩來取代雅各布·祖馬（Jacob Zuma）總統醜聞纏身的政府，人們有理由充滿希望。

en: More broadly, many African countries need to find ways to create more employment – and fast.
zh: 更廣義的看，許多非洲國家需要想方設法快速創造更多就業。

en: The share of the working-age population is rising faster in Africa than in any other region.
zh: 非洲勞動年齡人口比例的上升比其他任何地區都快。

en: This “demographic dividend” has immense potential.
zh: 這一“人口紅利”可能帶來巨大的潛能。

en: But if job creation stalls, the unemployed or under-employed are likely to become frustrated – a recipe for conflict.
zh: 但如果就業創造停滯不前，失業或就業不足者很有可能會感到沮喪 — — 並進而造成衝突。

en: Consider the case of Tanzania.
zh: 以坦尚尼亞為例。

en: Thanks to President John Magufuli’s effort to mobilize more domestic revenue to support increased development spending, the economy is doing well.
zh: 多虧約翰·馬古夫裡總統努力調動更多國內收入來支援追加發展開支，該國經濟目前表現良好。

en: But, with roughly 800,000 individuals entering the labor force each year, Tanzania needs much more working capital, better infrastructure, and educational reform aimed at ensuring that workers have the skills, resources, and opportunities to secure decent jobs.
zh: 但因為每年約有 800,000人要加入勞動力隊伍，坦尚尼亞還需要更多週轉資金、更好的基礎設施和旨在確保工人擁有體面就業所需技術、資源和機會的教育改革。

en: The same is true of Ethiopia.
zh: 衣索比亞的情況也是一樣。

en: In the last couple of decades, the country has made great strides in export-led growth, supported by a growing industrial sector and large investments from China.
zh: 過去幾十年，在工業持續增長和來自中國的鉅額投資的支援下，該國的出口拉動型增長已經取得了長足的進步。

en: Now, it is poised to take over as the economic powerhouse of East Africa.
zh: 現在，衣索比亞已經註定成為東非的經濟強國。

en: Yet the urban youth unemployment rate stands at 23.3%. Left unchecked, this situation could easily end up fueling ethnic conflict and political turmoil.
zh: 但城市青年失業率維持在23.3 % ： 如果不加以控制，這種情況很可能導致種族衝突和政治動盪。

en: Another, related challenge concerns resource mobilization: countries need funds to invest in infrastructure, human capital, and the creation of trade and digital links within and beyond Africa.
zh: 另一個相關挑戰涉及資源調配：各國需要資金投資於非洲內外的基礎設施、人力資源以及貿易和數字聯絡的創造。

en: The AfDB report estimates that, for infrastructure investment alone, the continent needs some $170 billion per year, which is $100 billion more than is currently available.
zh: 非洲開發銀行報告預計僅基礎設施投資一項，非洲大陸每年就需要約1，700億美元，這比現有資金高出一千億之多。

en: As it stands, Africa receives a total of about $60 billion in foreign direct investment each year.
zh: 目前，非洲每年能獲得總共約600億美元的外國直接投資援助。

en: To close the gap, African governments must attract more money.
zh: 非洲政府必須吸引更多資金來彌補這一差距。

en: That will require establishing effective regulatory structures that facilitate long-term borrowing and repayment, while ensuring that lenders do not exploit borrowers, as has occurred everywhere from rural India to the United States mortgage market.
zh: 而這需要建立促進長期借貸和還貸的有效的監管制度，並確保債主不像在印度農村和美國抵押貸市場那樣剝削借貸者。

en: The challenges are daunting, to say the least.
zh: 至少可以說，挑戰是艱鉅的。

en: But there are lessons that African countries can learn from one another.
zh: 但非洲國家可以相互吸取經驗。

en: For example, Ghana’s smooth transfer of power after the December 2016 election set a positive democratic example.
zh: 例如，迦納在2016年12月選舉後權力順利移交樹立了民主制度的積極榜樣。

en: Nigeria’s Lagos State and Tanzania have done a good job of mobilizing internal resources for development.
zh: 奈及利亞的拉各斯州和坦尚尼亞在調動內部資源謀求發展方面做的非常不錯。

en: Add to that the emergence of an indigenous intelligentsia in the region, exemplified by organizations like the AfDB, and it seems that Africa’s moment may have arrived at last.
zh: 加之像非洲開發銀行等機構所代表的地區本土知識階層的崛起，目前的情況似乎是非洲的發展機會可能最終到來了。

en: Africa’s Schooling Without Learning
zh: 非洲的校內失教問題

en: ACCRA – As the school year began this September, there was welcome news for Ghana’s nearly half-million students entering high school: President Nana Akufo-Addo had fulfilled his campaign promise of free secondary education for children nationwide.
zh: 發自阿克拉 — — 隨著9月新學年開始，新升讀高中的近五十萬迦納學生迎來了好訊息：納納·阿庫福-阿多總統履行了他關於為全國兒童提供免費中學教育運動的承諾。

en: He swore not only to do away with admissions fees, but also to provide free textbooks and meals, the cost of which had often remained a barrier for the poorest students.
zh: 他不僅宣誓要免除學費，還提供免費的教科書和膳食 — — 這兩者過往總會成為阻止那些最貧困學生入學的障礙。

en: Ghana had introduced free compulsory education at the primary and junior high school levels in 1995, but implementation had been painfully slow – and students’ educational dreams were often cut off before high school.
zh: 迦納1995年開始在小學和初中階段實行免費義務教育，但執行情況不盡人意 — — 學生的求學夢往往在升讀高中之前就告終。

en: Even in 2014, only 37% of the nation’s students were enrolled in secondary school, owing to high fees.
zh: 即使是在2014年，在高昂的收費下全國只有37％的學生入讀中學。

en: The president’s move is thus an inspiring example that Ghana’s neighbors should follow.
zh: 而總統的這一舉動則是諸鄰國應當仿效的一個鼓舞人心的榜樣。

en: Unfortunately, despite progressive reforms like these, students across Africa still face other steep barriers to a truly comprehensive education.
zh: 不幸的是，儘管實施了這些漸進式改革，非洲的學生們在實現真正全面教育方面依然面臨這其他嚴重阻礙。

en: In Ghana, for example, poor and rural children are unlikely to reap the full benefits of their new access to secondary education.
zh: 就算在迦納，貧窮和農村的孩子依然難以從新的中學教育政策中得益。

en: The situation is arguably worse elsewhere on the continent.
zh: 非洲大陸其他地區的情況可能更糟。

en: The issue is not only lack of access to schools, but also lack of good schools.
zh: 問題不僅在於無法進入學校就讀，也在於缺乏好學校。

en: The results of a staggering new report from the UNESCO Institute of Statistics show that six out of ten children and adolescents around the world – 600 million in total – are not achieving basic skills in mathematics and reading.
zh: 聯合國教科文組織統計研究所新發布的一份令人震驚的報告顯示，全球每10個兒童和青少年中有就有6人 — — 合共6億人 — — 未能習得數學和閱讀方面的基本技能。

en: In Sub-Saharan Africa, it is estimated that 88% of children and teenagers will enter adulthood without basic literacy.
zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地區，有88％的兒童和青少年在不具備基本識字能力的情況下就進入成年階段。

en: This constitutes a moral and development crisis that demands immediate action.
zh: 這就構成了一個需要立即採取行動應對的道德和發展危機。

en: Having served as head of the department of Ga-Dangme education at the University of Education in Winneba, I know from first-hand experience that one of the main problems is lack of education and absenteeism among teachers themselves.
zh: 對此曾任迦納溫尼巴教育大學加-阿當梅語（Ga-Dangme）教育系主任的筆者從自身的經驗體會到，主要問題之一是教育缺乏以及教師缺勤。

en: The World Bank, which similarly raised the issue of “schooling without learning” in a new report, has corroborated my view.
zh: 世界銀行在其新發布的一份報告中同樣提出了“來到學校卻未能接受教育”的問題，同樣證實了我的看法。

en: Addressing this issue requires investing more in teachers’ colleges, promoting teaching as the career of nation-builders, and encouraging the best and brightest students to aspire to a teaching career.
zh: 解決這個問題需要投資設立更多的師範學院，推崇教學作為國家建設者的職業榮譽，同時鼓勵最優秀最聰明的學生走上教學生涯。

en: We cannot expect students to learn from poorly educated, poorly paid teachers.
zh: 我們不能指望那些從受過良好教育，薪酬微薄的老師那裡學到什麼東西。

en: We must also invest more in resources for schools and learning across the board, from scholarships for poor students to new libraries and classroom equipment.
zh: 我們還必須投入更多的資源 — — 包括從貧困學生獎學金到新的圖書館和教室裝置 — — 來全方位地提升學校和學習狀況。

en: With so many African governments already failing to provide equal, high-quality access to education for their citizens, this is not a challenge that they can take on alone.
zh: 由於很多非洲國家政府都無力為公民提供平等而高質量的受教育渠道，所以這不是一個它們能去獨立承擔的挑戰。

en: As the continent’s population booms – half of the world’s population growth between 2017 and 2050 is expected to occur here – African heads of state will have to work closely with key allies and multilateral organizations to bring in funding and share know-how.
zh: 隨著非洲大陸人口的增長 — — 預計2017至2050年間全世界有一半人口增長都源自此地 — — 非洲國家元首必須與主要盟國和多邊組織密切合作以爭取資助和分享核心教育技巧。

en: Fortunately, with the launch of the UNESCO report, several partners have already stepped up.
zh: 幸運的是，隨著聯合國教科文組織報告的面世，幾個合作伙伴已經站了出來。

en: French President Emmanuel Macron is perhaps the most prominent of those who have promised to make investment in education in Africa a high priority.
zh: 而法國總統埃馬紐埃爾·馬克龍（Emmanuel Macron）也許是承諾將非洲教育投資作為優先選項的國家元首中最為突出的一位。

en: As the UN’s main educational and cultural organization, UNESCO itself will play a key role in promoting initiatives to bring free, high-quality schooling to students across the continent.
zh: 作為聯合國的主要教育和文化組織，教科文組織本身將在推動為非洲大陸學生提供免費，高質量的學校教育方面發揮關鍵作用。

en: And whoever takes over UNESCO, following the election of a new director-general next month, will have a make-or-break opportunity to craft the right agenda to meet this challenge.
zh: 在下個月選舉上臺執掌教科文組織的新任總幹事也將有機會制定正確的議程來應對這一挑戰。

en: Currently, the organization is mired in a financial crisis and internecine disputes, and it will need a leader who has the vision to solve both internal and external problems.
zh: 當前該組織陷入了財政困局和內部糾紛之中，它需要一位具有眼光去解決內部和外部問題的領導者。

en: Notably, France’s candidate, former Minister of Culture and Communication Audrey Azoulay, has put both UNESCO’s internal crisis and education at the top of her agenda.
zh: 值得注意的是，法國的候選人，前文化交流部長奧黛麗·安祖拉（Audrey Azoulay）將教科文組織的內部危機和教育置於其議程的首位。

en: She has singled out the financial crisis as the biggest threat facing UNESCO and has stressed the need for greater dialogue with members in arrears, like the United States.
zh: 她將財政困局列為教科文組織面臨的最大威脅，並強調需要與美國等拖欠會費的成員國進行更多的對話。

en: In her previous governmental roles, Azoulay helped launch a global plan for cultural diversity through books and introduced plans to protect cultural heritage in conflict zones.
zh: 在其以前擔任的政府角色中，安祖拉協助發起了一項透過書籍宣傳全球文化多樣性計劃並提出了保護衝突地區文化遺產的計劃。

en: Azoulay also has called for UNESCO to treat education as a catalyst for development and gender equality, and as the best way to help combat the “radicalization of the mind.”
zh: 她還呼籲教科文組織將教育作為促進發展和性別平等的催化劑，也是協助打擊“思想激進化”的最佳途徑。

en: If elected, she has promised to put Sustainable Development Goal 4 – universal quality education – at the heart of UNESCO’s mission, with a special focus on Africa.
zh: 她承諾如果當選的話會將可持續發展目標4 — — 普適性的高質量教育 — — 作為教科文組織的核心使命，並會特別關注非洲。

en: The preamble to the Constitution of UNESCO declares, “Since wars begin in the minds of men, it is in the minds of men that the defenses of peace must be constructed.”
zh: 《聯合國教科文組織憲章》序言部分指出 ： “ 由於戰爭發端於人們的心靈，所以應當在人們心中建立起對和平的捍衛。

en: Unfortunately, in Africa, we know all too well what happens when efforts to construct the defenses of peace ultimately fail.
zh: ”不幸的是，在非洲我們都知道在構建捍衛和平的努力最終失敗後會產生什麼後果。

en: Islamist insurgents continue to pose a threat to Mali, where in 2013, they set fire to a library holding thousands of priceless historical manuscripts in the ancient cultural center of Timbuktu.
zh: 伊斯蘭武裝分子持續對馬裡施加威脅，在2013年他們就在縱火燒燬了位於廷巴克圖古帶文化中心區的一座藏有數千部無價歷史手稿的圖書館。

en: The incident was not only a devastating blow to world heritage; it was also a reminder of Africa’s history as a center for cultural exchange, literacy, and learning, and a call to action.
zh: 這一事件不僅是對世界文化遺產的一個沉重打擊啊；也提醒了人們非洲曾是一個文化交流，文學和教育的中心，且亟待行動去拯救。

en: The stakes for Africa are high.
zh: 非洲承受的風險極高。

en: Our children are threatened not only by lack of access to schools, but also by lack of opportunities to learn, and by the loss of irreplaceable fragments of their rich history.
zh: 我們的孩子不僅受到無力入學的威脅，還缺乏學習的機會, 更失去了自身豐富歷史中不可替代的部分。

en: We must hope that more governments follow Ghana’s example, that more allies like France increase their support, and that the new director general will place a high priority on UNESCO’s missions in Africa, which are more critical than ever.
zh: 我們真心希望更多的國家政府能仿效迦納的榜樣, 更多像法國這樣的盟國能增加它們的支援，而新的總幹事能教科文組織在非洲的使命列為優先事務，所有這一切都將比以往任何時候更為重要。

en: Africa’s Year of Opportunity
zh: 非洲的機遇之年

en: GENEVA – We are still near the start of 2018, and already it feels like tension and disorder will be the year’s defining characteristics.
zh: 日內瓦 — — 我們剛剛進入2018年年初，就已經感受到緊張和混亂將成為這一年的決定性特點。

en: From anti-immigration policies in the United States to flaring geopolitical hotspots in the Middle East and East Asia, disruption, upheaval, and uncertainty seem to be the order of the day.
zh: 從美國的反移民政策到中東和東亞引人矚目的地緣政治熱點，破壞、動盪和不確定性似乎在當下司空見慣。

en: But at least one metric offers reason for cautious optimism: economic growth.
zh: 但至少一個指標讓我們有理由保持謹慎樂觀：那就是經濟發展。

en: The International Monetary Fund estimates that global growth will reach 3.7% this year, up from 3.6% in 2017.
zh: 國際貨幣基金組織估計今年的全球經濟增長將達到3.7 % ， 高於2017年的3.6 % 。

en: As Christine Lagarde, the Fund’s managing director, put it in a speech in December, “The sun is shining through the clouds and helping most economies generate the strongest growth since the financial crisis.”
zh: 就像國際貨幣基金組織總裁克里斯蒂娜·拉加德在12月的一次演講中所說的那樣 ， “ 陽光正在穿透烏雲，並協助絕大多數經濟體取得自金融危機以來最強勁的發展。 ”

en: It was fitting that Lagarde made that observation in Addis Ababa, because it is in Africa where the rays of prosperity are shining brightest.
zh: 拉加德在亞的斯亞貝巴得出這樣的結論是正常的，因為繁榮之光在非洲閃耀得最為亮眼。

en: In fact, I predict that 2018 will be a breakout year for many – though not all – African economies, owing to gains in eight key areas.
zh: 事實上，因為八個關鍵領域的增長，我預測2018年將成為許多 — — 雖然並不是全部 — — 非洲經濟體的突破之年。

en: For starters, Africa is poised for a modest, if fragmented, growth recovery.
zh: 首先，即使斷斷續續，非洲也即將實現緩慢的經濟復甦。

en: Following three years of weak economic performance, overall growth is expected to accelerate to 3.5% this year, from 2.9% in 2017.
zh: 在經歷三年經濟表現疲弱的考驗後，總體增長預計將從2017年的2.9%加速至今年的3.5 % 。

en: This year’s projected gains will come amid improved global conditions, increased oil output, and the easing of drought conditions in the east and south.
zh: 今年的預期增長主要來自於全球環境改善、石油產量增加以及東南部非洲地區旱災的緩解。

en: To be sure, growth will be uneven.
zh: 可以肯定，增長並不平衡。

en: While nearly a third of African economies will grow by around 5%, slowdowns are likely in at least a dozen others.
zh: 雖然近1/3的非洲經濟體將實現約5%的增長，但還有十多個非洲國家的經濟增長可能放緩。

en: Sharp increases in public debt, which has reached 50% of GDP in nearly half of Sub-Saharan countries, are particularly worrying.
zh: 近半數撒哈拉以南非洲國家公共債務激增至GDP的50 % ， 這種狀況特別令人焦慮。

en: But, overall, Africa is positioned for a positive year.
zh: 但總體而言，非洲將迎來積極的一年。

en: Second, Africa’s political landscape is liberalizing.
zh: 第二，非洲的政治格局正在實現自由化。

en: Some of Africa’s longest-serving presidents – including Zimbabwe’s Robert Mugabe, Angola’s José Eduardo dos Santos, and the Gambia’s Yahya Jammeh – exited in 2017.
zh: 某些非洲任期最長的總統於2017年退位 — — 包括辛巴威的羅伯特·穆加貝、安哥拉的何塞·愛德華多·多斯桑托斯和甘比亞的葉海亞·賈梅。

en: In South Africa, Jacob Zuma’s resignation allowed Cyril Ramaphosa to become president.
zh: 在南非，雅各布·祖馬的辭職讓西里爾·拉馬福薩成為總統。

en: In January, Liberians witnessed their country’s first peaceful transfer of power since 1944, when former soccer star George Weah was sworn into office.
zh: 1月，利比亞民眾目睹了自1944年以來第一次權力的和平轉移，前足球明星喬治·維阿宣誓就職總統。

en: All of these gains will be tested, however, as voters in 18 countries go to the polls this year.
zh: 隨著今年有18個國家的選民參與投票，所有這一切進步都將經受考驗。

en: Adding to Africa’s story of divergence will be continued political fragility in a number of states, including the Central African Republic, Burundi, Nigeria, South Sudan, and Somalia.
zh: 不少非洲國家繼續處於政治脆弱狀態將進一步擴大非洲的差異，包括中非共和國、蒲隆地、奈及利亞、南蘇丹和索馬利亞。

en: A third source of optimism is Africa’s agricultural sector, where the potential of smallholder farmers, the majority of whom are women, is finally being realized.
zh: 第三個樂觀來源是非洲的農業產業，那裡的小農潛力終於得以實現，其中絕大部分是婦女。

en: African agricultural output is forecast to reach $1 trillion by 2030.
zh: 非洲農業產量預計到2030年將達1萬億美元。

en: This maturation could not have come at a more opportune time; roughly two-thirds of Africans depend on agriculture to make ends meet.
zh: 這樣的成熟期恰恰出現在最恰當的時機；約2/3的非洲民眾依靠農業來維持生計。

en: Large tracts of uncultivated land, a youthful workforce, and the emergence of tech-savvy “agropreneurs” – agricultural entrepreneurs – are lifting production and transforming entire economies.
zh: 大片未開墾的土地、年輕勞動力和技術精湛的“農業企業家 ” （ agropreneurs）的出現正在提升產量並改革整個經濟體。

en: Fourth, Africans are benefiting from technological disruption.
zh: 第四，非洲民眾正在從技術破壞中受益。

en: With more than 995 million mobile subscribers, Africa’s increasing connectivity is being used to power innovation.
zh: 非洲手機使用者已超過9.95億，不斷發展的資訊互聯正在實現加速創新的目的。

en: Key sectors like farming, health, education, banking, and insurance are already being transformed, greatly enhancing the region’s business landscape.
zh: 農業、醫療、教育、銀行和保險等關鍵部門已經開始轉型，這極大地改善了該地區的商業格局。

en: Fifth, African leaders are getting serious about curbing illicit financial outflows from corrupt practices that rob African countries of some $50 billion annually, much of it in the oil and gas sector.
zh: 第五，非洲領導人正在認真遏制腐敗行為所造成的非法資金流出，腐敗行為多數發生在石油天然氣領域，因此被掠奪的非洲國家財富每年約為500億美元。

en: While US lawmakers are pushing to repeal portions of the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial reform legislation – which contains a provision requiring oil, gas, and mining companies to disclose payments they make to governments – the broader trend is toward greater transparency and accountability.
zh: 儘管美國立法者正在推動廢除2010年多德-弗蘭克金融改革法案的部分內容 — — 該法案當中包含要求石油天然氣和礦業企業披露向政府付款的相關規定 — — 但卻阻擋不了提高透明度和建立問責制的大趨勢。

en: For example, the Panama Papers and the Paradise Papers pulled back the curtain on the murky system of tax havens and shell companies that shelter billions of dollars from some of the world’s poorest countries, including many in Africa.
zh: 例如，巴拿馬檔案和天堂檔案揭開了在避稅天堂和空殼公司等地下系統掩護下，數十億美元流出世界某些最貧困國家，其中也包括許多非洲國家的黑幕。

en: And with the G20 and the OECD working to stop tax avoidance, Africa may soon benefit from global efforts to end shady accounting.
zh: 隨著20國集團和經合組織竭盡全力打擊逃稅，非洲可能很快就會從全球打擊會計黑幕的工作中受益。

en: Sixth, Africa’s energy sector is set to thrive.
zh: 第六，非洲的能源行業註定會蓬勃發展。

en: While 621 million Africans still lack reliable access to electricity, innovations like renewables, mini-grids, and smart metering are bringing power to more people than ever before.
zh: 雖然6.21億非洲人仍然缺乏可靠的電力供應，但可再生能源、微型電網和智慧電錶等創新正在使越來越多的人享受到能源的便利。

en: In South Africa, renewable energy has taken off; the price of wind power is now competitive with coal.
zh: 在南非，可再生能源事業已經起飛；風電價格現在已經與煤電價格具有同等的競爭力。

en: Ethiopia, Kenya, Morocco, and Rwanda are also attracting large investments in renewable energy.
zh: 衣索比亞、肯亞、摩洛哥和盧安達也吸引了大量可再生能源投資。

en: A seventh area showing signs of progress is education.
zh: 顯示出進步跡象的第七個領域是教育。

en: To be sure, Africa’s educational offerings remain dismal; more than 30 million children in Sub-Saharan Africa are not in school, and those who do attend are not learning as much as they could.
zh: 可以肯定，非洲的教育產品水平仍然很低；撒哈拉以南非洲地區高達3，000萬兒童失學，即使那些上學的兒童也沒有學到足夠多的知識。

en: But many African leaders and publics have recognized these deficiencies; in some countries, such as Ghana, education has even become a deciding issue for voters.
zh: 但許多非洲領袖和民眾已經認識到上述缺陷；在以迦納為代表的某些國家，教育甚至已經成為選民投票的決定性問題。

en: As the Education Commission highlights, some countries are boosting investments in education.
zh: 正如教育委員會所強調的那樣，某些國家正在加大對教育領域的投資。

en: This represents an opportunity to align learning outcomes with future employment needs.
zh: 這創造了一個使學習成果與未來就業需求相協調的機遇。

en: But with over a billion young people living in Africa by 2050, greater investment in education is urgently needed.
zh: 但因為到2050年將有超過10億年輕人生活在非洲，因此迫切需要加大對教育領域的投資。

en: Finally, greater attention is being paid to developing a pan-African identity, and African fashions, films, and foods are expanding to new markets.
zh: 最後，人們越來越重視打造泛非身份，而非洲時裝、電影和食品正在向新市場進軍。

en: As these cultural connections grow, Africa’s soft power will continue to rise and extend far beyond the continent.
zh: 隨著文化聯絡的不斷發展，非洲的軟實力將繼續增加並強勢輻射非洲大陸以外地區。

en: In many corners of the world, 2018 is shaping up to be yet another disappointing year, as inequality and poverty continue to fuel anger and populism.
zh: 在世界許多角落，2018年正逐漸成為令人失望的一年，因為不平等和貧困繼續助長憤怒和民粹主義。

en: Africa will not be entirely immune from such developments.
zh: 非洲將不會在這樣的事態發展面前完全免疫。

en: Nonetheless, the continent’s inhabitants have at least eight good reasons – far more than most people elsewhere – to be optimistic.
zh: 但儘管如此，非洲大陸居民至少有八個充分的理由保持樂觀，其他地方的絕大多數人都沒有這樣的運氣。

en: Resetting the Africa-Europe Relationship
zh: 重置非洲-歐洲關係

en: JOHANNESBURG – In October, the European Union announced a plan to invest €40 billion ($47.6 billion) in Africa, a “Marshall Plan” for the continent that would boost economic growth, create jobs, and, ultimately, slow the migration of young Africans to Europe.
zh: 約翰內斯堡—10月，歐盟宣佈計劃了一項在向非洲投資400億歐元的計劃，這是一項非洲“馬歇爾計劃 ” ， 將提振非洲經濟增長、創造就業崗位，最終緩解非洲年輕人向歐洲的移民。

en: “Words won’t convince migrants to stay at home,” European Parliament President Antonio Tajani said. “We must give them a chance to have a decent life.”
zh: “光靠說無法讓移民留在家裡 ， ” 歐洲議會主席塔雅尼（Antonio Tajani）說 ， “ 我們比給他們過上體面生活的機會。

en: Tajani is right.
zh: 塔雅尼是對的。

en: Unfortunately, his approach is not.
zh: 不幸的是，他的方針是錯的。

en: For almost 60 years, well-meaning foreign governments, many of them European, have poured huge sums of money into Africa, with little to show for it.
zh: 近60年來，初衷良好的外國政府 — — 其中許多來自歐洲 — — 向非洲投入了鉅額資金，但收效甚微。

en: Lasting solutions to Africa’s development challenges require funding, to be sure, but they also demand a significant recalibration in relations with foreign partners.
zh: 非洲發展挑戰的持續解決方案當然需要資金，但也需要對與外國合作伙伴的關係做出重要調整。

en: And Africa’s relationship with Europe may require the biggest overhaul of all.
zh: 其中非洲與歐洲的關係最需要調整。

en: The problem goes much deeper than money; one might even say it’s philosophical.
zh: 問題比金錢深刻得多；甚至有人會說這是個哲學問題。

en: Africa and Europe have a very old relationship, marked by complexity and pain.
zh: 非洲和歐洲的關係由來已久，充滿了複雜性和陣痛。

en: Europe imposed its system of governance, values, and more recently, approaches to trade, long claiming that Africans need to be trained, to modernize, and to emphasize “capacity building.”
zh: 歐洲將它的治理體系、價值觀，後來又將它的貿易方針強加給非洲，一直說非洲人需要訓練，需要現代化，需要強調“能力建設 ” 。

en: This patronizing partnership has run its course, and it is crucial that we change the dynamic.
zh: 這一庇護式的合作關係早已不合時宜，改變這一動態至關重要。

en: Meetings like the fifth African Union-European Union summit, which wrapped up last week in Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire, are a good start.
zh: 第五次非盟-歐盟峰會於上週在象牙海岸的阿比讓落下帷幕。 類似的會議是很好的起點。

en: The meeting, which focused on “investing in youth,” put a spotlight on the complex links between the sides.
zh: 在這次非盟-歐盟峰會上 ， “ 投資於年輕人”成為焦點主題，也讓人們看到了雙方的複雜聯絡。

en: One conclusion was clear: the EU’s current answer to addressing migration from Africa is outdated.
zh: 一個清晰的結論是：歐盟當前的非洲移民問題解決方案已經過時了。

en: If Europe’s strategy to solve its migration challenges relies on money alone, it will fail.
zh: 如果歐洲用來解決移民挑戰的戰略完全依賴金錢，那是註定要失敗的。

en: We are a long way from the lopsided dynamic that defined African-European relations during the colonial era.
zh: 殖民地時代的傾斜的非歐關係早已一去不復返了。

en: Today, Europe may need Africa more than Africa needs Europe, especially if one considers human capital.
zh: 如今，歐洲需要非洲甚於非洲需要歐洲，特別是在人力資本方面。

en: Over the next 15 years, some 440 million Africans will enter the job market, compared to 72 million in Europe.
zh: 在未來十五年中，有4.4億非洲人將進入勞動力市場，而歐洲只有7,200萬人。

en: Africa’s job seekers will need work, and Europe will have it.
zh: 非洲的求職者需要工作，而歐洲有工作。

en: An aging population is already putting a squeeze on Europe’s growth, and vacancies are forecast to multiply amid a shrinking labor pool.
zh: 老齡化的人口已經開始影響歐洲的增長，而隨著勞動力人數的下降，崗位空缺預計將成倍增長。

en: There is even a strong possibility that, in the long run, it will be African young people who pay for the care of European pensioners.
zh: 甚至很有可能，從長期看，歐洲退休者的看護需要非洲年輕人來買單。

en: These demographic differences underscore the potential benefits of rethinking economic and political relations.
zh: 這些人口差異意味著重新思考經濟和政治關係具有很大的潛在收益。

en: Without migration, the redistributive policies on which European welfare states depend will be unable to withstand the current rate of aging.
zh: 如果沒有移民，歐洲福利國家所依賴的再分配政策將無法面對當前的老齡化率。

en: Not only will finding the staff to care for an aging population become more difficult; obtaining sufficient revenue to fund social security systems will also become harder as the dependency ratio rises.
zh: 不但照顧日已老化的人口將變得更加困難；獲取足夠收入來為社會保障體系提供資金也將隨著贍養比的上升而日益艱難。

en: Migration policies that emphasize mobility are essential to support European industries, household consumption and, ultimately, the financing of social benefits.
zh: 強調流動性的移民政策是支援歐洲工業、家庭消費以及最終的社會福利融資的關鍵。

en: Because strategic competitors like China and India have already identified the human-capital potential of Africa’s youth, Europe must move quickly to attract and retain – rather than repel – African professionals.
zh: 中國和印度等戰略性競爭者已經認識到非洲年輕人的人力資本潛力，歐洲必須迅速行動起來，吸引和挽留 — — 而不是抵制 — — 非洲專業人士。

en: Of the 375,000 students from the continent who study abroad each year, many will establish businesses and find their own place in a globalized economy upon graduation.
zh: 每年有375,000非洲學生出國留學，其中很多人畢業後將會創業並在全球化的經濟中找到一席之地。

en: There is already growing competition in the US, Canada, China, the Middle East, and Africa itself to attract these highly educated and mobile students.
zh: 美國、加拿大、中國、中東以及非洲本身都已經開始日益激烈地爭奪這些受過良好教育的高流動性學生。

en: Just as sixteenth-century Europe needed African gold, twenty-first-century Europe cannot do without the African diaspora.
zh: 正如十六世紀的歐洲需要非洲的黃金，沒有非洲僑民，二十一世紀的歐洲將步履維艱。

en: Which other world region can offer similar market potential for European industries faced with declining demand and or subdued growth in both their domestic and traditional export markets?
zh: 除了非洲，世界上還有哪個地區能夠為飽受需求下降和/或國內和傳統出口市場增長紛紛放緩之苦的歐洲國家提供類似的市場潛力？

en: That is why it is more important than ever that Europe not engage in an administrative bean-counting exercise, in which other economies will always appear stronger.
zh: 因此，對歐洲來說，歐洲切不可陷入政治算計，在這方面它爭不過其他經濟體。

en: Instead, the EU should commit to mutually beneficial employment schemes that maximize the strengths of people and cultures on both continents, notably through skills transfer.
zh: 相反，歐洲應該致力於互惠共贏的就業機制，從而實現兩大洲人員和文化優勢最大化，最主要的就是要透過技能轉移實現。

en: Europe’s recognition of its need for Africa is a necessary paradigm shift, leading, one hopes, to reasoned collaboration.
zh: 歐洲承認其對非洲的需要是必不可少的正規化轉變，我們希望，這能夠帶來理性的合作。

en: In an increasingly uncertain world, Africa and Europe can set the foundations for a smarter partnership by changing the basis of their cooperation.
zh: 在一個日益不確定的世界中，非洲和歐洲能夠透過改變合作基礎，為更加明智的夥伴關係奠定基礎。

en: Failure to do so will be costly.
zh: 如果無法實現這一點，代價將相當高昂。

en: But most of that cost will be borne by Europe.
zh: 但大部分代價都會由歐洲來承擔。

en: With alternative partners already courting their talent, it is not Africa that will be hurt the most by the missed opportunity.
zh: 其他合作伙伴早已開始追逐人才，失去機會影響最大的並不是非洲。

en: Gender Equity for Africa’s Scientists
zh: 非洲科學家的性別平等

en: KIGALI – A girl in Ethiopia could grow up to engineer a new method for improving agricultural yields, if only she could meet the right mentor.
zh: 基加利 — — 一位衣索比亞女孩只要能找到合適的導師，長大就可以設計出提高農作物產量的新方法。

en: A young woman in Malawi has ideas for new cancer treatments, but will never apply them if she is pushed out of school.
zh: 一位馬拉維青年女性有治療癌症的新想法，但如果被迫離校將永遠無法付諸實施。

en: And a girl in Rwanda has all the skills to create a mathematical model to mitigate droughts; all she needs is a research grant to help her pay for college.
zh: 而一位盧安達女孩掌握了創造數學模型緩解乾旱的所有技能; 她需要的僅僅是一筆研究捐款來幫助她上大學。

en: There is a global gender imbalance in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics – the so-called STEM disciplines.
zh: 在科學、技術、工程和數學領域都存在著全球性別失衡現象 — — 這就是所謂的STEM法則。

en: But in Africa, this imbalance is doing more than threatening individual futures.
zh: 但在非洲，不僅是個人未來正受到這種失衡的威脅。

en: It is also depriving the continent of talents and contributions needed to drive development and progress.
zh: 它還剝奪了推動這塊大陸發展和進步所需的人才和貢獻。

en: A 2011 African Development Bank report finds that “getting women into science and technology ultimately promises to benefit society as a whole.”
zh: 2011年一份非洲開發銀行的報告顯示“讓女性參與科學和技術最終有利於整個社會。 ”

en: Gender equity in STEM is achievable, and many African scholars are showing the world how to do it.
zh: 科學、技術、工程和數學領域的性別平等可以實現，許多非洲學者正在向世界展示他們如何以身作則。

en: But they need help, and programs that offer scholarships and support are among the best ways to achieve parity in the sciences.
zh: 但他們需要幫助，而提供獎學金和支援的相關計劃是實現科學平等的最佳方式。

en: The causes of Africa’s STEM gender imbalance are often compared to a leaky pipe: girls start out with interest and aptitude, but drop out of the disciplines at various points in their education.
zh: 非洲在科學、技術、工程和數學領域失衡的原因往往被比作一根漏水的水管：女孩開始時充滿了興趣和天賦，但卻在教育的各個階段被迫退學。

en: Early data from a Mastercard Foundation initiative aimed at reversing these trends show that a comprehensive approach to plugging the leaks can make a difference.
zh: 來自萬事達基金會旨在扭轉上述趨勢行動的早期資料表明全面採取措施來堵住漏洞能夠使整個局面得到改觀。

en: Success begins with acknowledging that gender equity in STEM matters.
zh: 承認科學、技術、工程和數學領域存在的性別平等問題是成功的開始。

en: “Science needs us” is how Armanda Kouassi, an industrial engineer and former Mastercard Foundation scholar, puts it.
zh: “科學需要我們”是前萬事達基金會學者兼工業工程師阿曼達·庫瓦希的言辭。

en: “With different ideas and perspectives come better solutions and thinking that can move scientific innovations forward and benefit the whole of Africa.”
zh: “不同的理念和視角可以帶來更好方案和思維，從而推動科學創新向前發展並惠及整個非洲。 ”

en: Kouassi is right.
zh: 庫瓦希說的完全正確。

en: Africa cannot afford to squander its young, female talent.
zh: 非洲承受不起浪費年輕女性人才的損失。

en: Sub-Saharan Africa faces a shortfall of some 2.5 million engineers, technologists, mathematicians, and scientists.
zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲面臨高達250萬名工程師、技術人員、數學家和科學家的短缺。

en: This dearth of expertise threatens a number of Sustainable Development Goals, such as food security, health care, clean water and sanitation, energy, and infrastructure.
zh: 這種專業知識的缺乏可能威脅幾項可持續發展目標的實現，例如糧食安全、醫療衛生、清潔飲水、衛生裝置以及能源和基礎設施。

en: Removing gender barriers to STEM requires African governments to make equity in the sciences a priority.
zh: 消除科學、技術、工程和數學領域的性別障礙需要非洲政府優先關注科學平等問題。

en: Nowhere is this happening more successfully than in Rwanda, where our collective experience has helped more than 1,250 girls and young women excel in STEM disciplines.
zh: 在這方面盧安達做得最為成功，我們的集體經驗已經幫助超過1，250名女孩兒和青年女性在上述學科領域取得優異的成績。

en: The African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS), in Rwanda’s capital, Kigali, is one of these agents of change.
zh: 位於盧安達首都基加利的非洲數學科學研究所是這場變革的推動力量之一。

en: The school believes that the next Einstein could be an African woman, an educational approach that informs its comprehensive strategy to plug leaks in the STEM development pipeline.
zh: 該校認為下一個愛因斯坦可能是一位非洲女性，這種教育方法反映了其堵住科學、技術、工程和數學領域發展渠道漏洞的全方位戰略。

en: AIMS’s innovative approach includes helping governments train teachers, ensure that female students are not vastly outnumbered in their classrooms, support students who are mothers, and engage with industry leaders to help graduates succeed in their careers.
zh: 非洲數學科學研究所的創新方法包括協助政府培訓教師，確保課堂上有一定數量的女生、支援已經身為人母的女性並同時與行業領袖合作幫助畢業生取得事業上的成功。

en: To attract more female students, 30% of the school’s scholarships are reserved for female applicants, and the school aspires to reach 50% in the near future.
zh: 為吸引更多女性學生，該校將30%的獎學金預留給女性申請者，而學校希望這一比例能在不久的將來達到50 % 。

en: Similarly, Carnegie Mellon University Africa (CMU-Africa), also in Kigali, is championing change by allocating 30% of its scholarships to young women.
zh: 同樣設在基加利的非洲卡內基梅隆大學（CMU-Africa）正在透過將30%的獎學金分配給年輕女性來推動變革的發生。

en: These commitments will have a positive effect on the entire institution, as CMU-Africa seeks to increase dramatically enrollment of female scientists.
zh: 上述舉措將對整個教育體制產生積極的影響，因為非洲卡內基梅隆大學正在積極採取措施大幅提高女性科學人才的入學率。

en: Finally, the Forum for African Women Educationalists (FAWE) in Rwanda has funded the education of 1,200 girls enrolled at the country’s top-performing secondary schools specializing in STEM subjects.
zh: 最後，盧安達非洲女性教育人士論壇（FAWE）已經資助了在該國優秀高中學習科學、技術、工程和數學等學科領域的1，200名女性學生接受教育。

en: Of these students, an estimated 70% are expected to study science at the university level.
zh: 在這些學生中，估計有70%有望考上大學學習理科專業。

en: Despite these positive developments, quotas alone will not achieve parity.
zh: 儘管事態出現了這些積極的進展，但單純依靠配額仍無法達到平等的目的。

en: To make lasting gains, opportunities outside the classroom are also needed.
zh: 需要課堂以外的機會才能獲得持久的收益。

en: At FAWE Rwanda, a program called Tuseme (a Swahili word meaning “let’s speak out”) offers girls leadership training through drama, song, and creative arts to teach presentation, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
zh: 在盧安達非洲女性教育人士論壇，一個名叫Tuseme的專案（這個斯瓦希里語單詞的意思是“讓我們公開表達 ” ） 透過戲劇、歌唱以及創意藝術來訓練女孩的領導能力，並教會她們掌握演講、談判和決策技術。

en: FAWE Rwanda also works with teachers to develop gender-responsive pedagogical methods.
zh: 盧安達非洲女性教育人士論壇還與教師合作開發以性別特點為基礎的教學方式。

en: Likewise, at CMU-Africa, scholars are invited to participate in the university’s Meeting of the Minds Symposium, an annual global gathering for undergraduates to showcase their work to a wider audience of faculty, students, government officials, and industry representatives.
zh: 同樣，非洲卡內基梅隆大學學者應邀參與學校的思想研討會，這是一年一度的全球本科生聚會，本科生們在這次研討會上面向教職員工、學生、政府官員和行業代表展示他們所取得的成績。

en: And, the Next Einstein Forum, a select program at AIMS that recognizes Africa’s best young scientists and technologists – of which 40% are women – provides emerging innovators with an opportunity to lead their own research while inspiring the next generation of scientific thinkers.
zh: 另外，非洲數學科學研究所的精選專案下一個愛因斯坦論壇負責選拔非洲最高水平的青年科學家和技術工作者 — — 其中有40%是女性 — — 為正在打拼的創業者提供領導自己研究的機會，同時激勵下一代科學思想家。

en: Inequalities faced by girls and young women in African education cannot be erased overnight.
zh: 非洲女孩和年輕女性在教育領域所面臨的不平等不可能一夜間消除。

en: As Rebecca, a Mastercard Foundation scholar from Uganda, remembers, “When I was at my school, the boys used to call us ‘half-men,’ because if you’re a lady and you go for sciences, you’re a half-man.”
zh: 正如烏干達萬事達基金會學者麗貝卡所回憶的那樣 ， “ 我在校期間，男生曾經稱我們為‘假小子 ’ ， 因為如果你是一名女生而且學習理工科，你就是假小子。

en: But, Rebecca adds, “It was cool being a science student.”
zh: ”但麗貝卡補充道 ， “ 學習理科是一件很酷的事。 ”

en: Africa needs more women who share Rebecca’s enthusiasm for STEM.
zh: 非洲需要更多像麗貝卡一樣熱愛科學、技術、工程和數學學科的女性。

en: To ensure that science remains appealing to girls, schools, governments, and industries must cooperate to educate teachers and mentors, and allocate funding to close the gender gap.
zh: 為確保科學對女性的吸引力，學校、政府及各行各業都必須齊心協力教育教師和輔導員，同時撥款彌補性別差距。

en: As Miranda, another Mastercard Foundation scholar, recently observed, “As we try to find new innovations and inventions to drive the economy, I believe that math and science is at the forefront of that progress.”
zh: 另一位萬事達基金會學者米蘭達最近指出 ， “ 當我們想找到新的創造和發明來推動經濟發展時，我相信數學和科學處在進步的前沿位置。

en: As professionals working to improve African education, we couldn’t agree more.
zh: ”作為竭盡全力改善非洲教育的專業人士，她的觀點我完全同意。

en: Liberal Democracy in Africa Can Wait
zh: 非洲自由民主可以等

en: YAOUNDÉ – Africa’s policymakers understand that strong economic and political leadership is essential to growth and stability.
zh: 雅溫得—非洲決策者明白，強大的經濟和政治領導是增長和穩定的關鍵。

en: For years, African economies have fared better than expected, owing to a commitment to improving governance.
zh: 多年來，非洲經濟表現一直好於預期，這便是致力於改善治理的結果。

en: The question now is how to sustain the momentum.
zh: 現在的問題是如何保持這一勢頭。

en: Current strategies do not provide an adequate answer.
zh: 當前的戰略沒有提供充分的答案。

en: Although leaders at a recent African Economic Conference in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, committed to keeping governance reforms at the top of Africa’s agenda, they offered no blueprint.
zh: 在最近的衣索比亞亞的斯亞貝巴非洲經濟會議上，領導人承諾繼續將治理改革列為非洲日程的重中之重，但他們並沒有給出路線圖。

en: From my perspective, this void presents an opportunity to consider new governance paradigms, including those that borrow from two commonly discussed models: the “Washington Consensus” and the “Beijing Model.”
zh: 從我的角度看，這一空白是一次思考新治理正規化的機會，包括那些借鑑兩大熱門模式 — — “華盛頓共識”和“北京模式”的正規化。

en: Development practitioners have long debated which model offers the best framework for reform.
zh: 長期以來，發展實踐家一直在爭論那種模式是最好的改革框架。

en: Put simply, “governance” refers to a dynamic framework of rules, structures, and processes that help a government manage its economic, political, and administrative affairs.
zh: 簡言之 ， “ 治理”指的是一個動態規則、結構和過程框架，以幫助政府管理經濟、政治和行政事務。

en: But which principles a government focuses on varies by approach.
zh: 但對於政府應該注重哪些原則，不同的方法有不同的看法。

en: The model championed by the West places a premium on human rights and democracy, while the one advocated by China is more concerned with political stability and economic growth.
zh: 西方所領銜的模式優先關注人權和民主，而中國所主推的模式更關注政治穩定和經濟增長。

en: Since the election of President Donald Trump, the United States, which remains one of Africa’s top donors, has focused more on the principles China favors – like political stability, trade, and counterterrorism – than on human rights.
zh: 自特朗普當選總統以來，仍然是非洲首要捐助國的美國，開始更加註重中國所中意的原則 — — 如政治穩定、貿易和反恐 — — 而非人權。

en: The rationale is that the Beijing Model is better for Africa in the short and medium term.
zh: 原因在於北京模式在短期和中期對非洲更有利。

en: And, while it might not be popular to admit, Trump has a point.
zh: 儘管承認這一點未必討好，但特朗普不無道理。

en: Simply put, food, shelter, health, and good sanitation are more relevant for most Africans than the right to vote.
zh: 簡言之，糧食、住所、健康和良好的衛生設施對於大部分非洲人來說要比投票權更加重要。

en: Moreover, only a moderately wealthy population, with a healthy middle class, can adequately demand the rights that democracy provides.
zh: 此外，只有當人口比較富裕，並形成了一個健康的中產階級時，才能充分地要求民主所提供的權利。

en: Paradoxically, the fastest way to build a strong middle class in Africa would be to move toward the hierarchy of principles that China’s model promotes.
zh: 諷刺的是，在非洲構建強大中產階級的最佳方式便是在各個層面採取中國模式所推行的原則。

en: For Africa to reorient its governance approach, and embrace a post-Washington Consensus, its leaders must commit to improving institutional effectiveness and economic management.
zh: 對非洲來說，調整治理方針、接受後華盛頓共識需要其領導人致力於改善機構效率和經濟管理。

en: The first set of reforms would involve establishing clear lines of sovereignty with international partners.
zh: 第一組改革應該包括與國際合作夥伴劃定明確的主權邊界。

en: Africa’s relationship with Western donors, for example, has historically placed individual rights over national rights.
zh: 比如，非洲與西方捐助國的關係，在歷史上將個體權利置於國家權利之上。

en: But in my view, individual rights should not supersede sovereign ones.
zh: 但在我看來，個體權利不應該超越主權權利。

en: Punishing entire countries for laws that affect a minority is counterproductive.
zh: 因為影響少數人的法律而懲罰整個國家效果會適得其反。

en: An example of such collective punishment occurred in Uganda in 2014, when the World Bank froze some $90 million in loans following the government’s enactment of legislation criminalizing homosexuality.
zh: 這種集體懲罰的一個例子發生在2014年的烏干達，因為烏干達政府實施了同性戀入罪的立法，世界銀行凍結了約9,000萬美元貸款。

en: As a Ugandan government spokesman said at the time, the bank “should not blackmail its members” to adopt Western values.
zh: 當時，烏干達政府發言人表示，世界銀行“不應該綁架其成員”接受西方價值觀。

en: Yet, when governance models are judged solely through the lens of the Washington Consensus, there is very little alternative.
zh: 但是，當治理模式完全以華盛頓共識的標準來評判時，就幾乎別無選擇。

en: Along the same lines, the second set of reforms pertains to prioritizing economic rights over political rights.
zh: 同時，第二組改革優先考慮經濟權利而非政治權利。

en: For example, politicians who manage an economy well should not be subject to term limits.
zh: 比如，管理經濟的政客不應該有任期限制。

en: Neither Singapore nor China is a democracy; but leaders in both countries have used their political power to improve living standards.
zh: 不管是新加坡還是中國，都不是民主國家；但兩國領導人運用他們的政治權力去改善生活水平。

en: Forcing leaders to step down in the middle of economic reforms seems counterproductive.
zh: 在經濟改革進行中期迫使領導人下臺可能起到適得其反的效果。

en: These are not far-fetched ideas.
zh: 這些都不是牽強附會。

en: Today, leaders in Rwanda, which is widely considered an African success story, have improved stability by moving away from the Washington Consensus approach to governance.
zh: 如今，在被廣泛認為是非洲成功故事之一的盧安達，領導人透過放棄華盛頓共識的治理方針，成功改善了穩定。

en: Politically, Rwanda is strong, disciplined, and organized, but it is not liberal.
zh: 從政治上看，盧安達強大、有組織、有紀律，但不自由。

en: The landslide reelection of President Paul Kagame last year had more to do with power than democracy.
zh: 總統卡加梅在去年的大選中以壓倒性優勢連任與其說源自民主，不如說源自權力。

en: Although Kagame remains popular, his government was criticized for stifling free speech and human rights in the run-up to the vote.
zh: 儘管卡加梅保持著很高的支援率，但他的政府被批在選舉期間扼殺言論自由、壓迫人權。

en: The conclusion I draw is not that human rights don’t matter, but that political discipline and imperfect forms of democracy are acceptable if the tradeoff is sustained progress in economic and institutional governance.
zh: 我從中得出的結論不是人權不重要，而是政治紀律和不完美的民主形式，在面臨經濟和機構治理持續改善的權衡面前也是可接受的。

en: We should be intellectually honest and call a spade a spade.
zh: 我們應該在理智上保持坦誠，實話實說。

en: Rwandans should not be ashamed to value economic and administrative strength more than fair elections.
zh: 盧安達人民不必因為重視經濟和行政強勢甚於公平選舉而感到羞愧。

en: The question for other African states seeking to reform their governance models, then, is how much of Rwanda’s approach to emulate.
zh: 因此，其他非洲國家尋求改革治理模式時所面臨的問題是在多大程度上效仿盧安達的方針。

en: Neither the Washington Consensus nor the Beijing Model has all the answers.
zh: 華盛頓共識也好，北京模式也好，都不是答案的全部。

en: But, as Rwanda has demonstrated, if discipline and strong leadership are improving lives and delivering public goods, perhaps liberal democracy should be a long-term priority.
zh: 但是，盧安達證明，如果紀律和堅強的領導能夠改善生活、提供公共品，那麼也許自由民主應該作為一項長期的重點。

en: Health Coverage Must Not Ignore Africa’s Elderly
zh: 醫療保險不能忽視非洲的老年人

en: DAR ES SALAAM – My grandmother is 76, and my grandfather is 83.
zh: 達雷斯薩拉姆 — — 我的祖母76歲，祖父83歲。

en: They have lived fruitful lives together, cultivating crops and grazing cattle in a remote village in the hills of southwest Uganda.
zh: 他們在烏干達西南部山區的一個偏遠村莊裡共同生活，邊養牛邊種植農作物。

en: But whenever I think of them, I am more in awe of their good health than their hard work.
zh: 但每當我想起他們，我更佩服他們的健康體魄而非辛勤勞作。

en: Because of the remoteness of their community, anytime my grandparents need medical care, they must travel 25 miles to the nearest hospital on motorcycles known as boda-bodas, paying about 50,000 Ugandan shillings (about $13) for the round-trip journey.
zh: 因為生活的地方偏遠，每次我的祖父母需要看醫生，都必須騎著被當地人稱為 boda-bodas的摩托車前往25英里外最近的醫院，來回路費需要50,000烏干達先令（約合13美元 ） 。

en: Then, because they were recently dropped from their health-insurance plan due to age, they must cough up more money to foot the bill for treatment.
zh: 而後，由於他們最近因超齡而被迫退出醫療保險計劃，他們必須自己掏更多錢來支付醫療賬單。

en: In other words, for my grandparents – and for many older Africans – a visit to the doctor is onerous, costly, and exceedingly rare.
zh: 換言之，對於我的祖父母 — — 和許多非洲老年人來講 — — 看醫生不僅麻煩、昂貴而且非常罕見。

en: Access to health care is an obsession for experts in international development.
zh: 醫療服務普及度幾乎已經成為困擾國際發展專家的強迫症。

en: In May, at the World Health Organization’s annual World Health Assembly, officials from dozens of countries discussed how to achieve universal health coverage through the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
zh: 今年5月，在世衛組織一年一度的世衛大會上，來自數十個國家的官員探討了如何藉助聯合國可持續發展目標實現全民醫療覆蓋。

en: And yet, most of the attention centered on mothers, newborns, and children; elderly populations in developing countries were largely ignored.
zh: 但母嬰及兒童吸引了絕大部分注意力；討論基本對發展中國家的老年人口視而不見。

en: Failure to address this omission would leave an increasing share of the population without access to affordable health care.
zh: 如果解決不了這一遺漏問題，越來越多的非洲人口將無法獲得平價的醫療保健。

en: According to the World Bank, life expectancy in Sub-Saharan Africa has risen steadily in recent decades, from just 40 years in 1960 to 60 years today.
zh: 世界銀行資料顯示，撒哈拉以南非洲地區的預期壽命近幾十年來一直穩步上升，從1960年的僅40歲上升到今天的60歲。

en: If this trend continues, the number of Africans living past their 60th birthday will more than double by 2050.
zh: 如果這一趨勢得以沿續，那麼到2050年活過60歲生日的非洲人會比現在翻一番。

en: This is of course good news; longevity is a key indicator of human development.
zh: 這當然是個好訊息；長壽是人類發展的一項關鍵指標。

en: But Africa’s elder boom will be a disaster if living longer means living sicker because of inadequate health care.
zh: 但如果壽命延長意味著因醫療條件不足而罹患疾病 ，那麼非洲的老年人口膨脹將帶來災難性的後果。

en: In Uganda, many rural health-care centers lack the personnel, supplies, and infrastructure to meet the needs of older patients.
zh: 在烏干達，許多農村醫療中心滿足老年患者需求的人員、物資和基礎設施都十分匱乏。

en: Small clinics typically refer their oldest patients to the closest big hospital, which is often many miles away.
zh: 小珍所通常會將最年長的患者轉到最近的大醫院，而大醫院通常距離都在幾英里開外。

en: Traveling by motorcycle over rough terrain can worsen health conditions; but with no other options, the frail must choose between a bumpy ride on the back of a bike and no treatment at all.
zh: 在崎嶇山路上騎摩托車可能導致健康條件惡化；但因為沒有其他選擇，體弱者必須在騎車經受顛簸和放棄治療之間作出選擇。

en: It’s hard to blame those who opt for the latter.
zh: 難怪有人選擇後者。

en: According to a 2010 survey by doctors at the Mulago National Referral Hospital in Kampala, boda-bodas are Uganda’s leading cause of road-related injuries.
zh: 2010年坎帕拉姆拉哥國家轉診醫院醫生髮起的一項調查顯示，boda-bodas是烏干達道路傷害的主要原因。

en: During the survey period, motorcycle passengers accounted for 41% of the hospital’s 1,500 trauma cases, and riders’ injuries consumed 62.5% of the hospital’s surgery budget.
zh: 在調查期間，摩托車乘客佔該院1，500起創傷病例的41 % ， 而騎車者的傷害佔該院手術預算的62.5 % 。

en: Given the dangers of travel, it is no wonder that my grandparents are reluctant to seek medical care.
zh: 鑑於路上可能面臨的危險，難怪我的祖父母不願尋求醫療服務。

en: Of course, the biggest obstacle to health care in Uganda – like everywhere else – is money.
zh: 當然，像其他地方一樣，錢才是烏干達醫療保健最大的障礙因素。

en: In 2015, researchers at Makerere University found that household income is the main determinant of elderly people’s access to and use of health-care services.
zh: 2015年，馬克雷雷大學的研究人員發現家庭收入是老年人獲取並使用醫療保健服務的主要決定因素。

en: The story is similar in the United States, where average annual health-care costs have been increasing for decades.
zh: 美國的情況也十分類似，平均每年的醫療保健成本近幾十年來一直處於增加當中。

en: But while older patients in the US can turn to Medicare (which accounted for 15% of federal spending in 2017), the elderly in most African countries have less government support.
zh: 但雖然美國的老年患者可以藉助聯邦醫療保險（2017年佔聯邦開支的15 % ） ，但多數非洲國家的老年人卻缺乏政府支援。

en: Still, a dearth of dedicated resources does not mean that Africa’s leaders must ignore their older constituents.
zh: 儘管如此，專屬資源的欠缺並不意味著非洲領導人一定要忽視老年選民需求。

en: By combining elder-care services with existing programs, health benefits can be extended to underserved populations.
zh: 透過將老年人護理服務與現有計劃相結合，可以將健康福利拓展到服務欠缺的人口。

en: For example, single-sector initiatives, like HIV/AIDS treatment schemes, could include elderly-friendly health-care components.
zh: 例如，像艾滋病毒/艾滋病治療計劃等單一領域計劃可以納入方便老年人的醫療保健元素。

en: Health-care workers who serve expectant and new mothers could also be trained to provide in-home care for the elderly in multigenerational households.
zh: 服務孕婦和新媽媽的衛生保健工作者也可以接受培訓後在幾代人共同生活的家庭為老年人提供上門醫療服務。

en: These types of initiatives would not require vast sums of money; rather, the most important factor in launching them is political support and effective program integration.
zh: 上述型別的計劃不需要鉅額資金；相反，啟動該計劃的最重要因素是政治支援和有效的專案整合。

en: Developing countries have made considerable gains when it comes to improving health care for the young.
zh: 發展中國家在改善年輕人的醫療服務方面已經取得了重大的進步。

en: Now, we must do the same for the elderly.
zh: 現在，我們必須為老年人提供同樣的服務。

en: In Uganda, the government’s national health-care strategy could easily be strengthened by adding seniors to the list of so-called vulnerable groups.
zh: 在烏干達，將老年人列入所謂的弱勢群體名單可以輕易實現對政府 國家醫療保健戰略的強化。

en: Integrating elder-care options into existing frameworks – such as the health extension program in Ethiopia, the community-based health program in Tanzania, and village health teams in my country – are other ways to extend coverage.
zh: 擴大醫療覆蓋範圍的其他方式是將老年人保健方案納入衣索比亞衛生推廣計劃、坦尚尼亞社群衛生計劃以及我所在國家的鄉村衛生小組等現有醫療框架。

en: Finally, community health-insurance schemes must be overhauled to prevent the exclusion of poor older patients.
zh: 最後，為防止將貧困老年患者排除在外，必須對社群醫療保險計劃進行徹底的改革。

en: To maintain coverage and protect the elderly from financial ruin, reforms are needed to create plans that are financially sound and drawn from a larger pool of subscribers.
zh: 為確保為老年人提供醫療服務並保護老年人避免財務破產，我們需要改革制定在財務上可行並擴大使用者基數的保險計劃。

en: We all yearn to live long, healthy, productive lives – just as my grandparents have.
zh: 人人都渴望像我的祖父母那樣過上長壽、健康和有效率的生活。

en: But without lifelong access to quality health care, longevity will be more luck than science.
zh: 但如果沒有終身高質量的醫療保健，就只能憑藉運氣而非科學來實現長壽。

en: The integrity of any society can be judged by how well it treats its youngest and oldest members.
zh: 如何對待最年輕和最年長的社會成員可以判定社會的健全程度。

en: That calculus applies to governments, too.
zh: 這樣的推論同樣適用於政府。

en: Africa’s Must-Do Decade
zh: 非洲這十年必須要做的事

en: VIENNA – Since 2000, Africa has recorded impressive rates of economic growth, owing largely to development assistance and a prolonged commodity boom.
zh: 維也納 — — 自2000年來，主要因為發展援助和商品的長期繁榮，非洲的經濟增長速度令人印象深刻。

en: While the continent shows great diversity in the socioeconomic trajectories, growth rates have generally masked an underlying lack of structural transformation.
zh: 儘管非洲大陸在社會經濟的發展路徑方面表現出極大的多樣性，但增長率往往掩蓋了背後結構轉型的缺失。

en: Many African countries have yet to undergo the kind of transformation that is necessary for socially inclusive and environmentally sustainable development over the long term: namely, industrialization.
zh: 許多非洲國家仍未經歷實現長期社會包容及環境可持續發展所需要的那種轉型：那就是工業化。

en: Wherever industrialization has occurred, it has reliably improved economic diversification and helped to nurture, strengthen, and uphold the conditions for competitive growth and development.
zh: 無論工業化發生在哪裡，它都勿庸置疑地促進了經濟多樣化，有助於培育、加強和維護競爭性發展和增長所需的環境。

en: In recent decades, some developing countries – mainly in Asia – have managed to industrialize.
zh: 近幾十年來，一些發展中國家 — — 主要分佈在亞洲 — — 成功地完成了工業化程序。

en: But, despite repeated attempts, African countries have not.
zh: 但儘管也曾反覆嘗試，非洲國家仍未能完成工業化程序。

en: In 2014, the Asia and Pacific region’s share of value added in global manufacturing was 44.6%, whereas Africa’s was just 1.6%.
zh: 2014年，亞太地區佔全球製造業增加值的比重為44.6 % ， 而非洲則僅有區區1.6 % 。

en: With South Africa as its only industrialized country, Sub-Saharan Africa is the least industrialized region in the world.
zh: 因為只有南非一個工業化國家，撒哈拉以南非洲成為全世界工業化程度最低的地區。

en: For African countries to achieve sustainable development, they will have to increase substantially the share of industry – especially manufacturing – in their national investment, output, and trade.
zh: 非洲國家要想實現可持續發展，就必須在國家投資、生產和貿易等領域大幅增加工業 — — 尤其是製造業 — — 的比重。

en: And, to their credit, most African countries already recognize that such a transformation is necessary to address a wide range of interconnected challenges that they are now confronting.
zh: 值得肯定的是，絕大多數非洲國家已經認識到要想解決它們目前所面臨的一系列相互關聯的挑戰，就必須進行這樣的轉型。

en: One such challenge is population growth.
zh: 其中一個挑戰是人口的增長。

en: More than half of the continent’s 1.2 billion people are under the age of 19, and almost one in five are between the ages of 15 and 24.
zh: 非洲大陸12億人有超過一半年齡在19歲以下，而且幾乎1/5的人年齡在15到24歲之間。

en: Each year, 12 million new workers join the labor force, and they will need the tools and skills to ensure their future livelihoods.
zh: 每年都有1，200萬新增勞動力加入到勞動力隊伍，他們需要相應的工具和技能來確保未來的生活水平。

en: Industrialization is the key to helping Africa’s fast-growing population realize a demographic dividend.
zh: 工業化是幫助非洲快速增長的人口實現人口紅利的關鍵要素。

en: A related challenge is migration.
zh: 與之相關的挑戰是移民。

en: Many of Africa’s most ambitious and entrepreneurially minded young people are joining others in migrating north.
zh: 許多非洲國家最雄心勃勃並富於創業精神的年輕人正在和其他人一道向北方移民。

en: But no country, especially in Africa, can afford to lose so much talent and potential.
zh: 但沒有哪個國家，尤其是非洲國家，能夠承受得了一下子失去這麼多的人才和潛能。

en: Industrialization alone cannot resolve the migration crisis, but it can address one root cause, by creating jobs in the countries of origin.
zh: 僅靠工業化無法解決移民危機，但卻可以透過在原籍國創造就業機會的方式來化解其中一個根本原因。

en: A third challenge is climate change, which weighs heavily on countries where agriculture is still the primary sector for employment.
zh: 第三個挑戰是氣候變化，氣候變化嚴重影響到仍然以農業作為主要就業領域的國家。

en: To confront the threat, Africa will need to develop and adopt green technologies, while channeling more investment into resource efficiency and clean energy.
zh: 要想面對這一挑戰，非洲需要發展和應用綠色技術，同時為資源效率和清潔能源領域吸引更多投資。

en: With the right investments, African countries can reduce the cost of delivering power to rural areas, and contribute to global efforts to reduce emissions and mitigate the effects of climate change.
zh: 如果有充足的投資，非洲國家可以降低向農村輸電的成本，並貢獻於減排和緩解氣候變化影響的全球性事業。

en: In short, Africa must industrialize, and it must do so in a socially inclusive and environmentally sustainable manner.
zh: 總之，非洲必須實現工業化，而且必須以能確保社會包容和環境可持續的方式。

en: Given that most previous efforts at sustainable development in Africa have failed, there is a clear need for a new approach: a broad-based, country-owned process that taps financial and non-financial resources, promotes regional integration, and fosters cooperation among Africa’s development partners.
zh: 鑑於以往在非洲進行的可持續發展努力多數以失敗告終，所以顯然需要採取一種新的方式：可持續發展必須在擁有廣泛基礎的前提下照顧到國情，充分利用金融及非金融資源，推動地區一體化並培育非洲發展夥伴之間的合作關係。

en: As it happens, the United Nations General Assembly has declared 2016-2025 to be the Third Industrial Development Decade for Africa.
zh: 事實上，聯合國大會已經宣佈2016-2025年為非洲工業發展第三個十年。

en: During IDDA III, the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, which I lead, will spearhead the new approach to sustainable development sketched above.
zh: 在工業發展第三個十年期間，由我領導的聯合國工業發展組織將率先落實上面提到的可持續發展新方式。

en: UNIDO has put its full support behind partnerships for mobilizing resources, and is offering a tested model for African countries to follow: the Programme for Country Partnership (PCP).
zh: 聯合國工業發展組織全力支援合作伙伴調動資源，同時為非洲國家提供了國傢伙伴關係專案（PCP）這樣一個經過驗證的模式。

en: UNIDO’s PCP provides countries with technical assistance, policy advice, and investments to help them design and implement industrialization strategies.
zh: 聯合國工業發展組織的國傢伙伴關係專案為各國提供協助其設計並推行工業化戰略的技術援助、政策諮詢和投資。

en: The program was launched in 2014, and is already being successfully implemented in two African countries – Ethiopia and Senegal – and in Peru.
zh: 該專案於2014年啟動，並已經在衣索比亞和塞內加爾等兩個非洲國家得到成功實施。

en: The PCP provides a multi-stakeholder partnership model that can be adapted to each country’s national development agenda.
zh: 國傢伙伴關係專案提供了一種以多利益相關方為基礎的夥伴關係模式，可以根據各國的國家發展議程進行調整後加以實施。

en: It is designed to work in synergy with governments and their partners’ ongoing development efforts, while funneling additional funds and investments toward sectors that have high growth potential and are important to a particular government’s industrial-development agenda.
zh: 它旨在與政府部門及其合作伙伴持續不斷的發展努力協調合作，同時為具有高增長潛力和對政府工業發展議程至關重要的部門提供額外的資金和投資。

en: Priority sectors are typically chosen for their job-creation, investment, and export potential, and for their access to necessary raw materials.
zh: 人們通常會選擇能創造就業崗位、吸引投資和具有出口潛力的部門作為優先投資物件，還有一個條件就是原材料必須容易獲取。

en: The PCP approach is designed to maximize the impact of all partner programs and projects that are relevant to industrial development.
zh: 國傢伙伴關係專案旨在令與工業發展相關的所有夥伴專案和計劃的影響力得到最大限度的發揮。

en: To that end, strategic partnerships with financial institutions and the business sector are particularly important.
zh: 為了實現這一目的，與金融機構和企業部門建立戰略伙伴關係尤為重要。

en: With these in place, African countries can marshal additional resources for infrastructure, innovation, expertise, and new technologies.
zh: 有了這些，非洲國家就可以籌集更多資源用於基建、創新、專業知識和新技術專案。

en: UNIDO’s goal is to make the PCP model the mainstream approach for all African countries.
zh: 聯合國工業發展組織的目標是使國傢伙伴關係模式成為所有非洲國家採用的主流模式。

en: We stand ready to support Africa on its path to inclusive and sustainable industrial development – during IDDA III and beyond.
zh: 我們隨時準備支援非洲走向包容性和可持續的工業發展 — — 無論是在非洲工業發展第三個十年期間還是以後。

en: Africa’s Decade of Industrialization
zh: 非洲的工業化十年

en: VIENNA – In today’s interdependent global economy, Africa remains a weak link.
zh: 維也納—在當今互相依存的全球經濟中，非洲仍然是弱環。

en: If the world is to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals, thereby completing the United Nations 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, it must help Africa accelerate its development by promoting rapid and responsible industrialization.
zh: 要想實現可持續發展目標 ， ， 進而完成聯合國2030年可持續發展日程，就必須透過促進迅速而負責任的工業化幫助非洲加快發展。

en: Africa is by no means destined to lag behind the rest of the world economy.
zh: 非洲絕不是註定要拖世界經濟的後腿。

en: On the contrary, it could easily become a global economic powerhouse – and within the next decade.
zh: 相反，它很有希望成為世界經濟的發動機 — — 並且未來十年就能實現。

en: But, to fulfill its economic potential, Africa must industrialize.
zh: 但是，要想實現其經濟潛力，非洲必須工業化。

en: The importance of this has been stressed repeatedly at recent international forums, including last August’s Sixth Tokyo International Conference on African Development (TICAD VI), and the G20 summit in Hangzhou, China, the following month.
zh: 這一點的重要性在最近的國際論壇中反覆強調，包括去年8月的第六屆東京非洲發展國際會議（TICAD VI）和9月的G20杭州峰會。

en: For the first time, the G20 placed industrialization in Africa – and all of the Least Developed Countries (LDCs) – on its agenda.
zh: G20第一次將非洲 — — 以及全部最不發達國家 — — 的工業化列上日程。

en: The African Union’s Agenda 2063 also supports this drive.
zh: 非盟的2063年日程也支援非洲工業化。

en: The recent UN General Assembly resolution declaring 2016-2025 the Third Industrial Development Decade for Africa is yet another push in this direction.
zh: 最新的聯合國大會決議將2016—2025年列為非洲工業發展的第三個十年，這是這一方向上的最新進展。

en: The organization that I represent, the UN Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), has been tasked with operationalizing and leading the implementation of the concomitant program, including mobilizing the needed resources.
zh: 我所代表的組織 — — 聯合國工業發展組織（UNIDO ） ， 承擔了執行和領導實施多管齊下的計劃的任務，包括動員所需要的資源。

en: All of these declarations and commitments are an important first step.
zh: 所有這些宣言和承諾都屬於重要的第一步。

en: But they will mean little unless they are translated into concrete and effective action that advances African industrialization, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive and sustainable economic growth and development.
zh: 但除非能轉化為切實有效的行動推進非洲工業化、創造就業、促進包容而可持續的經濟增長和發展，否則它們毫無意義。

en: The question is how.
zh: 問題在於如何做到。

en: The short answer is money and action.
zh: 簡單的答案是金錢和行動。

en: We must challenge the international community and development partners to back their words with real financial commitments.
zh: 我們必須敦促國際社會和發展合作伙伴兌現真金白銀的融資承諾。

en: And we must build partnerships to operationalize programs that will enable Africa to become the world’s next main engine of economic growth.
zh: 我們必須構建合作伙伴關係執行能讓非洲成為世界下一個經濟增長主要引擎的計劃。

en: Such programs must recognize and tackle the acute challenges the continent faces.
zh: 這些計劃必須承認和解決非洲所面臨的尖銳挑戰。

en: The economic growth experienced in recent decades has not been structurally driven, sustainable, or fully inclusive.
zh: 近幾十年來的經濟增長並非結構性驅動，不可持續，也不完全包容。

en: Indeed, growth rates vary widely across the continent, and not all Africans are benefiting.
zh: 事實上，非洲國家的增長率彼此大相徑庭，也並不是所有國家都在受益。

en: Though the middle class in Africa has expanded markedly in recent years, generating a consumer boom and boosting domestic investment, many people still struggle to make a living.
zh: 儘管非洲中產階級在近幾年中迅速擴大，形成了一波消費繁榮，也提振了國內投資，但許多人仍在艱難度日。

en: Unemployment rates are high, especially for young people and women – a reality that drives many Africans to head north.
zh: 失業率高企，特別是年輕人和婦女 — — 這個現實讓許多非洲人向北方遷移。

en: To keep them home, Africa’s economies must move beyond producing raw materials to build dynamic and competitive manufacturing sectors with higher value added.
zh: 要想留住這些人，非洲經濟體就不能只是生產原材料，也要構建充滿活力和競爭力的增加值更高的製造業。

en: Here, Africa must draw on the opportunities presented by participation in global and regional value chains.
zh: 在這方面，非洲必須抓住參與全球和地區價值鏈的機會。

en: New and innovative industrial-development strategies, as well as carefully tailored measures to attract foreign direct investment, must be introduced.
zh: 必須引入新的創新性工業發展戰略，以及精心設計的吸引外國直接投資的措施。

en: Of course, to develop such strategies and participate effectively in industrial value chains, Africans need knowledge.
zh: 當然，制定這些戰略和有效參與工業價值鏈需要知識。

en: Investment in education and skills training is imperative to facilitate successful and lasting industrialization.
zh: 教育和技能培訓投資是成功而持續的工業化的關進。

en: By understanding and drawing on proven innovations from around the world, Africa could leapfrog more developed countries technologically, building the capacity to produce more sophisticated, higher-value goods.
zh: 透過理解並從世界各地引進有效的創新，非洲能夠在技術上趕超更加發達的國家，構建生產更先進、價值更高的商品的能力。

en: Knowledge of other countries’ experiences will also help Africa to avoid the pitfalls of unbridled industrialization – particularly environmental damage.
zh: 瞭解其他國家的經驗也有助於非洲避免自由放任的工業化的弊端 — — 特別是環境破壞。

en: Africa must ensure that its industrial-development strategy includes effective environmental safeguards.
zh: 非洲必須確保其工業發展戰略中包括有效的環境保護措施。

en: Africa is well placed to industrialize.
zh: 非洲的處境十分有利於工業化。

en: Beyond its massive natural-resource endowments, the continent has a favorable demographic profile (its rapidly growing population means that it will soon have the world’s largest workforce) and high urbanization rates.
zh: 除了富饒的自然資源稟賦，非洲還擁有有利的人口結構（迅速增長的人口意味著它很快就能擁有世界上最龐大的勞動力大軍）和很高的城市化率。

en: It also benefits from a highly educated diaspora.
zh: 非洲也從受過良好的教育的僑民中獲益。

en: But industrialization is never automatic.
zh: 但工業化不會從天上掉下來。

en: Governments must step up to address market failures, while planning, implementing, and enforcing industrial policies that address the shortcomings of previous ineffective versions.
zh: 政府必須出手解決市場失靈，同時規劃、實施和執行解決此前低效方案的短板的產業政策。

en: They must then institutionalize these new policies in national and regional development strategies.
zh: 它們還必須將這些國家和地區發展戰略制度化。

en: To succeed, governments will need adequate capacity, competence, and legitimacy to mobilize and interact with all stakeholders, thereby creating an attractive investment climate.
zh: 要想成功，政府必須有足夠的能量、能力和合法性動員相關利益方並與之互動，從而建立有吸引力的投資氣候。

en: The necessary reforms will open the way for public-private partnerships, which can provide investment for infrastructure development and maintenance.
zh: 實施必要的改革能開啟公私合作之門，而公私合作能提供基礎設施開發和維護投資。

en: They will also facilitate cooperation with international organizations and development finance institutions, which can provide additional funds, while helping countries to upgrade their productive capacity.
zh: 政府還要為與國際組織和發展融資機構的合作提供便利，後兩者可以提供更多的資金，並幫助非洲國家升級產能。

en: A recent report, prepared for the Hangzhou G20 Summit, features a number of recommendations for Africa.
zh: G20杭州峰會的報告為非洲列出了許多建議。

en: It suggests support for agriculture and agribusiness development and linking them with other sectors, as well as measures to boost resilience to price shocks.
zh: 報告提出要為農業和農商企業發展提供支援，讓它們與其他部門形成連線，並採取措施加強對價格衝擊的恢復力。

en: Furthermore, the report emphasizes the need to deepen, broaden, and update the local knowledge base, invest in energy- and material-resource efficiency, and promote green technologies and industries.
zh: 此外，報告強調需要深化、廣化和更新地方知識儲備，投資於提高能源和原材料效率，以及促進綠色技術和產業。

en: Other recommendations relate to trade and regional integration, leveraging domestic and external finance, and promoting what it calls the “New Industrial Revolution.”
zh: 其他建議包括貿易和地區一體化、利用本地和外部資金、促進所謂的“新工業革命”等。

en: My numerous meetings with African leaders and visits to dozens of countries across the continent have convinced me that Africa is committed to industrialization.
zh: 我與非洲領導人進行過數不清的會晤，也訪問過數十個非洲國家，這些經歷使我相信，非洲有工業化的決心。

en: In fact, the process is already underway in many countries, including Ethiopia, Ghana, Rwanda, and Senegal.
zh: 事實上，工業化在許多國家已經開始了，包括衣索比亞、迦納、盧安達、塞內加爾等。

en: By offering our commitment and support, we can enable these countries to realize inclusive and sustainable development for the benefit of everyone.
zh: 透過提供我們的承諾和支援，我們能讓這些國家實現包容和可持續的發展，讓所有人都從中獲益。

en: A Roadmap for African Industrialization
zh: 非洲工業化路線圖

en: ABIDJAN – Africa is at a crossroads.
zh: 阿比讓—非洲正站在十字路口。

en: Six of the world’s ten fastest-growing economies are now located in the region, and the continent’s GDP is expected to grow at a rate of 4.1% this year, up from 3.6% in 2017.
zh: 今天，世界十個增長最快的經濟體有六個在非洲，今年非洲GDP 增長預計將達4.1 % ， 而2017年為3.6 % 。

en: Yet Africa’s economic growth has not been accompanied by a commensurate level of job creation, which has particularly negative implications for women and young people.
zh: 但非洲經濟增長並未帶來相稱的就業創造，這對婦女和年輕人的影響尤為消極。

en: In fact, today’s jobless growth could even reverse the gains made in eradicating poverty in recent years.
zh: 事實上，今天的無就業增長甚至可能抹殺近幾年來所取得的減貧進展。

en: The problem is that Africa’s growth, while impressive, has been volatile, because it has been driven mainly by high commodity prices, rather than by manufacturing.
zh: 問題在於，非洲的增長雖然耀眼，但很不穩定，因為其主要系受到大宗商品價格高企而非製造業驅動。

en: The economic effects of this imbalance should not be underestimated.
zh: 這一失衡的經濟影響不可低估。

en: Among other things, it explains why a region that produces about 75% of the world’s cocoa accounts for just 5% of the nearly $100 billion annual chocolate market.
zh: 它和其他因素一起導致了非洲產出全世界75%的可可，卻只佔近每年價值1,000億美元的巧克力市場的5 % 。

en: Despite its vast natural resources, Africa will remain at the mercy of commodity prices and trade flows until it undertakes a profound structural transformation.
zh: 儘管擁有大量自然資源，非洲仍然需要靠大宗商品價格和貿易流吃飯，除非它實現深層次結構轉換。

en: The time has come for Africa to unlock its true economic potential by following in the footsteps of every modern economy and undertaking the transition from agriculture to manufacturing.
zh: 非洲應該儘快循著所有現代經濟體的軌跡，完成從農業到製造業的轉型，釋放其真正的經濟潛力。

en: Africa’s manufacturing sector is the weakest link in its ongoing integration into the global economy.
zh: 在非洲融入全球經濟的過程中，製造業是最弱的一環。

en: Today, primary products (raw materials) comprise 62% of Africa’s total exports, the highest share in the world.
zh: 今天，初級商品（原材料）佔了非洲總出口額的62 % ， 這一比例為全球最高。

en: At the same time, manufactured exports per capita in 2014 totaled just $218, which is among the lowest levels in the world, and far below other developing regions such as Asia ($883) and Latin America ($1,099).
zh: 與此同時，2014年人均製造業出口總量只有128美元，位居世界最低行列，遠低於亞洲（883美元）和拉丁美洲（1,099美元）等其他發展中地區。

en: Clearly, Africa must start catching up.
zh: 顯然，非洲必須開始趕超。

en: Fortunately, there is already a global consensus that industrialization matters, and that it is in everyone’s interest for Africa to become the global manufacturing power it ought to be.
zh: 幸運的是，全球化很重要已是全球共識，而讓非洲成為其應該成為的全球製造力量符合所有人的利益。

en: With its “High 5 Agenda,” the African Development Bank (AfDB) has made industrialization a top priority.
zh: 非洲開發銀行（AfDB）提出了“五項重點日程 ” ， 將工業化列為最重要的工作。

en: Likewise, industrialization is a key component of the African Union’s “Agenda 2063.”
zh: 類似地，工業化也是非盟“2063日程”的重要組成部分。

en: And, in 2016, the United Nations General Assembly declared 2016-2025 the “Third Industrial Development Decade for Africa.”
zh: 2016年，聯合國大會宣佈2016—2025年為“非洲工業發展的第三個十年 ” 。

en: But such pronouncements are meaningless in the absence of concrete action.
zh: 但如果不拿出切實行動，這些宣告都毫無意義。

en: To change the region’s economic trajectory, African policymakers must focus on three key areas: industrial policies, infrastructure financing, and leadership.
zh: 要改變非洲的經濟軌跡，非洲決策者必須聚焦於三個關鍵領域：產業政策，製造業融資，以及領導力。

en: We now know that industrial policies can be effective in boosting growth.
zh: 我們現在知道，產業政策對於刺激增長十分有效。

en: The question is whether states possess the capacity to implement the policies they design.
zh: 問題在於國家是否具備實施它們制定的政策的能力。

en: If they do, they can channel resources toward industry and marshal available technologies to create synergy between the agriculture and manufacturing sectors.
zh: 如果具備，它們可以引導資源流向工業，利用可以利用的技術實現農業和製造業的協同。

en: A number of African countries have already moved in this direction.
zh: 不少非洲國家已經開始朝這一方向努力。

en: Ethiopia, for example, has created special economic zones, where it has lowered production costs by investing in infrastructure.
zh: 比如，衣索比亞成立了特別經濟區，透過基礎設施投資降低生產成本。

en: As a result, the country has emerged as Africa’s largest hub for textile manufacturing, attracting major players like H&M and Primark.
zh: 結果，衣索比亞成為非洲最大的紡織品製造中心，吸引了H&M和普利馬克（Primark）等服裝大牌。

en: Similarly, Rwanda’s Kigali Special Economic Zone, which exempts firms from taxes for ten years, has attracted a $20 million investment from Volkswagen for a new vehicle-assembly plant.
zh: 類似對，盧安達的基加利特別經濟區（Kigali Special Economic Zone）擁有十年免稅權，吸引大眾汽車公司投資2,000萬美元建立了新的汽車組裝廠。

en: But industrialization cannot happen without power, roads, and railways, which is why infrastructure must be a key focus.
zh: 但工業化不可能在沒有電力、公路和鐵路的情況下憑空出現，因此，基礎設施也必須是關鍵。

en: As of now, the AfDB pegs Africa’s infrastructure gap at $130–170 billion per year.
zh: 目前，AfDB認為非洲基礎設施缺口在每年1,300—1,700億美元。

en: Closing it will require not just more financing, but also more innovative thinking, particularly concerning joint public-private efforts.
zh: 填補這一缺口不僅需要更多的融資，也需要創新思維，特別是公私合作方面的創新思維。

en: To that end, the AfDB has expanded its portfolio for financing new infrastructure projects in several countries.
zh: 在這方面，AfDB擴大了多國新基礎設施專案的貸款。

en: As part of our “New Deal on Energy for Africa,” we have scaled up investment in renewable energy and put $265 million toward developing two solar-power plants in Morocco.
zh: 作為我們的“非洲能源新政”的一部分，我們增加了在可再生能源方面的投資，並拿出2.65億美元用於開發墨西哥的兩座太陽能電廠。

en: In Côte d’Ivoire, where demand for energy is surging by 8-9% annually, we are investing $60 million to bring a new 44-megawatt hydropower plant onstream.
zh: 在象牙海岸，能源需求以每年8—9%的速度飆升，我們投資了6,000萬美元在上游建立了一座新的44百萬瓦的水電站。

en: African countries should make such investments now to reap the demographic dividend of the continent’s population bulge in the years ahead.
zh: 非洲國家應該多做這樣的投資，從而在未來多年內實現非洲人口膨脹所帶來的人口紅利。
