en: The Big Bond approach represents a much-needed update to the ODA framework – one that supports higher and more sustainable growth in recipient countries, while lowering the burden on donor countries.
zh: 大債券方針是代表著ODA框架所急需的一個升級方向 — — 它能支援受資國更高、更可持續的增長，同時減輕出資國的負擔。

en: At a time when aid is under political pressure, perhaps such a bold approach to maximizing the efficiency of donor resources is exactly what the world needs.
zh: 如今，援助飽受政治壓力，或許這一大膽的最大化援助資源效率的方針正是全世界所需要的。

en: Accelerating Africa’s Energy Transition
zh: 加快非洲能源轉型

en: PARIS – For much of Africa, the transition from fossil fuels to cleaner forms of energy is seen as an environmental imperative.
zh: 巴黎—在非洲大部，從化石燃料向更清潔的能源形式的轉型被視為一項環境當務之急。

en: With fossil fuels comprising a majority – as high as 70% in some cases – of the energy mix, the situation on the continent is indeed ecologically dire.
zh: 化石燃料在一些地區佔能源構成的大多數 — — 高達70 % — —非洲的形勢確實非常不利於生態。

en: But Africa’s energy transition is economically urgent as well.
zh: 但從經濟上說，非洲也迫切需要能源轉型。

en: Each year, oil subsidies consume 1.5% of the continent’s GDP – roughly $50 billion.
zh: 非洲每年的石油補貼高達500億美元左右，相當於全洲GDP的1.5 % 。

en: That is enough money to provide solar power to some 300 million people.
zh: 這筆錢足以為3億人提供太陽能。

en: If the continent could rebalance its energy portfolio, moving away from hydrocarbons slowly, those subsidies could be reallocated in ways that would yield both environmental and economic benefits.
zh: 如果非洲能夠實現能源組合再平衡，逐漸擺脫碳氫化合物，那麼這些補貼就能轉作其他用途，產生環境和經濟效益。

en: Today, neither oil exporters nor importers are adequately insulated from price shocks.
zh: 如今，石油出口國和進口國都無法避免受到價格衝擊的影響。

en: When oil prices declined rapidly in 2015, for example, Africa’s energy importers spent less on oil, while exporting countries suffered financially.
zh: 2015年，比如，石油價格迅速下跌，非洲能源進口國的石油支出有所下降，而出口國則蒙受經濟損失。

en: When prices rebounded, the relationship switched: energy-exporting countries’ revenues inched up, while importing countries struggled to maintain consumption levels.
zh: 當結果反彈時，關係正好相反，能源出口國收入增加，而進口國難以維持消費水平。

en: This is a needless cycle.
zh: 這是一個毫無必要的迴圈。

en: Integrating cleaner power into national energy systems would not only raise local capacities; it would also free up hydrocarbons for export.
zh: 將更清潔的電力納入國家能源體系不但能夠提高地方產能；還能釋放更多碳氫化合物用於出口。

en: The resulting revenue could then be invested into new forms of greener power.
zh: 由此獲得的收入可以投資於新型綠色電力。

en: Such a transition, which would require cooperation with the oil sector, promises to boost socioeconomic progress.
zh: 這一轉型需要石油部門的合作，有望對社會經濟進步起到刺激作用。

en: Among the biggest benefits would be the electrification of areas that, under current distribution systems, are literally in the dark.
zh: 收益最大的某些地區的電氣化。 在這些地區，以目前的配電系統，可以說是還生活在黑暗時代。

en: Today, just 30% of Africa has access to reliable electricity.
zh: 如今只有30%的非洲地區能夠獲得可靠電力。

en: But, with a total capacity estimated at around ten terawatts, installed solar capacity in Africa could broaden access dramatically.
zh: 但非洲建成太陽能裝機容量據估計達到了十萬億瓦，可以大大擴大電力的普及。

en: In fact, according to some estimates, the increase in solar generation by 2030 could range from 15 to 62 gigawatts.
zh: 事實上，據某些估算，到2030年，太陽能發電量可以提高15到62十億瓦。

en: Fossil fuels are not destined to be phased out anytime soon, but an energy mix that included a significant increase in solar power would have major economic advantages for Africa, especially in areas where agriculture is the largest economic sector.
zh: 化石燃料無法在短時間內退出，但如果能源組合中的太陽能比重能夠顯著提高，將給非洲帶來的巨大的經濟優勢，特別是在農業是最重要的經濟部門的地區。

en: Electrifying agricultural areas would facilitate the storage and transportation of farmed products, improve food security, and increase farmers’ earning capacity.
zh: 電氣化農業區能夠便利農作物的儲存和 運輸，改善糧食安全，提高農民的收入能力。

en: In the drive to rebalance Africa’s energy mix, the continent maintains one crucial advantage over developed economies: a clean slate.
zh: 在實現能源組合的再平衡的過程中，非洲擁有一個相對於發達經濟體的重要優勢：非洲是一塊白板。

en: The relative absence of legacy investments is the principal reason why green power is Africa’s best energy option.
zh: 歷史包袱相對較小是使綠色電力成為非洲最佳能源選擇的主要原因。

en: Although every country must balance its own energy needs, reliance on renewable sources, and solar power in particular, is the most cost-efficient strategy for fostering rapid economic development throughout the continent.
zh: 儘管每個國家都必須平衡自身的能源需求，但依靠可再生資源（特別是太陽能 ） ， 對於促進全非洲快速經濟發展來說是價效比最高的策略。

en: Evidence of this potential can be found in the few photovoltaic power plants that have begun operating in Africa.
zh: 這一潛力有多大？ 從非洲已經開始執行的少數光伏發電廠可見一斑。

en: For example, the Senergy 2 solar plant in Senegal sells electricity to the Senegalese power utility at a price that lowers the cost of the energy mix by 50%.
zh: 比如，塞內加爾的Senergy 2太陽能電站向塞內加爾電網出售的電價能讓能源總成本下降50 % 。

en: Similar solar solutions are being implemented by African telecoms to electrify communication towers.
zh: 類似的太陽能方案也被非洲電信公司用於給通訊塔供電。

en: The best way to accelerate the transition from hydrocarbons to greener forms of energy would be to redirect a portion of national oil subsidies to renewables.
zh: 加快從碳氫化合物到綠色能源的轉型的最佳辦法是將一部分國家石油補貼用於可再生能源。

en: This would create stronger incentives to reduce fossil-fuel consumption, while encouraging investment and growth in green-energy output.
zh: 這將帶來更強的激勵去降低化石燃料消費，同時鼓勵綠色能源產出的投資和增長。

en: For Africa’s rural regions, moreover, such policies would help bring communities out of darkness and lead to the installation of other critical infrastructure that economic growth requires.
zh: 此外，對非洲農村地區來說，這類政策還有助於讓社群擺脫黑暗，建造其他經濟增長所需要的重要基礎設施。

en: But while renewables hold the key to Africa’s long-term prosperity, the continent’s transition to cleaner power should not lead to an immediate, full-scale repudiation of hydrocarbons.
zh: 但儘管可再生能源是非洲長期繁榮的關鍵，非洲向清潔電力的轉型也不應該立刻一刀切地否定碳氫化合物。

en: The oil sector will still have an important role to play.
zh: 石油部門仍將扮演重要的角色。

en: The industry’s experience on the continent will be needed to navigate the energy transformation.
zh: 非洲需要石油業的經驗來完成能源轉型。

en: And, because fossil fuels will remain part of the continent’s energy mix, the oil sector must be encouraged to clean up its own act.
zh: 而由於化石燃料仍然是非洲能源組合的一部分，因此也必須鼓勵石油業向清潔化方向發展。

en: This may sound like an impossible alliance.
zh: 這聽上去像是一個不可能的聯盟。

en: But as policymakers across the continent seek to secure adequate supplies of clean energy to ensure rapid, inclusive economic growth and environmental sustainability, they are likely to find that there is no alternative.
zh: 但在全非洲的決策者尋找確保清潔能源的充足供給，以保證高速、包容的經濟增長和環境可持續性之際，他們也許會發現除此之外別無選擇。

en: Cooperation between old and new energy industries may be the only engine that is capable of powering Africa forward.
zh: 新舊能源業的合作可能是能夠推動非洲向前的唯一引擎。

en: Africa’s Vaccination Test
zh: 非洲的疫苗考驗

en: BOSTON – In February in Addis Ababa, African health ministers signed a widely celebrated declaration of their commitment to keeping immunization at the forefront of efforts to save the continent’s children from death and disease.
zh: 波士頓—在2月的亞的斯亞貝巴，非洲各國衛生部長簽署了一份廣受歡迎的宣言，承諾將免疫作為拯救非洲兒童免遭死亡和疾病的措施的核心。

en: Fulfilling that commitment will be no easy feat.
zh: 兌現這一承諾絕不容易。

en: Immunization is not just a health issue; it is also an economic challenge.
zh: 免疫不僅是一個衛生問題，也是一個經濟挑戰。

en: The case for vaccination is strong.
zh: 支援疫苗的理由很充分。

en: Globally, an estimated 2-3 million child deaths and 600,000 adult deaths are prevented annually through immunization.
zh: 全球而言，每年有約200-300萬兒童死亡和60萬成人死亡透過免疫得以預防。

en: Moreover, immunization is considered one of the most cost-effective public-health interventions for reducing child morbidity, mortality, and disability.
zh: 此外，免疫被認為是價效比最高的降低兒童患病、死亡和殘疾的公共衛生干預措施。

en: A recent study estimates that every dollar spent on vaccination will save $16 in costs of illnesses averted.
zh: 一項最新研究估算，花在疫苗上的每一美元可以節約16美元的疾病預防成本。

en: Accounting for the value individuals place on longer and healthier lives, net returns on investments in immunization soar to some 44 times the cost.
zh: 考慮到個人對更長的壽命和更健康的生活的重視，免疫投資的淨回報高達成本的44倍。

en: And net returns exceed costs for all vaccines.
zh: 並且淨回報超過所有疫苗的成本。

en: Significant progress has been made.
zh: 我們已經取得了長足進步。

en: In 2014, 86% of children were immunized against diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis, compared to less than 5% in 1974.
zh: 2014年，86%的兒童接受了白喉，破傷風，百日咳免疫，而1974年還不到5 % 。

en: And there have been extraordinary advances in the number and kinds of vaccines that are available.
zh: 在可用疫苗的數量和種類方面也取得了重大突破。

en: Yet, worldwide, an estimated 18.7 million infants are not being reached by routine immunization services.
zh: 但是，全球而言，仍有約1,870萬嬰兒不能獲得常規免疫。

en: The problem, of course, is access.
zh: 當然，問題在於普及。

en: Detailed analysis of immunization reveals significant disparities within and across countries.
zh: 非洲各國的詳細免疫分析表明，各國國內和各國之間存在巨大差異。

en: More than 60% of the non-immunized infants live in just ten countries: the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iraq, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Uganda, and South Africa.
zh: 超過60%的未免疫嬰兒生活在十個國家：民主剛果（DRC ） 、 衣索比亞、印度、印度尼西亞、伊拉克、奈及利亞、巴基斯坦、菲律賓、烏干達和南非。

en: Routine immunization coverage remains particularly low in Africa; indeed, it has stagnated over the last three years, against a backdrop of weak and under-resourced health systems.
zh: 非洲常規免疫覆蓋率仍然非常低；事實上，該覆蓋率在過去三年保持停滯，原因是衛生體系薄弱、資源不足。

en: As a result, one in five African children still do not receive lifesaving vaccination.
zh: 結果，非洲五分之一的兒童仍得不到救命的疫苗。

en: In 2014, an estimated 42% of all global deaths from measles were in Africa.
zh: 2014年，大約42%的全球麻疹致死病例發生在非洲。

en: Most of Africa’s under-immunized children live in Nigeria, Ethiopia, the DRC, South Sudan, and Guinea.
zh: 大部分免疫不足的非洲兒童生活在奈及利亞、衣索比亞、民主剛果、南非、衣索比亞和幾內亞。

en: Poor people, those living in rural areas, and families with lower education levels comprise the majority of those who are not reached.
zh: 窮人、農村人口和教育層次較低家庭佔未得到免疫覆蓋兒童的大部分。

en: Clearly, money is a leading factor shaping immunization outcomes.
zh: 顯然，錢是決定免疫結果的首要因素。

en: Beyond inadequately financed health systems, which remain weak and inefficient, especially in rural areas, African countries face challenges in affording new, more expensive vaccines.
zh: 除了資金不足、依然薄弱和低效的衛生體系（特別是在農村地區 ） ， 非洲國家還面臨無力承擔更加昂貴的新疫苗的挑戰。

en: New vaccines should be enabling us to save more lives.
zh: 新疫苗應該讓我們得以拯救更多宣告。

en: Yet Médecins Sans Frontières estimates that the introduction of new vaccines made it 68 times more expensive to vaccinate a child in 2014 than in 2001 in most African countries.
zh: 但無國界醫生組織估計，引入新疫苗導致大部分非洲國家2014年接種一名兒童的成本比2001年增加了68倍。

en: Another study showed that in 2001, the total cost of the original set of six World Health Organization-recommended vaccines was less than one dollar.
zh: 另一項研究表明，2001年世界衛生組織最初推薦的六種疫苗總成本不到一美元。

en: In 2014, the number of WHO-recommended vaccines had risen to 11 – and the cost had reached about $21 for boys and $35 for girls.
zh: 2014年，世衛組織推薦的疫苗種類增加到11種 — — 成本也高達男孩約21美元，女孩約35美元。

en: The added costs of delivery, currently estimated at about $25 per child, bring the total cost of fully immunizing a child today to $50-60.
zh: 如今，打疫苗的新增成本 — — 目前大約為每名兒童25美元 — — 讓一名兒童獲得充分免疫的總成本達到了50—60美元。

en: That same study found that, in many low- and middle-income countries, immunization budgets are currently insufficient to sustain vaccination programs, much less incorporate the new costlier vaccines.
zh: 同一項研究表明，在許多中低收入國家，目前的免疫預算不足以維持疫苗專案，更不用說納入新的昂貴疫苗了。

en: As several health ministers pointed out in Addis Ababa, high vaccine prices force poor countries’ governments to make tough choices about which deadly diseases they can afford to prevent.
zh: 一些國家的衛生部長在亞的斯亞貝巴指出，高昂的疫苗價格迫使窮國政府需要作出承擔預防哪些致命疾病的成本的艱難選擇。

en: For some countries, the situation is about to get worse, as Gavi, the international group which has helped to finance the dramatic global expansion of new vaccines, phases out support for countries deemed to have “graduated” from assistance.
zh: 對一些國家來說，情況可能進一步惡化。 幫助融資支援新疫苗的大幅全球擴張的國際組織Gavi對於其認為已從援助“畢業”的國家逐漸收回支援。

en: Without eligibility for the lower prices obtained by Gavi, many of these countries may not be able to afford newer vaccines.
zh: 許多失去了獲得Gavi的低價的國家可能無法承擔更新的疫苗。

en: In order to cope with this challenge, African political leaders have committed to invest in the continent’s capacity to develop and produce its own vaccines.
zh: 為了應對這一挑戰，非洲政治領導人已承諾投資建設非洲開發和生產自己的疫苗的能力。

en: But this is a long-term strategy that will require coordinated regional investment planning, market development, and stronger regulatory capabilities.
zh: 單這一長期戰略需要互相協調的地區投資規劃、市場開發和更強的監管能力。

en: In the short to medium term, African countries would do well to look into the power of collective bargaining to strike better deals for needed vaccines.
zh: 在短期和中期，非洲國家最好著眼於集體討價還價力量，為需要的疫苗爭取更好的合同。

en: While Africa can and should do more to improve vaccination, the global community also has a responsibility to make a concerted effort to bring down vaccine costs.
zh: 非洲可以也應該為改善疫苗做出更多，單全球社會也有責任共同努力降低疫苗成本。

en: The recently announced reduction in the price of pneumococcal vaccine is a step in the right direction, but it is not enough.
zh: 最新宣佈的降低肺炎球菌疫苗價格的決定是邁向正確方向的一步，但仍不足夠。

en: Without collective action, equitable and sustained access to immunization in Africa will remain a major problem – and children’s lives will continue to be lost.
zh: 如果不採取集體行動，平等且持續地為非洲提供免疫仍將是一個重大問題 — — 兒童的生命也將繼續流失。

en: Africa’s Avoidable AIDS Crisis
zh: 可以避免的非洲艾滋病危機

en: NEW YORK – At Uganda’s largest AIDS clinic, I recently witnessed a remarkable celebration of life. The performers were a troupe of young African singers, drummers and dancers, ranging in age from roughly eight to 28.
zh: 紐約 — —

en: “This is a land,” they sang,
zh: 最近，我在烏干達最大的艾滋病醫院目睹了一場盛大的生命禮讚。 表演者是一群非洲年輕人，有歌手、鼓手和舞者，年齡從8歲至28歲不等。

en: “Where beautiful people
zh: “這片土地上生活著美麗的人民 ， ” 他們唱道，

en: Laugh and dance in harmony.
zh: “他們微笑，他們舞蹈，一切是那麼和諧。

en: Africa.
zh: “非洲。

en: O Africa.”
zh: 哦，非洲。 ”

en: And, indeed, these young people laughed and danced not only in harmony but with a joie de vivre that lit up their faces and filled us all with happiness.
zh: 而事實上，這些年輕人的笑容和舞蹈不僅和諧，而且帶有一種生存之樂，使他們臉上放出光彩，也使我們所有人充滿歡樂。

en: Listening, it was hard to imagine that they could easily be dead – and would be, if not for this clinic.
zh: 聽吧，很難想象死亡離他們近在咫尺 — — 而如果沒有這座醫院的話，他們也許早已離開人世了。

en: Each of those splendid performers is living with HIV.
zh: 這些出色的表演者都是艾滋病病毒（HIV）攜帶者。

en: Some arrived at the clinic so ill that they could scarcely walk.
zh: 其中一些人來到這家醫院的時候已經病得無法走路了。

en: Others showed few symptoms but, having tested positive, came to be treated.
zh: 其他人來的時候雖然沒有什麼症狀，但檢查均呈陽性。

en: They were mothers and fathers, sisters and brothers, children and grandparents.
zh: 他們中有的是父母親，有的是兄弟姐妹，有的是祖孫。

en: All were alive and healthy for one reason only: the Joint Clinical Research Center in Kampala, and the drugs that it provides them.
zh: 他們能夠活下來，完全是因為位於坎帕拉的這家聯合臨床研究中心及其提供的藥物。

en: Uganda was the epicenter of the AIDS epidemic. There the scourge began in earnest; there (as elsewhere in Africa) it exacts its highest toll.
zh: 烏干達是艾滋病流行的中心地帶，是艾滋病最先爆發的地方，也是（和非洲其他地區一樣）艾滋病發病率最高的地方。

en: Yet Uganda is also a success story.
zh: 但烏干達在防治艾滋病方面做的很好。

en: A decade ago, fewer than 10,000 people were taking the new generation of antiretroviral drugs that suppress the disease and offer the promise of a normal life.
zh: 十年前，只有不到10 000人能夠獲得新一代艾滋病特效藥抗逆轉錄酶病毒藥物從而轉危為安。

en: Today, that figure is 200,000, thanks in large measure to generous support from the United States (under its PEPFAR program) and the Global Fund in Geneva.
zh: 今天，這一數字達到了200 000，這離不開美國（透過其PEPFAR專案）和日內瓦全球基金的慷慨支援。

en: We have seen similarly encouraging progress elsewhere.
zh: 其他地方也能看見類似的可喜進展。

en: Botswana, among others, has invested heavily to offer universal treatment, and now is well on its way to ensuring that no baby is born with HIV – a reality in developed countries, but not so in Africa, where 400,000 children are born with the disease each year.
zh: 其中，波札那投入重金建立了全民醫療，正在朝著消滅艾滋病嬰兒的目標大踏步前進 — — 在發達國家，這一目標早已實現，但在非洲，每年仍有400 000嬰兒生來就帶有艾滋病。

en: South Africa, with the largest number of people living with HIV, has spent nearly $1 billion over the past year in an ambitious counseling and testing campaign to roll back the epidemic.
zh: HIV攜帶人口數量最多的南非去年花費了近10億美元用於艾滋病諮詢和檢查專案，以此來對其進行控制。

en: But there is a new and growing danger that these advances might not be sustained.
zh: 但一個新的威脅已經出現並在日益嚴重，使得這些進步有可能無法持續。

en: Peter Mugyenyi, who runs the Joint Clinical Research Center, told me that part of the problem is the sheer weight of numbers.
zh: 聯合臨床研究中心主任彼得·莫緣依（Peter Mugyenyi）告訴我，問題的一部分是數字的分量太輕。

en: In Uganda, only about half of those with HIV/AIDS are being treated.
zh: 在烏干達，只有一半的艾滋病患者/HIV攜帶者獲得了醫治。

en: Meanwhile, money for treatment is drying up.
zh: 同時，醫療資金正在枯竭。

en: Because of the global recession, some international donors are threatening to cap their financial support.
zh: 由於全球衰退，一些國際贊助者警告將對財務支援進行限制。

en: Countries such as Malawi, Zimbabwe, and Kenya, as well as Uganda, are requesting assistance for emergency drug supplies.
zh: 馬拉維、辛巴威、肯亞和烏干達等國家正在要求緊急藥物供給援助。

en: In Kampala, Dr. Mugyenyi has begun placing new patients on a waiting list.
zh: 在坎帕拉，莫緣依醫生已經開始將新的求醫者納入候診名單中。

en: As many as seven million Africans who should be getting treatment for HIV are not.
zh: 多達700萬本應獲得HIV治療的非洲人沒能獲得治療。

en: Worldwide, the number is about 10 million.
zh: 而全球高達1 000萬人。

en: Compounding the problem: donors have also been shifting their focus from AIDS to other diseases, because there is a sense that more lives can be saved more cheaply.
zh: 雪上加霜的是，贊助者現在開始轉向其他疾病，因為他們感覺這樣可以用更少的錢救更多的人。

en: At a time when we should be scaling up to meet the AIDS challenge, we are dialing back.
zh: 眼下正是一鼓作氣擊敗艾滋病的時候，我們卻自己打了退堂鼓。

en: In our global war on AIDS, the international community is on the verge of snatching defeat from the jaws of victory.
zh: 在對艾滋病的鬥爭中，國際社會正在將唾手可得的勝利拱手讓出。

en: Those who rallied to the fight are alarmed. They fear that the impressive gains of the last decade will be lost.
zh: 這使得仍在戰鬥的鬥士感到十分不安，擔憂過去十年來取得的驕人戰績將付之東流。

en: “We are sitting on a time bomb,” Dr. Mugyenyi told me.
zh: “我們正坐在定時炸彈上 ， ” 莫緣依醫生告訴我。

en: Every day, he is forced into moral choices that no one should have to make.
zh: 每天，他都面臨著本可避免的良心選擇。

en: How do you choose to treat a young girl but not her little brother?
zh: 你怎麼忍心治療一個小女孩而放棄她的弟弟？

en: How do you turn away a pregnant mother, sitting with her children, crying for help?
zh: 怎麼忍心放棄和孩子坐在一起、乞求幫助的懷孕母親？

en: Surely we can do better.
zh: 毫無疑問，我們可以做得更多。

en: In Kampala, I promised my young friends that I would do everything I could to help.
zh: 在坎帕拉，我向我的年輕朋友們承諾將盡我所能提供幫助。

en: In Washington recently, the United Nations rolled out an action plan that should dramatically accelerate progress on maternal and child health, including HIV.
zh: 最近，聯合國在華盛頓推出了一項旨在大幅加強母嬰健康的行動計劃， 其中就包括了艾滋病防治。

en: At the International AIDS Conference in Vienna, in July, I hope that the international community will rally around UNAIDS’ launch of Treatment 2.0 — the next generation of HIV treatment, which must be more affordable, more effective, and accessible to all.
zh: 7月份在維也納舉行的國際艾滋病大會上，我希望國際社會能夠支援聯合國艾滋病規劃署（UNAIDS）的新一代HIV治療計劃 — — Treatment 2.0。 這一計劃價格更低、效率更高，而且可以覆蓋每一個人。

en: As chair of this year’s replenishment of the Global Fund, I urge all donors to see to it that countries such as Uganda get the support they need, so that Dr. Mugyenyi and other front-line soldiers in the fight against AIDS need not make those difficult choices.
zh: 作為今年全球基金峰會的主席，我敦促所有贊助人都能著眼於讓烏干達這樣的國家獲得所需的支援，著眼於讓莫緣依醫生及其他艾滋病戰爭的一線鬥士不再需要做出艱難抉擇。

en: I left Uganda with a snatch of song that still echoes within my heart.
zh: 在我離開烏干達的時候，那些歌聲仍然在我心頭縈繞。

en: Its inherent truth would be obvious, had you been there to see:
zh: 歌聲所表達的感情如此強烈，只要你到了那裡，一定可以感受到：

en: We are still useful.
zh: 我們仍是有用之材，

en: To our countries, to our families.
zh: 能為國家和家庭做出貢獻。

en: All we need is a way to live our days,
zh: 我們需要活下去，

en: All we need is to survive in Africa.
zh: 在非洲活下去。

en: Yes, times are hard.
zh: 是的，世事艱難。

en: That is all the more reason to act out of compassion and with generosity.
zh: 因此我們更加需要放開胸懷，不吝同情。

en: Africa’s Diaspora to the Rescue
zh: 非洲海外移民拯救非洲

en: DAKAR – There is something dismally familiar about the tide of news reports concerning Africa’s increased suffering – more poverty, malnutrition, civil strife, and death – in the face of the recent global financial crisis.
zh: 達喀爾 — — 關於此次全球金融危機下的非洲充斥著連篇累牘的熟悉而又令人痛心的報導。 非洲人民所受的苦難越來越深重 — — 貧困、營養不良、內亂和死亡的境況愈來愈嚴酷。

en: Almost everywhere, the media translates academic conclusions into graphic illustrations of brutality and despair in places such as Guinea and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
zh: 幾乎在每一個地方，媒體都在用幾內亞和剛果民主共和國等地充滿殘暴和絕望氣息的生動故事對這個學術結論進行著詮釋。

en: But there is another, woefully under-reported, side to the story.
zh: 但這個故事還有另外一個側面，而媒體對這個側面的報導卻嚴重不足。

en: African countries that were locked out of international capital markets for most of the past five decades have largely been spared the twin woes of financial turmoil and economic downturn.
zh: 過去50年來一直被封鎖在國際資本市場外的非洲在很大程度上避開了金融動盪和經濟衰退的雙重困境。

en: The continent’s economies experienced a slowdown, but not a recession.
zh: 非洲大陸的經濟增長有所放緩，但卻並沒有陷入大規模的經濟衰退。

en: Indeed, according to McKinsey & Company, Africa was the third-largest contributor to world economic growth in 2009, after China and India.
zh: 事實上，根據麥肯錫公司的統計，非洲是2009年世界經濟增長的第三大貢獻者，非洲的貢獻僅次於中國和印度。

en: Moreover, several African countries have received ratings from credit agencies, which has opened up global financial centers to them.
zh: 此外，有幾個非洲國家已經得到信用機構評級，這意味著信用機構的全球金融中心已經對這幾個非洲國家開放。

en: In some cases, these ratings have proved equivalent to or higher than those of countries such as Turkey or Argentina.
zh: 在某些情況下，非洲國家的評級已經超過了土耳其或阿根廷，或者至少也與之相當。

en: Stock exchanges are being established across the continent.
zh: 非洲大陸到處都建立了證券交易所。

en: Furthermore, countries such as China, India, and Brazil has provided a platform for increased exports and the inception of a model of cooperation based on trade, investment, and technology transfer, rather than “aid.”
zh: 此外，中國、印度和巴西等國已經建立了平臺用於擴大出口，並開創了並非基於“援助 ” 、 而是基於貿易、投資和技術轉讓的合作模式。

en: China-Africa trade alone increased from $10 billion in 2000 to $107 billion in 2008, and billions of dollars are being invested in oil production, mining, transportation, electricity generation and transmission, telecommunications, and other infrastructure.
zh: 僅中非貿易額就從2000年的100億美元增長到2008年的1070億美元，此外還有數十億美元投向石油開採、採礦、交通運輸、發電、電力傳輸、無線通訊和其他基礎設施建設。

en: These developments have combined to improve African countries’ macroeconomic performance dramatically.
zh: 這些成就共同改善了非洲國家的宏觀經濟狀況。

en: Inflation has been halved since the 1990’s, and foreign-exchange reserves have increased 30%.
zh: 20世紀90年代通脹降低了一半，而外匯儲備則呈現30%的增長。

en: Public finances showed a 2.8%-of-GDP surplus in 2008, compared to a 1.4%-of-GDP deficit in 2000-2005.
zh: 公共財政在2008年出現了佔GDP2.8%的盈餘，2000－2005年公共財政赤字在GDP中的佔比曾為1.4 % 。

en: Savings rates are between 10% and 20%, and external debt has decreased from 110% of GDP in 2005 to 21% in 2008.
zh: 儲蓄率徘徊在10－20%之間，而外債則從2005年佔GDP的110%下降到2008年佔GDP的21 % 。

en: Since 2000, sub-Saharan African countries have achieved economic growth of 5-7%.
zh: 從2000年以來，撒哈拉南部非洲國家已經實現了5-7%的經濟增長。

en: Many factors have contributed to this upturn.
zh: 多重因素共同促成了這次經濟回暖的現狀。

en: Emerging-market demand has pushed up commodity prices.
zh: 新興市場需求推高了商品價格。

en: Urbanization has given rise to a dynamic informal sector.
zh: 城市化造就了一個活躍的非正規部門。

en: Improved governance, higher food production, increased inter-regional trade, debt cancellation, better use of official development assistance (ODA), and thriving telecommunications and housing markets have helped as well.
zh: 施政改善、擴大糧食產量、區域內貿易增長、債務取消、更合理利用官方發展援助（ODA）和蓬勃發展的電信和住房市場也有助於實現經濟增長。

en: But transfers from the African diaspora stand out as the most significant contributing factor.
zh: 但經濟恢復最重要的貢獻因素是世界各地非洲人的匯款。

en: A study commissioned by the Rome-based International Fund for Agricultural Development indicates that more than 30 million individuals living outside their countries of origin contribute more than $40 billion annually in remittances to their families and communities back home.
zh: 一項由總部設在羅馬的國際農業發展基金會發起的研究顯示生活在原籍以外的3000多萬非洲人每年為國內的家人和社團貢獻超過400億美元的匯款。

en: For sub-Saharan African countries, remittances increased from $3.1 billion in 1995 to $18.5 billion in 2007, according to the World Bank, representing between 9% and 24% of GDP and 80-750% of ODA.
zh: 根據世界銀行的統計，撒哈拉以南非洲國家的匯款數額從1995年的31億美元增長到2007年的185億美元，這一數字的GDP佔比在9%到24%之間，官方發展援助佔比則為80－750 % 。

en: Migrants’ remittance behavior is essentially dictated by the regulatory environment and the quality – in terms of speed, cost, security, and accessibility – of products and services offered by banks, money-transfer companies, micro-finance institutions, and informal operators.
zh: 整體監管環境以及銀行、匯款公司、小額信貸機構和非���規經營機構的產品和服務質量（包括速度、成本、安全性和易用性）能夠對移民的匯款行為造成本質性的影響。

en: In this respect, there are three different strategies in place in Africa.
zh: 在這方面，非洲目前存在三種不同的對策。

en: The Anglophone strategy focuses on freeing up the remittance market by encouraging competition, relaxing regulatory constraints for non-bank operators, offering financial incentives, encouraging technical and financial innovation, and stimulating collaboration among market players.
zh: 英語國家主要透過鼓勵競爭、放鬆對非銀行經營者管制、提供財政獎勵、鼓勵技術及金融創新以及促成市場參與者之間進行合作等方式來放開匯款市場。

en: This approach, also adopted by Italy, contributes to reducing costs and increasing the overall volume of funds for beneficiaries.
zh: 這種方式也被義大利所採用。 它有助於降低成本，增加受益人收到的匯款總額。

en: The Hispanic approach emphasizes migrants’ involvement in banking by offering a range of banking services in both the country of origin and the host country, products of specific interest to migrants, and low commissions on foreign transfers.
zh: 西班牙語國家則透過在移民原籍及其所在國提供各種銀行服務、推出與移民利益有特殊關係的產品和手續費低廉的跨國匯款服務來吸引移民參與銀行業務。

en: This approach, widely developed by Morocco and the Portuguese-speaking world, is epitomized by the zero-commission policy initiated by the Spanish bank Santander and its Moroccan counterpart, Attijariwafa Bank.
zh: 這種方式被摩洛哥和講葡萄牙語的國家所廣泛採用，其中最具代表性的是由西班牙銀行桑坦德集團及其摩洛哥同行阿提哈利瓦法銀行首創的零手續費匯款服務。

en: Finally, the Francophone approach relies on two types of monopoly.
zh: 最後，兩類壟斷構成了法語國家對策的基礎。

en: The first is enjoyed by Western Union, which controls up to 90% of the total formal transfer volume within Africa’s 16-member Franc Zone.
zh: 其一是西聯的壟斷地位，該機構控制了非洲法郎區16國正式匯款高達90%的份額。

en: Western Union charges fees as high as 25% on transfers to these countries, compared to an average global benchmark of 5%, and has required that Franc-Zone countries sign exclusivity agreements, thereby preventing foreign-exchange bureaux, post offices, and micro-finance institutions from carrying out money transfers.
zh: 西聯針對這些國家匯款收取高達25%的費用，大大高於全球平均標準的5 % ， 並要求法郎區國家簽署獨家服務協議，以藉此防止外匯局、郵局和小額信貸機構開展貨幣匯款業務。

en: The second monopoly is exercised in the banking sector.
zh: 法語國家的另外一重壟斷存在於銀行機構。

en: France has a veto within the boards of directors of the Franc Zone’s two central banks, while two French commercial banks, BNP-Paribas and Société Générale, exercise a quasi-monopoly on lending programs, mainly centered on short-term trade financing and the needs of governments, public and private companies, and the elite.
zh: 法國在法郎區兩大央行董事會均握有否決權，與此同時兩大法國商業銀行 — — 法國巴黎銀行和法國興業銀行 — — 有權對貸款計劃行使準壟斷決策，要求貸款計劃主要滿足短期貿易融資和政府、公私企業及上層人士的需求。

en: All other local banks have adopted the same approach, severely restricting access to financial services for households and entrepreneurs.
zh: 當地其他銀行也採用同樣的策略，這嚴重限制了家庭和企業獲取金融服務。

en: Despite the increasing importance of remittances from Italy, Spain, and the United States, the largest share in absolute terms still originates from France.
zh: 儘管來自義大利、西班牙和美國的匯款佔比越來越大，但絕對意義上的最大額度依然來自於法國。

en: There is thus a real need in the Franc Zone for a financing institution that would convert migrant remittances into productive investments, thereby generating jobs and wealth, and that would broaden access to banking services, mortgages, insurance products, pension plans, and technical assistance.
zh: 因此迫切需要在法郎區出現一家能夠將移民匯款轉化為高效投資的貸款機構，並以此為起點創造就業機會和財富，能夠讓更多的人享受到銀行服務、抵押貸款、保險產品、養老金計劃和技術援助。

en: Official statistics for 2009 are likely to show that migrants’ remittances fell sharply, as the global recession severely eroded job opportunities abroad.
zh: 2009年的官方資料很可能顯示移民匯款總額出現大幅度下降，下降的原因是全球經濟衰退嚴重侵蝕了國外的就業機會。

en: That makes it all the more important that African countries, many of which have laid a strong groundwork for sustainable growth, have a financial system in place that can leverage remittances effectively as the global economy recovers.
zh: 在這種情況下，隨著全球經濟的復甦，非洲國家建立能夠有效利用匯款的金融體系就顯得至關重要，很多非洲國家都為實現可持續發展奠定了堅實的基礎。

en: Africa’s Dictator-Diplomat
zh: 非洲的獨裁者外交家

en: BRUSSELS – The recent death in Brussels of Ethiopian Prime Minister Meles Zenawi finally brings to light what lay behind his mysterious two-month disappearance from public life.
zh: 布魯塞爾—最近，衣索比亞首相澤納維（Meles Zenawi）在布魯塞爾逝世，他近兩個月以來從公眾視野消失之謎終於隨之解開。

en: Ethiopia’s government had strenuously denied rumors of serious ill health caused by liver cancer.
zh: 衣索比亞政府一直在否認關於他身患嚴重肝癌的傳聞。

en: Now that the worst has, indeed, proven true, Ethiopia and all of East Africa will need to learn to live without the stabilizing influence of its great dictator-diplomat.
zh: 如今，隨著最壞的訊息最後得到了證實，衣索比亞和整個東非也因此需要學會如何在沒了這位偉大的獨裁外交家的穩定影響力的情況下生活。

en: Meles was certainly both.
zh: 澤納維毫無疑問兼具了雙重身份。

en: Ethiopia has undergone a remarkable transformation under his strongman rule since 1991, when his Tigrayan minority group from the country’s north came to power with the overthrow of the odious Communist Derg led by Mengistu Haile Mariam (still enjoying a comfortable retirement in Robert Mugabe’s Zimbabwe).
zh: 衣索比亞自1991年起便在他的鐵腕統治下開始了令人矚目的轉型。 他所屬的生活在衣索比亞北部的少數民族提格雷族（Tigray）推翻了馬里亞姆（Mengistu Haile Mariam）領導的邪惡的共產主義軍政府（馬里亞姆如今在穆加貝治下的辛巴威享受著悠閒的退休生活 ） 。

en: Initially serving as the president of the first post-Derg government, and then as Ethiopia’s prime minister from 1995 until his death, Meles (his nom de guerre in the revolution) oversaw 7.7% annual GDP growth in recent years.
zh: 澤納維最初是後軍政府時代第一屆政府的總統，接著又於1995年開始出任衣索比亞總理直至去世。 近幾年來，在澤納維（他的名字Meles是革命時期獲得的外號）的領導下，衣索比亞的年GDP增長率高達7.7 % 。

en: Strong economic performance is somewhat surprising, given his party’s interventionist policy approach, but Meles showed himself to be a consummate pragmatist in attracting investment – particularly from China – to drive growth.
zh: 強勁的經濟表現有些出人意料，因為他所在的政黨採取的是干涉主義政策模式，但澤納維本人在吸引投資（主要來自中國）推動增長方面是個不折不扣的實用主義者。

en: Meles’s own political provenance as the leader of the Tigrayan People’s Liberation Front was Marxist-Leninist.
zh: 澤納維以提格雷人民解放陣線（Tigrayan People’s Liberation Front）領導人出身，其政治背景是馬克思列寧主義的。

en: But, when the Cold War ended, so, too, did his dogmatism.
zh: 但是，隨著冷戰的結束，他也拋棄了馬列主義教條。

en: To his credit, child mortality was reduced by 40% under his government; Ethiopia’s economy became more diversified, with new industries like car manufacturing, beverages, and floriculture; and major infrastructure projects, including Africa’s largest hydroelectric dam, were launched.
zh: 在他的政府治下，嬰兒死亡率下降了40 % ； 衣索比亞經濟實現了多樣化，出現了汽車製造、餐飲、花卉等新產業；還建成了一系列主要基礎設施工程，包括非洲最大的水電大壩 — — 這些都要記在他的功勞簿上。

en: Once a basket-case associated in the world’s eyes only with famine and drought, Ethiopia has become one of Africa’s largest economies – and without the benefit of gold or oil.
zh: 衣索比亞曾是飢餓和乾旱的代名詞，但現如今它已成為非洲最大經濟體之一 — — 而且是在不靠黃金和石油的情況下取得的。

en: Perhaps more important than Meles’s domestic achievements was his diplomatic record.
zh: 也許比澤納維的國內成就更重要的是他的外交記錄。

en: He was an indispensable ally of the West in the fight against Islamist terrorism, culminating in Ethiopia’s military operation in neighboring Somalia in 2006.
zh: 他是西方必不可少的對抗伊斯蘭恐怖主義的盟友，2006年衣索比亞對鄰國索馬利亞的軍事行動是這一角色的巔峰之作。

en: More recently, Meles coordinated efforts with Kenya to stage limited strikes against the al-Shabaab militia, which has waged an unrelenting war to turn Somalia into a fundamentalist Islamic theocracy.
zh: 最近，澤納維與肯亞一起合作對青年軍（al-Shabaab）進行了有限打擊。 青年軍一直在試圖把索馬利亞轉變為原教旨伊斯蘭神權國家。

en: At the same time, Meles courted China as both an investor and as a hedge against the West’s criticism of his human-rights record.
zh: 與此同時，澤納維還吸引中國，既作為投資者，也作為西方對其人權紀錄批評的擋箭牌。

en: And yet he controversially but rightly held out a hand of friendship to the breakaway region of Somaliland, before it became fashionable, and went as far as he could short of formal re-recognition of that ray of democratic hope in the Horn of Africa.
zh: 此外，他還���受爭議但正確地向索馬利亞蘭分裂地區伸出了友誼之手，此時這一舉動還遠未成為時尚。 他還竭盡全力促成正式重啟談判，為非洲之角帶來民主的希望之光。

en: Meles will be sorely missed in Hargeisa, as he planned to run a Chinese-financed gas pipeline through Somaliland territory from the Ogaden to the coast.
zh: 澤納維將會被哈爾格薩（Hargeisa）人民永遠銘記，因為他計劃在索馬利亞蘭領土上建造一條從奧加登（Ogaden）到海邊的輸氣管道，資金由中國提供。

en: More important, Meles put Addis Ababa on the map as the home of the African Union, and as a capital where Africa’s worst problems could be discussed in a pragmatic manner, unburdened by colonial grudges.
zh: 更重要的是，澤納維讓亞的斯亞貝巴成為非洲聯盟的總部，該市也成為能夠務實討論非洲最嚴重問題的非洲之都。

en: Meles himself became a major diplomatic player, particularly over climate-change policy, and most recently was active in mediating border and natural-resource disputes between Sudan and the newly independent (and oil-rich) South Sudan.
zh: 澤納維本人也在外交舞臺上長袖善舞，特別是在氣候變化問題上，最近，他還積極地為斡旋蘇丹和新獨立的（富油的）南蘇丹之間邊境和自然資源之爭奔走。

en: He will be remembered for accepting the painful secession of Eritrea in 1993, rather than prolong the civil war, and for his efforts to reach an agreement with Egypt over the use of the Blue Nile waters.
zh: 他將因在1993年痛苦地接受厄利垂亞獨立而不是延長了內戰時間而被人銘記，也將因與埃及達成了如何使用青尼羅河河水的協議而被人銘記。

en: The great stain on Meles’s record will always be his intolerance of dissent.
zh: 對持異見者的不容忍是澤納維的一大汙點。

en: To be sure, his human-rights record was far better than the Derg’s.
zh: 平心而論，他的人權紀錄比軍政府好多了。

en: For example, he allowed a private press to flourish, and in 2000 he became the first Ethiopian leader to hold multi-party parliamentary elections.
zh: 比如，他允許私人出版社的經營，在2000年，他還成為首位主持多黨議會選舉的衣索比亞領導人。

en: Moreover, compared to neighboring Eritrea under President Isaias Afewerki or Omar al-Bashir’s Sudan, his regime was by no means the worst offender in the region.
zh: 此外，與阿費沃爾基（Isaias Afewerki）總統治下的厄利垂亞和巴希爾的蘇丹等鄰國相比，他的政權絕對稱不上是該地區的頭號罪犯。

en: Nor was there much evidence of personal enrichment or widespread corruption.
zh: 衣索比亞也沒有多少中飽私囊和腐敗橫行的證據。

en: Nevertheless, following a violently contested parliamentary election in 2005, in which more than 30 parties participated, Meles demonstrated open contempt for democratic pluralism and press freedom, jailing several journalists in recent years.
zh: 儘管如此，在2005年經歷了有30多個政黨參與的競爭慘烈的議會選舉之後，澤納維公開對民主多元論和言論自由表示鄙夷，並在最近幾年囚禁了多位記者。

en: At the same time, he imposed increasingly strict central control on his ethnically and linguistically diverse country.
zh: 與此同時，對於他統治的在種族和語言上多樣化程度極高的國家，他採取了越來越嚴格的中央控制。

en: Although nominally governed by “ethnic federalism,” where this threatened secession, as in Oromia or the Ogaden, Meles was quick to ignore the constitutional set-up.
zh: 儘管名義上衣索比亞是“民族聯邦制”國家，但若出現分裂危險 — — 比如奧羅米亞（Oromia）和奧加登 — — 澤納維很快就放棄了這一憲法規定。

en: Although he strengthened religious freedom and peaceful coexistence between Muslims and Christians, the human-rights situation in Ethiopia remained poor.
zh: 儘管他加強了宗教自由和穆斯林和基督徒之間的和平共存，但衣索比亞的人權狀況依然很差。

en: For example, groups like Freedom House and Human Rights Watch have documented widespread official repression of the Oromo people.
zh: 比如，自由之家和人權觀察等組織就報告說奧羅莫族遭受了普遍的官方壓迫。

en: And yet Meles is irreplaceable – unmatched intellectually as an African leader (he dropped out of medical school, but went on to teach himself impeccable English and obtain European university degrees by correspondence), and unmatched politically at home, with no obvious successor groomed to replace him.
zh: 但澤納維是不可替代的 — — 作為非洲領導人，他的智商無與倫比（他曾經學醫，輟學後自學英語直到熟練掌握，並透過函授獲得了歐洲大學的學位 ） ， 在國內，他的政治能力也無與倫比，沒有顯而易見的繼任者能夠取代他。

en: In the Horn of Africa, there is no leader of his stature who could ensure the stability and strong governance that the region so desperately needs.
zh: 在非洲之角，沒有人能像他那樣能夠確保該地區繼續的穩定而強硬的治理。

en: Hailemariam Desalegn, Meles’s foreign minister, will take over Ethiopia’s government.
zh: 澤納維的外交部長德薩勒恩（Hailenmarian Desalegn）將執掌衣索比亞政府。

en: But there will be considerable concern in the West about the danger of a power vacuum or struggle in a geopolitically vital but fractious country – and just when neighboring Somalia is supposed to be undergoing a transition to a new parliament and elected government.
zh: 但西方很擔心出現權力真空或在一個具有極高地緣政治重要性但又極難對付的國家出現鬥爭，而與此同時相鄰的索馬利亞又正好即將經歷通向新議會和選舉政府的轉型。

en: For his admirers and critics alike, Meles leaves behind a potent political legacy.
zh: 毀也好，譽也罷，澤納維身後留下了強有力的政治遺產。

en: He will be remembered as an African leader of major historical significance: visionary, despotic, and indispensable.
zh: 他將作為具有重大歷史影響力的非洲領導人被人銘記：遠見卓識、暴虐專橫又不可或缺。

en: Africa’s Economic House Divided
zh: 難以維繫的非洲經濟

en: DAKAR – The world economic downturn and financial-market tremors have strained budgets across Africa.
zh: 達喀爾 — — 世界經濟衰退和金融市場震盪已經導致非洲國家預算緊張。

en: With the exception of Ghana, and a few other states, in 2009 most African countries’ fiscal balances deteriorated.
zh: 除迦納和少數幾個其他國家之外，2009年絕大多數非洲國家的財政收支狀況均呈現惡化態勢。

en: But, thanks to prudent management of public finances during previous periods of robust growth, a significant number of African countries have endured the current crisis in better fiscal shape than during past crises.
zh: 但多虧在之前的強勁增長期對公共財政的審慎管理，相當數量的非洲國家在這次危機中的財政狀況強過以往的歷次危機。

en: In 2009, aggregate GDP growth in Africa averaged 1.6%, down from about 5.7% during the 2002-2008 period – but growth all the same.
zh: 2009年，非洲各國合計平均GDP增長為1.6 % ， 較之2002－2008年間的5.7%有所下降，但仍然呈現增長態勢。

en: Moreover, several African countries continued to implement long-term reforms to improve their business and investment climate, despite the daunting challenges presented by the crisis.
zh: 此外，儘管面臨金融危機的嚴峻挑戰，但一些非洲國家仍繼續推進改善商業和投資環境的長期改革措施。

en: Now that international trade and global industrial production are on the mend, sub-Saharan economies look set for more robust growth, as demand for and prices of oil and other minerals rebound and general economic activity resumes.
zh: 當前國際貿易和全球工業生產正逐漸好轉，隨著石油和其他礦產品需求及價格反彈和一般經濟活動恢復，撒哈拉沙漠以南的非洲國家似乎增長會更加強勁。

en: Of course, numerous downside risks – adverse weather shocks, military conflict, and political turmoil – still can undermine the hard-earned benefits of this social and economic record.
zh: 當然，惡劣天氣的衝擊、軍事衝突和政治動盪等多種下行風險仍然可以破壞這一社會經濟記錄的來之不易的收益。

en: But it is the dichotomized nature of their economies and finances that represents Africa’s most intractable structural imbalance.
zh: 但讓非洲最棘手的結構性失衡卻是其經濟和金融結構的二元化屬性。

en: Frankly, two Africa’s are emerging: a modern economy and a cash-based economy.
zh: 坦率地說，有兩個非洲正在崛起： 一個是現代經濟的非洲，而另一個則是以現金為基礎的經濟。

en: Across Africa, almost all governments praise – some honestly, some not – economic modernization as the cornerstone of prosperity and the yardstick by which their effectiveness should be measured. Many boast of the modernity of the financial infrastructure of their economies, which is based on an entire set of legal, regulatory, accounting, credit reporting, and payment and settlement systems.
zh: 在非洲國家，無論由衷與否，幾乎所有政府都將經濟現代化奉為繁榮的基石和自身執政效率的衡量標準而推崇備至。 許多國家誇耀自身金融基礎設施的現代化，這種現代化的金融基礎設施是以一整套法律、法規、會計、徵信、支付和結算系統為基礎建立的。

en: National payment systems operate electronic-based payment products and services.
zh: 國家支付系統推出一系列電子支付產品和服務。

en: A high-value inter-bank funds-transfer system settles transactions in real time, eliminates credit risk between system participants, increases circulation of funds, and enhances monetary-policy implementation.
zh: 一套具有極高價值的銀行間資金轉移系統負責進行實時交易結算、消除系統參與者之間的信用風險、加速資金週轉，以及改善貨幣政策的實施。

en: Banks are provided with a facility to monitor their positions in real time and hence make cost-effective investment decisions.
zh: 這套系統為銀行提供實施監管頭寸的相關工具，從而輔助它們做出符合成本效益原則的投資決策。

en: So far, only a few registered financial institutions, primarily offshoots of Western commercial banks, have access to such payment-system facilities.
zh: 目前，只有西方商業銀行分支機構等少數幾家註冊金融機構獲准使用這套付款系統設施。

en: Non-banking financial institutions such as foreign exchange bureaus, post offices, and micro-finance lenders are not admitted, even when they are financially sound and sustainable.
zh: 外匯局、郵局和小額信貸機構等非銀行金融機構即使財務健全、有持續發展能力也沒有資格進入。

en: The effects of banks’ hijacking of national payment systems to service only the modern economy are compounded by the exclusive agreements that banks and money-transfer companies such as Western Union have signed with most African countries.
zh: 銀行和西聯等匯款公司與多數非洲國家簽訂的獨家協議進一步加劇了銀行劫持國家支付系統、只為現代經濟服務的惡果。

en: These agreements lock out non-banking entities from the highly lucrative market for migrant remittances from the African diaspora, which remain a key engine of growth.
zh: 上述協議將非銀行機構排除在利潤豐厚的非洲散居移民匯款市場之外，而散居移民匯款一直是非洲經濟增長的重要引擎。

en: Yet rapid urbanization everywhere in Africa has given rise to a dynamic informal sector unconnected to the modern economy.
zh: 但非洲各地快速城市化已經催生出一個與現代經濟無關的活躍的非正規部門。

en: Although marginalized by African officials, this cash-based economy is a major contributor to the continent’s productive capacity.
zh: 雖然被非洲官員邊緣化，但上述以現金為基礎的經濟仍然是這塊大陸生產率的主要貢獻者。

en: It employs more than 90% of the workforce and is home to 75% of the retailers.
zh: 這個部門吸納了超過90%的勞動者和75%的零售業者。

en: But, despite the pivotal economic role that the informal sector plays, it has no access to conventional bank loans.
zh: 但儘管上述非正規部門發揮瞭如此關鍵的經濟作用，它仍然不具備獲得傳統銀行貸款的資格。

en: Micro-finance institutions provide the only credit lines open to informal operators.
zh: 微型金融機構提供了向非正規經營者們開放的唯一的信貸額度。

en: The micro-finance business model is based on lending that is guaranteed by the group.
zh: 集體擔保貸款是小額信貸的慣用商業模式。 這種模式進而轉化為減輕信貸風險並鼓勵付款紀律的休慼相關的網路和支援機制。

en: This translates into a solidarity network and a support mechanism that mitigates credit risk and encourages payment discipline. Credit repayment in well-managed micro-finance institutions is around 95%. All studies undertaken in the area have also revealed that women are not only the most active among informal-sector entrepreneurs, but they are also quicker to meet their commitments.
zh: 管理狀況良好的小額信貸機構其信貸還款率為95%左右。 相關領域進行的所有研究也顯示女性不僅是非正規經濟部門最活躍的企業家，而且也能更迅速地兌現她們的承諾。

en: African states must now recognize that modernizing their informal sectors by integrating them into the modern economy can be a major development tool. Yet only a few countries have started moving in that direction.
zh: 非洲國家現在必須意識到將非正規部門現代化並納入現代經濟範疇能夠成為一種重要的發展工具。 但只有幾個國家開始進行這方面的努力。

en: Nigeria has refrained from signing any exclusive agreements with Western Union and others, and its newly consolidated banking industry is making significant inroads across the region.
zh: 奈及利亞已經拒絕與西聯和其他企業簽訂獨家協議，這個國家最新完成整合的銀行業在區域內的進展非常迅速。

en: Rwanda, too, has enacted regulations that eliminate exclusive agreements, opening doors for micro-finance institutions to become payment-service providers.
zh: 盧安達也已經透過了廢除獨家協議的法規，並向小額信貸機構敞開大門，吸納它們加入支付服務提供商的隊伍。

en: The South African Reserve Bank has created a special platform within its national payment system for micro-finance institutions and non-banks.
zh: 而南非儲備銀行已經在國家支付系統內部為小額信貸及非銀行機構建立了一個特別的平臺。

en: Malawi’s national payments system is directly accessible to non-bank participants, including third-party service providers.
zh: 馬拉維的國家支付系統直接對包括第三方服務提供商在內的非銀行參與者開放。

en: Giving micro-finance institutions access to national and regional payments systems and electronic retail facilities will go a long way toward meeting the requirements of the retail and business sector in terms of banking facilities.
zh: 允許小額信貸機構使用國家和地區支付系統及電子零售設施將會在銀行信貸領域對滿足零售和商業部門的需求產生很大的幫助。

en: It will also help facilitate access by the poorest to financial services, thus helping to reduce the high proportion of the un-banked population.
zh: 這樣也有助於底層貧困人口使用金融服務，從而降低不使用銀行服務的人口比例。

en: All of this will invariably spur development and integration of national financial systems and intra-regional trade.
zh: 所有這些總能促進國家金融系統和區內貿易的發展和整合。

en: This will be a welcome development, because a large proportion of intra-regional trade is carried out by informal operators and small and medium enterprises that do not have access to the banking system.
zh: 這樣的發展趨勢令人欣慰，因為很大比例的區域內貿易來自那些無權利用銀行系統的非正規經營者及中小企業。

en: Moreover, economic integration and increased intra-regional trade are the best entry point into global markets for all countries.
zh: 此外，經濟整合和加強區域貿易是所有國家進軍全球市場的最佳切入點。

en: When it comes to analyzing what ails Africa, it is customary to dwell at length on the continent’s traumatic past.
zh: 每每談到對非洲存在問題的分析，人們總是習慣於不厭其煩地歷數這塊大陸滿是創傷的過去。

en: But it strains the imagination to link Africa’s colonial-era pains with the willingness of African leaders to spend a fortune to equip their countries with state-of-the-art settlement systems, and then proceed to exclude their citizens from using them.
zh: 但是將非洲殖民時代的陣痛與非洲領導人耗費巨資為國家建設最先進的結算系統，而後又禁止本國公民對其加以利用這兩者聯絡在一起卻似乎超出了人們的想象力。

en: Abraham Lincoln once said that a house divided cannot stand.
zh: 亞伯拉罕·林肯曾經說過“不順則不立 ” 。

en: There is an economic corollary to this: an economic house divided cannot prosper.
zh: 這句話在經濟領域的推論是： 繁榮只能來自於高效順暢的經濟關係。

en: Africa’s Hard Black Gold
zh: 非洲的硬黑金

en: LAGOS - Few infrastructure services in the developed world may be as taken for granted as electric power.
zh: 拉各斯 - - 在發達國家中，沒有什麼基礎設施服務專案比電力更為普及、人們更為習以為常的了。

en: To consumers in industrialized countries, uninterrupted power supply is a given.
zh: 對於工業化國家的消費者而言，不中斷的電力供應是天經地義的。

en: Not so in much of Africa, which experiences some of the world’s greatest power deficits, and where only two in ten people have access to electricity.
zh: 但是這在非洲並非如此。 非洲的幾個地方是全世界電力短缺最為嚴重的，只有百分之二十的人口有電力供應。

en: According to the International Monetary Fund’s most recent Regional Economic Outlook for Sub-Saharan Africa, in 2007 alone, nearly two-thirds of the countries in the region experienced an acute energy crisis marked by frequent and extended electricity outages.
zh: 國際貨幣基金組織最新發表的非洲薩哈拉以南地區經濟展望指出，僅僅在2007年，該地區三分之二的國家存在極度能源危機，表現為經常持續斷電。

en: There is no shortage of hydropower plants for electricity generation in Africa.
zh: 非洲並不乏水電站發電。

en: However, many of these plants are unable to keep up with rapid population growth and attendant increases in demand.
zh: 但是，許多這些電站無法跟上快速人口增長以及隨之而來的需求增加。

en: Furthermore, they are prone to frequent drought, which reduces their output significantly, leaving many as little more than decorative infrastructure landmarks.
zh: 而且，這些電站還要受到頻繁的乾旱影響。 乾旱會大幅度降低電力產量，使得很多電站成為基礎設施點綴而已。

en: Increasingly burgeoning populations in countries like Nigeria and Ghana imply a greater extraction of water resources for power generation.
zh: 奈及利亞和迦納等國人口越發膨脹，意味著要加大抽取水資源用於發電。

en: Rapid expansion of agricultural activity is requiring more and more water all across the continent.
zh: 農業活動迅速擴大，對整個非洲大陸的用水提出了更高的需求。

en: Other resources like fuel oil, diesel, light crude, solar, and gas are also available as means of electricity generation, but their costs are all quite prohibitive.
zh: 燃油、煤油、輕原油、太陽能以及天然氣等其他資源也可以用於發電，但是它們的成本過高，無法供應。

en: These factors make a good argument for coal as a cheap alternative source of Africa's power.
zh: 這些因素使得人們可以提出使用煤炭作為便宜的非洲電力替代資源。

en: Coal has historically played a crucial role as a source of energy worldwide, and has several important advantages over other fossil fuels.  First is its relative abundance.
zh: 在歷史上，煤炭作為全世界的能源來源發揮了關鍵作用，而且對於其他礦物燃料擁有幾個重要的優勢。

en: The current level of proven coal reserves worldwide stands at roughly 850 billion tons.
zh: 首先是煤炭儲量相對豐富。 目前全世界探明的煤炭儲量大約是8500億噸。

en: Africa has about 50 billion tons.
zh: 非洲有大約500億噸。

en: Coal is also much more widely distributed geographically than any other fossil fuel.
zh: 煤炭要比其他任何礦物燃料分佈更為廣泛。

en: Worldwide energy demand has increased by more than 50% since 1980, and is expected to grow annually by 1.6% between now and 2030.
zh: 從1980年以來，全球能源需求增加了50%以上，而且預計將會從現在起到2030年每年增加1.6 % 。

en: More than 70% of this new demand will come from developing countries, with fossil fuels projected to account for about 80% of total energy demand by the end of this period.
zh: 這一新需求的70%以上來自發展中國家。 預計，礦物燃料將在這一期間末佔全部能源需求的大約80 % 。

en: Coal is the world’s fastest growing fossil fuel, with annual production increasing by 6.4% since 2004.
zh: 煤炭是世界上增長最快的礦物燃料，從2004年以來年產量遞增6.4 % 。

en: It is already the dominant source of power generation in some very important energy-consuming nations.
zh: 在某些十分重要的能源消費國家中，煤炭已經統領電力來源。

en: Much of the future increases in coal-fired electricity generation will come from strategically important developing countries like China and India.
zh: 中國和印度等戰略上重要的發展中國家將會是未來煤炭發電增長的主要國家。

en: In 2006 alone, China added about 93,000 megawatts of coal- fired electricity generating capacity, and this trend is expected to continue as the country tries to meet its huge energy needs.
zh: 僅僅在2006年，中國增加了大約93000百萬瓦特的煤炭發電產量，而且這一趨勢預計將會隨著中國努力滿足其巨大的能源需求而繼續。

en: Even in many developed countries, coal still accounts for a large share of power generation.
zh: 即使在許多發達國家，煤炭依然佔據發電量的很大一部分。

en: Coal plants currently provide more than half of America’s electricity supply.
zh: 美國電力供應的一半以上來自於煤電廠。

en: Denmark, which houses some of the most efficient coal-fired power plants in the world, equally relies on coal for half of its electricity production.
zh: 丹麥擁有一些全世界最為高效的煤電廠，其煤炭發電佔據半壁河山。

en: The same is true for Germany, which is home to some of the most efficient pulverized coal combustion units in Europe.
zh: 德國也是一樣，它擁有一些歐洲最為高效的粉煤燃燒電廠。

en: Poland uses coal for 98% of its electricity production, and South Africa uses coal for about 50% of its electricity production.
zh: 波蘭電力生產的98%使用煤炭，而南非則為大約一半。

en: Against this picture then, it is hard not to expect developing countries to exploit their abundant coal resources to generate power for their own development, especially given that modern technology can help produce coal cleanly.
zh: 因此，在這種背景下，特別是鑑於現代技術可以幫助以清潔的方式產煤，人們很難不料想發展中國家會開發其豐富的煤炭資源來為其自身發展提供電力。

en: Some argue that gas might be a better alternative to hydro or coal, but for countries that must import much of their gas the benefits of a stable and reliable source of cheap fuel in the form of coal present a very strong counter-argument to the capital costs of a gas plant.
zh: 有人認為，天然氣或許是水力或者煤炭更好的替代之物。 但是對於必須進口大部分天然氣的國家而言，以煤炭作為穩定和可靠的便宜燃料來源益處多多，而天然氣電廠需要資本投入，因此煤炭是強有力的反駁。

en: Unlike prices for coal, which is abundant and dispersed geographically, gas prices are subject to significant volatility, and the long-term trend in the face of fossil fuel depletion is uncertain.
zh: 煤炭儲量豐富，分佈廣泛。 與煤炭價格相比，天然氣價格波動巨大，而且，在礦物燃料殆盡的情況下，其長期趨勢也不明朗。

en: In contrast, coal prices are more stable, and may remain that way for a long time.
zh: 比較而言，煤炭價格更為穩定，也可能持續很長一段時間。

en: Apart from electric-power generation, coal also has wide application in a number of industries.
zh: 除了發電，煤炭還廣泛應用於其他幾個產業。

en: It is pivotal in both steel and cement production.
zh: 它是鋼鐵和水泥生產的關鍵要素。

en: Moreover, the use of wood by Africa’s growing population is causing increasingly rapid deforestation in many countries.
zh: 而且，非洲越來越多的人口使用木材正在許多國家造成森林迅速退化。

en: There is significant potential domestic demand for coal briquettes to replace wood for cooking and domestic and industrial heating.
zh: 煤餅的潛在需求巨大，以取代木材用於做飯、家用和工業取暖。

en: The demand outlook thus appears favorable for the coal industry, creating significant investment opportunities.
zh: 因此，煤炭產業的需求前景頗佳，從而創造巨大的投資機遇。

en: Clearly, there are environmental drawbacks from the use of coal as an energy resource, and these concerns are far too important to overlook.
zh: 很明顯，使用煤炭作為一種能源會產生環境倒退，而且人們不能忽視這些巨大的擔憂。

en: The massive reserves notwithstanding, coal is still a finite resource.
zh: 儘管儲藏巨大，但是煤炭依舊是有限資源。

en: It must be mined with greater efficiency and with a view to mitigating the environmental impact.
zh: 因此，必須更為高效地開採煤炭並且顧及減少環境影響。

en: Fortunately, much greater attention is paid today to mine safety and the management of the by-products of coal use.
zh: 所幸的是，如今人們對煤礦安全以及管理煤炭使用的副產品更為關注。

en: With acid rain and other public-health hazards linked to coal combustion, more technologies are emerging for reducing harmful emissions from power plants.
zh: 酸雨和其他公共健康危害與煤炭燃燒有關，越來越多的技術正在湧現以減少發電廠的有害排放。

en: Fueled by research, the past few years have witnessed the development of increasingly cleaner and more energy-efficient coal-fired generation plants and the retirement of older technologies, especially in the developed world.
zh: 過去幾年中，受到研發推動，越發清潔、更為高效的煤電廠建成，而且，特別是在發達國家中舊技術正在淘汰。

en: Developing countries have lagged behind in this process, but, with the common threat of global warming, there is now growing pressure to adopt conservation policies.
zh: 發展中國家在這一程序中已經落後，但是，隨著全球變暖的共��威脅，現在採納保護環境政策的壓力越來越大。

en: Africa's mineral-rich countries must exploit their abundant natural resources.
zh: 非洲礦物儲量豐富的國家必須利用它們豐富的自然資源。

en: They must use coal to advance their economic development.
zh: 它們必須使用煤炭來推進經濟發展。

en: Failure to do so would be a missed opportunity at a time when African countries must avail themselves of all available resources for poverty reduction.
zh: 當前，非洲國家必須利用所有可資利用的資源脫貧，否則就會坐失良機。

en: Africa’s Immunity
zh: 非洲的免疫

en: ACCRA – The United States suffers rising job losses.
zh: 阿克拉—越來越多的美國人丟掉了工作。

en: Britain nationalizes its banks.
zh: 英國對銀行實行國有化。

en: Once high-flying small economies like Ireland, Hungary, and Iceland break down.
zh: 愛爾蘭，匈牙利，冰島等一度騰飛的小型經濟體垮掉了。

en: Even robust China and India are experiencing slower growth, curtailed ambitions, and broken dreams.
zh: 甚至連生機勃勃的中國和印度也在放慢增長速度，雄心被抑制，美夢正破碎。

en: Yet, in sub-Saharan Africa, there are few hints of the global financial crisis that is consuming the capitalist world.
zh: 但是，在撒哈拉以南的非洲地區，卻幾乎看不到全球金融危機的影響，雖然這場危機正在毀掉資本主義世界。

en: In fashionable African cities, residential home prices remain stratospheric.
zh: 在時髦的非洲城市，住宅房屋的價格依然高不可攀。

en: A typical Western-style house in Kampala or Accra, for example, now costs an astonishing two to three times the price of a comparable home in, say, Cleveland or other cities in the American heartland.
zh: 例如，比起克里夫蘭或是美國心臟地帶其他城市裡類似的房子，坎帕拉和阿克拉城裡一棟典型的西式房屋現在的價格要高出一到兩倍，這令人驚奇。

en: While home prices are crashing from Madrid to Dublin and Miami to Los Angeles, African prices remain near or at record-high levels.
zh: 從馬德里到都柏林，從邁阿密到洛杉磯，房價一路狂跌，而非洲房價卻接近或者正處於有史以來的最高水平。

en: African banks, meanwhile, are rock-solid compared to their debt-heavy counterparts in the US and Europe.
zh: 與此同時，比起身負重債的美國和歐洲銀行，非洲銀行堅如磐石。

en: While international bankers went bust by making legions of bad loans, African bankers stuck to earning profits the old-fashioned way: paying very little to depositors, and earning a big “spread” by buying guaranteed government debt, which yielded healthy returns.
zh: 當國際銀行家們因為發放了大批不良貸款而破產的時候，非洲銀行家堅持採用老派方法來賺取利潤：付給存款人很少的利息，同時透過購買有擔保的政府債務來獲得大額差價， 這些債務會帶來健康穩定的回報。

en: Even government deficit spending – long the bane of Africa – seems positively puny compared to the massive debts that the US and some European countries face.
zh: 和美國以及一些歐洲國家面臨的鉅額債務相比，甚至連政府的赤字開支—長久以來這一直是非洲的禍害—似乎也完全是微不足道的。

en: The new Obama administration is proposing spending plans that would create a record US deficit of more than one trillion dollars – and this coming on top of the outgoing Bush administration’s record deficit.
zh: 新的奧巴馬政府提出了開支計劃，其中赤字超過一萬億美元，這會創下新的紀錄。 而這還是在剛離任的布什政府已經創下了有史以來的最高赤字之後。

en: And yet there are good reasons to believe that it is just a matter of time before Africa and its peoples experience the ill effects of the global crisis.
zh: 儘管如此，仍然有可靠的原因讓我們相信非洲和它的人民將會吞下全球危機的惡果，這只是個時間問題而已。

en: From Ghana to Kenya, governments are having increased difficulty in raising money for infrastructure projects and selling official debt.
zh: 從迦納到肯亞，政府為基礎設施專案融資和出售政府債務時面臨的困難正在增加。

en: Foreign investment in sub-Saharan Africa, which reached record levels in recent years, is retreating, which is evidence of investor caution, not any underlying lack of optimism about the region.
zh: 近年來，外國在撒哈拉以南地區的投資創下新高，但這些投資正在撤出。 這意味著投資者開始謹慎行事，他們不再掩飾對這個地區缺乏信心。

en: And exports of raw materials to China, India, Europe, and the US – a key factor in Africa’s recent growth surge – may suffer simply because the global slowdown means less consumption everywhere.
zh: 向中國，印度，歐洲和美國出口原材料是非洲最近經濟飆升的一個關鍵因素，但這種出口可能受挫，因為全球經濟下滑意味著每個地區都會減少消費。

en: All of these factors suggest that an African financial bust is possible.
zh: 所有這些因素都表明非洲可能發生金融破產。

en: Popular equity investments, such as shares in Safaricom, are already trading at unexpectedly low levels.
zh: 流行的股權投資，例如Safaricom裡面的股份，已經在以低得出乎意料的水平進行交易了。

en: If real estate prices were to fall dramatically, a chain reaction could occur, taking down big and small investors alike, and over time causing wide suffering to ordinary Africans.
zh: 如果地產價格急劇下降，就會發生連鎖反應，大小投資者同樣受困，一段時間過後還會給許多普通非洲民眾帶來痛苦。

en: Even assuming stability in real estate prices, the global crisis surely will cause a fall in remittances by Africans working good jobs in Europe, the US, Canada, Australia, and the Middle East.
zh: 即使假設地產價格穩定，全球危機也必然會導致在外工作的非洲人士減少匯款。 這些人工作優渥，呆在歐洲，美國，加拿大，澳大利亞和中東。

en: Remittances are already believed to be falling, which makes sense: immigrants in rich countries are and will be disproportionately hurt by slowing economic activity.
zh: 人們已經相信匯款額會下降，這不難理解：經濟活動減緩正在，而且將要，極大傷害遷往富裕國家的移民。

en: Immigration itself may even slow dramatically, depending on the length and depth of the economic slowdown.
zh: 基於經濟衰退的長度和深度，甚至移民活動本身也會急劇減少。

en: Fewer Africans working in rich countries will automatically translate into less money circulating in African countries.
zh: 當在富裕國家工作的非洲人數量減少時，這自然會導致在非洲國家裡流動的錢也會變少

en: The decline in remittances, however, cuts both ways.
zh: 然而，減少匯款具有正反兩面作用。

en: Remittances have long spurred inflation in many parts of Africa.
zh: 長期以來，匯款刺激了非洲很多地方的通貨膨脹。

en: A Ugandan doctor working in Norway, for instance, cares little about the cost of a beer in Kampala.
zh: 例如，一位在挪威工作的烏干達醫生很少關注坎帕拉一瓶啤酒的價格。

en: He is also willing – and able – to pay more than a local doctor for services and, of course, a home in Uganda.
zh: 和一位當地醫生相比，他願意並且能夠為接受服務—當然還有一個在烏干達的家—支付更多的錢。

en: Fewer remittances flowing into Uganda could mean less economic activity – or simply lower prices.
zh: 流入烏干達的匯款減少意味著經濟活動減少，或者就是價格降低。

en: The financial meltdown in the US, which incubated the global crisis, is either coming under control or threatening to mutate into a new, more virulent form that could destroy not only America’s paper economy of trading and brokering, but also its real economy of goods and services.
zh: 這場引發全球危機的美國金融崩潰不是被控制下來，就是有可能演變成新一波更致命的崩潰。 新一輪的崩潰將不止會摧毀美國由交易業務和經紀業務構建的虛擬經濟（paper economy ） ， 還將搞跨貨物和服務構成的實體經濟。

en: President Barack Obama, acting as if the latter scenario remains likely, is betting on large-scale government spending to prop up the real economy.
zh: 總統巴拉克·奧巴馬現在的行事風格就像後一種情況可能發生一樣，他打賭大規模的政府開支將支撐起實體經濟。

en: If his administration succeeds, the chances that Africa will remain relatively unscathed will grow.
zh: 如果他的政策成功了，就會相應增加非洲得以倖免的機會。

en: Even if Obama fails, however, Africans should escape the worst of the global crisis, for both good reasons and bad.
zh: 不過，即使奧巴馬失敗了，非洲也應該能逃出全球危機的最重災區，其原因好壞參半。

en: The good reasons have to do with African self-reliance and a growing awareness among scholars and policymakers that trade within the region – especially between urban and rural Africa – will ultimately deliver enormous benefits.
zh: 好的原因關乎非洲的自力更生，而且學者和決策者們越來越意識到地區內的貿易，尤其是非洲的城鄉貿易，最終將會帶來巨大的收益。

en: Another factor working in Africa’s favor is its private companies’ and consumers’ low dependence on borrowed money.
zh: 另外一個對非洲有利的因素是這裡的私人公司和消費者很少依賴借來的錢。

en: People tend to pay cash for goods and services, however costly.
zh: 人們傾向於用現金來支付貨物和服務，不論有多貴。

en: In the US, loans for cars and homes – loans that now aren’t being paid back – are the major factor behind the financial crisis.
zh: 在美國，買房買車的貸款（那些現在收不回來的貸款）是金融危機後面的主要���素。

en: In Africa, very few people borrow money for such purchases.
zh: 而非洲只有極少數人借錢買這些東西。

en: Africa’s cash-based economy has in the past constrained development.
zh: 過去，非洲以現金為基礎的經濟阻礙了發展。

en: After all, by allowing people to spend more than they have, borrowed money can fuel growth.
zh: 畢竟，透過允許人們超前消費，借來的錢可以為經濟助燃。

en: But today, Africa’s pay-as-you-go practices are a powerful defense against financial contagion.
zh: 但今天，非洲“現收現付”的習俗成了抵禦金融危機蔓延的有力保障。

en: Another way of looking at Africa’s paradoxical economic position is to admit that the region’s historical marginalization within the international financial system – so costly in times of global plenty – is proving to be an unexpected benefit when the wealthiest of the world are sick unto death.
zh: 觀察非洲自相矛盾的經濟狀況時，另一種方法是承認該地區歷史上一直被全球金融體制邊緣化，結果在世界繁榮的時候損失慘重。 然而在全球最富裕的國家病入膏肓的時候，這一點反而成了是一個出人意料的益處。

en: Ensuring Africa’s Continued Rise
zh: 確保非洲繼續崛起

en: LAGOS – Africa’s rise is in danger of faltering.
zh: 拉各斯—非洲的崛起有夭折的危險。

en: After years during which the continent’s economy grew at an average annual rate of 5%, global uncertainty, depressed commodity prices, and jittery external conditions are threatening to undermine decades of much-needed progress.
zh: 在經歷了多年年均5%的經濟增長後，全球不確定性、大宗商品價格低迷以及不利的外部條件有可能破壞幾十年來急需的進步。

en: Ensuring the wealth and wellbeing of the continent’s residents will not be easy; but there is much that policymakers can do to put Africa back on an upward trajectory.
zh: 確保非洲居民的財富和福祉絕非易事；但決策者可以想很多辦法幫助非洲重回向上軌跡。

en: First and foremost, policymakers must secure the financing needed to pursue sustainable development in an uncertain global environment.
zh: 首先也是最重要的是，決策者必須確保所需要的資金在不確定的全球環境中追求可持續發展。

en: The World Bank estimates that Africa will require at least $93 billion a year to fund its infrastructure needs alone.
zh: 世界銀行估計，光是基礎設施資金，非洲每年就至少需要930億美元。

en: Climate-friendly, sustainable infrastructure will cost even more.
zh: 氣候友好型可持續基礎設施的成本更高。

en: And yet, as long as global growth remains weak, Africans cannot count on developed countries to fully honor their commitments to help attain the Sustainable Development Goals.
zh: 但是，只要全球增長持續低迷，非洲人就無法指望發達國家充分兌現它們幫助實現可持續發展目標的承諾。

en: Africa must rapidly develop its own resources, beginning by nearly doubling tax revenues.
zh: 非洲必須迅速開發其自身的資源，第一步是將稅收收入提高近一倍。

en: Across Sub-Saharan Africa, tax revenues account for less than one-fifth of GDP, compared to more than one-third in OECD countries.
zh: 在整個撒哈拉以南非洲，稅收收入還不到GDP的五分之一，而經合組織國家這一比例高達三分之一以上。

en: This means there is plenty of room for improvement.
zh: 這意味著還有巨大的改善空間。

en: From 1990 to 2004, for example, Ghana reformed its tax system and raised revenues from 11% to 22% of GDP.
zh: 比如，從1999年到2004年，迦納改革了其稅收制度，稅收收入佔GDP之比從11%增加到22 % 。

en: Admittedly, such progress is difficult; in Nigeria, we saw an opportunity in raising non-oil tax revenues, but struggled to seize it.
zh: 誠然，取得這樣的進步是困難的；在奈及利亞，我們也看到了提高非石油稅收收入的機會，但難以抓住它。

en: Another source of domestic resources is the roughly $380 billion in pension assets held by just ten African countries.
zh: 另一個國內資源是十個非洲國家所持有的大約3,800億美元退休金資產。

en: Policymakers should be leveraging these considerable sums.
zh: 決策者應該利用這一數量可觀的資金。

en: At the same time, African countries will have to find a way to diversify their economies.
zh: 與此同時，非洲國家必須找到辦法實現經濟多樣化。

en: Diversification requires investment in the future, in the form of education and well-developed infrastructure, including telecommunications, power, roads, rail, and water.
zh: 多樣化需要為未來投資，如教育和發達的基礎設施（通訊、電力、公路、鐵路、水道等 ） 。

en: There are plenty of models to follow: Dubai, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Mexico, Indonesia, and South Korea are all admired by Africans as economies that managed to transform themselves.
zh: 可以效仿的榜樣很多：迪拜、新加坡、泰國、馬來西亞、墨西哥、印度尼西亞和韓國都是非洲人民所景仰的成功實現轉型的經濟體。

en: Dubai, for example, set out more than three decades ago to prepare for a future without oil.
zh: 比如，迪拜三十多年前就開始為沒有石油的未來做準備。

en: The government implemented a step-by-step transformation of the country into a service economy, putting in place the infrastructure and incentives necessary to build up financial services, tourism, medical services, real estate, media, arts, and culture.
zh: 迪拜政府實施了逐步的轉型，將經濟轉變為服務經濟，為金融服務、旅遊、醫療服務、房地產、傳媒、藝術和文化等行業提供必要的基礎設施和激勵。

en: South Korea and Singapore, which had few natural resources on which to rely, are no less inspiring.
zh: 韓國和新加坡都沒有天然資源可以依賴，但它們的例子也十分鼓舞人心。

en: The secret behind these countries’ success is relentlessly focused leaders, whether entrenched but benign dictators or democratically elected politicians with a shared vision of a broad-based economy.
zh: 這些國家成功的背後是堅持不懈的領導人，不管是長期執政但溫和的獨裁者，還是對寬基礎經濟有著共同願景的民選政客。

en: Sub-Saharan Africa has paths for diversified growth that many of the trailblazers did not: value-added agriculture and agro industry, the processing of mineral resources, petrochemical complexes, manufacturing of durable and consumer goods, tourism and entertainment, and an emerging information-technology sector.
zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲擁有許多先行者所不具備的多樣化增長路徑：增加值農業和農用工業、礦產資源、石化、持久品和消費品製造、旅遊和娛樂，以及新興的資訊科技業。

en: As the necessary measures for diversification are implemented, policymakers must ensure that the economic growth they are pursuing creates jobs.
zh: 在實施必要的多樣化措施的同時，決策者必須確保他們所追求的經濟增長能創造就業。

en: Sadly, this has not always been the case.
zh: 悲哀的是，事實未必如此。

en: Much of the recent growth has benefited only a few, leaving many behind – most notably young people and women.
zh: 近期的大量增長只是肥了一小撮人，而將大部分人排斥在外 — — 特別是年輕人和女性。

en: From 2006 to 2013, inequality rose in many of the continent’s most important economies, including South Africa, Nigeria, Ghana, Tanzania, and Rwanda.
zh: 從2006年到2013年，非洲的許多最重要經濟體，包括南非、奈及利亞、迦納、坦尚尼亞和盧安達等，不平等性都有所上升。

en: These were challenges that we were starting to address in Nigeria when I was finance minister.
zh: 我擔任奈及利亞財政部長時，已經開始解決一些挑戰。

en: We knew that we needed not just to secure growth, but also to improve the quality of that growth.
zh: 我們知道我們不但需要確保增長，還需要改善增長的質量。

en: To that end, policymakers must ensure that growth is channeled into sectors that create jobs, such as agriculture, manufacturing, and services.
zh: 在這方面，決策者必須確保增長被引導到創造就業的部門，如農業、製造業和服務業。

en: They may also have to redistribute income and strengthen social safety nets to protect better those at the bottom of the ladder.
zh: 他們還必須重新分配收入和強化社會安全網，以更好地保護底層人群。

en: Matching skills to job opportunities will be crucial.
zh: 讓技能與就業機會相匹配至關重要。

en: Some 70% of Africa’s population is under 30, and the continent is home to half the world’s primary-school-age children who have been deprived of the opportunity to study.
zh: 大約70%的非洲人口還不到30歲，非洲輟學小學適齡兒童佔世界的一半。

en: Offering Africa’s children basic reading, writing, and technology skills, as well as vocational, technical, and entrepreneurial training, must be a top priority.
zh: 讓非洲兒童擁有基本的閱讀、寫作和技術技能並獲得職業、技術和創業培訓必須成為重中之重。

en: Weak health-care systems must also be strengthened in order to tackle the endemic diseases that sap productivity, such as malaria, as well as improving preparedness for outbreaks of deadly epidemics.
zh: 拙劣的醫療體系也必須強化，以解決制約生產力的地方性疾病（如瘧疾）以及改善對致死傳染病爆發的預防工作。

en: The stakes are high.
zh: 茲事體大。

en: The World Bank estimates the Ebola outbreak shrank the economies of Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Liberia by 16%.
zh: 世界銀行估計，埃博拉疫情的爆發讓獅子山、幾內亞和賴比瑞亞經濟萎縮了16 % 。

en: As the world economy sputters, African countries will have to develop trade with one another.
zh: 世界經濟形勢堪憂，非洲國家必須發展彼此之間的貿易。

en: In 2013, African goods and services accounted for just 16% of trade within the continent, and just over 3% of world trade.
zh: 2013年，非洲商品和服務只佔非洲內部貿易的16%或世界貿易的3%略多。

en: One problem is that most African countries produce the same type of commodities and trade them with very little value-added.
zh: 一個問題是大部分非洲國家生產同類商品，並以極少量附加值進行貿易。

en: Policymakers must encourage greater specialization; differentiated goods and services will add value and volume to trade.
zh: 決策者必須鼓勵提高專業化；多樣化的商品和服務能夠自增加貿易的價值和量。

en: Logistics pose another obstacle to intra-African trade.
zh: 物流是非洲內部貿易的另一障礙。

en: Policymakers must make it easier to move goods across borders, by improving connectivity between countries and reducing bureaucratic hurdles and administrative costs.
zh: 決策者必須改善國家之間的聯絡，降低官僚障礙和行政成本，從而讓商品跨國運輸更加便利。

en: For example, road transport tariffs across Africa are estimated at $0.05-$0.13 per ton-kilometer, compared to the average of $0.01-$0.05 for all developing countries.
zh: 比如，非洲公路運輸關稅據估計在每噸千米0.05—0.13美元，而所有發展中國家的平均水平為0.01—0.05美元。

en: The Rift Valley Railway project, which will eventually link Mombasa on the Kenyan coast to Kampala in Uganda, is a good example of the benefits that investments in transportation could provide.
zh: 最終將連線肯亞蒙巴薩海濱和烏干達坎帕拉的東非大裂谷鐵路工程很好地說明了交通投資所能提供的好處。

en: The African Development Bank estimates that it will double the volume of trade between the two countries, while reducing marginal costs by 30%.
zh: 非洲開發銀行估計它將讓兩國間貿易量翻一番，同時將邊際成本降低30 % 。

en: As they make these investments, policymakers must not forget that much of Africa’s recent growth can be credited to good macroeconomic policies and sound economic management.
zh: 在做出這些投資的同時，決策者也絕不能忘記近期非洲的大部分增長要歸因於良好的宏觀經濟政策和可靠的經濟管理。

en: Extending the continent’s rise will require strengthening the continent’s economic fundamentals.
zh: 延長非洲的崛起需要強化非洲經濟基本面。

en: This means ensuring that prices in the economy are correct, starting with the exchange rate.
zh: 這意味著確保經濟中的價格是正確的。 首先是匯率。

en: Some countries may need temporary controls to curb damaging capital outflows, but policymakers should aim for a market-based exchange rate and a solid plan for governing inflation, debt, foreign-exchange reserves, current accounts, and fiscal balances.
zh: 一些國家也許需要暫時管制以遏制破壞性資本流出，但決策者應該將目標放在市場匯率和制定可靠的計劃治理通貨膨脹、債務、外匯儲備、經常賬戶和財政平衡上。

en: Africa’s potential can hardly be overstated.
zh: 非洲的潛能是無窮的。

en: The continent is well placed to build diversified economies based on low-carbon, sustainable infrastructure.
zh: 非洲很適合構建基於低碳可持續基礎設施的多樣化經濟。

en: But policymakers cannot simply assume that Africa’s rise will continue.
zh: 但決策者不能想當然地認為非洲能持續崛起。

en: They must take the right steps to ensure that it does.
zh: 他們必須採取正確的措施保證這一點。

en: Africa’s Urban Farmers
zh: 非洲的城市農夫們

en: NAIROBI – When I met Eunice Wangari at a Nairobi coffee shop recently, I was surprised to hear her on her mobile phone, insistently asking her mother about the progress of a corn field in her home village, hours away from the big city.
zh: 發自內羅畢 — — 當我最近在肯亞首都內羅畢一家咖啡廳遇見尤妮斯·瓦嘉裡時，就對她打電話的內容感到驚訝無比。 她在手機裡不斷地詢問她母親家裡玉米田的長勢，而那個地方離首都還有幾個小時車程。

en: A nurse, Wangari counts on income from farming to raise money to buy more land – for more farming.
zh: 作為一名護士，尤妮斯希望用種地所賺來的錢來購買更多土地 — — 然後再種更多的地。

en: Even though Wangari lives in Kenya’s capital, she is able to reap hundreds of dollars a year in profit from cash crops grown with the help of relatives.
zh: 雖然生活在肯亞首都，但尤妮斯每年都能在親戚幫助下從經濟作物種植中獲利數百美元。

en: Her initial stake – drawn from her nursing wages of about $350 a month – has long since been recovered.
zh: 而啟動資金則是她當護士每月約350美元工資 — — 不過這筆本錢早就收回來了。

en: Wangari is one of thousands of urban workers in Kenya – and one of hundreds of thousands, even millions, across Africa – who are increasing their incomes through absentee agriculture.
zh: 尤妮斯是成千上萬名生活在肯亞的“城市農夫”中的一員 — — 而在非洲大陸則有數十萬到數百萬這樣的人 — — 他們靠“遠端”務農來增加自己的收入。

en: With prices for basic foodstuffs at their highest levels in decades, many urbanites feel well rewarded by farming.
zh: 由於基礎食品的價格達到了幾十年中來的最高水平，許多城裡人都覺得靠務農來掙錢還是報酬頗豐的。

en: Absentee agriculture also bolsters national pride – and pride in traditional diets – by specializing in vegetables specific to the region.
zh: 遠端務農也因此增強了人們的民族自豪感，同時也並透過對某些地區特產蔬菜的關注而提升了對傳統飲食的自豪感。

en: “For too long our country has been flooded with imported food and Westernized foods,” Wangari says. “This is our time to fight back – and grow our own.”
zh: “進口食品和西式食物已經在我們國家氾濫太久了 ” ， 尤妮斯說 ， “ 現在是我們發起反擊，種植自己的食物的時候了。

en: Across Africa, political leaders, long dismissive of rural concerns, have awakened to the importance of agriculture and the role that educated people, even those living in major cities, can play in farming.
zh: 在經歷了對農村地區的長期不重視之後，整個非洲大陸的領導人都悟到了農業的重要性，並意識到那些受過教育的人們，即使是在主要城市裡謀生，也可以在農業中扮演一個角色。

en: In Nigeria, former President Olusegun Obasanjo has a huge diversified farm and has pushed for policies to help absentee farmers prosper.
zh: 在奈及利亞，前總統奧盧塞貢·奧巴桑喬就擁有一個從事多種經營的巨大農場，並推行一系列政策來幫助那些遠端農夫成功創業。

en: In Uganda, Vice President Gilbert Bukenya routinely travels the country, promoting higher-value farming, such as dairy production.
zh: 在烏干達，副總統吉爾伯特·布坎尼亞在全國例行走訪途中也著力推廣更高價值的農業經營方式，比如奶製品生產。

en: Perhaps the most visible political support for absentee agriculture is in Liberia, a small West African country where civil war destroyed agriculture, rendering the population dependent on food imports, even today.
zh: 對遠距離農業給予最明確政治支援的國家大概當屬賴比瑞亞。 這個西非小國的農業在內戰中遭遇重大打擊，導致國家至今依然需要依賴進口食品來養活整個人口。

en: President Johnson-Sirleaf, recognizing that educated people could contribute much to an agriculture revival, launched her “Back to the Soil” campaign in June 2008 in large part to encourage urban dwellers to farm.
zh: 當約翰遜-瑟利夫總統意識到受過良好教育的人們能夠為農業振興貢獻很大力量時，她隨即於2008年6月啟動了“迴歸沃土”活動，尤其是鼓勵城市居民投身農業。

en: To be sure, absentee farming by elites and educated urban workers can’t solve all of Africa’s urgent food needs.
zh: 有一點可以確定，那就是由精英和受過教育的城市人所構建的遠端農業無法解決當前非洲所有迫在眉睫的食品問題。

en: Moreover, absentee farmers face unexpected problems.
zh: 此外，這些遠端農業從業者們還會遇到意想不到的難題。

en: Because they don’t visit their fields often, they rely heavily on relatives and friends.  When I decided to farm wheat for the first time this spring on leased land in my childhood village, my mother agreed to supervise plowing, planting, and harvesting.
zh: 因為無法經常去地裡檢視，他們很大程度上只能依賴自己的親戚朋友去照看田地。 今年春天，當我在從小長大的鄉村裡租了一塊地並決定種一些小麥時，我母親答應幫我定期檢視播種、澆水和施肥的情況。

en: Without her help, I might not have farmed at all.
zh: 如果沒有她的幫助，我也許根本無法進行耕作。

en: Even with mother’s help, I have worries.
zh: 但即使在母親的幫助下我依然有諸多擔憂。

en: Although I grew up around wheat fields, my knowledge of farming is thin.
zh: 雖然自小在麥田周圍長大，可我關於農耕的知識卻十分貧瘠。

en: Fertilizer and spraying were both more expensive than I thought.
zh: 肥料和殺蟲劑的價格都比我想象的要貴。

en: While my wheat stalks are sprouting on schedule, I now fear that at harvest time – in November – prices will fall and I won’t recoup my costs.
zh: 當一棵棵麥苗正按部就班地發芽時，我卻開始擔心到了11月收穫時小麥價格會跌，那我就連本都收不回來了。

en: One key tool is the mobile phone.
zh: 這時最關鍵的工具就是手機。

en: My hopes for success are buoyed by my ability to call my mother inexpensively and discuss the farm.
zh: 我重新浮現出對成功的希冀，因為我能給母親打電話同她商量農場的事情，電話費也不貴。

en: We even decided over the phone what kind of pesticide to use and which tractor company to hire.
zh: 我們甚至在通話中決定用哪種殺蟲劑以及僱傭哪家拖拉機公司。

en: Because they know both the tastes of fellow city dwellers and rural conditions, many urban farmers are succeeding.
zh: 由於這些城市農夫對城市居民的喜好以及農村的狀況都很熟悉，所以其中許多人都取得了成功。

en: In fact, some city dwellers don’t even bother with acquiring land or gaining distant help. Certain crops can be grown in their own homes.
zh: 事實上，一些城市居民根本無需擔心購買土地或者獲取遠端協助的問題，因為一些特定種類的農作物在他們自己家中就可種植。

en: James Memusi, an accountant, grows mushrooms in a spare bedroom, selling them to nearby hotels and supermarkets.
zh: 會計師詹姆斯·麥姆錫就利用家裡一間空臥室種植蘑菇，並將收穫賣給臨近的飯店和超市。

en: Nevertheless, most people living in Africa’s cities have access to land in the countryside, which is why Liberia’s government rightly highlights the potential for farm expansion.
zh: 不過大多數住在非洲城市裡的人都有辦法在農村弄到土地，這就是為什麼賴比瑞亞政府如此肯定地強調農業的拓展潛力。

en: In a new advertising campaign rolled out this summer, the authorities declared, “The soil is a bank; invest in it.”
zh: 在今年夏天發起的一項新運動的推廣中，官方就是這樣宣傳的 ： “ 土地就是座銀行，往裡面投資吧！ ”

en: In Liberia, the main push is to reduce imports of staples such as rice and tomatoes.
zh: 在賴比瑞亞，主要動力是為了降低類似大米和西紅柿等主食的進口額。

en: In more prosperous countries, African elites are motivated by a complex interplay of national pride, dietary concerns, and the pursuit of profit.
zh: 而在一些更為富裕的國家，非洲的精英們被相互作用的複雜原因驅動著，這些原因之中既摻雜國家自豪感和對食品短缺的擔憂，又出於利益的驅使。

en: In Zambia, for example, Sylva Banda ignited a craze for authentic traditional meals two decades ago with a chain of popular restaurants.
zh: 比方說希爾維亞·班達20年前在尚比亞開了一系列廣受喜愛的餐館，用真正的本地菜引領起一股時尚潮流。

en: Now, ordinary Lusakans want to cook similar meals in their own homes, driving demand for farmers who produce such delicacies as dried pumpkin, “black jack” leaves, and fresh Okra.
zh: 而現在，普通盧薩卡市民也想要在家中自己烹飪相似的菜餚，這就需要越來越多的農民們去生產更多的精細食品，比如南瓜幹 、 “ 黑傑克”菜葉和新鮮秋葵。

en: Similarly, in Nairobi, Miringo Kinyanjui, another woman entrepreneur, is supplying unrefined – and more nutritious – maize and wheat flour.
zh: 類似的，在內羅畢有一位名叫米林格·金亞朱尼的女企業家正在生產更有營養的粗磨玉米麵和小麥粉。

en: In another move to distinguish her ingredients from Western versions, Kinyanjui also sells through grocery stores flour flavored with Amarathan, a green vegetable that grows around Kenya.
zh: 而將她供應的食品同西方食品進一步區分開來的則是金亞朱尼同樣透過食品店售賣一種“阿瑪拉桑”口味的麵粉，而“阿瑪拉桑”是一種在肯亞全國都有種植的綠色蔬菜類植物。

en: The revival of traditional foods has attracted the attention of large multinational corporations.
zh: 傳統食品的重新流行吸引了許多跨國公司的注意。

en: Last year, Unilever’s Kenyan branch ran a “taste our culture” campaign in support of its line of traditional East African herbs and spices.
zh: 就在去年，聯合利華公司駐肯亞的子公司就啟動了一項“品嚐我們的文化”活動來推廣他們混合了東非香草和香料的一系列產品。

en: Such campaigns go hand-in-hand with expanded farming, because sellers of these foods prefer nearby growers – even if these growers increasingly live in the city.
zh: 這些活動都與農業規模的擴大緊密相關，因為這些賣家都更偏愛臨近的種植者，即便這些“農夫”越來越都是些城裡人。

en: Building Africa’s Scientific Talent
zh: 培養非洲的科學人才

en: TORONTO – Ten years ago, South African physicist Neil Turok made a bold prediction: the world’s next Einstein will be from Africa.
zh: 發自多倫多 — — 十年前，南非物理學家尼爾·圖羅克（Neil Turok）做出了一個大膽的預言：下一位愛因斯坦將來自於非洲。

en: A decade later, it is worth considering whether the continent is any closer to finding the next global genius.
zh: 如今十年已過，也是時候思考一下非洲大陸是否更接近於誕生下一個全球性天才了。

en: Statistically, there is indeed a high probability that it will happen.
zh: 從統計上來說這確實很有可能。

en: By 2050, 40% of the world’s young people will be African.
zh: 到2050年，世界上40％的年輕人將是非洲人。

en: By virtue of demographics alone, it stands to reason that Africa is destined to generate prodigies in science or technology.
zh: 僅就人口結構統計資料來看，非洲註定會產生眾多科學技術方面的神童。

en: Africans have led the world in science before.
zh: 非洲人曾一度在科學上領先世界。

en: In fact, some of humanity’s greatest innovations – from vaccines to brain surgery – were pioneered by Africans.
zh: 事實上，一些人類最偉大的創新 — — 從疫苗到腦手術 — — 都是由非洲人開創的。

en: One of the oldest measuring devices ever used, the Lebombo Bone, was carved by people believed to have lived some 35,000 years ago in modern-day eSwatini (Swaziland).
zh: 迄今為止發現的最古老測量裝置之一列彭波骨（Lebombo bone）被考證為大約3.5萬年前生活在當今伊斯瓦蒂尼（原名史瓦濟蘭）的人類所造。

en: In other words, mathematics itself is an African invention.
zh: 換句話說，數學本身就是非洲的發明。

en: For decades, science and policy luminaries like Calestous Juma, a global advocate for science-driven sustainable development, and Wangari Maathai, an environmental activist and Nobel laureate, championed Africa’s science agenda.
zh: 幾十年來，眾多科學和政策傑出人物 — — 比如以科學為導向的可持續發展的全球倡導者卡萊斯圖斯·尤馬（Calestous Juma）以及環境事務活動家和諾貝爾獎獲得者旺加里·馬塔伊（Wangari Maathai ） — —都支援非洲的科學議程。

en: With these visionaries now gone, Africa needs a new brain trust to inspire future generations of ethical and public-spirited researchers.
zh: 隨著這些有遠見者紛紛離世，非洲需要一批新智囊團來激勵未來一代具備道德和公益精神的研究人員。

en: But how do we ensure Africa discovers, supports, and develops innovative, game-changing scientists?
zh: 但是我們如何確保非洲能去發現，支援和培養出那些改變遊戲規則的創新科學家？

en: The missing element has been an African education system that supports innovation in research, and that provides the next African revolutionary scientist with the training and support he or she needs – in Africa.
zh: 而缺失的因素其實是一套支援研究創新，可以 — — 而且是在非洲本地 — — 為下一位革命性非洲科學家提供他或她所需要的培訓和支援的非洲教育體系。

en: Across the continent, there is a growing consensus among governments that education and research in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) is critical for economic growth and development.
zh: 縱觀整個非洲大陸，各國政府已經日漸形成了共識，認定科學，技術，工程和數學的教育和研究對經濟增長和發展至關重要。

en: At the moment, however, too many of Africa’s young researchers see no option but to go abroad for school and work.
zh: 然而目前非洲的許多年輕研究人員別無選擇，只能出國學習和工作。

en: That can change, but only with concrete investments in homegrown talent.
zh: 這個局面可以被改變，但只能透過對本土人才的切實投資來改變。
