en: This means rethinking the entire education system in Africa.
zh: 這意味著要對整個非洲教育體系進行重新思考。

en: Three priorities stand out.
zh: 而其中有三個事項必須優先解決

en: First, African countries need to fix the knowledge pipeline.
zh: 首先，非洲國家需要修復知識輸送管道。

en: That means investing in teacher training, improved learning outcomes, retention of girls in STEM courses, supporting research earlier in university, helping young researchers through so-called sandwich programs, establishing university-private sector labs on campus, and more.
zh: 這意味著投資教師培訓，提高學習成果，保留科技工程學科中的女生，為大學研究的初級階段提供支援，透過所謂的三明治計劃幫扶年輕研究人員，在校園內建立大學-私營部門實驗室等多項舉措。

en: Second, Africa needs indigenous knowledge creation.
zh: 其次，非洲需要實現立足本地的知識創造。

en: This requires facilitating both fundamental and applied research and creating the necessary infrastructure for the dissemination of research outcomes.
zh: 這需要同時促進基礎和應用研究，併為研究成果的傳播創造必要的基礎設施。

en: This could include making more funding available to researchers and research institutions, as well as promoting open sources for knowledge sharing.
zh: 這將包括為研究人員和研究機構提供更多資金以及推動開源性的知識共享。

en: The third priority is putting knowledge into practice.
zh: 第三個優先事項是將知識付諸實踐。

en: This could involve making scientific information accessible to the general public and innovators, and supporting public-private partnerships to pilot, demonstrate, and apply research outcomes, thereby creating jobs addressing public problems.
zh: 這可能涉及向公眾和創新者提供科學資訊，並支援公私夥伴關係去試驗，展示和應用相關研究成果，從而創造一批專門應對公共問題的就業崗位。

en: A good example is Zipline, which deploys drone technology to deliver blood transfusions to remote areas of Rwanda.
zh: 對此滑索公司（Zipline）就是一個很好的例子，它採用無人機向盧安達的偏遠地區輸送血液。

en: To deploy this technology, which is based on American research but piloted in-country, Zipline signed agreements with the aviation authority and the ministry of health, among others, and a public-private partnership was set up to fund the program.
zh: 為了部署這項基於美國研究但在盧安達試行的技術，滑索與航空管理局和衛生部等簽署了協議並建立了公私合作伙伴關係以資助該計劃。

en: After successfully deploying the technology in Rwanda, it is currently being rolled out in Ghana.
zh: 該技術在盧安達成功部署後目前正被引入迦納。

en: Zipline has saved hundreds of lives and demonstrated the potential of technology transfer with large-scale impact.
zh: 它挽救了數百人的生命，並展示了具備大規模影響力的技術轉讓所能發揮出來的潛力。

en: The Next Einstein Forum (NEF), an initiative of the African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) and the brainchild of Turok, supported partly by the Mastercard Foundation, is demonstrating that Africa produces strong scientific talent.
zh: 由非洲數學科學研究所倡導建立的下一位愛因斯坦論壇（The Next Einstein Forum ） — —也是圖羅克的創意並由萬事達基金會提供部分支援 — — 表明非洲能產生出高階科學人才。

en: The NEF focuses on convening Africa’s innovators to highlight breakthrough discoveries and catalyze scientific collaboration for human development.
zh: 論壇致力於召集非洲的創新者去彰顯突破性發現並促進人類發展方面的科學合作。

en: Since the first cohort of NEF Fellows was selected in 2015, the program has highlighted the contributions of young African researchers who are working to tackle some of the world’s toughest scientific and technological challenges.
zh: 自2015年甄選出第一批論壇研究員以來，論壇已經將許多致力於解決世界最棘手科技挑戰的非洲年輕研究人員的貢獻宣揚於世。

en: NEF’s current cohort includes Somalia’s Abdigani Diriye, who created a blockchain-enabled lending platform in Kenya and was recently named one of Africa’s top 30 innovators; Nigeria’s Peter Ngene, whose work on nanotechnologies is being used to improve renewable energy and who also recently created a hydrogen-based eye sensor that detects lactose intolerance; and Vinet Coetzee of South Africa, whose research in non-invasive measures of health has led to a patent application for a device that could detect malaria.
zh: 論壇目前的研究隊伍包括來自索馬利亞的阿布迪加尼·迪裡耶（Abdigani Diriye ） ， 他在肯亞建立了一個以區塊鏈為基礎的貸款平臺，最近被評為非洲30大創新者之一；來自奈及利亞的彼得·涅訥（Peter Ngene ） ， 他在奈米技術方面的工作正用於改進可再生能源，最近還創造了一種能夠檢測乳糖不耐受症的氫基眼感測器；還有南非的文奈特·科特茲（Vinet Coetzee ） ， 他在非侵入性健康測量方面的研究已經產生了一項瘧疾檢測裝置的專利。

en: With so many complex issues vying for attention today, Africa will need innovative education and research models.
zh: 在有許多複雜問題都要得到關注的今天，非洲需要整套創新的教育和研究模式。

en: But as long as the NEF and similar efforts continue to nurture the continent’s brightest young scientists and tackle systemic issues like funding, mobility, and research infrastructure, the odds are good that those leading the search for solutions will be the very people Turok predicted.
zh: 但只要下一位愛因斯坦論壇和類似的專案繼續對非洲大陸那些最聰明的年輕科學家加以培養並解決諸如資金，流動性和研究基礎設施等系統性問題，那麼解決方案研究的學術帶頭人中就很可能湧現出圖羅克預言中的下一位愛因斯坦。

en: Improving African Women’s Health Through Financial Inclusion
zh: 透過金融包容改善非洲女性健康

en: ACCRA – In late October, the World Health Organization’s Regional Office for Africa signed an agreement with the United Nations International Telecommunication Union (ITU).
zh: 阿克拉—去年10月，世界衛生組織非洲地區辦公室與聯合國國際電信聯盟（ITU）簽署了一份協議。

en: The aim of the unlikely partnership is to encourage the use of digital services “to save lives and improve people’s health.”
zh: 這一看似不可能的合作關係的目標是鼓勵使用數字服務“拯救生命、改善人民健康 ” 。

en: But perhaps the pact’s most innovative feature is the vow to merge financial inclusion strategies with modern health-care delivery.
zh: 但也許該協議最具創新性的部分在於它承諾將金融包容策略與現代醫療服務相結合。

en: Financial inclusion is a proven pathway to improving people’s health, especially the health of women in developing countries.
zh: 金融包容是證實了的改善人民健康的有效方法，特別是發展中國家女性的健康。

en: Women who can easily access bank accounts or cash payment options tend to invest more in their businesses and families.
zh: 能夠輕鬆獲得銀行賬戶或現金支付選項的女性，往往會為她們的企業和家庭投入更多。

en: In turn, they live healthier, more satisfying lives.
zh: 反過來，她們也生活得更健康、更滿足。

en: Yet, too often, initiatives like the one signed in October focus on one or the other – e-health or financial products like insurance.
zh: 但是，常常發生的情況是，類似10月份簽署的協議這樣的計劃，總是關注其中之一 — — 電子健康（e-health）或金融產品（如保險 ） 。

en: Because Africans’ ability to earn and save money can be the difference between good care and no care at all, this represents a missed opportunity to help patients and build more resilient communities.
zh: 非洲人賺錢和存錢的能力決定了他能獲得好醫療還是根本看不起病，因此這是一個被錯過的幫助患者、構建恢復力更強的社會的機會。

en: The cost of this choice is disproportionately high for Africa’s women.
zh: 這一選擇給非洲女性造成的代價尤其高昂。

en: In Nigeria, for example, 400,000 women live with obstetric fistula, a disabling condition often caused by complications in childbirth.
zh: 比如，在奈及利亞，有400,000女性身患產瘻，這是一種致殘的分娩併發症。

en: In Tanzania, some 8,000 women die annually during pregnancy or delivery; most of these deaths could be prevented.
zh: 在坦尚尼亞，每年都有大約8,000女性死於妊娠或分娩；這些死亡大部分是可以避免的。

en: And, across the continent, women’s life expectancy at birth is just 58 years, compared to more than 80 years in developed countries.
zh: 而就整個非洲而言，女性出生壽命預期只有58年，而發達國家高達80多年。

en: Progress is being made to connect women’s health solutions and financial inclusion.
zh: 人們正在努力將女性健康方案與金融包容聯絡起來，並在不斷取得進步。

en: At a recent conference in Dar es Salaam, experts from the technology and financial services sector joined investors, philanthropists, and development specialists to devise ways to make finance work for Africa’s women.
zh: 在達累斯薩拉姆舉行的最新會議上，來自科技和金融服務業的專家與投資者、慈善家和發展專家一起為非洲女性制定金融工作方法。

en: Through programs like these, development experts can advocate for digital solutions as a means of social and financial empowerment.
zh: 透過類似於此的計劃，發展專家能夠宣傳作為社會和金融賦權手段的數字方案。

en: Unfortunately, cooperation like the pact signed in October is the exception, rather than the norm.
zh: 不幸的是，類似於10月所簽署的協議的合作計劃只是例外，而不是常例。

en: Banks, regulators, finance ministries, and telecommunications companies all frequently gather to consider financial inclusion without the local and global health community.
zh: 銀行、監管者、財政部門和電信企業都在頻繁開會討論金融包容性，但並沒有將本地和全球醫療界包括進去。

en: This must change if we are to build more inclusive platforms for African patients and clients.
zh: 如果我們想要為非洲患者和客戶建立更加包容性的平臺，這一點必須改變。

en: The first step is to identify missed opportunities.
zh: 第一步是認識錯失的機會。

en: A big one stems from the disparate approaches to bringing financial services and digitized health care to rural parts of Africa.
zh: 一個大機會是採取不同方法將金融服務和數字化醫療服務推廣到非洲農村地區。

en: At the moment, banks and mobile network operators are working to expand their digital banking services to unbanked and under-banked clients.
zh: 目前，銀行和行動網路運營商正致力於擴大數字銀行服務，以覆蓋沒有銀行賬戶或銀行服務不足的客戶。

en: At the same time, community health workers (CHWs) are operating in these regions to prevent, treat, and refer patients to clinics.
zh: 與此同時，社群衛生工作者（CHW）正在這些地區展開預防、治療和分診工作。

en: Combining these efforts makes sense, because both initiatives rely heavily on trust.
zh: 將這些措施相結合非常有意義，因為兩項計劃都非常依賴信任。

en: Through pre-established networks, CHWs could augment their e-health offerings with financial products, like mobile cash payment systems.
zh: 透過預先構建的網路，CHW能夠利用金融產品，如移動現金支付系統來擴大電子健康服務覆蓋面。

en: Broadening digital disease management and access to health information to include financial wellbeing would create natural synergies.
zh: 擴大數字疾病管理和健康資訊普及以納入金融福祉能產生自然的協同效應。

en: While there are some concerns that adding responsibilities to CHWs could undermine health-care quality, a fragmented approach to prosperity is even more damaging.
zh: 有人擔心增加CHW的責任會拖累醫療質量，但碎片化的繁榮觀弊端更大。

en: Once opportunities for expansion are identified, other issues will need to be addressed before women’s health and financial inclusion programs can be widened.
zh: 在認識到擴大的機會後，在女性健康和金融包容性計劃得到推廣之前，還需要解決其他問題。

en: For starters, a lack of sex-disaggregated data makes it difficult to draft policies based on health quality and financial need.
zh: 首先，缺乏按性別區分的資料導致難以根據健康質量和金融需要來制定政策。

en: Although some countries, such as Burundi and Senegal, are working to improve their gender-specific data collection, a broader, more coordinated push is needed.
zh: 儘管蒲隆地和塞內加爾等國家正致力於改善具體的性別資料收集，但仍需要範圍更廣、更具協作性的計劃。

en: Raising the region’s financial literacy will be another challenge.
zh: 增進地區的金融知識是另一項挑戰。

en: The ability to understand and execute matters of personal finance is the weakest link in transforming women’s opportunities through financial inclusion.
zh: 理解和執行個人金融事務的能力是透過金融包容改變女性機會的鏈條上的最弱一環。

en: Moreover, financial literacy is a pre-requisite for the rollout of financing initiatives, such as programs that support women-led small and micro-enterprises.
zh: 此外，金融知識是啟動融資計劃 — — 如支援女性領導的小微企業 — — 的先決條件。

en: If financial literacy levels can be raised, women can access resources such as land and credit, tools that hold the keys to business development, social mobility, and personal growth.
zh: 如果能夠提升金融知識水平，女性就能獲得土地和信用等資源，這些工具是商業發展、社會流動性和個人成長的關鍵。

en: Progress has been made in leveling the playing field, but these gains must be sustained.
zh: 在構建公平競技場方面，我們取得了一些進步，但必須保持勢頭。

en: The agreement between the WHO and the ITU will help promote wealth creation in parts of Africa where access to health care and financial services is lacking.
zh: 世衛組織和ITU的協議有助於促進缺乏醫療和金融服務的非洲地區的財富創造。

en: To maintain this momentum, deeper commitments are needed, especially from the global health community.
zh: 要保持這一勢頭，需要更深度的承諾，特別是來自全球醫療界的承諾。

en: But, however African governments proceed in digitizing their health and financial services offerings, women’s needs must remain at the center of any solution.
zh: 但是，不論非洲各國政府如何推進健康和金融服務數字化，女性的需要都必須作為他們的方案的核心。

en: Closing the Youth Apathy Gap
zh: 填補青年冷漠缺口

en: NAIROBI – When the United Nations’ member countries adopted the Sustainable Development Goals two years ago, they committed themselves to reduce substantially “the proportion of youth not in employment, education, or training.”
zh: 內羅畢—兩年前，聯合國成員國採納可持續發展目標（SDG）時，它們自我承諾要可持續地減少“被排除在就業、教育和培訓之外的青年的比例 ” 。

en: That commitment will be virtually impossible to fulfill, unless political participation by young people increases considerably.
zh: 除非年輕人的政治參與能夠顯著增長，否則這一承諾幾乎不可能實現。

en: Young people are critical to progress.
zh: 年輕人是進步的關鍵。

en: As US President Barack Obama put it in a 2015 speech in Nairobi, “no country can achieve its full potential unless it draws on the talents of all its people.”
zh: 美國總統巴拉克在2015 年的內羅畢演講中指出 ， “ 除非一個國家能夠依賴全體人民的才華，否則它就無法實現全部潛能。

en: And youth now comprise a large share of those people – 18% of the world’s population, to be precise.
zh: ”如今，青年構成了這些人民中的很大一部分 — — 準確地說，他們佔據了世界人口的18 % 。

en: The share is even larger in much of the developing world.
zh: 在大部分發展中國家，這個比例還會更高。

en: The median age of Africa’s population is just 19.5 years.
zh: 非洲人口的中位年齡只有19.5歲。

en: Given their numbers, not to mention rising education and literacy rates, young people can make a world of difference, shaping political discourse and electoral outcomes.
zh: 從這些資料看 — — 更不用說不斷提高的教育水平和識字率了 — — 年輕人能夠改變世界，影響政治程序和選舉結果。

en: But that requires them to be engaged and active.
zh: 但這需要他們參與和活躍。

en: In the United Kingdom, most young people wish to remain in the European Union.
zh: 在英國，大部分年輕人想要留在歐盟。

en: As a Lord Ashcroft poll showed, 73% of those aged 18-24, and 62% of those aged 25-34, voted accordingly in last year’s referendum.
zh: 阿什克羅夫特勳爵（Lord Ashcroft）調查表明，73%的18—24歲群體，以及62%的25—34歲群體，在去年的全民公決中投票贊成留歐。

en: But most young British did not actually show up to cast their votes, allowing the UK’s older, predominantly pro-Brexit cohorts to win the day.
zh: 但大部分英國年輕人實際上並沒有行使投票權，這使得英國年長者 — — 他們大多支援退歐 — — 贏得了勝利。

en: Presumably having learned their lesson from the Brexit referendum, young Britons contributed to an unexpected victory for Labour in June’s snap general election.
zh: 想必是從退歐公投中汲取了教訓，英國年輕人在6月份的臨時大選中幫助工黨贏得了出人意料的勝利。

en: In Kenya’s presidential election, held last month, 51% of registered voters were below the age of 35 years.
zh: 在上個月舉行的肯亞總統選舉中，51%的註冊選民年齡低於35歲。

en: Although the Supreme Court annulled the results and ordered a fresh vote, owing to electoral irregularities and illegalities, large numbers of young people are likely to turn out again.
zh: 儘管最高法院因為選舉違規和違法行為推翻了結果，勒令重新投票，但大量年輕人可能會再次走向投票箱。

en: Unfortunately, Kenya is the exception that proves the rule.
zh: 不幸的是，肯亞只是一個證明了規則的例外。

en: Political apathy among young people, like that seen in the Brexit referendum, remains pervasive worldwide.
zh: 年輕人的政治冷漠 — — 就像英國退歐公投所表現的那樣 — — 仍然在全球範圍內普遍存在。

en: In many regions of Africa, for example, young people are disillusioned with politics, convinced that wealthy older people will always prevail and advance their own interests, often at the expense of younger generations.
zh: 比如，在非洲大部，年輕人對政治早已幻滅，認定勝者永遠是富有的年長者，他們推動自己的利益，犧牲年輕一代的利益。

en: This sense of disempowerment is threatening to turn the developing world’s youth bulge into a youth curse – with serious potential consequences.
zh: 這種失權（disempowerment）感有可能讓發展中世界的青年膨脹（youth bulge，即青年占人口多數的現象）演變為青年詛咒 — — 並帶來嚴重的潛在後果。

en: The Arab Spring uprisings, which led to violence and instability in most affected countries, were fueled largely by desperate young people demanding rights and opportunities.
zh: 阿拉伯之春暴亂導致了大部分受影響國家陷入暴力和動盪，其背後的主要推動力正是絕望的年輕人要求權利和機會。

en: To avoid such outcomes, young people need to be part of their countries’ political life, able to advance their own vision of the future.
zh: 要避免這樣的結果，年輕人必須成為國家政治生活的一部分，能夠推動他們自己的未來願景。

en: As young Kenyans repeated during the recent election campaign, “If you are not at the table, you are on the menu.”
zh: 就像肯亞年輕人在最近的選戰中一再強調的 ， “ 不入廟堂，便為魚肉。 ”

en: So what can be done to increase political awareness and participation among young people?
zh: 那麼，如何提高年輕人的政治意識和參與呢？

en: In Kenya, government efforts have focused on the creation of three institutions: the Ministry of Public Service, Youth, and Gender Affairs, the Youth Enterprise Development Fund, and the National Youth Council.
zh: 在肯亞，政府措施的重點是建立了三個機構：公共服務、青年和性別事務部、青年創業發展基金，以及國家青年委員會。

en: Though somewhat dysfunctional, these institutions have helped to empower Kenyan youth, driving the high election turnout last month.
zh: 儘管這些機構功能未必完善，但仍有助於賦權肯亞青年，為上個月選舉的高投票率立下了功勞。

en: But perhaps the most effective approach to closing the apathy gap focuses on initiatives led by young people themselves.
zh: 但填補冷漠缺口的最有效的方針集中在由年輕人自己領導的專案上。

en: In Nigeria, young people spearheaded the Not Too Young to Run campaign, which led to a constitutional amendment lowering the minimum age for candidates.
zh: 在奈及利亞，年輕人領銜發起了“起步永不早 ” （ Not Too Young to Run）運動，該運動促使奈及利亞修改憲法，降低候選人的最低年齡。

en: Their success inspired a global campaign to support young people’s right to run for office.
zh: 他們的成功啟發了一場全球運動，支援年輕人主持政府部門的權利。

en: In Kenya, the youth-led Jiactivate– the name, which combines Swahili and English, means “Activate Yourself” – has sought to boost youth participation in politics by highlighting the main issues affecting young people.
zh: 在肯亞，青年領導的Jiactivate — — 這個名字結合了斯瓦西里語和英語，意為“啟用你自己 ” — —旨在透過強調影響年輕人的主要問題，提高青年的政治參與。

en: Jiactivate, in which I am engaged as National Chairperson, aims to serve as a platform that amplifies young Kenyans’ voices, offering them easier ways to take action.
zh: 我以全國理事長（National Chairperson）的身份參與了Jiactivate，我們的目標是充當一個放大肯亞年輕人的聲音的平臺，讓他們更加方便地採取行動。

en: To inspire more such initiatives, there must be a deliberate effort to engage with youth in a way that supports real political engagement, not tokenism and empty rhetoric.
zh: 要想啟發更多的類似專案，必須有意識地採取措施，以支援真正的政治參與的方式與年輕人合作，而不是做表面文章和空喊口號。

en: To that end, the Organisation of Africa Youth, of which I am coordinator, has not only worked with local youth groups and community networks; it has also taken lessons from a GeoPoll survey of 2,000 urban and rural Kenyan youth.
zh: 在這方面，由我擔任協調員的非洲青年組織（Organisation of Africa Youth）不但與本地青年團體和社群網路合作；還從一份覆蓋2,000名肯亞城鎮和農村青年的GeoPoll調查中總結經驗。

en: That survey showed that, while 27% of respondents had never engaged politically, 26% had attended an event and 34% had posted on social media.
zh: 這份調查表明，27%的受訪者從未參與過政治，但26%出席過政治事件，34%釋出過社交媒體。

en: Moreover, 68% of respondents said that they would participate in political action only if they had access to a safe and trusted platform that would protect them from victimization, intimidation, or reprimand.
zh: 此外，68%的受訪者說，只有在能夠獲得安全和可信任的平臺渠道，能夠保證他們不受傷害、恐嚇和懲戒的情況下，才會參與政治活動。

en: One lesson than can be drawn from these data is the potential value of social media, which, despite being constrained in many countries during elections, remains a potent tool to facilitate youth political engagement.
zh: 從這些資料中，我們可以總結一個經驗，即，儘管社交媒體在許多國家的選舉期間飽受遏制，它仍然是便利青年參與政治的有力工具。

en: For example, by creatively using social media to collect, collate, and amplify young people’s priorities in the Kenyan elections, Jiactivate helped spur their interest in politics.
zh: 比如，Jiactivate創造性地利用社交媒體收集、整理和放大年輕人在肯亞選舉中的重點關注點，提高了他們對政治的興趣。

en: Nonetheless, many Kenyans who were popular on social media did not make much of an impact on the election’s outcome.
zh: 儘管如此，許多在社交媒體上廣受歡迎的肯亞人，並沒有對選舉結果產生多少影響。

en: Translating social media energy into effective action in the real world remains a daunting challenge.
zh: 將社交媒體的能量轉化為真實世界中的有效行動仍然是一個艱鉅的挑戰。

en: Increasing youth involvement in politics will require sustained commitment and hard work.
zh: 提高青年的政治參與度需要持續的努力和艱苦奮鬥。

en: But, far from a deterrent, this should serve as a powerful incentive to get started.
zh: 但是，這不應該成為阻力，而應該成為刺激我們開始行動的強大動力。

en: No one is more affected by past, present, and future policies than young people.
zh: 年輕人是受過去、現在和未來政策影響最大的群體。

en: They must take their seat at the table, not wait until one is offered.
zh: 他們必須躋身廟堂，而不能坐等施捨。

en: The Transformative Power of Africa’s Youth
zh: 非洲青年的變革力量

en: TORONTO – A few years ago, during a conversation with young people from some of Senegal’s poorest communities, a pair of social entrepreneurs told me about projects they were working on to help their peers succeed.
zh: 多倫多 — — 幾年前，在與塞內加爾某些最貧困社群的年輕人交談時，兩位社會企業家對我講述了他們正在進行的幫助同齡人取得成功的專案。

en: One young man said he planned to put more computers into primary schools; another had set up a network to connect rural job seekers in the urban tumult of Dakar, Senegal’s capital.
zh: 其中一位年輕人說他計劃為小學配備更多電腦；另外一位則在塞內加爾首都達卡爾的城市混亂中建立起了聯絡農村求職者的網路。

en: After they finished sharing their plans, I congratulated them, and said that their parents must be very proud.
zh: 在聽完他們的計劃後，我對他們表示祝賀，說他們的父母肯定是非常自豪的。

en: But instead of accepting the compliment, they demurred.
zh: 但他們非但沒有接受讚美，反而陷入了沉默。

en: “My parents are against what I’m doing,” they said, almost in unison, before explaining that young people face family pressure to get a government job or use their English skills to work as a tour guide – not to become a risk-taking entrepreneur.
zh: “我的父母反對我在做的事 ， ” 他們幾乎異口同聲的說，而後他們對我解釋年輕人面臨來自家庭的壓力希望找到一份政府工作或者利用自己的英語技能成為導遊 — — 而不是成為冒險的創業者。

en: For ambitious young Africans, there are many obstacles to success.
zh: 對於雄心勃勃的非洲年輕人來說，需要克服許多障礙才能取得成功。

en: The journey to a job – whether formal or informal, entrepreneurial or traditional – is often a solitary one.
zh: 無論從事正式或非正式、創業或傳統工作，求職的旅程往往都充滿了孤獨。

en: Many young people lack access to skills training or even a favorable social environment to try something new.
zh: 許多年輕人缺少技能訓練，甚至得不到有利的社會環境來嘗試新鮮事物。

en: As I was reminded that day in Senegal, helping young people find gainful employment is the most important thing that the international community can do to help Africa develop.
zh: 那天在塞內加爾的經歷提醒我，幫助年輕人找到有價值的工作是國際社會能夠幫助非洲發展的最重要的事務。

en: Africa is home to the world’s largest population of young people.
zh: 非洲擁有全世界數量最大的年輕人口。

en: In about 25 years, those young people will be part of the biggest workforce in the world, with more than 1.1 billion people of working age.
zh: 在未來25年間，這些年輕人將成為世界勞動大軍的主力，其中有超過11億工作年齡人口。

en: By some forecasts, 11 million people will enter Africa’s labor market each year for the next decade, most of whom will be first-time job seekers.
zh: 某些預測認為，未來十年，每年將有一千一百萬人進入非洲勞動力市場，其中絕大多數都是首次求職者。

en: If African countries boost job growth and equip young people with employable skills, this youth bulge can deliver rapid, inclusive, and sustainable economic growth to the continent.
zh: 如果非洲國家促進就業增長並用就業技能武裝年輕人，這股年輕人大潮可以為非洲大陸帶來快速、包容和可持續的經濟增長。

en: In turn, millions would have the opportunity to lift themselves out of poverty.
zh: 反過來，成百上千萬人或許有機會擺脫貧困。

en: But Africa cannot achieve this future alone.
zh: 但非洲無法憑藉一己之力實現這樣的未來目標。

en: At the Mastercard Foundation, we believe that, if Africa is to reach its potential, gaps in two keys areas must be closed.
zh: 在萬事達基金會，我們認為如果想讓非洲充分發揮其潛力，那麼有兩大關鍵領域的差距必須得到彌補。

en: The first area is access to financial products and services.
zh: 第一個領域是獲取金融產品和服務。

en: According to the World Bank, some two billion people around the world currently lack such access.
zh: 據世界銀行統計，世界各地約有20億人目前無法獲得金融產品和服務。

en: In Sub-Saharan Africa, just 34% of adults have a bank account, making it difficult for people to put money aside for unplanned events, like a bad harvest, or to save for school.
zh: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地區，僅有34%的成年人擁有銀行戶頭，這種狀況為人們儲蓄資金以備不時之需帶來了困難，比如遇到農作物歉收或者為了積攢學費的需要。

en: This must change, with Africans gaining not only better access to banking systems, but also improved financial literacy.
zh: 這種狀況必須改變，非洲民眾不僅應當擁有更好的金融系統，而且應當提高金融素養。

en: The second key challenge that must be addressed is exclusion from secondary and higher education.
zh: 必須解決的第二個關鍵問題是排斥中等和高等教育。

en: While progress has been made in some regions, only about one-third of Africa’s young people graduate from high school.
zh: 儘管某些地區已經取得了進展，但從高中畢業的年輕人僅佔約三分之一左右。

en: Girls are particularly disadvantaged; according to UNESCO, in Sub-Saharan Africa, an estimated nine million girls under the age of 11 have never been to school, compared to six million boys.
zh: 這方面女孩兒尤其弱勢；據聯合國教科文組織統計，在撒哈拉以南非洲地區，估計有900萬11歲以下女童從未接受過學校教育，而從未上過學的男童僅有600萬左右。

en: To address these issues, the Mastercard Foundation has established partnerships with local organizations to design education and financial-literacy programs aimed at helping young people find and keep jobs.
zh: 為了解決這些問題，萬事達基金會已經與當地組織建立了合作，目的是設計幫助年輕人找到並保住工作崗位的教育和金融素質專案。

en: By building a better-trained workforce, the Foundation’s programs are helping to empower the next generation of Africa’s community members and leaders, so that they can help their families, communities, and countries achieve a brighter and more prosperous future.
zh: 透過建設更加訓練有素的勞動隊伍，萬事達基金會專案正在協助授權下一代非洲的社群成員和領導者，以便他們能夠幫助自己的家庭、社群和國家實現更加光明和繁榮的未來。

en: Already, a new generation of educated and ethical entrepreneurs, like those I met in Senegal, is emerging across Africa, demonstrating a profound commitment to building a stronger Africa.
zh: 就像我在塞內加爾所遇到的那樣，非洲各地正在湧現新一代受過教育且講道德的企業家，體現了建設更強大非洲的深遠的目標。

en: For example, when I ask young people participating in our Scholars Program what they plan to do with their new skills, they almost always reply that after getting a job, they plan to help somebody else, by returning to their secondary schools to serve as mentors to younger students.
zh: 例如，當我問及參與我們學者計劃的年輕人他們學會技能後要做些什麼，他們幾乎無一例外地回答說在找到新的工作後，他們希望能幫助他人，比如回到自己畢業的中學擔任導師輔導年輕的學生。

en: Some of our program’s graduates have even established community projects in their villages to address HIV/AIDS or to build shelters for orphans and young children.
zh: 我們課程的某些畢業生已經在自己的村裡設立了應對艾滋病毒/艾滋病的社群計劃，還有人修建了孤兒和幼兒收容機構。

en: Every one of these bright young Africans – examples of what the Mastercard Foundation calls “transformative leadership” in action – has the potential to drive change in their own countries and communities.
zh: 每個聰明的非洲年輕人 — — 萬事達基金會所謂“變革型領導者”的例項 — — 都有可能在自己的國家和社群推動變革。

en: Those of us working in the field of international development can help level the playing field even more, by giving young Africans from all backgrounds an opportunity to lead in transformative ways.
zh: 我們這些國際發展領域工作者可以協助進一步創造公平環境，賦予所有背景的非洲年輕人機會以變革的方式進行領導。

en: If we succeed, Africa’s dreamers of today will be the catalysts of positive change tomorrow.
zh: 如果我們能夠取得成功，非洲今天的夢想家將成為明天積極變革的催化力量。

en: Africa’s Defining Challenge
zh: 非洲決定性的挑戰

en: ADDIS ABABA – Africa has the youngest population in the world, and it’s growing fast.
zh: 亞的斯亞貝巴 — — 非洲有全世界最年輕的人口，而且正在快速增長之中。

en: By 2055, the continent’s youth population (aged 15-24), is expected to be more than double the 2015 total of 226 million.
zh: 到2055年，非洲大陸的年輕人口（15到24歲）預計將比2015年的總人數2.26億翻兩番以上。

en: Yet the continent remains stubbornly inhospitable – politically, economically, and socially – to young people.
zh: 但年輕人在非洲大陸卻仍然面臨著不友好的政治、經濟和社會環境。

en: The success of African governments’ efforts to address this will be the single most important factor determining whether the continent prospers or suffers in the coming decades.
zh: 非洲國家政府能否解決這一問題將成為今後幾十年非洲大陸繁榮或是蕭條的唯一最重要的決定因素。

en: A business-as-usual approach would risk exposing Africa not only to economic underperformance and a brain drain, but also to criminality, political and social unrest, and even armed conflict.
zh: 如果繼續採用一切照舊的做法，那麼非洲不僅需要面對經濟疲軟和人才外流，而且可能面對犯罪活動猖獗、政治和社會動盪乃至爆發武裝衝突。

en: But Africa can thrive if its governments act now to tap the energy and dynamism of the burgeoning youth population.
zh: 但如果非洲政府立即採取行動激發新一代年輕人的能量和活力，將會給非洲大陸帶來繁榮。

en: What is needed is a comprehensive policy agenda, comprising demographically informed measures that address political, cultural, and economic exclusion in a synchronized manner.
zh: 我們需要制定全面的政策議程，充分考慮到相關的人口因素，同步解決政治、文化和經濟領域青年人所面臨的排斥和困境。

en: This will be no small feat, not least because of the massive age gap between Africa’s young majority and their leaders: the average age of an African president is 62, while the median age of Africa’s population is 19.5.
zh: 實現這一目標絕非輕而易舉，尤其考慮到非洲絕大多數年輕人和國家領袖之間巨大的年齡落差：非洲總統的平均年齡為62歲，而非洲年輕人的中位數年齡僅為19.5歲。

en: That is the world’s largest age gap between governors and the governed, and it raises concerns about how well decision-makers understand the needs and aspirations of young people.
zh: 這創造了全世界執政者和被執政者之間最大的年齡差，並引起了人們對決策者能否理解年輕人期望和需求的擔心。

en: It does not help that a tradition of gerontocracy prevails in many countries, meaning that young people’s political participation and influence is restricted on cultural grounds.
zh: 許多國家在傳統上盛行老人政治也讓問題變得更加嚴重，這意味著年輕人的政治參與和影響力受制於文化因素。

en: To help overcome this barrier, governments should treat generational inequality with the same sense of urgency as other forms of inequality, accelerating efforts to introduce youth quotas for political parties, parliaments, and other decision-making institutions.
zh: 為克服這一障礙，非洲政府應當以解決其他不平等問題同樣的緊迫感來解決代際不平等問題，加速推進在政黨、議會和其他決策機構實行年輕人配額的工作。

en: Much work also remains to be done on the economic front.
zh: 經濟方面也還有許多工需要完成。

en: According to the African Development Bank, 12 million young people entered Africa’s labor force in 2015, but only 3.1 million jobs were created.
zh: 據非洲開發銀行統計，2015年有1，200萬年輕人加入非洲勞動者隊伍，但卻僅僅創造了310萬個就業崗位。

en: That means that millions of young people were left without a stake in the economy.
zh: 這意味著數以百萬計年輕人的一切經濟利益都被剝奪。

en: In the short and medium term, it will be virtually impossible to create enough jobs to meet the needs of the unemployed and vulnerably employed.
zh: 中短期來看，幾乎不可能創造就業機會來滿足失業和弱勢群體的就業需求。

en: Africa does not have a large labor-intensive manufacturing sector to absorb its mushrooming young population.
zh: 非洲並不具有能大量吸納年輕人口的大規模勞動密集型製造業。

en: But there are programs that can help.
zh: 但有些專案可以起到一定的緩解作用。

en: For example, YouthConnekt Africa, launched by the United Nations Development Programme and the government of Rwanda, encourages youth-friendly policies, such as access to finance and skills development, that match the needs of the market in particular countries.
zh: 比如，由聯合國開發計劃署和盧安達政府共同發起的YouthConnekt Africa計劃鼓勵對年輕人採取友善的政策，比如為他們提供融資和技能開發的機會，以滿足所在國家的市場需求。

en: Still, given the dearth of opportunities at home, many young Africans view migration as a chance for social mobility.
zh: 但鑑於國內機會的嚴重匱乏，許多非洲年輕人依靠移民來爭取社會流動性。

en: Yet, as the CEO of a major company based in Sub-Saharan Africa recently lamented to me, acquiring work visas for Africans is extremely difficult.
zh: 但撒哈拉以南非洲一家大企業的執行長最近曾對我抱怨，為非洲人爭取工作簽證是一項極其困難的任務。

en: In fact, it can be easier to get a work visa for a British citizen than for, say, a Ghanaian with the same skills.
zh: 事實上，英國公民或許能比具有同等技能的迦納公民更容易地取得工作簽證。

en: Africa’s vision for economic integration, as set out in the African Union’s Agenda 2063, cannot be realized without labor migration that creates African careers paths for young people.
zh: 如果沒有為非洲年輕人拓展職業道路的勞工移民政策，就很難實現非洲聯盟2063年議程所規劃的非洲經濟一體化的前景。

en: It is telling that so many Africans are willing to risk drowning in the Mediterranean Sea, living in appalling detention centers in North Africa, or sleeping in public parks in European cities, rather than remaining in Africa.
zh: 如此之多的非洲人寧願冒險葬身地中海、生活在北非可怕的拘留中心或者露宿歐洲城市公園，也不願留在非洲就很能說明問題。

en: Yet, contrary to popular belief, young people are not migrating from Africa exclusively for economic reasons.
zh: 但與外界的普遍認識不同，年輕人並非僅僅出於經濟原因才選擇移民。

en: Rather, they are motivated by the promise of opportunities for genuine self-improvement and the freedom to decide who to be and how to live.
zh: 相反，他們希望尋找真正的自我完善機會以及決定自我身份和生活方式的自由。

en: That is certainly what led me to leave Africa and head to Europe at a young age.
zh: 我年輕時肯定因為這些因素才離開非洲來到歐洲。

en: In fact, the desire for self-improvement through migration is a key element of the human story – one that no desert, sea, or artificial barrier has been able to quell.
zh: 事實上，透過移民實現自我完善的願望是人類經歷的一個關鍵要素 — — 任憑沙漠、海洋抑或人為的屏障都無法阻隔。

en: Political and cultural exclusion intensifies it.
zh: 政治和文化排斥加劇了這種現象。

en: Given this, any strategy that does not address the broader environment of marginalization is a bridge to nowhere.
zh: 因此，任何無法真正解決邊緣化大環境的策略都根本行不通。

en: So far, Africa seems to be sleepwalking into a future of lost opportunity and, potentially, serious instability.
zh: 到目前為止，非洲似乎在夢遊中進入到一個喪失機會、而且可能極端不穩定的未來。

en: And Africa’s international partners have remained preoccupied with containing migration from the continent, rather than addressing its underlying causes.
zh: 而且非洲的國際夥伴似乎一直專注於限制來自非洲大陸的移民，而不是關注產生移民問題的根本理由。

en: But there may be reason for hope.
zh: 但我們仍有理由滿懷希望。

en: The fifth European Union-Africa Summit, to be held later this year, will focus squarely on the continent’s young people.
zh: 今年晚些時候即將召開的歐盟非洲首腦會議勢必將關注的重點放在非洲大陸的年輕人身上。

en: Likewise, the African Union’s theme for 2017 is “Harnessing the Demographic Dividend Through Investments in Youth.”
zh: 同樣，非盟2017年的工作主題是“透過投資年輕人挖掘非洲的人口紅利 ” 。

en: One hopes that the growing recognition of the need to create opportunities for young people leads to effective, solidarity-based initiatives that address the barriers to youth empowerment on the continent, instead of erecting barriers to prevent young people from leaving.
zh: 我們希望為有必要為年輕人創造機會的越來越清醒的認識能夠催生消除非洲大陸年輕人就業障礙的團結一致的高效舉措，並且取代那些單純透過設定障礙來防止年輕人離開的行動。

en: To paraphrase Martin Luther King, Africa confronts the fierce urgency of now.
zh: 借用馬丁·路德·金的話講，非洲現在正面臨著萬分緊急的時刻。

en: There is such a thing as being too late.
zh: 有的時候太晚就一切都來不及了。

en: Listening to Africa’s Future Farmers
zh: 聆聽非洲未來農民

en: NAIROBI – Africa is in the midst of a youth employment crisis.
zh: 內羅畢—非洲陷入了一場青年就業危機。

en: By 2035, some 350 million new jobs will be needed, and agriculture, the continent’s biggest industry, could provide the bulk of them.
zh: 到2035年，非洲需要大約3.5億個新工作崗位，其最大產業農業能夠提供其中的大部分。

en: But at the moment, young Africans are shunning life on the farm for work in the city.
zh: 但目前，非洲年輕人正在離開田間地頭，來到城市中工作。

en: If Africa’s employment gap is to be closed, agribusinesses must find ways to recruit younger hands.
zh: 要想填補非洲就業缺口，農業企業必須設法招募更年輕的人手。

en: This challenge was the focus of my research as part of the Youth Think Tank, a youth-led research initiative in partnership with Restless Development Uganda and the Mastercard Foundation.
zh: 這一挑戰是我的研究重點。 這項研究是由年輕人領銜、研究計劃青年智庫（Youth Think Tank）與不懈開發烏干達（Restless Development Uganda）和萬事達卡基金會（Mastercard Foundation）合作開展的計劃的一部分。

en: In a recent report, we examined the experiences of young African agriculturalists in seven countries.
zh: 在最新報告中，我們考察了非洲多國年輕農業專家的經驗。

en: And what we discovered is that the best way to entice young people back to the farm is by improving access to and engagement with emerging technologies.
zh: 我們發現，吸引年輕人重回農場的最佳辦法是讓他們能夠獲得和利用新興技術。

en: Many of the young people with whom we spoke said that their biggest obstacle to a career in farming is learning the digital and technical skills necessary to succeed in today’s agricultural market.
zh: 與我們交流的許多年輕人說，他們務農的最大障礙是學習在當今農業市場中獲得成功所必須的數字和科技技能。

en: With technologies like cloud computing, soil sensors, and weather drones changing how food is produced, packaged, and distributed, digital literacy is as important as arable land and high-quality seeds.
zh: 雲端計算、土地感測器、天氣無人機等技術正在改變糧食的生產、包裝和分銷方式，數字素質（digital literacy）與適耕土地和高質量種子一樣重要。

en: It stands to reason, then, that if more young people could master digital skills, more would find work in the field.
zh: 因此，如果更多年輕人能夠駕馭數字技能，就自然會有更多人在田間地頭找到用武之地。

en: To understand how important technology is to the young African farmer, consider competition for land.
zh: 要理解技術對非洲年輕農民的重要性，可以考察以下土地競爭。

en: Most farmland is acquired through hereditary or communal distribution systems, and when new plots are allocated, they are typically smaller than those provided to previous generations.
zh: 大部分農地透過遺產或公共分配製度獲得，而新分配農地往往大小不如此前所分的農地。

en: To remain profitable, younger growers must produce larger crops from smaller spaces, which requires innovation.
zh: 要保持盈利能力，年輕農民必須在更少的土地上種出更多莊稼，而這就需要創新。

en: Our study found that in many cases, the best solutions for young farmers are already being designed by young people.
zh: 我們的研究發現，在許多情況下，對年輕農民來說最好的辦法已經在年輕人的開發之中。

en: For example, in Kenya, one vegetable grower turned her kitchen garden into a vertical farm to increase its output.
zh: 比如，在肯亞，一位菜農把她的裁菜園改造為垂直農場以增加產出。

en: Today, she runs her own business designing, fabricating, and installing similar structures for a variety of customers.
zh: 如今，她經營著自己的企業，為各種客戶設計、製作和安裝類似的結構。

en: Another interviewee created a mobile app to help farmers connect with local seed and fertilizer suppliers.
zh: 另一位受訪者開發了一個移動應用幫助農民與本地種子和肥料供應商聯絡。

en: Unfortunately, these types of youth-driven innovations rarely receive the necessary political or financial backing to make them viable and scalable.
zh: 不幸的是，這些年輕人推動的創新很少能夠獲得必要的政治和財務支援實現生存和擴張。

en: Despite having great ideas, most young agricultural innovators do not feel supported in their efforts.
zh: 許多年輕農業創新者擁有了不起的想法，但難以獲得支援。

en: Young people can help solve Africa’s unemployment challenges, but those closest to the problem have yet to be made part of the solution.
zh: 年輕人能夠助力解決非洲的失業問題，但最接近問題的人卻無法成為解決方案的一部分。

en: Our research suggests several strategies to achieve this outcome.
zh: 我們的研究建議了一些實現這一結果的策略。

en: For starters, young people need places to engage with like-minded innovators.
zh: 首先，年輕人需要與創新同道交流的場所。

en: Recognizing this, policymakers and the private sector should work together to create incubation centers and ideation hubs to help young people build, discuss, and access farm-related technologies.
zh: 認識到這一點，決策者和私人部門應該合作建立孵化中心和創意樞紐（ideation hub）幫助年輕人構建、討論和接觸與農場相關的技術。

en: Moreover, those who promote new farm technologies should travel to the places where young people gather, to provide hands-on, audience-specific training.
zh: 此外，推進新農場技術的人應該親身體驗年輕人聚集的場所，提供親身體驗、為受眾量身定製的培訓。

en: If the newest farm gadgets and tools are marketed only on social media, as is often the case, uptake in rural areas will remain weak.
zh: 如果最新農場技術和工具旨在社交媒體上兜售（通常正是如此 ） ， 農村地區對這些技術和工具的吸收便無法提高。

en: Next, young people need access to financial products and services to help them turn their ideas into marketable businesses.
zh: 還有，年輕人需要得到金融產品和服務，以助他們將概念轉化為可以在市場推廣的業務。

en: And, finally, countries must find ways to involve their youth in early stages of the technology-development pipeline.
zh: 最後，各國必須設法在技術發展的早期階段就讓年輕人參與進來。

en: As the experience of the Kenyan gardener illustrates, young people are often the best judges of what will deliver long-term, practical results.
zh: 前述肯亞菜農的經驗表明，年輕人常常是哪些概念能帶來長期切實效果的最佳評判者。

en: Last year, I had the privilege of presenting these findings at the Global Youth Economic Opportunities Summit in Washington, DC.
zh: 去年，我有幸在華盛頓的全球青年經濟機會峰會（Global Youth Economic Opportunities Summit）上展示這些發現。

en: I spoke about the role young people play in Africa’s economy, and the importance of soliciting their views on the future of African agriculture.
zh: 我談到了年輕人在非洲經濟中的作用，以及收集他們關於非洲農業的未來的觀點的重要性。

en: It was an important first step in bringing young peoples’ ideas to the table.
zh: 這是將年輕人的概念擺上檯面的重要的第一步。

en: But much work remains to be done.
zh: 但還有很多工作需要完成。

en: According to the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, the average age of an African farmer today is about 60, while 60% of the population is under the age of 24.
zh: 據聯合國糧農組織，非洲農民的平均年齡目前為60歲左右，而60%的非洲人口不到24歲。

en: To breathe new life into Africa’s farms, the entire industry must innovate.
zh: 要向非洲農場注入新鮮血液，整個農業都必須創新。

en: And, as our research shows, the best way to do that is by working much more closely with those who have the most to gain from progress.
zh: 而我們的研究表明，實現創新的最佳辦法是與從進步中獲益最多的群體進行更加緊密的合作。

en: After Assimilation
zh: 同化以後

en: Human migration is as old as history. Even migration to distant places and remote cultures is nothing new.
zh: 人類的遷徙與我們的歷史一樣悠久，即便移民到遙遠、陌生的國度也毫不新奇。

en: In the nineteenth century, millions of Europeans sought liberty and prosperity in the Americas, notably in the United States.
zh: 19世紀，成百上千萬的歐洲人前往美洲，特別是美國尋找自由和繁榮。

en: What is new today is the scale of migration, often across huge cultural divides - and often without a definite aim.
zh: 但今天的移民規模是前所未有的，移民們常常跨越了巨大的文化障礙－而且沒有特定的目標。

en: The African boat people in the Mediterranean are often not even sure whether they want to be in Italy, Germany, or Britain.
zh: 地中海的非洲船民常常不清楚自己想去哪裡：義大利、德國還是英國。

en: Even those who are certain, like North Africans in Spain and France, or Turks in Germany, had as their priority escaping the hopelessness of their home countries, not arriving at a particular destination.
zh: 即便像西班牙和法國的北非移民或德國的土耳其移民那樣清楚自己的目的地，他們的首要目標也是擺脫國內的絕望窘境，而不是易地而居。

en: This modern form of migration raises massive problems for countries on the receiving end. In Europe, it is probably the most serious social issue today, because no one has a clear idea about how to manage the resulting clash of cultures.
zh: 這種現代形式的遷徙給接收國造成了很多麻煩，甚至成了歐洲目前最嚴重的社會問題，因為沒人知道該怎樣處理由此產生的文化衝突。

en: Once upon a time, North America, notably the US, seemed to provide the answer.
zh: 曾幾何時，北美洲，特別是美國，成了解決問題的樣板。

en: It was that of the "melting pot": different peoples made their own contribution to American culture, but, above all, they made every effort to accept what they found and integrate.
zh: 他們提出了"熔爐"概念：不同的人為美國文化做出自己的貢獻，但最重要的是，他們盡力接受現實，融入美國社會。

en: "No," the Russian woman who came to the US in the early twentieth century replied to the grandchild who asked whether her ancestors arrived with the Pilgrims on the Mayflower. "Our ship had a different name, but now we are all Americans."
zh: 當小孫孫問起20世紀初移民美國的俄國婦女，他們的祖先是不是和朝聖者一起坐著"五月花"號輪船到達美國時，她回答說 ： " 不是，我們的船有個不一樣的名字，但我們現在都是美國人。

en: More recently, this has changed, giving rise to a process described by Arthur Schlesinger, the historian and former aide to President John F. Kennedy, in his book The Disuniting of America.
zh: 可近來情況卻有所變化，約翰·F·肯尼迪總統的前助理、歷史學家阿瑟·施萊辛格在其著作《美國的分裂》中描述的問題開始初現端倪。

en: No longer are all US citizens Americans. They have become hyphenated Americans: Italian-Americans, African-Americans, Hispanic-Americans, and so on.
zh: 美國公民不再都是美國人，而是要在前面加上特定的修飾語：義大利裔美國人、非洲裔美國人、西班牙裔美國人等等等等。

en: The ingredients of the melting pot are separating.
zh: 美國熔爐的各個部分開始四分五裂。

en: Even in Israel, the last true immigration country - at least for Jews - assimilation is no longer so easy.
zh: 即使在最後一個真正的移民國家以色列－至少對猶太人來講確實如此－文化融合也不再是件易事。

en: Recent newcomers from Russia have their own political party, and old Europeans have become a distinct minority.
zh: 不久前到來的俄國新移民成立了自己的政黨，而那些歐洲老移民成了當然的少數民族。

en: Israel and America continue to have mechanisms to integrate new migrants.
zh: 以色列和美國仍然具備融合新移民的機制。

en: Language is an important underlying factor, and in Israel, there is the army, while in America, the values embodied in the Constitution still represent a shared secular faith.
zh: 語言是個重要的根本因素，此外以色列還有軍隊，而美國憲法蘊藏的價值觀仍然代表著共同的社會信仰。

en: But these mechanisms are weakening everywhere, and are virtually non-existent in European countries.
zh: 但這樣的機制正在全球範圍內逐漸削弱，在歐洲國家更是幾乎不復存在。

en: Modern societies are characterized by acute problems of belonging.
zh: 歸屬問題成了現代社會最嚴重的危機。

en: They don't offer the implicit, unconscious ties of community that citizens felt in the past. As a result, people have begun to cling to other, more primordial group identities.
zh: 人們再也無法像過去那樣感覺到含蓄卻潛移默化的整體聯絡，結果導致他們開始固守其它更原始的團體特徵。

en: They resist assimilation, fearing that it will rob them of their identity without offering a new one.
zh: 他們拒絕同化，害怕文化的融合不僅帶不來新的歸屬感，還會把原來的身份也無情地奪走。

en: What then is the alternative to assimilation?
zh: 那麼除同化外還有什麼其它的選擇？

en: The "salad bowl" of so-called multiculturalism is no real alternative, because it does not provide the necessary glue that binds communities together.
zh: 所謂的多文化主義"沙拉"並不是真正的選擇，因為它提供不了聯結團體所必須的粘合劑。

en: All the ingredients remain separate from the outset.
zh: 所有的部分從一開始就四分五裂。

en: The only viable alternative for which there are examples is probably that of London or New York. The main characteristic of this alternative is the coexistence of a common public sphere shared by all and a considerable degree of cultural separation in the "private" sphere, notably in residential areas.
zh: 有成功先例並且唯一可行的備選方案可能就要數倫敦和紐約了，其主要特點是所有人擁有共同的公共領域，而在"私人"領域，特別是居民區中則有很多文化差別。

en: The public space is multicultural in terms of people's backgrounds, but is governed by agreed values, even a common language, whereas the people's private lives are - to use an ugly word - ghettoized.
zh: 公共領域中人們的背景非常多元化，但卻奉行共同的價值觀甚至講同樣的語言，而人們的私生活卻－用個不太好聽的字眼來形容－形形色色。

en: In theory, this is a distinctly second-best solution to the cultural consequences of migration; in practice it is the best answer we have.
zh: 從理論上講，這是解決移民問題的次優方案，但從實際來看，這是我們現有的最佳做法。

en: But it cannot be had for nothing.
zh: 但這也絕不是唾手可得。

en: Even the necessary minimum of a common language requires a deliberate effort, to say nothing of certain rules of behavior.
zh: 因為即便想滿足共同語言的最低限度也需要努力，更不用說建立特定的行為規範了。

en: Living in London, I marvel at the way in which we Londoners have come to terms with Indian family shops and West Indian-run public transport, while not asking many questions about whole districts that are Bangladeshi or Chinese.
zh: 作為倫敦居民，倫敦人對印度家庭商店和西印度人管理公共交通的無言認可常常讓我感到驚訝，他們從來不問為什麼這個地區都是孟加拉人或中國人。

en: No one has yet found a name for this new version of the "separate but equal" doctrine that some of us fought so hard against in the 1960's: separate private lives in a common public space that is equal for all.
zh: 甚至沒有人想到過給這種20世紀60年代曾被我們強烈反對的"分離而平等"理念取個名字：在平等的公共領域中存在著迥然不同的個人生活。

en: This is clearly easier in London and New York than it is in smaller towns or even in the capitals of countries where the world language of English is not spoken.
zh: 如果比起小城鎮甚至是非英語國家的首都，這樣的現象在倫敦和紐約等城市肯定更為普遍。

en: Berlin's Turkish community and the North African communities around Paris seem increasingly separate, with their own public sphere and often language.
zh: 柏林的土耳其人和巴黎周邊的北非人似乎越離越遠，每個民族都有自己的公共領域，也都有自己的語言。

en: Where this happens, an explosive condition can arise, a kind of separatism within, not by historically separate groups but by newcomers against natives.
zh: 如果出現了這種情況，就會產生蘊含著分離主義的爆炸性局面，這不是古已有之的團體對立，而是新移民與當地人之間的對立。

en: If we are forced to abandon the hope of assimilation, our efforts should concentrate on creating a public space to which all contribute and that all enjoy.
zh: 如果我們被迫放棄同化的希望，那麼就必須集中力量創造所有人為之奉獻並共同享受的公共環境。

en: Ideally, this should be an expanding public space, for in the end, the element of unity in a modern society is the guarantee of its citizens' liberty.
zh: 理想狀況下，這種公共環境應該持續發展，因為歸根結底，現代社會的團結因素是公民自由的最終保障。

en: After Austerity
zh: 緊縮之後

en: NEW YORK – This year’s annual meeting of the International Monetary Fund made clear that Europe and the international community remain rudderless when it comes to economic policy.
zh: 紐約—今年的IMF年會清楚地表明，歐洲和國際社會對經濟政策還是一頭霧水。

en: Financial leaders, from finance ministers to leaders of private financial institutions, reiterated the current mantra: the crisis countries have to get their houses in order, reduce their deficits, bring down their national debts, undertake structural reforms, and promote growth.
zh: 財政領導人們 — — 不管是財政部長還是私人財政機構 — — 不斷地唸唸有詞，說危機國必須收拾好自己的房子，削減自己的債務，降低自己的國民債務水平，實施結構性改革，並努力刺激增長。

en: Confidence, it was repeatedly said, needs to be restored.
zh: 需要重塑信心這一點被反覆重申。

en: It is a little precious to hear such pontifications from those who, at the helm of central banks, finance ministries, and private banks, steered the global financial system to the brink of ruin – and created the ongoing mess.
zh: 這些把持著央行行長、財政部長、私人銀行老闆高位的大佬們幾乎把全球金融系統拉下懸崖，造成的混亂至今仍在影響著我們，他們能說出這樣的話真是有些“難能可貴 ” 。

en: Worse, seldom is it explained how to square the circle.
zh: 更糟糕的是，這不啻緣木求魚。

en: How can confidence be restored as the crisis economies plunge into recession?
zh: 在危機經濟體深陷衰退的時候，如何重塑信心？

en: How can growth be revived when austerity will almost surely mean a further decrease in aggregate demand, sending output and employment even lower?
zh: 在緊縮幾乎肯定會進一步拖累總需求、使產出和就業繼續惡化的時候，如何重塑增長？

en: This we should know by now: markets on their own are not stable.
zh: 現在我們需要知道的是，市場不能靠自己穩定下來。

en: Not only do they repeatedly generate destabilizing asset bubbles, but, when demand weakens, forces that exacerbate the downturn come into play.
zh: 市場不但一再造成不穩定的資產泡沫，當需求疲軟時，市場還會形成加劇下滑趨勢的力量。

en: Unemployment, and fear that it will spread, drives down wages, incomes, and consumption – and thus total demand.
zh: 失業以及對失業蔓延的擔心壓低了工資、收入和消費，從而拖累了總需求。

en: Decreased rates of household formation – young Americans, for example, are increasingly moving back in with their parents – depress housing prices, leading to still more foreclosures.
zh: 家庭形成速度的下降 — — 比如，年青一代美國人越來越多地搬回家去和父母同住 — — 抑制了房價，導致了更多的人被剝奪了按揭權。

en: States with balanced-budget frameworks are forced to cut spending as tax revenues fall – an automatic destabilizer that Europe seems mindlessly bent on adopting.
zh: 實行平衡預算框架的國家被迫削減預算，因為稅收收入降低了 — — 這就是歐洲一根筋地力行不懈的“動搖器 ” （ destabilizer ） 。

en: There are alternative strategies.
zh: 我們可以採取替代措施。

en: Some countries, like Germany, have room for fiscal maneuver. Using it for investment would enhance long-term growth, with positive spillovers to the rest of Europe.
zh: 德國等國家擁有財政機動的空間，用之進行投資可以提振長期增長，並對歐洲其他國家形成積極的溢位效應。

en: A long-recognized principle is that balanced expansion of taxes and spending stimulates the economy; if the program is well designed (taxes at the top, combined with spending on education), the increase in GDP and employment can be significant.
zh: 一條早已為人所知的原理是稅收和支出的平衡擴張能刺激經濟，如果有一個設計良好的計劃（對尖端人士徵稅，並增加教育方面的支出 ） ， GDP和就業將能有巨大改善。

en: Europe as a whole is not in bad fiscal shape; its debt-to-GDP ratio compares favorably with that of the United States.
zh: 整體而言，歐洲的財政狀況並不差：其債務-GDP比率比美國還要好。

en: If each US state were totally responsible for its own budget, including paying all unemployment benefits, America, too, would be in fiscal crisis.
zh: 如果美國的每個州都需要對自身預算完全負責（包括支付所有失業保險 ） ， 那麼美國也將爆發財政危機。

en: The lesson is obvious:  the whole is more than the sum of its parts.
zh: 美國的經驗是顯而易見的：部分之和大於整體。

en: If Europe – particularly the European Central Bank – were to borrow, and re-lend the proceeds, the costs of servicing Europe’s debt would fall, creating room for the kinds of expenditure that would promote growth and employment.
zh: 如果歐洲（特別是歐洲央行）可以借款並轉手放貸，那麼歐洲債務的維持成本就會下降，從而為刺激增長和就業的支出創造空間。

en: There are already institutions within Europe, such as the European Investment Bank, that could help finance needed investments in the cash-starved economies.
zh: 歐洲內部已經有了合適的機構（如歐洲投資銀行）可以幫助資金受困國為必須的投資融資。

en: The EIB should expand its lending.
zh: 歐洲投資銀行應該加大貸款力度。

en: There need to be increased funds available to support small and medium-size enterprises – the main source of job creation in all economies – which is especially important, given that credit contraction by banks hits these enterprises especially hard.
zh: 中小企業 — — 就業創造的主力軍，在任何國家都是如此 — — 需要更多的資金支援，這一點尤其重要，因為銀行信用的收縮對中小企業的衝擊尤重。

en: Europe’s single-minded focus on austerity is a result of a misdiagnosis of its problems.
zh: 歐洲之所以一根筋地死抓緊縮不放，是因為他們誤診了問題。

en: Greece overspent, but Spain and Ireland had fiscal surpluses and low debt-to-GDP ratios before the crisis.
zh: 希臘確實是指出過度，但西班牙和愛爾蘭在危機前財政都有盈餘，債務-GDP比率也���低。

en: Giving lectures about fiscal prudence is beside the point.
zh: 大談審慎財政可謂使錯了力。

en: Taking the lectures seriously –  even adopting tight budget frameworks – can be counterproductive.
zh: 把這一點當真，甚至採取嚴厲的預算框架只能適得其反。

en: Regardless of whether Europe’s problems are temporary or fundamental – the eurozone, for example, is far from an “optimal” currency area, and tax competition in a free-trade and free-migration area can erode a viable state – austerity will make matters worse.
zh: 不論歐洲的問題是暫時性的還是基礎性的 — — 比如，歐元區遠非“最優”貨幣區，且自由貿易和人口自由流動地區的稅收競賽會拖垮原本健康的國家 — — 緊縮肯定只能讓情況更加糟糕。

en: The consequences of Europe’s rush to austerity will be long-lasting and possibly severe.
zh: 歐洲忙不迭採取緊縮措施的後果將持續很長時間，而且可能會很嚴重。

en: If the euro survives, it will come at the price of high unemployment and enormous suffering, especially in the crisis countries.
zh: 如果歐元可以倖存下來，那也是以高失業和多重痛苦（特別是對危機國家來說）為代價的。

en: And the crisis itself almost surely will spread.
zh: 而危機本身幾乎肯定會蔓延開來。

en: Firewalls won’t work, if kerosene is simultaneously thrown on the fire, as Europe seems committed to doing: there is no example of a large economy – and Europe is the world’s largest – recovering as a result of austerity.
zh: 一邊建防火牆一邊火上澆油，最後只能是無功而返，這就是歐洲正在做的事情：還沒有哪個大型經濟體 — — 歐洲是世界最大經濟體 — — 曾經透過緊縮帶來過復甦。

en: As a result, society’s most valuable asset, its human capital, is being wasted and even destroyed.
zh: 因此，社會最寶貴的資產 — — 人力資本正在被浪費甚至摧毀。

en: Young people who are long deprived of a decent job – and youth unemployment in some countries is approaching or exceeding 50%, and has been unacceptably high since 2008 – become alienated.
zh: 年輕人長期找不到體面的工作 — — 一些國家年輕人失業率正在達到或超過50 % ， 且自2008年以來便一直處於難以接受的高水平 — — 對社會產生了離心感。

en: When they eventually find work, it will be at a much lower wage.
zh: 即使他們最終找到了工作，工資也會低得多。

en: Normally, youth is a time when skills get built up; now, it is a time when they atrophy.
zh: 通常，青年時代是積累技能的時期，而現在的年輕人卻在流失技能。

en: So many economies are vulnerable to natural disasters – earthquakes, floods, typhoons, hurricanes, tsunamis – that adding a man-made disaster is all the more tragic.
zh: 如此多的國家在自然災害面前束手無策 — — 地震、洪水、颱風、颶風、海嘯，等等 — — 而人造災難更是雪上加霜。

en: But that is what Europe is doing.
zh: 但這正是歐洲做的事情。

en: Indeed, its leaders’ willful ignorance of the lessons of the past is criminal.
zh: 事實上，歐洲領導人故意忽視歷史教訓可以說是一種犯罪。

en: The pain that Europe, especially its poor and young, is suffering is unnecessary.
zh: 歐洲 — — 特別是歐洲窮人和年輕人 — — 所正在經歷的痛苦是完全可以避免的。

en: Fortunately, there is an alternative.
zh: 幸運的是，我們可以找到替代方案。

en: But delay in grasping it will be very costly, and Europe is running out of time.
zh: 但遲遲不行動將帶來高昂的代價，而歐洲正在浪費寶貴的時間。

en: Immunization Independence
zh: 接種獨立

en: WASHINGTON, DC – The first years of this century have been heady ones for global health.
zh: 華盛頓—本世紀的頭十幾年是全球衛生的黃金時代。

en: International donors – whether national governments, such as the United States, through its PEPFAR program, or new international funding initiatives, such as the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria and Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance – have invested billions of dollars in national disease-control programs and health systems, saving millions of lives.
zh: 國際出資人 — — 不管是國家政府，如透過PEPFAR專案出資的美國，還是新國際融資計劃，如全球遏制艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾基金以及疫苗聯盟（Gavi ） — —在國家疾病控制計劃和衛生體系方面投入了數十億美元，拯救了數百萬條生命。

en: But now some of the countries that have benefited from these programs face a new challenge: sustaining the gains they have made once external support is withdrawn.
zh: 但如今一些從這些計劃中獲益的國家面臨一個新挑戰：在失去外部支援後繼續保持已經取得的成果。

en: Ultimately, it is on the basis of this transition that donors’ initiatives – and the health aid enterprise as a whole – will be judged.
zh: 說到底，出資人的專案 — — 以及作為一個整體的衛生援助事業 — — 都要根據這一轉變來予以評判。

en: Consider Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance.
zh: 以疫苗聯盟Gavi為例。

en: Founded in 2000 by a partnership of major donors, international agencies, and vaccine industry leaders, Gavi’s goal is to help the world’s poorest countries introduce new lifesaving vaccines and strengthen their immunization programs.
zh: Gavi成立於2000年，是一家由主要出資人、國際機構和疫苗行業領導者組成的合作計劃，其目標是幫助全世界最貧困國家引入新的救命疫苗、強化它們的接種計劃。

en: When a country’s annual per capita income rises above a certain threshold – currently $1,580 – it becomes ineligible for Gavi support.
zh: 年人均收入達到一定標準 — — 目前是1,580美元 — — 的國家就無法獲得Gavi支援。

en: Of course, Gavi doesn’t just cut off funding all at once.
zh: 當然，Gavi不會立即切斷資金。

en: Support is phased out over a period of several years.
zh: 支援會在幾年的時間裡逐步結束。

en: During this transition period, countries rapidly increase their financial contribution to their immunization programs and prepare to assume full responsibility.
zh: 在這個過渡期中，國家要大幅增加免疫計劃的財政投入，並準備好完全自力更生。

en: This approach, which enables Gavi to concentrate its resources on countries with the greatest need, has been in place since 2010.
zh: 這一方針自2000年以來實施至今，讓Gavi能夠將資源集中於最需要的國家。

en: But it is now being put to a stern test: one-third of the 73 countries to which Gavi extends support are either in the midst of the transition process or have just completed it.
zh: 但如今，它面臨著嚴峻的考驗：在73個Gavi延長支援的國家中，有三分之一要麼正處於過渡期，要麼剛剛結束過渡期。

en: The group includes countries as different from one another as Armenia, Bhutan, Honduras, and Vietnam, as well as India and Nigeria, which have the largest birth cohorts.
zh: 這些國家情況各異，如亞美尼亞、不丹、宏都拉斯、越南，也包括出生率最高的國家，如印度和奈及利亞。

en: The Gavi model is now under the microscope.
zh: Gavi模式正在被放在顯微鏡下觀察。

en: Will countries be able to continue purchasing and delivering the vaccines that were introduced with Gavi support?
zh: 這些國家能夠繼續購買和普及透過Gavi支援引入的疫苗嗎？

en: Equally important, will that commitment hold up over time?
zh: 同樣重要的是，這一事業能夠堅持下去嗎？

en: If government budgets are cut, will immunization be protected, along with other essential health services?
zh: 如果政府預算被削減，接種能與其他基本衛生服務一起得到保護嗎？

en: Will countries be able to introduce new lifesaving vaccines as they become available?
zh: 當新的救命疫苗面世時，各國能夠引入它們嗎？

en: Will they sustain and strengthen disease surveillance, so that outbreaks are detected and addressed quickly?
zh: 它們能夠保持和強化疾病監控，以使疾病的爆發得以發現並迅速控制嗎？

en: Or will fiscal pressures lead, in some countries, to vaccine shortages, to declines in immunization coverage, or even, in the worst case, to vaccines being dropped altogether from national programs, reversing the hard-won gains of recent years?
zh: 或者，財政壓力會導致一些國家出現疫苗短缺、接種覆蓋率下降，甚至最糟糕的，疫苗從國家接種計劃中除名、近幾年來好不容易取得的進步毀於一旦嗎？

en: The answers to these questions are important not only for the countries themselves, but also for their neighbors, which could be put at risk by backsliding on immunization.
zh: 這些問題的答案不僅對於這些國家本身十分重要，對於它們的鄰國也很重要，因為鄰國可能因此出現免疫退步的情況。

en: After all, infectious diseases do not respect national boundaries.
zh: 畢竟，傳染病是不會尊重國界的。

en: The recent yellow fever epidemic in Angola, for example, spread to its much poorer neighbor, the Democratic Republic of Congo.
zh: 比如，最近安哥拉爆發的黃熱病疫情就傳播到了比它窮得多的鄰國民主剛果。

en: The experiences of countries that have “graduated” from Gavi assistance will also hold important lessons for other international health programs and their beneficiaries.
zh: 從Gavi援助中“畢業”的國家的經驗也給其他國際衛生專案及其受益國提供了重要的教訓。

en: With so much at stake, international agencies must do whatever they can to prepare countries for “life after Gavi.”
zh: 茲事體大，國際機構必須竭盡全力為這些國家準備好“沒有Gavi的日子 ” 。

en: For some of these countries, especially those that have adopted many new vaccines, obtaining adequate and sustainable financing is one of the most daunting challenges posed by the transition.
zh: 對其中一些國家，特別是引入了大量新疫苗的國家，獲得並保持足夠的資金是這一轉型最艱鉅的挑戰。

en: Although immunization programs require only a relatively small share of health budgets and yield exceptionally high economic returns, securing the needed financing requires careful planning.
zh: 儘管免疫計劃只需要花費衛生預算的相對較小比例，並且能夠帶來極高的經濟回報，但保證所需資金仍然需要仔細的規劃。

en: A new resource can help countries as they wrestle with this challenge.
zh: 新資源有助於各國戰勝這一挑戰。

en: Immunization Financing: A Resource Guide for Advocates, Policymakers, and Program Managers provides information on estimating immunization costs, assessing the pros and cons of various sources of financing, shaping purchasing strategies, and navigating policy processes.
zh: 《免疫融資：推廣者、決策者和專案管理者資源指南 》 （ Immunization Financing: A Resource Guide for Advocates, Policymakers, and Program Managers）提供了關於估算接種成本、評估不同融資資源的利弊、制定採購策略、透過政策流程的資訊。

en: It does not prescribe one way forward, but rather provides relevant information and expert analysis.
zh: 它不指定某種做法，而是提供相關資訊和專家分析。

en: Countries can then evaluate options in light of their own circumstances, and advocates can ask the right questions.
zh: 各國可以據此根據各自所處環境評估各種選項，推廣者也可以提出正確的問題。

en: With Gavi support, close to 580 million children have been immunized since 2000, and more than eight million future deaths have been averted.
zh: 在Gavi的支援下，2000年以來有接近5.8億兒童獲得了接種，超過八百萬起未來死亡得到避免。

en: These are impressive gains that are worth celebrating.
zh: 這是值得慶祝的令人矚目的成就。

en: But only if countries successfully negotiate the transition from Gavi support can they be confident that future generations will enjoy the same health protections.
zh: 但只有各國成功度過取消Gavi支援的過渡期，它們才會有信心讓子孫後代獲得同樣的健康保護。

en: After Kyoto
zh: 京都議定書之後

en: The Kyoto Protocol treaty has now entered into force for the 126 nations who have joined it so far.
zh: 《京都議定書》已對參加該協議的126國生效。

en: Now is the time to start thinking about how to engage all nations, including large emitters, in conversations about what to do after the treaty’s expiration in 2012.
zh: 現在是時候考慮如何使所有的國家，包括那些氣體排放大國，參與討論2012年，即該議定書失效後的應對方法了。

en: This is exactly what the European Commission did recently by providing its first strategy for a post-Kyoto era, which will be discussed by the European Council next March.
zh: 這正是歐盟執委會最近針對後京都時代提出的第一個策略所要做的，這一策略將在三月份交由歐盟理事會討論。

en: While the Kyoto Protocol represents only a modest reduction of carbon emissions in industrialized countries – 5.2% between 2008-2012 relative to 1990 levels, with varying targets for individual countries – real progress can be made in sustaining development efforts and preserving our planet.
zh: 儘管京都議定書已使工業國家二氧化碳排放量略有輕微下降 — — 伴隨著各國不一的目標，2008至2012年間二氧化碳排放量比1990年下降了5.2 % — —但是真正的進展卻要透過致力於持續發展和保護我們的星球才能實現。

en: But first, all countries must integrate climate concerns into policy planning, and improve their governance in key sectors such as energy, infrastructure, and transport.
zh: 但是首先，所有國家必須將對氣候的關注與政策制定融合一體，加強對能源、基礎設施和交通等重要部門的控制。

en: In other words, we must act in accordance with the recognition that climate change and its effects on people in both rich and poor countries remains a threat to global security.
zh: 換言之，在對氣候變化有所認識並且意識到它給發達國家和貧困國家人民帶來的影響將對全球安全構成威脅這一點後，我們必須採取相應措施。

en: At the end of the day, the long-term approach is likely to include a rules-based system, an incentives system, and investments in technology change.
zh: 最後，這一長期計劃應該包括一個標準式系統、一個激勵體系以及技術改革所需的投資資金。

en: Increasingly, adaptation at the national level will be recognized as a major issue that will require appropriate funding.
zh: 國家對此計劃的應用將日益成為一個需要充足資金的主要專案。

en: Dealing with the impacts of climate change and with emission reductions should not be mutually exclusive, but complementary.
zh: 對氣候變化影響和減排量這兩個問題的處理並非相互排斥，而是互補的。

en: Looking ahead to the post-Kyoto world offers us the chance to start a new dialogue and to look at new options on climate change.
zh: 對後京都時代的展望將讓我們有機會開啟一場新對話，並開始尋求解決氣候變化問題的新方案。

en: Nations could set the more ambitious goal of limiting the long-term change in the earth’s temperature, and then assign emissions rights among countries in such a way that will eventually limit temperature increases to an acceptable level.
zh: 各國可以將“長期限制地球溫度的變化”作為更具雄心的目標，隨後在各國之間分配排放權，最終在一個可以接受的水平內限制溫度上升。

en: This would require increasing investments in energy research and development for new and improved technologies – a process that needs to be supported by stronger public-private partnerships.
zh: 這將需要在能源研究和開發新型技術方面持續加大投入 — — 需要更為強有力的公私營機構的合作予以支援。

en: Up to now, with only 15% of the world’s population, rich countries have been responsible for more than 75% of global carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions, and thus most of the environmental damage.
zh: 目前為止，只佔世界人口15%的發達國家卻排放了佔世界總量75%以上的二氧化碳，是大部分環境破壞的罪魁禍首。

en: However, it is the developing countries – and thus the world’s poor – who are most vulnerable.
zh: 然而，發展中國家，也就是全世界的貧困人民 — — 卻飽受苛責。

en: It is unrealistic to ask poor countries, where more than 1.6 billion people do not have access to clean energy and technologies, to bear the costs associated with the much needed technological change.
zh: 要那些居住在貧困國家、無法獲得清潔能源和技術的16億人民去承擔技術改革所需的費用是不現實的，儘管這樣的技術改革非常必需。

en: Working with partners, the World Bank is supporting financial strategies to assist developing countries in meeting the costs caused by climate change.
zh: 世界銀行與其合作伙伴一起，正致力於為發展中國家提供金融策略以幫助他們支付氣候變化帶來的費用。

en: To date, over $1 billion dollars in Global Environment Facility (GEF) grants, together with about $8 billion in co-financing, have been committed to programs related to climate change.
zh: 迄今為止，來自全球環境基金（GEF）的十億多美元資金，與80億美元的聯合資金一起，已承諾將用於氣候變化相關的專案。

en: While the regulatory mechanisms of both Kyoto and the European Trading Scheme have contributed to the establishment of an emerging market for carbon trading, interested parties are now concerned about the immediate future.
zh: 京都議定書和歐洲貿易計劃的調節機制促進了日益興起的碳貿易的確立，使得有興趣的政黨現在開始對不久的將來表示擔憂。

en: Without a regulatory framework beyond 2012, the window of opportunity for initiating project-based transactions will close by 2006/2007.
zh: 若2012年後還沒有一個管理框架出臺，那麼創立一個專案式交易的機會之窗將在2006或2007年之前關閉。

en: Given the long lead time between project preparation and the first benefits of emissions reductions, project developers have only a few years to act before carbon payments cease to make a meaningful contribution to project finance in the current context.
zh: 如果專案準備期與減排第一次利潤出現之間還有一段很長的前置期，那麼，在碳交易結算停止之前，專案發展者只有短短几年的時間在當前情況下為該專案資金創造一個有價值的貢獻。

en: Developing infrastructure projects is a long process that requires 3-7 years from identification, through licensing, financing, and construction, and finally to the first certification of carbon emission reductions.
zh: 發展基礎設施專案是一個漫長的過程，從確立到獲得許可、籌措資金，到最後證明碳化物排放減少需要3到7年的時間。

en: Therefore, projects need to be operational at the latest by 2007.
zh: 因此，該專案必須在2007年之前進入操作階段。

en: The World Bank has been instrumental in advancing carbon finance as a viable development tool, and in facilitating private-sector participation in the market.
zh: 世界銀行已經開始將碳資金當作一項可行的發展工具來加以促進推動，並且鼓勵私營機構加入此市場。

en: The Bank is focused on representing the interests of its borrowing countries, helping them to develop assets for carbon trading according to their own priorities.
zh: 世界銀行將重點放在維護其債國的利益之上，幫助他們根據各自的優勢來發展碳貿易的資產。

en: But, without a commitment by governments to limit greenhouse gas emissions beyond 2012, the carbon market will remain uncertain, and the private sector – vital to the market’s success – is unlikely to expand its participation in a meaningful and sustained way.
zh: 但是，若政府不作出在2012年後降低溫室氣體排放的承諾，碳市場將仍然難以捉摸，對該市場成功與否至關重要的私營機構，將不願意持續地、針對性地擴大它們的參與範圍。

en: According to a recent World Bank-supported survey of companies interested in carbon finance, only one in five respondents declared that they were interested in buying post-2012 emissions reductions.
zh: 根據最近由世行資助的一項對有意碳資金的公司的調查來看，只有五分之一的公司宣稱他們有興趣購買2012年後的減排量。

en: Now is the chance to look forward and enlist the global community – with no exclusions, although with differentiated responsibilities – in the pursuit of a more secure world, one that avoids the dire risks of environmental degradation and social conflict implied by inaction.
zh: 現在正是考慮將來並爭取全球所有國家（儘管各國責任各有不同，但無一例外）支援的大好機會，這樣才能尋求一個更為安全的世界，避免環境惡化帶來的可怕後果和消極以待將引發的社會爭端。

en: After Paris
zh: 巴黎之後

en: NEW YORK – The attacks in Paris by individuals associated with the Islamic State, coming on the heels of bombings in Beirut and the downing of a Russian airliner over the Sinai Peninsula, reinforce the reality that the terrorist threat has entered a new and even more dangerous phase.
zh: 紐約—與伊斯蘭國有關的個體對巴黎進行了襲擊，此前，貝魯特發生爆炸事件，更有一家俄羅斯班機在西奈半島上空墜毀。 這一切強化了恐怖主義威脅正在進入更危險的新階段的現實。

en: Just why the Islamic State decided to stage its attacks now is a matter for conjecture; it may well be that it is going global to compensate for its recent loss of territory in Iraq.
zh: 伊斯蘭國為什麼要組織襲擊現在仍停留在猜測階段；很有可能是因為它因為最近在伊拉克喪失領土而追求全球報復。

en: But whatever the rationale, what is certain is that a clear response is warranted.
zh: 但不管原因如何，可以確定的是必然會有明確的反應。

en: Actually, the challenge posed by the Islamic State calls for several responses, as there is no single policy that promises to be sufficient.
zh: 實際上，伊斯蘭國所構成的挑戰需要多重反應，因為沒有哪項單獨的政策足以應對。

en: Multiple efforts are needed in multiple domains.
zh: 我們需要多重領域的多重反應。

en: One is military.
zh: 其一是軍事。

en: More intense attacks from the air against Islamic State military assets, oil and gas facilities, and leaders are critical.
zh: 加大針對伊斯蘭國軍事資產、石油和前燃氣設施以及領導人的空中打擊力度至關重要。

en: But no amount of air power on its own will ever get the job done.
zh: 但不論多大的空中力量也無法單槍匹馬解決戰鬥。

en: A substantial ground component is needed if territory is to be taken and held.
zh: 如果想要佔領並守住領土，就必須大量派遣地面部隊。

en: Unfortunately, there is no time to build a partner force on the ground from scratch.
zh: 不幸的是，已經沒有時間從零開始建設一支地面友軍。

en: This has been tried and failed, and Arab states are unable or unwilling to constitute one.
zh: 曾經做過這一嘗試，但以失敗告終，而阿拉伯國家也無法或不願組建這樣一支地面部隊。

en: The Iraqi army has also come up short.
zh: 伊拉克軍隊讓人失望。

en: Iran-backed militias only make matters worse.
zh: 伊朗支援的民兵只能讓事情變得更糟。

en: The best option is to work more closely with Kurdish troops and select Sunni tribes in both Iraq and Syria.
zh: 最佳的選擇是與庫爾德軍隊更加緊密地合作，並遴選伊拉克和敘利亞的遜尼派部落。

en: This means providing intelligence, arms, and being willing to send more soldiers – more than the 3,500 Americans already there, and possibly on the order of 10,000 – to train, advise, and help direct a military response.
zh: 這意味著提供情報、武裝並準備派遣更多士兵 — — 目前只有3,500美軍，這是不夠的，也許需要上萬人的數量級 — — 訓練、充當顧��和幫助指導軍事行動。

en: Such an effort must be collective.
zh: 這一方針必須以集體行動的方式落實。

en: It can be informal – a “coalition of the willing” that would include the United States, France, the United Kingdom, Arab states, and even Russia under the right circumstances – or carried out under NATO or United Nations auspices.
zh: 可以是非正式的形式 — — 一個包括美國、法國、英國、阿拉伯國家，甚至在正確的前提下包括俄羅斯在內的“志願聯盟 ” — —也可以在北約或聯合國的支援下進行。

en: The packaging matters less than the results.
zh: 如何組織不重要，結果更重要。

en: Symbolic declarations of war, though, ought to be considered with caution, lest the Islamic State appear to be winning every day it does not lose.
zh: 但象徵性地宣戰要慎之又慎，以免造成伊斯蘭國不輸便是贏的表象。

en: A diplomatic component is no less essential to any response.
zh: 外交反應的重要性不下於任何其他反應。

en: Syrian President Bashar al-Assad is a recruiting tool for the Islamic State and must go.
zh: 敘利亞總統巴沙爾·阿薩德是伊斯蘭國招募人手的工具，他必須下臺。

en: But any successor government must be able to maintain order and not permit the Islamic State to exploit a power vacuum, as it has done in Libya.
zh: 但繼任政府必須能夠維持秩序，不允許伊斯蘭國利用權力真空，重蹈利比亞的覆轍。

en: Moreover, orderly political change can be brought about only with Russian and Iranian support.
zh: 此外，有序的政治變革必須在俄羅斯和伊朗的支援下進行。

en: One near-term option worth exploring is a coalition government still headed by a representative of the Alawite minority, a concession that could well be the price of moving Assad out of power.
zh: 一個值得探索的短期選擇方案是成立一個仍以阿拉維少數派代表為首的聯合政府，這是讓巴沙爾遠離權力的必要的讓步。

en: In principle, and over time, a more representative national government could come about, although talk of holding elections in 18 months is fanciful under any scenario.
zh: 理論上，藉以時日，可能產生一個更具代表性的國家政府，儘管不論在何種情形下，要在18個月內舉行選舉都只是幻想。

en: But reaching a compromise along these lines could well be impossible.
zh: 但在這些方面形成妥協也許非常困難。

en: This is why increased military effort is needed to bring about larger and more secure enclaves that could better protect civilians and take the fight to the Islamic State.
zh: 因此，必須加碼軍事手段建立更大更多的飛地以更好地保護平民和打擊伊斯蘭國。

en: Syria is not a normal country in any sense, and it will not be for a long time, if ever.
zh: 不論從何種角度看，敘利亞都不再是正常國家，並且在相當長的一段時間（如果不是永遠的話）都無法成為正常國家。

en: A Syria of enclaves or cantons is a more realistic model for the foreseeable future.
zh: 在可預見的未來，一個由飛地和根據地組成的敘利亞才是更加現實的模式。

en: Other indispensable elements of any effective strategy include expanded help for or pressure on Turkey to do much more to stem the flow of recruits to the Islamic State.
zh: 有效戰略的其他不可或缺要素包括給予土耳其更大的幫助或壓力，令其花更大的力氣阻止應募者流入伊斯蘭國。

en: And Turkey, along with Jordan and Lebanon, need more financial assistance as they shoulder the bulk of the refugee burden.
zh: 土耳其以及約旦和黎巴嫩需要更多的金融支援，因為它們承擔了大部分難民負擔。

en: Arab and Muslim leaders can do their part by speaking out to challenge the Islamic State’s vision and delegitimize its behavior.
zh: 阿拉伯和穆斯林領導人也可以做出貢獻，挑戰伊斯蘭國的願景、破壞伊斯蘭國行為的合法性。

en: There is also a domestic dimension to policy.
zh: 國內政策也大有可為。

en: Homeland security and law enforcement – increasing protection both at borders and within them – will have to adjust to the increased threat.
zh: 祖國安全和執法情況 — — 加強邊界和內部保護 — — 必須根據日益嚴重的威脅作出調整。

en: Retail terrorists – individuals or small groups carrying out armed attacks against soft targets in open societies – are extremely difficult to deal with.
zh: 零散恐怖分子 — — 針對開放社會的軟目標實施武裝襲擊的個體或小集團 — — 最難對付。

en: The threat and the reality of attacks will require greater social resilience and quite possibly a rebalancing of individual privacy and collective security.
zh: 襲擊的威脅和現實需要更大的社會恢復力，也許還需要平衡個人隱私和集體安全之間的關係。

en: What is also required is a dose of realism.
zh: 除此之外還需要現實主義。

en: The struggle against the Islamic State is not a conventional war.
zh: 與伊斯蘭國的鬥爭不是一場傳統戰爭。

en: We cannot eradicate or destroy it any time soon, as it is as much a network and an idea as it is an organization and a de facto state that controls territory and resources.
zh: 我們無法短時間內根除或消滅伊斯蘭國，因為它有一個網路、一套思想，也因為它是一個控制著領土和資源的組織、一個事實上的國家。

en: Indeed, terrorism is and will continue to be one of the scourges of this era.
zh: 誠然，恐怖主義是並將繼續是現時代一場災難。

en: The good news, though, is that the threat posed by the Islamic State to the Middle East and the rest of the world can be dramatically reduced through sustained, concerted action.
zh: 但好訊息是，伊斯蘭國給中東和世界其他地區所造成的威脅可以透過持續的集體行動大幅削弱。

en: The main lesson of the attack on Paris is that we must be prepared to act over time and place alike.
zh: 巴黎襲擊的主要教訓是我們必須隨時隨地做好行動準備。

en: After Pax Americana?
zh: 美式和平之後

en: NEW YORK – It has become popular to suggest that when the dust settles from the global financial crisis, it may become clear that the United States-led post-war world has come to an end.
zh: 紐約 - - 一段時間以來，有人熱衷於說當全球金融危機塵埃落定之時，美國主導的戰後世界將會結束。

en: If so, the global system that has secured peace, security, openness, and economic growth over the past six decades could be in grave danger.
zh: 如果這樣，在過去六十年中確保了和平、安全、開放以及經濟增長的全球體制就會處於嚴重危險之中。

en: Inspired by American leadership since World War II’s end, Europe, then Japan, then much of Asia and the world rose to new levels of prosperity; the world economy globalized upon the foundation of international institutions, norms, and standards; and foreign students educated in American universities returned home with new ideas about free markets, entrepreneurship, and democracy.
zh: 歐洲、日本和亞洲和世界其他大部分地區受到美國戰後領導地位的鼓舞相繼實現了繁榮。 世界經濟在國際體制、規則以及標準的基礎上實現了全球化。

en: The US military’s protective umbrella gave large swaths of the world a vacation from war, making it easier for them to focus on economic growth and regional integration.
zh: 在美國大學接受教育的外國學生把有關自由市場、創業精神以及民主的新觀點帶回國內。 美國軍隊的保護傘讓世界上的大部分地區免於戰火，使得這些地區更為容易地專心致志地從事經濟增長和地區聯合。

en: America not only took the lead role in building the institutions of a globalizing world – the United Nations, World Bank, IMF, NATO– it also became the model that many other countries looked to for inspiration.
zh: 美國不僅在建立聯合國、世界銀行、國際貨幣基金組織以及北約等全球化世界的機制中發揮了主導作用，而且，其他許多國家也尋求美國模式的靈感。

en: After eight years of compromised American leadership, a botched war of choice in Iraq, failure to take the lead in global efforts to address climate change, Abu Ghraib, Guantánamo Bay, running up a $10 trillion debt, and igniting a global financial crisis – America’s once-glittering model has lost a good deal of its luster and America’s leadership has been questioned by many.
zh: 它限於伊拉克戰爭泥潭，未能領導世界處理氣候變化問題，在阿布格萊布虐囚，在關塔納摩基地關押人犯，赤字高達十萬億美元並且引發了全球金融危機。 美國一度耀眼的模式已經風光不再，而且許多人質疑美國的領導地位。

en: The point was driven home at the 7th Asia-Europe Meeting (ASEM) in Beijing this autumn, where European and Asian leaders began exploring ideas for a new global financial structure.
zh: 今年秋天在北京舉行的第七次亞歐首腦會議證明了這一點。 在這次會議上，亞歐各國領導人開始研究建立新的全球金融結構。

en: For much of the past 60 years, it would have been impossible to hold such a fundamental dialogue without US participation. Today, it is almost becoming a new global norm that neither the international committee nor the US is prepared for.
zh: 在過去六十年的大部分時間裡，人們不可能在沒有美國參加的情況下舉行這樣的重大對話，這一全球性的情況國際社會和美國都沒有做好準備。

en: Despite talk about American decline, the world is not prepared for a post-American era.
zh: 儘管人們談論美國衰落，但是世界對後美國時代還是沒有做好準備。

en: As irksome as some of America’s actions have been, particularly over the past eight years, America remains the world’s most critical champion of the progressive values that have lifted hundreds of millions of people out of abject poverty and political repression.
zh: 儘管美國的某些行為令人厭煩，但是在促進將數以億計的人口從極端貧困和政治迫害中解脫出來的進步價值觀上，美國還是一馬當先。

en: If the US were to play a relatively smaller role in world affairs, and no other system was created to pick up the slack, these values could be at risk.
zh: 如果美國在世界事務上發揮相對較小的作用而且沒有建立其他制度來彌補空缺，那麼，這些價值觀就會受到危險。

en: Although many states now hide behind an alleged universal principle of inviolable state sovereignty, for example, would the international community really want to go back to the old model where states did whatever they wanted to their citizens within the confines of their own borders?
zh: 儘管有些國家躲藏在所謂的主權不可侵犯的普遍原則上，國際社會是否果真願意回到國家可以對其人民為所欲為的老模式之中呢？

en: Do countries around the world believe that they will be better off if the global trade system breaks down or international shipping lanes become less secure?
zh: 世界各國是否相信，如果全球貿易體系崩潰或者國際航運線路不再安全它們的日子會更好呢？

en: Are countries like China willing to step up and pay their fair share of dues to keep the UN running (China currently pays 2.1% of UN dues, compared to more than 25% for the US), or to capitalize revised international financial institutions or the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria in a meaningful way?
zh: 像中國這樣的國家是否願意增加聯合國會員經費以保持聯合國運轉(中國目前的經費是2.1 % ， 美國是25 % ) ？ 還是願意為改制後的國際金融機構或全球基金注資來確實消除艾滋病、肺結核以及霍亂呢？

en: Unless other countries become more willing to step forward for the common good, a post-American world could quickly become a far more frightening environment than what it would replace.
zh: 除非其他國家更加願意為人類共同事業挺身而出，否則，後美國的世界將會馬上要比原先的更為令人害怕。

en: To make its case for a continued global leadership role, America must, however, step up to the plate.  While the go-it-alone impulse of the Bush administration has been discredited by its consequences, the inverse lessons regarding how important collaborative action is in today’s interconnected world are still being learned.
zh: 美國為了繼續領導世界就必須承擔責任。 布什政府的單邊主義衝動由於其後果而受到非議，但是反過來，如今相互依存的世界中相互合作的重要性人們還是在摸索。

en: Even at the apex of American power, America’s greatness was always based on inspiring others, and the opportunities for building market share in that particular category remain unlimited.
zh: 即使在美國鼎盛時期，其偉大之處也是鼓舞激勵他人，而在這一特殊領域中建立市場份額的機會還是不可限量。

en: It is impossible to overestimate how significant a step Barack Obama’s election is in this direction, but America’s actions over the coming years will be the ultimate determinant of whether the power of America’s model can be restored.
zh: 奧巴馬當選美國總統在這一方向邁出了重大一步，對此人們不可低估。 但是，美國在未來幾年中採取的行動將會最終決定美國模式的力量是否可以恢復。

en: America can and should, for example, become the global leader combating climate change through major investments in alternative energy, conservation, and energy efficiency, and by taking strong actions at home to reduce America’s greenhouse gas emissions.  It should transform its immigration policy to recruit the best and brightest people from around the world to move to the US and become citizens, and remain the world’s leading champion of open markets, especially during the current financial crisis.
zh: 美國可以而且應該領導世界，透過大量投資於替換能源、節能、能源效率以及採取大力行動減少溫室氣體排放來處理解決氣候變化問題。 它應該改變移民政策，在全球招募俊才前來美國併成為美國公民，以及繼續推行公開市場，特別是當前金融危機之下。

en: Closing the prison at Guantánamo and reaffirming America’s commitment to international law and human rights will also be an important step in this direction.
zh: 關閉關塔納摩監獄並且重申美國對國際法和人權的承諾也將是這一方向的重要一步。

en: The world wants to believe in an America that lives up to its own best values.
zh: 世界想要相信遵守自身最佳價值觀的美國。

en: The prospect of a truly global community of nations working together to achieve the greater good for all is indeed exciting.
zh: 國際社會各國共同努力實現共同事業這一前景的確令人激動。

en: But, although America has been far from perfect over the last six decades, the end of the pax Americana has the potential to create a dangerous void in international affairs.
zh: 但是，儘管美國在過去六十年中並非完美無缺，美式和平的終結有可能在國際事務中造成危險的真空。

en: If the world is going to shift in the direction of a new and more globally democratic system, other nations will need to meaningfully step forward to assume new responsibilities.
zh: 如果世界轉向一個新的、更為全球性民主的體制，那麼，其他國家就需要有效地採取行動承擔新的責任。

en: It is in America’s and the world’s interest that they do so.  The evidence of this will be seen not only in global institutions but also in places like Darfur, Zimbabwe, and Burma.
zh: 它們這樣做符合美國和世界的利益。 不僅在全球性機構、而且在達爾富爾、辛巴威以及緬甸等地方都可以得到驗證。

en: Until this happens, let us all hope that America can get back on track as the global champion of collaborative action to address the world’s greatest challenges and work with as many other countries  as possible to move collectively in the right direction.
zh: 在這以前，還是讓我們希望美國再次成為共同處理解決世界最嚴重挑戰的帶頭人，並且於盡量多的國家合作朝向正確的方向前進。

en: After the Guns of August
zh: 八月衝突之後

en: The Middle East is a place where the dust hardly ever settles.
zh: 中東戰爭的塵埃從未落定。
