en: When it occasionally does, even for a short interval – as UN Resolution 1701 for cessation of hostilities in Lebanon seems to be holding – it is time to take stock of events in the hopes that a responsible debate may influence those in power.
zh: 每當偶爾閃現出瞬間的希望¾就像平息黎巴嫩衝突的聯合國1701號決議讓人們看到了曙光¾人們真的應該抓住機會認真思考整個事件的前前後後，期望一場負責任的辯論能夠對當權者造成影響。

en: Let’s start with the United States.
zh: 就從美國說起吧。

en: President George W. Bush has been short on neither initiatives nor catchy slogans and acronyms.
zh: 喬治·W·布什總統既拿不出可行的方案，也提不出令人心動的口號和名詞。

en: Recent years are littered with them: “Global War on Terror” (GWOT), “Road Map,” “Middle East Partnership Initiative “ (MEPI), “Broader Middle East and North Africa” (BMENA) – originally “Greater Middle East Initiative (GMEI) – Democracy Assisted Dialogue (DAD), and so on.
zh: 近年來充斥著他平庸的創意 ： “ 對恐怖主義的全球戰爭 ” （ GWOT ） 、 “路線圖 ” 、 “中東夥伴關係計劃 ” （ MEPI ） 、 “泛中東和北非倡議 ” （ BMENA）¾也就是原來的“泛中東倡議 ” （ GMEI）¾“民主支援的對話 ” （ DAD）等等諸如此類。

en: His latest reverie, envisioned in the thick of the recent fighting between Israel and Hezbollah, was the New Middle East (NME), with US clients Israel, Egypt, Jordan, and Saudi Arabia serving as the pillars of regional order.
zh: 他在以色列和真主黨交戰正酣之際最新提出的幻想被命名為“新中東計劃 ” （ NME ） ， 在這項計劃裡，美國的委託人以色列、埃及、約旦和沙烏地阿拉伯被當成了地區秩序的支撐力量。

en: But like all his previous initiatives since the terrorist attacks on New York and Washington almost five years ago now, the NME ran into trouble from the outset.
zh: 但正如他在五年前紐約和華盛頓遭襲後提出的所有計劃一樣 ， “ 新中東計劃”從一開始就麻煩重重。

en: Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice announced its birth while rejecting an immediate ceasefire in Lebanon.
zh: 國務卿康多莉扎·賴斯在宣佈該計劃誕生的同時，否決了黎巴嫩立即停火的提案。

en: Her poor timing made the initiative appear heartless, as thousands of civilians were being uprooted, killed, or maimed by Israel’s efficient but ruthless artillery and air force.
zh: 她不恰當的時間選擇讓新計劃毫無誠意可言。 在這項計劃誕生的同時，成千上萬的平民百姓在以色列高效但卻無情的炮火和空襲中流離失所、無辜喪命或者身負重傷。

en: This so embarrassed the three Arab NME partners that each raced to distance itself from the US-sponsored initiative.
zh: “新中東計劃”令三位阿拉伯夥伴深感不安，它們都迫不及待地同這項由美國提出的計劃劃清界限。

en: Saudi Arabia, which had remained silent for nearly two weeks, did so with a $500 million contribution to rebuilding devastated areas of Lebanon and another billion to support Lebanon’s threatened currency.
zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯在沉默了近兩個星期後，終於宣佈捐款5億美元重建被戰火摧毀的黎巴嫩區域，不僅如此，沙特還承諾撥出10億美元支援岌岌可危的黎巴嫩貨幣。

en: Egypt’s heir apparent Gamal Mubarak followed suit in the fourth week of the fighting by heading a 70-member delegation on a solidarity visit to Beirut.
zh: 黎以交戰進入第四個星期時，埃及政權當然的繼承人賈邁勒·穆巴拉克(Gamal Mubarak)也站到了黎巴嫩一邊，率領70人的代表團訪問貝魯特。

en: But, rather than earning him the respect of an outraged Egyptian public, revelations in the opposition press that his plane had to obtain a safe passage and authority to land from the Israelis garnered only howls of derision.
zh: 但那次訪問不但沒能贏得憤怒的埃及公眾對他的尊重，反而使他成為了笑柄，因為反對派媒體上披露他的專機被迫為安全通行和降落請求以色列人的批准。

en: As for America, anything it touches in the Middle East has become radioactive, even for longstanding clients and friends.
zh: 至於美國，它在中東的舉手投足無一例外地臭名昭著，即便是長期委託人和朋友也避之唯恐不及。

en: In the course of maneuvering to delay the UN ceasefire, Bush and Rice continually reiterated the need for a Security Council resolution that deals forcefully with “the roots of the problem.”
zh: 在為推遲聯合國停火協議四處遊說的同時，布什和賴斯翻來覆去地強調必須透過一項安理會決議，用武力來應對“問題的根源 ” 。

en: Of course, for them and for Israel, this was Hezbollah and the need to eradicate or at a minimum disarm it and force its fighters to a safe distance from settlements and towns in northern Israel.
zh: 勿庸置疑，對美國和以色列來講，這個根源就是黎巴嫩真主黨，必須將其徹底消滅，至少也要解除武裝，迫使真主黨的戰士遠離以色列北部的城鎮和猶太定居點。

en: While this is a reasonable demand, the rest of the Middle East – and, indeed, much of the world, including Europe – regard the root cause of the conflict as Israeli intransigence and arrogance, together with America’s blind support for it.
zh: 儘管這個要求當屬合理，但其他中東國家¾實際上甚至包括歐洲在內的世界上大部分國家¾都把以色列的強硬傲慢，以及美國對它的盲目支援看做是衝突的根源所在。

en: Both America and Israel have cited foot-dragging in implementing UN Resolution 1559, which calls for disarming all non-state actors in Lebanon and the deployment of government forces all the way to the southern border.
zh: 美國和以色列都稱聯合國第1559號決議執行不力，決議內容要求解散黎巴嫩所有非政府武裝，並把政府部隊一直部署到黎南部邊境。

en: But for years the US and Israel have not uttered a word about the dozens of UN resolutions, going back as far as Resolution 49 on partition in 1947, which called for the establishment of distinct Arab and Jewish states on roughly half of Mandated Palestine.
zh: 但多年以來，美國和以色列卻從未對多達幾十項其他聯合國決議發表過任何評論，這種情況最早可以追溯到1947年的第49號決議，該決議要求把巴勒斯坦的託管土地分成兩半，分別建立起阿拉伯以及猶太國家。

en: This and numerous other resolutions seeking redress for injustices toward Palestinians have been ignored by the US.
zh: 試圖改變巴勒斯坦人所受不公正待遇的上述以及其他決議美國全都置之不理。

en: Thus, for 300 million Arabs and more than one billion Muslims the “root cause” of the Middle East conflict is not Hezbollah.
zh: 正因為如此，對3億阿拉伯人和10多億穆斯林來說，黎巴嫩真主黨並不是中東戰爭的“最終根源 ” 。

en: As its leader, Hassan Nasrallah aptly put it, “We are just a reaction to chronic injustice.”
zh: 真主黨領袖哈桑·納斯魯拉(Hassan Nasrallah)形容得十分貼切 ， “ 真主黨只不過是長期不公所締造的產物。 ”

en: It may well be that there is more than one root cause – every party to the conflict has a favorite one.
zh: 衝突的根本原因很可能不只一種¾各方對此都有著不同的說辭。

en: There is no point in belaboring whose pain is greater or whose root cause is deeper.
zh: 分析哪一方的痛苦更劇烈或根源更深刻沒有任何意義。

en: In fact, arguing over grievances merely drives the sides further apart.
zh: 事實上，對不滿情緒無休止的爭論只會使各方離得更遠。

en: The long overdue UN Resolution 1701 may, with its adoption, indicate that all parties are fatigued, or could no longer withstand international pressure.
zh: 遲來太久的聯合國第1701號決議的生效可能表明各方都已經感到疲憊，抑或是再也忍受不了國際上的壓力。

en: This is good news for all concerned and provides an opportunity to tackle each party’s “root cause.”
zh: 這對各方來講都是好訊息，給它們帶來了解決各自根源問題的一次機遇。

en: Seizing the opportunity requires that humility rather than moral supremacy prevails.
zh: 抓住這次機遇需要虛懷若谷，而不是盲目自大。

en: Empathy, not ethnocentrism, should be the order of the day now that the guns are falling silent and we have rediscovered the limits of military force.
zh: 在炮火逐漸平息、武力界限再度浮現的時刻，需要設身處地地為對方考慮，而不是盲目愚蠢的自我中心。

en: But if we have learned anything at all from the tragic assassinations of the region’s greatest peacemakers, Anwar Sadat and Yitzhak Rabin, it is that the guns do not remain silent for long.
zh: 但如果中東地區最偉大的和平使者安瓦爾·薩達特和伊扎克·拉賓被刺的悲劇曾經留給過我們什麼教訓，那就是戰火熄滅的時間不會太長。

en: During any lull, a fanatic from either side could jump to center stage and, through an act of utter madness, kick up the settling dust and dash the hopes of the many on both sides who still long for a lasting peace.
zh: 在短暫的寧靜時刻，來自任何一方的狂熱分子隨時有可能跳到前臺，用絕對的瘋狂行為重新點燃戰爭的怒火，毀滅雙方愛好和平的人們對永久和平的期望。

en: After the Millennium Development Goals
zh: 千年發展目標之後

en: CAMBRIDGE – In 2000, 189 countries collectively adopted the United Nations Millennium Declaration, which evolved into a set of concrete targets called the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs).
zh: 美國劍橋—2000年，189個國家一致接受了聯合國千年宣言，並將其納入了被稱為千年發展目標（MDG）的一系列具體計劃中。

en: These ambitious targets – ranging from halving extreme poverty and reducing maternal mortality by three-quarters to achieving universal primary schooling and halting (and beginning to reverse) the spread of HIV/AIDS – are supposed to be met by the end of 2015.
zh: 這些雄心勃勃的計劃 — — 從將貧困降低一半和讓產婦死亡率減少四分之三到讓所有孩子都接受小學教育和讓艾滋病（毒）停止傳播（甚至減少 ） — —應該在2015年底之前完成。

en: As the deadline approaches, development experts are debating a new question: What comes next?
zh: 隨著截止期的臨近，發展專家們開始討論新的問題：接下去怎麼辦？

en: It is virtually certain that many of the MDGs will not have been met by the end of 2015, but there have been striking successes in some areas.
zh: 幾乎可以肯定的是，很多MDG在2015年底之前是實現不了的，但在不少領域還是取得了極大的成功。

en: For example, the goal of halving extreme poverty (measured by the number of people living on less than $1.25 a day) will likely be achieved ahead of time, largely thanks to China’s phenomenal growth.
zh: 比如，將極端貧困減少一半（以每天生活費不到1.25美元的人群數量為衡量標準）的目標就有可能提前完成，其中中國的顯著增長功不可沒。

en: At the same time, there is little evidence to suggest that those successes were the result of the MDGs themselves.
zh: 與此同時，沒有證據顯示這些成功是MDG本身的結果。

en: China implemented the policies that engineered history’s greatest poverty eradication program prior to, and independently from, the Millennium Declaration and the MDGs.
zh: 中國的史上最偉大減貧計劃因國內政策而起，發生於千年宣言和MDG之前，也獨立於後兩者。

en: Clearly, however, the MDGs were a public-relations triumph, which is not to belittle their contribution.
zh: 不過，毫無疑問，MDG稱得上公關勝利，這麼說並不是要貶低它們的作用。

en: Like all worthwhile PR efforts, the MDGs served to raise awareness, galvanize attention, and mobilize action – all for a good cause.
zh: 與所有有價值的公關活動一樣，MDG有助於提高認識、吸引注意力和動員行動，均是積極影響。

en: They amplified the global conversation about development and defined its terms.
zh: 它們擴大了關於發展問題的全球對話，並決定了對話的主題。

en: And there is evidence that they got advanced countries to pay more attention to poor nations.
zh: 有證據表明，它們還使發達國家更加關注窮國。

en: Indeed, the MDGs possibly had their clearest impact on aid flows from rich to poor countries.
zh: 事實上，MDG最顯而易見的影響可能就在於富國向窮國的援助流。

en: A study by Charles Kenny and Andy Sumner for the Center for Global Development in Washington, DC, suggests that the MDGs not only boosted aid flows, but also redirected them toward smaller, poorer countries, and toward targeted areas like education and public health.
zh: 華盛頓全球發展中心的查爾斯·肯尼（Charles Kenny）和安迪·薩姆納（Andy Sumner）的研究表明，MDG不但刺激了援助流，還將援助流定向至更小、更窮的國家以及教育和公共衛生等更為具體的領域。

en: However, aid was not directly linked to performance and results, and it is much more difficult to know whether it had the desired impact overall.
zh: 不過，援助與表現和效果並不直接相關，瞭解援助是否達到了理想效果要困難得多。

en: The MDGs encompass eight goals, 21 targets, and 60 indicators.
zh: MDG包括八個大目標（goal ） ， 21個小目標（target）和60項指標。

en: Much criticism has focused on the use of these numerical targets and indicators, which, skeptics argue, are misspecified, mismeasured, and divert attention from equally important areas.
zh: 許多批評的矛頭指向這些數量化的小目標和指標。 質疑者認為，它們的方向和衡量手段都是錯誤的，導致了注意力從其他同等重要領域移開。

en: But these complaints miss the point.
zh: 但這些指摘並沒有抓住重點。

en: Any effort that is concrete and implementable needs to monitor the results, and setting clear numerical targets is the best way to do so.
zh: 任何具體且可實施的目標都需要檢測結果，而設定清晰的數量目標是檢測結果的最佳方法。

en: Still, a central paradox plagues the MDGs.
zh: 但仍有一個核心悖論困擾著MDG。

en: The Millennium Declaration was meant to be a compact between the world’s rich and poor countries.
zh: 千年宣言不啻發達國家和貧窮國家之間的契約。

en: Poor countries promised to refocus their development efforts while rich countries pledged to support them with finance, technology, and access to their markets.
zh: 貧窮國家承諾重新調整發展努力，而發達國家承諾向它們提供金融、技術和市場渠道支援。

en: But, oddly, of the eight goals, only the last one deals with “global partnership,” or what rich countries can and should do.
zh: 但是，奇怪的是，在八個大目標中，只有最後一個是關於“全球合作 ” ， 即發達國家可以和應該怎麼做的。

en: Even here, the MDGs contain no numerical target for financial aid or any other aspect of rich countries’ assistance, in contrast to the highly specific poverty-related targets set for developing countries.
zh: 即使在這裡，MDG仍沒有為金融援助或其他發達國家援助設定數量化目標，這與針對發展中國家的極其具體的貧困相關目標形成了鮮明對比。

en: It is perhaps telling that the “progress charts” prepared by the United Nations Development Program, the agency charged with reporting on progress toward achieving the MDGs, track only Internet usage under that goal.
zh: 具有說明力的是，聯合國發展計劃署 — — 負責報告MDG進展情況的機構 — — 所準備的“進展圖”所追蹤的唯一一個該大目標相關數字是網際網路的使用情況。

en: Why we need a global effort to convince developing countries to do what is good for them is not clear.
zh: 為什麼我們需要全球措施來使發展中國家相信怎樣做才是最好的？

en: Poverty reduction and human development should be the first order of business for governments in these countries, with or without the MDGs.
zh: 這個問題還沒有明確答案。 減貧和人類發展應該是這些國家政府的首要職責，不管有沒有MDG都是如此。

en: It is true, of course, that these governments often pursue different goals, for political, military, and other reasons.
zh: 當然，實事求是地說，出於政治、軍事和其他原因，這些國家的政府通常會追求不同的大目標。

en: But it is wishful thinking to believe that they can be persuaded to act otherwise by international declarations that lack enforcement mechanisms.
zh: 但認為可以透過缺少強制機制的國際宣言說服它們改變做法純屬一廂情願。

en: If we have learned one thing in the development business, it is that real reform cannot be bought with donors’ money, let alone with vague promises of money.
zh: 如果說發展事務對我們有什麼教育意義的話，那就是真正的改革不可能是贊助者的金錢帶來的，更不用說只是虛無的承諾資金支援了。

en: Equally problematic, the MDGs implicitly assume that we know how to achieve development targets, and that only resources and political will are missing.
zh: 同樣有問題的是，MDG隱含地假設我們知道如何達到發展小目標，所缺乏的只是資源和政治意願。

en: But it is doubtful that even well-intentioned policymakers have a good handle on, say, how to raise secondary-school completion rates sustainably or reduce maternal mortality.
zh: 但即使是有心的決策者，他是否能處理好（比如）持續提高中學完學率和降低產婦死亡率等問題仍然值得懷疑。

en: Many development economists would argue that significant improvements in governance and political institutions are required before such goals can be achieved.
zh: 許多發展經濟學家會說，在大目標可以實現之前，必須發生治理和政治制度的重大進步。

en: The most that rich countries can do is to provide an enabling environment for the benefit of developing countries that are willing and able to take advantage of it.
zh: 發達國家最能給出的援助是提供促進性的環境，讓願意且有能力利用該環境的發展中國家收益。

en: These considerations suggest an obvious direction for the next iteration of the MDGs.
zh: 這些考慮清晰地給出了下一代MDG的方向。

en: First, a new global compact should focus more directly on rich countries’ responsibilities.
zh: 首先，新的全球契約應該更直接地專注於發達國家的責任。

en: Second, it should emphasize policies beyond aid and trade that have an equal, if not greater, impact on poor countries’ development prospects.
zh: 第二，它應該強調援助和貿易之外的、對貧窮國家的發展前景具有同樣（如果不是更大）推動的政策。

en: A short list of such policies would include: carbon taxes and other measures to ameliorate climate change; more work visas to allow larger temporary migration flows from poor countries; strict controls on arms sales to developing nations; reduced support for repressive regimes; and improved sharing of financial information to reduce money laundering and tax avoidance.
zh: 這些政策應該包括：碳稅和其他改善氣候變化的措施、增加貧窮國家臨時性人口遷徙的工作簽證、嚴格控制對發展中國家的軍售、減少對壓迫性政權的支援，以及改善金融資訊的共享狀況以打擊洗錢和逃稅。

en: Notice that most of these measures are actually aimed at reducing damage – for example, climate change, military conflict, and financial crime – that otherwise results from rich countries’ conduct.
zh: 注意，這些措施的大部分實際上都是為了減少發達國家援助行為的傷害 — — 比如氣候變化、軍事衝突和金融犯罪。

en: “Do no harm” is as good a principle here as it is in medicine.
zh: “不產生傷害”這一醫學格言在這裡同樣是一條很好的原則。

en: This kind of reorientation will not be easy.
zh: 制定這樣的新目標絕非易事。

en: Advanced countries are certain to resist any new commitments.
zh: 發達國家必然會抵制新承諾。

en: But most of these measures do not cost money, and, as the MDGs have shown, setting targets can be used to mobilize action from rich-country governments.
zh: 但這些措施大多並不需要金錢，MDG也表明，設定小目標可以用於動員發達國家政府的行動。

en: If the international community is going to invest in a bold new public-relations initiative, it might as well focus on areas where the potential payoffs are the greatest.
zh: 如果國際社會欲投資雄心勃勃的新公關計劃，那麼把目光集中在潛在收益比最高的領域是不錯的選擇。

en: After the Promised Land
zh: 追逐理想之地

en: LONDON – At the height of the Arab uprisings last spring, many Europeans were gripped by nightmare visions of a tsunami of migrants crashing against the continent’s shores.
zh: 倫敦 — — 去年春天，在阿拉伯起義愈演愈烈之際，許多歐洲人被大批移民將湧入歐洲的可怕遠景困擾。

en: The wave never hit, but its specter fed a tenacious anti-immigrant populism that has concealed an important new trend: migration to Europe – and to the United States – has largely stalled.
zh: 事實並非如此，但是這種恐懼感催生了強烈的反移民民粹主義，這掩蓋了一種重要的新趨勢：移民歐洲和美國基本上停滯了。

en: In many countries, more immigrants are leaving than are arriving, owing mainly to the economic crisis that has drained jobs in the West.
zh: 對於許多國家而言，移民國外的人要比入境的移民要多，這主要是因為經濟危機導致西方的就業崗位減少。

en: That reversal is one of the great under-reported stories of 2011 (and of the preceding two years), and the numbers are startling.
zh: 這種倒退的情況是2011年（以及2011年之前的兩年）報道嚴重不足的地方之一，各項資料令人吃驚。

en: Consider Spain, which is on track to lose more than a half-million residents by 2020.
zh: 拿西班牙來說，到2020年，其居民將減少50多萬。

en: By contrast, between 2002 and 2008, Spain’s population grew by 700,000 a year, driven largely by immigration.
zh: 相比之下，2002年至2008年期間，西班牙的人口每年增長70萬，這主要得益於移民。

en: The trends are similar elsewhere in Europe.
zh: 歐洲其他國家的趨勢也大同小異。

en: While this fact alone will not quiet opponents of immigration, it does give countries more breathing room to repair and strengthen badly broken systems for receiving and integrating newcomers.
zh: 儘管這一事實無法讓移民的反對者守住嘴巴，但是它讓各國有了更多的餘地，修復和加固嚴重受損的制度，以便接受新移民並讓他們融入本國。

en: Although rapidly aging Western countries are unable to attract the immigrants they need, they allow millions who are already there to suffer discrimination and abuse.
zh: 儘管快速老齡化的西方國家無法吸引其所需的移民，但是它們還讓數百萬已經移居於此的移民遭受歧視和虐待。

en: Detentions and deportations take place under sometimes terrible conditions.
zh: 有時在極其惡劣的環境下扣押和驅逐出境。

en: Meanwhile, the international community collectively fails to protect vast populations of vulnerable migrants, such as the millions stranded by the recent conflicts in North Africa.
zh: 與此同時，國際社會都沒有保護大量易受傷害的移民群體，比如因最近北非衝突陷入困境的數百萬人。

en: Undoubtedly, rising anti-immigrant populism must be confronted.
zh: 毋庸置疑，日益高漲的反移民民粹主義情緒必須加以遏制。

en: While polling suggests that attitudes are influenced more by ethnicity than religion, both help to define identities and mindsets.
zh: 但是民調顯示，民眾的態度較之宗教，更多的是受到種族的影響，種族和宗教都有助於確定身份和思維模式。

en: Political parties in France, Switzerland, and the Netherlands (to name a few) have run successful campaigns that scapegoat immigrants.
zh: 法國、瑞士和荷蘭等國的政黨都成功地發起了嫁禍移民的運動。

en: Moreover, governments from Alabama to Hungary are passing laws that undermine what should be migrants’ rights.
zh: 此外，從亞拉巴馬到匈牙利，各地政府正在透過法律，削弱移民應有的權利。

en: Italy recently adopted harsh “emergency” decrees that target migrants by making undocumented entry and residence a criminal offense.
zh: 最近，義大利採取了針對移民的嚴厲的“緊急”法案，將非法入境和居住視為犯罪。

en: Anti-immigrant rhetoric from the political extremes has fed into mainstream political discourse.
zh: 政治極端派反移民的言論已經進入政治討論的主流。

en: European leaders trip over themselves to declare, one more forcefully than the next, that multiculturalism is dead.
zh: 歐洲領導人搬起石頭砸自己的腳並且一浪高過一浪地宣佈，多元文化主義已經滅亡。

en: Dutch politician Geert Wilders, whose Freedom Party is informally part of the governing coalition, did them one better by being charged with incitement to anti-Muslim hatred.
zh: 荷蘭政客格特•懷爾德是自由黨人，自由黨不是正式執政聯盟的一部分，他受到了激起反穆斯林敵意的指控，比其他人做的要好。

en: In the US, alligator-filled moats and electrified border fences have featured in the current presidential campaign.
zh: 在美國邊境，壕溝中都是短吻鱷，還有帶電的圍欄，這顯示出了當前總統競選的特色。

en: Such attacks on immigration might offer some instant political gratification, but their net result is to cleave societies whose cohesion is already seriously challenged by the economic crisis.
zh: 這樣對移民進行攻擊或許能夠帶來一些即時的政治利益，但是最終結果必定會使社會分裂，而社會的凝聚力已經受到了經濟危機嚴重影響。

en: Growing discrimination in employment, housing, and education affects not just immigrants and their children; it harms our societies as a whole.
zh: 在就業、住房和教育方面日益嚴重的歧視問題不僅會影響移民及其後代，也不利於我們整個社會。

en: With the lull in net immigration, we now have a window of opportunity to address these shortcomings.
zh: 由於淨移民停滯，現在我們擁有了克服這些不足的機會之窗。

en: Debunking the myths about migration – that most immigrants enter unlawfully, for example, or that immigration displaces existing workers – would be a good place to start.
zh: 揭露移民方面的錯誤 — — 比如，大多數移民非法入境或移民導致現有工人失業 — — 是一個良好的開端。

en: It would also be useful to explain that immigration is necessary for prosperity and growth in almost all OECD countries.
zh: 移民幾乎對所有經合組織成員國的繁榮和經濟增長都必不可少，這種解釋也是非常有用的。

en: If aging societies in the West and elsewhere (like Japan) fail to get immigration right, they will be woefully unprepared when they confront the real tidal wave: the retirement of baby boomers in the coming two decades.
zh: 如果西方以及其他地方（比如日本）的老齡化社會沒有正確對待移民，當真正的浪潮來臨時，它們將不知所措：嬰兒潮一代在今後20年內退休。

en: The gaps in these countries’ labor markets – from software specialists to physicians to home health aides – will be immense.
zh: 這些國家的勞動力市場 — — 從軟體專家、醫生到家庭醫療助理等 — — 將出現巨大的缺口。

en: The European Union’s labor force will decline by almost 70 million workers in the next 40 years; in the absence of significant net immigration (combined with a much higher retirement age), European economies and social safety nets will shrivel.
zh: 歐盟的勞動力將在今後40年減少近7000萬名工人，如果沒有大量的淨移民，不大幅提高退休年齡，歐洲經濟體和社會保障體系將力不從心。

en: The priorities are clear.
zh: 優先任務非常清楚。

en: We need to understand better how our economies will evolve in the coming decades, and to redesign our educational systems to produce workers with usable skills.
zh: 我們需要更好地瞭解自己的經濟體在今後數十年將如何演化，需要重新設計我們的教育體制，從而培養出掌握有用技能的工人。

en: And, where it is clear that immigrants will be needed, we must be able to identify, welcome, integrate, and protect them.
zh: 此外，在明確需要移民的地方，我們必須能夠認可、歡迎並保護他們，讓他們融入到我們當中來。

en: Meanwhile, our most fundamental institutions – schools, police, and the courts – must be re-engineered to reflect and respond to the diversity of our communities, which is now a fact of life.
zh: 與此同時，我們最基本的機構 — — 學校、警察局和法院 — — 必須重新調整以反映和應對我們社群的多樣性，這是如今的真實生活。

en: Countries must learn to work together to achieve these goals, few of which can be reached by going it alone.
zh: 各國必須學會互相合作實現這些目標，單打獨鬥能實現的目標寥寥無幾。

en: If our toolbox were empty, our inaction might be understandable.
zh: 如果我們的工具箱空空如也，那麼我們無所作為或��可以理解。

en: But examples of smart migration practices abound.
zh: 但是採取明智移民舉措的例子比比皆是。

en: Canada and the Philippines, for instance, have a well-functioning accord that protects the rights of temporary workers.
zh: 譬如，加拿大和菲律賓擁有保護臨時工權利的協議，效果相當好。

en: Sweden has developed legislation that minimizes bureaucracy for companies that need foreign workers.
zh: 瑞典已經透過立法，為需要外國工人的公司儘量簡化了行政手續。

en: And important advances have been made in ensuring that immigrant children receive the education that they need to become full members of society.
zh: 在確保移民的孩子接受成為正式公民所需的教育方面也取得了重要進展。

en: Progress is being made on the global level as well, despite the economic crisis and populist headwinds.
zh: 儘管受到經濟危機和民粹主義的影響，全球而言還是取得了進展。

en: In June, the International Labor Organization’s member states overwhelmingly approved the Domestic Workers Convention, which will significantly increase protections for a vulnerable group of workers – the majority of whom are migrants.
zh: 6月份，國際勞工組織成員國以壓倒性優勢透過了《國內工人公約 》 ， 這將大大增加對易受傷害的勞動群體 — — 其中大多數是移民 — — 的保護。

en: Meanwhile, the Global Forum on Migration and Development, established in 2007, has quickly become an important means of fostering knowledge and partnerships.
zh: 與此同時，成立於2007年的移民與發展全球論壇迅速成為了增加知識和增進夥伴關係的重要途徑。

en: The reason for growing international cooperation is simple: countries everywhere are affected by migration, and, increasingly, they are experiencing immigration and emigration simultaneously.
zh: 國際合作日益增多的原因很簡單：世界各國都受到移民的影響，移民入境和本國居民移居海外在同時進行著。

en: Indeed, roughly one-third of migrants nowadays move between developed countries; one-third move between developing countries; and only one-third move from the developing to the developed world.
zh: 實際上，目前約三分之一的移民在發達國家之間流動；三分之一的移民在發展中國家之間流動；只有三分之一的移民在發展中國家和發達國家之間流動。

en: Highly skilled workers, such as bankers and engineers, are flocking to China.
zh: 有高技能的工人，比如銀行家和工程師，蜂擁去了中國。

en: Mexico, known primarily as a country of emigration, is home to millions of migrants from Central America.
zh: 墨西哥以主要的移民出口國出名，現在有來自中美洲的數百萬移民在此安家。

en: Millions of people in Southeast Asia venture to the Middle East to work, but millions more cross borders within the region.
zh: 有數百萬東南亞人冒險到中東工作，但是還有數百萬人跨境到該地區的其他國家。

en: The list goes on.
zh: 這樣的例子不勝列舉。

en: When it comes to migration, we are all in the same boat – and that boat is leaking.
zh: 關於移民，我們都坐在同一條船上，而這條船是漏水的。

en: Starting in 2012, countries should redouble their efforts to fix it.
zh: 從2012年開始，各國必須加倍努力解決這個問題。

en: A Future without Precedent
zh: 前所未有的未來

en: JERUSALEM – In my nearly nine decades of life, I cannot recall a time in which the past was so irrelevant to policymaking.
zh: 耶路撒冷—以我將近90歲的年紀，想不起有哪個時候的決策與過去如此毫無關聯。

en: All of today’s significant developments went unpredicted by anyone.
zh: 今天的一切重大發展都是所有人前所未見的。

en: Experts studied the past, but, constrained by old paradigms, they could not discern the future.
zh: 專家們研究過去，但他們被舊正規化限制住了頭腦，無法清醒地看到未來。

en: Today’s dynamic complexity, in which a science-based, fast-changing global economy makes so many more phenomena interdependent, prevents us from foreseeing the future through linear extrapolations of the past.
zh: 今天，世界充滿了動態的複雜性，基於科學、快速變遷的全球經濟使得如此之多的現象互相交錯，以至於我們無法透過根據過去的線性外推來預測未來。

en: The only certainty is that the future will be defined by scientific progress and innovation, which cannot be known ahead of time.
zh: 唯一確定的是，未來將由科學進步和創新決定，但科學進步和創新是無法預知的。

en: As a result, the traditional power of states and leaders is declining; in today’s global economy, innovators, not politicians, wield the most influence.
zh: 因此，傳統的國家和領袖權力在削弱；在當今全球經濟中，創新者，而不是政客，才擁有最大的影響力。

en: The globalized economy affects every state, yet no single state can determine the outcomes, because science and technology are borderless.
zh: 全球化經濟影響著所有國家，但沒有哪個國家能夠單槍匹馬決定結果，因為科學技術是無國界的。

en: Global companies wish to do business worldwide, eroding not just sovereignty, but also racism and prejudice, as well as significantly weakening nationalism.
zh: 全球公司希望在全世界範圍開展業務，這不但削弱了主權，也削弱了種族主義和偏見，並極大地抑制了民族主義。

en: This transformation has placed the world in the hands of a younger generation, more technologically savvy than their parents and connected to one another through social networks that are not confined by territory, language, or government.
zh: 這一轉型把世界交給了年青一代，他們比老一輩更精於技術，透過打破領土、語言和政府界限的社交網路彼此相連。

en: The young leaders who created Facebook and Google have had a greater global impact than many statesmen and generals.
zh: 創立Facebook和谷歌的青年領袖要比許多政治家和將軍擁有更大的全球影響力。

en: These young people are also the leaders of erupting political protest movements.
zh: 這些青年人也是風起雲湧的政治示威運動的領導人。

en: The “Arab Spring,” the tent demonstrations in Israel, Occupy Wall Street, and the protests in Russia reveal not a clash of civilizations, but a battle of generations.
zh: “阿拉伯之春 ” 、 以色列的露營示威 、 “ 佔領華爾街”以及俄羅斯大遊行所揭示的並不是文明的衝突，而是代際戰爭。

en: The young generation understands that the way states and economies are currently run is unfit for the new era.
zh: 年青一代明白，國家和經濟的現有執行模式已經落後於新時代了。

en: Yet there are political “hitchhikers” who want to exploit the recent awakening, not by promoting an agenda of freedom, but by imposing a different type of coercion.
zh: 但也有意在利用當下覺醒潮的“政治浪人 ” ， 他們不推行自由日程表，反而實行另一種形式的高壓。

en: In the Arab world, it is mainly extreme Islamists who are hijacking the young generation’s wave, stealing their revolution.
zh: 在阿拉伯世界，極端伊斯蘭主義者正在綁架年青一代的運動，竊取革命果實。

en: Israel has reacted positively to the will of the young generation, but it cannot and should not intervene in events in the Arab world.
zh: 以色列積極響應年青一代的志願，但不能也不應該干預阿拉伯世界的事務。

en: Our hearts are with the rebelling youngsters and their legitimate yearning for freedom and basic rights to express themselves, choose their leaders, and earn their own living.
zh: 我們的心與叛逆青年們在一起，支援他們對自由和表現自己、選擇自己的領導人、自力更生過自己的生活的權利的訴求。

en: Israelis wait for the day when our country will no longer be the region’s only democracy, because being an island of prosperity in a sea of poverty is unnatural.
zh: 以色列人期待著我們的祖國不再是該地區唯一民主國家的那一天，因為成為貧困汪洋中的繁榮孤島是極不自然的。

en: Yet there is a real concern that the extremists, who are politically well organized, are seeking to gain control by the ballot over less-organized liberals, thus preventing peace and stability.
zh: 但是，我們也有現實顧慮：有著良好政治組織的極端主義者正在尋求透過投票打敗組織鬆散的自由派贏得控制權，從而阻止和平與穩定。

en: Fundamentalist radicals cannot provide real solutions to the region’s basic problems.
zh: 原教旨主義激進派不可能為該地區的基本問題提供現實解決方案。

en: The social changes now underway threaten their way of life, which includes discrimination against women and a ban on modern education.
zh: 當今社會的變化正在威脅他們的生活 — — 歧視婦女、禁止現代教育。

en: But only profound reforms of traditional authority can pave the way towards freedom and growth.
zh: 但唯有對傳統權威的深遠改革才能鋪平通向自由和增長之路。

en: Israel can serve as an example to others striving to reach economic prosperity and social freedom, because its success is due to the fact that the country had absolutely nothing at the start.
zh: 對於正在追求經濟繁榮和社會自由者，以色列可以作為一個樣板，因為以色列的成功可以說完全是從一無所有起家的。

en: We returned to our homeland, rich with history, but devoid of natural resources.
zh: 我們回到了我們的故鄉，這裡有著豐富的歷史，但自然資源貧乏。

en: Israel was left with only one resource: its human capital.
zh: 以色列只有一種資源：人力資本。

en: So we invested in education and science, and today we have the world’s highest percentage of scientists and patents per capita.
zh: 因此我們投資於教育和科學，而如今，我們擁有全世界最高比例的科學家和人均專利數量。

en: Roughly 95% of our agriculture is hi-tech.
zh: 我們的農業95%是高科技農業。

en: We use less water and yield more crops per acre than any other country in the world.
zh: 我們用更少的水種出比世界上其他國家更多的糧食畝產。

en: What Israel can do, others can do as well.
zh: 以色列能夠做到的，其他國家也能做到。

en: We will gladly offer a helping hand to whoever is willing to reach for it.
zh: 只要願意向這方面努力，我們十分樂意施以援手。

en: Together, in peace with our neighbors, we can create a region of hope, development, and success.
zh: 與鄰邦保持和平，我們就可以開創一個希望、發展和成功的地區。

en: In particular, we must do everything in our power to end the conflict with the Palestinians.
zh: 尤其重要的是，我們必須盡一切力量終結與巴勒斯坦的衝突。

en: Israel was not born, and it is not Israel’s destiny, to govern another people.
zh: 以色列不是生來就主宰其他民族的，這也決不是以色列的命運。

en: We are sincerely interested in the establishment of a Palestinian state living peacefully side-by-side with Israel, the democratic state of the Jewish people.
zh: 我們真心實意地樂意看到能與猶太人民主國家以色列手拉手和平相處的巴勒斯坦國的建立。

en: For us, peace is both a moral imperative and a national-security strategy, because resolving the conflict would help to stabilize the region by neutralizing the extremists who seek to manipulate today’s popular movements to advance their radical agenda.
zh: 對我們來說，和平既是道德目標，也是國家安全戰略，因為解決衝突將有助於透過中和試圖操縱當下群眾運動從而實現其激進目標的極端分子實現地區穩定。

en: The international community can support these efforts by providing incentives to countries that choose freedom and progress.
zh: 國際社會可以透過向選擇自由和進步的國家提供激勵來支援我們的努力。

en: At the same time, determined and decisive policies must be taken against extremists.
zh: 與此同時，必須對極端分子採取堅決果斷的政策。

en: In particular, Iran is a fount of moral corruption that spearheads extremism and halts reform, crushing the legitimate protest of its own citizens and acting against the brave Syrians now fighting for their freedom.
zh: 特別是伊朗，這個國家是道德腐敗的源頭，極端主義的先鋒隊，改革的絆腳石；它鎮壓本國公民的合法示威，與正在為自由而鬥爭的勇敢的敘利亞人民作對。

en: Iran also uses proxies to instigate terror against moderate forces in the Palestinian Authority, Lebanon, and Iraq.
zh: 伊朗還透過其代理人教唆人們對巴勒斯坦權力機構、黎巴嫩和伊拉克的溫和派大搞恐怖主義。

en: If Iran is successful in its plan to acquire nuclear weapons, its leaders could shake the Middle East and encourage more extremism and violence.
zh: 如果伊朗成功地實現其獲得核武器的計劃，那麼其領導人將能夠震懾中東，掀起更多的極端主義和暴力。

en: Israel will defend itself if Iran continues to call for its destruction.
zh: 如果伊朗繼續倒行逆施，以色列將堅決捍衛自己。

en: However, the threat is not to Israel alone; Iran is a danger to the peace and stability of the entire world.
zh: 不過，感到威脅的並非只有以色列；伊朗是全世界和平與穩定的潛藏危機。

en: The world’s democracies have declared that they will not allow Iran to possess nuclear arms; it is their duty to follow through on that commitment, before doing so becomes impossible.
zh: 民主國家已經宣佈，不會容忍伊朗擁有核武器；民主國家應該堅決履行這一承諾，不能等到大勢已去才有所動作。

en: Beyond the short-term challenges ahead, we all have a duty to profoundly change the way we prepare our children to cope with today’s new world.
zh: 除了眼前的短期挑戰，我們所有人都有責任徹底改變我們為子孫後代準備的應對當今新世界的方法。

en: In an era where yesterday has become almost irrelevant and we can hardly predict tomorrow, the role of education must allow all children to reach their highest potential.
zh: 在一個過去幾乎毫無關聯、未來幾乎無法預測的時代，並需透過教育讓所有孩子獲得充分的潛能開發。

en: Today’s educators should inspire our children towards creativity and innovation.
zh: 現時代的教育者應該激發孩子的創造力和創新力。

en: Self-expression is as important as free expression.
zh: 自我表現與言論自由一樣重要。

en: I write this in the 88th year of my life, but not because I have learned from experience.
zh: 我已88歲之齡寫下這篇文字，但我之所以這麼說，並非是出於我的經驗。

en: On the contrary, experience is overrated, often constraining the courage needed to face tomorrow and build an unprecedented new world.
zh: 相反，經驗的作用被高估了，通常會阻撓直面明天、建設前所未有的新世界所需要的勇氣。

en: The future is already here; there is no point in looking back.
zh: 未來就在那裡，沒有必要回頭看。

en: Against Simplification
zh: 反對簡單化

en: NEW YORK – It is said that Americans have a genius for simplification.
zh: 紐約 — — 都說美國人善於將事情簡單化。

en: Gradually, however, the quest for it has become a global trend, one that continues to conquer new territories, just as blue jeans once did.
zh: 但是，追求簡單化早已逐漸成為一種全球趨勢，簡單化之風逾吹愈勁，就像當年的牛仔褲風尚。

en: The speed of our daily life is visibly increased – and not for the better – by this unstoppable evolution.
zh: 在這一不可阻擋的變化的影響下，我們的日常生活節奏在加快，這一點誰都能看出，但生活並沒有因此變得更好。

en: The tyranny of pragmatism seems to mark all of the complex dilemmas of our time.
zh: 實用主義大行其道似乎已成為現時代複雜困境的共同特徵。

en: Too many valid choices are ignored or skirted through the routine of short-cuts.
zh: 人們總是希望走捷徑，這使得許多有效選擇被忽略和遮蔽了。

en: Nowhere is this trend more damaging than in today’s mercantile approach to art.
zh: 說到這一趨勢的害處，沒有比藝術的商業化更大的了。

en: Even the much-praised notion of competition seems fake and cynically manipulated by the “corporate” mentality that now pervades the world of culture – by the financial pre-selection that determines what publishers, producers, and other impresarios will support.
zh: 當前的文化世界瀰漫著“公司”思維 — — 從財務角度出發預先選定發行商、製作商及其他藝術經理的支援物件 — — 這使得即便是廣受讚譽的“競爭”概念看起來也是假的，被可悲地操縱著。

en: Just imagine what might have happened with the works of, say, Proust, Kafka, Musil, Faulkner, or Borges had they been subjected to mass-market competition like shoes or cosmetics.
zh: 想象一下，將普魯斯特、卡夫卡、穆西爾、福克納和博爾赫斯像鞋子和化妝品那樣置於暢銷市場的競爭中去會是怎樣一幅情景。

en: Culture is a necessary pause from the daily rat race, from our chaotic and often vulgar political surroundings, and it is a chance to recover our spiritual energy.
zh: 文化是快節奏生活中必須的調節劑，讓我們從混亂可鄙的政治環境中暫時得到解脫；同時也讓我們的精神力量得到恢復。

en: Great books, music, and paintings are not only an extraordinary school of beauty, truth, and good, but also a way of discovering our own beauty, truth, and good – the potential for change, of bettering ourselves and even some of our interlocutors.
zh: 偉大的書、音樂和繪畫不僅是非比尋常的真善美學校，也是我們自身真善美的發現之路 — — 它們給我們帶來改變潛能，完善我們甚至我們的對話者。

en: If this respite and refuge is gradually narrowed and invaded by the same kind of “products” as those that dominate the mass market, we are condemned to be perpetual captives of the same stunted universe of “practicalities,” the ordinary agglomeration of clichés packaged in advertisements.
zh: 如果這一緩衝器和避難所逐漸被某些主宰暢銷市場的“產品”所壓縮和侵蝕，我們就將淪為這一畸形“實用”世界的永久奴隸，沉淪在被廣告包裝著得常規陳腐題材集合中。

en: I was thinking again about these old and seemingly unsolvable questions during my re-reading of a quite challenging novel by a close friend and a great writer, not very present in the vivid landscape of American letters of today.
zh: 我是在閱讀一本叛逆小說時開始再次思考這些老生常談但似乎無法解決的問題的。 這本小說的作者是我的一位好友，一位了不起的作家，但在當今美國生機勃勃的文壇中並不經常露臉。

en: The theme, style, and echo of his work says a lot, I think, about our simplified world.
zh: 我認為，他的作品的主題、風格以及反響是對我們簡單化世界的寫照。

en: The novel is Blinding, by Claudio Magris.
zh: 這部小說名叫《炫目 》 （ Blinding ） ， 克勞迪奧·馬格里斯（Claudio Magris）著。

en: Hailed in Europe as one of the great novels of the twentieth century, Blinding arrived in America only after a great delay, and never received the attention that it deserved.
zh: 本書在歐洲大受歡迎，被目為20世紀的偉大作品之一，但很晚才進入美國，而且一直沒有受到應有的關注。

en: Unfortunately, that is no surprise.
zh: 不幸的是，這一點都不令人奇怪。

en: The number of literary translations done nowadays in the United States is, according to a United Nations report, equal to that of Greece, a country one-tenth the size.
zh: 根據聯合國的報告，如今美國文學翻譯數量和希臘相當，而希臘只是一個只有美國十分之一的小國。

en: Imported books are thought to be too “complicated,” which is another way of saying that literature should deal with simple issues in a simple way, obeying the rules of the mass market, with its tricks of packaging, accessibility, advertisement, and comfort.
zh: 外來書籍被認為太“複雜 ” ， 潛臺詞就是文學作品應該用簡單的方式處理簡單話題，順應暢銷市場要求，需要包裝廣告、易得易讀。

en: At the core of Magris’ book is the destiny of a group of Italian communists who travel to Yugoslavia after the Second World War to contribute to the construction of a socialist society, only to be caught in the conflict between Stalin and Tito.
zh: 馬格里斯的書的中心是一群義大利共產黨員的命運，他們在二戰後前往南斯拉夫，幫助建設社會主義社會，但在斯大林和鐵托的衝突中身陷囹圄。

en: They are imprisoned for their Stalinist allegiance; when they are finally allowed to return to Italy, their old comrades refuse to accept them.
zh: 他們因效忠斯大林而被捕；而當他們最終獲准返回義大利時，又被義大利老同志們拒絕了。

en: The book’s plot spans two centuries of revolution.
zh: 該書的情節跨越了兩個世紀的革命。

en: Then, suddenly,
zh: 然後，突然地，

en: “the party vanished, overnight, as if all of a sudden a giant sponge had drained the entire sea, Adriatic and Austral, leaving litter and clots of mud, and all the boats stranded.
zh: “黨垮臺了，在一夜之間垮臺了，就好像是一塊巨大的海面吸乾了整個亞得里亞海和南海，留下一地狼藉，所有的船都擱淺了。

en: How can you go home again if the sea has been sucked down a vast drain that opened up beneath it, emptying it who knows where, into a void?
zh: 當海洋被海底的巨大排水口吸乾，成為一片沒人知道身居何處的灘塗時，你又怎能找到歸途？

en: The earth is arid and dead, but there won’t be another one, nor another heaven.”
zh: 地球成了荒蕪的不毛之地，但你找不到第二個地球，也找不到第二個天堂。 ”

en: The solitude of the individual facing his faith alone, without collective illusions, and forced to do something with himself in the arid, noisy world tells us something important about the exiled world of modernity and its complex and contradictory problems.
zh: 寂寞的人將孤獨面對自己的信仰，沒有集體幻覺誤導他，他將被迫在荒原上自力更生；而嘈雜的世界告訴了我們一些很重要的東西，關於這個被放逐的現代世界及其所包含的複雜而矛盾的問題的東西。

en: Magris’s novel is not only an important literary achievement; it also has a deep connection to the dangers that we face now, particularly the wave of fanaticism, from Mumbai to Oslo, in the name of a holy war against the “other.”
zh: 馬格里斯的小說不僅是文學上的重大成就，它與我們當今所面臨的危險有著深層次的聯絡，特別是從孟買到奧斯陸打著與“異端”聖戰名義的狂熱主義。

en: Are all the extremists searching for a new coherence, for a lost illusion of togetherness and a new hope of resurrection?
zh: 所有的極端主義都在尋找新的一致，尋找失落的團結幻覺，尋找復興的新希望嗎？

en: Can we ever forget September 11, 2001, the start of a bloody century in which the mystical force of hatred and destruction has recovered its strength?
zh: 我們可能忘記2001年9·11，拉開了神秘的仇恨和毀滅力量死灰復燃的血腥世紀的那一天嗎？

en: Are Osama Bin Laden’s minions, the bloody Hamas-Hezbollah battalions, or troubled loners like Timothy McVeigh, Theodore Kaczynski, and now Norway’s Anders Behring Breivik, the “heroes” of our contemporary nightmare?
zh: 本·拉登的門徒、血腥的哈馬斯-真主黨武裝，或麥克維（Timothy McVeigh ） 、 卡欽斯基（Theodore Kaczynski）以及最近的挪威人佈雷維克（Anders Behring Breivik）等其他困獸般的人物是我們當代噩夢中的“英雄”人物嗎？

en: Is this the “rebel” response to an overly globalized, incoherent, and ultimately disturbing reality?
zh: 這是對過度全球化、不和諧以及令人不堪煩擾的現實的“叛逆”嗎？

en: If so, their barbarism demands scrutiny – in relation to both historical precedent and to our modernity – rather than merely being labeled “monstrous” (though it certainly is that).
zh: 如果是的話，他們的野蠻行徑就必須仔細審查 — — 既要考察他們的歷史淵源，也要研究他們與我們的現代性的關係 — — 而不是給他們貼上“惡魔”的標籤（儘管這在所難免）了事。

en: The new religious militants, fighting in the name of their particular and peculiar God, seem as fanaticized as the Fascists, Nazis, and Communists of earlier decades.
zh: 新的宗教激進分子是在各自不同的上帝名義下鬥爭的，正如幾十年前的法西斯主義、納粹主義和共產主義狂熱。

en: Magris’s main character is a rebel in more than one embodiment: as Salvatore Cipico, one of the inmates in the communist concentration camp in Yugoslavia; as Jurgen Jurgensen,  ephemeral king of Iceland and a convict forced to build his own jail; and as Jason, the mythic adventurer searching for the volatile truth.
zh: 馬格里斯小說中的主角是一個多重反叛角色：如薩爾瓦多·西皮科（Salvatore Cipico ） ， 南斯拉夫共產主義集中營中的一員；又如約根·約根森（Jurgen Jurgensen ） ， 被迫自掘墳墓的短命冰島國王；又如傑森（Jason ） ， 尋找捉摸不定的真理的神話冒險家。

en: A multilayered and complex chronicle of the devastating tragedies of the twentieth century, Blinding is an insistent, informed, and irreplaceable incursion into the moving landscape of the human soul, its wounds and voids, its vitality and versatility, its deep distortions and its unpredictable dynamics.
zh: 《炫目》是一部關於20世紀毀滅性悲劇的多層次複雜編年史，入木三分地描繪了不斷變化的人類靈魂圖景、它的創傷和空虛、它的活力和多能、它的深深的扭曲和它的不可預測的活力，這是一部堅韌的、資訊量極豐富的、不可替代的作品。

en: It is a fascinating story about the conflict between ideals and reality, or Utopia and humanness; about being faithful to a cause and betraying it; and about sacrifice and solidarity.
zh: 這是一個夢幻般的故事，它講述了理想和現實（或者說烏托邦和人性）的衝突，講述了信仰和背叛的，講述了犧牲和團結。

en: It is also a rich and original literary achievement that challenges today’s consumerist ethic.
zh: 這也是一部具有豐富內涵的反對當今消費主義思想的原創文學大作。

en: By renouncing simplicity, it also repudiates today’s prevailing confusion of information with literature, of facts with creativity, and best-selling products with true works of art.
zh: 這部小說斷然否定簡單化，也否定了當今的流行思潮 — — 混淆資訊與文學、現實與創造力以及暢銷作品與真正藝術品。

en: An Agenda for Resolving the US-China Conflict
zh: 化解美中衝突的議程

en: NEW HAVEN – With charges flying back and forth between the United States and China ahead of the eagerly awaited December 1 meeting between President Donald Trump and President Xi Jinping at the upcoming G20 meeting in Buenos Aires, resolving the conflict has taken on great urgency.
zh: 紐黑文市 — — 隨著定於12月1日即將召開的唐納德·特朗普總統和習近平主席備受期待的布宜諾斯艾利斯20國集團峰會美中首腦會晤前雙方的相互指責滿天飛，化解衝突已經成為一個非常緊迫的問題。

en: The alternatives pose grave risks for both countries: an ever-escalating trade war, a cold war, or even a hot war.
zh: 替代選擇會給雙方都帶來嚴重的風險：不斷升級的貿易戰、冷戰，甚至是一場真正的戰爭。

en: These risks can be avoided, but only if both leaders are willing to engage in principled compromise.
zh: 上述風險可以避免，但前提是兩國領導人都願意作出有原則的妥協。

en: There is no question that a serious conflict has been building for a long time.
zh: 毫無疑問，長期以來一直存在著嚴重的衝突。

en: Contrary to the US narrative, the problem is not the outsize bilateral trade deficit between the world’s two largest economies.
zh: 與美國的說法相反，問題並不在於世界前兩大經濟體之間雙邊貿易逆差過大。

en: That is largely an outgrowth of macroeconomic imbalances that afflict both sides: China saves too much and the US saves too little.
zh: 而主要在於困擾兩國的宏觀經濟失衡：中國儲蓄太多，而美國則儲蓄過少。

en: These saving disparities give rise to multilateral trade imbalances that cannot be resolved by bilateral efforts.
zh: 上述儲蓄差異導致了雙邊努力所無法解決的多邊貿易失衡。

en: The US had merchandise trade deficits with 102 countries in 2017, whereas China had trade surpluses with 169 countries in 2016.
zh: 2017年美國與世界102個國家出現商品貿易逆差，而2016年中國則與世界169個國家擁有貿易盈餘。

en: Squeeze one part of the multilateral imbalance for a deficit country or a surplus saver, and it simply gets allocated to other trading partners.
zh: 如果單純擠壓赤字國或盈餘儲蓄國多邊不平衡的某個部分，那麼貿易不平衡分配給其他貿易伙伴將會是唯一的結局。

en: For the US, this would lead to higher-cost imports – the functional equivalent of a tax hike on consumers.
zh: 對美國而言，這將導致抬高進口成本 — — 類似於向消費者徵稅所起到的作用。

en: For China, it would spell increased export penetration into other markets.
zh: 而對中國而言，這意味著增加對其他市場的出口滲透率。

en: Fixation on the blame game of bilateral trade imbalances overlooks the possibility that this is a classic struggle of codependency.
zh: 將注意力集中在就雙邊貿易失衡而相互指責忽略了這是一種經典的相互依存鬥爭的可能性。

en: Yes, China has long relied on the US as the major source of external demand for its export-led economy.
zh: 誠然，中國長期以來一直依賴美國作為其出口導向型經濟的主要外部需求來源。

en: But the US needs low-cost imports from China to make ends meet for its income-constrained consumers; it also relies on China as the largest foreign buyer of US Treasuries to help fund chronic government budget deficits.
zh: 但美國也同樣需要從中國進口低成本商品，才能維持其收入有限的消費者的收支平衡；美國還依賴中國作為美國國債規模最大的國外買家來協助平衡其長期以來的政府預算赤字。

en: And, as America’s third largest and most rapidly growing export market, China has become an increasingly important source of demand for US firms.
zh: 而作為美國第三大、同時也是增長最快的出口市場，中國已經成為美國企業越來越重要的需求來源地。

en: The codependency framework is important because it underscores the need for joint resolution and compromise.
zh: 相互依賴的框架非常重要，因為它強調了聯合解決和相互妥協。

en: As in interpersonal relationships, economic codependency can be destabilizing and ultimately destructive.
zh: 就像在人際關係中，經濟依賴可能會破壞穩定，並最終帶來毀滅性的後果。

en: When one partner changes course, the other, feeling scorned, lashes out in response.
zh: 當夥伴國之一改弦更張時，另一個感覺受到輕視的夥伴所做出的反應很可能是猛烈攻擊。

en: China, in this case, is the change agent – shifting its growth model from manufacturing to services, from exports to internal consumption, and from imported technology to indigenous innovation.
zh: 現階段，中國扮演了變革因素 — — 將其增長模式從製造業轉向服務業、從出口轉向內部消費，並從進口技術轉向自主創新。

en: At the same time, China is also moving from surplus saving to saving absorption, leaving it less to lend to its deficit partner, the US.
zh: 與此同時，中國還從盈餘儲蓄轉向儲蓄吸收，這導致它不再有那麼多錢為美國這個赤字夥伴國提供借貸。

en: Uncomfortable in its own skin, the US feels threatened by a partner that is changing the rules of this relationship.
zh: 不安的美國感受到了來自夥伴國的威脅，因為這個夥伴國正在改變設定的關係。

en: While Trump has acted on those threats far more aggressively than his predecessors, there can be no mistaking the bipartisan US sentiment now aligned against China.
zh: 雖然特朗普對上述威脅所採取的行動遠比自己的前任更加激進，但不容置疑的是，在中國問題上美國現在的兩黨情緒正在達成高度的統一。

en: According to a September 2018 Axios survey, fully 80% of Republicans – long the party most supportive of free trade – believed that increased tariffs would be good for the US.
zh: 據2018年9月進行的一次愛可信調查顯示，佔總數80%的共和黨人 — — 共和黨長期以來一直是自由貿易的最大支持者 — — 認為提高關稅將會對美國有益。

en: Leading Republicans, such as Vice President Mike Pence and former Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson, have warned of a new cold war with China, while leading Democrats have come to the view that China has abrogated its role as a responsible global stakeholder.
zh: 最具影響力的共和黨人，例如副總統邁克·彭斯和前財政部長亨利·保爾森，已經警告可能與中國爆發新冷戰，而最具影響力的民主黨人也一致認為中國已經放棄了自身作為全球利益相關方的責任。

en: At a time of ever-escalating threats and counter-threats, the imperative of compromise cannot be understated.
zh: 在這樣一個不斷升級的威脅和反威脅時代，決不能忽視妥協的必要性。

en: The upcoming meeting between Trump and Xi provides an opportunity to reframe the conflict as a strategic challenge for the world’s two leading economies.
zh: 特朗普和習近平即將舉行的會晤提供了重新定義美中衝突，並使之成為世界兩大主要經濟體所面臨的戰略挑戰的機會。

en: Four possible avenues to consider:
zh: 我們必須考慮四種可能的途徑。

en: Market access: After ten years of tortuous negotiations, the time for a breakthrough on a US-China bilateral investment treaty (BIT) is at hand.
zh: 市場準入：經過長達十年的曲折談判，美中雙邊投資協議（BIT）現在正面臨著突破的時機。

en: Both sides would need to offer concessions.
zh: 雙方均需要做出讓步。

en: A BIT would lift ownership caps on foreign direct investment by multinational corporations in both countries, eliminating the contentious joint-venture structure in China that the US continues to insist – incorrectly, in my view – has become a mechanism for forced technology transfer.
zh: 美中雙邊投資協議將提升兩國跨國企業實施外國直接投資的所有權上限，取消中國充滿爭議的合資機制，美國一直堅持這種合資安排已經成為一種強制技術轉讓的機制，而在我看來美國這種堅持並無道理。

en: A BIT would also enable an expansion of Chinese ownership of US-domiciled assets – posing a challenge to the anti-China thrust of recent legislation that broadens the oversight powers of the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States.
zh: 雙邊投資協議還將擴大中國對美國註冊資產的所有權 — — 從而挑戰不久前透過的擴大美國外國投資委員會監管權的推動反華的相關法律。

en: Saving: Both countries need to commit to responsible macroeconomic adjustments.
zh: 儲蓄：兩國均需要承諾作出負責任的宏觀經濟調整。

en: The US needs to save more, reversing the reckless budget-busting trajectory reinforced by last year’s ill-timed, outsize tax cuts.
zh: 美國需要加強儲蓄，徹底逆轉去年不合時宜的大規模減稅所帶來的不計後果的破壞預算的軌跡。

en: Rebuilding saving, rather than tariffs, is the most effective strategy to reduce trade deficits with China or any other trading partner.
zh: 重建儲蓄而非關稅是減少與中國或其他任何貿易伙伴貿易赤字的最為有效的策略。

en: At the same time, China needs to save less, putting its vast pool of capital to work funding the country’s social safety net, which is essential for consumer-led economic rebalancing.
zh: 與此同時，中國需要減少儲蓄，利用所積累的海量資金來建設該國的社會安全網，這與由消費者主導的經濟再平衡之間有著至關重要的聯絡。

en: Cyber security: The digital realm is the battleground of the Information Age, and the September 2015 accord between President Barack Obama and Xi clearly did not go far enough in defusing persistent tensions over online espionage, hacking, and disruption.
zh: 網路安全：數字領域是資訊時代的主戰場，而美國總統巴拉克·奧巴馬和習近平於2015年9月所達成的協議顯然沒有有效地緩解網路間諜、駭客攻擊和破壞的持續不斷的緊張局勢。

en: The two countries should take the lead in forging a global cyber accord, complete with pooled metrics of cyber incursions, attack-reduction targets and a robust dispute-resolution mechanism.
zh: 兩國應率先制定全球網路協議，上述協議應包括網路入侵、緩解攻擊目標和強有力的爭端解決機制等彙總指標來加以綜合考慮。

en: Dialogue: It is terrific that the two presidents are meeting again after their earlier tête-à-têtes in Beijing and at Mar-a-Lago.
zh: 對話：兩位總統在早前北京和海湖莊園舉行的兩次會晤後再次舉行會晤無疑是件幸事。

en: Those gatherings follow more formal engagements such as the Strategic and Economic Dialogue.
zh: 那些會晤遵循更為正式的安排，如戰略和經濟對話。

en: But all of these efforts have been episodic events that are long on glitz and short on substance.
zh: 但所有這些努力其實都逃脫不了偶發的性質，雖然光彩奪目，但卻缺少實質。

en: A permanent secretariat that would engage in full-time collaborative efforts on key policy issues (including data sharing, joint research, and public-private consultation) would be far more productive.
zh: 設立就關鍵政策問題（包括資料共享、聯合研究和公私協商）進行全天候合作的常設秘書處將會是更富於成效的舉措。

en: In light of contentious recent developments between the US and China, it is hard to be optimistic that a meaningful breakthrough is at hand.
zh: 鑑於美中之間近期充滿爭議的事態發展，人們很難對雙方取得有意義的突破保持樂觀的態度。

en: An agenda of substance should be used as a checklist against any accord that may be struck by Trump and Xi.
zh: 應當對照一份實質性的內容清單來檢驗特朗普和習近平可能達成的任何協議。

en: The world is watching.
zh: 全世界都在拭目以待。

en: The Age of Hyper-Uncertainty
zh: 超級不確定性時代

en: BERLIN – The year 2017 will mark the 40th anniversary of the publication of John Kenneth Galbraith’s The Age of Uncertainty.
zh: 柏林—2017年是約翰·肯尼斯·加爾佈雷斯（John Kenneth Galbraith）的《不確定性的時代 》 （ The Age of Uncertainty）出版四十週年。

en: Forty years is a long time, but it is worth looking back and reminding ourselves of how much Galbraith and his readers had to be uncertain about.
zh: 四十年很長，但值得回首並提醒我們自己加爾佈雷斯和他的讀者有多大的不確定。

en: In 1977, as Galbraith was writing, the world was still reeling from the effects of the first OPEC oil-price shock and wondering whether another one was in the pipeline (as it were).
zh: 1977年，在加爾佈雷斯寫作這本書的同時，世界仍在第一次歐佩克石油衝擊的影響中掙扎，也不知道會不會有第二次衝擊（後來發生了 ） 。

en: The United States was confronting slowing growth and accelerating inflation, or stagflation, a novel problem that raised questions about policymakers’ competence and the adequacy of their economic models.
zh: 美國正面臨增長減速、通脹加速，亦即滯漲，這個突出的問題令人們開始質疑決策者的勝任能力以及他們的經濟模型的適當性。

en: Meanwhile, efforts to rebuild the Bretton Woods international monetary system had collapsed, casting a shadow over prospects for international trade and global economic growth.
zh: 與此同時，重建佈雷頓森林國際貨幣體系的努力以失敗告終，給國際貿易和全球經濟增長前景蒙上一層陰影。

en: For all these reasons, the golden age of stability and predictability that was the third quarter of the twentieth century seemed to have abruptly drawn to a close, to be succeeded by a period of greatly heightened uncertainty.
zh: 出於所有這些原因，貫穿二十世紀第三個四分之一的穩定和可預測性的全球時代似乎戛然而止，隨之而來的是一個不確定性突出的時期。

en: That’s how things looked in 1977, anyway.
zh: 無論如何，1977年的情況就是這樣。

en: Viewed from the perspective of 2017, however, the uncertainty of 1977 seems almost enviable.
zh: 但是，從2017年的視角看，1977年的不確定性簡直令人嫉妒。

en: In 1977, there was no President Donald Trump.
zh: 1977年，沒有唐納德·特朗普總統。

en: Jimmy Carter may not go down in history as one of the best US presidents, but he did not threaten actions that placed the entire global system at risk.
zh: 吉米·卡特也許不是美國歷史上最好的總統個，但他沒有威脅要採取讓整個全球體系陷入危險的行動。

en: He did not turn his back on America’s international commitments such as NATO and the World Trade Organization.
zh: 他沒有背棄北約和世界貿易組織等美國的國際責任。

en: Nor did Carter go to war with the Federal Reserve or pack its board with sympathetic appointees willing to sacrifice sound money to his reelection prospects.
zh: 卡特也沒有向美聯儲宣戰，或用同情他、願意犧牲可靠貨幣助他連任的人選填充美聯儲理事會。

en: On the contrary, he appointed Paul Volcker, a towering pillar of monetary stability, as chairman of the Board of Governors.
zh: 相反，他認命了貨幣穩定的中流砥柱保羅·沃爾克（Paul Volcker）為美聯儲理事會主席。

en: And although Carter did not succeed in balancing the federal budget, he didn’t blow it up, either.
zh: 而儘管卡特沒能成功地平衡聯邦預算，但他也沒有弄得一團糟。

en: Whether Trump slaps a tariff on Chinese goods, repudiates the North American Free Trade Agreement, packs the Federal Reserve Board, or undermines fiscal sustainability remains to be seen.
zh: 特朗普是否會對中國商品課以關稅、廢除北美自由貿易協定、用自己人填充美聯儲理事會，或者損害財政可持續性仍有待觀察。

en: Conceivable outcomes range from mildly reassuring to utterly catastrophic.
zh: 差可令人放心到十足的災難都有可能。

en: Who knows what will happen?
zh: 誰知道會發生什麼？

en: By today’s standards, Carter was the embodiment of predictability.
zh: 從今天的標準看，卡特簡直是可預測性的化身。

en: In 1977, moreover, the prospects for European integration were rosy.
zh: 此外，1977年，歐洲一體化前景光明。

en: Denmark, Ireland, and, most notably, the United Kingdom had recently joined a rapidly growing European Community.
zh: 丹麥、愛爾蘭以及最受矚目的英國剛剛加入茁壯成長中的歐洲共同體。

en: The EC was attracting members, not losing them.
zh: 歐共體吸引著新成員，而不是失去它們。

en: It was a club that countries sought to join precisely in order to achieve faster economic growth.
zh: 它是一個俱樂部，國家之所以加入其中，正是為了實現更快的經濟增長。

en: Moreover, to buttress its common market, the EC had just established a regional monetary system, the suggestively named “snake in the tunnel.”
zh: 此外，為了支援共同市場，歐共體剛剛成立了區域貨幣體系，並暗示性地命名為“隧道蛇 ” 。

en: While this was far from a perfect monetary system, it had one very positive attribute: countries could leave in hard economic times, and rejoin if and when the outlook brightened.
zh: 儘管這遠非完美的貨幣體系，但有一個非常積極的特性：各國可以在經濟艱難時期離開，並在前景恢復光明後重新加入。

en: In 2017, in contrast, negotiations over Brexit will continue to cast a dark cloud of uncertainty over the European Union.
zh: 相反，2017年，圍繞英國退歐的談判將繼續成為飄蕩在歐盟上空的一朵烏雲。

en: How those negotiations will proceed and how long they will take are anyone’s guess.
zh: 這些談判如何進行、將消耗多長時間，我們都只能猜測。

en: Moreover, the main questions raised by Britain’s decision to leave – whether other countries will follow and, indeed, whether the EU itself has a future – remain far from resolved.
zh: 此外，英國退出歐盟的決定所帶來的主要問題 — — 其他國家是否會效仿，以及，事實上歐盟自身還有沒有未來 — — 也遠未解決。

en: Meanwhile Europe’s monetary house remains half built.
zh: 與此同時，歐洲貨幣大廈仍然處於爛尾狀態。

en: The eurozone is neither appealing enough to attract additional members nor flexible enough to grant troubled incumbents a temporary holiday, in the manner of the currency snake. The euro will likely survive the year, inertia being what it is.
zh: 歐元區既不足以吸引更多的成員，也不夠靈活可以給陷入麻煩的成員暫時離開喘息的機會（即蛇形浮動 ） 。

en: In 1977, uncertainties emanating from emerging markets were not on commentators’ radar screens.
zh: 1977年，源自新興市場的不確定性根本提不起評論家的興趣。

en: Developing countries in Latin America and East Asia were growing, although they depended increasingly on a drip feed of foreign loans from money-center banks.
zh: 拉丁美洲和東亞的發展中國家正在成長，盡��越來越依賴貨幣中心銀行的外幣貸款續命。

en: China, still largely cut off from the world, did not figure in this discussion.
zh: 中國仍然基本與世隔絕，不再人們的討論範圍中。

en: And even if something went wrong in the Third World, developing countries were simply too small to drag down the global economy.
zh: 而即便第三世界出現某些狀況，發展中國家規模實在太小，不足以拖累全球經濟。

en: The situation today couldn’t be more different.
zh: 今天的情況大相徑庭。

en: What happens in China, Brazil, or Turkey doesn’t stay in China, Brazil, or Turkey.
zh: 中國、巴西或土耳其的情況所影響到的絕不僅限於中國、巴西或土耳其。

en: On the contrary, developments in these countries have first-order implications for the world economy, given how emerging markets have accounted for the majority of global growth in recent years.
zh: 相反，這些國家的形勢將給世界經濟帶來最為重大的影響，因為近幾年來新興市場一貫貢獻著全球增長的大部分。

en: China has an unmanageable corporate-debt problem and a government whose commitment to restructuring the economy is uncertain.
zh: 中國存在一個難以管理的公司債務問題，政府關於調整經濟結構的承諾也處於不確定中。

en: Turkey has a massive current-account deficit, an erratic president, and an unstable geopolitical neighborhood.
zh: 土耳其存在巨大的經常賬戶赤字，有一位反覆無常的總統，還有一個不穩定的地緣政治周邊。

en: And if political scandals were export goods, Brazil would have a clear comparative advantage.
zh: 而如果政治醜聞可以出口的話，巴西將擁有明顯的比較優勢。

en: Although The Age of Uncertainty was about much more than the year 1977, it captured the tenor of the times.
zh: 儘管《不確定性的時代》跟多地是關於1977年的著作，但它抓住了時代的主旨。

en: But if Galbraith were writing the same book in 2017, he probably would call the 1970s The Age of Assurance.
zh: 但如果加爾佈雷斯在2017年寫作這本書，他可能會將20世紀70年代稱為《確定的時代 》 。

en: A German Europe?
zh: 德國的歐洲？

en: LISBON/RIGA – Is the Europe that is emerging from the euro crisis a German one?
zh: 里斯本/里加 — — 歐元危機中的歐洲成了德國的歐洲？

en: During the euro crisis, power in the European Union seems to have shifted towards national capitals in general, and towards one national capital in particular: Berlin.
zh: 歐元危機期間，歐洲聯盟的力量似乎已經向主要國家首都轉移，尤其是柏林。

en: But, with Germany introverted, France downgraded, and Britain semi-detached, the big story in European foreign policy is that the time has come for the little guy who thinks big.
zh: 但是，德國轉內，法國降級，英國半獨立，在歐洲外交政策的大故事Ａ是，讓小傢伙有大作用的時候到了。

en: In this Europe, the important moves are now sometimes made in Stockholm or Warsaw, not only in Berlin, Paris, or London.
zh: 在歐洲，這一重要舉措不僅出現在柏林、巴黎或倫敦，現在也有時出現在斯德哥爾摩或華沙。

en: And, with major foreign-policy issues on Europe’s doorstep – whether in Egypt, Belarus, or now Syria – useful European initiatives are to be welcomed, regardless of where they originate.
zh: 歐洲門檻上的重大外交政策問題 - 無論是在埃及，白俄羅斯，或現在的敘利亞 – 實用的歐洲倡議是受歡迎的，無論它們源於何方。

en: Germany, in foreign policy as well as in economics, can exert decisive leadership in the EU – when it wants to.
zh: 德國無論在外交政策還是在經濟上，都可以在歐盟中發揮決定性的領導地位。

en: For example, together with Poland, it led the EU’s attempt to develop a coordinated approach to Russia, and it flexed its muscles on Serbia.
zh: 例如，它與波蘭一起，帶領歐盟試圖建立與俄羅斯的協調關係，並延伸向塞爾維亞。

en: But, on other issues – for example, Libya – Germany did not so much lead as use its newfound room for maneuver to follow its own preferences in the face of other EU members.
zh: 但是，在其他問題上，例如利比亞，德國沒有為了自身利益在其他歐盟成員面前太多地使用迴旋的新餘地。

en: So the answer today to Henry Kissinger’s famous question about whom he should call when he wants to speak to Europe, is not necessarily “the German chancellor.”
zh: 所以，今天對於基辛格著名問題有關當他想與歐洲對話時該找誰的答案不必再是德國總理了。

en: While Berlin is increasingly imposing its economic preferences on others in the eurozone, it is not prepared to use military force as a foreign-policy tool, as it demonstrated in the case of Libya.
zh: 雖然柏林在歐元區不斷加強其經濟上對別國的影響，但它不準備使用武力作為外交政策工具，正如它在利比亞所做的那樣。

en: Moreover, Germany, it seems, is becoming a “geo-economic power” driven by the needs of its export sector.
zh: 此外，德國似乎因其出口部門的需求驅動而成為一個“地緣經濟力量 ” 。

en: By using economic means to pursue its foreign-policy ends, Germany is gradually turning its back on its European partners.
zh: 用其經濟手段來實現外交政策目的，德國正逐漸背向其歐洲夥伴。

en: Meanwhile, as France experiences a loss of power relative to Germany on economic issues, it continues to play a decisive role in foreign policy.
zh: 與此同時，法國經歷了相對德國來說在經濟問題上權力的損失，它仍在外交政策上發揮決定性的作用。

en: France led the Libya operation, and is doing much the same with attempts to impose stronger sanctions against Iran and provide support for the United Nations in Côte d’Ivoire.
zh: 法國引導利比亞運作，並試圖對伊朗實施更嚴厲的制裁，正如其提供對聯合國在象牙海岸的支援一樣。

en: But France’s unilateral approach often antagonizes its European partners.
zh: 但法國的單邊主義做法往往使其與歐洲夥伴敵對。

en: For example, French President Nicolas Sarkozy preempted a common European position on the Palestinian statehood bid at the UN in September.
zh: 例如，9月份，法國總統薩爾科齊在聯合國巴勒斯坦建國投票中搶佔了歐洲共同立場。

en: In other words, even when France leads, it does not always do so in a constructive way.
zh: 換句話說，即使由法國來領導，它也並不總是用這樣建設性的方式.

en: Apart from the decisive role that it played in Libya alongside France, Britain is becoming increasingly marginal in European foreign policymaking.
zh: 除了與法國一起在利比亞發揮了決定性的作用，英國在歐洲外交決策中變得日益邊緣化。

en: Even before it vetoed a plan by eurozone countries to create a “fiscal union” at the European summit in December 2011, it was playing less of a leadership role than it traditionally has on key European foreign-policy issues.
zh: 儘管之前，在2011年12月的歐盟首腦會議上它否決了一項由歐元區國家提出的建立“財政聯盟”計劃，它在歐洲關鍵外交政策上的影響與其以前的傳統領導地位相比正在逐漸減弱。

en: Britain has continued to support EU enlargement, closer links with Turkey, and development in Africa, but it has not launched any creative initiatives to bring other member states along or change the terms of the EU debate.
zh: 英國支援歐盟東擴，發展與土耳其更密切的聯絡及對非洲的開發，但還沒有推出任何創造性的舉措，使其他成員國支援或改變歐盟爭論的條款。

en: On other issues, such as engaging “strategic partners” – China and Russia in particular – the United Kingdom is often a follower as well.
zh: 在其他問題上，如搞“戰略伙伴 ” — —特別是對中國和俄羅斯 — — 英國往往也是支持者。

en: As the “big three” increasingly pursue their own narrowly defined national interests, however, other EU member states are emerging as leaders in key foreign-policy fields.
zh: “三巨頭”越來越追求自己狹隘的國家利益，而其他歐盟成員國正在成為重要外交政策領域的領導者。

en: For example, Sweden – the 14th largest member state in terms of population, and eighth in terms of GDP – under the leadership of Prime Minister Fredrik Reinfeldt and Foreign Minister Carl Bildt punches considerably above its weight.
zh: 例如，瑞典 — — 成員國中人口排列第14位，GDP第8位 — — 在首相賴因費爾特和外交大臣卡爾·比爾特的領導下，其影響力遠遠大於其排位。

en: Last year, it increased annual aid to North Africa by SEK100 million (€11.1 million), proposed an EU mission to Tunisia just a week after the revolution to support democratic aspirations there, and was an early and strong backer of UN resolutions in support of the uprising in Libya.
zh: 去年，它對北非的年度支援增加了100萬克朗（11.1百萬歐元 ） ， 突尼西亞革命一週後，它提出派一個歐盟代表團以支援那裡的民主意願，也是聯合國有關支援利比亞起義決議的早期和強大的支持者。

en: Poland, too, is emerging as a foreign-policy leader.
zh: 波蘭，也逐漸成為外交政策的領導者。

en: Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Foreign Minister Radek Sikorski have particularly taken the initiative on the EU’s strategy towards Russia, where Poland has largely overcome its differences with Germany and is now at the forefront of efforts to develop a genuinely comprehensive approach.
zh: 總理圖斯克和外長西科斯基尤其在歐盟對俄羅斯的戰略上採取主動，波蘭已經在很大程度上克服了與德國的分歧，現在正努力發展真誠廣泛的途徑。

en: Poland has also led on European defense (though it declined to take part in the military intervention in Libya).
zh: 波蘭也領導了歐洲防務（儘管它拒絕參加在利比亞的軍事幹預 ） 。

en: This reflects the strength of the Polish economy, which is expected to grow by more than 3% in 2012 – faster than almost anywhere else in the EU.
zh: 這反映了波蘭經濟的實力���預計在2012年增幅將超過3 ％ - 比歐盟別的大部分國家更快。

en: Germany might be getting all of the attention in this time of crisis, but the last year has been a reminder that Europe is most effective and influential when the small countries get involved and join forces with – and even lead – the big ones.
zh: 德國可能在危機時刻得到更多的注意，但去年的情況證實，當小國同大國一起參與、甚至是領導時，歐盟會產生最大的效力和影響力。

en: For example, on Iran (with exceptions like Greece), Europeans have united around a clear policy and collective positions, such as an oil embargo.
zh: 例如，對伊朗（希臘除外 ） ， 歐洲各國都共有一個明確的政策和一致的立場，如石油禁運。

en: So, Poland and Sweden:  Europe needs your leadership.
zh: 因此，波蘭和瑞典：歐洲需要你們的領導。

en: But that might not be enough in an EU with more than 500 million citizens.
zh: 但在一個擁有500多萬公民的歐盟來說這是遠遠不夠的。

en: Other EU states need to follow their example in order to make European foreign policy truly effective and influential.
zh: 歐盟其他成員國需要以他們為榜樣，使歐洲的外交政策有真正的效力和有影響力。

en: A German Glimmer in a Global Boom
zh: 全球經濟繁榮中的德國曙光

en: In 2004, the world economy grew at a rate of 5.1%, the fastest pace in the last 28 years.
zh: 2004年，世界經濟增長5.1 % ， 為過去28年中最快。 Ifo的世界經濟景氣指標來源於對90個國家的1200名專家進行季度調查。

en: While Ifo`s World Economic Climate indicator, generated from quarterly surveys of 1,200 experts in 90 countries, worsened slightly during the first three quarters of 2005, it rose again in the last quarter, indicating a continuation of the boom.
zh: 儘管這一指標在2005年的頭三個季度稍微有所惡化，但是在最後一個季度中再次上升。 這表明，繁榮在延續。

en: In 2005, growth is estimated to have been about 4.3%, and a similar rate can be expected in 2006, marking a period of sustained rapid global growth unseen since the 1970’s.
zh: 2005年，預計增長大約4.3 % ， 預計2006年也會有類似的增長率。 這將是自上世紀七十年代以來所沒有出現的全球經濟快速持續增長的時期。

en: But the boom is not uniform.
zh: 但是，這一繁榮並不平衡。

en: In the United States, the number of experts giving a favorable assessment of the current situation declined; indeed, a majority believes that the economic situation will worsen during the next six months.
zh: 在美國，對現狀作出有利評估的專家人數有所下降。 實際上，大多數人認為經濟形勢在以後6個月中將有所惡化。

en: However, in the Asian countries, including China, the optimism is unbroken.
zh: 但是，包括中國在內的亞洲國家卻都很樂觀。

en: The same is true for Eastern Europe, the ex-Soviet states, and Latin America.
zh: 東歐、前蘇聯國家以及拉丁美洲國家也是如此。

en: The big surprise is Europe, which, unlike in 2004 and the first half of 2005, now seems to be catching up with the rest of the world.
zh: 令人驚訝的是歐洲。 與2004年很2005年上半年不同的是，歐洲看起來正在趕上世界其他地方。

en: Whereas growth was a miserable 1.5% in 2005 in the 15 “old” members of the European Union, Ifo expects EU-15 growth to accelerate to 2.1% in 2006.
zh: 2005年15個“老”歐盟成員的增長率儘管只有可憐的1.5 % ， Ifo預計，歐盟15國在2006年的增長將會加快到2.1 % 。

en: To be sure, economic performance will vary widely among EU countries.
zh: 的確，歐盟成員國的經濟表現差異巨大。

en: While Italy will be the laggard, with only 1.1% growth, the Irish rocket will not lose its force, pushing real GDP up by about 4.8%.
zh: 義大利居於人後，只有1.1 % ， 愛爾蘭火箭般的發展速度不會降低，其實際GDP將增長大約4.8 % 。 總體而言，與歐盟較小的國家相比，歐盟大國仍然差強人意。

en: In general, the big EU countries are still performing badly, in contrast to the smaller members – hardly surprising, given that the EU is basically an institution to help the smaller countries overcome the drawback of their size by extending the agglomeration advantages that formerly were reserved to the bigger countries.
zh: 這並不奇怪，因為歐盟機構基本上是透過給予小國以大規模經濟優勢而幫助它們克服狹小的弱點。 這些大規模經濟優勢以往都是被大國所佔據。

en: But even Germany, Europe’s biggest economy, is experiencing an upswing.
zh: 但是，即使是歐盟最大的經濟體德國也在上升。

en: The Ifo climate indicator for Germany, based on monthly surveys of 7,000 firms, jumped upwards in the second half of 2005, reaching its highest value since the boom year 2000, with businesses’ assessment of the current situation and expectations improving.
zh: 根據對7000家公司所做的月度調查，Ifo的德國經濟景氣指標在2005年下半年躍升，達到2000年繁榮之年以來最高值，工商界對當前形勢和預期的評估也在改善。

en: After five years of stagnation, the economy is finally on the move.
zh: 經過5年的滯脹，德國經濟終於開始復甦。

en: The driving force is external demand, as Germany, the world’s second-largest exporter, profits from the global boom.
zh: 外在需求是經濟復甦的驅動力量。 德國作為全球第二大出口國從全球繁榮中受益巨大。

en: Exports increased by 6.2% in 2005 and are expected to increase by 7.4% in 2006.
However, as we saw in 2004 and 2005, exports are not enough to create substantial growth if domestic demand does not follow.
zh: 但是，正如我們在2004年和2005年所看到的那樣，如果國內需求跟不上的話，出口並不足以創造可持續的增長。

en: The good news for Germany is that investment demand is now growing, too.
zh: 德國的好訊息是投資需求也在增長。

en: While the second half of 2005 was already quite good, Ifo expects investment in equipment to grow by a healthy 6% in 2006.
zh: 2005年下半年已經很好，Ifo預計，裝置投資在2006年會健康地增長6 % 。

en: After many years of contraction, investment in construction also will rise slightly.
zh: 經歷數年的萎縮，建築投資也將略有增長。

en: Total investment growth is expected to reach 2.9% – weak by past standards, but nonetheless a promising salve for the wounded German mood.
zh: 整體投資增長預計達到2.9 % ， 這按照過去的標準而言是軟弱的，但是對於受傷的德國情緒而言卻是大有希望的寬慰。

en: Moreover, any investment growth is vital for Germany, which, according to the latest OECD statistics, currently suffers from the world’s lowest share of net investment in national income.
zh: 而且，對於德國而言，任何投資增長都是至關重要的。 根據經合組織最新統計資料，德國的淨投資在全國收入中所佔的份額目前是全球最低的，因此深受其害。

en: Even if Germany remains the world’s laggard, rising investment demand as such will contribute to GDP growth, which Ifo estimates at 1.7% in 2006.
zh: 即使德國仍然滯後於全球經濟，如此增長的投資需求將會為GDP增長作出貢獻。 Ifo估計，德國2006年的GDP增長率為1.7 % 。

en: That number looks small compared to most other countries.
zh: 與其他大多數國家相比，這一數字相形見絀。

en: In fact, all EU countries except Italy and the Netherlands will grow faster.
zh: 實際上，除了義大利和荷蘭以外的所有歐盟國家都將提速。

en: But everything is relative: Germany’s trend growth rate is just 1.1%, and the country has been the slowest growing EU country since 1995.
zh: 但是，所有的事情都是相對的：德國的趨勢增長率僅為1.1 % ， 而且自1995年以來一直是歐盟國家中增長最慢的國家。

en: Measured against a disappointing past, even Germany is currently experiencing an economic boom.
zh: 與令人失望的過去相比，即使是德國目前也在經歷經濟繁榮。

en: Indeed, even German unemployment, which has been rising in cycles since 1970, will decline slightly in 2006, from 4.8 to 4.7 million.
zh: 德國的失業人數自1970年以來一直迴圈上升，即使如此，失業人數也會在2006年略微下降，從480萬下降到470萬。

en: The good economic data will reinforce initial favorable impressions of Angela Merkel’s new government, which got off to an excellent start at the EU Summit, where Merkel helped to broker a compromise between Britain and France on the Union’s 2007-2013 budget (by adding another €2 billion to Germany’s annual contribution).
zh: 良好的經濟資料將鞏固對莫科爾新政府的不錯的印象。 莫克爾政府由於在歐盟首腦會議上幫助英國和法國就歐盟2007年到2013年預算達成妥協（將德國的年度分攤又增加20億歐元）而嶄露頭角。

en: In fact, the government may even have contributed a bit to the good economic data by announcing a serious effort to consolidate Germany’s own public finances – a prerequisite for investor confidence.
zh: 實際上，莫克爾政府透過宣佈有力措施鞏固德國自身的公共財政而甚至可能為良好的經濟資料作出了貢獻。 鞏固自身的公共財政對於投資者信心而言是前提條件。

en: According to the government, substantial tax increases will bring the fiscal deficit below the 3%-of-GDP limit set by the Stability and Growth Pact – a target missed for five consecutive years – by 2007.
zh: 根據政府的資料，大幅度增稅將在2007年把財政赤字降低到歐洲穩定和增長公約規定的GDP的3%以下的限度。 過去5年來德國一直超過了這一限度。

en: The real test for the German government is the labor market.
zh: 德國政府真正的考驗是勞動力市場。

en: Most observers now agree that Germany needs something like the American earned-income tax credit.
zh: 大多數觀察家現在都認為，德國需要類似美國那樣的所得稅抵扣。

en: In Germany, it’s called “activating social aid” or “combi wages,” but the principle is the same: the state should reduce the money it pays for doing nothing and pay more for participating in the work force.
zh: 在德國，這被稱之為“啟用社會援助”或者“綜合工資 ” 。 但是原則是一樣的，那就是，國家應當對好吃懶做者少給錢，而對參加工作的人應該多給錢。

en: That would widen the wage distribution, create jobs, and maintain the living standard of the poor.
zh: 這將會擴大工資分配，創造就業機會，並且維持窮人的生活水準。

en: Merkel announced in her inaugural speech in the Bundestag that her government will introduce such a system in 2006.
zh: 莫克爾在德國議會所作的就職演說中宣佈，她的政府將將在2006年實施這一制度。

en: If this is more than lip service, and if she really carries out a serious reform of the German welfare state’s incentive structure, the result could be higher employment and structural economic growth.
zh: 如果付諸行動，而且她果真認真地改革德國福利國家的激勵結構，結果將有可能會是更高的就業率和結構性經濟增長。

en: In the long term, that would be more promising for the EU – and for the global economy – than the demand-driven performance that Germany is currently enjoying.
zh: 從長遠來看，這對歐盟和全球經濟而言要比德國目前所處的由需求驅動的經濟表現更加有前途。

en: Is Pensioner Populism Here to Stay?
zh: 年長者民粹主義會成為常態嗎？

en: MILAN – The right-wing populism that has emerged in many Western democracies in recent years could turn out to be much more than a blip on the political landscape.
zh: 發自米蘭 — — 近年來在許多西方民主國家中崛起的右翼民粹主義或許不僅僅是政治版圖中的曇花一現。

en: Beyond the Great Recession and the migration crisis, both of which created fertile ground for populist parties, the aging of the West’s population will continue to alter political power dynamics in populists’ favor.
zh: 除了為民粹主義政黨創造了肥沃土壤的大衰退和移民危機之外，西方的老齡化也將繼續引導政治權力態勢向著對民粹主義者有利的方向轉變。

en: It turns out that older voters are rather sympathetic to nationalist movements.
zh: 事實證明年長的選民對民族主義運動相當同情。

en: Older Britons voted disproportionately in favor of leaving the European Union, and older Americans delivered the US presidency to Donald Trump.
zh: 投票支援脫歐的年長英國人要高於其所佔人口比例，而年長的美國人則將總統大權交到了特朗普手裡。

en: Neither the Law and Justice (PiS) party in Poland nor Fidesz in Hungary would be in power without the enthusiastic support of the elderly.
zh: 如果沒有老年人的熱情支援，波蘭的法律和正義黨以及匈牙利的青年民主聯盟都不會上臺。

en: And in Italy, the League has succeeded in large part by exploiting the discontent of Northern Italy’s seniors.
zh: 在義大利，聯盟黨在很大程度上成功利用了義大利北部老年群體的不滿情緒。

en: Among today’s populists, only Marine Le Pen of France’s National Rally (formerly the National Front) – and possibly Jair Bolsonaro in Brazil – relies on younger voters.
zh: 在當下的民粹主義者中，只有法國國民聯盟（前身為國民陣線）的馬琳·勒龐 — — 或許還有巴西的賈伊爾·波爾索納羅（Jair Bolsonaro ） — —會依賴年輕選民。

en: Next spring, this age-driven voting pattern could drive the outcome of the European Parliament election.
zh: 到了明年春天，這種年齡驅動型投票模式可能會影響到歐洲議會的選舉結果。

en: According to recent studies, older Europeans – especially those with less education – are more suspicious of the European project and less trusting of the European Parliament than younger Europeans are.
zh: 最近有一項研究指出，年齡較大的歐洲人 — — 特別是那些受教育程度較低的人 — — 對歐洲同一程序的疑慮更深，對歐洲議會的信任程度也低於年輕一代。

en: This is surprising, given that memories of World War II and its legacy should be fresher for older generations.
zh: 這點有些出乎意料，因為照理來說老一代人應該對第二次世界大戰的記憶及其遺產更為熟知。

en: Nevertheless, their skepticism toward democratic EU institutions may explain their receptiveness to authoritarian leaders.
zh: 然而，他們對歐盟民主機構的懷疑可能解釋了他們對專制領導人的接納行為。

en: Most likely, a growing sense of insecurity is pushing the elderly into the populists’ arms.
zh: 最有可能的是，日益增加的不安全感正在將老年人推向民粹主義者的懷抱。

en: Leaving aside country-specific peculiarities, nationalist parties all promise to stem global forces that will affect older people disproportionately.
zh: 而在針對每個國家各自特點的許諾之外，各民族主義政黨都承諾要遏制那些對老年人構成不成比例影響的全球性力量。

en: For example, immigration tends to instill more fear in older voters, because they are usually more attached to traditional values and self-contained communities.
zh: 比如說，年長選民一般會對移民產生更多的恐懼，因為他們通常更加依賴於傳統價值觀和自給自足的社群。

en: Likewise, globalization and technological progress often disrupt traditional or legacy industries, where older workers are more likely to be employed.
zh: 同樣全球化和技術進步經常會衝擊一些傳統或遺留行業，而這些行業更有可能僱用老年人。

en: The rise of the digital economy, dominated by people in their twenties and thirties, is also pushing older workers to the margins.
zh: 由20~30歲人群主導的數字經濟也在把老年工人推向邊緣。

en: But, unlike in the past, crumbling pension systems can no longer absorb such labor-market shocks. The result is that older workers who lose their job are condemned to long-term unemployment.
zh: 但與過去不同的是，搖搖欲墜的養老金體系再也無法吸收這種勞動力市場衝擊，結果是老年工人一旦失去工作就將陷入長期失業。

en: Moreover, pensioners now have reason to worry about threats to their retirement benefits from their own children.
zh: 此外，養老金領取者現在也有理由擔心自己後代的退休福利待遇會受到威脅。

en: Young people, frustrated with socioeconomic systems that are clearly tilted in favor of retirees, are increasingly calling for fairer intergenerational redistribution of scarce resources.
zh: 年輕人對明顯偏向退休人員的社會經濟體系感到沮喪並日益呼籲對稀缺資源進行更公平的代際再分配。

en: For example, Italy’s Five Star Movement, which governs in a coalition with the League, recently called for a “citizen’s income” that would be available to all unemployed people regardless of age.
zh: 比如與義大利聯盟黨聯合執政的五星運動黨最近提出要對所有失業人士 — — 無論年齡 — — 發放“公民收入 ” 。

en: So, while right-wing populists have attracted older voters, left-wing populist have gained a following among younger generations.
zh: 可見雖然右翼民粹主義者吸引了年長的選民，但左翼民粹主義者也在年輕一代中贏得了追隨者。

en: By backing right-wing populists, older voters hope to return to a time when domestic affairs were insulated from global forces and national borders were less porous.
zh: 透過支援右翼民粹主義者，年長選民希望回到那個內政不太受全球勢力左右且國界不那麼容易被穿越的時代。

en: At the heart of today’s nationalist politics is a promise to preserve the status quo – or even to restore a mythical past.
zh: 當前民族主義政治的核心是承諾要保持現狀 — — 甚至回到那個虛無縹緲的過去。

en: Hence, nationalist politicians often resort to nostalgic rhetoric to mobilize their older supporters.
zh: 因此民族主義政治家經常訴諸一些懷舊言論來鼓動自己那些年長支持者。

en: For his part, Trump has pledged to bring back jobs in the American Rust Belt, once the center of US manufacturing.
zh: 比如特朗普就承諾要將就業職位帶回到曾經是美國生產中心的北部鐵鏽帶地區。

en: Likewise, there could be no clearer symbol of resistance to change than his proposed wall on the US-Mexico border.
zh: 同時也沒有什麼比他提出的美墨邊境牆更具有明確的抵制變革象徵意義了。

en: And his crackdown on illegal immigration and ban on travelers from predominantly Muslim countries signals his commitment to a “pure” American nation.
zh: 而他對非法移民的打擊以及針對主要穆斯林國家公民的入境禁令則標誌著他對一個“純粹”美國國家的承諾。

en: Similarly, in continental Europe, right-wing populists want to return to a time before the adoption of the euro and the Schengen system of passport-free travel within most of the EU.
zh: 同樣在歐洲大陸，右翼民粹主義者希望迴歸到歐元和大部分國家申根無護照旅行制度實施之前的年代。

en: And they often appeal directly to older voters by promising to lower the retirement age and expand pension benefits (both are flagship policies of the League).
zh: 他們通常會用降低退休年齡和擴大養老金福利（這兩者都是義大利聯盟黨的主要政策）的承諾來直擊年長選民。

en: In the United Kingdom, the “Leave” campaign promised vindication for those who have been left behind in the age of globalization.
zh: 在英國 ， “ 脫歐”運動承諾要為那些被全球化時代拋棄的人做主。

en: Never mind that it also touted the idea of a free and independent “Global Britain.”
zh: 不過它也大肆吹噓要建立一個自由和獨立的“全球性英國 ” 。

en: The Brexiteers are not known for their consistency.
zh: 脫歐者的善變也不是什麼新鮮事了。

en: At any rate, to the extent that today’s populist wave is driven by demographics, it is not likely to crest anytime soon.
zh: 無論如何，由於當前的民粹主義浪潮是由人口統計資料推動的，因此這一趨勢不太可能會迅速到達頂點。

en: In graying societies, the political clout of the elderly will steadily grow; and in rapidly changing economies, their ability to adapt will decline.
zh: 在日漸老齡化的社會中老年人的政治影響力將穩步增長，但在快速變化的經濟中他們的適應能力又會下降。

en: As a result, older voters will demand more and more socioeconomic security, and irresponsible populists will be waiting in the wings to accommodate them.
zh: 因此年齡較大的選民將尋求越來越多的社會經濟安全感，而不負責任的民粹主義者正時刻準備著去安撫他們。

en: Can anything be done?
zh: 那我們對此有何對策？

en: To stem the nationalist tide, mainstream parties urgently need to devise a new social compact that addresses the mounting sense of insecurity among older voters.
zh: 為了遏制民族主義潮流，主流政黨迫切需要設計一種新的社會契約以疏解老年選民日益增長的不安全感。

en: They will need to strike a better balance between openness and protection, innovation and regulation; and they will need to do so without falling into a regressive populist trap.
zh: 它們需要在開放和保護、創新和監管之間取得更好的平衡；而且需要在避免陷入民粹主義倒退陷阱的情況下做到這一點。

en: The answer is not to suffocate global forces, but to render them more tolerable.
zh: 答案不是要扼殺全球性力量，而是讓它們變得更加可以接受。

en: Citizens of all ages need to be equipped to face current and future disruptions.
zh: 所有年齡段的公民都需要具備應對當前和未來衝擊的能力。

en: In this sense, it is better to empower the elderly than simply to protect them. Most advanced economies simply cannot afford massive new benefits for an oversized interest group.
zh: 從這個意義上講，與其只是保護老年人，不如去賦予他們權力，因為大多數發達經濟體根本無法為這麼一個超大型利益集團帶來巨大的新利益。

en: And besides, a policy that makes people reliant on some form of external support is morally questionable, at best.
zh: 此外一項讓人們依賴某種形式外部支援的政策至少在道德上是有問題的。

en: Instead, governments should focus on upgrading older workers’ skills, creating more opportunities for older and younger generations to work together, and holding disruptors accountable for the socioeconomic consequences they generate.
zh: 相反，政府應該專注於提升老年勞動者的技能，為老一輩和年輕一代創造更多機會一起合作，讓那些攪局者承擔因他們產生的社會經濟後果。

en: Subsidies to the most vulnerable should remain a last resort.
zh: 那些對最弱勢群體的補貼應當是最後的手段。

en: In many ways, older voters’ infatuation with populists is a cry for help.
zh: 在許多方面看來，年長選民對民粹主義者的迷戀其實是一種求救的呼聲。

en: It is up to enlightened politicians to respond to it constructively.
zh: 而開明的政治家應該對此建設性的回應。

en: A Global Agenda for Seven Billion
zh: 70億人的全球日程

en: NEW YORK – Late next month, a child will be born – the 7th billion citizen of planet Earth. We will never know the circumstances into which he or she was born.
zh: 紐約 — — 下個月晚些時候出生的某個孩子將成為地球的第70億位公民。 我們不會知道他會出生在什麼環境中。

en: We do know that the baby will enter a world of vast and unpredictable change – environmental, economic, geopolitical, technological, and demographic.
zh: 但我們知道，這個孩子進入的是一個面臨著不可預料的大變局的世界，不管是環境、經濟、地緣政治、技術，還是人口。
