en: The world’s population has tripled since the United Nations was created in 1945.
zh: 自聯合國於1945年成立以來，世界人口已經翻了三倍，並且仍在增長，人口一起增長的是土地、能源、食品和水源壓力。

en: And our numbers keep growing, with corresponding pressures on land, energy, food, and water. The global economy is generating pressures as well: rising joblessness, widening social inequalities, and the emergence of new economic powers.
zh: 全球經濟也在製造壓力：失業人數不斷上升，社會不平等不斷加劇，新的經濟勢力不斷形成。

en: These trends link the fate and future of today’s seven billion people as never before. No nation alone can solve the great global challenges of the twenty-first century. International cooperation is a universal need.
zh: 這些趨勢比以前更加緊密地與現今的70億人民的命運和未來聯絡在一起。 沒有哪個國家可以單槍匹馬解決21世紀的重大全球挑戰。

en: The 66th session of the UN General Assembly is a renewed opportunity for the countries of the world to set aside narrow, short-term interests and commit to cooperative efforts to address humanity’s long-term imperatives.
zh: 第66屆聯合國大會是一次嶄新的機會，讓各國拋棄狹隘的短期利益，承諾合作解決人類的長期使命。

en: At a time when all nations are experiencing individual challenges, we need to forge a worldwide common agenda that can help to ensure that the seven billionth baby and future generations grow up in a world characterized by sustainable peace, prosperity, freedom, and justice.
zh: 如今，所有國家都在經歷各自的問題，我們需要創造一個全球共同日程表來幫助我們確保第70億位公民以及我們的後代能在持續和平、繁榮、自由和公正的世界中成長。

en: To help create this future, I am focusing my second term as Secretary-General on five global imperatives – five generational opportunities to shape the world of tomorrow by the decisions we make today.
zh: 為了創造這樣的未來，我的第二個聯合國秘書長任期將專注於五大全球使命 — — 五大以我們的當前決策創造明日世界的代際機會。

en: The first and greatest of these imperatives is sustainable development. We all must understand that saving our planet, lifting people out of poverty, and advancing economic growth are one and the same fight. We must connect the dots between climate change, water scarcity, energy shortages, global health, food security, and women’s empowerment. Solutions to one problem must be solutions for all.
zh: 我們所有人都必須明白，拯救地球、消滅貧困、推進經濟增長是殊途同歸之事。 我們必須把氣候變化、水資源匱乏、能源短缺、全球衛生、食品安全和女性權利諸事聯絡起來。

en: In the next five years, we need to create a new economic vision for sustainable development and forge global consensus on a binding climate change agreement.
zh: 在未來五年中，我們需要創造一個新的可持續發展願景，在有約束力的氣候變化協議問題上達成全球一致。

en: Fostering economic growth, realizing the Millennium Development Goals, and combating climate change will all depend on creating a new energy system for the twenty-first century and extending it to every person on the planet.
zh: 推進經濟增長、實現千禧年發展目標以及與氣候變化做鬥爭均取決於創造一個面向21世紀的新的能源體系，並推廣到地球上的每一個人。

en: Prevention as a framework for international cooperation is a second opportunity.
zh: 作為國際合作框架的預防是第二大機會。

en: This year, the UN peacekeeping budget will total $8 billion. Think of what we could save by avoiding conflicts – by deploying political mediation missions, for example, rather than troops.
zh: 今年聯合國維和預算總額為80億美元。 想想看，我們能夠透過避免衝突剩下多少錢 — — 比如用政治調解代替維和部隊。

en: We know how to do this.
zh: 我們知道怎樣做這件事。

en: Our record proves it – in Guinea, Kenya, and Kyrgyzstan.
zh: 我們在蓋亞那、肯亞和吉爾吉斯斯坦的工作記錄就是明證。

en: A third imperative is building a safer and more secure world. In this effort, we must be courageous in standing up for democracy, human rights, and peace.
zh: 第三大使命是打造一個更安全、更穩定的世界。 在這個問題上，我們必須提起勇氣捍衛民主、人權和和平。

en: This year was one of signature achievements in restoring and securing peace – in Côte d’Ivoire, Darfur, Egypt, and elsewhere. But hatred and bloodshed still stand in the way of our vision for peace.
zh: 今年是在重塑並確保和平取得標誌性成就的一年 — — 在象牙海岸、達爾富爾、埃及以及其他地區。 但仇恨和殺戮仍然是我們的和平願景之路上顯而易見的障礙。

en: In the Middle East, we must break the stalemate.
zh: 在中東，我們必須打破僵局。

en: Palestinians deserve a state.
zh: 巴勒斯坦人理應擁有自己的國家。

en: Israel needs security.
zh: 以色列需要安全感。

en: Both want peace. A negotiated settlement can produce these outcomes, and the UN is a platform for forging such a peace.
zh: 雙方都盼望和平。 談判解決方案可以創造這些結果，而聯合國就是打造和平的平臺。

en: So, too, will we continue our efforts to foster democratic governance in Iraq, Afghanistan, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Sierra Leone. And, in the name of all of humanity, we will continue to push forward on nuclear disarmament and non-proliferation, in service of realizing a world free of nuclear weapons.
zh: 伊拉克、阿富汗、民主剛果、獅子山的民主治理程序亦然。 此外，以全人類的名義，我們將在核裁軍和核不擴散方面繼續前進，致力於實現無核武器的世界。

en: The fourth big opportunity is supporting countries in transition.
zh: 第四大機會是支援轉型國家。

en: This year’s dramatic events in North Africa and the Middle East inspired people around the globe.
zh: 今年在北非和中東所發生的重大事件鼓舞著全球人民。

en: Let us help make the Arab Spring a true season of hope for all.
zh: 讓我們攜手讓阿拉伯之春成為人類希望的源泉。

en: In Libya, we are deploying a new UN support mission to assist the country’s transitional authorities in establishing a new government and legal order, consistent with the aspirations of the Libyan people.
zh: 在利比亞，我們正在部署新的聯合國支援計劃，協助該國過渡當局建立符合利比亞人民願望的新政府和法律秩序。

en: Syria is a special concern.
zh: 敘利亞是個特別的問題。

en: For six months we have seen escalating violence and repression.
zh: 這半年以來，我們看到那裡的暴力和鎮壓在不斷升級。

en: The government has repeatedly pledged to undertake reforms and listen to its people. It has not done so.
zh: 敘利亞政府一再承諾實施改革、聽取人民的意見，但始終不見實踐。

en: The moment to act is now.
zh: 是時候採取措施了。

en: The violence must stop.
zh: 暴力必須停止。

en: Last but not least is the imperative of working with and for women and young people.
zh: 最後一項使命是與女性和年輕人攜手共進。

en: Women hold up more than half the sky and represent much of the world’s unrealized potential.
zh: 女性頂起的不止半邊天，她們代表著大部分人類為意識到的潛能。

en: We need their full engagement – in government, business, and civil society.
zh: 我們需要完全接納女性 — — 不管是政府、商業還是公民社會。

en: The UN has placed a high priority on promoting women at all levels of the Organization and this year, for the first time, UN Women is operating to promote the interests and rights of women all over the world.
zh: 聯合國已經將全面提升女性在聯合國中的地位作為高階優先事項，而在今年，聯合國女性首次開始在全世界致力於提升女性權益。

en: Seven billion people now look toward the United Nations for solutions to the world’s great global challenges.
zh: 如今，70億人看著聯合國，希望它拿出解決方案應對世界重大挑戰。

en: They hold different religions and backgrounds but common dreams and aspirations.
zh: 他們的信仰和背景各不相同，但夢想和願望是一樣的。

en: Our global future depends on bringing these individual talents and universal rights together in common cause.
zh: 地球的未來取決於將個人天賦和普世權利集中於共同事業下。

en: Let our common agenda begin.
zh: 讓我們啟動共同日程吧。

en: A Global Consensus Against Terrorism
zh: 全球反恐輿論

en: Mention the United Nations and the first reaction is likely to be the ongoing oil-for-food scandal and what it will mean for Secretary-General Kofi Annan’s ability to lead the organization for the remaining year and a half of his tenure.
zh: 一提及聯合國，第一個反應可能就是正鬧得沸沸揚揚的石油換食品醜聞，以及這一事件給聯合國秘書長科菲·安南在今年及他餘下的一半任期中對該組織的領導能力所帶來的影響。

en: But there is much more going on at the UN than investigations.
zh: 但是除了調查之外，聯合國內還在經歷更多事情。

en: Reform is in the air – in part because of the scandal, but also because of the UN’s inability to deal effectively with challenges ranging from Rwanda and Kosovo to Iraq and, most recently, Sudan.
zh: 改革氣氛瀰漫 — — 一部分由於醜聞，同時也因為聯合國在處理從盧安達、科索沃到伊拉克以及最近蘇丹問題上表現出來的無能和無效性。

en: Even the UN’s most ardent supporters now recognize that change is called for if the organization is to make a significant contribution to international peace and security.
zh: 即使是聯合國最忠實的支持者，現在也開始意識到，如果聯合國要對國際和平與安全做出重要貢獻的話，就必須有所改變。

en: Some of the reform talk concerns the UN Security Council’s composition.
zh: 一些有關改革的討論涉及到聯合國安理會的構成。

en: The Security Council represents what the World War II Allies believed the post-war world would look like and how it should be run.
zh: 安理會代表了二戰同盟軍所認同的戰後世界格局以及如何管理這個世界。

en: This helps to explain why a much-weakened France was made a permanent member of the Council – and why Germany and Japan (and a not-yet independent India) were not.
zh: 這有助於解釋為何一個力量已經大為削弱的法國能夠成為安理會的常任理事國 — — 而德國和日本（以及還未獨立的印度）卻不能。

en: Defending the Security Council’s current make-up is impossible; the need for change is beyond debate.
zh: 維持安理會目前的構成狀態是不可能的，改變的需求無可爭議。

en: But coming up with an approach that gains broad international support will prove extremely difficult.
zh: 但是要透過一種獲得廣泛國際支援的途徑來達成此目標極度困難。

en: Great Britain and France will resist being replaced by a single EU seat, while making Germany a permanent member would only exacerbate the problem of Europe’s relative over-representation.
zh: 大英國和法國將會抵制他們兩國被一個歐盟席位所取代，並且將德國推上常任理事國成員議席只會加劇歐洲相對的超額代表。

en: Pakistan would object to adding India to the Security Council; Argentina, Chile, and Mexico to adding Brazil; Nigeria to South Africa (and vice-versa); and several countries, including China, Indonesia, and South Korea, might resist creating a permanent seat for Japan.
zh: 巴基斯坦將反對把印度加為安理會成員；阿根廷、智利和墨西哥將反對巴西；奈及利亞反對南非（反之亦然 ） ； 還有幾個國家包括中國、印度尼西亞和韓國，也許反對日本成為常任理事國。

en: Clearly, fixing the Security Council will require considerable time and political effort.
zh: 顯然，確定安理會需要大量的時間和政治努力。

en: In the meantime, there is important work to be done. One productive avenue would be to follow up on one of the recommendations of the High Level Panel that was endorsed by Annan; namely, that all UN members go on record declaring that terrorism has no place in today’s world.
zh: 同時，還有重要的工作要做，採取一項有效手段加強由安南簽署成立的高階別小組(High Level Panel)所提出的一個建議，即所有聯合國成員國都應當簽署一個宣稱恐怖主義在今日世界絕無立足之地的檔案。

en: This will prove more difficult than it first sounds.
zh: 這做起來可比第一次聽到的時候難多了。

en: For too long, the international community has tolerated terrorism – the intentional killing of civilians and noncombatants by non-state actors for political purposes – on the grounds that, on occasion, “one man’s terrorist is another man’s freedom fighter.”
zh: 國際社會已經容忍恐怖主義太久了 — — 非政府機構有時出於“一個人的恐怖主義者是另一個人的自由戰士”的理由，為了達到政治目的故意殺害平民和非戰鬥人員。

en: Historians have the luxury of debating whether terrorism may have been justified in certain situations in the past.
zh: 歷史學家對恐怖主義可能在過去某些情形下被合理評價進行過大量辯論。

en: We do not.
zh: 我們不用這麼做。

en: Modern terrorism is too destructive to be tolerated, much less supported.
zh: 現代恐怖主義太具破壞性以至於我們已經不能容忍，不能再對它有任何支援了。

en: Weapons of mass destruction – nuclear, biological, and chemical weapons – are just that, and no cause can excuse their use.
zh: 正是這些大規模殺傷性武器 — — 核武器、生物武器以及化學武器，沒有任何原因可以成為使用這些武器的藉口。

en: Moreover, as the terrorist attacks on America of 2001 showed, weapons as basic as box-cutters can become weapons of mass destruction if they are used to exploit the vulnerabilities of modern, global life.
zh: 此外，正如恐怖分子2001年襲擊美國所表現出的那樣，如果被用以傷害當今全球的脆弱生命，即使是像紙箱切割刀這樣基本的武器也會成為大規模殺傷性武器。

en: Terrorism is even less justified given that political avenues exist nowadays for pursuing political aims.
zh: 考慮到現存的為達成政治目的而使用的政治途徑，恐怖主義更欠正當。

en: Palestinians can negotiate their future relationship with Israel and can count on American, Russian, European, and UN assistance.
zh: 巴勒斯坦能與以色列就他們未來的關係進行談判，並能依賴於美國、俄羅斯、歐洲和聯合國的援助。

en: Iraqis have elected their own representatives and are poised to write their constitution.
zh: 伊拉克人已經選舉出了他們自己的代表，正準備起草他們的憲法。

en: No one pursuing reasonable goals and who is prepared to compromise can argue that terrorism is his or his group’s only option.
zh: 沒有任何一個尋求合理目標或準備和解的人可以辯稱恐怖主義是他的或他們黨派的唯一選擇方案。

en: The world has already taken some important steps against terrorism.
zh: 全世界已經採取了一些重要的措施來反對恐怖主義。

en: A dozen international conventions and numerous UN resolutions commit governments to oppose hostage taking, the hijacking of civilian aircraft, and terrorism more broadly.
zh: 12個反恐怖主義公約和諸多聯��國決議要求各國政府更廣泛地抵制綁架人質、劫持民用航班以及恐怖主義。

en: Similarly, the mandate of the Financial Action Task Force, created in 1989 to curb money laundering, has grown and become focused mainly on curbing terrorist financing.
zh: 同樣，為打擊清洗黑錢而成立於1989年的“國際金融特別行動組 ” （ Financial Action Task Force）已經羽翼豐滿，並把重點主要放在了打擊恐怖主義融資上面。

en: UN Security Council Resolution 1373, passed after the September 11 attacks, calls on states to deny safe haven to terrorists, bring to justice anyone associated with terrorism, suppress recruitment by terrorist groups, block terrorists’ efforts to acquire weapons, and cooperate with other governments and international organizations in tracking suspects and boosting security.
zh: 911事件之後，聯合國安理會透過的1373號決議，呼籲各國拒絕為恐怖分子提供安全避難，依法懲處任何與恐怖主義有關聯的人，查禁恐怖主義集團的招募，堵住恐怖主義分子獲得武器的各種途徑，並與其他政府和國際組織一同追蹤恐怖主義嫌疑犯並加強安全。

en: What is missing is a new, 13th convention that closes the loophole that seems to permit governments to decide what constitutes terrorism and what does not.
zh: 允許政府來決定什麼是恐怖主義的構成是一個漏洞，現在缺少的是一個新的第13個公約來彌補這一漏洞。

en: Broad agreement is needed that any intentional killing of civilians and noncombatants is unacceptable, and that its perpetrators and supporters must be punished.
zh: 我們需要在廣範圍內達成一致，任何故意殺害平民及非戰鬥人員的行徑都是不可接受的，任何罪犯或幫兇必須接受嚴懲。

en: Of course, such a convention will not prevent all future acts of terrorism.
zh: 當然，這樣一個公約並不能防範將來所有的恐怖主義行動。

en: But ideas matter.
zh: 但是這個觀念很重要。

en: Terrorism needs to be de-legitimized in the way that slavery has been.
zh: 恐怖主義應當像奴隸制一樣被定為非法化。

en: Doing so will make governments and individuals think twice before becoming a party to terrorism; it should also make it less difficult to garner support for international action against those who nevertheless carry it out.
zh: 這樣做能使得政府和個人在加入恐怖主義陣營前三思而後行；也為那些反對實施恐怖主義行動的國際行動爭取更多支援提供方便。

en: We are taught early on in our lives that the end cannot justify the means.
zh: 我們自小就被教育，即使目標正確，也不能不擇手段。

en: It is time to put this principle into effect before many more innocent lives are lost.
zh: 在更多的無辜生命喪失之前，是時候將這條準則付諸實施了。

en: A Global Green New Deal
zh: 全球綠色新政

en: NAIROBI – With unemployment soaring, bankruptcies climbing, and stock markets in free-fall, it may at first glance seem sensible to ditch the fight against climate change and put environmental investments on hold.
zh: 內羅畢 - - 目前，全球失業率竄升，破產上升而且股市大跌。 猛地一看，放棄應付氣候變化以及暫緩環境投資或許是有道理的。

en: But this would be a devastating mistake of immediate, as well as inter-generational, proportions.
zh: 但是這將會是一個錯誤，其影響馬上就會形成，而且會持續幾代人。

en: Far from burdening an already over-stressed, over-stretched global economy, environmental investments are exactly what is needed to get people back to work, get order books flowing, and assist in powering economies back to health.
zh: 環境投資不僅不會給已經困難重重、舉步維艱的全球經濟帶來負擔，而且會正好給人們帶來工作、訂單並且協助各國經濟恢復健康。

en: In the past, concern for the environment was viewed as a luxury; today, it is a necessity – a point grasped by some, but by no means all, economic architects yet.
zh: 如今，這是一項必需品。 有些人認識到了這一點，但是，並不是所有的經濟規劃者也都有這樣的意識。

en: A big slice of President Barack Obama’s $825 billion stimulus package for the United States includes a boost to renewable energy, “weatherizing” a million homes, and upgrading the country’s inefficient electricity grid.
zh: 奧巴馬總統價值八千二百五十億美元的經濟刺激計劃中有一大部分包括大力提高可再生能源，給一百萬房屋改進取暖禦寒效能並且改進美國低效率的電網系統。

en: Such investments could generate an estimated five million “green-collar” jobs, provide a shot in the arm for the construction and engineering industries, and get America back into the equally serious business of combating climate change and achieving energy security.
zh: 這些投資可以產生大約五百萬“綠領”工作，給建築和工程產業注入一劑強心針並且把美國帶回到氣候變化以及實現能源安全的同樣重要的任務上來。

en: The Republic of Korea, which is losing jobs for the first time in more than five years, has also spotted the green lining to grim economic times.
zh: 韓國在五年來第一次出現了失業上升的情況，但是也在嚴峻的經濟時期中發現了綠色內容。

en: President Lee Myung-Bak’s government plans to invest $38 billion employing people to clean up four major rivers and reduce disaster risks by building embankments and water-treatment facilities.
zh: 李明博總統計劃投資三千八百億美元，僱傭人工清理四條主要的河流並且透過建設防護以及水處理設施來減少災害風險。

en: Other elements of Lee’s plan include construction of eco-friendly transportation networks, such as high-speed railways and hundreds of kilometers of bicycle tracks, and generating energy using waste methane from landfills.
zh: 李總統計劃的其他要素還包括建設生態友好的運輸網路，例如高速鐵路以及幾百公里長的腳踏車車道，並且從垃圾堆中利用甲烷來製造能源。

en: The package also counts on investments in hybrid vehicle technologies.
zh: 這一計劃還大力投資於混合燃料汽車技術。

en: Similar pro-employment “Green New Deal” packages have been lined up in China, Japan, and the United Kingdom.
zh: 中國、日本以及英國也有類似促進就業的“綠色新政”計劃。

en: They are equally relevant to developing economies in terms of jobs, fighting poverty, and creating new opportunities at a time of increasingly uncertain commodity prices and exports.
zh: 這些計劃對於發展中國家在就業、減少貧困並且在原材料價格和出口形勢越發不確定的時候創造新的機遇同樣重要。

en: In South Africa, the government-backed Working for Water initiative – which employs more than 30,000 people, including women, youth, and the disabled – also sees opportunity in crisis.
zh: 南非政府支援的治水計劃僱傭三萬人以上，包括婦女、年輕人以及殘疾人。 這一計劃也在危機中看到了機遇。

en: The country spends roughly $60 million annually fighting invasive alien plants that threaten native wildlife, water supplies, important tourism destinations, and farmland.
zh: 南非每年大約花費六千萬美元清除威脅本國野生動物、水供應、重要旅遊景點以及農地的外國侵入植物。

en: This work is set to expand as more than 40 million tons of invasive alien plants are harvested for power-station fuel.
zh: 隨著四千多萬噸侵入植物被割除用於發電燃料，這一計劃將會擴大。

en: As a result, an estimated 500 megawatts of electricity, equal to 2% of the country’s electricity needs, will be generated, along with more than 5,000 jobs.
zh: 結果，將會產生大約五百千瓦的電力，相當於國家用電需求的百分之二，同時還會創造出五千個工作崗位。

en: So it is clear that some countries now view environmental investments in infrastructure, energy systems, and ecosystems as among the best bets for recovery.
zh: 因此，某些國家現在把在基礎設施、能源系統以及生態系統上的環境投資視為經濟復甦的最佳手段。

en: Others may be unsure about the potential returns from investing in ecosystem services such as forest carbon storage or in renewable energy for the 80% of Africans who have no access to electricity.
zh: 還有一些國家或許並不十分清楚投資於生態系統服務的潛在回報。

en: Still others may simply be unaware of how to precisely follow suit.
zh: 這些包括森林二氧化碳儲存或者為沒有電的百分之八十的非洲人提供可再生能源。

en: In early February, the United Nations Environment Program will convene some of the world’s leading economists at the UN’s headquarters in New York.
zh: 二月上旬，聯合國環境規劃署將在紐約聯合國總部召集某些世界主要經濟體國家開會。 會議上將會推出全球綠色新政計劃。

en: A strategy for a Global Green New Deal, tailored to different national challenges, will be fleshed out in order to assist world leaders and ministers craft stimulus packages that work on multiple fronts.
zh: 這一計劃將會針對不同國家的挑戰而做出調整，從而協助世界各國的領導人和政府部長們制定在多種方面都奏效的經濟刺激計劃。

en: The Global Green New Deal, which UNEP launched as a concept in October 2008, responds to the current economic malaise.
zh: 聯合國環境規劃署在2008年十月推出了全球綠色新政這一概念，目的是應對當前的經濟危機。

en: Spent wisely, however, these stimulus packages could trigger far-reaching and transformational trends, setting the stage for a more sustainable, urgently needed Green Economy for the twenty-first century.
zh: 但是，如果這些經濟刺激計劃得以明智地實施，就將會帶來影響深遠以及變革性的趨勢，為二十一世紀急需的、更為可持續的綠色經濟奠定基礎。

en: The trillions of dollars that have been mobilized to address current woes, together with the trillions of investors’ dollars waiting in the wings, represent an opportunity that was unthinkable only 12 months ago: the chance to steer a more resource-efficient and intelligent course that can address problems ranging from climate change and natural-resource scarcity to water shortages and biodiversity loss.
zh: 各國已經動用了幾萬億美元來應對當前的經濟困境，加上投資者還有幾萬億美元在等候，這就提供了一個在僅僅一年以前還是不可想像的機會，也就是導向一個更為靈巧、使用能源更為高效的解決問題的道路。 這些問題包括氣候變化、自然資源貧乏、水資源短缺以及生物多樣性的損失。

en: Blindly pumping the current bail-out billions into old industries and exhausted economic models will be throwing good money after bad while mortgaging our children’s future.
zh: 把目前的救市資金盲目地投入到舊產業以及窮途末路的經濟模式中就是浪費錢財並且把子孫後代的未來用作抵押。

en: Instead, political leaders must use these windfalls to invest in innovation, promote sustainable businesses, and encourage new patterns of decent, long-lasting employment.
zh: 相反，政治領導人必需利用這些難得的機遇來投資於創新、促進可持續企業並且鼓勵新的、體面而又長久的��業模式。

en: A Global Growth Bargain
zh: 全球增長協議

en: LONDON – US President Barack Obama caught the imagination of the world when he talked recently of a new “Sputnik moment.”
zh: 發自倫敦 — — 美國總統奧巴馬最近用一場關於新“衛星時刻”的演說勾起了全世界的想象。

en: He outlined a bold plan for improving education, infrastructure, and technology, and vividly compared the resolve required to put a man on the moon to the determination needed to restore growth to the US economy.
zh: 他提出了一個全面提升教育，基礎設施和科學技術的宏偉計劃，並雄心勃勃地將恢復美國經濟增長的志向與當年執行登月計劃的決心相提並論。

en: Obama is right to say that the West faces not only great challenges, but also great opportunities. In the last decade, the global economy was transformed by one billion Asian workers entering the ranks of industrial producers. In 2011, for the first time in two centuries, Europe and America face being out-produced, out-exported, and out-invested by China and the rest of the world.
zh: 在過去十年中，全球經濟將10億亞洲勞動者轉型為產業工人。 隨著2011年的來臨，歐美地區在兩個世界以來首次在生產，出口和投資三個方面同時被中國以及世界其他國家甩在了後面。

en: Yet Asia’s growth also gives the West unprecedented economic hope.
zh: 但亞洲地區的增長也為西方都帶來了前所未有的經濟曙光。

en: In this decade, the world will be transformed yet again by the rise of the Asian consumer. By 2020, Asia’s domestic markets will be twice the size of America’s.
zh: 在未來十年內，世界將在亞洲消費者群體的崛起中再一次發生轉變。 預計到2020年，亞洲各國的國內市場規模將達到美國的兩倍。

en: The world’s middle class will have swelled from one billion consumers to three billion.
zh: 世界中產階級的數量也將由10億增長到30億。

en: The opportunities for growth in Europe and the US from this additional global demand are enormous.
zh: 這一新增需求也為歐美地區的增長創造了可觀的機遇。

en: The countries and companies that will flourish in Asia’s new markets will be those that can provide the technology-driven, custom-built, high value-added goods and services needed to serve Asia’s two billion consumers.
zh: 那些能為這20億亞洲消費者提供高技術含量，針對性設計和高附加值產品和服務的國家和企業將繁榮興旺。

en: But neither Europe nor the US is in a strong enough position to take best advantage of these new markets.
zh: 但歐美兩地似乎都尚未準備好以最佳狀態投入這些新市場。

en: The West must again begin to out-invent, out-innovate, and out-skill the rest of the world if it is to seize the opportunities that Asia presents. Indeed, unless the West significantly expands its capital investment in engineering, science, and new technologies, it will be marginalized by countries whose governments back their innovators with hard cash.
zh: 如果想抓住這些亞洲市場機會的話，西方必須再度開始在發明，創新和技術等方面超越其他地區。 事實上，除非西方大規模擴張其在工程，科學和新技術上的資本投資，否則就將被那些政府大力支援創新者的國家邊緣化。

en: Obama’s investment plan could be the foundation stone for a formal global agreement that delivers higher levels of growth to all corners of the world and creates millions of new jobs.
zh: 奧巴馬的投資計劃將可能成為一份正式全球協議的奠基石，而該協議不但會為全球各地帶來更高程度的增長，還將創造數百萬個新就業職位。

en: Under such an agreement, Europe would join the US in raising levels of investment – complementing America’s “moonshot” initiative with a program of structural reform aimed at building a digital, green, energy-efficient, and competitive economy – while China would play its part by increasing its consumption.
zh: 在這一協議下，歐洲將與美國攜手擴大投資規模 — — 透過推動一個旨在構建數字化、綠色環保，高能效以及高競爭力經濟的結構改革來響應美國的“登月”倡議 — — 而中國將擔負起增加消費的角色。

en: I believe that such an agreement could boost the world economy by around 3% by 2014 – and lift 100 million people out of poverty.
zh: 我個人認為這樣一項協議將在2014年提升世界經濟增長約3 % — —並使1億人擺脫貧困。

en: I presented this plan when I chaired the G-20 in London in 2009.
zh: 我在2009年主持倫敦G20峰會時就提出了這一計劃。

en: I wanted East and West to commit to a formal strategy to deliver more enduring results than those promised by the rescue packages that we were putting together at the time.
zh: 我希望東西雙方能致力於提出一個能產生更多長期效果的正式戰略，而不僅僅是那些在危機時共同承諾的拯救計劃。

en: Our attention was focused on preventing recession from turning into depression.
zh: 我們的注意力集中在防止衰退轉變成蕭條。

en: I argued that this was also the moment to pioneer a more lasting framework of growth.
zh: 我認為這同時也是一個創設更長久發展框架的好時機。

en: In the end, no agreement was possible on a shared growth objective, and there has not yet been enough political will for the coordinated action to achieve it.
zh: 但在會議結束之前，各方並未達成一個共同發展目標的共識，也缺乏足夠的政治決心去合作實現之。

en: Since then, Europe and America have grown well below their capacity (despite huge unmet demand throughout the world) and unemployment has climbed to around 10% on both continents (with youth unemployment reaching an alarming 20%).
zh: 從那以後，歐美的發展速度顯著低於其實際潛力（儘管面對著全世界的巨大需求也是如此）而大西洋兩岸的失業率也攀升到近10 % （ 青年人失業率則上升到危險的20 % ） 。

en: The global growth agreement that evaded us in 2009 remains the unfinished work of the G-20.
zh: 而2009年未能達成的全球發展計劃至今尚未完成。

en: Front-loaded public investment could be funded through an enhanced European Investment Bank.
zh: 前期的公共投資可以透過一個增強的歐洲投資銀行來進行。

en: China has already laid the foundation for playing its part: its policy of xiaokang (reducing poverty and expanding the middle class) should create a market for billions of dollars of Western goods and services.
zh: 中國在這方面已經開始為其所扮演的角色打下基礎：小康政策（減少貧困並擴大中產階級）將為西方商品和服務創造一個價值數十億美元的市場。

en: The West should propose that if China’s consumption increases by 2-4 percentage points of its GDP over the next three years (entirely possible as it improves its social safety net, cuts taxes, and puts homeownership within reach of ordinary citizens), America and Europe will expand their public investment by similar amounts.
zh: 西方應提議如果中國的消費佔GDP的比例在未來3年內增長2~4 % （ 假如中國改善其社會安全網，減稅並令普通家庭都能擁有住房就完全能實現這一點 ） ， 歐美都將增加同等比例的公共投資。

en: If other Asian countries do likewise, and agree to create a level playing field for exporters, we could create around 50 million additional jobs.
zh: 如果其他亞洲國家能夠效仿並同意為出口商創造一個平等的平臺，我們就能額外創造大約5000萬個職位。

en: Of course, in the West, an investment plan invites criticism from those who prefer that we do nothing but talk about growth strategies.
zh: 當然，在西方，這樣的投資計劃都會招來那些只愛空談發展計劃卻不願動手者的批評。

en: Indeed, critics argue that raising public investment conflicts with the drive to reduce deficits, and warn of higher interest rates on the back of further spending.
zh: 事實上，批評認為增加公共投資與減少赤字的目標相沖突，並擔憂政府進一步增加開支的行為會導致利率升高。

en: But critics are wrong about the impact on the deficit of focused investment.
zh: 但這些批評錯誤估計了集中投資對赤字所產生的影響。

en: A recent study by the International Monetary Fund produced unequivocal evidence that we can actually maintain deficit-reduction plans while benefiting from the additional capital investment that the US and European economies need.
zh: 世界貨幣基金組織最近給出的權威證據表明，我們可以在維持赤字削減計劃的同時受益於歐美經濟所需的額外投資。

en: My extrapolation of the IMF model shows that Western countries can boost their long-term GDP growth significantly by increasing their levels of capital investment over a three-year period.
zh: 依據世界貨幣基金組織的經濟模型，我推斷西方國家可以透過在3年內提高投資水平來推動長期的GDP增長。

en: An annual stimulus equivalent to just 0.3% of GDP yields a return in the US of 0.8% in economic growth at its peak in 2013, and 0.4% in Europe.
zh: 一個僅等同於GDP0.3%的年度刺激計劃可以為美國的GDP帶來0.8%的貢獻，並在2013年達到頂峰，而同樣的計劃則能讓歐洲的GDP取得0.4%的增長

en: This approach, which secures growth and cuts unemployment without raising the deficit, is needed to energize the private sector and mobilize some of the capital that has accumulated on corporate balance sheets in recent years.
zh: 我們需要這一既能確保增長和削減失業，又不會提高赤字的手段來啟用私人部門，並調動起近年來沉積在企業內部的資本。

en: It also underscores the importance of the G-20 and the IMF in seeking global consensus now.
zh: 同時也有助於凸顯出G20和世界貨幣基金組織在達成全球共識方面的重要性 。

en: The West is well placed to play its part in global renewal.
zh: 西方在全球經濟重建方面其實早已準備就位。

en: Its extraordinary workforces produce world-class goods and services.
zh: 它的優秀勞動力能提供世界級的商品和服務。

en: But the West’s workforce must not be condemned to policies that willfully produce a decade of slow growth and low employment.
zh: 但這些勞動力不應被那些蓄意導致長達10年的低速增長和高失業率的政策所拖累。

en: That would be a human tragedy, not just an economic disaster.
zh: 如果那樣的話，這不但是一場經濟災難，更是一場人類悲劇。

en: A Global Perfect Storm
zh: 全球完美風暴

en: NEW YORK – Dark, lowering financial and economic clouds are, it seems, rolling in from every direction: the eurozone, the United States, China, and elsewhere.
zh: 紐約—不管往哪個方向看，金融和經濟都是陰雲密佈：歐元區、美國、中國概莫能外。

en: Indeed, the global economy in 2013 could be a very difficult environment in which to find shelter.
zh: 事實上，到2013年，全球經濟可能出現極其困難的情況，沒人能獨善其身。

en: For starters, the eurozone crisis is worsening, as the euro remains too strong, front-loaded fiscal austerity deepens recession in many member countries, and a credit crunch in the periphery and high oil prices undermine prospects of recovery.
zh: 首先，歐元區危機正在惡化，由於歐元維持強勢，前瞻性財政緊縮將會深化多個成員國的衰退，而外圍國信貸動盪和高油價又阻撓了復甦前景。

en: The eurozone banking system is becoming balkanized, as cross-border and interbank credit lines are cut off, and capital flight could turn into a full run on periphery banks if, as is likely, Greece stages a disorderly euro exit in the next few months.
zh: 隨著跨國及銀行間信用的收縮以及希臘可能在未來幾個月無序退出歐元區將導致資本外逃演變為外圍國銀行的完全擠兌，歐元區銀行系統正在分崩離析。

en: Moreover, fiscal and sovereign-debt strains are becoming worse as interest-rate spreads for Spain and Italy have returned to their unsustainable peak levels.
zh: 此外，隨著西班牙和義大利利差回到再次達到不可持續的峰值水平，財政和主權債務緊張正在惡化。

en: Indeed, the eurozone may require not just an international bailout of banks (as recently in Spain), but also a full sovereign bailout at a time when eurozone and international firewalls are insufficient to the task of backstopping both Spain and Italy. As a result, disorderly breakup of the eurozone remains possible.
zh: 事實上，歐元區所需要的可能不僅僅是針對銀行（目前是西班牙銀行）的國際援助，而是在歐元區和國際防火牆不足以抵禦西班牙和義大利事件的情況下進行完全的主權援助。

en: Farther to the west, US economic performance is weakening, with first-quarter growth a miserly 1.9% – well below potential.
zh: 在更遠的西方，美國經濟表現也在萎靡，一季度增長率只有區區1.9 % ， 遠低於潛在增長率。

en: And job creation faltered in April and May, so the US may reach stall speed by year end.
zh: 此外，4月和5月就業增長不振，因此美國可能會在年底陷入停滯。

en: Worse, the risk of a double-dip recession next year is rising: even if what looks like a looming US fiscal cliff turns out to be only a smaller source of drag, the likely increase in some taxes and reduction of some transfer payments will reduce growth in disposable income and consumption.
zh: 更糟糕的是，明年發生二次探底的風險正在增加：即使看起來令人悚然的美國財政懸崖最終只是次要的拖累因素，稅收的增加和轉移支付的減少也將削弱可支配收入和消費的增長。

en: Moreover, political gridlock over fiscal adjustment is likely to persist, regardless of whether Barack Obama or Mitt Romney wins November’s presidential election.
zh: 此外，不管是奧巴馬還是羅姆尼贏得11月總統大選，關於財政調整的政治僵局都可能會持續下去。

en: Thus, new fights on the debt ceiling, risks of a government shutdown, and rating downgrades could further depress consumer and business confidence, reducing spending and accelerating a flight to safety that would exacerbate the fall in stock markets.
zh: 因此，關於債務上限的新鬥爭、政府破產的風險以及信用評級降級將可能進一步抑制消費和商業信心，拖累開支並加快資金湧向安全資產（從而加速股市下跌 ） 。

en: In the east, China, its growth model unsustainable, could be underwater by 2013, as its investment bust continues and reforms intended to boost consumption are too little too late.
zh: 在東方，中國的增長模式是不可持續的，如果投資不振情況期許而提振消費的改革來的太晚、力度太輕，則可能將於2013年陷入衰退。

en: A new Chinese leadership must accelerate structural reforms to reduce national savings and increase consumption’s share of GDP; but divisions within the leadership about the pace of reform, together with the likelihood of a bumpy political transition, suggest that reform will occur at a pace that simply is not fast enough.
zh: 中國新一屆領導人必須加快結構性改革，降低國民儲蓄，增加消費佔GDP的比重；但領導人之間對改革節奏存在分歧，且政治權力的過渡可能並不平緩，這表明改革步伐可能跟不上需要。

en: The economic slowdown in the US, the eurozone, and China already implies a massive drag on growth in other emerging markets, owing to their trade and financial links with the US and the European Union (that is, no “decoupling” has occurred).
zh: 美國、歐元區和中國的經濟減速已經對其他新興市場造成了重大影響，這是由它們與美國和歐盟的貿易和金融聯絡決定的（也就是說 ， “ 脫鉤”並沒有發生 ） 。

en: At the same time, the lack of structural reforms in emerging markets, together with their move towards greater state capitalism, is hampering growth and will reduce their resiliency.
zh: 與此同時，新興市場結構性改革的缺位以及向國家資本主義的演進正在妨礙它們的增長、削弱它們的韌性。

en: Finally, long-simmering tensions in the Middle East between Israel and the US on one side and Iran on the other on the issue of nuclear proliferation could reach a boil by 2013.
zh: 最後，在中東，以色列和美國與伊朗關於核濃縮問題的緊張對峙可能在2013年爆發。

en: The current negotiations are likely to fail, and even tightened sanctions may not stop Iran from trying to build nuclear weapons.
zh: 當前的談判可能會失敗，即使收緊制裁可能也阻止不了伊朗製造核武器。

en: With the US and Israel unwilling to accept containment of a nuclear Iran by deterrence, a military confrontation in 2013 would lead to a massive oil price spike and global recession.
zh: 由於美國和以色列不願意用威懾的方式牽制有核的伊朗，因此2013年可能爆發軍事衝突，這將導致油價的暴漲和全球衰退。

en: These risks are already exacerbating the economic slowdown: equity markets are falling everywhere, leading to negative wealth effects on consumption and capital spending.
zh: 這些風險已然對經濟減速起到了推波助瀾的作用：各國股市都在下跌，導致了消費和資本支出的負財富效應。

en: Borrowing costs are rising for highly indebted sovereigns, credit rationing is undermining small and medium-size companies, and falling commodity prices are reducing exporting countries’ income.
zh: 重債國的借貸成本在聲聲，信貸配額正在擠壓中小企業，而商品價格的下跌正在拖累出口國的收入。

en: Increasing risk aversion is leading economic agents to adopt a wait-and-see stance that makes the slowdown partly self-fulfilling.
zh: 風險厭惡度的上升正在導致經濟行為人採取靜觀其變的立場，而這給經濟減速帶來了某些自我實現的效果。

en: Compared to 2008-2009, when policymakers had ample space to act, monetary and fiscal authorities are running out of policy bullets (or, more cynically, policy rabbits to pull out of their hats).
zh: 與2008—2009年相比 — — 當時決策者擁有充足的行動空間 — — 貨幣和財政當局的手段快要用盡了（或者，更諷刺地說，快要黔驢技窮了 ） 。

en: Monetary policy is constrained by the proximity to zero interest rates and repeated rounds of quantitative easing.
zh: 貨幣政策已經撞上了零利率和一輪又一輪量化寬鬆的南牆。

en: Indeed, economies and markets no longer face liquidity problems, but rather credit and insolvency crises.
zh: 事實上，經濟和市場所面臨的問題早已不再是流動���，而是信用和償債能力危機。

en: Meanwhile, unsustainable budget deficits and public debt in most advanced economies have severely limited the scope for further fiscal stimulus.
zh: 與此同時，大部分發達國家的不可持續的預算赤字和公共債務水平嚴重掣肘了進一步財政刺激的空間。

en: Using exchange rates to boost net exports is a zero-sum game at a time when private and public deleveraging is suppressing domestic demand in countries that are running current-account deficits and structural issues are having the same effect in surplus countries.
zh: 在私人和公共去槓桿化侵蝕著經常專案赤字國內需而結構性問題給盈餘國帶來相同影響的當口，用匯率來提振淨出口是一個零和博弈。

en: After all, a weaker currency and better trade balance in some countries necessarily implies a stronger currency and a weaker trade balance in others.
zh: 畢竟，一國貨幣貶值和貿易平衡的改善必然意味著其他國家貨幣升值和貿易平衡的惡化。

en: Meanwhile, the ability to backstop, ring-fence, and bail out banks and other financial institutions is constrained by politics and near-insolvent sovereigns’ inability to absorb additional losses from their banking systems.
zh: 與此同時，阻擋、隔離和原著銀行及其他金融機構的能力也因政治和瀕於破產國無力吸收銀行系統更多的債務而被束縛住了。

en: As a result, sovereign risk is now becoming banking risk.
zh: 結果，主權風險正在演變為銀行風險。

en: Indeed, sovereigns are dumping a larger fraction of their public debt onto banks’ balance sheet, especially in the eurozone.
zh: 事實上，不少國家（特別是歐元區）正在把越來越多的公共債務轉移到銀行的資產負債表上。

en: To prevent a disorderly outcome in the eurozone, today’s fiscal austerity should be much more gradual, a growth compact should complement the EU’s new fiscal compact, and a fiscal union with debt mutualization (Eurobonds) should be implemented.  In addition, a full banking union, starting with eurozone-wide deposit insurance, should be initiated, and moves toward greater political integration must be considered, even as Greece leaves the eurozone.
zh: 為避免歐元區出現無序結果，當下的財政緊縮應該大大放緩，新的歐盟財政契約應該輔之以增長契約，財政聯盟應該輔之以債務共同化（歐元債券 ） 。 此外，即使希臘脫離歐元區，也應該成立完整的銀行聯盟（以泛歐元區存款保險為第一步 ） ， 並考慮進一步的政治一體化。

en: Unfortunately, Germany resists all of these key policy measures, as it is fixated on the credit risk to which its taxpayers would be exposed with greater economic, fiscal, and banking integration.
zh: 不幸的是，德國阻撓著所有這些關鍵性政策措施，因為進一步的經濟、財政和銀行一體化會讓其納稅人暴露於信用風險中。

en: As a result, the probability of a eurozone disaster is rising.
zh: 結果，歐元區災難的發生可能性變大了。

en: And, while the cloud over the eurozone may be the largest to burst, it is not the only one threatening the global economy.
zh: 儘管歐元區頂上的陰雲最為可怖，但這並不是唯一威脅全球經濟的因素。

en: Batten down the hatches.
zh: 我們還是未雨綢繆為妙。

en: A Global Solutions Network
zh: 全球解決方案網

en: NEW YORK – Great social change occurs in several ways.
zh: 紐約—社會發生深刻變遷的方式不一而足。

en: A technological breakthrough – the steam engine, computers, the Internet – may play a leading role.
zh: 技術突破 — — 蒸汽機、計算機和網際網路 — — 可能起到了領導作用。

en: Visionaries, such as Mahatma Gandhi, Martin Luther King Jr., and Nelson Mandela, may inspire a demand for justice.
zh: 理想家 — — 比如聖雄甘地、馬丁·路德·金和納爾遜·曼德拉 — — 則受著公正要求的鼓舞。

en: Political leaders may lead a broad reform movement, as with Franklin Roosevelt and the New Deal.
zh: 政治領導人也可能引領廣泛的改革運動，比如富蘭克林·羅斯福和他的新政。

en: Our own generation urgently needs to spur another era of great social change.
zh: 我們這一代人迫切地需要發生又一次偉大社會變革時代。

en: This time, we must act to save the planet from a human-induced environmental catastrophe.
zh: 這一回，我們必須從人類導致的環境災難中拯救地球。

en: Each of us senses this challenge almost daily.
zh: 可以說，我們每一個人每一天都在感受這一挑戰。

en: Heat waves, droughts, floods, forest fires, retreating glaciers, polluted rivers, and extreme storms buffet the planet at a dramatically rising rate, owing to human activities.
zh: 熱浪、乾旱、洪水、森林大火、冰川消融、河流汙染、極端暴風肆虐地球的頻率越來越高，而這一切都是人類活動導致的。

en: Our $70-trillion-per-year global economy is putting unprecedented pressures on the natural environment.
zh: 全球經濟每年產生70萬億美元的產值，同時也對自然環境產生著前所未見的壓力。

en: We will need new technologies, behaviors, and ethics, supported by solid evidence, to reconcile further economic development with environmental sustainability.
zh: 我們需要有紮實證據支撐的新技術、新行為和新倫理來協調未來經濟發展和環境可持續性。

en: United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon is taking on this unprecedented challenge from his unique position at the crossroads of global politics and society.
zh: 聯合國秘書長潘基文正在承擔這一前所未有的挑戰 — — 他身居一個獨一無二的位置，戰在全球政治和社會的十字路口上。

en: At the political level, the UN is the meeting place for 193 member states to negotiate and create international law, as in the important treaty on climate change adopted at the Rio Earth Summit in 1992.
zh: 在政治層面，聯合國是193個成員國一起坐下來談判的地方，1992年裡約地球峰會的氣候變化條約等重要國際法就產生於這類談判。

en: At the level of global society, the UN represents the world’s citizenry, “we the peoples,” as it says in the UN Charter.  At the societal level, the UN is about the rights and responsibilities of all of us, including future generations.
zh: 在全球社會層面，聯合國代表著全世界的公民 — — 聯合國憲章所謂“世界各族人民”是也。 在社會層面，聯合國代表著我們所有人 — — 包括我們的子孫後代 — — 的權利和義務。

en: In the past two decades, governments have come up short on solutions to environmental threats.
zh: 在過去二十年中，政府一直沒能拿出應對環境挑戰的方案。

en: Politicians have failed to implement properly the treaties adopted at the 1992 Earth Summit.
zh: 政客沒能很好地實施1992年地球峰會透過的跳躍。

en: Ban knows that strong government action remains vital, but he also recognizes that civil society must also play a larger role, especially because too many governments and politicians are beholden to vested interests, and too few politicians think in time horizons that extend past the next election.
zh: 潘基文明白，政府的強勢行動仍然是至關重要的，但他也知道，公民社會必須起到更大的作用，特別是當太多的政府和政客牽涉到既得利益而太少的政客能將目光放長到卸任以後的時候。

en: To empower global society to act, Ban has launched a bold new global initiative, for which I am grateful to volunteer.
zh: 為了增加全球社會行動的能量，潘基文丟擲了一項雄心勃勃的新全球計劃，我很高興地自願為之奔走。

en: The UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network is a powerful effort to mobilize global knowledge to save the planet.
zh: 聯合國可持續發展解決方案網（Sustainable Development Solutions Network）是潘基文的力作，意在動員全球知識拯救地球。

en: The idea is to use global networks of knowledge and action to identify and demonstrate new, cutting-edge approaches to sustainable development around the world.
zh: 該計劃的想法是利用全球知識和行動網識別和展示全世界的高精尖方法可持續發展新方法。

en: The network will work alongside and support governments, UN agencies, civil-society organizations, and the private sector.
zh: 該網將配合並支援政府、聯合國機構、公民社會團體和私人部門。

en: Humanity needs to learn new ways to produce and use low-carbon energy, grow food sustainably, build livable cities, and manage the global commons of oceans, biodiversity, and the atmosphere.
zh: 人類需要學習新方法制造和使用低碳能源、可持續地種植糧食、建設宜居城市、治理全球共有的海洋、生物多樣性和大氣。

en: But time is running very short.
zh: 但時間緊迫。

en: Today’s mega-cities, for example, already have to confront dangerous heat waves, rising sea levels, more extreme storms, dire congestion, and air and water pollution.
zh: 比如，如今的大都市已面臨著危險的熱浪、海平面上升、極端風暴數量增加、可怕的擁擠以及空氣和水汙染等問題。

en: Agricultural regions already need to become more resilient in the face of increased climate volatility.
zh: 農業區也需要更強的應對氣候波動增加的能力。

en: And as one region in one part of the world designs a better way to manage its transport, energy needs, water supplies, or food supplies, those successes should quickly become part of the global knowledge base, enabling other regions to benefit rapidly as well.
zh: 而當作為世界一部分的某地區設計出更好的交通、能源需求、水攻擊和食品供給管理辦法時，其成功應該很快地變為全球知識資料庫的一部分，讓其他地區也能早日獲益。

en: Universities have a special role to play in the new UN knowledge network.
zh: 大學在這一新的聯合國知識網中起著特殊的作用。

en: Exactly 150 years ago, in 1862, Abraham Lincoln created America’s “land-grant” universities to help local communities to improve farming and the quality of life through science.
zh: 150年前的1862年，亞伯拉罕·林肯創造了“政府授地 ” （ land-grant）大學，以幫助當地社群透過科學改善農業和生活質量。

en: Today, we need universities in all parts of the world to help their societies face the challenges of poverty reduction, clean energy, sustainable food supplies, and the rest.
zh: 如今，我們需要全世界的大學幫助所在社會應對減貧、清潔能源、可持續食品供給等挑戰。

en: By linking together, and putting their curricula online, the world’s universities can become even more effective in discovering and promoting science-based solutions to complex problems.
zh: 透過互相連線以及將課程掛上網路，全世界大學可以在發現和促進基於科學的複雜問題解決之道方面變得更加高效。

en: The world’s corporate sector also has a significant role to play in sustainable development.
zh: 全球公司部門在可持續發展方面也起著重要作用。

en: Now the corporate sector has two faces.
zh: 如今，公司部門有著兩副面孔。

en: It is the repository of cutting-edge sustainable technologies, pioneering research and development, world-class management, and leadership in environmental sustainability.
zh: 它是高精尖可持續技術儲備庫、研發活動先鋒、世界級管理的先行者、環境可持續性的領導者。

en: Yet at the same time, the corporate sector lobbies aggressively to gut environmental regulations, slash corporate-tax rates, and avoid their own responsibility for ecological destruction.
zh: 但與此同時，公司部門也在大力遊說放鬆環境監管、降低公司稅率、逃避它們應付的生態毀滅責任。

en: Sometimes the same company operates on both sides of the divide.
zh: 有時候，同一家公司同時扮演著兩方面的角色。

en: We urgently need far-sighted companies to join the Sustainable Development Solutions Network.
zh: 我們迫切需要具有遠見卓識的公司加入到可持續發展解決方案網中來。

en: These companies are uniquely placed to move new ideas and technologies into early-stage demonstration projects, thereby accelerating global learning cycles.
zh: 這些公司在將新思想和新技術轉化為早期示範工程方面能起到獨一無二的作用，從而加快全球學習週期。

en: Equally important, we need a critical mass of respected corporate leaders to press their peers to cease the anti-environmental lobbying and campaign-finance practices that account for the inaction of governments.
zh: 同樣重要的是，我們需要超過臨界數量的廣受尊敬的公司領導者來向他們的同儕施加壓力，停止可能導致政府不作為的反環境遊說和政治獻金活動。

en: Sustainable development is a generational challenge, not a short-term task.
zh: 可持續發展是幾代人都將面臨的挑戰，不是一朝一夕可以解決的問題。

en: The reinvention of energy, food, transport, and other systems will take decades, not years.
zh: 能源、食品、運輸和其他系統的更新換代需要幾十年，而不是幾年。

en: But the long-term nature of this challenge must not lull us into inaction.
zh: 但該挑戰的長期性質並不是我們不作為的理由。

en: We must start reinventing our productive systems now, precisely because the path of change will be so long and the environmental dangers are already so pressing.
zh: 正是因為變革需要極長時間，而環境風險已經迫在眉睫，我們才必須從現在就開始重塑我們的生產系統。

en: At the Rio+20 Summit this past June, the world’s governments agreed to adopt a new set of goals on sustainable development for the period after 2015, to build upon the Millennium Development Goals’ success in reducing poverty, hunger, and disease.
zh: 在去年6月的里約+20峰會上，全球政府同意在千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goal）在較少貧困、飢餓和病痛方面取得諸多成就的基礎上設立新的面向2015年之後的可持續發展目標。

en: In the post-2015 era, the fight against poverty and the fight to protect the environment will go hand in hand, reinforcing each other.
zh: 2015年以後，全世界將攜手共同抵抗貧困和保護環境。

en: Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon has already initiated several global processes to help establish the new post-2015 goals in an open, participatory, and knowledge-based way.
zh: 秘書長潘基文已經啟動了數項全球計劃以幫助全世界以開放性、參與式、以知識為基礎的方式設定面向2015年後的新目標。

en: The Secretary General’s launch of the Sustainable Development Solutions Network is therefore especially timely.
zh: 因此，秘書長啟動可持續發展解決方案網的舉動可謂正逢其時。

en: Not only will the world adopt a new set of goals to achieve sustainable development, but it will also have a new global network of expertise to help achieve those vital objectives.
zh: 全世界不但將接受新的可持續發展目標，還將擁有新的全球專家網路來實現這些關鍵目標。

en: A Good Rate Hike for Europe
zh: 歐洲升息的靈丹妙藥

en: Two wrongs don’t make a right.
zh: 一錯再錯也不等於正確。

en: Just because European governments have failed to put bread on their constituents’ tables doesn’t mean that the European Central Bank should likewise fail in its job of promoting price stability in the euro zone.
zh: 僅僅因為歐洲政府未能把麵包擺上選民的餐桌並不意味著歐洲央行也同樣不能保持歐元區的價格穩定。

en: That may sound obvious, but abandoning price stability is exactly what some European politicians are advocating.
zh: 這聽上去道理再明顯不過，但某些歐洲政客卻正在竭力鼓動放棄價格穩定。

en: For example, Italian politicians, who, given Italy’s recent dismal economic performance, would seem the least qualified to offer the ECB advice on monetary policy, are nonetheless advocating interest-rate cuts.
zh: 舉例來講，由於近來國內經濟狀況低迷，義大利政客照理應該是最沒有資格向歐洲央行提出貨幣建議的，但恰恰正是他們拼命鼓吹削減利率。

en: Echoing comments by Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi, Deputy Economics Minister Mario Baldassarri said in Il Sole 24 Ore last week that all efforts to boost growth are in vain “if someone is pushing on the brake pedal.”
zh: 秉承西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼西爾維奧·貝盧斯科尼的意志，義大利經濟部副部長義大利經濟部副部長巴爾達薩里上週在《二十四小時太陽報》撰文稱“如果有人踩著剎車 ” ， 那麼所有推動經濟增長的努力都將化為泡影。

en: Who’s he kidding?
zh: 他在打趣誰？

en: If anyone is “pushing down on the Italian growth brake” it is Berlusconi himself.
zh: 如果真有誰“踩著義大利增長的剎車 ” ， 那正是貝盧斯科尼本人。

en: He has made no efforts at economic reform during his term and now seeks to blame the ECB for Italy’s lame economic performance.
zh: 他執政期間沒有進行任何經濟改革，現在又試圖把義大利的經濟疲軟歸罪於歐洲央行。

en: But it is precisely the lack of economic reform at home that has made Italy one of the least competitive states in the euro-zone economy.
zh: 然而，正是國內經濟改革的匱乏使得義大利淪為了歐元區內最缺乏競爭力的國家。

en: More than the usual “blame game” is at work here.
zh: 這比通常所說的“責備遊戲”更甚一籌。

en: Pressures are mounting on the ECB to raise interest rates – and Berlusconi and Co.’s attacks are as much as an attempt to forestall future rate hikes as to get the ECB to loosen its monetary policy.
zh: 歐洲央行升息的壓力越來越大¾而貝盧斯科尼及其同伴的攻擊既是為了在未來大幅升息的情況下佔得先機，也是為了讓歐洲央行放鬆其貨幣政策。

en: Soaring energy prices, for example, have become a leading inflation risk.
zh: 節節攀升的能源價格，舉例來講，成了導致通貨膨脹的首要危險因素。

en: But higher energy prices, by themselves, will not cause the ECB to pull the interest-rate trigger.
zh: 但僅僅是能源價格上漲本身還不足以使歐洲央行調整利率。

en: The key will be so-called “second-round effects” – whether growing crude prices lead to higher wage demands from trade unions.
zh: 關鍵問題是所謂的“次輪效應”¾那就是原油價格上漲會不會導致工會提出增加報酬的要求。

en: So far, the “social partners,” as ECB president Jean-Claude Trichet likes to call the unions, have been quiet.
zh: 迄今為止，被歐洲央行歐洲央行行長特里謝行長特里謝習慣地稱之為“社會夥伴”的工會內部仍然風平浪靜。

en: Should this change, the ECB will have to raise rates even if Europe’s economic growth remains slack.
zh: 但如果情況有變，那麼即便經濟增長依然遲緩，歐洲央行也不得不採取升息的措施。

en: The good news is that economic growth in the euro-zone economy appears to be picking up (even in Italy).
zh: 好訊息是：歐元區國家的經濟增長似乎正趨於好轉（義大利也不例外 ） 。

en: Though second-quarter GDP growth was weak — the euro-zone average was only 0.3% year on year – third-quarter data are indicating a sustained economic pick-up in the second half of the year. Only consumption is lagging.
zh: 儘管第二季度的國內生產總值仍不盡如人意，歐元區年均增長率只有區區0.3 % ， 但第三季度的統計資料顯示：下半年經濟增長正在持續性地恢復，只是消費還略顯疲軟。

en: How will the ECB react to better economic news?
zh: 歐洲央行對經濟的恢復又將做何反應？

en: Some on the Governing Council have grown uncomfortable that euro-zone interest rates have stayed so low, at 2%, for so long (more than two years).
zh: 監管理事會的某些成員已經對兩年多來歐元區利率維持在2%的低水準頗有微辭。

en: True, there is no inflation problem in the short run, but the ECB’s monetary policy focuses on the medium term.
zh: 沒錯，短期內不會出現通貨膨脹，但歐洲央行的貨幣政策更加關注中期的目標。

en: One particular worry is that euro-zone money supply is well above the ECB’s benchmark level, indicating an excess supply of liquidity.
zh: 人們所擔心的問題之一是歐元區的貨幣供應遠遠高於歐洲央行所擬定的基準，這顯示了清償能力已經供過於求。

en: It is doubtful that the ECB would raise interest rates to curb excess liquidity so long as economic recovery remains in question.
zh: 只要經濟復甦還是個未知數，歐洲央行就不一定會提高利率，來控制過剩的清償能力。

en: Slow growth has silenced the monetarists on the ECB’s Governing Council. This will change, however, once the economic pick-up is confirmed.
zh: 緩慢的增長速度堵住了歐洲央行監管理事會貨幣專家們的幽幽眾口，但只要經濟復甦得到確認，所有這些情況都會有所改變。

en: Interest-rate hikes may be coming sooner rather than later, which is why Berlusconi and French President Jacques Chirac are talking up interest-rate cuts now.
zh: 利率飆升可能會來得更早，這也是貝盧斯科尼和法國總統雅克·希拉剋現在就大力鼓吹降低利率的原因所在。

en: Meanwhile, in Germany, the elections this September may have surprising consequences for ECB monetary policy.
zh: 與此同時，德國今年9月舉行的選舉可能會對歐洲央行的貨幣政策產生令人驚異的影響。

en: Angela Merkel, the Christian Democrats’ candidate, is a reformer, holding out hope for Germany’s future – and that of Europe.
zh: 基督教民主黨候選人安格拉·默爾克是一位改革者，他為德國，以及歐洲的未來帶來了希望。

en: Unfortunately, Merkel’s campaign is off to a rocky start, and the recent entry of Oskar Lafontaine’s extreme left-wing party into the fray may necessitate the formation of a grand coalition between the Christian Democrats and the Social Democrats.
zh: 不幸的是，默爾克的競選從一開始就困難重重。 最近奧斯卡·拉方丹的極左翼黨派加入競爭後，可能就必須建立基督教民主黨和社會民主黨的總體聯盟。

en: This would be bad news for the German economy, which could delay possible ECB interest rate hikes.
zh: 這對德國經濟是個壞訊息，因為它可能延遲歐洲央行利率的迅速飆升。

en: Because the expected gridlock in parliament would make reforms less likely, companies might hold off on investment, while consumers would be more likely to keep their wallets closed, because official policy would be even less clear than it is now.
zh: 由於議會中業已存在的僵局會削弱改革的可能性，導致公司延緩投資，而消費者則更有可能合攏錢包，因為官方政策比現在還要更加捉摸不定。

en: On the other hand, a center-right coalition between the Christian Democrats and the Free Democrats could spark the ECB into action.
zh: 另一方面，基督教民主黨和自由民主黨的中右翼聯盟也可能會刺激歐洲央行採取行動。

en: This raises an interesting point.
zh: 這就提出了一個非常有趣的觀點。

en: The public should be relieved if the ECB raises rates, because this would most likely signal that the long-awaited economic recovery is well under way, and that inflationary repercussions are being addressed.
zh: 歐洲央行提高利率會讓公眾感到如釋重負，因為利率的提升可能意味著人們盼望已久的經濟恢復已經開始，而通貨膨脹的影響也正在得以解決。

en: A hike, in other words, would indicate that good things are happening.
zh: 換句話講，升息意味著好的形勢已經開端。

en: But the public often views interest-rate increases as negative events that increase unemployment and stifle growth.
zh: 但公眾卻常常把升息看作一項負面因素，認為它有可能導致失業增長、抑止經濟發展。

en: Blame-game politicians like Berlusconi, who have failed to put bread on the table, their minions in the media, and Keynesian economic professors who don’t understand and misrepresent Keynes sustain this distorted view.
zh: 像貝盧斯科尼這樣未能將麵包擺上普通百姓的餐桌但卻精於責備遊戲的政客、他們在各大媒體的御用走狗和根本沒有弄懂凱恩斯理論真諦的凱恩斯主義經濟學家仍然緊緊抱著歪曲的觀點不放。

en: Europe would be a lot better off if someone told the public the truth.
zh: 如果有人對公眾說出真相，那麼無疑會為歐洲的經濟發展帶來福音。

en: A Good Year for God
zh: 上帝的幸運年

en: LONDON – It’s been a better year for God.
zh: 倫敦 — — 上帝在這一年運氣不壞。

en: After withering literary assaults on the Almighty from the Oxford academic Richard Dawkins, the essayist Christopher Hitchens, and others, believers have hit back.
zh: 在挫敗牛津大學學者理查德·道金斯、散文家克里斯托弗·希欽斯和其他人對萬能的主發起的文學攻擊後，上帝的信徒們開始反擊。

en: Best of all has been The Case for God by the brilliant religion writer Karen Armstrong.
zh: 其中最出色的要數傑出的宗教作家凱倫·阿姆斯特朗的著作《上帝的旨意 》 。

en: More important still is the news that more people (certainly in Britain) are going to Christian churches of all denominations.
zh: 更重要的是新聞中報導英國有越來越多的人走進各教派基督教堂做禮拜。

en: Moreover, the Pope made a very successful visit to Britain in September.
zh: 此外，教皇9月對英國的訪問非常成功。

en: We know already about heavy attendance at the country’s mosques.
zh: 當時英國教堂人滿為患的盛況給我們留下深刻的記憶。

en: At this time of year, of course, many Christians who are not regular churchgoers attend the Nativity services.
zh: 當然每到一年中這個時候，很多平常不去教堂的基督徒也趕赴教堂參加聖誕儀式。

en: Carols, church bells, and mangers are still at the heart of mid-winter festivities, alongside the consumer binge.
zh: 讚美詩、教堂鐘聲和馬槽依然是隆冬慶典的核心內容，此外還有消費者的狂熱消費。

en: This year, however, the “big spend” in Europe may have been inhibited by the big winter freeze and the big austerity programs across most of the continent.
zh: 不過今年，歐洲的“狂歡購物”可能受到遍佈歐洲大陸的冬季冰雪和大規模緊縮計劃的抑制。

en: Even in the most Godless households, most children in Western societies probably know the details of the Christmas story.
zh: 即使在宗教信仰最弱的家庭，西方社會的多數兒童或許也知道聖誕故事的細節。

en: The travelers who can find no room at the inn.
zh: 人滿為患的小旅館。

en: The birth of a baby in the stables.
zh: 一名嬰兒出生在馬廄裡。

en: The arrival of the wise men bearing gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
zh: 帶著黃金、乳香和沒藥等禮物的智者。

en: We learn about all this at the same time as we are told about Father Christmas, his Lapland reindeers, and his sacks full of presents.
zh: 我們在聽說聖誕老人、拉普蘭馴鹿和裝滿禮物的包裹時就知道了這個故事。

en: We rapidly lose our belief in that winter myth.
zh: 我們很快就不再相信這個冬天的神話。

en: But we tend to retain into adulthood the same views of God that we formed in childhood.
zh: 但孩提時對上帝形成的印像卻會一直保留到成年時期。

en: An old man with a long beard watches over us, and most of us retain a pretty literal opinion of the stories about his Son told in the Bible’s New Testament.
zh: 上帝是一直照看我們的長鬍子老人，而且多數人對《聖經新約》中上帝之子的故事有著相當表面化的理解。

en: It is this God that atheists like Dawkins and Hitchens attack.
zh: 道金斯和希欽斯這樣的無神論者所攻擊的正是我們的上帝。

en: And, with such a target, it is not very difficult to poke holes and pile on the ridicule.
zh: 而且，面對這樣一個目標，故意找茬加以嘲笑似乎並非難事。

en: Leave aside the fact that you can make an even stronger case against Godlessness – remember the atrocities of atheist totalitarians in the twentieth century – and consider the assault on those whose commitment to literal interpretations of religious texts means that they deny science and reason.
zh: 撇開可以大力反駁無神論的事實不談（二十世紀無神論極權主義份子的暴行至今還讓人記憶猶新 ） ， 單說攻擊字面解讀宗教典籍者意味著他們否定科學和推理。

en: To them the world was made in six days; evolution is a fanciful tale.
zh: 在他們看來創世紀只需要六天，而生物進化不過是虛構的故事。

en: Those of us who think that science and religion dwell in different domains, and who recall that Socrates argued that science did not teach you about morality or meaning, find that our case is undermined by the literalists and fundamentalists in every religion.
zh: 認為科學和宗教分屬於不同領域、並牢記蘇格拉底“科學無法教會人道德和生命意義”教誨的我們漸漸發現，各種拘泥於字面解釋的信徒和原教旨主義者破壞了我們的論據。

en: There are Christians who know all about the fire and brimstone of the Book of Revelation, but seem not to have heard the instructions about generosity in the Sermon on the Mount.
zh: 大量基督徒完全相信《啟示錄》中地域的硫磺與烈火，但卻似乎從未聽到過《山中聖訓》中有關寬容大度的訓誡。

en: Likewise, there are hard-line Jews, such as the settler groups who drive Palestinians from their homes in East Jerusalem and Hebron, who have forgotten the early teachings of Jewish scholars who argued that strangers should be treated like your own people.
zh: 同樣，到處都是態度強硬的猶太人，比方說將巴勒斯坦人趕出東耶路撒冷和希伯倫家園的定居者團體，他們早就把猶太學者早期的訓誡拋到了腦後，這些訓誡要求猶太教信徒給予陌生人親人般的待遇。

en: And there are Muslims who ignore the Koran’s commands of pluralism, tolerance, and peace.
zh: 還有很多穆斯林信徒對《古蘭經》多元化、忍耐與和平的訓誡完全無視。

en: Where the atheist assault is often correct is in pinpointing the amount of harm frequently done in our world by such fundamentalists.
zh: 無神論者攻擊的正確之處在於經常能夠指出此類原教旨主義者對世界所造成的危害。

en: Right-wing American attitudes about their country’s place in the world are invigorated by fundamentalist dogma.
zh: 原教旨主義教義鼓舞了右翼美國人有關自己國家國際地位的姿態。

en: The United Nations is the devil’s own creation.
zh: 聯合國是魔鬼自身的創造。

en: President Barack Obama is an un-American Muslim.
zh: 巴拉克·奧巴馬總統具有非美穆斯林身份。

en: Palestine from the Jordan River to the coast should be handed to Israel so that the world can end with a cataclysmic Christian triumph.
zh: 從約旦河到海岸線的巴勒斯坦領土應該交由以色列控制，這樣世界就會以一場災難性的基督教勝利結尾。

en: Jewish fundamentalists obstruct any peace process that is left in the Middle East and build more illegal settlements.
zh: 猶太原教旨主義者極力阻撓中東僅存的和平程序，繼續建設非法定居點。

en: Islamic fundamentalists define jihad as a war of terror against the West and call for an Islamic caliphate from the Atlantic to the Pacific.
zh: 伊斯蘭原教旨主義者將針對西方世界的恐怖主義定義為聖戰，呼籲建立從大西洋到太平洋的伊斯蘭王國。

en: The strident and damaging dogmatism of fundamentalists of every stripe has a common feature: a truculent sense of grievance, rooted in fear and resentment of modernity.
zh: 形形色色原教旨主義分子的教條既咄咄逼人又為禍不淺，它們都有著共同的特色： 那就是植根於對現代社會的恐懼和憤懣的氣勢洶洶的怨恨。

en: Christian fundamentalism in America harks back to nineteenth-century populism and anti-intellectualism.
zh: 美國的基督教原教旨主義可以追溯到十九世紀的民粹主義和反智主義。

en: Members of evangelical churches associate their beliefs with the rugged individualism of the early pioneers.
zh: 福音教會會員將自己的信仰與早期先驅不屈不撓的個人主義密切聯絡在一起。

en: They are contemptuous of the establishment.
zh: 他們蔑視當權人士。

en: Jewish fundamentalists believe that Israel’s critics are anti-Semitic or, in the case of Jewish opponents of Israel’s harder-line policies, “self-hating Jews.”
zh: 猶太原教旨主義者相信以色列的批評者要麼是反猶份子，要麼就是像以色列強硬政策的猶太反對者那樣，是“自我仇恨的猶太人 ” 。

en: Islamic fundamentalists reckon that what the rest of us regard as the liberalizing influence of technological progress and globalization is a brash re-run of Western colonialism.
zh: 以色列原教旨主義者認為我們其他人眼中技術進步和全球化的自由化影響反應出西方殖民主義不可一世的重新抬頭。

en: For a happier New Year, we should listen to the core messages of all these great religions, above all the Confucian golden rule that we should never do to others what we would not like to be done to us.
zh: 要想在新的一年中生活得更加愉快，我們應當聽取所有偉大宗教的核心教義，特別是儒家“己所不欲、勿施於人”的金科玉律。

en: What religion should teach us is not how to hate, but – to borrow again from Confucius – how to develop societies that look after and welcome the poor, the stranger, and the oppressed.
zh: 宗教教會我們的不該是仇恨，而是 — — 再次借用孔子的名言 — — 如何建設照顧歡迎窮人、外來者和被壓迫者的大同社會。

en: That is the most important message for everyone, atheists included, to take from the Christian story of Christmas.
zh: 所有人，包括無神論者，都應該從基督的聖誕故事中領會這種最重要的精神涵義。

en: A Gravity Test for the Euro
zh: 歐元重力測試

en: CAMBRIDGE – Although I appreciate that exchange rates are never easy to explain or understand, I find today’s relatively robust value for the euro somewhat mysterious.
zh: 坎布里奇 — — 儘管我贊同匯率問題很難解釋或理解清楚，但仍然對眼下歐元相對穩健的價值感到有些不解。

en: Do the gnomes of currency markets seriously believe that the eurozone governments’ latest “comprehensive package” to save the euro will hold up for more than a few months?
zh: 難道貨幣市場真的相信，歐元區各國政府最新的歐元拯救“完整方案”能維持幾個月？

en: The new plan relies on a questionable mix of dubious financial-engineering gimmicks and vague promises of modest Asian funding.
zh: 新計劃頗不靠譜，它依賴於可疑金融工程伎倆和從亞洲適量融資的含糊承諾。

en: Even the best part of the plan, the proposed (but not really agreed) 50% haircut for private-sector holders of Greek sovereign debt, is not sufficient to stabilize that country’s profound debt and growth problems.
zh: 即便是該計劃的最佳部分 — — 即準備（但並未實際透過）讓希臘主權債務的私人投資者損失50 % — —也不足以穩定希臘沉重的債務和增長問題。

en: So how is it that the euro is trading at a 40% premium to the US dollar, even as investors continue to view southern European government debt with great skepticism?
zh: 那麼，既然投資者仍對南歐政府債務充滿疑慮，為何歐元對美元仍有40%的溢價？

en: I can think of one very good reason why the euro needs to fall, and six not-so-convincing reasons why it should remain stable or appreciate.
zh: 在我看來，歐元必須下跌這一觀點有一個非常充分的理由，而歐元應該維持穩定甚至升值有六個不那麼令人信服的理由。

en: Let’s begin with why the euro needs to fall.
zh: 讓我們從歐元為何必須下跌開始。

en: Absent a clear path to a much tighter fiscal and political union, which can lead only through constitutional change, the current halfway house of the euro system appears increasingly untenable.
zh: 在缺乏形成更緊密的財政和政治聯盟的明確道路的背景下 — — 這一點只有透過修憲才能實現 — — 當前的歐元體系只是半吊子工程，且正在變得越來越難以為繼。

en: It seems clear that the European Central Bank will be forced to buy far greater quantities of eurozone sovereign (junk) bonds.
zh: 顯然，歐洲央行將被迫購買數量甚巨的歐元區主權（垃圾）債券。

en: That may work in the short term, but if sovereign default risks materialize – as my research with Carmen Reinhart suggests is likely – the ECB will in turn have to be recapitalized.
zh: 這樣做在短期可能有效，但如果主權違約風險成為現實 — — 根據我和卡門·萊因哈特（Carmen Reinhart）的研究，這很有可能 — — 那麼歐洲央行自身也將需要資本重組。

en: And, if the stronger northern eurozone countries are unwilling to digest this transfer – and political resistance runs high – the ECB may be forced to recapitalize itself through money creation.
zh: 此外，如果較穩健的北歐國家不願意承擔轉移成本 — — 政治阻力相當大 — — 歐洲央行可能被迫用印鈔來實現自身的資本重組。

en: Either way, the threat of a profound financial crisis is high.
zh: 無論如何，爆發深度金融危機的風險很高。

en: Given this, what arguments support the current value of the euro, or its further rise?
zh: 既然如此，支援歐元維持當前水平甚至有所升值的觀點有哪些呢？

en: First, investors might be telling themselves that in the worst-case scenario, the northern European countries will effectively push out the weaker countries, creating a super-euro.
zh: 首先，投資者可能會告訴自己，在最壞情形下，北歐國家將拋棄疲軟國家，創造新的超級歐元。

en: But, while this scenario has a certain ring of truth, surely any breakup would be highly traumatic, with the euro diving before its rump form recovered.
zh: 但是，儘管這一情景不能說完全沒有可能，但歐元區的分崩離析將是高度災難性的，歐元得先跌到底才能復甦。

en: Second, investors may be remembering that even though the dollar was at the epicenter of the 2008 financial panic, the consequences radiated so widely that, paradoxically, the dollar actually rose in value.
zh: 其次，投資者可能記得，在2008年的金融恐慌中，處於震中的美元由於恐慌影響覆蓋面非常廣，反而有所升值。

en: Although it may be difficult to connect the dots, it is perfectly possible that a huge euro crisis could have a snowball effect in the US and elsewhere.
zh: 儘管很難將當初的美元和現在歐元聯絡在一起，但巨型歐元危機仍大有可能在美國和其他地區造成連鎖反應。

en: Perhaps the transmission mechanism would be through US banks, many of which remain vulnerable, owing to thin capitalization and huge portfolios of mortgages booked far above their market value.
zh: 或許傳遞機制會是美國銀行 — — 許多美國銀行仍然十分脆弱，因為它們的資本充足率很低，手中的按揭組合簿記價值也遠高於市場價值。

en: Third, foreign central banks and sovereign wealth funds may be keen to keep buying up euros to hedge against risks to the US and their own economies.
zh: 第三，外國央行和主權財富基金可能樂於繼續購買歐元，以對沖美元和自身經濟的風險。

en: Government investors are not necessarily driven by the return-maximizing calculus that motivates private investors.
zh: 政府投資者與私人投資者不同，並不一定按最大回報的標準投資。

en: If foreign official demand is the real reason behind the euro’s strength, the risk is that foreign sovereign euro buyers will eventually flee, just as private investors would, only in a faster and more concentrated way.
zh: 如果外國官方需求才是歐元強勢背後的真正原因，那麼歐元所面臨的風險就是外國主權買家的最終逃離 — — 與私人投資者不會有什麼兩樣，只是更快更集中。

en: Fourth, investors may believe that, ultimately, US risks are just as large as Europe’s.
zh: 第四，投資者可能會認為，說到底，美國的風險一點都不比歐洲小。

en: True, the US political system seems stymied in coming up with a plan to stabilize medium-term budget deficits.
zh: 確實如此，美國政治體系在達成穩定中期預算赤字計劃方面受到了阻礙。

en: Whereas the US Congress’s “supercommittee,” charged with formulating a fiscal-consolidation package, will likely come up with a proposal, it is far from clear that either Republicans or Democrats will be willing to accept compromise in an election year.
zh: 儘管主管制定財政整合計劃的美國國會“超級委員會”或許能夠拿出一套���案，但共和黨和民主黨是否願意在選舉年妥協還遠未可知。

en: Moreover, investors might be worried that the US Federal Reserve will weigh in with a third round of “quantitative easing,” which would further drive down the dollar.
zh: 此外，投資者還可能擔心美聯儲會考慮實行第三輪“量化寬鬆 ” ， 這將進一步壓低美元。

en: Fifth, the current value of the euro does not seem wildly out of line on a purchasing-power basis.  An exchange rate of $1.4:€1 is cheap for Germany’s export powerhouse, which could probably operate well even with a far stronger euro.
zh: 第五，歐元的當前值並未脫離購買力評價標準太遠。 1歐元兌1.4美元的匯率對德國出口商來說很便宜，即使歐元出現大升值，它們也不會受到多大影響。

en: For the eurozone’s southern periphery, however, today’s euro rate is very difficult to manage.
zh: 但是，對歐元區南部外圍國家來說，現在的歐元匯率是難以為繼的。

en: Whereas some German companies persuaded workers to accept wage cuts to help weather the financial crisis, wages across the southern periphery have been marching steadily upwards, even as productivity has remained stagnant.
zh: 一些德國公司說服員工接受減薪以助抵禦金融危機，但南歐外圍國家的工資一直在穩步上升，甚至在生產率停滯不前時也照漲不誤。

en: But, because the overall value of the euro has to be a balance of the eurozone’s north and south, one can argue that 1.4 is within a reasonable range.
zh: 但是，由於歐元的整體價值必須平衡南歐和北歐，因此，可以說1.4處於一個合理的區間內。

en: Finally, investors might just believe that the eurozone leaders’ latest plan will work, even though the last dozen plans have failed.
zh: 最後，投資者可能認為，儘管此前的諸多計劃都以失敗告終，但歐元區領導人的最新計劃終將見效。

en: Abraham Lincoln is credited with saying “You can fool some of the people all of the time, and all of the people some of the time, but you cannot fool all of the people all of the time.”
zh: 林肯有句名言 ： “ 你可以一直欺騙一些人，可也以一度欺騙所有人，但你不可能一直欺騙所有人。

en: A comprehensive euro fix will surely arrive for some of the countries at some time, but not for all of the countries anytime soon.
zh: ”完整的歐元修復計劃會在某個時候在某些國家出現，這是肯定的，但不可能一下子在所有國家出現。

en: So, yes, there are plenty of vaguely plausible reasons why the euro, despite its drawn-out crisis, has remained so firm against the dollar so far.
zh: 因此，你可以找出大把雄辯理由證明為何歐元儘管存在曠日持久的危機，但到目前為止仍然維持著對美元的堅挺。

en: But don’t count on a stable euro-dollar exchange rate – much less an even stronger euro – in the year ahead.
zh: 但展望明年，別指望歐元-美元匯率能保持穩定，至於歐元走強的可能性，那就更渺茫了。

en: A Green Alternative to Austerity?
zh: 一個緊縮的綠色替代項?

en: OXFORD – While austerity in Europe faces increasing social resistance, in principle it has the merit of simplicity.
zh: 發自牛津 — — 雖然歐洲緊縮政策面臨的社會阻力與日俱增，但至少該政策在原理上還具備簡單直接的優點。

en: As the debate on fiscal consolidation versus growth intensifies, it is clear that there is little agreement on how to kick-start the economy, beyond fielding broad stimulus packages.
zh: 而隨著鞏固財政還是確保增長的辯論日趨激烈，顯然除了實施大規模刺激政策之外，在如何啟動經濟方面並未形成多少共識。

en: One idea is that environmental technology might feed a virtuous cycle of innovation and employment.
zh: 一項理念隨之產生，認為環保科技可以推動一個創新與就業的良性迴圈。

en: To some, green growth evokes a countryside covered with windmills and urban roofs lined with solar panels.
zh: 在某些人看來，綠色增長就意味著遍佈鄉村的風車以及城市屋頂上的太陽能電池板。

en: But it is broader than that.
zh: 但這其實只是冰山一角。

en: For example, when Airbus moved from injection molding to 3D printing to produce the metal hinges for its airplanes’ doors, it reduced their weight by half, yielding phenomenal savings in material and associated fuel consumption over a lifetime of flying those hinges around the world.
zh: 以空中客車公司生產的機艙門鉸鏈為例，用三維噴射技術取代原有注射成型工藝可使鉸鏈的重量減少一半，不但節省了大量生產材料，在這些鉸鏈全球飛行的生命週期中也隨之減少了許多燃料消耗。

en: Still, it is easier to find exciting anecdotes than it is to show how they scale up to revitalizing an entire economy.
zh: 但相對於演示這些技術如何擴大並使整個經濟重煥生機，講故事顯然更加容易。

en: Moreover, there is a great diversity of narratives on the green economy – and their proliferation is likely to grow.
zh: 此外，對綠色經濟的不同故事描述之間也大相徑庭，而且這些分歧還有不斷加大之勢。

en: This June, thousands of activists, policymakers, and business people will converge on Rio de Janeiro for the third giant United Nations Sustainable Development Conference (Rio+20), whose theme is the green economy.
zh: 今年6月，數千名社會活動分子，政策制定者和商界人士都將齊聚里約熱內盧，參加以綠色經濟為主題的第三屆聯合國可持續發展會議（Rio+20 ） 。

en: The conference will unleash new arguments about green jobs, growth, cost increases, cost reductions, changes in values, consumer choice – green this and green that.
zh: 該會議也將釋放出一批關於綠色職位、增長、成本增加、成本削減，價值觀轉變和消費者選擇的新論點 — — 什麼都離不開綠色。

en: As a co-author of A New Growth Path for Europe, a report commissioned by the German government, I am guilty of contributing to this cacophony of complementary perspectives on green growth.
zh: 作為德國政府主持撰寫的報告《一條歐洲新增長路徑》的合著者，筆者很抱歉在本已眾說紛紜而又互為補充的綠色增長前景預測方面又增添了一把聲音。

en: The European Climate Foundation had already published its Roadmap 2050, A Practical Guide to a Prosperous, Low-Carbon Europe.
zh: 歐洲氣候基金會已經發表了《2050路線圖，一個實現繁榮低碳歐洲的實用指南 》 。

en: Since then, the UN Environment Program has released its Green Economy Report; McKinsey has written about the Resource Revolution; and the International Trade Unions Council has published Growing Green and Decent Jobs – to name but a few.
zh: 自那以後，聯合國環境計劃釋出了其《綠色經濟報告 》 ； 麥肯錫撰寫了《資源革命 》 ； 國際貿易聯盟委員會也發表了名為《增加綠色且體面的工作》的報告。

en: All take somewhat different approaches and offer different recommendations, making it hard for policymakers to see the forest through the trees.
zh: 上述所有報告都採取了某種不同的研究路徑並提出了各式各樣的建議，也令政策制定者們如墜五里霧中。

en: And, at the root of this multiplicity of perspectives lays the fact that economics struggles to explain how growth and innovation move an economy as a whole.
zh: 而這些預測之所以五花八門，根源就在於經濟學也無法完美解釋增長和創新是如何令一個經濟整體向前推進的。

en: The macroeconomic models on which policymakers depend are solid tools in times of smooth and incremental evolution, but green growth is not about gradual change.
zh: 在平穩且漸進式發展的時代，宏觀經濟模型是政策制定者們的可靠工具，但綠色增長卻不屬於漸進式變革的範疇。

en: For example, the European Union’s goal of achieving an 80% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2050 implies a complete overhaul of EU infrastructure in just a few decades.
zh: 舉個例子，歐盟在2050年實現溫室氣體減排80%的目標必然意味著在未來短短幾十年內對聯盟境內各類基礎設施進行全面升級改造。

en: Economists’ inability to model such rapid, radical change should not be taken as a condemnation of the discipline; it is simply a reflection of the state of our knowledge, and of the fact that the economy is really, really complicated.
zh: 即便經濟學家無法為這種迅速且激進的變革構建出模型，他們也不應該受到譴責，因為這只不過反映了我們當前的知識水平，以及經濟學真的非常、非常複雜的現實。

en: We simply do not yet have sufficiently precise insights into how all of its elements interact during times of far-reaching change, whether it be a financial crisis or a growth spurt.
zh: 我們只不過尚未具備足夠的深刻洞察力去理解在一場遙遠的變革 — — 不管是一場金融危機還是爆發式增長 — — 中所有的因素將如何互動。

en: Yet, the studies of green growth mentioned above all appear to provide such explanations.
zh: 但上述提及的所有關於綠色增長的研究似乎都提供了這類解釋。

en: So, what do they really tell us?
zh: 那麼他們究竟告訴了我們些什麼？

en: In practice, each is limited to just one or two aspects of the economy, and describes how these interact.
zh: 但實際操作中，每一項研究都僅僅侷限於經濟中的一個或兩個方面，並對它們的互動方式進行了解釋。

en: Growing Green and Decent Jobs looks at the relationship between investment and jobs.
zh: 《增加綠色且體面的工作》研究了投資與就業之間的關係。

en: A New Growth Path for Europe examines the impact of expectations and learning-by-doing.
zh: 《一條歐洲新增長路徑》解釋了預期以及邊幹邊學所產生的影響。

en: Roadmap 2050 focuses on greening the power system.
zh: 《2050路線圖》則把目光集中在能源系統的綠色化之上。

en: The authors then make a leap of faith to derive conclusions about the economy as a whole.
zh: 隨後各報告的作者們都對作為一個整體的經濟下了一個大膽的結論。

en: But, while the value of these studies is in the light that they shed on the parts, the ensuing headlines invariably are about the whole, articulated in terms of GDP and jobs.
zh: 但當這些研究的價值體現在對各部分的解釋之上時，隨後的核心卻總是關於整體，而整體則是用GDP和就業來進行衡量的。

en: Each of the studies describes a part of a green economy, but none can capture the whole – not because they are deficient, but because it is simply beyond our capability.
zh: 每一項研究都解釋了綠色經濟的一部份，沒有一個能涵蓋整體 — — 這不是因為這些研究有缺陷，只不過因為這件事已經完全超出了我們的能力之外。

en: That said, the fact that one cannot prove conclusively how green growth would work does not mean that we should give up on the idea.
zh: 這說明，雖然人們尚未可以確鑿證明綠色增長是有效的，但也不意味著我們應當放棄這個理念。

en: We know from history that waves of innovation, from the steam engine to the information and communications revolution, have led to dramatic increases in economic growth.
zh: 我們都從歷史上中看到過那些革新的浪潮，從蒸汽引擎到資訊與通訊革命，都引發了激動人心的經濟增長。

en: We cannot prove that a wave of environmental innovation will have a similar effect, but the studies of the parts make such an outcome highly plausible.
zh: 我們無法證明一股環境革新的浪潮會產生類似的效應，但針對不同部分的研究使得這樣一個結果更有說服力。

en: As humans, we are uniquely equipped to make decisions on the basis of ambiguous information – in fact, we do it all the time.
zh: 作為人類，我們都擁有依據模糊資訊做出決定的獨特能力 — — 事實上我們無時無刻都在這樣做。

en: When we choose a career or a spouse in our private lives, or when a politician seizes an opportunity from a plethora of possibilities, the task at hand is always about making highly consequential decisions based on imperfect information.
zh: 當我們選擇一項事業或者配偶，或是一個政治家從一堆可能性中抓住一個機會的時候，當務之急往往都是基於不完整的資訊來做出可能引發連串後果的決定。

en: A big pile of green-growth reports demonstrates the plausibility of this path to recovery from an historic economic crisis.
zh: 一大疊綠色發展報告都展示了這條把全世界從一個歷史性的經濟危機中實現復甦的路徑的說服力。

en: It is now up to us to realize its potential.
zh: 而如今也是我們將其潛力變成現實的時候了。

en: Green growth offers a realistic alternative to the faltering austerity approach to overcoming the current economic crisis.
zh: 相對於當前步履蹣跚的經濟危機緊縮應對政策，綠色增長提供了一個現實的替代選項。

en: Policymakers should incorporate this thinking into the “beyond austerity” narrative that is taking shape in a growing number of key EU member states.
zh: 而政策制定者們也應當把這一理念合併到當前在各歐盟主要成員國中日漸成形的“超越緊縮”述事中去。

en: Ethics and Agriculture
zh: 倫理與農業

en: MELBOURNE – Should rich countries – or investors based there – be buying agricultural land in developing countries?
zh: 墨爾本—發達國家（或那裡的投資者）應該購買發展中國家的農地嗎？

en: That question is raised in Transnational Land Deals for Agriculture in the Global South, a report issued last year by the Land Matrix Partnership, a consortium of European research institutes and nongovernmental organizations.
zh: 這是歐洲研究機構和非政府組織聯合體土地矩陣合夥組織（Land Matrix Partnership）去年題為《南半球跨國農用土地交易 》 （ Transnational Land Deals for Agriculture in the Global South）的報告中提出的問題。

en: The report shows that since 2000, investors or state bodies in rich or emerging countries have bought more than 83 million hectares (more than 200 million acres) of agricultural land in poorer developing countries.
zh: 報告顯示，自2000年以來，發達或新興國家的投資者或國家機構在更不發達國家購買了8 300多萬公頃（2億多英畝）的農地。

en: This amounts to 1.7% of the world’s agricultural land.
zh: 這相當於世界農地面積的1.7 % 。

en: Most of these purchases have been made in Africa, with two-thirds taking place in countries where hunger is widespread and institutions for establishing formal land ownership are often weak.
zh: 大部分農地買賣發生在非洲，其中三分之二發生在飢餓蔓延、缺少正式土地所有權框架的國家。

en: The purchases in Africa alone amount to an area of agricultural land the size of Kenya.
zh: 非洲的農地買賣量相當於肯亞的總面積。

en: It has been claimed that foreign investors are purchasing land that has been left idle; thus, by bringing it into production, the purchases are increasing the availability of food overall.
zh: 外國投資者宣稱自己購買的是閒置土地，因此，透過讓這些土地形成產出，土地買賣增加了糧食供應量。

en: But the Land Matrix Partnership report found that this is not the case: roughly 45% of the purchases involved existing croplands, and almost a third of the purchased land was forested, indicating that its development may pose risks for biodiversity.
zh: 但土地矩陣合夥組織的報告發現並非如此：約45%的土地買賣物件是已存在的耕地，幾乎三分之一的交易土地是林地，這表明開發可能威脅生物多樣性。

en: The investments are both private and public (for example, by state-owned entities) and come from three different groups of countries: emerging economies like China, India, Brazil, South Africa, Malaysia, and South Korea; oil-rich Gulf states; and wealthy developed economies like the United States and several European countries.
zh: 這類投資既有私人部門，也有公共部門（如國有實體 ） ， 主要購買者是三類國家：中國、印度、巴西、南非、馬來西亞和韓國等新興經濟體；波斯灣富油國；以及美國和不少歐洲國家等富有的發達國家。

en: On average, per capita income in the countries that are the source of these investments is four times higher than in the target countries.
zh: 平均而言，投資來源國的人均收入比投資目標國高出四倍。

en: Most of the investments are aimed at producing food or other crops for export from the countries in which the land is acquired, for the obvious reason that richer countries can pay more for the output.
zh: 大部分投資的目的是在土地收購國生產糧食和其他作物並用於出口，其中的原因顯而易見 — — 較發達國家對土地產出的出價更高。

en: More than 40% of such projects aim to export food to the source country – suggesting that food security is a major reason for buying the land.
zh: 40%以上的投資目的是向投資來源國出口糧食 — — 這表明糧食安全是購買土地的主要原因。

en: Oxfam International calls some of these deals “land grabs.”
zh: 國際樂施會（Oxfam International）將部分交易稱為“搶地 ” 。

en: Its own report, Our Land, Our Lives,indicates that, since 2008, communities affected by World Bank projects have brought 21 formal complaints alleging violations of their land rights.
zh: 其報告《我們的土地，我們的生命 》 （ Our Land, Our Lives）顯示，自2008年以來，受世界銀行專案影響的社會共提出了21次指責破壞其土地權利的正式投訴。

en: Oxfam, drawing attention to large-scale land acquisitions that have entailed direct rights violations, has called on the Bank to freeze investments in land purchases until it can set standards ensuring that local communities are informed of them in advance, with the option of refusing them.
zh: 為了吸引人們對存在直接侵權現象的大規模土地收購的關注，樂施會呼籲世界銀行凍結土地買賣投資，直到保證當地社會能提前獲得告知並選擇是否拒絕的標準出臺。

en: Oxfam also wants the Bank to ensure that these land deals do not undermine either local or national food security.
zh: 樂施會還呼籲世界銀行保證這些土地交易不能破壞當地和國家糧食安全。

en: In response, the World Bank agreed that there are instances of abuse in land acquisition, particularly in developing countries in which governance is weak, and said that it supported more transparent and inclusive participation.
zh: 作為回應，世界銀行同意土地收購過程中存在不端行為，特別是在治理薄弱的發展中國家，並表示它支援更透明、更包容的參與。

en: At the same time, it pointed to the need to increase food production to feed the extra two billion people expected to be alive in 2050, and suggested that more investment in agriculture in developing countries is required to improve productivity.
zh: 與此同時，世界銀行也指出，增加糧食產量以餵飽2050年的20億預計新增人口是十分必要的，並暗示要改善生產率，就必須增加發展中國家的農業投資。

en: The Bank rejected the idea of a moratorium on its own work with investors in agriculture, arguing that this would target precisely those who are most likely to do the right thing.
zh: 世界銀行拒絕中止其與農業投資者的合作，表示這類合作將明確定位於最有可能把事情作對的人和組織。

en: One may ask whether transparency and the requirement that local landholders consent to a sale is enough to protect people living in poverty.
zh: 你也許會問，有了透明度以及必須有當地地主願意出售的要求就足以保護生活在貧困中的呃人們了嗎？

en: Supporters of free markets will argue that if local landowners wish to sell their land, that is their choice to make.
zh: 自由市場的支持者會說，如果當地地主願意出售他們的土地，那麼這就是他們的自主選擇。

en: But, given the pressures of poverty and the lure of cash, what does it take for people to be able to make a genuinely free and informed choice about selling something as significant as a right to land?
zh: 但是，在貧困的壓力和現金的誘惑下，是什麼讓人們能夠在資訊充分的情況下真正自由地做出出售重要如土地的決策？

en: After all, we do not allow poor people to sell their kidneys to the highest bidder.
zh: 畢竟，我們不能允許窮人向出價最高者出售腎臟。

en: Of course, hardline supporters of free markets will say that we should.
zh: 當然，一根筋的自由市場支持者會說我們應該允許。

en: But, at the very least, it needs to be explained why people should be prohibited from selling kidneys, but not from selling the land that grows their food.
zh: 但是，無論如何，必須解釋人們為什麼應該被禁止出售腎臟而可以出售長出糧食的土地。

en: Most people can live without one kidney.
zh: 大部分人都可以在失去一個腎臟的情況下活著。

en: No one can live without food.
zh: 但沒人可以在沒有糧食的情況下活著。

en: Why does the purchase of body parts give rise to international condemnation, while the purchase of agricultural land does not – even when it involves evicting local landholders and producing food for export to rich countries instead of for local consumption?
zh: 為什麼買賣人體器官會引發國際社會的譴責，而買賣農地則否 — — 即使後者包括驅逐當地地主以及為發達國家而不是當地消費者生產供出口的糧食？

en: The World Bank may indeed be more concerned about local landholders’ rights than other foreign investors are.
zh: 事實上，與其他外國投資者相比，世界銀行也許能夠更關心當地地主的權利。

en: If so, the 21 complaints made against Bank projects are most likely the visible tip of a vast iceberg of violations of land rights by foreign investors in agricultural projects in developing countries – with the others remaining invisible because victims have no access to any complaint procedure.
zh: 果真如此的話，21份針對世界銀行專案的投訴極有可能只是外國投資者在發展中國家農業專案上大規模侵犯土地權利狀況的冰山一角，有大量侵權案例我們不曾看到，因為受害者投訴無門。

en: One such case belatedly came to the attention of the United Nations Human Rights Committee.
zh: 一宗此類案件終於引起了聯合國人權委員會的注意。
