en: In November, the Committee concluded that Germany had failed to police the Neumann Kaffee Gruppe regarding its complicity in the forced eviction of several villages in Uganda to make way for a large coffee plantation.
zh: 11月，該委員會認定德國在諾依曼咖啡集團（Neumann Kaffee Gruppe）串謀強迫驅趕烏干達幾個村莊村民建立大規模咖啡種植園的問題上不作為。

en: But the evictions took place in 2001, and the villagers are still living in extreme poverty.
zh: 但驅趕行為發生在2001年，被驅趕的村民至今仍生活在極端貧困中，他們沒有得到侵權補償，不管是烏干達還是德國。

en: They found no remedy, in either Uganda or Germany, for the violation of rights that, according to the Committee, they possess under the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, to which Germany is a signatory.
zh: 他們的土地權利受《民事和政治權利國際公約 》 （ International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights）保護，而德國是簽約國之一。

en: Are we to believe that landholders fare better with Chinese or Saudi investors?
zh: 我們可以指望當地地主從中國或沙特投資者手中獲得更好的補償嗎？

en: The Rise of the Food Barons
zh: 食品大亨的崛起

en: BERLIN – The industrial-agriculture sector has long faced criticism for practices that contribute to climate change, environmental destruction, and rural poverty.
zh: 柏林—長期以來，工業農業（industrial-agriculture sector）一直被人詬病加劇了氣候變化、環境破壞和農村貧困。

en: And yet the sector has taken virtually no steps to improve quality and sustainability, or to promote social justice.
zh: 但給行業幾乎沒有採取任何措施改善質量和可持續性，或促進社會公平。

en: This is not surprising. Although there are more than 570 million farmers and seven billion consumers worldwide, just a handful of companies control the global industrial-agriculture value chain – from field to shop counter.
zh: 這不足為奇，全世界有超過5.7億農民和七十億消費者，但從田間到店頭，全球工業農業的價值鏈控制在一小撮公司手中。

en: Given the high profits and vast political power of these companies, changes to the status quo are not in their interest.
zh: 這些公司利潤豐厚，炙手可熱，改變現狀可不符合它們的利益。

en: Moreover, market concentration in the agriculture sector is on the rise, owing to increased demand for the agricultural raw materials needed in food, animal feed, and energy production.
zh: 此外，拜糧食、飼料和能源生產的農業原材料需求增長所賜，農業的市場集中度也在升高。

en: As the middle class in southern countries has grown, its members’ consumption and nutritional habits have changed, boosting global demand for processed foods – and setting off a scramble for market power among multinational agricultural, chemical, and food corporations.
zh: 隨著南方國家中產階級的崛起，他們的消費和營養習慣也發生了改變，從而刺激了對加工食品的需求，也掀起了一場跨國農業、化工和食品公司爭奪市場大權的戰爭。

en: The biggest players in these sectors have been buying out their smaller competitors for years.
zh: 多年來，這些行業中的最大牌公司一直在收購規模較小的競爭對手。

en: But now they are also buying out one another, often with financing provided by investors from completely different sectors.
zh: 但如今，它們同時也在互相收購，融資常常來自完全不同行業的投資者。

en: Consider the seed and agrochemical sector, where Bayer, the second-largest pesticide producer in the world, is in the process of acquiring Monsanto, the largest seed producer, for €66 billion ($74 billion).
zh: 以種子和農化行業為例，全球第二大殺蟲劑生產商拜耳公司（Bayer）正在收購第一大種子生產商孟山都公司（Monsanto ） ， 作價660歐元。

en: If the United States and the European Union approve the deal, as seems likely, just three conglomerates – Bayer-Monsanto, Dow-DuPont and ChemChina-Syngenta – will control over 60% of the global seed and agrochemical market.
zh: 如果美國和歐盟批准這筆交易（目前看來很有可能 ） ， 那麼三家企業集團 — — 拜耳-孟山都、陶氏-杜邦（Dow-DuPont）和中化-先正達（ChemChina-Syngenta）將控制全球60%以上的種子和農化市場。

en: “Baysanto” alone would be the proprietor of almost every genetically modified plant on the planet.
zh: 光是“拜山都”一家，就幾乎囊括了全世界所有的轉基因作物。

en: With other large mergers also being announced, the global agriculture market at the end of 2017 could look very different than it did at the beginning.
zh: 隨著其他大型收購案的不斷宣佈，到2017年底，全球農業市場將與年初發生天翻地覆的變化。

en: Each of the three major conglomerates will be closer to its goal of achieving domination of the seed and pesticide markets – at which point they will be able to dictate food products, prices, and quality worldwide.
zh: 三大企業集團都將更加接近它們實現主宰種子和殺蟲劑市場的目標 — — 到時候它們就可以隨心所欲地控制全球食品的生產、價格和質量了。

en: The agrotechnical sector is experiencing some of the same changes as the seed sector.
zh: 農業技術行業正在經歷與種子行業類似的變化。

en: The five largest corporations account for 65% of the market, with Deere & Company, the owner of the John Deere brand, in the lead.
zh: 五家最大的公司控制了65%的市場，約翰迪爾（John Deere）商標所有人迪爾公司在這方面一馬當先。

en: In 2015, Deere & Company reported $29 billion in sales, surpassing the $25 billion that Monsanto and Bayer made selling seeds and pesticides.
zh: 2015年，迪爾公司披露的銷售額為290億美元，超過了賣種子和殺蟲劑的孟山都和拜耳的250億美元銷售額。

en: The most promising new opportunity for food corporations today lies in the digitization of agriculture.
zh: 如今，食品公司最憧憬的新機會在於農業數字化。

en: This process is still in its early stages, but it is gathering momentum, and eventually it will cover all areas of production.
zh: 農業數字化過程仍處於初級階段，但正在起勢，最終將涵蓋所有產品領域。

en: Soon enough, drones will take over the task of spraying pesticides; livestock will be equipped with sensors to track milk quantities, movement patterns, and feed rations; tractors will be controlled by GPS; and app-controlled sowing machines will assess soil quality to determine the optimal distance between rows and plants.
zh: 過不了多久，無人機全面接管噴灑殺蟲劑的任務；牲畜將配備感測器追蹤產奶量、運動軌跡和飼料配給；拖拉機將透過全球定位系統控制；而透過手機應用控制的播種機將評估土壤質量決定作物的最優間距。

en: To maximize the benefits of these new technologies, the companies that already dominate the value chain have begun cooperating with one another.
zh: 為了實現新技術效益最大化，已經佔據價值鏈主導地位的公司早已開始彼此合作。

en: The John Deeres and Monsantos have now joined forces.
zh: 約翰迪爾們和孟山都們已經結成了聯盟。

en: The confluence of soil and weather “big data,” new agrotechnologies, genetically modified seeds, and new developments in agrochemistry will help these companies save money, protect natural resources, and maximize crop yields worldwide.
zh: 土壤和天氣“大資料”的聚合、新農業技術、轉基因種子和農化新發展趨勢將幫助這些公司節省成本、保護自然資源、實現全球作物收成最大化。

en: But while this possible future bodes well for some of the world’s largest companies, it leaves the environmental and social problems associated with industrialized agriculture unsolved.
zh: 但這樣的未來可能固然有利於少數世界性大公司，並不能解決工業化農業遺留下來的相關環境和社會問題。

en: Most farmers, particularly in the global South, will never be able to afford expensive digital-age machinery.
zh: 大部分農民，特別是全球南方地區的農民，永遠買不起昂貴的數字時代機器。

en: The maxim “grow or go” will be replaced with “digitize or disappear.”
zh: “要麼成長，要麼離開”的格言將變成“要麼數字化，要麼消失 ” 。

en: The ETC Group, an American non-governmental organization, has already outlined a future scenario in which the major agrotechnology corporations move upstream and absorb the seed and pesticide producers.
zh: 在美國非政府組織ETC集團所列出的未來情景中，農業技術大公司將向上遊移動，吸收種子和殺蟲劑生產商。

en: At that point, just a few companies will determine everything that we eat.
zh: 到那時，少數幾家公司就能決定我們吃的一切。

en: Indeed, the same market-concentration problem applies to other links in the value chain, such as agricultural traders and supermarkets.
zh: 事實上，相同的市場集中問題在價值鏈的其他環節也存在，比如農業貿易商和超級市場。

en: And even though food processing is not yet consolidated on a global scale, it is still dominated at the regional level by companies such as Unilever, Danone, Mondelez, and Nestlé.
zh: 而儘管食品加工尚未出現全球規模的整合，但在地區層面上，聯合利華、達能、蒙德利茲（Mondelez）和雀巢的公司已經實現了主宰。

en: These companies make money when fresh or semi-processed food is replaced by highly processed convenience foods such as frozen pizza, canned soup, and ready-made meals.
zh: 隨著新鮮和半加工食品被速凍披薩、湯罐頭和即食肉製品等深加工食品所取代，這些公司也賺了個盆滿缽滿。

en: While lucrative, this business model is closely linked to obesity, diabetes, and other chronic diseases.
zh: 儘管利潤豐厚，但這一商業模式很容易導致肥胖、糖尿病和其他慢性疾病。

en: Worse, food corporations are also profiting from the proliferation of illnesses for which they are partly responsible, by marketing “healthy” processed foods enriched with protein, vitamins, probiotics, and omega-3 fatty acids.
zh: 更糟糕的是，食品公司也因為它們負有部分責任的疾病擴散中而獲利，因為它們推廣的“健康”加工食品中富含蛋白質、維生素、益生菌歐米茄-3脂肪酸。

en: Meanwhile, corporations are amassing market power at the expense of those at the bottom of the value chain: farmers and workers.
zh: 與此同時，這些公司贏得市場權力以價值鏈底層 — — 農民和工人的犧牲為代價。

en: International Labor Organization standards guarantee all workers the right to organize, and they prohibit forced and child labor and proscribe race and gender discrimination.
zh: 國際勞工組織規則保障所有工人都有組織工會的權利，也禁止強迫勞動和童工以及種族和性別歧視。

en: But labor-law violations have become the norm, because efforts to enforce ILO rules are often quashed, while trade union members are routinely threatened, fired, and even murdered.
zh: 但違反勞動法的情況司空見慣，因為國際勞工組織規則的執行力往往很弱，而工會成員常常受到威脅、解僱甚至謀殺。

en: In this hostile climate, minimum-wage, overtime-pay, and workplace-safety standards are openly neglected.
zh: 在如此不利的環境下，最低工資、加班費和工作場所安全標準被公然無視。

en: And women, in particular, are at a disadvantage, because they are paid less than their male counterparts and often must settle for seasonal or temporary jobs.
zh: 婦女尤其不利，因為她們的薪酬低於男性同事，從事的也常常是季節性或臨時性工作。

en: Today, half of the world’s 800 million starving people are small farmers and workers connected to the agricultural sector.
zh: 如今，全世界8億吃不飽飯的人中有一半是小農和農業相關工人。

en: Their lot will hardly improve if the few companies already dominating that sector become even more powerful.
zh: 如果極少數已經成為行業主宰的公司繼續獲得更大的權力，他們的境況將難以改善。

en: How to Feed the World
zh: 如何養活世界

en: PRAGUE – Hunger has wracked humanity since time immemorial.
zh: 布拉格—從遠古時代開始，飢餓一直困擾著人類。

en: Nearly every major society has been shaped by famine; one estimate suggests that China suffered drought or flood-induced starvation in at least one province almost every year from 108 BC to 1911.
zh: 幾乎所有主要社會都受到饑荒影響；有人估算，從公元前108年到公園1911年間，每一年中國都至少有一個省出現旱災或洪災導致饑荒的情況。

en: Yet the struggle against hunger is a battle that humanity could finally win.
zh: 但與飢餓的鬥爭是一場人類最終能夠取得勝利的鬥爭。

en: More cereals were produced annually in the last quarter of the twentieth century than in any preceding period, and more grain will be harvested this year than at any time in history.
zh: 二十世紀最後四分之一的穀物年產量要比此前任何一個時期都要高，而今年的穀物產量更是要高於歷史上任何一年。

en: Since 1992, the number of hungry people worldwide has plummeted by more than 200 million, even as the human population grew by nearly two billion.
zh: 自1992年以來，全球饑民數量減少了兩億多，儘管人口數量增加了近二十億。

en: But enormous challenges remain.
zh: 但仍有諸多挑戰。

en: Affordable, nutritious food is one of people’s top priorities everywhere, and one in nine people still do not get enough food to be healthy.
zh: 平價營養食物是所有人類最要緊的事，而有九分之一的人類仍然無法獲得足夠的食物保持健康。

en: With today’s population of 7.3 billion expected to reach 8.5 billion by 2030 and 9.7 billion in 2050, food demand will increase accordingly.
zh: 今天的73億人口預計到2030年將變為85億，到2050年將變為97億，食物需求也將相應增長。

en: Along with more mouths to feed, stresses on food supplies will include conflicts, economic volatility, extreme weather events, and climate change.
zh: 隨著有更多的肚子需要填飽，食物供給的壓力將來自衝突、經濟動盪、極端天氣事件、氣候變化等。

en: Increases in agricultural productivity, owing to improvements in seeds, new fertilizers and pesticides, improved credit access, and technological breakthroughs, have been a key driver in reducing hunger.
zh: 拜種子改良、新化肥和殺蟲劑、信用渠道暢通化以及技術突破所賜，農業生產率獲得了極大的提高，併成為減少飢餓的主要推動力量。

en: Between 1930 and 2000, agricultural output in the United States quadrupled, with productivity growth outstripping that of manufacturing.
zh: 從1930年到2000年，美國農業產出翻了兩番，農業生產率增長比製造業更快。

en: Developing countries have begun sharing in these gains: responsible for next-to-none of the world’s fertilizer consumption in 1960, by 2000 they used more than industrialized countries.
zh: 發展中國家也開始分享這些收益：1960年，它們的化肥消費佔比可以忽略不計，到2000年，它們的化肥使用量已經超過了工業化國家。

en: The World Bank has found that productivity growth in agriculture can be up to four times more effective in reducing poverty than growth from other sectors.
zh: 世界銀行發現，農業生產率增長���減少貧困的作用是其他部門生產率增長的四倍。

en: So how do we keep up this progress?
zh: 那麼，我們如何保持這一勢頭？

en: Investment in research and development is vital.
zh: 研究和開發投資至關重要。

en: According to research conducted for Copenhagen Consensus, which I direct, investing an extra $88 billion in agricultural R&D over the next 15 years would increase yields by an additional 0.4 percentage points each year, which could save 79 million people from hunger and prevent five million cases of child malnourishment.
zh: 據由我領導的哥本哈根共識中心所做的研究，未來十五年在農業研發上增加880億美元投資每年能夠多提高0.4個百分點的產量增長，讓7,900萬人擺脫貧困，讓五百萬兒童免於營養不良。

en: Achieving these targets would be worth nearly $3 trillion in social good, implying an enormous return of $34 for every dollar spent.
zh: 實現這些目標相當於實現3萬億美元的社會公益，即每一美元支出帶來34美元的鉅額回報。

en: Scientific breakthroughs also play a key role in fighting specific nutritional challenges such as vitamin A deficiency, the leading cause of preventable childhood blindness.
zh: 科學突破也在戰勝具體的營養挑戰方面起著關鍵作用，比如維生素A缺乏症，它是引起可預防兒童失明的主要原因。

en: Robert Mwanga was awarded this year’s World Food Prize for inspiring work that resulted in the large-scale replacement of white sweet potato (with scant Vitamin A content) by a vitamin A-rich alternative in the diets of Uganda’s rural poor.
zh: 羅伯特·姆萬加（Robert Mwanga）因為在用富含維生素A的品種大量替換烏干達農村窮人日常實用的甘白薯（維生素A含量很低）方面所取得的鼓舞人心的工作而被授予世界糧食獎。

en: Another way to increase agricultural productivity is through labor.
zh: 另一個增加農業生產率的方法是透過勞動力。

en: When Copenhagen Consensus researchers examined responses to global warming in Bangladesh, they found that increasing agricultural labor productivity “is the only way to increase the resilience of Bangladesh to climate change and to meet long-term development goals.”
zh: 哥本哈根共識中心研究者在考察孟加拉國應對全球變暖的方法時發現，增加農業勞動力生產率“是加強孟加拉國面對氣候變化的恢復力、實現長期發展目標的唯一方法。

en: Investing around $9,000 per worker over two decades could boost agricultural productivity by 10%.
zh: ”在二十年的時間裡對每位工人投資大約9,000美元能夠讓農業生產率提高10 % 。

en: Bangladesh is an instructive case, because it is susceptible to flooding and the effects of climate change, and its agricultural productivity lags behind other developing and middle-income countries.
zh: 孟加拉國的例子很有說明意義，因為它極易受到洪水和氣候變化影響，而其農業生產率也落後於其他發展中和中等收入國家。

en: Unsurprisingly, the Bangladeshi prime minister’s office is striving to lead in global innovation, sustaining an agriculture innovation lab that shares best practices and ideas.
zh: 毫不奇怪，孟加拉國總理辦公室正致力於引領全球創新，建立了一座共享最佳實踐和思想的農業創新實驗室。

en: Copenhagen Consensus has worked with the world’s largest NGO, BRAC, to find out the policy wishes of people living in rural Bangladesh, including the “ultra-poor” with whom BRAC works closely.
zh: 哥本哈根共識中心與全球最大的非政府組織BRAC合作瞭解孟加拉國農村地區人口 — — 包括BRAC共組人員與之近距離共事的“極端貧困”人口 — — 想要什麼政策。

en: These laborers, housewives, and others, some of whom live on the equivalent of $0.60-0.70 or less a day, are seldom given a place at the table to discuss policy.
zh: 這些勞動者、家庭主婦和其他人員每天的生活費不超過0.6—0.7美元，他們的聲音很少在政策討論擁有一席之地。

en: Across nine rural forums in far-flung parts of the country, the participants overwhelmingly spoke with one voice, calling for the same policy priority: increased agricultural productivity.
zh: 在孟加拉國偏遠地區的九個論壇上，參與者一邊倒地發出一個聲音，提出了同一個政策重點要求：提高農業生產率。

en: “Everyone knows Rangpur has a Monga problem,” said a local from Chandpara in the Rangpur division, using the Bengali term for the annual cyclical phenomenon of seasonal hunger.
zh: “眾所周知，朗布林（Rangpur）地區存在孟加（monga）問題 ” ， 朗布林省錢德帕拉（Chandpara）的一位當地人如是說 ， “ 孟加”是孟加拉語，指年復一年發生的季節性飢餓現象。

en: “We cannot feed our people two times a day – we need to increase our agricultural productivity.”
zh: “我們的人一天吃不上兩頓飯 — — 我們需要提高農業生產率。 ”

en: A Mukimabad villager had the same vision for Bangladesh: “We need crops and seeds which are not vulnerable to salinity and flood so that we do not have to die from food shortages.”
zh: 一位木吉瑪巴德（Mukimabad）村民持有同樣觀點 ： “ 我們需要抗鹽鹼和洪水的莊稼和種子，這樣我們才不會死於食物短缺。 ”

en: Humanity’s fight against hunger can be won.
zh: 人類可以打贏與飢餓的戰爭。

en: Great progress has been made, but the world needs more agricultural R&D and higher productivity.
zh: 人類已經取得了巨大的進步，但世界需要更多農業研發和更高的生產率。

en: As a rural villager from Deukhola, near the Brahmaputra River in remote northern Bangladesh, starkly put it: “Our survival depends on it.”
zh: 孟加拉國北部偏遠地區布拉馬普特拉河附近的德克霍拉（Deukhola）的一位農民尖銳地指出 ， “ 我們的生存就係於此。

en: We would do well to listen.
zh: ”聆聽能讓我們做得更好。

en: An Arab Marshall Plan
zh: 阿拉伯馬歇爾計劃

en: OXFORD – The wave of revolts that swept across the Arab world two years ago were fueled by demands for freedom, bread, and social justice.
zh: 牛津—兩年前席捲阿拉伯世界的革命風潮的推動力來自自由、麵包和社會公正的要求。

en: But, although the revolutions toppled dictators and transformed societies, these core objectives remain as distant as ever.
zh: 但是，儘管革命顛覆了獨裁者、改變了社會，但這些核心目標扔像從前一樣遙遠。

en: In fact, the economic challenges facing the Arab Spring countries have become even more pressing, weighing heavily on these countries’ political prospects.
zh: 事實上，阿拉伯之春國家面臨的經濟挑戰甚至變得更加緊迫了，嚴重地影響著這些國家的政治前景。

en: Unemployment has nearly doubled in Tunisia and Egypt, and foreign direct investment has dried up across the Arab world.
zh: 突尼西亞和埃及的失業率幾近翻番，整個阿拉伯世界的外國直接投資幾乎枯竭。

en: Tourism revenues, while resilient, are declining, and fiscal challenges remain considerable.
zh: 旅遊收入隨雖然堅挺，但也在下降，財政挑戰也依然嚴峻。

en: But the economic urgency is not reflected in the policy response, which has been painfully slow or non-existent.
zh: 但經濟緊迫性並未反映在緩慢（如果不是沒有的話）的政策反應中。

en: For example, Egypt’s fiscal deficit will exceed 11% of GDP this year.
zh: 比如，埃及今年的財政赤字將超過GDP的11 % 。

en: But the country’s leaders have been stalling on the terms of a much-needed International Monetary Fund loan.
zh: 但該國領導人還在急需的IMF貸款條件上扯皮。

en: The government’s reduction of fuel subsidies last year was not followed by additional reforms, and the required tax increase was delayed soon after President Mohamed Morsi announced it.
zh: 政府在去年削減了燃料補貼，但並未增加進一步的改革，總統穆爾西在宣佈實施必要的增稅後馬上把這一措施推遲了。

en: Almost all political stakeholders in Egypt, as in the other Arab countries in transition, recognize the need for economic reform.
zh: 埃及幾乎所有的政治相關利益者（其他阿拉伯過渡國家也一樣）都知道經濟改革的必要性。

en: But neither citizens nor policymakers appear willing to bear its social and political costs.
zh: 但人民和決策者都不希望承擔改革的社會和政治成本。

en: In a charged and uncertain political climate, in which new crises erupt on a daily basis, it is unsurprising that economic reform has been postponed repeatedly.
zh: 在敏感而不確定的政治氣候下 — — 幾乎天天爆發新危機 — — 經濟改革一再中止並不令人奇怪。

en: Politicians know that macroeconomic stabilization and social cohesion can be irreconcilable in the short run.
zh: 政客們明白，宏觀經濟穩定和社會團結在短期是不可調和的。

en: Slashing food and energy subsidies in order to reduce fiscal strain is unlikely to win favor in a country like Egypt, where 40% of per capita income is allocated to food.
zh: 削減食品和能源補貼以降低財政負擔不可能讓你在埃及贏得支援，因為埃及人均收入的四成用於食品。

en: Politics is thus constraining efforts to strengthen public finances.
zh: 因此，政治成了加強財政健康的約束。

en: At the same time, narrow IMF prescriptions threaten to exacerbate political instability, with citizens no longer afraid to take to the streets to demonstrate their dissatisfaction.
zh: 與此同時，狹隘的IMF藥方有放大政治動盪的可能，人民已不再憚於走上街頭表達自己的不滿。

en: The current impasse on economic reform highlights a larger point: subsidy and tax regimes cannot be reformed without first redefining the underlying social contract, which has long exchanged welfare distribution for political acquiescence.
zh: 近期的經濟改革僵局凸顯出一個更大的問題：欲改革補貼和稅收制度，必先重新規定社會契約。 長期以來，社會契約的內容是用財富分配換取政治順從。

en: But such a move is far too risky for an individual politician, or even a single country, at a time of economic uncertainty and high unemployment.
zh: 但是，在經濟不確定性和失業高企的時期，這樣一場運動對政治家個人甚至個別國家來說風險太大。

en: In order to create the political space needed for economic reform, Arab leaders must underwrite a regional growth pact – a Marshall Plan of sorts – that would facilitate major new investments aimed at reviving economic activity.
zh: 為了創造經濟改革所需要的政治空間，阿拉伯領導人必須丟擲地區增長契約 — — 類似於馬歇爾計劃 — — 以刺激旨在重振經濟活動的投資。

en: It is much easier to reform subsidy programs when the economy is expanding.
zh: 一旦經濟開始擴張，改革補貼計劃就會容易得多。

en: Moreover, building competitive markets is essential to ensuring sustainable GDP growth.
zh: 此外，建設競爭市場是確保可持續GDP增長的關鍵。

en: To this end, regional trade barriers, which are more pervasive in the Arab world than even in Sub-Saharan Africa, must be dismantled.
zh: 在這方面，地區貿易壁壘 — — 阿拉伯世界的這個問題甚至比撒哈拉以南非洲還要普遍 — — 必須打破。

en: By agreeing to the pact, Arab countries would commit to reforming their subsidy systems and to reducing restrictions on cross-border economic exchange.
zh: 透過同意這一契約，阿拉伯國家將能致力於改革補貼制度、減少跨國經濟往來限制。

en: The regional dimension of prosperity has long been ignored in the Arab world.
zh: 繁榮的地區維度在阿拉伯世界長期受到忽視。

en: But weak regional linkages limit small firms’ growth potential, forcing them to depend on state patronage.
zh: 但微弱的地區聯絡侷限了小企業的增長潛力，迫使它們依賴國家支援。

en: Although Arab leaders often cite Turkey as a beacon of hope, they rarely acknowledge that the country’s recent transformation from the “sick man of Europe” to one of the world’s fastest-growing emerging markets would not have been possible had it not pursued regional synergies.
zh: 儘管阿拉伯領導人經常把土耳其當做希望的燈塔，但他們很少承認，如果不追求地區協同效應，土耳其當前從“歐洲病夫”向世界增長最快的新興市場的轉型根本不可能實現。

en: Such linkages are particularly important for Egypt and Tunisia, which will struggle to reduce unemployment unless Libya’s labor market – which has historically absorbed migrants from its North African neighbors – is reopened.
zh: 這一聯絡對埃及和突尼西亞尤其重要，除非利比亞勞動力市場重新開放 — — 傳統上，利比亞吸收著來自北非諸鄰國的移民 — — 否則埃及和突尼西亞很難降低失業率。

en: And, while Tunisia’s situation seems to be the most promising, a crippling investment shortfall is threatening to derail reform efforts there.
zh: 而儘管突尼西亞的狀況似乎最為樂觀，但要命的投資短缺有可能使改革夭折。

en: With Europe mired in crisis, capital flows from Tunisia’s resource-rich Arab neighbors are its best hope.
zh: 在歐洲飽受危機折磨的前提下，來自資源豐富的阿拉伯鄰國的資本流入是突尼西亞最大的希望。

en: Furthermore, Arab countries must ratchet up development spending.
zh: 除此之外，阿拉伯國家必須逐漸增加發展支出。

en: Given that existing development banks in the region have largely failed to act as vehicles of coordination and commitment, a new institution – resembling the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development – would have to be established to oversee a regional aid push and underwrite the costs of economic transition.
zh: 該地區現有開發銀行作為協調和委託實體大體上可以說是失敗的，因此需要建立模仿歐洲復興開發銀行的新機構來管理地區援助，比如承銷經濟轉型的成本。

en: New investment vehicles, such as sovereign wealth funds and Islamic finance, can contribute financing to credit-starved firms.
zh: 新投資實體，比如主權財富基金和伊斯蘭金融也可以幫助信用飢渴的企業融資。

en: At the same time, Arab countries must streamline current aid efforts.
zh: 與此同時，阿拉伯國家必須讓當前援助措施合理化。

en: For too long, Arab governments have simply thrown money at problems, with the rich Gulf countries effectively subsidizing their troubled neighbors’ public services.
zh: 長期以來，阿拉伯國家政府總是把錢浪費在問題上，富有的波斯灣國家實際上補貼著它們陷入麻煩的鄰國的公共服務。

en: Over the last two years, Saudi Arabia has provided more than $3 billion to Yemen.
zh: 過去兩年來，沙特向葉門提供了30多億美元。

en: Qatar has provided  $5 billion to Egypt since 2011, with a promise of $3 billion more.
zh: 卡達自2011年以來向埃及提供了50億美元，並承諾還將提供30億美元。

en: And the United Arab Emirates recently pledged $2.5 billion to Bahrain.
zh: 阿聯酋最近也承諾向巴林提供25億美元。

en: But unconditional aid only delays reforms, because it weakens budget constraints, which reduces pressure on policymakers and creates moral hazard.
zh: 但無條件的援助只能拖延干戈，因為這削弱了預算約束，從而減輕了決策者的壓力，創造了道德風險。

en: The Arab Spring has exposed fault lines that run not just through individual countries, but also through the entire region.
zh: 阿拉伯之春暴露了不僅存在於個體國家之間、也存在於整個地區的斷層線。

en: This calls for redefining relationships not only between citizens and states, but also among Arab countries.
zh: 這不但需要重新定義人民和國家間關係，也需要重新定義阿拉伯國家之間的關係。

en: Above all, it is no longer prudent to divide Arab countries between donors and recipients, or between resource-rich and resource-poor countries.
zh: 最重要的是，將阿拉伯國家分為贊助過和受贊助國或資源富裕國和資源貧乏國已不再合適。

en: It is in the interest of the entire region – including those countries that do not seem to face an imminent threat of revolt – to contribute to their neighbors’ economic revival and facilitate their political transitions.
zh: 協助鄰國經濟復興、刺激政治過渡是整個地區的利益所在 — — 包括並不面臨迫切革命威脅的國家。

en: The Ahistorical Federal Reserve
zh: 反歷史的美聯儲

en: BERKELEY – Economic developments over the past 20 years have taught – or ought to have taught – the US Federal Reserve four lessons.
zh: 伯克利—過去20年的經濟發展教給 — — 或者應該教給 — — 美聯儲四個教訓。

en: Yet the Fed’s current policy posture raises the question of whether it has internalized any of them.
zh: 但美聯儲當前的政策姿態讓人們質疑他們是否消化了其中任何一個。

en: The first lesson is that, at least as long as the current interest-rate configuration is sustained, the proper inflation target for the Fed should be 4% per year, rather than 2%.
zh: 第一個教訓是，至少在當前利率保持調整態勢的情況下，美聯儲合理的目標通脹應該是每年4 % ， 而不是2 % 。

en: A higher target is essential in order to have enough room to make the cuts in short-term safe nominal interest rates of five percentage points or more that are usually called for to cushion the effects of a recession when it hits the economy.
zh: 為了在衰退影響到經濟時有足夠的空間削減通常所需要的短期安全名義利率五個或更多百分點，提高通脹目標至關重要。

en: The Fed protests that to change its inflation target even once would erode the credibility of its commitment to ensuring price stability.
zh: 美聯儲反對說，改變通脹目標，哪怕一次，會有損於其確保物價穩定的承諾的信譽。

en: But the Fed can pay now or it can pay later.
zh: 但美聯儲可以現在付出代價，也可以隨後付出代價。

en: After all, what good is credibility today when it means sticking tenaciously to a policy that deprives you of the ability to do your job properly tomorrow?
zh: 畢竟，如果今天的信譽意味著堅持限制你明天遊刃有餘地完成任務的能力的政策，還有什麼有點可言？

en: The second lesson is that the two slope coefficients in the algebraic equation that is the Phillips curve – the link between expected inflation and current inflation, and the responsiveness of future inflation to current unemployment – are both much smaller than they were back in the 1970s or even in the 1980s.
zh: 第二個教訓是菲利普斯曲線代數公式中的兩個斜率都較20世紀70年代甚至80年代出現了大幅下降。 菲利普斯曲線描述預期通脹和當前通脹之間的關係。

en: Then-Fed Chair Alan Greenspan recognized this in the 1990s.
zh: 20世紀90年代，時任美聯儲主席艾倫·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）發現了這一現象。

en: He rightly judged that pushing for faster growth and lower unemployment was not taking excessive risks, but rather harvesting low-hanging fruit.
zh: 他正確地判斷，推動加快增長和降低失業不會帶來過度風險，反而是唾手可得的果實。

en: The current Fed appears to have a different view.
zh: 現任美聯儲似乎持有不同觀點。

en: The third lesson is that yield-curve inversion in the bond market is not just a sign that the market thinks that monetary policy is too tight; it is a sign that monetary policy really is too tight.
zh: 第三個教訓是債券市場收益率曲線反轉不僅僅是市場認為貨幣政策過緊的訊號；它就是貨幣政策過緊的訊號。

en: The people who bid up the prices of long-term US Treasury bills in anticipation of interest-rate cuts when the Fed overshoots and triggers a recession are the same people who are now on tenterhooks wondering when to start cutting back on investment plans because a recession will soon produce overcapacity.
zh: 當初認為美聯儲超調會導致利率下降而競價抬高長期美國國債的人，與現在因為衰退會迅速導致產能過剩而焦慮不安地考慮何時收回投資計劃的人，是同一撥人。

en: The Fed today has a “habitat theory” about why this time is different – that is, why the preferences of investors for particular maturity lengths imply that a yield-curve inversion would not mean what it has always meant.
zh: 今天，美聯儲有一套“棲息地理論”解釋為何這次不一樣 — — 即為何投資者對某個久期長度的偏好意味著收益率曲線反轉的含義與過去不再相同。

en: But 2006, just before the financial crisis hit, was supposed to be different, too.
zh: 但在2006年，就在金融危機爆發前夕，人們也以為這次不一樣了。

en: (And there were plenty of times before then that were supposed to be different, too.)
zh: （在此之前也有許多次人們認為這次不一樣。

en: History suggests that this time is highly unlikely to be different – and that it will not end well if the Fed continues to believe and behave otherwise.
zh: ）歷史表明，這次不太可能不一樣 — — 如果美聯儲繼續這次會不一樣，解決肯定不會好。

en: The fourth lesson similarly reflects developments extending back further than 20 years.
zh: 第四個教訓同樣反映了可追溯到20多年前的發展趨勢。

en: Back in the 1980s, it was not unreasonable to argue that the next large shock to the US macroeconomy was likely to be inflationary.
zh: 20世紀80年代，有充分的理由認為下一場對美國宏觀經濟的大沖擊可能是會引起通脹。

en: It is much more difficult to reasonably argue that today.
zh: 今天做出這樣的判斷依據不再。

en: For the past three and a half decades, the principal shocks have not been inflationary, like the 1973 and 1979 oil crises, but rather deflationary, like the US savings and loan crisis in the 1980s and 1990s, the 1997 Asian crisis, the 2000 dot-com bust, the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, the 2007 subprime collapse that began in the US, and the 2010 European debt crash.
zh: 在過去三十五年中，主要衝擊都沒有引起通脹，如1973和1979年石油危機，相反，它們引起了通縮，如20世紀八九十年代的美國儲貸銀行危機、1997年亞洲金融危機、2000年網際網路泡沫破裂、2001年9月11日恐怖襲擊、2007年始於美國的次貸危機，以及2010年歐洲債務危機。

en: Former Fed Chair Janet Yellen told me back in the 1990s that, in her view, conducting the Fed’s internal debate within the framework of interest-rate rules had greatly increased the ease of getting from agreement about the structure and state of the economy to a rough consensus on appropriate policy.
zh: 美聯儲前主席珍妮特·耶倫（Janet Yellen）在20世紀90年代告訴我，在她看來，在美聯儲內部組織在利率規則框架內的爭論大大便利了從關於經濟結構和狀態的一致實現關於合適政策的粗略共識。

en: But, at least as I see it, right now the Fed’s process of getting from a realistic view of the economy to an appropriate monetary policy does not seem to be functioning well at all.
zh: 但是，至少在我看來，現在美聯儲從經濟的現實觀點到合適貨幣政策的轉變過程執行一點都不好。

en: Perhaps it is time for the Fed to place its internal discussions in a more explicit framework.
zh: 也許美聯儲應該在更加明確的框架中進行內部討論。

en: One can imagine, for example, the Fed adopting an “optimal control” method, whereby monetary-policy settings are established by running multiple simulations of a macroeconomic model using different combinations of interest rates and balance-sheet tools to project future inflation and unemployment.
zh: 比如，可以想象美聯儲採取“最佳化控制”方法，貨幣政策的制定建立在多重宏觀經濟模型模擬的基礎上。 這些模型採用不同的利率和資產負債表工具組合，預測未來通脹和失業。

en: The problem for optimal control methods is that the real world is not some closed system where economic relationships never change, or where they change in fully predictable ways.
zh: 最佳化控制方法的問題是真實世界是一個比較封閉的系統，經濟關係從不改變，或者以完全可預測的方式改變。

en: The most effective – and thus the most credible – monetary policy is one that reflects not only the lessons of history, but also a willingness to reconsider long-held assumptions.
zh: 最有效 — — 因此也是最可信 — — 的貨幣政策不但要反映歷史教訓，也要反映反思長期以來的假設的意願。

en: A History Lesson for Koizumi
zh: 給小泉的一堂歷史課

en: Once again, protests against Japanese Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi’s annual visit to the Yasukuni shrine are breaking out in China as well as South Korea.
zh: 中國和韓國又一次爆發了反對日本首相小泉純一郎一年一度參拜靖國神社的抗議活動。

en: Koizumi’s insistence on paying homage to the war dead interred at Yasukuni, where convicted war criminals from World War II are among the buried, has been damaging relations with Japan’s neighbors for years.
zh: 小泉堅持拜祭埋葬有二戰戰犯的靖國神社，多年來一直損害著日本與鄰國的關係。

en: Indeed, Chinese President Hu Jintao continually affirms that he will not hold a summit with a Japanese prime minister who goes to Yasukuni, which most Chinese regard as a glorification of past Japanese aggression and colonialism.
zh: 實際上，中國主席胡錦濤一直聲稱不與參拜靖國神社的日本首相舉行首腦會談。 大部分中國人認為參拜是美化日本過去侵略和殖民歷史。

en: Even some in Japan are becoming critical of Koizumi.
zh: 甚至日本一些人也開始對小泉持批評意見。

en: While the public remains negative about Chinese outbursts against Japan, a recent survey indicates that more than 70% of Japanese view the current state of Japan-China relations as unacceptable.
zh: 雖然公眾仍舊覺得中國人對日本爆發憤怒不可理喻，但是最近一項調查顯示70%多的日本人認為日中關係當前的這種狀態不可接受。

en: More people are not supporting Koizumi’s annual pilgrimage to Yasukuni, with seven former prime ministers jointly demanding that he refrain from the visits.
zh: 更多的人不支援小泉每年參拜靖國神社，七位前首相聯合要求他放棄參拜。

en: Yet Koizumi remains defiant.
zh: 然而小泉卻一意孤行。

en: Moreover, Chief Cabinet Secretary Shinzu Abe, the front-runner to succeed him, has openly declared that he will continue to visit the shrine as prime minister.
zh: 而且，最有可能接任他的內閣官房長官安倍晉三已經公開宣佈他擔任首相後將繼續參拜靖國神社。

en: Foreign Minister Taro Aso, another possible successor to Koizumi, has called for the Japanese Emperor to pray at Yasukuni.
zh: 另一個可能接替小泉的人，外相麻生太郎呼籲日本天皇去參拜靖國神社。

en: So pessimism appears to be settling in, and the deadlock over Yasukuni appears to be deepening.
zh: 儘管局勢似乎如此悲觀，靖國神社僵局似乎正在加深。

en: But the past can bring us more than just troubles of this kind.
zh: 但是歷史不僅僅能夠給我們帶來現在這種困境。

en: Even on the issue of Yasukuni, there are positive lessons to be learned.
zh: 甚至是在靖國神社問題上，也有積極的經驗可供我們學習。

en: Consider Yasuhiro Nakasone, Koizumi’s predecessor in the 1980’s.
zh: 想一想小泉20世紀80年代的前輩中曾根康弘首相吧。

en: Both are master politicians who remained popular and served long terms in office.
zh: 兩人都是精明的政治家，一直很受歡迎，執政時間也很長。

en: Both are conservative and nationalistic, advocating the revision of the constitution and an assertive political and military role for Japan abroad.
zh: 兩人都是保守派，信奉民族主義，鼓吹修改憲法和日本在海外發揮更大的政治和軍事作用。

en: Finally, both are pro-American, with Nakasone declaring Japan to be America’s “unsinkable aircraft carrier” in East Asia and Koizumi sending troops to Iraq in support of the United States-led war effort.
zh: 最後，兩人都親美，中曾根康弘宣佈日本是美國在東亞“不沉的航空母艦 ” ， 小泉則向伊拉克派兵支援美國為首的戰爭行動。

en: But a crucial difference between Nakasone and Koizumi is often overlooked: their handling of the Yasukuni controversy and relations with China.
zh: 但是中曾與小泉之間一個重要的差別卻常常被忽視,那就是他們處理靖國神社爭議和對中關係的方法。

en: Nakasone broke the taboo by being the first prime minister to worship at the Yasukuni shrine in his official capacity on August 15, 1985, the fortieth anniversary of the end of World War II.
zh: 1985年8月15日、第二次世界大戰結束40週年紀念日那天，中曾根康弘打破禁忌成為了第一位在職期間參拜靖國神社的首相。

en: The decision triggered a severe response from China, where students held demonstrations against his visit.
zh: 這個決定激起了中國強烈的反應，學生對他的參拜舉行示威遊行。

en: Bilateral relations were frozen.
zh: 雙邊關係被凍結。

en: But, instead of capitalizing on domestic resentment over China’s criticisms, Nakasone decided not to visit Yasukuni again.
zh: 但是，中曾根康弘沒有利用國內對中國批評的不滿，而是決定不再參拜靖國神社。

en: He chose to mend relations with China by focusing on the positive aspects of bilateral ties.
zh: 他選擇修復與中國的關係，重點關注雙邊聯絡中積極的方面。

en: In 1986, Nakasone went to Beijing at the personal invitation of Chinese Communist Party General Secretary Hu Yaobang and laid the cornerstone for a Sino-Japanese Youth Exchange Center, promising to forge future friendships with China.
zh: 1986年，中曾根康弘應中共總書記胡耀邦的個人邀請訪問北京，參加了中日青年交流中心的奠基活動，承諾培育與中國面向未來的友好關係。

en: This genuine embrace of reconciliation provided much-needed support to Chinese leaders, who were eager to control anti-Japanese sentiments.
zh: 這種真誠的擁抱和解為中國領導人提供了急需的支援，他們正急於控制國內的反日情緒。

en: Hu praised Nakasone’s courage and warned Chinese youth publicly that if they “think merely of the well-being of their own country… they are not sober-minded patriots.”
zh: 胡耀邦讚揚了中曾根康弘的勇氣並公開警告中國年輕人如果他們“只考慮自己國家的利益，就不是頭腦冷靜的愛國者。 ”

en: Nakasone emerged from the crisis and was recognized as a capable statesman in managing Japan’s diplomacy with China.
zh: 中曾根康弘成功地擺脫了這場危機，作為一位政治家，被認為善於處理日本與中國的外交關係。

en: There was no accusation that Nakasone was “selling out” to Beijing.
zh: 沒有人指責中曾為了北京而“出賣國家 ” 。

en: Nor were his conservative, nationalist, and pro-American credentials damaged.
zh: 他的保守主義、民族主義和親美傾向的政治形象也沒有受到損害。

en: This episode suggests that Koizumi’s hardline position isn’t the only option.
zh: 這段插曲表明小泉的強硬立場並不是唯一的選擇。

en: A Japanese prime minister can be strong without exploiting domestic resentment against the country’s neighbors, and conservative, patriotic, and pro-American while forging a healthy working relationship with China.
zh: 日本首相可以是強勢首相而不必利用國內對鄰國的不滿情緒；可以在培育正常運轉的對中關係的同時保持保守、愛國和親美的立場。

en: Indeed, the cessation of Yasukuni visits would likely open the door to the long-overdue Sino-Japanese summit, which in turn might strengthen moderate voices in China seeking a future-oriented relationship with Japan.
zh: 實際上，停止參拜靖國神社很可能將開啟擱置已久的中日政府首腦會議的大門，這將加強中國溫和派的聲音，他們尋求發展面向未來的中日關係。

en: Unfortunately, Koizumi and his allies are not prepared to move forward on the Yasukuni issue.
zh: 不幸的是，小泉和他們的盟友不準備在靖國神社問題上更進一步。

en: As Foreign Minister Aso recently put it: “The more China voices [opposition], the more one feels like going there.
zh: 正如外相麻生太郎最近指出的那樣 ： “ 中國反對的聲音越強，日本人越覺得應該去參拜。

en: It’s just like when you’re told ‘Don't smoke cigarettes,’ it actually makes you want to smoke.”
zh: 這就好像當有人告訴你‘不要抽菸’時，實際上卻讓你更想抽菸。 ”

en: No one expects the current Japanese and Chinese leaders to embrace, as Nakasone and Hu did two decades ago, but it is a sad state of affairs when the leaders of neighboring giants pretend not to see each other at international forums.
zh: 沒有人期望日本和中國現在的領導人如中曾根康弘和胡耀邦二十年前那樣互相擁抱，但是相鄰兩個大國的領導人在國際會議上假裝互相沒看見這種情形令人悲哀。

en: If Nakasone, who now urges Koizumi to stop the Yasukuni pilgrimage, were to respond to Aso, he might simply extend the analogy: it is not in Japan’s national interest to continue to inhale Koizumi’s second-hand smoke.
zh: 如果現在規勸小泉根康弘停止參拜靖國神社的中曾來回答麻生太郎，他可以簡單地發揮一下這個類比：繼續吸小泉的二手菸不符合日本的國家利益。

en: Israel versus America versus Iran
zh: 以色列、美國和伊朗

en: TEL AVIV – Israel’s concern about the specter of a nuclear Iran has now degenerated into a crisis of confidence concerning the United States.
zh: 特拉維夫—以色列對有核伊朗這一幽靈的擔憂不欠已經變成了一場對美國的信心危機。

en: Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu has embarked on a campaign to force President Barack Obama to set a red line that Iran must not cross, lest it risk unleashing an American military response.
zh: 總理內塔尼亞胡在一次活動中強迫奧巴馬設定一條伊朗不得跨越的紅線，否則美國將採取軍事幹預。

en: Implicit threats of a unilateral Israeli attack, together with conspicuous meddling in the US presidential election campaign, have compounded Netanyahu’s effort to twist Obama’s arm.
zh: 暗示以色列將單方面採取軍事襲擊以及赤裸裸地干預美國大選，這些舉動表明內塔尼亞胡在和奧巴馬較勁。

en: The controversy between the two allies partly reflects their divergent timelines: for Israel, the red line is Iran’s imminent burial deep underground of its uranium-enrichment facilities; for the US, it is the start of a dedicated weapons program.
zh: 兩大盟友之間的爭議部分地反映了它們不同的當務之急：對以色列來說，紅線是伊朗馬上就要上馬的深層地下鈾濃縮設施；而對美國來說，最緊迫的問題是專門用於軍事目的的核設施。

en: But, equally important, the dispute underscores their different objectives.
zh: 但是，同樣重要的是，這一爭議體現了它們不同的目標。

en: For Israel, war with Iran is not about neutralizing an existential threat; it is about reasserting its regional status.
zh: 對以色列來說，和伊朗開戰並不是為了消滅一個已經存在的威脅，而是為了重建其地區地位。

en: Israel’s leaders see their country’s standing in the region being seriously threatened by the emergence of a hostile Islamist regime in Egypt; the possibility that a similarly hostile regime will eventually emerge in Syria; the fragility of traditionally friendly Jordan; and the dangerous boost that the regional Islamist awakening has given to Israel’s sworn enemies, Hamas and Hezbollah.
zh: 以色列領導人認為該國在中東地區的地位受到了嚴重威脅：埃及出現了敵對伊斯蘭政權而；敘利亞也有可能出現類似的敵對政權；傳統友邦約旦搖搖欲墜；以色列不共戴天的仇敵哈馬斯和黎巴嫩真主黨等地區伊斯蘭組織也因此大為振奮。

en: Both Netanyahu and Defense Minister Ehud Barak thus regard an attack on Iran as a major strategic move aimed at the broader Middle East, which implies that they would not discount a military campaign that goes well beyond surgical air strikes.
zh: 因此，內塔尼亞胡和國防部長巴拉克均將伊朗視為意在大中東的戰略性動作，這是一種暗示：以色列不會憚於發動遠超外科手術式空襲規模的軍事行動。

en: Indeed, they probably contemplate land incursions into Iran, and possibly a decisive – and, from their perspective, long overdue – showdown with Hamas in Gaza and Hezbollah in Lebanon.
zh: 事實上，他們可能已經在考慮從陸上突入伊朗，並（這方面或許已經謀劃已久了）對加沙地區的哈馬斯和黎巴嫩真主黨予以決定性打擊。

en: Though determined to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, even if doing so requires military action, the US weighs the consequences of a military showdown in very different terms.
zh: 美國不會接受伊朗擁有核武器，即使為此採取軍事行動也在所不惜。 儘管如此，美國對軍事行動後果的評估與以色列大不相同。

en: A superpower that has earned only frustration in its abortive efforts – whether war or regional diplomacy – in the dysfunctional Middle East, the US faces the Iran crisis in the midst of its epochal strategic shift to Asia and the Pacific.
zh: 作為一個超級大國，美國在癱瘓的中東所做的一系列動作都沒有取得成功（不管是戰爭還是地區外交 ） ， 伊朗危機又發生在其欲進行將重點移到亞太地區的劃時代的戰略大轉移的當口。

en: The fallout from a war in Iran would pin down the US in the Middle East for years to come, undermining its new strategic priorities.
zh: 與伊朗開戰的不良影響將在多年內對美國的中東地位造成危險，破壞其新的戰略要務。

en: As a result, the US, though certainly better equipped than Israel for a war to ensure that Iran forever abandons its nuclear ambitions, could nonetheless conclude that that objective is simply too costly.
zh: 因此，儘管對於讓伊朗永久放棄核野心方面，美國顯然比以色列有更好的條件發動戰爭，但美國極有可能認為這一目標實在成本太高。

en: The recent report by The Iran Project, whose signatories include the former US national security advisers Brent Scowcroft and Zbigniew Brzezinski, concluded that an American military attack on Iran could only delay its nuclear program for up to four years.
zh: 最新的伊朗報告（Iran Project，署名作者包括前美國國家安全顧問斯考克羅夫特和布熱津斯基）指出，美國對伊朗的軍事打擊最多隻能將後者的和程序延緩四年。

en: To guarantee that Iran never acquires a nuclear bomb, the US would need to maintain military pressure on Iran for several years.
zh: 為了保證伊朗永遠不會有核彈，美國需要在多年內保持對伊朗的軍事壓力。

en: And, if forced to impose regime change as the ultimate solution to the dilemma, the report assumes that this would require military occupation, which would entail a commitment of resources and personnel greater than what the US invested in the Iraq and Afghanistan wars combined.
zh: 伊��報告說，如果最終必須靠推翻政權來解決這一難題，那麼就需要採取軍事佔領，而軍事佔領伊朗所需要的資源和人力比伊拉克和阿富汗兩場戰爭的總和還要多。

en: Moreover, the conventional assumption that the region’s Sunni Arab regimes would give tacit approval to a military attack on Iran’s nuclear installations must be revisited in the wake of the Arab Spring – particularly in the aftermath of the recent, sudden upsurge in anti-American violence throughout the Muslim world.
zh: 此外，在阿拉伯之春爆發後，傳統智慧 — — 中東地區的遜尼派阿拉伯國家必然會預設對伊朗核設施的軍事打擊 — — 必須重新評估了，特別是在最近突然爆發的席捲穆斯林世界的反美暴力風潮之後。

en: The pre-Arab Spring paradigm that framed the Middle East as being divided between “moderates” and “extremists” has become obsolete.
zh: 前阿拉伯之春時代的正規化 — — 中的你可以分為“溫和”和“極端”兩大陣營 — — 已是老黃曆了。

en: The Islamist governments that have emerged from the downfall of America’s puppet regimes are no friends of an Iranian nuclear empire.
zh: 趁美國傀儡政權倒臺而出現的伊斯蘭政府並不是伊朗核帝國的盟友。

en: But, in their struggle to survive, they must channel popular anti-Americanism.
zh: 但是，在生存鬥爭中，它們必須疏導流行的反美主義。

en: For Egyptian President Mohamed Morsi, that imperative meant placating the angry mob that recently attacked the US embassy rather than merely condemning the violence.
zh: 對埃及總統穆爾西來說，這一要求意味著必須對最近襲擊美國大使館的暴徒進行安撫，而不僅僅是譴責暴力。

en: An attack on Iran, especially if it develops into a longer war involving regional proxies, is bound to become the trigger for mass anti-Israel and anti-US hysteria, which might draw the Islamist regimes in the region into a dynamic of escalation.
zh: 襲擊伊朗，特別是如果這發展為涉及地區代理的長期戰爭，註定會演變為出發反以和反美狂潮的扳機，將該地區的伊斯蘭政權成為燎原之勢。

en: It would be impossible to rule out a regional war.
zh: 這樣一來，地區戰爭就不可避免了。

en: The main problem facing a military operation in Iran is the need to ensure its legitimacy.
zh: 對伊朗採取軍事行動的一個主要問題是必須保證這麼做的合法性。

en: China and Russia would never allow the US to secure a United Nations mandate for an attack.
zh: 中國和俄羅斯絕不會讓美國促使聯合國透過軍事打擊的決議。

en: Moreover, while Iranian provocations that clearly reveal the regime’s intentions to develop a nuclear-weapons capability might help build support for American military action, it is far from certain that Europeans, or others, would rush to join another US-led “coalition of the willing.”
zh: 此外，儘管伊朗的挑釁行為明白無誤地揭露了其發展核武器的意圖，這有助於培養對美國軍事行動的支援，但歐洲和其他地區會不會爭相加入另一場美國領導的“自願聯盟”還遠未可知。

en: The dire legacy of Iraq and Afghanistan weighs heavily on the Western democracies.
zh: 伊拉克和阿富汗戰爭的可怕結局將對西方民主國家造成重大影響。

en: The saddest part of the story is Israel’s utter indifference to the need to build international legitimacy for its drive to stop Iran’s nuclear program.
zh: 最悲觀的部分在於以色列在為阻止以色列核計劃的行動營造國際合法性方面具有完全不同的需求。

en: Netanyahu thinks in bold military terms, not in terms of geopolitical strategy.
zh: 內塔尼亞胡認為應該採取斷然軍事手段，而不是地緣政治戰略博弈。

en: His careless Palestine policy has left Israel with few friends in the international community, let alone in the Arab Middle East.
zh: 他的魯莽巴勒斯坦政策已經讓以色列在國際社會中失去了所有朋友，更不用說阿拉伯中東地區的友邦了。

en: Indeed, many regard Netanyahu’s Iran obsession as nothing more than a successful ploy to divert attention from the Palestinian issue.
zh: 事實上，許多人認為，內塔尼亞胡在伊朗問題上糾纏不休無非是成功將注意力從巴勒斯坦問題上轉移的伎倆。

en: Only a generous, bold peace initiative that would genuinely revive the two-state solution, accompanied by a freeze on construction and enlargement of West Bank settlements, would help to recover the good will of the Palestinians and their brethren throughout the Arab world.
zh: 只有真正可以修補兩國關係的寬宏、果斷的和平計劃，並輔之以停止約旦河西岸定居點的建設和擴充套件，才能夠重新贏得巴勒斯坦人民及其阿拉伯世界同胞的好感。

en: And only that outcome can secure the international goodwill that both Israel and the US will need for a showdown with Iran.
zh: 而只有贏得了阿拉伯世界的好感，才能保證國際社會肯定以色列和美國遏制伊朗的意圖。

en: A Human Rights Crime In Gaza
zh: 加沙的人權犯罪

en: Atlanta -- The world is witnessing a terrible human rights crime in Gaza, where a million and a half human beings are being imprisoned with almost no access to the outside world by sea, air, or land. An entire population is being brutally punished.
zh: 亞特蘭大-世界正在見證著發生在加沙的一場嚴重的人道犯罪，在那裡有大約150萬人被囚禁在幾乎與世界斷絕聯絡的地方，無論是從海上、空中或者陸路都很難進入這個地方。 裡面所有的人都在承受著殘酷的懲罰。

en: This gross mistreatment of the Palestinians in Gaza was escalated dramatically by Israel, with United States backing, after political candidates representing Hamas won a majority of seats in the Palestinian Authority parliament in 2006. The election was unanimously judged to be honest and fair by all international observers.
zh: 在2006年代表哈馬斯的政治候選人贏得巴勒斯坦議會的大多數席位後，以色列在美國的支援下對加沙的巴勒斯坦人這種不加區分的虐待更加變本加厲了，儘管這次選舉被所有的國際觀察員一致認為是誠實和公正的。

en: Israel and the US refused to accept the right of Palestinians to form a unity government with Hamas and Fatah and now, after internal strife, Hamas alone controls Gaza.  Forty-one of the 43 victorious Hamas candidates who lived in the West Bank are now imprisoned by Israel, plus an additional ten who assumed positions in the short-lived coalition cabinet.
zh: 以色列和美國拒絕接受巴勒斯坦人組成哈馬斯和法塔赫的聯合政府的權利；而現在，在一場內戰後，哈馬斯獨自控制了加沙。 在生活在西岸的43個獲勝的哈馬斯候選人中有41個現在被以色列監禁著，此外以色列還監禁了10名曾在短命的聯合政府中任職的哈馬斯派別的人。

en: Regardless of one’s choice in the partisan struggle between Fatah and Hamas within occupied Palestine, we must remember that economic sanctions and restrictions in delivering water, food, electricity, and fuel are causing extreme hardship among the innocent people in Gaza, about one million of whom are refugees.
zh: 不管對巴勒斯坦被佔領土上法塔赫與哈馬斯之間的黨派鬥爭支援哪一方，我們必須記住的是經濟制裁以及限制供應水、食品、電力和燃料正在給生活在加沙的無辜的民眾的生活造成極度的困難，其中有大約100萬人是難民。

en: Israeli bombs and missiles periodically strike the encapsulated area, causing high casualties among both militants and innocent women and children.
zh: 以色列對這個被圍困的地區不時的轟炸以及發射的火箭彈給那裡的武裝人員和無辜的婦女兒童都造成了巨大的傷亡。

en: Prior to the highly publicized killing of a woman and her four little children last week, this pattern was illustrated by a previous report from B’Tselem, the leading Israeli human rights organization: 106 Palestinians were killed between February 27 and March 3. Fifty-four of them were civilians who didn't take part in the fighting, and 25 were under 18 years of age.
zh: 在上週發生的一名婦女和她的四個孩子被炸死的事件被廣為曝光前，這樣的事情實際上之前已經被B’Tselem（被佔領土人權狀況以色列資訊中心）的一份報告描述過了：在2月27日至3月3日期間，有106位巴勒斯坦人被殺害，其中54人是從未參加過任何武裝鬥爭的平民，25人未滿18歲。

en: On a recent trip through the Middle East, I attempted to gain a better understanding of the crisis.
zh: 在我最近對中東地區的穿梭訪問中，我試圖對這場危機有更好的理解。

en: One of my visits was to Sderot, a community of about 20,000 in southern Israel that is frequently struck by rudimentary rockets fired from nearby Gaza.
zh: 其間我訪問了斯德羅社群，這是一個位於以色列南部、大約有20000人口的社群，經常遭到來自臨近的加沙的那些劣質火箭彈的襲擊。

en: I condemned these attacks as abominable and an act of terrorism, since most of the thirteen victims during the past seven years have been non-combatants.
zh: 我譴責這些襲擊為可惡和恐怖行為，因為過去七年間的13位犧牲者大多數是非武裝人員。

en: Subsequently, I met with leaders of Hamas, both a delegation from Gaza and the top officials in Damascus, Syria.
zh: 隨後我會晤了哈馬斯的領導人，有來自加沙的代表團以及來自敘利亞大馬士革的高階官員。

en: I made the same condemnation to them, and urged that they declare a unilateral ceasefire or orchestrate with Israel a mutual agreement to terminate all military action in and around Gaza for an extended period.
zh: 我再次譴責了他們的襲擊行為，並且敦促他們宣佈單邊停火或者與以色列共同達成協議在相當長的一段時間內停止加沙內外的所有軍事行動。

en: They responded that such previous action by them had not been reciprocated, and they reminded me that Hamas had previously insisted on a ceasefire throughout Palestine including both Gaza and the West Bank, which Israel had refused.
zh: 他們回答說他們以前曾經採取過這樣的行動，但是沒有得到響應。 他們還提醒我說哈馬斯此前曾堅持在包括加沙和西岸的整個巴勒斯坦地區實現停火，但是被以色列拒絕了。

en: Hamas then made a public proposal of a mutual ceasefire restricted to Gaza, which the Israelis considered and also rejected.
zh: 後來哈馬斯公開提出雙方只在加沙地區實現停火，對此以色列表示願意考慮，但最後還是拒絕了。

en: There are fervent arguments heard on both sides concerning blame for a lack of peace in the Holy Land.
zh: 雙方內部對於無法在聖地實現和平都充滿著激烈的爭論。

en: Israel has occupied and colonized the Palestinian West Bank, which is approximately one-fourth (28.5%) the size of the nation of Israel as recognized by the international community.
zh: 以色列已經佔領並且殖民化了巴勒斯坦的西岸地區，其面積大約相當於以色列被國際社會認可的國土面積的四分之一（28.5 % ） 。

en: Some Israeli religious factions claim a right to the land on both sides of the Jordan River, and others aver that their 205 settlements with some 500,000 people are necessary for “security.”
zh: 一些以色列的宗教派別宣稱以色列對約旦河兩岸的土地都擁有權利，還有一些人堅稱他們居住著大約50萬人口的205個定居點需要“安全 ” 。

en: All Arab nations have agreed to full recognition of Israel if it will comply with key United Nations resolutions.
zh: 所有的阿拉伯國家都同意如果以色列願意遵守主要的聯合國決議，它們就將完全承認以色列。

en: Hamas has agreed to accept any negotiated peace settlement between Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas and Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert, provided it is approved in a referendum among the Palestinian people.
zh: 哈馬斯已經同意接受巴勒斯坦民族權利機構主席阿巴斯與以色列總理奧爾默特之間達成的任何和平協議，只要它能夠被巴勒斯坦全民公決透過。

en: This holds promise of progress, but despite the brief fanfare and positive statements at the peace conference last November in Annapolis, Maryland, a retrogression has occurred in the process.
zh: 這讓我們看到了取得進展的希望，但是儘管去年11月份在馬里蘭州的安那波利斯和平會議上發表了令人鼓舞宣言，和平程序還是出現了倒退。

en: Nine thousand new Israeli settlement housing units have been announced in Palestine, the number of roadblocks within the West bank has increased, and the stranglehold on Gaza has been tightened.
zh: 以色列宣佈將在巴勒斯坦建設9000套新的居住單元，設在西岸地區的路障數量還在增加，而對加沙的壓制則更緊了。

en: It is one thing for other leaders to defer to the US on the crucial peace negotiations, but the world must not stand idle while innocent people are treated cruelly.
zh: 其他國家的領導人遵從美國在至關重要的和平談��上的地位是一回事，但是另一方面當無辜的民眾受到殘酷的虐待時世界絕不能袖手旁觀。

en: It is time for strong voices in Europe, the US, Israel, and elsewhere to speak out and condemn this human rights tragedy among the Palestinian people.
zh: 現在是歐洲、美國、以色列和其他地區發出強烈的聲音，齊聲譴責發生在巴勒斯坦人民身上的這場人權悲劇的時候了。

en: A Hundred Years of Superconductivity
zh: 超導百年

en: CHICAGO – The world’s first “quantum” computer – a machine that harnesses the magic of quantum phenomena to perform memory and processing tasks incredibly faster than today’s silicon-based computer chips – was recently sold by D-Wave Systems of Canada to Lockheed-Martin.
zh: 發自芝加哥 — — 世界首臺“量子”計算機 — — 一臺利用量子現象的魔力來構成記憶體且任務執行速度遠遠高於當前使用的矽晶片的機器 — — 最近由加拿大的D-Wave系統公司出售給洛克希德-馬丁公司。

en: And, while some question whether the machine is truly a quantum computer, its designers have published articles in peer-reviewed journals demonstrating that the basic elements of this novel computer are indeed superconducting quantum bits.
zh: 與此同時，當人們開始質疑這臺量子計算機的真偽時，其設計者在權威專業雜誌上發表文章，闡述了構成這臺嶄新計算機的基本元素其實就是超導的量子位。

en: This spring marked the 100th anniversary of the discovery of superconductivity – the ability of materials to carry electrical current with no loss.
zh: 此舉也成為了超導現象100週年紀念的標誌性事件。 所謂超導，就是物質攜帶電流卻不造成損失的能力。

en: Currents set up in superconducting wires can exist for years without any measurable decay.
zh: 超導線中的電流可以存在數年都不出現可測量的衰減。

en: Because of this property, superconductors have unique features that can be exploited in many ways.
zh: 這種特性使得超導體擁有了可供多方面利用的獨有特徵。

en: They can carry enormous amounts of current, making them ideal for urban power grids. And, when wound into coils, they can produce extremely strong magnetic fields.
zh: 它們可以攜帶巨量電流，非常適用於城市電網，而被捲成線圈時又能製造出極其強大的磁場。

en: Such superconducting magnets have been applied in a variety of technologies.
zh: 這些超導磁體被應用到一系列技術當中。

en: The best-known examples are the magnets that drive the magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) machines found in most hospitals.
zh: 最廣為人知的就是驅動醫院磁共振成像系統（MRI）的磁體。

en: Perhaps the most exotic are the huge magnets used to accelerate particles in the Large Hadron Collider, which seeks to discover the fundamental principles of matter.
zh: 最鮮為人知的或許是歐洲大型強子對撞機中用於加速粒子的巨型磁體，而該裝置則被利用來探索物質的基本原理。

en: Despite their great promise, however, superconductors have limits, the primary one being that most superconduct at very low temperatures – indeed, near absolute zero (-273 ºC).
zh: 雖然擁有巨大的前景，但超導體也存在自身的限制，其中最主要的一點就是大多數超導現象只有在極低溫環境下才能實現 — — 事實上就是接近絕對零度 （ - 273攝氏度 ） 。

en: Such temperatures can be achieved only through liquid-helium cooling.
zh: 而這種溫度只能透過液氦冷卻來實現。

en: Thus, Swiss researchers caused excitement in 1986 by announcing the discovery of superconductivity in an oxide of copper at twice the temperature of the previous record holder.
zh: 因此當瑞士研究人員在1986年宣佈發現了一種可以在比前紀錄保持者高一倍的溫度下實現超導的銅氧化物時，全世界都為之一振。

en: Shortly thereafter, researchers in the United States found a related material that superconducts above the temperature at which air liquefies.
zh: 不久之後美國研究人員也發現了一種可以在高於氣體液化溫度的情況下實現超導的相關物質。

en: As Time magazine proclaimed in May 1987, with the discovery of these so-called “cuprates,” the superconducting revolution had begun.
zh: 正如《時代》雜誌在1987年5月正式宣佈的那樣，隨著這類名為“高溫超導銅氧化物”的發現，我們已經迎來了超導的革命。

en: Alas, the revolution soon bogged down.
zh: 無奈這場革命卻很快陷入了低潮。

en: Cuprates are notoriously difficult materials to work with, because they are very brittle.
zh: 這類銅化合物非常難以使用，因為它們極為易碎。

en: This is exacerbated by their strong anisotropy – the materials have a quasi-two-dimensional structure consisting of a weakly coupled stack of conducting sheets. As such, they are a challenge for industry, though applications are beginning to appear.
zh: 更糟糕的則是它們本身強烈的各向異性 — — 這種材料擁有一個由大量互相弱連結的導電薄層所組成的準二維結構，因此雖然不斷得到應用，對工業界來說也極富技術難度。

en: Since the cuprates first appeared, a variety of other “high temperature” superconductors have been discovered – one is a simple compound of magnesium and boron, and another involves a mixture of iron and arsenic.
zh: 在高溫超導銅氧化物發現之後，科學界也發現了一系列其他型別的“高溫”超導體 — — 其中一種是鎂和硼的簡單化合物，另一種則是鐵和砷的混合物。

en: Although none of them superconduct at temperatures as high as liquid air, they may ultimately be better materials with which to work.
zh: 雖然這些材料都未能在高於氣體液化溫度的情況下實現超導，但他們可能會最終成為可供應用的更佳材料。

en: Given the vast number of combinations of elements that can form compounds, there is a good chance that better superconductors await our discovery.
zh: 考慮到不同元素間可以組合出成千上萬種化合物，因此更好的超導材料很可能就在不遠處。

en: In the coming years, superconductors are expected to play a growing role in technology.
zh: 超導體預計將在未來科技中扮演日漸重要的角色。

en: Already, “second generation” cuprate wires are being used to make high-capacity cables for electric-power transmission, and lighter-weight generators for wind turbines.
zh: “第二代”高位超導銅氧化物導線已經被用於製造利於電力傳輸的高能電纜以及風力渦輪的更輕量發電機。

en: Stronger superconducting magnets are leading to the development of MRIs with more sophisticated diagnostic capabilities.
zh: 強超導磁體推動下的MRI技術發展使得醫學診斷更加精確。

en: Superconductors are being used for levitated trains in high-speed rail transport, and as microwave filters for improved signal bandwidth in cellular base stations.
zh: 超導體被運用於高速懸浮列車，還可以製成微波過濾器來提高蜂窩電信基站的訊號頻寬。

en: The discovery of a new superconductor with enhanced properties could lead to even greater technological innovation.
zh: 一個擁有更優秀特性的新超導體的發現可能會帶來更重大的技術革新。

en: This brings us to the intellectual challenge of superconductors.
zh: 這是我們所面臨的關於超導體智力挑戰。

en: It took 46 years from the discovery of superconductivity to the 1957 Bardeen, Cooper, and Schrieffer (BCS) theory of how the phenomenon occurs.
zh: 從發現超導現象到1957年巴丁-庫珀-施裡弗（BCS）關於該現象如何產生的理論發表足足用了46年。

en: Along the way, a number of famous physicists tried and failed to get the answer – Albert Einstein, Werner Heisenberg, and Richard Feynman being notable examples.
zh: 沿著這條道路，一大批著名物理學家前赴後繼地追尋這個答案 — — 愛因斯坦，沃納·海森堡和理查德·費曼則是他們的傑出代表。

en: Discovering the solution required the development of advanced theoretical techniques.
zh: 解開這個難題需要依靠先進理論工具的發展。

en: What had been difficult to figure out was how to get electrons to superconduct.
zh: 其中較為困難的則是如何使電子顯示超導性。

en: The basic discovery of BCS was that if the electrons pair up, those couples could indeed superconduct.
zh: 巴丁-庫珀-施裡弗理論的基本發現則是如果電子能兩兩配對，那麼這些電子對就能實現超導。

en: Fortunately, the mechanism for such coupling was known.
zh: 幸運的是，這種配對的機制已經被發現了。

en: Although electrons are negatively charged, and therefore repel one another, the positive ions that they leave behind when they flow through a metal can mediate an effective attraction between two electrons under restrictive conditions (for example, the metal must be very cold).
zh: 雖然電子都是帶負電並互相排斥的，但它們穿過金屬時所拋棄的正離子可以在某種限制性條件下（比如冷卻該金屬）成為兩個電子互相吸引的有效媒介。

en: The suspicion, though, is that this is not the case in the new superconductors.
zh: 但也有人認為這不會是新超導體的特性。

en: Cuprates superconduct at much higher temperatures, but, more importantly, they possess some exotic properties: they are formed by doping electrical carriers into a host material that is a magnetic insulator – the last place one would look for a conventional superconductor.
zh: 高溫超導銅氧化物能在更高的溫度下實現超導，但更重要的是它們擁有一種吸引人��特性：它們是由將電載流子摻入基質材料而形成的 — — 該材料是一種磁性絕緣體，也是研究者們最沒想到可能實現常規超導體的地方。

en: And, unlike BCS theory, in which the pairs are isotropic – with identical properties in all directions in space – the pairs in cuprates are strongly anisotropic, resembling a cloverleaf.
zh: 跟巴丁-庫珀-施裡弗理論中電子對都是等方性的（即空間中所有方向都具有同樣特性）不同的是，高溫超導銅氧化物的電子對是強烈各向異性的，類似一個四面立體交叉的結構。

en: How can one pair electrons without ions holding them together, thereby enabling higher-temperature superconductors?
zh: 如何能在缺少離子的情況下讓電子對互相連結在一起，並以此實現高溫超導體？

en: While ideas about this abound, new theoretical breakthroughs most likely will be needed to develop the machinery required to solve such electron-electron theories, perhaps even involving black holes.
zh: 當關於這點的理論設想層出不窮之時，必須在解釋這類電子-電子理論的體系（甚至包括黑洞）上取得新的理論突破。

en: Whatever the theory turns out to be, it is certain to revolutionize physics.
zh: 但無論這一理論將如何發展，它都註定將催生物理學的革命。

en: Lies, Damned Lies, and AI
zh: 謊言、該死的謊言和人工智慧

en: CAMBRIDGE – Algorithms are as biased as the data they feed on.
zh: 劍橋 — — 演算法和演算法所依賴的資料一樣帶有偏見。

en: And all data are biased.
zh: 而且一切資料都是帶有偏見的。

en: Even “official” statistics cannot be assumed to stand for objective, eternal “facts.”
zh: 即使是“官方”統計資料也不能被認定代表客觀永恆的“事實 ” 。

en: The figures that governments publish represent society as it is now, through the lens of what those assembling the data consider to be relevant and important.
zh: 政府釋出的數字代表著當前的社會狀況，在那些蒐集資料的人看來代表著重要性和相關性。

en: The categories and classifications used to make sense of the data are not neutral.
zh: 被用於理解資料的範疇和分類並不是中立的。

en: Just as we measure what we see, so we tend to see only what we measure.
zh: 就像我們只衡量我們所看到的那樣，我們往往會對衡量範疇以外的東西視而不見。

en: As algorithmic decision-making spreads to a wider range of policymaking areas, it is shedding a harsh light on the social biases that once lurked in the shadows of the data we collect.
zh: 就像演算法決策擴散到更大範圍的決策領域一樣，它正在刺眼地暴露出曾經藏在我們蒐集資料陰影中的社會偏見。

en: By taking existing structures and processes to their logical extremes, artificial intelligence (AI) is forcing us to confront the kind of society we have created.
zh: 透過將現有結構和流程納入其邏輯極值，人工智慧（AI）正迫使我們正視我們所創造的社會。

en: The problem is not just that computers are designed to think like corporations, as my University of Cambridge colleague Jonnie Penn has argued. It is also that computers think like economists.
zh: 問題不僅在於我在劍橋大學的同事詹妮·潘所提出的，設計計算機的初衷是讓它像企業一樣思考，而是計算機也在模仿經濟學家的思考方式。

en: An AI, after all, is as infallible a version of homo economicus as one can imagine.
zh: 畢竟，人工智慧是人類想象範圍內從不出錯的經濟人。

en: It is a rationally calculating, logically consistent, ends-oriented agent capable of achieving its desired outcomes with finite computational resources.
zh: 它是一種能夠合理計算、邏輯連貫並以目標為中心的代理，能夠利用有限的計算資源實現其期望中的局面。

en: When it comes to “maximizing utility,” they are far more effective than any human.
zh: 如果說到“效用最大化 ” ， 它們的有效性超過任何人。

en: “Utility” is to economics what “phlogiston” once was to chemistry.
zh: “效用”之於經濟學就像是曾幾何時“燃素”之於化學一般。

en: Early chemists hypothesized that combustible matter contained a hidden element – phlogiston – that could explain why substances changed form when they burned.
zh: 早期的化學家們假設可燃物質含有一種隱蔽元素 — — 也就是燃素 — — 這就可以解釋物質為什麼在燃燒時會發生形式改變。

en: Yet, try as they might, scientists never could confirm the hypothesis.
zh: 但儘管竭盡全力，這一假設卻永遠無法被科學家們證實。

en: They could not track down phlogiston for the same reason that economists today cannot offer a measure of actual utility.
zh: 化學家無法證明燃素的存在，同理今天的經濟學家也無法測量實際效用。

en: Economists use the concept of utility to explain why people make the choices they do – what to buy, where to invest, how hard to work: everyone is trying to maximize utility in accordance with one’s preferences and beliefs about the world, and within the limits posed by scarce income or resources.
zh: 經濟學家利用效用的概念來解釋人們作出選擇的原因 — — 買什麼、投資什麼，工作多努力：每個人都試圖根據自身關於世界的偏好和信念來實現效用最大化，同時也要受到收入和資源稀缺所帶來的侷限。

en: Despite not existing, utility is a powerful construct.
zh: 儘管並不存在，但效用卻是一種強勢結構。

en: It seems only natural to suppose that everyone is trying to do as well as they can for themselves.
zh: 人們似乎自然而然地認為，每個人都在盡一切可能為自己的利益打算。

en: Moreover, economists’ notion of utility is born of classical utilitarianism, which aims to secure the greatest amount of good for the greatest number of people.
zh: 此外，經濟學家的實用概念源於古典功利主義，而為最多人獲取最大的利益是古典功利主義的目標。

en: Like modern economists following in the footsteps of John Stuart Mill, most of those designing algorithms are utilitarians who believe that if a “good” is known, then it can be maximized.
zh: 正如現代經濟學家追隨約翰·斯圖爾特·密爾的腳步一樣，絕大多數演算法設計者都是功利主義者，他們相信如果知道有“好處 ” ， 那麼就可以將好處最大化。

en: But this assumption can produce troubling outcomes.
zh: 但這種假設可能造成的結果卻會令人不安。

en: For example, consider how algorithms are being used to decide whether prisoners are deserving of parole.
zh: 比如，假設使用演算法來決定囚犯是否應當獲得假釋。

en: An important 2017 study finds that algorithms far outperform humans in predicting recidivism rates, and could be used to reduce the “jailing rate” by more than 40% “with no increase in crime rates.”
zh: 2017年一項重要的研究發現，演算法在預測累犯率方面的成效遠遠高於人類，並且可以用來將“監禁率”降低40%以上，同時“並不導致犯罪率的增加 ” 。

en: In the United States, then, AIs could be used to reduce a prison population that is disproportionately black.
zh: 於是在美國，人工智慧可以被用於改變黑人監禁人口不成比例的狀況。

en: But what happens when AIs take over the parole process and African-Americans are still being jailed at a higher rate than whites?
zh: 但如果由人工智慧接管假釋程式後，非洲裔美國人的監禁比例仍然高於白人該怎麼辦？

en: Highly efficient algorithmic decision-making has brought such questions to the fore, forcing us to decide precisely which outcomes should be maximized.
zh: 高效的演算法決策令這些問題脫穎而出，並迫使我們準確地決定究竟應當最大化哪些結果。

en: Do we want merely to reduce the overall prison population, or should we also be concerned about fairness?
zh: 我們是單純地想要減少總體監禁人口，還是也應當對公平給予恰當的關注？

en: Whereas politics allows for fudges and compromises to disguise such tradeoffs, computer code requires clarity.
zh: 儘管政治可以允許迴避和妥協來隱藏這種權衡，但計算機程式碼卻必須清晰明瞭。

en: That demand for clarity is making it harder to ignore the structural sources of societal inequities.
zh: 這種對清晰的要求使得人們對社會不公平的結構性來源更加難以忽視。

en: In the age of AI, algorithms will force us to recognize how the outcomes of past social and political conflicts have been perpetuated into the present through our use of data.
zh: 在人工智慧時代，演算法將迫使我們清晰地認識過往社會和政治衝突的結果如何能夠透過我們對資料的利用而延續到現在。

en: Thanks to groups such as the AI Ethics Initiative and the Partnership on AI, a broader debate about the ethics of AI has begun to emerge.
zh: 多虧人工智慧道德倡議和人工智慧合作伙伴等團體，關於人工智慧道德更廣泛的討論已經開始出現。

en: But AI algorithms are of course just doing what they are coded to do.
zh: 但人工智慧演算法當然僅僅是按照編碼來工作。

en: The real issue extends beyond the use of algorithmic decision-making in corporate and political governance, and strikes at the ethical foundations of our societies.
zh: 真正的問題不僅僅限於企業和政治治理領域對演算法決策的運用，同時也在抨擊我們社會的道德基礎。

en: While we certainly need to debate the practical and philosophical tradeoffs of maximizing “utility” through AI, we also need to engage in self-reflection.
zh: 在我們當然要對透過人工智慧實現效用“最大化”所需的實踐和哲學權衡展開辯論的同時，我們也需要進行自我反思。

en: Algorithms are posing fundamental questions about how we have organized social, political, and economic relations to date.
zh: 演算法正在提出迄今為止我們如何組織社會、政治和經濟關係的根本性問題。

en: We now must decide if we really want to encode current social arrangements into the decision-making structures of the future.
zh: 我們現在必須決定，我們是否真的希望將現有的社會安排編入到未來的決策機制。

en: Given the political fracturing currently occurring around the world, this seems like a good moment to write a new script.
zh: 鑑於目前世界各國正在發生的政治分裂，這似乎是開啟全新篇章的最好時機。

en: A Better Global Framework to End AIDS
zh: 一個更好的消滅艾滋病全球框架

en: STOCKHOLM, GENEVA – This week, we celebrate the tremendous progress that has been made in the struggle against HIV and AIDS.
zh: 斯托克霍姆、日內瓦—本週，我們為對抗艾滋病方面所取得的進步而歡呼。

en: In many countries with strong health systems, HIV is no longer a death sentence, but a chronic condition.
zh: 在許多具備強有力的衛生體系的國家，艾滋病早已不再等同於死刑，而只是一種慢性病。

en: And Africa has reached a critical milestone: each year, there are now more Africans starting HIV treatment than being infected.
zh: 非洲也抵達了臨界點：如今，每年開始治療艾滋病的非洲人數量已經超過了被感染人數。

en: Still, even as we celebrate, we must also mourn the 1.1 million people who lost their lives to the disease this year.
zh: 但是，在我們歡呼的同時，仍然要為今年因為艾滋病而喪生的110萬人默哀。

en: HIV still infects 6,000 people every day, and AIDS remains a leading cause of death among children, adolescents, and women in Africa.
zh: 每一天都有6,000人感染艾滋病毒，艾滋病也仍然是非洲兒童、青少年和婦女的主要死因之一。

en: The movement against AIDS has inspired all of us to help the people who continue to be left behind, and to commit to ending AIDS once and for all.
zh: 打擊艾滋病運動激發我們所有人幫助落後人群，並致力於一勞永逸地消滅艾滋病。

en: Fortunately, we already have the know-how, resources, and, crucially, the political momentum to do this; and at the High-Level Meeting on Ending AIDS this year, United Nations member states made ambitious commitments that will put us on the fast track toward our goal.
zh: 幸運的是，我們已經具備了完成這一目標的知識、資源以及最重要的政治動力；在今年的消滅艾滋病高規格會議上，聯合國各成員國做出了雄心勃勃的承諾，這些承諾將讓我們走上實現目標的快車道。

en: What’s more, in September, Canada hosted a successful financing conference for the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria, which brought in almost $13 billion, replenishing the Global Fund for 2017-2019.
zh: 此外，9月加拿大舉辦了成功的遏制艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾全球基金融資會議，籌德近130億美元資金，足夠全球基金2017—2019年的用度。

en: Meanwhile, individual countries have increased their domestic investments, and international partners – big and small – have maintained their support, which is how we will reach the $26 billion needed for the global AIDS response in 2020.
zh: 與此同時，個別國家也增加了國內投資，而國際合作方 — — 不論大小 — — 也保持了支援，我們也因此能夠籌足2020年全球艾滋病應對計劃所需要的260億美元資金。

en: But funding parts of the global health system is not enough.
zh: 但為全球衛生體系籌資是不夠的。

en: The international community must take a more holistic view and reinforce a global-response architecture that features a clear division of labor and seamless cooperation among various stakeholders.
zh: 國際社會必須採取更加全面的視角，加強全球響應安排，這一安排必須對各利益相關方做出明確的分工和緊密的合作。

en: Ultimately, the goal of such a framework must be to support countries’ own health systems, by marshaling public and private actors at all levels in a given country, so that every facility – from the public hospital in the capital to the village clinic – is properly provisioned.
zh: 說到底，這一安排的目標必然是支援各國自身的衛生體系，方法是引導給定國家的各層次公共和私人行動方，以使所有設施 — — 從首都公立醫院到鄉村診所 — — 都有合適的準備。

en: Sweden is proud to continue its support for the Global Fund; at the replenishment conference in September, it pledged 2.5 billion krona ($271 million).
zh: 瑞典為一直支援全球基金而感到驕傲；在9月的籌資會議上，瑞典承諾出資25億克朗（2.71億美元 ） 。

en: The Global Fund is by far the largest multilateral source of financing for efforts to fight AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria; but just like the Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunization (now known as Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance), it is part of a global architecture, and relies on a range of partners to deliver aid effectively.
zh: 全球基金是目前規模最大的遏制艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾多邊融資源；但正如全球疫苗和免疫聯盟（目前稱為Gavi，或疫苗聯盟 ） ， 它只是更大的全球安排的一部分，依靠各合作方有效提供援助。

en: So, if country-level support for other global-health organizations – such as UNAIDS, the World Health Organization, and the UN Development Programme – dries up, continued progress in the fight against HIV and AIDS will be at risk.
zh: 因此，如果支援其他全球衛生組織 — — 如聯合國艾滋病規劃署、世界衛生組織和聯合國開發規劃署等 — — 的國家層面支援乾涸，就很難保持打擊艾滋病方面的進展。

en: Providing the necessary support will require donors to coordinate with one another, so that all parts of the existing architecture for managing global health issues are adequately funded.
zh: 提供必需的支援需要出資方彼此合作，以使全球衛生問題的當前安排的各個部分都能獲得充足的資金。

en: This will then ensure that all countries – and, more importantly, all people – receive the support they need.
zh: 這反過來將確保所有國家 — — 以及更重要的所有人民 — — 都能獲得需要的支援。

en: UNAIDS is setting a powerful example for international collaboration, by organizing partners around a common 2016-2021 Strategy to end AIDS.
zh: 聯合國艾滋病規劃署為國際合作樹立了強有力的榜樣，它組織各方為消滅艾滋病的2016-2021年戰略的共同目標而努力。

en: This unique and innovative partnership brings together 11 co-sponsoring UN agencies, each with diverse sector-specific expertise, and mobilizes various government stakeholders.
zh: 這一獨特的創新合作安排集合了11家聯合國機構共同出資，它們各自具備多樣化的具體部門的專業經驗，並動員各大全球利益相關方。

en: Partners include business, community, and faith leaders, as well as teachers, judges, members of law enforcement, parliamentarians, and many others outside the health sector whose actions nonetheless affect health outcomes.
zh: 合作方包括企業、社群和宗教領袖，也包括教師、法官、執法官員、議會議員和許多衛生部門之外但能夠影響到衛生結果的人士。

en: One of UNAIDS’ tasks is to encourage national governments to keep AIDS high on their public-health agendas, and to invest in joint efforts to end the disease.
zh: 聯合國艾滋病規劃署的任務之一是鼓勵國家政府將艾滋病列為公共衛生日程重點，並聯手投資於消滅這種疾病。

en: It is also the only organization with a mandate to set norms and standards for the global response to AIDS, which means that it plays a key role in the current international framework.
zh: 它是唯一一個擁有制定全球艾滋病應對措施規範與標準的權力的組織，這意味著它在目前的國際安排中起著關鍵性作用。

en: UNAIDS maintains a close partnership with the Global Fund.
zh: 聯合國艾滋病規劃署與全球基金保持著緊密合作。

en: It has a presence in more than 80 countries, and its regional teams provide technical support and strategic information, which helps the Global Fund direct its grants to the right programs, locations, and populations at sufficient scale.
zh: 它在80多個國家設有辦事處，其地區團隊可以提供技術支援和戰略性資訊，從而有助於全球基金將足夠規模的資金投向正確的專案、地區和人口。

en: Moreover, it helps to create the social, legal, and political conditions for people to use health services, not least by promoting gender equality and ensuring that populations at higher risk of contracting HIV do not face adverse discrimination.
zh: 此外，它還有助於為人們創造使用醫療服務的社會、法律和政治條件，手段包括但不限於促進性別平等和確保染艾滋病毒高危人群不會面臨歧視。

en: UNAIDS engages with civil society at all levels, by leveraging the international AIDS response to promote equality, dignity, and human rights around the world.
zh: 透過利用國際艾滋病應對計劃促進全世界的平等、尊嚴和人權，聯合國艾滋病規劃署與各個層面的公民社會進行合作。

en: As such, UNAIDS works to expand the political space for – and investment in – civil society.
zh: 在這些合作中，聯合國艾滋病規劃署致力於為公民社會擴大政治空間和投資。

en: Yet, despite its broad mandate and many functions, UNAIDS lacks adequate resources, which threatens past achievements and future programs alike, and poses a danger to people and communities that depend on the lifesaving support the organization helps facilitate.
zh: 但是，儘管聯合國艾滋病規劃署許可權廣泛，功能齊全，但它缺少足夠的資源，這威脅到以往的成就和未來專案，並給依賴該組織幫助提供便利的救命支援的人民和國家帶來風險。

en: Sweden and UNAIDS will work together to ensure that the international AIDS response continues to transform – and save – lives.
zh: 瑞典和聯合國艾滋病規劃署將攜手致力於確保國際艾滋病應對措施能夠繼續改變 — — 並拯救 — — 生命。

en: We will safeguard and empower women and girls, and make sure that vulnerable populations’ voices are heard.
zh: 我們將保護和賦權給婦女和女孩，確保脆弱人口的聲音得到聆聽。

en: But, at the same time, the international community must strengthen the existing framework for managing global-health issues.
zh: 但是，與此同時，國際社會必須強化管理全球衛生問題的現有框架。

en: As Swedish Prime Minister Stefan Löfven said in Montreal in September: “Today we are focusing on the Global Fund, but tomorrow let’s not forget to provide sufficient funding for the entire global health architecture.”
zh: 瑞典首相洛夫文9月在蒙特利爾表示 ， “ 今天我們關注全球基金，但願我們明天不要忘記為整個全球衛生安排提供充足的資金。

en: It is time for the international community to meet that challenge, by pledging to support our global health infrastructure, so that no agency – and no country or person – is left out.
zh: ”國際社會應該直面這一挑戰，承諾支援我們全球衛生基礎設施，所有機構 — — 以及所有國家和個人 — — 都要參與進來。

en: AIDS, NCDs, and the ABCs of Organizing
zh: 艾滋病、非傳染性疾病和組織學的“ABC”

en: GENEVA – Non-communicable diseases (NCDs), like heart disease, stroke, cancer, diabetes, and chronic lung disease, are responsible for 70% of all deaths.
zh: 日內瓦—非傳染性疾病（NCD ） ， 如心臟病、中風、癌症、糖尿病和慢性肺病等，造成了全部死亡案例的70 % 。

en: There is incontrovertible evidence that tobacco use, inactivity, unhealthy diets, and excessive alcohol consumption increase the odds of dying prematurely from an NCD.
zh: 無可反駁的證據證明，吸菸、不運動、不健康飲食和飲酒過度會增加因NCD而過早死亡的風險。

en: And yet, despite widespread knowledge of the risks, global obesity goes largely unchecked, while tobacco and alcohol use continue to rise.
zh: 但儘管這些風險早已眾所周知，全球肥胖率仍居高不下，而菸草和酒精消費量在不斷增加。

en: It is against this backdrop that networks of NCD alliances met December 9-11 at the second Global NCD Alliance Forum, in the United Arab Emirates.
zh: 在這一背景下，NCD聯盟網路於12月9—11日在阿聯酋召開了第二屆全球非傳染性疾病聯盟論壇。

en: As they search for solutions to bring NCDs under control, they should look for inspiration to the movement to fight AIDS.
zh: 在我們尋找控制NCD的方法的過程中，應該著眼於消滅艾滋病運動的經驗。

en: People living with and affected by HIV continue to drive response efforts, and their unique form of mobilization has been instrumental to progress.
zh: 攜帶艾滋病毒並受其影響的人不斷地推動著響應措施，而他們獨特的動員形式也有助於進步。

en: While the battle is not over, AIDS activists know that it can be won.
zh: 儘管革命尚未成功，但艾滋病活躍分子知道勝利一定屬於他們。

en: Similarly, a mobilized NCD movement can turn the tide against that epidemic.
zh: 類似地，動員起來的NCD運動能夠改變潮流。

en: Yet, in 2015, Richard Horton, the editor of The Lancet, described the NCD community as needing an “electric shock to its semi-comatose soul.”
zh: 但是 ， 《 柳葉刀》雜誌編輯理查德·霍頓（Richard Horton）在2015年將說NCD界需要“給你他們的半昏迷的靈魂來一次電擊。

en: He added: “But who has the courage to deliver it?”
zh: ”他還說 ， “ 但誰有興趣來擔當電擊者？ ”

en: We believe there are lessons to be learned from AIDS activists.
zh: 我們相信，艾滋病活動家的很多經驗可以借鑑。

en: As global attention focuses on NCD prevention, those seeking to control preventable illnesses should look to the “ABCs” of AIDS organizing for guidance.
zh: 隨著NCD的防治獲得全球關注，尋求控制可預防疾病的人應該借鑑艾滋病組織的“ABC ” 。

en: The first letter that the NCD community should consider is “A,” for activism.
zh: NCD界需要考慮的第一點是A，即活動（activism ） 。

en: Anyone over 40 will recall images of AIDS activists performing “die-ins” at scientific meetings around the world.
zh: 40歲以上的人都能想起艾滋病活躍分子在全球科學會議上的“裝死示威 ” 。

en: In the United States, AIDS activists took to the streets, even shutting down the Food and Drug Administration’s headquarters for a day in October 1988.
zh: 在美國，艾滋病活躍分子走上街頭，甚至在1988年10月的某日令食品和藥品監督局總部關門 。

en: Globally, activists lobbied governments and pharmaceutical companies to make medicines more affordable.
zh: 全球而言，活躍分子游說政府和製藥公司降低藥品價格。

en: This activism continues, and should serve as a model for action on NCDs.
zh: 這些活動還在繼續，並理應成為NCD活動的榜樣。

en: Next, the NCD community must adopt a bolder approach to budgets – the “B” of the AIDS movement’s strategy.
zh: 其次，NCD界必須果斷推進位制定預算（budget ） ， 即艾滋病運動戰略中的B。

en: Civic organizing and grassroots activism may fuel early energies, but organizing and sustaining a broad-based coalition takes money.
zh: 公民組織和草根活動或許能夠注入早期能量，但組織和維持廣大聯盟需要資金。

en: The AIDS movement was clear about this from the beginning, and lobbied for resources to support its advocacy and accountability effectively.
zh: 艾滋病運動從一開始就非常明確這一點，並有效地遊說資源以支援其主張和責任。

en: “C” is for coalitions: the AIDS movement was quick to understand that progress would come only with diverse support.
zh: C則是聯盟（coalition ） ： 艾滋病運動很快就認識到，只有獲得了多樣化的支援，才能取得進步。

en: Activists established links between people living with HIV and those with other concerns, such as women’s rights, intellectual property, nutrition, and housing.
zh: 活躍分子建立起艾滋病攜帶者和其他問題關注者（如女權、智慧財產權、營養和住房等）之間的聯絡。

en: Issue-specific coalitions and campaigns work best when they bring together government insiders and outsiders, to combine perspectives and expertise.
zh: 不同問題的聯盟和運動，如果能夠將政府內部人士和外部人士聯合起來，形成觀點和專業知識的合力，則能夠起到最大的效果。

en: The AIDS movement also understood that a holistic response to the epidemic was essential.
zh: 艾滋病運動還認識到，要讓支援得到推廣，對於這種傳染病必須採取整體響應措施。

en: Thus, “D,” the underlying determinants of health, was to draw attention to the interconnectivity of the drivers of challenge.
zh: 因此，D — — 成功的決定因素（determinant ） — —是要吸引對挑戰的聯動性的關注。

en: For example, lobbying education leaders to keep girls in school longer has contributed to providing young people with the knowledge and agency to make smart decisions about when and with whom to negotiate safe sex.
zh: 比如，遊說教育領袖讓女孩讀更長時間的書，從而幫助年輕人們獲得知識以做出關於何時和和誰談論安全性行為的明智的決定。

en: Similarly, links were forged between groups working on poverty, gender, and nutrition – factors that played a role in driving the AIDS crisis.
zh: 類似地，致力於貧困、性別和營養問題 — — 這些都是助推艾滋病危機的因素 — — 的相關組織之間也形成了聯絡。

en: NCDs are no less isolated in their causality, and similarly require a multi-sector approach to prevention.
zh: NCD的致病原因不是孤立的，同樣也要求多管齊下的預防之道。

en: Engagement – “E” – was what helped the AIDS movement become so influential.
zh: 參與（engagement ） — —E — — 給了艾滋病運動巨大的影響力。

en: By borrowing from the playbook of the disability rights movement, which championed the mantra “Nothing About Us Without Us,” AIDS advocates demanded representation on the bodies established to address the disease.
zh: 艾滋病運動支持者借鑑了殘疾人權利運動的策略，打出了“我們的事，我們都得參與”的口號，要求在解決疾病問題的機構中擁有自己的代表。

en: For example, UNAIDS remains the only United Nations agency with seats on its board for representatives from civil society.
zh: 比如，聯合國艾滋病規劃署仍然是唯一一個理事會中有來自公民社會代表的聯合國機構。

en: This norm is so powerfully embedded in the AIDS movement that it would be almost unthinkable for an AIDS meeting to take place without representation from the community.
zh: 這一正規化被強力嵌入在艾滋病運動中，沒有艾滋病攜帶者代表參與的艾滋病會議幾乎是不可想象的。

en: Disease prevention movements must also develop persuasive narratives, and “F” – framing the issue – was essential to the AIDS community’s effort to gain support from political leaders.
zh: 疾病預防運動還必須發展出有說服力的敘事，而F — — 界定（frame）問題 — — 是艾滋病界贏得政治領導人支援的關鍵。

en: In particular, access to AIDS treatment was framed as a matter of economic justice.
zh: 特別是，獲得艾滋病治療被界定為一個經濟正義的問題。

en: Framing the narrative this way led to a dramatic reduction in the price of medicines, so much so that more than half of people living with HIV in low- and middle-income countries are in treatment.
zh: 如此界定敘事令藥品價格大幅下降，讓一大半中低收入國家的艾滋病攜帶者能夠獲得治療。

en: An equally important framing issue for AIDS, which is highly relevant to the NCDs movement, is that of responsibility.
zh: 一個對艾滋病 — — 對NCD運動也是如此 — — 同樣重要的界定問題是責任。

en: The AIDS community worked hard to shift the focus from blaming individuals’ lifestyle choices to putting the onus on the state for providing health care and removing legal discrimination.
zh: 艾滋病界努力讓人們的關注焦點從譴責個人生活方式選擇轉移到要求國家擔負提供醫療和消除法律歧視上。

en: In the AIDS debate, gender – our movement’s “G” – was a significant focal point.
zh: 在艾滋病爭論中，性別（gender ） — —即我們的運動中的G — — 是一個重要焦點。

en: HIV was initially seen as a “gay disease,” and gender identity was embedded in the DNA of the AIDS movement early on.
zh: 艾滋病一開始被視為“同性戀病 ” ， 而性別身份從一開始就烙印在了艾滋病運動的DNA中。

en: Gender dimensions of NCDs are no less important; one only has to consider how alcohol and tobacco are marketed to understand that.
zh: NCD的性別問題也同樣重要；只要想想酒精和菸草的營銷手段便可瞭解這一點。

en: Gender, therefore, must become a focus of NCDs prevention efforts.
zh: 因此，性別應該成為NCD預防的重點。

en: Finally, “H” – human rights – was the bedrock of the AIDS response.
