zh: 最後，H — — 人權（human right ） — —是艾滋病響應機制的基石。

en: Campaigns were launched against discrimination in workplaces, schools, and health centers.
zh: 艾滋病活躍分子發動了反對職場、校園和醫院的歧視的運動。

en: Strategic litigation helped ensure equality under the law.
zh: 策略性訴訟幫助確保了法律面前人人平等。

en: The AIDS movement refused to hold major conferences in countries with punitive laws against people living with HIV.
zh: 艾滋病運動拒絕在對攜帶艾滋病毒的人實施懲罰性法律的國家召開大會。

en: The NCD movement could take a similar tack by, for example, refusing to meet in countries that fail to restrict advertising of junk food to children.
zh: NCD運動也應該採取同樣的策略，比如拒絕在不限制面向兒童的垃圾食品廣告的國家召開大會。

en: The list of AIDS lessons could continue throughout the alphabet, but ending with “H” is apt, given that human rights drove the response, and should drive the response to NCDs.
zh: 艾滋病運動的教訓可以寫全整個字母表，但在H結尾比較合適，因為人權推動了艾滋病響應機制，也應該推動NCD響應機制。

en: Poverty, exclusion, and social and economic marginalization put people at higher risk for HIV.
zh: 貧困、排斥以及社會和經濟邊緣化讓人們更容易感染艾滋病毒。

en: It is no different for NCDs.
zh: NCD也是如此。

en: The early mainstream reaction to the AIDS epidemic was to ask, “Why don’t those people make better choices?”
zh: 人們對艾滋病的早期主流反應是問“為什麼那些人沒有做出更好的選擇？

en: The AIDS movement made clear that that was the wrong question.
zh: ”艾滋病運動證明了這是一個錯誤的問題。

en: Today, with 70% of the planet at risk of premature death from preventable illnesses, “those people” are many of us.
zh: 今天，70%的地球人面臨因為可預防疾病而過早死亡的風險 ， “ 那些人”就是我們自己。

en: The NCD and AIDS communities can learn from one another.
zh: NCD和艾滋病界可以互相學習。

en: We are a stronger movement when we join forces.
zh: 當我們加入這股力量之中，就形成了一個更加強大的運動。

en: The views expressed here do not necessarily reflect those of UNAIDS.
zh: 本文不代表聯合國艾滋病規劃署觀點。

en: Aid Works
zh: 援助是有用的

en: NEW YORK – The critics of foreign aid are wrong.
zh: 紐約—對外部援助的批評是錯誤的。

en: A growing flood of data shows that death rates in many poor countries are falling sharply, and that aid-supported programs for health-care delivery have played a key role.
zh: 越來越多的資料表明，很多國家貧困人口的死亡率在迅速下降，衛生援助專案居功至偉。

en: Aid works; it saves lives.
zh: 援助是有用的，它能夠拯救生命。

en: One of the newest studies, by Gabriel Demombynes and Sofia Trommlerova, shows that Kenya’s infant mortality (deaths under the age of one year) has plummeted in recent years, and attributes a significant part of the gain to the massive uptake of anti-malaria bed nets.
zh: 德莫姆比尼斯（Gabriel Demombynes）和特羅穆勒洛瓦（Sofia Trommlerova）的最新研究表明，近幾年來，肯亞嬰兒（1歲以下）死亡率顯著下降，其中很大一部分原因在於防瘧疾床帳的大規模使用。

en: These findings are consistent with an important study of malaria death rates by Chris Murray and others, which similarly found a significant and rapid decline in malaria-caused deaths after 2004 in sub-Saharan Africa resulting from aid-supported malaria-control measures.
zh: 這一發現與穆雷（Chris Murray）關於瘧疾死亡率的重要研究是是一致的，穆雷發現，2004年以後，非洲撒哈拉以南地區的瘧疾致死率出現了顯著而快速的下降，其原因在於外部援助所支援的瘧疾控制措施。

en: Let’s turn back the clock a dozen years.
zh: 讓我們從12年前開始。

en: In 2000, Africa was struggling with three major epidemics.
zh: 2000年，非洲飽受三大傳染病的肆虐。

en: AIDS was killing more than two million people each year, and spreading rapidly.
zh: 艾滋病每年奪走200萬以上生命，並在快速蔓延。

en: Malaria was surging, owing to the parasite’s growing resistance to the standard medicine at the time.
zh: 由於寄生蟲對傳統藥物的抗藥性越來越強，瘧疾出現了大爆發。

en: Tuberculosis was also soaring, partly as a result of the AIDS epidemic and partly because of the emergence of drug-resistant TB.
zh: 結核病也在肆虐，一部分是由於艾滋病所致，一部分是因為具有抗藥性的結核病的出現。

en: In addition, hundreds of thousands of women were dying in childbirth each year, because they had no access to safe deliveries in a clinic or hospital, or to emergency help when needed.
zh: 此外，每年有數十萬婦女在分娩時喪命，因為她們無法在安全的診所和醫院中生產，也得不到所需的緊急救援。

en: These interconnected crises prompted action.
zh: 這些危機刺激了行動。

en: The United Nations’ member states adopted the Millennium Development Goals in September 2000.
zh: 聯合國各成員國在2000年9月透過了千年發展目標（MDG ） 。

en: Three of the eight MDGs – reductions in children’s deaths, maternal deaths, and epidemic diseases – focus directly on health.
zh: 在MDG的八大目標中，有三個直接關注衛生狀況，即減少兒童夭折、難產致死和傳染病致死。

en: Likewise, the World Health Organization issued a major call to scale up development assistance for health.
zh: 類似地，世界衛生組織也大力呼籲加大衛生髮展援助力度。

en: And African leaders, led by Nigeria’s president at the time, Olusegun Obasanjo, took on the challenge of battling the continent’s epidemics.
zh: 以時任奈及利亞總統奧巴桑喬為首的非洲領導人接受了與非洲大陸傳染病作戰的重任。

en: Nigeria hosted two landmark summits, on malaria in 2000 and on AIDS in 2001, which were a crucial spur to action.
zh: 奈及利亞舉辦了兩次標誌性峰會，即2000年的瘧疾峰會和2001年的艾滋病峰會，這兩次峰會在促進採取行動方面居功至偉。

en: At the second of these summits, then-UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan called for the creation of the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria.
zh: 在第二個峰會中，時任聯合國秘書長安南呼籲建立全球抵抗艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾基金（Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria ） 。

en: The Global Fund began operations in 2002, financing prevention, treatment, and care programs for the three diseases.
zh: 該全球基金於2002年開始運作，為這三種疾病的預防、治療和看護提供融資。

en: High-income countries also finally agreed to reduce the debt owed by heavily indebted poor countries, allowing them to spend more on health care and less on crippling payments to creditors.
zh: 高收入國家也最終形成協議，同意免去重債窮國的債務，減輕它們的還債負擔，將更多的錢用於衛生專案。

en: The United States also took action, adopting two major programs, one to fight AIDS and the other to fight malaria.
zh: 美國也採取了行動，出臺了兩大專案，一個針對艾滋病，另一個針對瘧疾。

en: In 2005, the UN Millennium Project recommended specific ways to scale up primary health care in the poorest countries, with the high-income countries helping to cover the costs that the poorest could not pay by themselves.
zh: 2005年，聯合國千年專案給出瞭如何增進最窮國家初級衛生保障的具體辦法，其中高收入國家應該幫助最窮國家承擔後者無法獨力承擔的成本。

en: The UN General Assembly backed many of the project’s recommendations, which were then implemented in numerous low-income countries.
zh: 聯合國大會透過了該專案的多項建議，並開始在多個低收入國家實施。

en: Donor aid did start to rise sharply as a result of all of these efforts.
zh: 在這些努力的推動下，捐贈援助的確出現了蓬勃發展。

en: In 1995, total aid for health care was around $7.9 billion.
zh: 1995年，衛生援助總額約為79億美元。

en: This inadequate level then crept up slowly, to $10.5 billion by 2000.
zh: 這一遠遠不夠的援助水平緩慢地增加著，2000年上升到了105億美元。

en: By 2005, however, annual aid for health had jumped another $5.9 billion, and by 2010, the total had grown by another $10.5 billion, to reach $26.9 billion for the year.
zh: 但是，到了2005年，年度衛生援助大漲59億美元，而到了2010年，援助總額在增加105億美元，達到了269億美元。

en: The expanded funding allowed major campaigns against AIDS, TB, and malaria; a major scaling up of safe childbirth; and increased vaccine coverage, including the near-eradication of polio.
zh: 資金的充裕使得抵抗艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾的專案得以啟動、安全分娩得到了大普及，也增加了疫苗的覆蓋面，小兒麻痺症基本上被消滅了。

en: Many innovative public-health techniques were developed and adopted.
zh: 許多創新性衛生技術被開發出來並得到了使用。

en: With one billion people living in high-income countries, total aid in 2010 amounted to around $27 per person in the donor countries – a modest sum for them, but a life-saving one for the world’s poorest people.
zh: 約10億人口生活在高收入國家中，2010年的援助總額意味著他們人均貢獻了27美元 — — 對他們來說算不了什麼，但對最貧困人口來說足以救命。

en: The public-health successes can now be seen on many fronts.
zh: 如今，公共衛生領域的諸多方面都可以看到進步。

en: Around 12 million children under five years old died in 1990.
zh: 1990年，有1200萬不到5歲的兒童夭折。

en: By 2010, this number had declined to around 7.6 million – still far too high, but definitely an historic improvement.
zh: 到了2010年，該數字下降至760萬左右 — — 依然很高，但毫無疑問是歷史性的進步。

en: Malaria deaths in children in Africa were cut from a peak of around one million in 2004 to around 700,000 by 2010, and, worldwide, deaths of pregnant women declined by almost half between 1990 and 2010, from an estimated 543,000 to 287,000.
zh: 非洲瘧疾兒童致死數量也從2004年的最高峰（���100萬）下降至2010年的約70萬，而全球孕婦死亡數量在1990—2010年間下降了幾乎一半，從543 000降至287 000（估計值 ） 。

en: Another $10-15 billion in annual aid (that is, roughly $10-15 more per person in the high-income world), bringing total aid to around $40 billion per year, would enable still greater progress to be made in the coming years.
zh: 如果年度衛生援助能增加100—150億美元（即高收入國家居民每人再拿出10—15美元 ） ， 達到每年400億美元，那麼未來幾年還能取得更大進步。

en: The MDGs for health could be achieved even in many of the world’s poorest countries.
zh: 衛生相關MDG即使在世界最貧困國家也能夠實現。

en: Unfortunately, at every step during the past decade – and still today – a chorus of aid skeptics has argued against the needed help.
zh: 不幸的是，在過去十年所採取的每一個步驟中（現在也不例外 ） ， 總有一群援助懷疑者對必要的援助指手畫腳。

en: They have repeatedly claimed that aid does not work; that the funds will simply be wasted; that anti-malaria bed nets cannot be given to the poor, since the poor won’t use them; that the poor will not take anti-AIDS medicines properly; and so on and so forth.
zh: 他們一再聲稱援助根本沒什麼效果；援助資金都打了水漂；抗瘧疾床帳不能給窮人使用，因為他們根本不會去用；窮人不會正確服用抗艾滋藥物；如此等等。

en: Their attacks have been relentless (I’ve faced my share).
zh: 他們的攻擊是冷血的（包括對我的攻擊 ） 。

en: The opponents of aid are not merely wrong.
zh: 援助的反對者不僅僅是錯誤的。

en: Their vocal antagonism still threatens the funding that is needed to get the job done, to cut child and maternal deaths by enough to meet the MDGs by 2015 in the poorest countries, and to continue after that to ensure that all people everywhere finally have access to basic health services.
zh: 他們異口同聲的反對仍在威脅取得成就所必須的融資 — — 減少嬰幼兒死亡從而讓最貧困國家在2015年完成MDG以及此後再接再厲確保所有國家所有人民都能獲得基本衛生服務都需要資金。

en: A decade of significant progress in health outcomes has proved the skeptics wrong.
zh: 十年來衛生成果的巨大進步已經證明，懷疑者是錯的。

en: Aid for health care works – and works magnificently – to save and improve lives.
zh: 衛生援助在拯救生命、改善生活方面是有用的，而且很有用。

en: Let us continue to support these life-saving programs, which uphold the dignity and well-being of all people on the planet.
zh: 讓我們繼續支援這些生命挽救計劃，提升所有地球人的尊嚴和福利。

en: The AIIB and Global Governance
zh: 亞投行和全球治理

en: HONG KONG – Despite official American and Japanese opposition, 57 countries have opted to be among the founding members of the China-led Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB).
zh: 香港—儘管有美國和日本官方的反對，57個國家選擇了成為中國發起的亞洲基礎設施投資銀行（亞投行）創始成員。

en: Regardless of what naysayers believe, this remarkable turn of events can only benefit global economic governance.
zh: 不管對此持懷疑態度者的觀點如何，這一令人矚目的變局有利於改善全球經濟治理。

en: According to former US Treasury Secretary Larry Summers, the AIIB’s establishment “may be remembered as the moment the United States lost its role as the underwriter of the global economic system.”
zh: 美國財政前部長拉里·薩默斯（Larry Summers）指出，亞投行的成立“也許將以美國失去其全球經濟體系擔保人地位的時刻被人銘記。

en: Asia Development Bank (ADB) President Takehiko Nakao, by contrast, does not believe that there will be a “major change to the world of development finance,” though he conceded that “there can be interpretations as to the symbolic meaning of this.”
zh: ”相反，亞洲開發銀行（亞開行）行長中尾武彥（Takehiko Nakao）則認為亞投行的成立不會導致 “發展金融的重大變化 ， ” 儘管他也承認“對於它的象徵意義，可能存在各種解讀。 ”

en: Who is right will depend largely on the decisions that the AIIB’s top shareholders make regarding its operating structure.
zh: 誰對誰錯在很大程度上取決於亞投行大股東對其運營結構所做的決定。

en: So far, the AIIB has not sought to amend the principle that the largest contributor to a multilateral organization gets the largest say in running it.
zh: 目前，亞投行並沒有試圖改變一條國際組織通行原則，即多邊組織的最大貢獻者獲得最大的運營話語權。

en: Just as the US dominates the World Bank and Europe leads the International Monetary Fund, China will head the AIIB.
zh: 正如美國主導世界銀行、歐洲領導國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）一樣，中國也將主導亞投行。

en: This implies a larger global leadership role for China – which the world, including its traditional powers, should welcome.
zh: 這意味著中國會承擔更多的全球領導作用。 全世界，包括其中的傳統力量，應該歡迎這一變化。

en: After all, global leadership is not just a matter of might; it also reflects the provision of global public goods.
zh: 畢竟，領導全球並不僅僅是實力問題，它也包括了為全球提供公共品服務。

en: When World War II ended, the US, aside from being the world’s leading military and economic power, was the largest provider of such goods, through the Marshall Plan, support for the United Nations, and contributions to the Bretton Woods institutions (the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank).
zh: 二戰結束時，美國不但是世界上最強大的軍事和經濟力量，也是全球公共品服務的最大供應者，美國實施了援助歐洲重建的馬歇爾計劃，支援了聯合國，併為佈雷頓森林機構（IMF和世界銀行）貢獻其力量。

en: But massive debts have lately undermined the ability of the US – not to mention Europe and Japan – to continue making such large contributions.
zh: 但如今，巨大的債務制約了美國 — — 更不用說制約了歐洲和日本 — — 繼續做出如此巨大的貢獻的能力。

en: Fortunately, China is willing and able to fill the gap.
zh: 幸運的是，中國願意也有能力填補這個空白。

en: In fact, China might have done so within the Bretton Woods institutions, were the distribution of voting rights within them not skewed so heavily toward the incumbents, who still enjoy veto power.
zh: 事實上，中國本可以在佈雷頓森林機構內填補這一空白，但這些機構內部的投票權太過傾向於目前當權的發達國家，它們仍享有否決權。

en: For example, China has a 3.8% voting share in the IMF and World Bank, even though it accounts for more than 12% of world GDP.
zh: 比如，中國在IMF和世界銀行中的投票權比例只有3.8 % ， 儘管其佔全球GDP比例已高達12%以上。

en: The United Kingdom and France – which are one-third the size of China – each have a 4.3% share.
zh: 英國和法國 — — 經濟規模只有中國的三分之一卻都擁有4.2%的投票權。

en: With the incumbents unwilling to bring China’s voting share in line with its economic might, China had little choice but to launch its own institution.
zh: 目前的發達國家當權者不願意給予中國與其經濟實力相稱的投票權，中國別無選擇，只能成立自己的機構。

en: But the AIIB has its own objectives, which do not align precisely with those of, say, the World Bank.
zh: 但亞投行有其自身的、與世界銀行等不完全一致的目標。

en: Specifically, the bank is a critical element of China’s “one belt, one road” strategy, which encompasses two initiatives: the overland Silk Road Economic Belt, connecting China to Europe, and the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, linking China to Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
zh: 具體而言，亞投行是中國透過“一帶一路”戰略促進周邊國家經濟發展的關鍵要素之一。 “一帶一路”戰略包括兩大工程：連線中國和歐洲的陸上絲綢之路經濟帶，以及連線中國和東南亞、中東和歐洲的21世紀海上絲綢之路。

en: While the US “pivots” to the east, China is pirouetting west, applying the lessons of its development to its trading partners across Eurasia and beyond.
zh: 在美國向東“轉”的同時，中國正在向西邁進，將它的發展經驗傳播給歐亞地區及之外的貿易伙伴。

en: Perhaps the most important of these lessons is that connectivity is vital to economic growth.
zh: 也許這些經驗中最重要的便是連通性（connectivity）對經濟增長的關鍵作用。

en: Over the last three decades, the construction of roads, railways, ports, airports, and telecommunications systems in China has fostered trade, attracted investment, and, by linking the country’s land-locked western and southern provinces to its more prosperous coastal areas, helped to reduce regional disparities.
zh: 在過去三十年中，中國的公路、鐵路、機場和通訊系統建設刺激了貿易，吸引了投資，並透過將中國內陸西部和南部省份與更繁榮的東部沿海城市連線起來降低了地區差異。

en: China’s Silk Road initiative, which aims to boost prosperity among China’s trading partners largely through infrastructure investment, is a logical next step – one on which China is spending significantly.
zh: 中國的絲綢之路工程旨在主要透過基礎設施投資刺激中國貿易伙伴的繁榮，這是中國發展順理成章的下一步。 中國正在這方面投入巨資。

en: In addition to its initial contribution of up to $50 billion to the AIIB, China has committed $40 billion to its Silk Road Fund, $32 billion to the China Development Bank, and $30 billion to the Export-Import Bank of China.
zh: 除了給亞投行的500億美元初始投資，中國還向其絲綢之路基金新注資400億美元，向國家開發銀行新注資320億美元，向國家進出口銀行新注資300億美元。

en: According to estimates by HSBC, the “one belt, one road” initiative could end up costing as much as $232 billion – just under two-thirds of the World Bank’s balance sheet in 2014.
zh: 根據滙豐銀行的估算 ， “ 一帶一路”工程最終可能耗資2,320億美元 — — 幾乎相當於2014年世界銀行資產負債表規模的三分之二。

en: The $100 billion AIIB will play a central role in this effort.
zh: 資本金預計達到1,000億美元的亞投行將在其中扮演核心角色。

en: Given massive global demand for infrastructure finance – which, according to ADB estimates, will amount to $8 trillion in Asia alone over the next decade – the AIIB should not be considered a threat to the World Bank, the ADB, or other multilateral lenders.
zh: 根據亞開行的估算，全球基礎設施融資需求旺盛，光是未來十年的亞洲就需要8萬億美元。 因此亞投行不應該被視為世界銀行、亞開行和其他多邊貸款機構的威脅。

en: Nonetheless, it will compete with them, owing to its distinctive – and probably more efficient – approach to lending.
zh: 儘管如���，亞投行將與其他機構展開競爭，因為它的貸款方針不同，也許效率更高。

en: In fact, the AIIB’s operations will most likely resemble those of the World Bank in the 1960s, when engineers with hands-on development experience dominated the staff and could design lending conditions that worked for borrowers.
zh: 事實上，亞投行的經營將更加類似於20世紀60年代的世界銀行，由擁有實地發展經驗的工程師主導工作團隊，可以為借款人設計合適的貸款條件。

en: In the late 1980s, the World Bank began to implement the Washington Consensus, pushing for economic and political liberalization, without sufficient regard for local political or economic realities.
zh: 20世紀80年代末，世界銀行開始實施華盛頓共識，追求經濟和政治自由化而不再充分考慮地方政治或經濟現實。

en: The result was conditional lending, with terms – created mostly by policy wonks – that many developing-country borrowers could not meet (at least not without hiring consultants to adjust their official reporting).
zh: 結果是有條件貸款盛行，而其貸款條件往往由學院派政策專家制定，導致許多發展中國家借款人如果不僱用國際組織顧問調整其官方報告，根本無法滿足其規定的貸款條件。

en: The acid test of the AIIB’s effectiveness will be its governance model.
zh: 亞投行成效的嚴峻考驗將是其治理模式。

en: One failing of the Bretton Wood institutions is their full-time shareholder boards of directors, which tend to undermine effectiveness by micro-managing and often requesting conflicting lending conditions.
zh: 佈雷頓森林機構的失敗之一是它有一個全職股東董事會來代表出資國意願，該董事會總是因為過度微觀管理而破壞專案的效果，並且常常要求互相矛盾的貸款條件。

en: The World Bank has wasted far too much time re-organizing itself under various presidents, without recognizing the fundamental problem with its own governance structure.
zh: 世界銀行浪費了太多時間不斷由新任行長展開對自身的行政重組，而沒有認識到其治理結構的根本性問題。

en: Even if the AIIB does not deliver as promised, its establishment is an important reminder that in a fast-changing world, economic governance cannot remain stagnant.
zh: 即使亞投行沒有給出其承諾的結果，其成立也可以作為一個重要的提醒，讓我們知道，在快速變化的世界中，經濟治理不能停滯不前。

en: If Western leaders really do believe in innovation, competition, and meritocracy, they should welcome the AIIB.
zh: 如果西方領導人真的相信創新、競爭和英才治國，他們就應該歡迎亞投行。

en: AIPAC in Decline
zh: 美以公共事務委員會的衰落

en: MADRID – The American Israel Public Affairs Committee’s lobbying power in the United States is undeniable.
zh: 馬德里 — — 在美國，美以公共事務委員會的遊說力量不可否認。

en: But AIPAC’s supposed ability to control US policy decisions is a Potemkin village myth, cultivated by friends and rivals alike.
zh: 但該委員會對美國決策所謂的控制力其實不過是盟友和對手共同製造的虛假神話。

en: In fact, thanks to Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu, AIPAC’s influence is under threat – though Netanyahu himself will be just fine.
zh: 事實上，雖然以色列總理內塔尼亞胡本人毫髮無損，但他的所作所為卻對委員會的影響力構成了威脅。

en: Claims about AIPAC’s clout have long shaped analysis of US foreign policy.
zh: 美以公共事務委員會影響力之說一直對美國外交政策分析產生影響。

en: For example, Steve Walt and John Mearsheimer, in their notorious essay “The Israel Lobby,” asserted that AIPAC manufactured the Iraq War.
zh: 比方說，沃爾特·史蒂夫和約翰·米爾斯海默在其臭名昭著的論文“以色列遊說勢力”中斷言該委員會是伊拉克戰爭的始作俑者。

en: But the reality is far less sinister: in that case, AIPAC merely surfed on the pro-invasion wave unleashed by President George W. Bush, with his Messianic urges, and Vice President Dick Cheney, a one-man war lobby.
zh: 但現實卻遠沒有那麼險惡：在伊拉克戰爭中，美以委員會僅僅是利用了喬治·W·布什總統扮演救世主的衝動和切尼副總統單槍匹馬的戰爭遊說所掀起的侵略狂潮。

en: The truth about AIPAC – that it is influential, but far from invulnerable – has recently been revealed, both to the public and to the group itself.
zh: 最近發生的事情令公眾和委員會自身看清了其影響力不凡但遠非無懈可擊的本來面目。

en: Having been pushed by Netanyahu into an unwinnable fight against US President Barack Obama’s administration over its nuclear deal with Iran, AIPAC is now crumbling under the weight of its own hubris.
zh: 因為被內塔尼亞胡推入到一場反對奧巴馬政府與伊朗達成核協議的不可能打贏的戰爭，美以公共事務委員會現在在狂妄自大的重壓下搖搖欲墜。

en: In fact, AIPAC has never overcome resolute opposition from an American president, particularly in a matter of US national security.
zh: 事實上，尤其當事關國家安全時，美以委員會從未戰勝過美國總統的堅決反對。

en: It failed to stop Jimmy Carter from selling F-15 Eagle fighters to Saudi Arabia in 1978, or to prevent Ronald Reagan from supplying AWACS reconnaissance planes to the Saudis three years later.
zh: 它未能阻止卡特1978年向沙特出售F-15鷹式戰鬥機，也未能阻止三年後里根將預警偵察機出售給沙特。

en: And its 1991 battle with President George H.W. Bush over the linkage of US loan guarantees for Israel with Prime Minister Yitzak Shamir’s support of the 1991 Madrid peace conference – one of Bush’s key legacies – ended in defeat.
zh: 1991年委員會與喬治·H·W·布什總統就美國以提供貸款擔保換取沙米爾總理對1991年馬德里和會的支援之爭（也是布什最關鍵的政策之一）同樣也以失敗而告終。

en: Against this background, AIPAC should have known that its attempt, in close cooperation with Obama’s Republican opponents, to block the Iran nuclear deal (one of Obama’s most important achievements) would fail.
zh: 在此背景下，委員會應該知道它企圖聯手奧巴馬的共和黨反對者阻止達成伊朗核協議（奧巴馬最重要的成就之一）將不會成功。

en: Indeed, Obama even used a tactic similar to that of George H.W. Bush to win the day.
zh: 事實上，奧巴馬甚至採用了與喬治·H·W·布什同樣的致勝戰術。

en: Just as Bush openly denounced the “thousand lobbyists” working the halls of the US Congress against a vital national interest, Obama said in a conference call that his critics “would be opposed to any deal with Iran,” and called out AIPAC’s $20 million advertising campaign against the agreement.
zh: 就像布什公開譴責“上千名說客”湧入美國國會大廳反對重要的國家利益一樣，奧巴馬在一次電話會議上說他的反對者“反對與伊朗達成任何協議 ” ， 並點名美以委員會投入2，000萬美元宣傳資金反對協議的達成。

en: He also put AIPAC in the same category as the Republicans who “were responsible” for leading the US into the Iraq war.
zh: 他還將委員會和共和黨人劃歸一類，指責其應對將美國拖入伊拉克戰爭負責。

en: For AIPAC – which has traditionally relied on a broad coalition of social and political forces in the US that view Israel’s security as both a moral cause and a vital national interest – this is not any old defeat.
zh: 對一直依靠將以色列安全視為既符合道德又合乎重要國家利益的一系列社會和政治勢力的美以公共事務委員會而言，這絕非是一次普通的挫折。

en: The Republican-backed crusade against a key agreement negotiated by a Democratic president, with his party’s overwhelming support, has threatened the bipartisan foundations of Israel’s cause in America.
zh: 由共和黨支援的對民主黨總統在本黨全力支援下所談關鍵協議的討伐已經對以色列美國事業的兩黨基礎構成了威脅。

en: Of course, the nuclear deal involved more than just the US and Iran.
zh: 當然，核協議所涉及的不僅是美國和伊朗。

en: AIPAC was opposing an international agreement that six major world powers – China, France, Germany, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the US – had already signed and that the United Nations had approved.
zh: 委員會反對的是中、法、德、俄、英、美等世界六大強國已經簽署且聯合國已經批准的國際協議。

en: Even some of Israel’s staunchest supporters in Congress were unlikely to deal a potentially devastating blow to America’s international credibility, and the idea that the negotiating countries would all agree to reopen the talks to produce a “better deal” was sheer fantasy.
zh: 即使國會中某些以色列最堅定的支持者也不太可能對美國的國際信譽發起毀滅性的打擊，認為談判國家會一致同意重開會談達成“更好協議”的想法純屬幻覺。

en: Yet that is the objective that Netanyahu set for AIPAC.
zh: 但這就是內塔尼亞胡為委員會設定的目標。

en: The row over the Iran deal is bound to be a watershed moment for American Jews, among whom sharp divisions have formed.
zh: 伊朗協議所引發的分歧註定會成為分裂美國猶太群體的標誌性時刻。

en: Indeed, the American Jewish Committee 2015 Survey of American Jewish Opinion reports the emergence of “two diverging Jewish sub-communities,” with a growing number of Jews feeling alienated by the organizations that claim to represent them.
zh: 事實上，美國2015年針對美國猶太人意見的統計調查顯示形成了“兩個有顯著分歧的猶太子群體 ” ， 進而導致越來越多的猶太人感到無法融入聲稱代表他們利益的組織。

en: AIPAC represents a striking anomaly in the life of American Jews.
zh: 委員會代表美國猶太人生活中突出的反常現象。

en: It is increasingly identified with the Republican agenda and Israel’s evangelical Christian supporters, even though polls have repeatedly shown that Jews are America’s most liberal ethnic group.
zh: 儘管民意調查一再顯示猶太人是美國最自由的族群，但委員會卻越來越貼近共和黨議程和以色列福音派基督教支持者。

en: The truth is that American Jews largely opposed the Iraq war.
zh: 事實是美國猶太人大多反對伊拉克戰爭。

en: They overwhelmingly vote for the Democratic Party.
zh: 他們壓倒性地投票支援民主黨。

en: They define their religion as moderate and liberal, with many upholding gay rights and abortion, both anathema to evangelical Christians.
zh: 他們將自身宗教定位為溫和自由，不少人崇尚同性戀權利和人工流產，這兩者在福音派基督教看來都是一種詛咒。

en: The majority of American Jews even support the creation of a Palestinian state.
zh: 大多數美國猶太人甚至支援建立一個巴勒斯坦國。

en: And, although they are far from united on the Iran deal, the agreement’s supporters outnumber its opponents.
zh: 而且雖然他們對伊朗協議的看法遠談不上一致，但支援協議的人明顯多於反對者。

en: Much of the blame for the damage that has been done – to AIPAC, American Jewish communities, and even the US political process – falls on Netanyahu.
zh: 內塔尼亞胡應該對委員會、美國猶太群體甚至美國政治程序所遭受的損失負責。

en: But he is unlikely to face retribution for any of it.
zh: 但他不太可能遭到任何報復。

en: On the contrary, the Obama administration has already begun the discussions it promised on upgrading Israel’s strategic capabilities.
zh: 相反，奧巴馬政府已經開始探討履行其提升以色列戰略實力的承諾。

en: As Arab countries throughout the Middle East melt down – with increasingly significant spillover effects in the West – Israel continues to represent a stable regional partner for the US.
zh: 在中東阿拉伯國家相繼崩潰對西方影響越來越顯著的情況下 — — 以色列將繼續扮演美國穩定合夥人的角色。

en: More dangerous, Netanyahu could achieve his next goal: preventing a strategic détente between the US and Iran that would enable cooperation in resolving major regional conflicts, from Yemen to Syria.
zh: 更危險的是，內塔尼亞胡可能會實現他的下一個目標：阻止美國和伊朗緩和戰略關係 及解決從葉門到敘利亞的主要地區衝突。

en: After all, Obama’s victory on the nuclear deal may have been inevitable, but it was far from easy.
zh: 畢竟，奧巴馬在核協議問題上的勝利或許不可避免，但卻絕非垂手可得。

en: An odd coalition of Iranian radicals, AIPAC, the Saudi-led Sunni alliance, the Israeli government, and US politicians from both parties have already compelled Obama to promise additional sanctions on Iran for its sponsorship of terrorism.
zh: 由伊朗激進分子、美以公共事務委員會、沙特領導的遜尼派聯盟、以色列政府和美國兩黨政客所組成的奇怪聯盟已經迫使奧巴馬政府承諾進一步制裁伊朗資助恐怖主義的活動。

en: As a result, America’s cold war with Iran is likely to persist.
zh: 結果是美國與伊朗的冷戰可能無法結束。

en: The Dawn of Climate-Friendly Air Travel
zh: 氣候友好型航空旅行的黎明

en: MONTREAL – As the world becomes increasingly interconnected, demand for air travel is growing, with more than 30,000 new large aircraft expected to take to the skies in the next few years.
zh: 蒙特利爾—隨著世界日益互通，航空旅行需求也在增長，未來幾年預計將有超過30,000架新的大飛機上天。

en: But if we are to sustain growth in air travel without aggravating global warming, we must quickly reduce aviation-related CO2 emissions, which are substantial and not covered by the Paris climate agreement that more than 190 countries agreed to last December.
zh: 但如果想要保持航空旅行增長又不加劇全球變暖，就必須迅速降低與航空有關的二氧化碳排放。 與航空有關二氧化碳排放量巨大，並且沒有寫入去年12月190多個國家達成一致的巴黎氣候協定。

en: Fortunately, now is the perfect time to decouple aviation emissions from air-travel growth.
zh: 幸運的是，現在是讓航空排放與航空旅行增長脫鉤的理想時機。

en: Representatives from 191 countries convened in Montreal this week for the 39th Session of the United Nations’ International Civil Aviation Organization; after decades of wrangling, they have agreed to an aviation-specific climate agreement.
zh: 本週，來自191個國家的代表齊聚蒙特利爾出席第39屆聯合國國際民用航空組織（ICAO）會議；在經歷了幾十年的爭論後，他們就一項專門針對航空的氣候協定達成了一致。

en: The new ICAO framework aims for “carbon-neutral growth” in international aviation from 2020 onward, and has as its centerpiece a global market-based measure (GMBM) to help airlines affordably cap their net emissions at 2020 levels.
zh: 這一新ICAO框架的目標是從2020年開始實現國際航程的“碳中性增長 ” ， 其核心是一項基於全球市場的措施（GMBM ） ， 幫助航空公司以可承受的成本將淨排放限制在2020年���平。

en: When implemented, it will be the first carbon-emissions cap on a global industry that does not noticeably increase costs for consumers.
zh: 該措施實施後將是第一項不給消費者帶來成本顯著上升的全球行業排放上限。

en: And airlines will purchase emissions reductions from other economic sectors, thus funneling billions of dollars into low-carbon development around the world.
zh: 航空公司將從其他經濟部門購買減排量，從而引導數十億美元用於全球低碳發展。

en: For the first six years, the new framework will apply only to flights between countries that have voluntarily adopted it, which means that the ICAO will have to encourage adequate participation for the program to be effective.
zh: 在一開始的六年中，新框架將只適用於自願接受框架的國家之間的航班，這意味著ICAO必須鼓勵足夠的參與度以使該計劃起到效果。

en: This opt-in approach has some critics, but whether a program is categorized as “voluntary” or “mandatory” is beside the point, because international accords generally apply only to the sovereign countries that have decided to join them.
zh: 這一自主加入方針受到了一些批評，但計劃應該被歸為“自願”還是“強制”無關緊要，因為國際協定一般只適用於決定加入其中的主權國家。

en: Some 64 countries have already signaled their willingness to sign on to the ICAO agreement, and together they account for nearly 80% of expected growth in CO2 emissions above 2020 levels.
zh: 有64個國家已經表示願意在ICAO協定上簽字，它們加起來佔二氧化碳排放量預期增長超過2020部分的近80 % 。

en: That isn’t 100%, but it’s a great start, and we can expect more countries to join when they see others reaping the benefits of low-carbon development.
zh: 100%固然沒有達到，但這是個良好的開端，我們期待更多的國家在看到其他國家收穫低碳發展的益處後也能加入。

en: The airlines themselves will welcome a coherent global framework that establishes clear and predictable compliance metrics, rather than a regulatory patchwork that differs from country to country and complicates international operations.
zh: 航空公司自身也將歡迎樹立明確可預測的合規標準的一致的全球框架，而不願面對各國各自為政、讓國際經營變得錯綜複雜的監管拼圖。

en: To minimize compliance costs – and because environmental sustainability is now a key competitive marker for customers and investors alike – airlines will likely encourage the countries where they do business to participate in the ICAO program.
zh: 為了實現合規成本最小化 — — 並且因為環境可持續性如今是爭奪客戶和投資者的關鍵性競爭市場 — — 航空公司可能會鼓動業務所在國加入ICAO計劃。

en: The new agreement provides an enormous opportunity to prevent the emission of 2.5 billion tons of CO2 in the first 15 years – the equivalent of taking roughly 35 million cars off the road every year the program is in force.
zh: 新協定提供了重要機會阻止第一個15年的排放量25億噸二氧化碳 — — 相當於每年減少3,500萬輛汽車。

en: The agreement will also spur major manufacturers such as Boeing, Airbus, Bombardier, and Embraer – which are already investing in quieter, more fuel-efficient aircraft and efficiency improvements for existing models – to develop cleaner technologies that will allow them to purchase fewer emissions offsets.
zh: 協定還將刺激波音、空中客車、龐巴迪和巴西航空等主要生產商開發更清潔的技術，從而減少排放抵扣的購買量。 這些公司已經開始投資於更安靜、燃料效率更高的飛機，並對現有機型進行改良。

en: However, the framework decided in Montreal is not complete, and crucial details need to be worked out quickly so that airlines can begin to plan how they will meet the new environmental targets.
zh: 但是，在蒙特利爾所確定的框架並不完整，必須加快制定關鍵細節，以使航空公司能夠開始著手規劃如何實現新環境目標。

en: Developed countries have already offered to help implement the GMBM, which, it is hoped, will pave the way for investments in emerging economies that are becoming new aviation powerhouses.
zh: 發達國家已經提出了幫助實施GMBM的方案，希望可以掃清投資於正日益成為新航空大國的新興經濟體的道路。

en: If the countries can leapfrog over old technologies, they can become new leaders in carbon-smart flying.
zh: 如果可以跨越舊技術，就能成為碳職能（carbon-smart）飛行的新領導者。

en: They should seize the opportunity before them and join the ICAO framework so that their manufacturers have a clear and predictable path forward.
zh: 它們應該抓住眼前的機會，加入ICAO框架以使其生產商得到明確可預測的前進方向。

en: At the Paris climate talks last year, we witnessed the power of global collective action to address climate change.
zh: 在去年的巴黎氣候談判上，我們看到了全球合作解決氣候變化問題的力量。

en: No fewer than 187 countries – large and small, developed and developing – announced emissions-reduction targets in the months before the conference, which created the momentum to reach a landmark accord.
zh: 不少於187個國家 — — 不管大小、是否發達 — — 在會議開始前幾個月宣佈了減排目標，這位達成里程碑式協定創造了勢頭。

en: With the Paris climate agreement on track to enter into force in the coming months – more rapidly than anyone ever thought possible – we still have that momentum.
zh: 隨著巴黎氣候協定距離幾個月後生效越走越近 — — 比任何人所預想的都要快 — — 我們仍保持著這一勢頭。

en: The ICAO agreement is the next wave in the international battle against climate change.
zh: ICAO協定是對抗氣候變化的國際戰爭的新一波浪潮。

en: Together, the two agreements will boost our chances of delivering environmentally sustainable economic growth.
zh: 這兩個協定加起來將增加我們實現環境可持續經濟增長的機會。

en: By cleaning up our carbon footprint now, future generations of air travelers from all countries will be able to look out their window onto a healthy planet.
zh: 透過從現在開始明確我們的碳足跡，未來航空旅行者不管來自哪個國家，都能夠從舷窗看到健康的地球。

en: Europe’s Airpocalypse
zh: 歐洲空氣啟示錄

en: SINGAPORE – European policymakers like to lecture the rest of the world on air pollution.
zh: 新加坡—歐洲決策者喜歡給世界其他地區上空氣汙染課。

en: Asia, and China in particular, is a favorite target for criticism.
zh: 亞洲，特別是中國是他們最喜歡的目標。

en: Indeed, it sometimes seems as if no major environmental conference is complete without a presentation by European policymakers on their continent’s supposed “best practices,” which the rest of the world should emulate.
zh: 事實上，有時候，似乎任何大型環境會議缺了歐洲決策者宣講應該供全世界模仿的歐洲的所謂“最佳實踐”都是不完整的。

en: When it comes to air pollution, however, Europe might consider doing less talking and more listening.
zh: 但是，在空氣汙染問題上，歐洲還是少說多聽為妙。

en: Air pollution is a growing concern across Europe.
zh: 空氣汙染正在日益成為全歐洲關注的問題。

en: The World Health Organization has called it the continent’s “single largest environmental health risk,” estimating that 90% of Europe’s citizens are exposed to outdoor pollution that exceeds WHO air-quality guidelines.
zh: 世界衛生組織稱它是“歐洲大陸最大的環境健康風險 ” ， 據估計90%的歐洲公民暴露在超出世衛組織空氣質量指導標準的室外汙染中。

en: In 2010, some 600,000 European citizens died prematurely because of outdoor and indoor air pollution, and the economic costs have been put at $1.6 trillion, roughly 9% of the European Union’s GDP.
zh: 2010年，大約600,000歐洲公民因為室外和室內空氣汙染而過早死亡，而經濟成本更是高達1.6萬億美元，相當於歐盟GDP的9%左右。

en: London and Paris suffer from particularly severe air-quality problems.
zh: 倫敦和巴黎因為嚴重的空氣質量問題而損失慘重。

en: Nitrogen dioxide levels in some parts of London regularly reach 2-3 times the recommended limit.
zh: 倫敦某些地方的二氧化氮水平有時高達建議上限的2—3倍。

en: In the United Kingdom, air pollution kills some 29,000 people a year, putting it second only to smoking as a cause of premature death.
zh: 在英國，空氣汙染k每年要殺死29,000人左右，是僅次於吸菸的第二大過早死亡原因。

en: Paris may be even worse off; in March, after air-pollution levels surpassed Shanghai’s, the city imposed a partial driving ban and introduced free public transportation.
zh: 巴黎的情況比倫敦還要糟糕；3月，巴黎空氣汙染水平超過上海，不得不實施區域性限行並推出免費公交。

en: Sadly, Europe’s policymakers do not seem up to the challenge.
zh: 悲哀的是，歐洲決策者似乎並未直面挑戰。

en: George Osborne, the UK’s chancellor of the exchequer, has argued against British leadership in the fight against climate change.
zh: 英國財政大臣喬治·奧斯本（George Osborne）反對英國在對抗氣候變化中其領導作用。

en: “We are not going to save the planet by shutting down our steel mills, aluminum smelters, and paper manufacturers,” he declared in 2011.
zh: “我們不會為了拯救地球而關掉我們的軋鋼廠、鍊鋁廠和造紙廠 ， ” 他在2011年說道。

en: Osborne is not alone.
zh: 奧斯本不是一個人。

en: With European politicians arguing that introducing environmental safeguards will hurt the EU’s already-weakened economy, it comes as little surprise that measures to limit air pollution fall far short of the mark.
zh: 歐洲政客認為引入環境保護機制會影響已經相當疲軟的歐盟經濟，因此，毫不奇怪遏制空氣汙染的措施遠遠達不到要求。

en: The EU’s proposed standards regulating toxic emissions from coal plants are even less strict than China’s, Greenpeace reports.
zh: 據綠色和平組織報告歐盟計劃採取的限制火電廠有害氣體排放的標準甚至還沒有中國嚴格。

en: Yet various European politicians have called for watering them down even further, with Hungary suggesting that they be scrapped altogether.
zh: 但許多歐洲政客還要求進一步降低標準，匈牙利認為應該完全放棄監管。

en: To be sure, air pollution levels in Asia are truly worrisome.
zh: 平心而論，亞洲空氣汙染水平確實值得擔憂。

en: The continent is home to nine of the world’s ten most polluted countries, according to Yale University’s 2014 Air Quality Ranking.
zh: 根據2014年耶魯大學空氣質量排名，世界十大汙染最嚴重國家中有九個位於亞洲。

en: New Delhi is ranked as the most polluted city on earth, with air pollution exceeding safe levels by a factor of 60.
zh: 新德里位列地球城市汙染程度榜第一名，空氣汙染超過安全水平60倍。

en: Owing to Beijing’s unhealthy air, foreign companies pay a “hardship bonus” of up to 30% to employees working there.
zh: 由於北京的空氣危害健康，外國公司必須向駐北京員工支付高達30%的“困難費 ” 。

en: But at least policymakers in Asia have recognized the problem and are taking steps to address it.
zh: 但至少亞洲決策者認識到了這一問題，並在採取行動解決它。

en: China, for example, has declared a “war on pollution.”
zh: 比如，中國宣佈要打一場“汙染之仗 ” 。

en: By 2017, Beijing – once dubbed “Greyjing” by the international media – will spend some CN¥760 billion ($121 billion) to combat air pollution.
zh: 到2017年，曾經被國際媒體戲稱為“霾都”的北京將斥資7,600億元人民幣治理空氣汙染。

en: At the heart of China’s measures are improved public transportation, green trade, and a revision of the energy mix.
zh: 中國的措施的核心是改進公共交通、綠色貿易和改變能源結構。

en: The government has decided to install bus stops every 500 meters in city centers, reduce tariffs to 5% or less for a list of 54 environmental goods, and decommission many outdated and inefficient coal plants.
zh: 政府在市中心每隔500米設立一個公交站點，將54種環境產品的關稅下降到5%或以下。

en: The share of non-fossil fuels in primary energy consumption is expected to increase to 20% by 2030.
zh: 非化石燃料佔初級燃料消費量的比重到2030年將上升到20 % 。

en: These targets are likely to be rigorously implemented, given strong political support from the very top.
zh: 這些目標有可能得到嚴格實施，因為它們得到了最高層的強力政治支援。

en: Meanwhile, in India, the state governments in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Tamil Nadu are about to launch the world’s first cap-and-trade schemes for particulates.
zh: 與此同時，載運毒，古吉拉特、馬哈拉施特拉和泰米爾納德等邦準備實施世界上首個微粒配額和交易機制。

en: India’s Supreme Court even suggested an extra charge on privately owned diesel vehicles in New Delhi.
zh: 印度最高法院甚至建議對新德里私家柴油機動車徵收附加費。

en: Other parts of Asia are also taking steps to improve air quality.
zh: 其他亞洲國家也在採取措施改善空氣質量。

en: Vietnam aims to construct eight urban rail lines in the coming years.
zh: 越南目標在未來幾年中建設八條城市軌道交通線。

en: Bangkok, which has been tackling air pollution since the 1990s, has planted 400,000 trees.
zh: 曼谷從20世紀90年代便開始治理空氣汙染，種植了400,000株樹木。

en: And Japan is offering subsidies for hydrogen cars and creating new pedestrian-only areas.
zh: 日本也採取了氫燃料汽車補貼，開闢新的步行區域。

en: Europe, as one of the world’s wealthiest regions, ought to be at the forefront of the effort to promote environmental sustainability.
zh: 作為世界最富有地區之一的歐洲理應站在促進環境可持續性的最前沿。

en: When it comes to air pollution, however, Europe’s policymakers should stop preaching to others and focus on fixing their own problems.
zh: 但是，在空氣汙染問題上，歐洲決策者應該停止好為人師，專注於解決自身問題。

en: A Japanese Metamorphosis?
zh: 日本的轉型？

en: OSAKA – Yesterday’s landslide general-election victory by the Democratic Party of Japan (DPJ) terminated the one-party-dominated system that the catch-all Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) has controlled almost without interruption since 1955.
zh: 大阪 — — 昨天日本民主黨（DPJ）在大選中以壓倒性優勢獲勝結束了自民黨無所不能的（LDP）一黨專政體系，從1955年以後一黨專政體系的控制權就一直牢牢掌握在自民黨手中。

en: For most of the last decade, the DPJ was not seen as a viable alternative to the LDP, although they appeared to form a pseudo-two-party system.
zh: 過去10年來，儘管偽兩黨體系已經初見規模，但民主黨一直被看作自民黨可能的替代黨派。

en: Twenty years after the Cold War’s end, Japan will at last have a post-Cold War system of government.
zh: 冷戰結束20年後，日本終於即將建立起後冷戰時期的政府體系。

en: The Japanese public, even now, remains uncertain about the DPJ’s ability to govern and is skeptical of its rosy programs of wealth redistribution, which lack solid funding.
zh: 即便現在，日本公眾仍然對民主黨的執政能力和缺乏資金支援的財富再分配的誘人計劃持懷疑態度。

en: The public is also fully aware that the ideologically fragmented DPJ lacks a pragmatic, coherent foreign and security policy
zh: 公眾也非常清楚在意識形態上壁壘分明的民主黨不具備現實、連貫的外交和安全政策。

en: Yet the DPJ will form the next government because of public disgust with the LDP.
zh: 但公眾對於自民黨的厭惡情緒卻使民主黨登上了下屆政府寶座。

en: For the last four years, the LDP had shown itself to be utterly unresponsive to the key issues of popular concern: pensions, unemployment, and the fraying social safety net.
zh: 四年來，自民黨徹底無視公眾所關注的養老金、失業和社會安全網損壞等關鍵性問題。

en: Moreover, the LDP was plagued by a string of minor scandals and consistent bungling.
zh: 此外，自民黨還受到一系列醜聞的困擾，並一如既往地表現出拙劣的執政能力。

en: The LDP’s need for three different prime ministers in the space of little more than a year made plain that the party’s power nucleus had melted down.
zh: 自民黨在短短一年多的時間裡更換三名首相充分說明該黨的權力核心已經解體。

en: Once in power, the DPJ will immediately confront the massive bureaucracy and entrenched mandarins, which usually sabotage any efforts at administrative reform that threatens their power and vested interests.
zh: 掌權以後，民主黨將立即需要面對龐大的官僚體系和根深蒂固的官僚家族，它們會故意破壞威脅其權力和既得利益的任何行政改革政策。

en: Indeed, immediately after the election, the budget estimates for the next fiscal year are due.
zh: 實際上，這次選舉剛剛結束，下一年度的財政預算案就必須提交。

en: The figures that will be presented are the result of a lengthy process, in which the bureaucracy closely consulted with LDP.
zh: 提交的預算數字需要經過繁瑣的程式，在此期間需要官僚體系與自民黨密切配合。

en: So, without breaking the regular budget cycle, the DPJ will be forced to implement not only the supplementary budget drawn up by the LDP, but will also be stuck with next year’s budget, which embodies LDP policies that the DPJ has denounced.
zh: 因此，如果不打破常規的預算週期，民主黨將被迫執行自民黨制定的補充預算計劃，而且還必須接受下一年度預算，而這份預算恰恰體現了民主黨一直聲討的自民黨政策。

en: As a result, the DPJ has announced plans to revoke the LDP’s guidelines for a ceiling on budget requests so as to formulate its own budget from scratch.  It will also revise the supplementary budget as well.
zh: 因此，民主黨已經宣佈廢除自民黨規則的計劃，取消預算申請上限，以便從零開始制定自己的預算計劃。 它還將修改補充預算計劃。

en: But time is short, and few of new DPJ lawmakers possess the legislative experience and budgetary expertise to make that happen.
zh: 但時間太過短暫，並且沒有多少民主黨立法人員掌握達到目標所需的立法經驗和預算知識。

en: To gain control of the mandarins, the DPJ plans to place 100 lawmakers in the ministries’ top leadership, as well as three dozen political appointees to policy staffs in the office of the prime minister.
zh: 為了控制官僚體系，民主黨計劃安排100名立法人員擔任各部的高層領導，並任命三十六名政治特派員承擔首相辦公室的政策工作。

en: Unfortunately, the DPJ scrapped an LDP-sponsored civil-service reform bill, which would have allowed the DPJ to replace mandarins with an army of political appointees.
zh: 令人遺憾的是，民主黨否決了一項由自民黨提出的公務員改革法案，這項法案本可以允許民主黨用政治特派員取代官僚家族。

en: The DPJ, despite its manifesto, seems unprepared to tame the mandarins, and so may be forced to rely on them.
zh: 儘管表面上態度堅決，但民主黨似乎還沒有準備好馴服各級官僚，因此可能最終不得不接受以他們為依託。

en: The ascendency of the mandarins is a legacy of Japan’s unique historical development dating back to its early modern period.
zh: 官僚家族的優越地位可以追溯到日本現代化早期獨特的歷史發展道路。

en: Unlike in Europe, Japan developed its state before building a strong civil society.
zh: 和歐洲不同的是，日本在強大的公民社會形成之前就已經建立了國家。

en: Indeed, full-fledged “society”-building started only after the 1868 Meiji Restoration, which tipped the balance of power definitively in favor of the state.
zh: 實際上，全方位的“社會”建設在1868年明治維新之後才真正開始，從而導致權力的天平徹底地向國家方向傾斜。

en: As a result, the mandarins survived WWII and the postwar American occupation relatively undamaged, and they will strive to survive the DPJ government as well.
zh: 官僚家族因此相對完好地度過了二戰和戰後的美國佔領，此次他們同樣也能安然度過民主黨政府的任期。

en: They will most likely succeed.
zh: 他們很有可能再次成功逃脫。

en: LDP lawmakers and mandarins developed a routine in which mandarins drafted cabinet-sponsored bills, LDP lawmakers checked the bills, and the two together finalized legislative drafts before they were introduced to the Diet (parliament).
zh: 自民黨立法人員和官僚家族形成了一套常規程式，由官僚家族負責制定內閣法案，立法人員負責稽核，再由兩者共同拿出最終的決議草案，而後再提交議會表決。

en: Since the LDP, recently with a coalition partner, controlled the Diet, the legislative process was simply the interaction between LDP lawmakers and mandarins, centered in the LDP’s headquarters.
zh: 自從自民黨不久前與聯盟夥伴共同控制議會以後，立法過程就成了以自民黨總部為核心的自民黨立法人士和官僚家族之間的互動。

en: The Diet’s role was merely pro forma.
zh: 議會不過起到了形式上的作用。

en: Indeed, under the LDP-led one-party-dominant system, this extra-constitutional mechanism became an integral part of Japan’s government polity.
zh: 實際上，在自民黨領導的一黨專政制度下，上述憲法外機制已經成為日本政府政體不可分割的組成部分。

en: The DPJ government will collide head-on with the mandarins, partly because the party will find it hard to recruit sufficiently qualified policymakers.
zh: 民主黨政府將直接與官僚體系發生碰撞，部分原因是民主黨難以招募到足夠數量的合格決策者。

en: The mandarins have maintained their privileged position in this regard, owing partly to the tax system, which prevents the emergence of non-profit institutions, especially think tanks, where independent policy expertise can be forged.
zh: 官僚家族在上述領域一直保持著優勢地位，這部分需要歸功於稅收體系妨礙了非營利性機構，特別是智庫的產生，而獨立的政策知識正需要透過以上渠道獲得。

en: Moreover, perhaps in anticipation of a change in power, the mandarins have moved forward the annual personnel changes in the major ministries’ top administrative positions.
zh: 此外，或許是預見到了權力的變化，官僚家族已經推動了主要部委高層行政職務的年度人員更替過程。

en: And what of the LDP?
zh: 那麼自民黨的境況又將如何？

en: Having fallen from power, it will lose its control of the redistribution of government funds.
zh: 失去權力後，它將無法控制政府資金再分配。

en: Unable to pay off its constituencies, disintegration looms, for the LDP has never been a party with entrenched grass-roots support, but instead operates as a machine of power and redistribution through a web of insiders across the country’s industrial sectors, occupational associations, and local communities.
zh: 如果無法兌現承諾給支持者的好處，就有可能導致分崩離析的結果，因為自民黨從來就匱乏根深蒂固的基層民眾支援，而是透過與遍佈全國的行業部門、職業協會和當地社群的內部人士聯網實現對權力和再分配機器的操縱。

en: Only by recruiting new blood and reorganizing itself with a solid ideological platform will an LDP comeback be possible.
zh: 只有透過吸收新鮮血液和重建牢固的意識形態，自民黨才有可能重新執政。

en: The DPJ has even weaker grass-roots support, so the mandarins will most likely use their standard techniques of divide and rule to cajole the party by teaching it to mimic the LDP in using state money and contracts to underwrite its major constituencies, such as labor unions and other interest groups.
zh: 民主黨的基層支援更為薄弱，因此官僚家族極有可能利用其分而治之的標準策略，誘騙民主黨像自民黨一樣利用國家資金和政府合同來回饋工會和其他利益組織等主要的支持者。

en: The birth of the DPJ government can yet be a turning point.
zh: 民主黨政府的誕生仍然可以是一次轉折。

en: A major power shift in favor of “society” has taken place.
zh: 一次有利於“社會”的權力轉型已經發生。

en: If the DPJ can break free of mandarin control by centralizing policy formation in the office of the prime minister, as it intends, Japan can emerge as a more resilient democracy with a full-fledged two-party system and greater willingness to assume an international leadership role.
zh: 如果民主黨能像自己希望的那樣透過集中首相辦公室的政策制定來擺脫官僚家族的控制，日本就能夠成為一個更有活力的民主國家，擁有更加完善的兩黨制度，也更願意發揮國際領導作用。

en: A Jobless Recovery?
zh: 失業問題困擾下的復甦？

en: CAMBRIDGE – Who will suffer the longest and the most from the implosion in 2008-2009 of Wall Street and the ensuing world recession?
zh: 劍橋 — — 2008至2009年華爾街風暴和緊接著的全球衰退中，誰會受到最長期、最猛烈的打擊？

en: Not the bankers and financiers who created the disaster.
zh: 不是造成這場災難的銀行家和金融家。

en: Some financiers, like Bernard Madoff, will go to prison for fraud.
zh: 某些金融家會因欺詐入獄，例如伯納德·麥道夫。

en: But, although Madoff was only the tip of the iceberg of rampant financial malfeasance, most suspect financiers need not fear arrest, either because their behavior merely skirted the law, or because financial impropriety more subtle than outright fraud is often difficult to prove.
zh: 但是，儘管麥道夫醜聞只是猖獗的金融違法行為的冰山一角，但大多數有嫌疑的金融家並不需要擔心被捕，因為他們的行為只是打了法律的擦邊球，或者是因為比徹底的欺詐更微妙的金融不當行為通常很難取證。

en: Some bank bosses will retire in shame, but with huge payments to ease their pain – such as the $55 million golden parachute handed to Bank of America’s Ken Lewis, with his, and the £25 million pension bestowed on Royal Bank of Scotland’s Fred Godwin.
zh: 一些銀行老闆會在恥辱中下臺，但會得到鉅額的補償來緩解他們的痛苦 — — 例如美國銀行的肯·劉易斯得到價值5500萬美元的“金色降落傘 ” ， 又如蘇格蘭皇家銀行的弗雷德·歌德溫得到2500萬英鎊退休金。

en: But, buoyed by government bailout money, guarantees, and low interest rates, many banks have again begun to pay their top managers huge bonuses while fighting vigorously against reforms designed to restrain their risk-taking and compensation.
zh: 然而，在得到政府緊急融資、擔保和低利率的支援後，許多銀行又開始給高層管理者支付鉅額的獎金，同時強烈地反對旨在限制他們冒險和補償的改革。

en: The big losers from this economic disaster are workers in the advanced countries that bought into the laissez-faire flexibility of American-style capitalism.
zh: 這場經濟災難的大輸家是那些認同美式資本主義放任自流政策的發達國家的工人。

en: From 2007 to October 2009, the United States lost nearly eight million jobs, which reduced the employment-population ratio from 63% to 58.5%.
zh: 從2007年到2009年10月，美國失去了近800萬個工作崗位，就業人口率從63%下降到58.5 % 。

en: The unemployment rate at the end of 2009 was above 10%, duration of joblessness was the longest since the Great Depression, millions had had their working hours cut, and millions more were too discouraged by a lack of jobs to seek work.
zh: 2009年底的失業率超過10 % ， 失業狀態的持續時間是大蕭條以來的最長，數百萬人的工作時間縮短，更有數百萬人因工作機會的缺乏而失去找工作的勇氣。

en: Advanced Europe, Canada, and Japan also suffered major job losses that will last for a long time.
zh: 歐洲的發達國家、加拿大和日本也遭受了嚴重的失業問題，並且會持續相當長的時間。

en: Spain, which allows for widespread temporary contracts, has had the biggest increase in unemployment, because Spanish workers can be fired as quickly as those in the US.
zh: 允許臨時合同廣泛存在的西班牙失業率增幅最大，因為西班牙的工人被炒魷魚的速度堪比美國工人。

en: Some countries – for example, Germany, Sweden, and South Korea – have “hidden” their joblessness by paying firms to keep workers on the payroll.
zh: 某些國家 — — 例如德國、瑞典和韓國 — — 付錢給公司，讓他們留住正式職員，從而“隱藏”了失業問題。

en: This can work in the short term, but it cannot be sustained over time.
zh: 這種做法在短期內可能有效，但不能長期維持。

en: From the 1980’s through the mid-2000’s, employment has increasingly lagged GDP in economic recoveries.
zh: 從上世紀80年代，一直到21世紀第一個十年中葉，就業率的恢復越來越落後於GDP。

en: In the US, there was a jobless recovery under President Bill Clinton until the dot.com boom in the latter part of the 1990’s, and there was a jobless recovery under George W. Bush in the wake of the 2001 slowdown.
zh: 在美國，克林頓總統治下的經濟復甦就存在失業問題，直到90年代後半葉網路公司興起。 2001年經濟增長放緩之後，喬治·布什治下的經濟復甦也存在失業問題。

en: In the early 1990’s, Sweden suffered a huge recession precipitated by a housing bubble and a banking crisis. Its unemployment rate rose from 1.8% in 1990 to 9.6% in 1994, before bottoming out at 5% in 2001.
zh: 上世紀90年代初，瑞典因房地產泡沫和銀行業危機而遭受了一場大規模的衰退，失業率從1990年的1.8%上升到1994年的9.6 % ， 2001年探底後回升，達到5 % 。

en: Sixteen years after the crisis, the unemployment rate was 6.2% – more than triple the rate in 1990.
zh: 這場危機過後16年，失業率達到6.2 % — —是1990年的三倍還多。

en: In 1997, Korea suffered not only from the Asian financial crisis, but also from insistence by the US and the International Monetary Fund that it raise interest rates and undertake “Washington Consensus”-style reforms to receive aid.
zh: 1997年，韓國不但遭受亞洲金融危機的打擊，更因美國和國際貨幣基金組織堅持讓其提高利率、執行類似華盛頓共識的改革來獲取援助而雪上加霜。

en: Employment recovered, but primarily in “non-regular” jobs with limited benefits, low wages, and little job security.
zh: 就業率恢復了，但主要是靠福利有限、低工資、且幾乎沒有就業保障的“非正式”工作。

en: Inequality in Korea rose from moderate levels to second highest (behind the US) among advanced OECD countries.
zh: 韓國的貧富差距從中等水平躍升至經合組織發達國家中的第二高（僅次於美國 ） 。

en: Weakness in the job market takes a huge toll on economic and personal well-being.
zh: 就業市場的虛弱對經濟的健康和個人的幸福造成了巨大損害。

en: Young people seeking their first jobs and experienced workers who lose jobs in a weak job market suffer economic losses that will last their entire lives.
zh: 在虛弱的就業市場上尋找第一份工作的年輕人和工作經驗豐富的失業者受到的經濟損失將影響他們的一生。

en: Studies of happiness show that unemployment reduces happiness by as much as the loss of a family member.
zh: 幸福指數的研究表明，失業對幸福感的打擊不亞於失去一名至親。

en: It is difficult to see the US re-attaining full employment anytime soon.
zh: 美國很難在不久的將來重新實現充分就業。

en: From 1993 to 1998, the US created millions of jobs, which raised the employment rate by 5.4 percentage points.
zh: 從1993年到1998年，美國創造了數百萬的工作崗位，就業率上升了5.4個百分點。

en: If employment began rising at this rate in 2010, it would take until 2015 before it reached its pre-recession level.
zh: 如果就業率在2010年開始以這個速度上升，要到2015年才能重新達到衰退前的水平。

en: And slow recovery in the US will drag down recovery in other advanced countries, reducing their employment as well.
zh: 美國經濟的緩慢復甦將會拖累其他發達國家，降低他們的就業率。

en: A long, painful period of high unemployment runs counter to what most experts believed the flexible US economic model would ever produce.
zh: 漫長而痛苦的高失業率與大多數專家心目中以為靈活的美國經濟模式會帶來的後果背道而馳。

en: From the early 1990’s on, many analysts viewed America’s weak unionization, at-will employment, limited legal job protection, and high job turnover as major factors in achieving a lower unemployment rate than most EU countries.
zh: 從上世紀90年代初起，許多分析家就把美國鬆散的工會組織、任意的聘用關係、法律對工作的有限保護、以及頻繁的工作變動視為失業率低於大多數歐盟國家的主要因素。

en: Many OECD countries initiated various kinds of flexibility reforms in the hope of improving their economies along US lines.
zh: 許多經合組織國家啟動了各種各樣的靈活化改革，希望按照美國的模式改善自己的經濟。

en: The view that flexibility is the key factor in employment is no longer tenable.
zh: 將靈活性視為保障就業關鍵因素的觀點再也站不住腳了。

en: In its 2009 Employment Outlook , the OECD took a hard look at its favored policy reforms and found them deficient in helping countries adjust to a finance-driven recession.
zh: 經合組織在2009年《就業展望》中仔細審視了他們偏愛的政策改革，結果發現這些改革不足以幫助各國適應金融業引起的衰退。

en: According to the OECD, “there does not appear to be any strong reason to expect that recent structural reforms mean that OECD labor markets are now substantially less sensitive to severe economic downturns.”
zh: 根據經合組織的說法 ， “ 沒有有力的理由讓人相信近來的結構改革能有效降低經合組織國家勞動力市場對嚴重經濟萎縮的敏感度。 ”

en: So the lesson from the recession is clear.
zh: 經濟衰退給我們的教訓已經顯而易見。

en: The weak reed in capitalism is not the labor market, but the financial market.
zh: 資本主義的弱點不在於勞動力市場，而在於金融市場。

en: At worst, labor-market failures impose modest inefficiency costs on society, whereas capital-market failures harm society greatly, with workers, rather than the perpetrators of financial disaster, suffering the most.
zh: 在最糟糕的情況下，勞動力市場的衰退也只能給社會不大的效率問題，但資本市場的衰退則會極大地損害社會，而受損最嚴重的是工人，而不是金融災難的罪魁禍首。

en: Moreover, globalization means that the US capital market’s failure spreads misery around the world.
zh: 而且，全球化意味著美國的資本市場衰退會在全球範圍內造成極大影響。

en: We owe it to workers victimized by this recession to reinvent finance so that it works to enrich the real economy, instead of enriching only the financiers.
zh: 我們虧欠因這場衰退而受到傷害的工人，有必要徹底改造金融制度，使之推動真正的經濟發展，而不是僅讓金融家中飽私囊。

en: This means changing the incentives and rules that govern the financial sector.
zh: 這意味著改變金融部門的激勵制度和規則。

en: Since other countries’ economies and jobs are also at stake, they owe it to their citizens to press the US to deliver meaningful financial reforms.
zh: 其他國家的經濟和工作崗位同樣危如累卵，因此他們為了各自的公民也必須敦促美國進行有意義的金融改革。

en: France’s Midsummer Night’s Dream
zh: 法國的仲夏夜之夢

en: PARIS – Bastille Day, the French national holiday, was glorious this year.
zh: 巴黎—巴士底日是法國的國定假日。 今年，這個日子無比光榮。

en: The military parade, dominated by the celebration of “victory” in Mali and the joint participation of African and United Nations troops, had the perfection of a gracious, albeit muscular, ballet.
zh: 以慶祝馬裡“勝利”和非洲和聯合國軍隊聯合參與為主題的軍事遊行堪稱優美的芭蕾表演 — — 儘管這是肌肉版芭蕾。

en: The classical concert that preceded the magisterial fireworks that ended the day was the closest thing to a French version of the Proms in London, mixing light classical and popular songs.
zh: 那一天的壓軸表演是古典音樂會及隨後的莊嚴的火花。 音樂會堪稱法國版倫敦逍遙音樂會（Proms in London ） ， 結合了輕古典樂和流行歌曲。

en: The Eiffel Tower imbued the evening with its magic.
zh: 埃菲爾鐵塔用它的魔力照耀著這個夜晚。

en: Paris, in case anyone had any lingering doubts, remains the capital of the world – or so it seemed for a night.
zh: 不管你是誰，心存何疑慮，在那個晚上，巴黎仍是世界之都。

en: The melancholia that began to seize France many years ago was all but forgotten.
zh: 纏上法國多年的壓抑被忘得一乾二淨。

en: The celebration of the glory of the past, mixed with popular English songs of the present, seemed to indicate renewed national confidence.
zh: 對昔日榮光的慶祝，伴隨著英語流行歌曲和表演，似乎在彰顯重生的民族自信。

en: What was the meaning of this moment of grace?
zh: 這一優美時刻有著什麼意義？

en: Was it purely the product of a collective delusion, an emotional Potemkin village of sorts, encouraged, if not conceived, by the authorities to restore some level of self-assurance among France’s depressed citizens?
zh: 它只是群體錯覺的產物，是當局為了在某種程度上重塑壓抑的法國國民的自尊而鼓勵（如果不是說服的話）的情感上的波將金村（Potemkin village）嗎？

en: Even if the positive emotions remain only fleeting (as seems most likely), they were real and palpable.
zh: 即使積極情緒最終只會消失殆盡（這是最有可能的情形 ） ， 它們也是真實而容易捕捉的。

en: The French seemed to be in the mood to celebrate.
zh: 法國人沉浸在喜慶之中。

en: Of course, it could simply have been the weather; a gorgeous summer has finally settled in after a miserable spring.
zh: 當然，也許原因僅僅是天氣 — — 在經歷了痛苦的春天后，燦爛的夏天終於到來。

en: But it might also have been one of those natural turning points, a collective and spontaneous decision to say: “Enough of depression, let’s move on.”
zh: 但這或許也是自然轉折點之一，是集體性的同時決定 ： “ 受夠了壓抑，讓我們前進吧。

en: We French may not be what we used to be, the celebrants seemed to be saying, but we are still much more than people think we are.
zh: ”慶祝者似乎在說，法國人或許已不再是昔日的法國人，但我們仍比人們所認為的更好。

en: We have a great revolutionary past that still conveys universal values – liberty, equality, fraternity – and an army that, as in Mali, continues to make a difference in the world.
zh: 我們有偉大的革命的過去，這一過去仍在傳達普世價值 — — 自由、平等、博愛；我們有軍隊，馬裡證明我們的軍隊仍能給世界帶來不同。

en: One can draw two lessons from this collective form of escapism.
zh: 在這一集體逃避現實中，你可以發現兩點。

en: The first is that, beyond the many layers of depression and distrust in France, there is potential for a new and collective departure.
zh: 第一點，在法國內部的多重壓抑和不信任之外，還有一層潛在的新的集體出發。

en: This would require, of course, less cynical political elites who can transcend their petty ambitions and divisions for the sake of the country.
zh: 當然，這要求有更加堅定的政治精英，為了國家的命運犧牲自己的小野心和小異議。

en: The second lesson, even more obvious, is that reality cannot be changed with a simple public spectacle.
zh: 第二點更加明顯，那就是現實不可能因為一場精彩的公共表演而改變。

en: France is not Imperial Rome, where panem et circenses made a fundamental difference.
zh: 法國不是羅馬帝國，麵包和遊戲（panem et circenses）就能造成根本性的不同。

en: It is a weakened democracy mired in an economic and social crisis so deep that it verges on becoming an identity crisis.
zh: 法國是一個削弱了的民主國家，困於深刻的經濟和社會危機，站在身份危機的邊緣。

en: The proof was provided by a third traditional event on Bastille Day, between the morning’s military parade and the evening’s music and fireworks: President François Hollande’s speech to the nation, which took the form of an interview with two prominent journalists.
zh: 巴士底日的第三項傳統節目提供了證明。 這個節目處於上午的軍事遊行和晚上的音樂和煙花之間：總統奧朗德發表全國演講，今年的形式是由兩名著名記者對他進行採訪。

en: He, too, was in a reassuring mood.
zh: 奧朗德也是一副躊躇滿志的樣子。

en: According to Hollande, the economic upturn – la reprise – had just started, and hope was around the corner.
zh: 在奧朗德看來，經濟好轉 — — 復甦（la reprise ） — —才剛剛開始，希望的曙光剛剛顯現。

en: His tone and message had changed.
zh: 他的語調和說辭發生了改變。

en: He was no longer the “normal man” of his election campaign and tenure until now; instead, he tried to present himself, like his predecessor, Nicolas Sarkozy, as a superhero.
zh: 他不再是競選期間和就任至今的那個“普通人 ” ； 相反，他試圖讓自己像他的前任薩科齊，成為超級英雄。

en: Of course, given his personality and low public-approval ratings, his address was the least convincing event of the day.
zh: 當然，從他的人格和低公共支援度看，他的演講是巴士底日最無說服力的事件。

en: Who could have said with certainty that the economic upturn announced by Hollande was real rather than aspirational?
zh: 誰能拍著胸脯說奧朗德所宣佈的經濟好轉是現實而不是願望？

en: Beyond his message’s wishful thinking, the public’s reaction to the messenger was a mixture of disbelief and indifference.
zh: 除了奧朗德話中的一廂情願，公眾對奧朗德的反應時不信任和冷漠。

en: Seeing the behavior of friends, all French, listening with me to Hollande, I was reminded of another moment.
zh: 看著和我一起聽奧朗德講話的朋友（都是法國人）的行為，我想起了另一個時刻。

en: It was December 31, 1989, and I was in the Soviet Union.
zh: 那是1989年12月31日，當時我在蘇聯。

en: I had found myself in a restaurant in the old city of Suzdal, listening to President Mikhail Gorbachev’s “New Year wishes.”
zh: 我在蘇茲達爾（Suzdal）老城的一家餐館，聽總統戈爾巴喬夫的“新年祝詞 ” 。

en: I was moved: The man who symbolized glasnost and perestroika, who had allowed the peaceful emancipation of most of Eastern and Central Europe, was speaking.
zh: 我感慨萬千。 這個象徵公開（glasnost）和改變（perestroika ） 、 允許東歐和中歐和平演變的人正在講話。

en: But I was alone in paying attention to him.
zh: 但我是唯一一個專心聽他講話的人。

en: The restaurant’s customers, like my French friends now, could not have cared less.
zh: 餐館裡的其他食客，就像現在我的法國朋友，對戈爾巴喬夫的講話一點都不關心。

en: Their president had become background noise.
zh: 他們的總統變成了背景噪聲。

en: Has Hollande become, in this sense, a French Gorbachev?
zh: 從這個角度講，難道奧朗德成了法國的戈爾巴喬夫？

en: For the left and the Greens, he is close to being a traitor.
zh: 對左派和綠黨來說，他近乎賣國賊。

en: These voters chose him a year ago not only because he was not Sarkozy, but because he incarnated the values of the true left, even if his centrist moderation seemed a bad omen.
zh: 這些選民一年前之所以選擇他，不僅是因為他不是薩科齊，也是因為他是真左翼價值的化身，儘管他的中間道路溫和立場並非吉兆。

en: Voters of the center or even the center-right are disappointed, too, by their president’s lack of charisma, if not sheer incompetence.
zh: 中間派選民甚至中右翼也感到失望，因為總統缺乏魅力（如果不是徹底無能的話 ） 。

en: After a year of Hollande, France is witnessing a fundamental political revolution.
zh: 奧朗德上臺一年後，法國正在發生根本性的政治革命。

en: During the half-century of the Fifth Republic, a bipartisan system of left and right has traditionally prevailed.
zh: 在第五共和國半個世紀的歷史中，左派和右派的兩黨制已經成為了傳統。

en: But now France is becoming a country dominated by a “tripartite system” of more or less equal strength: the left, the right, and the extreme right.
zh: 但如今法國正在變成由“三黨制”主宰的國家，左派，右派和極右派或多或少地同樣強大。

en: If France wants to capitalize on the positive emotions of Bastille Day, it needs much more responsible elites, ready to unite in the fight against unemployment and its causes (lack of competitiveness and labor-market rigidity) and consequences (the rise of populist, non-republican forces).
zh: 如果法國想利用巴士底日的積極情緒，就需要更負責的精英，準備著為了戰勝失業及其原因（缺乏競爭力和勞動力市場僵化）和後果（民粹主義反共和勢力崛起）而聯合起來。

en: What Bastille Day revealed, even briefly and superficially, is that the potential to unite France exists.
zh: 巴士底日表明 — — 儘管跡象既虛弱又膚淺 — — 團結的法國的潛在力量是存在的。

en: But doing so requires more than shallow promises.
zh: 但這樣做需要的不僅僅是流於表面的承諾。

en: A Kick-Off for Peace?
zh: 開啟和平

en: Yerevan – Armenian President Serzh Sargsyan’s recent invitation to Turkish President Abdullah Gul to visit Yerevan to watch a football match together was historic.
zh: 埃裡溫 - - 亞美尼亞總統薩爾基相最近邀請土耳其總統居爾訪問埃裡溫一同觀看足球賽，這是具有歷史意義的事件。

en: Given the two countries’ long-strained relations, this visit would have been remarkable at any time.
zh: 鑑於兩國關係長期僵持，這一訪問在任何時候都是不同尋常的。

en: But coming as it does only one month after the alarming Russian-Georgian confrontation, it may offer real hope that tensions in the volatile Caucasus region can be eased.
zh: 但是這是在觸目驚心的俄國和喬治亞衝突僅僅一個月以後，因此，這次訪問也許會給人們確實的希望，也就是高加索地區動盪不安緊張局勢可以得到緩解。

en: Of course, ancient and difficult issues divide Armenia and Turkey.
zh: 當然，亞美尼亞和土耳其之間的恩怨由來已久，錯綜複雜。

en: But now is the moment for both countries to put the past aside in order to address their common security concerns.
zh: 但是現在兩國應該摒棄前嫌，處理共同的安全關切。

en: In the new context set by the war in Georgia, the urgency of Turkey becoming a real bridge between the nations of the Caucasus is not lost on anyone.
zh: 喬治亞戰爭帶來了新的環境，因此，人們都清楚土耳其急於想要成為高加索地區國家之間真正的橋樑。

en: This expectation is an inevitable consequence of Turkey’s geography and history.
zh: 這一期望是土耳其的地理和歷史所決定的。

en: Situated figuratively between modernity and tradition, secularism and Islam, and democracy and tyranny, Turkey also is an actual physical bridge between East and West.
zh: 土耳其被比喻成為介於現代和傳統、世俗和伊斯蘭以及民主和專制之間，而且它在地理上也是東西方之間的橋樑。

en: For the peoples of the Caucasus, Turkey marks our path to Europe.
zh: 對於高加索地區的人民而言，土耳其標誌著我們通向歐洲的道路。

en: It is a NATO member, bordering the three Caucasus republics that have NATO Individual Partnership Action Programs.
zh: 土耳其是北約成員國，與三個高加索地區國家接壤，這三個國家都有北約單個夥伴行動計劃。

en: It aspires to join the European Union, and would bring the EU to our three borders, even as we, too, aspire to join one day.
zh: 土耳其渴望加入歐盟並且將會把歐盟帶到我們的三個邊境。 甚至我們也渴望有朝一日加入歐盟。

en: Indeed, Turkey has never missed an opportunity to present itself as a regional broker.
zh: 確實，土耳其從來就沒有錯過機會成為地區調停人。

en: Immediately after the collapse of the Soviet Union, Turkey proposed the Black Sea Economic Cooperation.
zh: 蘇聯解體後，它馬上就提議建立黑海經濟合作組織。

en: This year, as the American-led effort to mediate a Middle East peace settlement began to falter, Turkey took up the job of mediator in both the Israeli-Palestinian conflict and the conflict between Syria and Israel.
zh: 今年，當亞美尼亞主導的中東和平倡議告吹之際，土耳其擔當了巴以衝突和敘以衝突之間的調停人。

en: Now, in the immediate wake of the Russia-Georgia crisis, Turkey’s leaders have stepped forward once again to take a leadership role in the Caucasus.
zh: 現在俄國和喬治亞危機剛剛結束，土耳其領導人再次站出來在高加索地區發揮領導作用。

en: The world must fervently hope that the Turkish proposal for a Caucasus Stability and Cooperation Platform is more serious and sustained than previous similar efforts.
zh: 全世界熱切希望土耳其提出的高加索穩定和合作平臺比以往的類似建議更為嚴肅認真和持久。

en: But, in order to succeed, Turkey must firmly pursue a pledge from all the region’s players to repudiate the use of force in settling their disputes.
zh: 但是，為了成功，土耳其必須緊緊尋求本地區所有國家的承諾，在解決爭端中放棄使用武力。

en: If this pledge is adopted and respected, conflicts in the region will be viewed in a wholly different, more tolerant context, marking a historic breakthrough to peace.
zh: 如果這一承諾獲得透過並且尊重，那麼，人們就可以完全不同而且更為寬容的眼光來審視這一地區的各種衝突。 這將標誌著朝向和平的歷史性突破。

en: In fact, why not take the idea of such a pact one step further?
zh: 實際上，為何不把這一協議主張更推進一步呢？

en: We in this region can, and I believe should, call for a non-aligned Caucasus, free of security blocs and adversarial alliances.
zh: 我相信，本地區國家應該而且能夠呼籲建立不結盟的高加索地區，沒有安全結盟或者敵對聯盟。

en: After all, security alliances and guarantees only create dividing lines, with their attendant security challenges.
zh: 畢竟，安全挑戰伴隨著這些安全聯盟和保證，只會製造分歧。

en: Our countries and peoples have, throughout history, lived under a common umbrella for far longer than we have been divided.
zh: 我們的國家和人民在歷史上一直生活在一個共同的結構之下，長於分裂的時間。

en: Today, we share a common vision of European integration, and it is in this broader context that our conflicts should be resolved.
zh: 今天，我們共有歐洲聯合的願景。 正是在這一更廣大的背景之下我們的衝突才應該得以解決。

en: French President Nicolas Sarkozy’s and German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s visits to Georgia and Russia proved that there is no substitute for Europe insofar as the Caucasus is concerned.
zh: 法國總統薩爾科奇和德國總理默克爾對喬治亞和德國的訪問證明，對於歐洲而言，高加索地區是不可替代的。

en: Only Europe can play the role of honest broker in the region’s atmosphere of suspicion and intolerance.
zh: 只有歐洲才能夠在這一地區懷疑和沒有寬容的氣氛下發揮真正的調停人作用。

en: But, at the end of the day, we ourselves must be willing to work toward a region of peace and cooperation.
zh: 但是最終，我們自己必須願意努力建立地區和平及合作。

en: The Caucasus is too small a space for closed borders and explosive conflicts.
zh: 高加索地區並不遼闊，難以容得邊境封鎖和爆炸性衝突。

en: Although some of those tensions appear purely bilateral, the Georgian-Russian conflict demonstrates that there is no such thing anymore in this globalized world, and certainly not in this interconnected region.
zh: 儘管某些緊張局勢看似完全是雙邊的，但是喬治亞和俄國衝突表明，在這一全球化的世界裡以及這一相互關聯的地區不會有什麼雙邊緊張局勢了。

en: In fact, real peace in the Caucasus requires two key strategic transformations.
zh: 實際上，高加索地區的真正和平需要實現兩個關鍵性的戰略轉變。

en: One is a lesson from history: Russia’s strategic interests here cannot be ignored.
zh: 第一是吸取歷史教訓。

en: To believe and behave otherwise would lead to regional chaos.
zh: 俄國在這一地區的戰略利益不得忽視，否則將會導致地區混亂。

en: The other lesson is that Turkey and Armenia cannot remain adversaries forever.
zh: 第二個教訓是土耳其和亞美尼亞不能永遠為敵。

en: There must be normalization in our relations in order for the Caucasus to coalesce into a functional region.
zh: 兩國關係必須正常化才能讓高加索聯合成為一個可以運作的地區。

en: Ironically, both Russia and the United States recognize that this is in their interest.
zh: 具有諷刺意味的是，美俄兩國都承認這符合它們的利益。

en: The Russians view normal relations between Turkey and Armenia as a way to minimize Georgia’s strategic role in the region.
zh: 俄國認為，土耳其和亞美尼亞關係正常化可以把喬治亞在該地區的戰略作用降低到最小程度。

en: The US views an opening to Turkey as a way to decrease Armenia’s real and imagined reliance on Russia.
zh: 美國認為，向土耳其開放可以減少亞美尼亞對俄國實際和想象中的依賴。

en: Beyond the emotional impact of President Gul’s visit to Yerevan, real improvement in Turkish-Armenian relations requires opening the two countries’ closed border – the last in Europe.
zh: 居爾總統訪問埃裡溫除了具有情感上的影響之外，土耳其和亞美尼亞兩國關係得到實際改善要求開放兩國封閉的邊界。 這是歐洲範圍內最後封閉的邊界。

en: Or, for a start, the existing railroad link between the two countries could be made operational.
zh: 或者作為開始，兩國之間現有的鐵路連線應當投入執行。

en: If this does not happen within the coming weeks and months, then Turkey will have demonstrated that all this was just a show.
zh: 如果這一點在今後幾周或幾個月內無法實現，那麼，土耳其就會表明這一切都不過是演戲罷了。

en: President Gul’s visit does mark a watershed – either as a failure to make history, or as the beginning of a new era.
zh: 居爾總統的訪問的確具有分水嶺的意義，而這一分水嶺要麼是無法創造歷史，要麼是新時代的開始。

en: Truth and Consequences
zh: 真相與後果

en: NEW YORK – The recent re-election of Colombia’s president, Juan Manuel Santos, brings hope to a country seeking to end a half-century of conflict.
zh: 紐約 — — 不久前哥倫比亞總統胡安·曼努埃爾·桑托斯競選連任為結束該國半個世紀的衝突帶來了希望。

en: But, as with so many peace processes, finding a balance between creating a stable accord and acknowledging the terrible injustices that occurred during the conflict can be difficult to achieve.
zh: 但是像其他眾多和平程序一樣，在簽署穩定協議和承認衝突中發生的可怕的不公正之間找到平衡或許很難做到。

en: Many countries and communities, from Nepal to Northern Ireland, have grappled with legacies of ethnic, ideological, or religious division and violence, often with limited success.
zh: 從尼泊爾到北愛爾蘭的很多國家和團體一直在設法解決民族、意識形態、宗教分裂和暴力領域的遺留問題，但成功的先例卻少之又少。

en: This is frequently the case because the mechanisms established to cope with post-conflict reconciliation, truth, and justice, have proved inadequate.
zh: 歸根結底是因為事實已經證明處理衝突後和解、真相和正義的機制遠遠不夠。

en: In Bosnia and Herzegovina, the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) has made important contributions to truth seeking.
zh: 在波斯尼亞和黑塞哥維那，前南問題國際刑事法庭（ICTY）為揭露真相做出了重要貢獻。

en: But victims complain that its procedures are slow and abstruse; and many Bosnian Serbs are convinced that the tribunal is selective and politically motivated.
zh: 但受害者抱怨其程式遲緩晦澀；很多波黑塞族相信法庭是有選擇性和政治動機的。

en: An agreement between Nepal’s government and Maoist guerrillas to establish a truth commission and investigate the “disappeared” was delayed for seven years.
zh: 尼泊爾政府和毛派游擊隊之間成立真相委員會調查“失蹤人員”的協議被推遲了七年之久。

en: When legislators finally enacted the enabling legislation in May 2013, victims were dismayed to discover that the commission would be allowed to recommend amnesties for crimes against humanity, in contravention of international principles and United Nations guidelines.
zh: 當立法者終於在2013年5月頒佈授權法案時，受害者驚惶地發現該委員會居然有權建議赦免反人類罪，這悍然違反了國際原則和聯合國準則。

en: In Northern Ireland, the Good Friday Agreement, justly acclaimed for staunching the bloodshed and starting reconciliation, has – to the great frustration of victims – run into political resistance over one integral element of the peace process: the establishment of mechanisms to clarify past crimes.
zh: 北愛爾蘭終止流血並啟動和解的耶穌受難日協定理應受到讚譽，但令受害者沮喪的是，和平程序的一個組成部分 — — 建立調查過去罪行的機制 — — 遭遇的政治阻力非常之強。

en: Peace negotiators understandably fear that criminal accountability for past crimes will threaten their side’s leaders and supporters.
zh: 和平談判代表擔心追究過去罪行的刑事責任會威脅本方領導人和支持者的安全是有道理的。

en: Many have wrongly assumed – based on a misinterpretation of the South African experience – that truth commissions provide a “soft” alternative to justice.
zh: 很多人基於對南非經驗的誤解認為真相委員會比法律制裁更加“柔和 ” 。

en: As a result, they have willingly incorporated these mechanisms into peace agreements (conveniently ignoring the fact that the victims are forced to choose between seeking justice and learning the truth).
zh: 他們因此很願意把上述機制載入和平協定（由此正中下懷地忽略了受害者被迫要在正義和真相間做出選擇 ） 。

en: Predictably, as truth commissions have become established components of transitional justice, former fighters have become increasingly worried that their reputations and political credibility could be on the line should past crimes ever come to light.
zh: 可以想見，隨著真相委員會成為過渡正義的組成部分，曾經的武裝份子越來越擔心曝光過去的罪行會影響他們的聲譽和政治可信度。

en: Seeking the truth can be unsettling and painful for anyone, but it comes with serious consequences for those with reason to fear justice.
zh: 瞭解真相對任何人來講都伴隨著不安和痛苦，但卻會為那些有理由害怕制裁的人帶來嚴重的後果。

en: Indeed, conflict mediation and transitional justice rely on truth commissions as a fundamental building block of peace not because such commissions provide impunity for the worst crimes; on the contrary, they reinforce comprehensive rights-based policies and access to justice.
zh: 事實上，真相委員會作為衝突調解和過渡司法的和平基礎並不是因為其對最惡劣的犯罪行為免於懲罰；恰恰相反，它們落實了以權利為基礎的全面的法律和政策。

en: As a recent symposium, organized by the Kofi Annan Foundation and the International Center for Transitional Justice, concluded, truth commissions contribute most to peace by reasserting the rule of law, recognizing victims, and supporting institutional reform.
zh: 不久前由科菲·安南基金會和國際過渡時期司法中心舉辦的研討會得出結論，真相委員會透過恢復法治、承認受害者權利和支援機構改革而對和平貢獻最大。

en: But, in order to succeed, these commissions must be effective, independent, and legitimate.
zh: 但真相委員會成功的前提是高效、獨立、合法。

en: Half-measures will not do.
zh: 僅靠權宜之計不可能實現目標。

en: Truth commissions therefore should never be established as “box-ticking” exercises to assuage local public opinion or the international community, as witnessed in Nepal.
zh: 因此永遠也不要像尼泊爾那樣讓真相委員會淪為緩和當地或國際社會公眾輿論的象徵性機構。

en: Even when broad mandates and functions are established with the best of intentions, truth commissions are often deprived of the necessary resources, leading to further frustration and disillusion.
zh: 即使劃定廣泛的任務和職能範圍完全出於好意，但真相委員會卻往往得不到必要的資源，導致民眾進一步信心受挫、理想幻滅。

en: Moreover, a commission should not be led or staffed by individuals of questionable integrity, thereby undermining the legitimacy of the process.
zh: 此外，委員會不應默許品格有問題的人領導或參與，否則可能對程式的合法性構成威脅。

en: Above all, truth commissions must be adapted to a country’s particular circumstances.
zh: 總之，真相委員會必須與國家的具體情況相適應。

en: As we have seen in Bosnia, Colombia, Nepal, Northern Ireland, and elsewhere, the nature of conflicts and how they are resolved differ widely; so should their respective commissions.
zh: 我們已經在波斯尼亞、哥倫比亞、尼泊爾、北愛爾蘭和其他國家看到衝突的性質和解決的方法有很大不同；因此各國委員會應當本著因地制宜的原則。

en: A “one-size-fits-all” solution ends up fitting no one.
zh: “一刀切”的解決方案不適合任何國家。

en: It is vital that the details of each case of post-conflict transitional justice are understood and implemented.
zh: 理解並落實每宗過渡期司法個案的細節非常重要。

en: It is all too easy for political leaders to ignore victims or suppress the truth in their quest for a peace deal.
zh: 在試圖簽署和平協定時忽視受害者或隱瞞真相是政治領導人最容易犯的錯誤。

en: But recognizing victims’ rights is an indispensable condition for lasting peace.
zh: 但實現持久和平不可缺少的條件是承認受害者的權利。

en: Human suffering and victims’ dignity are too powerful to be erased by others’ political pacts.
zh: 任何人的政治協定都不能以罔顧人類苦難和受害者尊嚴為代價。

en: Eventually, the past demands its due: justice is not just an ideal; it is an investment in a better future.
zh: 最後，我們必須總結過去的經驗教訓：正義不僅是種理想；也是投資於更好的未來。

en: Alan Greenspan on Trial
zh: 審判格林斯潘

en: The release of Alan Greenspan’s ghostwritten memoirs The Age of Turbulence has elicited charges that he was not such a great central banker after all.
zh: 阿蘭•格林斯潘由他人捉刀的回憶錄《動盪歲月》出版以來，引發了認為他不是一位出色的央行行長的指責。

en: Stan Collender of National Journal sees the fingerprints of the White House on these attacks: Greenspan is harshly critical of George W. Bush’s administration, after all, and to attack the credibility of Republican ex-policymakers who are critical of Bush is standard counterpunching for it.
zh: National Journal 的Stan Collender在這些攻擊當中發現了白宮的影子：畢竟格林斯潘是布什政府的嚴厲批評者，而對一個對布什持批評態度的共和黨前政策制定者的公信力發動攻擊是不折不扣的報復手段。

en: But what is one to make of the criticisms of Greenspan’s tenure at the Federal Reserve?
zh: 但對格林斯潘執掌美聯儲的生涯橫加指責又有什麼道理呢？

en: The indictment contains four counts: that Greenspan wrongly cheered the growth of non-standard adjustable-rate mortgages, which fueled the housing bubble; that he wrongly endorsed Bush’s tax cuts; that he should have reined in the stock market bubble of the 1990’s; and that he should have done the same with the real estate bubble of the 2000’s.
zh: 這種指責包括四個要點：格林斯潘錯誤地鼓勵了非標準、可變利率按揭貸款的增長，而這就為房產泡沫推波助瀾；他錯誤地執行了布什的減稅政策；他本可以遏制1990年代的股市泡沫；他本可以同樣地制止本世紀初的不動產泡沫。

en: To the first two counts, Greenspan now pleads guilty.
zh: 對於前兩項罪名，格林斯潘供認不諱。

en: He says that he did not understand how the growth of non-standard mortgages had lured borrowers and investors into bearing dangerous risks.
zh: 他說他不明白為什麼非標準按揭貸款的增長會誘使借款人和投資人不顧風險趨之若鶩。

en: He was, he now says, focusing on how fixed-rate mortgages are relatively bad deals for borrowers in times of low inflation, which was a mistake.
zh: 現在他說當時錯誤地關注了為什麼固定利率按揭貸款在低通脹時期對借款人而言是不合理的。

en: Greenspan also pleads guilty to a mistake in early 2001.
zh: 格林斯潘還對2001年初的錯誤認罪。

en: He thought that he was giving balanced testimony to Congress on government budget issues.
zh: 他以為自己就政府預算問題在國會所作的證詞是合適的。

en: He testified that it is important to run surpluses to pay down the debt, but that surpluses must not be so large that the government winds up owning American industry.
zh: 他作證說利用盈餘償還債務是重要的。 但財政盈餘的規模不能大到使政府最終掌控美國的工業。

en: He also testified that tax cuts are better than spending increases to keep surpluses from growing too large, but that uncertainty is enormous, so that any tax cuts should be canceled if they threatened to bring us back to an age of deficits.
zh: 他還作證說減稅比提高支出更能將盈餘控制在一定的規模，但同時它也有相當的不確定性，因此任何有可能使我們重回財政赤字時代的減稅政策都應該取消。

en: Robert Rubin and Kent Conrad warned him that the press would not interpret his testimony as being balanced, and that Congress would interpret it as an excuse to abandon fiscal discipline.
zh: 羅伯特•魯賓 和 肯特•康拉德都警告他說新聞界不會認為他的證詞是合適的，且國會也會將其理解為一種放棄財政紀律的藉口。

en: They were right.
zh: 事情果然被他們言中了。

en: Greenspan also pleads guilty to misunderstanding the character of the Bush administration.
zh: 格林斯潘還承認誤解了布什政府的特點。

en: He thought that his old reality-based friends from the Ford administration were back in power.
zh: 他還以為是自己在福特政府的注重現實的老朋友又重新掌權了。

en: He thought that he – and Treasury Secretary Paul O’Neill – could win the quiet “inside game” for sensible policy without resorting to an “outside game” that would make his reappointment in 2004 unlikely.
zh: 他以為他—和財政部長保羅•奧尼爾—能夠透過兵不血刃的“內部博弈”贏得理智的政策而不用訴諸可能會使他2004年連任失敗的“外部博弈 ” 。

en: He was wrong.
zh: 他錯了。

en: But how serious are these policy-political crimes to which Greenspan now pleads guilty?
zh: 但這些現在讓格林斯潘供認不諱的政策—政治罪行究竟有多嚴重呢？

en: In my view, they are misdemeanors.
zh: 在我看來，他們只是小過錯。

en: Against them you have to set what former Treasury Secretary Larry Summers calls Greenspan’s “golden glove” performance at avoiding and minimizing recessions during his years at the Fed.
zh: 你必須把它們放在被前財長拉里•薩默斯稱為格林斯潘的“金手套”表現（即在其執掌美聯儲的歲月裡規避及遏制經濟衰退）的背景上來衡量。

en: The “felonies” of which Greenspan stands accused are the other two charges: that he should have done more to stop the stock market bubble of the late 1990’s, and that he should have done more to stop the housing bubble of the early 2000’s.
zh: 對於格林斯潘的兩項“重罪”指控是：他本應該更努力地制止1990年代的股市泡沫和本世紀初的房地產泡沫。

en: Here, Greenspan holds his ground, and pleads not guilty.
zh: 而在這兩點上，格林斯潘堅定地為自己進行無罪申辯。

en: The only way, he says, for the Fed to have kept stock prices in reasonable equilibrium ranges in the late 1990’s would have been to raise interest rates so high that they hit the real economy on the head with a brick.
zh: 他說，對美聯儲而言在1990年代末將股價控制在一個合理的平衡區間的唯一辦法就是把利率加高到對經濟當頭一棒的水平。

en: Interest rates high enough to curb stock market speculation would also have curbed construction and other forms of investment, raised unemployment, and sent the economy into recession.
zh: 利率高到足夠遏止股市的投機行為，也就會遏制建設和其他形式的投資、提高失業率並使經濟陷入衰退。

en: To cause a significant current evil in order to avoid a possible future danger when our knowledge is limited and our judgments uncertain is, Greenspan believes, unwise.
zh: 格林斯潘認為為了規避未來的危險而製造殘酷現實的策略在我們所知有限且判斷不明的情況下是不明智的。

en: In this, he is following a tradition of caution that extends from Edmund Burke to John Maynard Keynes.
zh: 在這一點上他所遵循的是從伯克到凱恩斯的一貫審慎。

en: Greenspan mounts a similar defense concerning the housing bubble.
zh: 格林斯潘對有關房地產泡沫的指控進行了類似的辯護。

en: High construction employment has been good for American workers in the past half-decade – a period that has not produced much good for them.
zh: 建築業的高就業率在過去五年以來對美國的工人而言是有利的—這一時期總體上並未給他們帶來多收好處。

en: Higher interest rates to reduce the housing boom seem, even in retrospect, ill advised if the cost is mass unemployment.
zh: 用高利率來給過熱的房地產市場降溫，如果其代價是大規模的失業，那麼即便現在回頭看來也是不可取的。

en: And Greenspan eschews paternalism: he would not assume the role of a regulator telling people that they cannot buy a house even though a lender is willing to finance it.
zh: 並且格林斯潘還避免家長式的作風：他不想扮演一個告訴人們即便貸方願意融資也不要買房的監管者角色。

en: But Greenspan would have served the country and the world better if he had been somewhat more paternalist in slowing the growth of non-standard adjustable-rate mortgages.
zh: 但格林斯潘如果在減緩非標準可變利率按揭貸款的增長方面多一點家長式的作風，那麼這對美國和世界本應該更好。
