en: But any cure would have to be administered before the plaques form, and years before symptoms of dementia appear.
zh: 但需要在這些斑塊形成前進行治療才行，這時距離出現痴呆症狀還有幾年時間。

en: Alzheimer’s might be more predictable if scientists had the time and resources to conduct far-reaching longitudinal studies over many years.
zh: 如果科學家有時間和資源進行為期多年的深入的縱向研究，阿爾茨海默症的可預測性可能會有所提高。

en: Such studies ideally would involve blood, imaging, memory, and medical tests, as well as detailed lifestyle questionnaires filled out by thousands of young and middle-aged people.
zh: 這些研究最好包括對數千青年和中年人進行血液、影像、記憶和醫學測試以及詳細的生活方式問卷調查。

en: Study participants would be followed over decades to see who developed the disease, and which tests proved positive before Alzheimer’s was diagnosed.
zh: 研究參與者將受到為期數十年的跟蹤，以觀察誰發展出阿爾茨海默症，哪些測試在阿爾茨海默症獲得診斷之前就能有所察覺。

en: In fact, two famous longitudinal studies – the Framingham Heart Study in Massachusetts and the Kungsholmen Project in Sweden – have led to important progress in predicting the disease.
zh: 事實上，兩項著名的縱向研究 — — 馬薩諸塞州的弗萊明漢姆心臟研究（Framingham Heart Study）和瑞典的國王島專案（Kungsholmen Project）在阿爾茨海默症的預測方面獲得了重要進展。

en: These studies found that short-term memory may be impaired for up to ten years before an Alzheimer’s diagnosis.
zh: 這些研究發現，在阿爾茨海默症被診斷出十年前，就有可能出現短期記憶損害。

en: Major advances have since been made in brain imaging, biochemical analysis, and, perhaps most important, genetic testing.
zh: 此後，大腦造影、生化分析以及 — — 也許是最重要的 — — 基因測試取得了重大進展。

en: Indeed, the risk of Alzheimer’s doubles if a parent or sibling has it, probably due in large part to the presence of the ApoE gene.
zh: 事實上，如果雙親或兄弟姐妹中有人罹患阿爾茨海默症，你的患病風險也將翻番，這很有可能是因為ApoE基因所賜。

en: The risk triples for Europeans who inherit a particular type of ApoE, called ε4; inheriting two copies of ε4 increases the risk roughly tenfold.
zh: 遺傳了某種ApoE基因（ε4）的歐洲人得阿爾茨海默症的機率會增加兩倍；遺傳雙份ε4基因會讓機率增加大約十倍。

en: But genetic testing alone is unlikely to be an accurate predictor, because around half of Alzheimer’s sufferers do not carry ε4, and probably half of those with ε4 do not develop the disease.
zh: 但光靠基因測試無法作為準確的指標，因為大約一半的阿爾茨海默症患者不攜帶ε4，並且可能有一半的ε4攜帶者不會發生阿爾茨海默症。

en: Moreover, though international studies of more than 70,000 people have found over 20 other genes linked to Alzheimer’s, their impact is minimal.
zh: 此外，儘管對70,000多人的國際研究表明有20多個基因與阿爾茨海默症有關，但它們的作用很小。

en: That said, a groundbreaking 2012 study published in the New England Journal of Medicine, analyzed a rare genetic mutation found in just 500 families around the world, which would lead to Alzheimer’s before the age of 50.
zh: 儘管如此 ， 《 新英格蘭醫學期刊 》 （ New England Journal of Medicine）上發表的一篇2012年的突破性研究分析了一個只在全世界500個家族身上發生的罕見基因突變，該突變會導致50歲前罹患阿爾茨海默症。

en: The study showed which tests were able to predict the outcome most accurately decades ahead of onset.
zh: 研究表明了那些測試可以在症狀出現前幾十年最準確地預測結果。

en: The research found that amyloid-beta – the substance that clumps together and forms amyloid plaques – becomes depleted in the cerebrospinal fluid around the brain as long as 25 years before the onset of dementia.
zh: 研究發現，乙型澱粉樣蛋白（amyloid-beta，這種物質會結團形成澱粉樣斑塊）會在痴呆症狀出現前25年就消失於大腦周邊的腦脊液中。

en: Fifteen years prior to onset, a positron emission tomography (PET) scan showed amyloid-beta being deposited in plaques in the brain itself.
zh: 痴呆症狀出現前十五年，正電子發射成像術（PET）掃描顯示乙型澱粉樣蛋白正在大腦本身的斑塊中堆積。

en: And detailed short-term memory tests were abnormal ten years before onset, as suggested in the Framingham and Kungsholmen studies.
zh: 弗萊明漢姆和國王島研究表明，痴呆症狀出現前十年，詳細短期記憶測試會有不正常表現。

en: These tests are now becoming part of clinical practice, and are available commercially.
zh: 這些測試目前正在成為臨床實踐的一部分，並以投入商業應用。

en: Memory and other cognitive tests can reveal whether one has minor problems with some aspects of thinking – a condition known as “mild cognitive impairment” that precedes Alzheimer’s disease.
zh: 記憶和其他認知測試可以揭示你是否在思維的某些方面存在小問題 — — 所謂的“溫和認知損傷 ” ， 常常在阿爾茨海默症之前出現。

en: The problem is that the tests must be administered by a trained neuropsychologist and take more than an hour to complete; moreover, many people with mild cognitive impairment do not progress to dementia.
zh: 問題是這些測試必須由受過訓練的神經心理學家進行，需要一個多小時時間完成；此外，許多有溫和認知損傷的人並不會出現痴呆。

en: Sampling cerebrospinal fluid via a lumbar puncture (or “spinal tap”) can predict which people with mild cognitive impairment will progress to dementia with over 80% accuracy, but this still means a misdiagnosis for one in five patients.
zh: 透過腰椎穿刺（或“脊椎抽��� ” ） 進行腦脊液取樣可以預測存在溫和認知損傷的人是否會出現痴呆，準確率在80%以上，但這仍然意味著每五人就有一人遭遇誤診。

en: PET scans are slightly less accurate, while routine MRI brain scans can reveal with perhaps only 70% accuracy subtle abnormalities in people with mild cognitive impairment.
zh: PET掃描準確率略低，而常規的MRI腦部掃描大概只能揭示70%的存在溫和認知損傷人士的準確微小異常。

en: Scientists are therefore still searching for an accurate predictive test that is cheaper, quicker, and less invasive than PET scans or lumbar punctures.
zh: 因此，科學家仍在尋找比PET掃描或腰椎穿刺更廉價、更快速、更加不痛苦的準確預測測試方法。

en: This year, two small studies of blood tests seemed to predict Alzheimer’s 1-3 years before it occurred, but the tests are complicated and require the measurement of ten or more substances.
zh: 今年，兩項小型血液測試研究似乎可以在阿爾茨海默症出現前1—3年作出預測，但測試很複雜，需要測量十種或以上物質。

en: Whichever predictive methods doctors use over the next few years will probably enable them to inform those patients with mild cognitive impairment about their chances of developing Alzheimer’s in the short term.
zh: 不管未來幾年醫生使用什麼預測方法，也許都能使他們能夠告知存在溫和認知損傷的患者短期內罹患阿爾茨海默症的機率。

en: The trickier question is whether we will be able to predict Alzheimer’s disease accurately in those with normal cognition and memory, or to predict it more than five years in advance.
zh: 更困難的問題是我們是否能夠準確預測認知和記憶能力正常人士的阿爾茨海默症，或在阿爾茨海默症出現五年前就做出預測。

en: Even if accurate early prediction of Alzheimer’s eventually is achieved, there are currently no drugs available to prevent or cure it before the amyloid plaques start destroying the mind.
zh: 即使最終實現了阿爾茨海默症的早期準確預測，目前也沒有藥物能夠在澱粉樣斑塊破壞思維之前預防或治療阿爾茨海默症。

en: That will be our next great challenge.
zh: 這將是下一個大挑戰。

en: Africa’s Necessary Data Revolution
zh: 非洲需要資料革命

en: WASHINGTON, DC – Since the term “data revolution” was introduced, there has been a flurry of activity to define, develop, and implement an agenda to transform the collection, use, and distribution of development statistics.
zh: 華盛頓—自從“資料革命”一詞出現以來，湧現出大量動作定義、發展和實施日程以改變發展統計資料的收集、使用和分配。

en: That makes sense.
zh: 這是有意義的事情。

en: Assessing the international community’s next development agenda, regardless of its details, will be impossible without accurate data.
zh: 要想評估國際社會的下一個發展日程（不管其細節如何 ） ， 沒有準確地資料是萬萬不能的。

en: Yet, in Sub-Saharan Africa – the region with the most potential for progress under the forthcoming Sustainable Development Goals – accurate data are severely lacking.
zh: 但是，在撒哈拉以南非洲 — — 在即將到來的可持續發展目標（Sustainable Development Goals）的指引下，該地區擁有最大的進步潛力 — — 極度缺乏準確資料。

en: From 1990 to 2009, only one Sub-Saharan country had data on all 12 indicators established in 2000 by the Millennium Development Goals.
zh: 從1990年到2009年，只有一個撒哈拉以南國家擁有2000年千年發展目標（Millennium Development Goals）所制定的全部12項指標的資料。

en: Indeed, of the 60 countries with complete vital statistics, not one is in Africa.
zh: 事實上，在關鍵統計資料完備的60個國家中，沒有一個是非洲國家。

en: While most African countries have likely experienced economic growth during the last decade, the accuracy of the data on which growth estimates are based – not to mention data on inflation, food production, education, and vaccination rates – remains far from adequate.
zh: 儘管大部分非洲國家在過去十年中都經歷了經濟增長，但作為增長估算的基礎的資料的準確性仍有較大差距，更不用說通貨膨脹、糧食生產、教育和疫苗接種率等資料了。

en: Inaccurate data can have serious consequences.
zh: 失準的資料可能造成嚴重後果。

en: Consider Nigeria’s experience earlier this year, when GDP rebasing showed that the economy was nearly 90% larger than previously thought.
zh: 以今年早些時候的奈及利亞為例，GDP重估表明該國經濟比此前認為的要大近90 % 。

en: The distorted picture of Nigeria’s economy provided by the previous statistics likely led to misguided decisions regarding private investment, credit ratings, and taxation.
zh: 此前的資料對奈及利亞經濟的扭曲刻畫可能導致私人投資、信用評級和稅收等方面的決策不當。

en: Moreover, it meant that Nigeria was allocated more international aid than it merited – aid that could have gone to needier countries.
zh: 此外，這意味著奈及利亞獲得了比它所應該獲得的更多的國際援助 — — 這些援助本可以用於更加需要的國家。

en: Contrary to popular belief, the constraints on the production and use of basic data stem not from a shortage of technical capacity and knowhow, but from underlying political and systemic challenges.
zh: 與流行觀點相反，基本資料生產和使用的約束並非來自技術能力和知識的欠缺，而是來自基本政治和制度挑戰。

en: For starters, national statistical offices often lack the institutional autonomy needed to protect the integrity of data, production of which thus tends to be influenced by political forces and special interest groups.
zh: 首先，國家統計部門往往沒有保證資料完整性的自主權，導致資料容易受到政治勢力和特殊利益集團的左右。

en: Poorly designed policies also undermine the accuracy of data.
zh: 設計不當的政策也妨礙了資料的準確性。

en: For example, governments and donors sometimes tie funding to self-reported measures, which creates incentives for recipients to over-report key data like vaccination or school-enrollment rates.
zh: 比如，政府和出資方有時讓資金與自我報告措施掛鉤，這就給受助者造成了誇大關鍵資料（如疫苗接種率和入學率）的激勵。

en: Without effective oversight, these well-intentioned efforts to reward progress can go awry.
zh: 沒有有效監督，這些本意良好的獎勵進步計劃有可能適得其反。

en: Despite these failings, national governments and international donors continue to devote far too few resources to ensuring the collection of adequate data.
zh: 儘管存在這些弊端，但國家政府和國際出資者用於確保收集足夠資料的投入仍然太少。

en: Only 2% of official development aid is earmarked for improving the quality of statistics – an amount wholly insufficient to assess accurately the impact of the other 98% of aid.
zh: 只有2%的官方發展援助被用於改善資料質量 — — 這一數字完全不足以準確評估其他98%的援助所產生的效果。

en: And governments’ dependency on donors to fund and gather their core statistics is unsustainable.
zh: 而政府依賴出資者供資和收集核心統計資料的做法也是不可持續的。

en: In fact, stronger national statistical systems are the first step toward improving the accuracy, timeliness, and availability of the data that are essential to calculating almost any major economic or social-welfare indicator.
zh: 事實上，加強國家統計資料體系是改善資料準確率、及時性和易得性的第一步。 對於計算幾乎每一個重要經濟和社會福利指標，資料的準確率、及時性和易得性都是至關重要的。

en: These include statistics on births and deaths; growth and poverty; tax and trade; health, education, and safety; and land and the environment.
zh: 這些統計資料包括出生和死亡資料、增長和貧困資料、稅收和貿易資料、衛生、教育和安全資料，以及土地和環境資料等。

en: Developing such systems is an ambitious but achievable goal.
zh: 發展這樣的制度是遠大但可實現的目標。

en: All that is needed is a willingness to experiment with new approaches to collecting, using, and sharing data.
zh: 所需要的只是實驗新方法以收集、使用和共享資料的意願。

en: This is where the public comes in.
zh: 公眾可以在這方面起作用。

en: If private firms, media, and civil-society organizations identify specific problems and call publicly for change, their governments will feel pressure to take the steps needed to produce accurate, unbiased data – for example, by enhancing the autonomy of national statistical offices or providing sufficient funds to hire more qualified personnel.
zh: 如果私人企業、媒體和公民社會組織認識到具體問題並公開呼呼變革，政府就會感到壓力採取所需步驟產生準確、無偏的資料 — — 如透過加強國家統計部門的自治權或拿出足夠資金聘請資質更好的人手。

en: While it may be tempting to bypass government and hope for an easy technology-based solution, sustainable, credible progress will be difficult without public-sector involvement.
zh: 繞過政府、寄希望於簡單的基於技術的解決方案或許很有誘惑力，但若無公共部門參與，很難產生持續而可信的進展。

en: The recognition by governments and external donors of the need for more – and more efficient – funding, particularly to national statistical systems, will be integral to such a shift.
zh: 政府和外部出資者認識到增加資金規模和效率的必要性（特別是國家統計制度問題）將有利於這一轉變。

en: Establishing stronger incentives for agencies to produce good data – that is, data that are accurate, timely, relevant, and readily available – would also help, with clearly delineated metrics defining what qualifies as “good.”
zh: 為有關部門提供產生優質資料（即更準確、及時、相關並且可隨時檢索的資料）的更強的激勵也大有裨益，但要明確定義衡量“優質”的指標。

en: In fact, tying progress on those metrics to funding via pay-for-performance agreements could improve development outcomes considerably.
zh: 事實上，用指標衡量進步，並採取按表現出資的協議可以大量改善開發成果。

en: One concrete strategy to achieve these goals would be to create a country-donor compact for better data.
zh: 一個實現這些目標的具體戰略是訂立關於改善資料的國家-出資者契約。

en: Such a compact would enable governments and donors to express their shared intention to build a national statistics system over a period of several years, with clear and verifiable milestones.
zh: 這一契約能讓政府和出資者明確在幾年的時間裡建立國家統計制度的共同意願，並定義明確可證的里程碑。

en: It would also provide a country-specific framework for innovation on funding mechanisms and the engagement of civil society and the private sector, while mobilizing new technologies for data collection and dissemination.
zh: 這樣還能提供因國而異的融資機制創新框架以及公民社會和私人部門參與框架，同時動員資料收集和傳播的新技術。

en: In short, a data compact would help to mobilize and focus domestic and donor funding to achieve national statistical priorities.
zh: 簡言之，資料契約有助於動員和集中國內和出資者資金實現國家統計資料的當務之急。

en: Data are the currency of performance, accountability, and credibility in the global economy, and improvements in data have been linked to better governance and higher levels of private investment.
zh: 資料是全球經濟績效、問責和信譽的通貨，改善資料與改善治理和增加私人投資息息相關。

en: That is just what Africa needs to support a new decade of growth and development.
zh: 非洲想要支援增長和發展的新十年，需要的正是改善資料。

en: The Experts’ Advantage
zh: 專家優勢

en: LONDON – Nearly everyone who sits on Google’s board of directors has at least one computer science or engineering degree or doctorate.
zh: 倫敦 — — 谷歌董事會每位董事幾乎都握有至少一個電腦科學或工程學位，或者擁有博士學位。

en: There are two university presidents and eminent scholars – Stanford University’s John Hennessy and former Princeton University President Shirley Tilghman – and several members of the National Academy of Engineering and other illustrious organizations.
zh: 其中有斯坦福的約翰·軒尼詩及前普林斯頓的雪莉·蒂爾曼兩位大學校長兼知名學者 — — 還有美國國家工程學院和其他著名機構的幾位院士。

en: For Google, it pays to have technical expertise at the top.
zh: 對谷歌而言，技術專家坐鎮高層自有其好處。

en: But Google is an unusual corporate giant in promoting those with scientific prowess to the top of the management ladder.
zh: 但谷歌在提拔具有科技實力的高管方面卻稱得起是非同尋常的企業巨頭。

en: Beyond Silicon Valley, few senior corporate executives boast technical expertise in the products that their companies produce.
zh: 在矽谷以外，鮮有企業高管掌握本企業產品領域的技術專長。

en: American boardrooms are filled with MBAs, especially from Harvard, while firms in the rest of the developed world (with the possible exception of Germany) seem to prefer professional managers over technical or scientific talent.
zh: 美國董事會幾乎成了以哈佛為首的MBA的天下，而其他發達國家（可能除德國以外）似乎相比科技人才更願意聘用職業經理人。

en: Nowadays, it seems as anomalous to have knowledge workers serve as professional leaders as it once did to have scientists in the boardroom.
zh: 今天像以往那樣讓知識型員工任專業領導、讓科學家進入董事會似乎已不太尋常。

en: It was previously thought that leadership is less necessary in knowledge-intensive organizations, where experts were assumed to be superior because they were motivated by intellectual pleasure rather than such extrinsic motivations as profit growth and cost targets.
zh: 人們曾認為知識密集型機構沒有太大必要設定領導，因為人們曾普遍認為專家相對於利潤增長和成本目標等外在動機更看重學術滿足感是一種優勢。

en: This difference in attitude is evident in many areas of society, not least in hospitals in the United States and the United Kingdom, where knowledge-intensive medical practitioners operate separately from managers.
zh: 這種觀念上的差異在社會眾多領域顯而易見，尤其是在英美兩國醫院，掌握大量知識的執業醫生與管理者分開工作。

en: Hospitals used to be run by doctors; today, only 5% of US hospitals’ CEOs are medical doctors, and even fewer doctors run UK hospitals.
zh: 醫生曾經是醫院的管理者，但今天只有5%的美國醫院由醫生出任執行長，而管理英國醫院的醫生則更是少之又少。

en: “Medicine should be left to the doctors,” according to a common refrain, “and organizational leadership should be left to professional managers.”
zh: 現代人常說“醫學問題就留給醫生去操心，而職業經理人則應當在組織中擔任領導角色。 ”

en: But this is a mistake.
zh: 但這種理解是個誤區。

en: Research shows that higher-performing US hospitals are likely to be led by doctors with outstanding research reputations, not by management professionals.
zh: 研究表明高效的美國醫院由科研聲譽卓著的醫生管理，而不���專門管理人員的可能性更高。

en: The evidence also suggests that hospitals perform better, and have lower death rates, when more of their managers up to board level are clinically trained.
zh: 此外還有證據表明如果董事會管理者接受過臨床培訓，那麼醫院總體業績更好、死亡率也更低。

en: We see similar findings in other fields.
zh: 其他領域的發現也十分類似。

en: My research shows that the world’s best universities, for example, are likely to be led by exceptional scholars whose performance continues to improve over time.
zh: 比方說，我所做的研究表明全世界最好的大學可能是由出色的學者領導，而他們的績效往往隨著時間的推移而不斷提高。

en: Departmental-level analysis supports this.
zh: 部門一級的分析資料也支援這種觀點。

en: A university economics department, for example, tends to perform better the more widely its head’s own research is cited.
zh: 打個比方，如果某大學經濟系主任的研究成果被廣泛引用，那麼該系的績效相應也會更為出色。

en: With experts in charge, it may not always look like there is an effective reporting structure in place.
zh: 專家管理時並不總需要有效的報告體制。

en: But, as the academic saying goes: just because you cannot herd cats, does not mean there is not a feline hierarchy.
zh: 但就像學術界一句俗語所說：雖然貓科動物很少成群活動，但並不等於不存在等級結構。

en: As with cats, academics operate a “relative hierarchy” in which the person in charge changes, depending on the setting.
zh: 就像貓科動物一樣，學者管理採取一種隨著管理者和環境不斷變化的“相對層次結構 ” 。

en: Even in the world of sports, where success is not an obvious preparation for management, we see interesting linkages between experience and organizational performance.
zh: 即使在運動成績並非明顯管理必備要素的體育界，我們也能在經驗和組織績效間看到某種有趣的聯絡。

en: The very best NBA basketball players often make top coaches, while former Formula 1 champion drivers are associated with great team performance.
zh: 最優秀的NBA籃球運動員往往能夠成為頂級教練，而前一級方程式冠軍車手執教的車隊大都也表現出色。

en: Of the 92 soccer clubs in the English football league, club managers played an average of 16 years in senior clubs.
zh: 92家英格蘭足球聯賽俱樂部經理在高階俱樂部的平均服役年限為16年。

en: Alex Ferguson, arguably Britain’s best manager, scored an average of one goal every two games in his professional career.
zh: 弗格森也許是全英國最好的足球經理，他在職業生涯中每兩場比賽打入一個球。

en: But where the pattern does occur, especially in the business world, we should take note.
zh: 但我們對以商界為代表的模式適用領域應當多加關注。

en: The senior partner of any professional services firm is likely to have been a top performer during a long career with the firm.
zh: 任何專業服務公司的高階合夥人很可能在其漫長的職業生涯中一直是該公司頂尖的執行者。

en: This might be because experts and professionals in knowledge-intensive organizations prefer a boss who has excelled in their field.
zh: 這或許是因為專家和知識密集型組織的專業人士更願意由在本領域取得過出類拔萃成績的老闆來領導自己的工作。

en: The leader’s credibility is vital: if she sets high standards, it seems only right that she should have matched or exceeded them herself.
zh: 領導者的信譽至關重要：如果她制定高標準，那麼這個標準她自己應該達到或者超過。

en: In short, she must lead by example.
zh: 總之，她必須能夠以身作則。

en: This sort of leadership arrangement creates a virtuous circle.
zh: 這種領導機制的迴圈是良性的。

en: A leader with prior experience knows how her subordinates feel, how to motivate them, and how to create the right working environment.
zh: 有過職業經歷的領導瞭解下屬的感受、懂得如何激勵下屬，以及如何創造良好的工作環境。

en: She probably makes better hiring decisions, too – after all, the best scientist or physician is more likely than a professional manager to know which researchers or doctors have the greatest potential.
zh: 她所做的聘用決定或許也更加合理 — — 最出色的科學家或醫生比職業經理人更有可能瞭解哪些研究員或者醫生的潛力最大。

en: The problem, however, is not simply that today’s leaders lack technical knowledge; it is that experts are often reluctant to lead.
zh: 但問題並不是今天的領導人缺乏技術知識那樣簡單；事實是專家往往不願意承擔領導工作。

en: But that can change.
zh: 但這種情況可以改變。

en: By communicating the importance of management and leadership early in a specialist’s career, and by offering tailored, digestible, and jargon-free training, we could bridge the gap.
zh: 如果在專家職業生涯的早期向其宣傳管理和領導工作的重要性並提供專門定製、易於消化且沒有專業術語的培訓，我們可以彌補這條鴻溝。

en: Many medical schools are already considering including management education as part of the curriculum.
zh: 很多醫學院已經在考慮把管理教育納入課程之中。

en: The trick is to get experts, who are trained to go ever deeper into their specialization, to step back and view the big picture.
zh: 關鍵是讓一向精於鑽研專業領域的專家退後一步，建立大局觀。

en: With the right preparation, there is no reason why a leader cannot specialize and manage.
zh: 只要正確引導，領導人可以在專業和管理領域同樣精通。

en: The results could be remarkable.
zh: 結果可能會令人讚歎。

en: Think of how governments run by scientists with management skills might respond to climate change.
zh: 想想由具有管理技能的科學家組成的政府可能會怎樣應對氣候變化。

en: Top minds should be put to top use.
zh: 頂級人才本來就應當被委以重任。

en: A Mania for Diagnosing Bipolar Disorder
zh: 雙相障礙診斷亂象

en: PROVIDENCE, RI – During the past few years, many experts have suggested that bipolar disorder – a serious illness resulting in significant psychosocial morbidity and excess mortality – is under-recognized, particularly in patients with major depression.
zh: 普洛韋登斯，羅得島 – 在過去的幾年裡，許多專家都認為雙相障礙（bipolar disorder ） - - 一種會造成重度社會心理病態和高死亡率的嚴重疾病—沒有得到足夠的重視，特別在患有嚴重抑鬱症的病人中更是如此。

en: Even patients who are diagnosed with bipolar disorder often wait more than 10 years after initially seeking treatment for the correct diagnosis to be made.
zh: 即便是被診斷為雙相障礙的病人，從最初的求診到最後的確診也往往會經歷十多年的時間。

en: The clinical implications of the failure to recognize bipolar disorder in depressed patients include the under-prescription of mood-stabilizing medications, and an increased risk of rapid “cycling” – swings between manic and depressive phases.
zh: 對抑鬱症患者雙相障礙的認識不夠在臨床上的反映包括情緒穩定藥物的使用不足和快速“迴圈 ” （ 即在狂躁與抑鬱階段之間搖擺）風險的增加。

en: But, perhaps as a consequence of concerted efforts to improve the recognition of bipolar disorder, during the past few years we have observed the emergence of an opposite phenomenon – over-diagnosis.
zh: 然而，同心協力提升對雙相障礙的認識的努力很可能產生了反作用。 在過去幾年裡我們觀察到了另一種極端的現象—過度診斷。

en: In my own practice, my colleagues and I have encountered patients who reported that they were previously diagnosed with bipolar disorder, despite lacking a history of manic or hypomanic episodes.
zh: 在我自己的從醫經歷中，我和同事們碰到過一些病人反映說他們雖然沒有過狂躁或輕度狂躁的情況，但也曾被診斷為雙相障礙。

en: To be sure, we have also seen patients seeking treatment for depression who really did have bipolar disorder.
zh: 當然，我們也的確看到有些因抑鬱求診的病人確實患有雙相障礙。

en: However, there seemed to be more over-diagnosis than under-diagnosis.
zh: 然而，過度診斷的情況似乎比診斷不足的情況多。

en: We therefore conducted a study to examine empirically how often bipolar disorder might be over- and under-diagnosed.
zh: 於是我們便展開了一項研究，從經驗的層面來考察雙相障礙被過度診斷和診斷不足的程度。

en: Seven hundred psychiatric outpatients were interviewed with the Structured Clinical Interview for DSM-IV (SCID) and completed a self-administered questionnaire that asked whether they had been previously diagnosed by a health-care professional with bipolar or manic-depressive disorder.
zh: 我們用《美國精神障礙診斷與統計手冊 》 （ 第4版）的結構化臨床問卷 （即人格障礙診斷問卷SCID）對七百名精神病科的門診病人進行了訪問並讓他們親自填寫了問卷，其內容是關於他們是否之前曾被醫療專業人員診斷為雙相或狂躁—抑鬱障礙。

en: Family history information was obtained from the patient regarding their immediate relatives.
zh: 我們還從病人處獲得了關於其近親的家庭病史的資訊。

en: Slightly more than 20% (145 patients) in our sample reported that they had been previously diagnosed as having bipolar disorder, significantly higher than the 12.9% rate based on the SCID.
zh: 抽樣病患中有20%多一點的人（145粒）報告之前曾被診斷為患有雙相障礙，這比基於SCID的12.9%的診斷率要高得多。

en: Less than half of those who reported that they had been previously diagnosed with bipolar disorder were diagnosed with bipolar disorder based on the SCID.
zh: 報告之前曾被診斷為患有雙相障礙的人之中根據SCID被確診為雙相障礙的不到一半。

en: Patients with SCID-diagnosed bipolar disorder had a significantly higher risk of bipolar disorder in their immediate family members than patients who self-reported a previous diagnosis of bipolar disorder that was not confirmed by the SCID.
zh: 透過此方法確診的雙相障礙患者與自己報告曾被診斷為雙相障礙但卻沒有被SCID確診的人相比較，前者的直系親屬罹患雙相障礙的風險要比後者的直系親屬高出許多。

en: Patients who self-reported a previous diagnosis of bipolar disorder that was not confirmed by the SCID did not have a significantly higher risk for bipolar disorder than the patients who were negative for bipolar disorder by self-report and the SCID.
zh: 後者患雙相障礙的風險也並不比自我報告和透過SCID診斷未患雙相障礙的病人高多少。

en: Our findings, validated by family history, thus suggest that bipolar disorder was over-diagnosed.
zh: 我們的研究發現經過家族病史的確認，從而顯示出雙相障礙被過度診斷的情況。

en: Any study seeking to determine whether a psychiatric disorder is over-diagnosed will find that some patients with the condition do not have it upon re-interview.
zh: 任何試圖判斷某種精神障礙是否被過度診斷的研究都會發現某種病情在病人再次問診時卻沒了蹤影。

en: Such is the nature of the imperfect reliability of psychiatric diagnosis.
zh: 這就是精神病學診斷的可靠性具有缺陷的特點。

en: The question, then, is not whether some patients previously given a diagnosis do not seem to have it upon re-interview, but rather how many.
zh: 因此，真正的問題就不在於是否有的曾被確診病人再次求診時似乎全然無恙，而是這樣的病人有多少。

en: How high the percentage should be before claiming over-diagnosis is a significant problem and a value judgment.
zh: 診斷的百分比應該達到多高才能說過度診斷是個嚴重的問題—這是個價值判斷。

en: But we think that an over-diagnosis rate of more than 50% crosses the clinical significance threshold.
zh: 但我們認為高於50%的過度診斷率超過了臨床意義的極限。

en: Over-diagnosis of bipolar disorder has costs.
zh: 雙相障礙的過度診斷會造成不良後果。

en: Mood stabilizers are the treatment of choice, and, depending on the medication, they can produce potentially significant health complications affecting renal, endocrine, hepatic, immunologic, or metabolic function.
zh: 情緒穩定藥物是一種治療的選擇。 根據藥物的不同，它們可能造成嚴重的併發症，影響腎臟、內分泌、肝臟、免疫系統或代謝功能。

en: Thus, over-diagnosing bipolar disorder can unnecessarily expose patients to serious side-effects of medication.
zh: 因此，雙相障礙的過度診斷可能讓病人不必要地承受嚴重的藥物副作用。

en: The impact of marketing efforts by pharmaceutical companies and publicity probably plays a role in the emerging tendency to over-diagnose bipolar disorder.
zh: 製藥公司的營銷和宣傳的影響很可能也對雙相障礙的過度診斷的趨勢起到了推波助瀾的作用。

en: Direct-to-consumer advertisements that refer individuals to screening questionnaires can result in patients suggesting to their doctors that they have bipolar disorder.
zh: 那些讓個人使用篩查問卷的直接以消費者為物件的廣告可能使病人在面對醫生時暗示自己患了雙相障礙。

en: We have seen evidence of this in our practice.
zh: 我們在自身的經歷中也見到過這樣的例子。

en: This does not necessarily reflect a problem with the performance of a screening questionnaire, but rather how these scales are used.
zh: 這並不一定反映了篩查問卷本身有效性的問題，而是反映了這些標準如何被使用的問題。

en: Screening questionnaires maximize sensitivity, at a cost of false positives, because it is presumed that they are followed by expert clinical evaluation.
zh: 篩查問卷以假陽性為代價使敏感度最大化，因為其假設前提是這些結果隨後會被專家進行臨床評估。

en: But insufficient diagnostic rigor can result in over-diagnosis.
zh: 但若診斷過程不夠嚴格就可能造成過度診斷。

en: Clinicians are inclined to diagnose disorders that they feel more comfortable treating.
zh: 臨床醫生們傾向於診斷那些他們治療起來比較拿手的（精神）障礙。

en: We believe that the increased availability of medications that have been approved for the treatment of bipolar disorder might be influencing clinicians who are unsure whether or not a patient has bipolar disorder or borderline personality disorder to err on the side of diagnosing the disorder that is responsive to medication.
zh: 我們相信被獲准用於治療雙相障礙的藥物越來越多可能會影響一部分臨床醫生。 他們不能判定一個病人是患了雙相障礙還是邊緣人格障礙就會錯誤地將病人診斷為對藥物有反應的某種障礙。

en: This bias is reinforced by the marketing message of pharmaceutical companies to physicians, which has emphasized research on delayed diagnosis and under-recognition of bipolar disorder, possibly sensitizing clinicians accordingly.
zh: 這種傾向被製藥公司傳送給醫師們的營銷資訊強化了。 這些資訊強調對雙相障礙診斷延誤和認識不足的研究，就有可能使醫師們變得敏感。

en: The campaign against under-recognition has probably resulted in some anxious, agitated, and/or irritable depressed patients who complain of insomnia and “racing thoughts” being misdiagnosed with bipolar disorder.
zh: 針對認識不足的行動很可能造成一些抑鬱病人被誤診為雙相障礙。 這些病人往往焦慮、不安和/或易怒，並抱怨有失眠和“思緒澎湃”的症狀。

en: The results of our study are consistent with prior studies suggesting possible problems with the diagnosis of bipolar disorder.
zh: 我們的研究成果和此前針對雙相障礙診斷中可能存在的問題的研究是一致的。

en: With the greater number of medications approved for the treatment of bipolar disorder, along with multiple reports cautioning clinicians against under-diagnosis, it appears that over-diagnosis has become a greater problem than under-diagnosis.
zh: 隨著更多的藥物被允許用於治療雙相障礙以及眾多警告醫生們防範診斷不足的報告的出臺，似乎過度診斷已經成為了一個比診斷不足更大的問題。

en: Both can have negative consequences.
zh: 而兩者都會造成不良的後果。

en: While there is still some uncertainty as to the best assessment approach, we recommend that clinicians use a standardized, validated method.
zh: 鑑於在最佳評估方法上還有一些不確定性，我們推薦醫生們採用標準化的、經過驗證的方法。

en: When Tweets Trump Diplomacy
zh: 當Tweet文壓倒外交

en: NEW DELHI – Diplomacy often witnesses unusual spats.
zh: 新德里—外交經常預見不同尋常的爭吵。

en: There was the Pig and Potato War of 1859, the Affair of the Dancing Lamas in 1924, and the Bogotá Bracelet incident of 1970, to name just a few.
zh: 1859年有豬和土豆戰爭（Pig and Potato War ） ， 1924年有跳舞的喇嘛事件（Affair of the Dancing Lamas ） ， 1970年有波哥大手鐲（Bogotá Bracelet）事故，諸如此類。

en: But few were more surprising than the just-concluded Episode of the Offensive Doormats.
zh: 但很少有比剛剛結束的冒犯性門墊事件（Episode of the Offensive Doormats）更加令人震驚的。

en: The e-commerce giant Amazon – which has lately been cultivating India as the next frontier of its global expansion, reflected in plans to invest $5 billion in the country – was recently startled by a series of intemperate tweets from Indian External Affairs Minister Sushma Swaraj.
zh: 電子商務巨頭亞馬遜公司 — — 它剛剛開始培育印度市場，將此作為其全球擴張的下一條陣線，計劃在印度投資50億美元 — — 最近被印度外交部長蘇什馬·斯瓦拉伊（Sushma Swaraj）的一系列有欠妥當的tweet嚇了一跳。

en: In just a few 140-character messages, Swaraj denounced the company and threatened to cancel its employees’ visas and refuse visas to its executives in the future.
zh: 斯瓦拉伊譴責亞馬遜公司，並威脅要吊銷其員工的簽證，拒絕日後為其高管簽發簽證。

en: What provoked Swaraj’s outburst was a Twitter user’s complaint to her that the Amazon Canada website offered for sale doormats depicting the Indian flag.
zh: 讓斯瓦拉伊突然爆發的是一位Twitter使用者像她投訴亞馬遜加拿大網站販賣印度國旗圖案的門墊。

en: The notion that dirty shoes would be wiped on a representation of the Indian flag had outraged the tweeter, Atul Bhobe, who contacted – and found an advocate in – Swaraj.
zh: 印度國旗被骯髒的鞋子踩踏，這樣的情景讓這位名叫阿圖爾·鮑比（Atul Bhobe）的Twitter使用者怒不可遏，與撒瓦拉伊取得了聯絡，並得到後者的支援。

en: Amazon was swift to respond.
zh: 亞馬遜很快就做出了反應。

en: After clarifying that the offending doormats were technically being offered by a third-party supplier, not Amazon itself, the company removed them from the Amazon Canada website and “implemented measures to ensure that these products could not be sold on any of our other marketplaces or websites.”
zh: 它先是澄清，技術上冒犯性門墊系由第三方供營商而提供而非亞馬遜自營，隨後將該款門墊從亞馬遜加拿大網站上下架並“採取措施確保這類產品不會再我們其他任何市場或網站上銷售。

en: Amazon’s India country manager offered an apology to Swaraj for “hurting Indian sensibilities” and, recalling the company’s $5 billion investment commitment, reiterated Amazon’s dedication to the country.
zh: ”亞馬遜印度經理向撒瓦拉伊致歉，表示“傷害了印度人民的感情 ” ， 重申亞馬遜公司將向印度投資50億美元，非常重視印度市場。

en: Less than 24 hours after the doormat crisis erupted, the matter was defused.
zh: 門墊危機爆發不到24小時，事件便已經解決。

en: But the episode raises a number of broader issues that won’t disappear so quickly.
zh: 但此事所引起的諸多更廣泛的問題不會這麼快消退。

en: The first issue is Swaraj’s use of Twitter.
zh: 第一個問題是撒瓦拉伊對Twitter的使用。

en: Swaraj stands out among her peers in India for her trigger-happy approach to tweeting (though her use of the platform is still dwarfed by that of US President-elect Donald Trump, who often uses Twitter as a bully pulpit).
zh: 撒瓦拉伊以喜歡發tweet在同僚中獨樹一幟（儘管與美國當選總統唐納德·特朗普比起來撒瓦拉伊仍只是小巫見大巫，特朗普簡直把Twitter當傳旨太監用 ） 。

en: I certainly do not oppose the use of Twitter by public officials.
zh: 我當然不反對公職官員使用Twitter。

en: On the contrary, I view the growing comfort of government ministers with social media as a matter for celebration.
zh: 相反，我認為越來越多的政府部長習慣於社交媒體可喜可賀。

en: It is a welcome change from my time as Minister of State for External Affairs, under the previous government, when official computers were barred from accessing social media, and the tweets I issued from my own devices would often become the stuff of needless controversy.
zh: 這是個值得歡迎的變化，我在前任政府中擔任外交部長的時候，官員的電腦是遮蔽社交媒體的，我用私人裝置所發的tweet文常常導致毫無必要的爭議。

en: But Swaraj may well be going too far, responding to every individual case of a lost passport or delayed visa tweeted to her – an approach that has earned her the not-entirely-flattering sobriquet of “India’s Minister for Consular Affairs.”
zh: 但撒瓦拉伊或許有些過頭了，連丟失護照或簽證延期這樣的私事tweet她也會回應 — — 這樣的做法為她贏得了一個不太體面的外號 ： “ 印度總領事 ” 。

en: That a foreign minister would respond to a Twitter complaint on such trivial matters, some would argue, seems to indicate that she lacks more important things to do.
zh: 一些人認為，外交部長回應投訴瑣事的tweet文表明她沒有更重要的事情可做。

en: (The suggestion undoubtedly reflects the fact that, under Prime Minister Narendra Modi, substantive foreign policy is conducted largely by him and his office, rather than by the External Affairs Ministry that Swaraj leads.)
zh: （這一觀點毫無疑問反映了一個事實：在總理莫迪領導下，實質性外交政策主要由他和他的幕僚完成，而不是由撒瓦拉伊領導的外交部負責。 ）

en: But the problem extends beyond Swaraj’s communication with ordinary citizens.
zh: 但問題不僅在於撒瓦拉伊與普通公民的交流。

en: In the recent doormat drama, she also used Twitter to issue instructions to her own diplomats, tweeting at the Indian High Commission in Canada to deal with the “unacceptable” matter, by taking it up with Amazon “at the highest level.”
zh: 在最近的門墊鬧劇中，她還用Twitter向手下外交官釋出指示，在加拿大印度高階專員公署（High Commission）發tweet文處理這個“不可接受”的問題，把它提高到亞馬遜“最高層 ” 。

en: Such a move is unprecedented, and not particularly welcome.
zh: 這樣的做法可謂前無古人，也不是很受歡迎。

en: Social media is no substitute for a diplomatic cable.
zh: 社交媒體不是外交專線的替代品。

en: Also less than diplomatic was the language Swaraj used in her warning to the company.
zh: 同樣不夠“外交”的還有撒瓦拉伊警告亞馬遜公司的用詞。

en: “Amazon must tender unconditional apology,” she tweeted.
zh: “亞馬遜必須無條件道歉 ” ， 她發tweet文說。

en: “They must withdraw all products insulting our national flag immediately.
zh: “他們必須立刻下架有辱我國國旗的產品。

en: If this is not done forthwith, we will not grant Indian Visa to any Amazon official. We will also rescind the Visas issued earlier.”
zh: 如果不馬上落實，我們將不會向任何亞馬遜官員簽發印度簽證，並廢除此前發出的簽證。

en: A profession famed for summoning ambassadors for a discreet dressing-down has been reduced to upbraiding companies on Twitter.
zh: ”外交部長的責任應該是傳召大使進行謹慎的斥責，現在卻墮落到在Twitter上抨擊公司。

en: The final issue that the doormat incident brought to the fore is Indians’ tendency to take offense at the slightest affront – a tendency that is now being elevated, by the thumbs of a top minister, to the level of official policy.
zh: 門墊事故所突出的最後一個問題是印度不容忍最輕微的冒犯的傾向 — — 如今這一傾向透過一位高階部長的手指頭升級到官方政策高度。

en: Of course, disrespect for the national flag is derided in most countries, and has been a criminal offense in India since 1971, with the adoption of the Prevention of Insults to National Honor Act, which threatens whoever “mutilates, defaces, disfigures, destroys, tramples upon, or otherwise shows disrespect to” the Indian flag with imprisonment.
zh: 當然，不尊重國旗在大部分國家都是一件大事，印度更是自1971年引入防止冒犯國家榮譽法（Prevention of Insults to National Honor Act ） ， 將此列為犯罪行為，任何人如果“切割、塗銷、玷汙、損毀、踩踏或表現出不尊重”印度國旗，都可以判處徒刑。

en: But Indians have a particularly low threshold for what qualifies as disrespect.
zh: 但印度人對什麼構成不尊重的門檻很低。

en: Whereas in other democracies, flags are used freely and harmlessly on t-shirts, boots, bikinis, and even underwear, in India, the majesty of the flag can, it seems, be tarnished by any tawdry manufacturer of gewgaws.
zh: 在其他民主國家，國旗可以自由地印在襯衫、鞋子、胸罩甚至內褲上而不受懲罰，但在印度，任何豔俗的小玩意兒都是對莊嚴的國旗的玷汙。

en: And it’s not just the flag.
zh: 並且不僅僅是國旗。

en: Last year, Amazon enraged many Indians by offering doormats with pictures of Indian gods and goddesses, prompting the furious hashtag #BoycottAmazon.
zh: 去年，亞馬遜因為出售印有印度諸神的門墊而激怒了許多印度人，催生了憤怒的熱門標籤#BoycottAmazon（抵制亞馬遜 ） 。

en: Two years earlier, the company’s website had caused similar outrage by selling women’s leggings with images of Hindu gods.
zh: 兩年前，亞馬遜網站因為出售印有印度教神形象的女士緊身褲而引起類似的眾怒。

en: So Amazon is no stranger to the anger of offended Indians.
zh: 因此，亞馬遜對於遭到冒犯的印度人的憤怒早已見怪不怪。

en: But the company’s swift capitulation in the latest incident – which will surely not be the last – shows that the value of a gigantic market like India far outweighs that of any single product.
zh: 但該公司在最近的事件 — — 顯然這不會是最後一次 — — 中迅速“認慫”表明大如印度的市場的重要性遠遠大於某種商品。

en: China has already proved that it can dictate terms to multinationals that covet its vast market.
zh: 中國已經證明，它可以指定條件要求覬覦其巨大市場的跨國公司就範。

en: India, it seems, will follow suit.
zh: 印度似乎要效而仿之。

en: But whoever has emerged as the winner of the doormat debacle – outraged Twitter users, perhaps – diplomacy has been the loser.
zh: 但不論誰是門墊災難的贏家 — — 也許是暴怒的Twitter使用者 — — 外交都是輸家。

en: Ambivalent Arabia
zh: 矛盾的沙烏地阿拉伯

en: A democratic tide seems to be sweeping across the Arab world.
zh: 一股民主浪潮正在席捲阿拉伯世界。

en: Even the traditional Arab monarchies and Emirates are changing in its wake.
zh: 即使是那些傳統的阿拉伯君主國和酋長國也正循著這股浪潮發生著某種改變。

en: Kuwait now allows women to vote, Qatar has embraced an ambitious reform program, Bahrain has shown great tolerance of mass demonstrations, and the U.A.E. is allowing something like a free press.
zh: 科威特現在已經允許婦女參加投票，卡達接受了一項艱鉅的改革計劃，巴林對群眾示威遊行表現出了極大的容忍，阿拉伯聯合大公國正允許透過某種新聞自由制度。

en: But Saudi Arabia continues to be deeply wary of any sort of change, and thus remains a huge and seemingly immovable obstacle to region-wide reform.
zh: 但是沙烏地阿拉伯卻依然對任何一種改變謹慎提防，也因此成為了阿拉伯地區改革程序中一塊巨大無比、看起來巋然不動的絆腳石。

en: Although the Saudi ruling family, the al-Saud, is under enormous pressure to follow the example of its neighbors, internal resistance to doing so remains very strong.
zh: 儘管沙特的統治家族 — — 邵德（al-Saud）家族，承受了要求他們學習鄰國榜樣的巨大壓力，但是內部的反對力量依然很強。

en: So the al-Saud have become Janus-faced: looking in one direction, the royal family encourages democratic reformers to speak out; looking in the opposite direction, it jails them when they do.
zh: 因此，邵德家族變成了雙面派：一方面，皇室家族鼓勵民主改革者大膽直言，另一方面，當民主改革者這麼做的時候，皇室就把他們打入大牢。

en: On May 15, in a closed trial without legal representation for the accused, three leading reformers – Ali Al Dumaini, a well-known journalist and poet, and university professors Abdullah Al Hamid and Matruk al Falih – were condemned and sentenced to prison terms ranging from six to nine years.
zh: 5月15日，在一場被告人無法合法抗辯的秘密審判中，三名改革領導人 — — 著名記者兼詩人Ali Al Dumaini，大學教授Abdullah Al Hamid 和 Matruk al Falih — — 被判有罪，分別被判入獄六至九年。

en: Their crime was to call for a constitutional monarchy.
zh: 他們的罪行是提倡鼓動憲法君主體制。

en: The official verdict states that they threatened national unity, challenged those in authority, and incited public opinion against the state while using “foreign,” that is, Western, terminology.
zh: 官方判決稱，他們使用“外國的 ” ， 也就是“西方的”的術語，威脅國家統一，挑戰國家主權，煽動民眾反對國家。

en: Not long after the September 2001 terrorist attacks in the United States, these liberal reformers joined with 160 other professionals to write and sign a petition to Crown Prince Abdullah asking for reforms.
zh: 2001年9月美國遭受恐怖襲擊後不久，這些自由改革者們和其他160名專家一起在一份遞交給皇儲阿卜杜拉（Abdullah ） 、 要求改革的請願書上簽字。

en: The petition called for the monarchy to work within constitutionally prescribed limits, and for an independent judiciary.
zh: 這份請願書要求君主政體在憲法規定的限度內工作，並且呼籲建立一個獨立的司法體系。

en: The reformers believe that such reforms are the only way for Saudi Arabia to survive the threat of violence, instability, and national fragmentation that is looming on its horizon.
zh: 改革者們相信這樣的改革是唯一能使沙烏地阿拉伯在暴力威脅、不穩定性和國家分裂等這些已經初露端倪的危機中得以生存的辦法。

en: Only a constitution, they argue, can restore much needed legitimacy to a political system that is widely perceived as deeply corrupt and inept.
zh: 他們認為，只有憲法才能夠恢復一個被普遍認為腐敗無能的政治體系所需的合法性。

en: Crown Prince Abdullah, Saudi Arabia’s de facto ruler in place of his incapacitated half-brother King Fahd, is keen to be seen as a champion of reform.
zh: 代替其碌碌無能的同父異母的兄長國王法德（King Fahd ） 、 沙烏地阿拉伯實際意義上的真正統治者皇儲阿卜杜拉，非常希望被看作一個改革的贏家。

en: He received these proposals with a warm welcome in January 2003.
zh: 2003年1月，他用一個熱烈的歡迎儀式接受了這些提議。

en: But his half-brother and more powerful rival, Prince Naif, the Minister of Interior, ordered the arrests, trial, and imprisonment of 13 reformers in March 2004.
zh: 但是他同父異母的兄長以及更為強大的競爭對手 — — 內政大臣納伊夫親王（Prince Naif）在2004年3月下令逮捕、審判並拘禁了13名改革者。

en: Crown Prince Abdullah offered not a peep of opposition, leaving the reform agenda that he initiated in a political netherworld.
zh: 阿卜杜拉皇儲沒有提出一點兒反對意見，就把這場他發動的改革計劃留在了政治地獄。

en: In order to maintain absolutist power and to minimize public anger, the Saudi princes, led by Prince Naif, asked the reformers to sign an agreement that they would never again ask for reform.
zh: 為了維持絕對權力並最大限度地降低公眾的憤慨之情，沙特的親王們在納伊夫親王的帶領下，要求改革者們簽署一項協議保證他們再也不會要求改革。

en: Prince Naif bans the very word “reform” from public discourse, because it suggests that there is something wrong with the system; his preferred term is “development.”
zh: 納伊夫親王在公共演講中禁止使用“改革”一詞，因為這個詞暗示了體系中的問題；他更喜歡的詞語是“發展 ” 。

en: Of the thirteen reformers who were arrested, ten submitted to this demand, but the other three refused and have paid the price.
zh: 在13名被逮捕的改革者中，有十個人向這個要求低頭屈服了，但是剩餘三人明確拒絕併為此付出代價。

en: They remained in jail in Riyadh without legal representation until the final verdict.
zh: 他們被關在Riyadh的監獄，在最後判決之前無法進行任何合法辯論。

en: Those who submitted had their passports withdrawn, lost their jobs, and were forbidden to speak to the press.
zh: 那些屈服的人被扣押了護照，失去了工作並被剝奪了對新聞媒體說話的權利。

en: Under regional and international pressure, the Saudi ruling family has constructed a Potemkin village of reform while retaining absolute control over all political developments.
zh: 在當地和國際壓力下，沙特的統治家族建造了一個改革版的波特金村莊（Potemkin village ） ， 與此同時，將對所有政治發展的絕對控制權牢牢掌握在手中。

en: Earlier this year, they staged partial, and tightly regulated municipal elections, with no independent opinion permitted to influence when and how the ballots were held.
zh: 今年年初，他們在區域性範圍內舉行了一場嚴格控制的地方選舉，不允許任何獨立觀點就應當何時以及如何舉行選舉發表評論。

en: These entire female population was excluded, and only one-quarter of the male population was eligible to vote.
zh: 所有女性被排除在投票選舉之外，並且只有四分之一的男性具有投票權。

en: Inevitably, Wahhabi Islamists did best.
zh: 毫無疑問，只有瓦哈比伊斯蘭分子（Wahhabi Islamists）才會做得最好。

en: The al-Saud face two threats: one from violent Islamists, and the other from liberal reformers.
zh: 紹德家族現在面臨兩大威脅：一個來自崇尚暴力的伊斯蘭分子，另一個來自自由改革者們。

en: There is every indication that they fear the reformers far more.
zh: 很明顯，他們更懼怕改革者。

en: Perhaps the princes believe that it is easier to kill “terrorist” criminals than to crush demands for social justice.
zh: 也許親王們認為，比起鎮壓要求社會正義的呼聲，除去“恐怖主義”罪犯要容易得多。

en: Indeed, killing violent Islamists and al-Qaeda affiliates is applauded by the international community, especially the United States, as success in the “war on terrorism.”
zh: 事實上，消滅暴力的伊斯蘭分子和基地組織分子會被當作反恐戰爭的勝利受到國際社會的嘉獎，尤其是美國。

en: But as they hunt down and kill violent domestic extremists, they are quietly tightening the noose around all those who want moderate reform.
zh: 但是當他們一路追尋並要除去國內的極端分子時，他們也悄悄地收緊了那些布在想要溫和改革的人周圍的套索。

en: This repression of liberal reformers passes unnoticed in the wider world, with America’s silence particularly noticeable.
zh: 這種對自由改革的鎮壓就這樣伴隨著美國尤為明顯的沉默，在世界範圍內悄無聲息地透過了。

en: This silence is vital to the princes, for what the al-Saud care about most is US support.
zh: 這種沉默對親王們至關重要，因為邵德家族最為在意的正是美國的支援。

en: As things stand in Saudi Arabia, the US administration has no credible ally for change outside of the existing regime.
zh: 在沙烏地阿拉伯當前的情形下，除了當前的政權，美國政府沒有其他可信任的同盟。

en: So, unlike in Ukraine, Georgia, Kyrgizstan, and Lebanon, it does nothing to encourage popular opposition.
zh: 因此，與烏克蘭、喬治亞、吉爾吉斯和黎巴嫩不同，美國支援強烈反對派毫無意義。

en: As long as the Saudi regime meets America’s oil needs and fights Islamist radicals, it will continue to receive US support and silence – and hence its tacit consent.
zh: 只要沙特���權能夠滿足美國的石油需求並對抗伊斯蘭激進分子，它將會繼續收到美國的支援和沉默 — — 以及它心照不宣的默許。

en: But turning a blind eye is shortsighted, for America and for the Saudis.
zh: 但是，對美國和沙烏地阿拉伯來說，視而不見並非長久之計。

en: Those who make peaceful revolutions impossible make violent revolutions inevitable.
zh: 那些抹殺和平革命可能性的人將會使暴力革命在所難免。

en: The liberal reformers who have been jailed could have paved the way for a peaceful transition to a reformed Saudi Arabia.
zh: 那些被囚禁的自由改革者們可能已經為通向一個改革一新的沙烏地阿拉伯的和平演變鋪平了道路。

en: By jailing them, the regime has made it clear that violence is the only avenue open to those seeking change.
zh: 當局透過囚禁這些人已經明確表明，暴力是那些尋求改變者唯一可用的途徑。

en: Algeria’s Dying Dictatorship
zh: 行將就木的阿爾及利亞獨裁

en: ALGIERS – Despite his failing health, Algerian President Abdelaziz Bouteflika won a fourth term last month, with 81% of the vote – or so the regime claimed.
zh: 阿爾及爾—儘管健康每況愈下，阿爾及利亞總統阿卜杜拉齊茲·波特弗利卡（Abdelaziz Bouteflika）仍在本月第四次當選總統，支援率高達81 % — —至少他的政府是這麼宣佈的。

en: In fact, far from signaling growing political stability, the 77-year-old incumbent’s sham victory underscores just how few options Algerians have to effect change from within the system.
zh: 事實上，這位77歲的現任總統的假勝利絕非政治日益穩定的訊號，而是反映了阿爾及利亞人無法從體制內影響變局。

en: Under Bouteflika’s leadership, Algeria’s government has failed to address the country’s most pressing economic and social challenges.
zh: 在波特弗利卡的領導下，阿爾及利亞政府無法解決該國最緊迫的經濟和社會挑戰。

en: And there is no reason to expect this to change.
zh: 也看不到可以發生變化的訊號。

en: Since suffering a stroke last year, Bouteflika has barely appeared in public, whether to campaign ahead of the vote or to acknowledge his victory after it.
zh: 自去年中風以來，波特弗利卡就很少出現在公眾面前，甚至在再次當選後都沒有現身宣佈自己的勝利。

en: As a result, the regime is finding it increasingly difficult to claim, as it has for the last 15 years, that Bouteflika’s leadership represents civilian control over the military.
zh: 結果，他的政權越來越難以如過去15年那樣宣佈波特弗利卡的領導是文治而不是武治。

en: So it has devised a new strategy, aimed at creating a sense of transition: the constitution will be revised to designate a vice president as the president’s legitimate successor.
zh: 因此，政權採取了新戰略，旨在營造轉型的氛圍：憲法將作出修訂，增加一名副總統作為總統的合法繼任者。

en: Of course, the move’s true purpose will be to allow the army to rally around the next compliant “civilian leader.”
zh: 當然，這一舉措的真實目的是讓軍方團結在下一位順從的“文官領導人”周圍。

en: The regime will also propose a “national contract,” supposedly to initiate a dialogue with the opposition.
zh: 政權還將提出“國民契約 ” ， 假裝開啟與反對派的對話。

en: But, in the wake of Bouteflika’s bogus victory, the opposition can no longer accept a sham role in the regime’s reform plans.
zh: 但是，面對波特弗利卡的假勝利，反對派無法繼續接受在政權的改革計劃中扮演掩人耳目的角色。

en: In fact, the announcement that Bouteflika planned to run was enough to unite Islamists and leftists – even parties that had previously been co-opted by the regime – and spur them to stage a boycott of the vote.
zh: 事實上，宣佈本特弗利卡計劃逃跑已足以團結伊斯蘭教徒和左派 — — 甚至此前被政權選中的政黨 — — 促使他們抵制投票。

en: When the election results were announced, they swiftly rejected the new government as illegitimate.
zh: 在選舉結果宣佈後，他們馬上拒絕承認新政府的合法性。

en: But, to gain credibility, the opposition parties will have to extend their criticism beyond Bouteflika to the system as a whole.
zh: 但是，要獲得信譽，反對黨必須將批評從本特弗利卡一人擴大到整個體制。

en: This has become crucial to their survival, as younger opponents are seeking new ways to bring about political change outside state-controlled politics.
zh: 這對於它們來說事關生死存亡，因為年輕一代反對派正在尋找新方式，在國家控制政治之外營造政治變革。

en: One important development is the growing influence of non-partisan voices of dissent.
zh: 一個重要的發展趨勢是無黨派持異見者影響力日增。

en: Non-violent movements have formed to protest not only Bouteflika’s continued leadership, but also the pervasive role of the army and intelligence services in civil society.
zh: 非暴力運動不但反對波特弗利卡的連選連任，也反對軍方和情報機構在公民社會中的無孔不入。

en: Such movements, like the much-publicized “Barakat” (“Enough”), have encouraged a shift among Algerians from resentful abstention to active boycott.
zh: 這些運動，如相當公開化的“足夠 ” （ Barakat）運動，鼓勵阿爾及利亞人從憤怒而消極的棄權轉為積極的抵制。

en: Underground unions – which mount demonstrations and strikes to protect workers’ rights, while refusing to cooperate with the regime’s official unions – have also criticized the election.
zh: 地下工會 — — 它們組織了保護工人權利的示威和罷工，並拒絕與政權的官方工會合作 — — 也批評選舉。

en: Moreover, young people have assumed a prominent role in opposition efforts, such as by disrupting Bouteflika’s campaign rallies.
zh: 此外，年輕人在反對運動 — — 包括干擾波特弗利卡的競選陣營 — — 中起到了主導作用。

en: Demonstrations by unemployed young people in southern Algeria, the center of the oil industry, drew a direct link between high unemployment and the military’s control of the country’s natural resources.
zh: 失業年輕人在阿爾及利亞南部的石油業中心舉行示威，認為高失業與軍方控制阿爾及利亞自然資源之間存在直接聯絡。

en: By organizing peaceful protests to demand accountability for public spending, these movements are raising issues that were not addressed during the election campaign.
zh: 這些運動透過組織和平示威要求問責公共支出，引出了競選期間未能解決的問題。

en: More immediately, they are also challenging the government’s ban on street demonstrations – a vestige of the state of emergency that lasted from 1992 until 2011.
zh: 此後他們還挑戰了政府的街頭遊行禁令 — — 從1992年一直持續到2011年的緊急狀態後遺症。

en: With the civil war of the 1990’s long over, security officials cannot explain why Algerians are being arrested for demanding jobs.
zh: 1990年內戰已經過去很久，安全官員已無法解釋為何要逮捕要求獲得工作的阿爾及利亞人。

en: Of course, repression continues to intimidate many Algerians.
zh: 當然，鎮壓將繼續威脅許多阿爾及利亞人。

en: But it is becoming increasingly easy to rouse their sympathy for their fellow citizens through Twitter, YouTube, and Facebook.
zh: 但透過Twitter、YouTube和Facebook激發他們對同胞人民的同情心已變得越來越容易。

en: By stimulating daily public debate about local human-rights violations, they spread the message of discontent more efficiently than traditional parties ever have.
zh: 他們透過激發對本地侵犯人權行為的日常爭論，更有效地傳播不滿情緒，這是此前的傳統政黨無法做到的。

en: By demanding better state services, rather than an “Arab Spring,” Algerians have walked a fine line, highlighting the regime’s inability to deliver security and economic prosperity, despite its efforts to stifle all debate.
zh: 阿爾及利亞人要求的是更好的國家服務，而非“阿拉伯之春 ” ， 這一做法十分巧妙，凸顯出政權在無力帶給人民安全和經濟繁榮，儘管它在竭力扼殺爭論。

en: Thus, even without explicitly talking about politics, ordinary Algerians are mobilizing in growing numbers against the government.
zh: 因此，即使不明確談論政治，仍有越來越多的普通阿爾及利亞人被動員起來反對政府。

en: The majority of street protests have occurred in the most deprived and neglected areas, and the primary demands have been economic: better jobs, housing, health-care services, and infrastructure.
zh: 街頭遊行主要發生在權利受侵害最嚴重、最受忽視的地區，基本需求也都是經濟方面的需求：更好的工作、住房、醫療服務和基礎設施。

en: For some, the right to make a living through the informal market would be sufficient.
zh: 對一些人來說，獲得在非正式市場中討生活的權利便已足夠。

en: And demonstrators have gone to great – sometimes destructive – lengths to be heard, blocking roads, occupying factories and government buildings, and sabotaging water and electricity infrastructure.
zh: 示威者的隊伍十分龐大 — — 有時具有破壞性 — — 發出振聾發聵的聲音，設定路障，佔領工廠和政府大樓，搗毀供水和電力基礎涉水。

en: More than 150 Algerians have even set themselves on fire since 2011, usually in front of public services buildings.
zh: 自2011年以來，150多名阿爾及利亞人甚至不惜自焚 — — 地點多在政府大樓前。

en: In this context, the failure of the government’s half-baked attempts to buy off protesters is unsurprising.
zh: 在這樣��背景下，政府做出試圖收買反對者的膚淺手段不足為奇。

en: In 2011, the government, fearing contagion from Tunisia and Egypt, where long-established dictatorships had just been toppled, responded to the spread of protests by public-sector workers by raising their salaries by 100% – retroactively to 2008.
zh: 2011年，政府擔心突尼西亞和埃及的狀況 — — 長期獨裁統治被推翻蔓延到阿爾及利亞，對公共部門員工示威蔓延的反應是提高100%的薪水，這在2008年算得上逆潮流而動。

en: But the plan backfired; protests intensified, with other workers demonstrating for similar benefits and railing against the inflation that the move engendered.
zh: 但這一計劃適得其反，示威更加嚴重了，其他部門的工人也要求獲得同樣的好處，並抗議政府的這一行為所導致的通貨膨脹。

en: To be sure, street protests have already had a profound impact on Algeria’s authoritarian politics, with official fears of massive uprisings affecting public budgets and political appointments.
zh: 平心而論，街頭抗議已經對阿爾及利亞集權政治造成了深遠影響，官員擔心大規模動亂影響公共預算和政治任命。

en: But the decision to prolong Bouteflika’s presidency will not provide the kind of strong, transformational leadership that Algeria needs to materialize the regime’s stability promises.
zh: 但延長波特弗利卡總統任期的決定並不能給阿爾及利亞帶來實現政權的穩定承諾所需要的強大的轉型性領導。

en: The Algerian authorities face a major challenge, because rejection of pluralist institutions makes it more difficult to find negotiating partners.
zh: 阿爾及利亞當局面臨著巨大的挑戰，因為拒絕接受多元制度讓它難以找到談判夥伴。

en: The more the regime tries to buy off the protesters, the more overweening it appears – and the angrier citizens become.
zh: 政權越是試圖收買反對者，就會越顯出它的自負 — — 人民也就變得越憤怒。

en: And the enraged younger generation, in particular, is not especially fearful of losing the limited benefits offered by the status quo.
zh: 尤其是，憤怒的年輕一代並不特別害怕失去現狀給他們帶來的那點可憐的好處。

en: America After the Election
zh: 大選後的美國

en: NEW YORK – The ongoing presidential campaign in the United States stands out for its lack of civility and the vast differences between the candidates: the anti-establishment businessman Donald Trump on the Republican side and the polished politician Hillary Clinton representing the Democrats.
zh: 基輔—正在進行中的美國總統選戰有兩個特點，一是不文明，二是候選人差異巨大：共和黨一邊是反建制商人唐納德·特朗普，代表民主黨的則是道貌岸然的政客希拉里·克林頓。

en: The contest has exposed deep fault lines within American society and damaged the country’s global reputation.
zh: 這場選戰暴露出美國社會內部深刻的斷層線，也損害了美國的國際名譽。

en: No surprise, then, that one of the few things Americans seem to agree on is that the campaign has gone on for too long.
zh: 因此，毫不奇怪，一件能讓美國人統一意見的極少數事情之一便是這場選戰實在是又臭又長。

en: But soon it will be over.
zh: 但它馬上就要結束了。

en: The question is: what comes next?
zh: 問題是，接下來會怎樣？

en: Polls suggest that Clinton, a former senator and secretary of state, will defeat the controversial Trump.
zh: 民調顯示，前參議員、國務卿克林頓將擊敗飽受爭議的特朗普。

en: But polls are not to be confused with reality.
zh: 但不要把民調與現實弄混了。

en: After all, going into June’s Brexit referendum, most observers believed that a victory for “Remain” was a sure thing.
zh: 畢竟，6月份英國舉行脫歐公投時，大部分觀察家認為“留歐”陣營取得勝利是板上釘釘。

en: More recently, Colombian voters rejected a peace accord that was widely expected to receive popular approval.
zh: 最近則有哥倫比亞人民拒絕和平協議的事件，人們原本廣泛預期這一協議會受到熱烈歡迎。

en: All of this is to say that, while a Clinton victory may be likely, it is no certainty.
zh: 所有這些表明，儘管克林頓眼看就要取得勝利，但結果仍不確定。

en: The only poll that counts is the one on November 8.
zh: 唯一有意義的民調是11月8日。

en: Until then, all we can do is speculate.
zh: 在此之前，我們只能猜測。

en: Yet some predictions can be made with greater confidence.
zh: 但已經有人做出了信心滿滿的預測。

en: There is little doubt that the US will emerge from this election a divided country with a divided government, regardless of who is president or which party has a majority in either chamber of Congress.
zh: 幾乎毫無疑問，經歷了這次選舉後，美國將是一個分裂的國家，出現一個分裂的政府，不管誰當總統、哪個黨控制國會兩院多數。

en: Neither Democrats nor Republicans will be able to realize their objectives without at least some support from the other.
zh: 不管是民主黨還是共和黨，都無法實現自己的目標，除非得到對方的一定的支援。

en: But no one should think that the only divide in American politics is between Republicans and Democrats.
zh: 但決不能認為美國政治唯一的分歧點就在共和黨和民主黨。

en: In fact, splits within the two major parties are just as deep, with large and highly motivated factions pulling each to their respective extremes – Democrats to the left and Republicans to the right.
zh: 事實上，兩大黨內部的分裂同樣深刻，規模龐大、鬥志昂揚的派系將兩黨推向各自的極端 — — 民主黨左傾，共和黨右傾。

en: This makes compromise on centrist positions all the more difficult to achieve.
zh: 這導致在中間立場形成妥協的局面非常難以達成。

en: The rapid resumption of presidential politics will undermine compromise further.
zh: 總統政治的迅速捲土重來將進一步破壞妥協。

en: If Clinton wins, many Republicans will assume that it was only because of Trump’s flaws, and they will judge her likely to be a one-term president.
zh: 如果克林頓獲勝，許多共和黨人會將全部責任推給特朗普的缺陷，而認為克林頓只能擔任一個任期。

en: A country favoring change, they will conclude, is unlikely to keep a Democrat in the Oval Office for a fourth term.
zh: 他們會這樣認為：一個喜歡變化的國家不可能讓民主黨主宰橢圓辦公室四個任期。

en: Many Republicans (especially those who deny the legitimacy of a Clinton victory) will thus seek to frustrate her administration, lest she be able to run again in 2020 as a successful incumbent.
zh: 許多共和黨人（特別是那些否認克林頓勝利合法性的共和黨）將因此尋求對克林頓政府從中作梗，唯恐她在2020年作為成功的在任總統再次競選。

en: Similarly, if Trump manages to win, most Democrats (and even some Republicans) will – after recovering from their surprise and dismay – make it their highest priority to ensure that he does not have an opportunity for a second term.
zh: 類似地，如果特朗普成功獲勝，大部分民主黨人（甚至一些共和黨人）在從震驚與沮喪中回過神之後將把確保特朗普無法參加第二次競選作為最高任務。

en: Given how much of Trump’s agenda his fellow policymakers would likely find objectionable, governing would be very difficult during his administration.
zh: 特朗普��策團隊所制定的日程必將遭遇重重阻力，在他的任期內，治理國家將非常困難。

en: In either scenario, it may still be possible to make progress in a few key areas.
zh: 不管發生哪個情景，仍有可能在一些關鍵領域取得進展。

en: The next US government might manage to enact legislation to fund the modernization of America’s aging infrastructure, a policy that both candidates and many in Congress favor.
zh: 下一屆美國政府或可以實施立法籌資對美國陳舊的基礎設施進行現代化，兩位獲選人和許多國會議員都支援這樣做。

en: It might also be able to cobble together a majority to reform the US tax code – in particular, lowering the high rate for corporations and raising taxes on the wealthy.
zh: 或許也有望湊成多數改革美國稅法 — — 特別是降低高昂的公司稅率並對富人增稅。

en: There could even be some reform of health care, President Barack Obama’s signature achievement, owing to serious implementation problems with the current system.
zh: 甚至還可能會有一些醫療改革，作為奧巴馬總統招牌式的成就，當前醫療制度仍存在嚴重的實施問題。

en: But other issues requiring cooperation between Congress and the president are unlikely to be addressed any time soon.
zh: 但其他要求國會與總統合作的問題絕無可能在短期得到解決。

en: One is immigration reform, which is as controversial in the US as it is in Europe.
zh: 其一是移民改革，這個問題在美國與在歐洲一樣存在爭議。

en: Another is trade: because the domestic political environment makes policymakers wary of supporting positions with dedicated opponents, both Trump and Clinton oppose the Trans-Pacific Partnership, even though its ratification would benefit America’s economy and strategic standing.
zh: 另一個是貿易：國內政治環境導致決策者害怕支援存在專注的反對者的立場，因此特朗普和克林頓都反對跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（TPP ） ， 即使批准該協定有利於美國經濟和戰略立場。

en: Meanwhile, America’s deficit and debt are certain to rise, as there seems to be little or no will to reduce entitlement spending.
zh: 與此同時，美國的赤字和債務也必將增加，因為根本看不出有削減福利支出的意願。

en: The foreign-policy implications of the election are somewhat different, because, under the US Constitution, the president enjoys considerable latitude.
zh: 大選的外交政策影響略有不同，因為，根據美國憲法，總統享有相當大的自由度。

en: While only Congress can officially declare war or ratify treaties, presidents may use (or refuse to use) military force without explicit congressional approval.
zh: 只有國會可以正式宣戰或批准條約，但總統可以在沒有國會明確批准的情況下使用（或拒絕使用）武力。

en: They can also enter into international agreements other than treaties, appoint powerful White House staff, and change US foreign policy by executive action, as Obama recently did regarding Cuba.
zh: 總統還可以簽署國際協定而非條約，任命強力白宮官員，以及透過行政動作改變美國外交政策（如奧巴馬最近對古巴的動作 ） 。

en: Under Clinton, this discretion could translate into establishing one or more safe areas in Syria, providing more defensive arms to Ukraine, and taking a tougher line toward North Korea as it continues its nuclear and missile buildup.
zh: 如果克林頓當選，這一自由裁量權將帶來的是：在敘利亞建立一個或多個安全區；為烏克蘭提供更多防禦武器；以及對繼續核和導彈實驗的朝鮮採取更加強硬的立場。

en: It is more difficult to guess what Trump would do.
zh: 特朗普會怎麼做更難猜測。

en: He is, after all, a political outsider, so no one knows how much of his campaign rhetoric would be translated into policy.
zh: 畢竟，他是政治局外人，因此沒人知道他的競選綱領中有多少會轉化為政策。

en: Still, one could anticipate a Trump administration distancing itself from some traditional allies in Europe and Asia and standing mostly aloof from the Middle East.
zh: 但人們可能預測特朗普政府將與某些歐洲和亞洲的傳統盟友保持距離，對中東更是敬而遠之。

en: What exactly will happen to America after the presidential election remains an open question.
zh: 美國總統大選後究竟會發生什麼仍是一個開放性問題。

en: Though some outcomes can reasonably be expected, the only genuine certainty is that the 96% of the world’s population that does not vote in US elections will feel the effects no less than Americans will.
zh: 儘管可以合理地預期到一些結果，但唯一真正確定的是不能在美國總統大選中投票的96%的世界人口都將與美國人一樣真切地感受到大選結果的影響。

en: America and Europe
zh: 美國和歐洲

en: Deeply frustrated by the Bush administration’s policies, many people and governments in Europe hope for a fundamental change in American foreign policy after the upcoming presidential election.
zh: 在對布什政府的政策深感挫傷之後，歐洲的許多人和政府都希望在即將進行的總統大選之後，美國的外交政策能有根本性的變化。

en: But it would take a medium-sized political miracle for these hopes not to be disappointed, and such a miracle will not happen – whoever is elected.
zh: 但要這些希望別成為失望，就需要有一場中等規模的政治奇蹟，而這樣的奇蹟將不會發生—不管誰當選。

en: The Bush administration made numerous foreign-policy blunders with far-reaching consequences.
zh: 布什政府在外交政策上屢犯大錯，後果深遠。

en: But Bush neither invented American unilateralism nor triggered the transatlantic rift between the United States and Europe.
zh: 但布什既沒有發明美國的單邊主義，也沒有造成大西洋兩岸歐美之間的裂隙。

en: To be sure, Bush reinforced both trends, but their real causes lie in objective historical factors, namely America’s being the sole world power since 1989 and Europe’s self-inflicted weakness.
zh: 確切地說，布什強化了這兩種趨勢，但究其原因還在於客觀的歷史因素，也就是自1989年以來美國在世界上的一家獨大和歐洲自作自受的軟弱。

en: As long as America remains the sole world power, the next US President will be neither able nor willing to change the basic framework of America’s foreign policy.
zh: 只要美國仍然還是世界唯一的超級大國，下一任美國總統就既不能也不願改變美國外交政策的基本框架。

en: It will, of course, be important who wins the presidency: a candidate expected to continue Bush’s foreign policy or someone ready for a new beginning.
zh: 當然，誰贏得總統寶座也很重要：是一個會繼續布什外交政策的候選人，還是一個準備重新開始的人。

en: In the former case, the transatlantic rift will deepen dramatically.
zh: 如果是前一種情況，歐美之間的裂隙會進一步加深。

en: Four, or even eight, more years of US policy à la Bush would inflict such damage on the substance of the transatlantic alliance as to threaten its very existence.
zh: 4年，甚至8年的“布什式”美國政策的繼續會給跨大西洋聯盟造成實質性的破壞，甚至危及其生存。

en: But if America’s next president is committed to a new direction, US foreign policy might again become more multilateral, more focused on international institutions and alliances, and willing to bring the relationship between military force and diplomacy back to within its historical proportions.
zh: 但如果美國的下一任總統有志於開拓新方向，那麼美國外交政策可能再一次變得更多邊化，更關注國際機構和聯盟，並願意將武力和外交的關係重新擺放到其歷史的範疇中去。

en: That is the good news.
zh: 那將會是條好訊息。

en: The bad news is that, even under such auspicious conditions, the US, as a world power, will not relinquish its “free-hand” policy or forget its strength and its claim to preeminence among nations.
zh: 而壞訊息則是，即便在如此祥和的環境下，美國作為世界唯一的超級大國，也不會放棄其“隨心所欲”的政策或忘記自身的實力，令其他國家唯其馬首是瞻。

en: Another piece of bad (or good?) news is that a more multilateral American policy will increase the pressure on Europeans to take on more responsibility for international crisis management and conflict resolution – in Afghanistan, Iran, Iraq, the Middle East, Transcaucasia, and Russia, and with respect to Turkey’s future.
zh: 另一個壞（抑或是好？ ）訊息是，一種更多邊化的美國政策會向歐洲人施加壓力，讓他們在國際危機管理和衝突解決方面擔負起更多的責任—在阿富汗、伊朗、中東、高加索地區和俄羅斯以及與土耳其的未來相關的事務方面。

en: To this common agenda, the Europeans should add Africa, climate change, and reform of the United Nations and the world trading system.
zh: 歐洲人還應該把非洲、氣候變化和聯合國改革及世界貿易體系寫入這一共同議程。

en: For a long time, Europe has underestimated its weight and importance.
zh: 長期以來，歐洲都低估了自己的份量和重要性。

en: Europe’s geopolitical, economic, and social weight is quite obvious.
zh: 它在地緣政治、經濟和社會方面的影響力不言自明。

en: But Europe’s integration of sovereign states’ interests by means of common institutions could also be an example for much of the world.
zh: 但歐洲透過共同制度整合主權國家利益的方式也同樣為世界其他許多地方做出了榜樣。

en: In particular, the way Europe, in the process of its enlargement, has projected its power to achieve lasting peace across the whole continent, and fostered development by integrating entire economies, states, and societies within its institutional framework, could become a model for shaping a cooperative world order in the twenty-first century.
zh: 特別是歐洲在擴大的過程中運用其實力實現整個大陸的持久和平，透過所有經濟體、國家和社會在其制度框架內的一體化來促進發展的做法，更可以成為二十一世紀建立合作的國際秩序的樣板。

en: This modern, progressive, and peaceful model is unique and superior to all other currently available approaches to the fundamental questions of political order.
zh: 這種現代、進步且和平的模式是獨特的，並且優於其它所有現行的、針對政治秩序的根本性問題的眾多模式。

en: But could doesn’t mean will.
zh: 但“能夠”並不意味著“將要 ” 。

en: Europe’s global influence is feeble because of its internal quarrels and lack of unity, which render the European Union weak and limit its ability to act.
zh: 歐洲全球影響力的虛弱是由於內部紛爭和缺乏統一。 這讓歐盟也變得軟弱，並限制了它的行動能力。

en: Objectively strong, subjectively infirm – that is how the EU’s present condition can be described.
zh: 外強中乾—這就是對歐盟現狀的最佳描述。

en: The current moment of American weakness coincides with a substantially changed international political environment, defined largely by the limits of US power, Europe’s ineffectiveness, and the emergence of new global giants like China and India.
zh: 美國現時的軟弱是與經歷了深刻變化的國際政治環境相關的，其特點是美國勢力的侷限，歐洲的無所作為和中國、印度等新的全球大國的出現。

en: In light of these developments, does it still make sense to speak of “the West”?
zh: 在這樣的形勢下，再提“西方”還有意義麼？

en: I believe it does, more than ever, because the rift between Europe and America leaves both sides substantially weaker in global terms.
zh: 我認為比以往任何時候都有意義，因為歐美之間的裂隙使得雙方的實力在全球層面上都大打折扣。

en: The unilateral overstretching of American power offers a chance for a new beginning in US-European relations.
zh: 美國實力的單邊過渡延伸給歐美關係的新起點提供了機會。

en: America, more than in the past, will depend on strong partners and will seek such partnerships.
zh: 美國比以往更需要強大的夥伴，也會尋求這樣的夥伴關係。

en: So what are the Europeans waiting for?
zh: 既然如此，歐洲人還在等待什麼？

en: Why not start now to overcome the traditional tension between NATO and the EU – especially as French policy toward NATO under President Nicolas Sarkozy has been moving in the right direction?
zh: 為什麼不從現在就開始改變北約與歐盟之間傳統的緊張局面—特別是在薩科奇總統主持下的法國對北約的政策正向著正確方向發展的情況下？

en: A regular mutual presence of the Secretary General of NATO and of the head of EU foreign policy in the councils of both organizations doesn’t require much time and effort.
zh: 讓北約的秘書長和歐盟外交政策的領導人定期相互出席對方組織相關委員會的會議並不需要花多少時間和精力。

en: Why not initiate EU-US consultations at a high political level (with the Secretary-General of NATO participating in security matters) – for instance, by inviting the US Secretary of State and other members of the administration, such as the Treasury Secretary or the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, to sit several times a year on the appropriate EU Council meetings?
zh: 何不開啟歐盟—美國的高政治級別（北約秘書��參與到安全事務中）協商—例如，邀請美國國務卿和其他政府官員，如財政部長或環保部門首長每年出席幾次歐盟相關委員會的會議呢？

en: Why not have routine annual meetings between the European Council and the US President?
zh: 為什麼不建立歐盟委員會和美國總統之間每年定期會晤的機制呢？

en: Periodic meetings between the appropriate committees of the US Congress and the European Parliament would also be of great importance, as ultimately both bodies will have to ratify any international treaties.
zh: 美國國會和歐洲議會的相關委員會之間的定期會晤也會十分重要，因為任何國際條約都要經過這兩個機構的批准。

en: The fate of the Kyoto Protocol should be a lesson to all parties involved.
zh: 《京都議定書》的命運對相關各方都應該是個教訓。

en: No such US-EU consultations would require any new agreements, so they could start without any further preliminaries.
zh: 如此的美國—歐盟協商機制不需要任何新的協議，因此完全可以馬上付諸實施。

en: There is one certainty that Europeans can take home from the US election campaign even today: with a more multilaterally oriented US foreign policy, Europe won’t be riding comfortably in the US world-political slipstream much longer.
zh: 就算在今天，歐洲人也能從美國總統競選中明確地看到一點：隨著美國外交政策更加以多邊化為導向，歐洲在美國的世界政治滑流中怡然而行的日子不會長久了。

en: And that is a good thing.
zh: 這是件好事。

en: The new transatlantic formula must be greater say in decision-making in exchange for a greater share of responsibility.
zh: 新的跨大西洋關係必須在決策方面擁有更大的發言權以換取更多的責任。

en: America at Stall Speed?
zh: 失速的美國？

en: NEWPORT BEACH – Judging from the skittishness of both markets and “consensus expectations,” the United States’ economic prospects are confusing.
zh: 紐波特海灘 — — 從市場和“一致預期”的變幻莫測判斷，人們對美國經濟前景仍是一片茫然。

en: One day, the country is on the brink of a double-dip recession; the next, it is on the verge of a turbo-charged recovery, powered by resilient consumers and US multinationals starting to deploy, at long last, their massive cash reserves.
zh: 今天眼看著美國就要掉下二次探底的懸崖了；過了一晚，受消費回彈刺激和美國跨國公司終於開始著手使用手裡的大把現金儲備，看上去高速復甦又近在眼前了。

en: In the process, markets take investors on a wild rollercoaster ride, with the European crisis (riddled with even more confusion and volatility) serving to aggravate their queasiness.
zh: 在市場的左右搖擺之間，投資者彷彿坐上了過山車，而歐洲危機（更令人困惑、更大起大落）進一步加劇了乘客的頭暈反應。

en: This situation is both understandable and increasingly unsettling for America’s well-being and that of the global economy.
zh: 這一情形不難理解，卻也加劇了美國和全球經濟的不安。

en: It reflects the impact of fundamental (and historic) economic and financial re-alignments, insufficient policy responses, and system-wide rigidities that frustrate structural change.
zh: 這反映了基礎性（和歷史性）經濟和財政再聯盟、政策應對不力、以及讓結構變革陷入停頓的系統性僵化所產生的後果。

en: As a result, there are now legitimate questions about the underlying functioning of the US economy and, therefore, its evolution in the months and years ahead.
zh: 結果，人們對美國經濟的基礎功能及其在未來數月和數年的發展動向提出了合理質疑。

en: One way to understand current conditions – and what is needed to improve them – is to consider two events that recently attracted considerable worldwide attention: the launch of Boeing’s Dreamliner passenger jet and the tragic death of Apple’s Steve Jobs.
zh: 一種理解當前形勢 — — 以及如何改進 — — 的辦法是思考兩件引起世界範圍大關注的事件：波音夢幻客機的釋出以及蘋果公司的喬布斯去世的噩耗。

en: Let us start with some simple aeronautic dynamics, using an analogy that my PIMCO colleague, Bill Gross, came up with to describe the economic risks facing the American economy.
zh: 讓我們從一些簡單的航空動力學開始，用我的太平洋投資公司（PIMCO）同事格羅斯（Bill Gross）所做的比方來描述美國經濟所面臨的經濟風險。

en: For the Dreamliner to take off, ascend, and maintain a steady altitude, it must do more than move forward.
zh: 夢幻客機想要起飛、升空然後維持穩定高度，光是向前運動是不夠的。

en: It has to move forward fast enough to exceed critical physical thresholds, which are significantly higher than those for most of Boeing’s other (smaller) planes.
zh: 它必須向前運動得足夠快，超過某個物理臨界閾值 — — 遠高於絕大部分波音其他型號（體型更小）的飛機。

en: Failure would mean succumbing to a mid-air stall, with tepid forward motion giving way to a sudden loss of altitude.
zh: 失敗意味著空中停車、降速因而導致高度突降。

en: Unless we are convinced of the Dreamliner’s ability to avoid stall speed, it makes no sense to talk about all the ways in which it will enhance the travel experience for millions of people around the world.
zh: 除非我們確信夢幻客機有能力避免失速，否則大談能如何改進全球數百萬乘客的旅行體驗純屬空中樓閣。

en: America’s economy today risks stall speed.
zh: 美國經濟如今就面臨著失速風險。

en: Specifically, the question is not whether it can grow, but whether it can grow fast enough to propel a large economy that, according to the US Federal Reserve, faces “balance-sheet deleveraging, credit constraints, and household and business uncertainty about the economic outlook.”
zh: 具體而言，問題不在於是否增長，而在於增長是否足夠快，足以驅動一個面臨著“資產負債表去槓桿化、信貸約束以及家庭和企業對經濟前景充滿狐疑 ” （ 美聯儲語）的大型經濟。

en: And, remember, it is just over a year since certain US officials were proclaiming the economy’s “summer of recovery” – a view underpinned by the erroneous belief that America was reaching “escape velocity.”
zh: 還有，不要忘了，僅僅是一年前，一些美國官員信誓旦旦地宣稱美國經濟已經步入了“復甦之夏 ” ， 而這一觀點還得到了美國正在達到“逃逸速度”的錯誤信念的支援。

en: Stall speed is a terrifying risk for an economy like that of the US, which desperately needs to grow robustly.
zh: 失速對於像美國這樣的極度需要穩健增長的經濟體來說具有很高風險。

en: Without rapid growth, there is no way to reverse persistently high and increasingly structural (and therefore protracted) unemployment; safely de-leverage over-indebted balance sheets; and prevent already-disturbing income and wealth inequalities from growing worse.
zh: 沒有快速增長就無法逆轉持續且越來越倒向結構性（從而會更加難以根除）的事業趨勢，無法實現過度負債的資產負債表的安全去槓桿化，無法防止已然惡化的收入和財富不平等雪上加霜。

en: The private sector alone cannot and will not counter the risk of stall speed.
zh: 私人部門無法也不會單獨抵擋失速風險。

en: What is desperately needed is better policymaking.
zh: 當前急需的是更好的決策。

en: Specifically, policymakers must be open and willing to understand the unusual challenges facing the US economy, react accordingly, and possess sufficiently potent policy instruments.
zh: 具體而言，決策者應該開誠佈公，並願意釐清美國經濟所面臨的非常規挑戰，做出相應的反應，同時掌握充分的有效政策工具。

en: Unfortunately, this has been far from the case in America (and in Europe, where the situation is worse).
zh: 不幸的是，美國（以及歐洲，那裡的情況比美國還遭）的現狀離這一步還差得很遠。

en: Moreover, US policymakers in the last few weeks have been more interested in pointing fingers at Europe and China than in recognizing and responding to the paradigm shifts that are at the root of the country’s economic problems and mounting social challenges.
zh: 此外，最近數週，美國決策者對向歐洲和中國指手畫腳更感興趣，而沒有把精力放在識別和應對正規化變化上，而正規化變化才是美國經濟問題和社會挑戰日漸艱鉅的根源。

en: This is where the insights of Steve Jobs, one of the world’s best innovators and entrepreneurs, come in.
zh: 這正是史蒂夫·喬布斯 — — 全世界最好的創新者和企業家 — — 的洞見的閃光之處。

en: Jobs did more than navigate paradigm shifts; he essentially created them.
zh: 喬布斯不但引導著正規化的變化方向；事實上，他創造著正規化。

en: He was a master at converting the complicated into the simple; and, rather than being paralyzed by complexity, he found new ways to deconstruct and overcome it.
zh: 他是化繁為簡的一代宗師；他不但沒有陷入複雜性的漩渦中無法走出，反而發現了重建和克服複雜性之路。

en: Teamwork was an obligation, not a choice.
zh: 團隊合作是一種義務，而不是一種選擇。

en: And he eschewed the search for the single “big bang” in favor of aiming for multiple breakthroughs.
zh: 他並沒有尋求單一的“大爆炸 ” ， 而是以各個擊破為目標。

en: Underlying it all was a willingness to evolve – a drive for perfection through experimentation.
zh: 歸根到底，這來自於漸近 — — 用實驗為推動力一步步邁向完美 — — 的意願。

en: Moreover, he excelled at selling to audiences worldwide both his vision and his strategy for realizing it.
zh: 此外，他還擅長向全世界信徒兜售自己的新願景及其實現戰略。

en: So far, America’s economic policymakers have fallen short on all of these fronts.
zh: 到目前為止，美國經濟決策者在這方面已經大大落後了。

en: Rather than committing to a comprehensive set of urgently-needed reinforcing measures, they seem obsessed with the futile search for the one “killer app” that will solve all of the country's economic problems.
zh: 他們並沒有承諾給出一整套急需的強化措施，而是沉溺於徒勞地尋求“大殺器”來一次性解決美���的所有經濟問題。

en: No surprise that they have yet to find it.
zh: 結果呢？ 當然是一無所獲。

en: Teamwork has repeatedly fallen hostage to turf wars and political bickering.
zh: 團隊合作經常會淪為山頭林立和政治扯皮。

en: Little has been done to deconstruct structural complexity, let alone win sufficient public support for a medium-term vision, a credible implementation strategy, and a set of measures that is adequate to the task at hand.
zh: 目前，我們連解構複雜性的努力都沒有拿出來，更不用說贏得公眾對某個中期願景、某個可信實施戰略以及一攬子足以應付手頭問題的措施的支援了。

en: The longer the policymaking impasse persists, the greater the stall-speed risk for an economy that already has an unemployment crisis, a large budget deficit, many underwater mortgages, and policy interest rates floored at zero.
zh: 決策僵局多持續一日，美國經濟 — — 已經陷入了失業危機、大規模財政赤字和大量資不抵債按揭貸款泥淖，同時政策利率已經下降到零水平 — — 的失速風險就放大一分。

en: This is an atmosphere in which unhealthy balance sheets come under even greater pressure, and healthy investors refuse to engage.
zh: 著這樣的環境下，不健康的資產負債表將進一步承受更大的壓力，而健康的投資者則拒絕趕這趟渾水。

en: In the process, the risk of recession remains uncomfortably high, the unemployment crisis deepens, and inequities rise as already-stretched social safety nets prove even more porous.
zh: 隨之而來的是，衰退風險將繼續陰魂不散，失業危機將繼續深化，而不平等性將隨著已然千瘡百孔的社會安全網的進一步損壞而繼續提高。

en: America, China, and the Productivity Paradox
zh: 美國、中國和生產率悖論

en: NEW HAVEN – In the late 1980s, there was intense debate about the so-called productivity paradox – when massive investments in information technology (IT) were not delivering measureable productivity improvements.
zh: 紐黑文—20世紀80年代末，有一個所謂的生產率悖論的激烈爭論 — — 資訊科技的大規模投資並沒有帶來可測的生產率改進。

en: That paradox is now back, posing a problem for both the United States and China – one that may well come up in their annual Strategic and Economic Dialogue.
zh: 如今，這一悖論捲土重來，給美國和中國造成了一個問題，一個將在一年一度的中美戰略和經濟對話中出現的問題。

en: Back in 1987, Nobel laureate Robert Solow famously quipped, “You can see the computer age everywhere except in the productivity statistics.”
zh: 讓我們回到1987年。 這一年，諾貝爾經濟學獎獲得者羅伯特·索洛（Robert Solow）提出了他的著名諷刺 ： “ 計算機時代隨處可見，就是無法在生產率數字中找到蹤跡。

en: The productivity paradox seemed to be resolved in the 1990s, when America experienced a spectacular productivity renaissance.
zh: ”生產率悖論似乎在20世紀90年代得到了解決，當時，美國出現了蔚為壯觀的生產率復興。

en: Average annual productivity growth in the country’s nonfarm business sector accelerated to 2.5% from 1991 to 2007, from the 1.5% trend in the preceding 15 years.
zh: 1991—2007年美國非農商業部門生產率年增長率為2.5 % ， 而此前15年的趨勢值為1.5 % 。

en: The benefits of the Internet Age had finally materialized.
zh: 網際網路時代的好處終於實現了。

en: Concern about the paradox all but vanished.
zh: 關於生產率悖論的關注也煙消雲散。

en: But the celebration appears to have been premature.
zh: 但人們似乎高興得太早了。

en: Despite another technological revolution, productivity growth is slumping again.
zh: 儘管經歷了又一次技術革命，但生產率增長再次下降。

en: And this time the downturn is global in scope, affecting the world’s two largest economies, the US and China, most of all.
zh: 這一回，生產率下降是全球趨勢，影響最大的正是世界最大的兩個經濟體 — — 美國和中國。

en: Over the past five years, from 2010 to 2014, annual US productivity growth has fallen to an average of 0.9%.
zh: 在過去五年中（2010—2014年 ） ， 美國生產率平均年增長率下降到0.9 % 。

en: It actually fell at a 2.6% annual rate in the two most recent quarters (in late 2014 and early 2015).
zh: 實際上，在最近兩個季度中（2014年底和2015年初 ） ， 生產率以2.6%的年率降低。

en: Barring a major data revision, America’s productivity renaissance seems to have run into serious trouble.
zh: 除非有重大資料修正，否則美國生產率復興已經陷入了大麻煩。

en: China is witnessing a similar pattern.
zh: 中國也經歷了類似的過程。

en: Although the government does not publish regular productivity statistics, there is no mistaking the problem: Overall urban employment growth has been steady, at around 13.2 million workers per year since 2013 – well in excess of the government’s targeted growth rate of ten million.
zh: 儘管政府並不定期公佈生產率數字，但問題已經顯而易見：城鎮總體就業增長十分穩定，自2013年一直保持在每年1,320萬人 — — 遠超政府目標增長率一千萬人。

en: Moreover, hiring seems to be holding at that brisk pace in early 2015.
zh: 而在2015年初，僱用活動似乎繼續維持著這一強勢。

en: At the same time, output growth has slowed from the 10% trend of the 33 years ending in 2011 to around 7% today.
zh: 與此同時，產出增長從33年（截至2011年底）來的趨勢率10%下降到如今的7 % 。

en: That downshift, in the face of sustained rapid job creation, implies an unmistakable deceleration of productivity.
zh: 這一降幅是在持續高速就業創造的背景下發生的，表明生產率必定在減速。

en: Therein lies the latest paradox.
zh: 最新的悖論就在這裡。

en: With revolutionary technologies now driving the creation of new markets (digital media and computerized wearables), services (energy management and DNA sequencing), products (smartphones and robotics), and technology companies (Alibaba and Apple), surely productivity growth must be surging.
zh: 革命性技術正在創造新的市場（數字媒體和計算機化可穿戴裝置 ） 、 服務（能源管理和DNA測序 ） 、 產品（智慧手機和機器人）和高科技公司（阿里巴巴和蘋果 ） ， 毫無疑問生產率增長應該高歌猛進。

en: As a modern-day Solow might say, the ���Internet of Everything” is everywhere except in the productivity statistics.
zh: 當代索洛也許會說 ， “ 萬物聯網”隨處可見，就是無法在生產率數字中找到蹤跡。

en: But is there really a paradox?
zh: 但這真是一個悖論嗎？

en: Northwestern University’s Robert Gordon has argued that IT- and Internet-led innovations like automated high-speed data processing and e-commerce pale in comparison to the breakthroughs of the Industrial Revolution, including the steam engine, electricity, and indoor plumbing.
zh: 西北大學的羅伯特·戈登（Robert Gordon）指出，資訊科技和網際網路引領的創新，如自動化高速資料處理和電子商務等，與包括蒸汽機、電力和自來水的工業革命相比根本不值一提。

en: He maintains that, although these innovations led to dramatic transformations of the major advanced economies – such as higher female labor-force participation, increased transportation speed, urbanization, and normalized temperature control – these changes will be extremely hard to replicate.
zh: 他認為，儘管這些創新給主要發達經濟體帶來了巨大的變化 — — 比如更高的女性勞動力參與率、交通速度的提高、城市化以及標準化溫度控制 — — 但這些變化極其難以複製。

en: Indeed, as taken with today’s revolutionary technologies as we are – I say this staring at my sleek new Apple Watch – I am sympathetic to Gordon’s argument.
zh: 事實上，今天的革命性技術令我沉迷 — — 寫下這句話的時候，我一邊看著我嶄新的蘋果手錶 — — 但我對戈登的觀點深有共鳴。

en: If US productivity figures are to be taken at anything close to face value – a persistently sluggish trend interrupted by a 16-year spurt that now appears to have faded – it is possible that all America has accomplished are transitional efficiency improvements associated with the IT-enabled shift from one technology platform to another.
zh: 如果美國生產率資料確實如其所表現的那樣 — — 一個長期萎靡的趨勢被一個為期16年的漲勢打破，而如今這一漲勢已經消失 — — 那麼有可能美國所取得的所有成就只是資訊科技所驅動的、發生在從一個技術平臺轉移到另一個技術平臺期間的過渡性的效率改進。
