en: Optimists maintain that the official statistics fail to capture marked quality-of-life improvements, which may be true, especially in the light of promising advances in biotechnology and online education.
zh: 樂觀派認為官方數字沒有體現生活質量的顯著改善，也許確實如此，特別是考慮到生物技術和線上教育等重大突破時。

en: But this overlooks a much more important aspect of the productivity-measurement critique: the undercounting of work time associated with the widespread use of portable information appliances.
zh: 但這忽視了生產率衡量手段批評的另一個重要得多的角度：行動式資訊裝置的普及所帶來的工作時間的低估。

en: In the US, the Bureau of Labor Statistics estimates that the length of the average workweek has held steady at about 34 hours since the advent of the Internet two decades ago.
zh: 在美國，據勞動統計局（Bureau of Labor Statistics）估算，平均工作周時長自二十年前網際網路出現以來一直保持在34小時左右。

en: Yet nothing could be further from the truth: knowledge workers continually toil outside the traditional office, checking their email, updating spreadsheets, writing reports, and engaging in collective brainstorming.
zh: 但這與現實相去甚遠：知識工人日益在傳統辦公室之外埋頭苦幹，檢查郵件、更新報表、撰寫報告、參與集體頭腦風暴。

en: Indeed, white-collar knowledge workers – that is, most workers in advanced economies – are now tethered to their workplaces essentially 24 hours a day, seven days a week, a reality that is not reflected in the official statistics.
zh: 事實上，白領知識工人 — — 即發達經濟體的大部分工人 — — 如今需要每天24小時、每週七天隨時待命，這完全沒有體現在官方數字中。

en: Productivity growth is not about working longer; it is about generating more output per unit of labor input.
zh: 生產率並不是工作時間更長；而是關乎單位勞動投入產生更多產出。

en: Any undercounting of output pales in comparison with the IT-assisted undercounting of working hours.
zh: 產出的低估與資訊科技所導致的工作時長低估相比不值一提。

en: China’s productivity slowdown is probably more benign.
zh: 中國生產率減速的情況也許不如美國嚴重。

en: It is an outgrowth of the Chinese economy’s nascent structural transformation from capital-intensive manufacturing to labor-intensive services.
zh: 它是中國經濟從資本密集型製造業向勞動密集型服務業的方興未艾的結構轉型的副產品。

en: Indeed, it was only in 2013 that services supplanted manufacturing and construction as the economy’s largest sector.
zh: 事實上，直到2013年，服務業才超過之熬夜和建築業，成為中國經濟最大的部門。

en: Now the gap is widening, and that is likely to continue.
zh: 如今，差距正在擴大，並且這一趨勢可能會繼續下去。

en: With Chinese services requiring about 30% more workers per unit of output than manufacturing and construction, combined, the economy’s structural rebalancing is now shifting growth to China’s lower-productivity services sector.
zh: 中國服務業每單位產出所需要的工人數量比製造業和建築業加起來還要多30 % ， 因此中國經濟的結構性再平衡正在讓增長轉移到生產率更低的服務業上。

en: China has time before this becomes a problem.
zh: 在這一轉變成為問題之前，中國還有充足的時間。

en: As Gordon notes, there have been long-lasting productivity dividends associated with urbanization – a trend that could continue for at least another decade in China.
zh: 戈登指出，城市化會帶來長期持續的生產率紅利 — — 在中國，這一紅利至少還可以維持十年。

en: But there will come a time when this tailwind subsides and China begins to converge on the so-called frontier of the advanced economies.
zh: 但這股順風終有停止的一天，而中國也將開始想所謂的發達經濟前沿靠攏。

en: At that point, China will face the same productivity challenges that confront America and others.
zh: 到了那一步，中國將面臨美國和其他國家所面臨的相同的生產率挑戰。

en: Chinese policymakers’ new focus on innovation-led growth seems to recognize this risk.
zh: 中國決策者將創新驅動型增長作為新的重點，這表明他們認識到了這一風險。

en: Without powerful innovations, sustaining productivity growth will be an uphill battle.
zh: 沒有強大的創新，維持生產率增長將十分困難。

en: China’s recent shift to a slower-productivity trajectory is an early warning of what may well be one of its most daunting economic challenges.
zh: 中國最近的生產率下降趨勢是一個早期訊號，它將成為中國最艱鉅的經濟挑戰之一。

en: There is no escaping the key role that productivity growth plays in any country’s economic performance.
zh: 生產率增長是一國經濟表現的決定性因素，古今中外概莫能外。

en: Yet, for advanced economies, periods of sustained rapid productivity growth have been the exception, not the rule.
zh: 但是，對發達經濟體而言，持續高速生產率增長已經成為例外而非常規。

en: Recent signs of slowing productivity growth in both the US and China underscore this reality.
zh: 最近出現的中美兩國生產率增長齊降現象凸顯出這一現實。

en: For a world flirting with secular stagnation, that is disturbing news, to say the least.
zh: 對於陷入長期停滯的世界來說，這是個令人心煩的訊息。

en: A New Blueprint for US-China Relations
zh: 美中關係新藍圖

en: NEW YORK – In the coming decades, nothing will matter more for global peace, prosperity, and governance than how the United States and China handle the ongoing shift in their relative power.
zh: 紐約—在未來幾十年中，美國和中國如何應對兩國相對實力的不斷變化將是影響全球和平、繁榮和治理的最重要的因素。

en: In the long term, today’s other pressing challenges – including Russia’s relationship with the West and events in the tumultuous Middle East – will amount almost to sideshows by comparison.
zh: 從長期看，目前的其他緊迫挑戰 — — 包括俄羅斯與西方的關係以及動盪的中東的各種事件 — — 相比之下只能等而下之。

en: What makes the Sino-American relationship dangerous is that powerful forces in both countries seem intent on a collision course.
zh: 讓中美關係變得危險的是兩國的強大力量似乎決定要來一個碰撞。

en: On the Chinese side, under Xi Jinping’s assertive leadership, the government is no longer heeding Deng Xiaoping’s injunction that the country should “hide its strength, bide its time, and never take the lead” in international affairs.
zh: 中國在習近平的強勢領導下，政府不再遵循鄧小平在國際事務上“韜光養晦，等待時機，永遠不要當頭”的遺訓。

en: It has pursued manifestly expansionist territorial claims, most notably in the South China Sea, and shown a clear determination to resist the indefinite continuation of American dominance in the region.
zh: 中國開始公然追求擴張主義領土主張，特別是在南海，並明確表現出反對美國在該地區無限期主導的決心。

en: The prevailing Chinese mindset is that the US is intent on isolating, containing, and undermining it.
zh: 中國人普遍認為，美國想要孤立、遏制和破壞中國。

en: Unhappily, there is plenty of evidence on the US side to feed that sentiment.
zh: 令人不快的是，美國方面的諸多證據催生了這一情緒。

en: Whatever many American policymakers may be saying in private, their public discourse almost invariably reflects an intention to remain the world’s dominant power – and specifically in Asia – in perpetuity.
zh: 不管美國決策者私下裡怎麼說，他們在公開場合幾乎無一例外地表示要永遠保持美國的世界主宰力 — — 特別是在亞洲。

en: The most confrontational recent articulation of this position can be found in a report for the Council on Foreign Relations, by Robert Blackwill and Ashley Tellis, arguing that the central objective of American grand strategy must be “preserving US primacy in the global system,” and urging a series of aggressive economic, political, and military measures to “balance” China.
zh: 這一立場最近的最具衝突性的表現莫過於羅伯特·布萊克維爾（Robert Blackwill）和阿什利·泰利斯（Ashley Tellis）撰寫的外交關係委員會（Council on Foreign Relations）報告。 該報告認為，美國大戰略的核心目標必須是“保持美國在全球體系中的超然地位 ， ” 並敦促美國政府採取一系列進攻性經濟、政治和軍事手段以“制衡”中國。

en: They say this is not a “containment” strategy, but it amounts to nothing less.
zh: 他們說，這不是“遏制”戰略，但其程度絕不下於遏制。

en: Is there another way to manage the relationship that, while reflecting the reality of these forces and mindsets on both sides, would not risk turning legitimate competition into dangerous confrontation?
zh: 有沒有另一種處理辦法，既能反映雙方的這些力量和思維的現實，又不會讓合理競爭演變為危險的衝突？

en: In a new report for the Harvard Kennedy School’s Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs, Kevin Rudd, former Australian Prime Minister and now head of the Asia Society Policy Institute, outlines just such a strategy, which he calls “constructive realism”.
zh: 在哈佛大學肯尼迪學院貝爾福爾科學和國際關係中心（Belfer Center for Science and International Affairs）的一份 新報告中，前澳大利亞總理、現任亞洲社會政策研究所（Asia Society Policy Institute）的陸克文（Kevin Rudd）提出了這樣一個戰略，他稱之為“建設性現實主義 ” 。

en: It’s a clunky label, but his analysis and policy prescriptions are compelling.
zh: 這是一個笨重的主題，但他的分析和政策建議極具說服力。

en: The “realist” dimension of Rudd’s argument recognizes that certain areas of disagreement – including Taiwan, territorial disputes in the South and East China Seas, US alliances in Asia, Chinese military modernization, and the legitimacy of China’s political system – will remain intractable for the foreseeable future.
zh: 陸克文觀點的“現實主義”維度承認，分歧的某些方面 — — 包括臺灣問題、南海和東海領土糾紛、美國的亞洲盟友、中國軍事現代化和中國政治制度合法性等 — — 在可預見的未來仍然非常棘手。

en: They will defy easy solutions – and thus will require very careful management.
zh: 這意味著不可能有容易的解決方案 — — 因此需要非常謹慎的管理。

en: The “constructive” part of Rudd’s thesis argues for systematic collaboration – with the US treating China more as an equal – in tackling a series of other difficult issues at bilateral, regional, and global levels.
zh: 陸克文報告的“建設性”部分提出，在處理雙邊、地區和全球層面上的一系列其他難題是，可以進行系統協作 — — 美國更應該將中國視為平等的對手。

en: Bilaterally, such cooperation might involve an investment treaty, a joint intelligence task force on terrorism, a cyber-security protocol, agreed measures for managing unplanned military incidents, and mutual ratification of the Comprehensive Nuclear Test-Ban Treaty.
zh: 就雙邊情形而論，這類合作可以包括投資條約、聯合反恐情報特勤組、網路安全協議、一致的意料外軍事事故管理辦法、互相批准全面禁止核武器條約（Comprehensive Nuclear Test-Ban Treaty）等。

en: On a regional level, Rudd argues, the US and China could work on joint strategies to denuclearize and, ultimately, reunify the Korean Peninsula; tackle the lingering sore of Japan’s war history; harmonize regional trade agreements; and transform the East Asia Summit into a more complete Asia-Pacific Community.
zh: 在地區層面，陸克文指出，美國和中國可以致力於制定聯合戰略，以促進朝鮮半島的去核化以及最終重新統一、處理長期懸而未決的日本戰爭史問題、協調地區貿易協議、將東亞峰會辦成更全面的亞太共同體等。

en: Globally, Rudd believes that the joint agenda could focus on combating climate change, revitalizing the G-20, further internationalizing the renminbi; giving China a greater role in the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank; and reforming other key international institutions within the UN system.
zh: 就全球層面而論，陸克文認為中美聯合日程應該著重於抵抗氣候變化、提振G-20、人民幣的進一步國際化、給予中國在國際貨幣基金組織和世界銀行更重要的角色、在聯合國體系內改革其他重要國際機構等。

en: Some in the West – including veteran China watcher David Shambaugh – remain convinced that this kind of collaborative accommodation will not be necessary, because failures of economic and political management will bring about China’s implosion.
zh: 一些西方人 — — 包括老牌中國觀察家沈大偉（David Shambaugh ） — —仍認為這類協作性適應（collaborative accommodation）並非必須，因為經濟和政治管理的失敗將讓中國從內部崩潰。

en: Rudd argues that they are wrong, and that Xi will neither overplay his authoritarian hand nor under-deliver on growth.
zh: 陸克文認為這些人是錯誤的，習近平不會過度使用極權措施，也不會讓增長大幅降低。

en: China’s rise will continue, and the world – including the US – will have to find principled ways of peacefully accommodating it.
zh: 中國將繼續崛起，而世界 — — 包括美國 — — 必須找到和平適應這一變化的原則性方法。

en: Rudd’s recommendations are undoubtedly ambitious.
zh: 陸克文的建議毫無疑問是宏大的。

en: But, given his credentials – he is a formidable Chinese linguist and creative policy thinker, with long and close personal relationships with key figures in both the US and China – his argument must be taken seriously.
zh: 但是，憑他的資質 — — 他精通漢語，又是建設性政策思想家，與美國和中國的重要人物有著長期緊密的個人關係 — — 他的觀點必須認真對待。

en: Indeed, though Rudd’s tenure as Australia’s prime minister was anything but smooth, his sheer force of intellect is unmatched by that of any public figure with whom I have interacted over the last 30 years.
zh: 事實上，儘管陸克文的澳大利亞總理生涯一點都不平坦，但他的過人智力是我在過去30年裡打過交道的所有公共人物中首屈一指的。

en: (Not that this will much help his evident willingness to be drafted as the next UN Secretary-General: in that role the major powers have always preferred bland secretaries to creative generals.)
zh: （這未必大大有助於他顯而易見的爭取成為下一任聯合國秘書長的意願：對於這個職位，主要大國永遠更喜歡平庸溫和的秘書，而不是有創造力的統帥。 ）

en: No American presidential candidate is likely to be comfortable talking about the US as anything other than Number One.
zh: 美國總統候選人絕不可能躊躇滿志地大談美國不再是第一名。

en: But we must hope that in the years ahead we hear less talk of “primacy” and “dominance” and much more about cooperation and collaboration.
zh: 但是，在未來幾年中，但願我們可以少聽到一些“超然 ” 、 “主宰 ” ， 多聽到一些合作和協作。

en: It is only with such US policies toward China that the world can begin to be confident that the twenty-first century will not, like the last, become a vale of tears.
zh: 只有這樣的美國對華政策可以讓世界有信心二十一世紀不會重蹈二十世紀淚流成河的覆轍。

en: A Bilateral Foil for America’s Multilateral Dilemma
zh: 美國多邊困境的一塊雙邊遮羞布

en: NEW HAVEN – The good news is that the United States and China appear to have backed away from the precipice of a trade war.
zh: 發自紐黑文 — — 美中兩國似乎已經從貿易戰的懸崖邊上撤了回來，這是個好訊息。

en: While vague in detail, a May 19 agreement defuses tension and commits to further negotiation.
zh: 雖然細節披露不多，但5月19日達成的協議消解了緊張局勢並承諾展開進一步談判。

en: The bad news is that the framework of negotiations is flawed: A deal with any one country will do little to resolve America’s fundamental economic imbalances that have arisen in an interconnected world.
zh: 而壞訊息則是這一系列談判的框架是有缺陷的：要想解決美國在一個相互聯絡的世界中產生的基礎經濟失衡問題，光靠跟任何一個國家達成協議都是杯水車薪。

en: There is a longstanding disconnect between bilateral and multilateral approaches to international economic problems.
zh: 針對國際經濟問題的雙邊和多邊解決方案之間長期存在著脫節。

en: In May 1930, some 1,028 of America’s leading academic economists wrote a public letter to US President Herbert Hoover urging him to veto the pending Smoot-Hawley tariff bill.
zh: 1930年5月，1028名美國知名學術經濟學家向時任總統的赫伯特·胡佛（Herbert Hoover）寫了一封公開信，敦促他否決尚未透過的斯穆特-霍利（Smoot-Hawley）關稅法案。

en: Hoover ignored the advice, and the global trade war that followed made a garden-variety depression “great.”
zh: 胡佛忽視了這一建議，結果隨之而來的全球貿易戰把一場原本小規模的蕭條搞“大”了。

en: President Donald Trump has put a comparable spin on what it takes to “make America great again.”
zh: 而如今特朗普總統對如何實現“讓美國再度偉大起來”這句口號的解讀方式也與前者異曲同工。

en: Politicians have long favored the bilateral perspective, because it simplifies blame: you “solve” problems by targeting a specific country.
zh: 政客們一直都偏愛雙邊的觀點，因為這可以將矛盾簡單化：你透過針對特定國家來“解決”問題。

en: By contrast, the multilateral approach appeals to most economists, because it stresses the balance-of-payments distortions that arise from mismatches between saving and investment.
zh: 相比之下多邊手段得到了大多數經濟學家的贊同，因為它強調了儲蓄和投資之間錯配所導致的國際收支扭曲。

en: This contrast between the simple and the complex is an obvious and important reason why economists often lose public debates.
zh: 而這種簡單和複雜之間的對比正是經濟學家經常在公眾辯論中落入下風的明顯重要原因。

en: The dismal science has never been known for clarity.
zh: 須知這門晦澀的學科從來都不是以清晰明瞭著稱的。

en: Such is the case with the US-China debate.
zh: 美中之辯正是如此。

en: China is an easy political target.
zh: 中國很容易被鎖定為一個政治目標。

en: After all, it accounted for 46% of America’s colossal $800 billion merchandise trade gap in 2017.
zh: 畢竟它在2017年佔據了美國8000億美元鉅額商品貿易逆差的46 ％ 。

en: Moreover, China has been charged with egregious violations of international rules, ranging from allegations of currency manipulation and state-subsidized dumping of excess capacity to cyber-hacking and forced technology transfer.
zh: 此外中國還被指控惡意違反國際規則，從貨幣操縱、國家補貼傾銷過剩產能，再到網路駭客行為以及強制技術轉讓。

en: Equally significant, China has lost the battle in the arena of public opinion – chastised by Western policymakers, a few high-profile academics, and others for having failed to live up to the grand bargain struck in 2001, when the country was admitted to the World Trade Organization.
zh: 同樣重要的是，中國在公共輿論領域已經身敗名裂 — — 受到西方政策制定者，一些知名學者以及其他認為該國未能兌現2001年加入WTO所承諾條款的人所指責。

en: A recent article in Foreign Affairs by two senior officials in the Obama administration says it all: “(T)he liberal international order has failed to lure or bind China as powerfully as expected.”
zh: 原奧巴馬政府的兩位高階官員最近在《外交》雜誌上發表的一篇文章一語中的 ： “ 自由的國際秩序沒未如預期那樣有力地誘惑或約束中國。

en: As is the case with North Korea, Syria, and Iran, strategic patience has given way to impatience, with the nationalistic Trump administration leading the charge against China.
zh: ”正如與朝鮮，敘利亞和伊朗那樣，戰略上的隱忍已經被煩躁所取代，而秉承民族主義的特朗普政府領導正是衝在了攻擊中國的最前線。

en: The counter-argument from multilateral-focused economists like me rings hollow in this climate.
zh: 而在這種氣氛中，來自像我這類多邊主義經濟學家的反對論點就顯得空洞無聊。

en: Tracing outsize current-account and trade deficits to an extraordinary shortfall of US domestic saving – just 1.3% of national income in the fourth quarter of 2017 – counts for little in the arena of popular opinion.
zh: 將美國巨大的經常賬戶和貿易逆差歸結於國內儲蓄的極端短缺 — — 在2017年第四季度僅相當於國民收入的1.3 ％ — —在公共輿論中不受待見。

en: Likewise, it doesn’t help when we emphasize that China is merely a large piece of a much bigger multilateral problem: the US had bilateral merchandise trade deficits with 102 countries in 2017.
zh: 同樣，當我們強調中國只是一個更龐大多邊問題的其中一個大的板塊時也無濟於事：美國在2017年可是與102個國家之間存在雙邊商品貿易逆差。

en: Nor does it matter when we point out that correcting for supply-chain distortions – caused by inputs from other countries that enter into Chinese assembly platforms – would reduce the bilateral US-China trade imbalance by 35-40%.
zh: 我們還指出存在自其他國家輸入中國裝配平臺的原料所引起的供應鏈扭曲現象，一旦把這種統計手法糾正過來將會令美中貿易失衡數字減少35~40 ％ ， 但應者寥寥。

en: Flawed as it may be, the bilateral political case resonates in a US where there is enormous pressure to ease the angst of the country’s beleaguered middle class.
zh: 儘管可能存在著謬誤，但雙邊政治話題的爭論在美國引起了共鳴，因為該國陷入困境的中產階級急於為自身的焦慮找到發洩口。

en: Trade deficits, goes the argument, lead to job losses and wage compression.
zh: 爭論中的說法是貿易赤字導致了失業以及工資縮減。

en: And, with the merchandise trade gap hitting 4.2% of GDP in 2017, these pressures have only intensified in the current economic recovery.
zh: 同時由於2017年的商品貿易缺口已經相當於GDP的4.2 ％ ， 這類壓力在當前的經濟復甦中只會日益加劇。

en: As a result, targeting China has enormous political appeal.
zh: 因此針對中國就具有巨大的政治吸引力。

en: So, what can be made of the May 19 deal?
zh: 那麼5月19日的交易又能敲定些什麼呢？

en: Beyond a ceasefire in tit-for-tat tariffs, there are few real benefits.
zh: 這除了叫停針鋒相對的關稅戰之外幾乎沒有實際好處。

en: US negotiators are fixated on targeted reductions of around $200 billion in the bilateral trade imbalance over a two-year time frame.
zh: 美國談判代表的全部注意力都集中於在兩年時間框架內將雙邊貿易不平衡削減約2000億美元的目標上。

en: Given the extent of America’s multilateral problem, this is largely a meaningless objective, especially in light of the massive and ill-timed tax cuts and federal expenditure increases that the US has enacted in the last six months.
zh: 而鑑於美國多邊問題的嚴重程度，這一目標在很大程度上是毫無意義的，尤其是美國在過去六個月出臺了大規模且不合時宜的減稅以及聯邦支出增長。

en: Indeed, with budget deficits likely to widen, America’s saving shortfall will only deepen in the years ahead.
zh: 事實上，由於預算赤字可能繼續擴大，美國的儲蓄缺口只會在未來幾年內進一步加深。

en: That points to rising balance-of-payments and multilateral trade deficits, which are impossible to resolve through targeted bilateral actions against a single country.
zh: 這意味著國際收支和多邊貿易的赤字都會增大，而這些赤字也無法透過面向某一國的針對性雙邊行動來解決。

en: Chinese negotiators are more circumspect, resisting numerical deficit targets but committing to the joint objective of “effective measures to substantially reduce” the bilateral imbalance with the US.
zh: 中方則更加謹慎，一方面抵制任何量化的赤字目標，另一方面又承諾實現“透過有效措施大幅減少”對美雙邊失衡狀況的共同目標。

en: China’s vague promise to purchase more American-made agricultural and energy products borrows a page from the “shopping list” approach of its earlier trade missions to the US.
zh: 中國對於購買更多美國農產品和能源產品的模糊承諾沿襲了其前一段時間赴美貿易代表團的“購物清單”手段。

en: Unfortunately, the big-wallet mindset of a deal-hungry China reinforces the US narrative that China is guilty as charged.
zh: 不幸的是，中國這種渴望大撒金錢來換取交易達成的思維反而讓美方更加坐實了那種中國有罪的說法。

en: Even if the stars were in perfect alignment and the US was not facing a saving constraint, it stretches credibility to seek a formulaic bilateral solution to America’s multilateral problem.
zh: 就算中方與美方步調一致且美國能擺脫儲蓄的掣肘，但美方尋求用一種公式化的雙邊方案來解決自身多邊問題的做法實際上也濫用了其信譽。

en: Since 2000, the largest annual reduction in the US-China merchandise trade imbalance amounted to $41 billion, and that occurred in 2009, during the depths of the Great Recession.
zh: 自2000年以來美中商品貿易失衡的最大年度縮減量為410億美元，但這一縮減是發生在2009年大衰退的最嚴重階段。

en: The goal of achieving back-to-back annual reductions totaling more than double that magnitude is sheer fantasy.
zh: 可見想要連續兩年實現該縮減量兩倍以上的目標純屬痴心妄想。

en: In the end, any effort to impose a bilateral solution on a multilateral problem will backfire, with ominous consequences for American consumers.
zh: 最後，任何在多邊問題上強加雙邊解決方案的努力都會適得其反，以致為美國消費者造成不利後果。

en: Without addressing the shortfall in domestic saving, the bilateral fix simply moves the deficit from one economy to others.
zh: 如果不解決國內儲蓄不足的問題，雙邊解決方案只不過是將赤字從一個經濟體轉移到另一個經濟體而已。

en: Therein lies the cruelest twist of all.
zh: 這是最棘手的問題。

en: China is America’s low-cost provider of imported consumer goods.
zh: 中國是美國進口消費品的低成本供應商。

en: The Trump deal would shift the Chinese piece of America’s multilateral imbalance to higher-cost imports from elsewhere – the functional equivalent of a tax hike on American families.
zh: 特朗普的這筆交易將把屬於中國的這一部分美國多邊失衡問題轉移到其他地方的更高成本進口商品上 — — 這形同於給美國家庭的加稅。

en: As Hoover’s ghost might ask, what’s so great about that?
zh: 倘若胡佛泉下有知，也會問這種做法究竟有什麼“偉大”可言呢？

en: America Confronts Old and New Europe
zh: 美國面對的新舊歐洲

en: US Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld's petulant remark of last year about "old and new Europe" was right for the wrong reasons.
zh: 美國國防部長唐納德·拉姆斯菲費爾德去年有關"新舊歐洲"的胡言亂語剛好歪打正著。

en: He meant it to refer to Europe's divisions, but in May, ten additional states joined the European Union.
zh: 他本來是指歐洲的分裂，但今年5月，又有10個國家納入了歐洲聯盟。

en: The expanded Europe truly forms a new Europe.
zh: 擴張後的歐洲真的成了新歐洲。

en: Should America be nervous?
zh: 這是否令美國感到不安？

en: Fifty-four years after the announcement of the Schuman Plan that began to knit together the economies of France and Germany, the EU now has 25 countries and a population larger than that of the United States.
zh: 聯結法德兩國經濟的舒曼計劃頒佈54年後的今天，歐盟已有25個成員國，人口數甚至超過了美國。

en: Eight of the new members are former Communist countries that were locked behind the Iron Curtain for nearly half a century.
zh: 其中8個新成員為前共產黨國家，近半個世紀來他們被鐵幕重重封鎖。

en: Their attraction to the Union is a sign of the appeal - the "soft power" - of the idea of European unification.
zh: 它們加入歐盟表明了歐洲統一理念"軟性力量"所具有的強大生命力。

en: Of course, this new Europe faces many problems.
zh: 勿庸置疑，這個新歐洲面臨著巨大的挑戰。

en: The per capita income of the new countries is less than half of that of the fifteen members they are joining. Concerns have been raised about the influx of cheap labor.
zh: 新成員的人均生產總值還不到原有15個國家的一半，廉價勞動力的大量湧入也引起了人們不小的擔憂。

en: But average GDP growth rates in the new members are twice as high as in the original members, and this can provide a welcome stimulus to stagnant labor markets and sluggish economies.
zh: 但新成員的平均國內產值增長率是原有成員國的兩倍，這對停滯的勞動力市場和裹足不前的經濟將產生良好的促進作用。

en: Political arrangements are somewhat more problematic.
zh: 政治局勢似乎更加問題重重。

en: Negotiations are underway to revise a draft EU constitution.
zh: 各成員國正在談判，修改歐盟憲法草案。

en: Some Europeans worry that the constitution will enable courts to carry the integration process further and faster than public opinion in member states will tolerate.
zh: 歐洲某些人擔心憲法將賦予法院權力，以超出成員國公眾所能容忍的最快速度推進歐洲的統一程序。

en: Lack of grassroots support might lead to rejection of the constitution in countries like Britain, where referenda have been promised before the new arrangements come into force.
zh: 缺少來自底層的支援可能導致英國等國否決這一憲法，因為上述當局許諾在新局勢成形前舉行全民公決。

en: Across the Atlantic, most Americans (to the extent they pay attention) regard these changes with general approval.
zh: 大西洋的另一端，關注此事的美國人多數持贊成態度。

en: But some express concern that the new Europe will be defined in opposition to the US.
zh: 但也有人表達了新歐洲也許會與美國作對的擔憂。

en: Not only do the remarks of French leaders about recreating a multi-polar world arouse alarm, but recent public opinion polls show a decline in the popularity of the US among Europeans and a desire for more independent policies.
zh: 不僅法國領導人重建多極世界的講話令人驚恐，最近的民意測驗也表明美國在歐洲的受歡迎程度日益下降，以及歐洲人對獨立自主政策越來越強烈的渴望。

en: The Iraq War proved costly to American soft power, with the US losing about 30 percentage points of attractiveness on average in Europe, including in countries like Britain, Spain, and Italy, whose governments supported the war.
zh: 對伊戰爭讓美國的"軟性力量"付出了昂貴的代價，美國在歐洲國家的平均吸引力下降了約30個百分點，其中包括在英國、西班牙和義大利等支援這場戰爭的國家。

en: The recent photographs of detainees being abused and sexually degraded in Baghdad's Abu Ghraib prison added fuel to the fire.
zh: 不久前戰俘在巴格達阿布格萊布監獄遭受虐待和性侮辱的照片曝光更為這一事件火上澆油。

en: Now some American neo-conservatives argue that the US should drop its longstanding support for European integration.
zh: 如今，美國某些新保守主義者甚至主張撤銷長久以來對歐洲統一程序的支援。

en: Such a policy change would be a serious mistake.
zh: 這樣的政策變化將犯下嚴重的錯誤。

en: Not only would it add to anti-American attitudes and fail to accomplish its objectives, but it over-estimates the extent to which the new Europe is being formed in opposition to the US.
zh: 它不僅助長反美情緒，達不到既定目標，還過高估計了新歐洲形成給美國帶來的威脅。

en: Whatever the rhetoric in France, for example, the policies and attitudes in countries such as Britain or Poland demonstrate that good trans-Atlantic relations can be maintained.
zh: 無論法國怎樣慷慨陳辭，英國或波蘭等國的態度依然表明：良好的泛大西洋關係能夠維持下去。

en: If anything, the risks of a US-Europe split will be reduced rather than increased by the EU's recent enlargement.
zh: 如果一定要說影響，那麼最近歐洲的東擴將削減而非助長美歐分裂的危險。

en: Moreover, there are several objective reasons why the current friction between Europe and the US is unlikely to lead to divorce.
zh: 此外，若干客觀原因使目前的歐美摩擦不會導致分離。

en: For one thing, the divisive war in Iraq may turn out to be the last act of the twentieth century rather than a harbinger of the twenty-first.
zh: 首先，伊拉克的分裂戰爭也許標誌著20世紀的終結，但絕非21世紀的起始。

en: American unilateralism is much less in evidence in the world's other hot spots, such as North Korea and Iran, both because of the costs of the war in Iraq and the realities of the situation in those other regions.
zh: 美國的單邊主義在北朝鮮和伊朗等其它熱點地區遠沒有如此明顯，這既因為伊拉克戰爭代價慘重，也是其它地區的現實情況使然。

en: Moreover, while the common security threat from the Soviet Union has disappeared, both the US and Europe face a new common threat from radical jihadist terrorism.
zh: 還有一點。 儘管蘇聯帶來的常規安全威脅已經不復存在，美國和歐洲又面臨著激進的吉哈德恐怖運動的共同威脅。

en: Neither side of the Atlantic is immune to the threat, despite the efforts of Osama bin Laden to drive a wedge between Europe and America.
zh: 這種威脅在大西洋兩岸同樣存在，儘管奧薩馬·本·拉登試圖在歐美之間挑起矛盾。

en: Transnational terrorism can only be confronted by close civilian cooperation such as intelligence sharing, police work across borders, and tracing financial flows. These forms of cooperation survived the divisions over Iraq.
zh: 只有透過情報共享、跨國警界合作和追蹤金融匯兌等密切的民間合作，才有可能戰勝跨越國界的恐怖活動。

en: Europe and America also share a common structure of economic interests and values.
zh: 歐洲和美國還擁有共同的經濟利益和價值觀結構。

en: While trade produces frictions in democracies, it also enhances wealth.
zh: 儘管貿易造成民主國家間的摩擦，但同時也帶來巨大的財富。

en: If one looks at foreign direct investment, it is clear that the two sides of the Atlantic are closely integrated.
zh: 看看國外直接投資就知道，大西洋兩岸是緊密聯絡在一起的。

en: In terms of values, while some differences exist between Europe and America, at the fundamental level of democracy and human rights, no other two parts of the globe share more.
zh: 價值觀方面，儘管歐洲和美國間存在分歧，但在民主和人權的根本問題上，沒有哪兩個地區觀點如此一致。

en: As the writer Robert Kagan concluded in the revision of his book in which he declared Europeans to be from Venus and Americans from Mars, it turns out that Americans seeking democratic legitimization of their policies and self-images cannot escape Europe.
zh: 正如作家Robert Kagan在其著作修訂版中總結的那樣，歐洲源於金星而美國源於火星，但最終尋求合法政策及自我形象的美國離不開歐洲的支援。

en: In short, it is good for Americans - and for the world - that old and new Europe are becoming one.
zh: 簡而言之，新舊歐洲合而為一對美國和世界都是喜訊。

en: We can all benefit from the soft power of an enlarged Europe.
zh: 我們都將受益於經過擴張的歐洲所擁有的軟性力量。

en: America’s Baby Bust
zh: 美國的生育低谷

en: LONDON – News that the United States’ fertility rate fell in 2017 to 1.75 has provoked surprise and concern.
zh: 倫敦—2017 年美國生育率下降到1.75，這則新聞令人驚訝又擔心。

en: A buoyant US economy in the 1990s and early 2000s was accompanied by fertility rates of 2.00-2.05 children per woman, up from 1.8-1.9 in the 1980s.
zh: 1990年代末至21世紀初，美國經濟繁榮，生育率為每個婦女生2.00—2.05個孩子，而1980年代為1.8—1.9。

en: But the increasingly strong economic recovery of the last five years has been accompanied by a declining birth rate.
zh: 但在過去五年，經濟復甦越來越強勁，生育率反而下降。

en: That seems to presage a long-term shortage of workers relative to retirees, and severe financial pressures on pension funds and health-care provision.
zh: 這也許預示著工人將相對退休者出現長期短缺，退休基金和醫療供給將面臨沉重財務壓力。

en: But the assumption that stronger growth and economic confidence must generate higher fertility – with low birth rates reflecting pessimism about the future – is not justified by the evidence.
zh: 但認為較強勁的增長和經濟資訊必然產生更高的生育率 — — 而出生率下降反映人們對未來感到悲觀 — — 並無證據支援。

en: Moreover, fertility rates at around the current US level do not pose severe problems – and bring some benefits.
zh: 此外，美國當前水平的生育率也不會造成嚴重問題 — — 還會帶來一些好處。

en: In all major developed economies, fertility rates fell during the 1960s and 70s, reaching levels below the replacement rate of around 2.05 children per woman.
zh: 在所有主要發達經濟體中，1960和70年代都出現了生育率下降，下降到每位婦女聲譽2.05個孩子的替代率以下。

en: The US rate reached 1.77 in the late 1970s, compared to 1.8 in Northern Europe and 1.65 in Western Europe.
zh: 美國在1970年代末的生育率達到過1.77，而北歐為1.8，西歐為1.65。

en: And while we cannot be certain, the best expectation is that this shift to fertility rates significantly below the replacement rate will prove permanent, with temporary reversals driven by specific one-off factors.
zh: 儘管我們不能確定，但想必這一生育率顯著低於替代率的變化方向會一直維持下去，當中會有一些因一次性因素導致的反覆。

en: Some viewed the US return to somewhat higher fertility rates in the 1990s as the consequence of greater economic dynamism and confidence, in contrast to “old Europe.”
zh: 一些人認為，美國在1990年代恢復了較高的生育率是因為經濟活力和信心提高，這與“老歐洲”形成了鮮明對比。

en: But throughout the last 30 years, fertility rates for white and black Americans have remained significantly below replacement level, and the three-decade rise and fall of US birth rates is explained primarily by higher Hispanic fertility, reflecting the common phenomenon that first-generation immigrants’ fertility rates are typically similar to those in their poorer countries of origin.
zh: 但在過去30年終，美國白人和黑人生育率都遠低於替代率，三十年來美國生育率的起落主要原因是西班牙裔生育率較高，這反映了一個常有的現象：初代移民生育率往往與較貧窮的來源國相仿。

en: The same effect explains why Canada – with immigration skewed toward low-fertility Asian countries of origin – has had a significantly lower fertility rate of around 1.6.
zh: 同樣的效應解釋了為何加拿大 — — 移民大多來自低生育率的亞洲國家 — — 生育率一直保持在1.6左右的顯著更低的水平。

en: But with Latin American fertility rates now in steep decline – Mexico’s is down from 2.9 in 2000 to 2.1 today, and Brazil’s has fallen from 2.5 to 1.7 – the immigrant-induced effect is disappearing, and the US is reverting to a typical fertility rate for a rich developed country.
zh: 但如今，拉丁美洲生育率大幅下降 — — 墨西哥從2000年的2.9下降到今天的2.1，巴西從2.5下降到1.7 — — 移民導致的效應正在消失，美國正在迴歸富裕發達國家典型的生育率。

en: Absent temporary migration-induced effects, all major developed economies have shifted to fertility rates of 1.2-2.0, with most falling between 1.3 and 1.9.
zh: 剔除暫時性移民導致的效應，所有主要發達經濟體的生育率到演變為1.2—2.0，其中大部分下降到了1.3到1.9之間。

en: And while there is some evidence that sudden deep recessions produce temporary fertility dips, followed by rebounds, cross-country comparison provides no evidence of any correlation – positive or negative – between medium-term economic success and precise fertility rates within this range.
zh: 一些證據表明，突發深度衰退會造成暫時性的生育率下降，隨後發生反彈，但跨國比較並未表明中期經濟成功與該區間內的具體生育率之間存在相關性 — — 不管是正還是負。

en: Canada, with its lower fertility rate, is quite as successful and confident as the US.
zh: 加拿大生育率較低，但其經濟與美國一樣成功和自信。

en: Strong German growth over the last 20 years has been combined with a fertility rate of 1.4-1.5, well below the 1.98 rate in less successful France.
zh: 過去20年來強勁的德國增長率帶來了1.4—1.5的生育率，遠低於不太成功的法國。

en: South Korea has maintained economic expansion with a fertility rate of just 1.2-1.3.
zh: 韓國以僅有1.2—1.3的生育率保持了經濟擴張。

en: Latin America’s most prosperous economy, Chile, has a fertility rate of 1.76, well below less successful Argentina’s rate of 2.27.
zh: 拉丁美洲最繁榮的經濟體智利的生育率也只有1.76，遠低於不太成功的阿根廷的生育率2.27。

en: The recent decline in US fertility is therefore unsurprising; and, provided it does not fall to much lower levels, there is no cause for concern.
zh: 因此，最近美國生育率的下降不足為奇；只要它不跌到顯著更低的程度，就沒有必要擔心。

en: Of course, in the long run, a lower fertility rate, combined with rising life expectancy, will produce a higher ratio of those over 65 years old to those conventionally labeled as “working age.”
zh: 當然，在長期，較低的生育率加上預期壽命的延長，將導致65歲以上人口與傳統上的“工作年齡”人口的比率。

en: But as people live longer and healthier lives, retirement ages can and should be increased.
zh: 但由於人們能夠活得更長、更健康，退休年齡也能夠並且應該提高。

en: And in a world of radical automation potential, which threatens low wage growth and rising inequality, a rapidly growing workforce is neither necessary nor beneficial, and a slightly contracting supply of workers may create useful incentives to improve productivity and support real wage growth.
zh: 在自動化潛力巨大的世界中，很可能發生工資增長低迷、不平等性加劇，迅速增加的工作人口既非必要，也無好處，而略微吃緊的工人供給可能能夠成為有用的刺激來改善生產率、支援真實工資增長。

en: Notably, fears that robots will take jobs are much less prevalent in Japan and China than in higher-fertility Western countries.
zh: 引人注目的是，對機器人將搶走飯碗的擔心在日本和中國遠不及生育率更高的西方國家的普遍。

en: In rich developed societies with modern attitudes to the role of women, fertility rates somewhat below replacement levels may thus be both inevitable and broadly welcome.
zh: 因此，在對婦女的作用持現代看法的富裕發達社會中，生育率總是會低於替代率也是是不可避免的，總體而言也是值得歡迎的。

en: But degree matters, and extremely low fertility, such as Japan’s rate of 1.4, will create major problems if permanently maintained.
zh: 但程度很重要，極低的生育率，比如日本只有1.4，如果長久保持的話，會造成重大問題。

en: The United Nations median projection suggests that the total population of North and South America, after growing by another 15-20% between now and 2050, will remain roughly stable for the rest of the twenty-first century.
zh: 聯合國中位預測表明，從現在到2050年，北美和南美總人口將再增加15—20 % ， 此後直到二十一世紀末都將保持穩定。

en: By contrast, Japan’s population is projected to fall from 125 million today to around 80 million.
zh: 相反，日本人口預計會從今天的1.25億下降到8,000萬左右。

en: Demographic contraction on that scale will severely stress Japan’s ability to support an aging population.
zh: 人口規模收縮將嚴重製約日本支援老齡化人口的能力。

en: Intelligent policy should therefore identify and remove any barriers unnecessarily depressing birth rates, such as labor-market discrimination, limited parental leave, or inadequate childcare facilities, which make it difficult for women to combine careers with having as many children as they wish.
zh: 因此，明智的政策應該辨別並消除一切非必要的抑制出生率的障礙，如勞動力市場歧視、限制育兒假，或兒童看護設施不足等，這些障礙讓婦女難以既追求事業，又能想生多少生多少。

en: The Scandinavian countries are exemplary in this respect, though fertility rates there have not returned to replacement levels, but only to about 1.75-1.9.
zh: 斯堪的納維亞國家是這方面的典範，儘管它們的生育率並沒有恢復到替代率，而是隻有1.75—1.9。

en: Similar policies in the US might marginally increase the fertility rate from today’s 1.75, with a mildly beneficial net effect.
zh: 美國採取類似政策的話，也許可以將生育率在目前1.75的水平的基礎上略微提高，形成比較有利的淨結果。

en: But the predominant response to America’s recent fertility decline should be to accept it as inevitable and to stop worrying about it.
zh: 但對於美國近期的生育率下降局面，最主要的應對應該是接受它的不可避免性，停止為它擔憂。

en: The US Is Exporting Obesity
zh: 輸出肥胖的美國

en: CAMBRIDGE – As US President Donald Trump’s administration throws sharp elbows in trade negotiations and systematically rescinds regulations introduced by President Barack Obama, one casualty is likely to be efforts to fight the global obesity epidemic.
zh: 發自劍橋 — — 當美國總統特朗普的政府在貿易談判中上竄下跳，並有計劃地撤銷奧巴馬總統所引入的條例時，其中一個深受其害的事務很可能是抗擊全球肥胖症流行現象的工作。

en: Left unchecked, rapidly rising obesity rates could slow or even reverse the dramatic gains in health and life expectancy that much of the world has enjoyed over the past few decades.
zh: 如果不加控制，肥胖率的迅速上升可能會減緩甚至扭轉過去幾十年來世界大部分地區醫療衛生水平以及預期壽命的巨大進步。

en: And by forcing its food culture on countries like Mexico and Canada, the United States is making the problem worse.
zh: 而透過將其飲食文化強加給墨西哥和加拿大等國，美國正在令問題變得更加嚴重。

en: One of the paradoxes of modern global capitalism is that whereas more than 800 million people in the world do not have enough to eat, an estimated 700 million people (including 100 million children) are obese.
zh: 現代全球資本主義的悖論之一就是，一方面世界上有超過8億人食不果腹，另一方面卻有大概7億人（包括1億兒童）陷入肥胖。

en: Of course, the two are not necessarily directly related. A considerable proportion of world hunger occurs in countries suffering from domestic strife or severe government dysfunction.
zh: 當然這兩者不一定直接相關，因為世界上有相當比例的飢餓發生在遭受內亂或政府嚴重失能的國家。

en: The obesity epidemic, however, has a much broader footprint, affecting advanced economies and most emerging markets.
zh: 與此同時肥胖症的流行範圍則更廣，遍及發達經濟體和大多數新興市場。

en: Although there is some connection between obesity and poverty within countries, it is notable that obesity rates in rich countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada are among the world’s highest.
zh: 儘管一些國家內部的肥胖與貧困之間存在某種聯絡，但值得注意的是，美國，英國和加拿大等富裕國家的肥胖率是全世界最高的。

en: Recently, the US Centers for Disease Control estimated that a stunning 40% of all Americans are obese (defined as having a body mass index of 30 or higher), a figure that includes 20.6% of adolescents (12-19 years old).
zh: 美國疾病控制中心最近釋出了一份報告，估算美國有40％的人肥胖（定義為身體質量指數BMI為30或更高 ） ， 其中包括20.6％的12~19歲青少年。

en: According to the CDC, the average weight of an American woman today is greater than the average weight of an American man in 1960 (166 pounds, or 75 kilos).
zh: 而據美國疾病控制與預防中心稱，當今美國女性的平均體重大於1960年美國男性的平均體重（166磅/75公斤 ） 。

en: Back in 1960, the average weight of an American woman was 140 pounds, while the average weight of an American man today is 195 pounds. (Over the same period, the average height of Americans increased by only one inch, or 2.5 centimeters.)
zh: 在1960年美國女性的平均體重是140磅/63.5公斤，而今天美國男性的平均體重是195磅/88.4公斤（而同期美國人的平均身高只增加了1英寸，即2.5釐米 ） 。

en: This same dynamic is playing out worldwide, with obesity rates soaring in Europe, Latin America, and even in China.
zh: 同樣的動態也存在於世界範圍內，歐洲，拉丁美洲乃至中國的肥胖率都在上升。

en: Although it is difficult to gauge the long-run health consequences, there is abundant evidence that obesity contributes significantly to higher rates of type II diabetes, heart attacks, and certain types of cancer.
zh: 雖然難以衡量長期的健康後果，但是有充分的證據表明肥胖對II型糖尿病，心臟病和某些型別癌症的發生率有著較高的影響。

en: The health costs are staggering, estimated to be close to $200 billion per year in the US alone.
zh: 因此產生的醫療費用也極為驚人，估計每年接近2000億美元。

en: And with rising childhood obesity rates worldwide portending significantly greater health problems in the future adult population, the costs are likely to rise considerably.
zh: 隨著兒童肥胖率在世界範圍內不斷上升，從而預示著未來成年人群的健康問題顯著增加，醫療成本還有機會大幅走高。

en: The causes of obesity are manifold and complex.
zh: 肥胖的成因是多方面且和複雜的。

en: Nevertheless, a growing body of evidence suggests that a culture emphasizing processed food and a generally sedentary lifestyle lies at the center of the problem.
zh: 然而越來越多的證據表明，注重加工食品和普遍久坐生活方式的文化是問題的核心。

en: In emerging markets, rapid urbanization is another important factor, as well as a desire to emulate Western lifestyles.
zh: 而在新興市場國家快速城市化則是另一個重要因素，此外還有模仿西方生活方式的意願。

en: Many governments have launched initiatives to improve nutrition education.
zh: 許多政府已經啟動了一些改善營養膳食教育的措施。

en: Unfortunately, industry advertising typically dwarfs these efforts, as do US trade lobbyists’ own efforts to push processed and fast food on the rest of the world.
zh: 但不幸的是，與美國貿易遊說者向世界其他地區推廣加工和快餐食品的努力一樣，行業廣告通常也會讓這些努力大打折扣。

en: It is hard to ignore the fact that Mexico’s adult obesity rate has soared since the adoption in 1993 of the North American Free Trade Agreement.
zh: 自從1993年簽署《北美自由貿易協定》以來墨西哥的成人肥胖率飆升，這是個難以忽略的事實。

en: While there are many causes, post-NAFTA direct foreign investment in the processed food industry and a surge in advertising are important contributors.
zh: 而協定生效後該國加工食品行業引入的直接國外投資以及廣告的激增是造成這種情況的重要因素。

en: Mexican consumption of sugary beverages nearly tripled between 1993 and 2014, and a new tax on sugary drinks has muted demand only slightly since then.
zh: 墨西哥在含糖飲料方面的消費量在1993~2014年間幾乎增長了兩倍，而自那以後的一項針對含糖飲料的新稅收僅僅令需求量略有下降。

en: The other NAFTA partner, Canada, has similarly experienced a rise in obesity, partly because US imports have led to a sharp decline in the price of fructose.
zh: 另一個《北美自由貿易協定》合作伙伴 — — 加拿大 — — 同樣也經歷了肥胖率上升的狀況，部分原因是來自美國的出口導致果糖價格急劇下跌。

en: It is unfortunate that government regulators have been so slow to try to reverse these trends by, for example, helping to educate the public on the science of nutrition.
zh: 不幸的是，政府監管機構試圖扭轉這些趨勢（例如向公眾傳播營養科學）的步伐太過緩慢。

en: And, for too long, most government anti-obesity education has focused on mechanically regulating calorie intake, without taking into account that different foods have dramatically different effects on appetite (as David Ludwig, a professor at Harvard Medical School, emphasizes in his excellent new book Always Hungry).
zh: 而且，長期以來，大多數政府反肥胖教育的重點都集中在刻板地調節卡路里攝入量，而沒有考慮不同食物對食慾的顯著差異性影響（正如哈佛大學醫學院教授大衛·路德維格（David Ludwig）在他的優秀新著《永遠飢餓》中指出的那樣 ） 。

en: Skeptics may point out that nutrition guidelines always seem to be morphing, with last year’s sin food becoming this year’s superfood, and vice versa.
zh: 懷疑論者可能會指出，營養指南似乎總是在變化，去年的罪惡食品經常搖身一變成了今年的超級食品，反之亦然。

en: Though there is some truth to this, the fact is that nutrition research has made significant progress in recent decades.
zh: 這有點道理，但事實是近幾十年來營養學研究已經取得了重大進展。

en: The government has other tools at its disposal, besides education, for affecting people’s eating habits.
zh: 除教育之外，政府還可以動用其他工具來影響人們的飲食習慣。

en: They can and should place greater restrictions on advertising to children, as the UK, France, and several other countries have done; obesity in early years can lead to lifelong problems.
zh: 它們可以且應該像英國，法國和其他幾個國家一樣對兒童廣告加大限制；因為早年的肥胖會引發終生的問題。

en: Beyond that, Ludwig, Tufts University’s Dariush Mozaffarian, and I have proposed instituting a tax on processed food, much the same way that tobacco is taxed.
zh: 除此之外，大衛·路德維格，塔夫茨大學的達瑞許·莫扎法裡安（Dariush Mozaffarian）和筆者也提議對加工食品徵稅，就跟菸草稅一樣。

en: Proceeds from the tax could be used to subsidize healthier alternatives.
zh: 而收上來的錢可用於補貼更健康的替代食品。

en: It is perhaps fantasy to expect the current US administration to consider any kind of anti-obesity strategy while it is still busy dismantling Obama-era policies.
zh: 期待正忙於廢止奧巴馬時代政策的現任政府考慮採取任何形式的反肥胖戰略或許只是幻想。

en: But that is all the more reason why countries entering new trade agreements with the US (for example, the post-Brexit UK, or post-NAFTA Canada) must be wary of any provisions that tie their hands in the war against obesity.
zh: 正因如此，那些即將與美國簽訂新貿易協議的國家（例如脫歐後的英國，或廢除《北美自由貿易協定》後的加拿大）更要特別警惕美國提出的任何可能束縛了反肥胖工作的條款。

en: “America First” Financial Regulation?
zh: “美國第一”金融改革？

en: LONDON – As US President Trump struggles to staff his administration with sympathizers who will help transpose tweets into policy, the exodus of Obama appointees from the federal government and other agencies continues.
zh: 倫敦—美國總統特朗普還在為找到同情他的立場、能幫他把推特轉化為政策的政府人手，而奧巴馬所認命的人則在不斷離開聯邦政府和其他機構。

en: For the financial world, one of the most significant departures was that of Daniel Tarullo, the Federal Reserve governor who has led its work on financial regulation for the last seven years.
zh: 對金融界來說，意義最重大的離職是在過去七年領導金融監管工作的美聯儲理事丹尼爾·塔魯洛（Daniel Tarullo ） 。

en: It would be a stretch to say that Tarullo has been universally popular in the banking community.
zh: 很難說塔魯洛受到了銀行界的一致歡迎。

en: He led the charge in arguing for much higher capital ratios, in the United States and elsewhere.
zh: 他領銜要求大幅提高美國和其他國家的資本率。

en: He was a tough negotiator, with a well-tuned instinct for spotting special pleading by financial firms.
zh: 他是個難產的談判對手，擁有很強的識破金融企業詭辯術的本能。

en: But crocodile tears will be shed in Europe to mark his resignation.
zh: 但隨著他的離職，歐洲將流下鱷魚的眼淚。

en: European banks, and even their regulators, were concerned by his enthusiastic advocacy of even tougher standards in Basel 3.5 (or Basel 4, as bankers like to call it), which would, if implemented in the form favored by the US, require further substantial capital increases for Europe’s banks in particular.
zh: 歐洲銀行，乃至歐洲監管者，擔心他堅定推行更嚴格的巴塞爾3.5標準（或者用銀行家的話說，是巴塞爾4.0標準 ） ， 如果這一標準以美國所想要的形式得到實施，就要求進一步大幅增加資本，特別是歐洲銀行。

en: In his absence, these proposals’ fate is uncertain.
zh: 他的去職讓這一方案的前景蒙上了不確定性。

en: But Tarullo has also been an enthusiastic promoter of international regulatory cooperation, with the frequent flyer miles to prove it.
zh: 但塔魯洛也熱衷於推動國際監管合作，頻繁出訪推銷監管合作。

en: For some years, he has chaired the Financial Stability Board’s little-known but important Standing Committee on Supervisory and Regulatory Cooperation.
zh: 多年來，他一直擔任金融穩定委員會（FSB）中鮮為人知但十分重要的監督和監管合作常務委員會主席。

en: His commitment to working with colleagues in international bodies like the FSB and the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, to reach global regulatory agreements enabling banks to compete on a level playing field, has never been in doubt.
zh: 他堅定地致力於與FSB和巴塞爾銀行監督委員會等國際機構的同事們合作以實現監管協定，從而讓所有銀行在公平的競技場上競爭，這一點從未動搖。

en: Already, some of those who criticized him most vocally in the past are anxious about his departure.
zh: 目前，一些過去批評他最賣力的人對他的去職十分焦慮。

en: Who will succeed him?
zh: 誰會接替他？

en: The 2010 Dodd-Frank Act created a vice-chair position on the Federal Reserve Board – which has never been filled – to lead the Fed’s work on regulation.
zh: 2010年多德-弗蘭克（Dodd-Frank）法案規定美聯儲需要設立一個副主席職位 — — 從未有人擔任過此職 — — 來領導美聯儲的監管工作。

en: Will that appointee, whom Trump now needs to select, be as committed as Tarullo to an international approach?
zh: 這一任命 — — 特朗普目前正在選人 — — 能像塔魯洛那樣致力於國際路線嗎？

en: Or will his principal task be to build a regulatory wall, protecting US banks from global rules?
zh: 或者，他的主要任務將是構建監管牆，讓美國銀行不受全球規則管轄？

en: We do not yet know the answers to these questions, but Fed watchers were alarmed by a January 31 letter to Fed Chair Janet Yellen from Representative Patrick McHenry, the vice chairman of the House Committee on Financial Services. McHenry did not pull his punches.
zh: 我們尚不清楚這些問題的答案，但美聯儲觀察者在1月31日看到了令人警惕的訊號：眾議院金融服務委員會副主席帕特里克·麥克亨利（Patrick McHenry）致信美聯儲主席耶倫，直白地提出了批評。

en: “Despite the clear message delivered by President Donald Trump in prioritizing America’s interest in international negotiations,” McHenry wrote, “it appears that the Federal Reserve continues negotiating international regulatory standards for financial institutions among global bureaucrats in foreign lands without transparency, accountability, or the authority to do so.
zh: “儘管特朗普總統明確表示要以美國在國際談判中的利益為先 ， ” 麥克亨利寫道 ， “ 但美聯儲似乎仍然在國外與全球技術官僚談判金融機構監管標準，這些談判不具有透明度和可問責性，美聯儲也不具備監管談判權。

en: This is unacceptable.”
zh: 這是不可接受的。 ”

en: In her reply of February10, Yellen firmly rebutted McHenry’s arguments.
zh: 在2月10日的覆信中，耶倫堅決反駁了麥克亨利的指責。

en: She pointed out that the Fed does indeed have the authority it needs, that the Basel agreements are not binding, and that, in any event, “strong regulatory standards enhance the stability of the US financial system” and promote the competitiveness of financial firms.
zh: 她指出，美聯儲絕對擁有它所需要的權力，巴塞爾協定不具有約束力，並且，無論如何 ， “ 強力監管標準能增強美國金融系統的穩定”並促進金融企業的競爭力。

en: But that will not be the end of the story.
zh: 但這絕不是故事的結局。

en: The battle lines are now drawn, and McHenry’s letter shows the arguments that will be deployed in Congress by some Republicans close to the president.
zh: 如今嗎，戰線已經劃定，麥克亨利的信表明了一些接近總統個共和黨將會在國會亮出怎樣的觀點。

en: There has always been a strand of thinking in Washington that dislikes foreign entanglements, in this and other areas.
zh: 華盛頓總是存在一些在這個或那個領域不喜歡與國外串聯的聲音。

en: While Yellen’s arguments are correct, the Fed’s entitlement to participate in international negotiations does not oblige it to do so, and a new appointee might argue that it should not.
zh: 儘管特倫的觀點是正確的，但美聯儲參與國際談判的許可權並不意味著它必須這樣做，而新的任命人選可能會認為美聯儲不應該這麼做。

en: Such a reversal would generate tensions within the Fed, and where it would leave the FSB, or indeed the Basel Committee, is unclear.
zh: 如此反覆將在美聯儲內部製造對立，而FSB，或者事實上還有巴塞爾委員會，將因此採取什麼立場仍不得而知。

en: In the early days of the Bank for International Settlements (where the Basel Committee’s secretariat is located) in the 1930s, the US government declined to take a board seat, and the US was represented by JP Morgan.
zh: 20世紀30年代國際清算銀行（巴塞爾委員會秘書處所在地）成立之初，美國政府曾經拒絕接受委員會席位，而美國的代表是JP摩根。

en: It is a little hard to see that arrangement working well today.
zh: 時至今日，顯然這一安排運轉得十分出色。

en: These questions are of more than passing interest in Europe.
zh: 這些問題對歐洲來說絕非稍縱即逝的利益。

en: European capital adequacy directives typically transpose Basel Accords into EU law.
zh: 歐洲資本充足度指引通常將巴塞爾協議轉化為歐盟法律。

en: If the Basel process stalls, transatlantic deals, which are the crucial underpinning of Western capital markets, will be far harder to reach.
zh: 如果巴塞爾程序陷入停頓，作為西方資本市場基礎的跨大西洋協議將極其難以達成。

en: There is a further complication arising from Brexit.
zh: 英國退歐進一步增加了複雜性。

en: Absent any special deal between the EU27 and the United Kingdom, British and EU regulators will come together in Basel, not in the European Banking Authority.
zh: 在歐盟27國與英國沒有達成任何特殊協議的情況下，英國和歐盟監管者將在巴塞爾協議中進行合作，而不是在歐洲銀行監管局（European Banking Authority）進行合作。

en: If Basel becomes a talking shop, without the ability to set firm standards, another key link in the chain will be broken, and it will be harder for the UK to argue that if London’s banks meet international standards, they should be granted equal treatment in the EU.
zh: 如果巴塞爾委員會淪為清談俱樂部，而不具備制定切實標準的能力，那麼這一鏈條的另一個關鍵環節將被打破，英國將更加難以主張，當倫敦的銀行面臨國際標準時應該享受歐盟同等待遇。

en: As central bankers bid farewell to the devil they know, financial regulation has entered a period of high uncertainty – and high anxiety for policymakers as they await an announcement from Mar-a-Lago.
zh: 當央行行長們與他們所熟知的惡魔揮手道別時，金融監管卻進入了一個高度不確定的時期 — — 而決策者們則將如坐針氈地在等待馬拉拉歌莊園（Mar-a- Lago）的指示。

en: No likely Federal Reserve Board candidates have been spotted at poolside, or being interviewed on the golf course, but a decision cannot be far off.
zh: 美聯儲理事不可能在游泳池邊得到任命，或一邊打高爾夫球一邊面試，但決定已經不遠了。

en: Nothing can be taken for granted.
zh: 沒有什麼是理所當然的。

en: The financial world is holding its collective breath.
zh: 金融界集體屏息以待。

en: Navigating America’s Economic-Policy Shocks
zh: 應對美國經濟政策衝擊

en: NEW YORK – With a series of tax and trade moves being considered in the United States this year, emerging-market economies are likely to face devaluation pressure and volatility.
zh: 紐約—今年美國將考慮一系列稅收和貿易動作，新興市場經濟體可能會面臨貶值壓力和波動。

en: Three sources of US-fueled economic uncertainty, in particular, will rattle emerging markets in 2017.
zh: 特別是，三個美國引發的經濟不確定性將在2017年影響到新興市場。

en: The first is a border adjustment tax that would give tax breaks to US exporters, but impose a levy – or, equivalently, disallow deductions – on imports to the US.
zh: 一是邊境調節稅。 邊境調節稅將讓美國出口商獲得稅收優惠，但對美國進口商品徵稅 — — 或取消抵扣，效果相同。

en: Both President Donald Trump and the Republican-controlled US Congress have said they favor the scheme, which has a fair chance of being enacted.
zh: 總統特朗普和共和黨控制的國會都表示支援這一方案，它很有可能成為現實。

en: Such a tax, or even the anticipation of its adoption, could drive up the US dollar’s exchange rate (which, ironically, would offset, at least partly, the improvement in the US trade imbalance for which the Trump administration may be hoping).
zh: 這一稅種，哪怕是對其實施的預期，都將推高美元匯率（諷刺的是，這至少將部分抵消特朗普政府所期待的美國貿易失衡的改善 ） 。

en: The second source of uncertainty is the possibility of more aggressive action on Chinese exports to the US.
zh: 第二個不確定性是美國可能對中國對美出口採取更加激進的措施。

en: The Trump administration has said many times that it will confront China over what it considers unfair trade practices.
zh: 特朗普政府已經多次表示，將在其所認定的不公平貿易行為上與中國針鋒相對。

en: Trump has openly mused about imposing a 45% tariff on Chinese imports.
zh: 特朗普公開嗆聲要對中國進口品徵收45%的關稅。

en: The introduction of anything close to that would generate downward pressure on the renminbi, given the resulting reduction in demand for Chinese exports.
zh: 實施任何類似的措施都將導致中國出口需求下降，從而給人民幣造成貶值壓力。

en: But such a move would serve to weaken many other currencies as well.
zh: 但這一動作也將導致其他許多貨幣貶值。

en: My research with Zhi Wang and Kunfu Zhu reveals that about half of Chinese exports to the US are value-added products manufactured with components from South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Singapore, and other countries.
zh: 我與王志（Zhi Wang，音譯）和朱坤福（Kunfu Zhu，音譯）的研究發現，中國對美出口中有大約一半為增值產品，零部件來自韓國、日本、臺灣、新加坡等其他經濟體。

en: Because products from China are often part of integrated global or regional value chains, a US restriction on its imports from China would indirectly, but very quickly, translate into reduced exports of value-added items by other countries in Asia.
zh: 來自中國的產品通常是一體化的全球或地區價值鏈的一部分，因此美國限制中國進口將間接（但十分迅速）地轉化為亞洲其他經濟體增值專案出口的下降。

en: This slippage would likely offset any direct increase in these countries’ exports to the US, at least in the short and medium term, because re-organizing production chains is not a trivial matter.
zh: 這一傳導機制很可能抵消這些經濟提對美出口的直接增量，至少在短期和中期是如此，因為重新組織生產鏈絕非易事。

en: A third US move that could unsettle emerging markets is faster-than-expected monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve.
zh: 美國可能動搖新興市場的第三個動作是美聯儲比預期更快地收緊貨幣政策。

en: A large interest-rate hike would translate into US dollar appreciation, and depreciation of developing-economy currencies.
zh: 大幅升息將轉化為美元升值和發展中經濟體貨幣貶值。

en: One exception may be the currencies of commodity exporters.
zh: 大宗商品出口國貨幣也許是例外。

en: Higher commodity prices, triggered in part by anticipation of increased demand as a result of a boost in US infrastructure spending, could cause these countries’ currencies to strengthen.
zh: 美國提高基礎設施支出可能引起大宗商品需求增加的預期，從而觸發價格上漲，進而導致這些國家貨幣升值。

en: Even on that front, though, some commodity exporters – such as Brazil and Russia – may not see much improvement in their exchange rates, given the drag of other forces on their weak economies.
zh: 但是，即使在這些國家中，某些大宗商品出口國 — — 比如巴西和俄羅斯 — — 也未必能夠看到匯率改善，因為它們疲軟的經濟中還有其他力量在起拖累作用。

en: The challenges that US policy changes pose for emerging-market currencies include not only downward pressure, but also greater volatility.
zh: 美國政策變化給新興市場貨幣造成的挑戰不僅包括貶值壓力，還包括波動加劇。

en: What, then, should emerging-market countries do to enhance their resilience in anticipation of the shockwaves?
zh: 那麼，新興市場國家應該如何加強對預期中的震波的抵抗力？

en: One option is to optimize the structure of capital inflows.
zh: 一個選擇是最佳化資本流入結構。

en: A second is to boost the flexibility of exchange rates.
zh: 其次是提高匯率彈性。

en: On the former, as my research with Hui Tong shows, countries that rely heavily on borrowing from foreign banks or international capital markets are more vulnerable to capital flight than countries that depend mainly on foreign direct investment.
zh: 對於前者，我和童輝（Hui Tong，音譯）的研究表明，嚴重依靠海外銀行或國際資本市場借貸的國家比主要依靠外國直接投資（FDI）的國家更容易受到資本外逃的影響。

en: Therefore, to guard against exchange-rate volatility or US interest-rate changes, emerging markets should work to improve their business environments to attract FDI, which would reduce their reliance on short-term infusions of “hot money” – and thus lower their vulnerability to abrupt capital-flow reversals.
zh: 因此，要抵禦匯率波動或美國匯率變化，新興市場應該致力於改善營商環境以吸引FDI，以此降低他們對短期進出的“熱錢”的依賴 — — 從而降低突發性資本流逆轉對它們所造成的影響。

en: As for the second option, allowing nominal exchange-rate flexibility would enable currency values to align with underlying economic fundamentals more quickly.
zh: 對於後者，允許名義匯率彈性可以讓貨幣價值更快地與經濟基本面看齊。

en: Such adjustment is especially important for countries with rigid labor markets.
zh: 這一調整對於勞動力市場僵化的國家尤其重要。

en: One danger of fixed exchange rates is the risk of an overvalued or undervalued currency, neither of which is good for economic stability.
zh: 固定匯率的一大風險是貨幣出現高估或低估，兩者都不利於經濟穩定。

en: The chance of either scenario is elevated when the forces influencing the equilibrium exchange rate become more volatile.
zh: 當影響均衡匯率的力量波動加劇時，發生高估或低估的可能性也會大大增加。

en: While the shape and timing of future US policies are uncertain, it seems clear that capital-flow management and nominal exchange-rate flexibility amount to good preparation.
zh: 美國未來政策的面貌和時機仍不確定，但顯然，資本流管理和名義匯率彈性都是非常好的準備工作。

en: To paraphrase Benjamin Franklin, if developing countries fail to prepare, they will have to prepare to fail.
zh: 用本傑明·富蘭克林的話說，如果發展中國家沒有做好準備，它們就必須做準備失敗。

en: Why Millennials Will Reject Trump
zh: 為什麼千禧一代會拒絕特朗普

en: NEW YORK – The key political divide in the United States is not between parties or states; it is between generations.
zh: 紐約—美國的關鍵政治分歧不在於黨派之間或州之間，而在於代際之間。

en: The millennial generation (those aged 18-35) voted heavily against Donald Trump and will form the backbone of resistance to his policies.
zh: 千禧一代（18—35歲）大多反對特朗普，並將成為反對特朗普政策的骨幹力量。

en: Older Americans are divided, but Trump’s base lies among those above the age of 45.
zh: 年長美國人比較分裂，但特朗普的基本盤是45歲以上群體。

en: On issue after issue, younger voters will reject Trump, viewing him as a politician of the past, not the future.
zh: 在問題不斷曝出後，年輕選民將拒絕特朗普，將他視為過去而不是未來的政客。

en: Of course, these are averages, not absolutes.
zh: 當然，這是平均而言，不是絕對的。

en: Yet the numbers confirm the generational divide.
zh: 但數字確證了代際分歧。

en: According to exit polls, Trump received 53% of the votes of those 45 and older, 42% of those 30-44, and just 37% of voters 18-29.
zh: 據出口民調，特朗普贏得53%的45歲及以上選民，42%的30—44歲選民，而18—29歲選民他只贏得了37 % 。

en: In a 2014 survey, 31% of millennials identified as liberals, compared with 21% of baby boomers (aged 50-68 in the survey) and only 18% of the silent generation (69 and above).
zh: 在一份2014年的調查中，31%的千禧一代被認為是自由派，而嬰兒潮一代（調查中的50—68歲群體）只有21 % ， 靜默一代（69歲及以上）只有18 % 。

en: The point is not that today’s young liberals will become tomorrow’s older conservatives.
zh: 箇中含義不是今天的年輕自由派會變成明天的年長保守派。

en: The millennial generation is far more liberal than the baby boomers and silent generation were in their younger years.
zh: 千禧一代遠比嬰兒潮一代和靜默一代年輕時更加偏向自由派。

en: They are also decidedly less partisan, and will support politicians who address their values and needs, including third-party aspirants.
zh: 他們的黨派色彩也要少得多，他們將支援解決他們的價值觀和需要的政客，包括來自第三黨的有志者。

en: There are at least three big differences in the politics of the young and old.
zh: 年輕人和年長者的政治學至少有三大不同。

en: First, the young are more socially liberal than the older generations.
zh: 首先，年輕人比年長者更加偏向社會自由。

en: For them, America’s growing racial, religious, and sexual plurality is no big deal.
zh: 對他們來說，美國日益嚴重的種族、宗教和性多樣化不是大問題。

en: A diverse society of whites, African-Americans, Hispanics, and Asians, and of the native-born and immigrants, is the country they’ve always known, not some dramatic change from the past.
zh: 由白人、非洲裔美國人、西班牙裔美國人、亞洲人組成的多元化社會，由土生土長的美國人和移民組成的多元化社會才是他們一直熟知的美國，而不是什麼與過去的戲劇性變化。

en: They accept sexual and gender categories – lesbian, gay, trans, bi, inter, pan, and others – that were essentially taboo for – or unknown to – their grandparents’ (Trump’s) generation.
zh: 他們接受性和性別分類 — — 女同性戀、男同性戀、變性人、雙性人、異裝癖、雙性戀 — — 這些群體對他們的祖父輩（即特朗普這一代）來說本質上是一種禁忌（或一種未知 ） 。

en: Second, the young are facing the unprecedented economic challenges of the information revolution.
zh: 其次，年輕人正面臨前所未有的資訊革命經濟挑戰。

en: They are entering the labor market at a time when market returns are rapidly shifting toward capital (robots, artificial intelligence, and smart machines generally) and away from labor.
zh: 他們進入勞動力市場正逢市場回報迅速流向資本（普遍化的機器人、人工智慧和智慧機器 ） ， 流出勞動力。

en: The elderly rich, by contrast, are enjoying a stock market boom caused by the same technological revolution.
zh: 相反，年長的富人享受著由同一場技術革命帶來的股市繁榮。

en: Trump is peddling cuts in corporate taxes and estate taxes that would further benefit the elderly rich (who are amply represented in Trump’s cabinet), at the expense of larger budget deficits that further burden the young.
zh: 特朗普正在兜售降低公司稅和地產稅的方案，這將進一步有利於年長富人（他們佔領了特朗普內閣 ） ， 而代價則是預算赤字進一步擴大，年輕人負擔進一步沉重。

en: Indeed, the young need the opposite policy: higher taxes on the wealth of the older generation in order to finance post-secondary education, job training, renewable-energy infrastructure, and other investments in America’s future.
zh: 事實上，年輕人需要相反的政策：提高老一代富人的稅收，為高等教育、就業培訓、可再生能源基礎設施和其他事關美國未來的投資融資。

en: Third, compared to their parents and grandparents, the young are much more aware of climate change and its threats.
zh: 第三，與父輩和祖父輩相比，年輕人更加清楚氣候變化及其威脅。

en: While Trump is enticing the older generation with one last fling with fossil fuels, the young will have none of it.
zh: 特朗普用化石燃料最後的狂歡麻痺年長一代，而年輕人只能獲得一地雞毛。

en: They want clean energy and will fight against the destruction of the Earth that they and their own children will inherit.
zh: 他們想要清潔能源，也將為他們和他們的孩子們將要繼承的被毀壞的地球戰鬥。

en: Part of the generational divide over global warming is due to the sheer ignorance of many older Americans, including Trump, about climate change and its causes.
zh: 在全球變暖問題上的代際分裂在部分程度上要歸因於許多年長美國人，包括特朗普在內，赤裸裸地忽視氣候變化及其原因。

en: Older Americans didn’t learn about climate change in school.
zh: 年長美國人在學校裡沒有學過氣候變化。

en: They were never introduced to the basic science of greenhouse gases.
zh: 他們從未獲得過關於溫室氣體的基本科學知識。

en: That is why they are ready to put their own short-term financial interests ahead of the dire threats to their grandchildren’s generation.
zh: 因此，他們欲把自己的短期財務利益置於孫輩致命威脅之上。

en: In a June 2015 survey, 60% of 18-29 year-olds said that human activity was causing global warming, compared with just 31% of those 65 and older.
zh: 在一份2015年6月的調查中，60%的18—29歲群體說人類活動正在導致全球變暖，而65歲及以上群體只有31 % 。

en: A survey released in January found that 38% of American survey respondents 65 and older favored fossil-fuel expansion over renewable energy, compared with only 19% of those 18-29.
zh: 一份1月份公佈的調查發現，38%的65歲及以上美國調查受訪者支援化石燃料而非可再生能源擴張，18—29歲群體只有19 % 。

en: Trump’s economic policies are geared to this older, whiter, native-born America.
zh: 特朗普的經濟政策偏向這一年齡更大、膚色更白、本土出生的美國人群體。

en: He favors tax cuts for the older rich, which would burden the young with higher debt.
zh: 他支援為年長富人減稅，而這將給年輕人帶來更多的債務負擔。

en: He is indifferent to the $1 trillion overhang of student debt.
zh: 他對1萬億美元的累計學生債務漠然無視。

en: He is reprising the 1990s NAFTA debate over free trade, rather than facing the far more important twenty-first-century jobs challenge posed by robotics and artificial intelligence.
zh: 他在三十年後重新翻出20世紀90年代北美自由貿易協定（NAFTA）爭論的舊賬，而不去面對機器人和人工智慧所帶來的更加重要的二十一世紀就業挑戰。

en: And he is obsessed with squeezing a few more years of profit out of America’s coal, oil, and gas reserves at the cost of a future environmental catastrophe.
zh: 他沉迷於讓美國煤炭、石油和天然氣儲備多貢獻幾年利潤，不惜讓未來爆發環境災難。

en: One might attribute Trump’s backward-looking mindset to his age.
zh: 你也許會將特朗普的退步思維歸因於他的年齡。

en: At 70, Trump is the oldest person ever to become president (Ronald Reagan was slightly younger when he took office in 1981).
zh: 70歲的特朗普是美國歷史上年紀最大的新總統（羅納德·里根上臺是位元朗普稍微年輕一些 ） 。

en: Yet age is hardly the sole or even the main factor here.
zh: 但年齡絕不是唯一的原因，甚至不是主要原因。

en: Bernie Sanders, certainly the freshest mind of all the 2016 presidential candidates and the hero of millennial voters, is 75.
zh: 伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）毫無疑問是2016年總統候選人當中思想最為新潮的，也是千禧一代選民心中的英雄，他已經75歲了。

en: The young are enchanted with Pope Francis, 80, because he puts their concerns – whether about poverty, employment difficulties, or vulnerability to global warming – within a moral framework, rather than dismissing them with the crass cynicism of Trump and his ilk.
zh: 年輕人因為80歲的教皇方濟各而歡欣鼓舞，因為他將他們的擔憂 — — 不管是貧困、就業困難還是面對全球變暖的脆弱性 — — 納入道德框架中，而不是像特朗普及其同黨那樣以粗魯的犬儒主義等閒視之。

en: The main issue here is mindset and political orientation, not chronological age.
zh: 這裡的關鍵問題是思維和政治導向，而不是年齡。

en: Trump has the shortest time horizon (and attention span) of any president in historical memory.
zh: 特朗普是歷史上所有總統中目光最短淺的（也是注意力範圍最狹隘的 ） 。

en: And he is utterly out of touch with the real challenges facing the young generation as they grapple with new technologies, shifting labor markets, and crushing student debt.
zh: 他根本不清楚年輕一代在面臨新技術、勞動力市場變遷和泰山壓頂般的學生債務時所遇到的真正挑戰。

en: A trade war with Mexico and China, or a tragically misconceived ban on Muslim migrants, will hardly meet their real needs.
zh: 與墨西哥和中國的貿易戰，以及計劃不周的悲哀的“禁穆令”根本無法解決他們的真正需要。

en: Trump’s political success is a blip, not a turning point.
zh: 特朗普在政治上的成功只是曇花一現，而不是轉折點。

en: Today’s millennials, with their future-oriented perspective, will soon dominate American politics.
zh: 今天的千禧一代，帶著他們未來導向的視角，將很快主宰美國政壇。

en: America will be multiethnic, socially liberal, climate conscious, and much fairer in sharing the economic benefits of new technology.
zh: 美國將是多種族的、社會自由的、充分認識氣候變化的國家，其新技術的經濟收益也將獲得更加公平的分享。

en: Too many observers remain fixated on the traditional party divides in the US Congress, not on the deeper demographic changes that will soon be decisive.
zh: 太多觀察家仍沉迷於美國國會中的傳統黨派分歧，而沒有關注更深層次的人口變化，而這一變化很快就將成為決定性因素。

en: Sanders nearly captured the Democratic nomination (and would likely have triumphed in the general election) with a platform appealing powerfully to the millennials.
zh: 桑德斯幾乎贏得民主黨提名（如果贏得提名，他很有可能贏得大選 ） ， 他憑藉的是充分吸引千禧一代的平臺。

en: Their time is coming, most likely with a president they support in 2020.
zh: 千禧一代的時代正在到來，並極有可能推動他們所支援的總統在2020年上臺。

en: What Makes America Great
zh: 是什麼讓美國偉大

en: CAMBRIDGE – Presidential inaugurations and commencement ceremonies are usually very emotional events.
zh: 坎布里奇—總統就職典禮和畢業典禮通常都是非常情緒性的事件。

en: They are rites of passage that mark both an end and a new beginning in the life of a country or an individual.
zh: 這類儀式既標誌著一個國家或一個個體的一個段落的結束，也標誌著新的開始。

en: As a professor at Harvard’s Kennedy School of Government, I attend our commencement ceremony every year.
zh: 作為哈佛肯尼迪政府學院教授，我每年都要參加畢業典禮。

en: Despite this regularity, I still become emotional as I see my students complete a phase of their lives and contemplate their future.
zh: 儘管畢業典禮對我來說如此平常，但當我看到學生完成了生命中的一個階段、開始考慮他們的我來時，我都會感到十分激動。

en: One of the highlights of our ceremony is a video in which several professors and public personalities read, line by line, John F. Kennedy’s inaugural address.
zh: 在我們的典禮上，一個高光時刻是多名教授和公共人物逐字逐句朗讀約翰·肯尼迪的就職演說。

en: It is a text written 56 years ago, in a different world, where the Cold War, the threat of nuclear Armageddon, and the challenges faced by so many newly independent poor states dominated policymakers’ concerns.
zh: 這是一份寫於56年前的檔案，它代表著一個不同的世界，一個冷戰、核末日威脅以及大量新晉獨立窮國所面臨的挑戰佔據決策者關注焦點的世界。

en: And yet, running at under 14 minutes, it never fails to move and inspire everyone in the audience, including that half of the graduates and their families who hail from other countries, near and far.
zh: 但是，在不到14分鐘的時間裡，這份就職演說每一次都能打動和鼓勵觀眾席上的每一個人，包括來自世界各地的那一半畢業生和他們的家庭。

en: To understand why, it is useful to recall a few of the most famous passages.
zh: 要想知道為什麼會這樣，不妨回憶一下這篇名著。

en: For starters, there was Kennedy’s vow to defend freedom for its friends and from its enemies: “Let every nation know, whether it wishes us well or ill, that we shall pay any price, bear any burden, meet any hardship, support any friend, oppose any foe to assure the survival and the success of liberty.”
zh: 一開始，肯尼迪宣誓要捍衛自由的朋友，抵禦自由的敵人 ： “ 要讓每個國家都知道，不管它想要我們好還是壞，我們都將不惜一切代價，承受一切負擔，克服一切困難，去支援我們的朋友，對抗任何敵人，以確保自由的生存和成功。 ”

en: There was also his commitment to fight poverty: “To those people in the huts and villages of half the globe struggling to break the bonds of mass misery, we pledge our best efforts to help them help themselves, for whatever period is required – not because the communists may be doing it, not because we seek their votes, but because it is right.
zh: 他還承諾打擊貧困 ： “ 住在鄉村茅舍、渴望打破重重痛苦的一半地球人：我們承諾竭盡全力幫助他們自力更生，不管需要多長時間 — — 這不是因為共產黨也會這麼做，不是因為我們需要他們的選票，而是因為這是正確的事。

en: If a free society cannot help the many who are poor, it cannot save the few who are rich.”
zh: 如果自由社會不能幫助眾多處於貧困的人，它也無法拯救那極少數富裕的人。 ”

en: And this commitment was part and parcel of hemispheric solidarity: “To our sister republics south of our border, we offer a special pledge – to convert our good words into good deeds – in a new alliance for progress – to assist free men and free governments in casting off the chains of poverty.”
zh: 而這一承諾是西半球團結的基石 ： “ 對於我們邊境以南的兄弟共和國來說，我們做出一項特殊承諾 — — 讓我們的好話變成好事 — — 在一個新的進步同盟中 — — 幫助自由人和自由政府擺脫貧困的枷鎖。 ”

en: Finally, there was Kennedy’s ethic of service on behalf of the commonwealth: “And so, my fellow Americans: ask not what your country can do for you – ask what you can do for your country.
zh: 最後，公益服務倫理觀 ： “ 還有，我的美國同胞：不要問國家能為你做些什麼 — — 問問你能為你的國家做些什麼。

en: My fellow citizens of the world: ask not what America will do for you, but what together we can do for the freedom of man.”
zh: 我的世界公民同胞：不要問美國會為你做什麼，問問我們攜起手來能為人的自由做些什麼。 ”

en: These words’ enduring emotional appeal is rooted in their embrace of a potentially difficult course of action, motivated by a pledge to uphold values shared by citizens of America and the world alike.
zh: 這些話之所以能夠造成經久不衰的情緒號召力，是因為它們提到了也許很困難的行動方針，其背後的推動力是誓死捍衛美國和世界公民的共同價值觀。

en: It was this approach – one founded on a value-based system of rules, not on individual deals – that enabled the US to create and sustain a coalition of countries that could maintain peace and international cooperation.
zh: 這一方針 — — 它建立在基於價值觀的規則體系之上，而不是建立在個人交易基礎上 — — 讓美國得以創造和維持一個能夠保證和平與和平合作的國家聯盟。

en: Fast forward to today.
zh: 快進到現在。

en: President-elect Donald Trump’s campaign narrative was based on the assumption that the US has fallen from its former greatness.
zh: 當選總統唐納德·特朗普的競選綱領基於這樣的認識：美國已經從昔日的偉大中衰落。

en: Jobs have moved to Mexico and China because weak leaders negotiated bad deals.
zh: 就業流向了墨西哥和中國，因為軟弱的領導人談判了糟糕的協議。

en: Immigrants, mostly illegal, have taken the few jobs that remain, killing and raping in their free time.
zh: 移民，主要是非法移民，則拿走了剩下的少數崗位，而在空餘時間盡幹些殺人強姦的勾當。

en: It follows that the US needs a president who will put America first and knows how to extract the best deals for it at every opportunity, using the country’s full might to advance its interests.
zh: 因此，美國需要一位把美國放在第一位、知道如何在每一次機會中如何獲得最佳協議、用美國的全部力量推進它的利益的總統。

en: I doubt that an inaugural address based on these ideas will awe and inspire many audiences at commencement ceremonies, especially where many of those in attendance are citizens of other countries.
zh: 我懷疑基於這些思想的就職演說是否能夠在畢業典禮上震撼和激發大量聽眾，特別是當許多聽眾是其他國家的公民的時候。

en: Such a speech will encourage no one to “bear any burden” for the sake of any universal principle or challenge, be it human rights or global warming.
zh: 這樣一份演講無法鼓勵任何人為任何普世原則或挑戰“承擔一切負擔 ” ， 不管是人權還是全球變暖。

en: It will not exhort us to focus on something bigger than ourselves.
zh: 它無法勸誡我們風物長宜放眼量。

en: Over the course of history, very few powerful states have developed a sense of themselves as being based not on ethnic heritage, but on a set of values that all citizens can live by.
zh: 在歷史程序中，很少有強大的國家能發展出這樣一種感受：認為自己不是基於民族文化遺產，而是基於一系列所有公民生存之所繫的價值觀。

en: For the US, it was “life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.”
zh: 對美國來說，這就是“生活、自由和追逐幸福 ” 。

en: For the Soviet Union, it was international proletarian solidarity – “workers of the world, unite.”
zh: 對蘇聯來說，這是世界無產者大團結 — — “全世界工人聯合起來 ” 。

en: The European Union is based on universal values and principles that are so attractive that 28 countries have opted to join it; and, Brexit notwithstanding, some half-dozen more are trying to get in.
zh: 歐盟是基於能夠吸引28個國家加入其中的普世價值觀和原則；儘管發生了英國退歐，仍有六個國家正在努力加入其中。

en: By contrast, a great and powerful Russia or China today – or the Third Reich in its time – may be able to garner the support of its citizens; but such states cannot constitute the basis of an international order that others find appealing, because they are based on a vision of themselves that does not encompass others.
zh: 相反，今天偉大且強大的俄羅斯或中國 — — 或當年的第三帝國 — — 也許能夠贏得本國公民的支援；但這些國家無法構成其他國家嚮往的國際秩序的基礎，因為它們是基於並不包含他者的自身的願景的。

en: The basis of America’s greatness and ability to lead the world stems from universal values that underpin a set of rules that uphold the others’ rights, not an America that tries to base its greatness on a set of deals aimed at getting the better of others.
zh: 美國的偉大和領導世界的能力的基礎來自普世價值觀，這些普世價值觀又是保護他者權利的規則體系的基礎，而不是試圖將偉大建立在以從他者身上獲得更多好處為目標的交易體系的基礎上的美國。

en: Such an America will find its ability to lead the world compromised by a shortage of goodwill and an abundance of distrust.
zh: 這樣一個美國將發現，它領導世界的能力受到缺乏商譽和充滿不信任的制約。

en: Other countries will huddle together to protect themselves from the US bully.
zh: 其他國家將聯合起來抵抗美國的仗勢欺人。

en: If Trump really wants to make America great again, he should ponder how his inaugural address will sound to a global audience 56 years from now.
zh: 如果特朗普真的想讓美國重新偉大，他應該仔細思考他的就職演說如何面對56年前的全球聽眾。

en: Will it inspire the Class of 2073 the way Kennedy’s address still inspires graduates today?
zh: 它能否激發2073屆畢業生，就像肯尼迪的就職演說激發今天的畢業生那樣?

en: America Goes from Teacher to Student
zh: 美國從教師爺變成學生

en: Cambridge -- As the United States’ epic financial crisis continues to unfold, one can only wish that US policymakers were half as good at listening to advice from developing countries as they are at giving it.
zh: 劍橋 - - 當美國龐大的金融危機繼續演進之時，人們只能希望美國的決策者們在從發展中國家聽取建議時能夠有一半像發表建議那樣在行就好了。

en: Americans don’t seem to realize that their “sub-prime” mortgage meltdown has all too much in common with many previous post-1945 banking crises throughout the world.
zh: 美國好像並不認識到，他們的“次級”房屋貸款破滅與許多1945年後席捲全球的銀行危機有太多的共同之處。

en: The silver lining is that there are many highly distinguished current and former policymakers out there, particularly from emerging market countries, who have seen this movie before.
zh: 令人欣慰的是，有許多特別是來自新興市場國家的在任和前任傑出的決策者們已經看到了這一局面。

en: If US policymakers would only listen, they might get an idea or two about how to deal with financial crises from experts who have lived through them and come out safely on the other side.
zh: 如果美國的決策者們聽取意見的話，他們就會從安然度過金融危機的專家那裡知道如何應付它們。

en: Unfortunately, the parallel between today’s US crisis and previous financial crises is not mere hyperbole.
zh: 不幸的是，當今美國危機和以往金融危機的相同之處並不僅僅是誇張的。

en: The qualitative parallels are obvious: banks using off-balance loans to finance highly risky ventures, exotic new financial instruments, and excessive exuberance over the promise of new markets.
zh: 本質上的相同之處是明顯的。 銀行使用帳外貸款來為極為具有風險的專案融資，別出心裁的金融工具以及對新的市場前景的過度興奮。

en: But there are strong quantitative parallels as well.
zh: 但是從數量上來說也有很強的共同之處。

en: Professor Carmen Reinhart of the University of Maryland and I systematically compared the run-up to the US sub-prime crisis with the run-up to the 19 worst financial crises in the industrialized world over the past 60 years.
zh: 馬里蘭大學萊恩哈特教授和我係統地比較了美國次級房貸危機和過去60年整個工業化世界19個最為嚴重的金融危機之前的狀況。

en: These include epic crises in the Scandinavian countries, Spain, and Japan, along with lesser events such as the US savings and loan crises of the 1980’s.
zh: 這些包括斯堪的那維亞國家、西班牙和日本發生的巨大的危機，以及二十世紀八十年代美國儲蓄和貸款危機等較為輕微的事件。

en: Across virtually all the major indicators – including equity and housing price runs-ups, trade balance deficits, surges in government and household indebtedness, and pre-crisis growth trajectories – red lights are blinking for the US.
zh: 幾乎所有主要標誌，包括資產和住房價格攀升、貿易平衡赤字、政府和居民負債猛增以及危機以前的增長軌跡等等都給美國亮出了紅燈。

en: Simply put, surging capital flows into the US artificially held down interest rates and inflated asset prices, leading to laxity in banking and regulatory standards and, ultimately, to a meltdown.
zh: 簡而言之，洶湧流向美國的資本人為地壓低了利率並抬高了資產價格，導致銀行和監管標準鬆懈並且最終造成瓦解。

en: When Asia and Latin America had their financial meltdowns in the 1990’s and early 2000’s, they took advice not only from the IMF, but also from a number of small panels composed of eminent people representing diverse backgrounds and experiences.
zh: 九十年代和二十一世紀之初亞洲和拉美金融危機發生之際，它們不僅從國際貨幣基金組織、而且也從幾個代表了多樣背景和經驗的著名人士組成的專家小組那裡聽取建議。

en: The US should do the same.
zh: 美國也應如此。

en: The head of the IMF, Frenchman Dominique Strauss-Kahn, could easily select a superb panel from any range of former crisis countries, including Mexico, Brazil, Korea, Turkey, Japan, and Sweden, not to mention Argentina, Russia, Chile, and many others.
zh: 國際貨幣基金組織主席、法國人思特勞斯·卡恩可以輕而易舉地從任何範圍的前危機國家、包括墨西哥、巴西、韓國、土耳其、日本以及瑞典，更不用說阿根廷、俄國、智利以及其他許多國家那裡挑選一個超級專家小組。

en: Admittedly, the IMF’s panel would have to look past America’s current hypocrisy.
zh: 應當承認，國際貨幣基金組織的專家小組將會放過美國目前的偽善。

en: The US Treasury strongly encouraged Asia to tighten fiscal policy during its 1990’s crisis.
zh: 在九十年代的危機中，美國財政部強烈鼓勵亞洲緊縮財政政策。

en: But today the US Congress and President are tripping over themselves to adopt an ill-advised giant fiscal stimulus package, whose main effects will be to tie the hands of the next president in simplifying the US tax code and closing the budget deficit.
zh: 但是今天，美國國會和總統卻自我矛盾地要採納一個巨大的、魯莽的財政刺激一攬子方案，其主要效果就是限制下一任總統簡化美國稅法以及消除預算赤字的空間。

en: Americans firmly told Japan that the only way to clean up its economy was to purge insolvent banks and regenerate the financial system through Schumpeterian “creative destruction.”
zh: 美國人堅定地告訴日本說，收拾日本經濟爛攤子的唯一途徑就是清除負債的銀行，並且透過熊彼特的“創造性破壞”來重造其金融體系。

en: Today, US authorities appear willing to contemplate any measure, no matter how inflationary, to insure that none of its major banks and investment houses fails.
zh: 如今，美國當局似乎願意考慮任何措施來確保其主要銀行和投資公司沒有一家倒閉，而無論其手段具有多大的通脹風險。

en: For years, foreign governments complained about American hedge funds, arguing that their non-transparent behavior posed unacceptable risks to stability.
zh: 多年來，外國政府抱怨美國的對沖基金，說它們不透明的行為對穩定造成不可接受的風險。

en: Now, many US politicians are complaining about the transparency of sovereign wealth funds (big government investors mainly from Asia and the Middle East), which are taking shares in trophy American assets such as Citibank and Merrill Lynch.
zh: 現在，許多美國政界人物則在抱怨國家財富基金(也就是主要來自亞洲和中東的龐大的政府投資者)的透明度問題。 這些基金正在花旗銀行和美林公司等讓美國驕傲的資產上入股。

en: In fact, having countries like Russia and China more vested in the well-being of the US economy would not be a bad thing.
zh: 實際上，讓像俄國和中國那樣的國家在美國經濟福祉上更多投資並非一件壞事。

en: Yes, the IMF ought to develop a voluntary code of conduct for SWF’s, but it should not be used as a weapon to enforce financial protectionism.
zh: 是的，國際貨幣基金組織應該給主權財富基金制定一個自願遵守的行為準則，但是這並不應當用來實行金融保護主義的武器。

en: For years, I, along with many others, have complained that emerging markets need greater representation in global financial governance.
zh: 多年來，我和其他許多人抱怨說新興市場國家需要在全球金融管理中佔有更大的代表比例。

en: Today, the issue goes far beyond symbolism.
zh: 今天，這一問題遠遠超過了象徵主義。

en: The US economy is in trouble, and the problems it spins off are unlikely to stop at the US border.
zh: 美國經濟陷入麻煩，而它所帶來的問題不大可能侷限於美國境內。

en: Experts from emerging markets and elsewhere have much to say about dealing with financial crises.
zh: 來自新興市場國家和其他地方的專家們對於應付金融危機有很多話要說。

en: America should start to listen before it is too late.
zh: 美國在為時已晚之前應該開始傾聽。

en: Obamacare and Effective Government
zh: 奧巴馬醫保和高效政府

en: BERKELEY – When historians look back on the United States’ Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA), President Barack Obama’s controversial 2010 health-care reform, we predict that they will not devote much attention to its regulations, its troubled insurance exchanges, or its website’s flawed launch.
zh: 伯克利—如果有歷史學家回顧2010年奧巴馬總統頗有爭議的醫療改革 — — 美國患者保護和平價醫療法（Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act，ACA ） ， 我們預測他們不會將注意力花在它的規則、它麻煩的保險交易以及它網站的漏洞上。

en: Instead, we think that they will focus on how “Obamacare” encouraged a wave of innovation that gradually tamed the spiraling costs of a dysfunctional system, even as millions of previously excluded Americans gained access to health insurance.
zh: 相反，我們認為歷史學家會將注意力集中在“奧巴馬醫保”如何鼓勵了逐漸控制一個功能失調的系統的不斷上升的成本的創新上，即使它讓數百萬此前被排除在外的美國人也獲得了醫療保險。

en: Innovation is probably the least discussed aspect of health-care reform.
zh: 創新也許是醫療改革中被討論最少的話題。

en: Yet it is crucial to “bending” the sector’s cost curve, because it enables the delivery of quality health care in cost-effective ways.
zh: 但它是“彎曲”醫療成本曲線的關鍵，因為它能夠讓高品質醫療以高價效比的方式提供。

en: Obamacare has provided powerful new incentives for such innovation.
zh: 奧巴馬醫保為這類創新提供了有力的新激勵。

en: From 1980 to 2010, US health-care spending grew almost twice as fast as the economy, rising from 9.2% to 17.4% of GDP.
zh: 1980—2010年，美國醫療支出速度幾乎是經濟增長的兩倍，佔GDP之比從9.2%上升至17.4 % 。

en: While many factors contributed to this surge, most experts agree that the single most important cause was a fee-for-service system that rewarded health-care providers for billing as many services as possible, rather than for keeping people healthy and treating their illnesses efficiently.
zh: 有許多因素促成了這一增幅，但大部分專家都同意，最重要的原因是按服務計費（fee-for-service）制度，該制度鼓勵醫療服務提供者儘可能多地提供收費服務，而不是把維持人民健康和有效治療疾病放在首位。

en: The ACA has been changing that, by establishing myriad new incentives to foster efficiency in health-care delivery – for example, by reducing costly and unnecessary hospital infections and readmissions, and by adopting electronic health records.
zh: ACA改變了這一切，其辦法是建立大量新激勵提高醫療服務提供效率 — — 比如降低昂貴且不必要的醫院傳染和再住院（readmissions ） 、 採取電子病歷等。

en: Most important, the ACA is providing incentives for the creation of “affordable care organizations,” “bundled payment systems,” and other delivery innovations to encourage better coordination of care, especially for patients with numerous chronic conditions.
zh: 最重要的是，ACA為建立“平價治療組織 ” 、 “捆綁支付系統”和其他醫療服務提供創新提供了激勵，從而鼓勵了更好的治療合作，特別是對存在多種慢性病的病患而言。

en: Such patients are among the 10% who account for an estimated 64% of overall health care costs.
zh: 這些病患佔10 % ， 但付出了約64%的總醫療成本。

en: Around the US, providers, insurers, non-profits, and local governments are responding to the ACA’s incentives.
zh: 放眼美國，提供商、保險商、非營利組織和地方政府都在響應ACA的激勵。
