en: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (which provide health insurance to pensioners and the poor) has just announced its second round of grants – $665 million to 28 states, three territories, and the District of Columbia – to encourage innovations in health-care delivery.
zh: 聯邦醫療保險和醫療補助服務中心（The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services，為退休者和窮人提供醫療保險）剛剛宣佈了第二輪資金分配 — — 28個州、三個領地和哥倫比亞特區獲得6.65億美元 — — 以刺激醫療服務提供創新。

en: Of course, it is still too early to declare victory, but Obamacare seems to be working.
zh: 當然，現在就宣佈勝利還為時尚早，但奧巴馬醫保似乎在起作用。

en: According to a recent analysis by the Council of Economic Advisers (CEA), about ten million people gained health insurance coverage in 2014 as a result of the ACA – the largest increase in coverage in four decades.
zh: 根據經濟顧問委員會（Council of Economic Advisers，CEA）的最新分析，2014年大約有1,000萬人因為ACA而獲得醫療保險覆蓋 — — 這是四十年來醫療覆蓋面增加最大的一年。

en: But the real surprise is that growth in health-care spending slowed dramatically from 2010 to 2013, to roughly the same pace as GDP growth.
zh: 但真正的驚喜是醫療支出增長在2010—2013年出現大幅放緩，已與GDP增長速度相仿。

en: This represented a sharp break from the previous half-century; indeed, this period was characterized by the slowest growth in real per capita health-care spending on record.
zh: 這與此前半個世紀形成了鮮明對比；事實上，這段時期創造了真實人均醫療支出增長最緩慢的記錄。

en: To be sure, the ACA is only one factor in this promising trend; growth in health-care spending often slows in the wake of an economic downturn.
zh: 誠然，ACA只是這一令人欣喜的趨勢的一個因素；醫療支出增長常常隨經濟衰退而放緩。

en: But Medicare spending, which is not affected by recessions, has slowed along with private health-care spending.
zh: 但聯邦醫療保險支出 — — 該指支出不受衰退影響 — — 也隨著私人健康支出一起放緩。

en: In a recent study, the CEA concluded that the ACA’s Medicare reforms account for a significant share of the slowdown.
zh: 在最新研究中，CEA測算出ACA的聯邦醫療保險改革貢獻了醫療支出增長放緩的很大一部分。

en: The ACA is an example of how government can promote innovation to address major societal challenges by providing goals, directions, and incentives, rather than dictating solutions.
zh: ACA是一個很好的範例，說明了政府如何能夠透過提供目標、方向和激勵而不是透過命令式方案促進解決重大社會挑戰的創新。

en: The government plays a role akin to that of a venture capitalist providing seed money and financial support to foster innovation.
zh: 政府的作用就像是風險資本家，提供種子資金和金融支援促進創新。

en: In this scenario, different players – Medicare and Medicaid, state and local governments, private insurers, physicians, and social entrepreneurs – collaborate to hammer out effective solutions that can be scaled with government revenues.
zh: 在這一情形中，不同的行為人 — — 聯邦醫保和聯邦醫療補助、州和地方政府、私人保險商、醫生和社會企業家 — — 合作打造佔政府收入一定比例的有效的解決方案。

en: For example, responding to the ACA’s incentives and flexibility, Arkansas and Oregon have launched bold experiments to revamp Medicaid, in part by rewarding health-care providers who deliver better outcomes and keep patients healthier.
zh: 比如，阿肯色州和俄勒岡州響應ACA的激勵和靈活性，啟動了大膽的實驗性措施改造聯邦醫療補助 — — 獎勵帶來更好結果、讓患者更健康的醫療服務提供商就是辦法之一。

en: In Camden, New Jersey, Jeffrey Brenner, a family doctor, has pioneered strategies to reduce hospital stays by “super-utilizers,” a small share of Medicaid patients who are frequently admitted for expensive acute care.
zh: 在新澤西州坎登（Camden ） ， 家庭醫生傑弗裡·布倫納（Jeffrey Brenner）率先試水透過“超級使用者 ” （ super-utilizers）減少住院的戰略。 超級使用者是一小部分聯邦醫療補助病患，他們經常使用昂貴的緊急治療。

en: Brenner mapped “hot spots” around Camden, and sought to find out why people in some areas ran up such huge bills.
zh: 布倫納繪製了坎登周邊的“熱點 ” ， 並且試圖找出為何某些地區的人醫藥費會如此巨大。

en: The problem was not fraud. It was an absence of coordinated medical care, especially basic primary care, and a lack of attention to people’s underlying risk factors.
zh: 問題不在於欺詐，而在於缺乏協作醫療特別是基本初級治療和缺乏對人們基本風險因素的關注。

en: The most expensive 1% of patients, those with a tangle of issues, accounted for 30% of Camden’s public health-care spending.
zh: 最昂貴的1%病患往往一身是病，他們佔據了坎登公共醫療支出的30 % 。

en: Brenner’s Camden Coalition of Healthcare Providers, founded in 2003, received its first funding from a philanthropy, the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation, and a private insurer, United Health Care.
zh: 布倫納的坎登醫療服務提供商聯盟（Camden Coalition of Healthcare Providers）成立於2003年，首筆資金來自慈善機構羅伯特·伍德·約翰遜基金會（Robert Wood Johnson Foundation）和私人保險商聯合醫療保險公司（United Health Care ） 。

en: The remarkable success in Camden has prompted the foundation to fund similar experiments in Boston, Cleveland, Cincinnati, western Michigan, and Humboldt County, California.
zh: 坎登的巨大成功促使該基金會又資助了波士頓、克利夫蘭、辛辛那提、西密歇根和加州洪堡縣（Humboldt County）的類似實驗。

en: Now the government is providing additional support, with grants to similar programs in Maryland, Colorado, Pennsylvania, and North Carolina.
zh: 如今政府也開始提供更多的支援，馬里蘭州、科羅拉多州、賓夕法尼亞州和北卡羅來納州的類似專案都獲得了政府撥款。

en: Oregon has entered into a pay-for-success bargain with the federal government.
zh: 俄勒岡州與聯邦政府進行了“成功後支付 ” （ pay-for-success）談判。

en: The state will receive $1.9 billion over five years to revamp its Medicaid services along the lines of Camden’s approach.
zh: 該州將在五年時間中獲得19億美元按照坎登的方法改造聯邦醫療補助服務。

en: Oregon will get the money only if its per-person Medicaid costs climb substantially more slowly than other states’.
zh: 俄勒岡州只有在人均聯邦醫療補助成本增速顯著低於其他州的情況下才能獲得這筆資金。

en: At the moment, Oregon is on track.
zh: 現在，俄勒岡州正在路上。

en: Arkansas has moved 20 different “episodes” of health-care delivery (including hip and knee replacements, pregnancy, colonoscopies, asthma, and congestive heart failure) from fee-for-service to paying for quality outcomes.
zh: 阿肯色州將20個不同的醫療服務提供“專案 ” （ 包括臀部和膝蓋替換術、懷孕、結腸鏡檢查、哮喘和充血性心力衰竭）從按服務計費變為按高質量結果支付。

en: The results so far are promising – not just by reining in costs, but also by better aligning service delivery with best practices.
zh: 到目前為止，效果很好 — — 不但降低了成本，也更好地將服務提供和最佳實踐結合起來。

en: The government can spur innovation by offering incentives that tap many different players’ strengths.
zh: 政府可以透過提供集中多個行動方的優勢的激勵刺激創新。

en: In health care, that means taking advantage of the purchasing clout of Medicare and Medicaid, the risk-taking of social entrepreneurs and philanthropists, and the dynamism of markets and private business.
zh: 在醫療領域，這意味著利用聯邦醫療保險和聯邦醫療補助的購買力、社會企業家和慈善機構的風險承擔力和市場和私人企業的活力。

en: And health-care reform is just one example in which government can deliver what the public wants by setting goals, encouraging creativity, and providing the resources to scale up what works.
zh: 而醫療改革只是政府可以透過設定目標、鼓勵創新、提供擴大有用方案的資源帶來公眾想要的東西的一個例子。

en: Twenty-five years from now, we hope that historians look back on the ACA as the start of a new era of public-private collaboration to develop innovative solutions to complex social problems – and thus to restore trust in government itself.
zh: 我們希望，二十五年後的歷史學家回顧ACA時會把它當做一個新時代的開端，在這個時代中，公共和私人部門合作開發複雜社會問題的創新性解決辦法 — — 從而也重塑了政府本身的信任。

en: America’s Hidden Debt
zh: 美國的隱藏負債

en: WASHINGTON, DC – Former US Secretary of the Treasury Lawrence H. Summers recently quipped that, “Fiscal stimulus is like a drug with tolerance effects; to keep growth constant, deficits have to keep getting larger.”
zh: 發自華盛頓特區 — — 前美國財政部長勞倫斯·薩默斯（Lawrence H. Summers）最近打趣說 : “ 財政刺激就像一種存在耐受性的藥物；為了保持持續增長，就必須得讓赤字不斷擴大。

en: People like Summers worry about deficits because they doubt that the money the government is borrowing is being spent in ways that will push the long-term growth of GDP above that of the debt.
zh: ”像薩默斯這樣的人之所以為赤字憂心，是因為他們懷疑政府借來的錢是否最終被用到了可以推動GDP長期增長超過債務增長的手段上。

en: Unless the mix of spending changes, the debt-to-GDP ratio will continue to grow, foretelling disaster.
zh: 除非支出組合發生變化，否則債務相對GDP的比率將繼續增長，直到災難降臨。

en: Others do not share such concerns.
zh: 其他人卻對此不以為然。

en: On the political left, Nobel laureate Paul Krugman, for example, argues that for “a country that looks like the United States, a debt crisis is fundamentally not possible.”
zh: 例如在左派諾貝爾經濟學獎得主保羅·克魯格曼（Paul Krugman）就認為對於一個“美國這樣的國家來說，債務危機根本不可能發生。

en: On the right, John Tamny, Forbes’ political economy editor, says, “Ignore the endless talk of doom, budget deficits really don’t matter.”
zh: ”而隸屬於右派的《福布斯》雜誌政治經濟編輯約翰·塔姆尼（John Tamny）也覺得應該“把那些沒完沒了的危言聳聽拋諸腦後，預算赤字委實無關緊要。 ”

en: But while judgments differ about the sustainability of US government debt, they both accept the standard measure of it as accurate.
zh: 但儘管各方對美國政府債務可持續性的判斷存在分歧，但他們都接受衡量這一指標的標準方法的準確性。

en: This is a mistake, and possibly a catastrophic one.
zh: 這就是一個錯誤，甚至可能是災難性的。

en: The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) recently reported that the federal budget deficit in the first ten months of this fiscal year was $116 billion higher than it was at the same time last year.
zh: 美國國會預算辦公室最近報告稱，本財年前十個月的聯邦預算赤字較去年同期高出1160億美元。

en: The CBO is now projecting that the annual deficit will reach $1 trillion by 2020.
zh: 國會預算辦公室目前預計到2020年時年度赤字將達1萬億美元。

en: This is worrying, but it does not reflect the harsh truth. The annual deficit almost certainly surpassed $1 trillion last year.
zh: 這雖然令人擔憂，但卻並未反映出嚴酷的事實：去年的年度赤字幾乎已經肯定超過了1萬億美元。

en: To understand why, think of America as a home with a leaky roof.
zh: 要理解這一點，可以把美國想象成一個天花漏水的屋子。

en: If you wanted to sell that home to a buyer who is financing the purchase with a mortgage, federal real-estate law would require you to get an appraisal, which would show that the roof needs repairs.
zh: 如果你想將房屋出售給透過抵押貸款來籌措房款的買家，聯邦房地產法會要求你先對房屋進行評估，而評估結果肯定會寫明屋頂需要維修。

en: In this scenario, your maintenance delays cannot be ignored.
zh: 在這種情況下你無法拖延維護。

en: The law requires that you disclose and pay for the hidden costs of repairing the roof. Otherwise, you are stealing from the buyer.
zh: 法律會要求你披露並支付修復屋頂的隱性費用，否則的話你就是在盜取買家的利益。

en: True, unlike the mortgage on your balance sheet, you may not regard roof maintenance as a current liability.
zh: 的確，與資產負債表上的抵押貸款不同，你可能不會將屋頂維護費用視為當期負債。

en: But putting it off doesn’t make it disappear.
zh: 但是推遲這筆支出並不會讓問題消失。

en: It is still a real debt – just one that has gone unaccounted for.
zh: 它仍然是一筆實實在在的債務 — — 只是暫時未計入而已。

en: The federal government also has debt that has not been accounted for, and which one doesn’t often hear about.
zh: 聯邦政府也有一些人們往往都不會留意到的未計入債務。

en: The debt that has been accounted for is the $15.6 trillion held by the public in the form of US Treasury bonds. The debts that have not been accounted for include the deferred costs of maintenance on roads, water systems, and 54,560 structurally deficient bridges, as well as the yet-to-be-built low-carbon energy systems necessary to mitigate the catastrophic effects of climate change.
zh: 已計入的債務是公眾以美國國債形式持有的15.6萬億美元；而未計入的債務包括維護道路，供水系統和54560個存在結構缺陷橋樑的延期成本，以及減輕氣候災難性影響所必需的、尚未建成的低碳能源系統。

en: And these are just two broad examples.
zh: 但這些只是其中兩個影響比較廣泛的例子而已。

en: So, just how much hidden US debt is there?
zh: 那麼美國究竟有多少隱藏債務呢？

en: At this point, we must rely on rough estimates.
zh: 在這方面我們只依靠粗略的估計。

en: For example, according to a 2016 report from the American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE), upgrading the country’s crumbling infrastructure would cost $5.2 trillion.
zh: 例如，根據美國土木工程師協會2016年釋出的一份報告，升級該國搖搖欲墜的基礎設施需要耗資5.2萬億美元。

en: And, according to a 2014 International Energy Agency (IEA) report and our own calculations based on the US share of global CO2 emissions, transitioning to a clean-energy system will cost an additional $6.6 trillion.
zh: 根據國際能源署2014年發表的報告和我們根據美國在全球二氧化碳排放量中所佔的份額進行的計算，向清潔能源系統轉換將額外花費6.6萬億美元。

en: All told, that is $11.8 trillion in unaccounted-for non-inflation-adjusted liabilities.
zh: 加起來就是11.8萬億包含通脹因素的未入賬負債。

en: To be sure, these debts are not solely federal liabilities.
zh: 可以肯定的是，這些債務不僅僅是聯邦債務。

en: In the past, state and local governments were responsible for most infrastructure and climate costs.
zh: 過去大多數基礎設施和氣候成本都由州和地方政府負責。

en: However, already burdened with more than $3 trillion of municipal debt, state governments are overwhelmed by the scale of their deferred-maintenance liabilities and the only recently documented costs of climate change abatement.
zh: 然而已經承受超過3萬億美元市政債務的各州政府被其大規模延後支付設施維護負債以及最近才列入記錄的緩解氣候變化成本壓得喘不過氣來。

en: However, because climate change and infrastructure security are national issues, rather than local, the federal government is ultimately responsible for that $11.8 trillion in infrastructure- and environment-related debts.
zh: 但由於氣候變化和基礎設施安全是國家而不是地方事務，這11.8萬億美元的基礎設施和環境相關債務最終還是要由聯邦政府負責。

en: They are America’s national “leaky roof.”
zh: 它們就是美國這個國家的“漏水屋頂 ” 。

en: That figure increases every year, because as bridges continue to weaken, it costs even more to fix them; and as sea levels and temperatures continue to rise, and as forest fires become more severe, it costs more to mitigate the damage.
zh: 這個數字會逐年增加，因為隨著橋樑結構的不斷瓦解，修復它們的成本只會更高；隨著海平面和氣溫的持續升高，森林火災的加劇，降低災害損失的成本也會增加。

en: In fact, between 2012 and 2016, the ASCE increased its estimate of America’s annual infrastructure-investment gap by $221 billion – about $55 billion per year.
zh: 事實上，在2012~2016年間，美國土木工程師協會將美國年度基礎設施投資缺口預測數提高了2210億美元 — — 每年增加約550億美元。

en: And between 2012 and 2014, the IEA increased its estimated cost of moving to a clean-energy system by roughly $270 billion per year.
zh: 而從2012年到2014年，國際能源署將向清潔能源系統轉換的估計成本每年調高大約2700億美元。

en: Together, the unaccounted-for inflation-adjusted deficit amounted to $345 billion – just from delaying needed infrastructure and climate abatement spending.
zh: 加起來排除通脹因素後的赤字總額達3450億美元 — — 僅僅是因為推遲了所需的基礎設施和氣候減排支出。

en: The 2017 US federal deficit was $665 billion, reflecting the amount by which debt that is actually accounted for increased.
zh: 2017年美國聯邦赤字為6650億美元，這反映了實際得到核算的債務增加額。

en: If infrastructure and climate debt that is not accounted for were to be included, the all-in deficit in 2017 would have been over $1 trillion.
zh: 但如果將未計入的基礎設施和氣候債務納入其中，2017年的全部赤字將超過1萬億美元。

en: Yes, these are back-of-the-envelope calculations, but they point to an urgent question: Why isn’t the US counting its hidden debts?
zh: 這雖然都是些粗略的計算，但它們指出了一個緊迫的問題：為什麼美國去不計算其隱藏債務？

en: The short answer is that the law doesn’t require it.
zh: 簡略的回答是法律並不要求這樣做。

en: The federal “debt limit” was never a firm construct, and under pressure it became a squishy “ceiling suspension” that allows the government to borrow as much as it wants.
zh: 聯邦“債務上限”從來都不是一個固定架構，並且在壓力之下它已經變成了一種軟性的“天花懸掛系統”好讓政府可以儘可能多地借錢。

en: Meanwhile, a congressional rule that was intended to ensure fiscal responsibility by prohibiting deficit increases above $1.5 trillion within a ten-year window has become an accounting trick to escape responsibility for the 11th year and beyond.
zh: 與此同時，一項原本旨在透過禁止赤字在十年內增加超過1.5萬億美元以確保政府能負起財政責任的國會裁定已淪為逃避第11年及隨後年份責任的會計技巧。

en: But just as we are stealing from the homebuyer if we do not disclose and pay for our leaky roof, we are stealing from future generations of Americans when we ignore the full extent of government liabilities.
zh: 但正如隱瞞和拖延維修漏水屋頂形同於從購房者處偷錢那樣，當我們忽視政府在全部範疇內的負債時，實際上就是打劫未來的美國人。

en: Until all debt is counted, we cannot even begin to know whether fiscal policies are having positive or negative effects on future growth.
zh: 除非所有債務都被記錄在案，否則我們甚至無法瞭解財政政策究竟會對未來增長產生正面還是負面影響。

en: America’s Second Chance with India
zh: 美國和印度的第二次機會

en: NEW YORK – Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Washington, DC, in June garnered little public attention outside of India.
zh: 紐約—印度總理莫迪6月份的訪美之旅在印度之外基本沒有引起什麼關注。

en: Yet diplomats and military professionals in Asia and beyond were certainly watching closely.
zh: 但亞洲外交官和軍事專業人士顯然在密切關注。

en: For good reason: the rapprochement between the world’s two most populous democracies could shape the world’s future.
zh: 其來有自：世界上人口最多的兩個民主國家之間的關係緩和可以決定世界的未來。

en: It is worth noting that in his address to the US Congress, Modi invoked the word “partner” or “partnership” no fewer than 15 times.
zh: 值得注意的是，在美國國會演講中，莫迪至少15次提到了“夥伴”一詞。

en: The official joint statement released by the two governments described India as a “Major Defense Partner” of the United States, eligible for advanced technologies with military applications.
zh: 兩國政府釋出的正式聯合申明將印度描述為美國的“主要防務夥伴 ” ， 有資格獲得軍用先進技術。

en: The relationship between India and the US has evolved from one of cool distance to strategic proximity in a generation – lightning fast for geopolitics.
zh: 在一代人的時間裡，印美關係從冷眼保持距離演變為戰略性靠近 — — 就地緣政治而言，發展不可不謂快。

en: The factors underlying this shift merit attention, for many of them are likely to bring the two countries even closer.
zh: 這一轉變背後的推動因素值得關注，因為其中許多因素有望讓兩國更加緊密。

en: The Cold War’s end was a significant part of the bilateral rapprochement, because it eliminated the possibility of India’s continued association with the Soviet Union, as well as its rationale for embracing non-alignment.
zh: 冷戰的結束是印美關係緩和的一個重要部分，因為印度不再需要與蘇聯打交道，不結盟的理由也不再成立。

en: A second factor is Pakistan.
zh: 第二個因素是巴基斯坦。

en: For a long time, the US pursued an even-handed policy toward South Asia’s two most strategically important countries.
zh: 長期以來，美國對這兩個在戰略上最重要的南亞國家採取的是一碗水端平的政策。

en: Nonetheless, during most of the Cold War, Pakistan was seen as a friendly country, whereas its great rival, India, was viewed as difficult.
zh: 儘管如此，在冷戰的大部分時間裡，巴基斯坦被視為友邦，而它的勁敵印度被視為一個難點。

en: This view was reinforced when Pakistan became the essential conduit of weapons to Afghans fighting the Soviet occupation of their country.
zh: 巴基斯坦成為向阿富汗輸送武器助其抵抗蘇聯侵略的重要通道後，這一觀點進一步得到了強化。

en: But the bond between the US and Pakistan weakened when Soviet forces withdrew from Afghanistan in 1989.
zh: 但1989年蘇軍撤出阿富汗後，美巴關係有所削弱。

en: Relations suffered further from Pakistan’s development of nuclear weapons, its provision of sanctuary and support to the Taliban, and its willingness to extend hospitality to some of the world’s most dangerous terrorists, including Osama bin Laden.
zh: 巴基斯坦發展核武器、為塔利班提供庇護和支援並且願意給包括本·拉登在內的全球最危險恐怖分子提供藏身之所，這進一步影響了美巴關係。

en: As a result, US ties to India were no longer constrained by fear of complications in Pakistan.
zh: 結果，美國建設對印關係不再受到顧慮巴基斯坦不滿的約束。

en: China is also animating the improvement in India-US ties.
zh: 中國也在推動印美關係的改善。

en: The motivation is far more fundamental than the fact that India and China still have an unresolved border.
zh: 其背後的動機遠比中印邊境問題仍有待解決這一事實更具根本性。

en: China’s rise has created a strong incentive for countries with a stake in Asia to increase their cooperation with the US, as well as with one another, to ensure that they can stand up to China’s political, military, and economic might.
zh: 中國的崛起強烈地刺激了在亞洲有利益所在的國家加強與美國以及彼此之間的合作，以確保能夠抵禦中國的政治。 軍事和經濟力量。

en: Domestic politics also loom large in the relationship’s development – on both sides.
zh: 國內政治也嚴重影響著印美關係的發展 — — 對兩國都是如此。

en: The decline of India’s Congress party reduced the influence of the political force most associated with maintaining distance from the US.
zh: 印度國大黨的衰落降低了最支援與美國保持距離的政治力量的影響力。

en: Meanwhile, there are now more than three million Indian-Americans, and, as with many other immigrant populations, they have become ever more prominent and powerful.
zh: 與此同時，如今美國有三百萬印度裔公民，與許多其他移民群體一樣，他們變得更加重要和強大。

en: Supporting closer ties with India has become a rare example of bipartisan US foreign policy, and it can be expected to continue regardless of which party controls the White House or Congress after this November’s elections.
zh: 支援加強對印關係已成為美國罕見的跨黨派外交政策之���，並且可以期待這一狀況將繼續保持，不管今年11月哪個黨入主白宮。

en: The breakthrough in bilateral ties came a decade ago, when the US lifted sanctions introduced in response to India’s nuclear weapons program and then signed an accord paving the way for US involvement in India’s civil nuclear energy program.
zh: 雙邊關係的突破始於十年前，當時，美國取消了因印度核武器計劃而實施的制裁，隨後簽署了一份協議，為美國參與印度民用核能計劃掃清了道路。

en: India, unlike both Pakistan and North Korea, is seen as a responsible nuclear power, a country the US now supports for membership in various groups designed to stem the further spread of nuclear materials and weapons.
zh: 和巴基斯坦和朝鮮不同，印度被視為負責任的核力量，目前美國支援印度加入各種為防止核材料和武器進一步擴散而設立的組織。

en: Economic ties are also growing, along with India’s economy.
zh: 隨著印度經濟的增長，印美經濟關係也在加強。

en: Bilateral trade has increased to more than $100 billion a year.
zh: 雙邊貿易已增加到每年1,000億美元以上。

en: High-level visits have become commonplace.
zh: 高層訪問已經稀鬆平常。

en: Closer economic ties and large-scale collaboration on clean energy are a high priority.
zh: 更緊密的經濟關係和清潔能源領域的大規模合作是重中之重。

en: One can also predict increased cooperation between the two countries’ military and intelligence establishments.
zh: 可以預期，兩國軍事和情報機構之間的合作也將增加。

en: Indeed, joint efforts to keep the Indian Ocean open and safe are already a reality.
zh: 事實上，保持印度洋開放和安全的聯合行動已是既成事實。

en: The US and India need not be formal allies for their relationship to have the desired effect on Chinese strategic calculations.
zh: 美國和印度正式結盟就可以對中國的戰略意圖形成想要的影響。

en: Challenges remain, of course.
zh: 當然，挑戰仍然存在。

en: Bureaucracy, corruption, and poor infrastructure continue to hold back India’s economy.
zh: 官僚主義、腐敗和拙劣的基礎設施仍然制約著印度經濟。

en: Indian leaders must also be careful not to do or say things that could alienate the country’s large Muslim minority.
zh: 印度領導任還必須保持謹慎，不可做出或說出可能梳理該國為數巨大的穆斯林少數群體的內容。

en: And they must still ensure that close ties with the US are not simply the policy of one prime minister or party.
zh: 他們還必須確保與美國的緊密關係不僅僅是一屆總理或一黨的政策。

en: This means getting the Congress party fully on board and overcoming the resistance of career officials to new ways of thinking and acting.
zh: 這意味著要讓國大黨充分參與進來，並克服事務官對新思維和行為的牴觸。

en: It is difficult to overlook the irony in much of this.
zh: 不難看出，其中不乏諷刺之處。

en: More than a half-century ago, in the early years of the Cold War, many in Washington saw India as a potential model of non-Communist political and economic development.
zh: 五十多年前，在冷戰初期，華盛頓有許多人將印度視為非共產主義政治和經濟發展的前在榜樣。

en: For many reasons, things did not work out that way, as India became economically statist, for a time politically authoritarian, and geopolitically closer to the USSR than US officials liked.
zh: 出於眾多原因，事情並未朝這個方向發展，印度在經濟上演變為國家主義，政治上一度成為極權主義，地緣政治上比美國官員所期待的更加接近於蘇聯。

en: Now, however, India is emerging as a successful example of a market-oriented democracy with close ties to the US.
zh: 但是，如今，印度正在崛起成為與美國關係密切的市場經濟民主的成功範例。

en: Second chances are rare in life, but both India and the US may be getting just that.
zh: 生活中很少能獲得第二次機會，而印度和美國可能恰恰獲得了這一機會。

en: America Keeping Haiti Down
zh: 美國在海地的伏都教人權政策

en: The IDB, the world's largest regional development bank, works in Latin America and the Caribbean purportedly to “contribute to the acceleration of economic and social development.”
zh: 作為世界上最大的區域開發銀行，泛美開發銀行在拉丁美洲和加勒比海地區的工作據稱是“為加快經濟和社會發展作貢獻 ” 。

en: Its actions in Haiti, however, have severely undermined those goals.
zh: 但是，它在海地的行為已經嚴重損害了這些宗旨。

en: Roughly $54 million in IDB loans for water infrastructure in Haiti, home to literally the world’s worst water, offered a proven path to preventing deadly water-borne diseases. Designed to assist in fulfilling the right to water in the most impoverished nation in the Western Hemisphere, these loans and the lives they could have saved instead have become pawns in a deliberate political power play.
zh: 泛美開發銀行為了改善海地的飲用水基礎設施 — — 毫不誇張地說，海地的飲用水狀況是世界上最糟糕的 — — 提供的大約5400萬美元貸款，為防止致命的水致疾病提供了可行的途徑。 這些貸款原計劃用於幫助世界西半球上最貧窮的國家實現其飲用水權利，它們及其可以挽救的生命不應該在一個深思熟慮的政治權力遊戲中成為犧牲品。

en: In 2001, US officials threatened to use their influence to stop previously approved IDB funding unless Haiti’s majority political party submitted to political demands to accept a particular apportionment of seats in a Haitian electoral oversight body.
zh: 2001年，美國官員威脅道，除非海地的主要政黨接受一家海地選舉觀察機構中席位分攤的特別的政治要求，否則他們就會使用他們的影響力來阻止事先已經獲得批准的泛美開發銀行對海地的資助。

en: Soon after, at the behest of the US, instead of disbursing the loans as planned, the IDB and its members took the unprecedented step of implicitly adding conditions to require political action by Haiti before the funds would be released.
zh: 不久之後，在美國的要求之下，泛美開發銀行及其成員沒有按原計劃發放貸款，而是採取了從沒采取過的措施，在發放這些資金之前暗示增加海地採取政治行動的條件。

en: These actions violated the IDB’s own charter, which strictly prohibits the Bank and its members from interfering in the internal political affairs of member states.
zh: 這些行為違反了泛美開發銀行自己的章程，該章程嚴格禁止銀行及其成員干涉成員國的內部政治事務。

en: Internal emails reveal that a US legal counselor inside the IDB proposed to the US Treasury Department that, though the loans faced no legitimate technical obstacles, the US could effectively block them by “slowing” the process.
zh: 一些內部電子郵件顯示，一位泛美開發銀行內的美國律師向美國財政部提出如下建議：雖然這些貸款不存在合法性技術障礙，但是美國可以透過“延緩”貸款程序來有效地阻止貸款的發放。

en: Indeed, by requesting further review of the loans, Haiti would have to make scheduled payments before the funds were even disbursed.
zh: 確實，透過要求對貸款進行進一步的審查，海地將不得不在貸款發放之前就進行定期還款。

en: “While this is not a ‘bullet-proof’ way to stop IDB disbursements,” the counsellor wrote, “it certainly will put a few more large rocks in the road.”
zh: “雖然這不是阻止泛美開發銀行貸款發放的‘完美無缺’的方法 ” ， 該律師寫道 ， “ 但是，它肯定會給貸款的發放設定更多的障礙 ” 。

en: In 2001, then-US Ambassador to Haiti Dean Curran publicly and explicitly linked the withholding of IDB loans to the demand that Haiti’s political parties reach a compromise that America wanted.
zh: 在2001年，時任美國駐海地大使的迪安·科蘭（Dean Curran）曾公開明確地將泛美開發銀行貸款的扣留和海地的政黨達成美國希望的妥協的要求聯絡起來。

en: These tactics worked.
zh: 這些策略奏效了。

en: Deprived of funds that had already been committed and expected, Haiti fell into arrears on money owed for loan repayment, triggering IDB policies that prevented the Bank from releasing loans.
zh: 由於被剝奪了已經被承諾和期待的資金，海地沒有支付償還借款的資金，而這會使泛美開發銀行啟動阻止銀行貸款發放的銀行政策。

en: In subsequent years, the US employed additional delaying tactics, working with the IDB to move the goal posts whenever Haiti appeared to be meeting their demands.
zh: 在後來的幾年裡，美國又使用了其他的延遲策略，這些策略就是在海地似乎快要滿足其要求的時候，和泛美開發銀行一起改變目標標杆。

en: The results have been devastating.
zh: 這些策略的後果是毀滅性的。

en: The town of Port-de-Paix, slotted ten years ago by the IDB as the first project site due to its particularly deplorable water situation, has yet to see the implementation of any water projects.
zh: 和平港市因為其悲慘的飲用水狀況，在十年前就被泛美開發銀行跟蹤作為第一個專案實施地點，但是，到目前為止還沒有看到任何飲用水專案的實施。

en: A study conducted by Zanmi Lasante, Partners In Health, the Robert F. Kennedy Memorial Center for Human Rights, and New York University’s Center for Human Rights and Global Justice found no functioning public water sources in the city.
zh: 由健康夥伴（Zanmi Lasante ） 、 羅伯特·弗·肯尼迪人權紀念中心以及紐約大學人權和全球正義中心進行的研究發現，在和平港市沒有可供飲用的公共水源。

en: Researchers found three-quarters of water sources in the city contained high levels of coliform bacteria, a key indicator of contamination with fecal matter.
zh: 研究人員發現，該市3/4的水源都含有很高水平的大腸杆細菌，這是水源被排洩物汙染的一個重要指標。

en: A frightening 15% of households reported symptoms likely related to typhoid.
zh: 而且，還有令人震驚的高達15%的家庭報告了可能和傷寒症有關的症狀。

en: If the US and other member states join the IDB and take on the responsibility to improve conditions in the Americas, they cannot then use their membership to undermine the basic rights of the people they claim to serve simply to advance their own political agenda.
zh: 如果美國和其他成員國加入泛美開發銀行，承擔起改善美洲各國狀況的責任，那麼，他們就不能僅僅為了推進自己的政治議程，而利用其成員資格去破壞他們聲稱要去服務的人們的基本權利，

en: The IDB and the US government must take responsibility for their actions and implement the necessary transparency mechanisms to ensure that such abuses do not recur.  Congressional inquiries and annual reviews of the Treasury Department by the Government Accountability Office could provide the oversight necessary to prevent future political misuse of the IDB and its funds.
zh: 泛美開發銀行和美國政府必須為他們的行為承擔責任，並實施必要的透明度機制來保證這樣的權利濫用不再發生。 美國國會質詢和政府責任辦公室對財政部的年度審查可以為防止以後對泛美開發銀行及其資金的政治濫用提供必要的監督。

en: The people of Haiti, as well as US taxpayers, deserve a system that makes public the status of IDB loans and projects in Haiti in order to ensure that the US and IDB member states uphold their commitments to development and human rights.
zh: 為了保證美國和泛美開發銀行成員國實踐他們對發展和人權的承諾，海地人民和美國的納稅人應該擁有一個將泛美開發銀行貸款以及在海地的專案的狀況向公眾公開的制度。

en: The Myth of Sound Fundamentals
zh: 基本面可靠的神話

en: NEW HAVEN – The spin is all too predictable.
zh: 紐黑文—起伏太容易預測了。

en: With the US stock market clawing its way back from the sharp correction of early February, the mindless mantra of the great bull market has returned.
zh: 隨著美國股市從2月初的大幅調整中逐步恢復，無腦大牛市的詛咒也開始迴歸。

en: The recent correction is now being characterized as a fleeting aberration – a volatility shock – in what is still deemed to be a very accommodating investment climate.
zh: 如今，最近的回撥被定義為短暫的偏離 — — 一次波動性衝擊 — — 投資環境仍然十分適宜。

en: After all, the argument goes, economic fundamentals – not just in the United States, but worldwide – haven’t been this good in a long, long time.
zh: 畢竟，這一觀點說，經濟基本面 — — 不僅僅是美國，也包括全世界 — — 很久沒有那麼好了。

en: But are the fundamentals really that sound?
zh: 但基本面真的如此可靠嗎？

en: For a US economy that has a razor-thin cushion of saving, nothing could be further from the truth.
zh: 對儲蓄緩衝薄得可憐的美國經濟來說，沒有比這離得更遠的真相了。

en: America’s net national saving rate – the sum of saving by businesses, households, and the government sector – stood at just 2.1% of national income in the third quarter of 2017. That is only one-third the 6.3% average that prevailed in the final three decades of the twentieth century.
zh: 2017年三季度，美國的淨國民儲蓄率 — — 企業、家庭和政府部門儲蓄之和 — — 只有國民收入的2.1 % ， 僅僅相當於二十世紀結束前三十年平均水平6.3%的三分之一。

en: It is important to think about saving in “net” terms, which excludes the depreciation of obsolete or worn-out capacity in order to assess how much the economy is putting aside to fund the expansion of productive capacity.
zh: 看到儲蓄要以“淨值”思維，這一點很重要。 這意味著要在評估經濟留出多少資金用於產能擴張時，要將已經報廢或廢棄的產能的折舊剔除。

en: Net saving represents today’s investment in the future, and the bottom line for America is that it is saving next to nothing.
zh: 淨儲蓄代表了今天對未來的投資，而美國的計算結果是儲蓄接近於零。

en: Alas, the story doesn’t end there.
zh: 可惜，故事到這裡還沒有結束。

en: To finance consumption and growth, the US borrows surplus saving from abroad to compensate for the domestic shortfall.
zh: 為了給消費和增長融資，美國向海外借入盈餘儲蓄來補足國內短缺。

en: All that borrowing implies a large balance-of-payments deficit with the rest of the world, which spawns an equally large trade deficit.
zh: 所有這些借款帶來了巨大的國際收支赤字，進而產生同樣巨大的貿易赤字。

en: While President Donald Trump’s administration is hardly responsible for this sad state of affairs, its policies are about to make a tough situation far worse.
zh: 特朗普總統的政府不需要為這個悲哀的狀態負責，但其採取的政策會大大加劇困境。

en: Under the guise of tax reform, late last year Trump signed legislation that will increase the federal budget deficit by $1.5 trillion over the next decade.
zh: 去年，特朗普打著稅收改革的旗號簽署了將讓美國聯邦預算赤字在未來十年增加1.5億美元的立法。

en: And now the US Congress, in its infinite wisdom, has upped the ante by another $300 billion in the latest deal to avert a government shutdown.
zh: 而如今，美國國用它的大智慧，在為了避免政府關門的人達成的最新協議中，將這個數字再度提高了3,000億美元。

en: Never mind that deficit spending makes no sense when the economy is nearing full employment: this sharp widening of the federal deficit is enough, by itself, to push the already-low net national saving rate toward zero. And it’s not just the government’s red ink that is so troublesome.
zh: 別在意在經濟接近充分就業的時候，赤字支出根本毫無意義：如此巨大的聯邦預算增幅本身已足以讓已然很低的淨國民儲蓄率向零靠攏。

en: The personal saving rate fell to 2.4% of disposable (after-tax) income in December 2017, the lowest in 12 years and only about a quarter of the 9.3% average that prevailed over the final three decades of the twentieth century.
zh: 2017年12月，個人儲蓄率下降至可支配（稅後）收入的2.4 % ， 為12年來的最低值，只有二十世紀最後三十年平均水平9.3%的四分之一左右。

en: As domestic saving plunges, the US has two options – a reduction in investment and the economic growth it supports, or increased borrowing of surplus saving from abroad.
zh: 隨著國內儲蓄的暴跌，美國有兩個選擇 — — 降低投資及其所支撐的經濟增長，或增加從海外借入的盈餘儲蓄。

en: Over the past 35 years, America has consistently opted for the latter, running balance-of-payments deficits every year since 1982 (with a minor exception in 1991, reflecting foreign contributions for US military expenses in the Gulf War).
zh: 在過去35年中，美國一直選擇了後者，1982年以來幾乎每年都出現國際收支赤字（只有1991年是微不足道的例外，原因是海灣戰爭期間外國幫助美國貢獻了不少軍事支出 ） 。

en: With these deficits, of course, come equally chronic trade deficits with a broad cross-section of America’s foreign partners.
zh: 當然，與這些赤字一同到來的是同樣根深蒂固的對美國各大貿易伙伴的貿易赤字。

en: Astonishingly, in 2017, the US ran trade deficits with 102 countries.
zh: 2017年，美國對令人咋舌的102個國家存在貿易赤字。

en: The multilateral foreign-trade deficits of a saving-short US economy set the stage for perhaps the most egregious policy blunder being committed by the Trump administration: a shift toward protectionism.
zh: 儲蓄短缺的美國經濟的多邊對外貿易赤字為也許是特朗普政府所犯下的最嚴重的政策錯誤 — — 轉向保護主義創造了條件。

en: Further compression of an already-weak domestic saving position spells growing current-account and trade deficits – a fundamental axiom of macroeconomics that the US never seems to appreciate.
zh: 進一步壓縮已然孱弱不堪的國內儲蓄頭寸意味著經常專案和貿易赤字繼續增加 — — 這可不是美國一貫欣賞的宏觀經濟學的基本準則。

en: Attempting to solve a multilateral imbalance with bilateral tariffs directed mainly at China, such as those just imposed on solar panels and washing machines in January, doesn’t add up.
zh: 1月份，特朗普政府對中國產太陽能面板和洗衣機徵收關稅，用諸如此類主要針對中國的雙邊措施來解決多邊失衡問題無濟於事。

en: And, given the growing likelihood of additional trade barriers – as suggested by the US Commerce Department’s recent recommendations of high tariffs on aluminum and steel – the combination of protectionism and ever-widening trade imbalances becomes all the more problematic for a US economy set to become even more dependent on foreign capital.
zh: 此外，由於出現新貿易壁壘的可能性不斷提高 — — 比如美國商務部最近建議對鋁和鋼鐵徵收高額關稅 — — 保護主義和不斷擴大的貿易失衡的組合對於越來越依賴外國資本的美國經濟來說將更成問題。

en: Far from sound, the fundamentals of a saving-short US economy look shakier than ever.
zh: 儲蓄短缺的美國經濟的基本面絕對算不上可靠，倒是比以往任何時候都要岌岌可危。

en: Lacking a cushion of solid support from income generation, the lack of saving also leaves the US far more beholden to fickle asset markets than might otherwise be the case.
zh: 由於缺少來自收入創造的可靠支撐緩衝，儲蓄不足還讓美國更加容易受到變幻無常的資產價格的影響。

en: That’s especially true of American consumers who have relied on appreciation of equity holdings and home values to support over-extended lifestyles.
zh: 對於依靠股票和房價上漲支援與收入不匹配的生活方式的美國消費者來說尤其如此。

en: It is also the case for the US Federal Reserve, which has turned to unconventional monetary policies to support the real economy via so-called wealth effects.
zh: 對美聯儲來說也是如此，它依靠非常規貨幣政策，透過所謂的財富效應來支援實體經濟。

en: And, of course, foreign investors are acutely sensitive to relative returns on assets – the US versus other markets – as well as the translation of those returns into their home currencies.
zh: 當然，外國投資者對相對資產回報 — — 美國相對其他市場 — — 以及將這些回報換回本幣的匯率非常敏感。

en: Driven by the momentum of trends in employment, industrial production, consumer sentiment, and corporate earnings, the case for sound fundamentals plays like a broken record during periods of financial market volatility.
zh: 受就業、工業產出、消費者情緒和公司收益的趨勢動能的推動，基本面可靠的觀點就像是在金融市場波動時期被打破的記錄。

en: But momentum and fundamentals are two very different things.
zh: 但動能和基本面是截然不同的兩件事。

en: Momentum can be fleeting, especially for a saving-short US economy that is consuming the seed corn of future prosperity.
zh: 動能隨時會消失得無影無蹤，對儲蓄短缺、寅吃卯糧的美國經濟來說尤其如此。

en: With dysfunctional policies pointing to a further compression of saving in the years ahead, the myth of sound US fundamentals has never rung more hollow.
zh: 適得其反的政策準備在未來幾年進一步壓縮儲蓄，照此看，美國基本面可靠的神話簡直像是一個恐怖故事。

en: America’s Midterm Elections Turn Menacing
zh: 美國的中期選舉變得異常兇險

en: WASHINGTON, DC – With the approach of this year’s midterm elections in the United States, domestic terrorism is starting to dominate the political landscape.
zh: 華盛頓 — — 隨著年內美國中期選舉的臨近，國內恐怖主義開始主導政治格局。

en: First, barely two weeks before Election Day, an angry supporter of US President Donald Trump began sending 14 bombs to prominent Democrats and others whom Trump has frequently attacked.
zh: 首先，就在選舉日前不到兩週，美國總統唐納德·特朗普一位憤怒的支持者開始向著名的民主黨人和其他特朗普經常攻擊的人士郵寄14枚炸彈。

en: (None of the bombs exploded.)
zh: （這些炸彈都沒有爆炸。

en: Then things became much worse, with the murder, on a Saturday, of 11 Jews in a Pittsburgh synagogue.
zh: ）而後局面更是進一步惡化，星期六，在匹茲堡的一座猶太教堂裡，11名猶太人被謀殺。

en: Today, a polarized and anxious American public finds itself with a president totally unsuited to, and not very interested in, comforting the nation, much less trying to lead it away from the hate and deadly partisanship that he has stoked.
zh: 今天，嚴重焦慮和兩極分化的美國民眾發現自己的總統對撫慰民眾不感興趣，而且也完全不適合安慰這個國家，就更不用說試圖領導美國擺脫他所挑起的仇恨和致命的黨派關係了。

en: Had the 14 crude bombs, which the FBI called “potentially destructive devices,” worked as intended, the bombmaker could have killed or gravely injured a who’s who of Trump adversaries.
zh: 如果被聯邦調查局稱之為“潛在破壞性裝置”的這14枚自製炸彈發揮了預期的效果，那麼炸彈製造者可能已經殺害或重傷了作為特朗普對手的名人。

en: The list included two former presidents (Bill Clinton and Barack Obama), Hillary Clinton, former Attorney General Eric Holder; a former CIA director; a former director of National Intelligence; two likely Democratic presidential candidates in 2020; a black congresswoman whom Trump frequently describes as “low IQ” (a common racist charge); two prominent Jewish billionaire philanthropists, one of whom, George Soros, is a frequent target of Trump and the subject of various right-wing conspiracy fantasies; and the actor Robert De Niro (who began his speech at this year’s Tony Awards ceremony by declaring, “Fuck Trump”).
zh: 這份名單包括兩位前總統（比爾·克林頓和巴拉克·奧巴馬 ） 、 希拉里·克林頓、前首席檢察官埃裡克·霍爾德；前中情局長；前國家情報局局長；以及兩名可能在2020年參選的民主黨總統候選人；一位經常被特朗普形容為“低智商”的黑人女議員（這是一種非常普遍的種族主義指控 ） ； 兩位著名的猶太億萬富翁慈善家，其中一位喬治·索羅斯一直是特朗普的常規目標，同時也是各種右翼陰謀幻想所針對的物件；此外還有演員羅伯特·德尼羅（他在今年託尼獎的頒獎典禮演說中一開始就宣佈 ， “ 去他的特朗普 ” ） 。

en: Though Trump had frequently singled out many of the bomber’s targets at his rallies – still attacking Hillary Clinton, his election opponent in 2016, for example, and then smiling as his audience chanted “Lock her up” – Trump’s defenders tried to throw the spotlight elsewhere.
zh: 儘管特朗普經常在集會上特別提到炸彈製造者的許多目標 — — 例如，他仍在攻擊作為自己2016年大選對手的希拉里·克林頓，而後面帶微笑地對聽眾高喊“鎖住她 ” — —特朗普的捍衛者仍試圖讓輿論聚焦到別的地方。

en: The mail bombs, they claimed, were a “false flag” operation by the left, with some of the Democrats even sending the bombs to themselves in order to blame Trump.
zh: 他們聲稱郵件炸彈是左翼“打著特朗普旗號的假冒行動 ” ， 有些民主黨人甚至給自己寄炸彈，並藉此指責特朗普。

en: So it was highly inconvenient for true believers when the would-be bomber turned out to be a fanatical Trump supporter who lives in Florida and drives a white van covered in hate-filled depictions of his targets.
zh: 因此當事實證明炸彈嫌疑人是居住在佛羅里達州的一位狂熱的特朗普支持者，並開著一輛繪滿了對其目標充滿仇恨的畫像的白色廂式貨車時，對特朗普的鐵桿支持者而言是非常尷尬的。

en: US law enforcement agencies – another frequent target of Trump – are extremely good at tracking down miscreants: the suspect was arrested four days after the first bomb was discovered in Soros’s mailbox.
zh: 美國執法機構 — — 也是特朗普經常攻擊的另外一個目標 — — 非常善於追查歹徒：嫌疑人在索羅斯郵箱發現第一枚炸彈四天後被捕。

en: The most disheartening aspect of the entire episode was Trump’s utter incapacity as a national leader.
zh: 整個事件從始至終最令人沮喪的就是，特朗普身為國家領袖卻完全束手無策。

en: But that should surprise no one.
zh: 但這應當早在所有人的預料之中。

en: How could a president who has thrived politically on dividing the American people, who has been spewing hate, sowing resentment, and at times even encouraging violence at his rallies, suddenly be – or even pretend to be – a healer?
zh: 怎麼能指望一個藉助分裂美國民眾而謀取大量政治利益、堅持播種仇恨、怨懟，有時甚至在集會上鼓勵暴力行為的美國總統突然之間扮演 — — 甚至假裝扮演 — — 治癒者的角色？

en: In fact, Trump’s pattern of incitement and routine denunciations of the media as “the enemy of the people” had convinced many that some of his followers might resort to violence against members of the press.
zh: 事實上，特朗普的煽動及不停譴責媒體是“人民公敵”的模式已經令很多人深信其追隨者有可能針對新聞媒體從業人員發起暴力行動。

en: The day after the discovery of the bombs sent to the Clintons and the Obamas, among others, a subdued Trump read a prepared statement at a prescheduled White House ceremony, condemning “acts or threats of political violence” and saying that the nation must unify.
zh: 此次事件中，在發現寄給克林頓和奧巴馬炸彈的第二天，一個被暫時被壓制的特朗普在一次預定舉行的白宮儀式上宣讀了一份準備好的宣告，譴責“政治暴力的威脅和行為 ” ， 並表示民眾必須統一起來。

en: It didn’t last.
zh: 但這種情況並沒有持續多久。

en: By that evening, at a rally in Wisconsin, he was making fun of his “trying to be nice” act and blamed the media for the violence.
zh: 到那天傍晚，在威斯康辛州舉行的一次集會上，特朗普就開始取笑自己“試圖變得和善”的行為，並稱媒體應對此次暴力行為負責。

en: And soon he was back to whipping up fear of a caravan of refugees from Honduras.
zh: 很快他又重新開始煽動對宏都拉斯難民車隊的恐懼。

en: Though still roughly 1,000 miles from the US border, Trump portrayed the refugees as an imminent national security threat, warning, without evidence, that “Middle Easterners” were among them.
zh: 儘管距美國邊境仍有1，000英里，但特朗普仍將那些難民描繪成迫在眉睫的國家安全威脅，並在毫無證據的情況下警告，難民隊伍中混入了“中東人 ” 。

en: Trump’s rallies are now almost a daily event, and his lies are even more frequent than before.
zh: 特朗普的集會現在幾乎天天上演，而他的謊言也比以前頻繁得多。

en: With the entire House of Representatives and one-third of the Senate to be chosen on November 6, the upcoming midterm election is widely regarded as the most consequential in memory, perhaps ever.
zh: 因為11月6日將選舉整個眾議院和參議院1/3的席位，即將到來的中期選舉被普遍視為人們記憶當中最重要的選舉，其重要性甚至也許是史無前例的。

en: The Republicans’ two-year lock on the entire US government – the House, the Senate, the presidency, and, with the recent addition of Justice Brett Kavanaugh, the Supreme Court – could be broken.
zh: 共和黨對整個美國政府長達兩年的完全控制 — — 包括眾議院、參議院、總統職位，以及不久前剛剛就任最高法院法官的佈雷特·卡瓦諾 — — 這次有可能會被打破。

en: The midterm election following the election of a new president is often considered a verdict on the incumbent, and his party usually loses strength, particularly in the House.
zh: 緊隨新總統當選後的中期選舉往往會被視為對現任總統的宣判，而其所屬政黨往往會失勢，尤其是在眾議院。

en: But Trump has made the midterms about himself to an unprecedented degree.
zh: 但特朗普已經把中期選舉和自己的關係抬高的前所未有的程度。

en: He tells audiences that though he’s not on the ballot, they should vote as if he were (though his approval ratings are in the low forties).
zh: 他告訴聽眾儘管他並未參加投票，他們在投票時應當假設他是其中的一員（儘管他的支援率現在已經降到40 % ） 。

en: It has long been believed that the Democrats are more likely to win the House than the Senate, because several of the Senate seats in play are held by Democrats in traditionally conservative states.
zh: 很長時間以來，人們一直認為與參議院相比，民主黨更有可能贏得眾議院，因為即將參與選舉的幾個參議院席位都掌握在傳統保守州的民主黨人手中。

en: Trump’s determination, or anxiety, that Republicans maintain control of both chambers is understandable.
zh: 特朗普對共和黨人繼續控制兩院的決心和焦慮可以理解。

en: Should the Democrats take over the House, newly empowered committee chairmen, armed with subpoenas, will launch investigations of a broad range of administration actions and agencies, where extensive corruption is suspected.
zh: 如果民主黨人接管眾議院，那麼新授權的委員會主席將會拿到傳票，並將廣泛調查涉嫌貪汙行為的一系列行政行為和機構。

en: But the real, almost palpable, fear on Trump’s part is that a Democratic-controlled House will focus all manner of investigations on him personally: his acceptance of Constitutionally forbidden “emoluments” from foreign countries; his failure to separate himself sufficiently from the family business; his tax returns; his unauthorized foreign wars in Yemen and Syria; and of course his official and private dealings with Russia.
zh: 但特朗普幾乎清晰可辨的真正的恐懼是民主黨控制的眾議院將把所有調查集中在他本人身上：他接受憲法明文規定禁止的外國“酬金 ” ； 他未能與家族企業充分脫鉤；他的納稅申報返還；他未經授權擅自在葉門和敘利亞發動戰爭；當然還有他與俄羅斯之間的公開和私下交易。

en: At least the House is likely to have the conclusions of Special Counsel Robert Mueller to consider.
zh: 至少眾議院可能會得出與特別顧問羅伯特·穆勒相同的結論。

en: In other words, no more lapdog Congress.
zh: 換句話說，國會將不再是特朗普豢養的寵物。

en: But if the Republicans maintain control of the Senate, there will be limits on what the Democrats can achieve.
zh: 但如果共和黨保持對參議院的控制，就會限制民主黨所能達到的目標。

en: Even if the House were to impeach Trump – no sure thing – convicting him in the Senate would be extremely difficult.
zh: 即使眾議院真的彈劾特朗普 — — 能不能彈劾現在還根本無法確定 — — 要想在參議院將他定罪也將是極其困難的。

en: Whether a Democratic House would even proceed in that direction has been the subject of intra-party debate.
zh: 甚至民主黨控制的眾議院是否會朝那個方向努力一直都還是黨內爭論的目標。

en: The nightmare election possibility for the Democrats is continued Republican control of both chambers.
zh: 對民主黨而言，噩夢般的選舉前景是兩院繼續由共和黨控制。

en: In that case, Trump will feel vindicated and more liberated than ever.
zh: 在那樣的情況下，特朗普相比任何時候都將更強烈地感受到無辜和自由。

en: He might then fire a raft of officials, treat immigrants still more harshly, and try to shut down Mueller’s investigation of his campaign’s possible collusion with the Kremlin and Trump’s probable obstruction of justice.
zh: 然後他可能會解僱大批官員，更嚴厲的對待移民，並試圖停止穆勒對其選舉團隊與克里姆林宮可能的串通以及特朗普可能的阻撓司法行為的調查行動。

en: The conventional wisdom may prevail, with the Democrats winning the House but not the Senate.
zh: 傳統智慧可能會佔據上風，民主黨可能會在眾議院而非參議院選舉中獲勝。

en: But the polls have been fluctuating.
zh: 但民意調查顯示的結果一直在波動。

en: And since Trump’s stunning election victory in 2016, most observers have become more cautious about predicting outcomes.
zh: 自從特朗普2016年令人矚目地獲勝以來，多數觀察家都對預測選舉結果變得更加謹慎。

en: Alliances for Peace
zh: 為了和平的聯盟

en: WASHINGTON, DC – I grew up in the shadow of World War II, and at the dawn of the Cold War.
zh: 華盛頓—我成長於二戰的陰影和冷戰的黎明中。

en: My father’s work as a Foreign Service officer gave me an opportunity to see history up close in a searing way: I will never forget walking the beaches of Normandy with him and seeing the burned hulks of Higgins’ boats still on those shores, just a few years after so many young men went to their graves so the world could be free.
zh: 我的父親是一位駐外事務處（Foreign Service）官員，這使我有機會以一雙火眼金睛近距離觀察歷史：我永遠不會忘記和他一起漫步在諾曼底海灘，看見燒燬的希金斯艇（Higgins’ boats）的龐大身軀仍矗立在岸上，就在幾年前，大批年輕人為了世界的自由慷慨赴死。

en: Likewise, I will never forget the eerie feeling of riding my bike through the Brandenburg Gate from West Berlin into the East, and seeing the contrast between people who were free and those who were trapped behind the Iron Curtain.
zh: 類似地，我也永遠不會忘記騎著腳踏車從西柏林透過布蘭登堡門前往東柏林時的怪異感覺，目睹自由的人和被困在鐵幕之後的人的反差。

en: What strikes me now, all these years later, is that a generation of leaders won not only a war, but also the peace.
zh: 多年以後，如今讓我震驚的是一代領導人不但贏得了戰爭，還贏得了和平。

en: They did it together.
zh: 他們齊心協力做到了這一點。

en: The United States and our partners worked to create alliances that brought prosperity and stability to Western Europe, Japan, and South Korea.
zh: 美國和我們的夥伴努力建立了給西歐、日本和韓國帶來繁榮與穩定的聯盟。

en: Old enemies became new allies, and together pioneered a new global economic system that made the world more prosperous.
zh: 舊敵人成了新盟友，並一起引領了讓全世界更繁榮的新全球經濟制度。

en: And even as the Cold War raged, leaders found ways to cooperate on arms control and prevent a nuclear Armageddon.
zh: 哪怕是在冷戰肆虐時，領導人們也找得到辦法在武器控制和阻止核末日等方面進行合作。

en: In short, by building effective and indispensable international institutions and strategic partnerships, we did not just avoid another catastrophic world war; we ultimately ended the Cold War and lifted global living standards for hundreds of millions of people.
zh: 簡言之，透過構建有效的、不可或缺的國際機構和戰略合作關係，我們不但避免了又一場災難性世界大戰，我們最終還結束了冷戰，提高了全球數億人的生活水平。

en: That is the remarkable story of the twentieth century.
zh: 這是20世紀令人矚目的故事。

en: The question now is what story will emerge from the twenty-first century.
zh: 現在的問題是21世紀的故事會怎樣展開。

en: Today, the world order faces new challenges.
zh: 今天，世界秩序面臨新挑戰。

en: Russian aggression is rattling allies.
zh: 俄羅斯的入侵讓盟國震驚。

en: Extremists who hijack religion threaten governments and people everywhere.
zh: 從事宗教聖戰的極端主義者威脅著政府和各處的人民。

en: Technology is accelerating a shift in the balance of power between governments and governed that offers both opportunities for democratic accountability and obstacles to inclusive politics.
zh: 科技正在加速治國者和被治者之間的實力平衡，既提供了民主問責的機會，也形成了包容政治的障礙。

en: We have gone from a world where power resided in hierarchies to one where it inhabits networks.
zh: 我們已經從權力呈現層級分佈的世界來到了權力呈現網路分佈的世界。

en: Statecraft has yet to adapt.
zh: 但治國術還沒有適應。

en: The international institutions and partnerships that emerged in the postwar years demand both maintenance and modernization.
zh: 戰後時期出現的國際機構和合作關係既需要維持，也需要現代化。

en: In the face of all of this turbulence, some suggest that America should turn inward.
zh: 面臨所有這些動盪，有人認為美國應該轉向內向。

en: That is nothing new.
zh: 這不過是陳詞濫調。

en: Some argued the same after WWII.
zh: 二戰後就有人提出這樣的觀點。

en: They argued it again 25 years ago, after the fall of the Berlin Wall.
zh: 25年前柏林牆倒塌後又有人這樣說。 那時，他們錯了。

en: They were wrong then – and they are wrong now.
zh: 如今，他們也是錯的。

en: The need for leadership has never been greater, and the US has never been more engaged with the world.
zh: 對領導力的需要從未如此巨大，美國也從未如此深地參與世界。

en: Our role in Afghanistan’s first-ever peaceful, democratic transition reminds us all that, having invested so much blood and treasure in helping to give Afghans a chance to succeed in battle, the world has just as much responsibility to help its leaders succeed in governance.
zh: 我們在阿富汗歷史上首次和平的民主轉型中所扮演的角色提醒我們所有人，世界付出如此大的鮮血和金錢代價幫助阿富汗人獲得在戰爭中獲勝的機會，也有同樣大的責任幫助阿富汗領導人在治國方面取得成功。

en: We know that the destruction of 100% of Syria’s declared chemical weapons would not have happened without direct, hands-on diplomacy and perseverance, just as Syria’s immoral and horrifying civil war will not end without an equal commitment.
zh: 我們知道，如果沒有親力親為地直接參與和堅持不屑，就不可能100%摧毀敘利亞宣稱擁有的化學武器，正如沒有這些努力，敘利亞令人駭人聽聞的邪惡內戰是不會結束的。

en: So, too, in Asia, where President Barack Obama and Chinese President Xi Jinping just announced ambitious commitments to tackle climate change, we are reminded of what countries can accomplish together with real leadership – and of how much additional leadership is required to conclude a successful climate agreement in Paris next year.
zh: 亞洲也是如此，奧巴馬總統和中國國家主席習近平剛剛作出宏達承諾解決氣候變化問題，我們可以從中看到，有了真正的領導力，各國可以完成怎樣的成就 — — 也可以看到，要在明年的巴黎敲定成功的氣候協定還需要多少領導力。

en: The world has changed, and we are changing with it.
zh: 世界已經發生了變化，我們也在隨之改變。

en: Lines on the map no longer contain the gravest threats, and the players are no longer divided neatly into two camps.
zh: 地圖上的線不再包含最嚴重的威脅，各行動方也不再涇渭分明地分成兩個陣營。

en: In the twenty-first century, next door is everywhere.
zh: 在21世紀，後門無處不在。

en: That is why the world needs coalition diplomacy.
zh: 因此，世界需要聯盟外交（coalition diplomacy ） 。

en: No country can defeat terrorism on its own.
zh: 沒有哪個國家能夠單槍匹馬擊敗恐怖主義。

en: No country can solve the existential threat of climate change alone.
zh: 沒有哪個國家能夠單槍匹馬解決生存危機。

en: No country can eradicate extreme poverty, combat potential pandemics, or improve nuclear security by itself.
zh: 沒有哪個國家能夠依靠自己消滅極端貧困、戰勝潛在傳染病或改善核安全。

en: None of us can live safer, richer lives by turning our back to the world.
zh: 如果我���不直面世界，我們所有人都無法獲得更安全、更富裕的生活。

en: We must build on our history of working with allies by forming new coalitions – with governments, with civil society, and, yes, with everyday people.
zh: 我們必須與政府、與公民社會 — — 是的，還要與普羅大眾 — — 結成新的聯盟，與盟友們一起構建歷史。

en: A good example is the international effort to confront the Islamic State’s malign brutality in Iraq and Syria.
zh: 一個很好的例子是針對伊斯蘭國在伊拉克和敘利亞殘忍暴行的國際努力。

en: Political, humanitarian, and intelligence tools from more than 60 countries are being used to support unified military action.
zh: 來自60多個國家政治、人道和情報工具被用於支援聯合軍事行動。

en: Success depends not on what one or even a handful of countries can do alone, but on what all of us are able to achieve by moving forward together against this common threat.
zh: 成功不取決於一國甚至少數幾國可以獨力完成什麼，而是取決於我們所有人可以透過攜手面對這一共同威脅實現什麼。

en: On an equally important front, the US is working with the United Nations to galvanize a global response to the danger posed by the Ebola virus.
zh: 在另一個同樣重要的陣線，美國正在與聯合國一起努力激勵全球應對埃博拉病毒的威脅。

en: I have personally talked with more than 50 foreign leaders, and we all agree that only by coordinating our actions can we stop the devastation in West Africa and halt Ebola’s spread.
zh: 我個人與50多位外國領導人討論了這一問題，我們都同意，只有透過協調行動才能阻止西非的災難和埃博拉的傳播。

en: We are making progress on both issues, but much work remains.
zh: 我們在這兩個問題上都在取得進展，但仍有許多工作要做。

en: Bringing together countries with competing interests and varying resources is hard work.
zh: 讓利益相互競爭、資源大相徑庭的國家走到一起是一個艱難的工作。

en: It demands intense diplomatic engagement and calls upon relationships that have been built and maintained over decades, as well as alliances with new partners.
zh: 這要求大量外交投入、動員幾十年來所構建和維持的關係以及與新合作伙伴的聯盟。

en: But by overcoming differences and coordinating efforts to defeat the Islamic State and conquer Ebola, we are reinforcing support for a world order grounded in collective solutions to common problems.
zh: 但透過克服差異、共同努力擊敗伊斯蘭國、征服埃博拉，我們正在強化對基於針對共同問題的集體解決方案的世界秩序的支援。

en: Cooperation is equally vital in reinforcing the bedrock economic principles on which America and other countries built their postwar prosperity.
zh: 對於鞏固作為美國和其他國家戰後繁榮基礎的經濟原則，合作也同樣重要。

en: Frustration cannot grow faster than opportunity in any country.
zh: 不論哪個國家，沮喪都不會比機會發展得更快。

en: For example, the negotiations on the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP) reflect President Obama’s determination to strike an accord with countries that represent one-third of global trade and 40% of global GDP.
zh: 比如，跨太平洋合作伙伴關係（Trans-Pacific Partnership，TPP）表明了奧巴馬與佔全球貿易三分之一、全球GDP百分之四十的地區形成一致的決心。

en: The benefits – for both the US and our partners – are enormous.
zh: 不管是對美國還是對我們的合作伙伴，好處都是巨大的。

en: Estimates are that the TPP could provide $77 billion a year in real income and support 650,000 new jobs in the US alone.
zh: 據估計，光是在美國，TPP每年可以增加77美元真實收入、支援650,000個新就業崗位。

en: The Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership being negotiated with the European Union offers another major step toward increasing trade.
zh: 正在與歐盟談判的跨大西洋貿易和投資合作伙伴關係（Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership）則提供了另一個促進貿易的一大步。

en: Whether for mutual security or shared prosperity, genuine partnerships are not built overnight.
zh: 不管是為了共同安全還是共同繁榮，真正的夥伴關係都不是一夜建成的。

en: Patient diplomacy and a collective will are needed to advance common goals. America’s objectives remain the same as they have been for decades – peace, prosperity, and stability for the US and for our partners around the world.
zh: 耐心的外交和集體意願是推進共同目標的必要條件，美國的目標與數十年來別無二致 — — 和平、繁榮以及美國和我們的全球夥伴的穩定。

en: Closing the Investment Gap
zh: 填補投資缺口

en: BERKELEY – The weakness of private investment in the United States and other advanced economies is a worrisome – and perplexing – feature of the recovery from the 2008 global financial crisis.
zh: 伯克利—美國和其他發達經濟體私人投資疲軟，2008年全球金融危機後的復甦的這一特徵令人擔憂，也令人困惑。

en: Indeed, according to the International Monetary Fund, through 2014, private investment declined by an average of 25% compared to pre-crisis trends.
zh: 事實上，據國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）的資料，2014年較危機前趨勢，私人投資平均下降25 % 。

en: The shortfall in investment has been deep and broad-based, affecting not only residential investment but also investment in equipment and structures.
zh: 投資不足的深度和廣度都很大，不但影響住宅投資，也影響裝置和結構投資。

en: Business investment remains significantly below pre-2008 expectations, and has been hit hard again in the US during the last year by the collapse of energy-sector investment in response to the steep drop in oil prices.
zh: 商業投資顯著低於2008年前的預期，去年美國商業投資因為石油價格暴跌所導致的能源部門投資驟降而再遭重創。

en: Interestingly, the investment shortfall in the US coincides with a strong rebound in returns to capital.
zh: 有趣的是，美國的投資短缺和資本回報率的強力反彈同時發生。

en: By one measure, returns to private capital are now at a higher point than any time in recent decades.
zh: 從某種程度上講，私人資本回報率目前比最近幾十年中的任何時候都要高。

en: But extensive empirical research confirms that at the macro level, business investment depends primarily on expected future demand and output growth, not on current returns or retained earnings.
zh: 但大量實證研究證實，在宏觀層面，商業投資主要取決於預期未來需求和產出增長，而不是當前回報率或留存利潤。

en: According to the IMF, this “accelerator” theory of investment explains most of the weakness of business investment in the developed economies since the 2008 crisis.
zh: 據IMF，這一投資的“加速器”理論解釋了2008年危機後發達經濟體商業投資疲軟的絕大部分。

en: In accordance with this explanation, investment growth in the US has been in line with its usual historical relationship with output growth.
zh: 根據這一解釋，美國投資增長與其與產出增長的正常歷史關係相符。

en: In short, private investment growth has been weak primarily because the pace of recovery has been anemic.
zh: 簡言之，私人投資疲軟主要是因為復甦疲軟。

en: Businesses have marked down their pre-crisis investment plans to reflect a post-crisis “new normal” of slower and more uncertain growth in demand for their output.
zh: 企業削減危機前的投資計劃，以適應速度更低、不確定性性更大的危機後產出需求增長“新常態 ” 。

en: Under conditions of weak aggregate demand, stronger public investment encourages more private business investment.
zh: 在總需求疲軟的背景下，加強公共投資鼓勵更多的私人商業投資。

en: But public investment, too, has fallen below pre-crisis expectations, aggravating rather than ameliorating the slump in private investment.
zh: 但公共投資也不如危機前預期，加劇而不是緩解了私人投資的暴跌。

en: The accelerator explanation of the shortfall in business investment in the US is consistent with evidence that, where projected demand growth has been relatively strong – for example, in cable, telecommunications, digital platforms, social networking, and, until recently, energy – investment growth has also been relatively strong.
zh: 美國商業投資短缺的加速器解釋與證據一致。 證據表明，預測的需求增長相對強勢的部門 — — 比如在電纜、通訊、數字平臺、社交網路以及直到最近的能源等 — — 投資增長也相對強勢。

en: Indeed, telecom and cable companies accounted for the largest share of business capital expenditures during the last three years, with energy production and mining second on the list.
zh: 事實上，通訊和電纜公司佔據了過去三年商業資本支出的最大份額，緊隨其後的是能源生產和礦產。

en: Differences in innovation opportunities across industries are also consistent with the changing composition of business investment.
zh: 行業間創新機會的差異也與商業投資份額變化一致。

en: During the 2009-2015 period, while business investment in equipment slowed in the US, it accelerated in intellectual property products, including research and development, software, and so-called artistic originals (the output of artists, studios, and publishers).
zh: 2009—2015年期間，美國裝置商業投資放緩，但智慧財產權產品，包括研發、軟體和所謂的原創作品（藝術家、工作室和出版商的產出）等，呈現加速增長。

en: R&D investment usually expands faster than GDP during cyclical expansions, and the current period is in line with historical trends.
zh: 在週期性擴張中，研發投資通常快於GDP，最近一段時期與歷史趨勢相符。

en: Indeed, as a share of the economy, R&D investment is now at its highest level on record, which bodes well for future productivity growth.
zh: 事實上，以佔經濟比重論，研發支出目前處於歷史最高水平，這十分有利於未來生產率增長。

en: As the accelerator theory of investment would predict, much R&D investment is occurring in technology-intensive sectors where current and future expected demand has been strong.
zh: 投資的加速器理論認為，大量研發投資發生在當前和未來預期需求強勢的技術密集型部門。

en: There is also evidence that the distribution of returns to capital is becoming increasingly skewed toward these sectors.
zh: 也有證據表明，資本回報的分佈越來越向這些部門傾斜。

en: According to a recent McKinsey Global Institute report, the most digitized sectors – ranked by 18 metrics on digital assets, digital usage, and digital workforce – enjoy significantly higher profit margins than traditional sectors.
zh: 據最新的麥肯錫全球研究所報告，最為數字化的部門 — — 透過數字資產、數字用途和數字勞動力等十八個指標排序 — — 所獲得的利潤率顯著高於傳統部門。

en: In a recent letter to the chief executives of the S&P 500 companies and large European corporations, Larry Fink, the CEO of BlackRock, the world’s largest investment management company, expressed concern that many global firms may be sacrificing value-creating investments by distributing dividends and buying back their own shares.
zh: 在致標普500成分股公司和嘔吼大公司執行長的信中，全球最大投資管理公司貝萊德公司（Black Rock）執行長拉里·芬克（Larry Fink）表示擔心許多全球企業可能正在用發放股利和回購本公司股票的方式浪費創造價值的機會。

en: Among US nonfinancial corporations, the proportion of investable funds used for dividends and share buybacks has been trending upward, albeit with cyclical ups and downs, since the 1980s.
zh: 在美國非金融公司中，20世紀80年代以來用於股利和股票回購的可投資資金比例呈現增加之勢（儘管存在起伏 ） 。

en: After a sharp downturn during the 2008-2009 recession, this proportion has now recovered to nearly 50%, a high point relative to historical averages.
zh: 2008—2009年衰退期間這一比例大幅下井，但如今又恢復到50%左右，從歷史平均值看相當高。

en: The macro evidence indicates that the primary cause of disappointing business investment in the US and other developed countries in the years following the global financial crisis has been anemic demand, not a lack of investable funds resulting from excessive distributions to shareholders.
zh: 宏觀證據表明，全球金融危機以來美國和其他發達國家商業投資令人失望的主要原因是需求萎靡，而不是過多地向股東分配而導致可投資資金不足。

en: Over the longer term, however, the upward trend in dividends and share buybacks as a percentage of corporate investable funds is a symptom of mounting shareholder pressure on corporations to focus on short-term returns at the expense of long-term investments.
zh: 但是，從長期看，股利和股票回購佔公司可投資資金的百分比的上升趨勢是股東日益向公司施加壓力、要求其專注於短期回報而非長期投資的症候。

en: In a recent McKinsey survey of 1,000 top executives and corporate directors, 63% reported that shareholder pressure to realize short-term returns has increased over the last several years.
zh: 最近，麥肯錫調查了1,000名高管和公司董事，其中63%表示過去幾年中股東對實現短期回報的壓力有所增加。

en: Indeed, some 79% reported pressure to demonstrate strong financial returns in two years or less.
zh: 事實上，79%的受訪者表示承受著在兩年或以內實現大量財務回報的壓力。

en: Shareholder pressure tends to be greater in older firms, and in the US over the last few decades, the proportion of older firms has been growing as the startup rate for new businesses has fallen.
zh: 股東壓力對於老牌企業往往更大，在過去幾十年中，美國老牌企業佔比因為企業創業率的下降而有所上升。

en: In addition, as Fink and others have warned, compensation practices that link top executives’ pay to measures of short-term success like quarterly earnings per share or annual equity performance also encourage “short-termism” in corporate investment decisions.
zh: 此外，芬克和其他人警告說，將高管薪酬與短期成功指標（如季度每股收益或年度股票表現）掛鉤的做法也鼓勵了 公司投資決策的“短期化 ” 。

en: A sliding capital gains tax, with rates that decline as the holding period for investments increases, would reduce incentives for short-termism among investors.
zh: 遞減的資本利得稅 — — 即稅率隨投資持有期的增加而降低 — — 能遏制投資者短期化的激勵。

en: Among others, Larry Fink, the Center for American Progress, and Hillary Clinton propose this approach.
zh: 拉里·芬克、美國進步中心（Center for American Progress）和希拉里·克林頓都建議採取這一方針。

en: In his recent CEO letter, Fink also calls on companies to issue annual “strategic frameworks” for long-term value creation, supported by quantifiable financial metrics and linking long-term executive compensation to performance on them.
zh: 在其最新的執行長的信中，芬克還呼籲各大公司為長期價值創造制定年度“戰略框架 ” ， 使用量化財務指標並將長期高管薪酬與這些指標的表現掛鉤。

en: These frameworks, Fink notes, should cover environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors that are core determinants of long-term value.
zh: 芬克指出，這些框架應該覆蓋環境、社會和治理（ESG）因素，它們是長期價值的核心決定因素。

en: Companies can use the new evidence-based standards developed by the Sustainability Accounting Standards Board to disclose material information about their ESG performance to their investors.
zh: 公司可以使用可持續性會計準則委員會（Sustainability Accounting Standards Board）所開發的新的基於證據的標準向投資者披露關於ESG表現的實質資訊。

en: Strategic frameworks, along with ESG disclosure, should encourage both companies and their shareholders to focus more on long-term value and less on short-term financial performance.
zh: 戰略框架配合ESG披露能夠鼓勵公司及其股東更加關注長期價值而不是短期財務表現。

en: But at the macro level, expected growth in demand and associated innovation opportunities will remain the primary drivers of business investment.
zh: 但在宏觀層面，需求及相應創新機會的預期增長將仍然是商業投資的主要推動力。

en: Inequality and the American Child
zh: 不平等性與美國兒童

en: NEW YORK – Children, it has long been recognized, are a special group.
zh: 紐約—我們早就知道，兒童是一個特殊群體。

en: They do not choose their parents, let alone the broader conditions into which they are born.
zh: 他們無法選擇父母，更不用說更廣義的出生環境了。

en: They do not have the same abilities as adults to protect or care for themselves.
zh: 他們沒有如同成人那樣的保護或照看自己的能力。

en: That is why the League of Nations approved the Geneva Declaration on the Rights of the Child in 1924, and why the international community adopted the Convention on the Rights of the Child in 1989.
zh: 因此，國際聯盟在1924年透過了日內瓦兒童權利宣言，國際社會也在1989年實施了兒童權利公約。

en: Sadly, the United States is not living up to its obligations.
zh: 悲哀的是，美國沒有在履行義務。

en: In fact, it has not even ratified the Convention on the Rights of the Child.
zh: 事實上，它甚至沒有批准兒童權利公約。

en: The US, with its cherished image as a land of opportunity, should be an inspiring example of just and enlightened treatment of children.
zh: 美國向來以機會之地的形象自豪，它本應該成為公正、開明地對待兒童的榜樣。

en: Instead, it is a beacon of failure – one that contributes to global sluggishness on children’s rights in the international arena.
zh: 相反，它卻成了失敗的象徵 — — 為兒童權利在國際經濟場上的全球頹勢做出了“貢獻 ” 。

en: Though an average American childhood may not be the worst in the world, the disparity between the country’s wealth and the condition of its children is unparalleled.
zh: 普通美國兒童也許不是全世界境況最糟糕的，但美國財富和兒童條件之間的反差大到無與倫比。

en: About 14.5% of the American population as a whole is poor, but 19.9% of children – some 15 million individuals – live in poverty.
zh: 大約14.5%的美國總人口屬於窮人，但19.9%的兒童 — — 大概相當於1,500萬人 — — 生活在貧困中。

en: Among developed countries, only Romania has a higher rate of child poverty.
zh: 在發達國家中，只有羅馬尼亞的兒童貧困率更高。

en: The US rate is two-thirds higher than that in the United Kingdom, and up to four times the rate in the Nordic countries.
zh: 美國的兒童貧困率比英國高三分之二，比北歐國家高三倍。

en: For some groups, the situation is much worse: more than 38% of black children, and 30% of Hispanic children, are poor.
zh: 某些群體的狀況更是惡劣得多：38%的黑人兒童和30%的西班牙裔兒童是窮人。

en: None of this is because Americans do not care about their children.
zh: 所有這些都不是因為美國不在乎它的兒童。

en: It is because America has embraced a policy agenda in recent decades that has caused its economy to become wildly unequal, leaving the most vulnerable segments of society further and further behind.
zh: 而是因為美國在近幾十年中採取的政策日程導致其經濟變得普遍不平等，讓最脆弱的社會細分群體越來越落後。

en: The growing concentration of wealth – and a significant reduction in taxes on it – has meant less money to spend on investments for the public good, like education and the protection of children.
zh: ��富的日益集中 — — 以及財富稅收的大幅減少 — — 意味著花在教育和兒童保護等公共品投資上的支出越來越少了。

en: As a result, America’s children have become worse off.
zh: 結果，美國兒童的境況每況愈下。

en: Their fate is a painful example of how inequality not only undermines economic growth and stability – as economists and organizations like the International Monetary Fund are finally acknowledging – but also violates our most cherished notions of what a fair society should look like.
zh: 他們的命運是一個慘痛的教訓，說明了不平等性不但破壞經濟增長和穩定 — — 經濟學家和國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）等組織總算開始承認這一點了 — — 也有悖於我們最珍視的公平社會的概念。

en: Income inequality is correlated with inequalities in health, access to education, and exposure to environmental hazards, all of which burden children more than other segments of the population.
zh: 收入不平等與健康不平等、教育不平等和環境危險不平等都具有相關性，而所有這些對兒童的影響比其他人群更大。

en: Indeed, nearly one in five poor American children are diagnosed with asthma, a rate 60% higher than non-poor children.
zh: 事實上，近五分之一的美國貧窮兒童被診斷出哮喘，比非貧窮兒童高出60 % 。

en: Learning disabilities occur almost twice as frequently among children in households earning less than $35,000 a year than they do in households earning more than $100,000.
zh: 年收入低於35,000美元家庭的兒童學習無能比例比年收入高於100,000美元家庭的兒童高出近一倍。

en: And some in the US Congress want to cut food stamps – on which some 23 million American households depend, threatening the poorest children with hunger.
zh: 一些美國國會議員還想削減食品券 — — 大約2,300萬美國家庭需要仰仗食品券 — — 這將令去貧窮兒童面臨捱餓的危險。

en: These inequalities in outcomes are closely tied to inequalities in opportunities.
zh: 這些結果上的不平等與機會不平等息息相關。

en: Inevitably, in countries where children have inadequate nutrition, insufficient access to health care and education, and higher exposure to environmental hazards, the children of the poor will have far different life prospects from those of the rich.
zh: 在兒童營養不足、無法獲得足夠醫療和教育的國家，環境風險也難免更高，窮孩子的生活前景遠遠比不上富孩子。

en: And, partly because an American child’s lifetime prospects are more dependent on his or her parents’ income and education than in other advanced countries, the US now has the least equality of opportunity of any advanced country.
zh: 此外，部分因為美國兒童一生前景比其他發達國家更多地取決於父母的收入和教育，目前美國的機會平等程度低於任何其他發達國家。

en: At America’s most elite universities, for example, only around 9% of students come from the bottom half of the population, while 74% come from the top quarter.
zh: 比如，在美國的精英大學，只有9%左右的學生來自底層二分之一人口，74%來自最高層四分之一人口。

en: Most societies recognize a moral obligation to help ensure that young people can live up to their potential.
zh: 大部分社會都認為幫助確保年輕人能實現潛力所允許的生活水平是一種道德義務。

en: Some countries even impose a constitutional mandate for equality of educational opportunities.
zh: 一些國家甚至從憲法上規定教育機會必須平等。

en: But in America, more is spent on the education of rich students than on the education of the poor.
zh: 但在美國，富學生的教育支出要高於窮學生。

en: As a result, the US is wasting some of its most valuable assets, with some young people – bereft of skills – turning to dysfunctional activities.
zh: 結果，美國正在浪費其最寶貴的資產之一。 一些年輕人無法獲得技能，只能從事非正常活動。

en: American states like California spend about as much on prisons as on higher education – and sometimes more.
zh: 加利福尼亞等州的監獄支出與高等教育支出相當，有時還要更高。

en: Without compensatory measures – including pre-school education, ideally beginning at a very young age – unequal opportunities translate into unequal lifelong outcomes by the time children reach the age of five.
zh: 不採取補償措施 — — 包括最好從幼兒時期就開始的學前教育 — — 機會不平等就會在兒童達到五歲時轉化為一生結果的不平等。

en: That should be a spur to policy action.
zh: 這應該成為對政策行動的鞭策。

en: Indeed, while inequality’s harmful effects are wide-reaching, and impose huge costs on our economies and societies, they are largely avoidable.
zh: 事實上，儘管不平等性的傷害效應很廣，並且給我們的經濟與社會造成了巨大成本，但它們大多是可以避免的。

en: The extremes of inequality observed in some countries are not the inexorable result of economic forces and laws.
zh: 一些國家所觀察到的極端不平等不是經濟力量和定律的無情結果。

en: The right policies – stronger social safety nets, progressive taxation, and better regulation (especially of the financial sector), to name a few – can reverse these devastating trends.
zh: 正確的政策 — — 強化社會安全網、累進稅制和更好的監管（特別是對金融部門 ） ， 等等 — — 可以扭轉這些消極趨勢。

en: To generate the political will that such reforms require, we must confront policymakers’ inertia and inaction with the grim facts of inequality and its devastating effects on our children.
zh: 要形成這些改革所需要的政治意願，我們必須將決策者的惰性和不作為與不平等性的嚴峻現實及其對兒童造成的消極影響對立起來。

en: We can reduce childhood deprivation and increase equality of opportunity, thereby laying the groundwork for a more just and prosperous future – one that reflects our own avowed values.
zh: 我們能夠減輕兒童權利的剝奪、增加機會平等，從而為更公正、更繁榮的未來 — — 反映我們所公開追求的價值的未來 — — 打下基礎。

en: So why don’t we?
zh: 為什麼我們還不行動呢？

en: Of the harm that inequality inflicts on our economies, politics, and societies, the damage done to children demands special concern.
zh: 不平等性給我們的經濟、政治與社會造成諸多傷害，其中對兒童的傷害需要特別關注。

en: Whatever responsibility poor adults may bear for their lot in life – they may not have worked hard enough, saved enough, or made good decisions – children’s circumstances are thrust upon them without any sort of choice.
zh: 成年人受窮，他自己得負責 — — 也許是工作不夠努力，儲蓄不夠充足、沒有做出好決策等 — — 但兒童的環境是上天強加給他們的，他們無從選擇。

en: Children, perhaps more than anyone, need the protection that rights afford – and the US should be providing the world with a shining example of what that means.
zh: 也許兒童比其他任何人都更需要權利賦予的保護 — — 而美國應該為前世界樹立此中含義的榜樣。

en: American Conservatism’s Crisis of Ideas
zh: 美國保守主義的思想危機

en: BERKELEY – On the back left corner of my desk right now are three recent books: Arthur Brooks’ The Battle, Charles Murray’s Coming Apart, and Nicholas Eberstadt’s A Nation of Takers.
zh: 伯克利—現在，在我書桌的左後角擺著三部新書：布魯克斯（Arthur Brooks）的《戰爭 》 （ The Battle ） 、 穆雷（Charles Murray）的《崩潰 》 （ Coming Apart）和埃伯斯塔特（Nicholas Eberstadt）的《匪之國 》 （ A Nation of Takers ） 。

en: Together, they constitute an important intellectual movement, which also happens to be a large part of the reason that American conservatism today has little that is constructive to say about managing the economy – and little purchase on the center of the American electorate.
zh: 總的來說，它們代表了重要的思想動向，這也恰好是當今美國保守主義對治理經濟鮮有建設性意見、在美國選舉舞臺上頻頻敗北的重要原因。

en: But let’s back up historically, to the founding of what we might call modern conservatism in early nineteenth-century Britain and France.
zh: 但讓我們回顧歷史，看看我們所謂的現代保守主義是如何在19世紀初的英國和法國起源的。

en: There were some – Frédéric Bastiat and Jean-Baptiste Say come to mind – who believed that government should put the unemployed to work building infrastructure when markets or production were temporarily disrupted.
zh: 一些人 — — 巴斯夏（Frédéric Bastiat）和薩伊（Jean-Baptiste Say）立刻出現在眼前 — — 認為當市場或生產出現了暫時性的干擾時，政府應該安排失業者去建設基礎設施。

en: But they were balanced by those like Nassau Senior, who spoke out against even famine relief: Although a million people would die in the Irish Potato Famine, “that would scarcely be enough.”
zh: 但他們的觀點被西尼爾（Nassau Senior）反對，他認為就連食品救濟都不應該有：儘管數百萬人因愛爾蘭土豆饑荒喪命，但“這遠遠不夠。 ”

en: The main thrust of early conservatism was root-and-branch opposition to every form of social insurance: make the poor richer, and they would become more fertile.
zh: 早期保守主義的主要賣點是徹底反對任何形式的社會保險：讓窮人變富，他們就會生更多孩子。

en: As a result, farm sizes would drop (as land was divided among ever more children), labor productivity would fall, and the poor would become even poorer.
zh: 結果，農場規模會下降（因為土地得分給越來越多的子女 ） ， 勞動生產率會下降，而窮人會變得更窮。

en: Social insurance was not just pointless; it was counterproductive.
zh: 社會保險不但毫無意義；簡直就是大逆不道。

en: The proper economic policy was to teach people to venerate the throne (so that they would respect property), the paternal hearth (so that they would not marry imprudently young), and the religious altar (so that they would fear pre-marital sex).
zh: 合理的經濟政策是讓人們尊王（從而尊重產權 ） 、 尊父（從而不會輕率早婚 ） 、 尊宗教（從而畏懼婚前性行為 ） 。

en: Then, perhaps, with women chaste for half or more of their childbearing years, the surplus population would diminish and conditions for the poor would be as good as they could be.
zh: 接著，只要女人在一半或以上的育齡時期嚴守貞潔，新增人口就會減少，窮人所處的環境就能儘可能地改善。

en: Fast-forward 150 years to post-World War II America, and to the original Chicago School critique of the New Deal version of social insurance – that it created “notches” that perverted economic incentives.
zh: 快速地瀏覽一下二戰前150年中的美國，看看芝加哥學派對羅斯福新政這一社會保險新形式的最初批判 — — 它形成了阻礙經濟創新的“等級 ” （ notch ） 。

en: The government, Milton Friedman and others argued, told the poor: make more money and we will take away your free housing, food stamps, and income support.
zh: 弗裡德曼和其他人指出，政府告訴窮人：賺多點錢，我們將剝奪你的免費房子、食品券和收入支援。

en: People are rational, Friedman said, so they will not work for long if they get nothing or next to nothing for it.
zh: 人是理性的，弗裡德曼說，因此如果沒有好處或好處不多，他們是不會長時間工作的。

en: The big difference between the Malthusian conservative critics of social insurance in the early nineteenth century and the Chicago critics of the 1970’s is that the Chicago critics had a point: Providing public support to the “worthy” poor, and then removing it when they began to stand on their own feet, poisoned incentives and was unlikely to lead to good outcomes.
zh: 19世紀初馬爾薩斯派保守主義對社會保險的批判和芝加哥學派20世紀70年代的批判之間的重大區別在於，芝加哥學派的批判有���樣一個要點：為“相稱的”窮人提供公共支援，在他們開始自立根生時撤掉支援，這樣做會破壞激勵，不可能形成好的結果。

en: And so, from 1970 to 2000, a broad coalition of conservatives (who wanted to see the government stop encouraging immorality), centrists (who wanted government money spent effectively), and leftists (who wanted poverty alleviated) removed the “notches” from the social-insurance system.
zh: 1970—2000年，保守派（他們想讓政府停止鼓勵傷風敗俗行為 ） 、 中間派（他們想讓政府把錢花在刀刃上）和左派（他們想減貧）組成了廣泛同盟，把“等級”從社會保險體系中逐出。

en: Presidents Jimmy Carter, Ronald Reagan, George H. W. Bush, Bill Clinton, and even George W. Bush and their supporters created the current system, in which tax rates and eligibility thresholds are not punitive disincentives to enterprise.
zh: 卡特、里根、老布什、克林頓甚至小布什諸位總統及其支持者建立了當前的體系，稅率和起稅點不再起到抑制企業的反激勵效果。

en: So what is the problem that America’s new generation of conservative critics of social insurance sees?
zh: 那麼，美國新一代社會保險的保守主義批判家看到了什麼問題？

en: It is not that raising poor people’s standard of living above bare subsistence produces Malthusian catastrophe, or that taxes and withdrawal of welfare benefits make people work, at the margin, for nothing.
zh: 產生馬爾薩斯式崩潰的不是窮人的生活水平較勉強維生有所提高，讓人們幾乎無酬工作的也不是稅收和取消福利。

en: For Eberstadt, the problem is that dependence on government is emasculating, and that too many people are dependent on government.
zh: 在埃伯斯塔特看來，問題在於對政府的依賴在讓人民變弱，太多的人仰仗政府過活。

en: For Brooks, it is that knowing that public programs make one’s life easier causes one to vote for non-Republican candidates.
zh: 在布魯克斯看來，問題在於知道公共專案讓生活變得更加容易導致民眾把選票投給非共和黨候選人。

en: For Murray, it is that social insurance means that behaving badly does not lead to catastrophe – and we need bad behavior to lead to catastrophe in order to keep people from behaving badly.
zh: 在穆雷看來，問題在於社會保險意味著做得不好不會導致崩潰 — — 我們需要導致崩潰的壞行為，這樣才能讓人們不再做出壞行為。

en: The crucial point is that America’s conservative elites believe Brooks, Eberstadt, and Murray.
zh: 關鍵點在於，美國保守主義精英相信布魯克斯、埃伯斯塔特和穆雷。

en: To this day, Mitt Romney is convinced that he lost the presidency in 2012 because Barack Obama unfairly gave Latino-Americans subsidized health insurance; gave women free reproductive health coverage (excluding abortion); and gave other groups similar “gifts.”
zh: 眼下，羅姆尼相信他之所以輸掉2012年總統大選，是因為奧巴馬不公平地給了拉丁裔美國人健康保險補貼，給了婦女免費的生殖健康保險（不含流產 ） ， 還給了其他群體類似的“禮物 ” 。

en: He could “never convince them that they should take personal responsibility and care for their lives.”
zh: 他絕不會“讓他們認為他們應該承擔個人責任，看好自己的生活。 ”

en: In fact, it would be a tough sell for any candidate to convince Americans who receive government benefits that they are dependent rather than empowered; that it is bad for people to vote for politicians who make their lives better; and that good public policy seeks to create human catastrophe rather than to avert it.
zh: 事實上，不論哪位候選人，讓拿政府福利的美國人相信他們與其說是受助者，不如說是依賴者、相信把票投給讓他們生活更好的政客是不對的、讓他們相信好的公共政策應該造成而不是避免人類災難都不是易事。

en: The problem for American conservatives is not their choice of candidates or the tone of their rhetoric. It is that their ideas are not politically sustainable.
zh: 美國保守主義者的問題不在於候選人的選擇或是說辭的語調，而在於他們的想法不具有政治可持續性。

en: An Unhinged Democracy in America
zh: 精神錯亂的美國民主

en: NEW YORK – Alexis de Tocqueville, a liberal French aristocrat, visited the United States in 1831 ostensibly to write a study of its “enlightened” prison system (locking people up in solitary confinement like penitent monks was the latest modern idea).
zh: 紐約—1831年，法國自由派貴族托克維爾訪問美國。 名義上，他是為了寫一篇關於美國“開明”監獄系統（最新的概念是將犯人如同懺悔的僧侶那樣關押在單間中）的研究。

en: Out of this trip came de Tocqueville’s masterpiece, Democracy in America, in which he expressed admiration for American civil liberties and compared the world’s first genuine liberal democracy favorably with Old World institutions.
zh: 結果，這次美國之旅造就了托克維爾的名著《論美國的民主 》 ， 在這部著作中，他對美國公民自由大加推崇，將這個世界上第一個正宗自由民主與舊世界的制度相比較，認為後者不如前者。

en: But de Tocqueville had serious reservations, too.
zh: 但托克維爾也有嚴重保留。

en: The biggest danger to US democracy, he believed, was the tyranny of the majority, the suffocating intellectual conformity of American life, the stifling of minority opinion and dissent.
zh: 他認為，美國民主的最大危險是多數人的暴政，美國式生活中令人窒息的思想順從，令人壓抑的少數派觀點和異見。

en: He was convinced that any exercise of unlimited power, be it by an individual despot or a political majority, is bound to end in disaster.
zh: 他相信，任何無限權力，不管是個人暴君還是政治多數，都註定要在一地狼藉中結束。

en: Democracy, in the sense of majority rule, needs restraints, just like any other system of government.
zh: 從多數規則的角度講，民主需要約束，一如其他所有制度的政府。

en: That is why the British have mixed the authority of elected politicians with that of aristocratic privilege.
zh: 因此，英國混合了當選政客的權力和君主特權。

en: And it is why Americans still cherish their Constitution’s separation of governmental powers.
zh: 同樣因此，美國人至今仍珍視憲法對政府權力的分割。

en: By contrast, in the French republican system, the state represents the so-called will of the people.
zh: 相反，在法國共和制度中，國家代表所謂的人民的意志。

en: As a result, its authority is less constrained, which may explain the greater frequency in France of street demonstrations and even of mob violence.
zh: 結果，它的權威約束較小，這也許解釋了法國街頭示威乃至群眾暴力更為頻繁。

en: Indeed, these upheavals may act as informal checks on official power.
zh: 事實上，這些劇變是對正式權力的非正式制衡。

en: De Tocqueville identified another source of restraint in the US system: the power of religion.
zh: 托克維爾還指出了美國製度的另一個約束來源：宗教的力量。

en: Human greed, as well as the temptation of going to extremes, was tempered by the moderating influence of a shared Christian faith.
zh: 人類的貪婪，以及走極端的誘惑，被共同的基督教信仰的影響所中和。

en: Liberty, in the US, was inextricably entwined with religious belief.
zh: 在美國，自由與宗教信仰密不可分。

en: The spectacle of American politics today would seem to cast doubt on de Tocqueville’s observation.
zh: 今天的美國政壇景象似乎讓人們質疑托克維爾的觀察。

en: Or, rather, the rhetoric of many Republicans aspiring to be President sounds like a perversion of what he saw in 1831.
zh: 或者說，許多志在總統之位的共和黨人的言論與托克維爾在1831年的所見所聞南轅北轍。

en: Religion and liberty are still mentioned in one breath, but often to promote extreme views.
zh: 宗教和自由仍然時時掛在嘴邊，但常常是用來推動極端觀點。

en: Religious minorities are denounced.
zh: 宗教少數群體遭到壓迫。

en: Apocalyptic fears are stoked.
zh: 天啟恐懼興起。

en: Intolerance is promoted.
zh: 黨同伐異被煽動。

en: All in the name of God.
zh: 所有這些打著上帝的名義。

en: Of course, the US is not the only country where fringe demagogues are now poisoning mainstream politics.
zh: 當然，美國並不是唯一的邊緣煽動著正在毒害主流政治的國家。
