en: Religious language is less often heard in Western Europe, but all the more in parts of Eastern Europe, Turkey, and Israel.
zh: 在西歐，宗教語言比以前更少聽到了，但在東歐、土耳其和以色列的一些地方，情況正好相反。

en: And the message of populism is similar everywhere in the democratic world: Liberal elites are to be blamed for all our ills and anxieties, from Europe’s refugee crisis to the inequities of the global economy, from “multiculturalism” to the rise of radical Islam.
zh: 民粹主義的意義在民主世界各地都差不多：自由精英要為我們的所有問題和焦慮負責，不管是歐洲難民危機還是全球經濟不平等性，不管是“多元文化主義”還是激進伊斯蘭教的崛起。

en: Populism is causing considerable alarm, not least because mainstream politicians seem less and less capable of finding a convincing way to stop its rise.
zh: 民粹主義正在敲響警鐘，因為主流政客越來越難以找到令人信服的方式阻止它的崛起。

en: Those who are rightly worried about the politics of fear like to assume that populism is a threat to democracy itself.
zh: 正確地擔心恐懼政治的人喜歡假設民粹主義是民主本身的威脅。

en: Distrust of the elites fosters distrust of the system, and the longing for great leaders who will deliver us from the selfishness of professional politicians will lead to new forms of tyranny.
zh: 不信任精英導致不信任制度，而期盼偉大領袖讓我們擺脫職業政客的自私將導致新形式的暴政。

en: That may turn out to be true.
zh: 這也許是真的。

en: But, in fact, it is not really democracy that is presently under siege.
zh: 但是，事實上，陷入重圍的其實並不是民主。

en: In some ways, many societies are more democratic than they were before.
zh: 從某種角度講，許多社會比從簡更加民主了。

en: If nothing else, the Donald Trump phenomenon shows that old party establishments can be skirted by popular outsiders.
zh: 唐納德·特朗普現象所表現的正是舊政黨格局可以被當紅外部人士顛覆。

en: Social media also make it possible to bypass the traditional filters of authority, such as serious newspapers or broadcasters, and publish any point of view directly.
zh: 社交媒體也讓繞過傳統權威濾網（如嚴肅的報刊或雜誌）成為可能，直接釋出任何觀點。

en: The power of private fortunes to sway public opinion, especially in the US, also upsets the traditional order.
zh: 私人財富左右公共觀點的力量也在干擾傳統秩序，特別是在美國。

en: Anti-elitism can be fanned by vast individual wealth, because elitism is defined less by financial clout than by education.
zh: 反精英主義可以透過巨大的個人財富煽動，因為精英主義更大程度上由教育而非財力定義。

en: Angry people swayed by the populist message are angrier at liberal professors, clever bankers, or skeptical journalists than they are at multi-billionaires.
zh: 被民粹主義信念激怒的人民對自由派教授、聰明的銀行家或懷疑派記者的憤怒要大於他們對億萬富翁的憤怒。

en: (It is both President Barack Obama’s elite education and the color of his skin – or, rather, the combination of the two – that has attracted so much rage.)
zh: （總統奧巴馬的精英教育和他的膚色 — — 或者說，是兩者的結合 — — 給她帶來了如此多的憤怒。 ）

en: At the same time, people have more power to elect power-hungry crooks than they did before.
zh: 與此同時，人民比以前有了更大的力量選舉渴望權力的惡棍。

en: Like the wild and woolly views swirling around the Internet, such figures are no longer kept at bay by traditional party elites.
zh: 和充斥網際網路的野蠻觀點一樣，這些人物也不再被傳統政黨精英壓制。

en: What is steadily falling away is not democracy, but the restraints that de Tocqueville thought were essential to make liberal politics work.
zh: 穩步消退的不是民主，而是托克維爾認為是自由政治起作用的關鍵的約束。

en: More and more, populist leaders regard their election by the majority of voters as a license to crush all political and cultural dissent.
zh: 民粹主義領導人越來越把多數人選擇了他們作為碾壓一切政治和文化異見的通行證。

en: De Tocqueville’s nightmare is not yet the reality in the US, but it is close to what we see in Russia, Turkey, Hungary, and perhaps Poland.
zh: 托克維爾的噩夢還沒有在美國的現實中出現，但俄羅斯、土耳其、匈牙利（也許還有波蘭）的情況已經與此不遠。

en: Even Israel, which, despite its many obvious problems, has always had a robust democracy, is moving in this direction, with government ministers demanding proof of “state loyalty” from writers, artists, and journalists.
zh: 甚至以色列 — — 儘管它存在諸多顯而易見的問題，但一直是強大的民主國家 — — 也在走向這一方向，政府部長要求作家、藝術家和記者證明其“國家忠誠 ” 。

en: It is hard to see how traditional elites are going to regain any authority.
zh: 很難說傳統精英如何繼續保留任何權威。

en: And yet I think de Tocqueville was right.
zh: 但我認為托克維爾是正確的。

en: Without editors, there can be no serious journalism.
zh: 沒有編輯，就不會有嚴肅的新聞。

en: Without parties led by experienced politicians, the borders between show business and politics will disappear.
zh: 沒有由經驗豐富的政客領導的政黨，娛樂和政治的界線就會消失。

en: Without limits placed on the appetites and prejudices of the majority, intolerance will rule.
zh: 不對大多數人的偏好和偏見加以限制，就會讓黨同伐異成為規則。

en: This is not a question of nostalgia or snobbery.
zh: 這不是懷舊或勢利。

en: Nor is it a plea to trust anyone with a plausible air of authority.
zh: 這也不是懇求信任任何擁有權威“氣場”的人。

en: Anger at the elites is not always unjust.
zh: 對精英的憤怒並非總是不公平的。

en: Globalization, immigration, and cosmopolitanism have served the interests of a highly educated minority, but sometimes at the expense of less privileged people.
zh: 全球化、移民和世界主義符合受到良好教育的少數群體的利益，但有時會犧牲沒有特權的人的利益。

en: And yet, the problem identified by de Tocqueville in the 1830s is more relevant now than ever.
zh: 但是，托克維爾在19世紀30年代所發現的問題在今天的意義比以往更大。

en: Liberal democracy cannot be reduced to a popularity contest.
zh: 自由民主決不能退化為民粹主義競爭。

en: Constraints on majority rule are necessary to protect the rights of minorities, be they ethnic, religious, or intellectual.
zh: 對多數人統治的約束是保護少數群體的必要條件，不管是種族少數群體、宗教少數群體還是知識少數群體。

en: When that protection disappears, we will all end up losing the freedoms that democracy was supposed to defend.
zh: 當這一保護消失時，我們最終將失去作為民主應有之義的自由。

en: The Indispensable American Partner
zh: 不可或缺的美國夥伴

en: MADRID – The United States is gearing up for that most intoxicating (and exhausting) of political events: an open-seat race for the presidency.
zh: 馬德里—美國正在為最令人興奮（也最令人疲憊）的政治事件做準備：總統席位的開放競爭。

en: With US President Barack Obama's eight years in office coming to an end, and Vice President Joe Biden unlikely to run, the race will be without an incumbent.
zh: 副總統拜登看起來不會參與，因此這場角逐不會有現任官員。

en: As a result, the election could be less a referendum on the last eight years than a contest of ideas, with foreign policy emerging as a key topic.
zh: 因此，這場大選也許並不是對過去八年的全民公決，而是一場思想的競爭，而外交政策正在成為其中的關鍵。

en: As for the Democrats, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton's likely nomination (despite recent revelations that she used her personal email account to conduct government business) reinforces foreign policy's centrality to the election.
zh: 在民主黨方面，前國務卿希拉里·克林頓可能獲得提名（儘管最新曝光表明她使用個人電子郵件賬戶處理公事 ） ， 這進一步加強了外交政策在大選中的關鍵性。

en: From my perspective as the group's only European member, the overarching message should be that the US must conceive of itself not as “the indispensable power," as it now does, but as “the indispensable partner."
zh: 我是小組中唯一的歐洲成員，在我看來，最重要的資訊應該是美國不可繼續如現在那樣將自己視為“不可或缺的力量 ” ， 而是將自己視為“不可或缺的夥伴 ” 。

en: This is not merely a matter of semantics; such a change will require the US to re-conceive its role in the world.
zh: 這不僅僅是語義學問題；如此挑戰要求美國反思其在世界中的作用。

en: But the payoff, for both the US and the liberal world order that it created, would be substantial.
zh: 但不管對美國還是對其所創造的自由世界秩序來說，這樣做的好處是無窮的。

en: The key to success will be America's ability to retain the best – and abandon the worst – of that most American of notions: exceptionalism.
zh: 成功的關鍵是美國能否對最“美國”的概念 — — 例外論去蕪存菁。

en: The sense in the US that the country is unique, with a special mission to promote prosperity, security, and freedom worldwide, has long shaped American foreign policy.
zh: 在美國，認為本國獨一無二，負有促進全球繁榮、安全和自由的特殊任務，這一觀念長期以來決定著美國的外交政策。

en: In doing so, he planted the seed of the values-based approach that was adopted by the US as it spearheaded the development of the rules and structures that order today's world.
zh: 就這樣，他種下了基於價值的方針的種子，美國根據這一方針領導制定了決定當今世界秩序的規則與結構。

en: Those rules and structures have delivered unprecedented economic growth, benefiting all (though the US has reaped the greatest rewards).
zh: 這些規則與結果帶來了前所未有的經濟增長，惠及所有人（儘管美國拿走了最大的果實 ） 。

en: But, ironically, the notion of American exceptionalism often has led the US to undermine the international system that it nurtured.
zh: 但是，諷刺的是，美國例外論常常導致美國破壞它所培養的國際體系。

en: Indeed, US history reveals a persistent isolationist streak, in which the “city upon a hill" is not a beacon, but a fortress.
zh: 事實上，美國曆史一直有一種孤立主義傾向 ， “ 山巔之城”好像不是一座燈塔，而是一座堡壘。

en: At times, including over the last six years, the belief that the US is better off going it alone has led to withdrawal from the world.
zh: 一次又一次（包括在過去六年中 ） ， 美國最好還是隻顧自己的觀念導致其從世界舞臺中退出。

en: This tendency was not a serious issue before World War II (though the people of Abyssinia and Manchuria may beg to differ).
zh: 這一趨勢在二戰前並不是什麼嚴重的問題（儘管阿比西尼亞和滿洲人會提出異議 ） 。

en: But today, US withdrawal from the international system that it built has serious ramifications – namely, the kind of chaos and lawlessness exemplified by Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
zh: 但如今，美國從其所構建的國際體系中退出將造成嚴重後果 — — 即各種混亂和無法，俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭就是明證。

en: Yet isolationism is not America's most destructive impulse.
zh: 但孤立主義不是美國危害最大的舉動。

en: Worse is its “exemptionalism": its penchant for opting out of the rules that it promotes – and often actively enforces – elsewhere.
zh: 更糟糕的是其“豁免論 ” （ exemptionalism ） ： 置身其在其他地區所推行 — — 並且常常積極執行 — — 的規則之外。

en: Beyond the resentment that such an attitude engenders, American exemptionalism directly undermines multilateral institutions' capacity to address challenges that the US is unwilling or unable to resolve on its own.
zh: 除了這一態度可能產生的不滿之外，美國豁免論還直接影響了多邊機構解決美國不願或不能獨力解決的挑戰的能力。

en: US President Barack Obama's administration has tried to create the illusion of a change of course in this regard, pushing “soft" deals that allow the US to participate without submitting to binding rules.
zh: 美國總統奧巴馬政府試圖營造一種狀況正在改變的幻覺，推出了一些“軟”協議讓美國可以在不必遵守約束性規則的情況下參與。

en: But, though such arrangements make for great headlines, they do not provide the stability and predictability necessary for long-term success.
zh: 但是，儘管這樣的安排吸引了大量目光，但並沒有提供長期成功所需要的穩定性和可預測性。

en: If the US is to serve as the world's “indispensable partner," it must recommit to the rules-based order that has served it – and the world – so well for the last seven decades.
zh: 如果美國要成為世界“不可或缺的夥伴 ” ， 它就必須重新致力於在過去七十年給它 — — 以及全世界 — — 帶來無窮好處的基於規則的秩序。

en: It should begin by strengthening the flagging institutions that have served as the backbone of the liberal international order.
zh: 首先，美國應該強化作為自由國際秩序基石的核心機構。

en: Indispensable partnership is about helping countries help themselves.
zh: 不可或缺的夥伴意味著幫助各國幫助自己。

en: It requires vision, commitment, and, most important, leadership.
zh: 這要求遠見卓識、承諾以及（最重要的）領導力。

en: A frank discussion about America's foreign policy could prove vital to ensuring that this “city upon a hill" remains a beacon of hope – and a catalyst of progress.
zh: 開誠佈公地討論美國外交政策將是確保這個“山巔之城”仍是希望燈塔 — — 以及進步催化劑的關鍵。

en: American Foreign Policy after Iraq
zh: 伊拉克之後的美國對外政策

en: What comes after Iraq?
zh: 伊拉克之後又會是什麼？

en: If President George W. Bush’s current troop “surge” fails to produce an outcome that can be called “victory,” what lessons will the United States draw for its future foreign policy?
zh: 如果布什總統的部隊“急流”不能交出一份可以稱作“勝利”的答卷，那麼美國可以從中為其未來的對外政策吸取什麼樣的教訓呢？

en: Will it turn inward, as it did after its defeat in Vietnam three decades ago?
zh: 它會轉為內向，正如30年前兵敗越南之後那樣麼？

en: Will it turn from promoting democracy to a narrow realist view of its interests?
zh: 它會從推動民主轉向為一種對自身利益的狹隘現實主義觀嗎？

en: Even while discussion in Washington is fixated on Iraq, a number of thoughtful foreign observers are asking these longer-term questions.
zh: 即便在華盛頓的討論仍聚焦伊拉克的情況下，一些有思想的外交觀察家已經開始提出這些長期性的問題了。

en: Analysts and pundits have often been mistaken about America’s position in the world.
zh: 分析家和專家們對美國在世界上的地位往往有錯誤的認識。

en: For example, two decades ago, the conventional wisdom was that the US was in decline.
zh: 例如，20年前，一般的公眾觀點認為美國正在衰落。

en: A decade later, with the Cold War’s end, the new conventional wisdom was that the world was a unipolar American hegemony.
zh: 10年後，隨著冷戰結束，新的公眾觀點又認為世界上只有美國一個超級霸權。

en: Some neo-conservative pundits drew the conclusion that the US was so powerful that it could decide what it thought was right, and others would have to follow.
zh: 一些新保守派專家認定美國是如此強大，以至於它可以按自己的意志決策，而其它國家不得不遵從。

en: Charles Krauthammer celebrated this view as “the new unilateralism,” and it heavily influenced the Bush administration even before the attacks on September 11, 2001.
zh: Charles Krauthammer高調地將這種觀點稱為“新單邊主義 ” 。 它甚至在2001年“9.11”襲擊發生之前都一直對布什政府產生著重要的影響。

en: But the new unilateralism was based on a profound misunderstanding of the nature of power in world politics.
zh: 但新單邊主義是基於對世界政治實力特點的深刻誤解。

en: Power is the ability to get the outcomes one wants.
zh: 實力是取得需要的結果的能力。

en: Whether the possession of resources will produce such outcomes depends upon the context.
zh: 透過所擁有的資源能否獲得這樣的結果還依賴於環境。

en: For example, a large, modern tank army is a powerful resource if a war is fought in a desert, but not if it is fought in a swamp – as America discovered in Vietnam.
zh: 例如，如果戰爭在沙漠中進行，那麼一支龐大的現代化坦克部隊就是一種強大的資源。 但如果戰事在沼澤地區進行則不然—正如美國在越南所發現的那樣。

en: In the past, it was assumed that military power dominated most issues, but in today’s world, the contexts of power differ greatly.
zh: 過去，人們一般認為軍事實力主導著絕大多數問題，但在當今的世界，實力的大環境千差萬別。

en: I have likened the distribution of power in politics today as analogous to a three-dimensional chess game.
zh: 我把當今政治實力的分配比作一盤三維國際象棋。

en: On the top board – military relations among states – the world is, indeed, unipolar, and likely to remain that way for decades.
zh: 在上盤—國家之間的軍事關係中—世界確實是單極化的，而且這種情況很可能還要持續幾十年。

en: But on the middle board of economic relations, the world is already multipolar, and the US cannot obtain the outcomes it wants without the cooperation of Europe, Japan, China, and others.
zh: 但在中盤的經濟關係方面，世界已經是多極化了，而美國也不可能不透過與歐洲、日本、中國和其它國家合作就獲得自己需要的結果。

en: And, on the bottom board of transnational issues outside the control of governments – including everything from climate change to pandemics to transnational terrorism – power is chaotically distributed, and it makes no sense at all to claim American hegemony.
zh: 在下盤超越政府控制之外的跨國事務方面—包括從氣候變化到流行疾病到跨國恐怖主義—實力的分配是混亂的，因而在這樣的背景下提出美國的霸權也是毫無意義的。

en: Yet it is on this bottom board that we find most of the greatest challenges we face today.
zh: 然而正是在下盤讓我們發現了當今面對的最大挑戰。

en: The only way to grapple with these problems is through cooperation with others, and that requires the “soft” power of attraction as well as the hard power of coercion. There is no simple military solution that will produce the outcomes we want.
zh: 應對這些問題的唯一途徑就是透過與他人合作，而這就需要吸引的“軟”實力和高壓的硬實力並用，而沒有現成的能讓我們如願以償的簡單軍事解決方案。

en: The new unilateralists who dominated Bush’s first administration made the mistake of thinking that the unipolar distribution of power in the military context was sufficient to guide foreign policy.
zh: 主導布什第一屆政府的新單邊主義者們錯誤地認為在軍事環境中的實力單極化分配足以引導對外政策。

en: They were like a young boy with a hammer who thinks that every problem resembles a nail.
zh: 他們就像一個手拿錘子的小孩，認為所有的問題都像釘子一樣。

en: The danger of their approach is now obvious.
zh: 他們這種思維方式的危險性在當下就顯而易見了。

en: Whoever plays a three-dimensional game by focusing on only one board is bound to lose in the long run.
zh: 任何人在玩三維國際象棋遊戲時，只注重某一個盤，那麼從長期來看他是註定要失敗的。

en: Fortunately, the pendulum has begun to swing back toward cooperation.
zh: 幸運的是，這個鐘擺現在又開始滑向合作。

en: In Bush’s second term, some of the most extreme unilateralists have departed from the government, and the president has approached difficult problems like North Korea or Iran with a more multilateral approach than during his first term.
zh: 在布什的第二任期，一些最極端的單邊主義者離開了政府，而總統本人在處理北朝鮮或伊朗等更復雜的問題時也採用了比在第一個任期更為多邊的策略。

en: Likewise, for all the complaints about the United Nations, the US and others turned to UN peacekeepers to sort out the mess after the Lebanon War last summer.
zh: 同樣，針對關於聯合國的所有抱怨，美國和其它國家都透過聯合國維和部隊來收拾去年夏天黎巴嫩戰爭留下的爛攤子。

en: The Iraq War, in particular, increased public awareness of the mistakes in Bush’s first term, but other issues are changing as well.
zh: 伊拉克戰爭尤其加深了公眾對布什在第一任期所犯錯誤的認識，但其它情況也在變化中。

en: Americans now view cooperative action on global climate change more favorably.
zh: 美國人現在開始以更讚許的態度來看待全球氣候變化方面的合作行動。

en: Similarly, the threat of pandemics means that Americans may come to recognize the importance of a stronger World Health Organization, just as the problem of nuclear proliferation is increasing awareness of the importance of the International Atomic Energy Agency.
zh: 同樣，流行性疾病的威脅意味著美國人可能會最終承認一個更強有力的世界衛生組織的重要性，正如核擴散的問題使公眾更加意識到國際原子能機構的重要性一樣。

en: The nature of these problems means that the US does not have the luxury of turning inward no matter what the outcome in Iraq.
zh: 這些問題的特點意味著不論伊拉克問題的結果如何，美國都沒有重新迴歸內向政策的奢侈了。

en: These are not problems you can leave overseas.
zh: 這不是些你能留在海外的問題。

en: They follow you home.
zh: 它們會如影隨形般的跟你回到國內。

en: It also is unlikely that American foreign policy will return to a narrow realism and drop all emphasis on democracy and human rights.
zh: 美國的對外政策也不大可能回到狹隘的現實主義，而不再強調民主和人權。

en: While the Iraq War discredited the idea of coercive democratization, both Republicans and Democrats have a strong strand of idealism in their foreign policy orientations.
zh: 儘管伊拉克戰爭令強制民主化的理念聲名狼藉，共和黨和民主黨人在他們的對外政策取向中仍保持著強烈的理想主義色彩。

en: The problem for whoever is elected president in 2008 will be to find appropriate realistic means to advance democratic values and adjust official rhetoric accordingly.
zh: 在2008年獲選總統的任何人所面臨的問題都將是尋求推進民主價值觀的適當的現實主義途徑並對官方論調做出相應調整。

en: When rhetoric greatly outstrips reality, others view it as hypocrisy.
zh: 當官方論調凌駕於現實之上時，別人就會認為這是種虛偽。

en: Americans will need to find ways to assert their narrative of democracy, freedom, and rights in a manner that respects diversity and the views of others.
zh: 美國人需要找到一種尊重多樣性和他人觀點的方式來宣揚他們對民主、自由和權利的堅持。

en: What Iraq has taught is the importance of developing civil society and the rule of law before trying to hold broad-based elections.
zh: 伊拉克給我們提供的教訓是在試圖舉行廣泛的選舉之前先發展公民社會和健全法制的重要性。

en: Democracy is more than voting, for it requires large investments in education, institutions, and promotion of non-governmental organizations.
zh: 民主不僅僅是選舉，因為它還需要在教育、制度和推動非政府組織發展方面進行大量的投入。

en: It must be rooted in the indigenous society and bear its characteristics, not be imposed from abroad.
zh: 它必須是植根於本地社會並承襲其特點，而不是被強加的舶來品。

en: It is highly unlikely that the US will react after Iraq as it did after Vietnam.
zh: 美國在伊拉克戰爭之後做出類似越戰後的反應的可能性微乎其微。

en: The paradox of American power is that the world’s only military superpower cannot protect its citizens by acting alone.
zh: 美國實力的悖論在於：這個世界唯一的軍事超級大國靠單打獨鬥無法保護其公民。

en: US Foreign Policy After the Midterm Election
zh: 中期選舉之後的美國外交政策

en: WASHINGTON, DC – One thing missing from the recent US midterm election campaigns was a focus on foreign policy.
zh: 發自華盛頓特區 — — 最近各類美國中期選舉拉票活動都遺漏了一點 — — 外交政策。

en: While much was made of the migrant caravan making its way from Central America through Mexico, issues such as trade with China, Iran, North Korea, and even Russia and cyber subterfuge didn’t get much traction.
zh: 雖然對從中美洲取道墨西哥前往美國的移民大篷車多有討論，但與中國、伊朗，朝鮮甚至俄羅斯的貿易以及網路暗戰等事務都沒有得到太多關注。

en: With the Democratic Party having regained control of the US House of Representatives, that will change.
zh: 而隨著民主黨重新控制美國眾議院，這一情況將發生改變。

en: A cornered President Donald Trump is likely to turn to a favorite tactic of autocrats everywhere: manufacturing foreign-policy crises to distract the public’s attention from problems at home.
zh: 走投無路的美國總統特朗普可能會轉而使用世界各地獨裁者都最喜歡的策略：製造外交政策危機以分散公眾對本土問題的注意力。

en: Trump’s determination to control media headlines makes him all the more likely, when it suits him, to call attention to the troubles in the Middle East, rediscover the North Korean nuclear threat, and force the Democrats to make a tough choice between being hard on Russia or getting into an arms race.
zh: 特朗普控制媒體頭條的決心使得他更有可能在時機到來時激起對中東問題的關注，重新發現朝鮮的核威脅，以及迫使民主黨人在對俄強硬或進入軍備競賽之間作出艱難的選擇。

en: Trump may also decide to use Congress as a foreign-policy foil, tossing international challenges back into the lap of lawmakers, who will be hard-pressed to come up with good answers.
zh: 特朗普也可能決定將國會用作外交政策擋箭牌，將國際挑戰甩回到立法者手裡從而把尋求良好應對措施的壓力轉移到他們肩上。

en: After all, in Trump’s zero-sum “I win, you lose” view of the world, congressional failures that he can blame on the Democrats are almost as good as White House successes.
zh: 畢竟在特朗普“我贏你輸”的零和式世界觀中，可以賴到民主黨身上的國會敗局幾乎和白宮的成功一樣美好。

en: With the US House of Representatives under “new management,” including a record number of Democratic women, Trump has a tempting target.
zh: 隨著美國眾議院被置於“新管理層”之下（包括創紀錄的民主黨女議員人數 ） ， 特朗普有了一個誘人的目標。

en: He has every incentive to show the newcomers up by passing the ball and watching them fail.
zh: 他有足夠的動力去讓那些新來者難堪，只要把事情丟給他們並坐觀其敗就行了。

en: In this new contest to pass the blame, Syria is ripe for the picking.
zh: 在這新一輪的推卸責任競賽中，敘利亞問題正好可以拿來使用。

en: Eliot Engel, the incoming chairman of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, has already said that the Democrats may seek congressional authorization for the use of military force in Syria.
zh: 即將就任眾議院外交事務委員會主席的艾略特·恩格爾（Eliot Engel）已經表示民主黨可能會尋求國會授權在敘利亞使用武力。

en: But no one, Democrat or Republican, has a plausible plan either for ending the war in Syria or even for helping Syrian civilians in significant numbers, other than making it risky for Syria’s ruler, Bashar al-Assad, to use chemical weapons too blatantly.
zh: 但除了能令敘利亞統治者巴沙爾·阿薩德不再過於貿然地使用化學武器外，無論是民主黨人或共和黨人沒有一個可信的計劃去結束敘利亞戰爭或大量幫助敘利亞平民。

en: Any move the Democrats make will be unpopular with their own voters and will simply shift attention from Trump’s inability to solve the problem to their own lack of a plan.
zh: 民主黨做出的任何舉動都不會受到選民的歡迎，只會將特朗普無法解決問題的注意力轉移到他們自身計劃的缺失之上。

en: Iran presents Trump with another opportunity to inflict political damage on the Democrats.
zh: 而伊朗則為特朗普提供了另一個政治上打擊民主黨人的機會。

en: Trump followed through on his threat in January to withdraw the United States from the 2015 Iran nuclear deal – formally known as the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action (JCPOA) – if Congress didn’t “fix” it.
zh: 特朗普會繼續推動他在今年1月提出將美國從2015年伊朗核協議（正式稱為《聯合全面行動計劃 》 ） 的威脅，除非國會能“修補”該協議。

en: Specifically, he wanted the ability to reimpose sanctions on Iran, which he did earlier this month.
zh: 具體而言，他希望重新獲得伊制裁的能力，正如他本月早些時候所做的那樣。

en: Sanctions, Trump has long maintained, would force Iran to negotiate. That has not happened and is unlikely to happen.
zh: 特朗普一直以來都堅稱制裁將迫使伊朗進行談判，但這種情況從發生也不太可能發生。

en: To push Iran toward the negotiating table, and, more importantly, assert his authority and save face, Trump might be tempted to heighten tensions, if not provoke Iran into a confrontation.
zh: 為了推動伊朗走向談判桌，更重要的是維護自身權威並挽回面子，特朗普可能會試圖加劇緊張局勢，只要不會激發伊朗的對抗。

en: And here, Engel might be forced to play along.
zh: 到那時候恩格爾可能會被迫入局。

en: Engel has said that Iran is the “most dangerous player” in the Middle East, and he was a vocal opponent of the JCPOA.
zh: 恩格爾曾表示伊朗是中東地區“最危險的參與者 ” ， 他本人也是伊朗核協議的反對者。

en: Though he supported the deal after it was signed and opposed withdrawing from it, Trump could use Engel’s own position on Iran to push him to adopt a more aggressive posture or risk appearing “weak” on national security.
zh: 雖然恩格爾在協議簽署後轉而表示支援並反對退出協議，但特朗普可以利用前者自身在伊朗問題上的立場去推動他採取更激進的態度或冒險在國家安全方面表現“軟弱 ” 。

en: But the payoff is likely to be a foreign-policy crisis that produces no meaningful progress toward a new nuclear deal and plenty of blame to go around.
zh: 但這最終可能會導向一場外交政策危機，不但在新的核協議上沒有取得任何有意義的進展，還會留下諸多口實供各方互相指責。

en: The Democrats also provide Trump an out on North Korea.
zh: 民主黨人也在朝鮮問題向特朗普露出了破綻。

en: Back in June, Engel introduced the North Korea Nuclear Baseline Act, which would require the White House to report on the status of North Korea’s nuclear program and provide a “baseline” of progress for continued talks.
zh: 早在今年6月恩格爾就推出了《朝鮮核基線法案 》 ， 該法案將要求白宮報告朝鮮核計劃的進展狀況，併為繼續談判提供一條進展“基線 ” 。

en: Engel has already said he will call a hearing on the talks.
zh: 恩格爾已經表示他將針對相關談判召集一場聽證會。

en: Whatever is said in that hearing could provide North Korean leader Kim Jong-un with a ready excuse to renege on his already-vague denuclearization agreement with Trump.
zh: 但聽證會上發表的任何言論都可以為朝鮮領導人金正恩提供一個藉口去違反與特朗普那本就含糊不清的無核化協議。

en: The US president, Kim could argue, can no longer be trusted with a hostile Congress at his back.
zh: 金正恩可以辯解說一個不能得到背後敵對國會支援的美國總統是不值得信任的。

en: Perhaps in anticipation of a Democratic-led House and a subsequent Democratic pile-on regarding Russia, Trump withdrew the US from the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty (INF) in October, citing Russian violations.
zh: 也許是預期到了一個民主黨領導的眾議院以及隨後民主黨在俄羅斯問題上連篇累牘的抨擊，特朗普在10月份藉口俄羅斯違規而撤出了《中程核力量條約 》 。

en: Signed in 1987 by Ronald Reagan and Soviet premier Mikhail Gorbachev, the INF required both the US and Russia to eliminate ground-launched ballistic and cruise missiles. The US withdrawal from it signals the start of a new arms race.
zh: 該條約由羅納德·里根和蘇共總書記米哈伊爾·戈爾巴喬夫於1987年簽署，要求雙方銷燬地面發射的彈道導彈和巡航導彈，而美國的撤出則標誌著新一輪軍備競賽的開始。

en: Trump has already called for an increase in defense spending and the launch of a “space force”.
zh: 特朗普已經呼籲要增加國防開支並啟動“太空力量”的建立。

en: As Democrats focus on Russian interference in the 2016 US elections, Trump’s ties to Russia, and the details of Trump’s closed-door conversation with Russian president Vladimir Putin in Helsinki in July, they will be faced with the prospect of signing off on increased defense spending or else appearing dithering and hypocritical on Russia.
zh: 鑑於民主黨對俄羅斯干預2016年美國大選，特朗普與俄羅斯關係以及特朗普7月份在赫爾辛基與俄羅斯總統普京閉門對話的關注，他們將面臨著簽署追加國防開支的前景，否則就是在俄羅斯問題上首鼠兩端和表現虛偽。

en: Much of the world breathed a sigh of relief at the Democrats’ recapture of the House, because it signaled a vulnerability in Trump’s aggressively anti-liberal “America First” approach to the world order.
zh: 民主黨重奪眾議院後世界大部分人都鬆了一口氣，因為這標誌著特朗普積極反自由的“美國優先”世界秩序手段是站不住腳的。

en: But Democrats should resist the urge to try correcting Trump’s perceived wrongs.
zh: 但民主黨人應該抵制試圖糾正特朗普錯誤的衝動。

en: The House has just enough power to get into foreign-policy trouble and not enough to get out of it or to adopt and implement a coherent strategy.
zh: 眾議院只是剛好有力量去介入外交政策的亂局，但還沒有足夠力量去擺脫它或採取和實施一套連續性的戰略。

en: The Democrats’ best bet is to let Trump take the lead on global affairs, however unsavory, and actively work to check and balance his actions.
zh: 民主黨最好的選擇是讓特朗普在全球事務中起帶頭作用，無論多麼令人討厭，並積極努力去制衡他的行為。

en: Oversight and the power of the purse will be their most powerful tools.
zh: 監督和財權將是他們最強大的工具。

en: In the end, Trump will need House Democrats for money, sanctions, or approval of trade agreements.
zh: 最終特朗普還是需要爭取眾議院民主黨人以獲取撥款，制裁或批准貿易協議。

en: If they play their cards right, he will have to deal them in. If they don’t, they will find that Trump still holds a much stronger hand.
zh: 如果他們能行使正確的策略，他將不得不跟他們妥協；但如果他們沒做到這一點，他們會發現特朗普仍然具備強大的實力。

en: American Foreign Policy After the Mid-Term Elections
zh: 中期選舉之後的美國外交政策

en: NEW YORK – Few Americans cast their ballot in the recent mid-term elections on the basis of foreign policy.
zh: 發自紐約 — — 在本次中期選舉中，只有為數不多的美國人是基於外交政策的原因而投票的。

en: While it may be difficult for people around the world to comprehend this, given the global reach of the United States, it is an undeniable fact.
zh: 鑑於美國的全球影響力，世界其他地方的人們可能難以理解這一點，但這卻是一個合理的事實。

en: Most Americans are, after all, preoccupied with the US economy’s sluggish growth and persistent high unemployment.
zh: 畢竟絕大多數美國人都將精力放在了國內的增長停滯和長期高失業率之上。

en: The world’s challenges seem far removed from their day-to-day lives.
zh: 而那些全球危機似乎離他們的日常生活太遙遠了。

en: The Cold War ended a generation ago; the terror attacks of September 11, 2001, are nearly a decade in the past.
zh: 冷戰結束已經是上一代人的話題；9·11恐怖襲擊也已經過去將近十年。

en: Most Americans do not feel the sacrifices associated with the large troop presence and ongoing conflicts in Afghanistan and Iraq.
zh: 大多數美國人都對派駐阿富汗和伊拉克的龐大軍隊所付出的犧牲毫無知覺。

en: But the fact that foreign policy did not materially affect the November elections does not mean that the results will not affect US foreign policy.
zh: 雖然外交政策並未對本次中期選舉產生重大影響，但這卻不意味著選舉結果不會影響美國的外交政策。

en: They will, but in ways that are inconsistent and even surprising.
zh: 影響是必然的，但會以一種反覆無常甚至令人大吃一驚的方式。

en: One relationship sure to be influenced by Republican gains will be that between the US and Russia.
zh: 共和黨佔優的形勢必將影響到美俄關係。

en: Quick or easy Senate approval of the New START arms-control treaty is highly unlikely, given stated concerns about verification and the protection of US missile-defense programs; instead, we can expect delays and, possibly, attempts to amend what the two governments already agreed upon.
zh: 參議院將無法迅速或輕易地批准新的《削減戰略武器條約 》 ， 因為議員們對如何核實戰略武器數量與美國導彈防禦系統防禦能力的都心裡沒底。 與於是乎，我們將會看到對條約的拖延，甚至對兩國政府業已達成的協議的反對。

en: Congress may also prove less willing to remove hurdles to Russia’s admission to the World Trade Organization, given what is widely judged to be its leaders’ anti-democratic behavior.
zh: 眾議院估計也不太會移除對俄羅斯加入世貿的諸多障礙，因為大家都對俄羅斯領導人的反民主行為感到反感。

en: China, too, will feel the results of the new balance in Congress.
zh: 中國也會感覺到兩黨重新劃分眾議院勢力的影響。

en: Pressure was already growing to introduce trade sanctions in response to China’s refusal to allow its currency to rise to a natural level against the dollar.
zh: 事實上，已經有越來越多的壓力要求對中國拒絕令其貨幣兌美元升值到一個合理水平的做法實施貿易制裁。

en: Such pressure will likely grow, given concerns over Chinese behavior both at home and abroad.
zh: 這些壓力將越來越大，因為大家對中國在其國內和國外的所做所為都有意見。

en: Moreover, Congress will resist rolling back any of the long-standing economic sanctions against Cuba.
zh: 此外，中國將抵制美國取消對古巴的任何長期制裁。

en: President Barack Obama has the authority to take some small steps on his own to normalize ties, but substantial change to US policy requires Congress to act – and Congress wants to see fundamental change in Cuba before it does so.
zh: 美國總統奧巴馬有足夠的權威區在美國-古巴關係正常化的道路上取得一些微小進展，但長期的改變則需要參議院批准 — — 但參議院卻希望在解除制裁之前能看到古巴發生一些根本性的變化。

en: There will be other consequences stemming from the election.
zh: 選舉還將帶來其他一些後果。

en: What little chance there was of the US backing any global plan to limit or tax carbon emissions has disappeared.
zh: 美國支援關於限制或者徵收碳排放稅的任何全球方案的微小可能性都已徹底破滅。

en: Improvement in US performance on climate change will have to come from innovation and increased energy efficiency.
zh: 美國在這方面的改善只能依靠科技創新和提高能源利用效率了。

en: One can anticipate the Republicans, now in control of the House of Representatives, exploiting their ability to convene hearings to question and review foreign policy.
zh: 人們可以預見到，目前控制了眾議院���共和黨人將利用手中的權力召開質疑或檢討當前外交政策的聽證會。

en: Depending on how this power is used (or abused), it can be beneficial (exercising needed oversight and increasing the transparency of policy and policy-making) or destructive (if, for example, hearings degenerate into politically motivated attacks on administration officials and policies).
zh: 取決於他們如何使用（或者濫用）這些權力，結果可能是有益的（實施必要的監察或者提高外交政策制定的透明度）或是有害的（比如說聽證會可能異化成對某些官員和政策的政治攻擊 ） 。

en: In many other areas, continuity can be expected to trump change.
zh: 而在其他許多領域，政策的持續性將不會有什麼變化。

en: This comes as little surprise, as America’s Constitution and political system delegate most of the initiative on foreign policy and defense to the president.
zh: 這毫不奇怪，因為美國的憲法和政治系統將大多數外交和國防事務交由總統承擔。

en: Yes, Congress must declare war, approve spending, agree to most senior appointments, and (in the case of the Senate) ratify treaties, but the president has enormous latitude when it comes to carrying out diplomacy and using military force in situations other than war, which tend to be most situations.
zh: 國會可以宣戰，批准預算，透過大多數高階官員任命，以及（就參議院來說）提準條約，但在絕大多數情況下，總統在執行外交或者除了戰爭之外的軍事行動方面都擁有極大的自由度。

en: One area of probable continuity is the Middle East, where Obama will continue to try to broker a deal between Israelis and Palestinians and press Iran not to develop nuclear weapons.
zh: 其中一個能保留政策持續性的領域可能是中東，因為奧巴馬將繼續嘗試促成以巴雙方的和平條約，並迫使伊朗放棄發展核武器（共和黨人一直都要求不要向以色列施加過多壓力，而對伊朗採取更強硬手段 ） 。

en: (Republicans, however will argue for putting less pressure on Israel to compromise and more pressure on Iran.)  But he can expect considerable backing from Republicans if he wants to maintain a sizeable US military presence in Afghanistan beyond this July, or a modest military presence in Iraq beyond the end of 2011.
zh: 但如果奧巴馬想要在今年7月後在阿富汗維持一直相當數量的部隊，或是在2011年末以後在伊拉克維持適度的軍事存在，他都是可以得到共和黨相當程度上的支援的。

en: Questions abound when it comes to foreign economic policy, however.
zh: 但在經濟外交政策方面則存在著許多問題。

en: Three completed trade agreements (with South Korea, Panama, and Colombia) have been languishing for years, mostly because of deep opposition to free trade from labor unions and the Democratic Party.
zh: 三項全面貿易條約（與韓國，巴拿馬和哥倫比亞）已經在工會和民主黨的阻撓下拖延了幾年時間。

en: Republicans have historically been more supportive of such bilateral free-trade agreements.
zh: 而共和黨一直以來對這類雙邊自由貿易條約都是表示支援的。

en: But will the new generation of Republicans continue this tradition?
zh: 但新一代共和黨人是否會堅持這一傳統？

en: There is a fair chance that one or more of these bilateral accords will be approved (in part because the Obama administration seems finally to have recognized that trade can generate good jobs), but it is far less certain that the president will gain the authority needed to negotiate a new global trade deal.
zh: 這是那幾項雙邊條約獲得透過的好機會（其中一部分原因是奧巴馬政府似乎最終意識到貿易可以催生新的工作機會 ） ， 但更不確定的則是總統是否有足夠的權威去商討一個新的全球貿易協定。

en: An even bigger question mark hovers over what might be the greatest national security concern of all: the federal budget deficit.
zh: 而一個更重要的問題則是所謂最大的國家安全問題：聯邦債務赤字。

en: Failure to address the deficit (and the mounting debt) will create pressures to reduce what the US spends on foreign aid, intelligence, and defense – although Republicans are more likely than Democrats to protect such spending (except for foreign aid).
zh: 如果無法解決赤字（以及不斷堆積的債務）的話，那麼美國的對外援助，情報和國防事務都將面臨巨大的壓力 — — 即便共和黨人比民主黨人更傾向於維持這部分經費（對外援助除外 ） 。

en: Mounting debt also leaves the US vulnerable to the decisions of those who lend it money – or to the vagaries of the market.
zh: 不斷增加的債務將迫使美國向那些國際債主們俯首稱臣，或是無法承受市場的突然波動。

en: A dollar crisis could weaken the foundations of American power.
zh: 美元危機將影響到美國的全球權力基礎。

en: But averting such a crisis requires that the White House and Congress, Democrats and Republicans, agree on a plan for moving the US budget toward balance.
zh: 但克服這一危機則需要白宮和國會，以及民主黨和共和黨雙方都能在促使美國實現財政平衡方面達成共識。

en: Alas, the election makes such agreement more distant than ever.
zh: 無奈的是，中期選舉卻令這類共識離我們更加遙遠了。

en: America’s Global Balancing Act
zh: 美國的全球平衡行動

en: With Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and annexation of Crimea, the disintegration of Iraq’s and Syria’s borders, and increasing Chinese assertiveness in the South and East China Seas, the post-Cold War era appears to have ended in 2014.
zh: 俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭併吞並克里米亞；伊拉克和敘利亞分崩離析；中國在南海和東海日益囂張 — — 考慮到這些發麵，後冷戰時代似乎已經在2014年結束了。

en: Is that true?
zh: 真的如此嗎？

en: The post-Cold War era was not really an “era,” but rather a gradual transition from a bilateral Cold War to a more complex international order that still involves, in the final analysis, two world powers.
zh: 後冷戰時代不是真正的“時代 ” ， 而是一個從雙邊對峙的冷戰最終分析仍存在兩個超級大國的更加複雜的國際秩序的逐漸轉變時期。

en: In brief, the decisive axis of the new order increasingly involves the United States and the People’s Republic of China.
zh: 簡單說，決定新秩序的軸心已經日益明確 — — 美國和中華人民共和國。

en: The Sino-American competition involves two significant realities that distinguish it from the Cold War: neither party is excessively ideological in its orientation; and both parties recognize that they really need mutual accommodation.
zh: 中美競爭包含了兩個重要事實，使其與冷戰區分開來：雙方對於方向問題都不過分意識形態化；雙方都認識到它們真的需要相互遷就。

en: America’s supposed “pivot to Asia” took a back seat in 2014 to the crises in Ukraine and the Middle East.
zh: 2014年，美國的“重返亞洲”政策因為烏克蘭和中東危機而變得不再顯眼。

en: To what extent has uncertainty about the US commitment in Asia stoked tension between China and America’s Asian allies?
zh: 美國的亞洲承諾的不確定性如何助長了中國和美國的亞洲盟國之間的緊張？

en: I disagree with the premises of the question.
zh: 我不同意這個問題的前提。

en: I do think America has made it quite clear that it is in the interest both of America and China to avoid situations in which they will be pushed toward a collision.
zh: 我確實認為美國非常清楚地表示，避免讓中美雙方陷入會把它們推向衝突的局面符合雙方的利益。

en: The recent indications of some initial dialogue between China and India, and between China and Japan, suggest that China also realizes that escalating old grievances is not in its interest.
zh: 最近的一些中印、中日之間初步對話的跡象表明，中國也認識到煽動舊仇恨不符合它的利益。

en: The more serious problem with the “pivot to Asia” was its actual wording, which implied a military posture designed to “contain” or “isolate” China.
zh: “重返亞洲”所包含的更加嚴重的問題是它的實際用詞，其中暗含要“遏制”或“孤立”中國的軍事姿態。

en: The Chinese have come to realize more clearly that we were not deliberately attempting to isolate them, but that we had a stake in the avoidance of collisions in the Far East that could produce a wider spillover.
zh: 中國人已經更清楚地認識到我們不是故意試圖孤立他們，而是避免可能產生更廣泛的溢位效應的遠東衝突對我們來說意義重大。

en: Xi Jinping has used his war on corruption to concentrate more power in his hands than any Chinese leader since Deng Xiaoping, 30 years ago.
zh: 習近平用其反腐鬥爭鞏固更多的權力，這是30年前鄧小平以來從未有過的。

en: How do you see Xi’s presidency evolving?
zh: 你認為習近平的任期會如何發展？

en: Power in China is somewhat informally defined, and its limits are set more by political realities than by constitutional arrangements.
zh: 從某種程度上講，中國的權力界定不那麼正式，其權力的邊界更多地由政治現實而不是憲法安排決定。

en: That makes it difficult to say whether Xi’s power is greater than any Chinese leader’s since Deng.
zh: 因此，很難說習近平的權力比鄧小平以來的任何一位中國領導人更大。

en: He certainly has an authoritative personality and without doubt is more active on the international scene than some of his predecessors.
zh: 他顯然是一個擁有權威的人，並且毫無疑問比他的幾位前任在國際舞臺上更加活躍。

en: He has also been very decisive in attacking the growing corruption that has become a major source of internal malaise, reaching even the highest levels of government.
zh: 在打擊業已成為國內頑症、甚至已蔓延到政府最高成的日益猖獗的腐敗方面，他也比幾位前任更加果斷。

en: In that respect, it may be argued that his power is more wide-ranging than that of his predecessors, but in fairness it must also be noted that the patterns of corruption that his predecessors faced were not as acute and widespread as they have become in recent years.
zh: 從這個角度講，或許可以說他的權力範圍比他的前任們更廣，但在公正方面，你還必須注意到，他的前任所面臨的腐敗方式沒有最近幾年那樣赤裸裸和普遍。

en: At the same time, the increasing emphasis in party journals on the proposition that China’s armed forces must be viewed as servants of the Communist Party, and not simply of the nation, seems to suggest concern that the military may be developing its own view of Chinese domestic affairs, in addition to proclaiming with increasing assertiveness its responsibility for national security.
zh: 與此同時，黨報日益強調黨指揮槍、反對軍隊國家化，這似乎表明存在一種擔心，即軍隊除了在捍衛國家安全責任方面變得日益強硬之外，也正在產生他們自身對中國內政的看法。

en: The Party elite, quite understandably, does not find this reassuring.
zh: 不難理解，中共精英對此感到十分不安。

en: Can Russian President Vladimir Putin’s regime withstand a prolonged period of low energy prices and Western sanctions?
zh: 俄羅斯總統普京的政權能夠抵擋長時期的低油價和西方制裁嗎？

en: What risks do you see emerging should Russia’s economy continue to decline, with Putin increasingly unable to reward his political base?
zh: 你認為如果俄羅斯經濟繼續衰退，普京在獎賞他的政治基礎方面日益力不從心，會產生什麼後果？

en: There is, of course, a danger that at some point Putin may choose to lash out and create a truly massive international crisis, and perhaps precipitate some new form of direct East-West warfare.
zh: 當然，在某個點上普京也許會選擇孤注一擲，製造真正的大規模國際危機，也許還會引爆新形式的東西方直接戰爭，這種危險是存在的。

en: But to say that, one must also assume that to some extent he himself is unbalanced and has shifted from a kind of guerilla warfare against the West, always with some possibility of retreat, to all-out combat.
zh: 但果真如此的話，我們還必須假設，在某種程度上，他本人已經失衡，從對西方的某種游擊戰 — — 永遠存在撤退的可能 — — 轉變為孤注一擲的戰爭。

en: The outcome of that would be inherently unpredictable, but probably in any case very destructive for Russian wellbeing.
zh: 這一情況的結果具有內在不可預測性，但也許無論如何對俄羅斯人的福祉來說都是一場災難。

en: If Russia’s economy continues to decline, and if the West succeeds in deterring Putin from further use of force, it is still conceivable that some acceptable resolution (a form of which I recommended publicly by talking about the Finland model) may be contrived.
zh: 如果俄羅斯經濟繼續衰退，並且西方繼續威懾普京使之不敢擴大武力，我們仍然可以認為可以形成某種可接受的解決方案（我在談及芬蘭模式時曾公開建議過 ） 。

en: But that depends in turn on the West’s firmness in supporting Ukraine’s efforts to stabilize itself.
zh: 但這反過來取決於西方在支援烏克蘭穩定自身方面有多堅定。

en: Following the withdrawal of US troops from Afghanistan and Iraq, much of the world now perceives the US as being in a period of “retreat,” similar to the post-Vietnam War era.
zh: 美軍撤出阿富汗和伊拉克後，世界上有許多人現在認為美國已經入“撤退”期，就像越戰後時代那樣。

en: Is the US embracing a form of neo-isolationism?
zh: 美國正在採取某種形式的新孤立主義嗎？

en: Or will America’s apparent inward turn be as brief as it was following Vietnam?
zh: 還是說，美國顯而易見的向內轉和越戰之後一樣只是短暫現象？

en: I do not believe that the US is in a “period of retreat.”
zh: 我不認為美國進入了“撤退期 ” 。

en: The fact of the matter is that the redistribution of global power has produced a situation in which the US is no longer the sole hegemon.
zh: 重要的事實是全球實力的再分配產生了一個美國不再是唯一霸權的局面。

en: The US has to acknowledge the fact that the world is now much more complex.
zh: 美國必須承認一個事實，即現在的世界比以前複雜得多。

en: The spread of conflict throughout the Middle East is currently precipitated more by the rise of religious sectarianism than by American interventionism.
zh: 中東地區的衝突蔓延更多地是拜宗教門戶之見崛起所賜，而不是因為美國的干涉。

en: In these volatile circumstances, greater attention must be given to the national interests of countries such as Turkey, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Israel.
zh: 在這些暴力環境下，必須將更多注意力放在土耳其、伊朗、沙烏地阿拉伯、埃及和以色列等國家的國家利益上。

en: By the same token, the interests of any one of them must not be allowed to become the total interest of the US.
zh: 同理，這些國家中的任何一國的利益決不能成為美國的總利益。

en: What may surprise the world most in 2015?
zh: 2015年什麼事情能給世界帶來最大的意外？

en: Perhaps the gradual reappearance in Russia of a more politically assertive liberal middle class.
zh: 也許是俄羅斯逐漸在再現政治上更積極的自由中產階級。

en: That middle class was beginning to play a more significant role in shaping domestic and international Russian policy under Dmitri Medvedev.
zh: 在梅德韋傑夫時期，這一中產階級開始在俄羅斯國內和國際政策中扮演更加重要的角色。

en: With Putin’s return to power and his recent adventurism, it has been pushed aside by deliberately awakened and intensely stimulated national chauvinism.
zh: 隨著普京重回寶座並且採取了最近的冒險主義，自由中產階級被刻意喚醒並且密集刺激的民族沙文主義所壓制。

en: Waving a chauvinist banner, however, may not be the best solution for dealing with international problems, especially if the West is intelligent and united. The Russian middle class, quite naturally, wishes to live in a society like that of Western Europe.
zh: 但是，高舉沙文主義的大旗也許並不是處理國際問題的最佳方案，特別是在面臨明智而團結的西方的情況下。

en: A Russia that gradually begins to gravitate toward the West will also be a Russia that ceases to disrupt the international system.
zh: 逐漸開始被西方吸引的俄羅斯也將是一個停止干擾國際制度的俄羅斯。

en: America’s Enemy Within
zh: 美國國內的敵人

en: NEW YORK – Barring any unexpected new revelations, there is not much to be learned from the Tsarnaev brothers, better known as “the Boston bombers.”
zh: 紐約 — — 除出人意料的事實真相外，從察爾納耶夫兄弟（也叫“波士頓兄弟 ” ） 身上再也得不到什麼新的東西。

en: We can dig into their family histories in strife-torn Dagestan, or examine, once again, the lethal appeal of Islamist radicalism.
zh: 我們可以挖掘倆兄弟在倍受紛爭蹂躪的家鄉達吉斯坦的家庭史，也可以再次審視伊斯蘭激進主義的致命吸引力。

en: But I doubt that this would be enlightening.
zh: 但我懷疑這樣做有沒有意義。

en: The elder brother, Tamerlan, who died in a gun battle with the police, appears to fit perfectly the profile of what the German writer Hans Magnus Enzensberger calls “the radical loser.”
zh: 在與警方交火中喪生的哥哥塔梅蘭似乎是德國作家漢斯·馬格努斯·恩岑斯貝格口中“激進失敗者”的典型。

en: And his younger brother, Dzhokhar, recovering from gunshot wounds in a Boston hospital while waiting to be put on trial for his life, seems to have been a pathetic follower who acted less out of deep conviction than out of fraternal love.
zh: 而正在波士頓醫院接受槍傷治療並等待接受死刑審判的弟弟焦哈爾與其說因為信仰參與恐怖活動，還不如說是因為兄弟情誼而被牽扯其中的可憐的追隨者。

en: The radical loser is the kind of young man who feels victimized by an unfeeling, uncaring world.
zh: 激進失敗者是指那些感覺被絕情、冷漠的世界拋棄的年輕人。

en: That sour sense of rejection, felt by many confused youths, turns for some into a fierce desire for vengeance.
zh: 很多困惑的年輕人那種酸楚的被拋棄感，在某些人身上化成了強烈的復仇欲。

en: Like Samson in the temple of Gaza, he wishes to destroy himself in a public act of violence, taking as many people as possible with him.
zh: 像加沙寺廟中的薩姆森一樣，他追求公眾暴力中的自我毀滅，讓儘可能多的人給他陪葬。

en: Anything can trigger this final act: a lover’s rejection, a job application denied.
zh: 情侶分手、工作申請被拒，任何小事均可觸發這場最後的瘋狂。

en: In the case of Tamerlan, a talented boxer, he was denied the chance to become a champion because he was not yet a United States citizen.
zh: 具體到天才拳手塔梅蘭，他因為不是美國公民而失去了登上冠軍寶座的機會。

en: Radical Islamism offered him a ready-made cause to die for.
zh: 激進伊斯蘭主義為他提供了為事業獻身的現成的機會。

en: More interesting, and in a way far more disturbing, has been the reaction in the US to the Boston bombings, which killed three people and injured 264.
zh: 美國對致3人死亡、264人受傷的波士頓爆炸事件的反應非常有趣，在某種意義上也更耐人尋味。

en: Even after Tamerlan had died, and Dzhokhar, already wounded, was the only known fugitive, the Boston authorities decided to close down the entire city.
zh: 即使在塔梅蘭已死，受傷的焦哈爾被證明是唯一已知逃犯的情況下，波士頓當局依然決定封鎖整座城市。

en: Public transport was halted, trains to and from the city were stopped, shops and business closed, and citizens were told to stay home.
zh: 公共交通及城市列車停運、公司商店關閉、市民被告知要待在家裡。

en: Until the surviving bomber was found, Boston was reduced to a ghost town.
zh: 在倖存的爆炸案嫌犯被發現之前，波士頓已經淪為一座鬼城。

en: If two troubled young men with homemade bombs cobbled together from fertilizer and pressure cookers can have this effect on a major American city, one can imagine how tempting their example must now be to other radical losers, not to mention radical groups.
zh: 如果兩個用化肥和高壓鍋自製炸彈的迷惑的年輕人能對美國的主要城市產生這樣的影響，那麼不難想象他們的榜樣對其他激進失敗者、更不要說極端組織將構成多大的誘惑。

en: It shows how vulnerable a modern city can be when its leaders lose their nerve.
zh: 此次事件顯示領導人喪失勇氣時現代城市將變得多麼脆弱。

en: The authorities’ overblown reaction – and that of much of the press – was all the odder for having occurred just as the US Senate was voting down a bill that would have made it harder for known killers and mentally disturbed people to buy guns, or for private individuals to acquire weapons normally used only in warfare.
zh: 因為發生在美國參議院剛剛否決一項加大已知殺手及精神錯亂人員購買槍支及私人獲取戰爭武器難度的法案之後，當局和多數媒體的誇張反應就顯得更加怪異。

en: It seems as though Americans can tolerate a society in which schoolchildren and other innocents are regularly murdered by deranged men with weapons bought on the open market, but erupt in collective hysteria when the killings are committed by people labeled as “terrorists.”
zh: 看來美國人可以容忍中小學生和其他無辜民眾被持有從公開市場所購武器的精神錯亂者殺害，卻在所謂“恐怖份子”策劃的殺戮中集體爆發癔症。

en: This may reflect what people are accustomed to.
zh: 這也許是人們習慣成自然的反應。

en: The Spanish had grown so inured to acts of violence from Basque separatists that the murder of 191 people in Madrid by Islamist extremists in 2004 was met with remarkable sang-froid. When 52 people were killed in a suicide bombing on the London Underground the following year, the British, too, reacted with relative calm, having lived through years of Irish terrorist violence in the 1970’s.
zh: 西班牙人對巴斯克分離主義份子的暴行麻木不仁，以致於2004年伊斯蘭極端份子在馬德里殺害191人的暴行並未引起多大反應；而次年當自殺式炸彈襲擊在倫敦地鐵奪去52條生命的時候，英國人也因為經歷過20世紀70年代愛爾蘭恐怖主義的暴行而顯得相對冷靜。

en: Like the Spanish, they were used to it.
zh: 英國人和西班牙人一樣已經見怪不怪。

en: Americans, despite the attacks of September 11, 2001, are not.
zh: 儘管經歷過2001年9月11日的恐怖襲擊，美國人卻還沒有對暴力司空見慣。

en: Worse than that, a number of Republican senators, including such luminaries as John McCain, called for stripping Dzhokhar Tsarnaev, who is a US citizen, of his legal rights and placing him before a military tribunal as an “enemy combatant,” as though the 19-year-old college student were a soldier in a war against America.
zh: 這還不算，就像年僅19歲的大學生兼美國公民焦哈爾·察爾納耶夫是反美戰爭中計程車兵一樣，以約翰·麥凱恩等傑出人物為代表的幾名共和黨參議員呼籲剝奪他的合法權益，並將其作為“敵方戰鬥人員”移交軍事法庭審理。

en: Exaggerated fear of outside enemies has always been part of the American political landscape.
zh: 美國政界一直存在對外敵誇大其詞的恐懼。

en: The “nation of immigrants” was traditionally regarded as a refuge from danger.
zh: 美國作為“移民國家”傳統上被視為避險之地。

en: The evil outside world should not be able to touch the Land of the Free.
zh: 邪惡的外部世界不應觸及這片自由的土地。

en: When it does – Pearl Harbor, September 2001 – all hell breaks loose.
zh: 當珍珠港、911等外來襲擊真實發生後，美國人好像掉進了活地獄。

en: Another factor may be the need for a common enemy in a country whose citizens come from so many different cultures and traditions.
zh: 另一個因素或許是民眾來自多元文化和傳統的國家需要同仇敵愾。

en: Besieged by Communists or Islamists, people feel a sense of belonging.
zh: 共產黨或伊斯蘭教徒的圍攻給人帶來歸屬感。

en: Defense of the nation against dangerous outsiders – and their domestic agents, whether real or imagined – provides a powerful bond.
zh: 保護國家免遭想象或真實的危險外來者及其國內代理人的荼毒可以產生強大的凝聚力。

en: Such bonds can be useful, even necessary, in times of war.
zh: 這樣的凝聚力在戰時不僅有效，而且必須。

en: But the politics of fear poses a danger to the US itself.
zh: 但恐懼政治也威脅美國自身的安全。

en: The aim of political terrorist groups, such as Al Qaeda, is to provoke retaliation and maximize publicity for their cause.
zh: 以“基地”為代表的政治恐怖組織的目的就是激起報復，最大限度地為他們的事業宣傳。

en: As common criminals, such groups’ members would not achieve this goal.
zh: 如果被當作普通罪犯，恐怖組織成員的上述目標將無法實現。

en: But by claiming to be soldiers at war with the world’s biggest military power, they gain sympathy, as well as recruits, among the radical losers and the disaffected.
zh: 但自稱與世界排名第一的軍事強國作戰能幫助他們博取同情，進而從激進失敗者和不滿群眾當中徵召人員。

en: Former President George W. Bush once explained terrorism as the expression of hatred for American freedom.
zh: 前總統喬治·W·布什曾經說過恐怖主義是表達對美國自由的仇恨。

en: But when terrorism results in torture of prisoners, ever more police surveillance, and official threats to US citizens’ legal rights – or, for that matter, when a crime committed by two young immigrants causes an entire city to be shut down – Americans’ government is harming their freedom more than any terrorist could ever hope to do.
zh: 但當恐怖主義導致對犯人施暴、警方加強監視和美國公民合法權益受到官方威脅 — — 或者就本案而言，兩名年輕移民所犯的罪行導致波士頓全城陷入癱瘓時 — — 美國政府對於自由的傷害遠遠超乎任何恐怖份子的想象。

en: American Hegemony or American Primacy?
zh: 美國霸權還是美國主導？

en: CAMBRIDGE – No country in modern history has possessed as much global military power as the United States.
zh: 美國劍橋—在現代歷史上，沒有哪個國家擁有如同美國那樣強大的全球軍事實力。

en: Yet some analysts now argue that the US is following in the footsteps of the United Kingdom, the last global hegemon to decline.
zh: 但如今一些分析家認為美國正在步上一個衰落的全球霸權 — — 英國的後塵。

en: This historical analogy, though increasingly popular, is misleading.
zh: 這一歷史比較儘管越來越熱門，卻有誤導之嫌。

en: Britain was never as dominant as the US is today.
zh: 英國從未獲得可與今日美國相媲美的主宰力。

en: To be sure, it maintained a navy equal in size to the next two fleets combined, and its empire, on which the sun never set, ruled over a quarter of humankind.
zh: 誠然，它擁有一支規模等於第二名和第三名之和的海軍，並且“日不落帝國”統治範圍覆蓋了四分之一的人類。

en: But there were major differences in the relative power resources of imperial Britain and contemporary America.
zh: 但大英帝國和當代美國的相對實力來源截然不同。

en: By the outbreak of World War I, Britain ranked only fourth among the great powers in terms of military personnel, fourth in terms of GDP, and third in military spending.
zh: 一戰爆發時，英國的軍人數量只在列強中位居第四，GDP也位居第四，軍事支出位居第三。

en: The British Empire was ruled in large part through reliance on local troops.
zh: 大英帝國在很大程度上利用當地武裝實現統治。

en: Of the 8.6 million British forces in WWI, nearly a third came from the overseas empire.
zh: 在一戰的860萬英軍中，近三分之一來自海外。

en: That made it increasingly difficult for the government in London to declare war on behalf of the empire when nationalist sentiments began to intensify.
zh: 這使得當民族主義情緒開始高漲時，倫敦政府日益難以代表整個帝國宣戰。

en: By World War II, protecting the empire had become more of a burden than an asset.
zh: 到二戰時，保護整個帝國成了一種負擔而不是資產。

en: The fact that the UK was situated so close to powers like Germany and Russia made matters even more challenging.
zh: 英國與德國和俄國的實力已非常接近，這一事實讓挑戰更加緊迫。

en: For all the loose talk of an “American empire,” the fact is that the US does not have colonies that it must administer, and thus has more freedom to maneuver than the UK did.
zh: 在所有泛泛而談的“美利堅帝國”論中，一個事實是美國並不擁有它必須管理的殖民地，因此擁有比英國更大的騰挪自由。

en: And, surrounded by unthreatening countries and two oceans, it finds it far easier to protect itself.
zh: 此外，美國周邊是沒有威脅的鄰國和兩個大洋，保護自己要容易得多。

en: That brings us to another problem with the global hegemon analogy: the confusion over what “hegemony” actually means.
zh: 這就引出了關於全球霸權比較的另一個問題：對“霸權”真實含義的混淆。

en: Some observers conflate the concept with imperialism; but the US is clear evidence that a hegemon does not have to have a formal empire.
zh: 一些觀察家將霸權列為帝國主義的同義詞；但美國是一個明顯的例子，說明了霸權並不一定要靠正式的帝國實現。

en: Others define hegemony as the ability to set the rules of the international system; but precisely how much influence over this process a hegemon must have, relative to other powers, remains unclear.
zh: 另一些觀察家將霸權定義為有能力制定國際制度規則；但霸權必須擁有相對其他列強多多少的影響力仍不明確。

en: Still others consider hegemony to be synonymous with control of the most power resources.
zh: 還有一些觀察家認為霸權意味著控制最多的實力資源。

en: But, by this definition, nineteenth-century Britain – which at the height of its power in 1870 ranked third (behind the US and Russia) in GDP and third (behind Russia and France) in military expenditures – could not be considered hegemonic, despite its naval dominance.
zh: 但是，據此定義，十九世紀的英國 — — 在1870實力頂峰時期，其GDP為世界第三（次於美國和俄國 ） ， 軍事支出亦為世界第三（次於俄國和法國 ） — —就不能稱之為霸權，儘管它擁有海洋主宰力。

en: Similarly, those who speak of American hegemony after 1945 fail to note that the Soviet Union balanced US military power for more than four decades.
zh: 類似地，說美國在1945年後擁有霸權的人沒有注意到蘇聯在四十多年的時間裡都在制衡美國的軍事實力。

en: Though the US had disproportionate economic clout, its room for political and military maneuver was constrained by Soviet power.
zh: 儘管美國擁有無與倫比的經濟實力，但其政治和軍事騰挪空間因為蘇聯的力量而大受限制。

en: Some analysts describe the post-1945 period as a US-led hierarchical order with liberal characteristics, in which the US provided public goods while operating within a loose system of multilateral rules and institutions that gave weaker states a say.
zh: 一些分析家將1945年後的時期稱為美國領導的、以自由為特徵的層級秩序，其中美國提供公共品並在弱國也能贏得話語權的鬆散的多邊規則和機構體系中施展。

en: They point out that it may be rational for many countries to preserve this institutional framework, even if American power resources decline.
zh: 他們指出，對許多國家來說，維護這一制度框架是理性的，即使美國實力源在衰落。

en: In this sense, the US-led international order could outlive America’s primacy in power resources, though many others argue that the emergence of new powers portends this order’s demise.
zh: 從這個角度講，美國領導的國際秩序能夠比美國的實力源主導地位存在更長時間，儘管其他許多人指出新力量的崛起預示著這一秩序的崩潰。

en: But, when it comes to the era of supposed US hegemony, there has always been a lot of fiction mixed in with the facts.
zh: 但是，在所謂的美國霸權時期，一直有許多混雜在一起的事實和矛盾。

en: It was less a global order than a group of like-minded countries, largely in the Americas and Western Europe, which comprised less than half of the world.
zh: 它與其說是一套全球秩序，不如說是一群觀念相近的國家（主要來自美洲和西歐，不到世界的一半 ） 。

en: And its effects on non-members – including significant powers like China, India, Indonesia, and the Soviet bloc – were not always benign.
zh: 其對非成員國的影響 — — 包括中國、印度、印度尼西亞和蘇聯陣營等主要力量 — — 並不總是積極的。

en: Given this, the US position in the world could more accurately be called a “half-hegemony.”
zh: 因此，美國在世界中的地位更應該稱為“半霸權 ” （ half-hegemony ） 。

en: Of course, America did maintain economic dominance after 1945: the devastation of WWII in so many countries meant that the US produced nearly half of global GDP. That position lasted until 1970, when the US share of global GDP fell to its pre-war level of one-quarter.
zh: 當然，美國確實在1945年後維持了經濟主宰力：二戰讓許多國家變成了焦土，這意味著美國貢獻了全球GDP的近一半。

en: But, from a political or military standpoint, the world was bipolar, with the Soviet Union balancing America’s power.
zh: 但是，從政治或軍事角度看，世界是雙極結構，蘇聯制衡著美國的實力。

en: Indeed, during this period, the US often could not defend its interests: the Soviet Union acquired nuclear weapons; communist takeovers occurred in China, Cuba, and half of Vietnam; the Korean War ended in a stalemate; and revolts in Hungary and Czechoslovakia were repressed.
zh: 事實上，在此期間，美國常常無法捍衛它的利益：蘇聯擁有了核武器；共產黨在中國、古巴和半個越南建立了政權；朝鮮戰爭以僵局收場；匈牙利和捷克斯洛伐克起義被鎮壓。

en: Against this background, “primacy” seems like a more accurate description of a country’s disproportionate (and measurable) share of all three kinds of power resources: military, economic, and soft.
zh: 在此背景下，或許“主導”才更準確地描述了一國在三大實力源上的（可測量的）超凡比重：軍事、經濟和軟實力。

en: The question now is whether the era of US primacy is coming to an end.
zh: 現在的問題是美國主導的時代是否正在走向結束。

en: Given the unpredictability of global developments, it is, of course, impossible to answer this question definitively.
zh: 考慮到全球發展趨勢的不可預測性，當然也就無法篤定地回答這個問題。

en: The rise of transnational forces and non-state actors, not to mention emerging powers like China, suggests that there are big changes on the horizon.
zh: 跨國力量和非國家行動方的崛起 — — 更不用說中國等新興力量了 — — 意味著全球局勢的重大變化。

en: But there is still reason to believe that, at least in the first half of this century, the US will retain its primacy in power resources and continue to play the central role in the global balance of power.
zh: 但仍有理由相信，至少在本世紀上半葉，美國將仍然擁有實力源的主導地位，並繼續在全球實力平衡中扮演核心角色。

en: In short, while the era of US primacy is not over, it is set to change in important ways.
zh: 簡言之，儘管美國主導的時代還沒結束，但必定會發生重要改變。

en: Whether or not these changes will bolster global security and prosperity remains to be seen.
zh: 這些改變能否提升全球安全與繁榮還有待觀察。

en: What I Tell My Non-American Friends
zh: 我告訴我美國以外的朋友

en: CAMBRIDGE – I frequently travel overseas, and invariably my foreign friends ask, with varying degrees of bewilderment: What in the world is going on in your country?
zh: 坎布里奇 — — 我時常前往海外，我外國的朋友每次都帶著不同程度的困惑問：你們國家究竟發生了什麼？

en: Here is what I say.
zh: 下面是我的回答。

en: First, do not misinterpret the 2016 election.
zh: 首先，不要誤讀2016年大選。

en: Contrary to some commentary, the American political system has not been swept away by a wave of populism.
zh: 與某些評論所聲稱的恰恰相反，美國政治制度並未被民粹主義浪潮所消滅掉。

en: True, we have a long history of rebelling against elites.
zh: 誠然，我們有著反抗精英的悠久歷史。

en: Donald Trump tapped into a tradition associated with leaders like Andrew Jackson and William Jennings Bryan in the nineteenth century and Huey Long and George Wallace in the twentieth century.
zh: 與十九世紀的安德魯·傑克遜和威廉·詹寧斯·布萊恩和二十世紀的休伊·朗和喬治·華萊士等領袖相關的傳統被唐納德·特朗普所利用。

en: And yet Trump lost the popular vote by nearly three million.
zh: 而且特朗普少近300萬張民眾選票。

en: He won the election by appealing to populist resentment in three Rust Belt states – Michigan, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin – that had previously voted Democratic.
zh: 他透過迎合密歇根、賓夕法尼亞和威斯康星這三個鐵鏽州所出現的民粹主義憤怒而贏得了大選 — — 這三個州此前曾是民主黨的票倉。

en: If a hundred thousand votes had been cast differently in those states, Trump would have lost the Electoral College and the presidency.
zh: 如果那些州有10萬張選票當時改變了歸屬，那麼特朗普將同時失去選舉團和總統。

en: That said, Trump’s victory points to a real problem of growing social and regional inequality in the United States.
zh: 也就是說，特朗普的勝利體現出的真正問題是美國愈演愈烈的社會和地區不平等。

en: J.D. Vance’s recent best-selling book Hillbilly Elegy compellingly describes the vast difference between California and Appalachia.
zh: 萬斯最新暢銷書《鄉村哀歌》令人信服地描繪了加利福尼亞和阿巴拉契亞之間的巨大差別。

en: Research by the Princeton economists Anne Case and Angus Deaton shows that the demographic trends among lower-income whites without a college degree are worse than those for African-Americans, who historically anchored the lower extremes of inequality.
zh: 普林斯頓大學經濟學家安妮·卡斯和安格斯·迪頓的研究顯示不具備大學學歷的低收入白人其人口趨勢比非洲裔美國人更加糟糕，而非洲裔美國人在歷史上曾長期經歷地位最低的不平等。

en: In 1999, mortality rates among whites with no college were around 30% lower than those of African-Americans; by 2015, they were 30% higher.
zh: 1999年，沒有大學學歷的白人死亡率比非洲裔美國人低30%左右；而到2015年，該資料卻變成了高30 % 。

en: Moreover, manufacturing employment, once a prime source of high-paying jobs for working-class whites, has fallen sharply over the last generation, to just 12% of the workforce.
zh: 不僅如此，曾一度成為工薪階層白人高收入主要來源的製造業崗位在過去一代人間急劇下降，目前僅佔勞動力總量的12 % 。

en: These previously Democratic voters were attracted by Trump’s promises to shake things up and bring back manufacturing jobs.
zh: 這些之前的民主黨選民被特朗普改變現狀和重新創造製造業就業機會的承諾所吸引。

en: Ironically, Trump’s efforts to repeal President Barack Obama’s health-care legislation would make their lives worse.
zh: 頗具諷刺意味的是，特朗普廢除奧巴馬總統醫改法案的努力將進一步惡化他們的生活狀況。

en: The second thing I tell my foreign friends is not to underestimate Trump’s communications skills.
zh: 我告訴外國朋友們的第二點是不要低估特朗普的溝通技巧。

en: Many are offended by his tweet storms and outrageous disregard for facts.
zh: 很多人非常厭惡他令人憤怒地無視事實以及他的推特風暴。

en: But Trump is a veteran of reality television, where he learned that the key to success is to monopolize viewers’ attention, and that the way to do that is with extreme statements, not careful regard for the truth.
zh: 但特朗普是位電視真人秀老手，他知道壟斷觀眾的注意力才是成功的關鍵，而且要靠極端言論才能做到這一點，而不是謹慎地看待真相。

en: Twitter helps him to set the agenda and distract his critics.
zh: 推特幫助他制定議程並分散批評。

en: What offends commentators in the media and academia does not bother his supporters.
zh: 冒犯媒體和學者的內容對他的支持者而言無關緊要。

en: But as he turns from his permanent self-centered campaigning to trying to govern, Twitter becomes a two-edged sword that deters needed allies.
zh: 但隨著他從永遠自我中心的競選活動開始轉向實際治理，推特也起到了阻止所需盟友的雙刃劍的作用。

en: Third, I tell my friends not to expect normal behavior.
zh: 第三，我告訴我的朋友不要指望特朗普表現正常。

en: Normally, a president who loses the popular vote moves to the political center to attract additional support.
zh: 通常情況下，在民眾投票中失利的總統會轉向政治中心以吸引更多支持者。

en: This is what George W. Bush did successfully in 2001.
zh: 2001年喬治·W·布什總統就曾成功地這樣做。

en: Trump, by contrasts, proclaims that he won the popular vote and, acting as though he really did, appeals to his base voters.
zh: 相比之下，特朗普宣稱自己贏得了民眾投票，而且就像真的贏了一樣對他的基礎選民發出號召。

en: While Trump has made solid centrist appointments to the Departments of Defense, State, and Homeland Security, his picks for the Environmental Protection Agency and the Department of Health and Human Services are from the extremes of the Republican Party.
zh: 特朗普在中規中矩地任命中間人士擔任國防部長、國務卿和國土安全部負責人的同時，卻任命共和黨極端份子擔任環保署和衛生與公共服務部部長。

en: His White House staff is divided between pragmatists and ideologues, and he caters to both.
zh: 他安排的白宮工作人員既有實用主義者也不乏空想家，而他能自如地與兩者打交道。

en: Fourth, no one should underestimate US institutions.
zh: 第四，人們不應低估美國的機構。

en: Sometimes my friends talk as though the sky is falling and ask if Trump is as dangerous a narcissist as Mussolini.
zh: 有時我的朋友說得就像天要塌了一樣，問特朗普是不是像墨索里尼一樣危險的自戀者。

en: I tell them not to panic.
zh: 我告訴他們不要驚慌。

en: The US, for all its problems, is not Italy in 1922.
zh: 儘管美國有各種各樣的問題，但絕不是1922年的義大利。

en: Our national political elites are often polarized; but so were America’s founders.
zh: 我們的國家政治精英往往兩極分化；但美國的開國元勳當時也是一樣。

en: In designing the US Constitution, the founders’ goal was not to ensure harmonious government, but to constrain political power with a system of checks and balances that made it difficult to exercise.
zh: 在設計美國憲法的時候，開國元勳們的目標不是確保建設和諧的政府，而是利用完整的制衡體系約束政權，增加權力的行使難度。

en: The joke goes that the founders created a political system that made it impossible for King George to rule over us – or for anyone to ever do so.
zh: 有人開玩笑說開國元勳們締造了阻止喬治國王 — — 或任何獨裁者 — — 執政的一整套政治制度。

en: Inefficiency was placed in the service of liberty.
zh: 他們寧願以低效為代價來實現自由的目標。

en: It is still early in the Trump presidency, and we cannot be sure what might happen after, say, a major terrorist attack.
zh: 特朗普執政尚處於早期階段，我們無法確定比如在一次重大恐怖襲擊後可能發生些什麼。

en: So far, however, the courts, the Congress, and the states have checked and balanced the administration, as Madison intended.
zh: 但到目前為止，法院、國會及各州政府都在按麥迪遜的意圖制約和平衡政府。

en: And the permanent civil servants in the executive departments add ballast.
zh: 行政部門的常任公務員也發揮了穩定作用。

en: Finally, my friends ask what all of this means for American foreign policy and the liberal international order led by the US since 1945.
zh: 最後，我的朋友問這對美國外交政策和1945年來由美國主導的自由國際秩序意味著什麼。

en: Frankly, I don’t know, but I worry less about the rise of China than the rise of Trump.
zh: 坦率地講，我不知道，但與其說我擔心中國的崛起還不如說我更擔心特朗普。

en: While American leaders, including Obama, have complained about free riders, the US has long taken the lead in providing key global public goods: security, a stable international reserve currency, relatively open markets, and stewardship of the Earth’s commons.
zh: 雖然美國領導人，包括奧巴馬在內，一直抱怨有人免費搭車，但美國一直在提供安全、穩定的國際儲備貨幣、相對開放的市場和地球公共資源管理等全球關鍵公共服務方面發揮著領導作用。

en: Despite the US-led international order’s problems, the world has prospered and poverty has been reduced under it.
zh: 儘管以美國為主導的國際秩序存在各種問題，但在這種制度下，世界實現了繁榮，貧窮也逐步減少。

en: But one cannot be sure it will continue.
zh: 但我們無法肯定現行制度將繼續下去。

en: The US will need to cooperate with China, Europe, Japan, and others to manage transnational problems.
zh: 美國需要與中國、歐洲、日本和其他國家合作來管理跨國事務。

en: During the 2016 campaign, Trump was the first major party candidate in 70 years to call the American alliance system into question.
zh: 2016年競選期間，特朗普是七十年來首位質疑美國聯盟制度的主要黨派候選者。

en: Since taking office in January, statements by Trump and his appointees suggest that it is likely to persist.
zh: 自1月上臺以來，特朗普及其任命人員的言論表明這種質疑很可能不會消除。

en: American hard and soft power, after all, stems largely from the fact that the US has 60 allies (while China has only a few).
zh: 歸根結底，美國的硬實力和軟實力大多來自美國的六十個盟友（而中國只有少數幾個 ） 。

en: But the stability of the multilateral institutions that help manage the world economy and global commons is more uncertain.
zh: 但協助管理世界經濟和全球民眾的多邊機構能否保持穩定不確定性更高。

en: Trump’s budget director speaks of a hard-power budget, with funds cut from the State Department and the United Nations system.
zh: 特朗普的預算總監談到硬實力預算，撥給國務院和聯合國系統的資金都有所減少。

en: Other officials advocate replacing multilateral trade deals with “fair and balanced” bilateral arrangements.
zh: 其他官員則宣揚用“公平和平衡的”雙邊安排取代多邊貿易協定。

en: And Trump is repudiating Obama’s efforts to address climate change.
zh: 而且特朗普拒絕承認奧巴馬應對氣候變化的工作。

en: I tell my friends I wish I could reassure them on these issues.
zh: 我告訴我的朋友我希望能在這些問題上給他們保證。

en: But I cannot.
zh: 但我做不到。

en: Reclaiming American Internationalism
zh: 重拾美國國際主義

en: DENVER – To watch the debate play out in America’s news media, it would seem that the opposite of “America First” is American interventionism: a chronic penchant for leaping, to no apparent end, into wars of choice and demonstrating America’s unrivaled military power.
zh: 發自丹佛 — — 如果你關注美國新聞媒體的爭論，就會發現“美國優先”的對立面似乎是美國的干預主義：經常出其不意地跳入戰爭選項並炫耀美國無與倫比的軍事實力。

en: But interventionism is not the same thing as internationalism.
zh: 但干預主義與國際主義不同。

en: Conflating the two collapses the distinction between quick and decisive use of force and thoughtful engagement with the world and its problems.
zh: 如果將兩者混為一談，就無法將快速斷然使用武力與深思熟慮地參與世界及其問題區分開來。

en: In America’s “get ’er done” transactional Weltanschauung, international disputes tend to be viewed as military challenges that are merely masquerading as political issues.
zh: 在美國那種“把事情擺平”的事務性世界觀中，國際爭端往往被視為偽裝成政治事務的軍事挑戰。

en: In fact, they are usually the opposite, which is why the world’s most complex conflicts are rarely resolved by intervention.
zh: 事實上情況通常是相反的，這就是為什麼世界上最複雜的衝突很少能透過干預來解決的原因。

en: Geopolitical conflicts have long, sordid histories, and violence is more often a symptom of their intractability than an inherent trait.
zh: 地緣政治衝突都有著悠久而醜惡的歷史，而暴力往往並非其固有特徵，而是證明其難以處理的症狀。

en: They often have something to do with identity, and with claims of collective ownership of the land beneath the feet of a particular “nation.”
zh: 它們往往與身份定義有關，並且聲稱對特定“國家/民族”腳下的土地擁有集體所有權。

en: The basis of political membership is more often ethnic than civil, which is contrary to Americans’ understanding of nationhood.
zh: 構建政治成員資格的基礎往往是種族而非公民身份，而這與美國人對國家的理解相悖。

en: Moreover, contemporary problems can be the products of flawed arrangements that were made decades or even centuries ago.
zh: 與此同時，某些當代問題可能是幾十年甚至幾百年前那些缺陷性安排的產物。

en: Two examples that immediately come to mind are the 1916 Sykes-Picot agreement between Britain and France, which carved up the Middle East, and the 1919 Treaty of Versailles, which established national borders in the Balkans.
zh: 可以信手拈來的兩個例子是1916年英法兩國瓜分中東的《賽克斯-皮科協定 》 ， 以及1919年為巴爾幹地區劃分了國界的《凡爾賽條約 》 。

en: In both cases, creating new states may have seemed like a straightforward solution, but doing so turned out to be a prescription for more war.
zh: 在這兩種情況下，建立一些新國家看似是個簡單明瞭的解決方案，但真這樣做只會引發更多戰爭。

en: For the United States, international conflicts are often an occasion to demonstrate “toughness” and “resolve.”
zh: 對美國來說，國際衝突往往是其展現“硬派”和“決心”的機會。

en: The US airstrikes in Bosnia were meant to lend momentum to a political process that already had the support of the European Union and Russia.
zh: 美國對波斯尼亞的空襲是為了推動一項已經得到歐盟和俄羅斯支援的政治程序。

en: The air campaign was a last resort, an effort to punish those who did not support the peace process.
zh: 空襲是最後的手段，是為了懲罰那些不支援和平程序的人。

en: For many American pundits and politicians, then, the lesson of Bosnia was merely that the bad guys should have been bombed sooner.
zh: 因此對許多美國權威人士和政治家來說，從波斯尼亞得到的經驗就僅僅是應該早點轟炸壞人。

en: Few took the opportunity to study the region’s complex history so that judicious inter-entity boundaries could be drawn up.
zh: 很少人藉此機會研究該地區的複雜歷史以便在各個實體間劃分出審慎明智的界限。

en: If they had, the final arrangement might have done more to preserve external borders and nurture a constitutional structure that would allow the new state to be integrated into the European map.
zh: 如果他們能做到這一點的話，最終安排可能會更加專注於保護外部邊界並培育出一種憲政架構，使新國家得以融入歐洲地圖。

en: Kosovo, too, supplied more historical complexity than many were willing to grapple with.
zh: 科索沃也是如此，因為該地的歷史要比許多人願意探究的更為複雜。

en: On-the-ground diplomacy to achieve sovereign autonomy for Kosovo while respecting Serbs’ emotional connection to it was derided.
zh: 力圖在實現科索沃主權自治的同時尊重塞族與該地情感聯絡的接地氣外交策略總是受到嘲笑。

en: The implication was that military means should be the first – rather than the last – option for securing Kosovo’s independence.
zh: 這意味著軍事手段成為了確保科索沃獨立的首要 — — 而不是最後一個 — — 選擇。

en: Never mind that many European countries objected to the creation of an independent state, and had called for multilateral diplomacy to be attempted before any discussion of air strikes.
zh: 更別提許多歐洲國家反對建立一個獨立國家，並呼籲在討論實施任何空襲之前嘗試進行多邊外交。

en: Interventionism, with internationalism as an afterthought, continued after the turn of the century, but on a much bigger stage.
zh: 在世紀之交之後，先干涉主義後國際主義的做法繼續存在，而且站在更廣大的舞臺上。

en: After the attacks of September 11, 2001, the US led an invasion and subsequent occupation of Afghanistan to root out al-Qaeda.
zh: 在2001年9月11日襲擊事件發生後，美國領軍了入侵併隨後佔領阿富汗以剷除基地組織。

en: But after 17 years with troops on the ground in that country, Americans have lost patience, with many embracing US President Donald Trump’s “America First” isolationism.
zh: 但是在駐軍17年後美國人失去了耐心，許多人接受了美國總統特朗普的“美國優先”孤立主義思維。

en: In Iraq, where the connection to terrorism was more dubious, the US mounted a major military effort with goals that were perplexing and shifting, insofar as they were ever clearly articulated at all.
zh: 在與恐怖主義聯絡更為微弱的伊拉克，美國花費重大的軍事努力去實現那些令人困惑且飄搖不定的目標，似乎它們根本就沒有被明確表達過。

en: American interventionism has often been accompanied by criticism of friends and allies, who are depicted as weak and vacillating in the face of global challenges such as Russian President Vladimir Putin’s annexation of Crimea or China’s increasing assertiveness in the South China Sea.
zh: 美國的干涉主義往往伴隨著對朋友和盟友的批評，指責它們在面對諸如俄羅斯總統普京吞併克里米亞或中國在南中國海日益橫行等全球性挑戰時表現弱勢和搖擺不定。

en: When things went wrong in Afghanistan and Iraq, the US blamed those countries’ political leaders, denouncing them as corrupt and deserving of regime change.
zh: 當阿富汗和伊拉克出現問題時美國就會抨擊這些國家的政治領導人，譴責他們腐敗並活該下臺。

en: The Europeans, too, were denounced, not just for fecklessness in the face of evil, but for living fat and happy lives without shouldering their proper burden.
zh: 歐洲人也受到譴責，不僅僅是因為面對惡行時的無能，還因為光顧享受生活而不去承擔適當的責任。

en: With these narratives deeply etched into American public consciousness, it is no wonder that Trump’s dystopian vision has prevailed over internationalism, which has become a byword for the endless use of force and condescension toward allies.
zh: 鑑於這些敘事已經深深地銘刻在美國公眾的意識當中，也難怪特朗普的反烏托邦視野能壓倒國際主義，因為後者已經成為無休止地使用武力並對盟友俯首帖耳的代名詞。

en: American internationalism will be back at some point.
zh: 美國的國際主義將會在某個時刻迴歸。

en: But those who claim to support it could hasten its revival by acting in accordance with its original meaning.
zh: 但那些聲稱支援它的人可以透過按照其原始含義行事來加速其復興。

en: Traditional internationalists show respect for the opinions of others, and a willingness to accept – and even champion – multilateral structures.
zh: 傳統的國際主義者會表現出對他人意見的尊重，並表現出接受 — — 甚至支援 — — 多邊架構的意願。

en: What internationalism needs now is a renewed American commitment to cooperation, even when other governments require more time to secure a mandate for action from their respective constituencies.
zh: 當前國際主義需要的是美國承諾重新參與合作，即使當其他政府需要更多時間來獲取來自各自體制的行動授權。

en: At the end of the day, US international leadership must rest on American values, and on a broad perception of adherence to the unalienable principles underlying liberal democracy.
zh: 畢竟美國的國際領導必須根植於美國的價值觀並廣泛遵守自由民主制度背後的一系列不可剝奪原則。

en: In other words, America must lead by example.
zh: 換句話說，美國必須以身作則。

en: Its failure to do so in recent times – not least on the refugee issue – has undermined the influence on which its power ultimately rests.
zh: 而其近期的失能 — — 尤其是在難民問題上 — — 已經破壞了其權力最終所賴以構築的影響力。

en: Renewing American Leadership
zh: 重建美國領導

en: MADRID – December always provides an opportunity to pause and reflect on what was and what will be.
zh: 馬德里—12月永遠是停下來思考過去怎樣、未來又會怎樣的機會。

en: This year, one of the conclusions that such reflection yields is that the United States remains firmly at the center of the liberal world order.
zh: 今年，這樣的思考所產生的一個結論是美國仍然是自由世界秩序的核心，這一地位十分穩固。

en: Another is that the US needs to do more to lead in the way that its international standing demands.
zh: 另一個結論是美國需要做更多的事才能滿足其國際地位所要求的領導責任。

en: Doubts about America’s continued global leadership have been proliferating for years.
zh: 多年來，關於美國是否能夠保持全球領導力的質疑此起彼伏。

en: But, though the much-discussed multi-polar world order may well be in the cards, the reality is that, for now, efforts to address global challenges – from climate change to conflict in the Middle East – demand US engagement.
zh: 但是，儘管廣受關注的多極世界秩序也許已經註定，但現實是就目前而言，解決全球挑戰 — — 從氣候變化到中東衝突 — — 的措施都需要美國的參與。

en: Unfortunately, the narrative of American decline has gained so much traction in recent years that even US officials seem to have started to believe it, pursuing weak and piecemeal policies (or, in some cases, doing nothing at all).
zh: 不幸的是，美國衰落的說法在近幾年中獲得了巨大的市場，就連美國官員也似乎已經開始相信它，推行弱勢的零星政策（在有些問題上甚至無所作為 ） 。

en: President Barack Obama’s restrained foreign-policy approach appears to be fueling, not reducing, global instability.
zh: 總統奧巴馬的剋制外交方針助長而不是遏制了全球動盪。

en: The reasons for this lack of strong action are disputed.
zh: 不再採取強勢行動的原因飽受爭議。

en: Some blame Obama’s own fears about repeating his predecessors’ mistakes; others blame a hostile Congress for tying his hands.
zh: 一些人指責奧巴馬害怕重蹈前任覆轍；也有人指責敵意國會的掣肘。

en: In fact, both factors may be at work.
zh: 事實上，也許兩個因素都在起作用。

en: It may well be true that Obama would rather exercise caution – even when bold action is called for – than act impulsively and potentially cause more damage.
zh: 奧巴馬寧願謹慎行事 — — 哪怕是在人們呼籲採取果斷行動時 — — 而不願衝動以免造成更多傷害。

en: But the negative impact of an obstructionist, highly partisan US Congress should not be underestimated.
zh: 但以製造障礙為己任的高度黨派對立的美國國會所起到的消極作用也不能小覷。

en: For example, by blocking reforms to International Monetary Fund governance that were agreed in 2010, Congress has damaged, perhaps irreparably, the legitimacy and relevance of the Bretton Woods institutions.
zh: 比如，國會阻撓在2010年就形成一致的國際貨幣基金組織（IMF）治理改革，這可能對佈雷頓森林機構的合法性和重要性造成了不可挽回的傷害。

en: Likewise, by refusing to ratify the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, the US Congress has undermined America’s credibility as it attempts to reaffirm international law in the South China Sea, where China is acting with increasing audacity.
zh: 類似地，美國國會拒絕批准聯合國海洋法公約，這損害了美國的信譽，使其在中國日益蠻橫的南海問題上難以主張國際法。

en: And, by opposing the inclusion of legally binding climate commitments, it weakened the global climate agreement that was reached this month in Paris, leaving compliance and implementation uncertain.
zh: 此外，美國國會還反對納入有法律約束的氣候承諾，從而削弱了本月在巴黎所達成的全球氣候協定，留下了遵守和實施方面的不確定性。

en: Stalemate has become the name of the game in US politics in recent years.
zh: 近幾年來，僵局已成為美國政治博弈的代名詞。

en: That is why next year’s presidential election is so crucial.
zh: 正因如此，明年的總統選舉至關重要。

en: It offers an opportunity for a fresh start, a new approach that produces the type of policy actions that the world needs.
zh: 這次選舉提供了一個採取新方針，帶來世界所需要的政策行動的全新開始的機會。

en: The key is engagement – among branches of the US government, between the US government and the public, and between the US and the rest of the world.
zh: 關鍵在於參與（engagement ） — —美國政府各部門的參與，美國政府和公眾之間的參與，以及美國和世界其他國家之間的參與。

en: For starters, to avoid the kind of obstructionism that prevailed in the last eight years, the next president must engage Congress directly and actively.
zh: 首先，為了避免過去八年中所出現的阻撓一切的情況，下一位美國總統必須直接、積極地參與國會。

en: And, in fact, two of the Obama administration’s recent wins – the passage of so-called trade promotion authority (fast-track negotiating authority to conclude the Trans-Pacific Partnership) and the reauthorization of the small but vital Export-Import Bank – were the result of dedicated outreach, education, and, yes, cajoling of lawmakers.
zh: 而事實上，奧巴馬政府的兩次最近的勝利 — — 透過所謂的貿易促進授權（快車道談判授權以完成跨太平洋合作伙伴關係）和對規模較小但至關重要的進出口銀行的重新授權 — — 便是不遺餘力的廣泛接觸、教育以及，是的，誘導立法者的結果。

en: The Iran nuclear agreement, one of Obama’s hallmark achievements, involved similar efforts to engage Congress, from protracted trips to Capitol Hill by Obama administration officials to a creative approach that allowed legislators to display their displeasure for the deal, without blocking its progress.
zh: 伊朗核協議是奧巴馬的標誌性成就之一，其中也包括了類似的參與國會的努力，奧巴馬政府官員堅持不懈地拜訪國會山，並提出了一套創造性的方針，允許立法者表達他們對協議的不滿而不會阻撓協議進展。

en: Even in America’s highly divisive political atmosphere, it seems, where there is a will, there is a way.
zh: 看起來，即使在高度分化的美國政治氣候下，也是有志者事竟成。

en: America’s next president must also improve engagement with citizens, whose widespread disaffection constrains – or allows – US leaders to pursue a weak foreign policy.
zh: 下一任美國總統還必須改善與公民之間的參與，美國公民的普遍不滿制約 — — 或者讓 — — 美國領導人採取了弱勢外交。

en: Like many Europeans today, most Americans do not seem to understand – or care to understand – that the crumbling of the liberal world order would have dire consequences for all of them.
zh: 和當今的許多歐洲人一樣，大部分美國人似乎不理解 — — 也不屑理解 — — 自由世界秩序的崩潰會給他們所有人都帶來可怕後果。

en: It was not always this way.
zh: 並不總是如此。

en: Immediately after World War II, the memory of war, together with the enduring threat posed by the Soviet Union, made plain the importance of building and maintaining a liberal world order.
zh: 第二次世界大戰剛剛結束時，戰爭的記憶加上蘇聯所帶來的持續威脅，使得人人都能理解構建和維持自由世界秩序的重要性。

en: Today, though the need for such an order is just as great, the argument is not nearly as comprehensible or emotionally powerful.
zh: 如今，儘管對這一秩序的需求與當時同樣巨大，但這一論點已不再那麼完整或者具有那麼強大的情感力量。

en: Discussion of rules and institutions comes across as bloodless.
zh: 對規則和制度的討論給人留下不會流血的引向。

en: It is up to political leaders – and especially the president – to figure out how to make a compelling case about what is at stake.
zh: 政治領導人 — — 尤其是總統 — — 的責任就是找到如何將讓最重要的事情顯得刻不容緩。

en: Only this approach can secure the mandate from the public that the next US president will need to engage effectively with other world leaders.
zh: 只有這一方針能夠確保下一任美國總統能夠獲得與其他世界領導人有效參與的公眾授權。

en: And make no mistake: Such engagement is indispensable.
zh: 不要搞錯了：這一參與是不可或缺的。

en: While the US must play an integral role in addressing global challenges, from ending the Syrian civil war to following through on the promises of the Paris climate agreement, it cannot do it alone.
zh: 美國必須在解決全球挑戰過程中起到核心作用，不管是結束敘利亞內戰還是兌現巴黎氣候協定承諾。

en: Real progress will demand real cooperation.
zh: 只有真合作才能帶來真進步。

en: In the second half of the twentieth century, the US showed that committed leadership could help to ensure widespread stability and prosperity.
zh: 二十世紀下半葉，美國證明了全力以赴兌現領導力能有助於確保廣泛的穩定與繁榮。

en: In the twenty-first century, it has showed how devastating a lack of such leadership can be.
zh: 在二十一世紀，美國又證明了缺乏這一領導力所能造成的災難性後果。

en: Finger pointing will not fix anything.
zh: 指責遊戲無助於解決問題。

en: Only by pursuing genuine, deep, and sustained engagement, both at home and abroad, can the next administration ensure that the coming years will be better than the last.
zh: 下一屆美國政府只有追求真正的深度可持續合作 — — 不管在國內還是國外 — — 才能確保未來幾年會比過去幾年更好。

en: American Pie in the Sky
zh: 美國派在天上飛

en: NEW YORK – While the risk of a disorderly crisis in the eurozone is well recognized, a more sanguine view of the United States has prevailed.
