zh: 紐約—歐元區發生無序危機的風險已為人們所認識到，但對於美國，人們的普遍看法仍是樂觀。

en: For the last three years, the consensus has been that the US economy was on the verge of a robust and self-sustaining recovery that would restore above-potential growth.
zh: 在過去三年中，共識一直是美國經濟快要實現穩健的自我維持復甦，將重回超過潛在增長率的增長階段。

en: That turned out to be wrong, as a painful process of balance-sheet deleveraging – reflecting excessive private-sector debt, and then its carryover to the public sector – implies that the recovery will remain, at best, below-trend for many years to come.
zh: 這是錯的，因為痛苦的資產負債表去槓桿化過程 — — 反映了私人部門的過度負債及其後負債向公共部門轉移 — — 意味著即使在最好的情形下，復甦在未來多年內也打不到趨勢水平。

en: Even this year, the consensus got it wrong, expecting a recovery to above-trend  annual GDP growth – faster than 3%.
zh: 即使在今年，共識也沒有看準形勢，期待超趨勢的年GDP增長復甦 — — 3%以上。

en: But the first-half growth rate looks set to come in closer to 1.5% at best, even below 2011’s dismal 1.7%.
zh: 但上半年的增長率能接近1.5%便已謝天謝地了，甚至連2011令人失望的1.7%都趕不上。

en: And now, after getting the first half of 2012 wrong, many are repeating the fairy tale that a combination of lower oil prices, rising auto sales, recovering house prices, and a resurgence of US manufacturing will boost growth in the second half of the year and fuel above-potential growth by 2013.
zh: 而如今，在錯判了2012年上半年的形勢後，很多人又在重複老童話了 — — 油價下降、汽車銷售增加、房價復甦、美國製造業重振雄風，所有這些的綜合作用將在今年下半年提振經濟增長，在2013年將增長拉到潛在水平之上。

en: The reality is the opposite: for several reasons, growth will slow further in the second half of 2012 and be even lower in 2013 – close to stall speed.
zh: 現實正好相反：多種理由表明增長會在2012年下半年有所放緩，在2013年進一步惡化，降至近乎停滯的程度。

en: First, growth in the second quarter has decelerated from a mediocre 1.8% in January-March, as job creation – averaging 70,000 a month – fell sharply.
zh: 首先，二季度增長率較一季度的差強人意的1.8%有所減慢，這是因為就業創造 — — 平均每個月創造70 000個崗位 — — 迅速疲軟所致。

en: Second, expectations of the “fiscal cliff” – automatic tax increases and spending cuts set for the end of this year – will keep spending and growth lower through the second half of 2012.
zh: 其次 ， “ 財政懸崖”預期 — — 在今年年底自動實行增稅減支 — — 將在2012年下半年拖累支出和增長。

en: So will uncertainty about who will be President in 2013; about tax rates and spending levels; about the threat of another government shutdown over the debt ceiling; and about the risk of another sovereign rating downgrade should political gridlock continue to block a plan for medium-term fiscal consolidation.
zh: 此外，2013年誰能入主白宮、稅率和支出水平會如何、債務上限是否會引發又一次政府關門、政治扯皮導致的中期財政整合計劃無法實施是否會引發主權評級的再次下調，這些方面的不確定性也會對支出和增長形成衝擊。

en: In such conditions, most firms and consumers will be cautious about spending – an option value of waiting – thus further weakening the economy.
zh: 在這樣的環境下，大部分企業和消費者會對支出慎之又慎 — — 等待的選擇價值 — — 從而進一步拖累經濟。

en: Third, the fiscal cliff would amount to a 4.5%-of-GDP drag on growth in 2013 if all tax cuts and transfer payments were allowed to expire and draconian spending cuts were triggered.
zh: 第三，財政懸崖將對2013年GDP形成4.5%的拖累作用，如果減稅和轉移支付到期停止且嚴厲的支出削減被觸發的話。

en: Of course, the drag will be much smaller, as tax increases and spending cuts will be much milder.
zh: 當然，如果增稅減支較為溫和的話，拖累作用也會大大降低。

en: But, even if the fiscal cliff turns out to be a mild growth bump – a mere 0.5% of GDP – and annual growth at the end of the year is just 1.5%, as seems likely, the fiscal drag will suffice to slow the economy to stall speed: a growth rate of barely 1%.
zh: 但是，即使財政懸崖最後只是增長的小趔趄 — — GDP只損失0.5 % — —且年末年增長率最後只有1.5 % （ 看起來很有可能 ） ， 財政拖累仍將把經濟增速壓低到停滯水平 — — 經濟增長率低於1 % 。

en: Fourth, private consumption growth in the last few quarters does not reflect growth in real wages (which are actually falling).
zh: 第四，過去幾個季度的私人消費增長並未反映真實工資增長（實際上，真實工資在下降 ） 。

en: Rather, growth in disposable income (and thus in consumption) has been sustained since last year by another $1.4 trillion in tax cuts and extended transfer payments, implying another $1.4 trillion of public debt.
zh: 相反，可支配收入增長（以及它所帶來的消費增長）在去年之所以能夠持續，是因為增加了1.4萬億美元的減稅並延長了轉移支付，而這意味著公共債務又增加了1.4萬億美元。

en: Unlike the eurozone and the United Kingdom, where a double-dip recession is already under way, owing to front-loaded fiscal austerity, the US has prevented some household deleveraging through even more public-sector releveraging – that is, by stealing some growth from the future.
zh: 美國與歐元區和英國不同，後兩者由於實行了前瞻性財政緊縮，二次探底已經發生了，而美國正在透過公共部門增加槓桿延緩家庭的去槓桿化，換句話說，美國在向未來偷取增長。

en: In 2013, as transfer payments are phased out, however gradually, and as some tax cuts are allowed to expire, disposable income growth and consumption growth will slow.
zh: 2013年，隨著轉移支付的逐漸停止（不管多麼緩慢）以及一些減稅專案的到期，可支配收入和消費增長將會下降。

en: The US will then face not only the direct effects of a fiscal drag, but also its indirect effect on private spending.
zh: 美國將不僅面臨財政拖累的直接後果，還將面臨其對私人支出的間接影響。

en: Fifth, four external forces will further impede US growth: a worsening eurozone crisis; an increasingly hard landing for China; a generalized slowdown of emerging-market economies, owing to cyclical factors (weak advanced-country growth) and structural causes (a state-capitalist model that reduces potential growth); and the risk of higher oil prices in 2013 as negotiations and sanctions fail to convince Iran to abandon its nuclear program.
zh: 第五，四大外部因素將進一步阻礙美國增長：歐元區危機的惡化、中國的硬著陸、因週期性因素（發達國家增長疲軟）和結構性原因（國家資本主義模式抑制了潛在增長率）共同導致的新興市場經濟體整體放緩、以及2013年油價上漲（因談判和制裁不能促使伊朗放棄核計劃所致 ） 。

en: Policy responses will have very limited effect in stemming the US economy’s deceleration toward stall speed: even with only a mild fiscal drag on growth, the US dollar is likely to strengthen as the eurozone crisis weakens the euro and as global risk aversion returns.
zh: 政策應對措施對於防止美國經濟滑向停滯效果極其有限：即使財政拖累對增長的影響很小，美元也可能因歐元區危機拖累歐元以及全球避險行為回潮而升值。

en: The US Federal Reserve will carry out more quantitative easing this year, but it will be ineffective: long-term interest rates are already very low, and lowering them further would not boost spending.
zh: 美聯儲將在今年追加量化寬鬆，但這不會起效：長期利率已然很低，進一步壓低它們不會提振支出。

en: Indeed, the credit channel is frozen and velocity has collapsed, with banks hoarding increases in base money in the form of excess reserves.
zh: 事實上，信用渠道已經凍結，貨幣流速極慢，銀行紛紛以超額儲備的形式囤積基礎貨幣。

en: Moreover, the dollar is unlikely to weaken as other countries also carry out quantitative easing.
zh: 此外，在其他國家也推出量化寬鬆的情況下，美元也不可能貶值。

en: Similarly, the gravity of weaker growth will most likely overcome the levitational effect on equity prices from more quantitative easing, particularly given that equity valuations today are not as depressed as they were in 2009 or 2010.
zh: 類似地，增長不振的重力極有可能會壓制透過進一步量化寬鬆對股價的浮力，特別是考慮到如今的股票估值早已不像2009和2010年那樣處於低位了。

en: Indeed, growth in earnings and profits is now running out of steam, as the effect of weak demand on top-line revenues takes a toll on bottom-line margins and profitability.
zh: 事實上，收益和利潤的增長正在失去動力，因為需求疲軟對運營收入的影響讓利潤率和盈利性遭受重創。

en: A significant equity-price correction could, in fact, be the force that in 2013 tips the US economy into outright contraction.
zh: 事實上，股價的重大修正可能在2013年將美國經濟拖入嚴重衰退。

en: And if the US (still the world’s largest economy) starts to sneeze again, the rest of the world – its immunity already weakened by Europe’s malaise and emerging countries’ slowdown – will catch pneumonia.
zh: 而如果美國（仍是世界第一大經濟體）再一次感冒，那麼世界其他國家 — — 免疫力已經因為歐洲的疲軟和新興國家的減速大衛削弱 — — 恐怕又要的肺炎了。

en: An American Political Tragedy
zh: 美國政治悲劇

en: BERLIN – US President Donald Trump’s nearly eight months in office have been characterized by a series of disturbing political developments.
zh: 柏林—美國總統特朗普上臺已經將近八個月了，這段時間伴隨著一系列令人不安的政治發展趨勢。

en: But Trump is not entirely to blame.
zh: 但不能將錯誤全部歸於特朗普。

en: His presidency is just the latest act in a long-running political tragedy.
zh: 他的總統生涯只是漫長的政治悲劇的最新一幕。

en: From a foreign-policy perspective, the problem began in the 1990s, when the United States squandered the post-Cold War peace dividend.
zh: 從外交政策角度，問題始於20世紀90年代，美國肆意揮霍冷戰後的和平紅利。

en: With regard to domestic policy, the failures began even earlier: from Reaganomics in the 1980s to Obamacare in the 2010s, major policies have often overpromised and underperformed, while failing to address underlying problems.
zh: 在國內政策方面，失敗要開始得更早：從20世紀80年代的里根經濟學到21世紀10年代的奧巴馬醫保，重大政策總是承諾過多、兌現過少，同時，根本性問題也沒有得到解決。

en: Of course, US politicians are rarely short on lofty rhetoric – from Ronald Reagan’s “Morning in America” campaign to Barack Obama’s “Yes, we can” slogan to Donald Trump’s “America First” refrain.
zh: 當然，美國政客並不缺少高尚的言辭 — — 從里根的“美國早晨”運動到奧巴馬的“是的，我們能”的口號，再到特朗普的“美國優先”信條，莫不如是。

en: And, beginning with John F. Kennedy, presidents have likened the US to a “city upon a hill” – an example to the rest of the world.
zh: 而從肯尼迪開始，諸任美國總統都將美國稱為“山巔之城 ” — —是世界其他國家的榜樣。

en: Yet it is hard to remember the last time the US produced a policy that could serve as a model for others to emulate.
zh: 但上一次美國拿出能夠作為其他國家效仿榜樣的政策是什麼時候，已經很難讓人記起了。

en: The country has not had a pro-active, forward-looking government since the 1960s.
zh: 自20世紀60年代以來，這個國家就再也沒有出現過積極主動、遠見卓識的政府。

en: Since the 1990s, it has not invested sufficiently in human capital to meet the fast-changing economy’s shifting skill requirements; undertaken no effective education, environmental, or labor-market reforms; and launched no new urban initiatives or future-proofing infrastructure policies.
zh: 自20世紀90年代以來，它也沒有對人力資本進行足夠的投資以滿足日新月異的經濟不斷變化的技能要求；沒有實施有效的教育、環境和勞動力市場改革；也沒有制定出新的城市建設計劃或面向未來的基礎設施政策。

en: The list goes on.
zh: 這個清單可以一直列下去。

en: The reason is simple: Americans’ longstanding suspicion of “big government” morphed into a kind of political self-hatred, with policymakers and citizens alike led to believe that government is at its best when it does not govern.
zh: 原因很簡單：長期以來，美國人一直對“大政府”持狐疑態度，這演變為一種政治自恨（self-hatred ） ， 不管是決策者還是公民，都相信政府不管政，才是最好的。

en: And, as the US government has retreated from society, the US has retreated from the rest of the world.
zh: 而隨著美國政府從社會中撤出，美國也從世界其他地區撤出。

en: These trends have culminated in Trump, whose most popular policies focus on destruction, rather than creation.
zh: 這些趨勢在特朗普上任後達到了頂峰，他最受民眾支援的政策集中在“毀”而不是“建”上。

en: Deregulation will supposedly slay the “deep state” chimera, while enabling the US to achieve energy independence.
zh: 去監管化可能扼殺“深度國家 ” （ deep state）的空想，儘管它也可能讓美國實現能源獨立。

en: A US-centered foreign policy focused not on reshaping America’s role in the world, but on reducing it.
zh: 以美國為中心的外交政策不注重美國在世界中的角色，而是以削弱這一角色為重點。

en: From the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare) to the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) policy, Trump likes to reverse past policies, without devising anything to replace them.
zh: 從平價醫療法（奧巴馬醫保）到暫緩遣返青少年（DACA）政策，特朗普想要扭轉過去的政策，但沒有拿出任何取而代之的政策。

en: American conservatives have so far failed to read Trump’s intentions accurately.
zh: 到目前為止，美國保守派沒能正確解讀特朗普的意圖。

en: In July, Robert W. Merry wrote that Trump had “yet to score anything approaching a serious legislative victory – or to demonstrate any serious political momentum.”
zh: 7月，羅伯特·梅里（Robert W. Merry）寫道，特朗普“在取得重大立法勝利方面還沒有任何得分 — — 也沒有表現出任何重大政治動能。

en: But the truth is that Trump’s agenda has plenty of momentum; it is just focused on demolishing Obama’s legacy.
zh: ”但真相是特朗普的日程充滿了動能；只不過它的重點是摧毀奧巴馬的遺產。

en: As the international law expert Richard Falk has argued, it is Trump’s “demagoguery” that enables this approach, as it “blinds adherents to their true material self-interests and misidentifies their real social enemies.”
zh: 國際法專家理查德·福爾克（Richard Falk）指出，特朗普的“蠱惑”成就了這一方針，它“讓追隨者對真正的物質自我利益視而不見，混淆了他們的真正的社會敵人。

en: Trump’s rejection of “reasoned discourse, including commitments to truth and evidence,” has been accompanied by an unlimited “capacity to manipulate mass opinion and play on such repressed emotions as racism and class envy.”
zh: ”特朗普拒絕“理性的討論，包括對真相和證據的評論 ” ， 是伴隨著無限的“操縱大眾觀點、利用種族主義和階級仇恨等壓抑的情緒的能力 ” 。

en: The result of Trump’s approach is that America’s existing problems are worsening and huge opportunities are being missed.
zh: 特朗普的方針的結果，是美國現有問題不斷惡化，重大機遇被白白浪費。

en: But what can stop demons already unleashed?
zh: 但什麼才能阻止已經被釋放出來的魔鬼？

en: And, even if they are stopped, can the damage they have already wrought be reversed?
zh: 即使這些魔鬼被阻止，它們已經造成的傷害能夠逆轉嗎？

en: There was some backlash against Trump when he failed to condemn clearly the white supremacist demonstrators in Charlottesville, Virginia, whose “Unite the Right” rally in August ended with the murder of a counter-protester.
zh: 當特朗普沒有明確地譴責弗吉尼亞州夏洛特維爾（Charlottesville）的白人至上主義示威者時，他遭到了一些“炮轟 ” 。 這些白人至上主義者在8月份舉行了“聯合右翼”的示威，最終導致一位反示威人士被殺。

en: But it has done little to weaken Trump’s destructive momentum: just a few weeks later, Trump announced his plan to end DACA, a policy that protected from deportation some 800,000 young immigrants who were brought to the US as children.
zh: 但特朗普的破壞動能並未就此削弱：不出幾周，特朗普就宣佈他計劃取消DACA。 DACA是一項保護在青少年時代被帶到美國的800,000年輕移民不受遣返的政策。

en: Beyond lamenting the astonishing depths to which a great political culture and system can fall, what can be done?
zh: 除了哀嘆一套偉大的政治文化和制度能夠墮落如斯，我們還能做些什麼？

en: One obvious option, which Democrats largely seem to be taking, is to reject Trump and everything his administration stands for.
zh: 一個顯而易見的選擇 — — 民主黨也大多在這麼做 — — 是拒絕特朗普和他的政府的一切立場。

en: But that risks ensuring the persistence of the dysfunctional dynamics that brought the US to this point.
zh: 但這有可能導致把美國帶到這一步的僵局持久化。

en: Another option, however unappealing at first glance, is to accept the Trump administration.
zh: 另一個選項 — — 咋看上去，這個選項毫無吸引力可言 — — 是接受特朗普政府。

en: The result of such a choice may well be the worsening of domestic problems and the weakening of checks and balances.
zh: 這一選擇的結果很可能是國內問題惡化、制衡被削弱。

en: But it is also possible that checks and balances will hold until the next election, enabling America’s existing political parties to rebuild and new parties to emerge.
zh: 但也有可能，制衡能夠維持到下一次選舉，讓美國現有政黨獲得重建、新的政黨得到湧現。

en: The result, one hopes, would be a much-needed political realignment – indeed, a political renaissance.
zh: 我們希望，結果將是急需的政治整頓 — — 事實上，是政治文藝復興。

en: To be sure, such a shift would take time – time that, depending on how long Trump remains in office, parties may not have.
zh: 誠然，這樣的改變需要時間，而政黨可能並沒有這麼長的時間 — — 取決於特朗普將執政多久。

en: Republicans may be politically handicapped for years, as they are forced to reckon with the Faustian bargain they struck for the sake of political power.
zh: 共和黨可能會在多年的時間裡在政治上一蹶不振，因為他們將被迫為了政治權力，而進行魔鬼交易。

en: Democrats, for their part, face a broad leadership vacuum and a lack of political vision, owing to their now-internalized fear of being labeled “big spenders.”
zh: 至於民主黨，他們面臨著廣泛的領導力真空，也缺少政治願景，因為他們現在有一種源自內心的對“大手大腳花錢”標籤的恐懼。

en: And, as it stands, no third parties or candidates provide reasonable alternatives.
zh: 而從目前看，沒有第三黨或候選人能夠拿出合理的替代方案。

en: Nonetheless, there are encouraging signs that some Republicans and Democrats are thinking outside the party box.
zh: 儘管如此，有令人鼓舞的訊號表明，一些共和黨和民主黨正在跳出黨派的桎梏考慮問題。

en: More must follow suit, recognizing that realigning the existing party system may be the only way to break the stalemate of US politics and, potentially, reverse decades of dangerous democratic underperformance.
zh: 必須有更多的人加入他們，認識到重整現有政黨制度可能是打破美國政治僵局並從根本上扭轉幾十年來國內表現低迷的危險趨勢的唯一辦法。

en: The next act in America’s political drama, following the 2018 congressional midterm election, could be marked by a kind of reckoning, with the 2020 presidential campaign accompanied by civic breakdown and the escalation of violent confrontation that has lingered beneath the surface for years.
zh: 美國戲劇的下一幕 — — 2018年國會中期選舉 — — 可能將標誌著某種深思，而2020年總統選戰將伴隨著已經在地下發酵多年的民眾決裂和暴力衝突升級。

en: To rewrite the plot before that scenario plays out requires reshuffling and revitalizing US politics, so that, in the words of the poet Seamus Heaney, “hope and history rhyme” once again in America.
zh: 在這一情景成為現實之前重寫劇本需要對美國政治徹底洗牌，讓其獲得重生，從而，用詩人西莫斯·希尼（Seamus Heaney）的話說 ， “ 希望和歷史的韻腳”再次在美國迴盪。

en: American Power in the Twenty-First Century
zh: 二十一世紀的美國實力

en: CAMBRIDGE – The United States government’s National Intelligence Council projects that American dominance will be “much diminished” by 2025, and that the one key area of continued American superiority – military power – will be less significant in the increasingly competitive world of the future.
zh: 坎布里奇 — — 美國政府國家情報委員會預測到2025年美國的優勢將“大幅度削弱 ” ， 而美國賴以保持其優勢的關鍵領域 — — 軍事實力 — — 其重要性也將在未來競爭日趨激烈的世界格局中有所降低。

en: Russian President Dmitri Medvedev has called the 2008 financial crisis a sign that America’s global leadership is coming to an end.
zh: 俄羅斯總統德米特里·梅德韋傑夫稱2008年金融危機標誌著美國全球領導地位的結束。

en: The leader of Canada’s opposition Liberal Party, Michael Ignatieff, suggests that US power has passed its mid-day.
zh: 加拿大反對派自由黨領導人邁克爾·伊格納季耶夫則認為美國權力的鼎盛期已經過去。

en: How can we know if these predictions are correct?
zh: 我們怎樣才能知道這些預測是否準確呢？

en: One should beware of misleading metaphors of organic decline.
zh: 人們應當警惕全方位衰退的誤導性比喻。

en: Countries are not like humans with predictable life spans.
zh: 國家畢竟不同於壽命可以預測的人類個體。

en: For example, after Britain lost its American colonies at the end of the eighteenth century, Horace Walpole lamented Britain’s reduction to “as insignificant a country as Denmark or Sardinia.”
zh: 例如，當英國在十八世紀末失去美洲殖民地後，霍勒斯·沃波爾曾哀嘆英國已淪落到“像丹麥或撒丁島一樣微不足道 ” 。

en: He failed to foresee that the industrial revolution would give Britain a second century of even greater ascendency.
zh: 但他沒有能夠預測到工業革命將使英國在接下來的世紀中統治地位更加穩固。

en: Rome remained dominant for more than three centuries after the apogee of Roman power.
zh: 羅馬帝國在登上權力頂峰後依然延續了三個多世紀的統治。

en: Even then, Rome did not succumb to another state, but suffered a death of a thousand cuts inflicted by various barbarian tribes.
zh: 即使到最後，羅馬也沒有向另外一個國家屈服，而是在被野蠻部落蹂躪得千瘡百孔後最終走上了滅亡的道路。

en: Indeed, for all the fashionable predictions of China, India, or Brazil surpassing the US in the coming decades, the classical transition of power among great states may be less of a problem than the rise of modern barbarians – non-state actors.
zh: 實際上，雖然未來十年內中國、印度或巴西將超越美國的預言盛極一時，但在大國間實現傳統權力轉換的問題或許比不上現代蠻族（非國家勢力）的崛起。

en: In an information-based world of cyber-insecurity, power diffusion may be a greater threat than power transition.
zh: 在以資訊為基礎但缺乏網路安全的世界裡，權力分散的威脅可能大於權力的轉移。

en: So, what will it mean to wield power in the global information age of the twenty-first century?
zh: 那麼，在全球資訊時代的二十一世紀行使權力將意味著什麼？

en: What resources will produce power?
zh: 哪些資源能夠帶來權力？

en: In the sixteenth century, control of colonies and gold bullion gave Spain the edge; seventeenth-century Holland profited from trade and finance; eighteenth-century France gained from its larger population and armies; and nineteenth-century British power rested on its industrial primacy and its navy.
zh: 十六世紀，對殖民地和金條的控制賦予西班牙競爭優勢，十七世紀的荷蘭從貿易和金融中獲利，十八世紀的法國依託龐大的人口和軍隊，而十九世紀英國的力量則來自於它獨一無二的工業地位和海軍。

en: Conventional wisdom has always held that the state with the largest military prevails, but in an information age it may be the state (or non-state) with the best story that wins.
zh: 傳統智慧一直認為軍隊規模最大的國家將會勝出，但在資訊時代獲勝的也許是最會講故事的國家（或非國家 ） 。

en: Today, it is far from clear how the balance of power is measured, much less how to develop successful survival strategies.
zh: 今天，仍然沒有明確的方法來衡量權力的平衡，更不必說如何制定成功的生存戰略了。

en: In his inaugural address in 2009, President Barack Obama stated that “our power grows through its prudent use; our security emanates from the justness of our cause, the force of our example, the tempering qualities of humility and restraint.”
zh: 在2009年的就職演說中，巴拉克·奧巴馬總統提出“我們的力量來自審慎地使用手中的權力；我們的安全來自正義的事業、榜樣的力量、以及謙卑和剋制的調和作用。

en: Shortly thereafter, Secretary of State Hillary Clinton said, “America cannot solve the most pressing problems on our own, and the world cannot solve them without America.
zh: ”其後不久，希拉里·克林頓國務卿也說 ， “ 美國僅憑一己之力無法解決最急迫的問題，而沒有美國的參與世界也無法解決這些問題。

en: We must use what has been called ‘smart power,’ the full range of tools at our disposal.”
zh: 我們必須充分利用所謂的‘明智的權力 ’ ， 利用能夠為我們所用的一切工具。

en: Smart power means the combination of the hard power of command and the soft power of attraction.
zh: ”明智的權力意味著將命令的硬實力和吸引的軟實力結合在一起。

en: Power always depends on context.
zh: 實力總與所處的環境脫不了干係。

en: The child who dominates on the playground may become a laggard when the context changes to a disciplined classroom.
zh: 在操場上呼風喚雨的孩子在循規蹈矩的教室則可能成為一名落後份子。

en: In the middle of the twentieth century, Josef Stalin scornfully asked how many divisions the Pope had, but four decades later, the Papacy was still intact while Stalin’s empire had collapsed.
zh: 二十世紀中期，約瑟夫·斯大林曾輕蔑地詢問教皇管轄幾個師，而四十年後，教皇制度依然完好無損，而斯大林的帝國卻已經分崩離析。

en: In today’s world, the distribution of power varies with the context.
zh: 當今世界，隨著環境的不同權力的分配也在發生變化。

en: It is distributed in a pattern that resembles a three-dimensional chess game.
zh: 權力分配的模式酷似一場三維棋局。

en: On the top chessboard, military power is largely unipolar, and the US is likely to remain the only superpower for some time.
zh: 在棋局的最上層，軍事實力基本將維持單極格局，而美國在一段時間內很可能仍會是唯一的超級大國。

en: But on the middle chessboard, economic power has already been multi-polar for more than a decade, with the US, Europe, Japan, and China as the major players, and others gaining in importance.
zh: 但在棋局的中層，十多年來經濟實力一直保持著多級化的態勢，美、歐、日、中是四大強國，而其他國家的重要性也日趨增加。

en: The bottom chessboard is the realm of cross-border transactions that occur outside of government control.
zh: 棋局的底層是政府無法控制的跨境交易領域。

en: It includes diverse non-state actors, such as bankers electronically transferring sums larger than most national budgets, and, at the other extreme, terrorists transferring weapons or hackers threatening cyber-security.
zh: 參與其中的有各式各樣的非國家角色，如電子匯款數額高於多數國家預算的銀行家，還有處在另一個極端的運送武器的恐怖分子或威脅網路安全的駭客。

en: It also includes new challenges like pandemics and climate change.
zh: 其中還包括傳染病和氣候變化等全新挑戰。

en: On this bottom board, power is widely dispersed, and it makes no sense to speak of unipolarity, multipolarity, hegemony, or any other cliché.
zh: 在這底層棋局上，實力異常分散，談論單極、多極、霸權或其他陳詞濫調都毫無意義。

en: Even in the aftermath of the financial crisis, the giddy pace of technological change is likely to continue to drive globalization and transnational challenges.
zh: 即便在金融危機發生後，令人目眩的技術發展仍然可能繼續驅動全球化和跨國挑戰。

en: The problem for American power in the twenty-first century is that there are more and more things outside the control of even the most powerful state.
zh: 即便是最強的國家也有越來越多的問題無法控制是二十一世紀美國權力所面臨的問題。

en: Although the US does well on military measures, there is much going on that those measures fail to capture.
zh: 雖然美國在軍事領域成績斐然，但還有很多軍事領域無法涵蓋的問題。

en: Under the influence of the information revolution and globalization, world politics is changing in a way that prevents America from achieving all its international goals acting alone.
zh: 在資訊革命和全球化的影響下，世界政治變化的方式阻礙美國自行其是地實現所有國際目標。

en: For example, international financial stability is vital to Americans’ prosperity, but the US needs the cooperation of others to ensure it.
zh: 例如，國際金融穩定對美國的繁榮至關重要，但美國需要其他國家的配合才能確保國際金融穩定。

en: Global climate change, too, will affect Americans’ quality of life, but the US cannot manage the problem alone.
zh: 全球氣候變化也將影響美國人的生活質量，但美國同樣無法依靠自身力量管理全球氣候。

en: In a world where borders are more porous than ever to everything from drugs to infectious diseases to terrorism, America must help build international coalitions and institutions to address shared threats and challenges.
zh: 在邊境面對毒品、傳染病和恐怖主義變得漏洞百出的世界裡，美國必須協助成立國際聯盟和機構，應對共同面臨的挑戰和威脅。

en: In this sense, power becomes a positive sum game.
zh: 從這個意義上講，權力已經成為一場能產生積極效應的遊戲。

en: It is not enough to think in terms of power over others. One must also think in terms of power to accomplish goals.
zh: 僅從相對於他人的實力角度考慮還遠遠不夠，我們必須考慮到實現目標的實力。

en: On many transnational issues, empowering others can help to accomplish one’s own goals.
zh: 在許多跨境問題上，為他國授權能有助於實現本國的目標。

en: In this world, networks and connectedness become an important source of relevant power.
zh: 在這個世界上，網路和聯絡成為相對實力的重要來源。

en: The problem of American power in the twenty-first century is not one of decline, but of recognizing that even the most powerful country cannot achieve its aims without the help of others.
zh: 二十一世紀美國實力所面臨的問題不是逐漸衰落，而是必須承認即便最強大的國家也無法單槍匹馬實現目標的現實。

en: Abusing Churchill
zh: 濫用丘吉爾

en: NEW YORK – A bronze bust of Winston Churchill, displayed in the White House since the 1960s, has been the object of a continuing right-wing canard in Washington.
zh: 紐約—從20世紀60年代開始，白宮裡擺著一尊丘吉爾的銅像，它是華盛頓一直在流傳的一個右翼謠言的目標。

en: The story goes that when President Barack Obama moved in, he returned the bust to the British Embassy, supposedly signifying his hatred of Britain.
zh: 這個謠言說，奧巴馬總統入主白宮時把這尊銅像還給了英國大使館，以示他對英國的討厭。

en: In fact, Obama did no such thing.
zh: 事實上，奧巴馬根本沒有這麼做過。

en: The bust still stands in the White House Residence, where it always did, except for a short time under President George W. Bush when it was being repaired.
zh: 丘吉爾銅像仍然矗立在在總統官邸，和往常一樣，只不過在小布什期間因為修復需要而離開了一小段時間。

en: But Obama might have done well to remove the bust.
zh: 但奧巴馬移除這尊銅像或許屬於“幹得漂亮”範疇。

en: The cult of Churchill has not been an altogether beneficial one for the United States.
zh: 丘吉爾崇拜對於美國來說有百害而無一利。

en: Too many US presidents fancy themselves Churchill’s true heirs.
zh: 太多美國總統幻想自己是丘吉爾的真正傳人。

en: Bush had a copy of Churchill’s bust, lent to him by Tony Blair, in the Oval Office.
zh: 布什有一尊託尼·布萊爾送的丘吉爾銅像複製品，把它擺在橢圓辦公室裡。

en: He liked to portray himself as a “war president,” a “decider,” and a “great leader,” like Churchill.
zh: 他喜歡自稱“戰時總統 ” 、 “決策者”和“偉大領袖 ” ， 就像丘吉爾那樣。

en: He had a taste for battle dress.
zh: 他也喜歡戎裝。

en: And he got his country into a very foolish war.
zh: 他也讓他的國家陷入了一場極其愚蠢的戰爭。

en: Donald Trump’s British crony, Nigel Farage, the former leader of the UK Independence Party, suggested that Trump should put the bronze bust back in the Oval Office.
zh: 唐納德·特朗普的英國密友、前英國獨立黨領導人尼格爾·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）建議特朗普把這尊銅像迎回橢圓辦公室。

en: Trump thought this was a splendid idea.
zh: 特朗普想這絕對是個好主意。

en: Trump is the least appropriate figure to cast himself in Churchill’s mold.
zh: 特朗普最沒有資格自比丘吉爾。

en: Insofar as he has a coherent position on anything, he is hostile to most of the things that Churchill stood for.
zh: 要說他對什麼東西存在一以貫之的立場，那就是他對於丘吉爾所主張的東西大多懷有敵意。

en: His “America first” posture, standing aloof from Western allies, is exactly the kind of attitude against which Churchill and Franklin D. Roosevelt struggled in order to successfully resist Hitler’s Third Reich.
zh: 他的“美國第一”姿態對於西方盟友冷眼相對，與丘吉爾和富蘭克林·羅斯福為了抵禦希特勒的第三帝國而努力的態度截然相反。

en: The summer before the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, 75 years ago this month, Churchill and Roosevelt met in Placentia Bay, Newfoundland, to set out their ideals for a postwar world.
zh: 日本偷襲珍珠港（75年前的12月）的那年夏天，丘吉爾和羅斯福紐芬蘭島佈雷莎灣（Placentia Bay）會晤，制定了戰後理想世界。

en: The resulting Atlantic Charter included everything Trump seems to be against: lower trade barriers, economic cooperation, and the advancement of social welfare.
zh: 脫胎於此的大西洋憲章囊括了一切特朗普所反對的東西：降低貿易壁壘、經濟合作、推進社會福利。

en: Once Hitler was defeated, Churchill was also a proponent of European unification, even if he remained ambivalent about Britain’s role in the future union.
zh: 打敗希特勒後，丘吉爾又成為歐洲結盟的支持者，即使他對英國在未來的聯盟中的角色態度矛盾。

en: Farage’s campaign for Brexit, often pilfering Churchill’s own wartime rhetoric about Britain’s finest hour in defending freedom against tyranny, was aimed at dismantling the very project Churchill favored.
zh: 法拉奇在宣傳英國脫歐時常常片面地移用丘吉爾本人的戰時修辭，說這是英國反抗暴政、捍衛自由的最佳時刻，而他的目標卻是讓丘吉爾所支援的工程轟然解體。

en: The “special relationship” between the US and Britain, established during WWII, was never as substantial as Churchill and others liked to believe.
zh: 二戰期間建立的美國與英國之間的“特殊關係” 從未向丘吉爾和其他人願意相信的那樣重要。

en: The US, as the dominant postwar power, pursued its own interests, whether the British liked it or not.
zh: 作為戰後主宰力量的美國追求自己的利益，不管英國喜不喜歡。

en: And British pride in standing alone against Nazi Germany, and the self-aggrandizing notion of being America’s special partner, has prevented the United Kingdom from playing to its full strength as a major power inside the EU.
zh: 英國獨力對抗納粹德國的驕傲，及其身為美國特殊夥伴的虛榮阻止了英國全力爭取成為歐盟內部的主要力量。

en: American leaders sometimes pay lip service to the special relationship, to flatter visiting British prime ministers or get the UK onside in dubious military adventures.
zh: 美國領導人有時在嘴上強調這一特殊關係，以奉承到訪的英國首相或讓英國在可疑的軍事行動中站邊。

en: There is talk of giving the relationship a new lease of life in the age of Trump and Brexit.
zh: 有人說，要在特朗普和英國脫歐時代讓這一關係獲得新生。

en: Whereas Obama warned that Britain outside the EU would be at the back of the queue for special trade deals, House Speaker Paul D. Ryan recently stated that the US should quickly make a new deal with Britain to show “solidarity” with an “indispensable ally.”
zh: 奧巴馬警告說，退出歐盟的英國應該在特殊貿易協議佇列中排在最後一個，但眾議院議長保羅·萊恩（Paul D. Ryan）最近表示美國應該迅速與英國簽訂新協議以彰顯與“不可或缺的盟友”的“團結 ” 。

en: A special US tenderness for Brexit Britain – Trump oddly referred to himself as “Mr. Brexit” – rather suggests the solidarity of two countries embarking on their own forms of economic nationalism.
zh: 美國對脫歐的英國的特殊關照 — — 特朗普反常地自稱為“英國脫歐先生 ” — —確實表明了這兩個採取各自經濟民族主義的國家之間的團結。

en: Again, this is precisely the route that Churchill and Roosevelt sought to avoid; after all, economic nationalism was one of the reasons why Europeans almost succeeded in destroying their continent.
zh: 而這亦是丘吉爾和羅斯福肯定會避免的道路；畢竟，經濟民族主義正是歐洲人幾乎毀掉歐洲大陸的原因之一。

en: Of course, Trump’s love of Brexit may be just a question of words, like so much else about the great showman.
zh: 當然，特朗普喜歡英���脫歐也許只是文字遊戲，這位偉大“影帝”最擅長此道。

en: It is hard to imagine the US jeopardizing its economic interests by favoring Britain at the expense of far bigger stakes in the rest of Europe.
zh: 很難想象美國犧牲歐洲其他部分的更大的代價支援英國，甚至不惜有損於自己的經濟利益。

en: But words do matter, as Churchill knew well.
zh: 但文字很重要，丘吉爾深知這一點。

en: Again, the rhetoric of Trump and his supporters, and of the Brexiteers, could not be further removed from the spirit of the Atlantic Charter.
zh: 特朗普及其支持者，以及英國脫歐派的修辭與大西洋憲章的精神完全南轅北轍。

en: Talk of sinister international bankers and other “citizens of nowhere” (British Prime Minister Theresa May’s phrase) undermining, in league with rootless liberal elites, “ordinary,” “real,” and “decent” people (Farage) smacks of the anti-Semitic propaganda that swirled around Europe in the 1930s.
zh: 關於與草根自由派精英 、 “ 普通的 ” 、 “真正的”和“體面的”人（法拉奇）合謀搞破壞的罪惡的國際銀行家和其他“無來處的公民 ” （ 用英國首相梅的話說）的言論很有些20世紀30年代縈繞歐洲的反猶宣傳的味道。

en: And Churchill’s response to the flirtations of Trump and the European far right with Vladimir Putin’s Russia can easily be imagined.
zh: 丘吉爾對於特朗普和歐洲極右翼與普京的俄羅斯眉來眼去會做出如何反應很容易想象。

en: None of this means that Churchill was always right, let alone a figure to emulate.
zh: 所有這些都不意味著丘吉爾永遠是對的，更不是永遠值得效仿的人物。

en: He was the right man in 1940 to raise British morale, when morale was about the only thing the British had going for them.
zh: 他是1940年提升英國人士氣的正確人選，當是時，士氣幾乎是英國人唯一的夥伴。

en: But he is not a good model for politicians in less perilous times.
zh: 但在不那麼危險的時代，他並不是一個很好的政治家榜樣。

en: His views of colonial rule were already out of date before the war, and became a racist anachronism after it.
zh: 他對殖民統治的觀點在戰前就已經不合時宜，戰後他更是堪稱種族主義老古董。

en: His romantic ideas about the moral superiority of the English-speaking peoples were old-fashioned during his lifetime, and are an arrogant absurdity now.
zh: 他關於英語民族道德優越性的浪漫理想在他的時代就已屬於迂腐，從今天看更是一種自大的荒謬。

en: But Churchill was neither petty nor provincial.
zh: 但丘吉爾既非小人，也不是鄉巴佬。

en: His vision, at least as far as the Western world is concerned, may have been romantic, but it had a certain nobility.
zh: 他的願景 — — 至少從西方世界的觀念看 — — 也許是浪漫的，但也有一定的貴族氣質。

en: The same cannot be said of the next occupant of the White House.
zh: 下一任白宮主人絕非如此。

en: The idea of Trump, advised by Farage, using Churchill’s bronze head as a totem would have filled the old man with horror.
zh: 特朗普根據法拉奇的建議用丘吉爾的銅頭像當作圖騰將讓這位老人驚悚不已。

en: American Retreats
zh: 美國的撤退

en: Los Angeles – As Barack Obama’s incoming administration debates the pace and consequences of withdrawal from Iraq, it would do well to examine the strategic impact of other American exits in the final decades of the twentieth century.
zh: 洛杉磯—當即將上任的巴拉克·奧巴馬政府激辯從伊拉克撤軍的速度和後果時，檢查美國20世紀最後幾十年進行其他撤退所產生的戰略影響頗有裨益。

en: Although American commitments to Lebanon, Somalia, Vietnam, and Cambodia differed mightily, history reveals that despite immediate costs to America’s reputation, disengagement ultimately redounded to America’s advantage.
zh: 儘管美國在黎巴嫩，索馬利亞，越南和柬埔寨分別履行了千差萬別的責任，歷史顯示撤出上述地區雖然會立刻影響美國的聲譽，但是最終還是對美國有益。

en: In all of these cases, regional stability of sorts emerged after an American military withdrawal, albeit at the cost of a significant loss of life.
zh: 所有這些案例在美國撤軍之後都出現了某種地區穩定，雖然是以損失大量生命為代價獲得的。

en: America’s former adversaries either became preoccupied with consolidating or sharing power, suffered domestic defeat, or confronted neighboring states.
zh: 美國原來的敵人不是全力關注鞏固或瓜分權力，遭受國內失敗，就是對陣鄰國。

en: Ultimately, America’s vital interests prevailed.
zh: 最後，美國的切身利益將會勝出。

en: The evidence today suggests that this pattern can be repeated when the United States departs Mesopotamia and leaves Iraqis to define their own fate.
zh: 今日的證據表明，當美國離開美索不達米亞，讓伊拉克人決定他們自己命運的時候，將會再現同樣的模式。

en: Of the four withdrawals, arguably the 1982-1984 American intervention in Lebanon marks the closest parallel to Iraq today.
zh: 在四次撤退中，1982年至1984年美國介入黎巴嫩被論證為和今天介入伊拉克最為相似。

en: A country torn by sectarian violence beginning in 1975, Lebanon pitted an even more complex array of contestants against each other than Iraq does today.
zh: 1975年開始的派別之爭撕裂了黎巴嫩，這個國家陷入比今日的伊拉克更復雜的派別敵對之中。 ，

en: Into this fray stepped the US and its Western allies. Their objective was to create a military buffer between the PLO and Israeli forces that were then fighting in Beirut in order to promote the departure of both.
zh: 美國和它的西方盟友介入了這場衝突，目標是在激戰的巴解組織和以色列軍隊之間建立軍事緩衝區，從而促進雙方撤軍。

en: The massacres in Palestinian refugee camps prompted a new commitment to “restore a strong and central government” to Lebanon, to quote President Ronald Reagan.
zh: 發生在巴勒斯坦難民營裡的屠殺又促成了一個新任務，用羅納德·里根總統的話來說，就是“為黎巴嫩重建一個強大的中央政府 ” 。

en: But the result of intervention was that US forces became just one more target, culminating in the 1983 bombing of a US Marine barracks that killed 241 American soldiers.
zh: 但介入的結果是美軍也成了目標，以1983年一座海軍營房被炸而告終，共有241名士兵在爆炸中喪生。

en: A similar suicide bombing two days later claimed the lives of 58 French soldiers.
zh: 兩天後，同樣的自殺式爆炸致使58名法軍士兵喪命。

en: In February 1984, facing a quagmire, Reagan acceded to Vice President George H.W. Bush’s recommendation to get out of Lebanon.
zh: 1984年2月，面對困境的里根同意了副總統喬治·H·W·布什的建議從黎巴嫩撤軍。

en: But the withdrawal of Western forces did not stop the fighting.
zh: 但西方軍隊的退出並沒有讓戰爭結束。

en: The civil war continued for another six years, followed by a bumpy political aftermath: Syrian intervention and expulsion (two decades later), as the Lebanese defined their own fate with the US exercising only background influence.
zh: 內戰又持續了六年，然後是棘手的政治後果：敘利亞介入並(在20年後)撤出，黎巴嫩人決定自己的命運，美國則只施加幕後影響。

en: In 1992, the sirens of Somalia’s political collapse lured the US into another civil war to save a country from itself.
zh: 1992年，索馬利亞政治崩盤的警報致使美國介入另一場內戰來拯救一個國家。

en: The US humanitarian mission to that benighted country sought to salvage a failed United Nations enterprise to secure and feed Somalia’s ravaged population.
zh: 美國在那個黑暗國家中的人道主義使命致力於完成聯合國已經破產的任務，對索馬利亞被劫掠的人民實施保護，提供食品。

en: The US committed 28,000 troops, which for a time imposed a modicum of security.
zh: 美國調遣了28000名成員的部隊，暫時還能勉強維持和平。

en: But ill-equipped and poorly led UN replacement forces for the American presence put the remaining US troops in the bull’s eye as they attempted to bring to justice the Somali warlord responsible for the death of Pakistani peacekeepers.
zh: 但是代替美軍的聯合國部隊裝備不佳，指揮混亂，結果當剩下的美軍試圖把該為巴基斯坦維和部隊成員死亡負責的索馬利亞軍閥繩之以法的時候，他們遭受了攻擊。

en: The ensuing bloodbath of US soldiers generated images that the American public could not stomach, prompting the exit of American and then UN forces.
zh: 美軍士兵之後的大屠殺樹立起美國公眾難以接受的形象，迫使美國軍隊和聯合國部隊先後撤軍。

en: As unrest mounted with these military retreats, offshore US forces monitored and intercepted jihadists who sought to enter Somalia, while Kenya and Ethiopia blocked the unrest from metastasizing across the region.
zh: 軍事撤退之後騷亂增加，國外的美軍對那些試圖進入索馬利亞的傑哈德聖戰者進行監視和攔截，肯亞和衣索比亞則防止騷亂越過這一地區向外轉移。

en: In 2006, the capture of Somalia’s capital, Mogadishu, by the Islamic Courts raised the specter of a jihadist state.
zh: 2006年，索馬利亞首都被伊斯蘭法院聯盟佔領，人們擔心會一個傑哈德聖戰者國家會由此出現。

en: But Somalia soon demonstrated that quagmires can be a two-way street.
zh: 但是索馬利亞很快顯示困境也有兩條路。

en: Following Ethiopia’s intervention, the Islamists found themselves out of power.
zh: 在衣索比亞的干預下，伊斯蘭分子發現他們被權力摒棄在外。

en: Today, Somalia remains a dysfunctional state, as rival clans, jihadists, and an interim government with Ethiopian support compete for power.
zh: 今天，索馬利亞依然是個混亂不堪運轉不靈的國家，敵對的部族，傑哈德聖戰者，和衣索比亞支援的過渡政府彼此爭權奪利。

en: The US, now out of the quagmire, exercises limited influence from afar.
zh: 擺脫泥潭的美國現在只在遠處施加有限的影響。

en: While Lebanon and Somalia remain damaged and failed states, respectively, regional and domestic factors have cauterized the consequences of America’s retreat from Vietnam and Southeast Asia. The result is the stable region that the world sees today.
zh: 當黎巴嫩和索馬利亞依然滿目瘡痍，毫無進步的時候，越南和東南亞自身的地區和國內因素則緩和了美國撤軍的後果—即今天世界看到的這個局勢穩定的地區。

en: But the US saw things very differently in the 1960’s, when the ghosts of Munich hovered over Vietnam’s jungles.
zh: 但在慕尼黑的幽靈盤旋在越南叢林中的1960年代，美國看到的東西可是大不一樣。

en: As President George W. Bush argued about the war in Iraq, US President Lyndon Johnson predicted that defeat in Vietnam “would be renewed in one country and then another.”
zh: 就像喬治·W·布什為伊拉克戰爭所做的辯護一樣，美國總統林登·約翰遜預測說在越南的失敗“將在一個國家，然後又一個國家裡重現 ” 。

en: What Johnson failed to foresee were the domestic and regional constraints that would prevent the dominos from falling in the way he predicted.
zh: 約翰遜沒有預測到的是某些國內和區域內的限制因素，這些因素將會阻止多米諾骨牌按他預計的方式滑落。

en: Although the US bombed northeastern Cambodia intensely throughout the Vietnam War years, it had no stomach for a ground commitment there.
zh: 雖然在整個越南戰爭期間，美國對柬埔寨的東北方狂轟亂炸，卻沒有胃口展開地面行動。

en: Still within congressional restraints, the Nixon administration attempted to bolster Cambodia’s military government.
zh: 還是在國會的限制內，尼克松政府試圖支援柬埔寨軍政府。

en: But, despite modest material support, the US could not sustain a government that could not sustain itself.
zh: 但是，雖然提供了一定的物質元祖，美國無力維繫一個不能維繫自身的政府。

en: Rather than the dominos falling following America’s retreat from Saigon in 1975, a Vietnam-Cambodian War ensued.
zh: 1975年美國從西貢撤軍後，多米諾骨牌沒有滑落，反而爆發了越南和柬埔寨之間的戰爭。

en: This in turn stimulated China’s unsuccessful intervention in North Vietnam.
zh: 隨後這又促使中國對北越展開不成功的干涉。

en: The withdrawal by all of these invading armies to the recognized international boundaries demonstrated that nationalist forces were dominant in the region, not communist solidarity.
zh: 所有這些侵略軍隊撤回到國際承認的邊界線顯示出這個地區佔優勢的是民族主義者的力量，而不是共產主義者的團結。

en: None of these American exits was without consequence.
zh: 沒有任何一次美國撤軍是不產生後果的。

en: But, while the US suffered costs to its reputation around the world, the supposed advantages from this for America’s opponents proved illusory.
zh: 但是，當美國承受在世界範圍內聲名掃地的代價時，認為美國的敵人會從中獲益已經證明是虛幻的。

en: America’s departure from Mesopotamia will likewise put the burden of problem solving onto Iraqis and other regional players, leaving the US offshore to assist when and where it deems appropriate.
zh: 美國撤離美索不達米亞也會同樣把解決問題的負擔交給伊拉克人和其他該地區的博弈者，美國的海外軍隊則會在合適的時間和地點介入其中。

en: History suggests that, in fits and starts, Iraq, like Vietnam and Lebanon, will find itself able to sort out its own affairs.
zh: 歷史表明，在起起伏伏之間，伊拉克將會如同越南和黎巴嫩一樣，發現自己能夠處理自身的事務。

en: Gun Nation
zh: 槍之國

en: NEW YORK – Defending the right of United States citizens to buy semi-automatic rifles or carry concealed weapons is akin to denying any human responsibility for climate change.
zh: 紐約—捍衛美國公民購買半自動步槍或攜帶隱蔽武器與否認人類需要為氣候變化負任何責任異曲同工。

en: Rational arguments are not the point.
zh: 重點不是理性辯論。

en: No matter how many schoolchildren are gunned down or what the scientific evidence may be for the effects of carbon dioxide emissions, people will not change beliefs that define their identity.
zh: 有多少學生倒在槍口下或者有多少科學證據證明二氧化碳排放的影響並不重要，人類不會改變決定了他們的身份的信念。

en: It follows, then, that the more liberals from New York or San Francisco, or indeed Houston, agitate for ways to control the sale of guns to civilians, the harder proponents of the right to own lethal weapons will fight back.
zh: 據此，越多來自紐約或舊金山的自由派，或者真的有來自休斯頓的自由派，鼓吹控制向公民出售槍支，支援擁有殖民武器的權利的人就越難反駁。

en: They will often do so with the zeal of religious believers who feel that their God has been offended.
zh: 他們常常以宗教信徒的狂熱來進行反駁，就像感到自己的神祇被攻擊了那樣。

en: Collective identities have a history, of course.
zh: 當然，集體身份有其歷史。

en: The US Constitution’s Second Amendment, which guarantees the right to keep and bear arms, was adopted in 1791, when citizens who had rebelled against the British monarchy thought they needed to protect themselves, if called upon, against an oppressive state.
zh: 保證持有和攜帶武器的權利的美國憲法第二修正案實施於1791年，當時，起義反抗英國君主的公民認為他們需要在被召喚的情況下保護自己，對抗壓迫的國家。

en: Interpretation of this amendment has been contested terrain, but the original idea was that citizen militias should be armed.
zh: 對這一修正案的解讀一直是爭議領域，但最初的思想是公民子弟兵應該得到武裝。

en: For many Americans, especially in rural areas and in the southern states, this collective entitlement became akin to a God-given individual right.
zh: 對很多美國人，特別是農村地區和南方州的美國人來說，這一集體權利好比是天賦個人權利。

en: Demagogues have had great success pitting such people against coastal and urban elites who supposedly want to strip them of this right.
zh: 鼓動家在煽動這些人反對沿海和城市精英方面取得了巨大的成功，說沿海和城市精英想要剝奪他們的權利。

en: The fear that demagogues exploit is rooted in more than a shared taste for hunting, or a notion of self-defense.
zh: 鼓動家所利用的恐懼不僅僅包括狩獵的共同愛好或自衛概念。

en: It is about who people think they are.
zh: 這其中還牽涉到人們認為他們到底是誰。

en: Take away their gun rights, and they would feel culturally and socially annihilated.
zh: 取消了他們的持槍權，他們就會感到在文化和社會上被“廢掉 ” 。

en: But if this is the core of many Americans’ identity, it points to an odd contradiction in their national self-image.
zh: 但如果這就是許多美國人的身份的核心的話，就引出了他們的國家自我形象的一個矛盾之處。

en: The Second Amendment is of course a legal concept.
zh: 第二修正案當然是一個法律概念。

en: In a way, that is true of the US itself.
zh: 從某種角度，美國本身也是一個法律概念。

en: As a country of immigrants, the US is not based on shared ancestry or culture.
zh: 作為一個移民國家，美國不是基於共同的祖先或文化。

en: It is based on laws – the only way a people from so many different cultural backgrounds could be bound together in a common enterprise.
zh: 它基於法律 — — 這也是一個由不同文化背景的人組成的民族能夠凝聚成一個共同體的唯一辦法。

en: No wonder, then, that there are so many lawyers in the US, and why Americans are more litigious than, say, the Japanese, who rely more on customs and traditions.
zh: 因此，毫不奇怪美國有如此多的律師，也毫不奇怪為何美國人比更依賴習俗和傳統的額日本人更喜歡訴訟。

en: If the US can be said to have a civic religion, the Constitution is its holy writ.
zh: 如果說美國有什麼民間信仰的話，那麼憲法就是這一信仰的聖經。

en: And that is precisely how conservatives treat the foundational laws, including the Second Amendment.
zh: 而保守派就是這麼對待包括第二修正案在內的根本大法的。

en: At the same time, however, many Americans cherish national myths, no less foundational in their way, which are in direct opposition to the idea of a nation of laws.
zh: 但與此同時，許多美國人也同時在根本上珍視國家神話，這些神話與法律之國的思想直接衝突。

en: In classical Westerns, the true American hero is the rugged gunslinger, the outlaw who knows right from wrong in his gut, the freedom-loving rambler who rides into the sunset on his trusted horse, a rifle slung across his shoulders.
zh: 在經典西部片中，真正的美國英雄是粗獷的槍手，憑內心區分對錯的不法之徒，熱愛的自由的流浪者，騎著心愛的坐騎走向夕陽，肩上扛著一杆步槍。

en: John Wayne arrives to save the citizens from the bad guys in black suits whose nefarious deeds undermine the liberty of the American frontier.
zh: 約翰·韋恩（John Wayne）拯救黎民於身穿黑衣、無惡不作、妨礙美國西部的自由的山賊之手。

en: But who are those villains dressed in black?
zh: 但身穿黑衣的反派都有誰？

en: They are bankers, lawyers, businessmen, and railroad builders, often representing the interests of powerful figures in the big cities on the East Coast.
zh: 他們中有銀行家、律師、商人和鐵路建造商，常常代表東海岸大城市權勢人物的利益。

en: They employ fighting men of their own, to be sure, but the black-suited men come from a world of contracts, treaties, and big government.
zh: 誠然，他們僱用打手充當家兵，但這些黑衣人都來自契約、條約和大政府的世界。

en: The story of most Westerns is of a wide-open rural idyll, where man has found perfect autonomy, threatened by a state ruled by man-made laws.
zh: 大部分西部片的故事是一曲開放的田園牧歌，人在其中找到完美的自主權，而威脅這個田園牧歌的則是由人造法律治理的國家。

en: The only laws the Western hero respects are those laid down by God and his own conscience. And he badly needs his gun to defend them.
zh: 西部英雄所尊重的唯一的法律由上帝和他自己的良心寫就，而他急需要槍來捍衛它們。

en: The problem with the American myth is that this rural idyll of perfect individual liberty, this state of nature, as it were, cannot possibly be maintained in a highly organized state of banks, courts, business corporations, and legislatures.
zh: 美國神話的問題在於這一完美個體自由的田園牧歌，這自然的狀態，無法在一個高度組織的銀行、法庭、商業公司和立法機關的國家中存在。

en: The Second Amendment is a sop to the myth, disguised by the fact that it is also encoded as law.
zh: 第二修正案便是對這一神話的討好，而披著法律的外衣。

en: Ronald Reagan understood the mythical yearning of many Americans better than most presidents, perhaps because he had acted in a number of Westerns himself.
zh: 里根比大部分總統都更能明白許多美國人對神話的嚮往，這也許是因為他本人演過很多西部角色。

en: When he famously proclaimed that “government is not the solution to our problem, government is our problem,” he was talking like a gunslinger, even though he was officially speaking as the newly installed US president.
zh: 他有一句名言 ： “ 政府不是問題的解決方案，政府就是問題。 ”說這番話的時候，他就像是一個持槍俠客，儘管他是以新任美國總統的身份在做正式講話。

en: In a far coarser and more belligerent way, Donald Trump has followed Reagan’s example.
zh: 特朗普則以更粗俗和挑釁的方式效仿了里根的例子。

en: In fact, he really is a kind of outlaw, with no use for norms of civility in government.
zh: 事實上，他是真正的法外之徒，在政府中完全不講禮儀規範。

en: In many ways, Trump has managed to combine the habits of a desperado with the interests of the men dressed in black suits, the corporate leaders, the bankers, and their political representatives in Washington.
zh: 從很多方面看，特朗普成功地將暴徒的習慣同黑衣人 — — 企業領袖、銀行家和他們在華盛頓的政治代表的利益結合起來。

en: Trump is a New York hustler who can tap into the fears of Bible Belt gun-lovers.
zh: 特朗普是一個紐約騙子，能夠利用聖經地帶（Bible Belt）槍支熱愛者的恐懼。

en: If the US is riven by an escalating culture war over its national identity, Trump has the uncanny ability of personifying the worst aspects of both sides of the divide: the lawlessness of the gunslinger and the rapaciousness of the city slicker.
zh: 如果美國因為關於國家身份的文化戰爭升級而撕裂，那麼特朗普擁有不可思議的將分裂雙方最糟糕的特點人格化的能力：持槍俠客的目無法紀和城市騙子的強取豪奪。

en: To overcome the dangerous fissures that are tearing its society apart, the US must find a president who can bridge the cultural divide.
zh: 要彌合正在撕裂社會的危險的裂紋，美國必須找到一位能夠連線缺口的總統。

en: Alas, it could not have chosen a man less suited to the task.
zh: 可惜，沒有位元朗普更不適合這個任務的人了。

en: My Apology Tour
zh: 我的道歉之旅

en: STOWE, VERMONT – American presidents are supposed to take America’s side when dealing with other countries.
zh: 斯托，佛蒙特州—美國總統理應在於其他國家打交道時，站在美國的一邊。

en: When Barack Obama was (falsely) accused of starting his term with a Middle East “apology tour,” it was understood that apologizing to foreigners would have been a bad thing, if true.
zh: 奧巴馬開始其中東“道歉之旅”時，被（錯誤）的指責，人們認為向外國人道歉是一件壞事（如果是真的話 ） 。

en: Now Donald Trump is being heavily criticized for failing to take the side of his own intelligence services and law enforcement agencies when their findings about his friend, Russian President Vladimir Putin, ran counter to what Putin assured him.
zh: 現在，特朗普因為不支援自己的情報部門和執法機構所提供的關於他的朋友俄羅斯總統普京的情報，而是相信普金對他做出的保證，而受到口誅筆伐。

en: But while US presidents are not supposed to apologize for their country, nothing says that professors can’t.
zh: 但即便美國總統不應該為他的國家道歉，教授則沒有這些禁忌。

en: Here goes:
zh: 我來倒一次歉：

en: Dear World: Not all Americans pay attention to foreign affairs.
zh: 情愛的世界：不是所有美國人都關注外交事務。

en: But presuming to speak on behalf of many who do: we are abjectly remorseful for inflicting Trump on you.
zh: 但斗膽代表許多關心國際事務的美國人說：我們萬分懊悔讓你碰到了特朗普。

en: We hope you still believe that America is better than this; will try to remain patient until this bizarre historical episode passes; and, when it does end, will join us in rebuilding an open and cooperative rules-based world order.
zh: 我們希望你仍然相信這不是美國的最好狀態；我們希望你能保持耐心，直到這出歷史鬧劇過去；我們希望當這出鬧劇終於結束時，你會加入我們建設一個開放的、基於合作規則的世界秩序。

en: Many of you deserve a dedicated apology.
zh: 許多人都應該得到誠摯的道歉。

en: In alphabetical order:
zh: 按字母排序：

en: Dear Africa: We apologize for Trump’s obscene remarks insulting your countries in January.
zh: 親愛的非洲：我們為特朗普1月份冒犯你們的國家的猥瑣言論致歉。

en: Dear Australia: We apologize for Trump’s January 28, 2017, phone call with your prime minister, in which he insulted immigrants, willfully misunderstood facts regarding an American commitment, and concluded that he found talking to Putin more pleasant.
zh: 親愛的澳大利亞：我們為特朗普在2017年1月28日與你們的總理的電話通話致歉。 在這次通話中，他攻擊了移民，故意歪曲與美國的承諾有關的事實，還說與普京講話更令人愉快。

en: Dear Britain: While visiting your country this month, Trump thoughtlessly undermined the political position of Prime Minister Theresa May.
zh: 親愛的英國：在這個月訪問你們國家時，特朗普魯莽地破壞了首相梅的政治立場。

en: Sorry for that, and for his mendacious attacks on London mayor Sadiq Khan.
zh: 很抱歉，同樣抱歉的還有他對倫敦市長沙迪克·汗（Sadiq Khan）的子虛烏有的攻擊。

en: Dear Canada: Sorry that Trump (falsely) said Canadians invaded the US and burned down the White House in the War of 1812; that he still hasn’t learned what the bilateral trade balance is; and that he insulted G7 host Prime Minister Justin Trudeau last month.
zh: 親愛的加拿大：對不起，特朗普（錯誤地）說加拿大人在1812年戰爭中侵略了美國，燒掉了白宮；他還說仍然沒有學會 雙邊貿易平衡是什麼；他並且在上個月羞辱了G7東道主特魯多總理。

en: Dear Central America: You were invisible to us until a small number of desperate refugee families reached our border, whereupon we separated small children from their families and locked them all up.
zh: 親愛的中美洲：在一些絕望的難民家庭來到我們的國境線前以前，我們幾乎沒有注意你們過，你們來到我們的國境線前，是因為我們將幼兒與他們的家庭分離，並把他們都關了起來。

en: How can we erase this stain?
zh: 我們如何洗去這個汙點？

en: We could help your countries develop, if we tried, and at a far lower cost than the doomed wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.
zh: 我們可以幫助你們發展，如果我們嘗試的話，並且成本要比該死的阿富汗和伊拉克戰爭低得多。

en: Dear China: We apologize for giving you piles of paper (Treasury bills) in exchange for all the neat merchandise you have been sending us.
zh: 親愛的中國：我們為用紙（美國國債）換取了你們運給我們的精緻商品致歉。

en: It’s not fair.
zh: 這不公平。

en: On the other hand, your current-account surplus peaked at 10% of GDP in 2007, and now stands at a mere 1.3% of GDP.
zh: 另一方面，你們的經常專案盈餘在2007年達到了峰值，佔GDP的10 % ， 而現在只佔GDP的1.3 % 。

en: So now you are getting real goods and services in exchange for your exports.
zh: 因此，現在你們的出口給你們換來了真正的商品和服務。

en: Dear Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania: We feel terrible that Trump’s wavering support for NATO has made you fear that the US might not honor its treaty commitment to come to your aid if Russia were to invade your territory.
zh: 親愛的愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞和立陶宛：特朗普在支援北約的態度上的搖擺不定導致你們擔心，如果俄羅斯侵略你們的領土，美國也許不會尊重與你們共同抵抗的條約承諾。 對此我們感到非常難受。

en: But we would.
zh: 但我們不會。

en: Dear European Union: We are sorry that Trump called you a foe and that he cheers on the forces trying to fracture you.
zh: 親愛的歐盟：對不起，特朗普說你們是敵人，還說他要為拆散你們的力量鼓掌。

en: Sorry for those steel and aluminum tariffs, too.
zh: 對不起，特朗普對你們徵收了鋼和鋁關稅。

en: Oh, and sorry for all those refugees we unleashed on you when we destabilized the Middle East.
zh: 哦，同樣對不起的是所有難民，他們是因為我們動搖了中東才逃到你們那裡的。

en: Dear France: Your president, Emmanuel Macron, made an excellent effort to befriend Trump while sticking to principle.
zh: 親愛的法國：你們的總統馬克龍做出了了不起的嘗試，既對特朗普示好，又能堅持原則。

en: We are sorry that it did not get him anywhere and in particular that Trump, ignoring European pleas, subsequently reneged on the 2015 Iran nuclear deal.
zh: 很抱歉這並沒有打動他，特別需要致歉的是，特朗普無視歐洲的籲求，隨後撕毀了2015年伊朗核協議。

en: Dear Germany: Sorry that Trump has repeatedly insulted Chancellor Angela Merkel.
zh: 親愛的德國：對不起，特朗普 多次攻擊你們的總理默克爾。

en: Dear Iran: We are sorry that Trump has withdrawn the US from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, as the nuclear deal is known, and is now re-imposing sanctions, even though you have verifiably abided by the agreed terms.
zh: 親愛的伊朗：很抱歉，特朗普讓美國退出了全面聯合行動計劃（核協議的全稱 ） ， 現在又準備重新採取制裁，儘管你們已經證實遵守了協議條款。

en: Usually we keep our word.
zh: 通常我們不會食言。

en: Dear Ireland: We are sorry that Trump apparently believes you are part of the United Kingdom and that you like him.
zh: 親愛的愛爾蘭：很抱歉，特朗普顯然認為你們是英國的一部分，並且你們很喜歡他。

en: We know you aren’t and don’t.
zh: 我們知道你們不是，也不喜歡他。

en: Dear Japan: Prime Minister Shinzo Abe is one of many foreign leaders to learn that cozying up to Trump works only while he is standing next to you.
zh: 親愛的日本：首相安倍晉三和許多外國領導人一樣，都領教到了只有在特朗普和你站在一起時，討好他才有效果。

en: In fact, Japan was the only major US ally not granted even a temporary exemption from Trump’s 25% steel tariff.
zh: 事實上，日本是唯一一個連25%的鋼關稅的臨時豁免都沒有獲得 的美國主要盟友。

en: Also, we are sorry for Trump’s apparent indifference to North Korea’s ability to strike you (and South Korea) militarily.
zh: 此外，很抱歉特朗普顯然漠不關心朝鮮擁有軍事打擊你們（還有韓國）的能力。

en: Dear Mexico: What can I say?
zh: 親愛的墨西哥：我還能說什麼呢？

en: We know that “criminals” and “rapists” are in fact far less common among immigrants from Mexico and elsewhere than among native-born Americans.
zh: 我們知道 ， “ 犯罪分子”和“強進犯”在墨西哥和其他國際移民群體中間要比土上土長的美國人中間罕見得多。

en: We know that you will not pay to build a border wall.
zh: 我們知道，你們不會為邊境牆買單。

en: We know that renegotiating the North American Free Trade Agreement in a way that would satisfy Trump, particularly the demand for periodic renewal, is not an option.
zh: 我們知道，以令特朗普滿意的方式重新談判北美自由貿易協定，特別是要求定期修訂，絕不是一個選項。

en: Dear Philippines, Russia, Turkey, Egypt, and others: We understand the historic attraction of a strong leader who claims to get things done.
zh: 親愛的菲律賓、俄羅斯、土耳其、埃及和其他國家：我們明白，宣稱會帶領國家走上正軌的強力領導人有其歷史吸引力。

en: But your “strongmen” do not help your countries in the long run, and we are sorry that Trump’s disdain for the rule of law aids their economic mismanagement and human-rights abuses.
zh: 但你們的“強人”從長期看對你們的國家沒有助益，很抱歉，特朗普對法治的蔑視助長了他們的經濟管理不善和人權侵犯。

en: Dear South Korea: We are sorry that Trump’s eagerness to match Kim Jong-un insult for insult last year stoked fears of a catastrophic war on the Korean Peninsula.
zh: 親愛的韓國：對不起，去年特朗普急於對金正恩以牙還牙，導致你們擔心朝鮮半島會爆發災難性戰爭。

en: President Moon Jae-in deserves the Nobel Peace Prize for ratcheting down the risk of conflict.
zh: 文在寅總統遏制了衝突風險，應該獲得諾貝爾和平獎。

en: It’s too bad that, following Trump’s summit with Kim in June, he didn’t consult you before announcing the discontinuation of joint military exercises, while getting nothing in exchange.
zh: 在今年6月與金正恩舉行峰會後，特朗普在不與你們協商的情況下就宣佈中止聯合軍演，並沒有因此獲得任何回報，這真是太糟糕了。

en: Dear Sweden: Sorry that Trump on February 19, 2017, fabricated a terrorist attack “last night in Sweden.”
zh: 親愛的瑞典：對不起，2017年2月19日特朗普捏造了“昨晚在瑞典”的恐怖襲擊。

en: Dear Ukraine: Trump’s historical memory appears not to go back as far as 2014, when Russia invaded you.
zh: 親愛的烏克蘭：特朗普的歷史記憶似乎不會超過2014年俄羅斯入侵你們的那一刻。

en: Or if it does, he says it’s okay because so many Ukrainians speak Russian.
zh: 或者他有這麼長遠的記憶，並表示這沒什麼，因為很多烏克蘭人講俄語。

en: Sorry for that – and that Trump’s campaign manager, Paul Manafort, now in jail, worked for the pro-Russian side in Ukraine.
zh: 對不起。 同樣對不起的是，特朗普的競選經理保羅·馬納福特（Paul Manafort，現已鋃鐺入獄）在烏克蘭站在親俄派這一邊。

en: Dear Venezuela: We regret that Trump is prolonging the life of your awful government by threatening invasion and giving the leaders a scapegoat for their humanitarian disaster.
zh: 親愛的委內瑞拉：很遺憾，特朗普用威脅入侵和為領導人尋找人道主義災難的替罪羊來延長你們的十惡不赦的政府的性命。

en: I also apologize to every country I left out of this tour.
zh: 我也為這場道歉之旅沒有經過的國家道歉。

en: Trump’s demolition of the rules-based, truth-based, pro-trade world order hurts everyone.
zh: 特朗普對基於規則和事實、支援貿易的世界秩序的背叛讓所有人都蒙受了損失。

en: Please keep our seat warm at international meetings and organizations.
zh: 請在國際會議和組織上為我們暖席。

en: The real US will return.
zh: 真正的美國會回來的。

en: Trump’s Deplorables
zh: 特朗普的可悲之徒

en: NEW YORK – Hillary Clinton, the Democratic US presidential nominee, recently described supporters of her opponent, Donald Trump, as a “basket of deplorables.”
zh: 紐約—民主黨美國總統提名人希拉里·克林頓最近把支援她的對手唐納德·特朗普的人稱為“一群可悲之徒 ” 。

en: It was neither a tactful nor an elegant phrase, and she later apologized for her remark.
zh: 這個用詞不得體，也不優雅，隨後她因為此番評論而道歉。

en: But she was more right than wrong.
zh: 但她是對的。

en: Trump has attracted many supporters whose views on race, for example, are indeed deplorable.
zh: 特朗普吸引了許多支持者，他們的有些觀點確實可悲，比如種族觀點。

en: The problem is that many of these deplorable voters are also relatively uneducated, which makes Clinton’s remark look snobbish.
zh: 問題在於許多這些可悲選民相對而言教育程度較低，這讓克林頓的評價顯得有些勢利。

en: Alas, the United States has too many relatively uneducated people.
zh: 唉，美國有太多教育程度相對較低的人。

en: Among developed countries, the US ranks low in terms of literacy, general knowledge, and science.
zh: 在發達國家中，美國識字率、常識和科學排名很低。

en: Japanese, South Koreans, Dutch, Canadians, and Russians score consistently higher.
zh: 日本、韓國、荷蘭和俄羅斯的得分比美國高很多。

en: This is at least partly the result of leaving education too much to the market: those with money are highly educated, and those with insufficient means are not educated enough.
zh: 這至少部分是因為教育過於依賴市場：有錢的人受到更好的教育，沒有門路的受教育不足。

en: So far, it seems clear that Clinton appeals to better-educated urban voters, while Trump attracts mainly less-educated white men, many of whom in earlier generations would have been Democrat-voting coal miners or industrial workers.
zh: 目前，顯然克林頓吸引了教育程度更高的城市選民，而特朗普主要吸引教育程度較低的白人，這些人的祖輩往往是支援民主黨的煤礦工人或產業工人。

en: Does this mean that there is a link between education – or the lack of it – and the appeal of a dangerous demagogue?
zh: 這是否意味著教育（或缺少教育）與危險的煽動家的吸引力之間存在關聯？

en: One of the most remarkable things about Trump is the extent of his own ignorance, despite his high educational attainment, and the fact that he seems to benefit from flaunting it.
zh: 特朗普身上一個最引人關注的特點是他自身的無知，儘管他受過高等教育，以及他從炫耀自己的無知中獲益這一事實。

en: Perhaps it is easier for a loud-mouthed ignoramus to convince large numbers of people whose knowledge of the world is as slight as his own.
zh: 也許大嗓門的無知者更容易讓大量對世界的知識與他一樣貧乏人們相信自己。

en: But this is to assume that factual truth matters in the rhetoric of a populist agitator.
zh: 但這不啻認為事實真相在民粹主義攪局者的修辭中至關重要。

en: Many of his supporters don’t seem to care much about reasoned argument – that is for the liberal snobs.
zh: 特朗普的許多支持者對理性觀點沒有什麼興趣 — — 這是自由主義小人關注的東西。

en: Emotions count more, and the prime emotions that demagogues manipulate, in the US and elsewhere, are fear, resentment, and distrust.
zh: 情緒更重要，而在美國和其他國家，煽動家所操縱的主要情緒是恐懼、怨恨和不信任。

en: This was also true in Germany when Hitler came to power.
zh: 希特勒掌權的德國也是如此。

en: But the Nazi Party in its early days did not find the bulk of its support among the least educated.
zh: 但納粹黨初期的支持者主要不是來自教育程度最低的群體。

en: Germany was more highly educated than other countries, on average, and the most enthusiastic Nazis included schoolteachers, engineers, and doctors, as well as provincial small businessmen, white-collar workers, and farmers.
zh: 平均而言，德國的高等教育人口比其他國家更多，並且最狂熱的納粹黨中有學校教師、工程師和醫生，也有地方小商人、白領工人和農民。

en: Urban factory workers and conservative Catholics were, on the whole, less susceptible to Hitler’s blandishments than many more highly educated Protestants.
zh: 總體而言，相對許多教育程度更高的新教徒，城市工廠工人和保守的天主教徒對希特勒的花言巧語比較不敏感。

en: Low educational standards do not explain Hitler’s rise.
zh: 低教育程度無法解釋希特勒的崛起。

en: Fear, resentment, and distrust ran very high in Weimar Germany, after the humiliation of wartime defeat and amid a devastating economic depression.
zh: 恐懼、怨恨和不信任程度在魏瑪德國很高，當時一戰的失敗以及災難性經濟蕭條讓德國人充滿了羞辱感。

en: But the racial prejudices whipped up by Nazi propagandists were not the same as the ones we see among many Trump supporters today.
zh: 但納粹宣傳機器煽動的種族偏見與我們今天常見於特朗普支持者的種族偏見不同。

en: The Jews were seen as a sinister force that was dominating the elite professions: bankers, professors, lawyers, news media, or entertainment.
zh: 猶太人被視為一股邪惡勢力，他們主宰了精英職業：銀行家、教授、律師、新聞媒體以及娛樂。

en: They were the so-called back-stabbers who prevented Germany from being great again.
zh: 他們是所謂的背後搞鬼者，讓德國無法再次走向偉大。

en: The Trump supporters are showing a similar animus against symbols of the elite, such as Wall Street bankers, “mainstream” media, and Washington insiders.
zh: 特朗普的支持者也表現出類似的對精英象徵的仇恨，如華爾街銀行家 、 “ 主流”媒體以及華盛頓局內人。

en: But their xenophobia is directed against poor Mexican immigrants, blacks, or Middle Eastern refugees, who are perceived as freeloaders depriving honest (read white) Americans of their rightful place in the social pecking order.
zh: 但他們的仇視被導向貧窮的墨西哥移民、黑人或中東難民，他們被視為不速之客，搶走了誠（白）實（人）美國人在社會等級中應有的位次。

en: It is a question of relatively underprivileged people in a globalizing, increasingly multi-cultural world, resenting those who are even less privileged.
zh: 這是一個在全球化的、文化日益多元的世界中相對弱勢群體仇恨比他們還要弱勢的群體的問題。

en: In the US today, as in the Weimar Republic, the resentful and the fearful have so little trust in prevailing political and economic institutions that they follow a leader who promises maximum disruption.
zh: 當今美國就像魏瑪共和國，仇恨者和恐懼者對主流政治和經濟機構毫無信任可言，因此追隨承諾最大程度破壞的領導人。

en: By cleaning out the stables, it is hoped, greatness will return.
zh: 他們希望，透過徹底的“打掃房子”可以恢復昔日榮光。

en: In Hitler’s Germany, this hope existed among all classes, whether elite or plebeian.
zh: 在希特勒德國，這一希望存在於所有階級中間，不管是精英還是草根。

en: In Trump’s America, it thrives mostly among the latter.
zh: 在特朗普的美國，這一希望主要在草根中間興盛。

en: In the US and Europe, today’s world looks less scary to more affluent and better educated voters, who benefit from open borders, cheap migrant labor, information technology, and a rich mixture of cultural influences.
zh: 在美國和歐洲，較為豐裕、教育程度較高的選民認為當今世界並不那麼可怕，他們得益於開放邊境、廉價移民勞動力、資訊科技和文化影響的豐富組合。

en: Likewise, immigrants and ethnic minorities who seek to improve their lot have no interest in joining a populist rebellion directed mainly against them, which is why they will vote for Clinton.
zh: 類似地，追求改善生活的移民和少數民族沒有興趣加入主要針對他們的反動，這也是他們投票支援克林頓的原因。

en: Trump must thus rely on disaffected white Americans who feel that they are being left behind.
zh: 因此，特朗普必須依靠認為自己被拋棄的不滿的美國白人。

en: The fact that enough people feel that way to sustain such an unsuitable presidential candidate is an indictment of US society.
zh: 深有同感的人多到足夠支援特朗普這樣的根本不合格的總統候選人，這一事實表明美國社會已經病入膏肓。

en: This does have something to do with education – not because well-educated people are immune to demagogy, but because a broken education system leaves too many people at a disadvantage.
zh: 這確實與教育有一定關係 — — 因為教育程度較高這能夠對煽動免疫，也因為拙劣的教育體系讓太多人成為弱勢群體。

en: In the past, there were enough industrial jobs for less-educated voters to make a decent living.
zh: 在過去，有足夠的產業工作崗位留給教育程度較低的選民，讓他們過上體面的生活。

en: Now that those jobs are vanishing in post-industrial societies, too many people feel that they have nothing more to lose.
zh: 如今，這些工作崗位正在後工業社會中逐漸消失，太多人覺得自己已經輸無可輸。

en: This is true in many countries, but it matters more in the US, where putting a bigoted demagogue in charge would do great damage not only to that country, but also to all countries trying to hold onto their freedoms in an increasingly perilous world.
zh: 在許多國家確實如此，但在美國茲事體大，讓一位偏執的煽動家主政不但將讓美國飽受傷害，也會讓所有試圖在日益危險的世界中捍衛自由的國家受傷。

en: The Double Standard of America’s China Trade Policy
zh: 美國對華貿易政策的雙重標準

en: CAMBRIDGE – A high-profile United States trade delegation appears to have returned empty-handed from its mission in China.
zh: 坎布里奇—高規格美國貿易代表團雙手空空地從中國回到了美國。

en: The result is hardly a surprise, given the scale and one-sided nature of the US demands.
zh: 這個結果並不出乎意料，因為美國的要求完全是單邊漫天要價。

en: The Americans pushed for a wholesale remaking of China’s industrial policies and intellectual property rules, while asking China’s government to refrain from any action against Trump’s proposed unilateral tariffs against Chinese exports.
zh: 美國人敦促中國徹底改變產業政策和智慧財產權規則，並要求中國政府不能對特朗普針對中國出口商品的單方面關稅方案採取任何行動。

en: This is not the first trade spat with China, and it will not be the last.
zh: 這不是第一次與中國發生貿易爭端，也不會是最後一次。

en: The global trading order of the last generation – since the creation of the World Trade Organization in 1995 – has been predicated on the assumption that regulatory regimes around the world would converge.
zh: 上一代全球貿易秩序 — — 從1995年世界貿易組織成立開始 — — 建立在一個前提假設的基礎上：全球規則機制將趨於統一。

en: China, in particular, would become more “Western” in the way that it manages its economy.
zh: 特別是中國的經濟管理方法將變得更加“西方 ” 。

en: Instead, the continued divergence of economic systems has been a fertile source of trade friction.
zh: 相反，經濟制度的不斷分化成為貿易摩擦的溫床。

en: There are good reasons for China – and other economies – to resist the pressure to conform to a mold imposed on them by US export lobbies.
zh: 中國和其他經濟體有很好的理由拒絕美國貿易遊說團體強加給它們的壓力。

en: After all, China’s phenomenal globalization success is due as much to the regime’s unorthodox and creative industrial policies as it is to economic liberalization.
zh: 畢竟，中國取得了巨大的全球化的成功，其體制的創造性非正統產業政策的功勞不亞於經濟自由化。

en: Selective protection, credit subsidies, state-owned enterprises, domestic-content rules, and technology-transfer requirements have all played a role in making China the manufacturing powerhouse that it is.
zh: 選擇性保護、信用補貼、國有企業、本土生產規則以及技術轉移要求都在中國成為製造業強國的過程中居功至偉。

en: China’s current strategy, the “Made in China 2025” initiative, aims to build on these achievements to catapult the country to advanced-economy status.
zh: 中國當前的戰略 — — “中國製造2025”計劃旨在在這些成就的基礎上更進一步，讓中國躋身發達經濟行列。

en: The fact that many of China’s policies violate WTO rules is plain enough.
zh: 中國的許多政策違反了世貿組織規則，這一事實是顯而易見的。

en: But those who derisively call China a “trade cheat” should ponder whether China would have been able to diversify its economy and grow as rapidly if it had become a member of the WTO before 2001, or if it had slavishly applied WTO rules since then.
zh: 但嘲弄中國是“貿易騙子”的人應該深思，如果它在2001年之前成為世貿組織成員，或如果它在2001年之後一絲不苟地履行世貿組織規則，它還能不能如此迅速地實現經濟多樣化和增長。

en: The irony is that many of these same commentators do not hesitate to point to China as the poster boy of globalization’s upside – conveniently forgetting on those occasions the degree to which China has flouted the global economy’s contemporary rules.
zh: 諷刺的是，同一批評論家有很多人會毫不猶豫地認為中國是全球化好處的榜樣 — — 心安理得地忘掉中國蔑視全球經濟的當代規則的程度。

en: China plays the globalization game by what we might call Bretton Woods rules, after the much more permissive regime that governed the world economy in the early postwar period.
zh: 中國用我們可稱之為佈雷頓森林規則的東西來玩全球化這場遊戲，在此之前，戰後早期治理世界經濟的機制更加寬鬆。

en: As a Chinese official once explained to me, the strategy is to open the window but place a screen on it.
zh: 一位中國官員曾經向我解釋，中國的戰略是開啟窗戶，再樹一塊屏風。

en: They get the fresh air (foreign investment and technology) while keeping out the harmful elements (volatile capital flows and disruptive imports).
zh: 如此，他們獲得了新鮮空氣（外國投資核技術 ） ， 又遮蔽了有害元素（高波動的資本流和破壞性進口品 ） 。

en: In fact, China’s practices are not much different from what all advanced countries have done historically when they were catching up with others.
zh: 事實上，中國的所作所為與所有發達國家在歷史上互相趕超時的所作所為並無很大區別。

en: One of the main US complaints against China is that the Chinese systematically violate intellectual property rights in order to steal technological secrets.
zh: 美國對中國的最大抱怨點之一是中國系統性地違反智慧財產權以竊取技術機密。

en: But in the nineteenth century, the US was in the same position in relation to the technological leader of the time, Britain, as China is today vis-à-vis the US.
zh: 但在十九世紀，美國與當時的技術領導者英國的關係正如今天中國與美國的關係。

en: And the US had as much regard for British industrialists’ trade secrets as China has today for American intellectual property rights.
zh: 美國對英國產業家的貿易秘密的關注也正如今天中國對美國智慧財產權的關注。

en: The fledgling textile mills of New England were desperate for technology and did their best to steal British designs and smuggle in skilled British craftsmen.
zh: 新英格蘭地區方興未艾的紡織廠渴望獲得技術，竭盡全力竊取英國的設計，挖掘熟練英國匠人。

en: The US did have patent laws, but they protected only US citizens.
zh: 美國確實有專利法，但只保護美國公民。

en: As one historian of US business has put it, the Americans “were pirates, too.”
zh: 一位美國商業史學家指出，美國“也是盜版之徒。 ”

en: Any sensible international trade regime must start from the recognition that it is neither feasible nor desirable to restrict the policy space countries have to design their own economic and social models.
zh: 而明智的國際貿易機制的起點必然是要承認，限制各國設計自身經濟和社會模式的政策空間既不可行，也不合理。

en: Levels of development, values, and historical trajectories differ too much for countries to be shoehorned into a specific model of capitalism.
zh: 各國的發展水平、價值觀和歷史軌跡大相徑庭，無法硬塞進具體的資本主義模式。

en: Sometimes domestic policies will backfire and keep foreign investors out and the domestic economy impoverished.
zh: 有時，國內政策會適得其反，讓外國投資者逃離，國內經濟陷入貧困。

en: At other times, they will propel economic transformation and poverty reduction, as they have done on a massive scale in China, generating gains not just for the home economy but also for consumers worldwide.
zh: 有時，國內政策會推動經濟轉型和減貧，就像中國大規模實現的那樣，不但讓本國經濟受益，也讓全世界消費者受益。

en: International trade rules, which are the result of painstaking negotiations among diverse interests – including, most notably, corporations and their lobbies, cannot be expected to discriminate reliably between these two sets of circumstances.
zh: 國際貿易規則是各種利益 — — 最令人矚目的是，包括公司及其遊說團體的利益 — — 經過痛苦的談判所形成的結果，你無法指望它可靠地區分 這兩類環境。

en: Countries pursuing harmful policies that blunt their development prospects are doing the greatest damage to themselves.
zh: 採取有害政策扼殺發展前景的國家，傷害最多的使它們自己。

en: When domestic strategies go wrong, other countries may be hurt; but it is the home economy that pays the steepest price – which is incentive enough for governments not to pursue the wrong kind of policies.
zh: 當國內戰略出錯時，其他國家可能會被波及，但付出最沉重代價的還是本國經濟 — — 這已足夠激勵政府不要採取錯誤的政策。

en: Governments that worry about the transfer of critical technological know-how to foreigners are, in turn, free to enact rules prohibiting their firms from investing abroad or restricting foreign takeovers at home.
zh: 反過來，擔心關鍵性技術知識轉移給外國人的政府，會實施禁止企業投資於國外或限制外國企業在國內收購的政策。

en: Many liberal commentators in the US think Trump is right to go after China.
zh: 許多美國的自由派評論家認為特朗普抓住中國不放是正確的。

en: Their objection is to his aggressive, unilateralist methods.
zh: 他們反對的是他的激進的單邊主義方法。

en: Yet the fact is that Trump’s trade agenda is driven by a narrow mercantilism that privileges the interests of US corporations over other stakeholders.
zh: 但事實上，特朗普的貿易日程背後是狹隘的重商主義，美國公司利益嚴格高於其他相關利益。

en: It shows little interest in policies that would improve global trade for all.
zh: 特朗普對於改善總體全球貿易的政策毫無興趣。

en: Such policies should start from the trade regime’s Golden Rule: do not impose on other countries constraints that you would not accept if faced with their circumstances.
zh: 這些政策應該從貿易機制的黃金規則開始：己所不欲，勿施於人。

en: America’s Ongoing Civil War
zh: 美國正在進行的內戰

en: NEW YORK –America continues be in a state of civil war.
zh: 紐約 — — 美國繼續處於內戰狀態。

en: Not just a civil war, but the civil war.
zh: 這不僅是一場普通的內戰，而是美國內戰。

en: In the first round, back in the 1860s, the Confederacy lost.
zh: 回溯到19世紀60年代的第一回合，邦聯戰敗。

en: Yet now the Confederacy is temporarily on top.
zh: 但現在邦聯暫時處於領先地位。

en: The United States remains one country divided by two cultures.
zh: 美國仍然被兩種文化所割裂。

en: From the start, the US has been a battleground of two competing visions.
zh: 從一開始，美國就一直有兩種願景在激烈交鋒。

en: America’s founding credo was that “all men are created equal.”
zh: 美國的創始信條是“人人生而平等 ” 。

en: Yet the founding reality was that white males were far more equal than everyone else.
zh: 但建國時的現狀卻是白人男性所得到的平等遠遠超過其他人。

en: White men owned slaves, denied the vote to women, and took the lands and lives of native Americans.
zh: 白人擁有奴隸，剝奪了女性的投票權，並剝奪了印第安原住民的土地和生存權。

en: During the 1861-1865 Civil War, the slaveholding Confederacy, formed by 13 secessionist states, was defeated by 19 northern states and then occupied by the federal government for a dozen years.
zh: 1861-1865年內戰期間，由13個分裂州組成的蓄奴邦聯最終被19個北方州所擊敗，而後被聯邦政府佔領了十幾年。

en: Yet after “Reconstruction” ended in 1877, the South vigorously practiced systemic racism for almost a century, until the US Congress enacted the 1964 Civil Rights Act and the 1965 Voting Rights Act, mainly with the support of northern Democrats.
zh: 但在1877年“重建”結束後，南方在長達近一個世紀的時間裡全力推行系統性種族歧視，直到美國國會主要在北方民主黨人的支援下，透過了1964年民權法案和1965年選舉權法案。

en: From that moment, Southern white voters deserted the Democratic Party en masse.
zh: 從那時起，南方白人選民不約而同地拋棄了民主黨。

en: The Republicans embraced the so-called Southern strategy, based on resisting the rise of African-Americans and other minority groups and opposing legislation that would transfer any funds, status, or power to them.
zh: 共和黨則奉行所謂的南方戰略，該戰略的基礎是抵制非洲裔美國人和其他少數民族群體的崛起，並反對向他們轉移任何資金、地位或權力的立法法案。

en: The Republicans thereby became the party of the South, and the Democrats the party of the Northeast and Pacific West, with the Midwest and western mountain states the swing regions.
zh: 共和黨也由此成為南方政黨，民主黨代表東北地區和太平洋西部，而中西部和西部山區則成為搖擺區。

en: The industrial Great Lakes region tended toward the Democrats while the Midwestern farm states and mountain states leaned Republican.
zh: 工業發達的五大湖區相對傾向於民主黨，而共和黨則更容易得到中西部各農業和山地州的支援。

en: The Midwestern and mountain states also carried the frontier culture of white settlers suppressing native Americans and Asian and Hispanic immigrants.
zh: 各中西部和山地州還盛行白人定居者的邊疆文化，他們鼓吹鎮壓美國土著、亞裔及西班牙裔移民。

en: Gun ownership marks another divide between Democrats and Republicans.
zh: 槍支所有權標誌著民主和共和黨人之間的又一個分歧。

en: The Republican Party’s gun culture reflects the same cultural forces that shape its anti-minority views.
zh: 共和黨的槍支文化其實是決定其反少數族裔觀點的同樣一種文化力量的反映。

en: In a brilliant book, Loaded, historian Roxanne Dunbar-Ortiz reminds us that the “well-regulated militias” mentioned in the US Constitution’s Second Amendment, which enshrines the right to bear arms, were groups of white men that raided native American villages and hunted down escaped slaves.
zh: 歷史學家Roxanne Dunbar-Ortiz在一本精彩著作子彈上膛中提醒我們，警惕美國憲法第二修正案所提到的“井然有序的民兵武裝分子 ” ， 這些人信奉槍支攜帶權，由他們所組成的白人團體襲擊美洲土著村莊並追捕逃跑的奴隸。

en: As Avidit Acharya, Matthew Blackwell, and Maya Sen powerfully argue in their recent book Deep Roots: How Slavery Still Shapes Southern Politics, it is the legacy of slavery and post-Civil War segregation that gave rise to the South’s current political culture.
zh: 正如Avidit Acharya、馬修·布萊克威爾和瑪雅·森在其近著深深紮根：奴隸制如何仍然決定著南方政治一書中所表明的那樣，南方目前的政治文化恰恰起源於奴隸制的遺存以及內戰結束後的種族隔離。

en: “It is within formerly high-slave areas,” they show, “that whites are the most likely to oppose the Democratic Party, oppose affirmative action, and express sentiments that could be construed as racially resentful.”
zh: 據他們論證 ， “ 以前高度信奉奴隸制的地區白人最有可能反對民主黨、反對積極行動，並表達可能被理解為種族怨恨的各種情緒。 ”

en: Both before and after the Civil War, poor Southern whites accepted their lowly status because they prized their superiority over even more desperate African-Americans.
zh: 內戰前後，貧窮的南方白人接受了自己的卑微地位，因為他們看重自己相對於更為絕望的非洲裔美國人所具備的身份上的優越。

en: Racial politics thus blocked the emergence of class politics, which would have brought poor whites and poor blacks together to demand more public services paid for by higher taxes on elite whites.
zh: 種族政治因此阻礙了階級政治的崛起，而階級政治本來可能讓貧窮的白人和黑人攜起手來，共同要求為提供更多公共服務而向白人精英層增稅。

en: Of the 26 senators representing the 13 former Confederate states today, 21 are Republicans and five are Democrats.
zh: 在今天代表13個前邦聯州的26名參議員中，21名來自共和黨，來自民主黨的僅有5名。

en: Of the 38 senators now representing the 19 northern states of 1861, 27 are Democrats and nine are Republicans (two Independents, Bernie Sanders and Angus King, caucus with the Democrats).
zh: 而在今天代表1861年19個北方州的38位參議員中，27人來自民主黨，而來自共和黨的僅有9名（還有2名是獨立無黨派人士，伯尼桑·德斯和安格斯·金，他們往往與民主黨人保持一致 ） 。

en: President Donald Trump is a geographical anomaly, a pro-southern racist from liberal New York.
zh: 唐納德·特朗普總統從地理角度看屬於異數，是一名來自自由紐約的親南方種族主義份子。

en: Trump, a champion of the white male southern culture, is shunned by his home state (59% disapproval as of September 2018).
zh: 特朗普擁護崇尚白人男性的南方文化，導致他自己的家鄉避之唯恐不及（截止2018年9月調查顯示59%的不贊成率 ） 。

en: He is more Mississippi than Manhattan.
zh: 他不像來自曼哈頓，更像來自密西西比。

en: The cultural divide was on full display in the Senate proceedings that recently confirmed Judge Brett Kavanaugh to the US Supreme Court.
zh: 上述文化鴻溝在最近確定佈雷特·卡瓦諾法官美國最高法院法官提名的過程中得到了充分的展示。

en: Kavanaugh’s Senate defenders were mainly white men of the South and Midwest who deflected the questioning of Kavanaugh’s white male prerogative to drink and carouse as a young man by instead attacking the nominee’s accusers.
zh: 卡瓦諾的參議院支持者主要是南部和中西部白人，他們在面對有人批評卡瓦諾鼓吹白人男性具有飲酒和尋歡作樂特權的質疑時全力為他打掩護，反而調轉矛頭對這位提名人的控訴者發起攻擊。

en: Mitch McConnell of Kentucky, a former slave state, successfully orchestrated Kavanaugh’s confirmation.
zh: 來自前奴隸州肯塔基的米奇·麥康奈爾成功策劃了卡瓦諾的提名確認。

en: Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, the first slave state to secede in 1860, was Kavanaugh’s most aggressive promoter on the Senate Judiciary Committee, describing sexual assault allegations against Kavanaugh as “the most unethical sham since I’ve been in politics.”
zh: 蓄奴的南卡羅來納州在1860年第一個宣佈分裂，而來自該州的林賽·格雷厄姆是卡瓦諾在參議院司法委員會中最強有力的支持者，他將針對卡瓦諾的性侵指控描述為“自我從政以來最不道德的騙局 ” 。

en: John Kennedy of Louisiana, another former Confederate state, called the hearings “an intergalactic freak show.”
zh: 約翰·肯尼迪出生於另一個前邦聯州路易斯安那，他用“銀河系級別的畸形秀”來形容這次聽證會。

en: The Democrats and Republicans are parties not just of different cultures and regions, but also of different economies.
zh: 民主和共和黨不僅是來自不同文化和地區的政黨，而且也代表著不同的經濟。

en: The Northeast and Pacific states lead the US in high technology, innovation, higher education, well-paying jobs, and per capita income.
zh: 東北和太平洋各州一直引領美國的高科技、創新、高等教育、高薪工作和人均收入。

en: The South lags far behind.
zh: 南方則遠遠不能與之相比。

en: Not only are the working-class white men of the South and Midwest defending their status and racial privileges; they are also fighting for their jobs in industries where automation and foreign trade have steadily eroded employment.
zh: 南方和中西部地區的工薪階層白人不僅捍衛自己的地位和種族特權；他們還在為保護自己的就業崗位而戰，因為在他們所處的行業，自動化和外貿一直穩步侵蝕著就業崗位。

en: Working-class southern whites would have much to gain from abandoning the Republicans’ race-based politics in favor of class-based politics.
zh: 來自工薪階層的南方白人如果願意放棄共和黨所奉行的種族政治，轉而信奉階級政治會得到很多好處。

en: It is, after all, white corporate elites, not poor African-Americans, Hispanics, and other minorities, who deprive working-class whites of quality public schools, affordable health care, and environmental safety.
zh: 歸根結底，是白人企業精英，而非貧困的非洲裔、西班牙裔和其他少數族裔美國人剝奪了工薪階層白人享有優質公共教育、廉價醫療和環境安全的權利。

en: Southern white male senators play up the culture war in part to shield the Republicans’ mega-rich donors, who feast on corporate tax cuts and environmental deregulation while the party scapegoats African-Americans and Hispanics.
zh: 南方白人參議員挑起文化戰爭的部分目的是保護共和黨的超級富豪捐贈者，他們享受著企業減稅和放鬆環境管制所帶來的盛宴，而共和黨卻將責任全部推給非洲裔和西班牙裔美國人。

en: The declining predominance of non-Hispanic whites in the total population has probably widened America’s cultural divide during the past 20 years.
zh: 非西班牙裔白人在總人口中所占主導地位不斷下降可能在過去二十年裡擴大了美國的文化差異。

en: And with non-Hispanic whites expected to become a minority of the total population by around 2045, America’s ongoing civil war could worsen.
zh: 因為預計到2045年左右非西班牙裔白人將成為總人口中的少數，美國正在進行的內戰有可能進一步加劇。

en: It will not end until working-class Americans of all regions, races, and ethnicities join forces to demand higher taxes and greater accountability of the rich corporate elite.
zh: 除非所有地區、族裔和種族的工薪階層美國人聯合起來，要求富有的企業精英繳納更多稅收和承擔更多責任，否則這場戰爭將不會結束。

en: America’s Exploding Deficit
zh: 美國的赤字怒潮

en: CAMBRIDGE – Two recent pieces of budget news are a grim reminder of the perilous state of fiscal policy in the United States.
zh: 發自劍橋 — — 最近兩則與預算有關的新聞是對美國財政政策危機狀況的嚴重警告。

en: President Barack Obama’s Office of Management and Budget announced that the federal government’s deficit this fiscal year will be about $600 billion, up by $162 billion from 2015, an increase of more than 35%.
zh: 奧巴馬總統下屬的行政管理及預算辦公室宣佈，本財政年度聯邦政府的赤字約為6000億美元，比2015年增加1620億美元，同比增長超過35 ％ 。

en: And the annual Long-Term Budget Outlook produced by the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) predicts that, with no change in fiscal policy, federal government debt will rise from 75% of GDP to 86% a decade from now, and then to a record 141% in 2046, near levels in Italy, Portugal, and Greece.
zh: 而美國國會預算辦公室釋出的年度長期預算前景則預測，在財政政策不變的情況下，聯邦政府債務將會在十年後從相當於GDP的75％上升至86 ％ ， 並在2046年達到創紀錄的 141 ％ ， 與義大利、葡萄牙和希臘水平相當。

en: Although the US debt-to-GDP ratio doubled in the past decade, the Obama administration and Congress ignored the problem, focusing instead on the annual deficit’s decline since 2012 and the relative stability of the deficit as a share of GDP.
zh: 雖然美國債務相對GDP比率在過去十年增加了一倍，奧巴馬政府和國會卻刻意無視這一問題，相反著眼於2012年以來年度赤字額的逐步下降和赤字相對GDP比率的相對穩定。

en: That temporary progress reflected the economic recovery and congressional votes to limit spending on defense and nondefense discretionary programs.
zh: 但這個短期成績其實源自於經濟復甦以及美國國會對國防和非國防可自由支配開支專案的限制決議。
