zh: 羅姆尼聲稱他將不會任命伯南克為美聯儲主席（可能的候選人選包括胡巴德（Glenn Hubbard ） 、 曼昆（Greg Mankiw ） 、 泰勒（John Taylor ） 、 費爾德斯坦（Martin Feldstein）等經濟學家 ） 。

en: Other presidential appointees exert considerable influence on firms, industries, or the entire economy.
zh: 其他總統任命職位將對企業、產業甚至整個經濟產生重大影響。

en: For example, Obama’s appointees to the obscure National Labor Relations Board tried to prevent Boeing from expanding in South Carolina, despite the state’s anti-union “right to work” legislation.
zh: 比如，奧巴馬授命成立的神秘的美國勞工關係委員會（National Labor Relations Board）試圖阻止波音公司在南卡羅來納州的擴張，儘管該州透過了反工會的“工作權利”立法。

en: These policies would affect US economic growth, the budget deficit, national saving, and hence global trade and capital flows.
zh: 這些政策將影響到美國的經濟增長、預算赤字、國民儲蓄，從而影響全球貿易和資本流。

en: With larger deficits under Obama than under Romney, America would need more capital from Europe, Latin America, and Asia, while higher taxes and debt would impede US growth and thus undermine these regions’ exports.
zh: 奧巴馬的赤字將高於羅姆尼，因此美國也將更需要來自歐洲、拉美和亞洲的資本，與此同時，稅收和債務的增加將阻礙美國的經濟增長，從而破壞這些地區的出口。

en: Obama would steer America in the direction of European social-welfare states; Romney’s agenda is designed to prevent that.
zh: 奧巴馬將把美國駛上歐洲式社會福利國家的道路；而羅姆尼的方案是阻止這一幕的發生。

en: Whoever wins, a fiscal cliff looms at the end of 2012.
zh: 不論誰獲勝，財政懸崖都將是2012年底的一打陰影。

en: Previous legislation, if not reversed, will lead to large abrupt tax hikes and spending cuts, which the Congressional Budget Office forecasts would likely cause a recession in 2013.
zh: 此前的立法如果不能扭轉，將導致突發性的大規模增稅和減支，據聯邦預算委員會的預計，這極有可能在2013年導致衰退。

en: While a post-election, lame-duck session of Congress will address the fiscal cliff, the deep differences between Republicans and Democrats on taxes and spending remain wide and difficult to bridge.
zh: 選舉之後的國會免不了像只跛腳鴨，儘管它會解決財政懸崖，但共和黨和民主黨之間在稅收和支出問題上的重大差異依然難以彌合。

en: With uncertainty plaguing Europe’s finances and China slowing, the last thing the global economy needs is a stagnant or shrinking US economy.
zh: 不確定性正在折磨歐洲財政，中國正在經歷減速，如果美國經濟再停滯不前甚至衰退，那世界經濟就完了。

en: But it will take strong leadership by the president-elect to avoid it.
zh: 但要阻止這一幕，就需要總統大選選出強大的領袖。

en: America’s Exceptional Fiscal Conservatism
zh: 美國的另類財政保守主義

en: WASHINGTON, DC – In most countries, to be “fiscally conservative” means to worry a great deal about the budget deficit and debt levels – and to push these issues to the top of the policy agenda.
zh: 華盛頓—在大多數國家，身為“財政保守派”意味著你非常擔心預算赤字和債務水平，並將這類問題置於政策日程的最優先位置。

en: In many eurozone countries today, “fiscal conservatives” are a powerful group, insisting on the need to boost government revenue while bringing spending under control.
zh: 如今，在許多歐元區國家 ， “ 財政保守派”是一個很有力量的集團，他們堅持政府需要增加收入，同時控制支出。

en: In Great Britain, too, leading Conservatives have recently proved willing to raise taxes and attempted to limit future spending.
zh: 在英國，執政的保守黨最近也顯示出徵稅和限制未來支出的意願。

en: The United States is very different in this respect.
zh: 在這方面，美國顯得極為不同。

en: There, leading politicians who choose to call themselves “fiscal conservatives” – such as Paul Ryan, now the Republican Party’s presumptive vice-presidential nominee to run alongside presidential candidate Mitt Romney in November’s election – care more about cutting taxes, regardless of the effect on the federal deficit and total outstanding debt.
zh: 在美國，自稱“財政保守派”的政治領袖 — — 比如共和黨確定的與總統候選人羅姆尼共同挑戰11月大選的副總統人選保羅·萊恩 — — 更關注減稅，而不管這會對聯邦赤字和總未償還債務水平的影響。

en: Why do US fiscal conservatives care so little about government debt, relative to their counterparts in other countries?
zh: 為什麼與其他國家的同道相比，美國的財政保守派基本不關注政府債務呢？

en: It has not always been this way.
zh: 並非總是如此。

en: For example, in 1960, President Dwight D. Eisenhower’s advisers suggested that he should cut taxes in order to pave the way for his vice president, Richard Nixon, to be elected to the presidency.
zh: 比如，1960年，艾森豪威爾總統的顧問就建議他減稅從而為其副總統尼克松問鼎總統寶座創造條件。

en: Eisenhower declined, partly because he did not particularly like or trust Nixon, but mostly because he thought it was important to hand over a more nearly balanced budget to his successor.
zh: 艾森豪威爾拒絕了這一建議，部分是因為他並不是很喜歡和信任尼克松，但主要原因是他認為給繼任者留下更接近收支平衡的預算非常重要。

en: The framework for US macroeconomic policy changed dramatically when the international monetary system broke down in 1971.
zh: 1971年國際貨幣體系崩潰後，美國宏觀政策框架有了極大的改變。

en: The US could no longer maintain a fixed exchange rate between the dollar and gold – the cornerstone of the postwar Bretton Woods system.
zh: 美國不再能夠維持美元和黃金之間的固定兌換率，而這正是戰後佈雷頓森林體系的基石。

en: The arrangement collapsed because the US did not want to tighten monetary policy and run more restrictive fiscal policy: keeping US voters happy was understandably more important to President Nixon than maintaining a global system of fixed exchange rates.
zh: 該安排之所以崩潰，是因為美國不再願意緊縮貨幣政策以及採取更嚴格的財政政策：不難理解，對尼克松總統來說，取悅美國選民要比維持全球固定匯率體系更加重要。

en: Ironically, however, rather than undermining the predominant international role of the US dollar, the end of Bretton Woods actually boosted its use around the world.
zh: 不過，諷刺的是，佈雷頓森林體系的終結並沒有動搖美元在國際上的主導地位，實際上反而增加了美元在世界範圍的使用。

en: Much has been written, and many hands wrung, about the dollar’s decline over the last four decades, but the fact remains that holdings of US dollar assets by foreigners today are vastly greater than they were in 1971.
zh: 過去四十年來，關於美元將要衰落的言論和行為層出不窮，但事實卻是如今由外國人持有的美元資產比1971年規模大多了。

en: This turns out to be a mixed blessing, because it has allowed the US to become less careful about its fiscal accounts.
zh: 這是一柄雙刃劍，因為這導致美國不再關注財政賬戶。

en: Foreigners now hold roughly half of all US federal government debt, and they are willing to hold it when it yields a very low return in dollars (and even when the dollar depreciates).
zh: 如今，外國人大約持有了美國聯邦政府債務的一半，而即使在這筆債務的美元回報率極低（以及美元出現貶值）的情況下，他們也願意持有

en: In fact, whenever the world looks unstable, investors want to hold more dollar assets – even when the US is the cause of the instability.
zh: 事實上，每當世界不太穩定的時候，投資者就會願意持有更多的美元 — — 即使不穩定的根源正是來自美國。

en: When big US banks are in trouble or Americans are having another debilitating political fight over their public finances, global investors scramble into US Treasuries.
zh: 當美國大銀行陷入麻煩或美國陷入危害甚深的公共財政政治鬥爭時，全球投資者忙不迭地買入美國國債。

en: Last year’s congressional showdown over the federal debt ceiling may have cost the US its AAA sovereign rating with Standard & Poor’s, but the federal government’s borrowing costs are actually lower now than they were then.
zh: 去年國會關於聯邦債務上限的大斗爭導致美國失去了標註普爾AAA級主權評級，但如今聯邦政府的借貸成本卻比那時候更低了。

en: What has America done with this opportunity – arguably the lowest-cost funding in the history of humankind?
zh: 美國利用這一機會做了些什麼呢 — — 這也許是人類歷史上最低廉的融資成本了？

en: Not much, in terms of productive investment, strengthening education, or maintaining essential infrastructure.
zh: 沒做什麼，如果你從生產性投資、加強教育或維持基本基礎設施角度來看的話。

en: But the US has done a great deal in terms of adopting tax cuts that boost consumption relative to income and lower government revenue relative to expenditure.
zh: 但若從採取減稅措施以增加消費相對收入的比例以及降低政府收入相對支出的比例來說，美國又做了很多。

en: This is the lasting legacy of the “temporary” tax cuts adopted by George W. Bush’s administration in the early 2000’s.
zh: 這是小布什政府在21世紀初所採取的“臨時”減稅措施的最後遺留效應。

en: And Americans have shifted greatly toward political philosophies – on the right and on the left – that regard public debt merely as a distraction. Or, as former vice president Dick Cheney put it, “Reagan taught us that deficits do not matter” – meaning that Ronald Reagan cut taxes, ran bigger deficits, and did not suffer any adverse political consequences.
zh: 而美國人的政治觀念有了很大改變，不管是左派還是右派，都把公債問題視為僅僅是個干擾因素��或者用前副總統切尼的話說 ， “ 里根教導我們，赤字不是問題 ” — —他指的是羅納德·里根減了稅、增加了赤字，卻沒有因此承受任何不利的整治後果。

en: Ryan and members of the Tea Party wing of the Republican Party undoubtedly want to cut the size of the federal government, and they have articulated plans to do this over several decades.
zh: 萊恩和共和黨中的茶黨成員毫無疑問希望削減聯邦政府的規模，他們交流這方面的計劃已經幾十年了。

en: But, in the near term, what they promise is primarily tax cuts: their entire practical program is front-loaded in that direction.
zh: 但是，在短期，他們的承諾主要是減稅：他們的整個實用性規劃是一個朝著這個方向前進的前瞻性計劃。

en: The calculation is that this will prove politically popular (probably true) while making it easier to implement spending cuts down the road (less obvious).
zh: 他們的算盤是，政治上，這會得到民眾支援（也許是對的 ） ， 與此同時，這會讓後續的減支計劃更容易實施（正確性不那麼明顯 ） 。

en: The vulnerability caused by higher public debt over the next few decades is simply ignored.
zh: 而未來數十年公債增加所引起的脆弱性完全不在他們的考慮範圍內。

en: For example, Ryan supported George W. Bush’s spending spree.
zh: 比如，萊恩支援小布什的無節制支出。

en: He also supports maintaining defense spending at or near its current level – resisting the cuts that were put in place under the Budget Control Act of 2011.
zh: 他還支援將防務開支維持在（接近）現有水平，拒絕接受根據2011年預算控制法實施的防務開支縮減。

en: The assumption here – unstated and highly questionable – is that the US will be able to sell an unlimited amount of government debt at low interest rates for the foreseeable future.
zh: 他們的假設 — — 並沒有明說，也很可疑 — — 是在可預見的未來，美國仍能以極低的利率出售任意數量的國債。

en: There is no other country in the world where fiscal conservatives would want to be associated with such a high-stakes gamble.
zh: 在其他國家，沒有哪個財政保守派願意進行如此高賭注的豪賭。

en: America’s Failed Militarized Foreign Policy
zh: 美國失敗的軍事化外交政策

en: Many of today’s war zones – including Afghanistan, Ethiopia, Iran, Iraq, Pakistan, Somalia, and Sudan – share basic problems that lie at the root of their conflicts.
zh: 當今許多戰火不斷的地區—包括阿富汗、衣索比亞、伊朗、伊拉克、巴基斯坦、索馬利亞和蘇丹—都有著植根於它們衝突之中的基本問題。

en: They are all poor, buffeted by natural disasters – especially floods, droughts, and earthquakes – and have rapidly growing populations that are pressing on the capacity of the land to feed them.
zh: 它們都很貧窮，飽受自然災害之苦—特別是洪水、乾旱和地震—並且都有著急速增長的人口，給土地的承載力帶來巨大的壓力。

en: And the proportion of youth is very high, with a bulging population of young men of military age (15-24 years).
zh: 年輕人口的比例很高，達到入伍年齡(15-24 歲)的年輕人數量也在不斷增加。

en: All of these problems can be solved only through long-term sustainable economic development.
zh: 所有的這些問題透過長期可持續的經濟發展都可以解決。

en: Yet the United States persists in responding to symptoms rather than to underlying conditions by trying to address every conflict by military means.
zh: 然而，美國的反應卻是治標不治本，試圖透過軍事手段應對每一場衝突。

en: It backs the Ethiopian army in Somalia.
zh: 它在索馬利亞支援衣索比亞軍隊。

en: It occupies Iraq and Afghanistan.
zh: 它佔領了伊拉克和阿富汗。

en: It threatens to bomb Iran.
zh: 它威脅轟炸伊朗。

en: It supports the military dictatorship in Pakistan.
zh: 它支援巴基斯坦的軍事獨裁政權。

en: None of these military actions addresses the problems that led to conflict in the first place.
zh: 沒有一項這樣的軍事行動是旨在解決引發衝突的問題。

en: On the contrary, American policies typically inflame the situation rather than solve it.
zh: 相反，美國的政策通常是給當前的局勢火上澆油。

en: Time and again, this military approach comes back to haunt the US.
zh: 這種軍事手段使得美國屢屢自釀苦酒。

en: The US embraced the Shah of Iran by sending massive armaments, which fell into the hands of Iran’s Revolutionary Government after 1979.
zh: 它曾以提供大量武器裝備的形式支援伊朗國王，但這些裝備在1979年以後卻落入了伊朗“革命政府”手中。

en: The US then backed Saddam Hussein in his attack on Iran, until the US ended up attacking Saddam himself.
zh: 美國在那時支援薩達姆攻打伊朗，直到調轉槍頭對準薩達姆本人。

en: The US backed Osama bin Laden in Afghanistan against the Soviets, until the US ended up fighting bin Laden.
zh: 美國曾在阿富汗支援本•拉登抵抗蘇聯，直到他最終成為美國的頭號敵人。

en: Since 2001 the US has supported Pervez Musharraf in Pakistan with more than $10 billion in aid, and now faces an unstable regime that just barely survives.
zh: 自2001年起，美國給巴基斯坦的穆沙拉夫提供了超過100億美金的援助支援，而現在所面對的卻是一個搖搖欲墜的政權。

en: US foreign policy is so ineffective because it has been taken over by the military.
zh: 美國的外交政策如此低效的原因是它被軍方控制了。

en: Even postwar reconstruction in Iraq under the US-led occupation was run by the Pentagon rather than by civilian agencies.
zh: 就連美國佔領下的伊拉克戰後重建也是由五角大樓而不是民間機構主導的。

en: The US military budget dominates everything about foreign policy.
zh: 美國的軍事預算主導著外交政策的方方面面。

en: Adding up the budgets of the Pentagon, the Iraq and Afghanistan wars, the Department of Homeland Security, nuclear weapons programs, and the State Department’s military assistance operations, the US will spend around $800 billion this year on security, compared with less than $20 billion for economic development.
zh: 將五角大樓、伊拉克及阿富汗戰爭、國土安全部、核武計劃和國務院的軍事協助專案的預算加在一起，美國今年將在安全方面花費約8000億美元，而用於經濟發展的預算卻只有200億美元。

en: In a stunning article on aid to Pakistan during the Bush administration, Craig Cohen and Derek Chollet demonstrated the disastrous nature of this militarized approach – even before the tottering Musharraf regime’s latest crackdown.
zh: 在一篇關於布什政府對巴基斯坦的援助的文章中，Craig Cohen 和 Derek Chollet赫然揭示了這種軍事化手段的災難性特質—甚至在岌岌可危的穆沙拉夫政權最近的鎮壓行動之前。

en: They show that even though Pakistan faces huge problems of poverty, population, and environment, 75% of the $10 billion in US aid has gone to the Pakistani military, ostensibly to reimburse Pakistan for its contribution to the “war on terror,” and to help it buy F-16s and other weapons systems.
zh: 文章透露儘管巴基斯坦面臨貧困、人口和環境的巨大難題，100億美援中仍有75%流向了巴勒斯坦軍方，公然對巴基斯坦在“反恐戰爭”中所做的貢獻進行償付，並幫助其購買F16戰鬥機和其他武器系統。

en: Another 16% went straight to the Pakistani budget, no questions asked.
zh: 另有16%直接流入巴基斯坦的預算，具體去向不明。

en: That left less than 10% for development and humanitarian assistance.
zh: 所剩給發展與人道主義援助的部分不足10 % 。

en: Annual US aid for education in Pakistan has amounted to just $64 million, or $1.16 per school-aged child.
zh: 用於巴基斯坦教育方面的年度美國援助總額僅有6400萬美元，平均到每個學齡兒童身上只有1.16美元。

en: The authors note that “the strategic direction for Pakistan was set early by a narrow circle at the top of the Bush administration and has been largely focused on the war effort rather than on Pakistan’s internal situation.”
zh: 該文的兩位作者還指出“巴基斯坦的戰略方向早先是由布什政府高層的一個小圈子設定的，其中心是戰爭而不是巴基斯坦的國內狀況。

en: They also emphasize that “US engagement with Pakistan is highly militarized and centralized, with very little reaching the vast majority of Pakistanis.”
zh: ”他們還強調“美國與巴基斯坦的接觸是高度軍事化和集中化的，與廣大巴基斯坦民眾幾乎不相干。

en: They quote George Bush as saying, “When [Musharraf] looks me in the eye and says…there won’t be a Taliban and won’t be al-Qaeda, I believe him, you know?”
zh: ”他們援引布什的話 ： “ 當（穆沙拉夫）直視著我的眼睛說 … … 將不會有塔利班也不會有基地組織時，我相信他，你���白麼？ ”

en: This militarized approach is leading the world into a downward spiral of violence and conflict.
zh: 這種軍事化的手段正將世界引入無止境的暴力與衝突之中。

en: Each new US weapons system “sold” or given to the region increases the chances of expanded war and further military coups, and to the chance that the arms will be turned on the US itself.
zh: “出售”或給予該地區的每一件新的美國武器系統都會增加戰爭擴大和進一步軍事政變的機率，也會增加將這些武器用來對付美國自身的機率。

en: None of it helps to address the underlying problems of poverty, child mortality, water scarcity, and lack of livelihoods in places like Pakistan’s Northwest Frontier Province, Sudan’s Darfur region, or Somalia.
zh: 它們對解決那些重要的問題毫無幫助：如在巴基斯坦西北的邊疆省、蘇丹的達爾富爾地區或索馬利亞的貧困、兒童死亡、水源缺乏及缺少謀生手段。

en: These places are bulging with people facing a tightening squeeze of insufficient rainfall and degraded pasturelands.
zh: 這些地區的眾多人口都面臨著降雨不足和草場退化的嚴重威脅。

en: Naturally, many join radical causes.
zh: 很自然，在這樣的情況下很多人加入了激進組織。

en: The Bush administration fails to recognize these fundamental demographic and environmental challenges, that $800 billion of security spending won’t bring irrigation to Afghanistan, Pakistan, Sudan, and Somalia, and therefore won’t bring peace.
zh: 布什政府沒有意識到這些人口和環境方面的挑戰，8000億的安全支出不會給阿富汗、巴基斯坦、蘇丹和索馬利亞帶來灌溉，因此也無法帶來和平。

en: Instead of seeing real people in crisis, they see caricatures, a terrorist around every corner.
zh: 他們看不到危機中的真實民眾，而只看得到漫畫般的，藏匿在每個角落的恐怖分子。

en: A more peaceful world will be possible only when Americans and others begin to see things through the eyes of their supposed enemies, and realize that today’s conflicts, having resulted from desperation and despair, can be solved through economic development rather than war.
zh: 只有當美國人及其盟友開始從他們假想敵的視角看問題，並意識到當今源自於絕望的衝突只能透過經濟發展而不是戰爭來解決時，我們才可能擁有一個更為和平的世界。

en: We will have peace when we heed the words of President John F. Kennedy, who said, a few months before his death, “For, in the final analysis, our most basic common link is that we all inhabit this small planet. We all breathe the same air.
zh: 如果我們注意聆聽肯尼迪總統在遇刺前的幾個月所說的話，就能得到和平—他說 ： “ 因為，終究我們最基本的共同聯絡是我們都生活在這個小小的星球；我們都呼吸著同樣的空氣；我們都珍惜孩子們的未來，而且我們都是凡人。

en: We all cherish our children’s future. And we are all mortal.”
America’s Financial Leviathan
zh: 美國的金融利維坦

en: BERKELEY – In 1950, finance and insurance in the United States accounted for 2.8% of GDP, according to US Department of Commerce estimates.
zh: 伯克利 — — 根據美國商業部的統計數字，1950年，美國金融和保險業佔GDP的比重為2.8 % 。

en: By 1960, that share had grown to 3.8% of GDP, and reached 6% of GDP in 1990.
zh: 1960年，這一比重已上升為3.8 % ， 1990年則達到了6 % 。

en: Today, it is 8.4% of GDP, and it is not shrinking.
zh: 今天，這一數字是8.4 % ， 而且並沒有出現下滑。

en: The Wall Street Journal’s Justin Lahart reports that the 2010 share was higher than the previous peak share in 2006.
zh: 《華爾街日報》的賈斯丁·萊哈特（Justin Lahart）報道說，2010年，該比重超過了2006年前一次高峰值。

en: Lahart goes on to say that growth in the finance-and-insurance share of the economy has “not, by and large, been a bad thing....Deploying capital to the places where it can be best used helps the economy grow...”
zh: 萊哈特繼續指出，金融和保險佔經濟比重的增加“大體而言並非壞事 … … 讓資本流到用場最大的地方有助於經濟的增長 … … ”

en: But if the US were getting good value from the extra 5.6% of GDP that it is now spending on finance and insurance – the extra $750 billion diverted annually from paying people who make directly useful goods and provide directly useful services – it would be obvious in the statistics.
zh: 但如果美國從這如今付給金融和保險業的額外資金 — — 佔GDP的5.6 % ， 相當於從付給直接生產有用商品和直接提供有用服務的人的錢中每年抽出7 500億美元 — — 中得到好處的話，那麼統計數字應該有所體現。

en: At a typical 5% annual real interest rate for risky cash flows, diverting that large a share of resources away from goods and services directly useful this year is a good bargain only if it boosts overall annual economic growth by 0.3% – or 6% per 25-year generation.
zh: 按風險現金流實際利率的通常水平5%計算，在今年將如此大比重的資源從直接可用的商品和服務中抽出，如果要讓其不至於得不償失，就意味著這筆資源能夠提振0.3%的年經濟增長 — — 或在25年的一代人的時間裡提振6 % 。

en: There have been many shocks to the US economy over the past couple of generations, and many factors have added to or subtracted from economic growth.
zh: 過去幾代人經歷了多次對美國經濟的衝擊，諸多因素都領經濟增長雪上加霜。

en: But it is not obvious that the US economy today would be 6% less productive if it had had the finance-insurance system of 1950 rather than the one that prevailed during the past 20 years.
zh: 但沒有明顯的證據表明，如果金融-保險系統維持1950年的水平，而沒有像過去20年那樣出現爆發式增長，那麼今天美國經濟的生產率會比現在低6 % 。

en: There are five ways that an economy gains from a well-functioning finance-insurance system.
zh: 經濟從運轉良好的金融-保險系統中獲益，存在五種途徑。

en: First, people are no longer as vulnerable to the effects of fires, floods, medical disasters, unemployment, business collapses, sectoral shifts, and so forth, because a well-working finance-insurance system diversifies and thus dissipates some risks, and deals with others by matching those who fear risk with those who can comfortably bear it.
zh: 其一，人們不再會因火災、水災、疾病、失業、企業倒閉、部門興衰等因素而遭受打擊，因為運轉良好的金融-保險系統會分散從而消解一部分風險，並能將懼怕某種風險的人與能夠安然承受這種風險等人之間匹配交易。

en: While it might be true that America’s current finance-insurance system better distributes risk in some sense, it is hard to see how that could be the case, given the experience of investors in equities and housing over the past two decades.
zh: 誠然，美國當前的金融-保險系統在某種程度上說也許更好地分散了風險，但從過去二十年的股票和房地產投資者的經歷看，很難判定這一點是否真的成立。

en: Second, well-functioning financial systems match large, illiquid investment projects with the relatively small pools of money contributed by individual savers who value liquidity highly.
zh: 其二，運轉良好的金融-保險系統將大規模、低流動性的投資專案與相對較小、由看重流動性的個人儲蓄者提供的資金組成的資金池匹配了起來。

en: There has been one important innovation over the past two generations: businesses can now issue high-yield bonds.
zh: 在過去兩代人的時間裡，有一項重要創新：現在，企業可以發行高收益債券。

en: But, given the costs of the bankruptcy process, it has never been clear why a business would rather issue high-yield bonds (besides gaming the tax system), or why investors would rather buy them than take an equity stake.
zh: 但是，處於破產過程成本的考慮，企業為什麼喜歡發行高收益債券（除了與稅收系統周旋的原因之外 ） 、 投資者為什麼喜歡購買高收益債券，而不採用股票發行和購買的方式還並沒有水落石出。

en: Third, improved opportunities to borrow allow one to spend more now, when one is poor, and save more later, when one is rich.
zh: 其三，借貸機會的改善使得人們可以在今天（較窮時）支出得更多，在未來（較富時）儲蓄得更多。

en: Households are certainly much more able to borrow, thanks to home-equity loans, credit-card balances, and payday loans.
zh: 家庭的借貸機會有了明顯的提高，這得歸功於住房所有權貸款、信用卡賬戶和發薪日貸款。

en: But what are they really buying?
zh: 但實際上他們買了些什麼呢？

en: Many are not buying the ability to spend when they are poor and save when they are rich, but instead appear to be buying postponement of the “unpleasant financial retrenchment” talk with the other members of their household.
zh: 許多人並沒有買到較窮時支出、較富時儲蓄的能力，而是買到了暫時不必與其他家庭成員討論“不愉快的財務緊縮”的機會。

en: And that is not something you want to buy.
zh: 而這正是你所想買到的。

en: Fourth, we have seen major improvements in the ease of transactions.
zh: 其四，我們看到，交易的便利性有了極大的改善。

en: But, while electronic transactions have made a great deal of financial life much easier, this should have been accompanied by a decrease, not an increase, in the finance share of GDP, just as automated switching in telecommunications led to a decrease in the number of telephone switchboard operators per phone call.
zh: 但是，儘管電子交易讓金融生活有了極大的便利，但這應該伴隨著GDP的金融比重的下降而不是上升，正如通訊裝置的自動開關應該使手機上的電話按鍵操作減少一樣。

en: Indeed, the operations of those parts of the financial system most closely related to technological improvements have slimmed down markedly: consider what has happened to the checking operations of the regional Federal Reserve Banks.
zh: 事實上，與���術進步關係最密切的那部分金融系統的操作有了顯著的簡化，地區聯邦儲備銀行的核對操作就是明證。

en: Finally, better finance should mean better corporate governance.
zh: 最後，更棒的金融意味著更棒的公司治理。

en: Since shareholder democracy does not provide effective control over entrenched, runaway, self-indulgent management, finance has a potentially powerful role to play in ensuring that corporate managers work in the interest of shareholders.
zh: 由於股東民主沒能有效控制管理層的放任恣睢，金融扮演著保證公司管理者按股東利益行事的重要角色。

en: And a substantial change has indeed occurred over the past two generations: CEOs focus much more attention than they used to on pleasing the stock market, and this is likely to be a good thing.
zh: 而在過去兩代人的時間裡，的確發生了深遠的變化：CEO們比以前更關注股市表現了，這或許是件好事。

en: Overall, however, it remains disturbing that we do not see the obvious large benefits, at either the micro or macro level, in the US economy’s efficiency that would justify spending an extra 5.6% of GDP every year on finance and insurance.
zh: 不過，總的來說，不管是在圍觀還是宏觀層面，我們並沒有看見顯而易見的大好處，這一點始終令人不安。 美國經濟的效率並沒有提高到能證明將這筆相當於GDP的5.6%的額外資金花在金融和保險上物有所值的程度。

en: Lahart cites the conclusion of New York University’s Thomas Philippon that today’s US financial sector is outsized by two percentage points of GDP.
zh: 萊哈特引用了紐約大學的托馬斯·菲力彭（Thomas Philippon）的結論：今日美國的金融部門顯得太大了，佔GDP的比重至少比合理水平高2個百分點。

en: And it is very possible that Philippon’s estimate of the size of the US financial sector’s hypertrophy is too small.
zh: 而且菲力彭對美國金融部門規模的估計很有可能是低估的。

en: Why has the devotion of a great deal of skill and enterprise to finance and insurance sector not paid obvious economic dividends?
zh: 為什麼投入金融和保險部門的技能和創業精神沒有產生顯而易見的經濟紅利？

en: There are two sustainable ways to make money in finance: find people with risks that need to be carried and match them with people with unused risk-bearing capacity, or find people with such risks and match them with people who are clueless but who have money.
zh: 在金融業中賺錢的可持續之道有二：找到有風險可轉的人，並將他們與有風險承擔能力的人相匹配；或找到有風險的人，並將他們與身份不明但手握重金的人相匹配。

en: Are we sure that most of the growth in finance stems from a rising share of financial professionals who undertake the former rather than the latter?
zh: 金融業的增長主要來自從事前一種業務還是後一種業務的專業人士，這個問題的答案有誰能確切知道嗎？

en: America’s Fiscal Isolationism
zh: 美國的財政孤立主義

en: DENVER – Patience might be a virtue, but not necessarily when it comes to American foreign policy.
zh: 丹佛 — — 耐心是一種美德，但在美國外交政策上絕非如此。

en: Consider “the long war,” a bold concept embraced a few years ago to describe the continuing struggle against terrorism, the grudging progress that could realistically be achieved, and the enormous financial burden that it would impose for years to come.
zh: 想想“漫長的戰爭”吧，這一醒目的概念是幾年前用來描述與恐怖主義曠日持久的戰爭的，獲勝可以做到，但其巨大的財政負擔將在多年內都無法消除。

en: It was also a realpolitik acknowledgement of the setbacks to be expected along the way (the “slog,” as then Defense Secretary Donald Rumsfeld put it).
zh: 這一概念也是對預期中的挫折的強權政治式的承認（用當時國防部長拉姆斯菲爾德的話說，就是“決勝 ” ） 。

en: Above all, the term was an effort to communicate to Americans, accustomed to waging war with speed and decisiveness (and insistent on it since Vietnam), the long-term sacrifice and commitment needed to win a war of survival.
zh: 無論如何，這個詞是說給美國人聽的，美國人習慣於發動決定性速決戰（自越戰以來這就是美軍所堅持的方針 ） ， 為事關存亡的戰爭作出長期犧牲和奮鬥。

en: Its proponents also understood that the war would not be limited to weapons, but would need to be a sustained effort, involving, as they put it, the “whole of government,” with civilian agencies marshaled behind military – or paramilitary – objectives.
zh: 其擁護者也明白，戰爭並非只是武器的比拼，而是連續不斷的付出，用他們的話說，要摧毀“政府全力投入”不僅是軍事或準軍事實體，還有其背後的民事機構。

en: Daunting as the effort would be, its advocates assumed a sustainable political consensus to support it.
zh: 這樣的付出令人生畏，因此其鼓吹者需要可持續的政治一致來支援它。

en: After all, the United States had been attacked.
zh: 畢竟，美國也曾被攻擊過。

en: Today, that consensus is unraveling as America’s politicians wrestle with a federal budget that is itself turning into a long war – one with its own casualties.
zh: 如今，隨著美國政客在曠日持久的聯邦預算論戰中鬥得不可開交，這個一致條件已不再成立。

en: The battle lines in this struggle suggest that there is little accord among political elites for any spending, let alone for a long war with far-flung commitments.
zh: 這場論戰表明，政治精英在所有支出方案上都存在分歧，更不用說勞師遠征事宜了。

en: As a result, basic assumptions are being questioned at every turn.
zh: 結果，每走一步，基本條件就會受到質疑。

en: Indeed, the current budget war seems to be reopening old divisions about America’s view of itself and the world.
zh: 事實上，當前預算論戰似乎重新撕開了美國對其自身以及世界看法的舊有分歧。

en: The outcome is far from certain, but even isolationism, a perennial American malady, seems to be making a comeback.
zh: 論戰結果遠未明瞭，甚至有孤立主義（在美國由來已久的弊端）捲土重來的可能。

en: Isolationism is a familiar refrain in US foreign policy among those elements of the right that consider the US too good for the world, as well as among those on the left who consider America a destructive global force.
zh: 美國外交政策經常陷入孤立主義的囹圄，孤立主義者既包括總是認為美國在全世界鶴立雞群的美國右派，也包括認為美國是全球不穩定因素的左派。

en: But this time, as perhaps never before, a bipartisan isolationist impulse is being driven by the budget.
zh: 但這一回可能與前幾次都不一樣，預算問題正在催生跨黨派孤立主義。

en: America’s fiscal crisis is profound, and it is not just about numbers.
zh: 美國的財政危機影響深遠，絕對不是幾個數字那麼簡單。

en: As the emotions in Washington today suggest, the aversion to tax increases runs far deeper than concern about their effect on current economic performance and job growth.
zh: 華盛頓的情緒表明，對加稅的厭惡要遠勝於當前經濟和就業表現。

en: In part, it represents a fundamental – some would say fundamentalist – view that taxes are to government what a bottle of whisky is to an alcoholic.
zh: 從某種程度上說，這代表著一種正統 — — 一些人稱之為正統派 — — 觀點，即稅收之於政府，就像威士忌之於酒鬼。

en: Government, as Ronald Reagan told us, is the problem, not the solution.
zh: 羅納德·里根告訴我們，政府不是解決方案，政府本身就是問題。

en: That message is bad news for American diplomacy.
zh: 這對美國外交來說可是個壞訊息。

en: The linkage between politicians’ unwillingness to fund domestic programs and the imperiled commitment to “the long war” might elude those in US foreign-policy circles, but it is not lost on the rest of the country.
zh: 政客一方面不願為國內計劃提供資金，一方面又在大打“漫長的戰爭 ” ， 美國外交圈可能會忽視兩者之間的聯絡，但其他美國人可不會。

en: Opinion surveys suggest that Americans want to maintain many of the “discretionary” domestic programs – schools, hospitals, transportation infrastructure, recreational parks, etc. – that are now on the chopping block in budget negotiations.
zh: 民意調查顯示，美國人願意維持許多“自由裁量”國內計劃 — — 學校、醫院、交通基礎設施，休閒公園等 — — 而這些計劃如今成了預算談判樽俎上的魚肉。

en: In places like rural El Paso County, on the eastern plains of Colorado, far from the federal budget debate’s epicenter, spending cuts are the order of the day.
zh: 在艾爾帕索縣（El Paso County）農村等地區，在科羅拉多州東部平原，在那些遠離聯邦預算論戰中心的地區，支出削減已經提上了議程。

en: School districts are increasing class sizes as they shed teachers, as well as deferring maintenance projects and curtailing the school-bus service.
zh: 隨著教師裁員，各學區紛紛提高了班級規模，校舍修繕計劃被推遲，校車服務也收到了影響。

en: These cuts are having a very real and immediate impact on El Paso County’s residents.
zh: 支出削減正在對艾爾帕索縣居民造成直接影響。

en: Can they, and other Americans who are losing vital services, really be expected to rise above it all and support funding to build new schools in Afghanistan?
zh: 他們（以及其他正在失去生活必須服務的美國人）真的會期待付出更多的稅收來為阿富汗建設新學校提供資金？

en: Not only are America’s public schools starting to look second-rate, but so is its infrastructure, which had long been a source of national pride.
zh: 不但美國公立學校正在淪為二等，美國基礎設施亦然，而這長期以來一直是美國人民的驕傲。

en: How many travelers nowadays can fail to note the difference between Asia’s new, efficient airports and the aging, clogged antiques in some major US cities?
zh: 現在，有多少旅行者會分不清亞洲的新建高效機場和美國各主要城市那老邁低效的古董機場？

en: The budget war is not producing any consensus on fixing America’s infrastructure, but it is beginning to produce a view that Afghanistan and Pakistan are far from being core US national interests.
zh: 預算論戰並沒有就修補美國基礎設施���成任何一致，倒是在造成這樣的印象：阿富汗和巴基斯坦才是美國的核心國家利益。

en: Why, people ask, are schools and roads in Afghanistan and Iraq more important than those in Colorado or California?
zh: 人們不禁要問，為什麼阿富汗和伊拉克的學校和道路比科羅拉多和加利福尼亞更重要？

en: At one point in 2008, the US military picked up the cost of transporting a tiger for the Baghdad zoo.
zh: 在2008年，美國軍隊承擔了向巴格達動物園運送一隻老虎的費用。

en: When was the last time the US government did that for a US zoo (outside of Washington, of course)?
zh: 美國政府上一次為美國動物園做同樣的事情要追溯到何年何月了（當然，華盛頓除外 ） ？

en: How this debate sorts itself out will have profound consequences for how America conducts itself in the world.
zh: 這場論戰如何收場將對美國如何在世界上給自己定位造成深遠影響。

en: But it might also take a toll on how the world reacts to America’s fastest-growing export: unsolicited advice.
zh: 但這也將有損於世界對美國增長最快的出口專案 — — 主動提供意見 — — 的反應。

en: Countries take others’ advice for many reasons.
zh: 一國接受他人意見的原因很多。

en: Sometimes they respect the adviser’s wisdom and insights (fairly rare in diplomacy).
zh: 有時他們尊重意見提供者的智慧和洞見（這在外交中非常罕見 ） 。

en: Or they might fear the consequences of not taking the advice (an offer one cannot refuse, so to speak).
zh: 有時他們害怕拒絕建議的後果（及不得不接受的意見 ） 。

en: Or, as is true of many of America’s diplomatic transactions, accepting advice could open the way to a better relationship and to additional assistance.
zh: 有時（正如大量美國外交交易所顯示的）接受建議開啟改善關係之門，從而帶來進一步的援助。

en: In short, diplomacy – and US diplomacy, in particular – often involves money.
zh: 簡言之，外交 — — 特別是美國外交 — — 通常與金錢有關。

en: But what if there is no money to offer?
zh: 但沒錢進行外交會怎麼樣呢？

en: What if Americans, tired of the budget cuts in their neighborhoods, refuse to support funds even for “the long war”?
zh: 如果美國人厭惡了對自己所住社群預算的削減，從而拒絕為“漫長的戰爭”掏腰包，情況又會如何？

en: At that point, senior US officials might well arrive in a country, offer advice, and find that nobody is bothering to listen.
zh: 真到了這一步，可能會是這樣：美國高官抵達某個國家，給出一些建議，結果發現根本沒人理他。

en: Learning from America’s Forgotten Default
zh: 汲取被遺忘的美國違約的教訓

en: LOS ANGELES – One of the most pervasive myths about the United States is that the federal government has never defaulted on its debts.
zh: 洛杉磯—關於美國的一則流傳甚廣的傳說是聯邦政府從未對其債務違過約。

en: Every time the debt ceiling is debated in Congress, politicians and journalists dust off a common trope: the US doesn’t stiff its creditors.
zh: 每一次國會爭論債務上限，政客和記者都會站出來說，美國不會失信於債權人。

en: There’s just one problem: it’s not true.
zh: 只有一個問題：這不是真的。

en: There was a time, decades ago, when the US behaved more like a “banana republic” than an advanced economy, restructuring debts unilaterally and retroactively.
zh: 幾十年前，美國曾經一度更像是一個“香蕉共和國”而不是發達經濟體，單方面和追溯性地重組債務。

en: And, while few people remember this critical period in economic history, it holds valuable lessons for leaders today.
zh: 儘管很少有人記得這段經濟史上的重要時期，但它對於今天的領導人來說是非常寶貴的教訓。

en: In April 1933, in an effort to help the US escape the Great Depression, President Franklin Roosevelt announced plans to take the US off the gold standard and devalue the dollar.
zh: 1933年4月，為了幫助美國擺脫大蕭條，羅斯福總統宣佈準備讓美國脫離金本位並讓美元貶值。

en: But this would not be as easy as FDR calculated.
zh: 但這不像羅斯福想象的那麼簡單。

en: Most debt contracts at the time included a “gold clause,” which stated that the debtor must pay in “gold coin” or “gold equivalent.”
zh: 當時的大部分債務合同都含有“黃金條款 ” ， 規定債務人必須用“金幣”或“黃金等價物”償付。

en: These clauses were introduced during the Civil War as a way to protect investors against a possible inflationary surge.
zh: 這些條款產生於內戰時期，初衷是為了保護投資者免收可能的通貨膨脹飆升的影響。

en: For FDR, however, the gold clause was an obstacle to devaluation.
zh: 但對羅斯福來說，黃金條款成為美元貶值的障礙。

en: If the currency were devalued without addressing the contractual issue, the dollar value of debts would automatically increase to offset the weaker exchange rate, resulting in massive bankruptcies and huge increases in public debt.
zh: 如果在不解決合同問題的情況下就讓美元貶值，那麼債務的美元價值就會自動上升以抵消下跌的匯率，導致大規模破產和公共債務水平飆升。

en: To solve this problem, Congress passed a joint resolution on June 5, 1933, annulling all gold clauses in past and future contracts.
zh: 為了解決這個問題，國會在1933年6月5日透過了聯合決議，廢除過去和未來的一切黃金條款。

en: The door was opened for devaluation – and for a political fight.
zh: 貶值的大門開啟了 — — 政治鬥爭的大門也隨之開啟。

en: Republicans were dismayed that the country’s reputation was being put at risk, while the Roosevelt administration argued that the resolution didn’t amount to “a repudiation of contracts.”
zh: 共和黨感到沮喪，因為美國的聲譽岌岌可危，而羅斯福政府認為決議並不構成“否認合同 ” 。

en: On January 30, 1934, the dollar was officially devalued.
zh: 1934年1月30日，美元正式貶值。

en: The price of gold went from $20.67 an ounce – a price in effect since 1834 – to $35 an ounce.
zh: 黃金價格從每盎司20.67美元 — — 自1834年生效的價格 — — 上漲到每盎司35美元。

en: Not surprisingly, those holding securities protected by the gold clause claimed that the abrogation was unconstitutional.
zh: 毫不奇怪，受黃金條款保護的證券持有者宣稱此舉違憲。

en: Lawsuits were filed, and four of them eventually reached the Supreme Court; in January 1935, justices heard two cases that referred to private debts, and two concerning government obligations.
zh: 這引起了很多官司，其中四宗最終抵達了最高法院；1935年1月，法官聽取了兩宗與私人債務有關的案件，兩宗與政府債務有關的案件。

en: The underlying question in each case was essentially the same: did Congress have the authority to alter contracts retroactively?
zh: 每宗案件的基本問題其實是一樣的：國會是否有權力追溯性地更改合同？

en: On February 18, 1935, the Supreme Court announced its decisions.
zh: 1935年2月18日，最高法院宣佈了裁決。

en: In each case, justices ruled 5-4 in favor of the government – and against investors seeking compensation.
zh: 每宗案件，法官都以5-4的投票做出有利於政府，不利於索賠投資者的裁決。

en: According to the majority opinion, the Roosevelt administration could invoke “necessity” as a justification for annulling contracts if it would help free the economy from the Great Depression.
zh: 根據多數意見，羅斯福政府可以以“必要性”為由撤銷合同，如果這有助於讓經濟擺脫大蕭條的話。

en: Justice James Clark McReynolds, a southern lawyer who was US Attorney General during President Woodrow Wilson’s first term, wrote the dissenting opinion – one for all four cases. In a brief speech, he talked about the sanctity of contracts, government obligations, and repudiation under the guise of law.
zh: 南方律師、在威爾遜總統的第一個任期擔任美國司法部長的詹姆斯·克拉克·麥克雷諾茲（James Clark McReynolds）法官撰寫了不同意見 — — 所有四個案件的不同意見都一樣。

en: He ended his presentation with strong words: “Shame and humiliation are upon us now. Moral and financial chaos may be confidently expected.”
zh: 在一次簡要演講中，他談到了合同的不可侵犯性、政府的義務，以及打著法律幌子的賴賬。

en: Most Americans have forgotten this episode, as collective amnesia has papered over an event that contradicts the image of a country where the rule of law prevails and contracts are sacred.
zh: 大部分美國人都忘了這段歷史，對於這個與國家形象 — — 法治和合同神聖不可侵犯 — — 相悖的事件，美國人犯了集體健忘症。

en: But good lawyers still remember it; today, the 1935 ruling is invoked when attorneys are defending countries in default (like Venezuela).
zh: 但好律師仍然記得；如今，為違約國家（如委內瑞拉）辯護的律師，都會援引1935年裁決。

en: And, as more governments face down new debt-related dangers – such as unfunded liabilities associated with pension and health-care obligations – we may see the argument surface even more frequently.
zh: 隨著更多政府面臨新的債務相關危機 — — 如與退休金和醫療義務有關的無力支付的負債 — — 我們可能會更加頻繁地看到這個論據出現。

en: According to recent estimates, the US government’s unfunded liabilities are a staggering 260% of GDP – and that does not include conventional federal debt and unfunded state and local government liabilities.
zh: 據最新估算，美國政府的無力支付負債高達GDP的260 % — —這還不包括常規聯邦債務和無力支付的州和地方政府負債。

en: Nor is this a problem only for America; in many countries, pension and health-related liabilities are increasing, while the ability to cover them is diminishing.
zh: 這一問題也不僅侷限於美國；許多國家的退休金和醫療相關負債都在不斷增加，而覆蓋這些債務的能力不斷削弱。

en: A key question, then, is whether governments seeking to adjust contracts retroactively may once again invoke the legal argument of “necessity.”
zh: 因此，一個關鍵問題是試圖追溯性調整合同的政府是否會再次援引“必要性”為合法藉口。

en: The 1933 abrogation of the gold clause provides abundant legal and economic reasons to consider this possibility.
zh: 1933年的撤銷黃金條款提供了充足的法律和經濟理由考慮這一可能性。

en: The US Supreme Court agreed with the “necessity” argument once before.
zh: 美國最高法院曾經首肯了“必要性”觀點。

en: It is not far-fetched to think that it may happen again.
zh: 認為它會再次這麼做絕非牽強附會。

en: The Maddening of America
zh: 變瘋的美國

en: BOSTON – The relative global decline of the United States has become a frequent topic of debate in recent years.
zh: 波士頓—近幾年來，美國的相對全球衰落成了常見的爭論主題。

en: Proponents of the post-American view point to the 2008 financial crisis, the prolonged recession that followed, and China’s steady rise.
zh: 後美國論的支持者的論據包括2008年金融危機及其後的長期衰退和中國的穩步崛起。

en: Most are international-relations experts who, viewing geopolitics through the lens of economic competitiveness, imagine the global order as a seesaw, in which one player’s rise necessarily implies another’s fall.
zh: 他們大多是國際關係專家，從經濟競爭力角度檢視地緣政治，將全球秩序想象為一個蹺蹺板，一方的崛起必然意味著另一方的衰落。

en: But the exclusive focus on economic indicators has prevented consideration of the geopolitical implications of a US domestic trend that is also frequently discussed, but by a separate group of experts: America’s ever-increasing rates of severe mental disease (which have already been very high for a long time).
zh: 但完全專注於經濟指標導致他們沒有注意到一個美國國內趨勢的地緣政治影響 — — 美國嚴重精神病發病率的日漸上升（這一比率已經多年保持高位 ） 。 這個趨勢也經常被討論，但討論者常常是另一群專家

en: The claim that the spread of severe mental illness has reached “epidemic” proportions has been heard so often that, like any commonplace, it has lost its ability to shock.
zh: 嚴重精神病的普遍程度已經達到了“傳染病”級別，我們經常能夠聽到這種論調，以至於已經對此見怪不怪了。

en: But the repercussions for international politics of the disabling conditions diagnosed as manic-depressive illnesses (including major unipolar depression) and schizophrenia could not be more serious.
zh: 但被診斷為狂躁抑鬱症（包括嚴重單相抑鬱）和精神分裂症的殘疾症狀的國際政治影響是極其嚴重的。

en: It has proved to be impossible to distinguish, either biologically or symptomatically, between different varieties of these conditions, which thus constitute a continuum – most likely of complexity, rather than severity.
zh: 不管從生物學還是從症候方面都無法區分這些不同型別的病症，於是我們看到了一個連續統 — — 最有可能是複雜性而不是嚴重性的連續統。

en: Indeed, the most common of these illnesses, unipolar depression, is the least complex in terms of its symptoms, but also the most lethal: 20% of depressed patients are estimated to commit suicide.
zh: 事實上，這些疾病中的最常見者 — — 單向抑鬱症從症狀來說是最不復雜的，但也是最致命的：據統計，20%的抑鬱症患者會走上自殺之路。

en: Both manic-depressive illness and schizophrenia are psychotic conditions, characterized by the patient’s loss of control over his or her actions and thoughts, a recurrent state in which s/he cannot be considered an agent with free will.
zh: 但狂躁抑鬱症和精神分裂症都屬於精神病範疇，其特徵是患者無法控制自身行為和思想，其發作具有週期性，發作時患者不能被視為擁有自由意志的行為人。

en: Obsessive suicidal thinking and paralyzing lack of motivation allow depressed patients to be classified as psychotic as well.
zh: 沉溺於自殺的想法和缺少動機使抑鬱症患者也可以歸為精神病。

en: These conditions are often accompanied by elaborate delusions – images of reality that confuse information generated in the mind with that provided from outside.
zh: 這些病症常常伴有精心構造的妄想 — — 即混淆了來自意識的資訊和來自外部提供的資訊的現實影像。

en: Often the distinction between symbols and their referents is lost, and patients begin seeing people solely as representations of some imagined force.
zh: 通常，符號及其意象之間的區別會消失，患者開始將人僅僅視為某種想象力量的代表。

en: The judgment of such people cannot be trusted, to put it mildly.
zh: 保守地說，這類人的判斷是不可信任的。

en: A massive statistical study, conducted from 2001 to 2003 by the US National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH), estimated the lifetime prevalence of major depression among American adults (ages 18-54) at more than 16%.
zh: 美國國家精神衛生研究所（US National Institute of Mental Health，NIMH）2001—2003年進行的一項大規模統計研究估算，美國成年人（18—54歲）終身嚴重抑鬱發病率為16%以上。

en: Lifetime prevalence for schizophrenia was estimated at 1.7%.
zh: 終身精神分裂症患病率約為1.7 % 。

en: There is no known cure for these chronic diseases; after onset (often before the age of 18), they are likely to last until the end of the patient’s life.
zh: 這些慢性疾病沒有已知的治療方法；首次發作（通常在18歲之前）後，就可能一直持續到患者生命終結。

en: Surveys among US college students estimated that 20% fit criteria for depression and anxiety in 2010, and that nearly 25% fit these criteria in 2012.
zh: 對美國大學生進行的調查表明，2010年有20%的受訪者符合抑鬱症和焦慮症標準，2012年則有25 % 。

en: Other studies have consistently shown rising rates of prevalence with each successive generation, and it is argued that, if older statistics were faulty, they erred on the side of underestimating the spread of mental illness.
zh: 其他研究也一致表明每一代人的發病率都在增加，有人指出，如果舊的統計數字是錯的，則錯在低估了精神疾病的普遍性。

en: All of this suggests that as many as 20% of American adults may be severely mentally ill.
zh: 所有這些表明，多達20%的美國成年人可能有嚴重的精神疾病。

en: In view of disputes over the significance of available data, let’s assume that only 10% of American adults are severely mentally ill.
zh: 從可獲得資料的重要性的爭論角度，我們假設只有10%的美國成年人有嚴重的精神疾病。

en: As these conditions are presumed to be distributed uniformly within the population, they must afflict a significant share of policymakers, corporate executives, educators, and military personnel of all ranks, recurrently rendering them psychotic, delusional, and deprived of sound judgment.
zh: 假設這些症狀在人口中均勻分佈，那麼它們必然同樣折磨著相當大比例的決策者、公司高管、教育家、各級軍士軍官，精神病的定期發作讓他們產生幻覺，無法做出正確判斷。

en: If it is deemed sensationalist to characterize this situation as terrifying, one may add that a much larger share of the population (estimated at close to 50% in the NIMH study) is affected by less severe forms of mental disease that only occasionally disturb their functionality.
zh: 如果說將這一狀況稱為可怕被認為是感覺論者，那麼���可以加上一點：更大比例的人口（NIMH估計接近50 % ） 受程度較輕的精神疾病的影響，這類疾病只是偶爾干擾神經功能。

en: Comparative epidemiologists have repeatedly noticed something remarkable about these illnesses: only Western countries (or, more precisely, societies with monotheistic traditions) – particularly prosperous Western countries – are subject to prevalence rates of this magnitude.
zh: 比較流行病學家一再注意到，這些疾病存在顯著特徵：只有西方國家（或者更準確地說，有一神論傳統的社會 ） ， 特別是繁榮的西方國家，存在如此程度的精神病普遍程度。

en: Southeast Asian countries appear to be especially immune to the bane of severe mental illness; in other regions, poverty, or lack of development, seems to offer a protective barrier.
zh: 南亞國家隊嚴重精神疾病尤其免疫；在其他地區，貧困或欠發展似乎可以成為保護性壁壘。

en: As I argue in my recent book Mind, Modernity, Madness, the reason for high concentrations of severe mental illness in the developed West lies in the very nature of Western societies.
zh: 我在近著《思維、現代性和瘋病 》 （ Mind, Modernity, Madness）中說明了嚴重精神疾病如此集中高發於發達西方的原因在於西方社會的性質。

en: The “virus” of depression and schizophrenia, including their milder forms, is cultural in origin: the embarrassment of choices that these societies offer in terms of self-definition and personal identity leaves many of their members disoriented and adrift.
zh: 抑鬱症和精神分裂症（包括程度較輕的形式 ） “ 病毒”根源在於文化：從社會成員的自我定義和個人身份角度講，這些社會存在選擇困難，以至於許多人迷失了方向，只能隨波逐流。

en: The US offers the widest scope for personal self-definition; it also leads the world in judgment-impairing disease.
zh: 美國提供了範圍最廣的個人自我定義；也存在世界上最大的選擇無能症候群。

en: Unless the growing prevalence of serious psychopathology is taken seriously and addressed effectively, it is likely to become the only indicator of American leadership.
zh: 除非嚴重精神病的日漸普遍被嚴肅對待、有效糾正，否則它將成為美國領導力的唯一指標。

en: The rise of China is unrelated to this.
zh: 中國的崛起與這一點可沒有關係。

en: Obama’s Underachieving Foreign Policy
zh: 奧巴馬外交政策差強人意

en: PARIS – To evaluate an American president’s foreign-policy performance after one term is challenging, given the complex diplomatic and strategic environment and significant domestic constraints that confront every US president.
zh: 巴黎—在美國總統的一個任期之後評估其外交政策表現是一個挑戰，因為每一位美國總統都面臨著複雜多變的外交和戰略環境以及嚴峻的國內約束。

en: Nevertheless, in advance of November’s presidential election, it is important to distinguish the forces that have shaped Barack Obama’s foreign policy, and to assess his handling of them.
zh: 儘管如此，在11月總統大選即將到來之際，認識一下什麼驅動力決定了奧巴馬的外交政策並評估他在處理外交問題上的表現仍然是非常重要的。

en: Obama kept his promise to withdraw American forces from Iraq during his first term.
zh: 在其第一個任期中，奧巴馬履行了從伊拉克撤軍的承諾。

en: But the move proved to be a strategic defeat, given that it significantly diminished the United States’ political influence in Iraq.
zh: 但這一行動是一場戰略失敗，因為這極大地削弱了美國在伊拉克的政治影響力。

en: Indeed, Prime Minister Nouri al-Maliki’s government is becoming increasingly allied with Iran.
zh: 事實上，總理馬利基政府正在倒向與伊朗結盟。

en: Obama, who opposed the Iraq war, should not be blamed for current circumstances there.
zh: 反對伊拉克戰爭的奧巴馬不應該成為伊拉克如此現狀的替罪羊。

en: But he was unable to improve the situation or help Iraq’s Shias and Sunnis reach a political compromise.
zh: 但他也沒能改善這一狀況或幫助伊拉克的什葉派和遜尼派達成政治妥協。

en: In contrast, Obama expanded the war in Afghanistan – which he considered to be a war of necessity – and put the Taliban on the defensive.
zh: 與之相對的是，奧巴馬擴大了阿富汗戰爭（他認為這是一場必要之仗 ） ， 並迫使塔利班採取了守勢。

en: But the US will begin to withdraw troops after 2014, without having defined a political solution in line with its interests.
zh: 但美國將在2014年後開始撤軍，與此同時，與其利益一致的政治解決方案並沒有產生。

en: Meanwhile, America’s strategic partnership with Pakistan, where Obama won a significant symbolic victory by eliminating Osama bin Laden, is in tatters.
zh: 與此同時，美國與巴基斯坦的戰略合作關係（在這方面，奧巴馬除掉了本·拉登，贏得了重要的象徵性勝利）也是千瘡百孔。

en: US-Pakistan relations have regressed to their level before September 11, 2001, with mutual distrust minimizing cooperation.
zh: 美巴關係已經退回了2001年9月11日之前的水平，相互不信任使得兩國無法精誠合作。

en: In fact, in all of the strategic challenges to US security that Obama inherited – Iran, North Korea, Iraq, Afghanistan, Pakistan, and the Israeli-Palestinian conflict – he has made virtually no significant political gains.
zh: 事實上，在奧巴馬接手的所有美國安全戰略挑戰中 — — 包括朝鮮、伊拉克、阿富汗、巴基斯坦和以色列-巴勒斯坦衝突 — — 他幾乎沒有取得任何重大政治成果。

en: Notwithstanding Obama’s skillful response to the Arab Spring – the only strategic surprise that he has faced as president – his credibility in the Muslim world has steadily declined.
zh: 儘管奧巴馬對於阿拉伯之春的反應可謂靈巧 — — 這也是他作為總統所面臨的唯一一次戰略驚奇 — — 但其在穆斯林世界中的信譽在穩步下降。

en: He has failed to deliver on the key promise of his Cairo speech in 2009: “to seek a new beginning between the United States and Muslims around the world.”
zh: 他沒能兌現2009年開羅演講所作出的重要承諾 ： “ 尋求美國和全世界穆斯林的新關係 ” 。

en: Moreover, Obama’s efforts to improve relations with Russia – embodied in the Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty (START) – did not lead to a genuine “reset” in bilateral ties, largely because an increasingly Soviet-style Russian leadership distrusts a US establishment that still regards Russia as a foe.
zh: 此外，奧巴馬與俄羅斯改善關係的努力 — — 體現在戰略武器削���條約（START）中 — — 並沒有讓兩國關係真正實現“重置 ” ， 這主要是因為越來越蘇維埃化的俄羅斯領導層不信任仍然將俄羅斯視為敵人的美國。

en: And the US-China relationship has deteriorated, with America seeking to manage China’s rise strategically – for example, through regional trade agreements and an enhanced military presence in Asia.
zh: 美中關係也出現了倒退，美國尋求遏制中國的戰略崛起，比如透過地區貿易協定以及增加在亞洲的軍事部署。

en: On multilateral issues, Obama’s performance is equally unimpressive.
zh: 在多邊問題方面，奧巴馬的表現也同樣不盡如人意。

en: After committing to a 17% reduction of greenhouse-gas emissions by 2020 – and despite his declaration that he would not tolerate inaction in this area – he simply stopped raising the issue after the Republicans’ sweeping victory in the November 2010 mid-term elections.
zh: 他承諾在2020年削減溫室氣體排放量的17 % ， 並聲稱他無法容忍在該領域無所作為，但在2010年中期選舉共和黨大獲全勝後，他便不再提及這一問題。

en: Likewise, domestic pressure has caused Obama to neglect trade issues.
zh: 類似地，國內壓力還迫使奧巴馬忽視貿易問題。

en: The US is largely responsible for the failure of the Doha Round of global trade talks.
zh: 美國要為全球貿易談判多哈回合的失敗負主要責任。

en: Obama’s one significant foreign-policy breakthrough has been to release the US from the grip of the “global war on terror.”
zh: 奧巴馬的重大外交政策突破之一是把美國從“全球恐怖戰爭”的束縛中解放了出來。

en: Jettisoning the Manichean rhetoric of that “war” allowed the US to regain the political legitimacy that former President George W. Bush had lost, without diminishing its strategic credibility.
zh: 放棄這場對“戰爭”的摩尼教式的口吻，美國重新贏得了前總統小布什所丟掉的政治合法性，同時又沒有降低其戰略信譽。

en: After the Vietnam War, Jimmy Carter hoped to make a break with established US policy.
zh: 越南戰爭後，卡特希望在既成美國政策中取得突破。

en: But his administration’s actions – including serious blunders in Iran and Afghanistan – made the US appear weak and indecisive.
zh: 但他的政府的行為 — — 包括在伊朗和阿富汗所犯下的重大錯誤 — — 讓美國顯得孱弱而猶豫。

en: While Obama’s policies have not weakened America’s international standing, they also have not led to achievements comparable to Richard Nixon’s rapprochement with China, largely owing to what might be described as the dogmatic pragmatism that underlies them – an emphasis on avoiding the worst, rather than on striving for the best.
zh: 奧巴馬的政策儘管沒有削弱了美國的國際立場，但也沒有帶來堪與尼克松與中國建交相比的成就，主要的原因在於奧巴馬外交政策背後的教條實用主義 — — 強調避免最壞結果，而不是追求最好結果。

en: Moreover, Obama has been confronted with significant constraints, including the global economic crisis, domestic political polarization, a hostile Congress, and the rise of emerging powers that need the US but are unwilling to accept its dominance.
zh: 此外，奧巴馬還面臨了重大約束，包括全球經濟危機、國內政治兩極分化、敵意國會，以及需要美國又不願接受美國主導的新興大國的崛起。

en: As a result, he has failed to change strategic realities by, for example, reconciling America’s broader interests with those of Iran (a declared enemy), Pakistan (a “frenemy”), and Israel (a key ally).
zh: 結果，奧巴馬沒能透過（比如）將美國與伊朗（明確宣佈的敵人 ） 、 巴基斯坦（亦敵亦友）和以色列（關鍵盟友）的更廣泛的利益協調起來改變戰略現實。

en: To be sure, Obama faces a more complex diplomatic and strategic environment than Nixon faced in the 1970’s.
zh: 平心而論，奧巴馬所面臨的外交和戰略環境比20世紀70年代尼克松更復雜。

en: Unstable coalitions in Iran prevent any substantive negotiations between the two countries, while political fragmentation in Pakistan significantly hinders US policy there.
zh: 伊朗內部聯盟的不穩定性決定了美伊之間不可能開展任何有意義的談判，而巴基斯坦的政治分裂局面也極大地拖累了美國的巴基斯坦政策。

en: And the fragility of Israel’s ruling coalition, combined with strong congressional support for Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu, makes it difficult to influence the country’s policies, despite Israel’s significant impact on US strategy in the Arab world.
zh: 以色列執政聯盟的脆弱性，加上國會對總理內塔尼亞胡的強烈支援導致美國很難影響以色列的政策，儘管以色列對美國的阿拉伯政策具有重大影響。

en: But Obama has also struggled to define the terms of a possible grand bargain.
zh: 但奧巴馬仍然勉強地給出了可能的大談判的條件。

en: Any agreement with Iran would require consent from Israel and the Gulf countries, which do not share the same objectives.
zh: 任何與伊朗達成的協議都必須經過以色列和海灣國家同意，而後兩者的目標並不相同。

en: And the US cannot reach an accord with Pakistan without India’s consent, which America would be unable to force, especially given that it relies on India to counterbalance China’s growing clout in Asia.
zh: 美國也不可能在印度不同意的情況下與巴基斯坦達成協議，而印度是否同意並不由美國說了算，特別是在美國需要依賴印度制衡中國在亞洲的影響力的情況下。

en: With Israel, the terms are ostensibly simpler: in exchange for a stronger US security guarantee, Israel would accept the establishment of a Palestinian state based on the 1967 borders.
zh: 至於以色列，條件看上去更簡單：作為對美國加強其安全保證的交換，以色列將接受巴勒斯坦沿1967年邊境建國。

en: But Israel is also a crucial domestic political topic in the US; indeed, any distancing from Israel is unacceptable to most Americans.
zh: 但以色列也是美國的主要國內政治話題之一；事實上，任何遠離以色列的做法對於大部分美國人來說都是不可接受的。

en: While Obama’s first term could not be called a foreign-policy disappointment, his achievements – although not trivial – have been limited.
zh: 儘管奧巴馬的第一個任期的外交政策算不上令人失望，但他的成就 — — 雖說不小 — — 極其有限。

en: If he wins a second term, he is likely to find it increasingly difficult to win by playing not to lose.
zh: 如果他能夠贏得第二個任期，那麼他可能會更加難以透過立足不敗之地獲得勝利。

en: America’s Groucho Marxists
zh: 美國的“格魯喬”馬克思主義者

en: LONDON – Groucho Marx has always been my favorite Marxist.
zh: 發自倫敦 — — 美國喜劇明星格魯喬·馬克思一直是我最鍾愛的“馬克思主義者 ” 。

en: One of his jokes goes to the heart of the failure of the ideology – the dogmatic religion – inflicted on our poor world by his namesake, Karl.
zh: 他的其中一條笑料道破了馬克思主義意識形態 — — 既所謂教條化的信仰 — — 為何失敗的核心原因，而這個信仰曾被他的同族人卡爾·馬克思所利用，令我們這個悲慘的世界飽受折磨。

en: “Who are you going to believe,” Groucho once asked, “me, or your own eyes?”
zh: “你到底要信誰 ， “ 格魯喬曾經這樣問道 ， “ 是我，還是你自己的眼睛？

en: For hundreds of millions of citizens in Communist-run countries in the twentieth century, the “me” in the question was a dictator or oligarchy ruling with totalitarian or authoritarian powers.
zh: ”對於成千上萬名生活在20世紀社會主義國家的公民來說，問題中的“我”是一個用極權主義或者強權主義來進行統治的獨裁者或者政治寡頭集團。

en: It didn’t matter what you could see with your own eyes. You had to accept what you were told the world was like.
zh: 你自己的眼睛看到的一切並不重要，你必須接受世界就是他們所說的樣子。

en: Reality was whatever the ruling party said it was.
zh: 執政黨說它是什麼它就是什麼，這就是現實。

en: The designated successor to Mao Zedong in China, Hua Guofeng, raised this attitude to an art form. He was known as a “whateverist.”
zh: 在中國，毛澤東指定的繼承人華國鋒把這個觀點發揮到了極致：眾所周知，他是個“凡是主義者 ” 。

en: The Party and people should faithfully follow whatever Mao instructed them to do.
zh: 中國共產黨和人民就該一心一意遵照毛主席曾經指示的去辦。

en: Groucho posed two insuperable problems for the “whateverists” of communism. First, your own eyes and your reason would surely tell you before long that the communist idyll – the withering away of the state and the triumph over need – would never come.
zh: 而格魯喬則向這種“凡是主義者”提出了兩個無法回答的難題：首先，你的兩隻眼睛和理智相當肯定地告訴你自己，類似“國家消亡”和征服市場需求理論這號共產主義田園牧歌式景象將永遠不會到來。

en: Communism, like the horizon, was always just beyond reach.
zh: 共產主義更像天邊的地平線，永遠可望而不可及。

en: It would be interesting to know how many of those at Beijing’s Central Party School – the party’s main educational institute – believe that the Chinese state is about to wither away, or ever will.
zh: 而如果能讓我們瞭解一下在北京中央黨校 — — 這個中國共產黨最主要的教育機構 — — 進修的人之中究竟有多少會相信作為一個國家形式的中國即將消亡，或者總有一天會消亡，這都會是一件挺有趣的事。

en: The second application of Groucho’s question was that citizens of most Communist countries soon learned that the loss of freedom that they suffered was not compensated by greater prosperity or a higher quality of life.
zh: 格魯喬難題在現實中的第二個體現，則是大多數共產主義國家的國民都很快發現，他們喪失自由的痛苦並沒有換來更多的繁榮或者更高的生活水平。

en: The more that Russians, Poles, Czechs, and others saw of the life-style in the Western democracies, the more they questioned their own system.
zh: 生活在俄羅斯、波蘭、捷克和其他社會主義國家的人們越多看到西方民主國家的生活方式，他們就越質疑自己的社會體系。

en: In his magisterial book The Rise and Fall of Communism, Archie Brown notes how travel abroad opened Mikhail Gorbachev’s eyes to the failure of the system that he had lived under all his life.
zh: 在阿奇·布朗的權威性著作《共產主義興衰論》中就記述了出國訪問是怎樣開啟了米哈伊爾·戈爾巴喬夫的眼界，令其發現了一生寄身其中的社會體系的失敗之處。

en: So, in the political sphere, reason has trumped both faith in an unattainable goal and self-delusion about the consequences of its pursuit.
zh: 因此在政治範疇內，理性既戰勝了那種追求遙不可及目標的信念，也擊敗了那種為這一追求而放棄某些權利的自欺欺人之舉。

en: Authoritarian party-states, such as China and Vietnam, survive, but not through commitment to communism. Their legitimacy depends on their ability to deliver economic growth through state-managed capitalism.
zh: 雖然中國和越南這類獨裁政黨統治下的國家最終生存了下來，但這並不是透過篤行共產主義那一套，而是依靠由國家主導的資本主義來發展經濟，最終保住了自己的統治合法性。

en: Democracies, of course, allow people to use their reason to make choices based on the evidence of their own eyes.
zh: 而民主國家這一邊，人民能夠運用自身的理智，根據他們親眼所見來作出選擇。

en: When you don’t like a government, you can turn the rascals out without overthrowing the whole system.
zh: 當你不喜歡某屆政府，你可以將這些混蛋趕下臺，而不必去推翻整個政體。

en: Change can be made in an evolutionary, rather than a revolutionary, way.
zh: 改變是漸進式的，而不是一場徹底革命。

en: But no one should think that debate in democracies is always based on reason, or that democracy necessarily makes people more rational.
zh: 但人們也不應認為民主國家裡的政治爭論就總是建築在理性之上的，或者想當然地認為民主制度必然會令人民變得更加理性。

en: Sometimes reason does prevail. This is what appeared to happen in the last Indian election, and the election in the United States of President Barack Obama was also plainly a supremely rational moment.
zh: 有時候理性確實能夠獲勝，正如最近一屆印度大選；美國總統奧巴馬的當選也無疑是個崇高的理性時刻。

en: But reason does not seem to be getting much of a hearing during the current health-care debate in the US.
zh: 然而，在目前關於美國醫療保健改革的爭論當中，理性似乎沒佔到什麼便宜。

en: Outsiders, even admirers, have often wondered how the most globalized country in the world – a continent inhabited by people from every land – can be so irrationally insular on some issues.
zh: 局外人，甚至是仰慕者們都經常感到詫異 — — 美國這個世界上全球化程度最高的國度、一塊由各大洲移民居住的大陸怎麼會在某些問題上顯得如此狹隘而不理智。

en: We scratch our heads about America’s gun laws. We were astonished during President George W. Bush’s first term at the administration’s hostility to science, reflected in its stance on climate change and Charles Darwin’s theory of evolution.
zh: 美國的槍支法令我們摸不著頭腦，我們也曾震驚於喬治·W·布什總統在其第一屆任期內那種對科學的敵視態度，比如此人在氣候變化和達爾文進化論上竟會如此頑固不化。

en: The opposition to health-care reform is a similar cause of bemusement.
zh: 而對醫療改革的反對，也引起了我們同樣的困惑。

en: We know that despite its great wealth – and its groundbreaking medical research – America’s health-care system is awful. It is hugely expensive.
zh: 眾所周知，除了巨大的財富與其不斷創新突破的醫藥研究之外，美國的醫療體系其實非常糟糕：它異常昂貴，並且花費高得令工作場所健康保險體系都負擔不住。

en: Its costs overwhelm workplace health-insurance schemes. The poor go unprotected.
zh: 窮人缺乏保護，很多疾病也不在保障範圍之內。

en: Too many of the sick are untreated. Overall health statistics are worse than those in comparable countries.
zh: 總的來說，美國的健康統計資料比其他類似國家都要差得多。

en: Yet Obama’s attempts to reform health care have run into hysterical opposition.
zh: 但即便如此，奧巴馬試圖改革醫療體系的舉措還是遭到了近乎瘋狂的反對。

en: His proposals would lead, it is said, to the state murdering the elderly.
zh: 有人說他的提案意味著國家在謀殺那些年老的公民。

en: They would introduce Soviet communism into the US – just like what apparently exists in Canada and Britain, with their state-sponsored health systems.
zh: 並認為政府這種由各州提供財政支援的醫療體系將等同於把蘇聯社會主義引入美國 — — 就像已經明確存在於加拿大和英國的那樣。

en: Communism in Toronto and London?
zh: 那麼此舉究竟有沒有讓多倫多和倫敦籠罩在共產主義的陰影之下？

en: Or just better, cheaper, more reliable health care for all?
zh: 還是創造了一個面向所有人，更好、更經濟實惠並且值得信賴的醫療體系呢？

en: Reason seems to be having a hard time of it in the US just now.
zh: 如今在美國國內，理性似乎正舉步維艱。

en: Maybe it’s no coincidence that Groucho Marx was an American citizen.
zh: 也許只有這樣一個國度才能孕育出格魯喬這種能深入思考教條主義的奇人。

en: But surely the way a society cares for its sick and needy and elderly is sufficiently important to deserve serious and thoughtful argument based on what we really can see with our own eyes rather than on uninformed partisan prejudice.
zh: 但能夠肯定的是，一個社會如何關照老弱病殘等弱勢群體的問題非常有必要得到人們嚴肅而周全的討論，而這些討論的依據必須是人們的親眼所見，而不是那些愚昧無知的黨派成見。

en: Gun Control After Newtown
zh: 紐頓之後話槍管

en: NEW YORK – The brutal murder of 20 children and seven adults in Newtown, Connecticut, shakes us to the core as individuals and requires a response as citizens.
zh: 紐約—康涅狄格州紐頓市20名兒童、7名成人遇害慘案駭人心魄，作為公民，我們必須對此有所反應。

en: The United States seems to reel from one mass gun killing to another – roughly one a month this year alone.
zh: 美國似乎陷入了大規模槍擊殺人的怪圈，光是今年，幾乎每個月都要發生一起。

en: Easy access to guns in the US leads to horrific murder rates relative to other highly educated and wealthy societies.
zh: 在美國，得到槍支易如反掌，這導致與其他教育程度較高的富裕社會相比，美國的謀殺大案率較高。

en: America needs to find a better way.
zh: 美國必須找到一條更好的道路。

en: Other countries have done so.
zh: 其他國家已經找到了這樣的道路。

en: Between the mid-1970’s and the mid-1990’s, Australia had several mass shootings.
zh: 20世紀70年代中期至90年代中期，澳大利亞發生過數起大規模槍擊案。

en: After a particularly horrible massacre in 1996, a new prime minister, John Howard, declared that enough was enough.
zh: 1996年的特別重大殺戮事件後，新任總理霍華德（John Howard）宣佈，夠了已經夠了（enough was enough ） 。

en: He instituted a severe crackdown on gun ownership, and forced would-be gun owners to submit to a rigorous application process, and to document why they would need a gun.
zh: 他嚴厲打擊槍支保有，強迫潛在持槍者走嚴格的申請程式，且必須說明需要持槍的原因。

en: Conditions for gun ownership in Australia are now very strict, and the registration and approval process can take a year or more.
zh: 如今，澳大利亞的持槍條件十分嚴格，註冊和批准程式長達一年或以上。

en: Howard’s government also implemented a rigorous “buyback” policy, to enable the government to purchase guns already owned by the public.
zh: 霍華德政府還實施了嚴格的“回購”政策，允許政府收購已被公眾所擁有的槍支。

en: The policy worked.
zh: 這一政策起到了效果。

en: While violent crime has not ended in Australia, murders are down, and, even more dramatically, there has not been a single mass shooting since 1996 in which three or more people died (the definition used in many studies of mass shootings).
zh: 儘管澳大利亞的暴力犯罪並未因此銷聲匿跡，但謀殺案有所下降，更重要的是，1996年之後再未發生過死亡人數三人或以上的大規模槍擊時間（3人死亡是很多研究中所定義的大規模槍擊事件標準 ） 。

en: Before the crackdown, there had been 13 such massacres in 18 years.
zh: 而在打擊槍擊保有之前，18年中澳大利亞發生了13起大規模殺戮事件。

en: Yet the US still refuses to act, even after this year’s string of shocking incidents: the massacre in a movie theatre in Colorado, an attack on a Sikh community in Milwaukee, another on a shopping mall in Oregon, and many more before the ruthless slaughter of first graders and school staff in Newtown.
zh: 但在美國，儘管今年發生了一系列槍擊事件，人們仍然拒絕採取行動：科羅拉多州電影院大屠殺、密爾沃基錫克教社群和俄勒岡州購物中心槍擊案，以及紐頓市一年級學生和教工血腥大屠殺之前所發生的多起案件。

en: The gun lobby in the US remains powerful, and politicians are afraid to counter it.
zh: 槍支遊說集團在美國仍然勢力強大，政客不敢得罪他們。

en: Given the shooting of then-Congresswoman Gabrielle Giffords in 2011, perhaps they even fear that they, too, might be targeted.
zh: 2011年，國會議員吉福斯（Gabrielle Giffords）遭遇槍擊，這使得政客們甚至害怕自己也成為目標。

en: There can be little doubt that some societies are more steeped in violence than others, even controlling for obvious factors like income levels and education.
zh: 毫無疑問，即使控制了收入水平和教育等顯而易見的因素，某些社仍比其他社會更具暴力傾向。

en: The US homicide rate is roughly four times that of comparable societies in Western Europe, and Latin America’s homicide rates are even higher than in the US (and dramatically higher than Asian countries at roughly the same income level).
zh: 美國殺人率大約是可比西歐社會的四倍，而拉美的殺人率比美國還高（比收入水平相當的亞洲高得多 ） 。

en: What accounts for staggeringly high rates in the US and Latin America?
zh: 美國和拉美殺人率如此之高的原因是什麼？

en: American violence is rooted in history.
zh: 美國的暴力有其歷史根源。

en: The US and Latin American countries are all “conquest” societies, in which Europeans ruled over multi-racial societies.
zh: 美國和拉美國家都是“��征服”社會，是由歐洲人統治的多種族社會。

en: In many of these countries, including the US, the European conquerors and their descendants nearly wiped out the indigenous populations, partly through disease, but also through war, starvation, death marches, and forced labor.
zh: 在這些國家中，有很多國家（包括美國在內）的土著被歐洲征服者及其子孫後代趕盡殺絕，部分是透過疾病，但也有戰爭、飢餓、被迫遷徙和強制勞動的因素。

en: In the US and many Latin American countries, slaveholding fueled mass violence as well.
zh: 在美國和許多拉美國家，蓄奴也是大規模暴力的助長原因。

en: The slaves – and generations of their descendants – were routinely murdered.
zh: 奴隸 — — 以及他們的後代 — — 經常被殺致死。

en: The US also developed a particular populist belief that gun ownership constitutes a vital protection against government tyranny.
zh: 美國還形成了一種帶濃厚民粹主義色彩的信念：擁有槍支是抵抗暴政的關鍵手段。

en: The US was born in a citizens’ revolt against British imperial power.
zh: 美國誕生在公民反抗英國帝國主義霸權的過程中。

en: The right of citizens to organize militias to fight government tyranny was therefore a founding idea of the new country, enshrined in the Second Amendment to the US Constitution, which declares that, because a country needs a well-regulated militia, the people have the right to bear arms.
zh: 公民組織軍隊抵抗暴政的權利因此成為美國建國的基礎性思想，被寫進了美國憲法第二修正案中，第二修正案規定，由於國家需要治理有方的軍隊，因此人民有權利擁有武器。

en: Since citizens’ militias are anachronistic, gun owners now use the second amendment merely to defend individual gun ownership, as if that somehow offers protection against tyranny.
zh: 公民建軍權已經過時，因此如今搬出第二修正案的持槍者捍衛的只是個人槍支擁有權，看起來好像這樣能夠提供抵禦暴政的保護。

en: A reckless, right-wing Supreme Court has agreed with them.
zh: 魯莽的右傾最高法院也站在持槍者一邊。

en: As a result, gun ownership has become perversely linked to freedom in the vast gun-owning American sub-culture.
zh: 於是持槍權與大規模持槍自由的美國亞文化緊密地聯絡在了一起。

en: But, instead of protection of freedom, Americans nowadays are getting massive bloodshed and fear.
zh: 但是，如今，美國人並沒有得到自由的保護，反而經受著大規模的流血事件和恐慌。

en: The claim that gun ownership ensures freedom is especially absurd, given that most of the world’s vibrant democracies have long since cracked down on private gun ownership.
zh: 持槍保證自由的說法尤其荒謬 — — 世界上生機勃勃的民主國家早就撤消了私人槍支擁有權。

en: No tyrant has risen in Australia since Howard’s gun-control reforms.
zh: 在霍華德槍支管制改革後，澳大利亞也沒有出現暴君。

en: Simply put, freedom in the twenty-first century does not depend on unregulated gun ownership.
zh: 簡言之，21世紀的自由並不取決於受管制的持槍權。

en: Indeed, America’s gun culture is a threat to freedom, after the murder of a president, senator, and other public leaders, and countless assassination attempts against public officials over recent decades.
zh: 事實上，美國的槍文化已是自由的威脅 — — 近幾十年來，總統、參議員、公眾領袖都被槍殺過，更有數不清的刺殺官員事件發生。

en: Yet US gun culture remains as pervasive as it is unrecorded.
zh: 但美國槍文化仍然無處不在，且鮮有報道。

en: America reels from one shooting disaster to the next, and on nearly every occasion, politicians dutifully declare their continued devotion to unregulated gun ownership.
zh: 美國接二連三遭遇槍擊災難，而在幾乎每一次槍擊案中，政客都會誓言旦旦地表示將繼續打擊不受管制的槍支援有。

en: Indeed, no one even knows how many guns Americans hold.
zh: 事實上，沒有人知道美國人到底擁有多少槍。

en: The number is estimated to be around 270 million, or almost one per person on average.
zh: 據估計，槍支數量在2.7億枝，平均人手一把。

en: According to one recent poll, 47% of households have a gun at home.
zh: 一份最新的民調顯示，47%的家庭在家裡藏著槍。

en: The shooting in Newtown was not only especially horrific and heartbreaking, but is also part of an increasingly common pattern – a specific kind of murder-suicide that has been carefully studied by psychologists and psychiatrists.
zh: 紐頓的槍擊事件不但可怕可憫，而且反映了日趨常見的模式 — — 心理學家和精神專家已有深入研究的一種特殊的殺戮式自殺（murder-suicide ） 。

en: Loners, often with paranoid tendencies, commit these heinous acts as part of their own suicide.
zh: 孤獨者 — — 往往有偏執傾向 — — 將這種可怕的行為作為自殺過程的一部分。

en: They use carefully planned and staged mass murders of innocents in order to take revenge on society and to glorify themselves as they take their own lives.
zh: 他們精心計劃和實施針對無辜群眾的大規模屠殺，目的是報復社會，然後光榮地自我了斷。

en: The perpetrators are not hardened criminals; many have no previous criminal record.
zh: 兇犯並不是頑固不化的罪犯；許多人都沒有犯罪記錄。

en: They are pathetic, deranged, and often have struggled with mental instability for much of their lives.
zh: 他們是可憐的精神錯亂者，常常在精神異常中苦苦掙扎。

en: They need help – and society needs to keep guns out of their reach.
zh: 他們需要幫助 — — 而社會需要讓槍支遠離他們。

en: America has now suffered around 30 shooting massacres over the past 30 years, including this year’s deadly dozen; each is a gut-wrenching tragedy for many families.
zh: 過去30年來，美國已經經歷了30次大規模槍擊，包括今年所發生的12次；每一次慘案都會讓許多家庭陷入悲劇。

en: And yet, each time, gun owners scream that freedom will be eliminated if they are unable to buy assault weapons and 100-round clips.
zh: 而每一次，槍支擁有著都在叫囂，如果他們無法買到攻擊性武器百發裝子彈，自由就會被剝奪。

en: The bloodbath in Newtown is the time to stop feeding this gun frenzy.
zh: 紐頓血案是叫停這一槍支狂熱的良機。

en: Australia and other countries provide models of how to do it: regulate and limit gun ownership to approved uses.
zh: 澳大利亞和其他國家給美國樹立了榜樣：管制和限制持槍和用槍的批准。

en: America’s real freedoms depend on sane public policy.
zh: 美國的真正自由取決於明智的公共政策。

en: America’s G-Zero Moment
zh: 美國的G0時刻

en: NEW YORK – The 2008 financial crisis marked the end of the global order as we knew it.
zh: 紐約—2008年的金融危機宣告了我們所熟悉的全球秩序壽終正寢。

en: In advance of the upcoming G-8 summit, it is impossible to overlook the fact that, for the first time in seven decades, the United States cannot drive the international agenda or provide global leadership on all of today’s most pressing problems.
zh: 在G8峰會即將到來之際，我們不能不注意到這樣一個事實：70年來，美國第一次不再能夠推行國際日程和在當今最緊迫的問題上成為全球領袖。

en: Indeed, the US has trimmed its presence abroad by refusing to contribute to a eurozone bailout, intervene in Syria, or use force to contain Iran’s nuclear breakout (despite strong Israeli support).
zh: 事實上，美國拒絕在拯救歐元區、干預敘利亞以及動用武力解決伊朗核問題（儘管以色列強烈支援這樣做）已經表明它的海外形象有所調整。

en: President Barack Obama officially ended the war in Iraq, and is withdrawing US troops from Afghanistan at a pace constrained only by the need to save face.
zh: 總統奧巴馬正式結束了伊拉克戰爭，並正在從阿富汗撤軍 — — 只能用控制撤軍節奏來挽回最後的顏面。

en: America is handing off the leadership baton – even if no other country or group of countries is willing or able to grasp it.
zh: 美國正在交出領導權杖 — — 儘管還沒有哪個國家或國家組織願意或能夠接過它。

en: In short, US foreign policy may be as active as ever, but it is downsizing and becoming more exacting about its priorities.
zh: 簡而言之，美國的外交政策或許亦然像從前那樣積極，但免不了正在走下坡路，越來越難以維持其超然的地位。

en: As a result, many global challenges – climate change, trade, resource scarcity, international security, cyber-warfare, and nuclear proliferation, to name a few – are bound to loom larger.
zh: 結果，諸多全球性挑戰 — — 氣候變化、貿易、資源稀缺性、國際安全、網路戰、核擴散等等 — — 將註定愈演愈烈。

en: Welcome to the G-Zero world, a more turbulent, uncertain environment in which coordination on global policy issues falls by the wayside.
zh: 歡迎來到G0世界，這是一個更動盪、更不確定的環境，全球政策問題的協調早已被拋諸腦後。

en: Paradoxically, this new environment, though daunting, is less troublesome for the US; in fact, it provides fresh opportunities for the US to capitalize on its unique position.
zh: 諷刺的是，這一令人沮喪的新環境倒讓美國落得了清淨；事實上，這給了美國一個全新的利用其獨一無二地位的機會。

en: The G-Zero world is not all bad for the US – if it plays its cards right.
zh: G0世界對美國來說並不是件壞事 — — 只要美國能打好手裡的牌。

en: Many residual strengths take on greater importance in such a world, and America remains the world’s only true superpower and its largest economy – still more than twice the size of China’s.
zh: 在這樣一個世界中，諸多剩餘力量將扮演更加重要的角色，而美國仍然是唯一的真正超級大國和第一大經濟體，比中國大出一倍有餘。

en: Its defense expenditures represent nearly half the world total, and exceed those of the next 17 countries combined.
zh: 美國的國防支出幾乎佔據了全球總數的半壁江山，比隨後的17國的總和還要多。

en: The dollar remains the world’s reserve currency, and investors’ scramble into US government debt at every peak in the crisis since 2008 has underscored America’s safe-haven status (even in crises that America caused).
zh: 美元仍是世界儲備貨幣，2008年，危機一冒頭，投資者們便紛紛湧向美國國債，這表明美國仍然擁有安全港的地位（儘管美國正是危機的始作俑者 ） 。

en: Likewise, the US continues to lead in entrepreneurship, research and development, higher education, and technological innovation.
zh: 類似地，美國在企業家精神、研發、高等教育和技術創新領域依然無人能出其右。

en: Moreover, it is now the world’s largest natural-gas producer and calorie exporter, which has reduced its vulnerability to price shocks or food shortages.
zh: 此外，如今美國還是世界最大的天然氣產國和熱量出口國，這降低了價格衝擊或食品短缺對美國的衝擊力。

en: No country rivals America’s promotion of the rule of law, liberal democracy, transparency, and free enterprise.
zh: 沒有哪個國家可以在推進法治精神、自由民主、透明和自由企業方面能與美國相媲美。

en: While other countries certainly support these values, only the US has been willing, healthy, and big enough to ensure that they prevail.
zh: 儘管其他國家顯然也支援這些價值，但只有美國一直願意、也足夠堅挺和強大以保證這些價值的推行。

en: So, as America curtails its global leadership, it will find itself in more demand.
zh: 因此，隨著美國全球領導力的收縮，它會發現自己變得更受歡迎。

en: Consider Asia, for example. As China’s economic importance and regional influence grows, its neighbors are seeking to deepen ties with the US.
zh: 以亞洲為例。 隨著中國的經濟實力以及地區影響力的提升，其鄰國紛紛開始尋求與美國的深度合作。

en: Japan, Australia, Indonesia, and Taiwan have all recently closed trade and security-related deals with the US.
zh: 日本、澳大利亞、印尼和臺灣地區最近都與美國展開了密切的貿易和安全相關問題的交流。

en: Even Burma has gotten on board, resuming diplomatic engagement with the US while trying to work its way out of China’s shadow.
zh: 甚至緬甸也開始倒向美國，重啟了與美國的外交關係，並竭力擺脫中國的陰影。

en: In other words, in a G-Zero world, an increasingly aggressive global environment makes the US all the more appealing to countries seeking to hedge their bets. As a result, the US has an opportunity to act more precisely in its own interests.
zh: 換句話說，在G0世界中，越來越波起雲湧的國際環境使得美國對不想孤注一擲的國家的吸引力更大了。 結果，美國贏得了更精確地按自己利益行事的機會。

en: Supplying less leadership allows the US to weigh opportunity costs before taking action, and to select the issues and circumstances that suit it the best. In this environment, military intervention in Libya does not necessitate the same in Syria.
zh: 減弱領導者角色讓美國得以在行動前掂量機會成本，選擇最合適自身的問題和環境展開行動。 在這樣一種環境下，軍事幹預利比亞和敘利亞不可同日而語。

en: The extent to which the US will capitalize on these opportunities remains to be seen.
zh: 美國可以多大程度上利用這些機會還有待觀察。

en: In fact, America’s short-term advantages pose the biggest obstacle to its long-term outlook.
zh: 事實上，美國的短期優勢正是其長期前景的障礙所在。

en: Call this the “safe-haven curse”: as long as the US remains the safest port in any storm, it faces no immediate pressure to address its weaknesses.
zh: 不妨將這稱為“安全港詛咒 ” ： 只要美國仍然是任何風暴最安全的避風港，那麼它就沒有動力馬上修復自己的弱點。

en: For example, for all of the hand-wringing about America’s national debt, investors will continue to loan the US money.
zh: 比如，所有關於美國國民債務的文章都說，投資者會繼續借錢給美國。

en: Over the long term, however, US policymakers must make steady progress in restoring confidence in the nation’s fiscal health by cutting politically sacred programs like social security, Medicare, and defense.
zh: 但是，從長期看，美國決策者必須透過削減社會保障、醫療和防務等具有政治不可動搖性的專案開支，從而在重塑人們對其國民財政健康度信心方面取得實實在在的進步。

en: Officials will have to put aside short-term motives and party orthodoxy to bolster America’s aging infrastructure, reform its education and immigration systems, and pursue long-term fiscal consolidation.
zh: 官員必須拋棄短視和政治正確性， 改善美國老化的基礎設施，改革其教育和移民制���，追求長期財政整合。

en: America’s advantages in the G-Zero world afford it the chance to invest in the future.
zh: 美國在G0世界中的超然地位給予了它為未來投資的機會。

en: But, by cushioning against sufficiently calamitous risks, the same advantages allow the US to procrastinate.
zh: 但是，正是這種超然地位消除了形成災難性後果的風險，從而讓美國安於現狀，不思進取。

en: American politicians need to recognize the new G-Zero reality and rebuild America’s domestic sources of strength, even if only incrementally. If they do, the US will have the vigor and flexibility to shape the next world order.
zh: 美國政客應該認清G0的現實，重塑美國強盛的內生源泉，即使只能逐漸進步。 惟其如此，美國才能擁有主導下一個世界秩序的力量和靈活性。

en: America’s political system usually works well in crises. But, thanks to its residual advantages in a leaderless world, the US need not rely on a crisis to precipitate action.
zh: 美國的政治制度通常能在危機中運轉良好。 但是，由於美國在缺少領袖的世界中還擁有一些殘存優勢，因此它並不需要一場危機來刺激行動。

en: It need only seize the G-Zero moment.
zh: 它所需要的，只是抓住G0時刻的機會。

en: America’s Houses of Cards
zh: 美國的房產危機

en: There are times when being proven right brings no pleasure.
zh: 有些時候即便證明自己正確也毫無快感可言。

en: For several years, I argued that America’s economy was being supported by a housing bubble that had replaced the stock market bubble of the 1990’s.
zh: 過去幾年來，我一直認為美國的經濟是由房地產泡沫支撐著。 這種泡沫取代了1990年代的股市泡沫。

en: But no bubble can expand forever.
zh: 但沒有泡沫可以無限膨脹。

en: With middle-class incomes in the United States stagnating, Americans could not afford ever more expensive homes.
zh: 隨著美國中產階級的收入滯脹，美國人買不起越來越貴的房產了。

en: As one of my predecessors as Chairman of the US President’s Council of Economic Advisers famously put it, “that which is not sustainable will not be sustained.”
zh: 作為美國總統經濟顧問委員會主席，我的一位前任曾有一句名言 ： “ 不可持續的東西是不會受到支撐的。

en: Economists, as opposed to those who make their living gambling on stocks, make no claim to being able to predict when the day of reckoning will come, much less identifying the event that will bring down the house of cards.
zh: ”相對於那些靠在股市搏殺為生的人，經濟學家們從未聲稱能預測清算日何時到來，更別說確認什麼事件會令房產市場崩盤。

en: But the patterns are systematic, with consequences that unfold gradually, and painfully, over time.
zh: 但有些徵兆是系統的，其後果也隨著時間的推移逐漸而痛苦地顯露出來。

en: There is a macro-story and a micro-story here.
zh: 這裡有宏觀和微觀層面的原因。

en: The macro-story is simple, but dramatic.
zh: 宏觀原因簡單但又富有戲劇性。

en: Some, observing the crash of the sub-prime mortgage market, say, “Don’t worry, it is only a problem in the real estate sector.”
zh: 有些觀察到次級貸市場崩潰的人說 ： “ 別擔心，這只是不動產行業的問題。

en: But this overlooks the key role that the housing sector has played in the US economy recently, with direct investment in real estate and money taken out of houses through refinancing mortgages accounting for two-thirds to three-quarters of growth over the last six years.
zh: ”但這種說法忽視了房產市場近年來在美國經濟中扮演的角色。 在過去六年裡，對不動產市場的直接投資和透過重新融資按揭從房產市場抽出的資金佔整個經濟增長量的三分之二到四分之三。

en: Booming home prices gave Americans the confidence, and the financial wherewithal, to spend more than their income.
zh: 房產價格的一路飆升給了美國人信心和資金讓他們可以超前消費。

en: America’s household savings rate was at levels not seen since the Great Depression, either negative or zero.
zh: 美國的家庭儲蓄率降到大蕭條以來的最低點，不是為負就是為零。

en: With higher interest rates depressing housing prices, the game is over.
zh: 隨著高利率對房價的壓制，遊戲結束了。

en: As America moves to, say, a 4% savings rate (still small by normal standards), aggregate demand will weaken, and with it, the economy.
zh: 當美國的儲蓄率達到4 % （ 就一般標準來看仍然很低 ） ， 累計總需求就會減弱，隨之而來的就是經濟走弱。

en: The micro-story is more dramatic.
zh: 微觀的分析則更具戲劇性。

en: Record-low interest rates in 2001, 2002 and 2003 did not lead Americans to invest more – there was already excess capacity.
zh: 2001、2002、2003年創紀錄的低利率並未引發美國人更大的投資熱情—超額產能（excess capacity）已經出現。

en: Instead, easy money stimulated the economy by inducing households to refinance their mortgages, and to spend some of their capital.
zh: 相反，賺快錢的心態誘使美國家庭將他們的按揭重新融資並支出部分資本從而刺激美國經濟。

en: It is one thing to borrow to make an investment, which strengthens balance sheets; it is another thing to borrow to finance a vacation or a consumption binge.
zh: 借錢投資是一回事，這能強化我們的資產負債表；但把借來的錢用於度假和瘋狂消費那就是另一碼事了。

en: But this is what Alan Greenspan encouraged Americans to do.
zh: 而這正是格林斯潘鼓勵美國人做的。

en: When normal mortgages did not prime the pump enough, he encouraged them to take out variable-rate mortgages – at a time when interest rates had nowhere to go but up.
zh: 當普通貸款不能滿足需求時，他鼓勵美國人進行可變匯率按揭—而且在利率只升不降的時期。

en: Predatory lenders went further, offering negative amortization loans, so the amount owed went up year after year.
zh: 貪婪的貸方進而推出了負攤銷貸款（negative amortization loans ） ， 從而使借款人的負債連年攀升。

en: Sometime in the future, payments would rise, but borrowers were told, again, not to worry: house prices would rise faster, making it easy to refinance with another negative amortization loan.
zh: 在未來的某個時候，還款額會提高，但借款人會又一次被告知，別擔心：房價上漲會更快，因此再借一筆負攤銷貸款會很容易。

en: The only way (in this view) not to win was to sit on the sidelines.
zh: （在這種觀點下）不能受益的只有那些靜觀其變的人。

en: All of this amounted to a human and economic disaster in the making.
zh: 這樣的推波助瀾最終導致了人類和經濟的災難。

en: Now reality has hit: newspapers report cases of borrowers whose mortgage payments exceed their entire income.
zh: 現實顯露出殘酷的一面：報紙上報導著借款人的總收入不夠償還按揭的案例。

en: Globalization implies that America’s mortgage problem has worldwide repercussions.
zh: 全球化意味著美國的貸款問題已經造成了世界範圍內的影響。

en: The first run on a bank occurred against the British mortgage lender Northern Rock.
zh: 第一波受到衝擊的是英國按揭貸款銀行Northern Rock。

en: America managed to pass off bad mortgages worth hundreds of billions of dollars to investors (including banks) around the world.
zh: 美國成功地將數以千億計的不良貸款轉賣給全世界的投資者（包括銀行 ） 。

en: They buried the bad mortgages in complicated instruments, buried them so deep that no one knew exactly how badly they were impaired, and no one could calculate how to re-price them quickly.
zh: 他們透過複雜的金融工具埋葬這些壞賬，埋葬得如此之深以至於沒人知道這些壞賬究竟有多壞，也沒人能夠很快地為它們重新定價。

en: In the face of such uncertainty, markets froze.
zh: 面對這樣的不確定性，市場就凍結了。

en: Those in financial markets who believe in free markets have temporarily abandoned their faith.
zh: 那些篤信自由市場原則的金融從業人士也暫時將他們的信念拋諸腦後。

en: For the greater good of all (of course, it is never for their own selfish interests), they argued a bailout was necessary.
zh: 他們說為了所有人的更大福祉（當然，他們從來就是為他人利益著想 ） ， 政府救市是必要的。
