en: While the US Treasury and the IMF warned East Asian countries facing financial crises ten years ago against the risks of bail-outs and told them not to raise their interest rates, the US ignored its own lectures about moral hazard effects, bought up billions in mortgages, and lowered interest rates.
zh: 儘管美國財政部和國際貨幣��金組織在十年前警告面臨金融危機的東亞各國政府救市有風險並告誡它們不要提高利率，但今天美國卻全然不顧對其他國家有關道德危險的教導，收購了鉅額的（不良）貸款，並降低了利率。

en: But lower short-term interest rates have led to higher medium-term interest rates, which are more relevant for the mortgage market, perhaps because of increasing worries about inflationary pressures.
zh: 但更低的短期利率導致了更高的中期利率，而後者與按揭貸款市場更有關聯或許是因為對通脹壓力的擔心日益增加。

en: It may make sense for central banks (or Fannie Mae, America’s major government-sponsored mortgage company) to buy mortgage-backed securities in order to help provide market liquidity.
zh: 各中央銀行（或美國主要的政府主辦貸款銀行—美國聯邦國民抵押貸款協會Fannie Mae）購入抵押貸款支援證券以增加市場的流動性可能會起到一些作用。

en: But those from whom they buy them should provide a guarantee, so the public does not have to pay the price for their bad investment decisions.
zh: 但證券的出售方應該提供某種擔保，這樣公眾就不必為他們糟糕的投資決策埋單。

en: Equity owners in banks should not get a free ride.
zh: 銀行的股權擁有者也不應該搭順風車。

en: Securitization, with all of its advantages in sharing risk, has three problems that were not adequately anticipated.
zh: 證券化在分擔風險方面雖然有其優勢，但也存在三個讓人沒有充分認識到的問題。

en: While it meant that American banks were not hit as hard as they would otherwise, America’s bad lending practices have had global effects.
zh: 儘管這意味著美國的銀行所遭受的打擊還不算最壞，但美國的不良貸款方式卻已經產生了全球性的影響。

en: Moreover, securitization contributed to bad lending: in the old days, banks that originated bad loans bore the consequences; in the new world of securitization, the originators could pass the loans onto others.
zh: 另外，證券化也為不良貸款火上澆油：在過去，產生不良貸款的銀行自食其果；但在證券化的新世界裡，壞賬的始作俑者可以將其轉嫁給他人。

en: (As economists would say, problems of asymmetric information have increased.)
zh: （就像經濟學家們會講，資訊不對稱的問題更嚴重了。 ）

en: In the old days, when borrowers found it impossible to make their payments, mortgages would be restructured; foreclosures were bad for both the borrower and the lender.
zh: 在過去，當借款人發現無法負擔他們的還款時，按揭貸款就會從新組合；抵押贖回對借貸雙方都不是好事。

en: Securitization made debt restructuring difficult, if not impossible.
zh: 證券化使債務重組變得困難（如果不是不可能的話 ） 。

en: It is the victims of predatory lenders who need government help.
zh: 掠奪性貸方的受害者們才是需要政府幫助的人。

en: With mortgages amounting to 95% or more of the value of the house, debt restructuring will not be easy.
zh: 當按揭總額達到房產價值的95%或以上時，債務重組就不那麼容易了。

en: What is required is to give individuals with excessive indebtedness an expedited way to a fresh start – for example, a special bankruptcy provision allowing them to recover, say, 75% of the equity they originally put into the house, with the lenders bearing the cost.
zh: 需要給予過度負債的個人一種重新開始的快速通道—例如透過一項特別的破產規定允許他們重新獲得起初投入房產的75%的資產，而貸方會承擔相應成本。

en: There are many lessons for America, and the rest of the world; but among them is the need for greater financial sector regulation, especially better protection against predatory lending, and more transparency.
zh: 美國和世界其他國家都應該從中汲取許多教訓；其中最重要的是對金融行業更嚴格的監管，特別是針對掠奪性的貸方提供更好的保護和更高的透明度。

en: America’s Interest-Rate Puzzle
zh: 美國利率之謎

en: A great puzzle in today’s world economy is the continued low level of long-term real interest rates in the United States.
zh: 美國的長期實際利率一直維持著較低水平，這可以算是當今世界經濟的一大難解之謎。

en: Conventional macroeconomists like me look at America’s current-account deficit, now running at 7% of GDP, and know that such vast deficits are inevitably followed by large currency depreciations.
zh: 現在，美國的經常專案赤字已達到國內生產總值的7 % 。 看到這種情況，像我這樣的傳統宏觀經濟學家都清楚，在鉅額赤字後，會不可避免地出現大幅度貨幣貶值。

en: So we expect a substantial depreciation premium on US interest rates.
zh: 所以，我們預測美國利率溢價會出現大幅度的下降。

en: If the dollar falls 20% more against the euro sometime in the next ten years, US long-term interest rates should be two percentage points higher than euro rates.
zh: 如果在未來十年的某一天，美元與歐元的匯率再下跌20 % ， 美國的長期利率就會比歐元高出2個百分點。

en: If it falls 40% against the yen sometime in the next ten years, US long-term interest rates should be four percentage points higher than Japanese rates.
zh: 如果在未來十年的某一天，美元與日元之比下跌40 % ， 美國的長期利率就會比日本高出4個百分點。

en: If it falls 60% against China’s currency, the yuan, sometime in the next ten years, US long-term interest rates should be six percentage points higher than Chinese rates.
zh: 如果在未來十年的某一天，美元與人民幣之比下跌60 % ， 美國的長期利率就會比中國高出6個百分點。

en: But we are not seeing signs of anything like this.
zh: 但是，現在我們卻看不到一點這樣的跡象。

en: The puzzle is not only that long-term rates are too low when viewed in the international context, but also that they are too low when viewed in America’s domestic context.
zh: 讓人不解的是，不僅從國際上看長期利率太低，而且就是從美國國內來看，這一利率也非常低。

en: The Bush administration continues to have no plans to sew up the veins it has opened with its medieval economic policy, which holds that bleeding revenue from the government cures all economic problems.
zh: 布什政府還是拿不出任何計劃來縫合自己用所奉行的中世紀經濟政策割開的血管，上述政策認為，只要政府出血，讓出部分稅收，就可以解決一切經濟問題。

en: This means that unless America’s domestic savings rate rises mightily – which it shows no signs of doing – and unless investment expenditure remains abnormally low for the rest of this decade, the supply of loanable funds to finance investment will soon be much less than demand when the current-account deficit narrows to sustainable levels. But when supply is less than demand, prices rise sharply.
zh: 這就意味著除非美國國記憶體款率大幅度上升（目前還沒有這種跡象 ） ， 除非2010年以前，投資支出依然保持現在這種不正常的超低狀態，否則當經常專案赤字降低到可持續水平時，用以支援投資的信貸資金很快就會嚴重供不應求，而當供不應求時，價格就會直線上升。

en: In this case, the price of loanable funds is the real interest rate.
zh: 在這種情況下，信貸資金價格就等於實際利率。

en: An expectation that interest rates will be high sometime in the next decade should mean high interest rates on long-term bonds today.
zh: 如果期望在未來十年的某一天利率走高，就意味著要提高目前長期債券的利率。

en: Yet financial markets are not pricing dollar depreciation and a rise in long-term US interest rates accordingly.
zh: 但金融市場並沒有美元貶值、美國長期利率上漲的相應計劃。

en: When we macroeconomists talk to our friends on Wall Street, we find that they don’t view this as a puzzle at all.
zh: 當我們這些宏觀經濟學家和華爾街的朋友們談起這個問題時，發現他們根本不覺得這有什麼難理解的。

en: On the contrary, they are puzzled about why we view the current low level of US long-term interest rates as worrisome.
zh: 正相反，他們不明白的是為什麼在我們眼裡，目前美國長期利率低是件令人擔心的事情。

en: From their perspective, today’s high demand for long-term dollar-denominated securities is easily explained: Asian central banks are buying in order to hold down their currencies, the US Treasury is borrowing short (and thus not issuing that many long-term securities), and US companies are not undertaking the kinds of investments that would lead them to issue many long-term bonds.
zh: 他們認為，目前對長期美元計價證券的高需求很容易解釋：亞洲中央銀行正在買進以穩定自己的貨幣，美國財政部正在借進短期債券（因此，不會大量發行長期債券 ） ， 美國公司目前進行的種種投資，也不會導致大量長期債券的發行。

en: But for every market mispricing there is a profit opportunity: if long-term interest rates are, indeed, too low and long-term bond prices too high, investors will short long-term US bonds, park the money elsewhere, wait for bond prices to return to fundamentals, and then cover their short positions.
zh: 但市場上的每一種價格偏離，總會帶來盈利機會：如果長期利率確實過低，而長期債券價格過高，做空倉的美國長期債券投資者將錢投到別的地方，等待債券價格回落到基點，再開始補倉。

en: By doing so, they will push prices close to fundamentals today.
zh: 如此一來，他們就能驅使價格接近今天的基點。

en: Wall Streeters, however, offer a counterargument: for any financial institution to, say, bet on the decline of the dollar against the yuan over the next five years in a serious, leveraged way is to put its survival at risk should the trades go wrong.
zh: 華爾街的朋友們卻提出了相反的論調：如果任何金融機構很認真地，甚至舉債來賭未來5年內美元與人民幣之比會大幅度下降，那麼，一旦交易出了問題，該機構就會面臨生存危機。

en: And trades do go wrong: remember the collapse of Long-Term Capital Management.
zh: 而交易確實出了問題：別忘了美國長期資本管理公司的倒閉。

en: The existence of large financial-market actors that do not care about maximizing their profits magnifies the riskiness of the bets.
zh: 金融市場上還有一些大戶，他們對最大化自己的利潤並不關心。 他們的存在更加大了投資的風險。

en: If, say, the Bank of China and the Federal Reserve decided to teach speculators a lesson by pushing the dollar’s value relative to the yuan up by 20% for a month, they could do so, bankrupting many financial institutions with short positions.
zh: 比如說，如果中國銀行和美聯儲決定教訓教訓投機者，將美元與人民幣的比價推高20 % ， 並保持一個月，它們這樣做是完全可能的，能讓大量做空倉的金融機構破產。

en: Similarly, any financial institution that bets on a sharp rise in long-term interest rates over the next five years in a serious, leveraged way also puts its survival at risk.
zh: 與此相似，如果任何金融機構很認真地，舉債來賭未來5年內長期利率會大幅度上漲，那它也是在拿自己的生存冒險。

en: For where should they park their money?
zh: 他們該把錢投在什麼地方？

en: Real estate rental yields and stock-market payouts are low, and real estate and stock prices may well fall as much as or more than bond prices if interest rates spike.
zh: 房地產租金收益和股市盈利率都太低。 此外，如果利率激增，房地產和股票價格會下跌，跌幅可能等於或大於債券價格的漲幅。

en: Only businesses that can borrow long-term now, lock in a low real interest rate, and invest in expanding their capacity can make the domestic bet that interest rates will rise.
zh: 只有那些現在能借進長期貸款，鎖定目前較低的實際利率，並投資擴大規模的企業可以在國內下注，賭利率上漲。

en: But America’s businesses see enough risk in the future to be wary of getting stuck with unutilized capacity.
zh: 但是美國的企業都看到了未來的風險，並時刻保持警惕，不讓自己被無用規模所套住。

en: Economists believe that market forces drive prices to fundamentals.
zh: 經濟學家們相信市場力量會驅使價格回到基點。

en: But we are not careful enough to distinguish situations in which equilibrium-restoring forces are strong from those in which such forces are weak.
zh: 但我們總是不夠仔細，不能把平衡恢復力強與弱的情況區分開來。

en: The dollar will fall and US long-term interest rates will rise, but only when traders on Wall Street and elsewhere decide that holding dollars and long-term US bonds is more risky in the short run.
zh: 只有華爾街和別的地方的交易者都認定從短期看，持有美元和長期美國債券風險更大時，美元才會下跌，美國長期利率才會上升。

en: When that happens, the long-run future will be now.
zh: 等到這種情況發生時，長遠的未來形勢還是會和現在一樣。

en: America’s Islamist Allies of Convenience
zh: 便利思維下的美國伊斯蘭盟友

en: NEW DELHI – In just one decade, the United States has intervened militarily in three Muslim-majority countries and overthrown their governments.
zh: 新德里—短短十年間，美國軍事幹預了三個穆斯林佔多數國家並顛覆了它們的政府。

en: Now the same coalition of American liberal interventionists and neoconservatives that promoted those wars is pushing for punitive airstrikes in Syria without reflecting on how US policy has ended up strengthening Islamists and fostering anti-Americanism.
zh: 如今，發動了這些戰爭的美國自由派干涉主義者和新保守主義者聯盟又在推動對敘利亞的懲罰性打擊，他們絲毫不顧美國政策的結局往往是增強了伊斯蘭教徒、鑄造了反美主義。

en: Indeed, the last “humanitarian intervention” has clearly backfired, turning Libya into a breeding ground for transnational militants.
zh: 事實上，上一次“人道主義干預”顯然適得其反，把敘利亞變成了跨國部隊的流血場。

en: As the intense US debate about President Barack Obama’s proposed use of military force highlights, the attack-Syria push is not about upholding America’s national interest.
zh: 關於總統奧巴馬的動武計劃的激烈爭論凸顯出，打擊敘利亞的舉動並不符合美國的國家利益。

en: Rather, the desire to protect US “credibility” has become the last refuge of those seeking yet another war in the wider Middle East.
zh: 相反，保護美國“信譽”的渴望成了那些尋求在大中東地區發動又一場戰爭的人的最後庇護所。

en: If “credibility” were purged from the debate and the focus placed squarely on advancing long-term US interests, it would become apparent that an attack on Syria might not yield even temporary geopolitical gains.
zh: 如果“信譽”因為爭論和真正將推進美國長期利益作為關注焦點而得到淨化，那麼顯然對敘利亞的打擊並不能產生哪怕暫時性的地緣政治好處。

en: Beyond the short term, it would unleash major unintended consequences, potentially including an Iraq-style “soft” partition of Syria and the creation of a haven for extremists stretching across much of Islamist-controlled northern Syria and into the Sunni areas of Iraq.
zh: 從超越短期的視角看，這會產生意料之外的重大後果，有可能使敘利亞發生伊拉克式的“軟”分裂以及在伊斯蘭教控制的敘利亞北部和伊拉克遜尼派勢力區形成大量極端主義者避風港。

en: Indeed, an attack would most likely increase America’s reliance on unsavory Islamist rulers in countries ranging from Saudi Arabia and Qatar to Turkey and the United Arab Emirates.
zh: 事實上，打擊敘利亞很可能讓美國更加依賴於從沙特到卡達和從土耳其到阿聯酋的不受歡迎的伊斯蘭統治者。

en: Some Arab monarchs have pledged to bankroll the US attack – an investment that they would easily recover, given that the war talk has already increased oil prices.
zh: 一些阿拉伯君主承諾為美國的打擊提供資金 — — 這筆投資很容易就能回本，因為戰爭言論已經使石油價格上漲。

en: Al Qaeda-type groups already have gained ground in the Middle East and North Africa as an unintended byproduct of US policies, creating fertile conditions for stepped-up international terrorism in the coming years.
zh: 基地組織已經在中東和北非生根發芽，給未來幾年國際恐怖主義逐步升級創造了良好條件，這便是美國政策的一個意料之外的後果。

en: The US invasion and occupation of Iraq, for example, created a major opening for Al Qaeda, whose affiliates now represent the Sunni struggle against the Shia-dominated government.
zh: 比如，美國對伊拉克的入侵和佔領給基地組織敞開了大門，其附屬組織目前代表著遜尼派與什葉派控制的政府作對。

en: Likewise, regime change in Libya aided the rise of Al Qaeda-linked militants, leading to the killing in Benghazi of the US ambassador.
zh: 類似地，利比亞的政權變化也助長了與基地組織有涉的軍事勢力，導致班加西美國大使遇刺。

en: A system based on sharia (Islamic law) has been imposed, human-rights abuses are legion, and cross-border movement of weapons and militants has undermined the security of Libya’s neighbors.
zh: 基於伊斯蘭法律的制度已經建立，侵害人權的狀況比比皆是，武器和軍隊的跨境流動破壞著利比亞鄰國的安全。

en: Meanwhile, America’s support for the regimes in Yemen and Saudi Arabia has contributed to the rise of Al Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula.
zh: 與此同時，美國對葉門和沙特政權的支援也有利於基地組織在阿拉伯半島的興盛。

en: In parts of southern Yemen, an Al Qaeda affiliate, Ansar al-Sharia, functions as a de facto government.
zh: 在葉門南部的一些地區，基地組織附屬機構Ansar al-Sharia才是事實上的政府。

en: In Syria, where sizable chunks of territory are already under Islamist control and the pro-Al Qaeda Al Nusra Front overshadows the US-backed Free Syrian Army, the Obama administration is staring at the bitter harvest of its previous policy choices.
zh: 在敘利亞，大量領土已經落入伊斯蘭教徒之手，親基地組織的Al Nusra Front的陰影在美國支援的自由敘利亞軍（FSA）頭上揮之不去，奧巴馬政府正在感受此前政策選擇帶來的苦果。

en: Airstrikes now would merely make matters worse by undercutting the FSA’s grassroots legitimacy and aiding Islamist forces.
zh: 目前，空襲將破壞讓FSA的草根合法性，倒過來幫助伊斯蘭勢力，讓情況更加惡化。

en: Farther east, the US wants an “honorable” exit from Afghanistan – the longest war in its history – through a peace deal with the Taliban, its main battlefield opponent.
zh: 在更向東的地方，美國希望與其在阿富汗的主要戰鬥對手塔利班達成和平協議，從而“光榮”地退出這場美國歷史上歷時最長的戰爭。

en: In seeking to co-opt the Taliban – an effort that has resulted in the Taliban establishing what amounts to a diplomatic mission in Doha, Qatar – the US is bestowing legitimacy on a thuggish militia that enforces medieval practices in the areas under its control.
zh: 在拉攏塔利班的過程中 — — 之所以如此，是因為塔利班已經與卡達形成了外交關係 — — 美國授予了這個在其控制地區推行中世紀統治的嗜血武裝力量合法性。

en: America’s dalliances with Islamist-leaning political forces – and governments – have been guided by the notion that the cloak of Islam helps to protect the credibility of leaders who might otherwise be seen as foreign puppets.
zh: 美國與親伊斯蘭政治力量和政府的結盟的指導思想是伊斯蘭教的外衣有助於保護可能被視為外國傀儡的領導人的信譽。

en: That simply will not work, even in the short term.
zh: 這一套根本不管用，即使在短期也是如此。

en: On the contrary, until the Egyptian army removed him from the presidency, the Muslim Brotherhood’s Mohamed Morsi was coming to be seen by many as America’s man in Cairo.
zh: 相反，在埃及軍隊將穆斯林兄弟會的穆爾西趕下總統寶座前，許多埃及人一直把他當成美國在開羅的代言人。

en: In the long term, the US will gain nothing – and risk much – by continuing to back oil sheikhdoms that fund Muslim extremist groups and madrasas from the Philippines and India to South Africa and Venezuela.
zh: 從長期看，美國什麼也得不到，風險倒是很大 — — 如果它繼續支援資助穆斯林極端主義集團的石油酋長和從菲律賓和印度到南非和委內瑞拉的宗教學校的話。

en: By supporting Islamist rulers, the US is contributing to a trend evident from the Maghreb to the badlands of Afghanistan and Pakistan – Muslims killing Muslims.
zh: 支援伊斯蘭統治者的美國在助長從馬格利布到阿富汗和巴基斯坦山溝的穆斯林殺戮穆斯林的趨勢。

en: American policy has also contributed to a growing conflict between Islamist and secular forces in Muslim countries.
zh: 美國的政策還在助長伊斯蘭教徒和穆斯林國家的世俗勢力之間的衝突。

en: This is best illustrated by Turkey, where Obama has ignored Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s heavy-handed efforts to annul free speech and turn himself into a twenty-first-century Sultan.
zh: 最佳的寫照就是土耳其，奧巴馬對總理埃爾多安辣手摧毀言論自由、使自己稱為21世紀蘇丹的行為視而不見。

en: There and elsewhere, the US, motivated by the larger geopolitical goal of containing Shia Iran and its regional allies, has embraced Sunni rulers steeped in religious and political bigotry, even though they pose a transnational threat to the values of freedom and secularism.
zh: 土耳其和別的國家，美國為了遏制什葉派伊朗及其地區盟友這一更大的地緣政治目標，放任遜尼派統治者邁向宗教和政治極端，即使它們對自由和世俗主義價值造成了跨國威脅。

en: Moreover, the clash within Islam is likely to be destabilizing regionally and counterproductive to the interests of the free world.
zh: 此外，伊斯蘭教內部的衝突也可能成為地區動盪因素，破壞自由世界的利益。

en: Against this background, Obama should heed the doctrine proposed in 1991 by General Colin Powell.
zh: 在這一背景下，奧巴馬應該遵循鮑威爾將軍在1991年提出的思想。

en: The Powell doctrine stipulates that the US should use military force only when a vital national-security interest is at stake; the strategic objective is clear and attainable; the benefits are likely to outweigh the costs; adverse consequences can be limited; broad international and domestic support has been obtained; and a plausible exit strategy is in place.
zh: 鮑威爾思想認為，只有在關鍵性國家利益受到威脅、戰略目標明確且可以達到、收益可能大於成本、消極影響可以得到限制、獲得廣泛的國內和國際支援、並存在可靠的退出戰略時，美國才應該動用武力。

en: Given the US record since the doctrine was formulated, another criterion should be added: the main beneficiaries of military intervention are not America’s mortal enemies.
zh: 美國在這一思想提出後的記錄表明，應該在這些標準之上再增加一條：軍事幹預的主要受益者不是美國的道德對手。

en: Drone Wars
zh: 無人機戰爭

en: BRUSSELS – “Sometime they’ll give a war and nobody will come,” the American poet Carl Sandburg wrote hopefully in 1936.
zh: 布魯塞爾 — — 1936年美國詩人卡爾·桑德伯格曾滿懷希望地寫道 ， “ 總有一天他們會發動戰爭但是沒有人來響應。

en: His sentiment seems more apt than ever nowadays, but not because humanity has turned pacifistic.
zh: ” 他的這種感覺比以往任何時候都更正確，但卻不是因為人類比以往更加嚮往和平。

en: Rather, wars are increasingly fought remotely, with drones – or unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) – doing the killing.
zh: 相反，人類越來越多地依靠無人機 — — 或無人駕駛飛行器（UAV ） — —進行遠端殺戮。

en: Under President Barack Obama, the number of drone strikes carried out by the United States has soared, with more than 300 UAV attacks reported in Pakistan alone.
zh: 在巴拉克·奧巴馬總統治下，美國由無人機發起的攻擊數量猛增，僅巴基斯坦一地報告的無人機攻擊就超過300次之多。

en: In March 2011, the US Air Force for the first time trained more pilots for drones than for any other purpose.
zh: 2011年3月，美國空軍培訓的無人機駕駛員首次超過其他機種。

en: This raises serious ethical questions.
zh: 這種情況引發了嚴重的道德問題。

en: With no military personnel risking their lives, UAVs make it easier to kill, and to justify war operations to the public at home.
zh: 因為沒有軍事人員需要冒生命危險，無人機降低了殺戮和向國內公眾證明戰爭合法性的難度。

en: Moreover, a human being’s reticence to kill is inversely related to the distance between attacker and target.
zh: 此外，襲擊者和目標之間的距離越遠人類進行殺戮的顧慮就越小。

en: In the case of a pilot flying drones over Yemen by operating a joystick in Nevada, the threshold to pulling the trigger is dangerously low.
zh: 如果無人機飛行員在內華達用操縱桿在葉門上空駕駛無人機，那麼扣動扳機的臨界點會低到十分危險的程度。

en: Killing is just a part of the job, to be followed by bowling, perhaps, or a quiet evening at home.
zh: 殺戮僅僅是工作的一部分，之後或許會去打保齡球，也可能靜靜地在家中渡過整個晚上。

en: Meanwhile, the mere sound of drones terrorizes whole populations, indicating to enemies and civilians alike that they are being watched and might be attacked at any moment – which could well play into the hands of terrorist recruiters.
zh: 此外，單單聽到無人機的響聲也會令所有人毛骨悚然，因為它向敵人和平民宣告他們正同時受到監視並隨時有可能遭到進攻 — — 這一點可能會被恐怖分子招募者所利用。

en: From a legal and human-rights point of view, the US drone program is even more alarming.
zh: 從法律和人權角度看，美國的無人機發展計劃更為驚人。

en: After all, countries such as Pakistan, Yemen, and Somalia do not belong to declared war zones.
zh: 畢竟，巴基斯坦、葉門和索馬利亞等國不屬於公認戰區的範疇。

en: Outside the context of war, in turn, state killings are legal only if they prove absolutely necessary to save lives.
zh: 在戰爭以外的情況下，只有證明對挽救生命絕對必要才能允許國家採取殺戮行動。

en: They must be conducted either in self-defense after an attack, or in anticipatory self-defense against an immediate threat, when taking time to discuss non-lethal alternatives is not feasible.
zh: 反擊必須在受到攻擊後以自衛為目的，或者為了應對可能發生的直接威脅而採取自衛行動，無論是上述哪種情況，都不可能有時間去討論非致命的替代行動。

en: More than a decade after September 11, America’s drone program does not fall into the first category of reactive self-defense.
zh: 9.11事件過去10年後，美國無人機計劃已無法再劃入第一類反應性自衛的範疇。

en: Likewise, there is no evidence that any presumed terrorist who was killed outside of official war zones in the last few years represented a threat so immediate to US citizens’ lives that preventive and premeditated killing was the only option.
zh: 同樣，也沒有證據表明過去數年內在正式戰區外打死的所謂恐怖分子對美國公民的生命安全造成了直接的威脅，而這種威脅又非得靠預防及預謀性的殺戮來解決不可。

en: Unless US leaders prove otherwise in every case, American UAV attacks in countries like Pakistan or Yemen should be called what they are: extrajudicial killings.
zh: 除非美國領導人能夠一一證明，否則美國無人機在巴基斯坦和葉門等國發動的攻擊應該還原其法外處決的本來面目。

en: US State Department legal adviser Harold Koh disagrees, arguing that America is involved in a worldwide “armed conflict with Al Qaeda, as well as the Taliban and associated forces.”
zh: 美國國務院法律顧問高洪柱不同意這種說法，並提出美國正在打一場世界範圍內“與基地組織和塔利班及相關勢力的武裝戰爭。

en: So, Koh claims, drone attacks are part of a global war, fought both in declared war zones and non-war countries; therefore, they are legal.
zh: ”因此高洪柱聲稱無人機攻擊是戰區及非戰區國家全球戰爭的組成部分，因此其具有合法性。

en: But, even under this adventurous assumption, human-rights issues arise.
zh: 但即使我們接受這一冒險的假設，仍然無法對人權問題做出合理的解釋。

en: The laws of war condone targeted killings only of “combatants” who “directly participate in hostilities.”
zh: 戰爭法只容許定點清除“直接參與敵對行動”的“戰鬥分子 ” 。

en: The killings must be proportionate, strategically necessary, and publicly justified.
zh: 而且殺戮行為必須有所控制、具有戰略必要性、且能為公眾所接受。

en: Avoiding harm to civilians should be the top priority.
zh: 避免傷害平民應當成為重中之重。

en: At the slightest sign of illegality, an investigation must be conducted, offenders prosecuted, and victims compensated.
zh: 必須對一絲一毫的非法行為展開調查，對行兇者提起訴訟，並對受害者進行賠償。

en: The US drone program’s legal basis is entirely unclear, however.
zh: 但美軍無人機計劃的法律基礎完全不明確。

en: Given that most information about UAV activity is classified, it is impossible to know whether all drone targets directly participated in hostilities.
zh: 鑑於多數無人機活動資訊屬保密級別，幾乎不可能瞭解是否所有無人機目標都直接參與了敵對行動。

en: And, while the Obama administration’s claim of zero or single-digit civilian fatalities may be true according to the official definition, it rests on the premise that any military-age male killed in a drone strike is a militant, unless intelligence posthumously proves otherwise.
zh: 並且雖然奧巴馬政府所稱的零或個位數的平民死亡數字按照官方定義可能確有其事，但其前提是無人機襲擊中喪生的任何適齡參軍男子都是武裝分子，除非其後的情報能做出相反的證明。

en: A recent report by the law schools at Stanford University and New York University concludes that, in reality, civilian casualties in Pakistan may have accounted for up to 75% of all UAV victims between 2008 and 2011.
zh: 斯坦福大學和紐約大學法學院在最近一份報告中做出結論，2008到2011年實際的巴基斯坦平民傷亡數量在所有無人機受害者中佔比可能高達75 % 。

en: Others estimate a lower, but still alarming, rate of 30%.
zh: 其他報告雖然估值略低，但仍然達到了30%的驚人比率。

en: The legal obligation of proportionality is clearly being violated.
zh: 這顯然違反了適度採取行動的法律義務。

en: Accountability is also being flouted.
zh: 問責制同樣遭到了蔑視。

en: Drone operations are carried out by the Central Intelligence Agency, an organization whose activities are shrouded in secrecy.
zh: 無人機行動的執行者是中央情報局，該組織的所有活動無不是秘密進行的。

en: And, unlike military personnel, CIA agents enjoy extensive immunity, undermining international legal standards.
zh: 而且與軍事人員不同，中央情報局特工享有全方位的豁免權，這已經破壞了國際法律的基礎。

en: Without increased transparency, to declare America’s UAV campaign legal is impossible, both in the context of war and outside of armed conflict.
zh: 無論在戰爭還是武裝衝突以外的情況下，要想宣佈美國無人機行動合法就必須增加透明度。

en: As long as the US keeps the rest of the world in the dark, illegal acts – including possible war crimes – may be committed with impunity.
zh: 只要美國仍然不讓世界其他國家瞭解真相，那麼違法行為 — — 包括可能發生的戰爭罪行 — — 就有可能繼續逍遙法外。

en: Just as citizens worldwide are demanding increased economic and financial accountability, more pressure must be placed on the US to either prove that its drone activities are necessary and legal, or to stop them immediately.
zh: 正如世界各國公民要求擴大經濟和財政問責範圍一樣，我們也必須向美國進一步施壓要求其證明無人機行動的必要性及合法性，或者要求他們立即停止行動。

en: Victims of UAV attacks, their families, and civil-society groups have begun to speak out against America’s questionable drone campaign, and to pursue legal action.
zh: 無人機攻擊的受害者及其家屬和民間社會團體已經開始站出來反對美國可疑的無人機行動，並且提起法律訴訟。

en: Others should feel encouraged to follow suit.
zh: 應該鼓勵其他人也這麼做。

en: In the meantime, every drone strike will not only undermine human rights and international humanitarian law, but will also further widen a legal loophole that other governments and armed groups will not hesitate to exploit.
zh: 與此同時，每次無人機進攻不僅會損害人權和國際人道主義法律，而且會製造其他政府和武裝組織會毫不猶豫加以利用的法律漏洞。

en: The US drone program does not make the world a safer place; it creates an environment in which unlawful killings can happen virtually anywhere, at any time, violating the fundamental human right not to be arbitrarily deprived of one’s life.
zh: 美國的無人機計劃不但沒有令世界更加安全，反而創造出非法殺戮幾乎隨時隨地可能發生恐怖環境，違反了不得強制剝奪他人生命的基本人權要求。

en: America’s Locust Years
zh: 美國的災年

en: BERKELEY – It is hard right now to write about American political economy.
zh: 伯克利 — — 現在寫點關於美國政治經濟學的文章可不容易。

en: Nobody knows whether the debt-ceiling tripwire will be evaded; if so, how; or what will happen if it is not.
zh: 沒人不知道債務上限這根緊繃的弦會不會鬆下來；如何鬆下來；如果不鬆下來又會發生什麼。

en: If no deal to raise the debt ceiling is reached by August 3, interest rates on United States Treasury bonds could spike, or they could remain stable, as investors decide they have other problems to worry about.
zh: 如果到8月3日還不能就債務上限問題達成一致，那麼美國國債利率可能會飆升，但也可能維持穩定（因為投資者會認為還有其他更加值得擔憂的東西 ） 。

en: Or the US Federal Reserve, the Peoples Bank of China (PBC), or both – or even some other body – could support the market.
zh: 美聯儲和中國人民銀行（以及其他機構）也可能會出手支撐市場。

en: Or interest rates could rise if people expect a much weaker global economy – and, in a weaker global economy with no inflation, investors should be holding more US Treasuries, not fewer.
zh: 如果人們預期全球經濟會進一步疲軟，那麼利率也可能會上升，而如果此時沒有通脹之憂，那麼投資者會更多（而不是更少）地持有美國國債。

en: Frankly, no one knows what legislative deal will be struck to raise the debt ceiling.
zh: 坦白講，沒人知道到底會達成什麼樣的方案來提高債務上限。

en: All we know as of this writing is that a deal would probably involve cuts in near-term spending, meaning weaker growth and higher unemployment over the next 18 months.
zh: 我們所能知道的是，該方案可能會包括削減近期支出的措施，這意味著在未來18個月裡，增長會進一步放慢，失業率會進一步增加。

en: And we can assume that it would be repealed and replaced by something else come January 2013, either by a re-elected President Barack Obama, or by a new, Republican president.
zh: 我們還可以認為這些措施會在2013年1月結束，屆時將會有新動作，丟擲新措施的既可能是連任的奧巴馬，也可能是新的共和黨總統。

en: So, rather than talking about the US debt ceiling, let us think instead about all of the things that the debt-ceiling impasse has prevented the US government from doing during the past six months – all of the useful policies that might have been debated and enacted, but were not.
zh: 因此，我們還是把美國債務上限放在一邊，先想一想債務上限僵局在過去半年以來是如何束縛住了美國政府的手腳的吧，讓我們想一想到底有哪些有用的政策是應該討論而未討論的。

en: The risks imposed by global warming, for example, have not gone away.
zh: 比如，全球變暖的威脅並未消除。

en: The sooner the world starts preparing to deal with those threats, the better.
zh: 對於這一威脅，越早準備越好。

en: Another six months should not be lost.
zh: 我們不應該再浪費另一個半年。

en: The employment-to-population ratio in the US remains flat – mired at the very low levels to which it fell during the recession.
zh: 美國就業-人口比率仍然停滯不前，維持在衰退期間的極低水平。

en: With households desperately trying to rebuild their balance sheets, and with capital investment remarkably healthy, the only places to boost spending to restore capacity utilization and unemployment to normal levels are exports, government purchases, and construction investment.
zh: 美國家庭正在竭盡全力重塑自己的資產負債表，而資本投資相當健康，因此唯一能夠刺激提振生產利用率支出的地方只剩下出口、政府購買和建設投資了。

en: But opportunities to pursue the necessary policies have not been grasped.
zh: 但我們並沒有抓住實施必要措施的機會。

en: Here, too, another six months should not be lost.
zh: 在這一方面，我們也不應該再浪費另一個半年了。

en: Likewise, the US could have fulfilled its normal role as the conductor of the international economic orchestra. It has not, even as the European Union continues to respond inadequately to its own slow-moving solvency crises.
zh: 類似地，美國本能勝任其國際經濟總指揮的日常職責，但它沒有做到，甚至連歐盟無法處理好其緩慢發酵的債務危機時也沒能挺身而出。

en: The mandarins of northern Europe continue to measure out a drip-feed of support with coffee spoons.
zh: 北歐的政要們惜錢如金，支援政策大大地不給力。

en: Another six months have been lost.
zh: 於是，又一個半年浪費了。

en: America faces long-run and short-run problems: decaying infrastructure, weakening educational systems, and a dysfunctional health-care system that produces sub-standard outcomes at twice the cost of any other industrial country.
zh: 美國面臨著長期和短期問題：破敗不堪的基礎設施、江河日下的教育體系，還有那功能障礙、事倍功半的醫療體系。

en: Solving any of these three problems would go a long way toward resolving the long-run financing imbalance between current tax rates and America’s long-run social-insurance promises that the debt-ceiling debate’s instigators supposedly want to address.
zh: 解決這三個問題中的任何一個都將是邁向解決美國長期財政失衡 — — 當前稅率與美國債務上限爭論煽動者所欲解決的長期社會保障費用之間的矛盾 — — 的重大進步。

en: But the US government won’t address them. Six months that could have been spent boosting the long-run growth potential of the American economy through infrastructure investment, educational reform, or an overhaul of health-care financing – greatly easing America's long-run deficit and debt dilemmas in the process – have been lost.
zh: 但美國政府解決不了這些問題，而且已經浪費了半年 — — 這半年本來可以花在透過基礎設施投資、教育改革以及醫保融資方案修正來提振美國經濟長期潛力上，從而大大紓解美國長期赤字問題和債務困境。

en: During the run-up to World War II, Winston Churchill, speaking in Parliament, lamented “the years that the locusts hath eaten” – the period during which preparatory action to face the great crisis of his day (the rise of Continental fascism) could have been taken, but was not.
zh: 二戰戰備期間，丘吉爾在議會演講中哀悼了“災難般的這幾年 ” — —他指的是那段本應為他那個年代的大危機（歐洲大陸法西斯主義的崛起）做好戰鬥準備但卻沒有如此行動的時期。

en: Over the past century – with the notable exception of the Great Depression – the US political system has been remarkably good at foreseeing crises long before they have happened, and at least setting the foundation for dealing with them when they have occurred.
zh: 在整個20世紀中 — — 大蕭條是個顯著例外 — — 美國政治體系總是能夠十分出色地預見很久以後才會發生的危機，而當危機發生時，美國至少已經為此打好了應對基礎。

en: But so far in the third millennium, this skill – or simply run of luck – has deserted the US.
zh: 但在第三個千禧年中，這項技能（也許只是運氣）離美國而去了。

en: My view is that the problem would fix itself easily if only the Republican Party of Dwight D. Eisenhower could stage a comeback (though without Richard Nixon and Joseph McCarthy).
zh: 在我看來，要是艾森豪威爾治下的共和黨能起死回生就好了（可別是尼克松和約瑟夫·麥卡錫的共和黨 ） ， 這樣的話，這個問題就能自動修正了。

en: It is becoming increasingly clear, however, that the problem is one not only for the US, but for the rest of the world as well.
zh: 不過，形勢已經越來越明朗，問題不僅出在美國，也出在世界其他地方。

en: Since December 7, 1941, the world has in large part been able to rely on global governance by a somewhat-competent hyperpower.
zh: 自從1941年12月7日以來，在大部分時間裡，世界一直依賴某個還算勝任的超級大國的治理。

en: That America may be gone for good.
zh: 這樣的一個美國也許已是前塵往事了。

en: If it is, the world needs to develop other institutions for global management – and quickly.
zh: 果真如此的話，世界就需要另外的制度來管理全球事務，越快越好。

en: America’s Misguided Immigration Debate
zh: 美國有關移民的辯論被引入歧途

en: A debate on immigration is beginning in the United States Senate, which will take up several proposals.
zh: 美國參議院正在展開一場有關移民問題的辯論，這場辯論將討論數個建議。

en: These include a hateful bill – which the House of Representatives has already approved – that provides for the construction of a wall along the US-Mexican border and makes unauthorized entry into the US a felony.
zh: 這些建議包括一項令人憎恨的法案，即規定沿著美國和墨西哥邊境修築一堵高牆，並且將非法進入美國定為一項重罪。 美國眾議院已經批准了這一法案。

en: The US Senate will also consider a bill co-authored by Senator Edward Kennedy and Senator John McCain, which proposes stronger border enforcement, a temporary workers program with a path to residency and citizenship, and legalization for people already in the US without papers.
zh: 美國參議院還將考慮一項由參議員肯尼迪和麥肯恩聯合提出的法案。 這一法案建議加強邊境執法，設立可以導向居留權和國籍的臨時工作專案以及將美國境內的無證人員合法化。

en: Another idea is to require anyone in the US wanting to regularize their immigration status to go home and wait in line there.
zh: 另一個主張是要求任何在美國境內想要獲得正常移民資格的人返回祖國並在那裡等候。

en: This last component is largely rhetoric; it is hard to imagine any Mexican already in the US voluntarily returning to, say, Zacatecas to wait patiently in line for a new visa.
zh: 最後一項建議基本上是誇誇其談。 很難想象任何一個已經在美國的墨西哥人主動返回到比如卡薩特卡斯的地方耐心排隊等候新的簽證。

en: President George W. Bush has been skirting the question ever since he committed himself to an immigration agreement with Mexico when he visited President Vicente Fox in Guanajuato almost exactly five years ago.
zh: 幾乎在五年前，當布什總統在瓜納華託拜訪福克斯總統的時候承諾與墨西哥簽訂一項移民協議以來，他一直就躲避這個問題。

en: Finally, and perhaps most importantly, there is Senate Judiciary Committee Chairman Arlen Specter’s compromise proposal.
zh: 最後，也許是最為重要的是參議院司法委員會主席斯佩克特的妥協性建議。

en: Specter’s proposal also provides for reinforced security at the border, as well as a six-year non-renewable Temporary Workers Program without a path to residency, although it would allow unauthorized immigrants to remain in the US with a new, non-immigrant status.
zh: 斯佩克特的建議同樣規定加強邊界安全，以及為期六年的不可續簽無法獲得居留權的臨時工作專案。 這一專案允許非法移民以新的非移民身份留在美國。

en: The latter status may or may not include a path to residency and citizenship; fudging the issue may be a negotiating tactic to avoid debate over whether this is a form of disguised amnesty (which, fortunately, to a certain extent, it is).
zh: 迴避這一問題可能是為避免討論這是否是一種變相大赦的談判戰術而已。 而不幸的是，在某種程度上這的確是一種變相的大赦。

en: What’s missing in the debate is the Latin American context.
zh: 這一辯論缺乏的是考慮到拉美大環境。

en: There was a time when north-south migratory flows in the western hemisphere were limited to Mexico and the Caribbean.
zh: 先前有段時期，西半球的南北向移民流動侷限於墨西哥以及加勒比。

en: That changed in the 1980’s, when Central America’s civil wars sent hundreds of thousands of migrants thru Mexico to the US, and then in the 1990’s, when people fleeing violence in Colombia, Venezuela, Peru, and Ecuador also began searching for opportunity.
zh: 二十世紀八十年代，當中美洲的內戰將數十萬移民透過墨西哥送進美國時，這一情況發生了改變。 九十年代，當逃避發生在哥倫比亞、委內瑞拉、秘魯以及厄瓜多暴力的人們同樣開始尋找機會時，形勢又發生了變化。

en: Today, even Brazil, traditionally a country of immigration, has become one of emigration.
zh: 巴西傳統上是一個吸納移民的國家。 如今，它也成為了輸出移民的國家。

en: Moreover, these migrants are no longer exclusively of rural origin, nor do they travel only to traditional areas in the US; they are, literally, everywhere.
zh: 更為重要的是，這些移民不再侷限於農村人口，而且他們不再只是前往移民在美國的傳統落腳點。 事實上，他們無處不在。

en: Their remittances contribute immensely to the economic welfare of their families, communities, and home countries’ economies.
zh: 他們的匯款為他們的家庭和社群的經濟狀況以及祖國的經濟做出了巨大貢獻。

en: Thus, whatever immigration policy emerges in the US will have an enormous impact south of the Rio Grande well beyond Mexico.
zh: 如此，美國無論出現何種移民政策都將會對里奧格蘭德以南墨西哥以外的地區產生重大影響。

en: This will occur precisely at a time when Latin America is swerving left, with country after country drifting back to anti-American, populist stances: Venezuela in 1999, Bolivia last year, perhaps Mexico, Peru, and Nicaragua later this year.
zh: 而這一情況恰恰發生在拉美向左轉，一個接著一個回到反美主義和民粹主義的立場。 先是1999年的委內瑞拉，然後是去年的玻利維亞，今年晚些時候可能還有墨西哥、秘魯和尼加拉瓜。

en: If the perception of further US hostility toward Latin America persists, the tilt toward an irresponsible, demagogic left will harden.
zh: 如果人們依舊感覺美國敵視拉美的話，將會硬化不負責任以及蠱惑人心的左派傾向。

en: The responsible left in Chile, Brazil, and Uruguay are an exception to the emerging rule set by Venezuela’s President Hugo Chávez.
zh: 對於委內瑞拉總統查韋斯所確立的新興規則而言，智利、巴西以及烏拉圭負責任的左派人士是例外。

en: The best way to accentuate the region’s growing anti-American sentiment is to try to close the US-Mexican border (which will be futile).
zh: 惡化該地區不斷增長的反美情緒的最佳辦法就是試圖關閉美墨邊境（這將會是徒勞的 ） 。

en: Instead, the US should establish humane, secure, and legal mechanisms of temporary or permanent entry for people the American economy needs and wants, and it should work with, not against, governments in Latin America.
zh: 相反，美國應該為美國經濟所需要而且想要的人們臨時或者永久進入美國建立人道的、安���的以及合法的機制，而且，美國應該與拉美國家政府合作，而不應該與之作對。

en: Five years ago, Mexico’s President Vicente Fox tried to convince Bush that something had to be done before a nativist backlash in the US complicated its relations with Latin America and made goals such as a Free Trade Agreement of the Americas (FTAA) impossible.
zh: 五年前，墨西哥總統福克斯試圖讓布什相信，為了防止美國內部的排外強烈反應把它與拉美的關係複雜化，而且使得類似美洲國家自由貿易協定等目標付諸東流，就必須採取行動。

en: But matters have gotten worse: border tensions between the US and Mexico have grown, the proposed wall has rightly provoked indignation, more unauthorized immigrants than ever are entering the US, and the FTAA has collapsed.
zh: 但是形勢卻變得更差。 美墨邊境的緊張局勢有所增長，修建高牆的建議正好挑起了憤怒，前所未有、更多的非法移民正在進入美國，而美洲國家自由貿易協定則無果而終。

en: Bush must begin to use what political capital he has left to support enlightened immigration reform, along the lines of the Kennedy-McCain bill.
zh: 布什必須開始利用他所剩下的政治資本，沿著肯尼迪和麥肯恩法案的路線來支援開明的移民改革。

en: He will never get a guest-worker program without Democratic support, which in turn is unlikely unless the White House supports access to a program for unauthorized immigrants already in the US that includes some type of path to residence and citizenship.
zh: 沒有民主黨人的支援，他就永遠無法獲得外來工人專案，而除非白宮支援包含某種永久居留以及國籍的、為已經在美國的非法移民制定的專案，否則就無法得到民主黨人的支援。

en: Mexico and the US must be sensitive to domestic political concerns in both countries.
zh: 墨西哥和美國必須對各自國家的國內政治關切保持敏感。

en: No immigration deal is feasible north of the border without addressing security matters; south of the border, there is no conceivable Mexican cooperation on border security or on a Temporary Workers Program if immigration reform ignores the nearly five million Mexican citizens without papers currently living in the US.
zh: 不解決安全問題就不可能在邊界的北邊處理好移民問題。 而在邊界南邊，如果移民改革忽視目前居住在美國的將近五百萬墨西哥非法移民，就無法想象墨西哥會在邊境安全以及臨時工人專案上進行合作。

en: Mexico must act on what Fox has called “shared responsibility.”
zh: 墨西哥必須在福克斯總統所說的“共同責任”上採取行動。

en: The best imaginable deal between the US and Mexico, or the best imaginable US immigration reform, will not eliminate the flow of undocumented migrants from Mexico and South America overnight.
zh: 美墨之間最為可行的協議、或者說可以想象得到的最佳的美國移民改革，並非是一夜之間就消除來自墨西哥以及南美的無合法證件的移民。

en: Mexico has to assume responsibility for regulating this traffic, which means more than sealing off its southern border.
zh: 墨西哥必須承擔責任對這一人流設施管理，這就意味著做比關閉南部邊境更多的事情。

en: The government could, for example, double welfare payments to households whose male heads stay home, threaten to revoke land reform rights after years of absence in rural communities, and establish choke points on highways at the Tehuantepec Isthmus.
zh: 例如，墨西哥政府可以加倍支付男子家長留在家裡的家庭的福利，威脅在離開農村社群幾年後就取消土地改革的權利，並且在特萬特佩克地峽的高速公路上設立檢查站。

en: Fox has said that he is willing to break with old Mexican taboos, but the Bush administration has never taken him up on it.
zh: 福克斯總統已經說過，他願意與舊的墨西哥禁忌決裂，但是布什行政當局從來沒有認真對待過。

en: That is unfortunate, because Fox will not be around forever.
zh: 這是不幸的，因為福克斯總統不會永遠當政。

en: Immigration has always been an immensely complex and delicate issue inside the US, and now for Latin America as well.
zh: 移民問題總是美國國內的一個極為複雜和微妙的問題，現在對於拉美國家也是一樣。

en: A window of opportunity opened at the beginning of Bush’s first term, and closed shut after the terrorist attacks of September 2001.
zh: 布什第一個任期內開啟的機會之窗在2001年9月份的恐怖主義攻擊後關閉了。

en: It is opening again and should be taken advantage of before it is too late.
zh: 現在這個窗戶在一次開啟，就應當在過於後遲之前加以利用。

en: Why Iran Won’t Budge
zh: 伊朗為什麼不會讓步

en: TEL AVIV – No one really believed that the latest round of international negotiations with Iran over its nuclear program would produce a breakthrough.
zh: 特拉維夫 — — 沒有人真的相信與伊朗的新一輪核計劃國際談判能夠取得突破。

en: So it was no surprise that itdid not, despite the concessions that were made at the meeting in Kazakhstan by the P5+1 (China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States, plus Germany).
zh: 因此儘管P5+1集團（中國、法國、俄羅斯、英國、美國，再加上德國）在哈薩克會議上已做出讓步，談判沒有進展也並不出人意料。

en: America’s belief that a harsh sanctions regime could coax Iran into a deal has proved – at least so far – to be unrealistic.
zh: 美國認為嚴厲的制裁制度​​可以勸誘伊朗達成協議的想法至少目前看來是不切實際的。

en: Despite being isolated and ostracized, Iran has managed to gain some strategic breathing room with the help of countries like China, Russia, India, Syria, and Venezuela, allowing it to resist Western pressure.
zh: 儘管遭到孤立和排斥，伊朗在中國、俄羅斯、印度、敘利亞和委內瑞拉等國的幫助下得到了對抗西方壓力的戰略喘息空間。

en: More important, even though the severe sanctions regime led by the United States is bound to be imperfect – it only hardens further Iran’s resistance to “America’s designs.”
zh: 更重要的是，即使美國領導的嚴厲制裁制度​​註定並不完美 — — 它只能進一步增強伊朗對“美國陰謀”的牴觸情緒。

en: To be sure, Iran’s alliances are vulnerable to erosion and, in the case of two staunch allies, Syria and Venezuela, to outright collapse.
zh: 可以肯定伊朗的戰略聯盟並不穩固，敘利亞和委內瑞拉這兩大堅定盟友甚至有可能徹底崩潰。

en: The end of Chavismo would threaten Iran’s vast interests in Venezuela and its considerable presence in the Andes, while the fall of the Assad dynasty would be a devastating blow to Iran’s regional strategy.
zh: 查韋斯政權終結有可能威脅伊朗在委內瑞拉的龐大利益，同時伊朗在安第斯山脈的勢力也有可能遭到破壞。 阿薩德王朝的垮臺將對伊朗地區戰略構成毀滅性的打擊。

en: Even so, Russia and China continue to take a much more lenient approach to Iran than Europe and the US have since the International Atomic Energy Agency’s report in November 2011 described in detail Iran’s activities in pursuing the capability to produce nuclear weapons.
zh: 儘管如此，從2011年11月國際原子能機構報告詳細闡述伊朗追求核武器製造能力的所作所為以來，俄羅斯和中國對於伊朗的態度依然比歐美國家更為寬鬆。

en: While the Western powers have embraced ever-harsher sanctions, Russia and China view Iran as a tool in their global competition with the US.
zh: 儘管西方列強採取的制裁措施比以往任何時候都更嚴厲，但俄羅斯和中國卻把伊朗作為工具與美國展開全球競爭。

en: China’s Iranian interests boil down to economics.
zh: 中國在伊朗的利益歸根結底是經濟利益。

en: Bilateral trade stands at about $40 billion a year, and China is not only Iran’s largest customer for crude oil, but also a colossal investor – somewhere between $40 billion and $100 billion – in Iran’s energy and transport sectors.
zh: 中伊雙邊貿易額每年約為400億美元，且中國不僅是伊朗最大的原油客戶，同時也是能源運輸業的鉅額投資人（投資額為400億到1000億美元不等 ） 。

en: True, China cannot entirely overlook US pressure and the staunch opposition of its top oil supplier, Saudi Arabia, to Iran’s nuclear program.
zh: 誠然，中國無法完全忽視來自美國的壓力及其頭號原油供應國沙烏地阿拉伯對伊朗核計劃的堅決反對。

en: But, while China has supported the mandatory sanctions set by the United Nations Security Council, it has rejected the West’s unilateral measures.
zh: 但在支援聯合國安理會強制制裁措施的同時，中國拒絕承認西方國家的單邊制裁措施。

en: With bilateral trade worth only about $5 billion annually, Russia’s economic interests in Iran are fairly modest.
zh: 俄伊的雙邊年度貿易總值僅50億美元，因此俄國在伊朗的經濟利益微乎其微。

en: But it fears Iran’s ability to cause trouble, particularly by stirring up unrest among Russia’s Muslim citizens.
zh: 但俄國擔心伊朗製造麻煩，特別是挑動俄國內的穆斯林民眾鬧事。

en: Moreover, America has refused to pay the Kremlin’s high price – curtailment of congressional human-rights legislation, repeal of Cold-War-era restrictions on Russian-US trade, and abandonment of plans for ballistic missile defense in Europe – for Russian support on Iran (or, for that matter, on any other trouble spot, such as Syria).
zh: 此外，美國拒絕了克里姆林宮開出的高價 — — 限制國會人權立法、廢除冷戰時期俄美貿易限制和放棄歐洲彈道導彈防禦計劃，以換取俄國在伊朗（或在敘利亞等其他任何動盪地區）問題上對於美國的支援。

en: The problem with the US drive to have key stakeholders join its anti-Iran crusade is that some of them live in neighborhoods where Iran is an important factor.
zh: 美國要求關鍵利益方參與對伊討伐運動的問題在於伊朗在某些國家所處的區域發揮著重要作用。

en: India is a case in point.
zh: 印度就是一個很好的例子。

en: India is certainly alarmed at the possibility of Iran developing nuclear weapons, not to mention its concern at the possible effects of Iran’s Islamist fundamentalism on Kashmiri Muslims.
zh: 印度肯定警惕伊朗發展核武器的可能性，更不用說它對伊朗伊斯蘭原教旨主義可能對克什米爾穆斯林造成的影響表示關注。

en: But its $14 billion in annual bilateral trade, and dependence on Iranian oil – many of India’s refineries have been built to run solely on Iranian crude – are key strategic considerations.
zh: 但140億美元的年度雙邊貿易和對伊朗石油的依賴（印度許多煉油廠完全依賴伊朗原油進口）卻是印度必需思考的關鍵戰略問題。

en: Moreover, India needs Iran as an alternative trade and energy conduit to Central Asia, bypassing rival Pakistan, and also as a hedge against an uncertain future in Afghanistan after America’s withdrawal in 2014.
zh: 此外，印度需要伊朗這條繞過巴基斯坦的中亞能源貿易替代通道，還需要伊朗在2014年美國撤出阿富汗之後對未來的不確定性進行對沖。

en: As a result, India’s policy mirrors China’s: it has aligned itself with mandatory international sanctions, but has abjured voluntary Western financial restrictions.
zh: 因此印度的政策和中國如出一轍：那就是贊同強制性的國際制裁，但拒絕執行西方的自願金融限制政策。

en: The best one can expect is that India continues to act at the margin – for example, by reducing dependence on Iranian oil while increasing imports from Saudi Arabia, already its largest supplier of crude.
zh: 可以想見的最好情況是印度繼續執行這種擦邊球政策 — — 比如在降低對伊朗石油依賴的同時擴大從沙烏地阿拉伯的石油進口，目前沙特已經是印度排名第一的原油供應國。

en: The equivocal nature of Iran’s alliances, however, can be a mixed blessing.
zh: 伊朗聯盟的曖昧態度其實好壞參半。

en: Yes, a harsh sanctions regime might still gain additional supporters, but an Iran with its back against the wall would probably be even more obstinate in its nuclear drive.
zh: 多一些國家支援嚴厲制裁當然是好事，但被逼入絕境的伊朗可能會更頑強地研製核武器。

en: After all, Iraq was an easy target in the first Gulf War precisely because it had abandoned its nuclear program, and possessed no weapons of mass destruction.
zh: 畢竟，伊拉克正是因為放棄核計劃且不擁有大規模殺傷性武器而成為第一次海灣戰爭的靶子。

en: Similarly, Libya’s Muammar el-Qaddafi exposed himself to a NATO onslaught by relinquishing his WMDs.
zh: 同樣，利比亞的卡扎菲也因為放棄了大規模殺傷性武器才成為北約的攻擊物件。

en: By contrast, North Korea shows that defiance, rather than accommodation, is a strategy that works.
zh: 相反，朝鮮的例子表明真正奏效的對策不是妥協而是挑戰。

en: That is why Syria, with North Korean assistance, tried to develop a nuclear program (presumably destroyed by Israel’s officially unacknowledged “Operation Orchard” in 2007).Iran will not consider abandoning its nuclear insurance policy unless a broad agenda is agreed upon that addresses Iran’s concerns as a regional power and secures the immunity of its Islamist regime from American actions.
zh: 敘利亞因此在朝鮮的協助下試圖發展核計劃（這項計劃有可能被以色列2007年未公開承認的“果園行動”所摧毀 ） 。 除非制定全方位計劃解決伊朗身為地區強國的關注並確保美國不對伊斯蘭政權採取行動，否則伊朗絕不會考慮放棄核保險政策。

en: Albert Einstein’s definition of insanity as “doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results” could be applied to America’s Iran policy.
zh: 愛因斯坦用“反覆做同樣的事，卻期待不同結果”來定義精神錯亂，這恰好適用於描述美國的伊朗政策。

en: The diplomacy of sanctions, ostracism, and brinkmanship has failed resoundingly.
zh: 外交制裁、排斥和邊緣化政策已經徹底失敗。

en: As Iran’s uranium-enrichment and other weapons-development activities continue unabated, the US needs to make a break with the old rules of engagement.
zh: 由於伊朗鈾濃縮和其他武器研發活動有增無減，美國需要徹底改變原有的交往規則。

en: America’s Misplaced Deficit Complacency
zh: 錯誤的赤字滿意

en: CAMBRIDGE – The United States still faces a dangerous fiscal deficit, but one might not know it from the complacency that dominates budget discussions in Washington.
zh: 美國劍橋—美國依然面臨著危險的預算赤字，但這個赤字可能無法從華盛頓預算討論中所瀰漫的自鳴得意之情中獲知。

en: Regarded as an urgent problem until recently, the federal deficit is now being placed on the back burner of American politics.
zh: 此前聯邦赤字被視為一個緊迫問題，但現在已經淪為美國政壇的次等問題。

en: The shift in thinking was triggered by the revised deficit forecasts recently published by the Congressional Budget Office, the independent technical agency responsible for advising Congress on budget issues.
zh: 觸發觀點改變的是國會預算辦公室（CBO，這是一個獨立的技術機構，負責向過會提供預算問題的建議）最新公佈的赤字預測。

en: According to the CBO’s report, the US fiscal deficit will decline from 7% of GDP in 2012 to 4% in 2013.
zh: 根據CBO的報告，美國財政赤字將從2012年的佔GDP的7%降至2013年的佔GDP的4 % 。

en: This reduction reflects the cuts in government spending on defense and non-defense programs mandated by the budget “sequester” that took effect in March, as well as the rise in revenue caused by higher rates for income and payroll taxes since the end of 2012.
zh: 這一減少幅度反映了去年3月生效的國防和非國防專案上的預算“封頂”所帶來支出削減以及2012年底生效的提高所得稅和工資稅稅率所帶來的收入增加。

en: More striking is the CBO’s projection that the deficit will continue to decline rapidly, reaching just 2.1% of GDP in 2015, before rising gradually to just 3.5% of GDP in 2023, the end of the CBO’s official forecast period.
zh: 更令人矚目的是CBO預測赤字將持續快速減少，2015年將減至GDP的2.1 % ， 此後會逐漸上升，到2023年（CBO正式預測期的期末）將佔GDP的3.5 % 。

en: That path of deficits implies that the government debt/GDP ratio will remain at about the current level of 75% for the next ten years.
zh: 預算變化路徑意味著未來十年的政府債務/GDP比率將維持在75%左右。

en: Unfortunately, these headline-grabbing numbers are not likely to be borne out in reality; indeed, even the CBO does not believe that they represent what will occur.
zh: 不幸的是，這些吸引眼球的數字不可能成為現實；事實上，即便是CBO也不相信它們代表將來發生的事情。

en: Instead, these official forecasts represent a “baseline” scenario that the CBO is required to present.
zh: 相反，這些官方預測代表一種CBO被要求給出的“基線”情形。

en: The CBO’s “baseline budget” assumes that all of the deficit-reducing features in current law will remain unchanged.
zh: CBO的“基線預算”假設當前法律的所有赤字削減內容都保持不變。

en: These include, for example, an old legislative requirement that payments to physicians in the government’s Medicare program be reduced sharply in future years, a requirement that Congress has voted each year to “postpone.”
zh: 這些內容包括（比如）一箇舊的立法要求 — — 政府醫療保險（Medicare）專案內支付給醫生的數字將在未來數年大幅下降，對於這一要求，過會每年都投票“暫停 ” 。

en: In order to provide better guidance, the CBO presents an “alternative fiscal scenario,” in which such very unlikely features are removed from the forecast.
zh: 為了提供更好的指導，CBO給出了“替代財政情景 ” ， 在這一情景中，可能性極低的內容被剔除出預測。

en: The alternative forecast implies that the annual budget deficit at the end of ten years will be back up to 4.7% of GDP, with the debt/GDP ratio at 83% and rising.
zh: 替代預測表明，十年後的年度預算赤字將回升至GDP的4.7 % ， 債務/GDP比率為83%並呈上升趨勢。

en: And those estimates are based on the optimistic assumption that the economy will have returned gradually to full employment with low inflation and moderate interest rates.
zh: 且這些估算基於樂觀的假設 — — 經濟將逐漸恢復充分就業，通脹較低，利率也很溫和。

en: Officials and others who favor stimulating growth through increased government spending ignore the CBO’s more realistic alternative scenario.
zh: 官員和其他支援透過增加政府支出刺激增長的人士忽略了CBO更為現實的替代情景。

en: They buttress their argument that the deficit is not an immediate problem by pointing to very low interest rates on long-term government debt, with a 2% yield on the ten-year Treasury bond and a negative real interest rate on Treasury inflation-protected bonds (TIPS).
zh: 他們用長期政府債務利率極低 — — 十年期美國國債收益率只有2 % ， 通脹保護國債（TIPS）實際利率為負 — — 為依據論證預算並非緊迫問題。

en: But such low rates do not reflect ordinary market sentiment; rather, they stem from the fact that the Federal Reserve is now buying more long-term securities than the government is issuing to finance the budget deficit.
zh: 但如此低利率並不反映正常的市場情緒；相反，低利率的原因是美聯儲正在買入更多長期證券，數量超過了政府為預算赤字融資所發行的量。

en: Looking further ahead, the CBO warns that the combination of a rapidly aging population and the increase in medical costs will cause the deficit to rise rapidly, driven by the higher costs of pension and health-care benefits for middle-income retirees.
zh: 方言未來，CBO警告快速老齡化的人口和醫療成本的上升相結合將導致赤字快速增加，其推動力來自退休成本和中產階級退休者醫療福利成本的增加。

en: According to the CBO, without legislative changes, the fiscal deficit in 2037 will be 17% of GDP, while the national debt will increase to more than 195% of GDP.
zh: 據CBO的數字，若無立法變化，2037年財政赤字將為GDP的1.7 % ， 而國民債務將升至GDP的195%以上。

en: A large and rising national debt is a serious danger to an economy’s health.
zh: 龐大且增長的國民債務對經濟健康而言是一個嚴重威脅。

en: Higher debt-service costs require higher tax rates, which in turn weaken incentives and reduce economic growth.
zh: 債務維持成本的上升要求提高稅率，而這反過來又削弱了激勵、抑制了經濟增長。

en: By the end of the decade, the US will have to pay an amount equivalent to more than one-third of the revenue from personal-income taxes just to pay the interest on the national debt.
zh: 十年後，美國需要付出相當於個人所得稅收入三分之一多的資金用來償付國民債務利息。

en: Foreign investors now hold more than half of that debt.
zh: 目前，外國投資者持有了一大半債務。

en: Paying interest to them requires sending more goods and services to the rest of the world than the US receives from the rest of the world.
zh: 向他們支付利息需要向世界其他地區輸送商品和服務，其數量超過了美國得自世界其他地區的數量。

en: That requires a weaker dollar to make US goods more attractive to foreign buyers and to make foreign goods more expensive to American consumers.
zh: 這要求美元貶值以使美國商品對外國買家更有吸引力，而使外國商品對美國消費者來說更貴。

en: The weaker dollar reduces the US standard of living.
zh: 美元貶值會降低美國的生活水平。

en: A large national debt also limits the government’s ability to respond to emergencies, including both military threats and economic downturns.
zh: 龐大的國民債務還限制了政府響應緊急情況的能力，包括軍事威脅和經濟衰退。

en: And it makes the US vulnerable to changes in financial-market sentiment, as the European experience has shown.
zh: 這還讓美國易受金融市場情緒變化的影響，如歐洲經驗所顯示的那樣。

en: Reducing future deficits and reversing the rise in the national debt require raising tax revenue and slowing the growth of government pension and health-care programs.
zh: 降低未來赤字、扭轉國民債務的上升之勢要求提高稅收收入和降低政府退休和醫療計劃的增長率。

en: Tax revenue can be raised without increasing marginal tax rates by limiting the tax subsidies that are built into the current tax code.
zh: 稅收收入可以透過限制現行稅法中的稅收補貼在不增加邊際稅率的情況下實現。

en: Those subsidies are a hidden form of government spending on everything from home mortgages and health insurance to the purchase of hybrid cars and residential solar panels.
zh: 這些補貼是隱性政府支出，其範圍從家庭按揭和醫療保險到混合動力汽車和家用太陽能板無所不包。

en: Slowing the growth of the pension and health-care programs for middle-class retirees cannot be done abruptly.
zh: 降低中產階級退休和醫療專案支出增長不是一夜之間就能完成的任務。

en: It must begin by giving notice to those who are now a decade away from retirement – which is why it is important to launch such reforms now.
zh: 它必須以警示離退休尚有十年的人群為起點 — — 這也是為何需要從現在就開始改革的原因。

en: Unfortunately, the new complacency about future deficits makes it difficult, if not impossible, to enact the legislation needed to begin the process of trimming America’s long-term fiscal deficit.
zh: 不幸的是，對未來赤字的新出現的自鳴得意之情讓實施開啟美國長期預算赤字整合過程所需要的立法變得十分困難（如果不是不可能的話 ） 。

en: It is important for policymakers and the public alike to understand the real fiscal outlook and the damage that high deficits will cause if prompt action is not taken.
zh: 對決策者和公眾來說，很重要的一點事要理解真實的財政前景和在不立刻採取行動的情況下高赤字所帶來的後果。

en: Merely moving the problem to the back burner will not prevent it from boiling over.
zh: 僅僅把問題移至次要地位是無法防止它爆發的。

en: Meeting America’s Growth Challenge
zh: 面對美國的增長挑戰

en: BERKELEY – The United States continues to recover from its deepest economic slump since the Great Depression, but the pace of recovery remains frustratingly slow.
zh: 伯克利—美國一直處在大蕭條以來最深經濟衰退之後的復甦中，但復甦的速度仍然低得令人沮喪。

en: There are several reasons to anticipate modest improvement in 2013, although, as usual, there are downside risks.
zh: 有理由表明2013年會出現一些好轉，儘管與往常一樣，下行風險依然存在。

en: Prolonged recession or a financial crisis in Europe and slower growth in emerging markets are the main external sources of potential danger.
zh: 歐洲衰退延續或爆發金融危機以及新興市場增長放緩是主要的外部憂慮來源。

en: At home, political infighting underlies the two greatest risks: failure to reach a deal to raise the debt ceiling and an additional round of fiscal contraction that stymies economic growth.
zh: 在國內，政治鬥爭體現了兩個最大的風險：無法達成提高債務上限的協議以及妨礙經濟增長的新一輪財政緊縮。

en: Since 2010, tepid average annual GDP growth of 2.1% has meant weak job creation.
zh: 自2010年以來，平均年GDP增長率只有2.1 % ， 這意味著就業崗位創造不振。

en: In both this recovery and the previous two, the rebound in employment growth has been weaker and later than the rebound in GDP growth.
zh: 在此次和前兩次復甦中，就業增長的反彈都比GDP弱，而且滯後於GDP。

en: But the loss of jobs in the most recent recession was more than twice as large as in previous recessions, so a slow recovery has meant a much higher unemployment rate for a much longer period.
zh: 但最新衰退中的就業崗位減少量比前兩次多兩倍，因此緩慢的復甦意味著在長得多的時間裡存在高得多的失業率。

en: Weak aggregate demand is the primary culprit for subdued GDP and employment growth.
zh: 總需求疲軟被指為GDP和就業增長不振的罪魁。

en: The 2008 recession was triggered by a financial crisis that erupted after the collapse of a credit-fueled asset bubble decimated the housing market.
zh: 2008年衰退由金融危機引發，而金融危機由信用催生的資產泡沫破裂摧毀了房地產市場引發。

en: Private-sector demand contracts sharply and recovers only slowly after such crises.
zh: 在這類危機後，私人部門需求會急劇下降，復甦會極為緩慢。

en: The private-sector financial balance swung from a deficit of 3.7% of GDP in 2006, at the height of the boom, to a surplus of about 6.8% of GDP in 2010 and about 5% today.
zh: 私人部門財務收支的波動情況是：2006年存在相當於GDP的3.7%的赤字（繁榮期最高值 ） ， 2010出現了相當於GDP的6.8%左右的盈餘，目前盈餘約為GDP的5 % 。

en: This represents the sharpest contraction and weakest recovery in private-sector demand since the end of World War II.
zh: 這意味著這是二戰結束以來私人部門需求最劇烈的衰退和最疲軟的復甦。

en: Growth in two components of private demand, residential investment and consumption, which account for more than 75% of total spending in the US economy, has been especially slow.
zh: 私人需求的兩大組成部分 — — 佔美國經濟總支出額75%以上的住宅投資和消費增長特別緩慢。

en: Both sources of demand are likely to strengthen in 2013.
zh: 兩大需求源都有望在2013年有所增強。

en: Residential investment is still at an historic low as a share of GDP as a result of overbuilding during the 2003-2008 housing boom and the tsunami of foreclosures that followed.
zh: 用佔GDP比重衡量，住房投資仍處在歷史低點，這是2003—2008年房地產泡沫期的過度建房以及隨後按揭止贖風暴帶來的後果。

en: But the headwinds in the housing market are dissipating.
zh: 但房地產市場的阻力正在消散。

en: Home sales, prices, and construction all rose last year, while foreclosures declined.
zh: 去年，住房銷量、價格和建築量均有所上升，而按揭止贖有所下降。

en: Residential investment should be a source of output and job growth this year.
zh: 住房投資應能成為今年產出和就業增長的一大源泉。

en: Large losses in household wealth, deleveraging from unsustainable debt, weak wage growth, and a decline in labor’s share of national income to a historic low have combined to constrain consumption growth.
zh: 家庭財富的巨大損失、在不可持續的債務水平上的去槓桿化過程、疲軟的工資增長以及勞動收入佔國民收入比重降至歷史低點，這些因素形成的合力約束了消費增長。

en: Real median household income is still nearly 7% below its 2007 peak, real median household net worth dropped by 35% between 2005 and 2010 (and remains significantly below its pre-recession peak), and about 90% of the income gains during the recovery have gone to the top 1%.
zh: 真實中位家庭收入仍比2007年的峰值低7 % ， 真實中位家庭淨財富在2005—2010年間下跌了35 % （ 目前仍顯著低於危機前峰值 ） ， 復甦期間90%的收入增長流入了最頂層1%人的腰包。

en: To be sure, the balance-sheet headwinds holding back consumption have eased.
zh: 實事求是地說，消費的資產負債表阻力已有所減緩。

en: Households have slashed their debt – often through painful foreclosures and bankruptcies – and their debt relative to income has sunk to its 2005 level, significantly below its 2008 peak.  Helped by low interest rates, debt service relative to household income has fallen back to levels not seen since the early 1980’s.
zh: 家庭債務已得到了削減 — — 往往是透過痛苦的按揭止贖和破產實現 — — 家庭債務/收入比率已降至2005年的水平，顯著低於2008年的峰值。 受低利率推動，債務償付佔家庭收入比重已降至20世紀80年代初的水平。

en: But consumption will be hit by the expiration of the payroll tax cut, which will reduce household income by about $125 billion this year.
zh: 但消費將因工資稅減免計劃到期而受到影響，今年的家庭收入將因此減少1 250億美元。

en: Another factor holding back recovery has been weak growth in spending on goods and services by both state and local governments, and more recently by the federal government.
zh: 妨礙復甦的另一大因素是州和地方政府商品和服務支出增長疲軟，最近，聯邦政府也加入了這一行列。

en: Indeed, since the recession’s onset, state and local governments have cut nearly 600,000 jobs and reduced spending for infrastructure projects by 20%.
zh: 事實上，自衰退發生以來，州和地方政府裁掉了600 000個工作崗位和20%的基礎設施專案支出。

en: The fiscal trends for 2013 are mixed, but negative overall.
zh: 2013年的財政趨勢仍不明朗，但總的來說是消極的。

en: While state and local government cutbacks in spending and employment are ending as the recovery boosts their tax revenues, the fiscal drag at the federal level is strengthening.
zh: 州和地方政府的減支和裁員過程正在隨復甦提振稅收收入而結束，聯邦層面的財政後腿則日趨嚴重。

en: The American Taxpayer Relief Act – the tax deal reached in early January to avoid the “fiscal cliff” – shaves about $750 billion from the deficit over the next ten years and could take a percentage point off the 2013 growth rate.
zh: 美國納稅人援助法（American Taxpayer Relief Act ） — —1月初為避免“財政懸崖”而達成的稅收協議 — — 裁掉了未來十年的7 500億美元赤字，這將拖累2013年增長率1個百分點。

en: In addition, although less widely appreciated, significant reductions in federal spending are already under way, with more likely to come.
zh: 此外，儘管大幅削減聯邦支出的方案支持者要少一些，但該方案已經步入了實施階段，未來可能還會加碼。

en: Spending cuts and revenue increases that have been legislated since 2011 will reduce the projected deficit by $2.4 trillion over the next decade, with three-quarters coming from spending cuts, almost exclusively in non-defense discretionary programs.
zh: 2011年寫入法律的支出削減和收入增加預計將在未來十年減少2.4萬億美元的赤字，其中四分之三來自減支，幾乎全是非國防自由裁量專案。

en: Based on current economic assumptions, the US needs about $4 trillion in savings to stabilize the debt/GDP ratio over the next decade.
zh: 根據當前的經濟假設，美國需要約4萬億美元儲蓄才能在未來十年中保持債務/GDP比率穩定。

en: It is already three-fifths of the way there.
zh: 其中五分之三已有了著落。

en: The so-called sequester (the across-the-board spending cuts scheduled to begin in March), would slash another $100 billion this year and $1.2 trillion over the next decade.
zh: 所謂的扣押（將於3月開始的全面減支）將在今年減少1 000億美元、未來十年減少1.2萬億美元赤字。

en: Although it could stabilize the debt/GDP ratio, the sequester would be a mistake: it fails to distinguish among spending priorities, would undermine essential programs, and would mean another significant dent in growth this year.
zh: 儘管這可以穩定債務/GDP比率，但扣押將是一個錯誤：它無法區分支出優先順序，會破壞重要專案，並會導致今年增長的嚴重削弱。

en: Moreover, despite the warnings of deficit alarmists, the US does not face an imminent debt crisis.
zh: 此外，儘管赤字悲觀派頻發警告，但美國仍沒有迫在眉睫的債務危機。

en: Currently, the federal debt held by the public is just over 70% of GDP, a level not seen since the early 1950’s.
zh: 最近，公共部門持有的聯邦債務略高於GDP的70 % ， 這是20世紀50年代初以來不曾有過的情況。

en: However, government debt soars by an average of 86% after severe financial crises, so the increase in the federal debt by 70% between 2008 and 2012 is not surprising.
zh: 儘管如此，平均而言政府債務會在嚴重金融危機後增加86 % ， 因此2008—2012年聯邦債務增加70%並不令人奇怪。

en: Nor is it alarming.
zh: 這也沒什麼值得擔憂的。

en: The US economy grew rapidly for several years after WWII with a higher debt/GDP ratio, and today’s ratio is lower than in all other major industrial countries (and roughly half that of Greece, analogies to which are absurd and misleading).
zh: 美國經濟二戰後債務/GDP比率要高得多，但經濟增長也快得多，如今的比率低於任何其他主要工業化國家（大約只有希臘的一半，用它來作類比是荒謬的，極易引人入歧途 ） 。

en: During the last two years, Washington has been obsessed with the need to cut the deficit and put the debt/GDP ratio on a “sustainable” path, even as global investors have flocked to US government debt, driving interest rates to historic lows.
zh: 過去兩年來，華盛頓沉溺於削減赤字、將債務/GDP比率保持在“可持續”路徑上，儘管全球投資者紛紛湧向美國國債，把利率推向了歷史低點。

en: The considerable progress that has been made on deficit reduction over the next ten years has been overlooked.
zh: 未來十年赤字削減取得重大進步被忽視了。

en: Also overlooked have been the immediate challenges of low growth, weak investment, and high unemployment.
zh: 同樣被忽視的還有低增長、投資不振以及失業高企所帶來的即期挑戰。

en: It is time to refocus.
zh: 是時候轉變專注點了。

en: The US needs a plan for faster growth, not more deficit reduction.
zh: 美國需要提振增長速度的計劃，而不是更多的赤字削減。

en: Evsey Domar, a legendary growth economist (and one of my MIT professors) counseled that the problem of alleviating the debt burden is essentially a problem of achieving growth in national income.
zh: 傑出的增長經濟學家多馬爾（Evsey Domar，我在MIT的教授之一）建議，緩解債務負擔的問題本質上是取得國民收入增長的問題。

en: We should heed his wisdom.
zh: 我們應該遵循他的智慧。

en: America’s New Progressive Era?
zh: 美國的新進步時代？

en: NEW YORK – In 1981, US President Ronald Reagan came to office famously declaring that, “Government is not the solution to our problem.
zh: 紐約—1981年，美國總統里根以一句名言入主白宮 ： “ 政府不是問題的解決方案。

en: Government is the problem.”
zh: 政府是問題。

en: Thirty-two years and four presidents later, Barack Obama’s recent inaugural address, with its ringing endorsement of a larger role for government in addressing America’s – and the world’s – most urgent challenges, looks like it may bring down the curtain on that era.
zh: ”三十二年、四任總統過去了，如今奧巴馬的最新就職演說響亮地喊出了支援政府在抵禦美國 — — 以及世界 — — 所面臨的最緊迫挑戰中擴大作用的口號，似乎將再一次拉開這一時代的序幕。

en: Reagan’s statement in 1981 was extraordinary.
zh: 里根1981年的名言是不同尋常的。

en: It signaled that America’s new president was less interested in using government to solve society’s problems than he was in cutting taxes, mainly for the benefit of the wealthy.
zh: 它表明這位美國新總統對用政府來解決社會問題不像他對減稅（主要受益者是富人）那樣熱衷。

en: More important, his presidency began a “revolution” from the political right – against the poor, the environment, and science and technology – that lasted for three decades, its tenets upheld, more or less, by all who followed him: George H. W. Bush, Bill Clinton, George W. Bush, and, in some respects, by Obama in his first term.
zh: 更重要的是，他在任上開啟了來自政治右翼的“革命 ” — —不利於窮人、環境和科技的“革命 ” ， 這場“革命”持續了三十年，隨後的各屆總統 — — 老布什、克林頓、小布什 — — 或多或少都從某些角度支援里根的思想，奧巴馬在第一個任期內也不例外。

en: The “Reagan Revolution” had four main components: tax cuts for the rich; spending cuts on education, infrastructure, energy, climate change, and job training; massive growth in the defense budget; and economic deregulation, including privatization of core government functions, like operating military bases and prisons.
zh: “里根革命”有四個主要組成部分：為富人減稅；削減教育、基礎設施、能源、氣候變化和職業培訓支出；大規模增加國防預算；以及經濟去監管化，包括核心政府功能的私有化，比如經營軍事基地和監獄。

en: Billed as a “free-market” revolution, because it promised to reduce the role of government, in practice it was the beginning of an assault on the middle class and the poor by wealthy special interests.
zh: 這場革命被稱為“自由市場”革命，因為它致力於減少政府的作用，在實踐中，它是富貴特殊利益打擊中產階級和窮人的開端。

en: These special interests included Wall Street, Big Oil, the big health insurers, and arms manufacturers.
zh: 這些特殊利益包括華爾街、大石油公司、大人壽保險商以及軍火商。

en: They demanded tax cuts, and got them; they demanded a rollback of environmental protection, and got it; they demanded, and received, the right to attack unions; and they demanded lucrative government contracts, even for paramilitary operations, and got those, too.
zh: 它們要求減稅，得到了滿足；它們要求不要糾結於環境保護，得到了滿足；它們要求並獲得了打擊工會的權利；它們還要求誘人的政府合同甚至經營準軍事活動，也得到了滿足。

en: For more than three decades, no one really challenged the consequences of turning political power over to the highest bidders.
zh: 三十多年來，沒有人真正挑戰過將政治權力交給出價最高者的後果。

en: In the meantime, America went from being a middle-class society to one increasingly divided between rich and poor.
zh: 與此同時，美國從中產階級社會變得日益貧富分化。

en: CEOs who were once paid around 30 times what their average workers earned now make around 230 times that amount.
zh: 從前，CEO的薪水是普通員工的30倍，如今是230倍。

en: Once a world leader in the fight against environmental degradation, America was the last major economy to acknowledge the reality of climate change.
zh: 從前，美國是對抗環境惡化的世界領袖，後來卻成為最後一個承認氣候變化現實的大國。

en: Financial deregulation enriched Wall Street, but ended up creating a global economic crisis through fraud, excessive risk-taking, incompetence, and insider dealing.
zh: 金融去監管化肥了華爾街，但最終因為欺詐、過度冒險、不勝任和內幕交易造成了全球經濟危機。

en: Maybe, just maybe, Obama’s recent address marks not only the end of this destructive agenda, but also the start of a new era.
zh: 也許，僅僅是也許，奧巴馬最新的就職演說不但標誌著這一毀滅性過程的結束，也標誌著新時代的開端。

en: Indeed, he devoted almost the entire speech to the positive role of government in providing education, fighting climate change, rebuilding infrastructure, taking care of the poor and disabled, and generally investing in the future.
zh: 事實上，他的就職演說幾乎全篇都在大談政府在提供教育、對抗氣候變化、重建基礎設施、照顧窮人和殘疾人以及一般化的未來投資方面的積極作用。

en: It was the first inaugural address of its kind since Reagan turned America away from government in 1981.
zh: 這是自1981年裡根讓美國原理政府以來第一個這樣說的總統就職演說。

en: If Obama’s speech turns out to mark the start of a new era of progressive politics in America, it would fit a pattern explored by one of America’s great historians, Arthur Schlesinger, Jr., who documented roughly 30-year intervals between periods of what he called “private interest” and “public purpose.”
zh: 如果奧巴馬的演說真的成為美國新進步政治時代的開端，則這將契合偉大的美國歷史學家小亞瑟·施萊辛格（Arthur Schlesinger, Jr . ） 所探索的路徑：他指出，美國存在“私人利益”和“公共目標”的交替，每個時期大約30年。

en: In the late 1800’s, America had its Gilded Age, with the creation of large new industries by the era’s “robber barons” accompanied by massive inequality and corruption.
zh: 十九世紀末，美國來到了鍍金時代，這一時代的“強盜資本家”建立了大規模的新產業，社會也滋生了大量的不平等和腐敗。

en: The subsequent Progressive Era was followed by a temporary return to plutocracy in the 1920’s.
zh: 隨後的進步時代引來的是20世紀20年代富豪統治的暫時復辟。

en: Then came the Great Depression, Franklin Roosevelt’s New Deal, and another 30 years of progressive politics, from the 1930’s to the 1960’s.
zh: 接著發生了大蕭條、羅斯福新政和新的30年進步政治 — — 20世紀30—60年代。

en: The 1970’s were a transition period to the Age of Reagan – 30 years of conservative politics led by powerful corporate interests.
zh: 70年代是向里根時代的過渡期 — — 權勢公司利益把持的30年保守政治。

en: It is certainly time for a rebirth of public purpose and government leadership in the US to fight climate change, help the poor, promote sustainable technologies, and modernize America’s infrastructure.
zh: 顯然，是時候讓公共目標和政府領導復甦，讓美國對抗氣候變化、幫助窮人、促進可持續技術並實現美國基礎設施現代化了。

en: If America realizes these bold steps through purposeful public policies, as Obama outlined, the innovative science, new technology, and powerful demonstration effects that result will benefit countries around the world.
zh: 如果美國透過有的放矢的公共政策實現這些重大步驟 — — 這也是奧巴馬的規劃 — — 那麼由此產生的創新科學、新技術和強大的示範效應將會讓全世界所有國家受益。

en: It is certainly too early to declare a new Progressive Era in America.
zh: 現在就宣佈美國進入了新進步時代顯然還為時過早。

en: Vested interests remain powerful, certainly in Congress – and even within the White House.
zh: 既得利益仍然十分強大，特別是在國會 — — 甚至是在白宮中。

en: These wealthy groups and individuals gave billions of dollars to the candidates in the recent election campaign, and they expect their contributions to yield benefits.
zh: 這些權貴集團和個人在最近的競選過程中向候選人提供了數十億美元，並期待他們的付出能產生回報。

en: Moreover, 30 years of tax cutting has left the US government without the financial resources needed to carry out effective programs in key areas such as the transition to low-carbon energy.
zh: 此外，30年的減稅也讓美國政府失去了實施關鍵領域（如面向低碳能源的轉型）的財源。

en: Still, Obama has wisely thrown down the gauntlet, calling for a new era of government activism.
zh: 儘管如此，奧巴馬仍然明智地下達了戰書，發出了新政府積極主義時代的呼聲。

en: He is right to do so, because many of today’s crucial challenges – saving the planet from our own excesses; ensuring that technological advances benefit all members of society; and building the new infrastructure that we need nationally and globally for a sustainable future – demand collective solutions.
zh: 這樣做是正確的，因為當今許多關鍵挑戰 — — 從我們的過度行為中拯救地球；確保技術進步讓所有社會成員受益；以及建設國家和全球可持續未來所需要的新基礎設施 — — 要求集體堅決方案。

en: Implementation of public policy is just as important to good governance as the vision that underlies it.
zh: 對良好的治理來說，公共政策實施與實施它們的願景一樣重要。

en: So the next task is to design wise, innovative, and cost-effective programs to address these challenges.
zh: 因此下一個任務是設計明智、新穎、低成本的方案解決這些挑戰。

en: Unfortunately, when it comes to bold and innovative programs to meet critical human needs, America is out of practice.
zh: 不幸的是，當需要採取大膽的創新方案滿足關鍵人類需求時，美國總是行動的矮子。

en: It is time to begin anew, and Obama’s full-throated defense of a progressive vision points the US in the right direction.
zh: 美國是時候脫胎換骨了，而奧巴馬全力為進步主義願景辯護的舉動為美國指明瞭正確的方向。

en: America’s New Trade Hypocrisy
zh: 美國新的貿易偽善

en: As the current “development round” of trade talks moves into its final stages, it is becoming increasingly clear that the goal of promoting development will not be served, and that the multilateral trade system will be undermined.
zh: 正值當前的“發展回合”貿易談判進入最後階段之際，人們越來越清楚地看到促進發展的目標無法實現，而且多邊貿易體系將會受到損害。

en: Nowhere is this clearer than in a provision that is supposed to give the least developed countries almost duty-free access to developed countries’ markets.
zh: 有一項條款讓這一現象再清楚不過了，那就是看似給予最不發達國家幾乎免稅的發達國家的市場準入。

en: A year ago, the leaders of the world’s richest countries committed themselves to alleviating the plight of the poorest.
zh: 一年前，世界最富有國家的領導人承諾緩解最窮國家的困境。

en: At Doha in November 2001, they pledged to give something more valuable than money: the opportunity for poor countries to sell their goods and earn their way out of poverty.
zh: 2001年11月在多哈，它們保證給予比錢更為有價值的東西，也就是給窮國出售其產品並且獲得收入擺脫貧困的機會。

en: With great fanfare, developed countries seemed for a while to be making good on their promise, as Europe extended the “Everything but Arms” initiative (EBA), under which it was unilaterally to open its markets to the poorest countries of the world.
zh: 在一陣大肆喧鬧中，當歐盟延伸“除了武器外的所有產品”專案（EBA ） ， 也就是向世界最貧困國家單方面開放其市場之際，發達國家們看似某些時候確實在實現其諾言。

en: The opening was less than it seemed.
zh: 這一開放比看起來的要小。

en: The devil is in the details, as many less developed countries discovered that EBA’s complicated rules of origin, together with supply-side constraints, meant that there was little chance for poor countries to export their newly liberalized products.
zh: 問題出在了細節之中。 許多不發達國家發現，這一專案複雜的原產地規則以及供應方限制意味著貧窮國家幾乎沒有機會出口它們剛剛獲得貿易自由的產品。

en: But the coup de grace was delivered by the world’s richest country, the United States, which once again decided to demonstrate its hypocrisy.
zh: 但是，美國這一世界上最富有的國家再次決定展現其偽善，從而給了致命的一擊。

en: The US ostensibly agreed to a 97% opening of its markets to the poorest countries.
zh: 美國表面上同意向最貧困國家開放其市場的97 ％ 。

en: The developing countries were disappointed with the results of Europe’s EBA initiative, and Europe has responded by committing itself to dealing with at least part of the problem that arises from the rules of origin tests.
zh: 發展中國家對於歐盟的開放市場專案的結果感到失望，作為回應，歐盟承諾解決至少一部分由原產地規則檢驗引起的問題。

en: America’s intention was, to the contrary, to seem to be opening up its markets, while doing nothing of the sort, for it appears to allow the US to select a different 3% for each country.
zh: 相反，美國的意圖卻是看似開放其市場實則無所作為，因為，美國針對每個國家挑選不同的3 ％ 。

en: The result is what is mockingly coming to be called the EBP initiative: developing countries will be allowed freely to export everything but what they produce.
zh: 其結果就是被嘲弄為EBP的專案，也就是，發展中國家被允許自由出口所有它們所不生產的產品。

en: They can export jet engines, supercomputers, airplanes, computer chips of all kinds—just not textiles, agricultural products, or processed foods, the goods they can and do produce.
zh: 它們可以出口噴氣機發動機，超級計算機，飛機以及所有種類的計算機晶片，唯獨沒有它們做得來而且實際生產產品，如紡織品、農產品或者加工食品。

en: Consider Bangladesh.
zh: 以孟加拉為例。

en: If we go by the most widely used six-digit tariff lines, Bangladesh exported 409 tariff lines to the US in 2004, from which it earned about $2.3 billion.
zh: 如果我們採用最為常用的六位數稅則編碼，孟加拉國在2004年向美國出口了409個稅則編碼產品，收入為23億美元。

en: But its top 12 tariff lines – 3% of all tariff lines – accounted for 59.7% of the total value of its exports to the US.
zh: 但是，其價值最大的12項稅則產品，也就是所有稅則編碼的3％佔向美國出口的總價值的59.7 ％ 。

en: This means that the US could erect barriers to almost three-fifths of Bangladeshi exports.
zh: 這就意味著美國可以給孟加拉出口產品的幾乎五分之三設立貿易壁壘。

en: For Cambodia, the figure would be about 62%.
zh: 對於柬埔寨而言，這一數字將近62 ％ 。

en: The situation is no better if the 3% rule applies to the tariff lines that the US imports from the rest of the world (rather than to the lines individual poor countries export to the US), for then the US can exclude roughly 300 tariff lines from duty-free and quota-free treatment.
zh: 即使美國把3％規則適用於從世界其他地方進口的產品稅則編碼也無濟於事，因為那樣美國就可以將大約300種稅則產品從免稅和免配額待遇中排除。

en: For Bangladesh, this implies that 75% of the tariff lines, accounting for more than 90% of the value of its exports to the US, could be excluded from duty-free treatment.
zh: 對於孟加拉而言，這就意味著佔向美國出口商品價值90％的稅則編碼的75％將可能被從免稅待遇中排除。

en: Exclusion from duty-free treatment could reach 100% for Cambodia, which exported only 277 tariff lines to the US in 2004.
zh: 排除在免稅待遇之外可能波及柬埔寨出口產品的100 ％ ， 而該國2004年僅僅向美國出口了277項稅則編碼產品。

en: The official argument for the 3% exclusion is that it affects “sensitive products.”
zh: 對於3％排除的正式理由是，這影響到“敏感產品 ” 。

en: In other words, while the US lectures developing countries on the need to face the pain of rapid adjustment to liberalization, it refuses to do the same.
zh: 換句話說，美國向發展中國家宣揚面對快速調節適應貿易自由化的痛苦的需��，它自己卻拒絕這樣做。

en: (Indeed, it has already had more than 11 years to adjust to liberalization of textiles.)
zh: （實際上，美國已經有11年的時間來適應紡織品貿易自由化。

en: But the real problem is far worse because the 3% exclusion raises the specter of an odious policy of divide and conquer, as developing countries are invited to vie with each other to make sure that America does not exclude their vital products under the 3%.
zh: ）但是真正的問題更為嚴重，因為3％排除法是可憎的分而治之政策的幽靈。 各發展中國家被邀請相互競爭來確保美國並不把它們的關鍵產品根據3％規則排除在外。

en: The whole exclusion simply undermines the multilateral trading system.
zh: 整個排除規則恰恰破壞了多邊貿易體系。

en: Indeed, there may be a further hidden agenda behind the 97% proposal.
zh: 確實，97％建議後面可能還有更大的不可告人的目的。

en: At the World Trade Organization’s meeting Cancun in 2003, the developing countries stood together and blocked efforts to forge a trade agreement that was almost as unfair as the previous Uruguay round, under which the poorest countries actually became worse off.
zh: 在世界貿易組織2003年坎昆會議上，發展中國家立場一致，阻止了制定幾乎和前一輪烏拉圭回合一樣不公正的貿易協議。 烏拉圭回合協議讓最貧窮國家雪上加霜。

en: It was imperative that such unity be destroyed.
zh: 摧毀這樣的聯合是非常必要的。

en: America’s strategy of bilateral trade agreements was aimed at precisely that, but it enlisted only a few countries, representing a fraction of global trade.
zh: 美國的雙邊貿易協議的戰略恰恰以此為目標，但是它只是得到了代表全球貿易一丁點兒的幾個國家的支援。

en: The 97% formula holds open the possibility of extending that fragmentation into the WTO itself.
zh: 97％規則可能會把這一分裂延伸到世界貿易組織本身。

en: The US has already had some success in pitting the poor against each other.
zh: 美國在讓窮國內鬥方面成功過。

en: Preferential access for African countries, under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) and more recent initiatives, seems to be largely a matter of trade diversion – taking trade from some poor countries and giving it to others.
zh: 根據非洲發脹和機遇法案（AGOA）和最近的倡議給予非洲國家們的優惠市場準入更為可能是一種貿易分離，也就是從某些窮國中分離貿易交給其他國家。

en: For example, Bangladesh’s share in US clothing markets declined from 4.6% in 2001 to 3.9% in 2004.
zh: 例如，孟加拉國在美國的服裝市場份額從2001年的4.6％下降到2004年的3.9 ％ 。

en: During the same period, AGOA countries’ market share in the US clothing sector increased from 1.6% to 2.6%, and it is likely to increase further when AGOA countries start to take full advantage of duty-free access.
zh: 在同一時期，AGOA國家在美國服裝市場份額從1.6％上升到2.6 ％ ， 而且，當AGOA國家開始充分利用免稅市場準入時，這一份額可能還會提高。

en: AGOA had a sunset clause, but if the duty-free access becomes permanent for less developed countries in Africa – as stipulated in Hong Kong – then poor countries in Asia will continue to lose US market share.
zh: AGOA包含一個日落條款，但是，如果正如在香港世貿會議規定的那樣將針對非洲欠發達國家而言免稅准入永久化，那麼亞洲窮國將繼續失去美國的市場份額。

en: The WTO is supposed to prevent these trade-diversionary agreements, but so far no case has been successfully brought.
zh: 世界貿易組織理應防止這些分離貿易的協議，但是目前為止還沒有成功地做到這一點。

en: Even if America succeeds in dividing the developing countries, however, it may inspire a degree of unity elsewhere.
zh: 即使美國成功地分離了發展中國家，也會在其他地方激發團結。

en: Both those committed to trade liberalization within a multilateral system and those committed to helping developing countries will look at America’s new strategy with abhorrence.
zh: 那些致力於多邊體系下的貿易自由化和幫助發展中國家的人們將以憎惡的目光看待美國的新戰略。

en: Game Changers for Growth
zh: 增長的局面改變因素

en: BERKELEY – The recent G-20 meeting of finance ministers in Saint Petersburg confirmed that the debate between growth and austerity is over – at least for now.
zh: 伯克利—最近在聖彼得堡舉行的G20財政會議確認了增長和緊縮之爭已經結束 — — 至少在當下是如此。

en: With protracted recession in Europe and slowdowns in emerging markets, concern about budget deficits has given way to apprehension about growth.
zh: 隨著歐洲的長期衰退和新興市場的減速，對預算赤字的擔憂已經讓位給對增長的擔憂。

en: In July, the International Monetary Fund revised its global growth forecast downward for the second time this year.
zh: 7月，IMF今年第二次下調全球增長預測。

en: Both Japan and the United States stand out as bright spots in the subdued global outlook, but for different reasons.
zh: 日本和美國成為暗淡全球前景的亮點，但各有各的原因。

en: In Japan, Prime Minister Shinzo Abe has unleashed a combination of aggressive monetary and fiscal expansion along with promised reforms of the labor market, corporate governance, regulation, and trade.
zh: 在日本，首相安倍晉三同時丟擲了激進的貨幣和財政擴張，並承諾改革勞動力市場、公司治理、監管和貿易。
