en: At the beginning of this year, Europe introduced a new Greenhouse Gas Emissions Trading Scheme that uses market-based incentives to control carbon emissions.
zh: 今年年初，歐洲引入了新的“溫室氣體排放權交易制度 ” ， 用市場激勵機制來控制碳的排放。

en: American companies operating in Europe are part of that system for their European-based emissions, so that US companies are being pulled into climate control even if their own government avoids the issue.
zh: 在歐洲營運的美國公司由於其在歐洲的排放也成為該體系的一部分。 因此即便在本國政府迴避這一問題的情況下，美國公司還是被納入了氣候控制的體系當中。

en: Second, major US investors, such as pension fund managers, are realizing that US companies that fail to control their emissions may be vulnerable to financial losses in the future.
zh: 再者，美國主要的投資人，如養老基金經理們正意識到不能控制排放的公司可能在未來遭遇經濟損失。

en: They know that, sooner or later, the US will have to join the rest of the world in controlling climate change.
zh: 他們明白美國遲早要加入全球控制氣候變化的程序當中。

en: At that point, power companies that use antiquated technologies that emit massive amounts of greenhouse gases may face serious financial losses.
zh: 到那時，使用過時技術的電力公司會因排放大量的溫室氣體而面臨嚴重的財務損失。

en: So investors are telling companies to report their carbon emissions today in order to assess future liabilities.
zh: 所以投資者們正讓當今的公司報告碳排放量以便評估未來的責任。

en: Similarly, many company bosses know that pretending that climate problems do not exist is bad for shareholders, because reality will one day strike.
zh: 同樣，許多公司的老闆都明白佯裝氣候問題不存在的做法有損股東利益，因為真相總有大白的一天。

en: They know that investing today in clean technologies can give them a long-term competitive advantage.
zh: 他們知道今天在清潔（能源）技術上的投資能增加公司的長期競爭力。

en: As a result, many companies are taking steps now to limit their emissions to avoid future financial liabilities and a lack of investor confidence.
zh: 其結果是許多公司都開始採取措施限制排放以避免在未來承擔不必要的經濟責任並以此保持投資者的信心。

en: The most dramatic breakthrough of this kind occurred when General Electric, one of the world’s most important, innovative, and respected companies, announced that it was going “green” with a major new corporate focus on environmentally sound technologies and a commitment to limit its own greenhouse gas emissions.
zh: 當全球最重要、最富創新精神和最受人尊敬的公司之一—通用電氣公司宣佈將透過實施採用有利於環境的技術的新主張和承諾限制其自身的溫室氣體排放，而成為一家“綠色”公司時，就引發了這一領域的最重大突破。

en: With GE’s leadership, which it termed “ecomagination” (combining ecology with imagination), many US businesses are sure to follow.
zh: 在通用電氣公司自稱為“生態想象力 ” （ 將生態與想象力結合）的領導力指引下，許多美國公司都會從善如流。

en: It is too early to count on success in engaging the US on climate change.
zh: 要說已成功地讓美國介入了應對氣候變化的陣營還為時尚早。

en: The Bush administration continues to delay and to avoid sound science.
zh: 布什政府仍繼續拖延並回避有效的科學論證。

en: Yet it is reasonably clear that a tipping point has been reached.
zh: 然而，比較明瞭的是現在的形勢已經到了一個轉折點。

en: Reality is catching up with the US, as it already has elsewhere in the world.
zh: 正如在其他國家已經發生的情況一樣，現實正在逼近美國。

en: As US citizens and businesses continue to suffer the results of climate change – heat waves, droughts, hurricanes, and floods – more and more Americans, including an increasing number of business leaders, will press America’s political leaders for real action.
zh: 隨著美國民眾和公司繼續遭受氣候變化的不良影響—熱浪、乾旱、颶風和洪水—越來越多的美國人，包括越來越多的商業領袖都會敦促美國的政治領導層採取切實的舉措。

en: The solutions will not be easy, and the effort must last over many decades in all parts of the world.
zh: 解決之道不會是一蹴而就的，這樣的努力必須在全世界範圍內持續數十年。

en: But the effort needs to start now.
zh: 但我們必須現在就開始行動。

en: As with Europe’s new carbon trading, all producers and consumers around the globe will need to face market incentives to adopt technologies and consumption patterns that slow (and eventually stop) the increase of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
zh: 如同歐洲的新排放交易制度一樣，全球的生產者和消費者都需要面對市場激勵機制採用減緩（並最終停止）增加大氣中溫室氣體的技術和消費模式。

en: We will all need to pay a “market price” when we contribute to global climate change, so that we give true economic incentives to sustainable energy systems and new public investments – for example, mass transit – that reduce greenhouse gas emissions and thereby head off future climatic disasters.
zh: 當我們對全球氣候變化負有責任時，我們都應該為一定的“市場價格”埋單。 這樣我們才能真正地從經濟上激勵可持續的能源體系和新的公共投資—例如大運量公交系統—從而減少溫室氣體的排放，進而防止未來的氣候災難。

en: The Right Weights for Mortgage Risks
zh: 按揭風險的正確權重

en: ABU DHABI – Ever since hunter-gatherers started to build their own dwellings some 14,000 years ago, homeownership has been a mark of high social and economic status.
zh: 阿布扎比—自從14,000年前採集狩獵部落開始建設棲身之所以來，房屋擁有權就成為社會和經濟地位崇高的標誌。

en: Today, the United States has built a mammoth financial bureaucracy to promote homeownership, and economists, bankers, politicians, and of course homeowners themselves keenly follow house-price indicators.
zh: 如今美國建立了巨大的金融機構系統以促進房屋擁有，經濟學家、銀行家、政客，當然還有屋主本身，都熱切地追蹤者房價指標。

en: But, as we have recently witnessed, unless mortgage risks are properly calculated, the dream of homeownership can all too easily become an economic nightmare.
zh: 但是，正如我們最近所看到的，除非按揭風險得到正確計算，否則擁有房子之夢很容易演變為經濟噩夢。

en: Mortgage debt has become households’ biggest liability throughout the developed world.
zh: 按揭債務已成為整個發達世界最大的家庭負債項。

en: In the decade preceding the financial crisis, US mortgage debt increased almost threefold, while the real economy grew by only one-third.
zh: 在金融危機之前的十年中，美國按揭債務幾乎增加了三倍，而實體經濟僅僅增長三分之一。

en: At its 2007 peak, US mortgage debt stood at $10.6 trillion – more than double the combined GDP of China and India.
zh: 在2007年高峰期，美國按揭債務高達10.6萬億美元 — — 比中國和印度GDP加起來還要多一倍有餘。

en: The six major banking crises in the advanced economies since the mid-1970s were all associated with a housing bust.
zh: 自20世紀70年代中期以來，發達經濟體共爆發過六次大型銀行危機，它們全部與房地產泡沫破裂有關。

en: A real-estate price crash has also been a key cause of emerging-market crises, such as the 1997-98 Asian collapse.
zh: 房地產價格崩潰也是新興市場危機的主要原因，1997—98年亞洲崩盤就是如此。

en: Research shows that lost output during recessions accompanied by a housing bust is double or triple what it might otherwise have been had real-estate prices held up.
zh: 研究表明，與房地產泡沫破裂有關的危機的產出損失比房地產價格保持堅挺的情況要大一到兩倍。

en: Moreover, housing busts tend to prolong recessions by almost three years.
zh: 此外，房地產泡沫破裂會讓衰退期延長近三年。

en: Given the enormous social and economic costs when high levels of mortgage debt meet a crash in house prices, one would expect regulators to be fully engaged on the issue.
zh: 當按揭債務高水平遇上房價崩盤時，就會引起巨大的社會和經濟成本，因此，監管者理應對這一問題全力以赴、密切關注。

en: Unfortunately, they are not.
zh: 不幸的是，並非如此。

en: Although the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, the primary global benchmark for bank regulations, proposed reforms after the 2008 crisis that are aimed at strengthening the financial system, mortgage regulations have changed little.
zh: 儘管2008年危機後全球銀行監管的主要基準 — — 巴塞爾銀行監督委員會（Basel Committee on Banking Supervision）建議實施旨在強化金融系統的改革，但按揭監管變化甚微。

en: The key to mortgage regulation is the concept of “risk weight,” a measure that increases with the probability that a borrower will default.
zh: 按揭監管的關鍵是“風險權重”的概念。 這一指標隨借款人違約機率的增加而增加。

en: For example, a loan to AAA-rated Microsoft has a 0% risk weight, meaning that it is virtually risk-free.
zh: 比如，貸給AAA級的微軟公司的貸款，風險權重為0 % ， 這意味著它可視為無風險。

en: A loan to the Indian government will have a risk weight of 50%, and one to a riskier Argentina will be weighted at 150%.
zh: 貸給印度政府的貸款，風險權重為50 % ， 風險更高的阿根廷貸款，風險權重將是150 % 。

en: When it comes to mortgages, the standard risk weight is 35% (down from 50% a decade ago).
zh: 至於按揭貸款，標準風險權重是35 % （ 十年前是50 % ） 。

en: But banks can use internal mathematical models to calculate their own risk weights.
zh: 但銀行可以用內部數學模型計算它們自身的風險權重。

en: This is akin to marking one’s own exam paper; unsurprisingly, banks’ risk scores are usually on the safe side.
zh: 這就好比是自己給自己的考卷打分；好不奇怪，銀行的風險評分往往落在安全區間。

en: Consider, for example, a $200,000 bank loan to buy a $235,000 home.
zh: 比如，考慮一筆200,000美元的貸款，用途為購買一套235,000美元的房子。

en: If the bank attaches a 10% risk weight to the loan, the risk-weighted equivalent is $20,000.
zh: 如果銀行賦予這筆貸款10%的風險權重，則其風險加權等價值為20,000美元。

en: If the amount of bank capital needed to protect that risk-weighted equivalent is 10%, then the bank requires just $2,000 of its own capital to fund the mortgage, $198,000 of which the bank itself borrows.
zh: 如果保護這一風險加權等價值所需要的銀行資本比重為10 % ， 則銀行只需要拿出2,000美元的資本就可以發起這筆貸款，其餘198,000美元都是銀行借來的。

en: All it takes to wipe out the bank’s own money is a 16% drop in the house’s price (from $235,000 to below $198,000).
zh: 讓銀行自己的錢損失殆盡需要房價下跌16 % （ 從235,000美元跌到198,000美元之下 ） 。

en: US house prices – as measured by the S&P/Case-Shiller National Home Price Index – fell by more than 30% from June 2006 to March 2009, while European countries, including Spain, Ireland, and the United Kingdom, experienced similar or greater declines.
zh: 用S&P/Case-Shiller全國住房價格指數衡量，2006年6月—2009年3月美國房價下跌了30%多，而歐洲國家（包括西班牙、愛爾蘭和英國）也經歷了類似或更大的跌幅。

en: The problem is that banks continue to offer big mortgages while having little of their own “skin in the game.”
zh: 問題在於，自己基本沒有“牽涉其中”的銀行繼續放出大量按揭貸款。

en: The IMF estimates that the average mortgage risk weight in Europe and Asia was 14% and 15%, respectively, with some banks using a risk weight as low as 6%.
zh: IMF估計，歐洲和亞洲的平均按揭風險權重分別為14%和15 % ， 一些銀行使用的風險權重低至6 % 。

en: Recently, some regulators have become suspicious of banks’ do-it-yourself risk weights.
zh: 最近，一些監管者開始質疑銀行自說自話的風險權重。

en: In 2012, the UK authorities asked banks to apply a temporary minimum 15% risk weight to their mortgage portfolios, though that guidance expired in July.
zh: 2012年，英國當局要求銀行按揭組合採取15%的臨時性風險權重下限，但該指引7月份就失效了。

en: The Swedish regulator has recommended that mortgage lenders raise their risk-weight floor from 15% to 25%.
zh: 瑞典監管者建議按揭貸款人將風險權重下限從15%提高到25 % 。

en: Although welcome, these steps may still be too little; more important, they lack flexibility.
zh: 儘管這些措施值得歡迎，但步子仍然邁得太小；更重要的是，它們缺少靈活性。

en: A better option would be to implement time-varying, pro-cyclical floors, forcing banks to hold more capital during housing booms.
zh: 更好的辦法是實施隨時間變化的順週期下限，強迫銀行在房地產繁榮期持有更多資本。

en: And, whereas a single, fixed floor might push banks toward riskier loans that offer higher returns for the same amount of capital, a dynamic system would allow lower floors for the lowest-risk mortgages and require higher floors for riskier loans.
zh: 此外，一刀切的固定下限可能促使銀行將同等資本用於風險更大、回報也更大的貸款；而動態系統允許降低風險最低的按揭貸款的下限，而對風險較大的貸款要求較高的下限。

en: Moreover, while risk weight is an important macro-prudential lever, it must be used in conjunction with regulators’ other tools.
zh: 此外，儘管風險權重是一個重��的宏觀審慎槓桿，但必須與監管者的其他工具配合使用。

en: These include mortgage eligibility criteria, such as loan-to-value and loan-to-income ratios, and dynamic provisioning (that is increasing banks’ mandatory loan-loss reserves during housing booms).
zh: 這些用具包括按揭合格標準（如貸款/房屋價值比和貸款/收入比）和動態拔備（即在房地產繁榮期提高銀行的法定貸款損失準備金 ） 。

en: It is important to calibrate the impact of risk weights on housing-market cycles relative to other measures, not least because excessive and overlapping intervention could itself fuel dangerous cycles.
zh: 根據房地產市場週期調整風險權重相對於其他指標的影響十分重要，因為過度和重複干預本身也可能導致惡性迴圈。

en: The reliance of modern banking regulation on risk weighting is nowhere more important than in the mortgage market.
zh: 現代銀行監管依賴於風險權重，最能表現這一點的莫過於按揭市場。

en: If regulators get it wrong, the entire edifice could collapse – yet again.
zh: 如果監管者措施失當，整個金融系統都要崩潰 — — 再一次崩潰。

en: The views expressed in this column are the author’s own, and do not represent those of the National Bank of Abu Dhabi.
zh: 本專欄僅代表作者個人觀點，不代表阿布扎比國民銀行觀點。

en: Hardening Brazil’s Soft Power
zh: 硬化巴西的軟實力

en: BRASILIA – It is, perhaps, a truism for Brazil’s citizens that their country is and always will be a peaceful one.
zh: 巴西利亞 — — 或許對巴西民眾來講，國家永遠和平是一個不言而喻的問題。

en: After all, Brazil has lived with its ten neighbors without conflict for almost 150 years, having settled its borders through negotiation.
zh: 畢竟在談判解決邊境爭端後，巴西與十個鄰國間已近150年沒有爆發任何衝突。

en: It last went to war in 1942, after direct aggression by Nazi U-boats in the South Atlantic.
zh: 1942年納粹U型潛艇明目張膽入侵南大西洋是巴西最後一次打仗。

en: It has forsworn nuclear weapons, having signed a comprehensive nuclear-safeguards agreement with Argentina and the International Atomic Energy Agency.
zh: 巴西已和阿根廷及國際原子能機構簽署了《全面核保障協定 》 ， 誓言放棄核武器。

en: Through the Common Market of the South (Mercosur) and the Union of South American Nations (Unasur), Brazil is helping to integrate the region politically, economically, socially, and culturally.
zh: 巴西正透過南方共同市場（Mercosur）和南美國家聯盟（UNASUR）為地區的政治、經濟、社會和文化融合貢獻自己的力量。

en: But is soft power enough for one of the world’s major emerging countries?
zh: 但向巴西這樣的世界主要新興國家單純依靠軟實力能否行得通？

en: To be sure, Brazil’s peaceful foreign policy has served it well.
zh: 可以肯定，巴西的和平外交政策效果良好。

en: Brazil has used its stature to advance peace and cooperation in South America and beyond.
zh: 巴西充分利用其自身地位推進南美及其他地區的和平合作。

en: Its constructive stance derives from a worldview that accords pride of place to the values of democracy, social justice, economic development, and environmental protection.
zh: 巴西將國家自豪感與民主制度、社會正義、經濟發展和環境保護相融合的世界觀造就瞭如此建設性的態度。

en: Brazil’s unique approach to promoting these ideals is an important source of its soft power, reflected in the broad international support that placed Brazilians atop international institutions like the Food and Agriculture Organization and the World Trade Organization.
zh: 巴西軟實力的重要來源是其弘揚理想的獨特方式，具體表現在巴西所獲的支援超過了糧農組織和世貿組織。

en: Yet no country can rely on soft power alone to defend its interests.
zh: 但沒有哪個國家可以單靠軟實力來捍衛自己的利益。

en: Indeed, in an unpredictable world, where old threats are compounded by new challenges, policymakers cannot disregard hard power.
zh: 事實上，在一箇舊威脅未去新挑戰又來的不可預知的世界，決策者絕不能忽視建設硬實力。

en: By deterring threats to national sovereignty, military power supports peace; and, in Brazil’s case, it underpins our country’s constructive role in the pursuit of global stability.
zh: 軍隊透過遏制對國家主權的威脅來保障和平。 以巴西為例，支撐其在全球穩定中發揮建設性作用的還是硬實力。

en: That role is more necessary than ever.
zh: 上述作用比以往任何時候都更有必要。

en: Over the past two decades, unilateral actions in disregard of the UN Security Council’s primary responsibility in matters of war and peace have led to greater uncertainty and instability.
zh: 過去的二十年來，單方面行動破壞了聯合國安理會在國際戰爭與和平領域的權威，導致動盪和不確定性加劇。

en: Likewise, little progress toward nuclear disarmament has been made, in disregard of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty.
zh: 《不擴散核武器條約》並未引起重視，核裁軍領域同樣進展甚微。

en: Brazil’s abundance of energy, food, water, and biodiversity increases its stake in a security environment characterized by rising competition for access to, or control of, natural resources.
zh: 巴西豐富的能源、食物、水資源和生物多樣性使其在對自然資源爭奪日趨白熱化的安全環境中愈加舉足輕重。

en: In order to meet the challenges of this complex reality, Brazil’s peaceful foreign policy must be supported by a robust defense policy.
zh: 為應對複雜現實的挑戰，巴西和平外交政策的背後必須有強大的國防政策支撐。

en: Brazil’s National Defense Strategy, updated in 2012, states that the modernization of the Armed Forces is intrinsically linked to national development.
zh: 2012年更新的巴西國防戰略 明確指出武裝部隊現代化與國家的發展具有內在的相關性。

en: Thus, it emphasizes the need to strengthen the domestic defense industry.
zh: 報告因此強調要加強國內國防工業。

en: In accordance with the Strategy, Brazil is enhancing its conventional deterrence capabilities, including by building a nuclear-propelled submarine as part of a naval program commensurate with its responsibilities in the South Atlantic.
zh: 巴西正按照該戰略要求加強自身的常規威懾能力，包括建造核潛艇，以使這部分海軍計劃與巴西在南大西洋的責任相稱。

en: Brazil coordinates closely on defense matters with its neighbors, both bilaterally and through Unasur’s South American Defense Council, which aims to promote confidence-building, transparency, a joint regional defense industry, and, most important, a common defense identity.
zh: 巴西透過雙邊及南美國家聯盟南美防務委員會在國防領域與鄰國展開密切合作，該委員會的宗旨是促進信任、透明度、聯合區域國防工業以及最重要的 — — 構建共同的國防身份。

en: One potential mechanism for advancing these objectives is a South American Defense College, now under consideration.
zh: 籌劃中的南美國防學院是推進上述目標的一個潛在機制。

en: South America is becoming a region where war is unthinkable – what the political scientist Karl Deutsch once called a “security community.”
zh: 戰爭在南美地區越來越不可想象 — — 這就是政治學家卡爾·多伊奇所謂的“安全社群 ” 。

en: Having visited every South American country in my tenure as Defense Minister, I am convinced that, the most effective deterrent on the continent is cooperation.
zh: 任職國防部長期間訪問南美各國令我堅信合作是該地區最有效的威懾手段。

en: At the same time, Brazil is pursuing increased bilateral defense cooperation with African partners.
zh: 同時，巴西正在尋求與非洲夥伴加強雙邊防務合作。

en: With our neighbors on both shores of the South Atlantic, Brazil is working closely to strengthen the Zone of Peace and Cooperation of the South Atlantic (ZPCSA), which aims to keep the ocean free from rivalries foreign to it and from nuclear weapons.
zh: 巴西正與遍佈南大西洋兩岸的鄰國密切合作為保護海洋避免對抗及核武器而加強南大西洋和平合作區（ZPCSA）的建設。

en: Brazil is also reaching out to other emerging countries, such as its fellow BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) and members of the IBSA Dialogue Forum (India, Brazil, and South Africa).
zh: 巴西也正爭取其他新興國家，比方說金磚四國（巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國和南非）其他國家和IBSA對話論壇（印度、巴西和南非）成員國的合作。

en: For example, Brazil conducts IBSAMAR, a regular trilateral naval exercise, with South Africa and India.
zh: 舉例來講，巴西與南非和印度定期舉行IBSAMAR三邊海軍演習。

en: More broadly, we are exploring ways to cooperate in the joint development of defense technologies.
zh: 更廣義地講，我們正在就國防科技研究的合作方式進行探索。

en: Through such endeavors, Brazil hopes to contribute to a more balanced international order, one less subject to hegemonies of any kind, without losing sight of the importance of mutually beneficial partnerships with developed countries.
zh: 巴西希望能夠透過上述努力在重視與發達國家互利夥伴關係重要性的基礎上，為建設免受霸權干擾的平衡國際秩序貢獻自己的力量。

en: Even as Brazil hardens its soft power, it remains deeply committed to the path of dialogue, conflict prevention, and the negotiated settlement of disputes.
zh: 即使在巴西硬化軟實力的過程中，它仍然堅定致力於透過對話預防衝突和談判解決爭端的道路。

en: The presence of Brazilian peacekeepers in countries like Haiti and Lebanon underscores Brazil’s contribution to maintaining peace and security worldwide.
zh: 巴西向海地和黎巴嫩等國派駐維和部隊凸顯了巴西為維護世界和平及安全所做的努力。

en: In the twenty-first century, a truly stable global order will depend on a legitimate and effective UN Security Council, one that reflects the plurality of the emerging multipolar world.
zh: 巴西還堅信二十一世紀真正穩定的全球秩序將取決於能否建設反應多元化新興多極世界的合法有效的聯合國安理會。

en: China Grows Down
zh: 減速增長再創改革紅利

en: HONG KONG – For more than three decades, China’s GDP has grown by an average of more than 10% annually.
zh: 香港 — — 三十多年來，中國以超過10%的GDP增長率快速發展。

en: But former Premier Wen Jiabao rightly described this impressive growth performance as “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable,” highlighting the many economic, social, and environmental costs and challenges that have accompanied it.
zh: 然而，在這令人讚歎的經濟增長成績背後，隨之而來的是諸多經濟、社會、環境成本和挑戰，正如前總理溫家寶準確的描述 — — “不穩定、不平衡、不協調、不可持續 ” 。

en: Now China must choose between the export-based, investment-driven growth model of the past and a new, more viable economic order.
zh: 現在，中國必須做出選擇：以出口投資為驅動的舊的經濟增長模式，還是可持續的經濟增長新秩序。

en: Cheap credit and perverse incentives – such as promotions for officials who contribute most to GDP growth – have led to massive but redundant investment, which, in turn, has contributed to excess capacity in manufacturing and infrastructure.
zh: 廉價信貸和錯誤的激勵機制（例如提拔對GDP增長貢獻最大的官員等）引發大規模的重複投資，進而導致製造業和基礎設施行業的產能過剩。

en: This model is not only inefficient; channeling government resources to support investment also undermines China’s social development.
zh: 這種模式不僅效率低下，還引導政府資源流向阻礙中國社會發展的無效投資。

en: Given this, China’s leaders have decided to stop using GDP growth as the primary criterion for evaluating officials’ performance.
zh: 有鑑於此，中國領導人已決定停止將GDP增長作為評價官員政績的主要標準。

en: Indeed, the 12th Five-Year Plan, which extends until 2015, aims to shift China’s economy to a new, more sustainable growth model based on quality and innovation, and accepts that annual GDP growth will likely fall to 7% during the transition.
zh: 實際上，將於2015年結束的“十二五”規劃旨在實現中國經濟向以質量和創新為基礎的可持續的新增長模式轉型，並接受在轉型期間GDP增長率降至7%的可能性。

en: Most discussion of growth models nowadays is based on work by the Nobel laureate Robert Solow.
zh: 時下大多關於增長模式的討論都基於諾貝爾經濟學獎得主羅伯特·索洛的理論。

en: For Solow, GDP growth is determined by the factor inputs of land, labor, and capital, together with the economy’s total factor productivity (TFP, or the change in output not accounted for by changes in the volume of inputs, but by factors like technological innovation and institutional reform).
zh: 在索洛看來，GDP增長率由土地、勞動力、資本等投入要素和全要素生產率共同決定。 全要素生產率（TFP）指不是因為投入量的變化、而是由於技術創新和制度改革所導致的產出變化。

en: Since 1978, China, by implementing major reforms, has achieved three periods of high TFP growth, each lasting 5-7 years.
zh: 1978年以來，透過推進重大改革，中國已經實現了三階段的全要素生產率高速增長期（每階段5-7年 ） 。

en: First, in the early 1980’s, following the introduction of the rural household-responsibility system, which boosted agricultural productivity and released a large amount of unskilled labor to work in the higher-productivity urban and industrial sectors, annual TFP growth accelerated to 3-4%.
zh: 第一階段是在20世紀80年代初引入農村家庭聯產承包責任制，成功促進了農業生產率的提高，並將大批非技術工人釋放到生產率較高的城市和工業部門工作， 全要素生產率年增長率也因此增至3-4 % 。

en: The second such period followed Deng Xiaoping’s southern tour in 1992, during which he emphasized the need to shift to a market-based – albeit state-controlled – system by opening China’s economy to foreign direct investment and establishing special economic zones to help develop export-oriented industries.
zh: 第二個快速增長期出現在1992年鄧小平南巡講話後，他在講話中強調中國經濟需要向外商直接投資開放，並設立經濟特區發展出口導向型產業，實現向以市場為基礎的國家控制體制的過渡。

en: This time, TFP growth soared to 5-6%, partly owing to the “catching up” process facilitated by China’s adoption of foreign technology and know-how.
zh: 這一次，部分因為中國引進國外先進技術及成功實現專業知識的“追趕 ” ， 全要素生產率一舉飆升至5-6 % 。

en: Finally, after major reforms of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and the tax system, China acceded to the World Trade Organization in 2001. With the country fully integrated into global supply chains, TFP growth hit 4%, where it remained until 2007.
zh: 最後，在對國有企業和稅收制度進行重大改革後，中國於2001年加入了世貿組織，促使中國徹底融入全球供應鏈，全要素生產率增速達到4 % ， 並且一直延續到2007年。

en: Since then, however, the TFP growth rate has fallen by almost half.
zh: 但是從那以後，全要素生產率增長速度已經下降了近一半左右。

en: Indeed, China’s economy has experienced a significant – and ongoing – growth slowdown in the wake of the global economic crisis that erupted five years ago.
zh: 事實上，自五年前全球經濟危機爆發以來，中國經濟增長就已經持續顯著放緩。

en: By 2012, human capital’s contribution to China’s GDP growth fell almost to zero, with fixed-capital accumulation accounting for roughly 60% of total growth.
zh: 截至2012年，人力資本對中國GDP的貢獻降至幾乎為零，而固定資本積累則佔增長總額的約60 % 。

en: Large-scale, debt-funded capital investments have raised the country’s credit/GDP ratio to nearly 200%, increasing the financial system’s vulnerability – a development reflected in the recent spike in interbank interest rates.
zh: 大規模債務融資將中國信貸佔GDP的比率提高到近200 % ， 凸顯出金融系統的脆弱性 — — 不久前的銀行同業拆借利率飆升就反映了這一點。

en: In order to achieve more balanced and sustainable GDP growth, China’s leaders must implement a set of deep, comprehensive, and long-lasting institutional reforms aimed at boosting TFP.
zh: 為了實現平衡、可持續的GDP增長，中國領導人必須全面落實旨在提高全要素生產率的深入長效制度改革措施。

en: In particular, the reforms should be designed to facilitate China’s transition from its traditional supply-based growth model, which assumes that building hard infrastructure leads automatically to demand growth.
zh: 改革應著力促進中國經濟增長模式轉型。 以發展基礎設施建設而達到擴大需求的傳統供應型增長模式，顯然已不適應當前的經濟形勢。

en: In fact, GDP growth may be slowing precisely because existing investment in manufacturing and infrastructure, undertaken largely by local governments and SOEs, does not match the pattern of domestic demand.
zh: 事實上，GDP增長放緩或許恰恰因為當前基本由地方政府和國有企業主導的製造業和基礎設施投資並不符合國內實際需求。

en: As a result, China now faces the problem of short-term excess capacity.
zh: 中國也因此面臨短期產能過剩的問題。

en: Improving the quality of GDP growth will depend on Chinese leaders’ willingness to enact market-oriented reforms.
zh: 能否改善GDP增長質量取決於中國領導人是否願意制定以市場為導向的改革措施。

en: Rather than directly driving investment, the state must emphasize its regulatory and enforcement functions, including setting and overseeing standards, building an effective property-rights infrastructure, and managing macroeconomic conditions.
zh: 政府必須強調自身的監管和執法職能，包括制定及監督標準，建立有效的產權基礎設施及管理宏觀經濟環境，而不是直接拉動投資。

en: At the same time, the state must improve the quality and delivery of education, health care, and security, while minimizing corruption and administrative abuses.
zh: 與此同時，政府應提高教育、醫療及社保的質量，並儘可能抑制腐敗和行政權力濫用。

en: In short, China must shift its focus from meeting GDP growth targets to creating an environment that fosters innovation and competition, thereby enabling market forces to set prices and allocate resources more effectively.
zh: 總之，中國必須將重點從實現GDP增長目標轉向營造促進創新與競爭的環境，從而允許市場制定價格並提高資源分配效率。

en: The state would thus become an intermediary agent, facilitating the development of a sustainable economic order in which less is more – that is, a system in which less intervention creates more opportunities for creativity.
zh: 政府進而轉變為促進可持續經濟秩序發展的中介力量， 以更少的干預換取更多的創新機會。

en: SOEs undoubtedly played an important role in China’s previous growth model, delivering the infrastructure and services that were deemed necessary for the global manufacturing supply chain to function.
zh: 毋庸置疑，國有企業在中國過去的增長模式中發揮了重要作用， 提供了全球製造業供應鏈運轉不可或缺的基礎設施和服務。

en: But access to cheap credit from state-controlled banks creates an incentive for SOEs to generate surplus capacity, which increases systemic risk in the economy.
zh: 但國有銀行的廉價信貸卻激勵國有企業積累過剩產能，導致經濟系統性風險增加。

en: To correct China’s excess-capacity problem would require the relevant enterprises, whether SOEs or private firms, to exit the market.
zh: 要想糾正中國的產能過剩問題，就必須讓相關低效企業退出市場，不論是國有企業還是民營企業。

en: Unless China’s leaders implement major structural reforms aimed at establishing a market-based growth model, they will be unable to avoid the “middle-income trap” that has prevented so many developing economies from attaining advanced-country status.
zh: 中國領導人需要推行重大結構性改革來建立以市場為基礎的經濟增長模式，好讓中國避開“中等收入陷阱 ” — —正是這一陷阱導致許多發展中經濟體無法進入發達國家行列。

en: The deceleration in GDP growth that such reforms would cause would be more than offset by increased market dynamism and overall economic stability.
zh: 中國需要用上述結構性改革帶來的改革紅利，包括市場活力和整體經濟穩定性增長，來抵消GDP增速放緩的改革成本。

en: Tracking Big Pharma’s Progress on AMR
zh: 追蹤大型製藥企業在抗菌素耐藥性方面的進展

en: LONDON – This week, at the World Economic Forum’s annual meeting in Davos, the Access to Medicine Foundation (AMF) is launching an antimicrobial resistance (AMR) benchmark to “track how pharmaceutical companies are responding to the increase in drug-resistance.”
zh: 倫敦 — — 本週，在達沃斯召開的世界經濟論壇年會上，藥品獲取基金會（AMF）正在制定一套抗菌素耐藥性標準，以“跟蹤製藥企業如何應對耐藥性的增加。

en: The benchmark builds on recommendations made in the May 2016 final report of the British government’s Review on Antimicrobial Resistance, which I chaired, and on the important work being done by Chatham House, Drive-AB, the Global Union for Antibiotic Research and Development, the Pew Trusts, and the World Health Organization.
zh: ”制定這套標準的基礎是2016年5月由我本人主持的英國政府抗菌素耐藥性最終評估報告所提出的建議，以及由查塔姆研究所、 Drive-AB、全球抗菌藥物研發聯盟、皮尤信託和世界衛生組織等機構所取得的重要成果。

en: For the past ten years, the AMF, which is independent of the pharmaceutical industry, has published a highly regarded Access to Medicine Index, making it uniquely suited to quantify how various companies measure up in the fight against AMR.
zh: 過去十年來，獨立於醫藥行業的藥品獲取基金會已經發布了一份備受推崇的藥品獲取指數，該指數特別適合量化各家企業在針對抗菌素耐藥性鬥爭中所完成的工作。

en: In my view, the new benchmark will have many benefits, not least for equity analysts who might consider adjusting their stock recommendations on the basis of the AMF’s findings.
zh: 在我看來，新基準的制定將帶來諸多好處，尤其是股票分析師，他們可以考慮根據藥品獲取基金會的研究成果來調整他們所推薦的股票。

en: During our Review, I learned that many in the investment community were not interested in pharmaceutical companies’ behavior on this issue, because there were no readily available data by which to make comparisons.
zh: 在評估過程中，我發現因為沒有現成的資料可以進行比較，許多投資者並不瞭解製藥企業在這方面所做的工作。

en: Well, now there are.
zh: 那麼，現在有了。

en: As I have written previously, the Review issued Ten Commandments for confronting the AMR threat.
zh: 我之前曾經寫道，評估報告發布了十條戒律，用於應對抗菌素耐藥性方面的危險因素。

en: While the AMF’s benchmark isn’t designed to address all ten, it does touch on the areas that are most relevant to the health-care industry.
zh: 儘管藥品獲取基金會制定的標準並不完全針對這十條戒律，但它確實觸及了那些與醫療保健行業關係最為密切的領域。

en: Two areas that would benefit from their own quantifiable benchmarks are diagnostics, to prevent antibiotics from being prescribed unnecessarily, and agriculture, where antibiotics are used excessively to promote livestock growth.
zh: 防止抗生素不必要使用的診斷和過度使用抗生素促進牲畜生長的農業是能夠受惠於自身可量化基準的兩大領域。

en: Ultimately, microbes will build a resistance to any new drugs that we create, so we also need to seek ways to reduce overall demand for antibiotics.
zh: 最終，微生物會對我們創造的任何新型藥物產生抗體，因此我們也必須想方設法減少對抗生素的總體需求。

en: For its part, the AFM will calculate its benchmark separately for the eight major pharmaceutical companies that currently appear to be working on replacement drugs, generic producers, and firms focused solely on research and development.
zh: 就藥品獲取基金會而言，它將針對目前似乎正在從事替代藥、仿製藥生產和專注研發工作的八大藥企分別展開基準運算工作。

en: The fact that only eight “Big Pharma” firms are even attempting to develop new antibiotics and vaccines is a cause for serious concern.
zh: 僅有“八家大型藥企”試圖研發新抗生素和疫苗的現實是引發人們嚴重關切的一個原因。

en: As the Review concluded, failure to create effective new drugs could result in ten million people dying from AMR-related diseases every year by 2050, at a cost of some $100 trillion.
zh: 評估結論指出，如果研製不出有效的新藥，到2050年可能導致上千萬人死於與抗菌素耐藥性相關的疾病，並造成高達一百萬億美元的損失。

en: One of the more radical ideas we discussed during the Review concerned financial “pull” incentives to reward firms that successfully develop new drugs.
zh: 我們在評估中探討的一個比較激進的觀點是對成功研發新藥的企業採用財務獎勵“拉動 ” 。

en: We determined that an effective market-entry reward could be funded by small levies on the sales of the other top-50 pharmaceutical firms that are not carrying their weight.
zh: 我們認為可以透過對其他前50家藥企銷售額小額徵稅的方式設立有效的市場準入獎勵，因為這其他50家製藥企業並沒有承擔他們應盡的義務。

en: The new benchmark’s overall score for a firm can be broken down into three separate categories: its commitment to research and development for new drugs; its manufacturing, production, and environmental standards; and its marketing and distribution practices, which should focus on ensuring access rather than excess.
zh: 新基準對企業的總體評分可以分為三類：新藥研發的力度；製造、生產和環境標準；以及具體的營銷和分銷操作，重點應當放在確保藥物推廣而非過度濫用。

en: Of the eight Big Pharma firms that are included, the British company GlaxoSmithKline currently scores the highest.
zh: 在八家正在進行研發的大型製藥企業中，英國的葛蘭素史克公司目前的得分最高。

en: For those of us who conducted the Review, this is no surprise.
zh: 對於我們這些實際進行評估的人來說，這並不是什麼意外的結果。

en: Frankly, we would not classify all eight firms as being truly committed to the cause, but at least with the benchmark, they can now see clearly how they can improve.
zh: 坦率的講，我們並不認為所有八家公司都真正致力於這項事業，但現在在基準的引導下，他們至少可以清楚地看到自己的不足。

en: Moreover, one hopes the benchmark will prod into action all of the firms that have not even bothered to join the fight against AMR.
zh: 此外，人們希望這項標準能夠刺激那些甚至從未費心加入抗菌素耐藥性鬥爭的企業。

en: It is worth remembering that at the World Economic Forum’s annual meeting in January 2016, more than 80 companies signed a declaration promising to work toward solutions.
zh: 值得一提的是，在2016年1月舉行的世界經濟論壇年會上，超過80家企業簽署了一份承諾尋求解決方案的宣告。

en: And yet more than 70 of those firms do not appear on the AMF’s new index.
zh: 而其中有70多家公司甚至從未登上藥品獲取基金會的新指數名單。

en: Talk is cheap; these companies need to put their money where their mouth is.
zh: 空口白話非常廉價；這些企業應當在他們承諾的領域投入資金。

en: As for generic producers, the AMF’s scoring of pollution could prove most important, given that many of these companies operate in developing countries where environmental degradation is a major concern.
zh: 對通用生產商來說，鑑於多數企業都在以環境惡化為主要問題的發展中國家開展經營活動，最重要的可能是藥品獲取基金會的汙染評分。

en: Policymakers and business leaders in these countries will want to pay attention to how their generic drug producers score, so that they can make improvements.
zh: 這些國家的決策者和商界領袖應當關注通用製藥企業的得分狀況，以便督促他們進行改進。

en: The benchmark’s third category concerns biotech firms, which conduct research into drugs that can combat the “priority pathogens” identified by the WHO.
zh: 第三類基準涉及生物技術企業，它們在世衛組織確定的可以對抗“優先病原體”的藥物領域展開研究。

en: This category will be particularly helpful for financial analysts, or even for venture capitalists, given that specific advances could earn a future market-entry reward or have vast commercial potential.
zh: 因為具體進展可以獲得未來的市場準入獎勵或可能取得巨大的商業潛力，上述分類對金融分析師乃至風險投資家尤其管用。

en: And, of course, the new scoring will also be important to the companies themselves, and for policymakers who are trying to strike a balance between “pull” incentives and current priority-drug needs.
zh: 當然，新評分標準不僅對企業本身、而且對試圖在“拉動”機制和目前的優先藥物需求間達成平衡的決策者也非常重要。

en: It would be great to see similar benchmarks for the major food producers and makers of diagnostics.
zh: 為主要食品生產企業和診斷企業制定類似的基準也是很大的進步。

en: Indeed, I have long believed that diagnostics could be the single biggest game changer in the fight against AMR.
zh: 事實上，我一直認為診斷領域可能成為抗菌素耐藥性鬥爭中唯一也是最大的變革因素。

en: But for now, let us hope the pharmaceutical benchmark gets the attention it deserves.
zh: 但現在，讓我們希望製藥基準能夠獲得應有的關注。

en: How to Fight Antimicrobial Resistance
zh: 如何遏制抗生素耐藥性

en: ZURICH – Two weeks ago, G20 leaders committed to working together to address one of the world’s most pressing and perplexing security threats: antimicrobial resistance (AMR) – a fierce and evolving adversary against which conventional therapeutic weapons are of no use.
zh: 蘇黎世—兩週前，G20領導人承諾要合作解決全世界最緊迫的問題和最麻煩的社會威脅之一 — — 抗生素耐藥性（AMR ） ， 這是一個來勢洶洶又不斷變化的大敵，常規治療手段對此束手無策。

en: The threat is straightforward: bacteria and other microbes are becoming resistant to available medicines faster than new medicines are being developed.
zh: 威脅是直接的：細菌和其他微生物對現有藥物產生耐藥性的速度快於新藥的研發速度。

en: Every year, drug-resistant microbes kill about 700,000 people worldwide – more than three times the annual death toll from armed conflicts.
zh: 每一年，耐藥微生物都會殺死全球700,000人 — — 比每年死於 武裝衝突的人數多兩倍多。

en: In 2016, a special panel commissioned by the British government predicted that, by 2050, as many as ten million more people will die from drug-resistant microbes every year.
zh: 2016年，英國政府組成的一個特別委員會預測，到2050年，每年將有多達一千萬人以上死於耐藥微生物。

en: AMR now poses a clear and present danger to every person on the planet.
zh: 如今，AMR對地球上的每個人都是明確的威脅。

en: Unless we confront it head-on, we could return to a world in which it is common for people to die from basic infections.
zh: 除非我們直面這個問題，否則世界可能回到普通感染就能置人於死地的時代。

en: Beyond the cost in human lives, AMR could devastate the world’s economies.
zh: 除了人的生命的損失，AMR也破壞了世界經濟。

en: In Europe alone, the annual health-care costs and productivity losses associated with AMR already total an estimated €1.5 billion ($1.7 billion).
zh: 光是在歐洲，每年與AMR有關的醫療成本和生產率損失預計可達15億歐元。

en: The G20, for its part, has taken an important step forward.
zh: G20邁出了非常重要的一步。

en: Each G20 country has promised to start implementing national plans to fight AMR in earnest, and to do more to promote new treatments against resistant microbes.
zh: G20各國都承諾開始堅決實施減輕AMR的國家計劃，並要增加投入推動解決耐藥微生物問題的新療法。

en: To that end, G20 leaders are calling for an international “R&D Collaboration Hub” to “maximize the impact of existing and new anti-microbial basic and clinical research initiatives.”
zh: 在這方面，G20領導人呼籲建立一個國際“研發合作樞紐 ” ， 以“實現現有和新抗生素基礎和臨床研究的效果最大化 ” 。

en: And they have promised to explore how market incentives can be used to encourage new research.
zh: 他們還承諾探索如何用市場激勵來推動新研究。

en: Beyond the G20, innovative public-private partnerships are emerging to deliver new treatments against drug-resistant killers such as tuberculosis.
zh: 除了G20，創新公私合作計劃也在為等結核病等耐藥殺手提供新療法。

en: And some governments have already started filling critical roles in the global response to AMR, by collecting data on the spread of resistant strains of E. coli, salmonella, and other common pathogens.
zh: 一些政府已經開始在遏制AMR的全球行動東起到關鍵作用，收集大腸桿菌、沙門氏菌和其他常見致病菌耐藥菌株蔓延的資料。

en: Now it is up to political leaders to follow through on their commitments.
zh: 現在，政治領導人也要拿出承諾來。

en: Because new treatments for multidrug-resistant microbes aren’t expected to generate much return on investment, it is incumbent upon governments to make research and development in this field more attractive to private companies, and, in order to stem the development of resistance, to ensure that new drugs are not overused.
zh: 由於多重耐藥微生物的新療法不可能產生很大的投資回報，因此，政府有義不容辭的責任讓這一領域的研究對私營公司更具吸引力，此外，為了阻止耐藥性的發展，還必須確保新藥不被濫用。

en: When traditional market mechanisms fail, instruments such as “transferable market exclusivities” can help, by allowing drug makers to transfer an antimicrobial medicine’s intellectual-property benefits to another drug.
zh: 當傳統市場機制失靈時 ， “ 可轉移的市場排他性”等工具可以起到幫助作用。 這一機制允許製藥公司將某種抗生素的智慧財產權轉移到另一種藥品身上。

en: In addition to policy innovations, more well-funded collaborations between governments and private institutions are needed.
zh: 除了政策創新，政府和私人機構之間還需要更多資金充裕的合作。

en: When private institutions enter into such collaborative efforts, they must be prepared to work outside of traditional boundaries, accept the challenges associated with complex public projects, and be willing to bring their skills, ideas, and experience to the table.
zh: 當私人機構加入這類合作計劃時，它們必須做好在傳統邊界之外工作的準備，接受複雜的公共專案帶來的挑戰，並願意拿出它們的技能、思想和經驗。

en: In responding to AMR, we can learn some valuable lessons from other global public-health efforts.
zh: 在應對AMR方面，我們可以從其他全球公共衛生計劃中汲取一些重要教訓。

en: Malaria, which is caused by a parasite transmitted by more than 100 species of Anopheles mosquito, is a leading cause of death in many parts of the world.
zh: 瘧疾是一種由寄生蟲引起的疾病，而能傳播這種寄生蟲的包括100多種安蚊。 瘧疾是世界上很多地區最主要的致死原因之一。

en: But now that many governments and private institutions have made fighting the disease a high priority, its death toll has been halved over the last 15 years.
zh: 但許多政府和私人機構都將消滅這種疾病列為工作重點，結果，瘧疾致死數量在過去15年裡減少了一半。

en: Still, the parasite that causes malaria is developing resistance to artemisinin, which forms the basis for the most effective treatment: artemisinin-based combination therapies.
zh: 但是，導致瘧疾的寄生蟲正在發展出青蒿素抗藥性，而青蒿素是最有效的瘧疾療法 — — 基於青蒿素的混合療法的基礎。

en: Artemisinin resistance first emerged in Cambodia just over a decade ago, and has since spread through Thailand, Laos, Vietnam, Myanmar, and China.
zh: 青蒿素耐藥性最早出現在十多年前的柬埔寨，隨後蔓延到泰國、寮國、越南、緬甸和中國。

en: It is now approaching India, and experts are sure that it will eventually reach Africa.
zh: 如今，它正在接近印度，專家確定它遲早將抵達非洲。

en: According to one recent study, if artemisinin resistance is allowed to spread, malaria will kill at least 116,000 more people every year.
zh: 根據一份最新研究，如果放任青蒿素耐藥性擴散，瘧疾每年至少要多殺死116,000人。

en: Unless new treatments become available, the tremendous progress that the world has made against malaria will have been tragically short-lived.
zh: 除非發明新的療法，否則，全世界所取得的針對瘧疾的巨大進步將十分短暫，這是一個悲劇。

en: Fortunately, those engaged in the global response to malaria recognize that just as parasites are adapting, so must we.
zh: 幸運的是，參與全球瘧疾應對的人員認識到，我們必須像寄生蟲一樣做出調整。

en: New efforts are underway to identify and minimize the spread of resistant malaria, while simultaneously developing new artemisinin-free treatments.
zh: 人們已經展開了新的行動，辨別和儘量降低耐藥性瘧疾的傳播，同時開發新的不使用青蒿素的療法。

en: For example, the Regional Artemisinin-Resistance Initiative is working to halt the spread of resistant malaria in the Mekong Delta region, by monitoring and sharing drug-resistance data and promoting proper use of antimalarial treatments.
zh: 比如，地區性青蒿素耐藥性計劃致力於阻止耐青蒿素瘧疾在湄公河三角洲地區的傳播。 該計劃監控和共享耐藥性資料，推廣抗瘧疾療法的合理使用。

en: So far, the initiative has secured €110 million through the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria, which is financed primarily by governments.
zh: 目前，該計劃已經從對抗艾滋病、結核病和瘧疾全球基金獲得1.10億歐元資金，主要出資者是政府。

en: Moreover, Novartis and the Medicines for Malaria Venture (with support from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation) are starting a new clinical trial next month to test KAF156, a molecule that could form the basis of a new treatment against artemisinin-resistant malaria strains.
zh: 此外，諾華集團和 瘧疾藥品公司（Medicines for Malaria Venture，在比爾和梅琳達·蓋茨基金會的幫助下）將於下個月開始新的臨床試驗，測試一種叫作KAF156的微粒，它有望成為耐青蒿素瘧疾菌株的新治療手段。

en: At the 2016 World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, 100 companies (including Novartis) and industry associations signed the Davos Declaration on AMR.
zh: 在2016年瑞士達沃斯世界經濟論壇上，100家公司（包括諾華集團）和行業協會簽署了《達沃斯AMR宣言 》 （ Davos Declaration on AMR ） 。

en: Under that commitment, we promised to work together with governments to slow the development of resistance, by increasing our investments in R&D and making high-quality antibiotics available to patients who need them.
zh: 在這個宣言中，我們承諾與政府合作，提高我們的研發投資，讓需要的患者能夠獲得高質量的抗生素，以此遏制耐藥性的發展。

en: The G20’s national action plans will, we hope, help us to meet these commitments.
zh: 我們希望，G20的國家計劃能夠有助於我們兌現這些承諾。

en: But political leaders, too, must marshal the will to turn words into action.
zh: 但政治領導人也應該用行動來證明言辭。

en: We urgently need more resources to monitor resistance, stronger incentives for R&D, and innovative financing mechanisms to ensure widespread access to accurate diagnoses and quality medicines.
zh: 我們急需更多的耐藥性監控資源、更強的研發激勵，以及確保普及精準診斷和品質醫療的創新性融資機制。

en: The world cannot afford to lose the fight against AMR.
zh: 世界決不能輸掉與AMR的戰爭。

en: Winning it will require large-scale public-private cooperation, underpinned by political leadership that makes global public health a top priority.
zh: 贏得這場戰爭需要大規模公私合作，而其基礎，就是將全球公共衛生置於重中之重的全球領導力。

en: A Murder in Moscow
zh: 莫斯科的謀殺

en: It is time to end the fiction that Vladimir Putin’s “dictatorship of law” has made postcommunist Russia any less lawless.
zh: 現在是結束那種所謂普京的“獨裁法治”讓後共產主義的俄羅斯變得沒有那麼不守法律的謊言的時候了。

en: The murder of Anna Politkovskaya, one of Russia’s bravest and best journalists, a woman who dared to expose the brutal murders committed by Russian troops in Chechnya, is final proof that President Putin has delivered nothing more than a run of the mill dictatorship with the usual contempt for law.
zh: 波利特科夫卡婭是俄羅斯最勇敢和最好的記者之一，一個敢於揭露俄羅斯軍隊在車臣進行殘暴殺戮的女人被謀殺，是對普京總統除了以對法律慣有的蔑視而推行的、平庸的獨裁統治的新證明。

en: This recognition is a timely one for the world to make, particularly Europe.
zh: 世界尤其是歐洲應該及時認清這一事實。

en: Germany’s Foreign Ministry is preparing a policy on Russian/German relations that will enshrine indifference to Putin’s lawlessness as being in the national interest of the most powerful member of the European Union.
zh: 德國外交部正在擬定的一項針對德俄關係的政策將會把對普京的違反法律視而不見作為這個最大歐盟成員國的國家利益。

en: But indifference becomes appeasement when it encourages Putin to pursue his lawless ways in the international arena, as in his current campaign to strangle Georgia’s economy.
zh: 但是漠視從而導致鼓勵普京在國際舞臺上推行他違法的方式就變成了姑息遷就，就像他正在推行的試圖扼殺喬治亞經濟的運動。

en: The killing of Politkovskaya has incited an eerie sense of déjà vu: just as in the KGB’s heyday, people simply disappear in Putin’s Russia.
zh: 對波利特科夫卡婭的謀殺讓人產生了一種不安的似曾相識的感覺：這就像是那個克格勃猖獗的年代，在普京統治下的俄羅斯，人們不知不覺地消失了。

en: Politkovskaya’s is the third politically tinged killing in three weeks.
zh: 波利特科夫卡婭是三週以來第三起與政治有牽連的被謀殺者。

en: Enver Ziganshin, the chief engineer of BP Russia, was shot to death in Irkutsk on September 30.
zh: 俄羅斯英國石油公司總工程師吉甘辛9月30日被人在伊爾庫次克槍殺。

en: Andrei Kozlov, the deputy governor of Russia’s central bank who was leading a campaign against financial fraud, was assassinated on September 14.
zh: 正在領導一場針對金融詐騙的運動的俄羅斯中央銀行副總裁科茲洛夫9月14日被人刺殺。

en: The fact that Russia’s Prosecutor General Yuri Chaika, took over the investigation into Politkovskaya’s killing, as he did with the murder of Kozlov, doesn’t inspire hope, as such senior level involvement would in any real democracy.
zh: 俄羅斯總檢查長切卡將軍主持對於波利特科夫卡婭謀殺案的調查工作，就像他在科茲洛夫謀殺案中所做的那樣，並不能讓人們像在真正的民主國家中那樣對於這種有高層參與的行為會產生希望。

en: In fact, the involvement of the highest level of Russia’s government is almost a guarantee that the killers will never be found.
zh: 事實上，俄羅斯政府最高層的參與幾乎使人們可以肯定兇手永遠不會被找到。

en: Politkovskaya’s murder is a particularly grim augury when you consider that she was a powerful critic of Russia’s President.
zh: 如果你認識到波利特科夫卡婭是俄羅斯總統的一個強有力的批評者的話,那麼她的謀殺就顯得尤其是一個可怕的徵兆。

en: In her articles for one of the few remaining independent papers in Moscow, Novaya Gazeta, and in her books “Putin's Russia: Life in a Failing Democracy” and “A Dirty War: A Russian Reporter in Chechnya,” Politkovskaya wrote of the vanishing freedoms that are the signature characteristic of Putin’s presidency.
zh: 在她在莫斯科僅存的幾家為數不多的獨立報紙之一新報上所發表的文章，以及她的著作《普京的俄羅斯：民主正在消失的生活》和《一場骯髒的戰爭：一個在車臣的俄羅斯記者》中，波利特科夫卡婭描述了在普京總統的統治下鮮明的特徵，那就是自由喪失。

en: As shown by the exile of the former media tycoons Boris Berezovsky and Vladimir Gusinky, and the imprisonment of oil magnate Mikhail Khodorkovsky, three fates await Putin’s enemies: exile, imprisonment, or the grave.
zh: 就像前媒體大亨別列佐夫斯基和古辛基被驅逐和石油巨頭科多爾科夫斯基被監禁中所表明的，等待普京敵人的是三種結果：放逐、監禁或者是墳墓。

en: I am not accusing Putin’s government of the contract killing of Politkovskaya.
zh: 我並不是指責普京政府協約謀殺了波利特科夫卡婭。

en: After all, as a campaigning investigative journalist she made many people angry besides Putin, not least of which is the current Chechen Prime Minister, Ramzan Kadyrov, whom she accused of a policy of kidnapping for ransom.
zh: 不管怎樣，作為一個好鬥的新聞調查記者，除了普京之外她還有很多敵人，其中就包括車臣現總理卡德羅夫，她指責他推行的是綁架以換取贖金的策略。

en: But even if Vladimir Putin’s associates had nothing to do with Politkovskaya being gunned down in an elevator of her apartment building in the center of Moscow, his contempt for law created the climate in which the murder was carried out.
zh: 但是就算普京的同黨與波利特科夫卡婭 被人在她位於莫斯科市中心的公寓樓的電梯裡槍殺事件不相干，他對法律的蔑視也製造了使這場謀殺得以進行的氣候。

en: Like the murder of Archbishop Thomas Beckett in his Canterbury Cathedral many centuries ago, the crime was committed in the clear belief that it would please the king.
zh: 就像許多世紀以前大主教貝科特被人在坎特伯雷教堂裡殺害一樣，是因為兇手相信這將會取悅國王。

en: Given what Politkovskaya represented—the responsibility of a democratic press to question the Kremlin and its policies—the government should have made certain that nothing bad happened to her.
zh: 考慮到波利特科夫卡婭所代表東西，也就是民主的新聞質疑克里姆林宮及其政策的職責，政府本該確保在她不會遭遇不測。

en: Putin’s Russia has already lost 12 leading journalists to murder in the past six years.
zh: 普京的俄羅斯在過去六年中已經失去了12位著名的記者。

en: None of those crimes has been solved, which would not be the case if Putin’s “dictatorship of law” was anything more than a PR strategy.
zh: 這些案件都沒有被偵破，如果普京的“獨裁法治”比公關策略稍好一點的話就不會這樣。

en: The six year period since Vladimir Putin arrived in the Kremlin has been a time of deeply conflicting signals.
zh: 普京入主克里姆林宮的六年充滿了相互矛盾的訊號。

en: On one hand, the world sees a young, educated leader pledging to modernize Russia, particularly in terms of bringing its law enforcement and judicial practices into line with international norms.
zh: 一方面，世界看到了一位年輕、受過良好教育的領導人誓言要使俄羅斯走向現代化，尤其是在法制的實施和司法程式上要向國際標準看齊。

en: On the other, the president watches in silence while his ex-colleagues in Russia's FSB security service (the former KGB) provide no security to those murdered, and launch a series of notorious espionage cases against journalists, scientists, and environmental activists.
zh: 另一方面，當他在俄羅斯國家安全域性（前身是克格勃）的前同事們沒有為那些被謀殺的人提供安全，並且對記者、科學家和環保主義者發起一系列臭名昭著的間諜案時卻袖手旁觀。

en: These “neo-spies” include journalist Gregory Pasko, arms control expert Igor Sutyagin, diplomat Valentin Moiseyev, physicist Valentin Danilov, and others.
zh: 這些“新型間諜”包括記者帕斯克，武器控制專家蘇特亞琴，外交官莫伊塞葉夫，物理學家達尼洛夫等等。

en: The supposedly civilizing influence of being a Western partner — chairing a G-8 summit in Saint Petersburg for example — seems to have been lost on Putin’s Kremlin cabal.
zh: 預想中作為一個西方夥伴所能帶來的文明的影響力，比如在聖彼得堡主持八國峰會，似乎在普京的克里姆林宮陰謀集團中消失了。

en: Once again exposure to Western values has delivered another Potemkin Village; Russia presents a façade of laws and democratic institutions, but behind that cardboard surface the same arbitrary brutes rule.
zh: 暴露在西方的價值觀面前的是又一個華而不實的例子。 在俄羅斯法律和民主制度的表面��隱藏的同樣專橫的暴君統治。

en: The danger for the world is that Putin’s lawlessness is being exported.
zh: 世界所面臨的危險是普京的違法行為正在向外輸出。

en: Across Russia’s near abroad, a form of criminalized diplomacy is taking root.
zh: 在俄羅斯的周邊國家，一種犯罪的外交政策正在形成勢力。

en: Look at Putin’s attempt to rig Ukraine’s previous presidential election, and the on again off again criminal charges brought against the opposition leader Yuliya Tymoshenko.
zh: 看看普京企圖操縱烏克蘭上一次總統選舉的行為，對於反對黨領導人季莫申科一再的犯罪指控。

en: Look at the rogue breakaway regions in Moldova and Georgia that exist only because of the Kremlin’s backing.
zh: 看看摩爾多瓦和喬治亞那些鬧著要分裂的無賴地區，它們之所以存在正是有了克里姆林宮的支援。

en: Look at how the Kremlin seeks to blackmail its neighbors by threatening their energy supplies.
zh: 看看克里姆林宮是怎樣憑藉威脅停止對它們的能源供應來訛詐鄰邦的。

en: Every policeman knows that when you ignore criminal behavior, criminals grow bolder.
zh: 每一個警察都知道當你無視犯罪行為時，罪犯們就會變得更加猖獗。

en: It is past time for the world to recognize Vladimir Putin for what he is: a man who is taking Russia back into the shadows.
zh: 世界早就應該認識到普京是怎樣一個人了：他正把俄羅斯重新帶回黑暗中。

en: So the world must now ponder that old Latin maxim qui tacet consentere videtur – silence means consent – and ask itself if it is wise to quietly consent to Putin’s construction of a lawless energy superpower.
zh: 所以世界現在應該好好思考一下那句古拉丁格言“沉默意味著容忍 ” ， 並且想一下預設普京建立一個不守法律的能源超級大國是否是明智之舉。

en: An Accidental Cure for Iraq
zh: 意外的伊拉克藥方

en: Doctors use the word “crisis” to describe the point at which a patient either starts to recover or dies.
zh: 醫生經常用“危象”一詞來描述某一時段，在這一時段中，病人要麼開始康復，要麼死亡。

en: President George W. Bush’s Iraqi patient now seems to have reached that point.
zh: 布什總統的伊拉克病人現在看起來已經達到了這一點。

en: Most commentators appear to think that Bush’s latest prescription – a surge of 20,000 additional troops to suppress the militias in Baghdad – will, at best, merely postpone the inevitable death of his dream of a democratic Iraq.
zh: 大多數評論家似乎認為，布什的最新藥方，也就是大幅增兵20000人來鎮壓巴格達的民兵將最多隻是推遲建立民主的伊拉克的夢想不可避免的滅亡。

en: Yet as “Battle of Baghdad” begins, factors beyond Bush’s control and not of his making (at least not intentionally) may just save Iraq from its doom.
zh: 但是，超出布什控制範圍、並且不是他所為(至少不是有意的)的因素也許就會從末日中挽救伊拉克。

en: One key factor is that, for the first time since the United States and Britain invaded Iraq, Arab Sunni leaders are backing a US military plan for that country.
zh: 其中一個關鍵因素是，自從美國和英國入侵伊拉克以來，阿拉伯遜尼派領導人第一次支援美國在伊拉克的軍事計劃。

en: These Sunni leaders live in abject fear of the geopolitical earthquake that any disintegration of political authority in Baghdad would bring, believing that all-out civil war would invariably follow – a war that would not respect international borders.
zh: 這些遜尼派領導人生活在悲慘的恐懼之中，擔心巴格達政權的解體所會帶來的地緣政治地震。 他們相信，那將會不可避免地引發全面內戰，而這一內戰將不會尊重國際邊界線。

en: Of course, America has been encouraging Sunni leaders in this belief.
zh: 當然，美國一直在鼓勵遜尼派領導人相信這一觀點。

en: Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice’s recent tour of Middle East capitals helped spread the word to Egypt, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, and the Gulf states that any US failure and sudden withdrawal would be certain to destabilize them.
zh: 國務卿萊斯最近訪問中東各國首都，向埃及、約旦、沙特以及海灣國家傳話說，美國一旦失敗並且匆忙撤兵肯定將會破壞它們國家的穩定。

en: Given the fragile grip that these leaders have over their societies, America’s warnings have been taken to heart.
zh: 鑑於這些領導人對其社會控制微弱，美國的警告得到了重視。

en: But the truly curious factor that might bring success to Bush is that those who have opposed or resented America’s presence in Iraq, such as the Iranian-backed Shi’a parties now also appear to want Bush’s new strategy to succeed.
zh: 但是真正可能給布什帶來成功的奇怪因素是，那些先前反對或者仇恨美國在伊拉克存在的勢力，例如由伊朗支援的什葉派派別現在似乎想要布什的新戰略成功。

en: They are for it because they believe it will defang Moqtada al-Sadr, the rogue Shi’a cleric whose power has mushroomed over the past three years – to the point that he now dominates much of Baghdad and holds the allegiance of countless angry young Shi’a men.
zh: 它們支援這一新戰略是因為它將剪除什葉派流氓教士阿薩德的羽翼。 該人的勢力在過去三年中膨脹到可以掌控巴格達大部分地區並且擁有無以計數的、憤怒的什葉派年輕人的效忠。

en: Of course, attacking Moqtada al-Sadr’s Mahdi Army in the name of fighting militia death squads has the potential to draw American military forces into a level of urban warfare unseen since the Falluja assaults of 2004 and 2005.
zh: 當然，以同死亡行刑隊作戰的名義襲擊阿薩德的救世主軍有可能將美國的軍事力量拖入城市巷戰之中，其規模是自2004年和2005年法魯賈戰役以來最大的。

en: Al-Sadr is seen as the protector of the Shi’a of Iraq and has are an estimated 60,000 fighters in his militia.
zh: 阿薩德被認為是伊拉克什葉派的保護人，其民兵擁有大約60000名戰士。

en: But he is deeply mistrusted by other Shi’a leaders, who fear that they may one day have to take him on by themselves.
zh: 但是，其他什葉派領導人對其深切懷疑，他們害怕總有一天他們自己要對付此人。

en: Better to let the Americans do it, though of course these Shi’a leaders prefer a slow strangulation of al-Sadr to a direct and bloody assault.
zh: 還是讓美國人來幹掉他，當然，這些什葉派領導人更喜歡慢慢勒死阿薩德，而不是刺刀見紅。

en: But make no mistake: how al-Sadr is handled is the big test of Bush’s new strategy.
zh: 但是不要搞錯，那就是，如果處理阿薩德是對布什新戰略的考驗。

en: Should the US choose to face al-Sadr and his forces head on, they risk alienating Iraq’s largest sectarian community, the Shi’a, adding fuel to the anti-occupation resistance and thus probably dooming Bush to failure.
zh: 如果美國選擇與阿薩德及其勢力正面交火，那麼，他們就冒著與伊拉克最大的教派社群，即什葉派分道揚鑣的風險，從而給反佔領抵抗火上加油，也有可能讓布什徹底失敗。

en: Iran and Syria, which have played a spoiler role in Iraq up to now, may also now be anxious to find a way to pull the country back from the brink.
zh: 伊朗和敘利亞目前為止在伊拉克扮演了搗蛋的角色，現在它們也可能急於找到途徑把這個國家從懸崖邊上來回來。

en: Bush still refuses to talk to either of them, and has lately been having US troops arrest Iranian agents in Iraq.
zh: 布什依舊拒絕與它們中的任何一方談判，最近他還下令美國軍隊逮捕在伊拉克的伊朗間諜。

en: Yet Iran may already see itself as victorious, with the current Iraqi government friendlier than any the Iranians have ever known.
zh: 但是，鑑於目前的伊拉克政府比伊朗所知道的以往的任何前任政府都要友善，因此伊朗可能已經認為自己獲勝了。

en: So maintaining that government in office has now become a strategic priority for Iran, particularly as it is now clear that any US hopes of using Iraq as a permanent military base are dead.
zh: 所以，維持該政府執政是伊朗的一個戰略重點，特別是現在已經清除，美國的任何把伊拉克作為永久軍事基地的希望已經破滅。

en: The “surge” also opens, perhaps for the first time, a serious possibility of pouring water on the insurgent fires in Anbar province, the heartland of the Sunni insurgency.
zh: 美國的大幅增兵還有可能第一次確實撲滅安巴爾省，即遜尼派叛亂的中心地帶的叛亂之火。

en: The US has achieved relative successes in the province through alliances with Sunni tribes.
zh: 美國透過與遜尼派部落結盟已經在該省取得了相對的成功。

en: The hope is that such realistic and pragmatic accommodations will be extended to Iraqis who are fighting under the banner of a nationalist and anti-occupation agenda.
zh: 美國所希望的是，這種現實主義的安撫可以延伸到那些在民族主義和反對佔領的旗幟下作戰的伊拉克人。

en: So some of the stars have come into alignment for Bush.
zh: 所以，布什可能已經有了某些好運。

en: But to keep them there in the long term, the Iraqi government will need to amend the constitution in a way that appeases the Sunni community.
zh: 但是，要長久保持這些運氣，伊拉克政府就需要修改憲法來安撫遜尼派社群。

en: Reassuring Iraq’s Sunnis that they have a place in the new Iraq will also reassure neighboring Sunni governments, which have mostly turned a blind eye to the support for the insurgency that has come from their lands.
zh: 向遜尼派保證說他們將會在新的伊拉克佔有一席之地也會讓鄰近的遜尼派各國政府放心。 這些政府大多數都對從它們境內出發的叛亂支援視而不見。

en: Of course, should the US see failure ahead, it could seek to broaden the war beyond Iraq’s borders by attacking Iran, a policy reminiscent of “Operation Sideshow,” when US failure in Vietnam in the late 1960’s enticed President Nixon into attacking Cambodia and Laos.
zh: 當然，如果美國預見到了失敗，它就可能尋求把戰爭擴大到伊拉克境外來攻擊伊朗。 這一政策讓人回想起所謂的“餘興行動 ” ， 即六十年代末期美國在越南失利，引發尼克松總統下令攻擊柬埔寨和寮國。

en: But Iran has resources that Cambodia and Laos could never muster; indeed, its ability to retaliate could set the entire region ablaze.
zh: 但是，伊朗卻擁有柬埔寨和寮國所從來沒有掌握的資源；實際上，其報復的能力可以讓整個地區陷於火海之中。

en: Whereas America’s war in Indochina was a tragic mistake, the cost of a wider war precipitated by the crisis in Iraq would be incomparably greater – for both the patient and the doctor.
zh: 美國在印度支那的戰爭是一個悲劇性的災難，由伊拉克危機所促發的更大範圍的戰爭的代價對於病人和醫生而言都將會更為巨大，無可比擬。

en: An Agenda for Growth in Europe
zh: 有關歐洲增長的議程

en: A recent OECD study reminds us, once again, that per capita income levels are roughly 30% lower in the euro area, as well as in the three largest Continental countries – France, Germany, and Italy – that dominate its performance, than in the United States.
zh: 經合組織最近的一項研究提醒我們，歐元區以及統領歐元區經濟表現的歐洲大陸最大的三個國家法國、德國和義大利的人均收入水平低於美國大約30 ％ 。

en: That gap is likely to widen as Europe’s demographic profile darkens, and if productivity continues to grow more slowly than elsewhere in the industrial economies.
zh: 隨著歐洲人口構成惡化，而且如果生產效率與工業化經濟體的其他地方相比繼續更為緩慢地增長，這一差距有可能擴大。

en: Why have the large European economies failed to catch up with US income levels?
zh: 歐洲經濟大國為何沒有趕上美國的收入水平？

en: The bulk of the shortfall is due to less intensive use of labor: employment rates for women and for the oldest and youngest age groups are lower in the euro area than in the US, working hours are far fewer, and, least significantly, unemployment rates are higher.
zh: 差距主要是由於勞動力使用不夠密集。 歐元區婦女、最大以及最年輕年齡組的就業率要低於美國，工作時間更少，而且更為重要的是，失業率更高。

en: Some take consolation from this, viewing it as positive that Europeans prefer leisure to work.
zh: 有些人從中得到慰藉，認為歐洲人相比工作更喜歡休閒是積極的。

en: But low levels of labor utilization are largely due to heavier income taxes and social security contributions, as well as high social benefit levels introduced at a time when the labor force was growing rapidly and the need to replace involuntary with voluntary unemployment seemed more urgent than today.
zh: 但是，更低水平的勞動力使用主要是由於更高的稅負以及繳納更多的社會保險金，也是由於很高的社會福利水平。 這種高社會福利水平是在勞動力增長迅速、用主動失業替換被動失業的需求比當今更為迫切的時期建立的。

en: These measures will need to be revisited both to increase the supply of labor and to make public finances more sustainable.
zh: 應當重新審視這些措施來提高勞動力的供應以及讓公共財政更為可以持久。

en: This process is already underway, particularly in Italy and France, through cuts in social security contributions for lower-paid workers, tighter conditions for drawing unemployment benefits, and tax credits for “the working poor.”
zh: 這一程序已經開始，特別是在義大利和法國。 這一程序透過為低工資工人降低社會保險金、更為嚴格的提取失業福利條件以及為“工薪窮人”提供稅收抵免實現。

en: Since the mid-1990’s, the relative decline in employment in these countries has, indeed, been slightly reversed.
zh: 從二十世紀九十年代以來，這些國家的相對就業率下降確實有所扭轉。

en: But factors beyond taxes and benefits also contribute to low employment rates in all the three major euro-zone economies: high minimum wages and some features of employment protection legislation slow down the flow of workers through the job market.
zh: 但是，稅收以及福利以外的原因也造成歐元區經濟體的三大國的低就業率，也就是較高的最低工資以及就業保護法律的某些特徵減緩了工人透過就業市場的流動。

en: Although a long agenda of reforms is beginning to be tackled, first in Germany and, more recently and cautiously, in France, the results are slow in coming and public understanding of the need for change remains limited.
zh: 儘管首先在德國、最近更為謹慎地在法國正在開始處理一長串改革議程，但是成效遲緩，公眾對有必要改革的理解也有限。

en: Much can be learned from each country’s experience and from that of smaller EU member states, but labor market reforms inevitably have a strong national flavor.
zh: 可以從每個國家的經歷以及歐盟小國中得出經驗，但是，勞動力市場的改革不可避免地更有國家特色。

en: Employment objectives have been formulated for all EU member states since 1997 in the so-called European Employment Strategy (EES), now part of the “Lisbon Agenda,” the set of goals established to boost EU productivity.
zh: 1997年制定“里斯本議程”中的歐洲就業戰略以來，已經為歐盟的所有國家確定了就業目標。 “里斯本議程”為提高歐洲的生產效率確立了一整套目標。

en: But, with the policy instruments for achieving these goals largely national and the arguments for applying them simultaneously in several member states weak, the EES has created unrealistic public expectations and triggered only limited action by governments.
zh: 但是，由於實現這些目標的政策手段主要集中在各國，而且在數個成員國同時實施這些政策手段的主張微弱，歐洲就業戰略已經造成了不切實際的期望。 而各國政府的行動有限。

en: Nor is the employment gap with the US the only problem for Europe.
zh: 與美國之間的就業差距並非歐洲的唯一問題。

en: Beginning in the mid-1990’s, the rate of growth in output per hour worked – a key factor behind the rise in per capita income – slowed in most European countries while it rose in the US, reversing a decades-long pattern.
zh: 每工作小時產量的增長率是人均收入增長的主要因素。 從九十年代中期開始，這一增長率在歐洲大多數國家都有所減緩，而美國則上升，從而逆轉了長達十年的模式。

en: Between 2000 and 2004, hourly labor productivity rose more than twice as fast in the US than in the large euro zone economies – 2.8% per year versus little more than 1%.
zh: 2000年至2004年之間，美國的每小時勞動生產率每年增長2.8 ％ ， 歐元區經濟體略高於1 ％ 。 美國的速度要比歐元區快大於兩倍。

en: So why have the Europeans been unable to sustain improvements in both foundations of growth – employment and productivity – at the same time?
zh: 那麼，為何歐洲無法同時在增長的兩大基礎、也就是就業和生產效率上維持增長呢？

en: This proved possible not only in the US, but also in other advanced economies outside Europe – Australia, Canada, and New Zealand – and, unsurprisingly, in the new EU member states.
zh: 這一點不僅在美國是可能的，而且在歐洲以外的其他發達經濟體，例如澳大利亞、加拿大、紐西蘭以及令人驚訝的歐盟新成員國中都是可能的。

en: The explanation is not capital spending, which is normally linked to productivity growth.
zh: 花費的資本通常與生產效率掛鉤，但是並不能以此來解釋。

en: There have been no major differences between the US and the large euro zone economies here.
zh: 這樣就只能用全要素生產率來解釋了。

en: This leaves the “explanation” to what economists call Total Factor Productivity (TFP), a mix of several important elements, including innovation activity, a well-functioning financial system ready and willing to take risks, and organizational flexibility that facilitates rapid diffusion of new technologies.
zh: 所謂全要素生產率，就是幾項重要因素的綜合，包括創新活動、運轉良好的金融體系準備而且願意承擔風險，以及促進新技術快速傳播的組織靈活性。

en: The main lapse in TFP growth in Europe over the past decade has been in services (excluding information and communications technologies).
zh: 歐洲過去十年中全要素生產率增長主要落後於服務業（不包括資訊以及通訊技術 ） 。

en: So deregulation and integration of services will be essential if the Euro area’s TFP is to improve, as more than two-thirds of total income in most EU economies is generated in this sector.
zh: 所以，歐元區的全要素生產率如果想要改善，解除服務領域管制並且加以聯合將是至關重要的，這是因為大多數歐盟國家經濟體總收入的三分之二是在這一領域創造的。

en: While product markets have held center stage in the creation of the single European market, services continue to be fragmented by national regulatory, anti-competitive practices.
zh: 儘管產品市場在建立歐洲單一市場中佔據中心地位，但是服務業繼續由於各國的管制以及反競爭的做法而條塊分割。

en: Much of the explanation lies in the very heterogeneity of services and the greater difficulties that mutual recognition, or the “country-of-origin principle” – essential in the integration of product markets – implies for services.
zh: 主要解釋在於服務業的多樣性，以及相互承認、或者叫做“原產國原則”對服務業的影響，而“原產國原則”在產品市場的聯合中至關重要。

en: Unfortunately, reform was derailed in 2005.
zh: 不幸的是，2005年改革受阻。

en: During the referendum campaign in France preceding the vote on the draft EU Constitutional Treaty, the proposed directive was vilified as undermining the rights of labor, symbolized by that dreaded bogeyman, the “Polish plumber.”
zh: 法國歐盟憲法草案全民公決前的運動中，歐盟建議的有關服務業的指令被誣衊為破壞勞動者權利，而這一指控透過“波蘭管道工”嚇人的形象體現出來。

en: These attacks overlooked the fact that the directive makes employment conditions of workers from other EU-member states subject in most respects to host-country rules.
zh: 這些攻擊忽視了這一事實，也就是這一歐盟指令在大多數情況下將從歐盟其他成員國來的工人的就業條件遵從於東道國的規則。

en: A revised version of the directive that reduces its sectoral scope and makes a number of compromises with the country-of-origin principle is now before the European Parliament.
zh: 現在，這一指令的修正版現在提交給了歐洲議會。 這一版本減少了行業範圍並在原產國原則上進行了幾項妥協。

en: Even this limited version would constitute progress; most of the gains arise from removing the red tape that complicates cross-border establishment of small and medium-size service enterprises and limits competition in broad sectors of the economy.
zh: 但是即使是這一個有限的版本取得進展，大多數進展還是來自於取消造成跨國界建立中小服務企業困難以及在經濟中的廣泛領域限制競爭的繁文縟節。

en: It is a sad reflection on the state of the EU that it seems unable to agree on the one clear productivity-advancing piece of legislation when improving productivity is held out as a shared goal.
zh: 儘管改善生產率被稱為歐盟的共同目標，但是，它仍舊無法在一項明顯提高生產率的法律上達成一致。 這難免不是歐盟處境的悲慘之處。

en: The failure to mobilize consumer interests in favor of European integration is particularly disappointing for the new member states, which had expected to reap some of the benefits.
zh: 歐盟新成員國打算從動員消費者對歐洲聯合的興趣來獲得利益。 但是，無法做到這一點對於他們來說特別令人失望。

en: An Alliance of Civilizations?
zh: 文明聯盟

en: MADRID – The first International Forum of the Alliance of Civilizations, conceived as an antidote to the idea that the world is doomed to a “clash of civilizations,” recently met in Madrid and revealed that there is more than a grain of truth in Robert Kagan’s idea that Americans are from Mars and Europeans from Venus.
zh: 馬德里-被認為針對社會註定要產生“文明衝突”的觀念的解毒藥的首個文明聯盟國際論壇最近在馬德里召開，揭示出羅伯特·卡根關於美國人來自火星，而歐洲人來自金星的說法其實是很有道理的。

en: Ever since September 11, 2001, the United States has been engaged in a crusade against the forces of evil in the Muslim world.
zh: 自從2001年9月11日以後，美國就一直在針對穆斯林社會的邪惡勢力進行一場十字軍運動。

en: By contrast, the March 11, 2004, terrorist attack on Spain, which left 200 dead, triggered an “anti-crusade” that seeks to disarm extremism by building bridges of understanding and reconciliation with Islam.
zh: 與之相比，2004年3月11日發生在西班牙造成200人死亡的恐怖襲擊引發了嘗試透過與伊斯蘭建立理解和和解來消除極端主義思想的“反十字軍運動 ” 。

en: Co-sponsored by Spain and Turkey, the Alliance of Civilizations initiative is not devoid of political calculation.
zh: 由西班牙和土耳其共同發起的文明聯盟倡議並非完全沒有政治上的考慮。

en: To the Spaniards, it helps to justify their abrupt withdrawal from Iraq in 2004; for the Turks, it is yet another vehicle in their struggle, as the vital bridge between Islam and the West, for admission into the European Union.
zh: 對於西班牙人來說，它能夠幫助表明他們在2004年突然從伊拉克撤軍的合理性；而對土耳其人來說，這是他們作為伊斯蘭和西方之間的重要橋樑尋求加入歐盟的另一個手段。

en: A loose and somewhat confused project, the Alliance of Civilizations aims to heal the wounds of conflict between Islam and the West through education, viable integration policies, and a better-informed dialogue with the media.
zh: 作為一項鬆散並且有些模糊的計劃，文明聯盟旨在透過教育、可行的融合政策以及與媒體更好的對話來治癒伊斯蘭與西方之間的衝突所留下的創傷。

en: But it suffers from the major global players’ profound skepticism, with the US, Russia, and, for that matter, the EU shown no real enthusiasm for it.
zh: 但是它卻面臨著主要大國極大的懷疑態度，美國、俄羅斯以及在這方面歐盟都很不熱心。

en: However vague, the alliance of civilizations idea certainly cannot do more harm than war against Islamic extremism.
zh: 儘管很模糊，但是文明聯盟的想法絕對不可能比與伊斯蘭極端主義的戰爭造成更大的危害。

en: After all, none of the Muslim world’s problems and conflicts with the West are susceptible to a military solution.
zh: 不管怎樣，任何穆斯林社會的問題以及它與西方社會的衝突都還沒有大到需要用武力來解決的程度。

en: Moreover, the Alliance is not an entirely incoherent proposal if the objective is that the West disengage from the politics of hubris and establish a genuine sphere of cooperation with the Muslim world in economics, culture, and science.
zh: 此外，如果它的目標是讓西方擺脫政治上的傲慢並且與穆斯林社會建立在經濟、文化和科學上真正的合作，那麼這個聯盟就不能被說成完全是一個沒有內聚力的提議。

en: Of course, the idea is held back by the inner workings of both parts of the proposed alliance.
zh: 當然，這種思想受到了提議成立聯盟的雙方內部力量的阻礙。

en: Many in the West question whether Islam is compatible with human rights and Western concepts of liberty.
zh: 許多西方人質疑伊斯蘭是否能包容人權和西方的自由觀念。

en: Many Muslims who have been fighting for years for  their countries’ modernization have so far failed to find a lucid response to the progressive wave of radical Islam.
zh: 而許多為他們國家的現代化奮鬥了多年的穆斯林迄今並沒有能對極端伊斯蘭主義高漲的浪潮給出清晰的回答。

en: To claim that Islam is incompatible with human rights is to consider it a civilization too hidebound to change.
zh: 認為伊斯蘭無法包容人權等同於認為這是一種十分古板而不會作出改變的文明。

en: This is a historic fallacy.
zh: 這是一個歷史性的謬論。

en: Nor is the claim that Islam is intrinsically inimical to innovation viable, because Muslim civilization has contributed mightily to science and art throughout history.
zh: 而那種認為伊斯蘭在本質上反對可行的創新的看法同樣也是錯誤的，因為穆斯林文明在歷史上為科學和文化作出了巨大的貢獻。

en: Today, Western universities are replete with distinguished Arab scholars in almost every field – the result of a brain drain that itself reflects the Islamic world’s centuries of decline.
zh: 今天，在西方國家的大學裡隨處可見幾乎所有領域的傑出的阿拉伯學者，這種人才外流的結果本身反映了伊斯蘭社會數個世紀以來的衰微。

en: In 2005, the 17 countries of the Arab world together produced 13,444 scientific publications, fewer than the 15,455 achieved by Harvard University alone.
zh: 2005年，17個阿拉伯國家總共出版了13444部科學著作，比哈佛大學一家出版的15455部還少。

en: Enemies of reason, however, are also to be found in the West.
zh: 但是，理智的敵人同樣也存在於西方社會。

en: We live in an age in which many people are disillusioned with secular politics, and are turning to religion instead, not only throughout the Muslim world, but in the core of Western civilization, Christian Europe and Evangelist America.
zh: 我們生活在一個許多人對世俗政治不再抱幻想而轉向宗教的時代，這不僅存在於穆斯林社會，而是同樣存在於西方文明的中心，也就是信仰基督教的歐洲和信仰福音的美國。

en: Nor is the Jewish state of Israel, where Messianic fanatics and religious nationalists have embraced a political theology that questions the very legitimacy of the democratic institutions, immune from this phenomenon.
zh: 在信仰猶太教的以色列也並非與這種現象絕緣，在那裡信仰彌賽亞的狂熱分子和宗教民族主義者篤信一種質疑民主制度的合法性的政治神學。

en: The current crisis of Islam might not be congenital, but Islam’s predicament is acute.
zh: 伊斯蘭社會目前的危機也許並不是先天性的，但是伊斯蘭社會確實面臨著巨大的困境。

en: The question is this: are Muslims ready to accept that Khomeini’s dictum that “Islam is politics or it is nothing” is wrong, that Islam is a religion and not a form of government, and that, as in the Christian world, there is a sphere for Caesar and a sphere for God?
zh: 問題是：穆斯林準備好接受霍梅尼關於“伊斯蘭就是政治，非此莫屬”的格言是錯誤的，伊斯蘭是一種宗教而不是政府的形式，就像在基督教社會，凱撒和上帝能夠共存一樣。

en: Those in the Muslim world who want to embrace reform must be driven by the conviction that theocracy has never served as a vehicle for human progress.
zh: 那些在穆斯林社會想要進行變革的人必須認識到神權統治從來都不是人類前進的載體。

en: Of course, the Alliance of Civilizations should not attempt to bridge differences by defending moral relativism.
zh: 當然，文明聯盟不應該試圖透過為道德相對主義作辯護來消除觀念上的不同。

en: If it is driven by a Western guilt complex that assumes that the solution simply lies in greater empathy for the Muslim predicament, then the skeptics are bound to be vindicated.
zh: 如果它是受認為解決的辦法就在於對穆斯林社會所面臨的困境表現出更大的同情的那種西方負罪情結的驅動，那麼人們真的應該對此持懷疑態度。

en: For the Alliance of Civilizations to have any chance of success, the emphasis must be on reciprocity.
zh: 如果文明聯盟想要取得成功，它關注的焦點必須是互惠。

en: Tolerance and religious freedom must be mutual.
zh: 包容和宗教自由必須是相互的。

en: Islam’s part in the deal must include a guarantee of human rights and civil liberties, improvement in women’s status, and realistic policies to stem the Islamic world’s demographic explosion.
zh: 從伊斯蘭這一面來說它應該保證人權和���民自由、提高婦女地位以及採取現實的政策制止伊斯蘭社會的人口爆炸問題。

en: Some, as usual, will claim that the Arab-Israeli conflict lies at the root of the problems that exist between Islam and the West, and that resolving the Palestinians’ plight will contribute immensely to smoother relations.
zh: 有些人像往常一樣阿拉伯與以色列之間的衝突是伊斯蘭與西方社會之間矛盾的根源，而解決了巴勒斯坦的困難就能夠大大地促進雙方更加和睦的關係。

en: But Arabs and Muslims must stop deluding themselves that the Israel-Palestine dispute is what is holding them back.
zh: 但是阿拉伯人和穆斯林不能再自欺欺人地認為以色列與巴勒斯坦之間的衝突是阻礙他們前進的根本原因。

en: Ending the American occupation in Iraq and imposing an Arab-Israeli peace would help, but they are no panacea.
zh: 結束美國在伊拉克的佔領以及推動阿拉伯與以色列之間的和平會對此有所幫助，但是它們並不是靈丹妙藥。

en: The fight to eradicate misery, illiteracy, and corruption, and Islam’s embrace of science, do not depend on the results of the Middle East peace process.
zh: 消除貧困、文盲和腐敗現象的鬥爭以及伊斯蘭社會對科學的推崇並不依賴於中東和平程序的結果。

en: An Alliance of Equals
zh: 平等的聯盟

en: PARIS – During NATO’s recent 60th anniversary ceremony in Strasbourg, the Alliance welcomed two new members, Albania and Croatia, bringing its total membership to 28.
zh: 巴黎 — — 正值北約在斯特拉斯堡慶祝其成立60週年之際，又迎來了新的兩個成員國：阿爾巴尼亞和克羅埃西亞。

en: This expansion is a good thing, for history has tormented these two countries.
zh: 至此，北約的成員國增加到28個。 此次北約擴張是一件好的事情。

en: Being welcomed within the great international family of the West will reassure them, stabilize them, and contribute to their political, cultural, and economic development.
zh: 從歷史來看，這兩個國家飽受磨難。 加入西方大家庭的懷抱之後，對這兩個 國家的政治經濟和文化的穩定平和發展都有好處。

en: But the good news was limited, because NATO addressed only a routine agenda.
zh: 但現在看來好處也是有限的。 北約只是在走一個常規的流程。

en: No core problem was really tackled.
zh: 並沒有什麼實質性的改變。

en: The controversy that arose in France over the country’s return to NATO’s unified military command makes this abundantly clear.
zh: 隨著法國有爭議地重新回到北約的軍事體系之下，問題就顯得更為清楚。

en: Was France losing its autonomy, perhaps even its sovereignty?
zh: 法國是否失去了自治的權利？ 甚至說是喪失了主權？

en: Was it capitulating to American hegemony?
zh: 還是向是美國霸權繳械投降？

en: These are real questions, yet at the NATO summit people spoke of them more in terms of symbols than as realities.
zh: ，在此次的北約峰會上，這些真正的問題並沒有解決，大家的討論象徵的意義大於實際的解決。

en: But what is the reality here?
zh: 這麼說的現實究竟是什麼呢？

en: NATO is a military alliance composed of 28 countries.
zh: 北約是由28個國家組成的軍事聯盟。

en: One of them, the United States, has a military budget that is more than three times that of all the other members combined.
zh: 作為成員國之一的美國，它每年軍費預算比其他所有的成員國加起來三倍還多。

en: Hence, the US runs most NATO civilian and military commands with the consent of the others.
zh: 所以說，美國實際上執行了北約大部分軍事和民用的命令。

en: Of course, there is a collective consultation and deliberative process that enables any member to be heard.
zh: 當然，從程式上來說，北約的決議都是經過成員國知曉並討論後作出的。

en: But in reality a member’s actual power is what affects common decisions.
zh: 但實際上美國是對所有的決定有著特殊的影響力。

en: This structure harks back to the conditions of NATO’s birth, when it was forged to thwart the Soviet threat to Western civilization.
zh: 這樣的組成結構當然有其歷史的背景，北約是作為抵抗前蘇聯對西方文明的入侵而建立的。

en: At the time, no one ever doubted that American power – already endowed with nuclear weapons – was the only counterpart.
zh: 當時，沒有人質疑作為西方核大國的美國應該是蘇聯的唯一對手。

en: For this reason, the US came to preside over the alliance.
zh: 也正因為此，美國掌控著整個聯盟。

en: During the 41 years of the Cold War, 14 of NATO’s 16 members strictly obeyed and complied with American decisions and policies.
zh: 在成立之後41年的冷戰時期，當時16個成員國中的14個都嚴格執行著美國的政策和命令。

en: French President Charles de Gaulle was the only one to question whether an American president would actually ever be ready to launch a nuclear attack on the USSR in order to protect one or several Alliance members if vital US interests were not directly at stake.
zh: 唯一例外的是法國總統戴高樂，他質詢如果沒有涉及到美國本國的利益情況下，其他成員國受到蘇聯的攻擊，美國是否會對蘇聯進行核打擊。

en: Based on that doubt, France – a nuclear power since 1960 – withdrew in 1966 from the Alliance’s permanent centralized military command in order to assert its own deterrent capability.
zh: 正基於此疑問，為了維護自身的主權安全，法國在1966年退出了北約的軍事體系（法國1960年成為有核國家 ） 。

en: This decision was mainly grounded on the American doctrine, adopted in 1962, of “flexible response,” which said to the Soviets: “As long as you do not use nuclear weapons, we will not use them, either.”
zh: 此項決定是在美國1962推出所謂“靈活應對”的法令後而做出的。 靈活應對的含義是“只要蘇聯不對美國實施核打擊，美國也不會使用核武器。

en: This very doctrine left Europe exposed.
zh: ”這樣來看的話，歐洲的安全利益就被出賣了。

en: Indeed, while it is a much disputed question, de Gaulle was probably right about America’s lack of commitment to the nuclear defense of Europe.
zh: 雖然戴高樂此項的決定值得推敲，但在美國並沒有對歐洲進行核保護的大背景下，這個決定也許是正確的。

en: Both Henry Kissinger and Robert McNamara left office admitting that de Gaulle had been correct.
zh: 亨利·基辛格和羅伯特·麥克納馬拉在卸任後都坦承說戴高樂是對的。

en: Nevertheless, de Gaulle’s insights left a legacy that still causes some mistrust and dissent within NATO.
zh: 不過怎麼說，法國的退出導致了北約內部的一些不信任感。

en: France was right on this key strategic point, but it was never able to explain its position to its allies.
zh: 法國在戰略上是對的，但對北約來說並不是一件好的事情

en: This inability to discuss, clearly and forthrightly, this strategic doctrine continues to hamper the Alliance.
zh: 有關法國退出北約而產生的不穩定問題，已經有過廣泛而深入的討論。

en: At the Strasbourg summit, confidence in the future could have been strengthened if a couple of troubling issues had been discussed.
zh: 戰略上的條例仍然阻礙著北約的發展。 在此次斯特拉斯堡會議上，如果討論有關北約未來的一些問題，北約的前途才有希望。

en: Instead, once again, there was an extended focus on the past.
zh: 但事實卻是，會議上更多的是對過去問題的糾纏。

en: The key questions are whether NATO’s doctrine of common defense is currently directed at one country in particular, and whether nuclear force remains the Alliance’s major defensive tool.
zh: 問題的核心是北約的共同防禦的法令是否還應該由一個國家說了算，核武器是否還是北約重要的防範手段。

en: In the current global situation, no predictable conflict will require the use of a nuclear weapon.
zh: 從目前的現實來看，核武器在未來的衝突中不可能使用。

en: At the moment, there is no global threat and the Alliance only intervenes in regional conflicts, so why not have NATO admit this?
zh: 目前世界性的威脅不復存在，地區的衝突才是問題的核心，北約為什麼不能正視這個現實呢？

en: But the most important matter that went unmentioned in Strasbourg is the relationship with Russia.
zh: 在此次會議上，最重要的問題並沒有被討論，那就是北約和俄羅斯的關係問題。

en: NATO was founded to confront the threat that the USSR represented 60 years ago.
zh: 北約是60年前為了抵抗蘇聯而成立的。

en: But the Warsaw Pact, the Soviet Union’s “anti-NATO” alliance of socialist countries, was dissolved in 1991; communism imploded the same year, with Russia caught ever since in a struggle to build a market economy and define a new global position for itself.
zh: 作為蘇聯對抗北約的社會主義軍事聯盟“華沙條約組織”早在1991年就已經解散。 以此同時，共產政權也土崩瓦解，俄羅斯開始擁抱市場經濟，並開始重新尋找自己的定位。

en: At a time when Russia was taking a more pacific course, NATO – unlike the Warsaw Pact – was not dismantled.
zh: 隨著俄羅斯和平的對外戰略，北約並沒有象華約那樣解散。

en: On the contrary, the Allies chose to maintain the pact and to extend it to numerous Russian neighbors.
zh: 相反的，北約反而向俄羅斯的鄰國進行擴張。

en: NATO’s members essentially said: “We Western nations do not trust you. Even if you become a democracy, we will always be suspicious.”
zh: 北約成員國的基本理念是 ： “ 我們西方社會並不信任你，即使你成為一個民主國家，我們還是保持一貫的懷疑。

en: George Kennan, one of the greatest American diplomats of the post-war years, once wrote that the Western world was committing its biggest mistake in 50 years time by expanding NATO after Soviet communism collapsed.
zh: 作為二戰後最偉大的美國外交官之一的喬治·凱南曾經寫道,西方社會在50年來犯得最大的一個錯誤就是，在前蘇聯共產政權倒臺之後，北約還繼續東擴。

en: The resulting humiliation and blatant mistrust that Russia’s elite has felt ever since has led them to their current policy of rearmament.
zh: 結果就是俄羅斯精英階層深受打擊和感到羞辱，從而走向目前繼續擴充軍備的政策。

en: The only way to resolve this problem is for NATO to assert its pacific intentions before the world.
zh: 如果要想解決這個問題，北約應該在全世介面前作出和平的姿態。

en: The most convincing way to do that is to moderate America’s excessive taste for power, which it demonstrated in Iraq.
zh: 如果要有所表示的話，美國應該抑制自己過分的權力，美國在伊拉克問題上的處理就是過分的表現例子。

en: NATO needs to shift its focus from organizing and administering a unified military command to building real confidence that every member’s voice will be heard.
zh: 美國應該拋棄過去那種軍事上的獨裁，轉向應對各個成員國的表示個體的尊重。

en: To that end, all members must stand on an equal footing.
zh: 最終來說，所有的成員國都應該平等地被對待。

en: France’s decision to return to full and equal Alliance membership was a good one, and France must now work from within to advance the principles in which it believes.
zh: 法國重新返回北約就是一個好的訊號，法國還應該一直為自己一貫堅守的原則而努力。

en: Avoiding a New American Recession
zh: 避免美國新衰退

en: CAMBRIDGE – The United States may be headed for a recession in 2013.
zh: 美國劍橋—美國可能在2013年步入衰退。

en: Even if the country avoids going over the “fiscal cliff,” a poorly designed political compromise that cuts the deficit too quickly could push an already weak economy into recession.
zh: 即使可以避免墜下“財政懸崖 ” ， 過快削減赤字的拙劣政治妥協也可能將已然相當疲軟的經濟拖入衰退。

en: But a gradual phase-in of an overall cap on tax deductions and exclusions (so-called tax expenditures), combined with reform of entitlement spending, could achieve the long-run fiscal consolidation that America needs without risking a new recession.
zh: 但逐漸實施的稅收減免總額上限（所謂的稅收支出）可以和福利支出改革一起構成美國所需要的能夠避免再次衰退的財政整合方案。

en: The US economy has been limping along with a growth rate of less than 2% during the past year, with similarly dim prospects in 2013, even without the shock of the fiscal cliff.  That is much too weak a pace of expansion to tolerate the fiscal cliff’s increase in tax rates and spending cuts, which would reduce demand by a total of $600 billion – about 4% of GDP – next year, and by larger sums in subsequent years.
zh: 去年，美國經濟以低於2%的增速蹣跚前行，2013年的前景也一樣暗淡，即便沒有財政懸崖衝擊也是如此。 這樣的擴張速度太慢，不能抵消財政懸崖所帶來的稅率提高和支出削減，後兩者將讓明年總需求下降6 000億美元（約為GDP的4 % ） ，後年更甚。

en: President Barack Obama’s proposed alternative to the fiscal cliff would substantially increase tax rates and limit tax deductions for the top 2% of earners, who now pay more than 45% of total federal personal-income taxes.
zh: 奧巴馬總統的財政懸崖替代方案將大幅提高薪酬最高的2%人群的稅率，限制他們的稅收減免優惠，如今，該群體貢獻了聯邦個人所得稅總量的45%以上。

en: His budget would also increase taxes on corporations, and would end the current payroll-tax “holiday,” imposing an additional 2% tax on all wage earners.
zh: 他的預算還將增加公司稅，結束當前的工資稅“豁免期 ” ， 這意味著對所有工薪族增加2%的稅收。
